صحيفة "عكاظ"، كواحدة من أهم المؤسسات الصحفية في السعودية، حظيت باهتمام عدد من ملوك السعودية ورؤساء الدول الأخرى. فقد ظهروا على صفحات "عكاظ" عبر حوارات مطولة أو من خلال زيارات لمقر الصحيفة أو أجنحتها في مناسبات مختلفة، ومن بين هؤلاء الملوك: فيصل، خالد، فهد، عبدالله، وسلمان.

في أكتوبر عام 1996، تشرفت المؤسسة بتدشين "الطباعة المتزامنة" للصحيفة من قِبل خادم الحرمين الشريفين الملك سلمان بن عبدالعزيز، عندما كان أميرًا لمنطقة الرياض. وأكد -حفظه الله- في كلمته أن "عكاظ" تعتبر من المؤسسات الناجحة بشهادة الجميع، مشددًا على أهمية الإعلام المقروء وتأثيره القوي، وداعيًا لاستقطاب أصحاب الفكر النير للمساهمة في العمل الصحفي. كما أوضح أن الدولة لا تضع رقابة على الصحف، مما يتطلب طرح الآراء المتبادلة بمسؤولية، وطالب الجميع بالصدق مع النفس وافتراض حسن النية في العاملين بالإعلام.

في مارس 2003، التقى الأمير نايف بن عبدالعزيز وزير الداخلية -يرحمه الله- بأسرة "عكاظ" وكتابها والمفكرين في الملتقى السنوي الأول بمقر الصحيفة في جدة. ودعا المسؤولين إلى التفاعل مع ما يكتب في الصحافة، وحث الكتّاب والصحفيين على استشعار مسؤولية الكلمة ومخاطبة الناس بما ينفعهم، وأكد على ضرورة أن يكون الكاتب عونًا للحق ومصوبًا لمن أخطأ، معبّرًا عن سعادته بوجوده في مقر الصحيفة ومؤكدًا على مسؤوليتها في مخاطبة الرأي العام.

La vacuna Soberana 02, una de las que desarrolla Cuba, culminó este miércoles los ensayos de fase 3. Completó el esquema de inoculación en 44.010 voluntarios de 18 a 80 años que participaron en la prueba. Su fórmula combina el antígeno del virus y el toxoide tetánico, y emplea también hidróxido de aluminio para estimular la respuesta del sistema inmune. Si estos estudios demuestran su efectividad, se convertiría en la primera vacuna desarrollada en Latinoamérica. La confirmación de eficacia permitiría a las autoridades sanitarias cubanas obtener autorización para uso de emergencia o registro farmacológico, algo que esperan lograr en junio.

Por otro lado, el Instituto Gamaleya reveló que las personas que recibieron ambas dosis de la vacuna Sputnik no propagan el Covid-19 en caso de contagiarse. Rusia anunció este jueves que firmó un acuerdo con UNICEF, el Fondo de Naciones Unidas para la Infancia, para suministrarle 220 millones de dosis.

John liked the moon, cracked as it now was. Rose loved running. Eve would always be so caring. These were the small pleasures and comforts that once defined our lives.

We couldn't keep on living in this world. Surviving was too hard. Living was too hard. We just got tired. I keep asking myself what the point of living is if you just barely manage to. We thought there'd be other people, but we've traveled for years and found no one. No animals either. Just the trees. And their fruits.

Rose and Eve were barren. It was obvious. After years of hoping that children could motivate us to live, we accepted that fact. It was probably the fruit that did it. And the constant dreams. It was like the world didn't want us here. Turns out our survival instinct can only keep going for so long. 

John was the first to suggest the unthinkable. He said that there was nothing left for us. Living was such a struggle. For what? Just to struggle again the next day. His words didn't convince me. But what he said next did. 

What if there was something after death? What if that is why life is such a struggle. What if we are being urged toward death by everything around us. What if, after death, we become who we were always meant to be. It made sense. 

Here I am. Alone. I couldn't. Rose. Eve. Unrecognizable........................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................

空军2架F-5E战斗机22日发生擦撞坠海意外，导致26岁中尉飞官罗尚桦不幸殉职，另名飞官上尉潘颖谆则下落不明、生死未卜。对此，国防部长邱国正25日表示，国军的搜救没有停、也不会停，不过在有些装备、座椅发现后，「到目前没有大的进展」。

立法院外交及国防委员会25日邀请邱国正报告「四年期国防总检讨」，并备质询。邱国正会前受访时表示，国军的搜救没有停、也不会停，不过在有些装备、座椅发现后，「到目前没有大的进展」。

邱国正说，不管地面部队、空中的、海上的都持续在做，「我来之前他们还跟我回报」，目前动员的兵力不少，绝对不是做个样子，国防部很诚恳地跟家属报告，搜救不会停止。

有关弹射椅的汰换期程，邱国正强调，「人命关天、生命无价，没有什么浪费的」，弹射椅不是因为案子才起案，是从去年不幸殉职的飞官朱冠甍事件后，空军就在做准备，而且有筹措经费要换掉座椅，期程都按照规划进行。

邱国正说明，空军已经有跟厂商协调，按照本来的期程，可能要到2022年才可以陆续获得，经过协调以后进度会加快，不过还是要注意到安全的问题。

邱国正也说，目前的状况大家很清楚，的确是两架战机有碰撞，但细部问题也是国军要追的，「不能讲说平白无故研判，各种可能我们都会纳入，一个一个验证」，后续程序会按照飞安委员会的步骤调查。

邱国正强调，厘清真相不光是大家的期望，也是军方绝对要知道的真相，如此才可以著手强化问题的解决。

Les enseignants du lycée Loubet à Valence se mobilisent en chanson contre la nouvelle formule du bac. Ils ont créé une reprise de la chanson "Balance ton quoi" d'Angèle, le texte est directement adressé à Jean-Michel Blanquer, le ministre de l'Éducation. Lors de leur mobilisation, les enseignants ont dénoncé les E3C, ces nouvelles épreuves de contrôle continu destinées aux élèves de première. "Les élèves étaient contre l'idée d'un blocage du lycée", explique un enseignant. Par conséquent, ils ont cherché une manière alternative et ludique de protester.

Depuis leur introduction le 20 janvier, ces épreuves de contrôle continu ont suscité la colère des syndicats, des professeurs et des lycéens qui veulent s'opposer à cette réforme du bac voulue par Jean-Michel Blanquer. L'hostilité envers cette réforme, crainte par ses détracteurs d'accentuer les inégalités, s'est manifestée par le blocage de plusieurs dizaines d'établissements en France métropolitaine et en outre-mer.

Twitch, la plataforma de streaming favorita de los amantes de los videojuegos, realizó una épica broma a sus miles de seguidores en todo el mundo, quienes fueron engañados al creer que verían una PS5 en vivo.

Todo comenzó el pasado 3 de septiembre, cuando Twitch utilizó su cuenta de Twitter para anunciar que harían una transmisión en vivo donde se haría una gran 'revelación' sobre la próxima consola de Sony.

PUEDES VER: La PlayStation 5 llegará con un puerto de audio menos respecto a la PS4

El streaming duró dos horas y alcanzó los 30.000 espectadores. Durante ese periodo, los gamers esperaban que la conductora Mari Takahashi proporcionara más detalles sobre la PS5 que tenía a su izquierda.

Al final de la transmisión, la presentadora finalmente decidió interactuar con la videoconsola, pero en vez de tratarla con cuidado, sacó una katana y la partió en dos, revelando que se trataba de un pastel.

Según detalla Hobby Consolas, un portal especializado en videojuegos, a la mayoría de los gamers no les resultó graciosa la broma de Twitch, lo cual se reflejó en la pérdida de más de 10.000 espectadores durante ese momento.

Una vez que terminó el evento online, la plataforma, que es propiedad de Amazon, compartió un video del momento exacto de la broma que dividió a los usuarios. A algunos les pareció graciosa, pero a otros no.

Cabe recordar que la PS5 llegará al mercado a finales de 2020 y tendrá dos versiones: una con lector de discos y otra llamada 'Digital Edition' que, como su nombre indica, solo permitirá juegos digitales.

In the article "Driverless Cars Are Coming," the author discusses both the positive and negative aspects of driverless cars. Although the arguments supporting the benefits of driverless cars are well-reasoned and valid, I still believe that driverless cars are not a good idea. My concern stems from the fact that anything can happen when a vehicle is entirely controlled by technology. Regardless of assurances, any system can experience malfunctions. 

For example, the seventh paragraph of the article states, "None of the cars developed so far are completely driverless," meaning that a human still needs to take precautions at all times. Another issue I have is the way these cars alert the driver in the event of traffic complications.

Commercial and civil unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) applications are expected to experience significant growth in the global market. According to SESAR, the European drone market is projected to surpass C10 billion annually by 2035 and exceed C15 billion annually by 2050 [SESAR JU, 2016]. It is anticipated that the most market value will come from operations of small UAS (sUAS) and within the very-low-level airspace (VLL), based on the characteristics of the missions and application fields. This growth trend will bring about increased traffic density and new challenges related to safety, reliability, and efficiency. Therefore, the development and implementation of conflict management systems are seen as crucial for the integration of UAS into civil airspace.

A notable effort in this regard is the initiative by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) in the USA to establish a UAS Traffic Management (UTM) system. This system aims to enable numerous UAS to operate at low altitudes alongside other airspace users [Barrado et al., 2020]. In Europe, similar progress is being made with the development of a UTM concept known as U-space, which is designed to provide a range of services to accommodate current and future traffic in the VLL airspace [Prevot et al., 2016]. China and Japan are also adopting similar approaches [Zhang, 2018].

Under the UTM services, UAS must possess the ability to avoid both static conflicts like buildings, terrain, and no-fly zones, and dynamic conflicts such as encounters with manned or unmanned aircraft. A pairwise conflict is defined as a breach of the en-route separation minima between two UAVs [ica]. To ensure conflict-free operations, UTM offers Conflict Detection and Resolution services, which consist of three safety layers based on the time-horizon (look-ahead time): Strategic and Tactical Conflict Mitigation and Collision Avoidance (CA) [ica][nas].

This study focuses on the tactical Conflict Resolution (CR) applicable for small UAS missions. This function is typically addressed in two ways: Self-separation and Collision Avoidance [nas] [Radanovic et al., 2019]. Self-separation involves a maneuver executed seconds before a potential breach of separation minima, aiming to prevent the need for Collision Avoidance activation. Collision Avoidance serves as a last-resort safety measure characterized by immediate and evasive maneuvers. Both functions fall under the umbrella term of Detect and Avoid capability [Consiglio et al., 2016, Johnson et al., 2017a].

In line with current advancements, a loss of separation minima is referred to as a loss of Well Clear (LoWC). While there is no standard definition of well clear (WC), two associated functions are Remain Well Clear (RWC) and Collision Avoidance (CA) [Manfredi et al., 2017]. RWC in terms of tactical CD&R is comparable to the self-separation function. The definition and computation of RWC thresholds remain areas of ongoing research, primarily conceptualized as a protection volume around UAS [Cook et al., 2017, Consiglio et al., 2019, Muñoz et al., 2016], typically defined by distance-based thresholds.

Moreover, the concept of a near-mid-air-collision (NMAC) represents the final safety volume. A distance smaller than NMAC signifies a severe loss of well clear that could potentially lead to a collision. This distance is typically determined based on the dimensions of the UAS and its navigation performance [Modi et al., 2016].

While numerous existing works propose conflict resolution algorithms (see Section II for a detailed overview), many primarily focus on pairwise conflicts.

**Introduction to Concept-Based Learning (CBL)**

Concept-based learning (CBL) is a well-established approach in machine learning that expresses model predictions in terms of high-level concepts derived from raw features, rather than using the raw features directly. This method provides a higher-level connection between the image and the decision using concepts, unlike the traditional pixel-based approach. Once each concept's interpretation is determined, understanding the decision becomes straightforward. In essence, high-level concepts are additional layers of expert knowledge, integrating human-like reasoning into machine learning models to enhance their efficiency, accuracy, and explainability. Concepts can be high-level features, like the color of a bird in an image, or complex classification labels. Training such models requires concept annotations, often in binary form, indicating whether a concept is "present" or "not present" in each image.

**Current Approaches in CBL**

Many recent CBL approaches utilize human-specified concepts as an intermediate step for deriving final predictions. Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) and Concept Embedding Models (CEMs) are examples of this implementation. In CBMs, concept predictions occur in the middle of the decision-making process, where the model first predicts concept labels from images and then uses these to predict the final label. This approach ensures the final decision is strongly tied to the concepts, with training possible independently or in an end-to-end manner.

**Proposed Models: Bridging CBL with Expert Rules**

In contrast to traditional CBL models, we propose models that not only use concepts for training but also combine them with knowledge-based expert rules. These models incorporate inductive learning tools (neural networks) alongside expert rules, such as "IF ..., THEN ..." statements, to enhance model predictions and their interpretation. For example, in lung cancer diagnostics, a rule might be "IF Finding is the mass, Contour is spicules, Inclusion is the air cavity, THEN Diagnosis is squamous cells carcinoma." Concepts and values in these rules help in shaping the decision-making process. This methodology finds relevance in various fields, beyond just medicine, emphasizing the importance of integrating expert knowledge into machine learning.

**Challenges and Solutions in Model Construction**

The challenge lies in constructing and training a neural network that deals simultaneously with concept-based datasets and knowledge-based rules to provide accurate, explainable predictions. We propose two approaches to incorporate expert rules into models. First, expert rules are represented as logical functions using disjunction and conjunction operations over concept values. Target values are also treated as concepts. This representation enables the writing of constraints for a joint probability distribution that satisfies expert rules, creating a neural network output that adheres to these rules. We define a feasible set of probability distributions as a convex polytope and identify its vertices. By using these vertices, a point inside the polytope is constructed, determining marginal probability distributions of concepts. Alternatively, the polytope can be defined in H-representation, simplifying the construction process.

**Benefits and Implications of the Proposed Models**

A significant advantage of the proposed models is their ability to compensate for incomplete concept labeling in datasets. While existing concept-based models may overfit with incomplete data, expert rules in our models mitigate this risk. Moreover, they address the partial availability of targets in the training set. The proposed models represent a synthesis of inductive and deductive learning, reshaping the probabilities of concepts and predictions for new instances.

**Conclusion**

In summary, incorporating knowledge-based expert rules into neural networks enhances predictions and their interpretability. Expert rules not only change concept probabilities but also predictions for new instances. The models extend beyond standard "IF ..., THEN ..." rules, encompassing any logical functions that connect concepts and class labels. This broadens the applicability of our approach, providing a robust framework for future research and application.

The code for the proposed algorithms is available at [https://github.com/andruekonst/ecbl](https://github.com/andruekonst/ecbl).

Los rayos por las tormentas de las últimas horas causan al menos diez incendios en seis provincias de CyL

VALLADOLID, 23 Jul. (EUROPA PRESS) -

Los rayos caídos como consecuencia de las tormentas que se han registrado en las últimas horas han provocado al menos diez incendios en seis provincias de Castilla y León, según se refleja en el último parte de incendios de la Consejería de Medio Ambiente.

La provincia de Zamora fue la más afectada, con cinco incendios provocados por la caída de rayos. De estos, todos han sido extinguidos salvo uno en Ferreras de Abajo, que se inició a las 20.35 horas del lunes y en el que trabajan dos agentes medioambientales, un helicóptero, dos aviones de carga en tierra, una brigada helitransportada, un bulldozer, tres autobombas y varias cuadrillas de tierra. Los otros incendios en Zamora se registraron en Bermillo de Alba, Peleagonzalo, Cerecinos del Carrizal y Moreruela de los Infanzones, todos entre las 18.30 y las 20.35 horas. Además, medios de la Junta intervinieron en otro incendio en la zona limítrofe con Portugal, también causado por rayos.

El incendio más importante es el que permanece activo en Poyales del Hoyo (Ávila), que está en nivel 1 del Plan de Protección Civil ante Emergencias por incendios forestales (Infocal) y en el que trabajan numerosos efectivos. Este fuego se inició a las 22.45 horas del lunes.

En la provincia de Burgos, los rayos causaron un incendio en Regumiel de la Sierra a las 14.30 horas del lunes. En León, otro incendio se registró en Santovenia del Monte a las 21.46 horas, mientras que en Palencia se produjo en Astudillo a las 20.50 horas. Por último, en Salamanca, un rayo provocó un incendio en Sancti-Spíritus en la madrugada de este martes, a las 3.51 horas.

A military air tanker crash in South Dakota in July, which resulted in the deaths of four airmen, was caused by a combination of human error and a severe "microburst" during a thunderstorm, as revealed by an accident report released on Wednesday. The U.S. Air Force C-130 Hercules crashed on July 1 while battling a wildfire near Edgemont, South Dakota. The crash claimed the lives of four North Carolina Air National Guard airmen and seriously injured two others.

The Air Force Air Mobility Command accident investigation report highlighted that an "inadequate assessment" by the cockpit crew of "operational conditions" led to the aircraft flying into a microburst, resulting in the crash. A microburst is described in the report as a severe, localized wind gust, blasting down from a thunderstorm, typically covering an area less than 2.5 miles in diameter and lasting less than 5 minutes.

The investigation also identified additional factors that contributed significantly to the mishap. These included the "failure of the Lead Plane and Air Attack aircrews to communicate critical operational information," as well as "conflicting operational guidance concerning thunderstorm avoidance."

The plane was part of a program involving eight U.S. Air Force aircraft that can be swiftly converted into firefighting tankers for use by a Defense Department-U.S. Forest Service collaboration when private and commercial fleets are insufficient to meet demands.

The individuals who lost their lives in the crash were identified as Lieutenant Colonel Paul Mikeal and Major Joseph McCormick, both pilots; Major Ryan David, a navigator; and Senior Master Sergeant Robert Cannon, a flight engineer.

The wildfire, which had consumed a few thousand acres at the time of the crash, was one of many raging across the United States during one of the most devastating fire seasons on record.

A recent study conducted at UCLA reveals that 27 percent of California youths, aged 12 to 17, self-report being perceived as gender "nonconforming" at school. This study, which has a margin of error of approximately six percent, was based on responses to two questions included in the California Health Interview Survey. The survey sampled 1,594 young people in the specified age range.

Initially, participants were asked, "Are you male or female?" Following this, they were presented with the question:

"A person’s appearance, style, dress, or the way they walk or talk may affect how people describe them. How do you think other people at school would describe you?"

The response options were:

- Very feminine
- Mostly feminine
- Equally feminine and masculine
- Mostly masculine

Avery's voice was hoarse and heavy as he spoke. "She used to be my best friend."

The silence in the room was punctuated only by the ticking clock behind him, the sound growing louder as the quiet stretched on. The man seated across from Avery touched a chewed pencil to his lips.

"And what is she now?" he asked softly.

"The same thing she is to you, I imagine."

"Well, I don't think that's true. She was your best friend, not mine."

Avery looked away. "Not anymore."

"Would you prefer to talk about something else for a while?"

*Tick. Tick. Tick.*

"No."

"Why do you think she's no longer your best friend?"

Avery shifted in his chair. The leather was warm and sticky against his arms, and his legs were beginning to go numb.

"Isn't it obvious?" he replied.

"Not necessarily."

*Tick. Tick. Tick.*

The man placed the pencil on the table and leaned back in his chair, crossing his fingers over his stomach.

"I can't help if you won't talk to me."

"What is there to talk about?" Avery said, his irritation rising.

"You know what. Her."

"I told you, she's gone. There's no point in arguing about it."

"Where did she go?"

"I don't know. She's just gone." Avery shifted in his chair again, his sweat sticking to the armrests.

*Tick. Tick. Tick.*

The man reached out to the small speaker box on the desk. "We're done for today, Jill."

Two men in white entered the room, standing behind Avery. The doctor gestured, and the men took Avery by the arms, leading him out.

The speaker buzzed. "Doctor, they've brought Mr. Baker up."

The doctor turned off the recorder, flipping open another file. "Send him in, thanks."

Traditional image segmentation typically requires explicit target objects or predefined categories for pixel-level classification. However, a wide range of open-world applications, such as home robotics [18], self-driving vehicles [8], and augmented reality [15], demand that segmentation systems comprehend and interact with more complex human instructions.

Recently, the advent of vision-language pretrained models, like CLIP [28], has transformed image segmentation from a closed-set approach—where targets must belong to predefined categories—to open-vocabulary segmentation, which allows adaptation to unseen categories. By unifying text and image into the same feature spaces, these models significantly reduce the cost of training on new datasets, thereby expanding the applicability of image segmentation tasks. However, the scope of open-vocabulary segmentation remains limited to the vocabulary or phrase level, lacking the capability to understand lengthy and complex text prompts.

The recent success of Large Language Models (LLMs) [2-4, 6, 30], such as ChatGPT and LLama [30], has introduced new possibilities for defining segmentation targets. These state-of-the-art models demonstrate remarkable reasoning abilities, enabling them to answer complex questions. To leverage the reasoning capability of LLMs in image segmentation, [16] introduces the concept of Reasoning Segmentation. This task requires the model to segment the target based on a question posed by a human, making it a more challenging endeavor due to the need for strong reasoning to identify the segmentation target, as well as the target's unclear granularity. Nevertheless, the application of Reasoning Segmentation is more expansive and dynamic.

In this work, we propose LLM-Seg, a two-stage method that combines vision-language models (VLMs) with vision foundation models. Our method, defined as two-stage, separates the processes of prompt understanding and image segmentation.

### 成功大学未来馆开幕

11月14日，成功大学旧图书馆（K馆）翻新为「成功大学未来馆」，并举行了隆重的开幕典礼。典礼由校长苏慧贞、永丰金控总经理朱士廷等人共同主持。新馆旨在应对并解决未来问题，设有第10学院－College X、未来智慧工场，同时提供智慧金融与先进数位技术体验。这一新基地顺应21世纪知识快速汇流与科技创新的趋势，实现了师生跨域新创与知识产出，成为学生团队创新、创业的加速器。

### 历史背景与建筑风格

位于胜利校区的旧图书馆K馆于1959年落成，曾是成大最大、最先进的图书馆，长期以来是师生求知与阅读的重要场所。K馆的现代主义建筑风格以钢筋混凝土和玻璃为主要建材，简洁细致且具有鲜明的工业感。成大建筑系兼任教授孙全文指出，K馆是成大最具代表性的建筑之一，由普渡大学担任顾问并与建筑系师生共同设计，是台湾少数类似建筑的遗存。1950年代的美援对台湾现代化影响深远，普渡大学的协助使成大迈向综合型一流大学，K馆也因此成为历史见证。

### 未来馆的新使命

随着时代进入21世纪的数字时代，旧建筑承载了新的任务，转型为培养创新科技人才的全新场域。苏慧贞校长在开幕致词中表示，K馆承载着成大人的共同记忆和学习经历。在面对未来的新创时代，成大未来馆象征着传承与创新，为全新的学习方向提供了空间。

I was stunned. The apparition's proposal seemed simply too good to be true. “You mean to tell me, you will grant me one – just one wish … anything I want?” Doubt, or maybe it was skepticism, crept into my mind, churning away at the potential and the risk.

The apparition nodded, thin lips curling into a charming wry grin – too charming. “That's about the size of it, mortal,” he answered. His words echoed through my consciousness – a gravelly, singsong tenor – as if every syllable hinted of Damocles.

“But at what cost?” I asked, turning my attention to the brass vessel from whence he came, taking refuge from his countenance in the filigree etched into its contours. In those etchings, I found some odd sense of peace. When I returned my attention to the apparition, he merely shrugged. “None that I could hold over you, mortal. Once the wish is made, I'll hold no power over you. From there, what you make of your wish is up to you.”

“Right … I'd like a do-over, then. I want to go back and change my greatest mistake.” The apparition sighed, eyes rolling as he ran his fingers through his hair. “Are you sure, mortal? Is that all you want? No riches? No power?”

I shook my head.

“Knowledge?”

“Not even women?”

“Men?”

“Neither,” I answered. “I just want to go back and correct my biggest mistake.”

Again the apparition sighed, shoulders slumped in resignation. “Very well, mortal … your wish is granted.” In an instant, my world was consumed by light.

Something about this seemed all too familiar. “Déjà vu,” I muttered, thrusting my hands in my pockets as I looked away.

“What was that?” the apparition demanded.

“This all just feels familiar. Déjà vu all over again.” At that, he just laughed.

“What? What's so funny?”

“You begin to see, mor— “

“ALBERT! My name is Albert, not ‘mortal.’” The apparition clutched his belly in uproarious laughter, speaking through gasps and snorting chortles as he attempted to collect himself. “I know – you've told me! – HA! More than once!”

“Look, I don't see what's so funny about all this. I know I told you. Just now!”

“Ha! More than that, mor— “

“ALBERT!”

“Fine, fine, Professor. We've been at this game long enough.”

This game? Something about those words felt … wrong. Feeling faint, I found myself slumping weakly into my chair. Dizzy, heedless of the clutter, I lay my head on the desk.

“Oh poor, dear Albert,” the apparition began. “It must seem like nothing makes sense anymore. We've been at this game for so long now.”

“It's hardly been ten minutes,” I muttered.

“Ten minutes upon tens of minutes, upon tens of minutes and more.”

“What are you going on about?” He snorted in amusement, clacking his teeth several times.

In the worst attack on Canadian Muslims since a 2017 shooting at a mosque in Quebec City, police say evidence shows a driver intentionally ran into Salman and Madiha Afzal, their 15-year-old daughter Yumna and nine-year-old son Fayez, and a 74-year-old grandmother whose name was not made public. Fayez was the only survivor of the attack and was recovering from his injuries in a hospital Tuesday morning. London police said the attack on the family as they were waiting to cross a street was “a planned, premeditated act, motivated by hate.” “We believe the victims were targeted because of their Islamic faith,” detective superintendent Paul Waught told reporters.

The murder of the Afzal family comes amid reports that hate crimes against Muslims are on the rise in Canada. In 2019, 181 crimes motivated by anti-Muslim hate were reported to Canadian police, according to Statistics Canada—up from 166 the previous year. The National Council of Canadian Muslims said the murders should be treated as a “terrorist attack on Canadian soil.” “We call on the government to prosecute the attacker to the fullest extent of the law, including considering terrorist charges,” CEO Mustafa Farooq, said Monday.

Matched with expressions of grief and anguish, progressives in both Canada and the U.S. are calling on the broader public to stand against Islamophobia after the murder of four members of a Muslim family in London, Ontario on Sunday. Prime Minister Justin Trudeau said Tuesday he planned to travel to London to attend an evening vigil. “To the Muslim community in London and to Muslims across the country, know that we stand with you. Islamophobia has no place in any of our communities. This hate is insidious and despicable—and it must stop,” said Trudeau. Jagmeet Singh, leader of the New Democratic Party (NDP), called on Canadians to “stand with our Muslim family, friends, and neighbors against such vile hate.”

A 20-year-old suspect was arrested in a mall parking lot after the attack and was charged with four counts of first-degree murder and one count of attempted murder. The suspect was wearing a body armor vest, according to Al Jazeera. The attack drew international condemnation, including from U.S. lawmakers like Rep. Ilhan Omar (D-Minn.). Prime Minister Imran Khan of Pakistan, from which the Afzal family emigrated 14 years ago, also expressed grief and outrage.

Others expressed similar sadness and horror over the tragedy, with calls for unity and justice in the face of rising Islamophobia. The incident has sparked a global conversation about the need to combat hate and bigotry in all its forms.

Hello,

I will never forget you or what you've done. You took my trust and shattered it into a million pieces, like a hammer striking glass. I thought we were friends, but friends don't act as you have. I believed I could trust you, but I was wrong.

I've read all the guides on avoiding people like you. You know the ones: they advise women to stay with their friends, never leave a drink unattended at a bar, and always watch when drinks are poured. They emphasize staying aware of your surroundings and maintaining constant vigilance. Take RAD classes. Aim for the groin. Yet, none of that prepared me for you.

The guides never taught me how to avoid someone like you. They never explained how to recognize when a friend was anything but friendly. They didn't warn me that you would respect my bodily autonomy until the day you didn't. They never mentioned that such a toxic intention could be disguised as the universe's cruelest gift.

The worst part of all this isn't the lost friends, the harassment by the police, or even the fact that you got away with it, both literally and figuratively. The worst part is that I will never forget you. I will never forget your taste or your scent. I'll never forget the taste of the fruit punch you gave me or how I couldn't taste the drug you slipped me. The worst part is that I will never forget that I can't remember. I will never forget you or what you did to me... and I hate you for it.

But I want you to know that you have not broken me. To you, I am just another victim, but what you don't realize is that I am a survivor. You will not stop me from achieving my potential, even though you certainly tried while stalking me. I realize now that I am much more than the trauma you caused, and you are worth less than the dog mess I stepped in this morning.

— A Survivor

The mission to the Alpha Centauri planetary system was a monumental undertaking, one that required the collective efforts of humanity. Fifteen ships, each carrying five hundred men and women, were dispatched to scout for habitable areas and establish colonies for future development. The planets designated *a Cen AB-b* and *a Cen AB-c* were identified as the most viable candidates for sustaining a human population, and thus, the ships were sent there.

Decades before the mission, interstellar probes were launched, and their faint transmissions had only recently reached us. These probes detected potential signs of life on some extrasolar planets, and an automated lander working with a satellite orbiting *a Cen AB-b* revealed a thriving ecosystem. Although the atmosphere was uncomfortable, it was capable of supporting human life. This discovery prompted us to send our bravest men and women into the darkest reaches of space.

In two years, the ships had journeyed beyond the Oort cloud and into interstellar space. As they traveled farther, communication between the ships and our Solar System grew increasingly distant, taking many months for signals to reach each other. Whenever we received a message, it was a cause for celebration. While most messages contained data incomprehensible to the average person, others carried more personal content. Some messages wished loved ones good luck, while others shared news of births and deaths with relatives on Earth. One notable message, a heartfelt and rambling account from a researcher missing her family on Europa, became headline news.

As time passed, the delay in communication meant that years would go by before we knew whether the mission was a success. By the time confirmation arrived, eight years would have elapsed. The uncertainty was immense—our explorers could all be dead, or they might have succeeded in extending the reach of our species. This was the greatest gamble in human history, capable of leading to either unprecedented success or monumental failure.

Two hours ago, Control received a message from the ships, ending a four-month silence that had led us to fear all hope was lost. The message read:

李俊宏（卫福部嘉南疗养院成瘾暨司法精神科主任）指出，使用物质（如酒、毒品）导致精神失常并引发犯罪行为存在三个层次。首先是与“原因自由行为”相关，要考虑个案过去使用毒品是否出于冲动或攻击行为，以及在清醒时是否自知而陷入这种状态。这一点常常需要法院做出判断，但在法学界仍存在争议。

其次，考虑个案当前的精神状态受毒品影响程度。司法精神鉴定通常不会涉及原因自由行为，而是评估当下的精神状态是否影响辨识行为的合法性，供合议庭参考。

第三个层次涉及长期使用毒品可能导致认知功能缺陷，甚至有些个案可能在长期使用甲基安非他命后发展出思觉失调症。在这种情况下，精神医疗团队也可以提供建议。

在进行二审时，这三个层次还有待进一步讨论。实际上，在符合《刑法》第19条第1项或第2项的个案中，对于免刑或减刑后的处理，选择合适的治疗机构至关重要。

在缺乏健保支持成瘾治疗的情况下，如何长期留置在治疗机构，资源来源是重要问题。从治疗机构回到社区后，如何继续监督和治疗也需仔细规划。只有摒弃本位主义，合作共赢，投入资源，进行网络合作，确保社会安全，这才是最重要的。

最后，对于那些有精神异常的案件，即使刑事上因无法辩护而被判“无罪”，个案在日后仍需担负道德责任，配合社会系统，改善自身状态。需要讨论的是如何处理这类案件，以确保个案能够接受治疗和监督。

因此，使用“无罪”这个词可能有点简化。实际上，应该更准确地表达为“无罪有责”，即刑事责任能力因精神异常而受限，但在日后个案仍需承担道德责任。这种情况下，社会可以就如何处理这些案件展开讨论。

In this paper, we investigate the numerical minimization of the Canham-Helfrich-Evans bending energy \(W(\partial\Omega) = 2\kappa_b \partial\Omega(H - H_0)^2 ds\), with \(\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^3\) being a bounded domain, subject to volume and area constraints. Here, the positive constants \(V_0\) and \(A_0\) satisfy the isoperimetric inequality. The mean curvature of \(\partial\Omega\), denoted by \(H := \frac{1}{2}(\kappa_1 + \kappa_2)\), represents its principal curvatures \(\kappa_1\) and \(\kappa_2\), \(2H_0\) is the spontaneous curvature, and \(\kappa_b\) is the bending elastic constant. We will use \(S := \partial\Omega\) as an abbreviation, where \(S\) encloses the volume \(\Omega\). This energy model (1.1) is proposed to simulate membranes like vesicles and red blood cells.

The numerical treatment of this problem is challenging as computing the mean curvature typically involves the Laplace-Beltrami operator of the normal field, requiring a certain smoothness of the surface. Shapes are commonly approximated with continuous, non-smooth triangulations, posing the question of computing/approximating the appropriate curvature. Despite the complexity, various approaches have been suggested. Methods based on discrete differential geometry (DDG) approximate the Laplace-Beltrami operator, and the minimization is achieved by differentiating the discrete energy and following a negative gradient. A popular discretization method involves the finite difference cotangent scheme on a Voronoi area, also computing Gaussian curvature in terms of the angle deficit.

The shape derivative of geometric quantities and the full Canham-Helfrich-Evans energy have been computed, involving fourth-order derivatives and the Gauss curvature of the shape. Techniques such as boundary integral methods and surface finite element methods (SFEM) have been employed for approximating surface shapes. Smooth surface approximations using high-order B-splines or subdivision algorithms have also been explored to maintain continuity in the normal vector field.

Level set and phase field approaches discretize the full space, representing the surface implicitly via a level set function. Time-stepping algorithms are often used to find stationary solutions or for dynamic tests, with Dziuk's algorithm being a popular choice. This work introduces a novel discretization method based on lifting the distributional curvature to a more regular auxiliary curvature field. By considering the element-wise shape operator and the angle of the normal vector jump between adjacent elements, the full curvature can be described efficiently.

The paper's main contributions include a new numerical scheme for discretizing the Canham-Helfrich-Evans bending energy, distributional curvature derivation in the context of FEM, rigorous computation of the first variation of the discretized bending energy, and numerical minimization of the bending energy using a gradient-type algorithm based on the first variation.

On April 5, 1998, the Mars Global Surveyor, during its first flyover of the Cydonia region since the Viking 1 mission discovered the face in 1976, captured a new, much sharper image. El Concejo Deliberante de Valle María dio inicio a su 10º período de sesiones ordinarias en su nueva sede, inaugurada en el año 2020, el martes 9 de marzo. En el acto de apertura del período legislativo 2021, estuvieron presentes el Presidente Municipal, el Vicepresidente Municipal, los Concejales, el secretario del Concejo, los secretarios del ejecutivo y, acompañando el acto, el Diputado Jorge Cáceres.

El inicio de sesiones es un acto público, como lo son todas las sesiones del Concejo Deliberante. Sin embargo, debido a las medidas de prevención dispuestas por la pandemia de Covid-19, no pudo realizarse con presencia de público. Para poder hacerlo accesible a la comunidad, se transmitió en vivo a través del Facebook institucional Valle María Comunicación: https://www.facebook.com/valle.maria.comunicacion. Es posible volver a ver el acto accediendo al siguiente enlace: https://www.facebook.com/valle.maria.comunicacion/videos/268179521535778.

Para dar inicio a este período de sesiones, el Presidente Municipal, en cumplimiento del artículo 108 de la Ley de Régimen Municipal, brindó una memoria detallada de la administración durante el año anterior y ofreció las líneas generales de aquello que se propone realizar en el año en curso. En su discurso inaugural, el intendente, Mario Sokolovsky, expuso cómo la Municipalidad y toda la comunidad debieron adaptarse a las nuevas condiciones impuestas por la pandemia de Covid-19, que afectó el normal desarrollo de las actividades. Destacó especialmente el trabajo de todos los integrantes del Comité de Emergencia local y del personal médico, por su dedicación en el cuidado de la salud de todas y todos.

Sokolovsky detalló lo desarrollado desde cada una de las áreas de administración municipal:

### Área de Desarrollo Social

**Primera infancia:**
El espacio de Primera Infancia trabajó en distintas propuestas y estrategias para sostener y apoyar la educación durante el tiempo de aislamiento y distanciamiento social. El Jardín Maternal Municipal Travesuras sostuvo los vínculos y el proceso de enseñanza-aprendizaje a través de los “Contenidos en Casa” y, más tarde, a través de encuentros con los padres, en los que se les hizo entrega de diversos kits que incluían juguetes, alimentos y materiales didácticos. Además, se ofrecieron charlas sobre la educación en tiempos de pandemia y se puso a disposición de los estudiantes una computadora en el hall de entrada de la Municipalidad.

**Adultos mayores:**
Se creó el Programa de Atención, Protección y Contención para Adultos Mayores, con el objetivo de fortalecer la participación activa de los adultos mayores en la comunidad. Se conformó un Voluntariado Joven en el marco del Programa ProtegER del Ministerio de Desarrollo Social del gobierno provincial, y en diciembre comenzó un taller de gimnasia al aire libre para adultos mayores. También se continuó con el apoyo a la Residencia Gerontológica Municipal “Hogar de los Abuelos María y Enrique”.

**Prevención de consumo problemático:**
Se creó el Programa Municipal de Prevención de Consumos Problemáticos, participando activamente en la red Provincial de Abordaje de Problemáticas de Consumo. Se realizaron jornadas virtuales sobre prevención de consumos problemáticos en el ámbito educativo.

**Violencia de género:**
Se puso en funcionamiento el Programa Municipal de Prevención, Detección y Erradicación de Violencia de Género, brindando información, contención y asesoramiento a mujeres en situaciones de violencia. Se llevaron a cabo diversas campañas y capacitaciones en el marco de la Ley Micaela.

**Discapacidad:**
Se aprobó el Proyecto de ampliación del Banco descentralizado de ayudas técnicas, a través del Instituto provincial de discapacidad de Entre Ríos.

**Asistencia alimentaria:**
Se priorizó la asistencia alimentaria a las familias durante la pandemia y se continuó con el Programa Pro-Huerta. También se dispuso personal y vehículos municipales para garantizar la continuidad de diferentes tratamientos médicos y se brindó asistencia en la atención virtual de ANSES.

### Área de Deportes y Juventud
Durante el período en que fue posible brindar actividades deportivas y recreativas, la Municipalidad sostuvo diversos talleres de deportes, actividades en el Complejo Municipal de Piletas y en el Balneario-Camping. Durante el período de distanciamiento, se coordinaron caminatas recreativas y se dieron clases de Gimnasia para Adultos, televisadas por Canal 3.

Travis McMichael, his father, Gregory McMichael, and their neighbor, William "Roddie" Bryan, have been indicted by a grand jury for the murder of Ahmaud Arbery, according to multiple reports. The indictment comes four months after Arbery was shot while on his daily jog on Feb. 23. Cobb District Attorney Joyette M. Holmes announced the indictment to reporters Wednesday afternoon. Although the defendants had been arrested for murder, the grand jury delivered the indictment, formally charging them each with one count of malice murder, four counts of felony murder, two counts of aggravated assault, one count of false imprisonment, and one count of criminal attempt to commit false imprisonment. Murder charges in Georgia typically go before a grand jury for indictment. Travis, Gregory, and Bryan have remained in custody since their arrests in May. They last appeared in court in early June for a probable cause hearing, where a judge concluded there is enough evidence to move forward with the case.

According to the police report, on Feb. 23, Gregory spotted Arbery on a run and assumed he was the person who committed "several break-ins" in their neighborhood. Gregory is a retired investigator with the Brunswick District Attorney's Office who previously served as a Glynn County police officer. The police report states that Gregory then alerted his son, Travis; they grabbed their guns and jumped into their car to find Arbery. Bryan was called, and he recorded the chase after Arbery.

**Japan to Create Crater on Asteroid to Gather Subsurface Samples**

TOKYO (AP) — Japan's space agency has announced that its Hayabusa2 spacecraft will embark on another daring mission following last month's successful touchdown on a distant asteroid. The spacecraft aims to drop an explosive device to create a crater, allowing it to collect subsurface samples that could provide valuable insights into the origins of the solar system.

On February 22, Hayabusa2 successfully landed on the asteroid, which is rich in boulders, and collected some surface fragments. The Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) stated on Monday that on April 5, Hayabusa2 will deploy a copper impactor onto the asteroid to gather samples from deeper beneath the surface. To ensure the spacecraft's safety from debris generated by the explosion, an immediate evacuation will be necessary.

حراج جدة يتميز بوفرة السيارات المتاحة للبيع وتنوع الموديلات والفئات. من بين العروض، نجد سيارة تويوتا كورولا موديل 2016 بيضاء اللون بحالة ممتازة، قير أوتوماتيك وقد سجلت ممشى 187 ألف كيلومتر والسعر المطلوب هو 21 ألف ريال. كما تتوفر سيارة كيا أوبتيما موديل 2015 بيضاء اللون بحالة جيدة جدًا مع قير أوتوماتيكي وممشاها يزيد قليلاً عن 230 ألف كيلومتر، ويبلغ السعر المطلوب 16 ألف و500 ريال.

من ضمن السيارات الأخرى المتاحة، نجد سيارة هيونداي النترا سوداء اللون موديل 2012 فئة GLX فل كامل بصمة، مزودة بقير أوتوماتيكي وفتحة سقف بانورامية، والممشى تجاوز 340 ألف كيلومتر، وسعرها وصل إلى 19 ألف و500 ريال. تتوفر أيضًا سيارة هيونداي إلنترا موديل 2015 بيضاء اللون بناقل حركة أوتوماتيك، والسعر المطلوب 14 ألف ريال فقط.

بالنسبة لأرخص العروض، تأتي سيارة بيجو 30 موديل 2007 زرقاء اللون في المقدمة، حيث وصل سومها إلى 3500 ريال والسعر المطلوب 4000 ريال، تتميز بقير عادي وممشاها 296 ألف كيلومتر ومزودة بشاشة وسطية. كما تتوفر شيفروليه كورفيت موديل 2008 بيضاء اللون بحالة ممتازة وبسعر 5000 ريال، وتحتل المركز الثاني في قائمة أرخص السيارات.

تشمل العروض كذلك سيارة فورد موديل 2010 بيضاء اللون بقير عادي وسومها 13 ألف و500 ريال، وسيارة لاند كروزر GXR موديل 2004 بيضاء اللون بثلاثة صفوف للمقاعد وقير أوتوماتيك دابل، والممشى 300 ألف كيلومتر والسوم وصل إلى 27 ألف ريال.

Rodney Rice entered his home state of West Virginia on a Sunday afternoon. The singer-songwriter from Littleton had just left Nashville after spending four days in a recording studio, marking his first proper visit to the country music hub. He was en route to visit family and install a kayak rack on his vehicle.

Despite the unconventional timing for travel, Rodney had been isolated for months and was eager to record new songs. Despite the challenges of the year, he remained productive. 

"I’m adhering to safety measures, wearing a mask, and carrying hand sanitizer," Rice said. "Everyone in the studio was diligent about it too, we were all masked up. I’m just trying to make my way across the country as safely as possible."

Rodney was thrilled that his upcoming second album, SAME SHIrT, DIFFERENT DAY, set to release on streaming platforms on October 23, was gaining attention. The album, labeled as “Bubblin’ Up” on the Americana Music Association’s chart, features twelve tracks of gritty, twangy country-rock with an array of guest musicians. The songs touch on themes like critiquing the current presidential administration and the struggles of a corporate job.

This album follows his 2014 debut, Empty Pockets and a Troubled Mind. Rodney felt more at ease in the studio this time around and found inspiration in the tumultuous state of the world.

"I prefer the second one," he remarked. "The songs feel more current and relevant. The first album included some of the earliest songs I had ever written, spanning from high school to the recording session. It covered a broader time frame."

The opening track of SAME SHIrT, DIFFERENT DAY, titled “Ain’t Got a Dollar,” delves into the presidency of Trump and the notion that politics often revolves around money. Rodney expressed his embarrassment over having a reality TV star as the country's leader, incorporating military references influenced by his family and friends' military service.

Rodney's upbringing in West Virginia, with its blend of city life and rural surroundings where darkness descends early in the “hollers,” has shaped his musical style. He believes Appalachia shares common daily life aspects across regions like West Virginia, Tennessee, and Kentucky, emphasizing the value of diverse experiences.

After returning to West Virginia to attend the University of West Virginia for a degree in geology, Rodney spent years in the oil industry before transitioning to focus on his music full-time. His time in Texas on oil rigs influenced his music, with songs like “Middle Managed Blues” drawing from his corporate job experiences.

Moving to Colorado after meeting a woman from Boulder, Rodney immersed himself in music during his Texas days, watching performances by outlaw country legend Billy Joe Shaver, who played a significant role in Rodney's musical journey.

Rodney's early exposure to music, raiding his sister’s collection of Uncle Tupelo, Waylon Jennings, and Shaver tapes and CDs, left a lasting impression. Attending a concert by John Prine at a young age further fueled his passion for music.

SAME SHIrT, DIFFERENT DAY will be available on October 23. For more information on how to access the album, visit Rodney Rice's website.

伊拉克近日爆发大规模示威，政府的处理方式引发广泛争议。多个城市实施宵禁、互联网被封锁，警方使用实弹对付示威者，已造成数十人死亡、数千人受伤。这场示威并非由政党组织，而是通过社交媒体发起，政府因此难以控制局势。

示威的主要原因是当地民众生活艰苦，基础设施差、贪污问题严重。尽管极端组织ISIS已被击退，国际也放宽了对伊拉克的制裁，使其近年能够和平且自由地做生意，并通过石油出口获利，但民众的生活并未得到显著改善。战争后，基础设施依然落后，失业率高，人民对此深感不满。

自10月1日起，大型反政府示威在伊拉克多个城市爆发，局势迅速失控。政府从10月3日起在首都巴格达及其他地区实施宵禁，禁止人员上街或车辆通行。然而，民众继续抗议，警方与示威者爆发冲突，使用实弹、水炮及催泪弹等手段对付示威者。据当地人权组织估计，连日示威已造成73人死亡，其中包括示威者与警员。

此外，政府还封锁了互联网，试图阻止民众通讯或上传示威视频。这一连串举动引发争议。10月5日，政府宣布解除首都巴格达的宵禁令，但据半岛电视台报道，其他地区尚未解禁。

面对当前局势，伊拉克总理迈赫迪承诺进行大幅改革，提供更多就业机会及更好的社会服务，如供电、医疗等，并致力于改善贫富不均的问题。然而，外界对政府能否平息此次示威持怀疑态度。路透社分析指出，这次示威不是由政党发起，缺乏组织领导，示威的突如其来让警方措手不及。由于没有领袖，政府在谈判方面也面临困难，令当前局势更难控制。

一名22岁的年轻示威者在采访中表示，他大学毕业却失业，感到愤怒和无奈。

This paper explores the separation of blind source nonstationary signals, where a nonstationary signal is expressed as a combination of Fourier-like oscillatory modes:

EQUATION

with \( A_k(t) \), \( \phi_k(t) > 0 \), and \( A_k(t) \) varying slowly. This form of representation, known as an adaptive harmonic model (AHM), is crucial for extracting information, such as the underlying dynamics embedded within the nonstationary signal. This involves using the trend \( A_0(t) \), instantaneous amplitudes (IAs) \( A_k(t) \), and instantaneous frequencies (IFs) \( \phi_k(t) \) to describe the underlying dynamics.

Many real-world phenomena in nature, which can be formulated as signals or time series, often appear as time-overlapping multicomponent signals as described in equation (1). A common approach to understand and process such phenomena is decomposing, or better, separating these multicomponent signals into their basic building blocks \( x_k(t) \) (referred to as components, modes, or sub-signals) to extract the necessary features. In applications such as radar and communications, signals often appear in multicomponent modes. Given that these signals are primarily nonstationary—meaning their amplitudes and/or phases change over time—few effective rigorous methods for their decomposition are available.

The empirical mode decomposition (EMD) algorithm, in conjunction with Hilbert spectrum analysis (HSA), is a popular method for decomposing and analyzing nonstationary signals. EMD functions as a filter bank to decompose a nonstationary signal into a superposition of intrinsic mode functions (IMFs) and a trend, after which the IF of each IMF is calculated by HSA. Numerous articles study the properties of EMD, and variants have been proposed to enhance its performance. For instance, EMD's separation capability was discussed, demonstrating its limitations in decomposing two components with closely spaced frequencies. The ensemble EMD (EEMD) was introduced to suppress noise interferences. Extensions of the original EMD to multivariate signals and alternative sifting algorithms have also been proposed. Similar to EMD's filter bank, the empirical wavelet transform serves as another decomposition method.

The Federal Executive Council on July 22, 2020, approved the sum of N75, 000,000,000.00 (seventy-five billion naira) for the establishment of the Nigeria Youth Investment Fund for the period of 2020 – 2023. This fund is dedicated to investing in the innovative ideas, skills, and talents of Nigerian youth, and to provide them with a special window for accessing much-needed funds, finances, business management skills, and other inputs critical for sustainable enterprise development.

The Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) has identified main business activities and sectors in the Nigerian economy eligible to access the N75 billion Youth Investment Fund. The eligible sectors include technology/innovation, agriculture and related value chain, green economy and renewable energy sector, manufacturing, hospitality/tourism, construction and logistics, healthcare value chain, creative sector, and trading and services. Preference will be given to enterprises that support the growth of priority sectors identified by the Economic and Recovery Growth Plan (ERGP) and the Nigerian Youth Employment Action Plan.

The Nigerian Youth Employment Action Plan, developed by the Federal Ministry of Youth and Sports Development, aims to respond effectively to the youth employment challenge in Nigeria. It seeks to address fragmentation of youth initiatives and provide Nigerian youth with the investment inputs needed to build successful businesses that can become sustainable employers of labor and contributors to Nigeria's development.

The Earth Observation Satellite (EOS) plays a crucial role in environmental monitoring, land surveys, detailed investigations of sensitive areas, and various other fields. The problem of satellite mission planning and scheduling mainly consists of two parts: data acquisition task scheduling and data downlink scheduling. Data acquisition involves capturing images, while data downlink refers to transmitting the stored imaging data to receiving resources, such as ground stations, as depicted in Figure 1. This process can involve complete or partial imaging data, or a combination of both.

With advancements in space technology, satellite imaging capabilities have significantly improved, leading to a surge in imaging data. The launch of GAOFEN II in 2014 ushered in the "submeter Era" for EOS in China, showcasing enhanced imaging capabilities. However, the downlink capacity of satellite antennas has not progressed at the same pace. For instance, the downlink rate of the GAOFEN II antenna is only 2,450 Mbps, creating a significant gap between data acquisition and data download capabilities.

The discrepancy between data acquisition and download capabilities presents a new challenge for Satellite Data Downlink Scheduling Problem (SDSP). Various studies have delved into different aspects of SDSP, focusing on single satellites, satellite constellations, time-switch constraints, resource constraints, and uncertainty in imaging data. Different optimization algorithms, such as ant colony algorithms, particle swarm optimization, genetic algorithms, and hybrid genetic algorithms, have been proposed to tackle the complexities of SDSP.

Most research on SDSP revolves around resource allocation for playback windows and resolving conflicts between them. A common assumption in these studies is the "First observed, First downlink (FOFD)" order for transmitting images. However, the assumption that one playback window can transmit multiple images becomes impractical due to the significant gap between data acquisition and download capabilities.

This paper introduces the Satellite Data Downlink Scheduling Problem under Breakpoint Resume Mode (SDSP-BRM), which allows for pausing and resuming image data transmission. This mode enables the division of a single image into smaller pieces, adding a layer of complexity to the traditional SDSP. SDSP-BRM surpasses the complexity of Satellite Range Scheduling Problem (SRSP) and SDSP, both of which are known to be NP-Hard.

The paper is structured as follows: Section 2 presents the mathematical formulation and complexity analysis of SDSP-BRM. In Section 3, a Simple and Effective Heuristic Algorithm (SEHA) is introduced to solve SDSP-BRM. Experimental results and analysis are presented in Section 4, while Section 5 concludes the paper.

路透台北3月7日 - 台湾指标10年期公债107/2殖利率周三早盘走低。交易员表示，由于美国债券殖利率在东京盘下跌，台债亦随之下滑。然而，由于临近1.0%的整数大关，市场买盘趋于谨慎，交投相对冷清，市场正静待明日20年券的标售结果。

本地时间10:55，10年券107/2殖利率跌1.20基点至1.0100%，成交23.5亿台币；而五年券107/1殖利率则涨0.70基点至0.6600%，成交0.5亿台币。股市方面，台湾加权指数小涨0.17%。交易员预估，今日107/2期殖利率的主要成交区间在1.00-1.03%。

交易员指出，美国指标10年债殖利率昨晚弹至2.90%后即回落，尾盘收稳于2.879%；但今早在东京盘反转走跌，带动台债10年券最低跌到1.01%。一大型银行交易员表示：“台债跟着美债下来，但盘面很冷清，毕竟到1.00%大家还是会谨慎一点。观察明天标债结果吧，如果标得好，应该会有些波动。”

他们进一步表示，由于市场资金宽松，且第一季公债到期量高达2,199亿台币，各大银行不仅有补券压力，还需寻找去化资金的标的。因此，预计明天20年券的标售有望好于预期，可能促使10年券殖利率下跌。

一大型证券商交易员则称，目前对台债持中性看法，短线关注明天20年券的标售结果，后续则视美债走势而定。不过，从近期美国10年债殖利率走势来看，短线在2.88%附近虽有支撑，但突破3.0%的机率仍然很高，一旦正式越过，停损压力会很大，台债亦将受到影响。

"Get down!" I whispered. He ducked down, his head just below the tops of the corn. 

"Who are they?" he whispered back as he began to realize our predicament. He shifted, trying to get closer to the ground without touching the mirey soil. 

"I'm not sure," I admitted. "But we weren't told to expect anyone." I strained my neck, trying to glimpse between the wavering plants to see any sign of them. 

"I need to go closer," I said. "Stay here." Isaac began to protest, but I motioned him to be quiet. "You'll be safer here," I said, as I swam deeper into the crop. 

My boots squelched quietly as I made my slow and cautious journey towards the landing site. Now and then, I heard their rough yelling and wondered if they had finally spotted my path through the field. There was no gunfire, and nobody appeared in my vision. My fingers still gripped tightly around my gun, my eyes scanning for the second of movement that might warn me I was about to be discovered.

Safe and efficient motion planning is crucial and often considered the bottleneck in autonomous driving systems (Yurtsever et al., 2020). With the advancement of intelligent simulators (Dosovitskiy et al., 2017; Sun et al., 2022b) and large-scale datasets (Caesar et al., 2021), learning-based planning algorithms such as imitation learning (IL) (Bansal et al., 2018; Zeng et al., 2019) and reinforcement learning (RL) (Chen et al., 2019a; 2020) have gained prominence. Building upon these, offline RL has emerged as a promising framework for safety-critical driving tasks, allowing learning from offline data while leveraging various data qualities (Fujimoto et al., 2019; Kumar et al., 2020).

However, the practical application of offline RL approaches in driving faces challenges. The driving task requires long-horizon planning to avoid shortsighted decisions (Zhang et al., 2022) and demands real-time responses due to the stochastic behavior of environmental objects (Diehl et al., 2021; Villaflor et al., 2022). The recent success of the Transformer architecture (Vaswani et al., 2017; Brown et al., 2020; Dosovitskiy et al., 2020) has inspired researchers to reformulate offline RL as a sequence modeling problem (Chen et al., 2021), which considers outcomes of multi-step decision-making and has proven effective in long-horizon tasks.

Typically, sequence models predict actions based on the current state and desired future outcomes. However, existing works (Brandfonbrener et al., 2022; Paster et al., 2022; Yang et al., 2022) have highlighted that decision transformers (DTs) can be overly optimistic in stochastic environments, mistakenly assuming consistent success for actions that achieved goals once. This assumption is easily invalidated in stochastic settings, where identical actions may lead to different outcomes, as illustrated in Fig. 1(a).

To overcome this, it is crucial to distinguish between the outcomes of agent actions and environment transitions, training models to pursue goals unaffected by environmental stochasticity. However, only a few works (Villaflor et al., 2022; Paster et al., 2022; Yang et al., 2022) have attempted solutions. They typically involve fitting a state transition model for pessimistic planning (Villaflor et al., 2022) or disentangling goals from stochasticity through adversarial training (Paster et al., 2022; Yang et al., 2022). These methods, while introducing complexity, are applicable only when a representative environment model can be learned, which is often not the case in complex driving scenarios (Sun et al., 2022a).

In this paper, we propose a novel approach to customize DTs for stochastic driving environments without complex generative models. Our insight stems from Fig. 1(a): using a truncated return from Task I as a condition helps mitigate environmental stochasticity, providing better supervision by considering rewards over enough timesteps for optimizing current actions. Additional experimental results validate this approach, revealing important properties of driving environments, such as Uncertainty Accumulation and Temporal Locality, as depicted in Fig. 1(b) and Fig. 1(c).

Based on these insights, the challenge is setting the span of the truncated return to minimize the impact of stochasticity. Our proposed UNcertainty-awaRE deciSion Transformer (UNREST) quantifies transition uncertainties through conditional mutual information between transitions and returns, segmenting sequences into certain and uncertain parts. With minimal stochasticity in 'certain parts,' we condition on cumulative rewards to reflect true action outcomes and generalize to higher rewards. In 'uncertain parts,' where stochasticity is high, UNREST uses dummy tokens as conditions, imitating expert actions.

We highlight the contributions of UNREST:
- It presents an uncertainty-aware sequential decision framework for offline RL in long-horizon, stochastic driving environments, with plans to release the code upon publication.
- By recognizing the properties of driving environments, it introduces a novel model-free environmental uncertainty measurement, segmenting sequences accordingly. UNREST replaces global returns in DTs with less uncertain truncated returns (or dummy tokens) for true outcome learning.
- Extensive evaluations on CARLA (Dosovitskiy et al., 2017) demonstrate UNREST's superior performance, consistently outperforming strong baselines (5.2% and 6.5% driving score improvement in seen and unseen scenarios). Further experiments validate the efficacy of the proposed uncertainty estimation strategy.

The Democrat-controlled Virginia General Assembly voted on Wednesday to approve Governor Ralph Northam's proposed changes to a marijuana legalization bill, which will permit limited possession and cultivation of the drug starting in July. Northam had sent the bill back to lawmakers with significant modifications from the version they had originally passed in February.

The amendments, agreed upon by lawmakers on Wednesday, will expedite the legalization timeline by approximately three years, a development that has been welcomed by advocates for racial justice. Northam's amendments were supported by a vote of 53-44 in the House, with two abstentions.

Subsequently, the Senate voted 20-20, with Democratic Lieutenant Governor Justin Fairfax breaking the tie by voting in favor of approving the amendments.

In a world of dark and grey, she was the light, that little piece of color, the fragment of hope that just happened to flutter its wings in the right place, at the right time. I'm not sure how I saw her, I know she didn't see me, but there she was, a million miles below and a life away, ready to catch me, should I fall.

Like the pool of deep water below the high dive, waiting with open arms and a smile for any who would fall into her cool embrace. Her warmth was like a steady wind, pushing me back, even from here, away, away from the million-mile drop, away from the crush of bone and stone.

I know she never saw me, she didn't know, but today, she saved a life.

川普关税政策挡不住「2025中国制造」

2018-06-17 17:17 经济日报 记者 任中原 ╱即时报导

美国对500亿美元中国产品开征关税，包括机械、电子、金属、化工及运输设备，主要是为了阻止中国主导未来产业的能力。然而，经济学家普遍认为，美国借由关税来拉高这些中国产品在美国的售价，未必能够拖住中国在机器人、生物科技及量子电脑等高科技产业的前进步伐。

以下是经济学者对川普试图阻碍中国推动高科技产业发展的看法：

1. 康乃尔大学经济学者普拉萨（中国经济专家）认为，美国开征关税过于鲁莽，而且效果不彰。由中国进口美国产品与服务的结构显示，川普政府并没有多少筹码能打压中国发展科技的雄心。再者，美国对中国需要的产品课征关税，只会加速中国在追求创新及取得零件方面的自给自足。更有效的策略是与许多中国的贸易伙伴建立联盟，这些国家同样关切中国的贸易及经济政策，包括强迫转移科技及保护知识产权不力等方面。

2. 北京Trivium China企业顾问公司经济学家卜安德指出，美国相信通过限制中国的出口，可以影响中国提升价值链的能力，但这是错误的思维，因为中国仍可将这些产品销往全球。此外，这也无法使美中贸易逆差大幅减少，因为目前中国这类产品对美国的出口额并不多。真正能够阻止中国提升价值链的筹码在于限制科技产品对中国的出口，例如半导体，因为半导体是所有这类产业的基础，而中国的半导体产业相对脆弱，这是中国的软肋。

3. 牛津经济学公司专家库吉斯表示，中国确实以自有品牌出口一些中、高阶科技产品及／或科技，但并非对美国出口。美国想通过关税迫使中国放弃这项产业政策，但中国绝不会放弃。

I stood in my underwear, gazing at my reflection. The life I had chosen was far from easy. The stress from my job had caused my hair to thin prematurely, while the bags under my eyes had only deepened. And don't even get me started on stress eating—I could devour an entire pig. Yes, you read that right, a whole pig. 

A knock on the door interrupted my thoughts. It was Samson, my ever-persistent secretary. "Just a minute," I called out. It wasn't even dawn, yet here he was, knocking at my door. I quickly threw on my Mayor's robe and, with great reluctance, opened the door.

There stood Samson, a muscular lad reminiscent of my younger self, with his long, flowing hair that I envied. I used to have long hair too, albeit brown, not blonde. Samson met my gaze with his shining blue eyes. "We... We have a problem, sir," he began. 

I rubbed my temples and winced. There was always some crisis to deal with, especially with a dark lord rising in the south. "The blacksmith seems to have produced an endless supply of wooden sticks," Samson continued. 

I blinked twice, processing the information. Before I could speak, I realized it was a recurring issue. "Did he also make an excessive amount of cloth armor?" I asked. Samson nodded quietly. "Okay, have him take the sticks and armor to the item shop. Tell him we've resolved the tent shortage since someone bought hundreds of them." 

Samson nodded in understanding. "A wise decision, sir. Now, there's the matter of debris outside the town. Some troublemakers trashed hundreds of tents, leaving behind a mess along with dead animals. It seems to be attracting the undead." 

I took a deep breath. This was a familiar scenario—people destroying tents instead of reusing them. "Increase guard presence and check for bites at the perimeter. Take volunteers and remaining guards to clear the debris," I instructed. 

Samson noted it down. "Masterfully handled, sir," he acknowledged. "Also, our priest believes he has power over life and death, proclaiming himself a god. We should address this promptly to avoid chaos." 

I reflected on a past priest's descent into madness. "Tell him to relinquish his priesthood and vacate the church if he wants to be a god," I instructed, feeling the weight of responsibility. 

As Samson reviewed his notes, he mentioned the return of the bandit. I sank into my chair, not surprised by the news. The bandit's recurrent activities had the townspeople demanding action, especially with an election looming. 

I remained calm, suggesting ways to address the issue. "Did anyone take advantage of the free door lock program to secure their homes?" I asked. 

Samson checked his papers. "Ol'John, the mill owner, did, and he was the only one spared from being robbed." 

I was exasperated. "We emphasized the importance of securing doors with the influx of strangers passing through town. Those who destroyed our tents and killed animals—do they seem heroic to you?" 

Samson shook his head, understanding my frustration. "Exactly, they're not heroes," I affirmed, pacing the room. "This town relies too heavily on us to solve their problems. It's a repetitive cycle of issues—too many sticks made, someone stuck in a well. We even had to block off the well due to numerous accidents." 

Releasing my pent-up emotions felt liberating. "You know what, that felt good," I admitted, appreciating Samson's grounded nature. 

Samson hesitated before asking, "Sir, could you sign off on my claim form for the stolen items?" 

I smiled. "Of course, Samson. Thank you for being the voice of reason in this chaos."

"No!" I exclaimed.

"It's your turn," the project's lead scientist said, nodding towards the airlock.

"I did it last time!"

"Okay, listen... we traveled all the way out here, five light-years in a blink. We must return, and so far, we only know that it worked with you."

"I was joking! I was drunk!" I protested, glancing at everyone behind him who peered out of the space shuttle portholes at the altered view of the stars.

"Regardless of that, we're far from home and we need to find our way back," he insisted. "You have to get us back!"

I sighed, "My rear end is going to freeze."

"We'll need to modify the design of the space suit if this works again," someone behind the lead scientist suggested.

"He was drunk before, maybe we should get him drunk again," another person quipped.

We had run out of beer, so that seemed unlikely. I frowned and donned the space helmet. They closed the airlock door behind me. I floated to the handles in the center of the room and gripped them tightly.

"Opening the outer door!" I heard through my helmet radio.

I waited until the door was fully open before dropping my pants. Clinging on for dear life, I hoped whoever was directing us back to Earth had aimed correctly.

Étourdi après la chute de Mariano Rajoy, le Parti Populaire espagnol (de droite) va choisir samedi son nouveau chef, parmi Soraya Saenz de Santamaria, ancienne bras droit de Rajoy, et Pablo Casado, jeune loup de droite radicale. Le congrès extraordinaire du PP, entamé vendredi, trouvera son épilogue samedi vers 13h00 (11h00 GMT) avec le vote de 3 082 grands électeurs chargés de désigner le nouveau président du parti, qui sera le candidat aux prochaines élections législatives, prévues au plus tard mi-2020. 

Président du parti depuis 2004 et chef du gouvernement espagnol depuis 2011, M. Rajoy, qui n'a pas nommé de successeur, a quitté la vie politique début juin, quelques jours après avoir été évincé du pouvoir le 1er juin, suite à la condamnation de son parti dans un méga-procès pour corruption. Ce scandale a permis au socialiste Pedro Sanchez de prendre la tête de l'exécutif avec le soutien du parti de gauche radicale Podemos, des indépendantistes catalans et des nationalistes basques.

Dans son dernier discours en tant que président du PP vendredi, M. Rajoy, ému, a fait ses adieux et remercié les militants de son parti, défendant son bilan et critiquant M. Sanchez pour être entré au palais de la Moncloa "par la petite porte". 

Les grands électeurs du PP ont le choix entre deux orientations, symbolisées par les candidats désignés le 5 juillet par les militants lors de primaires inédites au sein du parti. Soraya Saenz de Santamaria, qui a été la numéro deux des gouvernements Rajoy pendant six ans et demi, représente la continuité, tandis que Pablo Casado, député de 37 ans, incarne un virage à droite avec une proposition de refondation conservatrice du parti. 

La campagne, au ton virulent, a été entachée par deux vidéos anonymes attaquant chacun des finalistes, qui n'ont pas été capables d'organiser un débat en face-à-face.

En Argentina, se producen aproximadamente 60.000 nuevos casos de Accidente Cerebrovascular (ACV) o ataques cerebrales por año, siendo esta la primera causa de discapacidad y la tercera causa de muerte. Tiene una incidencia de 76,5 cada 100.000 habitantes, y 2 de cada 100 personas mayores de 40 años son sobrevivientes de este tipo de eventos.

En el Día Mundial del ACV, que se celebra el 29 de octubre, se recuerda que, si bien algunas patologías de base pueden ser condicionantes para el desarrollo del ACV, como la Fibrilación Auricular, la mayoría de los factores de riesgo están asociados al estilo de vida y/o medicamentos. Estos incluyen la hipertensión arterial, la diabetes, la obesidad, el colesterol, el estrés, el tabaquismo, el sedentarismo y la mala alimentación.

"La hipertensión arterial es el factor de mayor frecuencia entre quienes sufren un ACV. Tenerla controlada en los valores adecuados reduce en un 30% a 40% las posibilidades de presentarlo", señaló la doctora María Martha Esnaola, Neuróloga Referente del Servicio de Neurología del Hospital Dr. César Milstein y del Sanatorio Mater Dei.

A su vez, la diabetes aumenta trece veces el riesgo de tener un ACV y, según detalló la especialista, "en Argentina, 1 de cada 5 personas que sufre un ACV tiene diabetes". También mencionó que aquellos con colesterol elevado disminuyen los riesgos de ataque cerebral al reducir los niveles.

Lo mismo ocurre con el tabaquismo, el consumo excesivo de alcohol, el sobrepeso, el sedentarismo, los cuadros depresivos y el estrés. "Una persona que fuma diariamente 20 cigarrillos tiene 6 veces más riesgo de tener un ACV", indicó Esnaola. Mientras que con el sobrepeso, esta posibilidad aumenta en un 22%, y en un 64% en quienes sufren obesidad, comentó la médica.

Por su parte, la doctora Diana Dossi, Neuróloga Vascular del Instituto Fleni, compartió las conclusiones de los estudios realizados por la institución y coincidió en que "la gente reconoce los síntomas y los factores de riesgo del ACV, pero uno de cada 3 no sabe que existe un tratamiento específico y la importancia de una atención inmediata". También recordó que "cuando una persona ya ha tenido un ACV, tiene más riesgo de tener otro".

Los estudios realizados por el Instituto FLENI sobre la pandemia fueron los SIFHON y EstEPA, que mostraron que cada año se producen alrededor de 18.000 muertes asociadas a esta enfermedad. Además, se estima que aproximadamente 340.000 personas (el 2% de la población adulta de Argentina) viven con secuelas de un ACV.

En ese sentido, el doctor Sebastián Ameriso, jefe del Servicio de Neurología Vascular de Fleni, explicó que buscan "llegar a la población con información sobre esta patología para concientizar sobre los factores de riesgo y, sobre todo, la importancia de no descuidar los controles y los síntomas tempranos, ya que durante el aislamiento hemos observado que muchas personas no han continuado con sus controles y eso puede ponerlas en riesgo".

Por su parte, el doctor Augusto Lavalle Cobo, Coordinador del Servicio de Cardiología del Sanatorio Finochetto, señaló: "Los ACV pueden repetirse muchas veces, incrementando la discapacidad en cada uno. Cuando una persona ha sufrido un ataque, el riesgo de sufrir otro es mayor.

SALT LAKE CITY — Donovan Mitchell had a standout performance with a season-high 36 points, leading the Utah Jazz to a thrilling 129-118 victory over the New Orleans Pelicans on Thursday night (Friday, Manila time), extending their winning streak to seven games.

Mitchell excelled from beyond the arc, shooting 6 for 7 from 3-point range, contributing to the Jazz's 50% field goal shooting (44 for 88) in a repeat victory over New Orleans, following their 118-102 win on Tuesday night.

Joining Mitchell in the scoring front were Mike Conley with 20 points and Jordan Clarkson with 19, fueling Utah's success and securing the longest active win streak in the NBA. Both Jordan Clarkson and Rudy Gobert also put up significant numbers for the Jazz.

Zion Williamson led the Pelicans with 27 points, and Brandon Ingram added 23, but despite a strong start, New Orleans couldn't maintain their momentum after a near-flawless first half. The Pelicans briefly held a lead early in the second half before the Jazz took control.

A crucial 21-2 run, highlighted by a fast-break layup from Joe Ingles off a pass from Mitchell, propelled Utah to a commanding 96-80 lead with 4:27 left in the third quarter, causing frustration to boil over for the Pelicans. The tension escalated as Coach Stan Van Gundy received a technical and was eventually ejected, adding to the Pelicans' woes.

Although the Pelicans tried to make a late push, the Jazz's precision passing and shooting allowed them to rebuild a comfortable lead and secure the win. Brandon Ingram's impressive shooting display, including four 3-pointers, contributed to the Pelicans' strong first quarter, where they scored 43 points, the second-highest in franchise history.

The Pelicans led by as many as 16 points before the Jazz seized a narrow 70-69 lead at halftime, with both Mitchell and Ingram setting season-high scoring records for the first half.

Luke turned 18 before arriving in Greece, which meant he could be drafted for military service. "The cattle-boat trips were an unbelievable opportunity for a small-town boy," Luke says. "Besides helping people, I had the side benefit of seeing Europe and China.
