Este sábado, miles de iraquíes —entre ellos altas autoridades del país— se concentraron en la Zona Verde para demandar "venganza" en pleno cortejo fúnebre de Qasim Soleimani, quien fue aniquilado durante un bombardeo ordenado por Estados Unidos. Los simpatizantes rodearon el ataúd ondeando banderas iraquíes y de la milicia, y lanzando gritos como: “Muera América”, "No a Israel” y “América es el mayor diablo”.

Las proclamas, que surgen en medio de especulaciones de una probable Tercera Guerra Mundial, se escucharon tanto en la capital como en las ciudades santas chiitas de Kerbala y Nayaf. Allí también se rindió homenaje a Abu Mehdi Al Muhandis, quien fue jefe de la milicia iraquí aliada de Teherán, que acompañaba a Qasim Soleimani cuando ocurrió el ataque con drone.

El poderoso general iraní Qasim Soleimani era el líder de la fuerza Al Quds, el artífice de la estrategia militar de Irán en Oriente Medio, y además un experto en la lucha contra el yihadismo. El ataque donde murió el comandante, ocurrido cerca del aeropuerto de Bagdad, pulverizó dos vehículos y dejó un total de diez muertos, cinco iraquíes y cinco iraníes.

Mientras tanto, para justificar la orden de matarlo, el presidente estadounidense Donald Trump afirmó que había actuado para “detener” una guerra y aseguró que Qasim Soleimani estaba planeando ataques “inminentes” contra diplomáticos y militares estadounidenses. La muerte de Soleimani generó un consenso contra Estados Unidos en un Irak desgarrado desde hace más de tres meses por una revuelta popular contra el poder y el control de Irán.

Irán, que prometió “una dura venganza en el lugar y el momento adecuados”, convocó al encargado de negocios de Suiza en Teherán, representante de los intereses de Washington. Según el contralmirante Alí Fadavi, comandante en jefe adjunto de la Revolución, Washington transmitió a través de ese diplomático suizo un mensaje: "si quieren vengarse, vénguense proporcionalmente a lo que hemos hecho". Los estadounidenses no están en posición de "decidir" la respuesta de Irán, replicó el responsable militar.

Los restos del comandante serán devueltos a Irán este sábado por la tarde para ser enterrados en su ciudad natal, Kerman. Según informes locales citados por la BBC, su funeral en Irán se celebrará el martes. El guía supremo iraní, Alí Jamenei, y el presidente iraní, Hasán Rohani, que prometieron vengar su muerte, visitaron por separado a la familia Soleimani para presentar sus condolencias. 

El poderoso general iraní Qasim Soleimani murió en el ataque de un dron estadounidense. Foto: AFP.

Yakarta, 12 ago (EFE).- Indonesia anunció este jueves que investigará el trato violento dispensado por las autoridades de Inmigración a un diplomático nigeriano en una calle de Yakarta, lo cual ha provocado la llamada a consultas del embajador indonesio en Nigeria.

Un vídeo que ha causado indignación en las redes sociales muestra cómo tres agentes de Inmigración indonesios inmovilizan al diplomático dentro de un vehículo. Uno de ellos le sujeta el rostro con la mano mientras lo interrogan, y el diplomático grita y se queja de que no puede respirar.

El Departamento de Inmigración justificó este trato alegando la actitud 'poco cooperativa' del diplomático cuando, el pasado 7 de agosto, le pidieron que se identificase en una calle de la capital. Además, lo acusó de golpear a los funcionarios primero, cuando lo conducían a la Oficina de Inmigración.

'Lo que se ve en el vídeo son nuestros funcionarios tratando de evitar que el extranjero nigeriano cometa actos violentos', indicó el Departamento en un comunicado.

El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores nigeriano señaló que se trataba de un 'agente diplomático nigeriano acreditado' en la Embajada de Yakarta, pero no reveló su nombre.

Por su parte, el portavoz de la Cancillería indonesia, Teuku Faizasyah, afirmó que el Ministerio lamentaba el incidente y anunció una investigación por parte del Ministerio de Derechos Humanos.

'Ha sido un incidente aislado y no tiene nada que ver con el compromiso de Indonesia como país anfitrión según las convenciones de Viena sobre relaciones diplomáticas', afirmó en un comunicado.

La disculpa indonesia llegó después de que el Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores nigeriano llamara a consultas al embajador indonesio en Abuja, calificando el incidente como un 'acto egregio de delincuencia internacional por actores de Estado indonesios' y exigiendo 'sanciones apropiadas' contra los funcionarios involucrados.

A man stood in the middle of nothing, resembling a pen poised above a blank paper. After surveying his surroundings, pondering silently, and muttering a few words to himself, he began to speak.

As his words flowed, the void around him transformed into a vibrant scene, with characters materializing as if by magic. In no time, the space brimmed with life, intricate details, and excitement. Each utterance from the man's lips manifested into reality before him, with characters obediently enacting the actions he described and the scenery shifting in the blink of an eye.

Suddenly, an *ahem* pierced through the narrative and disrupted the man’s dialogue.

"Excuse me, but who are you?" Another man, strikingly similar to the first, interjected.

"Wait, **who** are you?"

"Isn't it obvious? I'm the Narrator. And look at the mess you've created!"

"No, I'm the narrator. Not you. Have you hit your head?"

"No, I haven't. I'm quite certain you've stumbled into the wrong story and are meddling with mine."

"This is my story, not yours. Please leave before causing further confusion and disrupting all my hard work."

The initial man glared at the second, almost daring him to challenge the statement. To his surprise, the second man not only spoke but also turned his words into reality around him. Shock quickly turned to anger as the initial man’s efforts were now being undermined and discarded.

Glowering at the interloper, the first man raised his voice, attempting to reclaim control by altering the story. Soon, both men were engaged in a fierce battle of words, each vying for dominance over the narrative, while the characters realized the futility of trying to follow the conflicting instructions.

Growing impatient, the characters demanded a resolution as they had other stories to participate in and needed their compensation.

"Come on, let's move on! We have other stories to be a part of!"

"For heaven's sake, just narrate the story!"

"We don't have all day!"

Ignoring the pleas of the characters, the two men remained steadfast in their quest for supremacy, completely engrossed in wresting control over the story.

Most of the characters gave up and departed for other tales, leaving behind a small group of four characters. One was injured but stable, while the other two needed just one more story before they could return home.

Despite attempts by the injured character to intervene, the ongoing power struggle between the narrators caused the appearance of useful objects to flicker and vanish erratically, making it nearly impossible to grasp them securely.

After what felt like an eternity, a loud popping sound shattered the silence, startling everyone.

"Hey, look! We can eliminate the narrators!" exclaimed one of the characters.

The surviving narrator trembled in fear as he glanced at his deceased counterpart. Struggling to speak, he was met with a shocked reaction from the other characters, who observed the third character holding a gun and the gradual disappearance of the deceased narrator.

"Shall we proceed? We've wasted enough time!" the characters urged.

The surviving narrator cleared his throat and began to speak, but was abruptly interrupted.

"I'm sorry, sir, but are you certain you're in the correct story? I was under the impression that this story belonged to me."

Le Galaxy Fold de Samsung devait être le premier smartphone à écran pliable à être lancé sur le marché. Cependant, des défauts de conception observés sur quelques modèles confiés à la presse américaine ont interrompu cet élan, obligeant le géant coréen à reporter la sortie initialement prévue le 26 avril. 

Il y a peu, DJ Koh, le patron de la division mobile de Samsung, a reconnu un excès de précipitation dans la mise sur le marché du smartphone à écran pliable de la marque. « C'était embarrassant. Je l'ai poussé avant qu'il ne soit prêt », a admis le dirigeant. Il a ajouté : « J'avoue que j'ai raté quelque chose sur le téléphone pliable, mais nous sommes en train de nous rattraper. » 

Selon les informations de Bloomberg, Samsung aurait finalement achevé la refonte du Galaxy Fold. Un des problèmes soulevés lors des premiers tests en conditions réelles concernait la présence d’un film de protection que certains testeurs ont retiré, entraînant immédiatement des défaillances. Le nouveau Galaxy Fold comportera un film protecteur qui s'enroule autour de l'écran, le rendant beaucoup plus difficile à enlever. 

Aucune date de sortie n'a encore été fixée, mais une source anonyme citée dans l’article indique que le constructeur serait en passe de démarrer la production en série. Cependant, même si Samsung semble prêt à lancer la production du Galaxy Fold, Bloomberg prévient qu’il est peu probable qu’il soit mentionné, et encore moins présenté, le 7 août prochain lors du lancement du Galaxy Note 10.

Madrid (AFP)
Europa superó los seis millones de casos conocidos de covid-19 el miércoles, advirtió el Banco Mundial, una pandemia que podría llevar a 115 millones de personas en todo el mundo a caer en la pobreza extrema.
La epidemia está ganando terreno nuevamente en el continente europeo a medida que avanza el otoño, pero también está amenazando a otras regiones como el Caribe, donde hay una "intensa transmisión" del virus, según la Organización Panamericana de la Salud (OPS).
Mientras tanto, el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, quien contrajo la enfermedad la semana pasada y salió del hospital tres días después, ya no presenta síntomas ni fiebre, según su médico en un comunicado.
- Los planes de España -
En total, se han detectado 6,000,940 casos en Europa, de los cuales 237,716 han resultado en muertes, según el recuento de la AFP.
Rusia es el país más afectado en términos de contagios, con poco más de 1.2 millones, mientras que el Reino Unido es el país con más muertes, con 42,445.
En los últimos siete días, el continente ha registrado un 26% más de casos que la semana anterior.
España, uno de los países más afectados, anunció un plan para crear 800,000 empleos a partir de los fondos negociados arduamente en la Unión Europea.
El gobierno socialista de Pedro Sánchez estima que podrá crear estos puestos de trabajo con una inversión de 140,000 millones de euros entre 2021 y 2026, asignada por Bruselas para la recuperación económica.
España tiene a más de 5 millones de ciudadanos bajo fuertes restricciones de movimiento para intentar frenar la segunda ola de la pandemia.
Otros países, como Italia, que hasta ahora han mostrado mejores cifras de contagios y hospitalizaciones, se esfuerzan por no caer en la misma situación.
Roma anunció que el uso de mascarillas será obligatorio en todo el país al aire libre y que el estado de emergencia se extenderá hasta finales de enero.
El presidente francés, Emmanuel Macron, advirtió que ante el avance de la enfermedad, será necesario imponer "más restricciones" en las áreas más afectadas.
- Malabarismos de los gobiernos -
Bruselas siguió el ejemplo de París y cerró restaurantes y bares.
La situación "es extremadamente compleja y tensa" en la capital belga, dijo el presidente de la región, Rudi Vervoort.
La complejidad no solo afecta a la situación sanitaria, sino que también parece contagiar a los gobiernos, que están haciendo malabarismos para imponer nuevas restricciones sin paralizar la economía.
En Escocia, los pubs y cafés de cinco regiones no podrán recibir clientes durante poco más de dos semanas, pero podrán vender bebidas para llevar.
- Estado mayor de Estados Unidos en cuarentena -
El regreso teatral de Trump a la Casa Blanca generó amplias críticas en los medios de comunicación estadounidenses en plena fiebre electoral.
Trump argumenta que como líder no podía mostrar debilidad y ha afirmado que ha retomado el control en la Casa Blanca.
El presidente "no ha tenido fiebre en los últimos cuatro días y no tiene síntomas desde hace 24 horas", explicó su médico, Sean Conley.

Most autonomous driving systems rely primarily on a combination of cameras and lidar for perception, with radar sensors taking a back-seat role. Cen and Newman presented a successful application of a scanning radar sensor to largescale outdoor ego-motion estimation, inspiring a resurgence of research into radar-based perception and navigation systems. Radar, with its longer wavelength, is more robust to precipitation compared to lidar, making it a potential key for enabling self-driving vehicles to operate in adverse weather. The ultimate goal of this research is to match and even surpass the performance of lidar-based algorithms in adverse conditions.

Previous works in radar-based odometry and place recognition have shown significant progress, but they have limitations, such as reliance on handcrafted feature extraction, correlative scan matching, or supervised learning algorithms. While it has been demonstrated that learned features can outperform hand-crafted features, the scalability of correlative scan matching systems to large-scale mapping and localization remains a question. To address these limitations, a new method is proposed, aiming to learn features directly from radar data without the need for groundtruth pose information.

In this work, an unsupervised radar odometry pipeline is presented, approaching the state of the art, as reported on the Oxford Radar RobotCar Dataset.

Throughout history, people have always wondered whether there was ever life on Mars. One photo in particular, capturing a mysterious figure, has sparked intense speculation, bringing us closer than ever to uncovering the potential existence of life on another planet. The topic of "Unmasking the Face on Mars" is a widely discussed subject, with some suggesting it was created by aliens, while others argue it is a natural landform.

In 1976, the Viking 1 spacecraft was orbiting Mars in search of a landing site for its sister ship, Viking 2. During its exploration, Viking 1 stumbled upon an image that seemed to suggest signs of life on Mars, appearing to depict a face, which sparked debates that lasted for years. However, in 1998, the Mars Global Surveyor (MGS) captured a clearer image, revealing that the "Face" was, in fact, a natural landform.

The 1998 image, ten times sharper than the 1976 photo, was released on the JPL website, confirming that the feature was a result of natural geological processes, dispelling the notion of alien involvement. Some, however, argued that the aliens, if they existed, were obscured, as the camera, tasked with capturing the image, had to pierce through the clouds, leading to the mysterious appearance.

SAFETY concerns are being brushed aside at mine sites as workers strive to reach coal production targets and bonuses. Workers are also failing to learn and follow the extensive regulations as they adopt a "bull at a gate" mentality to production. The explosive claims were from Oaky North site safety and health representative Joe Barber at the Queensland Coal Mining Board of Inquiry this week.

Mr Barber told the inquiry he believed workers not knowing the regulations was an issue, and suggested more active training was needed. "They (workers) don't know the regulations. They don't know the Act," Mr Barber said. "I don't know it fully, either. I suppose it's not that they don't really care, but they just - they just - they sometimes go a bit bull at a gate."

Mr Barber said the regulations could be broken down into "major ones that certain people need to know about". As an example, Mr Barber recalled a situation when an electrician turned off a fan without safety oversight in the section in a development panel. "You can't do that, there's that much gas in there," he said. " … He got hauled over the coals for it.

"I witnessed him talking to someone that he didn't really think that he'd done anything wrong. So then I pulled the extraction out of the regs and took it to him and showed him his obligations and said that if I ever found him doing that again, I would personally take him to the SSE. That's where they don't - a young bloke in the industry and just had no regard for it at all and didn't know what was - there was gas build-up in the stubs there."

On being asked "how big a problem" it was, Mr Barber replied: "I think it's a big problem. I don't know whether it's - you can train people. You know, you can give them as much training as you want to, but they've got to - it is a problem. "We've got such a big workforce, and the push to get the coal out, you know, like, 'she'll be right, mate. Let's just keep going'."

Dua Lipa aurait été « vraiment mal à l’aise » lorsqu’elle a été assaillie par des fans hurlants à Mexico. Son équipe de sécurité s’est précipitée à sa rescousse lorsque deux fans se sont précipités sur la superstar du chant – qui aurait une valeur estimée à 16 millions de dollars. Les fans ont été entraînés loin de la pop star, laissant le hitmaker de New Rules libre de la faire s’échapper dans la voiture en attente qui avait été préparée pour elle. Des images inébranlables du moment faisaient le tour des médias sociaux du monde entier après avoir été filmées dans la ville animée samedi.

Un initié a déclaré au Sun: « La nouvelle qu’elle était dans la région s’est répandue et de toute évidence, les gens étaient impatients d’apercevoir Dua. » La source a ajouté: « Mais ça a mal tourné quand deux fans se sont précipités vers elle. Ils ont vraiment couru vers elle et ça avait l’air effrayant. « Dua avait l’air vraiment mal à l’aise. Heureusement, la sécurité était là pour éloigner les gens parce que qui sait ce qui aurait pu arriver. » Le Mirror a contacté les représentants de Dua Lipa pour obtenir de plus amples commentaires.

Il est entendu que Dua Lipa était sur les lieux au Mexique pour travailler sur le tournage d’une nouvelle campagne pour Yves Saint Laurent. Elle a écrit sur Instagram: « Tellement heureuse d’être de retour sur le plateau pour la nouvelle campagne Libre avec mon équipe @yslbeauty. » Le top du classement n’a fait aucune référence à l’incident sur sa plate-forme de médias sociaux.

Dua Lipa a une carrière de haut vol dans le monde du showbiz et sur la scène musicale. La semaine dernière, la star a fait une performance énergique lors de la 63e cérémonie des Grammy Awards, à Los Angeles. Ce fut une grande soirée pour la princesse de la pop, nominée pour six prix. Dua Lipa a remporté le Grammy du meilleur album pop vocal lors de cette soirée éblouissante.

La secrétaire générale sortante de l'OIF, Michaëlle Jean, défend son bilan et affirme avoir "positionné la Francophonie sur l'échiquier multilatéral". Ici, lors du Sommet de 2016 à Madagascar, en compagnie du conseiller fédéral Johann Schneider-Ammann (archives).

Le Canada et le Québec ont annoncé mardi qu'ils ne soutenaient plus la candidature de Michaëlle Jean à la direction de l'Organisation internationale de la Francophonie (OIF) lors du prochain sommet de l'organisation. Elle est actuellement la secrétaire générale sortante.

La Canadienne, née en Haïti, ancienne gouverneure générale et ex-journaliste vedette, sera candidate à sa succession lors du prochain sommet de l'OIF jeudi et vendredi à Erevan. Elle sera opposée à Louise Mushikiwabo, ministre des Affaires étrangères du Rwanda, soutenue par la France et l'Union africaine.

La tradition veut que le choix soit fait par consensus, plutôt que par un vote formel. "Le Canada a décidé de se rallier au consensus, comme c'est la tradition, ça a toujours été la manière de faire, on ne va pas la changer", a déclaré une source gouvernementale à l'AFP. "On a bien vu qu'elle (Michaëlle Jean) n'avait pas les soutiens nécessaires, la suite lui appartient, il faut se rendre à l'évidence."

Consensus favorisé

"Quant au poste de Secrétaire général, le Canada est prêt à se rallier au consensus, conformément à la pratique francophone", a confirmé Jérémy Ghio, porte-parole de la ministre canadienne de la Francophonie, Mélanie Joly, dans un courriel.

Meaningful and succinct names of program entities play a vital role in code understandability. Misleading names in software libraries can confuse developers and cause them to make API misuses, leading to serious defects. During software development, the name of a method can become inconsistent with respect to its intended functionality. The first scenario is that the inconsistency occurs during the coding of a method when a misleading or confusing name is given to the method. In the second scenario, inconsistency occurs during software evolution in which code changes make the method's name and its implementation become inconsistent with one another.

Several approaches were proposed to detect the inconsistency between the methods' names and source code and to suggest an alternative name if such inconsistency occurs. The approaches mainly follow two directions: information retrieval (IR) and machine learning (ML). The idea of IR approaches is that similar methods should have similar names. Thus, they search for the names of methods with similar bodies to suggest for a method with an inconsistent name. The second direction is machine learning (ML). The ML approaches can overcome the key limitation of the IR direction due to its capability of generating a new name. While code2vec generates the method's name based on the paths over the AST of its body, MNire uses the sub-tokens in the program entities' names. Other approaches treat the method name suggestion problem as the extreme summarization from the method's body into a short text.

In this paper, in addition to using the body and interface of the method under study, we leverage a philosophy for this naming problem: "Show Me Your Friends, I'll Tell You Who You Are." That is, to characterize an entity/person, in addition to using its/his/her own properties, one can rely on the interactions of that entity/person with the surrounding and neighboring entities/persons. For the method name suggestion, examining only the content of the current method might be insufficient. The surrounding and interacting methods of a method under study could include the methods that are called within the body of the method (callees) and the methods that are calling the method (callers). The neighboring methods are the ones within the same class as the method (siblings). The information from the enclosing class also provides features for such characterization of a method. The key features from the caller and callee methods, sibling methods, and the enclosing class are used in addition to the features from the internal body and interface of the method to verify the consistency of the method with regard to its name and to suggest a proper method name.

We develop DEEPNAME, a context-based approach for method name consistency checking and suggestion. For the method under study, it extracts features from four contexts: the internal context, the caller and callee contexts, sibling context, and enclosing context. For name suggestion, only the callee methods are used because the callers of the method might not be written yet. We use name features, specifically, the sequences of subtokens from the program entities within each context, instead of AST or PDG. DEEPNAME uses an RNN-based encoder-decoder to combine all the sequences of sub-tokens in the contexts into a sequence of vectors for the method. A convolution layer is used on the vector for the method to classify the given name to be consistent or not. To suggest a name for the given method, we use our vocabulary to map all the generated vectors into the sub-tokens to compose the method name.

We also modify the operations of the aforementioned RNN-based encoder-decoder to integrate the copy mechanism and the novel non-copy mechanism. The copy mechanism helps emphasize the possibility of copying certain sub-tokens from the contexts to the output, i.e., the suggested method name. The non-copy mechanism is designed to determine the possibility of a sub-token that must not be copied to follow the current sub-token in the currently generated method name. We conducted several experiments to evaluate DEEPNAME in method name consistency checking and method name recommending on two large datasets used in prior works with +2M and +14M methods. DEEPNAME outperformed the state-of-the-art approaches in Liu et al. and MNire in recall, precision, and F-score for inconsistency checking and method name suggestion.

The writer picked up his old Moleskine journal, its binding coming undone, and the back cover hanging off. Recently, he had been going through his old stuff from his high school days, looking for things to throw away to make room for new things. Taking a deep breath and preparing himself for the worst, he sat down at his desk and opened the journal.

Inside, he was met with sloppy, smeared handwriting – line after line of nearly indecipherable scrawling text depicting dialogue, setting, and paragraphs. He looked over it with pangs of nostalgia and a touch of embarrassment. This was some of his early work, and it was absolutely horrible. However, it was his work, so he decided to keep it. All these years, it had been tucked away in the back of his closet, waiting for him. Flipping through the pages, memories flooded back of writing it all out, sitting on his bed in his old family home. He was so young back then, so naive.

As he read through everything he had written, he slogged through the awkward love scenes between the main character based on himself and the female character based on his then girlfriend. Their messy breakup had been one of the main reasons he stopped writing the story. It was a lesson learned – never base characters entirely on people you know.

Upon reaching the end, feeling sentimental, he wrote a note on the page where he left off.

Putting down his pen with a smile, he began to close the book when something caught his eye on the last page. Opening it back up, he discovered a message appearing below the one he had just written.

Startled, the writer sat there for a while, contemplating the note that had been written. The handwriting wasn't his, not even close, so it couldn't have been something he had written and somehow missed. He decided to write back, curious to see if there would be another response.

After a brief exchange of messages, the writer finally closed the journal, put it away, and walked into the kitchen. Searching for matches, he found them, returned to the back door, and proceeded to set the journal ablaze in the warm summer evening.

Standing there watching it burn, he felt oddly poetic about the act. Destroying his work also felt like shedding an old part of himself, one he wasn't proud of anymore. As the last of the ashes vanished into the night, he felt rejuvenated, like a phoenix being born anew from the remnants of the past. With a smile, he returned inside, leaving the pile of ash behind, carried away by the wind.

That night, as the writer slept, both he and Daniel, his creation, found peace in the ashes that drifted away, signaling a fresh start for them both.

Safe recovery from planned drops or unexpected falls is one of the most crucial features of animals, aiding in navigating challenging terrain and preventing significant damage from sudden drops. Similarly, a robust landing controller enables the deployment of quadruped robots into harsh environments where supervision is challenging. However, unlike the advancements in quadrupedal locomotion on robotic platforms, there has been limited exploration of how robots manage significant elevation changes or react to falls. Some studies have focused on controlling body orientation during rotation, but they often overlook the necessary reaction force profiles and poses for safe fall recovery.

A common strategy for landing actuated systems is to manage contact point impedances with some additional feedforward reaction forces. Lynch et al. discuss the 'soft landing problem,' exploring control methods to minimize foot penetration depth during a fall with prismatic actuation, but the discussion is limited to single impacts without rigid contacts. Similar to quadrupeds, studies have explored actuated landing gear for rotorcraft, aiming to find optimal impedances to mitigate impacts, but they only consider horizontal landings. Although previous research has demonstrated the effectiveness of impedance control, it often fails to capture the detailed motions involved in landing, such as landing posture, reaction force profile, contact location, and sequence. Without considering these complexities, the robot hardware's full potential to achieve smooth, safe landings cannot be realized.

For motion planning, which involves multiple, complex decision processes, trajectory optimization methods have been widely used. Automatic contact sequence selection is crucial, as feasible contact sequences can vary greatly, depending on the body's orientation at touchdown, and the timing is especially critical at higher velocities. Previous work, such as that of Winkler et al., parameterizes the gait to optimize contact schedule timing, but the complexity of the formulation poses challenges for real-time applications.

The study of vectorial (or multi-output) Boolean functions, denoted as (n, m)-functions mapping from \( F_2^n \) to \( F_2^m \), plays a pivotal role in the design of block ciphers in cryptography. These functions, especially when used in symmetric cryptography, are referred to as substitution boxes (S-boxes), which are fundamental components of block ciphers. Block ciphers, being essential to the security of modern communication, rely heavily on these functions for secure substitutions. The design and analysis of block ciphers have reached a level of maturity, with the current state of knowledge considering the construction of secure block ciphers largely a solved problem. For more in-depth information, the reader is directed to consult recent literature, such as the book referenced as [8].

Among vectorial Boolean functions, particular attention is given to (n, n)-vectorial functions that are bijective, as they are highly valued in symmetric cryptography. In typical block cipher operations, a permutation is used as an S-box during encryption, and its compositional inverse is utilized during decryption. Many block ciphers employ permutations \( F \) defined over the finite field \( F_2^n \) to map onto itself. The differential uniformity \( \delta_F \) of a permutation \( F \), when used as an S-box, is critical as it measures the block cipher's resistance against differential cryptanalysis. This is defined as \( \delta_F = \max_{a,b \in F_2^n, a \neq 0} \text{DDT}_F(a, b) \), where \(\text{DDT}_F(a, b) = \#\{x \in F_2^n, F(x + a) + F(x) = b\}\). The smaller the value \( \delta_F \), the better the resistance of the function against differential attacks, with optimal functions, known as almost perfect nonlinear (APN), satisfying \( \delta_F = 2 \).

The boomerang attack, introduced by Wagner in 1999, is another important cryptanalytical technique that extends differential cryptanalysis, particularly useful when no significant differential probability exists for the entire cipher. The resistance of a function to this attack is measured by the boomerang uniformity \( \beta_F \), a concept introduced by Boura and Canteaut [3]. The smaller the value \( \beta_F \), the stronger the function's resistance to the boomerang attack, with the optimal value being 2. However, constructing permutation functions with a boomerang uniformity of 2 is challenging. For binary fields \( F_2^n \), functions with \( \beta_F = 2 \), i.e., APN functions, exhibit the best resistance.

For odd values of \( n \), families of APN permutations are known. Conversely, for even \( n \), APN permutations are scarce. Notably, no APN permutation exists for \( n = 4 \), and up to some equivalence, only one example over \( F_2^6 \) is known [4]. These known APN permutations fall into four affine equivalence classes [8]. This scarcity leads researchers to focus on permutations with boomerang uniformity 4, given the difficulty of finding APN permutations in even dimensions—a challenge known as the Big APN Problem. Despite their maximal resistance to differential and boomerang attacks, APN permutations are difficult to construct.

Power functions, particularly monomial functions over finite fields of characteristic 2, have been extensively studied due to their simple algebraic form and low implementation cost in hardware. This algebraic structure simplifies the analysis of their differential properties. There are few known families of non-APN power permutations over \( F_2^n \) with known boomerang spectra, summarized in Table 1.

Recently, Budaghyan et al. [6] investigated the differential spectrum of power functions \( F(X) = X^d \) for certain \( d \) over \( F_2^{kn} \). This class includes well-known functions as special cases, such as the inverse function for \( n = 1 \) and the Dobbertin power permutation for \( k = 5 \).

The traditional process of radiation therapy is typically divided into two phases: the planning phase and the treatment phase. The treatment phase generally comprises multiple sessions where malignant tissue is exposed to radiation. During the planning phase, a CT scan is conducted on the patient, and the results are used to determine the specific area that will be targeted in the subsequent radiation sessions. It is crucial that the patient's position during the radiation sessions matches the position during the planning phase.

With the advent of head-mounted displays like the Microsoft HoloLens, Augmented Reality (AR) has gained momentum in medical research, particularly in surgical applications such as training and intervention. Medical experts have expressed overwhelmingly positive opinions about these systems. However, the use of AR to guide patient positioning is so rare that recent literature reviews do not mention any related work. AR for patient positioning could potentially assist operators by providing interactive, real-time visualization of the actual patient position compared to the desired position.

In the past decade, there has been an increase in the use of consumer-level depth or RGB-Depth (RGB-D) cameras, such as the Microsoft Kinect, in AR applications. These sensors are affordable and provide a real-time depth map of the scene along with a corresponding color image, offering a dense, real-time geometrical representation of the scene rather than the sparse pose estimation possible with fiducial markers. Concurrently, research on fiducial planar markers has led to the development of fast, robust, and inexpensive methods for precise camera pose tracking, requiring only a color camera and printed markers. Detectors like ArUco offer significant advantages over traditional infrared-based markers.

Leveraging these recent technologies, this paper proposes a novel method for assisted patient positioning that simultaneously tracks both the patient and the treatment environment. Our system can render a virtual overlay of the patient's current pose and the desired pose using a freely moving RGB-D camera, enabling mobile interactive AR to guide patient positioning. To our knowledge, this is the first method capable of such an operation. Additionally, our approach can be used for patient monitoring by fixing the RGB-D camera in a stationary position directed at the patient, although this does not utilize the full potential of our method, which allows the camera to move freely.

Our innovative RGB-D-based, model-based object tracking algorithm is both accurate and fast without requiring general-purpose GPU computing on a dedicated GPU, relying solely on the CPU. This makes our method usable on a wide range of hardware, increasing accessibility and cost-effectiveness.

Pour renforcer cet aspect, le Hori Wireless Racing Wheel est proposé, un peu plus cher mais sans les câbles encombrants. Faute de version pour la Xbox One, nous avons pour l’heure testé la déclinaison APEX, sur PC et PS4.

### Conception et qualité de fabrication

Les habitués des versions filaires de l’APEX ou de l’Overdrive ne seront pas dépaysés. Le Wireless RWA en est une copie presque conforme. L’ouverture du carton révèle d’abord le bloc volant, impressionnant par le niveau de finition de la roue. Bien sûr, à ce prix, il ne faut pas espérer du cuir ou un matériau équivalent, mais le caoutchouc qui recouvre la roue est d’excellente qualité. Il assure une bonne prise en main sans provoquer de transpiration excessive. Rapidement, on regrette son manque de résistance, surtout si l'on est habitué à des volants haut de gamme.

Si la roue est un peu "lâche", ce n’est pas surprenant : le Wireless RWA n’intègre pas de retour de force. À ce tarif, il aurait été difficile de proposer quelque chose de convaincant. On apprécie, en revanche, les multiples commandes disponibles : quatorze boutons, une croix directionnelle et deux palettes au dos de la roue. Ces dernières sont réactives, mais ne semblent pas très robustes, elles font "toc". Les boutons sont peu bruyants et réactifs, tandis que la croix marque bien les directions, sans nécessiter de force excessive.

À l’arrière du volant, on trouve une connectique réduite : une prise RJ11 pour connecter le pédalier et une prise microUSB pour recharger l’appareil. Sous le bloc, on accède aux deux systèmes de fixation. D’un côté, une "mâchoire" pour fixer le volant au bureau et de l’autre, cinq ventouses pour stabiliser la base sur la surface de votre choix.

A Professor of Plant Breeding and Genetics, Prof. Olusola Kehinde, delivered the Federal University of Agriculture, Abeokuta's 70th Inaugural Lecture at the varsity's Oluwafemi Balogun Ceremonial Building. His lecture, titled "From Generation to Generation: Plant Genetics Diversity, Continuity and Discontinuity," emphasized the critical need for sustained efforts to address the negative impacts of climate change on food security at the national and local levels.

During his lecture, Prof. Kehinde cautioned the Federal Government against neglecting the global issue of climate change, warning that such inaction could lead to food insecurity and famine in the country. He stressed the importance of bridging the gap between university researchers and scientists at the National Research Institute to enhance research outputs in the agricultural value chain, ultimately ensuring food security in Nigeria.

As the Deputy Vice-Chancellor (Development) at FUNAAB, Prof. Kehinde highlighted the necessity of adequate funding and sustained efforts for exploring, collecting, characterizing, and conserving plant genetic resources in Nigeria. He called for enhanced collaboration and synergy between researchers and scientists to conduct demand-driven, problem-solving research that justifies their existence. The professor emphasized the need for federal and state governments to demonstrate sincere commitment by increasing funding for research activities in universities and research institutes.

Additionally, Prof. Kehinde urged relevant authorities and agencies to regularly review national legislation supporting the conservation and utilization of plant genetic resources.

I believe that driverless cars should not be developed. While they may appear promising initially, the drawbacks of owning one of these vehicles are substantial. To start with, they would be exorbitantly expensive to manufacture and purchase, with the delicate sensors they rely on being prone to damage or malfunction. Moreover, the potential for these vehicles to be vulnerable to hacking, leading to malicious tampering that could result in accidents, is concerning. The possibility of a malfunction causing harm to a driver, passenger, or pedestrian further underscores the significant risks associated with these vehicles.

Even if these vehicles were to become more widely available, they would likely face continuous scrutiny and criticism, with people inevitably discovering flaws or finding ways to circumvent the safety features. For instance, pressure sensors could be implemented to ensure the car only operates when the driver's hands are on the steering wheel, but individuals could easily bypass this by, for example, wrapping the wheel with tape, potentially causing accidents. These factors, among others, lead me to the conclusion that the production and sale of driverless cars should be avoided.

Alzheimer's Disease (AD) is a type of dementia that is a progressive neurodegenerative disease affecting cognitive function, including language processing. One of the most significant language-related changes in individuals with AD is a decline in their lexicon, referring to the vocabulary and words they use to communicate. The loss of lexicon can make it challenging for individuals with dementia to express themselves clearly and understand others. Early detection of dementia is crucial for timely and appropriate treatment and improving patient outcomes. In recent years, there has been growing interest in using machine learning with different linguistic features to detect AD at an early stage, offering advantages such as being less intrusive, having minimal side effects, and being cost-effective.

One promising approach is using lexical features, linguistic elements related to vocabulary and word usage, in screening for AD through automated analysis of transcribed speech. While previous studies have shown promise in using lexical features to detect AD, there are gaps in understanding the impact of AD on lexicon processing. Existing studies often rely on a small number of lexical features, leading to limitations in generalizability and comparability of findings across studies.

To address these limitations, this study covers 99 lexical features, including some used in previous dementia studies like the Brunet index and Type Token Ratio (TTR), along with new features such as sentiment analysis, Text Focus, and knowledge depth. This paper aims to study the impact of dementia on a wide range of lexical complexity measures and demonstrate how these features, when combined, can aid in dementia detection using written and transcribed spoken linguistic production. By evaluating factors like the optimal set of features, input size, and model generalization, the study seeks to identify effective combinations for AD classification.

The paper is organized as follows: Section 2 provides a survey of relevant works on the impact of dementia on lexicon and using machine learning for dementia detection. Section 3 presents the methodology and dataset. Section 4 details the lexical features adopted in the study and their Anova stats. Section 5 covers machine learning experiments and results. Finally, the conclusion and future work will be discussed in Section 6.

On attendait de voir si Shy'm serait de la partie à Roland-Garros pour assister au match de son compagnon Benoît Paire contre le rouleau compresseur Rafael Nadal au premier tour du tournoi parisien. Elle y était. Si le tennisman français de 30 ans savait que la mission de battre le champion serait difficile, voire impossible, il a au moins pu compter sur le soutien de son clan. 

Ne pouvant que constater la rapide défaite de sa moitié sur le court Suzanne-Lenglen (6-1, 6-4, 6-1 en 1 heure et 52 minutes), Shy'm a affiché une toute nouvelle tête. Dans un petit top rouge à fines bretelles, les oreilles parées de larges créoles argentées, la chanteuse de 31 ans n'arborait plus de longues tresses mais une coiffure bien plus classique. Dès le 28 mai, la jeune artiste dévoilait sa nouvelle coupe sur Instagram, de façon artistique comme elle a pris l'habitude de le faire.

Fini le blond platine, qui avait divisé ses fans, bye bye les longues tresses qui les avaient pourtant beaucoup charmés, Shy'm est revenue à un look capillaire moins excentrique. L'ancienne candidate et jurée de Danse avec les stars est de retour au brun avec une coupe courte qu'elle semble décidée à laisser pousser. Jusqu'à sa prochaine folie... Quoi qu'il en soit, ses "shimisoldiers" aiment cette beauté sans artifice !

Des bulles déferlant en douceur sur son visage, Shy'm lève délicatement la tête pour les voir la caresser et éclater pour certaines. La chanteuse a récidivé le lendemain. Dans les rues de Paris, en route pour la Porte d'Auteuil, elle s'est affichée en noir et blanc, en pleine conversation téléphonique.

Le 23 décembre 2020, des volontaires se sont mobilisés pour une battue afin de retrouver Delphine Jubillar, disparue dans la nuit du 15 au 16 décembre à Cagnac-les-Mines, dans le Tarn. Les participants, dont le mari de la disparue, se sont rassemblés en nombre, bien au-delà des prévisions, sur un terrain de sport de la ville minière. Ils ont été organisés en petits groupes pour fouiller les environs.

Au cours de cette battue citoyenne, un couteau, un portable et des chaussettes ont été découverts, selon le lieutenant-colonel Thierry Blondet, numéro deux des gendarmes du Tarn. Malgré la quantité d'objets trouvés, il appelle à la prudence en attendant leur examen. Delphine Jubillar, une femme mince aux longs cheveux bruns, travaillait dans une clinique d'Albi et était vêtue d'une doudoune blanche au moment de sa disparition.

Les recherches sont menées dans le cadre d'une enquête pour "disparition inquiétante", mais une piste criminelle n'est pas écartée. Une information judiciaire pourrait être ouverte prochainement. Les participants à la battue expriment leur espoir de retrouver Delphine avant les fêtes, pour le bien de ses enfants et de sa famille, dans une atmosphère d'incertitude difficile à supporter.

Des citoyens de divers horizons se sont joints à la battue par solidarité envers la disparue et ses proches. Malgré la difficulté des recherches dans les bois et les reliefs de la région, ils restent mobilisés. La journée se conclut avec une seconde battue citoyenne démarrant à 14h00.

Stéphane Ciccione, directeur de Kélonia, l'observatoire et centre de soins des tortues marines à La Réunion, tire la sonnette d'alarme sur la situation préoccupante des tortues. En effet, selon les dernières statistiques, 95% des tortues prises en charge par Kélonia en 2017 ont ingéré du plastique, soit une hausse significative par rapport aux 30% enregistrés en 2010.

Cette évolution alarmante est soulignée par le directeur, qui met en lumière la quantité croissante de déchets plastiques retrouvés dans le système digestif de chaque tortue marine. Des objets tels que des bouchons, des fourchettes, des sacs plastiques, des cordages, des hameçons et autres morceaux de plastique sont régulièrement découverts.

Pour Stéphane Ciccione, ces chiffres sont inquiétants, car ils témoignent de l'état de santé préoccupant de l'océan. En tant qu'espèces parapluies, les tortues marines sont des indicateurs fiables de la santé des écosystèmes marins. L'augmentation du nombre de tortues affectées par l'ingestion de plastique est révélatrice des problèmes environnementaux qui sévissent dans les océans.

En outre, la pollution plastique menace directement la reproduction des tortues, comme en témoigne une vidéo poignante tournée sur une plage polluée en Australie. À La Réunion, les déchets charriés par les ravines finissent souvent dans la mer, mettant en péril les habitats des tortues marines et entravant le cycle de reproduction de l'espèce.

Face à cette situation critique, Stéphane Ciccione appelle à une prise de conscience collective et à des actions concrètes. Il encourage la réduction de la consommation de plastique, le tri sélectif des déchets, et la sensibilisation de la population à travers des initiatives éducatives, notamment auprès des écoliers.

En conclusion, le directeur de Kélonia insiste sur l'importance de l'éducation et de l'engagement de chacun pour préserver l'environnement et garantir un avenir plus sain aux tortues marines. Les efforts conjugués de tous, des autorités locales aux citoyens, sont indispensables pour lutter contre la pollution plastique et assurer la survie de ces espèces emblématiques.

À 72 ans, le producteur Dick Wolf n'a jamais semblé aussi en forme. Aux États-Unis, six de ses séries sont encore à l'antenne, perpétuant sa réputation de stakhanoviste du travail qui lui colle à la peau depuis une trentaine d'années. S'il débute comme scénariste sur Deux Flics à Miami dans les années 80, c'est en créant la série New York, police judiciaire en 1990 qu'il se fait un nom. Sa formule ? Des enquêtes policières carrées qui laissent peu de place à la vie privée de ses personnages et décrivent de manière aussi réaliste que possible les systèmes policier et judiciaire américains.

Un immense succès qui donnera lieu à maintes séries dérivées, dont sa plus célèbre, New York, unité spéciale, est encore active après vingt ans d'existence. En 2013, il lance une nouvelle franchise se déroulant à Chicago avec des séries suivant le quotidien de pompiers (Chicago Fire), de flics (Chicago PD), de médecins (Chicago Med) et d'avocats (Chicago Justice). Nouveau jackpot ! Sa dernière production, FBI, lancée en 2018, suit les enquêtes d'agents fédéraux et a été confirmée pour une saison 2 par la chaîne CBS. M6 l'a achetée. Dick Wolf est éternel.

À l'honneur sur TF1 avec New York, unité spéciale, lundi 4 mars à 23 h et sur CStar avec Chicago Fire, diffusée le dimanche 3 mars à 21 h, le producteur Dick Wolf est plus actif que jamais.

Online marketplaces like eBay and Amazon rely heavily on the connection between sellers and buyers. These platforms handle millions of daily transactions, which inevitably leads to conflicts ranging from unreceived packages to discrepancies between the product received and expected. Typically, disputes are resolved through direct communication between the buyer and seller, but when an agreement cannot be reached, the marketplace platform steps in with a human arbitrator to examine and resolve the case. This process is critical for maintaining user trust and addressing the interests of both parties. However, as the volume of transactions increases, the workload for manual arbitrators becomes a significant challenge.

To address this, automating the arbitration process is essential. While simple automated rules, such as "if tracking information shows that the item has not arrived, and the seller does not respond, the buyer wins the case," are commonly used, they often fall short. This is because many cases require a nuanced approach that is difficult to capture through rigid rule-based systems. Misunderstandings or missing information may necessitate examining buyer and seller data and their correspondence. For instance, in cases with fraud concerns, it’s important for an arbitrator to inspect the history of both the buyer and the seller for previous suspicious behavior. Additionally, understanding the natural language used by both parties is crucial to fully grasp their claims, and textual messages can provide clarity where other data, like shipping or tracking information, might be ambiguous.

To enhance decision-making, we propose supporting human arbitrators with a model that predicts the final resolution of disputes. We've compiled a large dataset containing features related to claims, transactions, sellers, buyers, and textual communication. Seller and buyer features include prior behavior on the site, demographic data, general priors, and transaction-specific priors. By leveraging this data to predict outcomes, we aim to offer human arbitrators an initial approximation of the dispute's resolution, thereby saving manpower and managing the growing volume of transactions and disagreements.

To the best of our knowledge, this is the first comprehensive study focused on dispute analysis and automatic resolution in e-commerce. Our contributions in this paper include the following:
- We collected and analyzed a dataset of disputes between buyers and sellers on an e-commerce platform, identifying interesting correlations and properties (Section 5).
- We trained models to predict dispute outcomes, developing a classifier with an AUC of 0.94, precision of 89%, and recall of 88% (Section 6).
- We describe the model results and conduct ablation studies to evaluate feature importance, discovering that integrating various data aspects is vital for performance, as no single feature set suffices for accurate classification. We also analyze and characterize model errors (Section 7).
- We introduced an interpretability module to our model, helping users understand the reasoning behind specific predicted decisions. This includes a feature importance component that explains the contribution of different features to the prediction and a textual feature interpretation component that highlights predictive tokens.
- We examined the effect of disputes on users, both during and after the dispute process.

NASA's mission to explore Mars with the global surveyor project gained traction, driven partly by the curiosity of taxpayers. Despite skepticism from some scientists about finding evidence of alien artifacts on Mars, capturing images of landmarks such as Cydonia, including the enigmatic face formation, became a significant milestone for NASA.

As NASA unveiled images captured by its spacecraft, featuring the renowned face on Mars in Cydonia, it sparked public intrigue and fascination. The distinctive rock formation stood out prominently in the photographs and quickly became a cultural icon and subject of popular culture references.

Upon closer inspection in 2001 using advanced imaging technology on board the Marz Global Surveyor spacecraft, new details emerged about the face landmark on Mars. The higher resolution images provided clearer insights into the structure and composition of these intriguing land formations.

While theories about alien intervention or manipulation persist among conspiracy theorists and enthusiasts, most people regard these claims with skepticism. The allure of exploring uncharted territories like Mars continues to captivate imaginations worldwide, sparking discussions about what lies beyond our own planet.

In conclusion, while some may entertain notions of extraterrestrial involvement in creating these peculiar landforms on Mars like the face at Cydonia, scientific exploration remains grounded in evidence-based inquiry.

Las entidades estarán obligadas a devolver las cláusulas suelo de las hipotecas que ya han sido canceladas. De Guindos defiende el sistema hipotecario actual, aunque reconoce que se pueden hacer mejoras que ya han comenzado a negociarse con los grupos políticos.
El Consejo de Ministros ha aprobado el real decreto de medidas urgentes de protección de los consumidores en relación a las cláusulas suelo indebidas. Establece un procedimiento extrajudicial para resolver las reclamaciones de los consumidores afectados, que según el ministro de Economía, Luis de Guindos, son alrededor de 1,5 millones de clientes. Esta información se confirmó durante la rueda de prensa posterior al Consejo de Ministros. Además, los bancos también deberán devolver el dinero correspondiente a las cláusulas suelo abusivas de las hipotecas que ya han vencido.
El procedimiento será obligatorio para el banco, el cual tendrá tres meses para llegar a un acuerdo y resolver las reclamaciones. Aunque siempre está disponible la opción de recurrir a la vía judicial, se busca evitar el colapso de los tribunales y permitir que todo el proceso se realice con las garantías adecuadas para el consumidor, según indicó De Guindos. Además, se mencionó que esta norma se ha consensuado con el PSOE, Ciudadanos, el PNV y Coalición Canaria, pero no fue posible llegar a un acuerdo con el resto de formaciones políticas.
Para las entidades, será obligatorio poner en marcha en un plazo máximo de un mes, las medidas necesarias para cumplir con el procedimiento.

Hoy recorremos una España feliz en un año tan difícil por la pandemia. Y esa alegría se refleja en los números que algunos ya custodian como si fueran un tesoro. El 72.897 es el primer premio de la lotería de Navidad y el 6.095 el segundo.

Además de estos dos grandes premios, hay otros números agraciados que dejan historias de felicidad por toda España. Alcañiz, un pueblo de Teruel, ha repartido uno de los quintos premios, en concreto el número 49.760, distribuyendo 10 millones de euros. Coincide que el año pasado ya tocó el Gordo en la residencia de mayores, repartiendo 12 millones de euros entre los residentes, sus familias y los trabajadores del centro. Así lo recordaba hoy el alcalde de Alcañiz, Ignacio Urquizu: “Hace unos años también nos tocó un premio similar, a través de una asociación, que fue un club de balonmano o voleibol, y la verdad es que de repente nos toca a todos porque Alcañiz es una ciudad de servicios. Casi todo es pequeño comercio, y esas compras que a veces no se hacen por falta de capacidad, ahora se convierten en mejores regalos, y al final nos beneficia a todos”.

La suerte no terminó ahí. Durante la pandemia, no se ha registrado ni un solo caso de COVID en la residencia. Y hoy, aún más celebraciones: un quinto premio para el pueblo. Ignacio Urquizu, alcalde de Alcañiz, comentó: “La gente fue muy disciplinada, pudimos superar bastante bien el confinamiento. Aunque murieron personas y hubo contagios, no fue como en otras grandes ciudades”.

Hoy, la alegría se reparte por toda España, a dos días de la celebración de la Nochebuena. ¿Sabemos ya cómo será el plan de Navidad? Varias comunidades autónomas siguen actualizándolo. En el caso de Castilla-La Mancha, mantienen las reuniones familiares, las cenas y comidas en casa con un máximo de 10 personas, aunque adelantan el toque de queda a las doce y media. Al final, habrá muchas navidades diferentes, pese a lo que anunció el ministro Illa. Comunidades como Valencia solo permitirán la entrada de residentes, mientras que otras, como Murcia y Castilla y León, no admitirán allegados.

Have you ever pondered what lies beyond our planet Earth? There is so much more out there than we currently comprehend. The universe remains a profound mystery. In the article "The Challenge of Exploring Venus," the author delves into the enigmatic nature of the planet Venus. Venus exceeds our current perceptions—it is not merely an ordinary planet, but holds complexities beyond our imagination. Due to NASA's lack of comprehensive information, there may be potential threats on Venus, as mentioned in Paragraph 2.

Unveiling the mysteries of Venus might prove to be more challenging than initially anticipated by NASA. Initially, acquiring materials suitable for surviving in Venus' harsh environment poses a significant obstacle. Building and ensuring the functionality of a spacecraft requires specific resources. Moreover, thorough training is imperative for individuals undertaking this perilous journey. While embarking on this mission will undoubtedly present challenges, it holds promise for NASA in unlocking essential insights about Venus.

The endeavor also comes with substantial costs—the development of specialized suits capable of withstanding extreme heat entails significant expenses. Similarly, constructing a spacecraft resistant to intense temperatures incurs high costs as well as advanced technology investments essential for mission success—an endeavor requiring extensive time and financial commitment.

Given NASA's limited knowledge about Venus, selecting individuals possessing intelligence and composure becomes crucial since navigating unanticipated scenarios demands both competence and resilience. Furthermore, venturing into uncharted territory like Venus may unveil unprecedented discoveries such as unknown creatures or objects—a scenario necessitating exceptional communication among crew members aboard the spacecraft aligned with statements made in Paragraph 4 detailing astronomers' fascination with discovering potentially Earth-like attributes on Venus.

Parkinson's disease (PD) is a neurological condition that primarily affects the elderly and impacts nearly 1% of the global population. The disease is characterized by a decrease in dopamine production due to the death of cells in the substantia nigra region of the brain. The progression of PD is marked by cognitive and behavioral symptoms, including personality changes, memory issues, and emotional dysregulation. Mobility problems also worsen over time. Early diagnosis is crucial for implementing effective treatment strategies to slow cognitive decline and manage symptoms.

Clinicians diagnose PD by assessing symptoms such as slow movement, stiffness, tremors, and coordination difficulties. However, the presentation and progression of symptoms can vary among individuals. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) has been instrumental in diagnosing PD and distinguishing it from other neurological conditions for the past three decades. Additionally, MRI is utilized in clinical trials to evaluate treatment efficacy.

Various studies have explored methods to detect PD using different data types, including physiological signals like speech, EEG, gait analysis, handwriting, and neuroimaging. Neuroimaging analysis has proven successful in developing sophisticated diagnostic techniques for PD. Constructing quantitative models of PD progression using patient data, including neuroimaging and clinical measures, is essential for accurate diagnosis and personalized treatment to improve symptom management and develop new therapies.

Understanding the progression of PD is crucial for reducing heterogeneity in clinical trials, monitoring treatment outcomes, and identifying new therapeutic targets. This knowledge also provides valuable insights into the degeneration mechanism of PD. This paper proposes a methodology for classifying PD stages and determining the disease progression using AI tools and the Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative (PPMI) dataset. Deep neural network models trained on MRI images and patient data from follow-up visits aim to predict PD severity using the Hoehn and Yahr (H&Y) scale.

The paper details the data processing techniques, augmentation methods, and neural network models employed in the study. The experimental neural network utilizes a 3D-CNN for image feature extraction and incorporates recurrent layers like GRU or LSTM for analyzing temporal data. The study outlines the works related to the research, the PPMI dataset usage, data processing techniques, neural network models, and discusses the results. Future directions for this research are also highlighted in the concluding section.

Simultaneous Neural Machine Translation (SNMT) tackles the challenge of real-time interpretation in machine translation. To achieve live translation, an SNMT model switches between reading the source sequence and writing the target sequence using a fixed or adaptive policy. Streaming SNMT models can only add tokens to a partial translation as more source tokens become available, with no option to revise the existing partial translation. A common application is conversational speech translation, where target tokens need to be added to the ongoing output.

For specific applications like live video captioning, the limitation of not revising the existing translation is overly confining. Given that we can revise the previous translation by re-translating each successive source prefix, a re-translation-based strategy becomes a feasible option. This strategy is not bound to preserving the previous translation, leading to higher translation quality. The current re-translation approaches, such as Equal contribution based on autoregressive sequence generation models (ReTA), sequentially generate target tokens in the partial translation. As the source sequence lengthens, the multiple re-translations in ReTA models with sequential generation cause a delay, resulting in the translation falling out of sync with the input stream. Moreover, due to the substantial number of inference operations involved, ReTA models are not ideal for resource-constrained devices.

In this study, we develop a re-translation-based simultaneous translation system using non-autoregressive sequence generation models to lower the computational cost during inference. The proposed system generates target tokens in parallel when new source information is received, reducing the number of inference operations needed for the final translation. To evaluate the effectiveness of our approach, we compare it with the re-translation-based autoregressive (ReTA) (Arivazhagan et al. 2020b) and Wait-k (Ma et al. 2019) models. Our experiments demonstrate that our model outperforms the ReTA and Wait-k models significantly in terms of computation time while upholding the superior translation quality property of re-translation over streaming-based methods.

Revising the existing output in re-translation-based approaches may introduce textual instability. Previous studies introduced a stability metric, Normalized Erasure (NE) (Arivazhagan et al. 2020b), to measure this instability. However, NE only focuses on the initial point of divergence between pairs of translations and does not fully quantify the user's experience of textual instability. In this research, we propose a new stability metric, Normalized Click-N-Edit (NCNE), which better captures textual instabilities by considering the number of insertions, deletions, and replacements in a pair of translations.

The main contributions of our work are as follows:
- We introduce a re-translation-based simultaneous system to reduce the lengthy inference time of existing re-translation approaches.
- We propose a new stability metric, Normalized Click-N-Edit, which is more sensitive to translation flickers compared to the existing metric, Normalized Erasure.
- We conduct multiple experiments on simultaneous text-to-text translation tasks and demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approach.

Harris Grill, a well-known Pittsburgh eatery with locations in Downtown and Shadyside, has announced that it is permanently closing its Fourth Avenue location in Downtown Pittsburgh. The last day of service at this location will be Thursday, December 30.

In a press release, the Harris Grill team cited struggles to recover from the COVID-19 pandemic as the reason behind the closure. "The Harris Grill 4th Avenue has struggled to remain open since the Coronavirus pandemic descended in March of 2020," the release stated. "With the loss of the downtown business office population and cancellation of cultural trust activities, sales have been down 75%." While some business has returned, the restaurant noted that "there is simply not enough continuing and regular foot traffic for the number of restaurants currently attempting to operate downtown."

The decision by some Downtown offices to delay or modify their return to in-person work has also impacted Harris Grill's cash flow issues. Furthermore, Allegheny County is still experiencing a high number of COVID-19 daily cases, and officials expect the situation to worsen as the Omicron variant spreads and people travel and socialize for the winter holidays.

En menos de 15 minutos, uno de los múltiples controles policiales en la zona de calle Gianelli de Anacleto Medina resultó en un oficial lesionado, dos vehículos dañados por piedras, un barrio alterado y un detenido.

El martes a las 18 horas, la Policía informó que se produjo el primer altercado durante el operativo de saturación en calle Gianelli. Un joven en motocicleta intentó evitar el control y, una vez alcanzado, se descubrió que no tenía la documentación necesaria para respaldar el vehículo.

En ese momento, el motociclista se negó a entregar la moto para ser secuestrada y se sentó en ella. La situación se agravó cuando el joven golpeó a un sargento, lo que provocó que escapara e ingresara a una casa cercana.

La tensión aumentó hasta tal punto que numerosos vecinos tomaron partido por el motociclista. Cerca de 30 personas comenzaron a agredir a los agentes y a los vehículos policiales, utilizando piedras, ladrillos y palos para tratar de hacer retroceder a los policías.

في خطوة تنذر بمواجهة مباشرة مع عملاق التواصل الاجتماعي فيسبوك، يخطط التطبيق الصيني العملاق "تيك توك" لدخول مجال التجارة الإلكترونية في الولايات المتحدة. وذكرت صحيفة "فاينانشال تايمز" البريطانية أن الشبكة الاجتماعية لمشاركة الفيديو والمملوكة لشركة "بايت دانس" الصينية، قدمت العديد من الميزات الجديدة للمعلنين، تتضمن إحداها أداة تسوق عبر الإنترنت تتيح للمستخدمين مشاركة روابط المنتجات وكسب العمولات تلقائيًا من أي عملية بيع، وتأمل في إطلاق هذه الميزات عام 2021.

وتشير التقارير إلى أن "تيك توك" يهدف أيضًا إلى إطلاق نسخة محمولة لقناة تسوق تلفزيونية، حيث سيتمكن المستخدمون من إتمام عمليات الشراء بسهولة بعد مشاهدة المنتجات التي يعرضها مؤثرو "تيك توك". ويبدو أن هذه الخطوة ستعزز المنافسة مع "فيسبوك"، الذي أعلن في وقت سابق عن شراكة مع منصة التجارة الإلكترونية "Shopify" الكندية.

Marseille (AFP) - Le président nationaliste de l'Assemblée de Corse, Jean-Guy Talamoni, a annoncé dimanche qu'il refuserait de rencontrer le Premier ministre le 2 juillet pour conclure un cycle de réunions sur l'avenir de l'île, dénonçant le "mépris" du gouvernement.

Dans une lettre adressée à Édouard Philippe, l'indépendantiste Jean-Guy Talamoni a écrit : "À défaut d'un signal fort, public - peu probable en l'état - indiquant que Paris entend rompre avec (sa) politique méprisante pour négocier loyalement avec la Corse, je ne me rendrai pas" à cette rencontre censée "conclure" ce cycle de réunions.

Le président de l'Assemblée insulaire avait déjà boycotté des visites ministérielles et exprimé à plusieurs reprises sa déception quant au dialogue ouvert avec le gouvernement, qui prévoit de dédier un article à la Corse dans sa réforme constitutionnelle. Les nationalistes au pouvoir dans l'île ont notamment été déçus par une visite en mars d'Emmanuel Macron, qui avait écarté plusieurs de leurs revendications.

Convié le 2 juillet et directement compétent pour intervenir dans ces discussions, le chef de l'exécutif corse, Gilles Simeoni, a refusé de commenter cette décision. Il décidera de faire le déplacement ou non "après avoir consulté mon conseil exécutif et les deux groupes de la majorité territoriale", les autonomistes dont il est issu, et les nationalistes de M. Talamoni, a-t-il déclaré à l'AFP.

Le dialogue avec le gouvernement a tourné court, regrette M. Talamoni, deux jours avant le démarrage de l'examen en commission à l'Assemblée du projet de loi constitutionnel : "Nos différentes demandes ont été traitées par le mépris et (...) Paris a fait ce qu'il avait déjà décidé de faire avant même l'ouverture des débats".

Il souligne dans sa lettre postée sur Twitter : "Ces derniers mois ont été l'occasion d'un terrible gâchis et d'un véritable déni de démocratie. Gâchis car tous les éléments étaient réunis dans l'île pour un règlement définitif de la question corse, avec notamment, en juin 2014, la décision du FLNC de sortie de la clandestinité".

Les électeurs ont accordé lors des élections territoriales fin 2017 "une majorité absolue à une liste se réclamant du mouvement national corse (mais) Paris n'a voulu en tenir aucun compte".

M. Talamoni poursuit : "Étant l'un des responsables d'un petit pays (...) soumis jusqu'à aujourd'hui au dédain et à l'arbitraire, je n'ai que peu de moyens pour combattre l'injustice qui continue à être faite à mon peuple".

近来，中国在对欧关系上遭遇两项挫败：一是中国与欧盟的全面投资协定被欧盟议会无限期搁置；二是立陶宛宣布退出中国与中东欧集团的「17＋1」合作机制。这些挫败固然与美中角力有关，也反映了中国战狼外交政策的失误。

去年底中欧投资协定的签订很大程度上依赖于德国的推动。作为当时的欧盟轮值主席国，德国的经济增长与中国市场及生产基地密不可分。总理梅克尔希望在卸任前留下政治遗产，同时欧盟希望在国际经贸势力的竞争中保持独立，不依附美国。

对中国而言，面对来自美国的全面打压，与欧盟联合可在政治和经贸上提供缓冲，中欧投资协定正好符合这一需求。这项谈判历时七年的协定对双方都有利。然而，美国在拜登政权交接期间曾建议欧盟不要仓促签署协定，但欧盟考虑自身经济利益，并未采纳这一建议。

虽然协定已通过欧盟执委会的批准，但还需欧洲议会的审议。然而，3月欧洲议会对新疆人权相关官员的制裁，激起中国的反制裁，北京错误地将制裁对象扩展到欧盟议会议员和学者，导致欧洲议会强烈反弹，并在5月20日投票冻结欧中投资协定，要求北京撤销制裁。

中国外长王毅开始寻求解套，强调投资协定不是「一方给予另一方的恩赐」，并指出中方坚持自己的制度和发展道路，同时尊重其他国家的自主选择。北京邀请波兰、塞尔维亚、爱尔兰和匈牙利四国外长访问中国，试图分化欧盟。

虽然欧盟声称「暂缓」并不等于「中止」，但投资协定的复活并非毫无希望。然而，梅克尔即将卸任，继任者绿党党魁贝尔伯克可能上台，而绿党在欧洲议会中对中国持反对立场。目前，中国不愿让步，欧洲议会也不愿妥协，形成僵局。

对欧洲而言，中国不仅是抗衡美国的筹码，也被视为威胁。虽然中方强调「支持欧洲一体化」，但欧盟担心中国分裂欧盟、分而治之。中国长期经营的「17＋1」合作机制，试图支持较不发达的中东欧国家对抗西欧。立陶宛23日宣布退出该机制，并敦促其他欧盟成员国采取「27+1」的交流方式。

立陶宛不仅在新疆问题上声援维吾尔族人权，还宣布将在台湾设立贸易代表处，中方的反应颇为激烈。

El Tamarite sumó un punto en su estreno liguero en La Colomina, donde jugó un encuentro disputado, pero poco vistoso contra el Belchite. El calor y la falta de rodaje por parte de ambas escuadras se hizo notar sobre el verde.

Los primeros minutos fueron de tanteo entre ambos equipos y no se produjeron ocasiones claras. Lo poco reseñable fue un aviso de Casals para el Tamarite en el minuto cinco que tampoco llevó excesivo peligro. Más peligro llevó un gran disparo de Sidi al cuarto de hora que se fue alto por poco. El cuadro visitante tuvo su mejor opción en un centro de Andreu que Pablo mandó fuera cuando el partido se acercaba a la media hora.

El cuadro visitante fue de menos a más durante el transcurso del partido. Tras el paso por vestuarios, el Belchite achuchó más en busca de los tres puntos. Cerca de la hora de juego, un disparo de Cirac se fue por encima del larguero local. De nuevo, Cirac volvió a intentarlo en un libre directo, pero el resultado fue el mismo que en el caso anterior y el balón se marchó alto.

Una gran parada de Salas evitó el gol del Belchite cuando Pablo se quedó solo ante él en el minuto 68. El Tamarite creó alguna ocasión en el tramo final, con Ars, Víctor y Gómez combinando en el ataque local. Ya en el minuto 91, una gran intervención de Salas evitó el gol de Mike que hubiera supuesto la victoria visitante. Al final, ninguno logró marcar y ambos estrenan su casillero de puntos.

Tamarite: Salas, Víctor, Alberto, Ars, Varilla, Pol, Sidi (Balue, 46), Ramón, Casals (Figueres, 63), Alexis (Bernadó, 78) y Gómez.

Love Island star Molly-Mae Hague returned home today with a solemn expression, fueling speculation among fans about a possible split from her boyfriend Tommy Fury. Missing from her side was her 20-year-old boxer beau, Tommy.

Molly-Mae and Tommy, who were the runners-up on Love Island, have not shared any photos together on their social media accounts, which collectively reach 5 million followers, since the show's finale where they lost to Amber Gill and Greg O'Shea. Prof. Thomas Huang from the University of Illinois, in collaboration with Prof. Hicu Sebe from the University of Amsterdam, developed a new software called the Facial Action Coding System. These professors specialize in improving communication between humans and computers.

The Facial Action Coding System aims to identify the subtle facial movements humans use to convey emotions. The technology began with a 3-D computer model of the human face, incorporating all 44 facial muscles. Psychologists, such as Dr. Paul Eckman, classified six basic emotions and associated each with distinct facial muscle movements.

This technology could have potential applications in various fields, such as investigations. For instance, in cases of bullying leading to tragic outcomes, the use of FACS could help determine the truthfulness of individuals connected to the victim, such as students.

While the Facial Action Coding System could be beneficial in certain scenarios, such as investigations, its primary utility may not lie in classroom settings. This technology, suitable for high school psychology classes, may not be as applicable in elementary or middle school environments, unless the school staff decides to introduce it to the students for studying emotions in different situations.

In conclusion, the Facial Action Coding System, while not specifically designed for classroom use, holds promise in fields such as law enforcement, healthcare, and government, where the analysis of facial expressions could be instrumental in solving crimes, conducting interviews, and making diagnoses.

Former Philadelphia Phillies pitcher Tyson Brummett, 35, and three others tragically lost their lives in a plane crash in rural Utah. Brummett was piloting the small plane that departed from the South Valley Regional Airport in West Jordan and crashed near Box Elder Peak in American Fork Canyon just before 8 a.m. on Friday, as reported by the Utah County Sheriff's Office.

An eyewitness stated that the plane went into a downward corkscrew motion before crashing. Regrettably, all four individuals onboard did not survive. The passengers were identified as Elaine W. Blackhurst, 60, her husband Douglas Robinson Blackhurst, 62, and their nephew Alex Blackhurst Ruegner, 35, all from Riverton, Utah.

In response to this tragedy, the Phillies organization expressed their deep condolences to the families and friends of Tyson Brummett and the members of the Ruegner and Blackhurst families involved in the crash, in a statement issued on Saturday.

Brummett was drafted by the Phillies in 2007 from UCLA. As a right-handed pitcher, he made his only appearance in the majors in 2012, facing four batters and striking out two of them.

The National Transportation Safety Board is conducting an investigation into the crash. This report includes information from The Associated Press.

Multi-stage training, which involves pretraining a model and then finetuning it, has become increasingly important and has achieved state-of-the-art results in many tasks. In natural language processing (NLP) applications, this approach typically starts with learning word embeddings (e.g., word2vec, GloVe) or contextual representations (e.g., ELMo, BERT) from a large unsupervised corpus, followed by refining or finetuning the model on supervised end tasks. These ideas from transfer learning have been widely applied across various tasks, leading to successful knowledge transfer from pretraining tasks to end tasks. However, despite the successes, current multi-stage learning approaches often rely on trial-and-error, leaving many fundamental questions unanswered, such as which pretraining data or tasks contribute most to the end task, how to detect "false transfer," and whether one can trace prediction errors back to problematic pretraining data. Addressing these questions requires a quantitative measurement of the pretraining data and loss function's influence, which is the main focus of this paper.

To determine the most influential training data responsible for a model's prediction, the influence function, initially introduced from a robust statistics point of view, has been a valuable tool. However, the influence function, as developed, primarily focuses on single-stage training, where only one model and one set of training data are involved, and, to the best of our knowledge, the influence of pretraining data on a finetuning task has not been studied, making the application of the original influence function to multi-stage training nontrivial.
