Le village de Kpe Aba, situé dans l'ouest de la Côte d'Ivoire, a été attaqué dans la nuit du 21 au 22 décembre par des assaillants venus de la Guinée voisine. Les circonstances de cette attaque restent floues, mais une source au ministère de la Défense ivoirien a confirmé l'information le jeudi 22 décembre. Des renforts sécuritaires ont été dépêchés sur place.

Selon une autre source sécuritaire citée par l'AFP, des militaires guinéens accompagnés de civils seraient à l'origine de l'attaque. Armés de Kalachnikov, ils auraient tué un villageois, blessé plusieurs autres et incendié des habitations avant de se replier du côté guinéen de la frontière.

Cependant, une source proche de l'état-major guinéen a nié toute implication de l'armée guinéenne, affirmant qu'aucun incident de ce type n'a été signalé jusqu'à présent. Bien que ce village ait été le centre de différends frontaliers entre les deux pays, cette source reconnaît que le problème a été résolu à un niveau élevé, malgré le risque que des individus malintentionnés cherchent à semer le trouble.

En janvier 2013, des militaires guinéens avaient déjà occupé le village de Kpe Aba, se retirant fin février après des pourparlers entre les gouvernements ivoirien et guinéen. À l'époque, Abidjan et Conakry avaient nié l'existence de tout conflit frontalier entre les deux pays.

Since the introduction of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) in 2010, the technology has been widely adopted in smartphones, wearables, and other IoT devices. In a modern household, there can be more than a dozen devices supporting this technology, constantly sending BLE advertisements to inform nearby devices of their presence, typically without the owner's notice. BLE devices, however, share potentially sensitive data with devices in proximity, posing a vast surface for privacy-compromising attacks.

In the past, researchers have found that BLE advertisements may contain fixed identifiers, allowing for device tracking despite MAC address randomization, and could even contain personally identifiable information, such as the user's phone number or email address. Additionally, adversaries might use BLE-based tracking devices, like the rumored Apple AirTags, to track individuals, leveraging a crowd-sourced finder network.

To improve our understanding of the privacy-related attack surface, the security community requires better application support, such as analyzing privacy leaks or detecting malicious devices. To address this, we propose BTLEmap, a network discovery, and security auditing tool, in the spirit of Nmap, but designed for BLE environments.

The sun plays a crucial role on Earth by providing light and energy essential for life and influencing the planet's climate. The sun's activity can vary from quiet to disturbed states, with disturbances like intense plasma eruptions known as solar flares. These solar flares come with coronal mass ejections, solar particle events, and other phenomena that can pose risks to spacecraft technology and astronauts in space. Monitoring the sun's activity and associated space weather conditions is vital. Solar observatory imagery, such as that captured by the National Aeronautics and Space Agency's (NASA) Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO), provides valuable information, with around 70,000 images of sun activity taken daily.

Analyzing and interpreting these vast amounts of data manually is challenging. Therefore, there is a need to develop automated approaches to detect and track the sun's activity for more precise space weather forecasts. Various methods, including Spectrogram, Image processing, Deep learning, Neural Network, and Machine Learning, have been proposed by researchers for classifying and detecting solar activity.

For instance, Yang et al. used a simulated Annealing Genetic (SAG) method to detect sunspots, achieving excellent segmentation results. Armstrong and Fletcher employed a deep convolutional neural network to classify solar features with high accuracy, even under resolution changes. Zhu and Lin utilized a deep learning technique to accurately identify solar filaments while minimizing noise effects. Love et al. developed a convolutional neural network to classify different solar observations with 94% accuracy, and Sarsembayeva et al. used image processing techniques to detect active regions on the sun effectively.

In this study, we introduce a novel approach to tracking sun activity by transforming solar observatory images into 1-Dimensional Time Series (1-DTS). This method captures precise information regarding solar activity, particularly in storm areas with strong magnetic fields and plasma twisting. We developed two approaches using 2D circular kernel time series transformation and statistical tools with Machine Learning (ML) techniques to classify areas with strong activity, termed as solar storm.

The main contributions of this study include transforming solar observatory images into one-dimensional time series, automating sun activity tracking through statistical and entropy measures and ML approaches, and achieving high classification accuracy using the 5th percentile (X5P) and Singular Value Decomposition (SVDEn).

Overall, this study aims to enhance our understanding of solar activity by developing innovative approaches to analyze solar observatory images, paving the way for more accurate space weather predictions.

Eight months have passed since everything changed. When I dream now, it's not the fantasies I used to have, but memories of the time before. I dream of when I wasn't weary, when I wasn't hungry, when I still had my old family.

I have a new family now. There is less warmth, but we look after one another. In some ways, it is better. I used to be a father, which brought responsibilities, expectations, and the burden of leadership. Not now. In this group, life is tougher, it's barely safe to sleep, and there is never enough food. Yet, having left the duties of parenthood, my job, and my past life, I find, for the first time, I am an equal. I feel, in a way, complete. 

Within this group, we are not friends, but survivors. We do not love, but we need, and, most importantly, we trust, each other.

With the recent exponential increase in large-scale cloud-based services, we are witnessing a paradigm shift in the nature of these systems and how they handle job tasks. An illustrative example is the presence of devices with varying capabilities spanning different generations of technology within a cluster. For instance, it's not uncommon to find a ∼4 TFLOP K80, a ∼30 TFLOP L4, and a ∼100 TFLOP TPUv3 in the same facility (Google, 2023b,a). Similarly, disparities in server speeds can arise due to the fractional allocation of resources in serverless computing setups (Amazon, 2023). Another scenario involves ML inference deployments where servers host models of varying sizes, resulting in differing service times (Shazeer et al., 2017).

Motivated by such heterogeneous systems, this work addresses the challenge of efficiently routing jobs in queueing systems with servers of varying speeds. We introduce a model with a single central queue and a set of heterogeneous servers, as depicted in Figure 1. Beyond the cloud computing context that inspired our study, this model and the routing policies proposed herein are also applicable in other domains such as packet routing in communication networks (Srikant and Ying, 2013) and resource management in healthcare, manufacturing, or ride-sharing operations (Walton and Xu, 2021; Tsitsiklis and Xu, 2017).

Traditional queueing methods are typically tailored for homogeneous systems and may not accommodate the heterogeneity in service rates (Harchol-Balter, 2013). While these policies might work well under specific load conditions or types of heterogeneity, they are not optimal for general scenarios. For example, a work-conserving routing policy that aims to keep all servers occupied when there are jobs in the system is latency-optimal for homogeneous systems but suboptimal for heterogeneous systems. In the latter case, it can be advantageous to keep slower servers idle and retain jobs in the central queue until the queue length surpasses a certain threshold or one of the faster servers becomes available.

Research has shown that for a scenario involving two servers – one fast and one slow – a threshold policy is optimal (Lin and Kumar, 1984; Koole, 1995; Walrand, 1984). However, extending the optimality proof of the threshold policy to a general multi-server setting has remained an open challenge for almost four decades (Koole, 2022). Additionally, determining the threshold as a function of service rates and job arrival rate is intricate and unknown.

In this work, in response to the complexity of devising a closed-form expression for the policy, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL) approach to determine the best routing policy in multi-server heterogeneous queueing systems. We offer the following key contributions to overcome the inefficiencies of conventional RL methods due to a high-dimensional state space: (a) We utilize the queueing structure to formulate a low-dimensional soft threshold policy and introduce ACHQ, an efficient policy gradient-based algorithm. (b) We provide guarantees for stationary points and, in the case of two servers, demonstrate convergence to an approximate global optimum. (c) We showcase an enhancement in the expected response time by up to ∼30% compared to a greedy policy that routes to the quickest available server.

To the best of our knowledge, this study is among the first to propose an RL solution to this issue and one of the few recent papers leveraging queueing structure to devise an effective RL methodology with provable assurances.

I sit still in the darkness of my living room, staring blankly out the window as the rain meanders down, obscuring my view of the street—the street my wife drove off on two hours ago. To say our marriage had become mundane lately would be an understatement. I accept my fair share of the blame; Mary has every right to be angry with me. I was absent, apathetic, and neglectful of my marital duties.

I can't explain why I lost interest, but I need to think quickly. She gave me an ultimatum—a directive of sorts—to give her a reason to stay. We've been married for three years, and it was thrilling at first. We were hopelessly in love. Somewhere along the way, the spark flickered, and one day, it disappeared.

What hurts the most is seeing that Mary is still deeply in love with me. She brings home my favorite doughnut when I'm stressed, knowing it will make me feel loved, and it always does. She affectionately plays with my hair while I read, complimenting my eyes. She squeezes my arm as we walk, making me feel wanted, needed. Yet, I find myself unable to reciprocate, and it breaks her heart. It breaks my heart, too.

I'm faced with an ostensibly incurable dilemma. I now have less than 22 hours to convince her that I still love her, that I can make her happy, as I once did. But, do I want to? She's the one working, agonizing, to restore our relationship, while I remain emotionally dormant, emotionally empty.

Let me declare, I do love her. I always have, and I always will. But, I am broken.

Les fans de sport se souviendront surtout de l'édition 2020-2021 comme celle où le gagnant n'a pas gagné. Il ne s'agit pas ici de déclassement pour dopage ou tricherie, comme on le voit trop souvent dans certaines grandes courses cyclistes.

Dix heures de bonus pour la victoire
Charlie Dalin, le premier arrivé, ne doit la perte du titre qu'à la bonification accordée à plusieurs marins qui ont aidé Kevin Escoffier en plein milieu de la course. La solidarité est une norme dans ce sport où la course passe après l'aide aux concurrents en difficulté. Dans les propos d'après-course du malheureux perdant, il n'y a d'ailleurs aucune contestation.

Le gagnant s'appelle donc Yannick Bestaven, arrivé en troisième position, un peu plus de 3h30 après Louis Burton. Arrivant au milieu de la nuit, il doit sa victoire aux dix heures de bonus accordées par les organisateurs. Il n'était pourtant pas spécialement favori. Les parieurs prévoyaient plutôt que l'Allemand Boris Hermann soulèverait le trophée. Deuxième jusqu'à 90 milles de l'arrivée, ses 6 heures de bonification auraient pu faire la différence. Une collision avec un navire de pêche non détectée par ses alarmes en a décidé autrement.

The Face is not an alien-made artifact, as NASA scientists conducted research and multiple trips to observe the land formation. Initially, NASA cameras did not provide clear evidence of any anomalies. A revisit 18 years later yielded more photographs, revealing no signs of alien involvement in the creation of the landform.

At NASA, scientists identified the formation as another Martian mesa, common in that region of Mars. They determined that the rock showed no indication of alien life, past or present. The large rock formation created an illusion of the Face when casting a shadow. Subsequent images in the summer of 1998 conclusively proved the large rock formation's natural origin.

Contrary to speculation, the Face is not of alien origin, as NASA scientists confirmed that the landform merely projected a shadow resembling a face. Due to the limitations of the Viking 1 cameras, the presence of any foreign entities was difficult to ascertain. With the advancement of technology, the follow-up images taken 18 years later provided clearer evidence, supporting the scientists' conclusion that the Face was a natural formation, devoid of alien involvement.

Le jeune homme en voulait à ses parents et à leur guerre sans fin. «J’ai une famille irrécupérable. Je n’ai aucun souvenir heureux de mes parents. Je me rappelle d’eux qu’en train de se déchirer et de se hurler dessus. Séparés, ils ont toujours eu ce besoin de se haïr et ils nous ont utilisés pour se faire du mal à distance. Je pense pouvoir parler de torture psychologique». Dans son enfance, la vie de famille semblait idéale, de l’extérieur du moins. «Une belle maison» dans les Bouches-du-Rhône, «avec un grand jardin». Mais tout va de plus en plus mal, raconte-t-il, entre son père, pilote de ligne colérique et ultra-exigeant, et sa mère, ancienne hôtesse de l’air, «impulsive» restée au foyer. À 5 ans, il voit son premier psychologue. À 7 ans, sa mère vient le chercher à l’école. «Elle m’a dit: “J’ai fait les valises, on s’en va”». Ils quittent tout sans explication, avec sa sœur de 3 ans sa cadette, et tous trois recommencent une nouvelle vie à Perpignan. «Mon passé m’était rappelé par les disputes qu’avaient encore mes parents à travers nous. Ça a duré une dizaine d’années. J’étais de plus en plus renfermé. À partir de 15 ans, je n’ai plus eu aucun contact avec mon père. J’ai commencé à devenir agressif envers ma sœur. Je l’injuriais. Je lui faisais ressentir un certain mépris que peut-être je sentais moi. Oui, un jour j’ai pris un marteau et je l’ai regardé avec un air menaçant. C’était sans doute un moyen d’attirer l’attention de ma mère qui ne voulait pas voir ce qui n’allait pas. Elle a demandé une enquête sociale qui a conclu que ce serait mieux que je m’installe dans mon propre appartement».
Plus on l’écoute, de sa voix claire et monocorde, plus on tente de percer la carapace lisse de Jonathan Duquenoy. Et plus on peine à l’imaginer. Pourtant, «j’y suis allé pour ça. Je voulais la tuer», avoue-t-il avec une sincérité confondante.

Smoke wafted from the old General's lips as he commanded, "Take the girl to my room," flicking cigar ash toward one of the many guards standing behind him.

"Please, please, sir! Please, do not take my daughter!" A man lay slumped on the palace floor, tears streaming down his face. "She is my child, she is my precious, sir!" He cried out as his resigned daughter was dragged from the room by one of the General's guards.

The man began to crawl, pleading for God's mercy upon his daughter. As he inched forward, hands clasped together in prayer, he begged the captors for his daughter, but a guard's boot suddenly slammed into his face, knocking him onto the cold marble floor. Through tears, he looked up to see the vacant eyes of a guard gazing down at him.

The General approached the man sprawled on the floor and sneered, "I hear you have another daughter, yes? Make sure to pay next month," before striding towards his bedchamber.

Alone in his chamber, the General ordered the girl beside his bed to undress, watching her reluctantly comply.

"What is the matter?!" the General bellowed as the guard who had assaulted the girl's father entered the room. The guard, with deep blue eyes, gazed at the girl and said, "Leave with your father, now." Startled, she recognized a familiar look in his eyes and hurriedly dressed, running from the room.

Enraged, the General demanded an explanation, but the guard merely smiled and uttered, "God is truly great," before swiftly drawing his sidearm and shooting the old dictator in the head.

El gobierno de Lenin Moreno está reprimiendo a los manifestantes que protestan en contra de medidas contrarias a los intereses del pueblo, ya sea con estado de excepción o sin él. La represión ha sido evidente en este segundo día de protesta, en el que el pueblo en todo el país salió a las calles para protestar por la eliminación de los subsidios a la gasolina, el aumento del costo de los combustibles y una reforma laboral que afecta a la mayoría de los trabajadores. Estas medidas incluyen una reducción del 20% en los salarios y la reducción de las vacaciones de 30 a 15 días. Todo esto ha desencadenado un estallido social en todo el país.

Desde Guayaquil, se han reportado casos de abuso de la fuerza policial contra los ciudadanos, como el caso de este policía que arrolló a uno de los manifestantes ante la mirada perpleja de los presentes. En Cuenca, otro funcionario policial arrastró a un ciudadano que estaba protestando en contra de las medidas impuestas por Lenin y el FMI. En Ibarra, la represión policial se manifestó con el uso de bombas lacrimógenas contra los ciudadanos que protestaban por el aumento del costo de los combustibles y las reformas laborales que afectan a millones de ecuatorianos.

Yo estuve allí, nadie me lo contó. Como muchos cienfuegueros, salí este sábado en la noche hasta el Malecón porque extrañaba el salitre, la brisa fresca, la complicidad de uno de los sitios más concurridos y hermosos de la ciudad del mar, luego de meses de encierro, o mejor, de cuidados necesarios y extremos.

Un proyecto cultural invitaba al baile, a escuchar –si es que sus oídos estaban preparados para eso– y lo peor, al jolgorio también extremo, cuando la COVID-19 todavía es un hecho y las vacunas no nos protegen del todo, según las autoridades sanitarias, que reclaman mantener las medidas higiénico-sanitarias para preservar la salud.

Una cosa es salir a caminar, conversar y compartir con amigos y otra es el desenfreno que pude ver esa noche, cuando el Proyecto Cultural Cienfuegos Party invitaba a adolescentes y jóvenes a bailar, gritar, brincar y cuanto más pudiera hacerse en una masa compacta de personas. En el colmo del frenesí musical y del desencierro, echaron a un lado los nasobucos, las distancias y todo lo que implicara cuidados mínimos, al menos, para no enfermar.

Luego, en redes sociales, apareció la constancia de la indisciplina masiva, sin recato alguno, y los comentarios lógicos del llamado a la prevención. Lo peor fue la búsqueda de culpables del desatino popular, que por supuesto, en buena medida recayó en el Gobierno de la ciudad.

No juzgaré la decisión gubernamental –espero que la haya habido– pues si regresamos a la normalidad, tendremos que actuar como entes ¿normales? Se corrió un riesgo seguramente conocido –con venta de bebidas y alimentos ligeros incluidos, a precios exorbitantes, como es habitual por estos tiempos–, pero habrá que pensar mejor estas convocatorias, porque marcan un conteo regresivo a los días de mayor incidencia de la pandemia.

Cuestionaré la actitud de mis coterráneos, que olvidaron en poco tiempo cuánto hemos sufrido la pérdida de seres queridos, conocidos y ajenos, pero que aún duelen en la ciudad. Reclamo la cordura que nos hace humanos y, por ende, racionales e inteligentes, como para salir a las calles como si nada hubiese pasado.

La COVID-19 nos mantiene con el sabor amargo de un cambio radical en nuestras vidas, de carencias originadas por el cierre de fronteras en el mundo y más en nuestra Cuba, aislada, bloqueada, en medio de un reordenamiento monetario que también nos complica la existencia, un país que ha gastado –y gasta– millones de pesos para preservar la salud de sus gentes.

Si ante cada intento por normalizar la cotidianidad respondemos de esta manera, regresarán las altas cifras de enfermos, los contagios masivos, más gastos al presupuesto del Estado y su repercusión en la economía familiar. Ni el Gobierno, ni Salud Pública son los responsables de nuestro actuar individual, quitémosle esa carga al Estado que luego todo lo carga sobre sus hombros: las culpas del desorden y el atendernos –como obligación. Cordura, cienfuegueros, ahora, más que nunca.

Lie group symmetries naturally arise in many control systems problems, as seen in motion planning for underwater vehicles, conflict resolution in differential games, collective motion in biological models, controlled Lagrangians, and coordination of multiagent systems. The objective of this study is to investigate symmetry reduction in optimal control problems for left-invariant affine multiagent control systems on Lie groups with partially broken symmetries. Specifically, this involves examining cost functions that disrupt some symmetries while leaving others intact. Symmetry breaking is a common phenomenon in various physical contexts, illustrated, for instance, in the dynamics of a spinning top under gravity where the dynamics are SO(2)-invariant but not SO(3)-invariant, unlike the free rigid body case. In motion planning, symmetry breaking manifests through barrier functions, as explored in this study.

Previous research has explored symmetries in Pontryagin's maximum principle (PMP) and employed a Lagrangian approach to leverage symmetries in the necessary conditions for optimal control problems. In particular, Lagrangian systems with broken symmetries have been utilized in optimal control problems on Lie groups for single-agent scenarios. Furthermore, investigations on semidirect products using a Clebsch formulation have been conducted, yielding coordinate-free equations that describe necessary conditions for extrema on vector spaces.

This work focuses on providing reduced equations on vector spaces, thereby avoiding the need to solve differential equations on manifolds, which typically involves embedding the manifold into Euclidean space and introducing additional constraints. By building upon prior research and incorporating considerations for obstacles in the configuration space to avoid mutual collisions, this study offers practical insights. 

The paper structure is organized as follows: Section II reviews fundamental concepts of mechanics on manifolds, particularly mechanics on Lie groups. Section III outlines the left-invariant affine multi-agent control system and the problem statement. Section IV presents the primary findings of the research, detailing the reduction of optimality conditions in the optimal control problem. Section V demonstrates the application of the results through an example involving three unicycles navigating collision avoidance and obstacles. Finally, Section VI delves into conclusions and outlines avenues for future research.

英国导演和演员多米尼克·韦斯特（Dominic West）最近在接受《星期天泰晤士报》杂志采访时表示，他认为接替丹尼尔·克雷格（Daniel Craig）饰演经典角色007的新人应该是汉纳·格拉芙。汉纳·格拉芙是英国军衔最高的跨性别军人，她原本是男性军官，在驻扎阿富汗期间选择变性，2013年返回英国进行手术，成为英军中军衔最高的变性军官。

韦斯特的建议在社交媒体上引起了轩然大波。他认为，格拉芙是一位非常酷的女性，「有个非常酷的女性，一名演员的妻子……她是英军工兵的上尉，是军队中级别最高的跨性别战士。」格拉芙的演员丈夫曾在韦斯特最近的传记剧情电影《科莱特》（Colette）中扮演过角色。韦斯特说，「她两次在阿富汗执行任务。她是个美丽的金发女郎，她能演邦德。这是个好主意。」

对此，格拉芙女士回应称韦斯特的建议让她感到受宠若惊，「我不认为我很快会成为演员，但是没有理由禁止塑造一个跨性别的邦德。」她还表示，一个女性扮演007会让年轻的女孩大受鼓舞，许多人也在讨论007角色是否应该有女性来演。

然而，英国女演员蕾切尔·薇兹（Rachel Weisz），詹姆士·邦德扮演者丹尼尔·克雷格的妻子，则提醒说，这样做需要谨慎。她在接受《每日电讯报》采访时提到，007的创作者伊恩·弗莱明（Ian Fleming）在塑造这个角色时非常用心，他笔下的007是一个独特的男性角色。

批评者认为，弗莱明创作的007应该保持男性白人中产阶级的传统形象。如果有人想做根本改变，就应该自己去创作剧本，而不是改变弗莱明的007。

Until recently, one word could have summed up my life pretty well: "typical." I took the same route as most of the kids from my neighborhood. After graduating high school, it was off to an in-state university to pick up my major in Awesome Studies. It was easy to follow the pack. In a way, it felt like I was doing the right thing, too. Who could argue with doing what my whole family expected of me? An Awesome degree would open plenty of doors that would take me into a comfortable life. 

There were plenty of Batmans in my family, and they were all proud of me when I took up the "family business." I can't deny, either, that there was a pleasure in a hard day's work. There was something soothing about routine. Punch in, beat up a couple of Riddlers and a Mr. Freeze, and punch out. It was simple. It was killing me. I was slow to realize it. That routine that I found so calming had a narcotic effect, I still believe that. It numbed me. 

But even after I graduated, I couldn't get an old college buddy, Vince, off of my mind. We hadn't spoken in years, but I couldn't stop thinking about something he'd told me. I still think about it. Vince was an unassuming kid. Quiet, studied hard, and, if you saw him pass by in the hallway, if you even noticed him, you'd probably think, "There goes another Formula 1 driver."

2019年已经过去，新的一年带来了新的目标和期许。在新的开始时，如果在身上刺上一些鼓励的句子，也许是个不错的主意。无论是在文学作品、电影戏剧、音乐歌词还是一些名人金句中，总有一句会触动你的心灵，比如美国文学家爱默生的名言：“进步是今天的活动、明天的保证”。种下好的种子，必将在未来收获丰盛。如果你有意刺上一些英文励志语句，不妨参考一下⋯⋯

“我是自己命运的主宰，我是自己灵魂的船长”，这句话让我想起美国著名电影导演史蒂芬·斯皮尔伯格，他执导过《侏罗纪公园》、《大白鲨》、《E.T.外星人》等经典作品。虽然在求学期间曾遭南加州大学电影艺术学院拒绝，但失望并没有击垮他成为导演的梦想，他选择自己掌握人生，为理想不断努力奋斗。最终，他成功了，并获得了奥斯卡最佳导演奖。

“笑声永恒，想象力无岁月，梦想永远”，这句话正是迪士尼创始人沃尔特·迪士尼对追求梦想的真挚表达。他凭借大胆的尝试和创新思维，创造了诸多经典作品，如《白雪公主》、《木偶奇遇记》等。

I married Tom four years ago. It was a green card marriage; I needed to enter the country, and he offered me a way in. We live together in the same home, and I have to say, he has been a real pain at times. Constantly saying things like, "Clean this," "Go get that," or "Can you please stop using the TV? I want to watch Game of Thrones." However, like a new pair of shoes, I've grown accustomed to it. I just don't want to throw away this pair of shoes yet.

I offered to marry Sarah so she could get into the country, and it was an amazing opportunity for me. Lower taxes and the chance to brag to my friends about my stunning wife were great perks. Yet, she can be annoying to live with. I always have to remind her to clean the bathroom, and she leaves bobby pins everywhere. I even found one in my shoe! She constantly rearranges everything and never leaves things where I put them. And she's always watching reruns of that house renovation show I dislike. Despite all this, my feelings for her haven't changed. I've always wanted to tell her how I feel, but we made it clear in the beginning that we weren't romantically compatible.

I looked in the mirror, grabbed a bobby pin, and fixed my hair. I wanted to look nice when I asked him. I decided to approach it casually, so I walked into the living room and put on my favorite show. Of course, I had to adjust the couch pillows again—honestly, who puts them in the center? They belong on the sides. He walked in through the front door and into the living room. I looked at him and asked him to come sit down on the couch.

I walked over to the couch and sat down. She moved the pillows again—who puts them on the sides when they belong in the center? She scooted closer to me and asked if I wanted to go on a date with her. I laughed and said, "A date? We're already married." She chuckled in response and then asked seriously. I responded with an enthusiastic "Yes."

It's been four years since we renewed our vows.

The algebraic theory of block codes is highly developed, resulting in sophisticated classes of codes accompanied by effective decoding algorithms. In contrast, algebraic general constructions for convolutional codes are rare, and most convolutional codes with favorable designed distance have been identified through computer searches. Due to the lack of straightforward algebraic methods to construct generator matrices for convolutional codes with good distance properties, several researchers have extended well-known block code classes into the convolutional domain. This approach was pioneered by Massey, Costello, and Justesen, who utilized cyclic or quasi-cyclic block codes [19, 20, 27]. Subsequently, many authors have expanded upon this idea [9, 22, 32, 14]. The core concept involves establishing a link between the generator polynomials of quasi-cyclic block codes and the generator matrices of convolutional codes. A key property of this connection is that it allows the free distance of the convolutional code to be bounded below by the minimum distance of the associated cyclic or quasi-cyclic block code. Within this framework, numerous constructions of convolutional codes with designed free distance have been developed based on different block code classes, such as Reed-Solomon or Reed-Muller codes. Additionally, in [31], the authors refined the parameters of these constructions to introduce the first Maximum Distance Separable (MDS) convolutional code, i.e., a convolutional code whose free distance meets the generalized Singleton bound presented in [30], provided the field size is congruent to 1 modulo the code length. Subsequently, other MDS convolutional codes for restricted parameter sets have been introduced [12, 29]. Notably, circulant Cauchy matrices were used for the construction of MDS 2D convolutional codes in [7, 8], which was later adapted for MDS 1D convolutional codes in [24]. All these codes are designed to achieve large free distances.

In the realm of convolutional codes, the objective is to build codes capable of correcting as many errors as possible across different time intervals. This capability is measured by column distances. Although column distance is arguably the most fundamental distance measure for convolutional codes (see [18, pag. 162]), little is known about constructing convolutional codes with large column distances. Furthermore, a large free distance does not ensure the largest possible column distances. Codes that maximize column distances are termed Maximum Distance Profile (MDP) codes, introduced in [16] and further explored in [13]. MDP convolutional codes are analogous to MDS block codes within a time interval and are thus considered more suitable analogs of MDS block codes than MDS convolutional codes. Practically, these codes have been shown to be highly effective for sequential transmission over erasure channels and low-delay streaming applications [6, 10, 26, 33].

استقبل الرئيس المصري عبد الفتاح السيسي اليوم السبت أرانتشا جونثاليث لايا، وزيرة الخارجية الإسبانية، بحضور سامح شكري، وزير الخارجية، والسفير الإسباني بالقاهرة.

وأوضح السفير بسام راضي، المتحدث الرسمي باسم رئاسة الجمهورية، أن الرئيس السيسي طلب نقل تحياته إلى الملك فيليب السادس، ملك إسبانيا، وبيدرو سانشيز، رئيس الوزراء الإسباني. وأكد تطلع مصر لاستمرار التعاون الوثيق من أجل تعزيز العلاقات الثنائية وتعظيم الاستفادة من الإمكانات والفرص المتاحة لدى البلدين في جميع المجالات، خاصة في مجالات الاستثمار والتجارة والطاقة والسياحة.

من جانبها، نقلت وزيرة الخارجية الإسبانية تحيات العاهل الإسباني ورئيس الوزراء إلى الرئيس السيسي، معربة عن تقدير بلادها لمصر قيادةً وشعبًا. وأشارت إلى عمق أواصر الصداقة والروابط الممتدة التي تجمع بين البلدين، وتطلع بلادها إلى تعزيز العلاقات الثنائية بين الجانبين وتطويرها في مختلف المجالات. كما أكدت حرصها على التنسيق والتشاور المكثف مع مصر، نظرًا لدورها المحوري والمتزن في إرساء دعائم الاستقرار في الشرق الأوسط ومنطقة البحر المتوسط، وجهودها الفاعلة في مكافحة الإرهاب والفكر المتطرف والهجرة غير الشرعية، إضافة إلى استضافة مصر لعدد كبير من اللاجئين من مختلف الدول وتوفير الرعاية الكاملة لهم، وهو الأمر الذي يحظى بتقدير أوروبي كبير.

وأضاف المتحدث الرسمي أن اللقاء شهد تبادل الرؤى ووجهات النظر حول سبل تطوير العلاقات الثنائية، بما في ذلك الموضوعات الأمنية والعسكرية، بالإضافة إلى تبادل الخبرات بشأن التعامل مع جائحة كورونا.

今天（23日），被誉为科技研发界的“奥斯卡”的工研菁英奖正式揭晓，共有6项技术荣获金奖，这些成就展现了工研院在“2030技术策略与蓝图”下的重要研发成果。

获得杰出研究金牌奖的项目包括：“智慧物联网关键记忆体”以其高速读取、低功耗等优势，提升存取的稳定性与速度，现已应用于半导体大厂的晶圆制造流程；“iKNOBEADS于次世代细胞免疫治疗之应用”，通过独特的突触结构显著提高T细胞活化效率，计划与国内大型医院合作推出临床用GMP等级产品；“可循环热固型树脂合成设计与产业应用链结”则解决了环氧树脂无法回收的环保问题。

荣获产业化贡献奖的项目有：“新型耐温热塑弹性体推动”，这种材料不仅耐候、耐寒、抗冲击，还可再生利用，现已进入试量产与验证阶段，市场前景广阔；“应用人工智慧提升光电半导体与PCB产业竞争力”和“推动Pre-5G/5G小基站白牌化产业”，这些项目利用最前沿的AI技术和5G发展趋势，助力产业优化升级，并与帆宣、华邦电等相关厂商合作，展现了工研院助力台湾经济发展的实力。

工研院院长刘文雄表示：“养兵千日，用在一时”，新冠疫情期间，台湾通过超前部署成功遏制疫情，从科技视角看，提前部署科技即是洞悉产业变化，引领未来发展方向。工研院制定的“2030技术策略与发展蓝图”聚焦于“智慧生活”、“健康乐活”、“永续环境”及“智慧化共通技术”领域的创新应用，旨在引领台湾产业共同创新。今年的“产业化贡献奖”和“杰出研究奖”六项金奖技术，呼应该蓝图，以市场需求为导向，部署下一代创新技术，这些成就体现了工研院将创新研发能力落实于产业，并携手共同创造新商机，助力台湾产业在未来十年奠定坚实基础。

**荣获杰出研究奖金牌奖的三项技术：**

1. **智慧生活**——智慧物联网关键记忆体技术
   - 开发出读取速度快、功耗低、持久耐用的下一代记忆体技术，满足物联网需求。特别在铁电记忆体(FRAM)领域，开发出耗电量仅为现有记忆体的1/1000，并达到50纳秒快速存取效率及超过1000万次操作耐久性的技术。磁性记忆体（MRAM）通过结构设计，优化数据读取和写入路径，减少电流经过绝缘层频率，以实现更稳定、更快速的存取。此外，工研院结合芯片设计与制造技术，将先进记忆体应用于内运算芯片，大幅提升AI运算效能。
   - **产业合作**：已与半导体大厂合作进行试量产制程开发。

2. **健康乐活**——iKNOBEADS于次世代细胞免疫治疗之应用
   - 全球首创的“仿生多突状磁珠制备技术”(iKNOBEADS)，通过独特突触结构提高T细胞活化效率，仅需目前市售磁珠量的三分之一，即可活化数百倍的T细胞，并具有记忆力，能够成功对抗癌细胞。
   - **产业合作**：已与国内大型医学中心合作，计划今年下半年推出临床用GMP等级产品。

3. **永续环境**——可循环热固型树脂合成设计与产业应用链结
   - 通过分子结构设计，实现可循环树脂的开发，突破传统热固型树脂无法重复制造的瓶颈。该树脂在特定温度下可解链(debonding)，恢复原化合物结构以实现循环再利用，解决现有环氧树脂无法回收的环保问题，广泛应用于PCB、碳纤维复合材料、粘合剂及涂料等产业。

I sense something has changed. It's not just the different scents or the expressions on their faces—it's me, too. I've been so tired, and it feels like it has been this way for a long time. They never seemed to mind, though. They would pet me, telling me I'm a good dog, and everything would feel okay.

Everything is okay.

It's not so bad when I realize what's different. I don't clearly remember how I got here, but I recognize this one human. He's the needle man in the strange white coat, but he's always been kind. I've been seeing him a lot lately.

...

I slipped into sleep again for a few moments.

Now, everyone is here—all the humans, all my friends. I'm so glad to see them. Soon, I will go to sleep for a long, long time, and I want them to know I love them.

It's hard, but I wag my tail, trying not to look too tired. I even attempt to stand, but I don't succeed, and the needle man gently places a hand on my side, making comforting noises, telling me not to try, and that's okay.

One by one, my humans come to me, petting, giving treats, and offering big, warm hugs. They all smell familiar, and, despite the sadness, their smiles are full of love.

One of the fundamental challenges in chemistry is computing the ground state energy of a many-body quantum system. Although density-functional theory [27] has partly addressed this issue, the quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) method [2, 37, 11, 42, 3] remains a vital tool for determining ground state energy and electron correlations.

This paper focuses on implementing QMC for many-body systems. Specifically, we examine the Hamiltonian:

EQUATION

Here, we use \( r = (r_1, r_2, \ldots, r_N) \) to denote the particle coordinates, with \( N \) being the total number of particles. The Laplacian in the first term of the Hamiltonian represents kinetic energy. The second term, a double sum, captures pairwise interactions, such as Coulomb interactions, while the last term includes the external potential:

EQUATION

where \( R_\alpha \), for example, can be the position of an atom.

In principle, the ground state can be obtained by computing the smallest eigenvalue and its corresponding eigenfunction, expressed in terms of a Rayleigh quotient:

EQUATION

The minimizer \( \Phi \) corresponds to the ground state wave function. However, due to the high dimensionality, direct numerical methods like finite difference or finite element methods, combined with numerical quadrature for integrals, suffer from the curse of dimensionality and are typically prohibitively expensive. The variational Monte Carlo (VMC) framework addresses this by selecting an appropriate ansatz, denoted as \( \Phi \approx \Psi_0 \), for the many-body wave function. The multi-dimensional integral is then interpreted as a statistical average, sampled using a Monte Carlo procedure. Traditionally, \( \Psi_0 \) is constructed using one-body wave functions, with particle correlations described by Jastrow factors [11]. Recently, artificial neural networks from machine learning have also been used to represent the many-body wave function [6, 15, 16, 35]. Indeed, the rising interest in applying machine learning to scientific computing has strongly motivated this work.

The first part of this paper discusses the numerical implementation of VMC. Since VMC frames the energy calculation as a sampling problem, the Metropolis-Hastings (MH) algorithm, a type of Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithm in statistics, is a natural approach. At each step, the chain is updated by calculating the energy change, necessitating visits to all particles in the system, as seen from equations (1) and (3). Directly handling this involves \( O(N(N + M)) \) operations per time step. The presence of the Jastrow factor further complicates computation. To reduce computational costs, we propose a random batch method (RBM), inspired by emerging machine learning algorithms [4, 44, 5] and recently applied to classical interacting particle systems [21], and extended to various applications in both classical and quantum N-body systems [13, 19, 20, 26, 28, 30, 29]. In particular, [21] established that the error of RBM is \( O(\sqrt{\Delta t}) \), where \( \Delta t \) is the time step, uniformly in \( N \). Our goal is to use this idea to efficiently relax the quantum system and sample energy in the VMC method.

To achieve this, we first formulate the sampling problem using an over-damped Langevin equation, where particles are driven by a drift and a stochastic force. The use of Langevin dynamics for constructing a VMC algorithm has been explored in [40]. Instead of computing particle interactions directly, our proposed RBM algorithm divides the system into random batches and computes only the interactions within each batch. Consequently, updating all \( N \) particles requires \( O(N + M) \) operations on average. We justify the method by examining the transition density, showing that at each step, the density induced by the RBM aligns with the exact transition kernel up to \( O(\Delta t^2) \), the same order as the Euler-Maruyama method.

Accurate estimation of the complete pose—encompassing position, velocity, and orientation—of a rigid body is a critical challenge for autonomous robotic platforms. Inertial navigation systems (INS) are pivotal in this context, enabling the localization and control of autonomous vehicles by integrating measurements from onboard sensors, primarily accelerometers and gyroscopes, which are typically part of an Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU). INS computes position, velocity, and orientation through direct integration of the sensor data. However, this method is susceptible to measurement errors or unknown initial conditions, necessitating additional sensors like the Global Positioning System (GPS) to refine position estimates over time. In GPS-denied environments, such as indoor settings, alternative sensors such as vision and acoustic sensors can provide bearing (direction) measurements. These measurements can be combined with body-frame vector data from onboard sensors, like magnetometers and dual-GPS, to achieve accurate pose estimation.

Various estimation algorithms have been developed to enhance INS by integrating bearing measurements and body-frame vector observations. These algorithms find applications across diverse fields, including source localization, multiple object tracking, marine navigation, and cooperative navigation. Many of these techniques are Kalman-type filters, which are recognized as industry-standard solutions but have inherent limitations, particularly their reliance on local linearization, making them prone to initialization errors. To address these issues, several nonlinear deterministic observers have been developed recently, offering advantages like well-established stability guarantees and computational simplicity compared to stochastic filters.

In the realm of vision-aided INS, a nonlinear observer using 3D position landmark measurements with global exponential convergence is proposed in some studies. To eliminate the need for reconstructing landmark 3D positions, a nonlinear observer with direct stereo bearing measurements is introduced, providing global stability guarantees under specific conditions related to the number and configuration of landmarks. Monocular cameras, in contrast, offer benefits in cost, simplicity, and reduced weight compared to stereo cameras. Consequently, a local Riccati observer has been proposed for the simultaneous estimation of attitude, position, linear velocity, and accelerometer bias using monocular-bearing measurements, achieving only local exponential convergence. For underwater applications, global exponential convergent observers have been proposed, relying on bearing measurements from acoustic sensors and relative velocity information.

In this paper, we propose a Riccati observer-based estimation scheme for state estimation using IMU and single bearing measurements. Unlike previous works, our estimator, supplemented with an additional body-frame vector observation (e.g., from a magnetometer), provides complete estimation of a vehicle's inertial position, inertial velocity, and orientation. Notably, we do not assume low acceleration to decouple IMU-based attitude and position estimation, as motivated by prior research. Under a persistency of excitation (PE) condition on the vehicle's motion relative to the landmark, our proposed observer ensures global exponential stability, a robust stability result unattainable with geometric observers due to topological constraints. Additionally, using only IMU and single bearing, a reduced-order version of the observer can estimate position, velocity, and gravity direction in the body frame. This body-frame gravity direction helps extract reduced attitude (roll and pitch), while yaw (heading) readings obtained from external sources like dual GPS or a compass enable full vehicle state recovery.

The rest of the paper is structured as follows. The next section provides some preliminaries. Section III formulates the considered problem, detailing the vehicle's model, the available measurements, and the technical assumptions necessary for our main result. In Section IV, we present the main result with the proposed observer and the associated observability analysis. In Section V, we offer simulation results, and Section VI concludes the paper.

美国于2019年7月26日宣布批准对巴基斯坦与印度的军售，包括向巴基斯坦提供1.25亿美元（约新台币39.18亿元）用于提升F-16战机，以及向印度提供6.7亿美元（约新台币210亿元）用于提升C-17运输机等项目。两项军售分别由美国国务院批准并由美国国防安全合作局公布。

此前，印度在2019年2月底曾越界空袭巴基斯坦境内的极端分子基地，巴基斯坦随后击落了一架印度战机，导致印巴两国紧张局势加剧。在此背景下，美国同意提供巴基斯坦F-16战机的技术和后勤支援。美国政府在声明中表示，将派驻美国人员全天候监督战机的最终用途，以确保美国的科技安全，这将有助于维护美国的外交政策和国家安全。数天前，美国总统川普在白宫接见了巴基斯坦总理伊姆兰汗。

对于印度的军售，美国国防安全合作局指出，印度请求为其波音C-17运输机添购备用零件和测试设备，并寻求人员培训等支持，预计相关军售援助金额约为6.7亿美元。美方声明强调，印度需要这些后续支援以维持军机操作准备，以及在区域内的人道救援与救灾能力，同时表示将这些支援融入印度军队不会有任何困难。

在两项军售声明中，美国均强调相关军售不会改变地区军事平衡。

It had been three days since I left the office. The long-range plan was due tomorrow, and for a guy in finance, that meant staying all night. You did what you needed to do to get the job done, and with layoffs around the corner, everyone was out for themselves. My database access had just been revoked due to someone looking at the server the wrong way, so free lunch and freer sunshine beckoned.

The picnic table bench creaked as I shifted from thigh to thigh. The boxed lunch I had pilfered from the office break room, leftover from some unfortunate souls who were bribed by free food to attend a lunchtime seminar on "The Eight Time-Saving Rules and You," was once again unsatisfactory. A vegetable sandwich on rye bread with a pickle in a Ziploc bag and what appeared to be a digestive biscuit. Beggars can't be choosers though.

Chewing thoughtfully, I tried to focus on where I was, the present moment. Anything to escape my churning brain. Closing my eyes, I could hear birds twittering away, staccatic shouts of children at the playground, bicycles winding around the pathways. The rye bread got soggier in my mouth, and a bitter rancid taste took over from the dry bready flavor. I realized that this sandwich might not have been from that day's lunch seminar, but possibly from last week's monthly lunch and learn ("Legal Hold Orders: What to do, Who to Contact").

I opened my eyes and looked at the half sandwich remaining and sighed. I put a hand to my stomach, hoping I wouldn't pay for this meal later. I rested my arms on the table and rested my head on my arms. "Hey, pal, can you spare a few crumbs?" I must have fallen asleep as this gentleman's voice woke me up. I raised my head and mumbled "it's gone bad, bub..." as I looked into the face of an inquisitive pigeon sitting on the table a foot from my face. I blinked at the bird. It blinked back at me.

Outline:
1. Introduction
2. Mathematical Setup
3. Main Results
4. Penalty Approaches and Convergence
5. Future Directions
6. Conclusion

Introduction:
Obstacle and equilibrium problems have a rich history in capturing various applications. While typically obstacles are placed inside Ω or on the boundary ∂Ω, this paper introduces a novel model, enabling obstacles to be placed outside Ω. The main focus is on the variational problem (1.1) involving a nonlocal Laplacian.

Mathematical Setup:
The paper considers a variational problem involving bounded open sets in R^N and introduces the necessary notations and preliminary results in Section 2, defining the Sobolev spaces involved. The problem involves solving for a function u in a closed, convex subset of W^s,2(R^N) subject to certain constraints.

Main Results:
The main novelty lies in the introduction of model (1.1) and the equivalence established between the variational problem and three other characterizations in Proposition 3.4. This work extends existing results by accounting for the nonlocal nature of the fractional Laplacian and employing convex analysis tools to establish key results.

Penalty Approaches and Convergence:
Two penalty approaches are considered in Section 4: L^2-penalty and Sobolev norm penalty. Convergence is established using Mosco convergence arguments, with the convergence rate in the penalty parameters discussed in detail. The paper provides insights into the linear convergence in the solution norm and the quadratic convergence in the constraint violation.

Future Directions:
The techniques developed in this paper hold promise for local problems and finite element approximations. The proposed penalization methods offer avenues for numerically tackling similar problems, with future investigations likely to focus on analyzing final approximation errors and discretization errors.

Conclusion:
In conclusion, this work marks a significant contribution by addressing the exterior obstacle problem, a novel extension from traditional obstacle problems. The paper presents a rigorous mathematical framework, establishing key results and convergence properties for the introduced variational problem, opening up avenues for future research and numerical implementations.

Une femme âgée de 37 ans, Katy Jomphe, originaire de Sainte-Brigitte-de-Laval, a comparu mercredi après-midi au palais de justice de Québec pour répondre à une accusation d’homicide involontaire liée au décès d'une fillette de 10 mois survenu en mai 2018. La Sûreté du Québec (SQ) a procédé à son arrestation mercredi matin. 

La fillette est décédée quelques heures après avoir été retrouvée inconsciente dans une garderie en milieu familial où travaillait Katy Jomphe au moment du drame, selon le sergent Louis-Philippe Bibeau. Une autopsie réalisée après les tristes événements a permis de mieux comprendre les circonstances de la mort de l’enfant, conduisant ainsi à l'arrestation de la suspecte le mercredi matin.

彰化县溪湖镇公所今天（3日）表扬模范夫妻，其中有4对结婚满60年的老夫妻穿上婚纱礼服接受祝福。连同陪伴前来的儿孙一起，礼堂座无虚席，也拍摄了全家福照片。

镇长黄瑞珠表示，这些夫妻来自不同的家庭，经历了漫长的旅程，一起走过酸甜苦辣，实在不容易。她祝福所有夫妻能够幸福美满。

溪湖镇公所特别利用中秋连假的返乡团圆机会，让结缡50年以上的银发长辈重新感受新婚的情愫，提前庆祝重阳节。活动由6对镇立幼儿园小朋友骑着脚踏车，可爱的小花童洒花引领下拉开序幕。共有4对钻石婚夫妻穿着白纱礼服入场，场面浪漫，家属踊跃参与。

白金婚夫妇陈环（93岁）和陈王盛（94岁）是凭借媒妁之言结为夫妻。他们一起种葡萄养家，陈王盛笑着说：“结为夫妻，别想太多，开心就好。”陈环则表示，夫妻间难免会有些口角，事过则忘。

黄瑞珠指出，许多婚龄超过50年的长辈结婚时从未穿过西式白纱礼服，甚至未见过对方的面容，却能相伴一生，这在当今离婚率攀升的社会中显得珍贵。因此，公所举办这次活动是希望以喜悦之心帮助长者重新体验婚礼的快乐。看着多位女性长辈穿上白纱，脸上露出害羞又幸福的表情，让人觉得这个活动意义非凡。

钻石婚夫妇陈荣（86岁）和章阿蜡（83岁）也是根据媒妁之言结为一对。陈荣是美发师，章阿蜡在家务农，共育有4名子女。章阿蜡表示，夫妻间若有分歧，她无论多不开心都会想到离异后面对公婆和处理孩子的难题。作为妻子、媳妇和母亲，她时刻为家庭全局着想。

老夫妻们分享经营婚姻的秘诀：一切都要平淡，“冤家难免有，过去了就好。”金婚夫妇面带笑容说着，手牵手互相注视，幸福在笑容中绽放。

Farm loan waivers have become a hot topic in Indian politics, with three newly elected Congress-led state governments announcing their intentions to waive off farm loans. Rahul Gandhi, the Congress chief, tweeted about the loan waivers in Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh, hinting that Rajasthan might follow suit soon. This move comes after the Congress defeated the BJP in these states.

The real impact of these loan waivers remains to be seen, as the quantum of funds required and the ability of the governments to fund such one-time expenses are in question. The fine print of the waivers, including the conditions for farmers to qualify, will determine the total amount needed in each state. Past experiences in states like Karnataka, Punjab, and Uttar Pradesh show that the actual impact of loan waivers takes time to materialize.

The history of farm loan waivers in India dates back to the UPA government's massive waiver in 2008, which helped them win another term in office. Subsequent loan waivers in states like Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Tamil Nadu have added to the burden on state finances. The RBI's report highlights the strain on state budgets due to revenue deficits and growing liabilities.

The current situation in the three Congress-led states raises concerns about revenue growth and fiscal responsibility. The states may face challenges in funding the loan waivers given the slow pace of revenue growth. The decline in tax revenues, particularly related to GST implementation, adds to the uncertainty surrounding the financial implications of the waivers.

While the exact amount for the farm loan waivers is unclear, it is evident that the states' revenue streams are not strong. Until GST collections stabilize, these governments may need to cut expenses in other areas to accommodate the loan waivers. The financial implications of these decisions will unfold in the coming months, shedding light on the feasibility and impact of the farm loan waivers in these states.

Antonio García debería formar parte de la lista de indultados por el Rey. Era el número 45 de la lista. A día de hoy sigue en Marruecos, sin fecha para volver. Afirma: "Me dicen que pronto marcharé, pero no sé más. Dicen que mi caso es especial, pero yo no sé nada".

Efectivamente, su caso es especial: está enfermo del corazón y sufre diabetes. Asegura que toma hasta 18 pastillas diarias y que ha sufrido varios amagos de infarto en prisión. Antonio confirma: "Desde los 16 meses que llevo aquí, ni idea de cómo prosigue mi enfermedad. Nadie me dice nada. Tomo 18 pastillas; es imposible controlarse aquí. No hay comida de dieta, no puedo hacer nada".

Incluso el Rey Don Juan Carlos se interesó por su caso. Fue el único preso por el que preguntó en su viaje a Marruecos. Aunque sigue entre rejas, Antonio se lo agradece y afirma: "Me gustaría volver a España y darle las gracias en persona al Rey".

Las condiciones en las que vive Antonio no son las mejores para su enfermedad. Explica que "hay 11 camas, somos 15 personas, hay gente que duerme en el suelo. Yo ahora ya tengo cama, antes no".

Asegura que ni siquiera puede seguir una dieta especial para controlar su diabetes. Está condenado a cuatro años de cárcel por tráfico de drogas. Es camionero, y el año pasado le encontraron, junto a su hijo, nueve toneladas de hachís en su camión. Su familia está muy preocupada. Piden que, si no se le indulta, al menos se le traslade a España. Así nos lo contaba su hermana hace unos días en 'Más Vale Tarde': "pedimos que le traigan aquí".

Quien está en España es su hijo. Fueron encarcelados juntos, pero él, que goza de buena salud, sí ha recibido el indulto. Antonio cuenta: "Aquí se está yendo todo el mundo menos yo".

Antonio está indignado, sobre todo sabiendo a quienes sí han indultado. Afirma: "Esto tiene cojones. Me estoy muriendo aquí con la enfermedad que tengo, y un pederasta sale libre. Pienso yo, estoy derrotado, totalmente caído".

En la cárcel de Tánger le dicen que pronto saldrá, que él no debería estar ahí, pero lo cierto es que está y que su salud empeora. Antonio es un error más de una lista de indultos llena de despistes y chapuzas.

In a shocking and gruesome incident, a 17-year-old boy, identified as Swethan, was brutally hacked to death by a group of men in Tamil Nadu's Cuddalore district. The attackers decapitated the teenager, wrapped his severed head in a gunny bag, and later threw it at the entrance of a police station. The headless body was found dumped in a lake approximately three kilometers away from the station.

Chilling CCTV footage captured two bikers arriving at the police station, flinging the severed head at the entrance, and speeding away. According to the police, the murder was carried out by a gang involved in chain-snatching and bike theft in the region. Investigators suspect the incident is linked to ongoing gang wars in the area.

Actuellement en pleine confiance et porté par un immense Nainggolan, Cagliari a corrigé la Fiorentina 5-2 dimanche lors de la 12e journée de Serie A, plaçant ainsi provisoirement les Sardes à la troisième place.

Cagliari enchaîne trois victoires consécutives et maintient un rythme soutenu depuis deux mois. Malgré avoir perdu les deux premiers matchs de la saison, l'équipe sarde reste invaincue depuis dix rencontres, remportant sept succès.

Cette victoire de dimanche lui permet de dépasser l'Atalanta Bergame ainsi que les équipes de Rome. Ces trois clubs doivent encore jouer ce dimanche et pourraient s'installer sur le podium, continuant ainsi à rêver de l'Europe.

Face à une Fiorentina en difficulté en l'absence de Franck Ribéry, le joueur clé du match a été Radja Nainggolan. De retour en Sardaigne après une saison compliquée à l'Inter Milan, le Belge a offert trois passes décisives et marqué un but d'une frappe fantastique.

Cagliari menait 5-0 et s'est simplement relâché en fin de match, permettant à la Fiorentina (8e) de limiter les dégâts.

مع كل أزمة يمر بها إخوتنا الأقباط لأسباب مجتمعية أو قضائية أو سياسية، يقوم بعض النشطاء الأقباط في الخارج بتوجيه الانتقادات للرئيس، وكأن الرئيس هو المسؤول عن منح فتاة المنيا صفراً في الامتحان، أو تحريض الأطفال على التظاهر ضد تعيين مديرة مسيحية للمدرسة، أو إصدار حكم بسجن أطفال المنيا الثلاثة لمدة خمس سنوات مع العمل الشاق!

وكأن السيسي يضطهد الأقباط في منازلهم. وفي الوقت نفسه، يلومون إخوتنا في الداخل على دعمهم للرئيس، ويستنكرون حبهم له باعتباره منقذهم من الاحتلال الإخواني. هذا أمر عجيب! ماذا فعل السيسي لهؤلاء، وماذا لم يفعله لهم؟ هل يتدخل في الأحكام القضائية؟ هل يمنح الطالبة الدرجات النهائية؟ هل يقرر ما يحدث في المدارس؟ هذا هو مجتمعكم، وهذا هو قانونكم، وهذه هي مدارسكم، وهي تركة ثقيلة يجب أن نساعد الرئيس في مواجهتها.

علاقة السيسي بالمصريين، والأقباط في مقدمتهم، لا تتأثر بقضايا ناتجة عن مجتمع مليء بالعنصرية والطائفية والتمييز. كلنا في الهم سواء، والعنصرية والطائفية والتمييز لا تستهدف إخوتنا الأقباط فقط، بل تستهدف الجميع. التمييز كأس مر يتجرعه الجميع. من منا لم يعانِ من العنصرية والطائفية والتمييز؟ نحن شعب يضطهد نفسه بنفسه، ولدينا مرجعيات مجتمعية موروثة تحتاج إلى ثورة لتغيير المفاهيم والقوانين. أين قانون منع التمييز؟ لماذا تستمر مادة ازدراء الأديان في التهام صغارنا؟

قصة فتاة المنيا مع إدارة الامتحانات ومديرة المدرسة مع الإدارة التعليمية، وكذلك قضية الأطفال الثلاثة، كلها معروفة. ما دخل الرئيس في ذلك؟ هذا ناتج عن خلل في المجتمع، أسوأ ما فينا يظهر تباعاً. العنصرية كامنة تحت الجلد، والطائفية تعيش في أعماق البيوت، والقضاء هو القانون. لو كان الأمر بيد السيسي، لربما حاول دعم جميع المصريين. أين دور النواب الأقباط والمسلمين في معالجة مادة ازدراء الأديان التي تضر بالجميع؟

تجربة الأقباط مع السيسي خلال 18 شهراً من الحكم تظهر أن الرجل لا يفرق بين المصريين، بل يتهمه البعض بمحاباة الأقباط. حضر احتفالات عيد الميلاد المجيد في الكاتدرائية المرقسية في مناسبتين متتاليتين، متحملاً هجمات المتطرفين، ودعا في المولد النبوي الشريف للاحتفال مع الإخوة الأقباط. أصبحت مشاركته في احتفالات عيد الميلاد تقليداً رئاسياً. وانتفض لذبح الأقباط في ليبيا، وأمر بشن غارات جوية انتقاماً لهم. هذا ليس غريباً على رئيس المصريين.

من يفكر ملياً في أوضاع الأقطار العربية بعد ما سُمّي بـ(الربيع العربي) يجد أن تلك الثورات لم تجلب لبلدانهم سوى الدمار. حصدت أرواح البشر وأحرقت الأخضر واليابس دون الوصول إلى نتيجة، كالمنبت لا أرضاً قطع ولا ظهراً أبقى.

يبدو للمفكر في هذه الأوضاع العجيبة أن ما حصل وما سيحدث في المستقبل ناجم عن (الأمية) التي لا تزال سائدة. فالجماهير الغوغائية التي تتبع دعاة الفتنة المتنازعين على الكراسي تدور بلا فلك وتصبح حطب تلك الفتن.

إن بداية المأساة كانت من الثورات والانقلابات العسكرية الطائشة منذ مطلع خمسينات القرن الماضي، مروراً بما حصل في بلاد الرافدين ومعارك ثماني سنوات مع (إيران) التي لم يقتصر ضررها على مسببيها بل طال دول مجاوريها، ثم انحسرت بالفشل. ناهيك عن الغزو البلهاء للجارة (الكويت) وما ترتب عليه من المآسي، وما يزال (العراق) يعاني من تفجير يومي يخرب ويدمر ويزهق الأرواح.

أما ثالثة الأثافي، فهي ما جاءت به ما يُسمى (الصحوة والأخونة الإسلامية) من إرباك وفوضى وبلبلة في مجتمع كان إلى أمد قريب مضرب المثل في الاستقرار والأمن والتعايش السلمي.

Graph-structured data are widely used in real-world applications, such as social networks and chemistry and biomedical molecules. Existing methods have achieved great success in tackling single tasks within these domains. For example, researchers have formulated molecular property prediction as a graph classification task, conducted graph sampling for large-scale graphs, designed expressive graph learning algorithms (GLAs) to extract structural information, and selected appropriate hyper-parameters during the evaluation stage. Despite these successes, several challenges remain in the field of graph learning.

One major challenge is the diversity of graph domains and learning problems encountered in real-world applications. This diversity necessitates that human experts configure complex procedures individually, requiring substantial professionalism and domain knowledge. The varying nature of tasks and domains makes it difficult for human experts to efficiently handle graph learning problems without significant human intervention. Consequently, there is a need for versatile graph learning methods that can adapt to different tasks and domains with minimal human assistance.

Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising solution for designing versatile graph learning algorithms due to their extensive knowledge and human-like intelligence. These large-sized, pre-trained language models have rapidly advanced in recent years. By pre-training on comprehensive text data and prompt-tuning for downstream tasks, LLMs demonstrate the ability to make human-level decisions. They can reason through mathematical problems, span different tasks with superior performance, and solve computer vision tasks similarly to human experts. Given these capabilities, LLMs show potential to serve as Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) and as general research assistants.

The advantages of LLMs have sparked interest in applying them to graph learning problems. By leveraging their preserved knowledge, various graph learning tasks can be translated into textual descriptions, allowing LLMs to make predictions. LLMs enhance textural-attributed graphs (TAGs) and have spurred progress in designing effective techniques for diverse graph learning problems. Consequently, it's essential to explore systematic approaches to developing versatile graph learning methods using LLMs.

This paper provides a comprehensive review of existing methods and develops a conceptual prototype by aligning the strengths of LLMs with the requirements of versatile graph learning methods. The key insights focus on identifying where LLMs can be integrated and how they can be used effectively. It is crucial to examine the feasibility of LLMs across diverse graph learning procedures to fully utilize their versatile abilities. We summarize four key procedures within a standard machine learning pipeline: task definition, feature engineering, model selection and optimization, and deployment and serving.

The "Where" perspective in our conceptual prototype spans the four key procedures in the graph learning pipeline, while the "How" perspective is organized based on the different levels of LLM capabilities. We categorize existing methods into three levels: those without LLM requirements, those emphasizing LLMs' ability to understand, encode, and reason with natural language, and those requiring human-level decision-making and domain-specific knowledge. This approach encourages exploring LLM applications in each procedure, enhancing the versatility of graph learning methods.

Our proposed conceptual prototype is illustrated in Fig. 1, highlighting the integration of LLM abilities at various levels within the graph learning pipeline. Table 1 provides detailed examples of how the desired LLM capabilities can be selected for each procedure. By considering these perspectives, we offer a comprehensive overview of graph learning methods integrated with LLMs and emphasize the potential for broad exploration and usability of LLM abilities in versatile graph learning approaches.

Finally, we suggest promising future directions, focusing on underexplored LLM abilities and the properties of graph-structured data. These include understanding graph structures, developing large graph foundation models, and creating universal graph learning agents.

El Gobierno de Santa Fe anunció este jueves que también exigirá el "pase sanitario" previsto por Nación para el ingreso a eventos masivos. La medida fue comunicada junto con la adhesión al pase sanitario para eventos masivos dispuesto por el gobierno nacional. La medida entrará en vigencia a las 0 del 21 de diciembre y las autoridades municipales y comunales podrán disponer en sus respectivos distritos la necesidad de contar con el esquema de vacunación completo, para participar en otras actividades adicionales a las definidas en el Decreto provincial.

En la ciudad de Santa Fe, autoridades de la Municipalidad mantendrán este viernes una reunión con representantes de los propietarios de boliches bailables para discutir los alcances de la implementación del pase sanitario.

En cuanto a la actividad de los locales gastronómicos, la provincia de Santa Fe dispuso un nuevo horario: los días jueves, viernes, sábados y víspera de feriados podrán permanecer abiertos hasta las 5 del día siguiente; el resto de los días de la semana, hasta las 4 del día siguiente.

Para los salones de eventos, fiestas y similares, las nuevas medidas permiten la apertura los días jueves, viernes, sábados y víspera de feriados, hasta las 5 del día siguiente; el resto de los días de la semana, hasta las 4 del día siguiente.

Por último, se anunció que los casinos y bingos podrán abrir todos los días de la semana, entre las 10 horas y las 5 horas del día siguiente, cumpliendo con las reglas generales de conducta y de prevención, así como los protocolos aprobados para la actividad.

Studying Venus is a worthy pursuit despite the dangers it presents because people can discover what is happening on Venus and uncover something new. The text explains that the conditions on Venus, while challenging, are survivable for humans due to factors such as high temperatures and pressure levels comparable to those at sea level on Earth. This suggests that there are ways to explore the planet without physically landing on its surface.

Furthermore, studying Venus allows researchers to identify similarities and differences between the planet and Earth. The text describes Venus as possibly having been covered by oceans in the past, potentially supporting various forms of life similar to our own planet. This comparison highlights the importance of understanding how Venus relates to Earth in terms of its composition and history.

Moreover, scientists are working towards creating machines capable of withstanding Venus's extreme conditions for exploration purposes. By developing technology resistant to factors like heat and pressure, researchers aim to gather valuable data about Venus without risking human safety. This emphasis on using durable equipment underscores the necessity of deploying robust tools for studying this enigmatic planet.

In conclusion, delving into the mysteries of Venus offers significant benefits despite the inherent risks involved in such endeavors. By leveraging innovative technologies, observing from a safe distance, studying similarities with Earth, and exploring potential habitability aspects from afar are all crucial aspects of investigating this fascinating celestial body.

اعتبرت ليلة جوائز الدورة الـ91 من الأوسكار ليلة المفاجآت والتنوع الثقافي. شهدت الليلة فوز ممثلين أسودين بجائزتي أفضل ممثل مساعد وممثلة مساعدة، وهما ماهرشالا علي وريجينا كينج، كما حصل ممثل من أصول عربية، رامي مالك، على جائزة أفضل ممثل عن تجسيده دور فريدي ميركوري في فيلم «الملحمة البوهيمية» (بوهيميان رابسودي)، الذي كان أكبر صائد للجوائز في الليلة، إذ حصد في الإجمال أربع جوائز. مالك، الذي وُلد في الولايات المتحدة لأبوين مصريين، قال: «ربما لم أكن الخيار الواضح، لكن أظن أن الأمر نجح».

فاز فيلم «كتاب أخضر» (جرين بوك)، الذي ينتمي إلى أفلام رحلات الطريق، بجائزة أوسكار أفضل فيلم، متغلباً على فيلم «روما»، ما حرم شبكة نتفليكس من فرصة أن تكون أول خدمة بث تتفوق على استوديوهات هوليوود في عقر دارها. الفيلم يحكي عن صداقة غير مألوفة تنشأ بين عازف بيانو أسود وسائقه الأبيض، وهما يجوبان الجنوب الأميركي في الستينات، حيث كان يشيع التمييز العنصري، وحصل على جائزتي أفضل سيناريو أصلي، وأفضل ممثل مساعد لعلي.

حصل فيلم «النمر الأسود» (بلاك بانثر)، الذي يهيمن السود على فريق التمثيل فيه، على ثلاث جوائز أوسكار، من بينها تصميم الأزياء، عن رؤيته لعالم مملكة واكاندا الإفريقية الخيالية.
