NEW YORK, Feb 15 (Reuters) - Morgan Stanley's chief U.S. equity strategist, Adam Parker, is departing the firm, as per an internal memo from the company seen by Reuters on Tuesday.

Parker is set to join hedge fund Eminence Capital as its director of quantitative strategy, as per a source familiar with the matter who chose to remain anonymous due to the confidential nature of the situation. While at Morgan Stanley, Parker also held the position of director of quantitative research.

In his absence, Mike Wilson, Morgan Stanley's chief investment officer of wealth management, will be taking on an expanded role. This includes assuming Parker's responsibilities and also acting as the chief investment officer of institutional securities.

Wilson has a long history with Morgan Stanley, having started at the firm in 1989 as an investment banker. Over the years, he has held various key positions, including head of content distribution. In 2012, he was appointed as the chief investment officer of wealth management.

The House has passed a bill to criminalize international doping conspiracies, similar to those that marred the 2014 Sochi Olympics. The bill, approved Tuesday by a voice vote, is named after Grigory Rodchenkov, the former director of Moscow's anti-doping lab, who played a key role in exposing Russia's extensive cheating scheme.

If the Senate, where the bill enjoys broad support, also passes it, the law would impose fines of up to $1 million and prison sentences of up to 10 years for those involved in schemes intended to manipulate international sports competitions through doping.

El Día de la Construcción se celebra este lunes en Uruguay. El sector, uno de los que se recuperó más rápidamente de la pandemia, emplea actualmente a unas 50.000 personas. En el segundo trimestre de este año, la industria de la construcción registró un crecimiento del 14% en comparación con el mismo período de 2020, cuando se había visto más afectada por la pandemia. Los empresarios estiman que al cierre de este año, la ocupación en el sector habrá crecido un 5%.

La industria de la construcción capta el 70% de la inversión en Uruguay. En 2020, esta cifra ascendió a US$ 6.000 millones. Actualmente, el 20% de esa inversión corresponde a la construcción de la nueva planta de UPM y la obra del Ferrocarril Central. Sin embargo, preocupa a los empresarios qué pasará cuando esas obras terminen.

La inversión en obra pública es un dato que la Cámara de la Construcción observa con atención. El año pasado, la inversión fue de 1.550 millones de dólares. Para los próximos cuatro años previstos en el presupuesto, se proyectan 6.800 millones de dólares, con un promedio anual de 1.770 millones de dólares entre 2021 y 2024.

El promedio de inversión en obra pública en esos cuatro años es de 2,8% del producto bruto interno (PBI). En el quinquenio anterior, del 2015 al 2019, la inversión fue de 3,5% del PBI. La Cámara de la Construcción estima que la inversión prevista debería crecer un 50% y alcanzar los 2.500 millones de dólares anuales.

彭博引述知情人士称，最近苹果公司（AAPL-US）与现代集团起亚汽车合作生产Apple Car的谈判已经暂停，但与其他生产商的磋商仍在进行中。

据报道，苹果确实曾与起亚进行磋商，但谈判在不久前暂停。苹果拒绝置评。

近来有关苹果开发电动车的“泰坦计划”（Project Titan）的传言甚嚣尘上，谣传合作对象现代和起亚的股价都大涨。

然而，也有报道披露，持有起亚控股权的现代集团对这项代工计划感到犹豫，与此同时，苹果正在与六家日本车厂洽商合作。

彭博指出，这些消息让多年来一直低调进行泰坦计划，并对供应商提出高要求的苹果感到沮丧。

目前尚不清楚苹果和现代何时会恢复磋商。在全球范围内，只有少数几家车厂有能力和充足的产能来量产汽车，但尚不清楚哪家车厂有兴趣为苹果进行代工。

除此之外，苹果和现代之间还存在其他阻碍因素，据说现代集团内部正在争论，代工合作应由现代还是起亚来承担。如果重新启动与苹果的谈判，可能更有可能交由起亚来生产，地点将位于乔治亚州的工厂。

业界也对苹果追赶特斯拉（TSLA-US）、通用（GM-US）等电动车生产商的决心感到好奇，是否已经强大到需要寻找一家成熟的制造商来生产自己的产品。

泰坦计划始于2014年，苹果曾公开表示不会开发电动汽车，只专注于研发自动驾驶系统，但在2019年挖角特斯拉高层后，低调推动计划进行。

"Our cause is righteous and just!" Rathna exclaimed, thrusting his fist into the air. Before him, three hundred followers echoed his gesture, their collective roar threatening to escape the confines of the warehouse. Yet Rathna was unconcerned; his people were ready. "We. Will. Not. FALTER!" he bellowed, and the crowd responded in kind, three hundred voices merging with his own. Dust shook from the wooden rafters, and the flickering torches lining the space cast wavering shadows.

As the noise gradually subsided, a squeaky voice emerged from the crowd before Rathna. 

"What if we do?" the voice questioned.

Rathna sought the source and found a man gazing up at him from a makeshift platform. The man wore the simple clothing of a peasant—a tan jacket and rough hessian trousers. His face was smudged with dirt, but his blue eyes shone like small pools of water on a sunny day. However, his expression revealed a complete lack of comprehension. Rathna opened his mouth to respond, but the man continued in his high-pitched voice.

"What if we do falter? I mean, there's a lot of men out there. Men with swords!" The man's brows were furrowed so deeply in confusion that Rathna feared they might remain that way.

Rathna seized the moment before it could slip away. "Swords?" he thundered to the crowd. "Swords?! We have hope! We have passion! We have strength!" The crowd roared again, and Rathna paused for breath to deliver the climax of his rousing speech. He noticed his men entering the warehouse from the rear, arms full of weaponry.

"Well, that's all very well, but I'd rather have a sword than hope. Who ever got stabbed with a *hope*?" the man quipped.

*He can't possibly be this slow? Surely this is a test?* Rathna scanned the crowd, who remained with him, and he sensed their fervent desire for freedom and justice. He laughed, feigning agreement with the simple-minded man. "What is your name, my friend?"

The man looked utterly perplexed. "Jezzeth."

Rathna turned his attention back to the crowd. "Jezzeth says he fears a sword if all we have is hope. But, my friends, I tell you, we have more than hope, more than passion, more than strength. We, too, have swords!" Rathna gestured towards the back of the expansive room, where his men unveiled gleaming piles of swords. The crowd turned and cheered as the metal caught the warm glow within the building.

"Well," Jezzeth began, his eyes searching the floor for words he had yet to form.

The effectiveness of Deep Learning models relies heavily on data representations [4]. Therefore, learning paradigms and metrics are devised to optimize the model's ability to extract valuable features from the data. Contrastive Learning (CL) approaches concentrate on learning data representations, typically in self-supervised settings [26]. The success of CL models can be attributed to the abundance of unlabeled visual data and the ease of implementing subtle yet impactful augmentations. The primary aim is to enhance the Mutual Information (MI) between features derived from augmented perspectives of the data. While CL paradigms excel in various tasks, their triumph is not solely due to the characteristics of MI alone [55].

In the linguistic realm, representations are influenced by both semantic and temporal information within the data [32]. Traditional methods [39, 44] encode words into vectors based on their positions in the corpus, whereas recent approaches optimize language modeling tasks to refine representations [46, 14, 7, 30, 37]. Recently, CL-based methods have emerged to develop universal representations through augmentations in pre-training [48, 35, 42, 10]. However, the discrete nature of languages poses challenges in creating label-preserving data augmentations [45]. Training paradigms like Multilingual Masked Language Modeling (MMLM) [14, 10, 29] and Translation Language Modeling (TLM) [28, 10] necessitate the acquisition of language-specific knowledge by the model [10]. The mixed training objectives introduce a trade-off between the universality of the learned representations, reliant on language-agnosticism, and the model's performance in tasks demanding language-specific information [10].

Neural Machine Translation (NMT) models endeavor to translate sentences between languages while maintaining semantic integrity. This requires models to prioritize extracting semantic and language-agnostic content over language-specific details. To enhance this process, we propose a novel Context Enhancement (CE) step that employs the Barlow Twins loss [62] to maximize MI and minimize redundancies between representations of parallel sentences. Our approach refrains from explicitly augmenting data, treating sentences as augmented perspectives of their meanings. Additionally, we enhance pre-trained embeddings instead of starting from scratch, enhancing generalizability and reducing computational overhead. Unlike previous works [28, 10, 29], our approach aligns with the primary NMT training objective.

Since its introduction, the Transformer architecture [66] has become the dominant model for natural language processing tasks, replacing the previously popular recurrent architectures. The Vision Transformer (ViT) [16] is a straightforward adaptation of transformers for computer vision tasks, such as image classification. In this approach, the input image is divided into non-overlapping patches, which are then fed into a standard transformer architecture after passing through a linear patch projection layer. Unlike networks built from convolutional layers, transformers enable parallel processing and provide a complete field-of-view in a single layer. Together with other attention-based architectures, such as those in [4, 7], transformers have significantly influenced the design of computer vision architectures. Many modern architectures in computer vision either directly inherit aspects of their design from transformers or, at the very least, draw inspiration from the recent advancements in the field [7, 16, 62]. Consequently, substantial improvements have been observed across various computer vision tasks, including object detection, segmentation [18], video analysis [1, 19], and image generation [9, 31].

While vision transformers have driven notable progress, the optimization of their design and training procedures has, so far, been explored only to a limited extent.

NORMAN (TNS) — Oklahoma safety Delarrin Turner-Yell was taken aback last week when he walked into his positional meeting room and noticed a new face.
There waiting was freshman Trejan Bridges, one of Oklahoma’s three five-star receivers from the 2019 recruiting class.
Although Bridges has played in the first three games, recording three catches for 56 yards and a touchdown, he might secure more consistent playing time at safety.
"That’s something Trejan discussed with Coach (Lincoln) Riley," noted Sooners defensive coordinator Alex Grinch. "We might end up in a recruiting battle, trying to recruit several offensive players if he allows us."
Grinch was likely jesting, and Riley probably does not want too many players shifting positions, but given Grinch's public concerns about the Sooners' safety depth since the spring, Bridges could become a valuable asset.
One of Grinch’s main objectives for his defense has been to develop sufficient depth to rotate players. This approach has worked well with the defensive line, linebackers, and cornerbacks.
However, the same cannot be said for the safety position. Starters Pat Fields and Turner-Yell have played significantly more than other defenders in the first three games of the season.
“You're not seeing enough rotation at that position,” Grinch remarked. “While our performance on Saturdays has been decent, it's not the standard. We strive for much higher excellence.”
Grinch emphasized that moving forward involves having more players ready to play in games, particularly given the heavy workload on the safeties, who must handle both run defense and pass coverage.
The speed at which Bridges might integrate into the defensive rotation remains uncertain, but Turner-Yell expressed confidence in Bridges' potential impact.
“He's still in the learning phase,” Turner-Yell stated. “I can't wait to see him fully grasp the defense. Once that happens, he's going to be outstanding. He'll be all over the field, making plays. He only switched over from offense, what, last week? So, I'm eager to see his progress.”
Earlier on Monday, Riley neither confirmed nor denied a potential position change for Bridges, indicating he would announce any permanent shifts.
“We haven’t made any final decisions with Trejan or anyone else,” Riley mentioned.

Motion planning is essential for autonomy of a robot in completing a task. In practice, robotic systems are subject to unmodeled dynamics or environment, which is often compensated by introducing random processes, i.e. noise, to the system model. The noise needs to be explicitly considered in the motion planning in order to complete a task reliably. In this work, we refer to such motion planning problems as stochastic motion planning. More specifically, we consider the problem of navigating a car-like robot with a range sensor.

A principled way to solve stochastic motion planning is to model the problem as a Partially Observed Markov Decision Process (POMDP). Methods following this approach are often known as belief space planning in the robotics community. van den Berg et al. extend iterative Linear Quadratic Regulator (iLQR) to belief dynamics, and propose (belief space) iterative Linear Quadratic Gaussian (iLQG), which solves a local optimal control policy for a continuous POMDP. Superior performance is shown in light-dark domain problems, where measurements have small or large noise in light or dark regions respectively. However, few work has reported successful applications of iLQG for more common sensors, such as range sensors considered in this work.

We summarize the reasons for the lack of applications of iLQG to range sensors as follows. First, iLQG requires the underlying system to have differentiable motion and measurement models. However, because of the discontinuity in the environment, the range sensor model is often nondifferentiable. Second, informative measurements, i.e. measurements that are effective in reducing localization uncertainty, from range sensors are sparse. To elaborate, informative measurements can only be obtained if obstacles are within the maximum sensing range of the beams. If the robot is sufficiently far from the obstacles with all measurements saturated at the maximum range, it cannot be known where to move to collect informative measurements by just locally perturbing the robot state. In terms of optimization, it means a majority of states are saddle points, providing trivial gradient information and preventing iLQG from converging to a local minimum.

Contributions: In this work, we apply iLQG to solve the stochastic motion planning problem for car-like robots with range sensors by addressing the previously mentioned two limitations.

Turlock junior running back Josiah Gonzales was simply looking for a chance to shine. When senior Anthony Frias left the game in the first quarter with a neck injury, Gonzales was called upon to carry a heavier-than-usual workload. He rose to the occasion, scoring three rushing touchdowns and leading Turlock to a 44-27 victory over Downey at Chuck Hughes Stadium on Friday, in a Central California Athletic League game.

“I loved it,” Gonzales said, who racked up 29 carries for 204 yards. “I have a lot more in store, and we made a big statement.”

Gonzales made an impact early, scoring a 54-yard touchdown run on the game's second play.

The Bulldogs introduced a new play called “Blue Bear,” which involves lining up in a spread formation, including the linemen, before pulling together tightly to run the ball. Gonzales’s touchdown was the first execution of this play, and the Bulldogs used it throughout the game.

“It’s something new,” Bulldogs coach James Peterson explained. “We are adding little wrinkles to our offense.”

In a closely contested matchup between two of the top teams in the CCAL, Turlock (1-0, 4-2) led 10-6 after the first quarter and held a 24-14 lead at halftime. The Bulldogs maintained a four-point advantage into the fourth quarter.

Early in the fourth quarter, Downey (0-1, 3-3) found themselves with a 1st-and-goal from the 1-yard line. After three negative plays, senior quarterback Bryce Gouker connected with senior wide receiver Lawrence Harris for a touchdown, giving the Knights their first lead.

However, Turlock quickly answered back. Senior quarterback Brock Paslay threw a 15-yard slant pass to Holden Baldwin, who completed the play for a 42-yard touchdown, giving Turlock a 30-27 lead with 7 minutes and 57 seconds remaining.

After Downey turned the ball over on downs, Gonzales ran in another touchdown with just over five minutes left, and senior running back Dalton Linn sealed the victory with a touchdown run with 55 seconds remaining.

Peterson credited the bye week for allowing his team to address some early-season sloppiness.

“We have been facing some tough defenses and needed to get back to basics, focusing on blocking and tackling,” he said.

The game was heated, with both teams exchanging words. The Knights suffered several costly penalties that negated significant plays in the fourth quarter.

“We can’t have those,” Downey coach Jeremy Plaa commented. “Those were self-inflicted.”

Plaa expressed concern about his team’s confidence after two consecutive losses before the bye week. The Knights had been outscored 104-26 in defeats to McClymonds and Escalon.

Despite the loss, Plaa was proud of his players' efforts. Senior running back Robert Rivera, who dealt with cramps in both legs throughout the game, managed 23 carries for 39 yards and a touchdown, along with nine receptions for 59 yards and another touchdown.

“He is one of the toughest kids in the CCAL,” Plaa praised.

Turlock improved its all-time record against Downey to 28-26-3.

“We need to stop the power run game,” Plaa concluded. “We have faced three tough opponents in a row and need to maintain our composure.”

Charlie Tate has brought remarkable stability and transformation to the Winter Haven football program since taking over as head coach. As the longest-serving coach in the team's history, Tate is the program’s all-time winningest coach, with 112 official wins and 117 wins on the field. His tenure, now in its 15th season, is marked by consistent victories and playoff contention.

Before Tate's arrival, Winter Haven had struggled to maintain winning seasons. From 1935 through 2004, the team won more than seven games just 11 times. In the 20 years preceding Tate's leadership, Winter Haven managed only nine seasons with a .500 or better record, and just seven seasons above .500, never winning more than seven games. In contrast, during Tate’s 14 full seasons, the team never had a losing record on the field and won more than seven games eight times.

This season, however, presented unique challenges for Tate and the Blue Devils. An exodus of top players in the spring, including quarterback Eric Williams and wide receiver Deangelo Sapp, left the team with a younger, less experienced lineup, especially on offense. The season started rocky, with the Blue Devils losing their first two games by a combined score of 64-21. "It's been different, that's for sure," Tate remarked on the early challenges.

Despite the setbacks, the team began to find its rhythm mid-season. Entering a homecoming rivalry game against Auburndale, Winter Haven was on a three-game winning streak, having outscored opponents 122-0. Yet, even Tate admitted uncertainty about the team's potential, acknowledging that two of the victories were against weaker teams, Liberty and Poinciana.

In response to losing key players, Tate opted for a strategic change by installing the Wing-T offense, an old but potentially unfamiliar formation for opponents. "We’ve got the big fullback (Tyreece Anglin), we’ve got some skill kids who can carry the ball. Let’s put in the Wing-T," Tate explained. The offense has been a work in progress, particularly as Anglin, the fullback, recovered from an early-season injury.

The turnaround commenced against Liberty, where the team's performance was exceptional.

In a well-known scene from the film "Titanic," Rose makes a simple yet profound request of Jack: "...draw me like one of your French girls." This request is deceptively rich in information. It instructs Jack to create a drawing, suggests that the style and composition should align with a particular subset of his past works, and through the word "me," specifies the unique subject: Rose herself. By making this request, Rose trusts Jack's ability to reason over both broad and specific concepts and bring them to life in a new creation.

Recently, large-scale text-to-image models (Rombach et al., 2021; Ramesh et al., 2021, 2022; Nichol et al., 2021; Yu et al., 2022; Saharia et al., 2022) have demonstrated an unprecedented capacity to interpret natural language descriptions. These models enable users to synthesize novel scenes with unseen compositions and produce vivid images in a myriad of styles. They have been employed for artistic creation, as sources of inspiration, and even in designing new physical products (Yacoubian, 2022). However, their use is constrained by the user's ability to describe the desired outcome through text. Returning to Rose, one might wonder: How would she phrase her request if she were to approach one of these models? How can we, as users, instruct text-to-image models to craft a novel scene featuring a cherished childhood toy or transform a child's drawing from the fridge into a work of art?

Introducing new concepts into large-scale models is often challenging. Re-training a model with an expanded dataset for each new concept is prohibitively expensive, and fine-tuning with a few examples typically leads to catastrophic forgetting (Ding et al., 2022; Li et al., 2022). More measured approaches freeze the model and train transformation modules to adapt its output for new concepts (Zhou et al., 2021; Gao et al., 2021; Skantze & Willemsen, 2022). However, these approaches still risk forgetting prior knowledge or struggle to access it concurrently with newly learned concepts (Kumar et al., 2022; Cohen et al., 2022).

We propose to overcome these challenges by discovering new words within the textual embedding space of pre-trained text-to-image models. Our focus is on the first stage of the text encoding process (Figure 2). Here, an input string is initially converted into a set of tokens. Each token is then replaced with its own embedding vector, which is processed by the downstream model. Our aim is to identify new embedding vectors that represent new, specific concepts.

We represent a new embedding vector with a pseudo-word, denoted as S*. This pseudo-word is treated like any other word and can be used to create novel textual queries for the generative models. Users can request "a photograph of S* on the beach," "an oil painting of S* hanging on the wall," or even combine concepts, such as "a drawing of S1* in the style of S2*."

El torneo de Monastir tiene lugar del 3 al 10 de enero en una pista dura al aire libre. Participan un total de 35 tenistas. En los dieciseisavos de final, Zeel Desai, la tenista india y cabeza de serie número 4, cumplió las previsiones al vencer en dos horas y treinta minutos a la jugadora francesa Hanna Bougouffa por 6-4, 1-6 y 6-2. Con este resultado, Desai avanzó a los octavos de final del torneo, donde se enfrentará a la francesa Jade Bornay.

Los datos del partido muestran que Desai logró quebrar el saque de su adversaria 6 veces, tuvo un 72% de efectividad en el primer servicio, cometió 3 dobles faltas y ganó el 50% de los puntos al saque. Por su parte, Bougouffa también logró quebrar el saque de su contrincante 6 veces, tuvo un 53% de efectividad en el primer servicio, cometió 9 dobles faltas y ganó el 52% de los puntos al saque. 

Así, Desai continúa su participación en el torneo de Monastir y se prepara para enfrentar a Jade Bornay en los octavos de final.

La bataille judiciaire qui a duré 11 ans a pris fin ce lundi 19 février, lorsque qu'une femme de 54 ans a été condamnée en son absence par le tribunal correctionnel de Nanterre à 18 mois de prison avec sursis. Elle a été reconnue coupable d'avoir exploité une adolescente malienne de sa famille pendant cinq ans à Châtenay-Malabry, dans les Hauts-de-Seine. La jeune fille était contrainte d'accomplir des tâches domestiques du matin jusqu'au soir.

Cette sentence inclut 60 000 euros de dommages et intérêts pour la jeune victime, aujourd'hui âgée de 31 ans, ainsi qu'un euro symbolique pour le Comité contre l'esclavage moderne, partie civile dans l'affaire. Lors de l'audience du 22 janvier, la plaignante a évoqué les illusions qu'elle nourrissait en quittant le Mali à 13 ans, en pensant à une vie meilleure avec une de ses cousines éloignées.

Dès son arrivée en France, la réalité fut bien différente pour la victime. Elle devait s'occuper des tâches ménagères pour une famille de neuf personnes, dont cinq enfants, pendant 15 à 18 heures par jour, sans pause ni rémunération. La jeune fille raconte avec émotion son calvaire : des repas après tout le monde, un sommeil précaire sur un matelas au sol et des sévices physiques et verbaux.

Enfin, à l'âge de 18 ans, elle a pu s'échapper de cet enfer grâce à l'intervention d'un jeune homme qui l'a encouragée à partir et à porter plainte. La coupable a été condamnée pour différentes charges liées à l'exploitation de la mineure. Cette condamnation marque la conclusion d'une procédure de 11 ans, jalonnée d'un non-lieu initial en 2009, d'appels successifs jusqu'à la Cour de cassation et enfin d'un renvoi devant le tribunal. Au cours de l'enquête, la quinquagénaire a nié les accusations de mauvais traitements et a prétendu que la jeune fille effectuait des tâches ménagères comme les autres enfants.

La marque d'antivirus NortonLifeLock a présenté jeudi des résultats financiers au quatrième trimestre meilleurs que prévus. Wall Street avait prévu un bénéfice de 19 cents par action sur des recettes de 601,3 millions de dollars. La société a annoncé des bénéfices non-GAAP de 26 cents par action sur un chiffre d'affaires de 614 millions de dollars, en baisse par rapport aux 617 millions de dollars de l'année précédente.

Les revenus liés aux utilisateurs sont de 610 millions de dollars, soit une hausse de 1 % par rapport à l'année précédente, avec un revenu moyen par utilisateur de 9,07 dollars, en augmentation de 3 %. NortonLifeLock a rapporté 9 milliards de dollars aux investisseurs au cours du trimestre.

« Au cours de notre deuxième trimestre seulement, nous avons obtenu des résultats supérieurs aux attentes, tant en termes de chiffre d'affaires que de résultat net, alors que nous nous sommes concentrés sur la promotion d'une croissance durable », explique Vincent Pilette, PDG de NortonLifeLock. Il ajoute : "Avec des demandes en hausse de 4 % d'une année sur l'autre et un autre quart de croissance séquentielle, les consommateurs constatent la valeur que nous apportons à la protection de leur vie numérique alors qu'ils vivent de plus en plus en ligne. Je suis extrêmement fier de la façon dont nous avons soutenu nos clients pendant cette crise de Covid-19 et de la façon dont nous jetons les bases d'une croissance à long terme."

Pour le trimestre en cours, les analystes prévoient un bénéfice de 20 cents par action sur un chiffre d'affaires de 608,4 millions de dollars. La société estime des prévisions de bénéfices par action pour le premier trimestre dans une fourchette de 18 à 20 cents, avec des revenus entre 590 millions et 605 millions de dollars. Les parts de NortonLifeLock ont augmenté de près de 4 % après la fermeture de la bourse.

In this paper, as a novel proposal, we introduce the mode-in-state contribution factor to a class of nonlinear dynamical systems. The mode-in-state contribution factor depends on (initial) states and is thus expected to extract global properties of nonlinear systems far from attractors. Our theory is based on spectral theory of nonlinear dynamical systems, precisely speaking, spectral properties of the Koopman operators and the idea of sensitivity analysis. The Koopman operator is a linear infinite-dimensional operator defined for a nonlinear dynamical system and keeps full information on the nonlinear system. The spectrum of the linear operator is the mathematical foundation of Koopman Mode Decomposition (KMD). Based on the KMD and the idea of sensitivity analysis, we introduce a data-driven mode-in-state contribution factor for a class of nonlinear systems. It should be noted that a KMD-based "participation" factor has been proposed, which does not depend on states, whereas our contribution factor does. The introduced contribution factor is applied to the numerical analysis of large-signal simulations in an interconnected AC/Multi-Terminal DC (MTDC) power system to show its technological potential. 

The so-called participation factor and contribution one quantify mutual impacts between state variables and modes in multi-degree-of-freedom linear dynamical systems. Many groups of researchers have studied definitions and interpretations of these factors from viewpoints of systems theory and physics. Their generalizations to nonlinear systems are also reported. Such generalizations are of fundamental concern in nonlinear systems theory and of technological significance in applications such as the analysis and control of electric power systems.

La Commission européenne a présenté jeudi sa stratégie pour le développement futur de la production d'énergie renouvelable en mer, déjà considérée comme une "success story européenne", selon le commissaire Frans Timmermans, responsable du Green Deal. Afin de soutenir les objectifs climatiques de l'UE pour atteindre la neutralité carbone d'ici 2050, la Commission prévoit d'augmenter la capacité de production éolienne offshore de l'UE (éolien fixe) de 12 GW actuellement à au moins 300 GW en 2050. À cela s'ajouteraient 40 GW provenant d'autres modes de production océanique, tels que l'énergie marémotrice et le solaire flottant. "Ce changement de rythme dans le développement soulève de nombreuses questions", a reconnu le commissaire néerlandais. Il se veut toutefois rassurant : la Commission estime que cette multiplication par près de 30 de la capacité éolienne offshore européenne nécessitera "moins de 3 % de l'espace maritime de l'UE". Pour encourager un développement massif de la production d'énergie en mer, une révision des lignes directrices concernant les aides d'État à la protection de l'environnement et à l'énergie est prévue.

随着资料传输量增加，谷歌和Facebook等网络运营商积极建设更多数据中心，市场对需求持续增长持乐观态度。这不仅能推动服务器出货量增长，还有助于连接器和线束等相关产业的发展。在其中，凡甲（3526-TW）、贸联-KY（3665-TW）和佳必琪（6197-TW）等相关企业都有望受益。

随着影音平台的兴起，各大内容网站处理的数据量不断增加，网络运营商如谷歌和Facebook积极建设更多数据中心，以满足内容处理的需求，促进服务器出货量增长。特别是在电力、信号和网络建设领域，推动了大量连接器和线束的出货量增长。

随着数据中心规模不断扩大，行业表示连接器和线束的需求非常强劲。市场研究机构TrendForce预测，超大规模数据中心服务器今年的市场份额将接近33%，明年有望达到近40%，整体数量持续增长。

凡甲近年来也积极降低笔记本电脑营收的占比，目前服务器应用和笔记本电脑连接器的趋势也有利于改善毛利率和盈利表现。

在线束方面，贸联的高速线材从内部线路拓展至外部线路，佳必琪的高速传输线也在上半年通过了美系大客户的认证。

محمد إسماعيل - القاهرة - كتب: صابر المحلاوي

رفضت محكمة جنايات جنوب القاهرة، المنعقدة بمعهد أمناء الشرطة بطرة، برئاسة المستشار محمد شيرين فهمي، يوم الثلاثاء، الاستشكال المقدم من المتهم أسامة أحمد السباعي على حكم حبسه لمدة 15 سنة مشدد في قضية "اقتحام قسم شرطة التبين" عقب فض اعتصامي رابعة العدوية والنهضة، وأكدت استمرار تنفيذ حكم حبسه.

وكان دفاع المتهم قد قدم استشكالًا جديدًا لوقف تنفيذ الحكم بعد أن رفضت المحكمة استشكاله في جلسة 18 نوفمبر 2018.

وأسندت نيابة جنوب القاهرة، بإشراف المستشار طارق أبو زيد المحامي العام الأول لنيابات جنوب القاهرة، إلى المتهمين في أمر الإحالة عددًا من التهم، منها التجمهر، والبلطجة، والشروع في قتل عدد من ضباط وأفراد أمن قسم التبين، وإضرام النيران بمبنى القسم وحرق محتوياته، ومحاولة تهريب المسجونين، وحيازة وإحراز أسلحة نارية وبيضاء، والانضمام إلى جماعة على خلاف القانون.

وتعود الواقعة إلى تجمع المتهمين أمام قسم شرطة التبين وإطلاقهم النيران على القوات المكلفة بالتأمين، مما أسفر عن مقتل شرطي من قسم التبين، وإصابة العديد من قوات الشرطة، وتهريب السجناء، واحتراق القسم، وذلك في أعقاب فض اعتصامي رابعة والنهضة.

Several studies about Hybrid Unmanned Aerial Underwater Vehicles (HUAUVs) have been conducted recently [1] - [8]. These vehicles provide an interesting range of possible applications due to their capability to operate in two different environments, including inspection and mapping of partly submerged areas in industrial facilities, search and rescue, and other military-related applications. However, the state-of-the-art is yet focused on the vehicle design and structure, with even fewer studies around autonomous navigation [9]. The ability to perform tasks in both environments and successfully transition between them imposes additional challenges that must be addressed to make this mobile vehicle autonomously feasible.

In this work, we explore the use of Deep Reinforcement Learning (Deep-RL) in the context of HUAUVs to perform navigation-related tasks, simulating environmental rescue tasks in robotics. We present two enhanced approaches based on state-of-the-art Deep-RL for continuous state scenarios: (1) a deterministic approach based on Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) [14], and (2) a stochastic approach based on Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) [15]. We demonstrate that we can train agents with a consistently better capability than the state-of-the-art, performing with more stability in mapless navigation, obstacle avoidance, and medium transition. We perform a two-fold evaluation with air-to-water and water-to-air navigation, and compare our Double Critic Reinforcement Learning (DoCRL) approaches with single critic-based approaches and an adapted version of a traditional Behavior-Based Algorithm (BBA) [16] used in aerial vehicles. Our proposed double critic formulation is illustrated in Fig. 1.

Approaches based on Deep-RL techniques have been enhanced to address navigation-related tasks for a range of mobile vehicles, including ground mobile robots [10], aerial robots [11], [12], and underwater robots [13]. These approaches, based on single critic actor-critic techniques with multi-layer network structures, have achieved promising results in mapless navigation, obstacle avoidance, and medium transitioning, even for HUAUVs [9]. However, the challenges faced by this kind of vehicle make these approaches limited, and they are not capable of scaling to more complex scenarios, such as rescue navigation tasks, for example.

This work contains the following main contributions:
- We propose two approaches based on state-of-the-art, actor-critic, double critic, Deep-RL algorithms, capable of successfully performing goal-oriented, mapless navigation for HUAUVs, using only range data and the vehicles' relative localization data.

El Tribunal Oral Federal 7, encargado de atender casos relacionados con funcionarios de la gestión kirchnerista, recibió los originales de los seis cuadernos manuscritos atribuidos a Oscar Centeno, el remisero. Inmediatamente se solicitó custodia policial permanente para la sede del tribunal, ubicada en Talcahuano 550 debido a limitaciones de espacio en Comodoro Py 2002.
Cristina Kirchner, quien está siendo enjuiciada como supuesta jefa de asociación ilícita y cohecho, fue elegida vicepresidenta de la Nación el domingo pasado.
Hasta el momento, el tribunal ha recibido la causa central de los cuadernos y su documentación, que actualmente se encuentra en un contenedor y está siendo certificada. Solo después de esto, las partes podrán acceder a la documentación.
Los mismos jueces que están a cargo del caso de los cuadernos también tienen pendientes otros juicios, como el de Andrea del Boca y el de De Vido por presunto fraude en el financiamiento de la tira "Mamá Corazón" durante el gobierno de Cristina Kirchner. Además, también podrían ser responsables del juicio por supuesta defraudación en Yacimiento Carbonífero Rio Turbio, ya que recientemente se prorrogó la prisión preventiva de De Vido por seis meses más.
La fiscal de juicio de estos casos es Fabiana León, quien seguirá participando en los procesos, independientemente de los cambios que ocurran en el gobierno y en los organismos acusadores.
Los jueces del Tribunal, Enrique Mendez Signori, Fernando Canero y Germán Castelli, recibieron con precaución los cuadernos originales y los revisaron detalladamente antes de dar por entregados.
Además de los cuadernos, también se recibieron otros objetos como papelitos con anotaciones y tickets de estacionamiento, que fueron adjuntados como evidencia.
El Tribunal envió un oficio al presidente de la Corte, Carlos Rozenkrantz, solicitando custodia permanente de la Policía Federal para garantizar la seguridad de la documentación remitida desde el juzgado de Bonadio, incluyendo los seis cuadernos.

大量科技 (3167-TW)，一家专注于 PCB 制程设备的公司，正逐步走出谷底，预计其增长动能将延续至明年上半年。这一进展主要得益于台系和陆厂设备投资的推动。公司今日（15 日）在董事会上批准了处分杨梅厂土地资产的决议，预计将获得 2.38 亿元的利润，贡献每股纯益 2.97 元，最快可在年底前入账。法人预计，大量科技今年每股纯益将超越 5 元。

在前三季度，大量科技的税后纯益为 1.24 亿元，每股纯益为 1.54 元。若第四季度能维持第三季度每股 0.54 元的获利水平，则 2020 年全年每股纯益将为 2.08 元，再加上杨梅厂的处分收益每股 2.97 元，全年每股纯益将超越 5 元。

大量科技的产能主要集中在桃园八德厂。公司今日还决议收购八德厂毗邻的元大人造树脂公司全部股权，以获得 4800 坪的大面积工业不动产，从而助力业务进一步扩张。元大人造树脂公司目前处于闲置状态，股本为 3000 万元。根据大量科技的公告，该公司将以每股约 300-400 元的价格收购元大人造树脂股权，双方已达成共识，全部收购资金超过 10 亿元。大量科技表示，将使用出售杨梅厂所得的 4.1 亿元资金、银行融资及自有资金完成此次收购。

看好半导体行业的快速发展需求，大量科技于 2018 年进入半导体产业设备领域，开发生产半导体制程设备，主要产品包括晶圆外观检查机及测试编带机，目前这些产品主要在桃园八德厂生产。公司已取得两岸多家半导体前、后段厂供应商的供应代码，该事业部门已显现营运成效。2019 年，来自半导体设备的营收约为 6000 万元，占总营收的约 3%。鉴于今年半导体设备销售的增长，预计营收将增至 1.5-16 亿元，年增长率为 1.66 倍。预计在半导体设备市场中，明年将实现爆发性增长。

Singapore’s technology industry saw a rise of 24.1% in overall deal activity during Q2 2020, when compared with the last four-quarter average, according to GlobalData’s deals database. A total of 67 deals worth $462.45m were announced in Q2 2020, compared to the last four-quarter average of 54 deals. Venture financing was the leading category in the quarter with 52 deals which accounted for 77.6% of all deals. In second place was M&A with 13 deals, followed by private equity with two transactions, respectively accounting for 19.4% and 3% of overall deal activity in the country’s technology industry during the quarter.

In terms of value of deals, M&A was the leading deal category in Singapore’s technology industry with total deals worth $304.31m, followed by private equity deals totaling $158.13m. The top five technology deals accounted for 72.1% of the overall value during Q2 2020. The combined value of the top five technology deals stood at $333.48m, against the overall value of $462.45m recorded for the month.

1) Kingboard Holdings’ $265.07m acquisition of Elec & Eltek International Holdings

根据研究显示，台湾有45％到49％的人口患有「酒精不耐症」，是全世界罹患该症比例最高的国家。患有酒精不耐症的民众，1周内最多只能喝20毫升的纯酒精，等于1罐500毫升铝罐装的啤酒或是1杯的红酒。一旦饮用超量，身体就会无法代谢累积于体内中，增加罹癌的风险。美国史丹佛大学医学院高级研究员陈哲宏呼吁，政府应该建立「酒害防制法」保护国人健康。

根据研究显示，患有酒精不耐症的患者，1周建议不要喝酒超过1次，每次喝酒都不要超过1瓶啤酒，或是1杯红酒，大约是14克的100％纯酒精又或者是20毫升的纯酒精。一旦超过体内就会累积酒精而无法代谢。陈哲宏表示，酒精不耐症的患者一旦饮酒超量，罹患口腔癌、食道癌的风险是没有酒精不耐症者的100倍，女性罹患乳癌的机率也比一般人高，同样也会增加罹患大肠直肠癌的机率。

陈哲宏表示，酒精不耐症是指体内缺乏「ALDH2 酵素」，该酵素主要是帮助代谢酒精。根据调查资料显示，台湾有45％到49％的民众有酒精不耐症，为世界第一。其次为日本有40％的民众、中国有35％的民众、南韩有25％的民众。若综观全世界罹患酒精不耐症的人口，约有5亿6000多万人，几乎都是华人为主，属于东南亚国家的特殊疾病。

将OK绷上涂上浓度70％的酒精，贴在皮肤上约10到15分钟后，若是皮肤颜色变得较红，就是酒精不耐症的患者。陈哲宏提醒，若饮酒后会脸红，有70％的机率是酒精不耐症的患者。若是想知道是否为患者，已有医院提供相关的基因检查，每次要价约2000元左右。他强调，酒精不耐症绝非通过不断饮酒来战胜，政府应该重视酒害防治。

**Robservations**

• **Contract Extension for Chris Jones:** Despite having a few missteps, Chris Jones, the Saskatchewan Roughriders' head coach, defensive coordinator, general manager, and vice-president of football operations, deserves a contract extension. Currently under contract through the 2019 CFL season, Jones should have at least one more year added to his deal. Given that the Roughriders are bidding for the 2020 Grey Cup, securing the football-operations hierarchy is crucial before the presentations are made.

• **CFL Coach of the Year:** Jones should also be named the CFL's coach of the year, and it shouldn’t be close. He has guided the team to a 12-6 record, despite having a below-average offense.

• **Roughriders' Playoff Scenario:** Mathematically, the Roughriders have a solid chance of finishing first in the West Division, although realistically, it is a long shot. For Saskatchewan to place first for only the second time since 1977, the B.C. Lions would need to defeat the visiting Calgary Stampeders on Saturday night. The challenge is that the Lions' playoff destination is already set — they will cross over into the East Division to face the Hamilton Tiger-Cats — while Calgary is the only team that can improve its standing with a win.

• **Possible Semi-final Matchup:** If/when Calgary wins, Saskatchewan will host the Winnipeg Blue Bombers in the West Division semi-final on November 11. This matchup would mark the first postseason meeting between these teams in Regina since the 1975 Western Conference semi-final, which the Roughriders won 42-24 in George Reed's final game at Taylor Field.

• **Rider Rumblings Podcast:** The playoff scenarios and other topics are discussed on the Regina Leader-Post's latest Rider Rumblings video podcast. This week's special guests are media titans Derek Meyers and Darren Dupont. The podcast is accessible via leaderpost.com, iTunes, or Google Play Music.

• **Home Playoff Game Attendance:** Interestingly, the Roughriders have not sold out their last two home playoff games, with attendances of 29,215 (2010) and 30,942 (2013). In both instances, Saskatchewan defeated B.C. in the West semi-final, with memorable moments such as Jason Clermont's game-winning overtime touchdown in 2010 and Darian Durant's standout performance in 2013.

• **Odell Willis' Fine:** The CFL made the right call, albeit belatedly, by issuing the maximum allowable fine (half a game cheque) to the Lions' Odell Willis for Saturday's high hit on Roughriders quarterback Zach Collaros. While some called for a suspension, a fine is deemed sufficient punishment, considering the hit was illegal but not excessively flagrant. Additionally, suspending Willis could be detrimental to the Roughriders since they are counting on him to help B.C. defeat Calgary on Saturday.

• **CFL vs. NFL Passing Records:** The CFL is losing ground to the NFL regarding prolific passers.

As I walk through the bustling city streets, I come across a man enthusiastically calling out to passersby, urging them to check out the gadgets and devices in his store. Despite his efforts, the crowd pays him little attention. Intrigued, I approach him and observe his expressions as he tries to attract customers.

The man's initial excitement fades as I walk past him, and he falls into a moment of despair. I reflect on his words about the future and how the concept has lost its meaning for me. The uncertainty and worry it once symbolized now overshadow any sense of hope.

Continuing my journey, I encounter a man in a suit at a crosswalk who shares his work struggles and aspirations for a promotion. His longing to spend more time with his son tugs at my emotions, but he grapples with doubts about whether things will truly improve. I leave him pondering the inevitability of change.

Moving into a less affluent area, I witness a young woman selling pills to make ends meet. Despite her defensive attitude, she reveals her struggles and aspirations, hoping for a better future beyond her current circumstances. I silently empathize with her plight as she vents her frustrations.

These encounters serve as poignant reminders of the human condition and the universal desire for change and improvement. As a spectral presence, I offer individuals a glimpse into their fears and uncertainties, nudging them toward pivotal decisions about their futures. Yet, I remain trapped in my spectral form, unable to alter my own fate.

My name is Alazia, and I embody the fear of stagnation and the longing for transformation that plagues those I encounter. Although change may seem elusive, the interconnected stories of these individuals illustrate the potential for growth and evolution amid life's uncertainties.

Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising path toward creating versatile and adept artificial agents. By learning from interactions, these agents can develop robust control strategies capable of handling real-world complexities that are challenging to engineer accurately. However, tasks like object manipulation present significant challenges for RL. Although remarkable outcomes have been achieved through methods like simulation-to-real transfer [1] and extensive physical parallelization [2], training typically demands countless hours of interaction. Therefore, enhancing sample efficiency is a crucial concern in RL. This paper addresses this issue from a causal inference perspective.

When can an agent be considered in control of its environment? An agent can influence its environment only through its actions. While this may seem obvious, it is often overlooked that the causal influence of actions is situation-dependent. Consider a simple scenario: a robotic arm in front of an object on a table. The object can only be moved when contact is made between the robot and the object. Generally, there are situations where immediate causal influence is possible and others where it is not. In this work, we formalize this situation-dependent nature of control and demonstrate how it can be leveraged to enhance the sample efficiency of RL agents. To achieve this, we derive a measure that captures the causal influence of actions on the environment and develop a practical method to compute it.

Understanding when the agent has control over an object of interest is crucial from both a learning and an exploration standpoint. The learning algorithm should focus on these situations because (i) the robot is initially rarely in control of the object of interest, making training inefficient, (ii) physical contacts are difficult to model and thus require more effort to learn, and (iii) these states enable manipulation toward further goals. However, for learning to occur, the algorithm first needs data that includes these relevant states. Therefore, the agent must consider its causal influence even during the exploration phase.

We propose several ways to integrate our causal influence measure into RL algorithms, addressing both the exploration and the learning aspects. For exploration, agents can be rewarded with a bonus for reaching states of causal influence. We demonstrate that such a bonus leads the agent to quickly discover useful behavior, even in the absence of task-specific rewards. Additionally, our approach allows the exploration to be explicitly guided, favoring actions with a higher predicted causal impact. This is a successful alternative to the -greedy exploration, as we demonstrate. Finally, for the learning phase, we propose an off-policy prioritization scheme, and the results show a reliable improvement in data efficiency. Our empirical evaluations, conducted in robotic manipulation environments, support the effectiveness of the proposed methods, showing a clear enhancement of the state of the art, utilizing the same, generic, influence measure.

Jonathan Van Ness, la estrella de Queer Eye, serie de Netflix basada en cambio de imagen a hombres con historias particulares, habló sobre el diagnóstico de VIH que recibió cuando tenía 25 años.

Durante una aparición en el programa Today, Jonathan recordó el momento en que recibió el diagnóstico. Mientras peinaba a uno de sus clientes más fieles, de repente se sintió mal y cayó al suelo. Al día siguiente, decidió ir a Planned Parenthood, donde descubrió que tenía VIH.

Para Jonathan, este diagnóstico fue un momento temido. Creció durante la crisis del VIH-SIDA y perdió a una generación entera de personas debido a esta enfermedad. Sin embargo, a pesar de vivir con el virus, Jonathan se siente feliz y lleva un tratamiento adecuado.

En la entrevista, Jonathan explicó que toma una píldora diaria que reduce la carga viral, es decir, la cantidad de copias del virus en su sangre. Gracias a esto, ha logrado mantener una carga viral indetectable, lo que significa que es no transmisible. Siguiendo su tratamiento y visitando regularmente a su médico, Jonathan ha podido retomar sus actividades, como el patinaje artístico, y se siente más lindo y capaz de trabajar más horas.

En resumen, Jonathan Van Ness ha demostrado que, a pesar del diagnóstico de VIH, es posible vivir una vida feliz y próspera con el tratamiento adecuado. Su historia es un testimonio de superación y esperanza para todos aquellos que viven con esta enfermedad.

**La question du barrage sur le Nil en 2021**

La guerre du Nil aura-t-elle lieu en 2021 ? Cette question se pose légitimement après l'annonce par l'Union africaine de l'échec des pourparlers tripartites entre le Soudan, l'Égypte et l'Éthiopie concernant le grand barrage de la Renaissance (Gerd). Le ministre soudanais de l'Irrigation et des Ressources en eau, Yasir Abbas, a déclaré : « Nous ne pouvons pas continuer dans ce cercle vicieux de négociations illimitées, sachant que le Gerd pose une menace directe sur le barrage soudanais de Roseires. » Lui et d'autres négociateurs soudanais demandent désormais que les négociations se poursuivent à un niveau plus élevé, entre les dirigeants des trois pays concernés et l'UA. Comment en est-on arrivé là, alors qu'il y a tout juste une semaine, les discussions étaient relancées ?

**Les pourparlers de la dernière chance**

La semaine dernière, les trois pays concernés s'étaient mis d'accord pour tenir de nouveaux pourparlers dans l'espoir de parvenir à un accord sur la gestion et le remplissage du réservoir du grand barrage de la Renaissance. Lancé en 2011, ce projet est destiné à devenir la plus grande installation hydroélectrique d'Afrique, mais il risque de réduire le débit du Nil lorsqu'il atteint l'Égypte, un casus belli pour les Égyptiens. 

Les derniers pourparlers, qui se sont tenus début novembre, s'étaient conclus sans avancée, les négociations étant dans l'impasse depuis plusieurs mois. Le Caire et Khartoum, en aval du fleuve, souhaitent un accord légalement contraignant, notamment sur la gestion du barrage et le remplissage du réservoir. Addis-Abeba, qui considère son barrage essentiel à son développement, y est réticente et soutient que l'approvisionnement en eau de ces pays ne sera pas affecté. L'Éthiopie avait annoncé le 21 juillet avoir atteint son objectif de remplissage pour la première année. Les nouveaux pourparlers n'ont pas abouti à un accord acceptable pour reprendre les négociations, selon l'agence d'État soudanaise Suna.

**Inquiétudes du Soudan et perspectives régionales**

Le ministère des Affaires étrangères éthiopien a confirmé, dans un communiqué dimanche soir, l'absence de progrès dans les négociations. L'Union africaine a proposé aux trois pays de tenir des rencontres bilatérales avec les experts désignés par l'UA, suivies d'une rencontre tripartite. Tandis que l'Éthiopie et l'Égypte ont accepté cette proposition, le Soudan l'a refusée, ce qui a entraîné la fin de la rencontre. Le gouvernement éthiopien assure avoir mis en place un mécanisme d'échange de données avec le Soudan pour répondre à ses inquiétudes.

Les relations entre l'Éthiopie et le Soudan se sont détériorées ces dernières semaines, notamment en raison d'accrochages à la frontière commune en marge de l'opération militaire éthiopienne dans la région dissidente du Tigré, frontalière du Soudan. Le barrage suscite des tensions, en particulier avec l'Égypte, qui dépend à 97 % du Nil pour son approvisionnement en eau et craint que celui-ci ne soit réduit. Le Soudan espère que le barrage aidera à réguler le flux du fleuve, mais met en garde contre le risque pour des millions de vies si aucun accord n'est conclu. Le Nil, long de quelque 6 000 kilomètres, est une source d'approvisionnement en eau et en électricité essentielle pour une dizaine de pays d'Afrique de l'Est.

Les baisses de services dédiés aux enfants à besoin particulier dans certains centres de la petite enfance, dont faisait état Le Devoir mardi, ont pris une tournure politique en ce sixième jour de campagne électorale. Dispersés aux quatre coins de la province, les chefs et porte-paroles des trois principaux partis d’opposition ont ainsi, tour à tour, déploré que des fonds dédiés aux enfants dans le besoin soient utilisés à d’autres fins. Ils n’ont toutefois pas manqué de rappeler la difficile et contraignante réalité financière avec laquelle les CPE doivent composer au quotidien.

« Ces cas illustrent les conséquences des mesures d’austérité du gouvernement Couillard, a soutenu le co-porte-parole de Québec solidaire Gabriel Nadeau-Dubois, qui était de passage à Cowansville dans une entreprise d’économie sociale qui emploie des jeunes à besoins particuliers. C’est la démonstration que lorsqu’on coupe comme on l’a fait dans les dernières années, et bien les directions d’établissement ou de CPE doivent faire des choix difficiles. » Le candidat solidaire dans la circonscription montréalaise de Gouin s’est toutefois refusé à faire porter le blâme uniquement aux CPE. « On aimerait que les budgets soient utilisés de la manière dont c’est prévu qu’ils soient utilisés, mais en même temps j’ai de la difficulté à jeter la pierre seulement aux CPE. On s’entend que s’ils sont rendus-là, c’est parce qu’en haut de l’échelle on fait des choix budgétaires qui contraignent les établissements à faire des choix difficiles comme ceux-là », a-t-il mentionné.

Un avis que partage son vis-à-vis péquiste. « Les CPE ont été obligés de rogner un peu partout dans leur budget parce qu’ils se sont fait couper un peu plus de 100 millions de dollars, a précisé, pour sa part, Jean-François Lisée.

بعد اتفاق المصالحة الخليجية، تزايدت التساؤلات حول مصير الإعلامي السعودي والمذيع السابق في قناة الجزيرة علي الظفيري. طرح العديد من المغردين والنشطاء هذا السؤال، بما في ذلك الناشطة السعودية المعارضة علياء الحويطي، التي تساءلت عبر تويتر: “هل سنراه قريباً على شاشة الجزيرة؟ هل سيخرج من السجن بعد الحكم عليه بـ5 سنوات بتهمة التخابر مع قطر؟”.

في سياق متصل، أعرب الباحث الموريتاني محمد المختار الشنقيطي عن افتقاده لعلي الظفيري، معبّراً عن أمله في أن تكون المصالحة السعودية القطرية فاتحة لعودته إلى شاشة الجزيرة. كما أعربت الشيخة القطرية مريم آل ثاني عن أملها في عودة الظفيري إلى العمل الإعلامي.

يذكر أن علي الظفيري، البالغ من العمر 41 عامًا، عاد إلى السعودية في يونيو/حزيران 2017 بعد أيام من إعلان حصار قطر، بناءً على طلب استدعاء تلقاه من السلطات هناك لـ"التحاور معه". وبعد دخوله الأراضي السعودية، تمكن من إبلاغ مقربين منه أنه قيد الإقامة الجبرية. وبعد انقطاع الاتصال مع معارفه في الدوحة، تم نشر تغريدة عبر حسابه على تويتر في 22 يونيو/حزيران، تعلن استقالته من قناة “الجزيرة”، وجاء فيها: “طاعة لله وولاة الأمر، حفظهم الله، وانحيازًا للوطن، والتزامًا بسياساته وقوانينه، أستقيل من قناة الجزيرة”.

ذكرت مصادر في ذلك الوقت أن الاستقالة جاءت نتيجة ضغوط شديدة من السلطات السعودية، التي رجحت أنه أُجبر على تسليم كلمة المرور الخاصة بحسابه على تويتر لأجهزة الأمن. لاحقاً، نشرت صحيفة “الوطن” السعودية مقالًا قيل إنه كتبه الظفيري بعنوان “المملكة أولًا وأخيرًا”، هاجم فيه دول المنطقة وجماعاتها، وبعد ساعتين من نشر المقال، قدّم الظفيري استقالته عبر تويتر، وحُذف المقال لاحقًا، قبل أن يُعاد نشره باسم الكاتب “هادي اليامي”.

"10 SECONDS UNTIL DEPLOYMENT!"

The General's voice pierced through the cacophony inside the helicopter as it skimmed low above the vibrant orange expanse of the Sahara Desert. Even from this height, I could see it - a bright blue glow radiating from its core. Among all the bombs I had disarmed, this one presented a wholly unfamiliar challenge.

"We don't know the repercussions of that device once activated," the Warrant Officer, seated to my right, warned. "It's safe to assume that we're all relying on you, Abe. Don't let us down."

"Never have."

"DEPLOYMENT IN 3, 2, 1..."

Swiftly, I descended from the helicopter, feeling my stomach lurch as I made a heavy landing on the sandy terrain below. The para-cord released, the helicopter departed, and in what seemed like an instant, I was left alone.

The enigmatic device, or bomb, emitted a steady hum just a few yards away. As I approached, the timer displayed only two minutes remaining.

Discovered by a nomad on camelback a day earlier, the device had been triggered by his touch, setting off a 24-hour countdown and the mysterious blue glow.

Placing my hand on the intricate metal structure, I felt its warmth and observed the alien symbols adorning its surface.

Korean-American hip-hop artist Jay Park recently reflected on his past negative comments about Korea. On October 1, Netflix released the first episode of the original show 'Paik's Spirit,' featuring Jay Park and fellow hip-hop artist Loco as guests. During a meal, Loco brought up the time when Jay Park faced heavy criticism for his past remarks.

In 2009, comments Jay Park made about Korea in 2005, shortly after he began training at JYP Entertainment, were discovered on his personal social media. Written in English to a friend, they read, "Korea is gay. I hate Koreans. I want to go back." These comments quickly spread online. Just three days later, Jay Park left his group, 2PM, and returned to his hometown of Seattle in the United States.

Reflecting on this period, Jay Park explained, "It wasn't entirely my decision to come to Korea at first. When I was asked to join JYP Entertainment, my mom suggested I should go for our future. My family was struggling financially in Seattle, and she thought I could earn good money there."

He continued, "There were many popular artists at JYP Entertainment, but I didn't know much about JYP or Korea. I went for my family. Life in Korea was very different from what I expected. It was my first time living away from my family and friends, and I had given up everything in Seattle for that. It wasn't easy for me; the cultural differences were challenging. I may have complained to my friends back in the States, and that's where those comments came from."

Jay Park added, "After I started gaining attention as the leader of 2PM, someone dug up those comments from the social media account I no longer used, and it became an issue. People kept saying, 'Jay Park hates Korea and Koreans,' but that can't be true because my parents are Korean, and I'm Korean myself."

He concluded, "Anyway, I was ignorant and thoughtless back then. I was too young, and my words came out wrong. I think I expected everyone to live like I did. I was too selfish.

Pour une femme d'affaires, quel est l'intérêt de s'inscrire et/ou de s'impliquer dans une Chambre de commerce ? Quelle valeur ajoutée apporte une présence féminine dans cet environnement ? Lors de notre enquête le mois dernier sur l'augmentation de la présence féminine au sein de la Chambre de commerce LGBT du Québec (CCLGBTQ), d'autres femmes d'affaires ont souhaité partager leurs expériences. Cet intérêt de la part de nos consœurs témoigne de l'« empowerment » économique des femmes dans la société en général et dans notre communauté en particulier.

Longtemps limitées à des rôles dans des causes communautaires et associatives, les femmes s'affirment de plus en plus comme des gestionnaires compétentes et des visionnaires dans le développement des affaires dans des secteurs à forte dimension économique, en tant qu'entrepreneures ou dirigeantes, et non plus seulement comme exécutantes. Les réseaux deviennent donc pour elles des atouts indispensables pour faire avancer leurs initiatives.

C'est ce que soutient l'avocate Marie-Laure Leclercq, pour qui la Chambre de commerce LGBT du Québec a offert un soutien précieux, où la dimension LGBT est implicite et n'a pas besoin d'être explicitée. « On n'a pas besoin de le cacher ou d'en parler. On est donc plus libre... d'en parler, » sourit-elle, puisqu'on intègre aussi une communauté de culture. « Ceux qui cherchent à créer des liens trouveront ce qu'ils cherchent. Toutefois, on y rencontre plus de personnes comme nous que de véritables clients. Mais les résultats sont là. En plus de briser la solitude, la CCLGBTQ m'a permis de développer des liens personnels qui m'ont apporté des opportunités d'affaires. »

« Une Chambre de commerce LGBT a l'avantage d'encourager une réflexion sur la nécessité du genre, » ajoute Marie-Laure Leclercq. « Alors que dans nombre d'institutions, la tendance est de tout genrer vers une normalité non pas tant homophobe qu'hétéronormative, et souvent ignorante de la condition féminine, ici on fait abstraction de cette normalité. »

Portes ouvertes… à élargir

Impliquée au conseil d'administration de la CCGQ, comme on l'appelait à l'époque (2006-2009), Marielle Dupéré se souvient qu'il n'y avait pas beaucoup de femmes au sein de la Chambre, et même lors des événements, elles étaient peu nombreuses. À la fin de son mandat, cependant, Marielle constatait déjà une différence, « mais cela restait difficile. » Le milieu des affaires est-il encore essentiellement masculin ? La question divise : « Je ne suis plus vraiment d'accord avec ça, » dit-elle. « De nombreuses femmes ont défendu leur place dans divers domaines et je pense qu'aujourd'hui les portes sont plutôt ouvertes. C'est encore difficile ; nous n'avons pas encore la reconnaissance salariale de nos savoirs et de nos compétences, mais c'est plus facile pour les jeunes femmes qui émergent. »

Selon elle, il est crucial qu'il y ait de plus en plus de femmes au sein de la CCLGBTQ « comme il y en aura de plus en plus dans la société, les conseils d'administration, et à la tête des entreprises et des institutions, » affirme Marielle. « Il est important de représenter toute la communauté : lesbienne, trans, gaie, hétéro, etc. C'est une très bonne idée qu'il y ait plus de femmes et qu'elles s'impliquent parce que les événements qui s'y organisent ne sont pas uniquement destinés à la gente masculine ! »

Faire une vraie place aux femmes

La valeur ajoutée d'une présence féminine dans une Chambre de commerce réside dans la diversité des idées et la proactivité. « Une présence féminine à la CC peut entraîner des changements dans la culture interne, » poursuit Marielle Dupéré, « parce qu'un équilibre va peu à peu se mettre en place, une égalité que nous n'avions pas auparavant. Ce n'est pas que nous n'en voulions pas, » se souvient-elle, « nous avions pourtant de la place pour d'autres, mais personne n'allait de l'avant sur cette question.

Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) is a vital task in computer vision, involving the detection and tracking of multiple objects over time in a sequence of images. This technology can be applied to various real-world scenarios, such as video surveillance, autonomous vehicles, and sports analysis. Despite numerous research methods proposed for MOT, challenges such as fragmented tracklets or ID switching, often caused by frequent occlusions in crowded scenes, persist. A promising solution is Multi-Camera Multi-Object Tracking (MC-MOT), which leverages information from multiple cameras. In this setup, objects occluded in one view may be visible in another, leading to more accurate tracking results.

Most tracking-by-detection paradigms [1] utilize the Kalman filter [17] in the data association stage, serving as a motion model to predict the next possible position and match it with previous detections. However, this method is typically deterministic and struggles to adapt to dynamically changing environments. Achieving globally optimal tracking results is challenging due to variations in illumination, relative geometry distance, or sampling rates across different datasets, which are common in real-world scenarios. An alternative approach is reformulating the association problem into link prediction on graphs [5, 18, 25, 27]. This method allows a trainable model to determine the strength of the connection between two detections, enabling dynamic object association based on environmental conditions.

Nonetheless, current graph-based models for MC-MOT still face issues. Many approaches rely on a single-camera tracker to generate initial tracklets [13, 25, 27, 37]. Although several methods refine tracklets, single-view tracking errors often remain unaddressed. Additionally, these methods do not fully exploit the rich spatial and temporal information crucial for MC-MOT. Recently, spatial-temporal models have been used to learn representative features for tracklets. However, the resulting graphs are usually complex and difficult to optimize.

In this paper, we propose a novel Reconfigurable Spatial-Temporal graph model (ReST) for MC-MOT to address these challenges. Our approach reformulates the MC-MOT problem into two sub-tasks: Spatial Association and Temporal Association. Spatial Association focuses on matching objects across different views, while Temporal Association uses temporal information, such as speed and time, to build temporal graphs that associate objects across frames. By dividing the problem into these sub-tasks, spatial and temporal consistency can be individually optimized for improved tracking results. Additionally, the graph model becomes more manageable and easier to optimize. To bridge the two association stages, we introduce a Graph Reconfiguration module that aggregates information from the spatial and temporal graph models. The benefits of graph reconfiguration are twofold: first, merging nodes of the same object results in a compact graph; second, iterative refinement of the graph model during each reconfiguration step enhances feature extraction and improves tracking results. As shown in Figure 1a, when the girl is occluded, fragmented tracklets lead to the ID switch problem. In Figure 1b, the correct object ID is retained by employing spatial and temporal consistency through Spatial Association, Temporal Association, and Graph Reconfiguration modules.

The proposed graph model is termed reconfigurable because the vertex and edge sets of spatial and temporal graphs are restructured to form a new graph at each moment, enabling adaptation to dynamic scenes. Unlike existing methods, our model does not rely on results from single-camera trackers. Instead, the tracking and association of detected objects are achieved by iteratively constructing spatial and temporal graphs. Our model is designed for online object tracking, as it does not rely on information from future frames.

Rappelons que l’interprète de « Casablanca » a été placé ce mardi en détention provisoire, suite à une décision de la cour d’appel d’Aix-en-Provence. Accusé de viol et placé sous contrôle judiciaire, il a comparu le 18 septembre devant le juge des libertés et de la détention à Draguignan.

Le Parquet de Draguignan avait en effet fait appel de la décision de le libérer sous contrôle judiciaire, souhaitant que l’artiste soit détenu provisoirement, au moins pendant le début de l’instruction. Interpellé à la fin du mois d’août à Saint-Tropez (Côte d’Azur) après la plainte d’une jeune femme de 29 ans pour « faits caractérisés de viol » et inculpé le 28 août, Lamjarred avait été placé sous contrôle judiciaire, avec interdiction de quitter le territoire et paiement d’une caution de 150.000 euros, par décision du juge des libertés et de la détention.

Par ailleurs, le chanteur marocain est toujours poursuivi par la justice française suite aux accusations de Laura Prioul qui remontent à 2016. D’autres affaires ont également entaché sa carrière ces dernières années.

The objective of this paper is to propose and analyze new risk-averse reinforcement learning methods for Markov Decision Processes (MDPs). Our goal is to combine the efficacy of the methods of temporal differences with the robustness of dynamic risk measures, and to provide a rigorous mathematical analysis of the methods.

MDPs are well-known models of stochastic sequential decision problems, covered in multiple monographs, and having countless applications. In the classical setting, the goal of an MDP is to find a policy minimizing the expected cost over a finite or infinite horizon. Traditional MDP models, although effective for small to medium size problems, suffer from the curse of dimensionality in problems with large state space. Approximate dynamic programming approaches try to tackle the curse of dimensionality and provide an approximate solution of an MDP. Such methods usually involve value function approximations, where the value of a state of the Markov process is approximated by a simple, usually linear, function of some selected features of the state.

Reinforcement learning methods involve simulation or observation of a Markov process to approximate the value function and learn the corresponding policies. The first studies attempted to emulate neural networks and biological learning processes, learning by trial and error. One of the core approaches in reinforcement learning is the method of temporal differences (TD(λ)), known as TD(λ). It uses differences between the values of the approximate value function at successive states to improve the approximation, concurrently with the evolution of the system. TD(λ) is a continuum of algorithms depending on a parameter λ ∈ [0, 1] which is used to exponentially weight past observations. The methods of temporal differences have been proven to converge in the mean.

We introduce risk models into temporal difference learning, rooted in the theory of dynamic measures of risk, which has been intensively developed in the last 15 years. In our previous work, we introduced the class of Markov dynamic risk measures, specially tailored for the MDPs, allowing for the development of dynamic programming equations and corresponding solution methods. Our ideas were successfully extended to undiscounted problems, partially observable and history-dependent systems, and further generalized.

A number of works introduce models of risk into reinforcement learning, with few later studies proposing heuristic approaches involving coherent risk measures and their mean-risk counterparts. In this paper, we use Markov risk measures in conjunction with linear approximations of the value function.

Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
• A projected risk-averse dynamic programming equation and analysis of its properties
• A risk-averse method of temporal differences and proof of its convergence
• A multistep risk-averse method of temporal differences and its convergence proof
• An empirical study comparing the efficacy of the methods.

Chandigarh (Punjab) [India], November 4 (ANI): The Punjab government has established District School Education Reform Teams to oversee school activities. According to a press release from the Information and Public Relations Department of Punjab, a spokesperson from the school education department stated that the District Education Officer (Sec. Edu.) will head each District Education Reform Team. These teams will work closely with the respective District Magistrate/Block Magistrate in their district and contribute to enhancing the quality of education by formulating plans aligned with the 'Parho Punjab, Paraho Punjab' initiative.

The spokesperson further explained that these teams will support the successful execution of ongoing projects such as the Punjab Achievement Survey, Smart School Project, English Booster Club, Welcome Life, Buddy Group, Mission Shat-Pratishat, and the enrolment drive. They will also encourage school principals, teachers, and other stakeholders to transform their schools into smart schools. Additionally, they will guide school heads in adhering to the government's instructions regarding Covid-19.

Driverless cars are on the horizon, but they raise concerns about safety for drivers and their families. While these cars could be beneficial if properly developed by knowledgeable technicians, there are uncertainties surrounding their effectiveness.

My stance on driverless cars is neutral. Humans are capable of driving vehicles proficiently, although fatigue from long drives can be an issue. Additionally, these "driverless" cars still require human intervention in complex traffic situations or construction zones. The potential risks arise when the person at the wheel falls asleep and the car needs manual control to avoid accidents.

The idea of tech giant Google producing driverless cars is controversial. Traditional automakers like Toyota, Ford, Chevy, or Pontiac seem more fitting for such ventures than a company primarily known for internet services. Google's pursuit of additional profits through this project raises ethical concerns as blame may shift to the occupant in case of accidents.

While creating driverless vehicles isn't inherently flawed, technical challenges loom large and could deter consumers from embracing them fully due to safety uncertainties. In scenarios where an accident occurs and results in catastrophic outcomes like explosions, attributing fault becomes murky when a human occupant was present but not actively driving.

Designating specific tracks exclusively for driverless car use could mitigate potential hazards posed by technical glitches leading to dangerous incidents within urban settings. Perhaps Google should stick to its core competency in internet services rather than venturing into manufacturing automobiles given the complexities involved that could expose them to liability risks stemming from malfunctions post-sale.

In conclusion, caution is warranted as integrating advanced technology like autonomous vehicles demands meticulous planning and robust safety measures to ensure public trust and minimize legal implications if unforeseen issues arise once these vehicles hit the market.

Deep learning models are now being utilized for a wide range of tasks. While many of these tasks may not necessarily require confident decision-making, such as advertising or content recommendations, global regulators are increasingly demanding that companies develop safer and more trustworthy artificial intelligence (AI) systems (e.g., the European Union's proposal for AI regulation). On the other hand, AI tasks that involve critical infrastructures, such as secure communication systems, radio surveillance, and navigation systems, require robust and safe models before deployment in real-world scenarios.

Developing safe deep learning models that can be relied upon in practical applications is a complex challenge. While one might consider amassing sufficient data, this solution is often either prohibitively expensive, hindered by confidentiality concerns, or simply unfeasible. Moreover, many tasks are continuously evolving, as seen with the impact of face masks on face recognition systems after the Covid-19 pandemic. Modeling the data is another approach, but it is not always feasible in every situation. For instance, while both yield correct predictions with high confidence on an in-distribution (ID) sample, a standard neural network exhibits a drastic decrease in confidence when faced with an out-of-distribution (OoD) sample, such as when trained with TrustGAN.

One proposed solution is to develop a deep learning model that excels in its designated task while also being equipped to flag uncertainties or abstain when confidence is lacking. Such a model would provide not only a decision but also an associated confidence level. This confidence must remain robust not only to rare samples within the training set but also, more crucially, to out-of-distribution samples. These unfamiliar samples, such as a bird mistakenly identified in an image classifier meant to differentiate helicopters from planes, necessitate the AI system to express low confidence levels. However, obtaining and utilizing OoD samples or datasets is often laborious and frequently impractical due to similar challenges encountered with training datasets.

Traditional training methods for deep learning models often overlook the estimation of confidence in the face of OoD samples, instead focusing on optimizing performance with the training dataset. Despite this, most machine learning models provide some form of confidence estimation on their decisions, like the maximum class probability (MCP), albeit known for being unreliable and commonly overestimated. For example, a number classifier may confidently misclassify an image of a pangolin as the digit 5, revealing a flaw in the system.

Introducing TrustGAN, a generative adversarial network (GAN) pipeline designed to enhance trustworthiness and confidence, aims to address these challenges. TrustGAN targets improving the confidence estimates of a given model through the manipulation of in-distribution and out-of-distribution samples. By generating adversarial samples, TrustGAN assists the target network in recognizing both efficient task execution and identifying distinctive characteristics of in-distribution samples.

TrustGAN consists of two neural networks: a "target model" intended to excel in a specific task while providing reliable confidence scores on both ID and OoD samples, and a "confidence-attacker" network (a GAN) designed to challenge the confidence of the target network. The code for TrustGAN is publicly available on GitHub.

Numerous other approaches in literature focus on enhancing the confidence estimates of neural networks, with TrustGAN either supplementing or potentially replacing existing methodologies. For instance, some studies incorporate dropout layers for confidence estimation, while others introduce additional neural networks to output confidence scores based on the target network's performance. Similarly, works like [6] leverage GANs to train a discriminator for confidence estimation, though this may necessitate deploying separate networks for prediction and confidence estimation on target hardware.

To demonstrate the efficacy of TrustGAN and its impact, we outline the training pipeline specifics, neural networks, loss functions, and training procedures in section II.

Backlund’s current contract is set to expire at the end of the 2017-18 season, a contract paying him $3.575 million annually. Given his surge in production over the last two seasons, he’s likely going to be seeking a raise, and deservedly so.

With his value likely now being around the $5 million mark, the problem for the Flames becomes extending his contract. Sure, it’s only $1.5 million more than he’s making now, but don’t forget about Matthew Tkachuk, whose contract is set to expire at the end of next season. Tkachuk is set to receive a sizeable raise as he’s currently playing on an entry-level contract, and is likely to receive an extension worth at least $4 million annually.

So, where will the money come from? Obviously, the easy fix would be finding a team willing to take on Troy Brouwer’s hefty contract via trade, but that remains unlikely. Matt Stajan is currently in the final year of his contract, which equals a salary cap hit of $3.125 million. Given his age, 33, and the depth the Flames have at the center position, it’s highly unlikely he will be re-signed, which opens up a large chunk of salary cap space.

Matt Stajan has really aged in front of us … He looks how I feel when I wake up in the morning. pic.twitter.com/vFsa9wl4Vj — Stephen Burtch (@SteveBurtch) October 5, 2017

Kris Versteeg and Jaromir Jagr both have contracts expiring at the end of this season, with salary cap hits of $1.75 million and $1 million respectively. There’s a chance the Flames decide to keep Versteeg for another year with Tkachuk still having another year left on his entry-level contract, but it’s hard to imagine any longer than that. The departures of Stajan, Versteeg, and Jagr would free up $5.875 million in cap space, enough to offer Backlund the extension and raise he deserves, while also locking up Tkachuk.
