There’s no question Mikael Backlund is playing the best hockey of his career right now. He’s finally moulded into the centerman the Calgary Flames hoped he’d become when they drafted him back in 2007. He set a career-high in points last season with 53 points (22 goals, 31 assists), surpassing his previous best 47 points from the 2015-16 season, and was even a legitimate contender for the Selke Trophy last season. There’s no doubt the Flames would like to keep him around, but it’s easier said than done.

Backlund has developed into a reliable two-way centerman who’s become a big part of the success of the Flames, making him all the more valuable to keep in Calgary.

“He’s strong on pucks. He battles. And with his skating, he’s able to get everywhere,” said Flames assistant general manager Craig Conroy in a Calgary Herald article. “He’s not going to run you over physically. He’s not going to fight you. But he’s going to battle in the face-off circle. He’ll bump you. He finishes checks. He’ll block shots. He’ll do all those other things.”

Related: Patience Pays off for Backlund

The End Result

If everything works out, the Flames will sign Backlund to a long-term, front-loaded extension that could see him play out his career in Calgary. He has become a rock for head coach Glen Gulutzan. He can be relied on in any situation on the ice, at any time of the game, and can be counted on for at least 40 points in all seasons going forward. He’s the centerpiece of the “3M line” (Tkachuk, Backlund, Frolik), a line that is being used regularly to shut down the opposition’s top line.

L'Organisation mondiale de la santé devrait lancer une application au cours du mois de mai pour aider certaines nations dépourvues de ressources à se protéger contre le coronavirus.
En France, l'application de suivi des contacts StopCovid, dont les tests en conditions réelles débutent cette semaine, devrait être lancée au début du mois de juin. D'autres pays ont déjà déployé leur propre version de l'outil, comme le Royaume-Uni, qui a également opté pour le traçage des contacts, tout comme l'Inde. Bernardo Mariano, Directeur de l'information à l'OMS, a informé nos confrères de Reuters que l'organisation travaille sur le lancement de sa propre application de traçage numérique.
StopCovid : le code source va commencer à être publié afin que les développeurs puissent le vérifier. Lire aussi :
Aider les citoyens des pays manquant de ressources suffisantes
L'OMS souhaite que les habitants vivant dans des pays ne disposant pas des moyens nécessaires pour développer une application mobile de lutte contre le Covid-19 puissent en utiliser une créée et déployée par l'organisation.
L'agence de l'ONU prévoit de mettre à disposition des États n'ayant pas suffisamment de ressources un outil permettant aux individus d'obtenir un premier diagnostic en répondant à des questions sur leurs symptômes potentiels, ce qui favoriserait le dépistage de la maladie. Le dispositif pourrait contenir de nombreuses fonctionnalités pratiques, telles que les moyens de se faire tester, par exemple.
Les gouvernements pourront adopter l'application développée par l'OMS
En outre, l'OMS souhaiterait inclure une fonctionnalité de suivi des contacts basée sur la technologie Bluetooth. Il convient de rappeler que pour ce qui est du suivi des données mobiles dans la lutte contre le Covid-19, le traçage des contacts se situe entre l'observation des déplacements collectifs et des mesures de confinement, et le contrôle des quarantaines individuelles, moins protecteur des libertés individuelles pour cette dernière.
Si l'organisation prévoit de publier sa propre version sur les magasins d'applications traditionnels, les gouvernements du monde entier pourront tirer parti du code source publié en open-source sur la plateforme GitHub pour ajouter des fonctionnalités et développer leur propre version de l'outil de traçage numérique.
L'OMS espère rendre son application accessible en particulier en Amérique du Sud et en Afrique, où les systèmes de santé ne sont pas optimaux et où la pandémie s'est propagée ces dernières semaines.

In the assignment problem (Hylland & Zeckhauser, 1979; Zhou, 1990), n agents each have unit demands and strict ordinal preferences for n items with unit supply. The goal is to compute an assignment that allocates each agent with one unit of items and maximizes agent satisfaction to the extent possible. This serves as a useful model for various scenarios such as house allocation (Shapley & Scarf, 1974), dormitory room assignment (Chen & Sönmez, 2002), school choice without priorities (Miralles, 2009), and the allocation of computational resources in cloud computing (Ghodsi et al., 2011; Ghodsi et al., 2012; Grandl et al., 2014).

Given the broad application of the assignment problem, there exists a significant body of literature focused on designing assignment mechanisms that meet efficiency, fairness, and strategyproofness criteria. However, many of these properties are inherently conflicting, necessitating trade-offs.

In many practical assignment problems, achieving maximal allocation of agents to their top items, known as first-choice maximality (FCM), is a crucial measure of agent satisfaction. For instance, in school choice programs, the percentage of students admitted to their preferred school is a key indicator of student welfare and a priority for school administrators (Dur et al., 2018). Alongside FCM, additional efficiency guarantees such as Pareto-efficiency (PE) are often sought, which ensures that an assignment cannot be improved to benefit some agents without harming others. Hence, in this paper, we aim to explore whether mechanisms can be designed to simultaneously satisfy crucial efficiency criteria like FCM and PE, while also maintaining fairness and strategyproofness.

Efficiency considerations have led to the development of mechanisms that aim to maximize total satisfaction through a heuristic approach of allocating items to agents based on their preferences. An example of this is the well-known Boston mechanism, which allocates items iteratively to agents based on their ranking preferences. Kojima and Ünver (2014) demonstrated that the Boston mechanism embodies the favoring-higher-ranks (FHR) efficiency property, encompassing both FCM and PE criteria.

Nevertheless, the Boston mechanism has faced criticism for lacking strategyproofness, which is deemed crucial in practical applications such as school choice and kidney exchange. Various efforts have been made to improve upon this drawback, with Mennle and Seuken (2021) highlighting that certain adaptive Boston mechanisms (ABM, Alcalde, 1996) achieve strategyproofness but do not address fairness considerations.

When items are indivisible, achieving even basic fairness ideals like treating agents with identical preferences equally can only be achieved through random mechanisms, such as the Boston mechanism which resolves ties via lotteries.

Leçon 1 : la victoire de l'abstention

Le dimanche 28 juin, 135 129 électeurs ont boudé les urnes, 109 889 ont voté pour l'un des deux candidats et 2 499 ont voté blanc. Le principal vainqueur de cette élection est donc le parti abstentionniste, avec 55,1 % de non-voix. Mieux cerner les profils de ces non-électeurs pourrait être utile aux nouveaux élus, afin de les réconcilier enfin avec la chose publique.

C’est ce que propose sur Twitter Ré_Mi_La, un Toulousain spécialiste des statistiques, qui a eu l’idée de comparer la carte de l’abstention avec les données de l’Insee. « Attention », prévient toutefois cet analyste souhaitant rester anonyme, « dans tout ce qui suit, il est question de la population résidant sur l’emprise d’un bureau de vote, non des personnes inscrites ou ayant voté le 28 juin. De plus, les données de l'Insee datent de 2015. »

En croisant les données, il apparaît que les bureaux de vote avec une forte population de plus de 65 ans (en violet pâle sur la carte) se sont le moins abstenus, avec 46 % en moyenne, tandis que l'abstention s'élève à 64 % dans les bureaux de vote avec très peu de personnes âgées (en violet sombre).

Outre l'âge, le niveau de vie apparaît comme un facteur déterminant dans l'envie de voter. « Si l'on regarde la part de propriétaires dans la population, l'abstention est élevée (72 %) lorsque les propriétaires sont rares (en rouge pâle sur la carte ci-dessous, NDLR) et faible (49 %) lorsqu'ils sont majoritaires (en rouge sombre) », . . .

El Gobierno ha destacado hoy en un comunicado que los indicadores de seguimiento, establecidos en el acuerdo sobre 'Actuaciones de respuesta coordinada para el control de la transmisión del COVID-19', aprobado por el Consejo Interterritorial del Sistema Nacional de Salud (CISNS), "coinciden plenamente" con los que utiliza la Consejería de Sanidad para la evaluación del semáforo Covid semanal. Así lo recoge el informe semanal por provincias elaborado por el Ministerio de Sanidad con la información del Sistema para la Vigilancia Epidemiológica en España (SIVIES), que muestra los niveles de riesgo por municipios en base a la Incidencia Acumulada (IA) en 7 y 14 días, tanto global como en mayores de 65 años, en la proporción de pruebas positivas, los casos con trazabilidad, y la ocupación de camas de agudos y UCI.

El informe del Ministerio "concuerda por completo en sus cifras" con el que elabora la Consejería de Sanidad de Cantabria. Tal y como se estableció para la puesta en marcha del semáforo Covid en Cantabria el pasado mes de mayo, el Ministerio también insiste en que la decisión final sobre el nivel de alerta precisa una evaluación de riesgo completa que incluya el resto de indicadores (brotes, variantes, etc.) y su tendencia temporal. Cantabria aplica este enfoque "de forma escrupulosa" para determinar el nivel de riesgo individualizado para cada uno de los municipios, sin sesgos.

Ayer, la Asociación Empresarial de Hostelería de Cantabria presentó un recurso ante el Tribunal Superior de Justicia contra el último semáforo covid, argumentando que "no estamos" en nivel 3 de riesgo, como ha determinado Sanidad, y apuntando que los informes no tienen en cuenta en sus cálculos el aumento de población que se produce en verano en varios municipios gracias al turismo.

En respuesta a esta acción, el consejero de Sanidad, Miguel Rodríguez, rechazó ayer calcular el nivel de riesgo en base a la población flotante, como reclaman los hosteleros, porque los contagios registrados en turistas son "irrelevantes", según indicó.

أكد خالد عبد العال، محافظ القاهرة، حرصه على الصحة العامة خلال شهر رمضان المعظم، مشيرًا إلى تتبعه الإجراءات التنفيذية التي تتخذها الأجهزة المحلية لتطبيق الإجراءات الاحترازية في الأحياء المختلفة.

وفي بيان صحفي، شدد محافظ القاهرة على ضرورة تنفيذ حملات مكثفة لرفع الإشغالات وإزالة التعديات عن الطرق العامة، خاصة فيما يتعلق بإشغالات الكافيهات والمقاهي، ودعا إلى التزام القواعد والقوانين النظامية.

وأكد محافظ القاهرة أهمية الحملات الرامية للقضاء على المظاهر السلبية في العاصمة، وحث رؤساء الأحياء على التواجد المستمر في الشوارع والتفاعل مع شكاوى المواطنين، مشددًا على ضرورة التنسيق مع شرطة المرافق لتحقيق الانضباط المجتمعي.

وأشار محافظ القاهرة إلى أهمية رفع تراكمات القمامة على الفور وسحب رخص جميع السيارات المخالفة واتخاذ الإجراءات القانونية اللازمة لتحقيق السيولة المرورية.

وتمثلت جهود محافظة القاهرة في تنظيم حملات مكثفة بالتعاون مع أحياء المنطقة الشرقية وشرطة المرافق ومديرية أمن القاهرة، وقد أسفرت هذه الحملات عن تنفيذ 370 حالة إزالة إدارية وتحرير 133 محضر ضد الباعة الجائلين والإدارات بدون تراخيص ورفع 11 سيارة مهملة في عدة أحياء بالمنطقة الشرقية.

In today's rapidly advancing technological landscape, the notion of computers being able to accurately define human emotions is becoming increasingly plausible. The potential for software to decipher and analyze our emotions is a concept that is gaining traction in various settings, be it at work or in educational environments.

Imagine a world in which computer software is capable of accurately interpreting and gauging human emotions. This would be a groundbreaking development, offering insights into individuals' true feelings that may not be readily apparent from mere facial expressions. In scenarios where individuals mask their emotions with a smile, the software could provide a deeper understanding of their underlying emotional state, offering a valuable tool for communication and empathy.

As time progresses, individuals may grow weary of expressing the same emotions repeatedly, potentially leading to a sense of stagnation. While the general emotions of happiness and sadness are easily recognizable, the complexity of human emotions extends beyond these basic categories. With the aid of computer software, a vast array of nuanced emotions can be identified and conveyed, enriching the depth of emotional communication.

The computational abilities of such software mirror the cognitive processes of the human brain, enabling the analysis of emotions with a degree of precision that surpasses human perception. By harnessing the power of this technology, individuals can gain a deeper understanding of their emotions and, in turn, proactively manage and alter their emotional states, thus promoting personal growth and well-being. Through the utilization of this software, individuals can bridge the gap between their outward expressions and their internal emotions, fostering a greater sense of self-awareness and emotional intelligence.

The Red River rivals, Oklahoma and Texas, had a rare occurrence last season when they faced each other twice in 115 years. The Sooners clinched their fourth consecutive Big 12 championship by avenging their sole regular-season loss.

Oklahoma has now added another transfer quarterback, former national championship winner Jalen Hurts, following two Heisman Trophy-winning and No. 1 NFL draft pick transfer quarterbacks in the past two seasons. This transition has taken place since Lincoln Riley assumed the head coaching position. On the other hand, the Longhorns, led by hometown quarterback Sam Ehlinger, are coming off their first 10-win season since 2009 under third-year coach Tom Herman.

Given the recent coaching turnover in the Big 12, which saw four new coaches, including two national championship winners, it would not be surprising if Oklahoma and Texas meet again outside their traditional October clash at the State Fair of Texas. Les Miles, a national championship-winning coach, has taken the reins at Kansas after his successful tenure at LSU. Similarly, Chris Klieman, who secured four championships in five seasons as North Dakota State's head coach, is now leading Kansas State.

Among the Big 12 coaches, only Mike Gundy of Oklahoma State (in his 15th season) and Gary Patterson of TCU (in his 19th season) have longer tenures than Matt Campbell. Campbell has been instrumental in the transformation of the Iowa State team, led by sophomore quarterback Brock Purdy, which seems poised to compete for a spot in the Big 12 title game in his fourth season.

The Big 12 has not produced a national champion since the 2005 Texas team led by Vince Young.

The league's other new coaches include Neal Brown at West Virginia and Matt Wells at Texas Tech. While Wells is starting his coaching journey at a Power Five school after a successful stint at Utah State, Brown, formerly Texas Tech's offensive coordinator, returns to the Big 12 after a stint at Troy.

Oklahoma has been the lone Big 12 team to reach the College Football Playoff but has faced defeat in the semifinals three out of the last four years. Coach Riley acknowledges the need for a complete performance in those critical games.

While the Big 12 lost standout receivers to the NFL, it still boasts talented junior receivers who surpassed 1,000 yards receiving last season. Players like Tylan Wallace of Oklahoma State, CeeDee Lamb of Oklahoma, and Jalen Reagor of TCU continue to shine on the field.

Notable early season matchups include Dana Holgorsen's Houston debut against Oklahoma on Sept. 1 and Texas facing LSU in the second weekend of the season. Additionally, Oklahoma State will kick off the Big 12's season with a game against Oregon State on Aug. 30.

Automatic facial behavior analysis has long been a topic of interest at the intersection of computer vision, physiology, and psychology, with applications spanning a wide range of fields, including medicine, health, driver fatigue monitoring, e-learning, marketing, entertainment, lie detection, and law enforcement. However, it is only recently, with the advent of large-scale datasets and powerful machine learning methods like deep neural networks, that automatic facial behavior analysis has truly begun to flourish.

When it comes to automatically recognizing affect in-the-wild (i.e., in uncontrolled conditions and unconstrained environments), there are three iconic tasks: (i) recognizing basic expressions (anger, disgust, fear, happiness, sadness, surprise, and the neutral state); (ii) estimating continuous affect (valence - how positive or negative a person is - and arousal - how active or passive a person is); and (iii) detecting facial action units (coding of facial motion concerning the activation of facial muscles, e.g., upper/inner eyebrows, nose wrinkles).

Ekman [11] defined the six basic emotions—anger, disgust, fear, happiness, sadness, surprise, and the neutral state—based on a cross-cultural study, which indicated that humans perceive certain basic emotions similarly, regardless of culture. Nevertheless, advanced research in neuroscience and psychology has argued that the model of six basic emotions is culture-specific and not universal. Moreover, the affect model based on basic emotions is limited in its ability to represent the complexity and subtlety of our daily affective displays. Despite these findings, the categorical model describing emotions in terms of discrete basic emotions remains the most popular perspective for expression recognition, due to its pioneering investigations and the straightforward, intuitive definition of facial expressions.

The dimensional model of affect, which is suitable for representing both extreme and subtle emotions occurring in everyday human-computer interactions, has also garnered significant attention in recent years. According to this dimensional approach [12, 65, 55], affective behavior is described by a number of latent continuous dimensions. The most commonly used dimensions include valence (indicating how positive or negative an emotional state is) and arousal (measuring the intensity of emotional activation).

Detection of Facial Action Units (AUs) has also attracted considerable attention. The Facial Action Coding System (FACS) [11, 2] provides a standardized taxonomy of facial muscle movements and has been widely adopted as a common standard for systematically categorizing the physical manifestation of complex facial expressions.

"What is this feeling?" I asked myself. I had been experiencing it since morning – a sense of terror that turned out to be a premonition. Suddenly, I felt as though I was falling, only to catch myself mid-air. Mike chuckled, pointing out that my shoelaces were untied.

Returning to reality, I saw that he was right. As I bent down to tie my shoelaces, the unnerving feeling returned, but I brushed it off. Mike continued walking ahead, creating a five-foot gap between us. Glancing up, I saw him being grabbed by a man emerging from a side alley, brandishing a silenced pistol and pulling Mike into the alley before shooting him.

Frozen in shock, I witnessed the assassination of my coworker and friend. Unsure how to react, I kept calm, aware that if I moved, the assassin might spot me. Pretending to tie my shoe, I acknowledged the grim reality – Mike was dead, likely in the dumpster in the alley.

"I thought you said there would be two," the man muttered. "Tying his shoelaces?" Panic surged through me; attempting to flee now seemed futile. The assassin knew I was there and fleeing might lead to dire consequences.

Summoning courage, I did the unexpected. "HELP!" I shouted, drawing attention from passersby and prompting some to investigate. Police officers arrived swiftly, guns drawn, as I pointed toward the alley where the crime had unfolded.

To my disbelief, the individuals in hockey gear denied seeing anyone in the alley. Confusion and fear gripped me. "But my friend, he was right there!" I exclaimed, met with skepticism from both the officers and bystanders.

A chilling realization struck me when a voice behind me spoke up – it was the assassin.

Policy gradient (PG) methods are a category of reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms that optimize the parameters of a stochastic policy with respect to the expected reward through gradient ascent. Since their inception with REINFORCE [40], PG methods, especially when combined with deep neural networks [33], have become some of the most effective model-free RL algorithms across various tasks [2, 6, 10]. However, the performance of PG methods is significantly impacted by the variance of the PG estimator [35, 37]. As the RL agent operates within an unknown stochastic environment, often considered a black box, the randomness of the expected reward can increase substantially with larger state and action spaces. This results in PG estimators with high variance, leading to low sample efficiency and unsuccessful training sessions [9, 35].

To address the issue of large variance and improve PG estimation, several variance reduction methods have been developed [9, 23, 35, 48]. One of the most widely applied and studied methods is control variate subtraction [8, 9, 37], also known as the baseline trick. A baseline is a scalar random variable that can be subtracted from the state-action value samples in the PG estimates to reduce variance without introducing bias. Baselines can be implemented as a constant value [8, 12] or as a state-dependent value [8, 9, 11, 33], such as the state value function, resulting in the zero-centered advantage function and the advantage actor-critic algorithm [18]. State-action dependent baselines can also be applied [9, 41], though they reportedly offer no advantages over state-dependent baselines [35].

In multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) [43], PG methods can naturally be applied. A straightforward approach is to have each agent ignore its opponents and treat them as part of the environment. In this scenario, single-agent PG methods can be applied in a fully decentralized way, known as decentralized training (DT). Although DT has several drawbacks, such as the non-stationarity issue and limited convergence guarantees [3, 16], it performs well empirically in certain tasks [19, 26]. A more robust approach is to extend the PG theorem to the multi-agent policy gradient (MAPG) theorem, creating a learning paradigm known as centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE) [7, 42, 45, 46]. In CTDE, each agent during training maintains a centralized critic that takes joint information as input, such as the joint state-action pair in COMA [7], while learning a decentralized policy that relies only on local state information for execution. The centralized critic helps address the non-stationarity issue encountered in DT [7, 16], making CTDE an effective framework for implementing MAPG, with successful applications in many real-world tasks [13, 17, 22, 38, 39, 50].

Unfortunately, compared to single-agent PG methods, MAPG methods are more susceptible to the large variance issue. In multi-agent settings, randomness arises not only from each agent's interactions with the environment but also from other agents' actions. This complicates the credit assignment problem [7, 36], making it difficult for an agent to determine whether an improved outcome is due to its actions or those of other agents. This problem is a major contributor to the high variance of CTDE methods [16]. Despite intuitive understanding, there is a lack of mathematical treatment to fully grasp the factors contributing to the variance of MAPG estimators, making it challenging to address this issue in MARL. One relevant baseline trick in MARL is the counterfactual baseline introduced in COMA [7], though COMA still suffers from large variance empirically [19].

In this work, we analyze the variance of MAPG estimates mathematically, aiming to quantify the contributions of the number of agents and the effects of multi-agent explorations on the variance of MAPG estimators.

The ubiquitous connectivity provided by modern cellular technologies, along with the success of mobile web and application paradigms, has introduced the necessity of contextualizing services with location information. While smartphones have supported this capability since their inception, the complexity of the World Wide Web—serving as the backbone for virtually the entire mobile application landscape—and the growing concerns over user privacy make the structured gathering of such information challenging. For example, geographic extensions of HTTP headers were proposed [1] but never approved by the IETF, leaving the collection of this information solely at the application level, either through JavaScript [2] or with OS APIs, subject to user permission. Consequently, mobile phones only share precise positioning data, such as GPS, if explicitly configured to do so, and only with applications and servers that have received specific user permission.

Nevertheless, locating users and devices can be valuable beyond the application domain, prompting network operators and third-party developers to employ alternative technologies to obtain location information. Network operators, with access to information from the lower layers of the network, can, for instance, deduce user positions and trajectories by analyzing the cell towers they have visited [3]. However, the most common method of acquiring positioning information, without the explicit use of GPS, is IP Geolocation, or GeoIP, for short.

In "The Challenge of Exploring Venus," the author addresses both the benefits and dangers associated with exploring this intriguing planet. Although Venus is renowned for its uninhabitable atmosphere and harsh environment, scientists believe it was once the planet most similar to Earth. In the article, the author advocates for overcoming these dangers, effectively supporting this stance with inspiring points that motivate readers to look beyond existing boundaries.

The article begins by outlining the extreme dangers posed by Venus. The author provides alarming facts that highlight how inhospitable Venus is for humans and even some spacecraft. For instance, it is noted: "These conditions are far more extreme than anything humans encounter on Earth; such an environment would crush even a submarine accustomed to diving to the deepest parts of our oceans and would liquefy many metals." This statement is not intended to frighten but rather bluntly illustrate what NASA scientists are confronting.

As the discussion progresses, the author delves into answering why such risks are worth taking. This crucial question—why anyone would want to face these hazards—is addressed by noting that "Astronomers are fascinated by Venus because it may well once have been the most Earth-like planet in our solar system." By emphasizing this potential similarity to Earth, albeit uncertain without further exploration, excitement among astronauts and explorers is kindled at possibly discovering another part of our world.

Venus indeed holds potential as an exciting new frontier but presents lethal challenges for astronauts and scientists.

شكرا لقرائتكم خبر عن وزير الاتصالات: دعم البنية التكنولوجية والتحول الرقمي بمؤسسات الفتوى والان مع تفاصيل الخبر

القاهرة - سامية سيد - ألقى الدكتور عمرو طلعت، وزير الاتصالات وتكنولوجيا المعلومات، كلمة بالنيابة عن الدكتور مصطفى مدبولي، رئيس مجلس الوزراء، في الجلسة الافتتاحية لمؤتمر "مؤسسات الفتوى في العصر الرقمي: تحديات التطوير وآليات التعاون" الذي تنظمه دار الإفتاء المصرية تحت رعاية رئيس الجمهورية في الفترة من 2-3 أغسطس.

قال الوزير: "يسرني أن ألتقي بكم اليوم في افتتاح هذا المؤتمر العالمي المرموق؛ ذلك المحفل الهام ذو المقام الرفيع الذي بات منصةً سنوية متميزة تجمع ثُلة من أفاضل العلماء الذين يساهمون في إثراء الفكر الإسلامي، وإعلاء رايات التنوير، وتعزيز منهاجية السماحة."

وتأتي هذه النسخة من المؤتمر في سياق له أهمية خاصة؛ إذ يعني بإحدى أهم القضايا الحيوية وهي المتعلقة بأهمية الاستفادة من التطور التكنولوجي والتفاعل مع معطيات العصر الرقمي في سبيل دعم الفتوى والإفتاء والنهوض بهما.

وتشهد مصر نقلة حضارية كبرى لبناء مصر الرقمية؛ حيث أولت الدولة المصرية اهتمامًا كبيرًا نحو اعتماد نهج شامل للتحول إلى مجتمع رقمي متكامل تتم من خلاله تبني أحدث التقنيات لتعزيز كفاءة الأداء الحكومي، ورقمنة الخدمات المقدمة للمواطنين على النحو الذي يسهم في تحسين جودة حياة المصريين.

وإذ تمثل مؤسسات الإفتاء المرجعية الشرعية في شتى مجالات الحياة التي تنظمها الشريعة السمحة، والحصن المنيع للذود عن الأمة الإسلامية في مواجهة فوضى الفتاوى التي تبثها الجماعات الظلامية.

ولذا، فلقد أصبح من الضروري والحتمي تسخير كافة الإمكانات لتعزيز قدراتها الرقمية وتمكينها من التجاوب مع متطلبات المستفتين بما يتواكب مع المستحدثات التكنولوجية التي باتت تتسارع وتيرتها يوما تلو يوم.

ومن هنا تبرز أهمية استخدام الوسائل الرقمية في خدمة الدعوى والإفتاء في ظل ما يمثلانه من مكون أساسي في تشكيل البنيان الفكري للمواطن المصري والذي يعد الهدف الأسمى في مصر الرقمية.

As I rummaged through my handbag, I remarked, "It's right here." I didn't anticipate the candy being too expensive. Knowing I had enough money, I located my wallet among the numerous papers in my bag. Opening it, I saw a stack of bills and retrieved one to pay for the candy.

Receiving a handful of change from the red-haired female shopkeeper, I noticed the distinct octagonal-shaped coins with Chinese inscriptions. Pondering where I was, I asked the shopkeeper, "Is this Canada?" She confirmed my suspicion.

Upon putting the change in my wallet, I discovered a card — a U.S. President's license. Excitedly, I exclaimed, "Hey! I'm the president of the United States," causing a scene that attracted some unwanted attention.

To divert from the situation, I grabbed the shopkeeper's hand, and we swiftly walked away, exploring the unique streets of the town. The town's architectural resemblance to a desolate southern hillbilly town on water, akin to Venice, intrigued me.

Boarding a fishing boat filled with gangsters inexplicably, we encountered a group of unfriendly thugs. They questioned my identity with a Southern-African accent, mistaking me for someone called Mike, who they believed had killed a certain "Skinny Mike."

华盛顿邮报报导称，霍根最近在佛蒙特州、内布拉斯加州等地支持的候选人都被归类为共和党中间路线的务实派。他还借机在一些原本偏向民主党的城郊选区展现出两党都可以接受的形象。在缅因州国会参议员候选人Susan Collins的选举广告中，霍根曾出现并表示支持，而且本周他还在为隶属跨党派党团的纽约州众议员John Katko进行网上筹款。

下周，霍根将与同样表态不支持川普的共和党麻州州长贝克一同举办线上选民大会，为佛蒙特州长候选人Phil Scott造势。Scott公开支持弹劾川普，并曾批评川普滥用职权。霍根近期的活动与他在过去五年任期内刻意回避全国性事件并且很少力挺马州同党候选人的作风大相径庭。

之前霍根接受采访时一直不透露他对总统大选的支持，只是说他需要时间考虑。

Orland Hardware Store Destroyed by Fire

The Orland Ace Hardware & Implement Co. on Fifth Street, just south of Highway 32, was engulfed in flames early Monday morning, resulting in significant damage. The blaze was first reported by a passing truck driver to the Glenn County Sheriff’s Office at 1:44 a.m.

Owner Ben Pforsick confirmed that the business suffered a total loss, with fire officials estimating the damages at $1.5 million. The store housed a substantial paint department, leading to aerosol paint cans exploding and being propelled out of shattered windows during the firefighters’ extensive four-hour effort to contain the fire.

Firefighters managed to remove several propane cylinders before they could detonate, except for one on a forklift in a storage area that did explode. Luckily, the absence of lumber in the store prevented further hazards.

The fire’s heavy smoke, carried by strong winds, prompted the evacuation of approximately a six-block radius, including a nearby retirement home. Twenty residents were evacuated to a nearby church for safety.

Multiple streets in the vicinity, such as Fifth, Colusa, and Mill, were closed for hours as firefighters battled the blaze. The evacuation orders remained in place until late Monday morning.

Although the hardware store shared a building with the Orland Volunteer Fire Department station, the fire was successfully contained without spreading to the station’s roof. A joint effort of 37 members of the Orland Volunteer Fire Department, along with crews from Capay, Artois, and Hamilton City, managed the firefighting operation.

Computation using spiking neural networks (SNNs) offers three significant architectural advantages: (1) sparse communication between elements, reducing energy costs; (2) binary communication through all-or-nothing spike responses without message discretization; and (3) completely asynchronous operation of computational units. Architecturally, the spiking paradigm shares several computational elements with traditional artificial neural networks (ANNs), such as weighted addition, nonlinearity, and learning algorithms, though it introduces the additional complexity of computation spread over time.

Traditional computational approaches, based on the von Neumann architecture—including modern systems equipped with graphical processing units (GPUs)—are not well-suited to this paradigm due to the fundamental separation between computing and memory units, which results in serialized processing tasks. Consequently, these traditional computing paradigms cannot efficiently support the required computational elements without significant simplification or long latencies, underscoring the need for new computer architectures. Neuromorphic design is guided by the principle that evolution has already produced a successful SNN architecture for real-time, low-power operation. Efforts to replicate this design involve various digital, analog, or mixed-signal circuits based on electronic, photonic, or optoelectronic devices. However, considerable work is needed to determine the optimal approach to abstract, apply, and enhance this evolutionary design.

Digital neuromorphic processors, such as TrueNorth, Loihi, and SpiNNaker, increase processing parallelization by incorporating a large number of cores that enable asynchronous computation. This approach contrasts with GPU architectures but resembles a specialized form of cluster computing. Although each core operates in parallel, the desire for determinism in digital electronics necessitates synchronization between simulated time steps, limiting full asynchronous operation, which may be prohibitive at biological network scales. Conversely, analog electronic meshes can provide fully parallel computation, but the capacitance of electrical wire networks increases both latency and power consumption.

Photonic and optical computing efforts aim to exploit the nearly lossless and parallel communication capabilities of optical fibers in photonic integrated circuits (PICs). Several demonstrations have showcased matrix multiplication and convolutional processing using non-spiking photonic circuits. These devices employ wavelength-division multiplexing (WDM) and space-division multiplexing (SDM) to manage multiply-and-accumulate (MAC) operations in parallel, making them compatible with spike processing in synaptic networks. Nonlinearity choices in spiking elements vary widely, but a major distinction exists between all-optical and optoelectronic approaches. Optical nonlinearities typically have shorter lifetimes, potentially enabling higher-speed computation compared to electronic nonlinearities based on electronic charges or currents. However, these nonlinearities are primarily governed by fixed material properties post-fabrication.

外交部长吴钊燮近日表示，如果政府的管制制度能够获得国人的信任，那么开放日本福岛核灾地区食品将是一个可能的方向。目前，全世界只有中国大陆和台湾全面禁止福岛核灾地区的食品。此言论在大陆总理李克强访日期间引发关注，因为盛传他可能会同意中国大陆解除对福岛食品的禁令。

吴钊燮在与媒体交流时指出，政府对于食品解禁政策持有持续性立场，并强调两个重要原则：一是确保国人健康，建立可靠的食品输入检视和管制体制；二是检视台湾法规是否符合国际规范，从科学原则出发审视日本食品解禁问题。他补充说，如果这些措施能够赢得国人的信任，那么开放福岛食品就是可能的。

与此同时，日本首相安倍晋三将在东京与李克强会谈，预计将讨论中国是否会松绑福岛核灾地区食品的进口。对此，吴钊燮强调，根据从日本朋友那里获得的信息，日中关系的改善绝对不会影响日本和台湾之间的关系，所有的合作成果都会持续下去。

另一方面，国民党副主席郝龙斌领衔的「反日本核食进口」公投案遭到中选会质疑。中选会要求对公投案的必要性进行补充说明，并指出日本曾就南韩禁止福岛食品进口向WTO提出贸易争讼，这可能涉及违反国际协定的问题。

郝龙斌对此表示强烈不满，批评中选会的做法是违法扩权，并质疑其行政中立性。他认为日韩贸易争讼结果不能约束台湾是否可以进口福岛食品，并指责中选会限制直接民权，否定日本核灾食品进口。此外，他质疑中选会为何对前国手纪政提出的「以台湾名义参与国际赛会」公投案未做类似质疑。

综上所述，福岛核灾区食品是否解禁仍是一个复杂的问题，涉及国际关系、公共健康和政治因素的多重考量。

Alors que l'annonce des résultats provisoires de l'élection présidentielle au Burkina Faso était très attendue, la Commission électorale nationale indépendante (Céni) vient d'annoncer que celle-ci se fera ce jeudi à 10 heures (TU).

En fin de soirée mercredi 25 novembre, une source au sein de la Commission électorale expliquait : « Il ne nous manquait presque rien. Les derniers résultats provenant des communes en zone rouge viennent de nous parvenir. À 10 heures, nous serons prêts », assurait cette source.

Ce qui a retardé la publication des résultats sont les polémiques entourant les compilations manuelles. Lundi, cinq des quinze commissaires de la Céni ont suspendu leur participation aux travaux de l'institution, en partie parce que les résultats commençaient à être publiés sans que le travail de compilation manuelle ne soit terminé dans tous les centres communaux. Les résultats annoncés étaient donc basés uniquement sur la compilation électronique, ce à quoi s'opposent fermement les candidats de l'opposition.

Une mission de bons offices a été menée par la CEDEAO, l'Union africaine, l'ONU et l'OIF pour tenter d'apaiser la situation. L'objectif était de retrouver le consensus politique qui a prévalu ces derniers mois. Mercredi, la situation semblait s'être améliorée puisque les cinq commissaires de l'opposition étaient de retour au sein de la plénière de la Commission électorale. De plus, l'opposition a annulé le rassemblement prévu devant le siège de la Céni, sans fournir d'explications sur l'objet initial de cette manifestation ni sur les raisons de son annulation.

Toutefois, selon l'un des candidats de l'opposition, le retour des commissaires se serait fait uniquement pour vérifier si les résultats des communes annoncés par la Céni étaient bien basés sur les compilations manuelles. « Or ce n'est pas le cas », déplore ce candidat. « Faux », réplique une source au sein de la Céni, « en même temps que les centres communaux nous envoient leur compilation électronique, ils nous scannent aussi leur compilation manuelle », affirme-t-elle.

(德国之声中文网) 在过去几周内，多国相继暂停了与香港的引渡条约，法国也于周一（8月3日）宣布中止批准与香港之间的引渡协议。法国外交部在当天发布的声明中表示：「鉴于最新发展，法国目前不会继续推动批准2017年5月4日与香港特别行政区签署的引渡条约。」

法国外交部严厉批评中国上个月在香港实施的《港区国安法》，称该法律违反了「一国两制」的原则，以及由此原则衍生出的各种自由。声明中写道：「国安法也直接影响到法国公民和企业。」

在法国之前，加拿大、澳大利亚、英国、新西兰和德国也相继中止了与香港的引渡条约。德国在上周五（7月31日）宣布这一消息后，德国外长海科·马斯（Heiko Maas）对香港的最新局势发表评论，强调德国已多次呼吁中国遵守国际法义务，确保香港基本法保障的自由与权利，其中包括自由和公正的选举。

欧盟呼吁香港重新考虑推迟立法会选举的决定

此外，欧盟周一也针对香港政府推迟立法会选举一事发表声明，指出香港延期举行立法会选举并取消多位民主派人士参选资格，引发外界对香港能否保障民主权利的质疑，并损害了香港自由开放的国际声誉。为此，欧盟呼吁香港重新考虑这一决定。

欧盟首席外交官约瑟普·博雷尔（Josep Borrell）在声明中指出，港府利用紧急法将立法会选举推迟一年，相当于延后了对香港民主授权的更新，这让各界质疑香港人能否继续行使基本法所保障的民主权利与自由。此外，保障香港人的公民与政治权利是「一国两制」的基础，欧盟也完全支持这一原则。

The integration of technology in the classroom is invaluable as it enhances the overall learning experience. It fosters student satisfaction, enables teachers to gauge student engagement, and promotes active participation. Let's delve into how student emotions play a pivotal role in this context.

In the school environment, students experience a range of emotions. As mentioned in the article, "A classroom computer could recognize when a student is becoming confused or bored." Students often transition between various emotional states, from happiness to sadness to boredom. If a computer can identify these shifts and alert the teacher to make necessary adjustments, it can significantly improve student satisfaction. Moreover, the article notes, "Then it could modify the lesson, like an effective human instructor." By tailoring lessons to suit individual student preferences, understanding of the subject matter improves, leading to better academic performance. This approach also benefits teachers, enhancing the overall classroom experience.

Furthermore, the technology can assist teachers in understanding student needs and preferences. By providing insights into student engagement, teachers can adapt their teaching methods to better suit the learning styles of their students. Through the data provided, teachers can identify students requiring additional support, thereby personalizing the learning experience. Additionally, the technology, as the article points out, can differentiate between genuine and forced expressions, enabling teachers to discern the true emotional state of the students, leading to the creation of more engaging lessons.

Lastly, the technology can cultivate a more active, participatory classroom, where students feel empowered to contribute. When students are genuinely interested in the subject, they are more likely to engage, participate, and, in the process, boost their confidence.

Swansea head coach Steve Cooper praised his team for handing striker Rhian Brewster the chance to grab the headlines after an impressive Sky Bet Championship victory at Middlesbrough. The 20-year-old Liverpool loanee scored twice in three minutes as the visitors ran out 3-0 winners at the Riverside Stadium. His brace and Andre Ayew’s penalty effectively clinched the points after only 34 minutes.

Cooper said: “In the first half in particular, he looked a real threat. He got his two goals – he was disappointed he didn’t have three. He’s a really good player, but we are a team that likes to play as a team. Rhian obviously will get some headlines today because he’s got a brace, but it’s as a consequence of the team playing the way we want to play.”

Brewster celebrated his 18th-minute opener by holding up a t-shirt bearing the message “Our colour is not a crime” in support of the Black Lives Matter campaign on a day when the players of both sides and the match officials took a knee before kick-off. Cooper said: “Rhian has a voice like everybody else and we all support each other. We’re as one here and it was just another example of that.”

The England Under-21 international doubled his tally in the 21st minute before Ayew completed the job from the spot, in the process maintaining the Swans’ bid for a play-off place. Cooper said: “We’ve always been in the mix. We’ve never been too far away from the play-off positions if we haven’t been in them, and that will continue after this weekend. We have just got to make sure that we just focus on the next game. The games are getting less and less and time is precious. We have got to make sure that we maximise everything that’s in our hands.”

Boro head coach Jonathan Woodgate admitted he was left “stunned” on the sidelines by a first-half display which belied what he had seen on the training ground earlier in the week. Woodgate said: “It’s hard to explain that type of performance. It wasn’t nice to see. In the week if you had seen how we were training, it was very good and to turn in a performance like that isn’t good enough.

شكرًا لقراءتكم. رينيه فايلر يرفض العروض المحلية لضم أحمد الشيخ في الصيف، ونؤكد لكم أننا نسعى دائمًا لإرضائكم. وإليكم التفاصيل:

جدة - عمرو شويل: رفض السويسري رينيه فايلر، المدير الفني لفريق الأهلي، فكرة رحيل أحمد الشيخ، جناح الفريق، خلال فترة الانتقالات الصيفية المقبلة.

تمسك فايلر ببقاء أحمد الشيخ على الرغم من أنه لا يعتمد عليه بشكل أساسي في مباريات الفريق، ورفض العروض المحلية التي وصلته في الفترة الماضية. فايلر يعتبر الشيخ جزءاً من القوام الأساسي الذي يعتمد عليه في مباريات الفريق سواء محليًا أو في بطولة أفريقيا.

دخل أحمد الشيخ ضمن حسابات نادي بيراميدز للانتقال إليه بداية من الموسم المقبل، سواء على سبيل الإعارة أو البيع النهائي، في ظل حاجة بيراميدز للتعاقد مع جناح مهاجم. أصبح الشيخ ضمن قائمة اللاعبين الذين يرغب بيراميدز في ضمهم من الأهلي، بعد نجاح النادي في التعاقد مع أحمد فتحي، وقرب انضمام شريف إكرامي بعد الاتفاق على رحيله من الأهلي بنهاية الموسم بعد انتهاء عقده. كما دخل الشيخ حسابات فريق إنبي، لكن فايلر يرفض التفريط في اللاعب حاليًا.

قرر مسؤولو الأهلي تأجيل تعديل عقود ثنائي الفريق، أحمد الشيخ وعلي لطفي، خاصة أنهما يحصلان حاليًا على أقل قيمة في العقود مقارنة بباقي زملائهما، وذلك بعد تعديل عقود أيمن أشرف ومحمد هاني مؤخرًا، حيث كانا يحصلان أيضًا على رواتب ضعيفة لا تتناسب مع عطائهما للفريق. أرجع مسؤولو الأهلي تأجيل هذه الخطوة إلى تداعيات فيروس كورونا الذي تسبب في إيقاف النشاط الكروي في مصر والعالم، بالإضافة إلى حدوث أزمات مالية على مستوى الأندية العالمية والمصرية على حد سواء.

It's 3:46 AM, precisely. Once again, I find myself in the kitchen with the alarm clock that usually sits next to my bed now plugged in and resting on the table where I'm seated. The room, as well as the entire house, is enveloped in darkness, with the curtains drawn against the blinking, bright cityscape outside my window. The only source of light is the red lines on the clock displaying the time: 3:46. Suddenly, the screen blinks, and it's 3:47. That's when it happens, like clockwork. A luminous figure materializes in front of me, resembling the afterimage left by staring at the sun for too long.

The figure repeats the same words it always does. “Get away! Get away from her!” It moves frantically, as if reaching out to someone invisible, desperately pulling them away from an unseen threat. The figure is me. I recognize the voice, the form, the gestures. It's a distorted projection of myself, trapped in a specific moment, replaying endlessly. It's a consequence of time travel, a residual glow of a displaced individual, caught in a loop, existing simultaneously in different temporal planes in the same space. Although I've never time-traveled, I can only assume it's a glimpse of my future self. I've never encountered myself in this setting or been involved in any conflict, so I infer that it's an event yet to unfold. As the figure struggles in mid-air, illuminating my kitchen with the radiance of a future self, I do what I always do at 3:47 AM.

I clench my fists, focusing intensely, and repeat to myself: *I will not engage in time travel. I shall never succumb to the temptation of time travel, under any circumstances. Should the opportunity arise, I will resist the urge to time travel. I shall refrain from time travel.* However, the glowing figure persists, reenacting the same crude sequence, as it always does. It continues grappling with invisible entities, falling to the ground, rising, and gesturing with an imaginary weapon, stabbing the air repeatedly until the threat no longer exists.

Exhausted, it utters its final words: “It's okay, you're okay now,” and vanishes at 3:48. “Is it still happening?” a voice interrupts from the doorway. Oh no, he's awake. He detests these apparitions that disrupt our sleep. He becomes irritable when he can't rest.

“I can't convince myself to stop,” I admit, my voice trembling, trying to hold back tears. He dislikes it when I cry.

“You know they're compelling people to do it, don't you?” He sounds critical now. “If you can't convince yourself, it won't cease.”

“I'm trying!” I sob.

Press Release: Dominica Fire Brigade Receives Timely Assistance

In the wake of Hurricane Maria's devastation, the local fire brigade in Dominica has been tirelessly engaged in post-disaster cleanup and restoration efforts, while also fulfilling its routine firefighting responsibilities in and around the capital city of Roseau.

Last week, the brigade issued an urgent plea for help when a crucial piece of equipment, a fire pump, required immediate replacement. The absence of this essential pump would have severely limited the brigade's ability to provide crucial assistance to communities in urgent need.

Responding swiftly to this call for aid, Stephen Lander, CIBC FirstCaribbean's Country Head in Dominica, took action by reaching out to the bank's philanthropic arm, the Comtrust Foundation. Within a remarkably short timeframe, a new fire pump was secured in Barbados, swiftly procured, and then transported to Dominica by the Barbados Coast Guard. Over the weekend, Lander personally delivered the pump to Josiah Dupuis, the Fire Chief of the Dominica Fire Brigade.

Chief Dupuis expressed deep gratitude on behalf of the fire brigade, the residents of Roseau, and the surrounding areas, emphasizing how the timely acquisition of the pump would significantly bolster their ongoing recovery and firefighting operations.

CIBC FirstCaribbean has pledged a generous sum of up to US$100,000 for relief initiatives in Dominica. This commitment comes in addition to an earlier donation of US$450,000 made by both the bank and its parent company, CIBC, to support the Caribbean nations impacted by Hurricane Irma.

Since its establishment in 2002, the bank has consistently earmarked a minimum of US$1 million annually to support various noble causes throughout the Caribbean.

Everyone is relatively sure that it's got to be something in the water. The only other place it could be is in the air, but we'd notice. They're relatively sure we'd notice. Of course where would we even begin if we figured out where it was coming from. Assuming that it's something we're imbibing or inhaling, I mean maybe they've figured out how to put it through the rays of the goddamn sun. And all of THAT is assuming it's a chemical or a medication. Maybe it's a.... procedure. I don't like to think about it. My own biology put on standby since I was a little one. And how? No one knows. But I swear, if we knew we'd fight it. Try and do our own reversals. Wouldn't you? If you ask me, the Laws shouldn't have passed. They shouldn't be able to control us like this.

I guess it's only a big concern when you think about it too much. Normally you can forget but when you drift off, the lingering thought rears it's ugly head. Of course, I think a lot these days. Grandpa says its so much easier now to drift off into thought. Stress kills thought, he says, but stress is just a memory to him now. The control doesn't even bother him! I could never understand how they could be okay with the Laws. The government controlling THAT much of a person. He insists if I was born in his time I'd understand. Wouldn't have had a table to eat off of, let alone something to eat, "if things continued." Honestly I think he's exaggerating. We were doing fine over here from all their accounts, there was plenty of space, my mum and dad did well. Never starved, never went "uneducated." We weren't billionaires like you hear of way back in the day, but we were solid. They were solid. Of course you never hear of starving or being stupid nowadays - but they say it was a thing and it was heading our way. But I don't want to think about it now. I'm not one of the ones anymore that has to think about it. Ruth and I, we've been approved.

What a day that was. I'll tell you, as soon as we were approved, she bloomed like I had never seen, her heart unfolded and beamed right through her skin.

The Facial Action Coding System is quite puzzling to me. Why would anyone want to know what someone else is feeling or their emotional state? To me, that's personal information I'd prefer to keep private. Besides, I doubt there are many people willing to invest money just to discern their emotions. That's just my perspective, though. What do you think about this concept? Would you spend time and money simply to determine your emotions and current mood? I wouldn't.

As you continue reading, I'll explain why I believe this is a poor idea—because it truly is. Who would dedicate time, effort, or money merely to identify their emotions or feelings? Honestly, who needs guidance on which facial expressions convey happiness when we already instinctively know how to express joy? We don't need a machine telling us how to look happy. When something wonderful occurs in someone's life and they feel happy, it's evident from the big smile on their face. Similarly, we recognize when someone is angry; they tend not to talk much and might appear as if they're ready for confrontation.

For instance, some texts provide step-by-step instructions on which facial expressions project happiness—as if we don't already understand how our faces naturally reflect happiness or sadness or anger! We certainly don't need a machine for that.

So why rely on technology for insights into what we innately comprehend? Our world seems preoccupied with spending resources on unnecessary things and creating inventions that serve no real purpose today. There's literally no point in such inventions existing. Furthermore, strangers likely wouldn't appreciate us calculating their emotions at any given moment since these matters are deeply personal; we have no understanding of their life's context or experiences.

Gimnasia y Esgrima La Plata obtuvo una victoria por 2 a 0 sobre Patronato de Paraná en un partido accidentado que se disputó hoy en el bosque platense, correspondiente a la novena fecha de la Superliga. El equipo platense aprovechó sus oportunidades y se impuso con goles de Nicolás Colazo a los 35 minutos del primer tiempo y Nicolás Mazzola a los 5 minutos del complemento.

El conjunto paranaense terminó el partido con nueve jugadores en el campo debido a las expulsiones de Renzo Vera y Lautaro Geminiani, a los 11 y 13 minutos del segundo tiempo. Esta fue la tercera victoria del "tripero" en el torneo, mientras que representó la cuarta derrota del "patrón" en la Superliga.

El partido comenzó trabado en la primera media hora de juego, ya que aunque Gimnasia buscó el control del balón, Patronato se defendió bien y apostó al contraataque como única arma de ataque. El uruguayo Aleman fue el jugador más destacado del equipo dirigido por Mariano Soso y fue el encargado de dar el pase para el gol de apertura, cuando Colazo definió ante la salida de Bértoli.

Patronato tuvo pocas oportunidades de reaccionar y solo un cabezazo de Ribas por encima del travesaño no pudo aportar mucho más. Al comienzo del segundo tiempo, el "lobo" aumentó la ventaja con un gol de Mazzola, tras un excelente pase de Faravelli, y el dominio del partido fue casi absoluto por parte del equipo local.

Sin embargo, en solo dos minutos, tal vez por desesperación o falta de opciones, Patronato se quedó con nueve jugadores debido a las expulsiones de Vera y Geminiani, en decisiones acertadas del árbitro Diego Abal. Vera golpeó por detrás a Dibble cuando el delantero local tenía el balón en su poder, y Geminiani entró duramente con una plancha a Mazzola, en una patada descalificadora que podría haber tenido consecuencias graves para el delantero.

A partir de ese momento, el partido quedó desvirtuado ya que Patronato no tuvo recursos para intentar avanzar, mientras que Gimnasia administró su ventaja y evitó entrar en enfrentamientos innecesarios, consciente de su superioridad.

Síntesis:
Gimnasia (LP) 2 - Patronato 0.
Estadio: "Juan Carmelo Zerillo" (Gimnasia La Plata).
Árbitro: Diego Abal.

Redacción - Ocho personas fueron detenidas por la policía en Alajuela, cuando huían tras cometer asaltos a comercios. Las detenciones obedecen a dos casos diferentes. El primero se registró en la localidad de Monserrat, mientras que el segundo en Zarcero.

En el primer caso, se reportaron detonaciones con arma de fuego en un bar, por lo que la policía se desplazó al sitio. Al arribo de los oficiales, se determinó que el comercio había sido víctima de robo y que los criminales huían en un carro blanco. Tras una rápida acción policial, el carro fue ubicado a 300 metros del lugar, al costado de la capilla de Monserrat.

Los oficiales detuvieron a tres hombres de apellidos Carranza, Soto y Rodríguez, quien mantiene antecedentes por receptación y resistencia agravada. Según confirmaron los oficiales, Rodríguez lanzó un arma tipo revólver fuera del carro al percatarse de la presencia policial. De igual forma, se detuvieron a dos mujeres que acompañaban a los hombres y estaban en el bar al momento del crimen.

Asegura que Junts tiene "muchos tics de la CUP" y recuerda que vetaron a candidatos independentistas
BARCELONA, 4 (EUROPA PRESS)

La candidata del PDeCAT a las elecciones catalanas, Àngels Chacón, ha asegurado este jueves que el objetivo de su formación es influir en el próximo Govern de la Generalitat "desde dentro o desde fuera" para evitar que sea la CUP quien lo haga.

"ERC y Junts se acercan cada vez más a la CUP, mientras que nosotros mantenemos la centralidad. Nuestro objetivo es condicionar el próximo Govern, y esto se puede hacer desde dentro o desde fuera, aunque desde fuera se condiciona mucho más", ha dicho en un acto con el Fòrum Demòcrata.

Ha insistido en que condicionar el Govern no significa necesariamente entrar en él: "Nosotros queremos otro Govern y no perpetuar el caos que se ha mantenido hasta ahora. No queremos continuar haciendo lo mismo".

Chacón ha asegurado que Junts tiene "muchos tics de la CUP" y ha recordado que los 'cupaires' han influido y vetado candidatos independentistas a la presidencia de la Generalitat, lamentando que Junts ahora se acerque a ellos.

ALEGACIONES PARA IR A LAS MESAS

En relación a las crecientes alegaciones a las Juntas Electorales de Zona para eludir la citación como miembros de mesas electorales, ha señalado que esto es "una muestra más de que existe un Govern desbordado y dividido".

"Pedimos que se vaya a votar y que el Govern garantice la seguridad, pero no se puede prorrogar este desgobierno", ha añadido Chacón, quien ha celebrado el crecimiento del PDeCAT en las encuestas.

The Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) [1] is a well-known combinatorial optimization challenge where the objective is to determine a set of routes with minimal total costs. For each route, the total demand must not exceed the vehicle's capacity. In the literature, algorithms for solving VRP are generally categorized into exact and heuristic approaches. Exact algorithms provide optimal solutions but are not feasible for large-scale instances due to high computational complexity. Conversely, heuristic algorithms are often faster but lack theoretical guarantees. Considering the trade-off between optimality and computational costs, heuristic algorithms can find suboptimal solutions within an acceptable timeframe for large-scale cases. However, designing an effective heuristic algorithm is challenging, as it demands extensive problem-specific expertise and hand-crafted features. This raises the question: can we automatically learn a heuristic without human intervention? Inspired by recent advancements in machine learning, particularly deep learning, several studies [2][3][4][5][6][7] have explored using end-to-end neural networks to directly learn heuristics from data, eliminating the need for hand-engineered reasoning.

In the case of VRP, as depicted in Fig. 1, the problem instance is a set of nodes, and the optimal solution is a permutation of these nodes, viewed as a sequence of decisions. Hence, VRP can be regarded as a decision-making problem solvable through reinforcement learning. In reinforcement learning, the state is typically seen as a partial solution of the instance and the features of each node. The action represents the choice of the next node to visit, the reward is the negative tour length, and the policy corresponds to a heuristic strategy parameterized by a neural network. The policy is trained to make decisions that maximize the reward.

Studying Venus has been a particularly challenging task for explorers. Not only is the planet itself perilous to study due to its features and structure, but the process of exploration is fraught with difficulties. Venus is the closest planet to Earth in terms of both density and size. Being known as the "shining star," explorers thought that learning more about it up close would be highly educational.

Venus is also the closest planet to the Sun, which explains why it is so hot and why it is referred to as the "shining star." This proximity is the reason it is visible from a considerable distance on Earth. The temperature on Venus averages over 800 degrees Fahrenheit, and the atmospheric pressure is 90 times greater than that on our planet. This information highlights the extreme danger of the Venusian environment, which is not suited to the human body.

Research on Venus has shown that explorers are wary of venturing there. They have no choice but to rely on machines to observe the planet and understand its conditions.

Driverless cars have been a hot topic of debate, with proponents touting their potential benefits and convenience. However, my stance on this technology is clear: we do not need driverless cars. There are several disadvantages to relying on this technology, and it is essential to consider these before embracing it wholeheartedly.

One key drawback of driverless cars is the uncertainty surrounding their reliability and functionality in real-world scenarios. Just because a car is labeled as "driverless" does not guarantee its flawless operation. The potential for technical glitches, malfunctions, and other issues looms large, raising concerns about the safety and practicality of these vehicles in the long run.

A telling example of the challenges associated with driverless cars is the emphasis on the need for smarter infrastructure, as highlighted in a historical context. Futurists have noted that the key to developing self-driving cars is not just in advancing the cars themselves, but also in creating intelligent road systems that can support and accommodate such vehicles. This perspective underscores the complexity and foresight required in the development and implementation of driverless technology.

Considering the uncertainties and challenges inherent in the advancement of driverless cars, it is wise to approach this technology with caution.

Ce samedi 5 septembre, Grasse se réveillera sous un ciel dégagé, avec des températures similaires à celles de la veille. Le vent soufflera à environ 5 km/h, venant du nord. Au petit matin, le thermomètre indiquera 16 °C et grimpera progressivement jusqu'à atteindre 24 °C en fin de matinée.

Cet après-midi, le soleil restera dominant et le mercure se stabilisera autour de 25 °C. La force du vent variera entre 5 et 10 km/h, toujours en provenance du nord.

Le soir, le ciel restera dégagé. Le vent, soufflant à environ 5 km/h, accompagnera une baisse progressive des températures, qui atteindront 18 °C entre 18 h et 21 h. Le vent continuera de souffler depuis le nord durant cette période.

Durant la nuit, la température se maintiendra autour de 17 °C, avec un vent stable à 5 km/h provenant du nord. Le ciel restera clair.

Pour la journée de demain, le ciel sera majoritairement dégagé, bien que des averses soient prévues l'après-midi. Les températures seront presque identiques à celles d'aujourd'hui, avec une moyenne de 19 °C. Le maximum, à 22 °C, sera atteint entre midi et 16 h.

أُصيب ثلاثة أشخاص بكسور وكدمات، أحدهم حالته الصحية غير مستقرة، في حادث تصادم وقع بين سيارة ملاكي ودراجة نارية توك توك على طريق مصر-أسيوط الزراعي، بالقرب من مرور مدينة الحوامدية جنوب محافظة الجيزة.

بدأت الواقعة بتلقي الرائد أحمد عصام عبدالباقي، رئيس مباحث قسم شرطة الحوامدية بمديرية أمن الجيزة، إشارة من غرفة عمليات النجدة تُفيد بوقوع حادث تصادم ووجود مصابين على طريق مصر-أسيوط الزراعي بالقرب من مرور مدينة الحوامدية في نطاق القسم.

انتقلت الأجهزة الأمنية فورًا إلى مكان الحادث، مدعومة بسيارتي إسعاف، حيث تم نقل المصابين إلى المستشفى لتلقي العلاج اللازم. تم تحرير محضر بالواقعة، وتولت النيابة العامة التحقيقات، وأُخطِر اللواء رجب عبدالعال، مساعد الوزير ومدير أمن الجيزة.

وفي سياق منفصل، تستعرض "الدستور" 38 قاعدة أساسية لقيادة آمنة على الطرق، وهي كالتالي:

1. تأكد من وضع العجلات الأمامية قبل التحرك.
2. قم بإجراء الفحص الأولي للسيارة قبل التحرك بها لضمان عدم حدوث عطل أو التسبب في حادث أثناء القيادة.
3. قم بتبديل الإطارات كل 7500 كم.
4. تأكد من اكتمال مستوى الماء في الرادياتير قبل التحرك.
5. تأكد من إغلاق الأبواب جيدًا قبل التحرك بالمركبة.
6. تأكد من ربط مسامير العجلات جميعها بإحكام قبل التحرك.
7. لا تقُد المركبة وبعض مسامير تثبيت العجلات مفقودة.
8. تأكد من ضبط الأنوار الأمامية حتى لا تسبب عمى مؤقتًا لأعين الآخرين أو تقلل من كفاءة الرؤية أثناء القيادة الليلية.
9. اضبط المرايا اليمنى بالميل إلى اليمين أثناء جلوسك على كرسي القيادة، بحيث ترى أقل جزء ممكن من جانب السيارة الأيمن.
10. اختبر الفرامل قبل القيام برحلة على الطريق السريع أو القيادة لفترات طويلة.
11. تأكد عند اختبار الفرامل من عدم توقف عجلة قبل أخرى أو انحراف السيارة يمينًا أو يسارًا عند الضغط على الفرامل.
12. تعرف على أماكن أدوات التحكم في المركبة قبل التحرك وضبط ما يمكن ضبطه أثناء التوقف.
13. اختبر جميع أنوار المركبة قبل التحرك، وخصوصًا أنوار الفرامل والأمامية وأنوار الطوارئ.
14. لا تضغط على الفرامل بعنف فهو يتلف نظام الفرامل مبكرًا ويعرض مركبتك للتصادم الخلفي.
15. ارتدِ حزام الأمان بحيث يتقاطع مع الكتف وليس الرقبة، ويمكن تحقيق ذلك بوسادة أسفل السائق أو الركاب.
16. لا تُسمح للأطفال دون سن السابعة بالجلوس في المقاعد الأمامية للسيارات.
17. يجب أن يكون حزام الأمان مشدودًا أثناء ارتدائه وليس مرتخيًا.
18. لا ترتدِ حزام الأمان ملفوفًا حيث يكون تأثيره أعنف في حالة وقوع الحوادث.
19. ارتدِ حزام الأمان حتى على السرعات البطيئة.
20. إذا انفجر الإطار أو فرغ من الهواء، لا تتوقف بغرض الحفاظ عليه، بل اختر مكانًا آمنًا للتوقف وتغيير الإطار.

En Guinée, l'Assemblée nationale a adopté un nouveau code civil le jeudi 9 mai, qui présente une particularité : il inclut un article sur la monogamie. En décembre dernier, les députés avaient adopté à la majorité un texte opposé, qui permettait la polygamie. C'est donc un changement, mais il reste encore beaucoup à faire pour faire évoluer les pratiques.

Avec ce nouveau code civil, la monogamie devient la norme. Ce statut a été obtenu après de longs mois de discussions au sein d'une Assemblée assez réticente. Fatou Souaré, directrice de l'ONG Women in Africa, se félicite de ce premier pas.

« La monogamie l'emporte, c'est-à-dire que lorsque le couple ne se prononce pas, le mariage est monogame jusqu'au bout, c'est donc une situation moins grave », explique-t-elle.

Ce texte est une situation moins grave, car il est encore possible d'opter, au moment du mariage, pour la polygamie. Le conjoint doit alors préciser combien d'épouses il souhaite avoir, un nombre limité à quatre selon la loi.

« Les femmes ont peur des ragots »

Il n'est pas facile d'apporter des changements profonds dans une société où le choix de la famille est déterminant pour sceller un mariage. « Cela sera difficile, car les femmes d'aujourd'hui ne parviennent pas à vivre réellement et concrètement en accord avec les textes de loi », précise Moussa Yero Bah, directeur de l'ONG Femmes, Développement et Droits humains en Guinée. La réalité est que les acteurs socio-culturels prennent souvent le dessus. Par exemple, les femmes ont plutôt peur de partir lorsque leur mari prend une seconde épouse. Elles préfèrent rester et subir, par crainte de ce que dirait la société, de divorcer ou des ragots en général... »

Selon cette militante, il faudra encore du temps et beaucoup de pédagogie pour faire comprendre aux femmes, en particulier en milieu rural, que leurs droits comptent.

Long videos often demand a significant time investment and can easily lose a viewer's attention. Thus, efficiently presenting videos to users is a crucial and practical challenge in various video applications. For instance, consider home surveillance videos, which are typically recorded continuously throughout the day. Users might find it difficult to pinpoint a specific moment, like a package delivery, in an hour-long video. More generally, videos that are not meticulously edited, such as many YouTube videos, often contain irrelevant sections. These videos require content pre-processing to allow users to quickly access meaningful information.

Videos are often composed of different modalities, primarily sequences of image frames. With advancements in recording devices and editing tools, videos can also include speech, as seen in YouTube videos recorded on smartphones, and subtitles, as in movies and TV shows. Research has shown that utilizing these different modalities can enhance various video tasks. However, it's important to note that these modalities can be quite noisy and redundant, featuring meaningless utterances, repeating frames, and more, which can lead to computational inefficiency and distract model learning.

周四(14日)外电报导，特斯拉Model 3和Model S电动轿车重新获得《消费者报告》(Consumer Reports)背书，在该杂志的年度产品可靠性调查中，获得「值得推荐」的评级，此消息有助抬升特斯拉在整体电动车市场地位。

《消费者报告》的调查收集了超过40万辆上市车款的数据，能替消费者把关，检视市面上新车是否会为车主带来问题，该杂志的评价在消费者和企业高管中皆具有相当的影响力。

由非营利组织美国消费者联盟(CU)创立的《消费者报告》，是一消费品测评类杂志，透过旗下测试实验室和调查研究中心的报告和结果，对消费品和服务的进行评估和比较。

根据周四释出的年度可靠性调查显示，特斯拉的Model X休旅车依然是最不可靠的车型。

特斯拉自2013年首次纳入该杂志汽车品牌行列后，电动轿车Model S大受欢迎，该车款在不同的《消费者报告》调查中名列前茅，更以车主的满意程度著称。

该杂志的汽车测试资深总监Jake Fisher表示，由于特斯拉致力于解决Model 3的生产问题，因此他们将特斯拉整体排名往上调了4个名次，目前特斯拉在《消费者报告》调查的30个美国车市品牌中，排名第23位。

日本与南韩汽车品牌，在此次调查报告里名列前茅。

Have you ever wanted to spend more time with your family? Well, you may have that opportunity sometime in the future. Even as we go about our daily lives, people somewhere are working to make that happen with driverless cars. The driverless car will no doubt help lessen accidents caused by cars, allow you to do something more important than driving to and from work, and help keep your children under control by enabling you to interact with them in the backseat.

Automated driving will help prevent accidents from occurring. Driverless cars are safer as they rely on sensors rather than the human attention span. These cars are equipped with an automatic brake system that can stop the car before a collision occurs if a child or car suddenly appears in front. Furthermore, automated cars will lead to a more technologically advanced lifestyle, revolutionizing how we live and enhancing productivity.

While driving, you must constantly be alert to potential hazards, leaving no time to work on your projects. Automated cars would allow you to focus on tasks, boosting work productivity and, in turn, driving economic growth. The widespread adoption of automated cars could create job opportunities, lifting more people out of poverty, and benefiting future generations.

Do you know what your kids are doing for half the day? How many life lessons could you have imparted to them if you didn't have to drive? Your children want to hear your stories, feel your love, and engage in meaningful conversations, which can be facilitated by the extra time and attention driverless cars offer. 尽管国泰航空上半年的员工开支有所减少，但仍高达86.23亿元。

Today, I aim to debunk the claim that aliens created the Face on the red planet Mars. The primary flaw in your argument is the assumption that the Face on Mars is of extraterrestrial origin. The Face depicted in the image is simply an oddly shaped Martian mesa, a common feature in that region. It is entirely possible that there are more such mesas in the area.

You seem to have misinterpreted the image caption or perhaps overlooked it altogether. Had you paid attention, you would have noted that the caption explains the resemblance to a human head as a result of the shadows, creating the illusion of eyes, a nose, and a mouth. The image was likely shared to generate more interest in Mars.

Additionally, on April 5, 1998, NASA officially confirmed on their website that the Face was merely a naturally occurring, peculiarly shaped landform.

In summary, there are multiple ways to refute the notion that the Face on Mars is of alien origin. Firstly, the structure is a mesa, lacking a distinct, intentional form, meaning that a similar formation could resemble a dog or a cat. Secondly, the caption, if read, clarifies that the Face's appearance is the result of the play of shadows, creating the illusion of facial features. These points conclusively establish the Face as a natural, rather than a man-made, formation.

Have you ever wondered if there was life on Mars? Well, Mars is a planet that is often shrouded in clouds, with its atmosphere consisting mostly of clouds. Many people have believed that there might be life on Mars. In the past, NASA's Viking 1 spacecraft spotted a shadowy likeness of a human face on the planet. However, this Face is actually a natural landform, situated at 41 degrees north martian latitude during the winter. The camera had to peer through wispy clouds, and the appearance of the Face was possibly caused by a butte.

This particular Face is located at a latitude of 41 degrees north during the martian winter, a time of the year when the planet is typically cloud-covered. This suggests that the dust on the planet could have been rearranged to create the shadowy likeness. This, in turn, could indicate that there is no actual form of life on Mars.

Manny Pacquiao is set to announce his retirement plans in conjunction with the confirmation of his next fight. The 42-year-old has not entered the ring since he handed Keith Thurman the first defeat of his career to claim the WBA welterweight world title nearly two years ago. The Filipino legend, who has achieved world titles in eight different weight divisions over his illustrious 26-year career, is currently negotiating a fight with Mikey Garcia scheduled for later this year.

Pacquiao had previously considered a bout with UFC star Conor McGregor, but that match was canceled after McGregor's knockout loss to Dustin Poirier in January. A highly anticipated fight with pound-for-pound star Terence Crawford was also in discussion, but negotiations fell through when a prospective site in the Middle East failed to provide the necessary funds.

Now ready to end his hiatus, Pacquiao is preparing for a match against Garcia, a fight that was initially planned before the onset of the coronavirus pandemic. 'The negotiations are ongoing. I will not go into details to avoid any complications,' Pacquiao stated. When asked about his retirement plans, he added, 'We won't answer that for now, as it is part of the negotiations. It will be included in the announcement.'

Due to his inactivity, Pacquiao was recently designated as a 'champion in recess' by the WBA, with Yordenis Ugas promoted to welterweight champion after winning the vacant 'regular' belt last September. Beyond the ring, Pacquiao has established himself as a prominent political figure in his home country, currently serving as a Senator of the Philippines.

His long-time trainer, Freddie Roach, indicated last year that Pacquiao, who has announced his intention to run for the presidency of the Philippines in 2022, would likely have only 'one or two' more fights before fully dedicating himself to his political career. 'I believe he will fight again, and from our conversations, he wants to fight once or twice more,' Roach shared.

In recent years, deep learning has shown remarkable progress. However, despite these advancements, models still lack a full understanding and often depend on irrelevant features, known as confounders, which can lead to what are known as Clever Hans predictors. These predictors may perform well on training data and even achieve high validation accuracy, but can lead to critical errors in practical applications, especially in regulated and safety-critical fields like medical image processing and autonomous driving, where avoiding such failures is paramount.

This paper introduces a new approach called Counterfactual Knowledge Distillation (CFKD) aimed at detecting and eliminating reliance on confounders with the aid of expert human feedback. The concept involves creating counterfactual scenarios to enlighten human experts on the model's decision-making process and using their feedback to develop a more accurate model that is less dependent on confounders. Our key contributions are as follows:

- We discuss the practical necessity of CFKD and provide a case study on the detection of ovarian follicles from histopathology data.
- We outline the advantages of counterfactual explanations over traditional attribution-based explanations in identifying confounders.
- We present a methodology utilizing augmented or resampled datasets to quantitatively assess the effectiveness of our approach in reducing Clever Hans effects.
- We illustrate how CFKD can incorporate various forms of explanatory feedback, such as human-in-the-loop interactions or oracle models.
- We introduce a novel metric that, through empirical evidence, shows a stronger correlation with the true test accuracy compared to the standard validation set accuracy. We demonstrate the quantitative efficacy of our method on a range of datasets, including a baseline dataset, artificial datasets designed to test various confounder scenarios, and a histopathological dataset with a known confounder.

El jefe de Gabinete bonaerense, Carlos Bianco, anunció este martes en una conferencia de prensa que, a partir de mañana, en los 110 distritos de la provincia de Buenos Aires que se encuentran en fase 4, se suspenderán todas las actividades recreativas y comerciales entre las 2 y las 6 de la mañana debido al aumento de casos de coronavirus.

En la conferencia de prensa, realizada en la Casa de Gobierno provincial, Bianco estuvo acompañado por el ministro de Salud, Daniel Gollan. Durante el evento, también se informó que las reuniones familiares, sociales y recreativas se limitarán a un máximo de 10 personas.

Las medidas anunciadas esta mañana para la provincia de Buenos Aires son las siguientes:
– En el sistema de fases, 110 distritos se encuentran en fase 4 y 25 distritos en fase 5.
– A partir de mañana, en los distritos en fase 4, se suspenden las actividades comerciales, artísticas, deportivas, culturales, sociales y recreativas entre las 2 y las 6 de la mañana.
– Se exceptúan de esta restricción horaria las actividades productivas de carácter manufacturero, agropecuario y todas aquellas definidas como esenciales.
– En los distritos en fase 4, las actividades sociales, recreativas y familiares se limitan a grupos de hasta 10 personas.
– Los integrantes del Comité Operativo de Emergencia Covid-19 de la provincia de Buenos Aires están revisando las actividades y restricciones de la Fase 3, para el eventual caso de que sea necesario reestablecerla ante un aumento mayor en el número de casos.

En el marco de la conferencia de prensa, Gollan expresó la "enorme preocupación" del Gobierno bonaerense por la "dimensión casi explosiva" que están teniendo en estos momentos los nuevos casos de coronavirus.
