PLAYA DEL CARMEN.— El Instituto Nacional de Antropología e Historia (INAH) ha confirmado el hallazgo de un templo maya en el interior de una cueva.

Por ello, se ha propuesto que el sitio se integre al Registro Público de Monumentos y Zonas Arqueológicas con el nombre de Cueva del Templo de La Estalagmita.

El nombre deriva del espeleotema (formación de origen kárstico) que precede al pequeño adoratorio maya encontrado en su interior.

Tesoros escondidos

Se trata de un sitio subterráneo recientemente inspeccionado en un área urbana de Playa del Carmen. Este espacio se suma a las más de 150 cavidades que contienen algún tipo de vestigio arqueológico en esa zona.

Enrique Terrones González, arqueólogo responsable de la inspección, y su colega José Antonio Reyes Solís, del Centro INAH Quintana Roo, destacaron que es común hallar altares en cuevas y cenotes en la costa oriental de la Península de Yucatán. 

Los antiguos mayas consideraban estos lugares como sagrados, pues se creía que en ellos habitaban divinidades del agua, la fertilidad y el comercio, como Chaac y Ek Chuah.

Ofrendas ceremoniales

Los especialistas señalaron que en toda el área de Playa del Carmen se distribuye un gran sistema de cuevas secas y semi-inundadas. En cerca de 150 de estas cuevas se ha encontrado evidencia arqueológica muy variada, desde altares adoratorios hasta sencillas ofrendas compuestas por piezas cerámicas, de lítica y hueso, e incluso grabados o pintura en sus paredes.

Desde agosto de 2019, expertos del Centro INAH Quintana Roo, bajo la dirección de Margarito Molina, trabajan en colaboración con el proyecto “Cenotes Urbanos de Playa del Carmen”. El biólogo Roberto Francisco Rojo García, director del Planetario Sayab de Playa del Carmen e integrante del Círculo Espeleológico del Mayab, A. C., solicitó la inspección de este sitio. El equipo ya ha realizado la planimetría del interior.

Características del templo maya

La Cueva del Templo de La Estalagmita está compuesta por sectores secos y otros con presencia de agua de poca profundidad, en un área aproximada de 800 m². Por los materiales arqueológicos recuperados en superficie, se deduce que el adoratorio se utilizó entre los años 1200 y 1550, coincidiendo con el período del que datan muchos de estos altares subterráneos.

Terrones González y Reyes Solís explican que estas estructuras en cavidades suelen corresponder al Posclásico Tardío, fase que varios investigadores señalan como de inestabilidad en la región debido a la interacción de varios factores. El crecimiento de las urbes mayas y de su población, así como la poca disponibilidad de recursos por sequías prolongadas, detonaron problemas sociales. Los mayas ingresaban a estos lugares, considerados “entradas del inframundo”, para depositar ofrendas y pedir consejo a los ancestros y ayuda de las deidades.

Planes para el recinto

Por ahora, solo se ha realizado un recorrido sistemático en la parte seca de la cueva, en el que se localizaron algunos materiales arqueológicos en superficie. Se plantea una exploración más detallada que conlleve también la consolidación y restauración del altar-adoratorio, el cual se ubica a 20 metros de la entrada de la cueva. Esta, a su vez, fue modificada por los antiguos mayas para facilitar el acceso e incluso realizaron algunas nivelaciones visibles del terreno.

La pequeña edificación prehispánica se construyó con piedra caliza y se revistió con estuco, que aún presenta restos de pintura en color azul. Su estilo arquitectónico corresponde al de la Costa Oriental, cuya temporalidad se ha definido para el Posclásico Tardío.

تجاوزت الإصابات بفيروس كورونا في الولايات المتحدة 30 مليون حالة، اليوم الأربعاء، وفقاً لإحصاء أجرته رويترز، في حين تسارع الولايات عملية التطعيم بخفض القيود المتعلقة بالعمر. وتهدف السلطات الصحية إلى تسريع حملات التطعيم لمواجهة أول زيادة أسبوعية في حالات الإصابة الجديدة منذ يناير. على الرغم من نصائح خبراء الصحة، قامت عدة ولايات برفع قيود وضع الكمامات، بينما انتشرت سلالات من الفيروس أشد عدوى في جميع أنحاء البلاد.

ورغم أن الحالات تتجه نحو الزيادة في 30 ولاية من بين الولايات الخمسين مقارنة بالأسبوع الماضي، يأمل مسؤولو الصحة أن تساهم عملية التطعيم في الحد من ارتفاع الوفيات، إذ تسبب الفيروس في حصد أرواح 544 ألف أمريكي منذ بدء الجائحة. 

في تطور ملحوظ، انضمت نيويورك يوم الإثنين إلى فلوريدا وعدد من الولايات الأخرى التي أتاحت اللقاحات لأشخاص من سن الخمسين فأكثر. وخلال الأسبوعين الأخيرين، خفضت ولايات كثيرة، منها ألاسكا وأريزونا وتكساس، القيود العمرية للحصول على لقاحات الوقاية من كورونا.

وفي وقت سابق من هذا الشهر، أصبحت ألاسكا أول ولاية أمريكية توفر اللقاح لكل من يبلغ من العمر 16 عاماً أو أكثر، وتتمتع حالياً بأحد أعلى معدلات التطعيم في البلاد، حيث تلقى 31.5% من سكانها جرعة واحدة على الأقل، وفقاً لبيانات المراكز الأمريكية لمكافحة الأمراض والوقاية منها.

无线前新闻主播伍家谦昨日在社交媒体上报喜，宣布明年春天「小怪兽」将诞生，他即将升级成为爸爸，恭喜！恭喜！他提到在看车时接到了太太的电话，太太告诉他说「有了」，原本看中了一辆双门车的他，因开心而转向考虑休旅车呢！他在社交媒体上留言说：

「想换车，心痒很久了。之前看中了一辆双门车，就去试驾了；试驾完，哇，喜欢得不得了。
正在我准备刷卡下单的时候，太太的电话就来了：
太太说：“喂！有了！”
我：“什么有了？我还在纠结颜色呢！”那一刻我只是在想着选什么颜色好。
太太：“不是啦！是有了！”
嗯？我好像意识到了一些事情......
我：“真的有了？”
太太：“真的有了！”
天啊！
挂了电话后，我第一反应就是跟销售员说：“不好意思......这辆车我不买了......哈哈哈......我可以看看你们的SUV吗......”
世事就是如此奇妙。这件事实在不知道配什么图好，所以只好在家附近随便拍了张天空的照片——真的，要感谢上天。
我们期待了很久了。借着一个好天气的日子，正式宣布：2020年春天，小怪兽来了！
#这次我真不是个怪兽家长」

À 39 ans, Mathieu Penhard fait partie des quatre pompiers du département des Côtes-d’Armor qui défileront le jour de la fête nationale avec le 14e bataillon des sapeurs-pompiers de France, représentant la zone ouest de défense et de sécurité. Cette zone de 128 347 km² comprend les régions de Bretagne, Normandie, Pays de la Loire et Centre-Val de Loire, soit 20 départements.

Des entraînements intensifs
Mathieu a postulé pour cet événement en mars « en hommage aux anciens, disparus en service commandé ». Après avoir participé aux deux rassemblements nationaux où quatre pompiers du département ont été sélectionnés, il a suivi plusieurs stages d’entraînements de défilé en ordre serré sur les pistes de l’aéroport du Mans. « J’ai l’avantage d’avoir dix années d’expérience de marche en ordre serré à travers la fanfare de Plémet, dans laquelle je tenais le clairon ou la trompette », souligne l’adjudant.

Une fierté partagée
À partir du 7 juillet, il participera à l’ultime semaine d’entraînement en région parisienne. La pression sera à son comble le jour J. « Représenter son département et les 250 000 pompiers de France, sans compter les anciens, ainsi que sa commune et son centre, ce n’est pas rien », avoue-t-il. Le lieutenant Jean-Maurice Robin, chef du centre de secours, ne cache pas sa fierté. « Je suis très content pour Mathieu, qui a passé brillamment les sélections. Il va vivre cette expérience exceptionnelle de participer au défilé emblématique des pompiers. Je suis également fier pour la caserne, et nous penserons tous à lui le 14 juillet ».

傅园慧爆红有压力：我就是个表情包吗？

2016年10月2日14:11 中央社 台北讯

傅园慧表示想念游泳训练。 图片截取自傅园慧的脸书。 分享到Facebook。

中国大陆游泳运动员傅园慧因在奥运期间的率真采访而走红。奥运结束后，她频繁出现在各种电视节目中，但近日她坦言自己开始“怀念泳池了”，并在微博上写道：“我练了十几年游泳就是个表情包吗？”

奥运后，傅园慧参加了许多综艺和访谈节目，因此一直没有进行系统训练。在昨天于大陆水立方闭幕的2016国际泳联短池游泳世界杯（北京站）比赛中，傅园慧并未报名自己擅长的仰泳项目。在她报名的三项比赛中，两项未能进入决赛，唯一进入决赛的女子50米自由泳最终获得第七名。

据《北京日报》报道，傅园慧一开始觉得上电视和接受媒体采访是新鲜有趣的，但随着时间的推移，她开始有些怀念泳池了。她表示：“上综艺节目特别累，虽然训练也累，但感觉不一样。我还是更适合在水里。”

外界对她的关注多集中在她的“表情包”和“有趣”之上，傅园慧的游泳专长似乎被忽视了。

I stared at the screen in disbelief. The sun was shining through the small windows above my head and tinted the room in the orange morning light. I could hear the birds chirping right outside of it. It was a peaceful Wednesday morning, but I couldn't feel any of this peace. Right now, I was horrified.

My legs still shaking, I stood up from my computer and searched my way into the kitchen. My vision was blurry and I couldn't tell walls from the floor any longer when I suddenly collapsed, like the rug was pulled from underneath my feet.

There I was, lying on the floor, still in shock because of what I saw, the vision of this horrible video playing again and again in my head, in full detail every time. His screams, his guts, his torn-off limbs.... And amidst that massacre, an innocent stuffed animal, smiling like all the horror doesn't happen around it, while its name-tag gets coated in blood. *Charlie*, the name I gave the little bunny that was John's present for our 1-year anniversary. It had gone missing the day the letter arrived, and now I knew why.

The realization hit me out of nowhere. I just became a witness to the murder of the man I shared my life with for 3 years. He was.... gone. Forever. Tears rolled down my numb cheeks like a small stream of water, and then the stream became a river and then the river became a waterfall. I couldn't control myself, I was just there, on the ground, uncomfortable slumped over my knees, sobbing. I didn't want to do anything. In that moment, I only wanted to cry. In that moment, I only wanted to die. And so, I cried, alone, on the cold floor.

I lost track of time, but when I managed to rise to my feet again, my tears had long dried out, and the light of the sun had disappeared. Even the cars on the road outside were silent, almost as if the whole world decided to grieve with me.

Once again, I tried to walk towards the kitchen door, this time with more success. As I opened the door, I expected the familiar smell of his favorite pancakes to fill my nose, I expected all my worries to be shaken off in an instant. The kitchen was empty.

My eyes fell on the black letter on the kitchen counter. The letter I received three days ago. The letter that started this. The letter that took the love of my life away from me.

I grabbed the letter in a hectic motion and stuffed it into the next-best pot I could find. After that, I took the pot, put it in the sink, and filled it with water until it was filled completely. Then, I violently put the water-filled pot on the stove, water splashing across the entire counter. I turned the stove on and set it on the highest setting. The next minutes, I spent looking at the letter inside the pot, as the water slowly began boiling just like I was. The letter dissolved more and more, until it was only a small, dirty lump.

Without turning the stove off, I slammed the handle of the pot and sent it flying through the air. The water hit my left hand, but it didn't matter to me anymore. The tiny, black lump landed on the counter, right next to the sharpest knife in the whole kitchen. I took it into my hand, and rammed it into the former letter. Then I did it again. And again. And again. And again... 

I was panting heavily. The whole ordeal left me exhausted. I covered my face with my hands and leaned against the counter. The taste of blood in my mouth was an alien feeling to me that I barely noticed. I must have slipped with the knife a few times without noticing.

After standing like this for a while, I decided to wash the blood off my face, so I entered the bathroom. It was small and white, quite perfect in a way. The two toothbrushes were standing at the sink, not knowing that one of them will never be used again. I took the pink one, threw it into the toilet and flushed it down. No one needed it anymore, anyway.

My eyes fell on the mirror above the sink, and a stranger looked back at me. My hair was still black, my eyes still brown and my face still unshaven, but the me in the mirror wasn't me. My hair lost its shine, my eyes were tired and red from me crying, and my whole face was covered in blood. I turned the water on and began washing my face. I only then noticed the cuts and burns on my left hand, but I put it under the water anyway. The pain felt refreshing, in a way. I finally felt something again, after being numb for almost half a day.

I was still dripping with water when I left the bathroom. There was no time to use a towel now. I had to do something. After making a coffee, I was sitting at my computer again. The video was still open, fixated on the smile of *Charlie*. I pressed Play again and began watching the video for the second time, this time, however, looking for clues. I examined every frame of torture, every shot of John's wounded body, but could barely find anything, until I noticed a peculiar moment. Whoever made this video appeared to have known about John's ring and our engagement. It was displayed on a small pedestal in the background with a large white sheet setting it apart from the warehouse setting of the rest of the video.

Whoever killed John knew about him and me, and that were not a lot of people. I remember him saying that he told his sister and his brother, but would any of those two kill him? Gary was in another country right now, and Sarah is busy with the daycare. Neither would've had the time to do this.

I pulled out my phone to see if his messages from yesterday had any clues in them. **sent Monday, 19:36** *sorry I couldn't make it babe* *had 2 run errands for my boss* **sent Monday, 20:21** *btw I won't make it to the apartment tonight* *go to bed without me k? * *I love you* *c ya*

Yes, he disappeared during Monday night. And he appeared to have had something to do that night, too. Did he meet up with a friend, a co-worker, or some gangsters? What did he do on Monday? Either way, I need to know who else he told about us. Or I'll never know who is responsible for this.

Knowing that I wouldn't get any answers from staring at my phone like an idiot, I rose and walked towards the door. As I reached for the handle, my eyes fell on the picture on the table. It was the picture I took with John when we were skiing in the mountains. The picture stand was quickly opened, and I put the picture into my chest pocket. I wanted the good memories of John to be close to me, now that he was gone.

I packed the handle of the door, opened it, and with a few swift steps, I left the apartment.

L'acteur, réalisateur et humoriste Dany Boon a déposé une plainte contre X, notamment pour vol et recel de documents personnels. Cette action a entraîné l'ouverture d'une enquête préliminaire après la diffusion en janvier d'une vidéo d'enquête de Mediapart remettant en question son "patriotisme fiscal".

Mediapart avait révélé que l'artiste avait investi dans des fonds spéculatifs via des paradis fiscaux, ce qui, selon le site, contredisait sa communication sur le patriotisme fiscal, sans toutefois mentionner de fraude fiscale. Cette enquête se fondait sur des documents détaillant son patrimoine que Mediapart avait pu obtenir.

Quelques jours après la publication de cette vidéo, l'humoriste avait affirmé que tous ses placements étaient légaux et déclarés en stricte conformité avec la loi fiscale, sans commenter directement les informations de Mediapart.

Dans un article récent, Mediapart a révélé être visé par une plainte de l'humoriste pour vol, atteinte au secret des correspondances, violation du secret professionnel et recel. Cette plainte a conduit le parquet de Paris à ouvrir une enquête préliminaire. Cependant, l'un des avocats de Dany Boon, Me Marie-Alix Canu-Bernard, a précisé que cette plainte ne ciblait pas directement le journal en ligne.

Dans le cadre de cette affaire, deux journalistes de Mediapart ainsi que le réalisateur de la vidéo incriminée ont été interrogés par la police judiciaire ce lundi. Selon Fabrice Arfi, coresponsable des enquêtes à Mediapart, l'objectif de cette plainte est de révéler les sources qui ont permis au journal en ligne de mener son enquête.

Fabrice Arfi assure que Dany Boon, bien qu'ayant refusé de répondre à leurs questions pendant des mois, ne conteste pas les informations révélées dans la vidéo d'enquête. Toutefois, il conteste le fait que ces informations aient été rendues publiques et a choisi de contourner le droit de la presse pour poursuivre Mediapart.

Devant les enquêteurs de la police judiciaire, Mediapart a refusé de participer à une procédure visant simplement à criminaliser le journalisme et a opposé le secret des sources aux questions des policiers, conformément à la loi.

Since its introduction by Yao [Yao79], communication complexity occupies a central position in theoretical computer science. A striking feature of communication complexity is its interplay with other diverse areas like analysis, combinatorics, and geometry [KN96, Rou16]. Vapnik and Chervonenkis [VC71] introduced the measure Vapnik-Chervonenkis dimension or VC dimension for set systems in the context of statistical learning theory. As was the case with communication complexity, VC dimension has found numerous connections and applications in many different areas like approximation algorithms, discrete and combinatorial geometry, computational geometry, discrepancy theory, and many other areas [Mat09, Cha01, PA11, Mat13].

In this work, we study both of them under the same lens: of restricted systems and, for the first time, prove that geometric simplicity does not necessarily imply efficient communication complexity.

Let's start by recollecting some definitions from Vapnik-Chervonenkis theory. Let S be a collection of subsets of a universe U. For a subset y of U, we define S|y := {y ∩ x : x ∈ S}. We say a subset y of U is shattered by S if S|y = 2^y, where 2^y denotes the power set of y. Vapnik-Chervonenkis (VC) dimension of S, denoted as VC-dim(S), is the size of the largest subset y of U shattered by S. VC dimension has been one of the fundamental measures for quantifying the complexity of a collection of subsets.

Now let us revisit the world of communication complexity. In communication complexity, two players, Alice and Bob, receive inputs x ∈ Ω1 and y ∈ Ω2, respectively, and their goal is to devise a protocol to compute f(x, y) by exchanging as few bits of information between themselves as possible. The deterministic communication complexity D(f) of a function f is the minimum number of bits Alice and Bob will exchange in the worst case to deterministically compute the function f. In the randomized setting, both Alice and Bob share an infinite random source and aim to give the correct answer with probability at least 2/3. The randomized communication complexity R(f) of f denotes the minimum number of bits exchanged by the players in the worst-case input by the best randomized protocol computing f.

One of the most well-studied functions in communication complexity is the disjointness function, where DisjU(x, y) = 1 if x ∩ y = ∅ and 0 otherwise. We also define the intersection function IntU(x, y) = x ∩ y, where both x and y are subsets of a universe U.

Using the standard rank argument, one can show that D(Disjn) = Θ(n). In a breakthrough paper, Kalyanasundaram and Schnitger proved that R(Disjn) = Ω(n). Razborov and Bar-Yossef et al. gave alternate proofs for the above result. From these results, we can also see that D(Intn) = R(Intn) = Θ(n).

Naturally, one would like to ask what happens to the communication complexity of Disjn and Intn when both Alice and Bob know that their inputs have more structure, such as being from a subset of S ⊆ 2^U, known to both players. Let DisjU functions restricted to S × S be denoted by DisjU|S×S. This problem has been studied extensively, particularly for special classes of subsets S ⊆ 2^U. For example, the sparse set disjointness function, where the set S contains all subsets of U of size at most d, is an important special case of these works.

One would also like to ask what happens to the communication complexity for other restrictions to the disjointness (and intersection) problem. Two natural problems with a geometric flavor are Discrete Line Disj and Discrete Interval Disj, for which the communication complexity needs to be studied. The Discrete Line Disj and Discrete Interval Disj functions are generalizations of the sparse set disjointness function and exhibit connections with VC dimensions, as seen through detailed proofs and analysis in the research.

Many network applications deliver flows with high Quality of Service (QoS), such as meeting end-to-end delay constraints. With the rise of mobile computing, multimedia applications are undergoing significant changes, altering user subscription patterns [1], [2]. For instance, Anvato [3] provides services like online video editing for content providers, ad insertion for advertisers, and caching and transcoding for diverse user devices. These specific requirements for video flows are typically fulfilled by traversing various network function middleboxes, a process known as a service function chain (SFC). Network Function Virtualization (NFV) [4] is an emerging technology for deploying network functions in software, offering multiple benefits. Notably, the popular streaming media company, Netflix [5], has adopted AWS to support their service chains through NFV.

However, implementing network functions in software via virtualization technologies on general servers may lead to performance degradation compared to physical versions on dedicated hardware [6]. This degradation occurs because the operation of Virtual Network Functions (VNFs) can be influenced by surges in computing load and hardware malfunctions. Consequently, deploying VNFs in different virtual machines (VMs) may result in varying delays and costs, affecting flow transmission expenses. For any given flow, the objective is to embed the required SFC with the minimum cost while satisfying the end-to-end delay constraint.

Figure 1(a) illustrates a network, where each edge and node is assigned a two-tuple weight, (cost, delay). The weights on the edges pertain to flow transmission, while the weights on the nodes relate to the flow process. In this context, a VM without a deployed VNF incurs a processing cost and delay of zero. There are four available VMs (A, B, C, D) for deploying the SFC, (f1 → f2 → f3).

In this paper, the assumption is that a VM can host, at most, one VNF.

The LGBT and Muslim communities of the capital will come together to observe Ramadan as part of this year’s Pride in London festival. The Big Gay Iftar, hosted at St Andrew’s Church in Southwark, will invite participants to partake in the traditional Islamic evening meal at sunset.

Pride in London announced that the event on June 24, open to everyone, will offer an opportunity for individuals to "talk to one another, learn about each other’s faiths, cultures, and sexualities, and spread some love."

The inaugural Big Gay Iftar took place last year as a response to the tragic killing of 49 people in the Pulse nightclub shootings in Orlando by an Islamic State sympathizer. This year’s expanded gathering is anticipated to draw even more participants.

This event is part of two weeks of celebrations dedicated to the capital's LGBT+ community, featuring more than 60 new and returning events leading up to the march on July 8. Festival organizers have unveiled the first 16 events, designed to "celebrate the true diversity of London’s art, history, theatre, film, music, and more."

The festival will officially open on June 24 at Tate Britain, in celebration of its exhibition Queer & Now. The National Theatre will host a series of events, including readings directed by Tarell Alvin McCraney, the writer of Moonlight, alongside playwright Polly Stenham and director Stephen Daldry.

London’s Gay Symphony Orchestra will perform at St John’s Smith Square to commemorate its 21st anniversary. Meanwhile, the BFI will showcase the Independent Cinema Office’s new LGBT+ archive film programs. For those under 18, Pride Prom 2017 will offer an evening of entertainment featuring LGBT+ performers and DJs.

Sadiq Khan, the Mayor of London, stated, “London’s LGBT+ community is one of the largest in the world, and I was proud to lead last year’s Pride march. I am honored to be the Mayor of a city that doesn’t just tolerate diversity but truly embraces and celebrates it. This year’s Pride in London program reflects the full spectrum of the capital’s LGBT+ community, and I urge all Londoners to immerse themselves in the festivities."

A well-studied issue in Internet of Things (IoT) systems in recent years revolves around scheduling status updates across a communication channel between a transmitter, often a remote sensor, and a receiver. The primary objective is usually to minimize the "age of information" (AoI) metric at the receiver, which signifies how current or up-to-date the available perception of the monitored process is.

By focusing on AoI as the performance indicator, a more suitable characterization for remote sensing applications is achieved compared to standard metrics like throughput or delay. This approach retains the benefits of a precise mathematical description. Typically, the long-term average AoI is specifically examined, although variations such as peak AoI, discounted AoI, or similar metrics exist. Furthermore, various studies in the field may differ in considering a discrete or continuous time-axis, leading to adjustments in mathematical tools used such as Markov chains or renewal theory.

This paper delves into minimizing average AoI over a finite time horizon in a resource-constrained transmitter-receiver system that exchanges data over an error-prone channel. We address scenarios where only the receiver, not necessarily the transmitter, is aware of the communication outcome and whether it has led to a useful update reducing the AoI. These particular variations are crucial in practical IoT applications, especially with technologies like LoRaWAN, where transmissions are limited, and listening for feedback messages can be as costly as transmitting data.

Specifically, we focus on a finite time horizon, representing the duration of a monitoring task. Departing from the commonly used infinite-horizon modeling, we align with the operational nature of IoT devices, which execute tasks over a finite time frame. Within this period, the transmitter can issue a restricted number of updates due to hardware and cost limitations. We present two distinct analytical formulations tailored to scenarios where feedback on update success is or isn't available at the transmitter's end.

Considering that implementing feedback may reduce available transmission opportunities over the finite time horizon, possibly due to increased energy consumption, we explore whether relying on a return channel is truly advantageous in terms of AoI over stateless optimization. We provide an analytical breakdown of the conditions favoring feedback usage, factoring in the time horizon, number of opportunities, transmission success probability, and feedback cost.

These findings hold practical significance in devising operational policies for obtaining fresh status updates from resource-constrained IoT devices, potentially streamlining feedback strategies that might be unnecessary. The paper proceeds with a review of related works in Section II, followed by an exposition of the model and approach in Section III, segmented into scenarios without and with feedback. Section IV presents and deliberates on numerical results to underscore the crucial trade-offs within the setting. Finally, Section V draws conclusions and highlights potential avenues for future research.

Text-to-image generators like Midjourney, Stable Diffusion (Rombach et al., 2022), and Dalle-3 (Betker et al., 2023) have recently experienced significant advancements, sparking widespread interest. However, these systems still exhibit notable weaknesses. For example, as noted by Gokhale et al. (2023) and Cho et al. (2023b), among others, current text-to-image generators struggle to accurately represent explicit spatial relations such as "left of" or "below." This limitation hampers their utility for critical applications like text-based image editing (Kawar et al., 2023).

We hypothesize that the subpar performance in depicting explicit spatial relations stems from the absence of such relationships in the training datasets of these models. To validate our hypothesis, we conducted an analysis of the LAION-2B dataset (Schuhmann et al., 2022), which serves as the training data for the cutting-edge open-source model Stable Diffusion. LAION-2B extracts captions from the alt-text fields of web images. Our automated search for explicit spatial relations (e.g., left, right, below) revealed that only 0.72% of captions contain these target words. Additionally, 64.1% of these spatial relations involve left and right directions, which pose a challenge for image generators due to the random horizontal flips applied during image training.

Driven by the scarcity of captions featuring spatial relations, we concentrate on refining the training data to enhance existing end-to-end diffusion models. This approach complements proposed architectural adjustments to the system itself (Cho et al., 2023b; Feng et al., 2023). Specifically, we introduce a method to automatically craft synthetic captions embedding explicit spatial relations in conjunction with actual images. By utilizing object annotations in COCO (Lin et al., 2014) and heuristic rules to deduce spatial relations between bounding boxes, we create a dataset of real images coupled with synthetic captions, termed Spatial Relations for Generation (SR4G).

We leverage SR4G to fine-tune two Stable Diffusion models, anticipating that exposure to image-caption pairs featuring explicit spatial relations will enhance the models' capacity to represent these relationships. To assess the efficacy of our fine-tuned models and compare them against the unaltered base models, we employ the recently introduced VISOR metric (Gokhale et al., 2023), which we extend to accommodate more spatial relations.

L'avenue du Mont-Royal, située dans le Plateau Mont-Royal à Montréal, est piétonne pour le deuxième été consécutif.

« Un désastre » : au téléphone, Claude Brûlé ne décolère pas. Ce restaurateur de 71 ans s'estime lésé par la piétonnisation de l'avenue du Mont-Royal, qui se poursuit pour la deuxième année consécutive cet été. Il estime que son restaurant, Chinoiseries & Dumplings, a perdu 65 % de son chiffre d'affaires en raison de la baisse de fréquentation. Il peine désormais à payer son loyer.

Rafael Miró, La Presse

Claude Brûlé affirme avoir perdu la majorité de sa clientèle qui se déplaçait pour acheter ses plats. Il ne compte désormais que sur une clientèle locale. « Quand j'ai ouvert, j'avais des clients qui venaient du centre-ville, d'Outremont, de Villeray, mais maintenant, je n'ai que les gens du Plateau qui passent à pied. Et ce n'est pas suffisant ! », s'exclame-t-il.

PHOTO OLIVIER JEAN, LA PRESSE Claude Brûlé

« Déjà, avant la fermeture de la rue, mes clients me disaient que c'était de plus en plus difficile de venir à cause des rues barrées et du manque de stationnement. Mais maintenant, c'est devenu impossible », explique Claude Brûlé, propriétaire de la cantine Chinoiseries & Dumplings.

Le voisin de M. Brûlé, Mario Marcotte, propriétaire de la serrurerie Serrupro sur Mont-Royal, partage le même avis. Avant la piétonnisation, la majorité de sa clientèle était composée de gros acheteurs du secteur commercial, qui se tournent désormais vers des concurrents plus accessibles en voiture.

Selon lui, les revenus de la serrurerie ont fondu des deux tiers. « Avec le loyer que je paie, mon marché, ce ne sont pas les gens qui viennent faire leurs clés à 4 $, c'est le secteur commercial et les concierges qui se déplacent pour acheter en gros.

أعلنت المؤسسة الوطنية للنفط في ليبيا، اليوم السبت، أن شركة الواحة قامت بتخفيض إنتاجها بمعدل يصل إلى 200 ألف برميل يوميًا. وأشارت إلى أن ذلك جاء نتيجة القيام بأعمال صيانة على خط الشحن الذي يربط بين حقول السماح والظهرة وميناء السدرة.

وأوضح البيان أن "الصيانة ستستغرق أسبوعين، وتم التنسيق مع الواحة لتقليل فترة التوقف إلى ما بين 7 و10 أيام"، مشيرًا إلى أن هذا "سيتسبب في خسائر فرص تزيد عن 165 مليون دولار على الخزينة العامة".

There was a man whose life was about to change. That man's name was Luke Bomberger. Luke had a friend who suggested an exciting opportunity to him – becoming a seagoing cowboy. Luke's friend asked him to go to Europe on a cattle boat, and Luke could not turn down the chance to start his whole career by traveling to Europe. Luke's journey as a seagoing cowboy commenced when he and his friend rode down on the cattle boat.

Luke reflected on the unbelievable opportunity the cattle boat trip presented to a small-town boy like him. It took a while to cross the Atlantic Ocean to the eastern coast of the United States and a month to reach China. Luke was kept busy during the crossing, tending to the animals that had to be fed two to three times a day. Despite the challenges, the experience was invaluable to Luke, who marveled at the sights he saw, such as the excavated castle in Crete and the Panama Canal on the way to China.

Quelques jours après l'attentat du commissariat de Rambouillet, le ministre de l'Intérieur Gérald Darmanin présente ce mercredi en Conseil des ministres un texte renforçant des mesures expérimentées dans le cadre de la lutte antiterroriste. Ce projet de loi propose de pérenniser la technique controversée de l'algorithme, introduite à titre expérimental dans la loi renseignement de 2015, qui permet le traitement automatisé des données de connexion pour détecter les menaces.

En quoi consiste ce procédé déjà utilisé par les services de renseignement français ? En effet, cet algorithme permet de surveiller l'activité des internautes afin de remonter de potentielles activités suspectes et ainsi lutter contre le terrorisme. Laurent Nuñez, l'ancien patron de la direction générale de la sécurité intérieure (DGSI), a souligné samedi « l'importance de cette technique avec des individus de plus en plus isolés dont les seules traces sont les traces numériques », à l'instar de l'auteur de l'attaque terroriste de Rambouillet.

Parmi ces mesures, on trouve un « algorithme anti-terroriste », qui fait déjà débat dans le rang des parlementaires.

Multi-media generation with diffusion models has attracted extensive attention recently. Following breakthroughs in image and audio generation, multi-media generation like video remains challenging due to increased data and content size and the added complexity of dealing with both audio and visual components. Challenges for generating multi-modal content include time variant feature maps leading to computationally expensive architecture and the requirement for audio and video to be coherent and synchronized in terms of semantics and temporal alignment.

Existing research has predominantly concentrated on unidirectional cross-modal generation, such as producing audio from video cues and vice versa. These approaches typically employ a conditional diffusion model to learn a conditional data distribution p(x|y). Although these models have shown considerable promise, their unidirectional nature is a limitation. However, Bayes' theorem suggests that a joint distribution can encompass bi-directional conditional distributions. Classifier guidance has emerged as a viable approach for training an unconditional model capable of conditional generation and has been extensively adopted in addressing the inverse problems associated with diffusion models.

MM-diffusion represents a groundbreaking foray into the simultaneous modeling of video and audio content. However, the model's computational complexity and the need for improvement in conditional generation performance and analysis present challenges. In this study, we introduce an improved multi-modal diffusion architecture for bi-directional conditional generation of video and audio. Our model integrates video and audio data more effectively and uses a novel joint contrastive diffusion loss to enhance alignment between video and audio pairs, resulting in superior quality and synchronization without loss.

The key contributions of our study include an optimized multi-modal latent-spectrogram diffusion model and a novel contrastive loss function tailored for the joint model to enhance the alignment accuracy for conditional generation of video and audio pairs. Our extensive experimental evaluations, performed on the AIST++ and EPIC-Sound datasets, demonstrate the superiority of our method over existing and non-contrastive variants, and the improved performance and synchronization achieved.

Tony Cascarino est convaincu que Chelsea mettra tout en œuvre pour recruter Erling Haaland cet été.

L'ancien attaquant irlandais, Tony Cascarino, a exhorté son ancien club, Chelsea, à réaliser un transfert "époustouflant" lors de la prochaine période estivale. Cascarino estime que le club de l'ouest de Londres pourrait décrocher la signature, potentiellement historique, du talisman du Borussia Dortmund, Erling Haaland.

Des rapports suggèrent que Chelsea aurait déjà finalisé des accords personnels avec l'attaquant norvégien et ferait pression pour que le transfert se concrétise au cours de la saison estivale. Un tel accord ne se fera cependant pas à moindre coût. Malgré tout, les Blues semblent dégager les fonds nécessaires pour accueillir Haaland, notamment avec le départ d'Olivier Giroud pour l'AC Milan et les spéculations sur un éventuel transfert de Tammy Abraham, courtisé par Arsenal, le plaçant ainsi en surplus par rapport aux besoins de l'équipe.

"La rumeur veut que Tammy (Abraham) parte, ce qui libère de l'espace. Ils doivent le faire en raison du fair-play financier", a déclaré Cascarino sur talkSPORT. "Pour ce faire, ils vont réaliser un transfert époustouflant, et je pense que ce sera Haaland.

صرّح العقيد شاكر التويجري، المُتحدث الإعلامي لشرطة منطقة الرياض، بأن جهود متابعة الجرائم المتعلقة بالتزوير والتزييف أسفرت عن إلقاء القبض على "ثلاثة وافدين من الجنسية السودانية في العقدين الرابع والخامس من العمر" من قبل شعبة التحريات والبحث الجنائي بشرطة الرياض.
وأكد التويجري أنه تم تأكيد تورطهم في ترويج عملات نقدية مزيفة، حيث تم ضبط مبلغ يقدر بحوالي 148 ألف ريال سعودي و5 ملايين دولار أمريكي من العملات المزيفة في مقر إقامتهم بحي الصفاء بالرياض، بالإضافة إلى مواد وأدوات تستخدم في عمليات التزوير وجهاز لعد النقود.
وأشار إلى أنه تم اتخاذ الإجراءات النظامية اللازمة واحالتهم إلى النيابة العامة.

Driverless cars are a significant advancement in transportation that are anticipated to become a reality in the near future. Unlike current vehicles that require human intervention, these cars will be able to navigate roadways autonomously. Presently, semi-autonomous cars exist, where drivers still need to maintain some level of control. However, the evolution towards fully autonomous vehicles promises to revolutionize driving, offering enhancements in technology, increased safety, and assistance to drivers.

One major aspect of driverless cars is the integration of advanced technology. This technology is designed to mimic human driving capabilities. A prime example of this is Google's modified Toyota Prius, which is equipped with various sensors, including those on the left rear wheel, the roof, and the rearview mirror, along with radar, an inertial motion sensor, a video camera, and a GPS receiver. A standout feature is the spinning sensor on the car's roof, which emits laser beams to create a 3-D model of the car’s surroundings, thereby enhancing the vehicle's control and situational awareness.

Improvement in safety is another significant benefit of driverless cars. Advanced sensors, capable of detecting and avoiding hazardous situations, will be a cornerstone of this safety enhancement.

Once, a man said, "If you gaze long into an abyss, the abyss also gazes into you." So, I gazed into the marble as if it were that abyss. Like every other curious observer, I could only look at it from afar. But it never gazed back at me. Perhaps there were too many others, and I was not special enough to capture its attention. Only the special ones, the chosen, could take a closer look. "The chosen"—not a very intricate name, if you ask me, but indeed, they were chosen. No one knew how or why, but it seemed that was all that mattered.

I visited the marble every evening after work, as if it were a dear friend, the dearest, that wouldn't even look at me. Yet, I looked at it, and that, for me, was enough.

New Delhi: Toll collection on all national highways in the country will transition to electronic means starting December 1, as per the latest directives from the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways. In a letter addressed to the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI), the ministry has instructed the conversion of all toll lanes on national highways to ‘FASTag lanes’. This initiative aims to streamline the process at toll plazas, eliminating congestion and making travel more efficient.

FASTags, which are RFID-based devices affixed to the vehicle’s windscreen, facilitate direct payment of fees from a linked prepaid or savings account. This enables vehicles to pass through toll plazas seamlessly without the need to stop for transactions. An earlier report by ET on July 9 highlighted the government’s intention to mandate FASTags for toll payment on national highways nationwide.

As per the National Highways Fee (Determination of Rates and Collection) Rules, 2008, a dedicated lane at toll plazas is exclusively reserved for FASTag users. Non-FASTag users passing through these lanes are liable to pay double the fee as specified in the rules. The ministry has urged NHAI to ensure strict enforcement of these regulations.

While a hybrid lane will be retained at each toll plaza to accommodate oversized vehicles, it will transition into a FASTag lane within a specified timeframe. This move is part of the ministry’s efforts to smoothly implement the transition to electronic toll collection.

To support the widespread adoption of FASTags, the ministry has requested NHAI to assess the national demand for these devices and ensure an adequate supply.

The face on Mars became a national sensation, appearing everywhere from TV shows and talk shows to movies and even grocery stores. America simply could not get enough of the "Mask on Mars." Although numerous conspiracy theories emerged, claiming it was evidence of alien life, all have been proven wrong. The so-called "face" is merely a heap of Martian material.

These theories have been debunked by various pieces of evidence. Photos clearly show that the shadows create facial characteristics such as eyes, nose, and mouth—a mere trick of light—and not because any government or NASA is hiding proof of alien existence. The reason it has not been photographed frequently since its first sighting in 1976 is simply that spacecraft do not often pass over the area where it is located.

Furthermore, the face is just a large hill with shadows cast by some crevices that give off an appearance resembling human features. Despite intriguing ideas suggesting aliens built this structure, clear pictures show no strange markings or proof supporting these claims; they depict only what truly exists—an ordinary mesa.

As for those who claim NASA is covering up evidence of aliens associated with the Face on Mars, they are mistaken. There isn't any connection between alien life and this geological formation.

In conclusion, hard facts and photographic evidence support that the Face was not created by an alien race but instead results from natural formations casting shadows mimicking human traits. While these conspiracy theories can be interesting and fun to explore in popular culture discussions—and read about—it remains essential to understand reality: The Face on Mars is just a mesa with slightly human-like characteristics achieved through shadow play.

Driverless cars have advanced significantly towards their intended purpose, but they do not completely eliminate the need for a driver. Despite the development and testing of driverless cars to potentially reduce accidents, the issue of accidents will always remain a concern. This raises questions about accountability in case of accidents involving driverless cars.

The blame game in accidents involving driverless cars could lead to legal complexities. Manufacturers may try to avoid liability, while drivers may not want to be held responsible for incidents that occur with these vehicles. This could result in an increase in lawsuits against manufacturers for failing to deliver truly autonomous driving capabilities as promised.

Currently, drivers are responsible for operating their vehicles and practicing defensive driving techniques to prevent accidents. In contrast, with driverless cars, drivers may need to monitor and intervene in the vehicle's operations more frequently than anticipated. The reliance on technology raises doubts among consumers about the safety and reliability of such vehicles.

The costs associated with accidents are significant, as are potential lawsuits related to driverless car incidents. The expensive technologies integrated into these vehicles contribute to their high price tags, making them inaccessible for many consumers who typically target more affordable options when purchasing a car.

As advancements continue in everyday vehicles without substantial decreases in prices, it becomes clear that driverless cars cater primarily to affluent individuals due to their exorbitant costs. This pricing strategy further alienates middle-class families looking for reliable transportation options within their budget constraints.

In summary, given the ongoing challenges around accountability, reliance on users' interventions even in "driverless" scenarios, and unaffordable price points make it evident that widespread adoption of driverless cars may not be a feasible or practical solution at this time. Ultimately, there is still room for improvement before fully embracing this technology as a standard mode of transportation.

Data center providers need to maximize server utilization to reap the greatest possible benefits from their substantial capital investments. However, many high-performance computing (HPC) applications achieve only a fraction of their theoretical peak performance, even after careful optimization. This inefficiency can lead to significant resource wastage across the entire data center.

In HPC systems, resource efficiency is an increasingly critical concern in the pursuit of exascale computing performance. Achieving exascale with current technology would require an impractically high amount of energy. Alarmingly, the electricity costs over the lifespan of these platforms could equal their hardware expenses. While energy-proportional designs could offer a solution, this technology is still in development. Consequently, exascale systems are expected to face resource constraints in the near future, with limited provisioned power severely restricting scalability to meet new user demands.

In a resource-constrained server environment, it is crucial to minimize resource usage while meeting performance requirements to keep up with rising computational demands. Techniques like hardware over-provisioning can be effective in systems with strict power limits. Over-provisioning involves using less power per node, allowing for more nodes in the system. In practice, over-provisioning can be implemented by enforcing socket-level power limits with Intel's RAPL technology. RAPL manages power usage of server components by updating registers and monitors low-level hardware events to estimate power consumption. It adjusts processor voltage and frequency to meet a specified power cap over a set time interval.

Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS) also adapts processor voltage and frequency to reduce power consumption. Lower frequencies require less power, which can lead to energy savings. However, this may negatively impact processor performance. Alone, neither DVFS nor RAPL is sufficient for operating in an over-provisioned environment, as each only enforces power limits for individual components, such as the CPU. Therefore, a global scheduler is needed to enforce power limits across all components and prevent exceeding the system's power capacity.

A promising method to increase overall system utilization and efficiency is running multiple applications concurrently on a server node, a technique known as workload colocation. The primary drawback of workload colocation is potential performance degradation due to shared resources like caches, memory controllers, data prefetchers, and I/O devices. This degradation is challenging to predict in real systems, making it impractical to measure the degradation of all application pairs in advance.

Due to these unpredictable degradation effects, HPC systems typically do not allow resource sharing among applications on the same computing node. Despite this, workload colocation has considerable potential to enhance system throughput, especially when colocated applications are bottlenecked on different resources. Importantly, this improvement in system utilization can be achieved without modifying the application's source code.

Machine learning techniques can uncover complex relationships among input features, such as hardware performance monitoring counters (PMCs), and predict the slowdown experienced by colocated applications. Given the diverse nature of applications in HPC systems, machine learning models can generalize to new and different applications. Although some machine learning approaches are computationally intensive, our experiments demonstrate that they can be used with acceptable execution overhead through optimizations, such as reducing the number of trees in a random forest model.

Plus de 20 personnes ont été tuées par le typhon le plus puissant à avoir frappé les Philippines cette année, ont annoncé les autorités samedi, faisant état de destructions "alarmantes" sur les îles ayant subi le plus durement la tempête. Vendredi, la vitesse du vent avait diminué à 155 km/h, selon l'Agence météorologique des Philippines. Il a traversé vendredi en fin d'après-midi le nord de l'île de Palawan, une destination touristique populaire, avant de se diriger vers la mer de Chine méridionale, en direction du Vietnam. "Il s'agit de l'une des tempêtes les plus puissantes à frapper les Philippines au mois de décembre au cours de la dernière décennie", a déclaré Alberto Bocanegra, responsable de la Fédération internationale des sociétés de la Croix-Rouge et du Croissant-Rouge aux Philippines, à l'AFP. Plus de 18 000 militaires, policiers, garde-côtes et pompiers vont se joindre aux efforts de recherche et de sauvetage dans les régions les plus touchées, a indiqué Mark Timbal, porte-parole de l'agence nationale des catastrophes, à l'AFP.

The news from the Lloyd’s insurance market this week highlights its deep concern about the potential loss of access to the single market should the UK leave the European Union. Lloyd's believes there is a serious possibility that several key firms, tired of the uncertainty, may decide to relocate. Lloyd’s chairman John Nelson expressed these fears strongly before the referendum, and nothing has occurred since to change his perspective.

This serves as a timely reminder, amid the hype surrounding recent positive reports on the UK’s current economic performance, that Brexit is a long-term issue. The challenges it presents have yet to be properly defined, much less addressed. Nonetheless, Lloyd’s at least has a future to worry about, which is noteworthy considering this week marks the 20th anniversary of its remarkable recovery. Two decades ago, Lloyd’s pulled off the greatest recovery act in the history of the City when its members voted in favor of a recovery plan that saved it from extinction.

The problem that brought Lloyd’s to its knees was the underwriting of open-ended commitments to insure pollution and asbestosis liabilities in the US without a full understanding of the risks. The situation was exacerbated by some market participants playing "pass the parcel" with the worst liabilities. When the bills came due, the members—known as Names—whose personal wealth backed the market, could not or would not pay. Instead, they sued their agents and underwriters for negligence.

Voice conversion (VC) is the process of altering the timbre, style, and other para-linguistic features of a speech utterance while preserving its linguistic content. This field is attracting increasing interest from researchers across various disciplines due to its wide-ranging applications in human-computer interaction, virtual humans, and multimedia production. Existing VC systems primarily focus on transforming the timbre and style of the source speaker to match those of a target speaker. However, the controllability of other para-linguistic aspects such as pitch and speed has not received as much attention. These features are crucial in speech communication as they convey emotions, intentions, and even semantic meanings. For instance, adjusting pitch and speed can be used to emphasize specific words. Therefore, enhancing the controllability of para-linguistic features like pitch and speed is essential for broadening the utility of VC techniques in various applications.

In VC, there are typically two levels of control over para-linguistic features. Global control involves managing features at the utterance level and is commonly associated with style transfer. For example, when converting an utterance from a male to a female speaker, the overall pitch range is usually elevated. Global control has been successfully implemented in many modern VC systems. On the other hand, local control refers to dynamically adjusting para-linguistic features over time. This aspect has not received much attention from contemporary neural-based methods and is the primary focus of this paper.

VC systems can be broadly categorized into parametric methods and end-to-end methods. Parametric approaches utilize statistical models or neural networks to estimate speech parameters from both source and target utterances. These estimated parameters are then used to generate converted speech with a vocoder. While parametric methods offer good controllability by directly modifying predicted parameters, they may struggle with accurately transferring the target timbre due to limited capacity.

In recent years, end-to-end VC methods have demonstrated superior performance in timbre transfer and speech naturalness of converted utterances. However, these methods often sacrifice controllability over para-linguistic features since they encode such features in network weights that are challenging to interpret. Recent efforts have aimed to disentangle different speech aspects like content, timbre, pitch, and speed into separate embeddings to achieve controllability, albeit mostly at the global level. Local control, especially time-varying control, remains a challenge in current approaches.

One potential solution is to develop a cascaded system that allows for time-varying control over pitch and speed in voice conversion. By first employing a neural-based method for timbre transfer and subsequently utilizing signal processing techniques like TD-PSOLA for time-stretching and pitch shifting, this approach could enable more granular control. However, challenges arise from the naturalness of adjusting pitch and speed, as different phonemes may respond differently to such modifications, necessitating further refinement in the VC pipeline.

In this paper, we introduce ControlVC, a novel voice conversion system that achieves time-varying control over pitch and speed. ControlVC utilizes TD-PSOLA for speed control by adjusting the source utterance's speed and modifies the pitch contour of the speed-controlled source utterance for pitch control. A VQ-VAE pitch encoder computes discrete pitch embeddings, while a pre-trained HuBERT extracts linguistic embeddings and a pre-trained speaker encoder captures speaker embeddings. These embeddings are then integrated using a modified HiFi-GAN vocoder to generate the converted utterance waveform. Notably, the pre-trained speaker encoder enhances model generalization to unseen speakers, while the linguistic encoder, trained on diverse datasets, improves coverage of linguistic content, facilitating zero-shot conversion without additional training data.

ControlVC stands out as the first neural VC system to enable time-varying control over pitch and speed. It offers generic control over these parameters without mimicking those of the target speaker. Although other works may have the potential for time-varying speed and pitch control, significant modifications and experiments are required to support such claims, which may not align with their primary research focus.

Discharge notes are vital in the healthcare sector, serving as comprehensive summaries of a patient's hospital stay. They include details on diagnoses, treatments, and follow-up care recommendations. These documents are crucial for ensuring smooth transitions between care settings, enhancing communication among healthcare providers, and supporting effective patient management after hospitalization. Additionally, they play a significant role in reducing readmission rates by facilitating the proper management of ongoing care plans, thus maintaining the quality and safety of patient care.

With the advancement of AI, particularly in natural language processing (NLP) algorithms, there is growing interest in their application across various domains, including healthcare. NLP technologies have demonstrated the capability of automating tasks that require understanding and generating human language, transforming the way we interact with data and technology. In healthcare, these applications range from automating clinical documentation to enhancing patient interaction with care providers through conversational agents.

Large language models (LLMs) have found significant applications in the medical field, including the creation of clinical notes, interpretation of lab results, and anonymization of patient data (Yang et al., 2023a). Their ability to generate human-like text promises to increase both the efficiency and accuracy of medical documentation, potentially reducing the administrative workload for healthcare professionals, and allowing them more time for patient care. However, the implementation of LLMs in healthcare faces challenges, notably the linguistic diversity and medical jargon prevalent in multicultural hospital settings. This complexity demands that LLMs comprehend and interpret medical terminology across different languages and understand the nuances of clinical communication.

Our study underscores the pivotal role of deploying specialized LLM, particularly Mistral-7B, in automating the creation of discharge notes in the field of cardiology, utilizing actual hospital patient data. 100,000 Without Power as High Winds Batter Western Washington and Oregon

High winds have caused significant damage in Western Washington and Oregon, leading to power outages for over 100,000 residents and disruptions in transportation.

Trees and power lines were knocked down by the strong winds, resulting in power outages and road closures throughout Washington and Oregon. The National Weather Service issued high wind warnings for Oregon and the Pacific Coast of Washington, with wind advisories for inland areas.

By Friday evening, more than 109,000 customers in Western Washington were without power. The impact of the storm was felt on various modes of transportation, with high-speed passenger ferry sailings being canceled due to the dangerous conditions. Dramatic footage shared by Washington State Ferries showed waves crashing over the bow of a ferry traveling from Bainbridge Island to Seattle.

In Seattle, winds gusted to at least 40 mph on Friday evening, prompting the NWS to issue a wind advisory for the area. Near downtown Seattle, trees blocked on-ramps to Interstate 90 from Rainier Avenue South, while power outages affected the Mercer Island tunnel farther east along I-90.

As of 7:30 p.m., approximately 43,000 Seattle City Light customers were without power. Puget Sound Energy also reported outages, but exact numbers were unavailable due to technical issues with their outage map.

The NWS Seattle bureau faced communication challenges, with services disrupted shortly after 7 p.m. The bureau intended to route communications through its Portland office until the issue was resolved.

In Washington State, downed trees and power lines led to the closure of a 22-mile stretch of state Route 112 west of Port Angeles. Olympic National Park took precautions by closing the visitor center in Port Angeles, Hurricane Ridge Road, and the Hoh Visitor Center for the day.

In Oregon, Pacific Power reported outages from Astoria to Cave Junction due to severe weather conditions. The Oregon Department of Transportation shut down a section of Interstate 84 between Pendleton and La Grande in eastern Oregon after 90 mph winds were recorded, leading to at least one truck overturning on the freeway.

Explainability has emerged as a crucial research area in light of recent advancements in machine learning, autonomous systems, complex decision-making, and smart cyber-physical systems. Users may lose trust in a system if they perceive a lack of control or if the system's behavior fails to meet their expectations, potentially leading to misuse or rejection. Numerous studies suggest that providing explanations can address these concerns by helping users develop a more accurate mental model of the system, enabling them to better anticipate and interpret its behavior.

The evolution of smart devices, cloud computing, mobile networks, and pervasive computing has given rise to intricate ecosystems that gather vast amounts of data on the environment and user interactions, goals, and preferences. This data facilitates context-aware decision-making and autonomous activities with the ultimate goal of enhancing user satisfaction and comfort. However, the autonomous nature of these systems can sometimes cause confusion and frustration among users. Therefore, there is a pressing need to offer explanations to users in real-time to elucidate the reasons, objectives, and benefits behind the system's actions.

Current explanation approaches in smart environments face certain challenges. Many of these approaches primarily focus on algorithmic explanations, which describe system behavior in terms of algorithms and processes. These explanations often unravel complex planning or causal chains of events that can be difficult for end-users to grasp. Moreover, algorithmic explanations tend to overlook the user's context and fail to consider other essential aspects of explanations beyond describing system operations, such as persuasion, learning, or assigning blame. To address these limitations, a user-centric explanation should integrate contextual elements, reasoning, and information beyond simple cause-effect relationships.

Furthermore, existing approaches for generating explanations in smart environments often lack personalization. Studies have shown varying perceptions among users regarding explanation attributes like completeness, soundness, and complexity, indicating a need for personalized and tailored explanations that account for individual differences.

La Fórmula 1 fue creada en Francia en 1950, aunque las competencias Grand Prix existían desde 1945. Fue en 1950 cuando las escuderías más importantes como Ferrari, Alfa Romeo, Maserati, entre otras, se unieron a la competencia con sus mejores autos y pilotos.

Antes de establecerse la FIA como organismo rector de la Fórmula 1, existía la Asociación Internacional de Clubes de Automóviles Reconocidos (AIACR). Con la FIA, se establecieron reglas precisas para los autos en cuanto a peso, cilindros, consumo y potencia, lo cual definió la fórmula a seguir para estos vehículos.

El primer auto de la Fórmula 1 fue el Ferrari 125F1, conocido como "Cavallino". Este año, todos estamos ansiosos por conocer las novedades y resoluciones del campeonato, como se muestra en el trailer de F1 2021.

In the deep of night, Woman walked through the quiet forest, her senses attuned to the hush that enveloped the surroundings. Her breath was the only audible sound, until a rustle on the path behind her broke the silence. Startled, she turned to find Snake slithering along, his scales glistening under the moonlight.

Snake stopped at her feet and lifted his head, inquiring, "Do you remember Rabbit?" Woman, recalling Rabbit's tragic fate, nodded in acknowledgment. Rabbit, once in a rush for clover, had met an untimely end when Snake startled him into the thicket's thorns.

Man and Woman, drawn by Rabbit's distress calls, had rushed to the scene. Snake, in a mix of confusion and remorse, explained that his intention was merely to greet Rabbit. As they all watched helplessly, Rabbit lay motionless on the grass, his fate sealed.

The realization of death hung heavy in the air as Man confronted God, questioning the finality of Rabbit's stillness. God calmly affirmed the truth of Rabbit's passing, prompting Man and Snake to fear their own mortality. They pleaded with God, not wanting to meet Rabbit's fate.

God's stoic response underscored the inevitability of mortality, leaving Man and Snake unsettled. As the forest echoed with the sounds of nature, Crow's mischief diverted Man's attention, allowing Snake to retreat and Woman to reflect on Rabbit's fate.

Woman, drawn to Rabbit's still form, cradled his body, pondering the absence of pain in death. She carefully laid Rabbit to rest before rejoining the forest, her thoughts lingering on mortality and the passage of life.

As night enveloped them, Woman and Snake faced the stark reality of mortality. Snake, voicing his fear of death, sought a way to defy nature's course. Remembering God's words, Woman acknowledged the Earth's immutable law of life and death.

Snake, determined to challenge fate, led Woman through the dark forest to a clearing with two distinct trees. One tree bore lush fruit and vibrant blooms, while the other held a singular, shimmering fruit on its gnarled branches.

Snake revealed that God partook of the fruit from these trees and remained immortal. Urging Woman to fetch the fruit, Snake's urgency intensified as Angel, a harbinger of danger, appeared in the clearing.

With resolve, Woman sprinted towards the trees, aware of the looming threat of Angel. Choosing the fruit from the twisted tree, she tasted its bittersweet essence, unveiling a newfound awareness of self and identity as Eve, embracing the knowledge bestowed upon her.

Stochastic models find applications across various fields such as ecology, genetics, economics, and engineering. While closed form solutions exist for some of the simplest drift and diffusion functions, numerical methods are essential for solving complex stochastic models, including the Fokker-Planck equation. The global dynamic behavior of nonlinear systems with noise is formally described by the evolution of the probability density function (PDF) through deterministic and diffusion processes, satisfying the Fokker-Planck (FP) partial differential equation [19]. The FP system, which bridges stochastic and deterministic dynamics, has been widely applied in physics, chemistry, biology, and finance [8, 9, 19, 20, 22].

This article focuses on the FP equations corresponding to stochastic differential equations, particularly the multidimensional model defined by:
\[dX_t = b(X_t, t)dt + \sigma(X_t, t)dW_t\]
where \(X_t \in \mathbb{R}^d\) represents the state variable, \(dW_t \in \mathbb{R}^l\) denotes the Wiener process, and \(\sigma \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times l}\) is a full-rank dispersion matrix. The state of the stochastic process can be described by a statistical distribution, and the evolution of this distribution is modeled by the FP equation. Several researchers have developed numerical solutions for the FP equations. The Chang-Cooper (CC) scheme, introduced in 1970 by Chang and Cooper, is a popular method for solving the linear FP equation [9]. The CC scheme is known for preserving essential properties of the original problem, such as positivity and conservation of total probability. Subsequent advancements include high-order finite difference schemes and solutions for nonlinear cases [13], as well as discussions on finite element schemes [22].

Various techniques, including semi-analytic approaches, have been employed to solve the FP equation. Examples include the Adomian decomposition method [12], variational iteration method [23], and finite difference schemes with spline collocation methods [21]. Additionally, fast algorithms and specific schemes tailored for different scenarios have been proposed [10, 17, 17]. Ongoing research in 2020 continues to explore numerical solutions for stochastic models and the FP equation, covering topics such as preserving nonnegativity and mass conservation, dealing with piecewise-constant drift, and addressing fractional Fokker-Planck Equations [1, 2, 8, 11, 25].

This work aims to solve the FP equation with both linear and nonlinear drift vectors and constant diffusion tensors. By doing so, the study focuses on the Gaussian distribution for the FP equation, a parabolic type differential equation that satisfies positivity and conservation conditions. A two-level algorithm is presented, incorporating coarsening by a factor-of-three strategy on staggered grids, along with backward time-difference schemes BDF1 and BDF2 for first and second-order accuracy, respectively. The Chang-Cooper discretization scheme is utilized to ensure second-order accuracy, positiveness, and conservation of total probability.

The following sections provide a detailed breakdown of the work: Section 2 introduces the Fokker-Planck equation, Section 3 explains the Chang-Cooper discretization scheme, Section 4 presents a two-level scheme with inter-grid transfer operators, Section 5 reports numerical results, and the concluding section offers final remarks.

Harry observed the three jars lined up on the bench in front of him. The first contained a deep red liquid, appearing thin with a quarter of it empty. The second jar held what seemed to be misty water, with bubbles forming at the top, untouched and filled to the brim. The third jar, also filled with water, was the clearest of the three and halfway empty. (Yes, Harry had a pessimistic streak.)

The inscriptions on the grand walls around him began peeling off, crawling along the ground like inchworms. Behind the desk, they twisted around each other, forming a large shadowy clawed hand. The hand's center bulged, opened, and revealed a small green singular eye. Harry noticed a resemblance between the hand and the eye, both possessing only one of each.

"Um.... hello! I am Death! How are.... how are you today?"

"You're Death?"

"Yep, that's me. The Grim Reaper. The Undertaker. Call me whatever."

Harry raised an eyebrow in confusion.

"Aren't you supposed to be super creepy?"

"Oh, no. No no no. W-Why does everyone think I'm evil? I just don't get it! I don't even kill anyone! No! I just take their souls! That's all I do!"

Death seemed to grow more irritated.

"Taking souls? That sounds pretty evil to me, bro."

"No! I take them so they don't linger in purgatory on Earth forever! I-.... Look. You see these jars? Right there? On the counter?"

"Yep."

"Great. One is filled with.... uh.... blood. I'm ashamed of that, really. The second jar is full of..."

Death closed his eye and sighed.

".... sweat. It's filled with sweat. I know. Gross. Who came up with this? OK, so.... the third one. That's filled with tears. That one isn't so bad."

Harry's eyes widened, realizing the situation he was in.

"Where did you get these?" he stammered, pointing at them and leaning back cautiously.

"Doesn't matter. Look, I just need you to pick one. Please."

"No, you sicko!" Harry screamed, scrunching up his face.

".... You're breaking my hearts. All four of them. Really. Please, just choose."

"Fine. I choose sweat."

Death recoiled in shock and disgust, then quickly became extremely upset.

"***REALLY?!? Did you REALLY have to choose SWEAT?!? WHY DO YOU THINK THE SWEAT JAR IS FULL?!? ***"

Death's eye glowed bright red, nearly blinding Harry. Slowly, it dimmed, and Death took deep breaths that seemed to materialize out of thin air.

"Fine. FINE. You chose sweat. To receive your trial, yo-"

"Hold up. Trial? You never said anything about a tri-"

"***OH MY FUCKING GOD WOULD YOU JUST SHUT THE HELL UP AND LISTEN TO WHAT I'M SAYING TO YOU?!?!? ***"

Harry backed down.

"OK. You have to drink from the jar."

Harry gagged, tears welling in his eyes.

"Hey. You didn't choose tears. Stop crying."

Harry stumbled over to the jar. He wrapped his hand around the lid, twisting it until it popped off. He raised the jar to his lips, hearing the soft crackling of the warm concoction inside.

*sip*

Harry vomited into the jar, setting it back down.

شكراً لقرائتكم خبر عن تونس تخشى «الوداع» أمام موريتانيا، والآن نبدأ بالتفاصيل:

المنتخب التونسي يبحث اليوم عن فوز لا بديل عنه في الجولة الثالثة الأخيرة لدور مجموعات كأس الأمم الإفريقية المقامة في مصر. يحتاج الفريق المرشح للقب لتفادي إحراج الخروج المبكر، خاصة بعد فشله في تحقيق الفوز في المباراتين الأوليين للمجموعة الخامسة، مكتفياً بالتعادل مرتين بنتيجة 1-1 ضد أنغولا ومالي.

وتقام مباراة اليوم ضد الوافدة الجديدة موريتانيا على استاد السويس. يحتل المنتخب التونسي حالياً المركز الثاني في مجموعته برصيد نقطتين، خلف مالي التي تتصدر بأربع نقاط، ومتساوياً مع أنغولا. ويتوجب عليه على الأقل تفادي الخسارة لتجنب الإقصاء من دور المجموعات.

في حال الخسارة، سيفشل المنتخب التونسي في احتلال أحد المركزين الأول أو الثاني (تأهل مباشر إلى دور الـ16)، كما لن يكون ضمن أفضل أربعة منتخبات تحتل المركز الثالث في المجموعات الست، إذ إن أربعة منتخبات جمعت في هذا المركز حتى الآن نقاطاً أكثر منه قبل مباريات الجولة الثالثة للمجموعتين الثالثة والرابعة.

نسور قرطاج الباحثون عن لقب ثانٍ في تاريخهم بعد 2004 دخلوا البطولة كأحد أبرز المرشحين للقب، لاسيما أنهم المنتخب الثاني قارياً بعد السنغال في تصنيف الفيفا. لكن الأداء التونسي كان دون المأمول، رغم تحسنه في المباراة الثانية ضد مالي، التي قدمت أداءً هجومياً قوياً ضد موريتانيا في مباراتها الأولى.

وقال وهبي الخزري، مسجل الهدف في اللقاء الثاني: «لقد لعبنا مباراة أفضل من المباراة الأولى، وصنعنا تأثيراً أكبر. أعتقد أننا كنا نستحق النقاط الثلاث. الأمور حسمت بالتفاصيل الصغيرة، وأعتقد أنه في حال لعبنا بهذا الشكل ضد موريتانيا، سنتأهل إلى دور الـ16». 

من جهته، قال زميله وجدي كشريدة: «أعتقد أننا رأينا منتخبين جيدين. الآن ثمة تأهل يجب أن يتم حسمه، ما يعني أن علينا الفوز بالمباراة الأخيرة».

إلى ذلك، تجد غانا نفسها في موقف مشابه للموقف التونسي، إذ حصل منتخب «بلاك ستارز» (النجوم السوداء)، المتوج باللقب أربع مرات آخرها عام 1982، على نقطتين فقط من المباراتين الأوليين في المجموعة السادسة التي تضم الكاميرون حاملة اللقب، إضافة إلى بنين وغينيا بيساو.
