En 2020, les charges de copropriété ont en moyenne diminué de plus de 2 %, selon le dernier observatoire de l’Association des responsables de copropriété (ARC), qui a analysé les comptes de 2 500 copropriétés adhérentes. Une telle baisse n'avait pas été enregistrée depuis 2014, année où les charges avaient reculé de 4,9 %. En 2020, le montant moyen des charges s'est établi à 49,95 euros par mètre carré de surface habitable, contre 50,95 euros en 2019, ce qui équivaut à une dépense moyenne de 2 997 euros par an pour un appartement type de 60 mètres carrés (la taille moyenne d'un appartement en copropriété, selon l'ARC).

Cependant, il convient de noter que cette baisse des charges ne concerne que les copropriétés dotées d'un système de chauffage collectif. En effet, comme c'est le cas chaque année, le chauffage demeure le premier poste de dépenses, représentant 25 % du total des charges. La diminution globale des charges s'explique principalement par la baisse significative des dépenses de chauffage et d'eau chaude sanitaire, passant de 14,6 euros par mètre carré en 2019 à 12,51 euros en 2020, soit une baisse de 14,3 %. Cette diminution s'explique en grande partie par des températures plus clémentes à l'automne et en hiver 2020 par rapport à 2019, entraînant une baisse de la consommation des ménages de 9,8 %.

Par ailleurs, l'ARC constate également une réduction générale des tarifs énergétiques, en moyenne de 4,5 %, en prenant en compte les baisses de tarifs du fioul et du gaz, ainsi que la hausse des prix du chauffage urbain et de l'électricité. En conséquence, les copropriétés sans chauffage collectif, qui ont tendance à utiliser plus fréquemment l'électricité pour se chauffer, ont vu leurs dépenses augmenter l'année dernière. Pour ces copropriétés, la hausse globale des charges s'élève à environ 3 % selon l'observatoire.

Les effets inflationnistes de la pandémie

Une autre donnée intéressante concerne la maîtrise globale des charges d'entretien pendant la pandémie de Covid-19. Selon Claude Pouey, responsable de l'observatoire des charges de copropriété à l'ARC, il est logique que les charges d'entretien aient été contenues pendant les périodes de confinement, car les copropriétaires ont engagé moins de dépenses, à l'exception des travaux d'entretien d'urgence. Ces charges ont légèrement augmenté, d'environ 1 %, et sont partiellement compensées par la diminution des dépenses de sous-traitance pour le nettoyage. Cependant, une reprise de ces dépenses est à prévoir cette année, puisqu'elles ont simplement été reportées.

Supermodular games, also known as games of strategic complements, were formalized by Topkis in 1979 [23] and have been extensively studied in the literature by researchers such as Bernstein and Federgruen [1] [2], Cachon [4], Cachon and Lariviere [5], Fudenberg and Tirole [11], Lippman and McCardle [16], Milgrom and Roberts [17] [18], Milgrom and Shannon [19], Topkis [24], and Vives [25] [26]. In these games, each player's utility function exhibits increasing differences, meaning a player's best response is a non-decreasing function of other players' strategies. For example, if firm A's competitor, firm B, increases its spending on research, it becomes more advisable for firm A to do the same.

Supermodular games appear in many applied models and encompass most static market models, such as investment games, Bertrand oligopoly, and Cournot oligopoly. Numerous models in operations research, including supply chain analysis, revenue management games, price and service competition, and inventory competition, have also been analyzed as supermodular games. Recently, power control problems in cellular CDMA wireless networks have been modeled as supermodular games.

The existence of a pure Nash equilibrium in any supermodular game is established by Tarski's fixed point theorem [21]. Tarski's theorem asserts that if (L, ≤) is a complete lattice and f is an order-preserving function from L into itself, then there exists some x* in L such that f(x*) = x*. This theorem is crucial for the economic analysis of supermodular games and has other important applications. To compute a Nash equilibrium in a supermodular game, a common approach is to convert the problem into finding a fixed point of an order-preserving mapping. Recently, an algorithm proposed by Echenique [10] has been designed to find all pure strategy Nash equilibria of a supermodular game, which inspired the study in this paper.

An efficient computational algorithm for finding a Nash equilibrium is a significant technical advantage in applications. Additionally, knowing whether an already-found equilibrium is unique can determine if further resources should be spent to improve the solution. Interesting complexity results have emerged in algorithmic game theory regarding the uniqueness of equilibrium points. For bimatrix games, Gilboa and Zemel [12] showed that determining whether a second Nash equilibrium exists is NP-hard. Even computing one equilibrium, known to exist, is challenging, with no known polynomial-time algorithms; finding a Nash equilibrium in bimatrix games is PPAD-complete [9]. Similar difficulties are noted in other problems such as market equilibrium computation (Codenotti et al.) [3].

In this work, we first address the computation of fixed points for order-preserving functions over a complete lattice, focusing both on finding solutions and determining the uniqueness of solutions. We then examine computational problems related to finding a pure Nash equilibrium and assessing its uniqueness in supermodular games. We consider both the oracle function model and the polynomial function model. For both fixed point problems and supermodular games, the domain space can be extensive. Discussions often center on a succinct representation (see Section 2.2) of the lattice (L, ≤) such that the input size is related to log |L|. This representation suffices for a variable in a lattice of size |L|. Both models return the function value f(x) at a lattice node x, with x sized log |L|. They differ in how functions are computed: the polynomial-time model uses an explicitly given algorithm in polynomial time of log |L|, while the oracle model returns the value in a single oracle step. More details comparing these models can be found in Section 2.3.

After Derby County's Championship play-off final loss to Aston Villa, a disheartened Tom Huddlestone was left pondering what could have been. Aston Villa secured a 2-1 victory at Wembley, earning promotion to the Premier League. Anwar El Ghazi put Villa ahead with a header just before half-time, and John McGinn scored a second goal shortly before the hour mark, capitalizing on a mistake by goalkeeper Kelle Roos. Derby managed to score a consolation goal late in the game when Jack Marriott's shot deflected off Martyn Waghorn.

Despite their efforts, Frank Lampard's team fell short in the end. Reflecting on his emotions after the match, Huddlestone expressed deep disappointment, saying, "I feel devastated, contemplating what might have been. The game was closely contested. Both teams had a slow start. We managed to find our rhythm in the middle of the first half, but conceding a goal just before half-time from what seemed like a harmless cross was a significant setback."

Throughout the season, Derby had staged remarkable comebacks, and they needed another one at Wembley. "That was the halftime message," Huddlestone revealed. "We have been in more challenging situations before – like Norwich away and Leeds in the play-offs. Everyone counted us out then, but we fought back. Unfortunately, we couldn't create a clear opportunity for an equalizer. We believed we had done enough to push the game to extra time. I felt the game was evenly poised, and if we had managed to score the equalizer, we would have seized the momentum and won within the regular ninety minutes. Towards the end, they appeared fatigued."

Huddlestone was reinstated to the starting lineup as Lampard made two changes to the team. "As you grow older, the chances of featuring in these significant matches diminish, so it was a personal moment for me. However, I would have preferred to be on the bench and witness a victory," admitted the former England international.

A geometric edge-to-edge tiling is a covering of the two-dimensional plane by polygonal tiles, such that there is no hole, no two tiles overlap, and adjacent tiles share a full edge. When all tiles are rhombuses (having four sides of equal lengths), it is called an edge-to-edge rhombus tiling. 

In the 1980s, de Bruijn discovered a duality between a class of edge-to-edge rhombus tilings and regular multigrids [dB81, dB86]. The former can be obtained from a finite family of infinitely many evenly spaced parallel lines (along a finite set of directions called normal vectors; each group of parallel lines also has a reference position called offset) by a correspondence associating a tile to each intersection of two lines. To leverage the results of [AI16], we first consider corona limits on the multigrid, to take advantage of its embodiment of the tiling's regularities. During a second step, we transfer our characterization of corona limits on the multigrid to the dual edge-to-edge rhombus tilings.

The most famous examples of edge-to-edge rhombus tilings are certainly Penrose tilings [Pen74]. They received great attention for their aesthetics and combinatorial properties in connection with the growth of quasicrystals [BG17]. They have the property of being aperiodic (no translation vector leaves the tiling unchanged) and quasiperiodic (every finite subset of tiles appears infinitely often).

It has been proven in [AI16] that, surprisingly, regular decagons emerge as fundamental elements of the structure of Penrose tilings. From an initial finite set of selected tiles called a patch, the edge-to-edge diffusion process (at each discrete step, tiles adjacent to the current selected patch are included in the selection) produces a regular decagon at the limit (after renormalization). This limit shape is called the corona limit. The authors of [AI16] studied the corona limits of Penrose tilings through the pattern of signal propagation in simple growth cellular automata, using combinatorial tools related to local dynamical behaviors specific to Penrose tilings (Ammann bars).

Regular corona limits obviously appear on simple periodic tilings such as triangular, square, and hexagonal grids and have also been characterized on other periodic tilings [ACIK19]. The corona limits of multigrid dual tilings are also discussed in [DHS22], where the authors state a similar result without a full formal proof.

Limit shapes of growth processes on R^d (and Z^d) have been studied in [GG93] for threshold dynamics (θ > 0) defined over a given finite neighborhood (N ⊂ R^d). It has been proven that, except in degenerated cases, there is a unique limit shape which is a polygon. Growth processes on groups also received attention. In [EM23], the authors consider strongly connected groups Γ and the iterated Minkowski sum φ^n A (W) = {w a | w ∈ W, a ∈ A}. When A contains the neutral element and generates Γ, it has been proven that φ^n A ({v}) tends to Γ (as n tends to ∞).

Text classification, also known as text categorization, involves assigning sentences, paragraphs, or documents to one of the n classes in our dataset. It is a fundamental task in Natural Language Processing (NLP) that relies on manually annotated data as input (Kowsari et al., 2019).

Tasks such as sentiment analysis, news categorization, and topic analysis are popular applications of text classification (Kowsari et al., 2019). In NLP, English is typically the language of choice, especially in academia for educational purposes, without much consideration for the impact of different algorithms in languages with structures distinct from English. This oversight neglects the specific characteristics of low-resource languages in the development of new algorithms.

Autonomous robots have gained significant attention in recent years, with applications ranging from aerial delivery to autonomous driving. A critical aspect of these applications is identifying free convex regions among dense obstacles, as these regions represent navigable spaces essential for routing and collision avoidance.

In this paper, we propose a novel method that efficiently generates large, free, and guaranteed convex polytopes directly from point clouds. Unlike traditional methods, which rely on iterative inflation on a discretized map, range queries on sophisticated binary space partitioning trees, and iterative enumeration and optimization, our method stands out for its generalizability, effectiveness, and efficiency. Firstly, it ensures that the generated volumes are convex and free, making it seamlessly applicable to mainstream constrained safe trajectory generators. Secondly, it operates directly and solely on point clouds, saving computational overhead and preserving the fidelity of raw measurements. Finally, it makes no assumptions about the convexity and structure of environments, making it suitable for noisy, real-world sensors, and versatile applications, allowing for easy, plug-in, and use.

Our method, which is divided into two steps, involves the modeling of free regions among obstacles and the construction of convex polytopes.

Introduced by Nakamoto in 2008, Bitcoin allows public users to maintain a ledger in a distributed manner. Transactions listed in the public ledger are secured by the longest chain protocol using a Proof of Work (PoW) approach. Honest miners who adhere to the protocol extend their longest chain of blocks containing the transactions. A new block must contain a nonce that meets the difficulty requirements of the chain to be considered valid. However, even if a block is at the tip of the longest chain and meets all requirements, it cannot be immediately confirmed due to a phenomenon known as "forking." Forking happens due to network delays and adversarial activities.

If all miners work on the same longest chain, the first one to mine a new block immediately sends it to their peers. However, due to the finite speed of light and network constraints, peers receive the new block with some delay. During this delay, they may mine a new block themselves with different content at the same height, resulting in a fork. Forks also occur when adversaries do not follow the longest chain protocol, attempting to undermine the ledger. As a result, the deeper a transaction is in the longest chain, the more secure its content becomes. This highlights the trade-off between security and transaction latency.

Following the Bitcoin whitepaper, Garay et al. were among the first to study the latency-security problem of blockchains against potential attacks. Subsequent studies have expanded the analysis to practical non-lockstep protocols. Recent research has provided extensive bounds on the security-latency trade-off under network delay. These studies investigate the security of a block at any point during the protocol's execution under a network delay.

Our work focuses on the approach examined in previous studies, tightening the lower and upper bounds of security guarantees significantly. We utilize the "rigged" model introduced earlier and adjust the region of interest where adversarial and honest chains compete when the target transaction enters the system. Our enhancements result in substantial improvements, by orders of magnitude, for certain parameter regimes. We present a formula for calculating the probability of achieving results and provide our findings for Bitcoin and PoW-Ethereum settings with varying degrees of adversarial presence.

In the case of Bitcoin, where a block is mined approximately every 10 minutes and assuming a maximum network delay of 10 seconds, under the widely adopted 6-block confirmation rule, the safety violation probability ranges between 0.112% and 0.173% with a 10% adversarial presence. In comparison, the previous best-known results ranged from 0.106% to 0.353%.

我的朋友吴卵泡
吴卵泡说他是我儿子的朋友。他们结为好友的那一年，儿子三岁，吴卵泡三十六岁。

在湘西，“卵泡”是一个辣词。湘西人称对方为“卵泡”，意味着大块吃肉、大碗喝酒、大声吵闹的铁兄弟。若是泛泛之交，你若趁着酒兴或跟着他人叫对方“卵泡”，对方必定怒目圆睁，酒杯摔地，大骂你祖宗八代。

然而，吴卵泡却是个例外。无论新朋友还是老朋友，只要称呼他，他总是笑容满面，喝酒抽烟，即使是初次见面也能讲笑话一大堆。时间久了，人们纷纷忘记他的姓名，只要提到他，口头上会说“吴卵泡”。

我第一天到大学教书，就有人提到吴卵泡。那时吴卵泡还在山里的一所中学教书。因为喜欢写作，偶尔在刊物上发表散文或小说，因此在湘西地区的文学界有些名气。文人彼此相轻，朋友们接纳他，并不是因为他写作有多出色，而是因为他为人义气，风趣幽默。无论是五湖四海的文学人士，无论名望大小，只要涉及文学，他总是热情款待。他会大肆地请客吃喝，直到自己的钱花光，然后再和朋友们共同买单，如果找不到别人，他会去学校食堂随便吃点。只要客人不说走，吴卵泡就会一直招待下去。

当时学校的写作老师是一位平反右派的姓胡的老师。据说他在北大也算是个才子，毕业后一直在那里教授留学生。因为言辞不慎，他被直接从课堂上送到监狱蹲了二十年。

Jeff Carter a inscrit un but et une mention d'assistance, tandis que Jonathan Quick a réalisé 23 arrêts, permettant ainsi aux Kings de Los Angeles de mettre fin à une série de trois défaites en battant les Flames de Calgary 4-1, samedi soir. Tyler Toffoli a brisé sa propre disette de 136 minutes et 51 secondes en marquant après seulement 75 secondes de jeu en première période. Anze Kopitar et Ilya Kovalchuk ont également trouvé le fond du filet pour les Kings, qui ont creusé l'écart en inscrivant trois buts lors de la deuxième période. Quick a ainsi décroché sa première victoire de la saison en quatre départs.

Mikael Backlund a privé Quick d'un blanchissage en marquant sur un tir de pénalité avec 2 minutes et 10 secondes restant au compteur. David Rittich, qui avait entamé la rencontre avec une moyenne de buts alloués de 2,55, a concédé quatre buts sur 28 tirs. Il a été remplacé par Cam Talbot en troisième période. Talbot a bloqué huit tirs pour les Flames, qui ont subi une troisième défaite consécutive à l'extérieur.

Selon une étude de l’organisation des Nations Unies, d’ici 2050, la population de l’Afrique pourrait doubler et atteindre 2,4 milliards de personnes (INED, Paris). Différentes sources démontrent que le continent connaît une explosion démographique avec en première ligne une majorité vulnérable composée de jeunes et de femmes. Cette réalité bouleverse inévitablement les perspectives de développement du continent, en tenant compte de la croissance économique.

En effet, comme l’annonce certaines études, le doublement de la population d’ici 2040 va engendrer des pressions sur la gestion de l’espace et les secteurs sociaux, entraînant des crises multisectorielles. Pour trouver des solutions adéquates à cette problématique, l’Afrique pourrait bénéficier en transformant cette forte croissance en un avantage de développement. Cela nécessite une restructuration de sa politique démographique, la valorisation de son capital humain à travers le développement, la réduction de la dépendance, et un investissement dans la jeunesse et l’autonomisation des femmes. Réussir à capturer ce dividende démographique serait un gage d’émergence pour les pays africains.

Comme l’explique le directeur du bureau régional pour l’Afrique de l’ouest et du centre de l’UNFPA dans la Newsletter du 28ème Sommet de l’UA, un fort taux de croissance démographique entraîne des besoins additionnels en termes d’éducation, de santé, et dans d'autres secteurs de développement. Cette situation exige des efforts financiers supplémentaires de la part des États pour répondre aux besoins accrus de la population. Réduire la croissance démographique pourrait améliorer la qualité et la couverture des services, ainsi que le bien-être des populations et l'équilibre au sein des communautés.

Cette vision semble être partagée par les Chefs d’État et de gouvernement réunis à Addis-Abeba pour le sommet de l'UA, axé sur le thème « Tirer pleinement profit du dividende démographique en investissant dans la jeunesse ». Le plaidoyer de l'UNFPA vise à encourager les pays à accroître leurs investissements dans le capital humain, en particulier dans la jeunesse.

CIUDAD DE MÉXICO: La Asociación de Bancos de México ha informado que las instituciones bancarias suspenderán sus operaciones al público el próximo lunes 19 de marzo de 2018.

Según el portal de noticias Televisa News, en un comunicado se ha detallado que los bancos ubicados dentro de almacenes comerciales y supermercados abrirán al público en los horarios habituales, a pesar de ser un día festivo.

Además, los clientes bancarios tienen a su disposición, los 365 días del año, servicios de banca telefónica, banca en línea y una red de más de 50 mil cajeros automáticos.

Es importante mencionar que, de acuerdo con la Ley para la Transparencia y el Ordenamiento de los Servicios Financieros, si la fecha límite de un pago corresponde a un día no laborable, dicho pago podrá efectuarse al siguiente día hábil.

Quejas en los bancos

A muchos mexicanos les ha ocurrido que, al revisar su estado de cuenta bancario, se encuentran con una compra desconocida, retiros de efectivo que no han realizado o cobros por servicios que no han contratado.

Are driverless cars beneficial for the future or a potential threat to it? I believe that driverless cars pose a danger to human lives due to the possibility of technological failure, a lack of regard for human judgment, and the complexity of their operation.

The first reason driverless cars are dangerous is their potential for failure. If I am driving, I certainly don't want the technology to fail and cause harm to others. For example, what if the car doesn't alert me to take control, and it drives through a construction site, injuring workers? I would bear the responsibility for the consequences.

The second reason driverless cars are unsafe is their lack of human judgment. Unlike a human driver, a driverless car doesn't understand the context of its surroundings or the need to alter its course to prevent harm. For instance, the car might not perceive a baby crossing the road as a significant enough threat to stop. As stated in the passage, "Most driving laws focus on keeping the driver, passengers, and pedestrians safe, and lawmakers know that safety is best achieved with alert drivers," which supports the point I am making.

The third reason driverless cars are a safety concern is the difficulty some people, particularly the elderly, may have in using the technology.

近日，中国国家发改委传出对全国水泥市场价格展开调查。然而，台泥表示目前中国水泥价格持平，没有出现大幅上涨的情况。台泥认为这次调查不会对实际情况造成影响。

在中国举行两会期间，有报道称水泥价格飙升。发改委紧急发布通知，要求各省提出与水泥产销、价格形势以及未来走势相关的政策建议，并在18日前提交报告。

台泥表示，目前中国南部地区由于刚刚复工，需求尚未回升，水泥价格出现回落。不过，由于今年雨季提前，回落幅度较去年同期较小。而在中国北部地区，由于冬季限产直到3月15日才结束，复工刚刚开始，供应减少导致价格短期上涨，但并未出现大幅上涨的情况。

台泥指出，一季度通常是中国水泥产业的淡季。目前整体水泥价格稳定，没有出现大起大落的趋势。加上这次调查只是例行公事，台泥认为后续不会对实际情况产生实质性的影响。

Ya habiendo cumplido más de un año de la aparición de la pandemia, todos hemos podido experimentar y ser conscientes de un mal invisible y oculto, pero con consecuencias más que notables. Para algunas personas es algo que pueden soportar, sobrellevar y adaptarse para salir de esa situación, pero para otras puede ser una auténtica odisea poder lidiar con los efectos de este fenómeno tan real como la vida misma.

Las eternas preguntas que se hacen muchas personas a día de hoy son: ¿Lo habré pasado? ¿Me afectará a mí? Es entonces cuando podemos caer en la búsqueda obsesiva de síntomas que nos den cualquier indicio para confirmar nuestras sospechas o miedos más profundos. Incluso podemos compartir esos miedos propios con los seres queridos y entrar en la espiral observacional compulsiva, creando así altos niveles de la temida ansiedad.

Sumada a la gran incertidumbre que la situación actual acarrea, es inevitable que nuestro cuerpo y nuestra mente entren en un estado de alarma muy palpable. Esta situación extraña y poco familiar para todos fomenta la aparición de episodios de ansiedad intensa.

La ansiedad es un mecanismo corporal y mental adaptativo que aparece ante situaciones estresantes, para activar los mecanismos necesarios para afrontar el reto que nos acomete. Debemos entender que es una herramienta adaptativa hasta cierto punto y nos motiva a buscar una solución a nuestra problemática. En niveles adecuados, nos ayuda a mantener la concentración y afrontar nuestras metas.

El problema aparece cuando esta ansiedad supera valores normales y nos desborda, ya sea debido a un nivel elevado de estrés o bien por la presencia de estrés continuo durante largos períodos de tiempo.

Los primeros síntomas que nos da nuestro cuerpo sobre esta ansiedad pueden ser: tensión muscular, temblores, sensación de mareo, dificultades respiratorias, sudoración, problemas digestivos, nerviosismo, jaquecas y taquicardia.

Los síntomas mentales típicos de la ansiedad son: cansancio, fatiga, agitación, dificultades para conciliar el sueño, hiper control, somatización y rumiación mental con pensamientos intrusivos.

La presencia de pensamientos intrusivos relacionados con el miedo y el peligro inminente interfieren en el desarrollo normal de la vida diaria. Este tipo de pensamientos fomenta aún más la autobservación en búsqueda de la confirmación de sospechas sobre la presencia de la enfermedad en nuestro cuerpo.

PARIS - US Open champion Sloane Stephens stated on Tuesday that her friendship with Madison Keys remains unaffected, despite their upcoming French Open semi-final match at Roland Garros, a rematch of last year's final at Flushing Meadows. The 10th seed delivered a commanding performance to defeat Russian Daria Kasatkina, who had previously eliminated world number two Caroline Wozniacki, with a score of 6-3, 6-1 on Court Philippe Chatrier in the quarter-finals. Earlier in the day, the 13th seed Keys secured a spot in the semi-finals for the first time by defeating Kazakhstan's Yulia Putintseva 7-6 (7/5), 6-4.

Stephens, who clinched her first Grand Slam title in New York last September with a 6-3, 6-0 victory over Keys, emphasized that their off-court relationship will not be affected by their upcoming on-court clash. She shared, "When we step onto the court, it's time to compete. But until then, there will be no awkwardness or tension between us." Stephens narrowly avoided an early exit in the third round against Camila Giorgi before securing an 8-6 victory in the deciding set.

This year marks the first time since 2002 that two American women have reached the semi-finals at Roland Garros, with Serena Williams prevailing over sister Venus in that year's final after a semi-final victory against Jennifer Capriati. Stephens, who was ranked 957th just six weeks before her maiden Grand Slam triumph last year due to injury setbacks, has now made it to a major semi-final for the third time. Reflecting on the achievement, the 25-year-old remarked, "Having two Americans in the semi-finals of the French Open is pretty remarkable. It guarantees that at least one American will be in the final, which is truly special. Overall, it's a situation where no one has anything to complain about."

During her match against Kasatkina, Stephens and her opponent exchanged breaks early in the match. Stephens' powerful shots in the eighth game earned her the opportunity to serve for the set, which she successfully did, including a stunning backhand drop shot. In the second set, despite Kasatkina starting strong with a service hold, Stephens broke in the third game with a sharp cross-court forehand and sailed to victory after just an hour and 10 minutes of play.

Keys, on the other hand, demonstrated her prowess by hitting 30 winners against Putintseva to secure her semi-final spot. Although Keys struggled under pressure at the US Open last year, she is confident that this experience will not impact her upcoming match at Roland Garros. In her match against Putintseva, Keys displayed mental resilience, bouncing back from a break in the seventh game to claim the set in a tie-break.

A new technology, known as the Facial Action Coding System, enables computers to recognize human emotions. This system has potential applications in fields such as psychology, art, and acting. However, while reading human emotions can be advantageous in certain areas, it offers limited value in the classroom setting. This is due to the diversity in student learning styles, the essential role of human teachers, and the high costs that outweigh the few benefits it might provide.

According to the article, Dr. Huang predicts that this technology could allow computers to detect when a student is confused or bored, adjusting the lesson accordingly. Although this seems beneficial, the reality is that not all students learn in the same way. A lesson that some students grasp easily might confuse others. Modifying the lesson to accommodate the confused students could, in turn, bore the ones who already understand, necessitating further adjustments. While the Facial Action Coding System can interpret emotions, it cannot cater to the unique needs of each student. Furthermore, the presence of a computer as the primary instructor in the classroom is, in itself, not ideal. Relying on computers as teachers could lead to the unemployment of human educators, radically alter the education system, and, potentially, bore students.

تلقت مليشيات الحوثي الانقلابية، اليوم، خبرًا كارثيًا من معقل زعيمها في محافظة صعدة. وذكر مصدر عسكري في تصريح صحفي رصده "المنارة نت" أن 13 من عناصر مليشيا الحوثي لقوا مصرعهم في مواجهات مع قوات الجيش الوطني، اليوم، في مديرية باقم بمحافظة صعدة. 

وأوضح قائد لواء العاصفة العميد خالد معروف لوكالة الأنباء اليمنية (سبأ) أن المواجهات اندلعت أثناء محاولة المليشيات التسلل باتجاه مواقع شمالي غرب مركز المديرية، مؤكدًا أن قوات الجيش أفشلت تلك المحاولة وأجبرت المليشيا على الفرار. وأضاف العميد معروف أن المواجهات استمرت حوالي 12 ساعة وأسفرت عن مصرع 13 من عناصر المليشيا وإصابة آخرين. 

وأشار إلى أن مدفعية الجيش الوطني استهدفت أيضًا تجمعات لمليشيا الحوثي بالقرب من تبة الروافض وألحقت بها خسائر فادحة في الأرواح والعتاد.

كانت هذه تفاصيل خبر مليشيا الحوثي تتلقى خبرًا كارثيًا من معقل زعيمها (تفاصيل هامة) لهذا اليوم. نرجو بأن نكون قد وفقنا بإعطائك التفاصيل والمعلومات الكاملة.

Le ministre de l'Intérieur a déclaré que la colère des forces de l'ordre était "légitime" suite aux récentes attaques contre des policiers. "Je les soutiens", a affirmé Gérald Darmanin, en annonçant lundi 17 mai qu'il se tiendrait aux côtés des agents de police lors de la manifestation prévue mercredi 19 mai devant l'Assemblée nationale à Paris.

"La colère des policiers est légitime", a-t-il souligné. Gérald Darmanin considère que "c'est une manifestation pour la République" et que "nous sommes tous ensemble dans le même bateau pour lutter contre l'insécurité". Il exprime sa "compréhension" face à la colère des policiers, évoquant les agressions et attaques dont ils sont victimes depuis plusieurs années, et plus récemment à Avignon ainsi qu'à Rambouillet, où une fonctionnaire de police a été assassinée le 23 avril dernier.

Imagine you are a NASA scientist discussing the face seen on Mars with someone who believes it may have been created by an alien life form. Do you think it was simply a natural landform, or do you entertain the idea of alien involvement? NASA's stance is that it is a natural landform. NASA made a discovery on Mars that resembles a face, but while they assert it is a natural formation, many disagree. There is no life on Mars, and the notion of aliens is merely a theory. The resemblance to a landform in Idaho, the Middle Butte in the Snake River Plain, further supports the natural explanation.

Firstly, there is no evidence of life on Mars. Despite NASA's extensive observations and imaging, no living creatures have been found on the Red Planet. The absence of any signs of life is apparent, as highlighted in the statement, "...if objects in this picture, like airplanes, pyramids, or a small shack, were present, they would be visible." This reinforces the conclusion that there is no life on Mars, as it would have been detected by now.

Secondly, the idea of aliens is a longstanding, yet unproven, theory. While the concept of aliens has persisted, there is no concrete evidence to support it.

The Winnipeg family of a First World War veteran is getting ready to fly to France on Tuesday to commemorate a century-old victory.

Ruth Breckman's father, George Hambley, participated in the battle in the town of Iwuy in northeastern France on Oct. 11, 1918. Not yet 22, he bravely charged into battle on his horse as a member of the Canadian Light Horse regiment, a unit he had served in for three years.

"My dad was part of that final charge, riding into battle on his horse, Nix," Breckman shared. "Sadly, his horse was killed almost immediately, along with his neighbor on horseback. My dad was left wounded by his horse as German machine guns began to take their toll, but they bravely engaged with swords."

Aged 85, Ruth Breckman, alongside her husband Kris Breckman, 88, and other family members, will be joining numerous other Canadian families in the town in France to pay homage to the sacrifices made by those who fought there.

"Standing there, amidst the trenches, remnants of war, and hearing all the stories—it truly puts into perspective the loss of so many young lives. It's truly heartbreaking," Breckman reflected.

George Hambley, a farm boy from Swan Lake, Manitoba, diligently maintained a diary during his time in the war, a diary which Breckman later donated to the Archives of Manitoba. Unlike many veterans, her father was always eager to share his war experiences.

"If you gave him a chance, he'd recount every detail. The war had such a profound impact on his life," she recalled.

Iwuy has arranged a grand celebration for the centenary, featuring music and a parade. Kris Breckman is deeply touched by this gesture.

"I'm truly overwhelmed by it. It's a remarkable show of gratitude, respect, and remembrance," he expressed.

He noted that the town is not just commemorating the victory of the battle.

"On the organizing committee, there was a member in a German uniform and another in a French uniform. They are aiming to present a full picture that reflects the horrors and sacrifices endured by those involved, rather than just celebrating a triumph," he added.

Following the war, George Hambley returned to Canada. Although he sustained gas exposure injuries that affected his sleep, he pursued studies in Toronto and later served as a United Church minister in several Manitoba communities.

He passed away in 1983 at the age of 86.

Source: CBC, with contributions from Laura Glowacki

富邦金 (2881-TW) 并购日盛金 (5820-TW) 的案子可谓一波三折，市场对此次并购是否存在变数充满关注。金管会主委黄天牧今日（6日）表示，对于价格的高低不予评论，尊重市场机制；关于中资疑虑，金管会已另案处理，并正在查核日盛金大股东是否涉及中资，如有发现，将依法行政。

金管会批准富邦金 (2881-TW) 的「金金并」后，不仅外界不断质疑金管会是否是在帮助中资解套，现在连双方对收购价格也产生了分歧。立委高嘉瑜和民进党前立委段宜康都认为，日盛金中资的疑云一直未能厘清，其两大股东建群投资、建高控股屡次被指为中资，绝对是无风不起浪。

段宜康指出，政府若确认确属中资，即便下令限期出售持股；但与目前富邦金出高价收购相比，被迫出售与待价而沽的市场行情自然大相径庭。

除了中资风波，富邦金与日盛金双方对收购价格也出现分歧。富邦金计划以每股13元收购日盛金，然而日盛金在股市公开观测站公告称经过独立专家评估，该价格不合理、过低。日盛金认为合理价格最高应达到每股16.93元，与富邦金的报价差距甚大，因此建议股东「应审慎评估是否卖出」。

Louise Kenny, a professor of obstetrics and a consultant obstetrician and gynaecologist, has witnessed the adverse impact of the Eighth Amendment on pregnant women with cancer. She emphasized that the Eighth Amendment casts a shadow over the care of women with complex medical needs in Ireland. In response to a previous opinion article by Prof Eamon McGuinness, Prof Kenny refuted claims that the Eighth Amendment does not endanger pregnant women's lives.

Prof Kenny cited the case of Michelle Harte, a woman who had to travel to Britain for an abortion while terminally ill with cancer. Despite being advised to terminate her pregnancy by doctors at Cork University Hospital, the hospital's ethics committee concluded that there was no immediate risk to Ms Harte's life and advised against termination.

Prof Kenny highlighted the challenges faced by pregnant women with cancer in accessing advanced cancer treatments that are often available only through clinical trials. She stressed the importance of having clear guidelines and legal interpretations to ensure timely and appropriate care for such patients.

Ms Harte's tragic case underscored the limitations imposed by the Eighth Amendment on women's healthcare choices. Despite the State providing substantial compensation to Ms Harte, she passed away in 2011. Prof Kenny urged for an open and respectful debate on the issue to ensure that decisions are made based on facts rather than opinions.

In conclusion, the Eighth Amendment has had real-life implications for pregnant women with cancer in Ireland. Prof Kenny's advocacy for the repeal of this amendment is rooted in her firsthand experiences of the obstacles it creates for women seeking essential medical care. The need for clarity, compassion, and evidence-based decision-making in women's healthcare cannot be overstated.

27 de diciembre de 2021. El Venezolano. - Rawdy Reales es un médico internista e influencer en las redes sociales con más de 4.5 millones de seguidores en TikTok debido a su contenido sobre salud. También cuenta con 743 mil seguidores en Instagram. Este doctor forma parte de la nueva generación de jóvenes que comparten su conocimiento universitario a través de las plataformas 2.0.

Para el 2022, espera seguir nutriendo a sus seguidores con enseñanzas. Además, continuará estudiando para compartir lo aprendido con los internautas.

"Ser médico es muy difícil, ser influencer o creador de contenido también lo es, ahora imagínense intentar ser ambos. Hacer ambas cosas me hace inmensamente feliz", expresó el galeno nacido en Valledupar, Colombia.

Con 30 años de edad, este especialista en el área de la salud reside actualmente en Bogotá y crea videos desde esa ciudad sobre temas de la vida cotidiana, medicina y "temas tabú" que publica los martes y que se han convertido en los favoritos de sus seguidores. Aborda temas como el aborto, las parafilias, la masturbación, entre otros, desde el punto de vista médico y científico.

Rawdy desea transmitir a las nuevas generaciones una visión positiva de la vida, enseñarles que siempre pueden superarse con esfuerzo y dedicación, luchar por sus sueños y no hacer daño a quienes los rodean. "Nada es fácil, pero la educación es el camino más seguro", afirmó.

En una nota de prensa enviada a esta redacción, el conferencista internacional mencionó que combinar su profesión con las plataformas digitales ha sido un reto, pero es lo que más le apasiona.

Este proyecto comenzó hace aproximadamente 5 años, cuando creaba memes académicos de salud, pero al ver el éxito que tenían, comenzó a crear contenido más estructurado. Luego, comenzó a crear contenido audiovisual que fue muy bien recibido por el público.

"Las ideas para mis proyectos surgen de manera espontánea, luego las planifico y busco la forma de ejecutarlas. No siempre es fácil, pero es satisfactorio lograrlo", mencionó el docente de la Universidad de la U del Bosque y de la U de Manizales.

Uno de los planes del doctor es viajar y conocer al menos 15 países. Uno de sus hobbies es conocer nuevas culturas y, por supuesto, mostrar la suya en el extranjero.

Compartir con sus seres queridos y estar con sus pacientes es algo que realmente disfruta Rawdy. "Tratar a mis pacientes, ayudarlos, verlos sonreír y brindarles palabras de aliento es satisfactorio", afirmó.

Si desea ver y estar al tanto de las publicaciones educativas de este especialista en Medicina Interna, puede seguirlo en sus redes sociales como: @Dr.rawdy.

The comparative performance assessment of image analysis algorithms is typically conducted through either the reimplementation of state-of-the-art methods or participation in international benchmarking competitions, also known as challenges [1]. The reimplementation approach is often prone to errors, such as mistakes in coding or suboptimal hyperparameter selection, and is also time-consuming. Consequently, challenges have become the de facto standard for benchmarking new methods.

However, as summarized in [2], relatively little effort has been devoted to the systematic analysis of these results. Specifically, most reports overlook a critical question, especially relevant in the medical domain: What characterizes the images on which algorithms fail? More broadly, how can we learn from challenge results in a way that helps us tailor future algorithm development to address specific, unmet needs?

Figure 1 provides an overview of the statistical approach to learning from a challenge. Based on the annotated challenge dataset (0) and the results of the challenge in question (1, in this case, the Robust-MIS challenge), a semantic annotation of the challenge's test cases (2) is conducted. This annotation forms the basis for a (generalized) linear mixed model ((G)LMM) analysis (3) to identify the primary sources of algorithm failure and to quantify the respective impact. Consequently, the algorithm development is tailored to the specific weaknesses (4) identified. 

Typically, the challenge organizers only provide a website with the rankings, as seen in the MISAW, SurgVisDom, and the EndoVis-WorkFlow Challenge, and the corresponding publications tend to focus on the presentation of aggregated metric values, visual examples, or the manual inspection of the best and the worst cases.

Professor Thomas Huang, along with Professor Nicu Sebe, are the masterminds behind the Facial Action Coding System, a revolutionary technology that can detect and analyze human emotions based on facial expressions. By utilizing a 3-D model of the face and focusing on the 44 major facial muscles, the system can accurately identify a wide range of emotions, from happiness and sadness to anger and fear.

The technology's capabilities extend beyond just recognizing individual emotions; it can also identify mixed emotions within a single facial expression. For example, a person may appear happy but also exhibit signs of fear, and the system is able to pick up on these subtle nuances. This level of detail was demonstrated when the system was applied to the iconic Mona Lisa painting, accurately assessing the various emotions present and assigning percentages to each.

While the Facial Action Coding System represents a significant advancement in the field of emotional detection, it is not infallible. Like any technology, it has the potential to experience errors or inaccuracies, and it is important not to rely on it as the sole source of emotional analysis. Despite this, the system holds great promise, particularly in educational settings, where it could be a valuable tool for students to learn about the intricacies of facial expressions and the emotions they convey.

In the classroom, the Facial Action Coding System could provide a hands-on learning experience, allowing students to not only observe the emotions portrayed by the system, but also to understand the specific facial muscles and movements responsible for each expression. This interactive approach to emotional analysis could enhance the students' comprehension and appreciation of the complexities of human emotions, making the technology a valuable asset in the educational sphere.

A Mobile network operator (MNO) requires to serve users with several new small cells to provide larger bit rates in the next-generation mobile communication networks. The current long term evolution (LTE), in which a base station combines baseband (BBU) and radio frequency (RF) processing units together, is not a cost-effective architecture for an ultra-dense small cell network configuration. As an alternative, Centralized/Cloud Radio Access Network (C-RAN) architecture has several benefits, such as energy-efficiency and ease of maintenance due to the centralization of the BBUs in a central unit (CU). Thus, an MNO reduces its operational expenditure (OpEx), which increases annually as a result of the increasing amount of base stations. The benefits of C-RAN are not limited by its scalability and multiplexing gain capability. This architecture is also a promising approach to increase the spectral efficiency by simplifying the coordinated multipoint (CoMP) technique.

Despite the advantages of C-RAN, increasing end-to-end delay and high-bandwidth requirement in optical fronthaul links between the CU and distributed units (DUs) make this architecture infeasible and uneconomical. Splitting the BBU functions between the CU and DUs is a promising approach to reduce these drawbacks in a C-RAN. Deciding the point where to break the function chain means how many functions are processed at the high powered CU instead of leaving them at a local DU. Besides, these split decisions may be dynamically adjusted by the MNO according to the network variations such as the daily data demand profile of the users. Therefore, this approach improves not only the overall network performance but also the quality of service (QoS) of the users in the network. Briefly, this method is a trade-off between the energy-efficiency and reducing the delay and bandwidth requirements by choosing the weight of centralization.

Another cost of the C-RAN architecture is the capital expenditure (CapEx) which originates from the newly constructed optical fiber links between the CU and DUs. The IEEE 1914 Next Generation Fronthaul Interface (xhaul) (NGFI) Working Group propose Radio over Ethernet (RoE) to reduce these costs.

Egocentric action anticipation is an essential component of artificial intelligence and computer vision, with applications in various fields such as autonomous driving and human-computer interaction systems. This involves anticipating future actions based on current and historical observation data. The task is challenging due to the gap between observed and future actions, making it more difficult than recognizing the present actions.

In egocentric action anticipation, classic methods are based on recurrent neural networks (RNN). To enhance performance, researchers have developed various network structures and anticipation algorithms. However, existing methods have encountered a performance plateau, with most focusing solely on visual information from videos. This approach has limitations in capturing high-level semantic information crucial for understanding the relationship between current observations and future actions.

To address the challenges in egocentric action anticipation, a novel Transformer-GRU-based framework enhanced by visual-semantic fusion (VS-TransGRU) is proposed. This framework combines Transformer as the encoder for temporal modeling and GRU as the decoder for anticipating future actions. Semantic features are introduced to provide high-level information, and fusion strategies are employed to integrate visual and semantic cues. The proposed model structure outperforms existing methods by leveraging both visual and semantic inputs for action anticipation.

Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed Transformer-GRU model with semantic features. When incorporating ground truth semantic features, the framework achieves a notable improvement in anticipation accuracy compared to state-of-the-art methods. Even with estimated semantic features, the performance shows enhancement, highlighting the significance of integrating semantic information in egocentric action anticipation tasks.

In conclusion, egocentric action anticipation is a complex task that requires understanding the relationships between observed data and future actions. By incorporating semantic features and utilizing fusion strategies, the proposed VS-TransGRU framework demonstrates superior performance in action anticipation compared to existing methods. This approach represents a significant advancement in the field of egocentric action anticipation, emphasizing the importance of integrating both visual and semantic information for enhanced predictive capabilities.

Gov. Charlie Baker unveiled a new $240 million economic stimulus bill on Wednesday in Salem, which seeks funding to incentivize the construction of new housing near public transit, maintain broadband service in western Massachusetts, grow manufacturing jobs, and support key technology industry clusters centered around university campuses. The administration stated that the legislation is based on its new economic development plan, aimed at continuing the growth that has led to the creation of 200,000 new private-sector jobs in the last five years and the lowest unemployment rate in nearly two decades.

Baker's bill includes various key initiatives such as allocating $50 million for high density, mixed-income affordable housing near transit, $40 million to support the redevelopment of underutilized or abandoned buildings, and $45 million to support "key clusters" with a focus on technologies like artificial intelligence, robotics, and bluetech. Additionally, it requests funds to rehabilitate blighted or vacant housing, improve broadband access, provide matching grants to low- and moderate-income entrepreneurs, and support advanced manufacturing.

The bill also includes provisions for $25 million to help rehabilitate blighted or vacant housing, $5 million for broadband access, $5 million for matching grants to assist low- and moderate-income entrepreneurs in starting or growing their businesses, and $10 million to support advanced manufacturing. Baker attached his separate "Housing Choices" bill to the new economic development bill in a move to emphasize his commitment to seeing it passed, an effort supported by Salem Mayor Kim Driscoll.

In a filing letter, Baker highlighted that while certain regions in the Commonwealth have experienced economic prosperity, some areas still lack opportunities for residents. The bill aims to address these challenges and enhance the state's overall economic prosperity. Despite its smaller bottom line compared to previous years, the economic development bill focuses on strategic investments to support growth and innovation across various sectors.

Dain sighed, shaking his head as he gazed at the pile of straw, reeds, and wood that had once formed the roof of the village well. Glancing up at Duncan, he asked, "So, you just walked out and found it like this? The whole bloody roof down?"

"Yes. It could have been the children; you know how they climb," Duncan replied, his voice weaker and more indecisive compared to his superior.

It was too early to debate the cause of the mess. As the assistant head of the village, Dain had other matters to attend to. "Where's the thatcher?" he inquired impatiently.

"Out," Duncan winced.

"For heaven's sake," Dain muttered. This task was bound to be time-consuming and intricate, two things he detested. "We'll have to use the computer."

"The computer?" Duncan's eyes widened at the mention of the device, which was a rarity in the village.

Dain marched off, and the young peasant boy timidly followed in his steps, appearing as meek as a mouse compared to the imposing figure of Dain and those who supported him.

They arrived at a large hut located at the center of the village, where the wise men resided, transcribing their knowledge into books. The lone machine in the village was kept in this hut, placed on a sacred platform of rock at the back. Dain strode up to the machine, turned it on, and the wise men remained engrossed in their tasks. Once the loading was complete, Dain called one of them over and instructed him to search for thatching tutorials. Meanwhile, Dain grabbed Duncan by the shoulder, directing his attention to the instructional video displayed on the screen.

"Watch, learn, and repair that well before the day ends. A generous reward will be yours if you succeed," Dain stated firmly.

Toda la información está disponible en la página web www.corredorcompletovirtual.es.

Como ha destacado la concejala de Participación Ciudadana y Deportes, María Teresa Flores, “a pesar de la situación actual, hemos querido mantener una propuesta deportiva muy esperada y especial para todos los runners. Después de la ‘Vuelta a Huelva’, esta carrera es una de las pruebas atléticas más antiguas de la ciudad y nos permitirá despedir este complicado 2020 apostando una vez más por el deporte, con el deseo de que en 2021 podamos volver a la normalidad”.

El Consistorio quiere poner en marcha la San Silvestre un año más, garantizando gracias al formato virtual que su celebración pueda llevarse a cabo de forma totalmente segura y sin ningún tipo de aglomeraciones. Esta decisión se toma tras la gran acogida que han tenido otras pruebas como la Nocturna, la Vuelta a Huelva y la Carrera de la Mujer, que también se han desarrollado en modalidad virtual y han contado con la participación de más de 1.100 corredores.

En este marco, María Teresa Flores ha querido agradecer “el apoyo de los ciudadanos y participantes, que nos ha permitido mantener el circuito de carreras de la capital, reinventándonos y buscando alternativas durante la pandemia para seguir fomentando el espíritu deportivo y los hábitos saludables”.

El director técnico de Corredor Completo, Emilio Muñoz, ha señalado que “esta carrera es muy importante porque puede realizarla cualquier persona a su ritmo, ya sea corriendo o andando según su condición física, lo que nos permitirá mantener viva la llama del deporte en estas fechas navideñas”.

El formato virtual ofrece la oportunidad de participar desde cualquier parte del mundo. Esto ha permitido que en las últimas tres carreras organizadas por el Consistorio onubense se hayan registrado corredores de Madrid, Almería, Sevilla, Barcelona, Zaragoza, Málaga, las Islas Canarias, así como de países como Alemania, Suiza y Francia.

Para participar en esta última prueba deportiva del año, que ya cuenta con 200 inscritos, tan solo hay que descargarse la aplicación gratuita Strava, buscar el Club Corredor Completo Virtual y darse de alta en la ‘Carrera de San Silvestre’, que podrá realizarse entre las 9:00 y las 12:00 horas del próximo domingo.

Finalmente, cabe indicar que esta carrera no es competitiva y sólo habrá una clasificación absoluta masculina y otra femenina con los tres primeros corredores que finalicen la prueba. El objetivo del Consistorio es mantener la esencia de esta querida prueba navideña y que los onubenses puedan acabar este 2020 disfrutando del deporte de manera segura, en el lugar que cada uno elija.

Driverless cars are often envisioned as a hallmark of the future, expected to dominate our roads in the next twenty years. However, technology is not advancing as rapidly as we might think, and there are numerous challenges and concerns associated with these vehicles.

When people imagine driverless cars, they envision a futuristic world finally becoming reality. Yet, as mentioned in several articles, these cars could malfunction and legally implicate manufacturers rather than drivers. Accidents are just one aspect; drivers would still need to be cautious and remain aware of their surroundings. Every time individuals enter their driverless vehicle, they must acknowledge the risks involved.

One significant concern is that driverless cars have a feature designed to alert humans when they need to take over control. However, this feature may not be as reliable or safe as believed. If the car fails to alert the person swiftly enough—especially on fast-moving highways—serious problems could arise for all those using such vehicles. The current technology struggles with recognizing traffic stops or work zones effectively, requiring drivers to intervene temporarily.

Furthermore, questions have been raised about whether a driver might become bored with their car being autonomous. Initially exciting, this novelty could fade over time since users aren't actively engaged in driving tasks. Although sensors require hands-on-the-wheel interaction at all times for safety reasons, this stipulation seems contradictory to calling them "driverless." Manufacturers must also address potential mishaps like falling asleep behind the wheel due to inactivity.

In conclusion, while incorporating advanced features into vehicles sounds appealing for those seeking futuristic enhancements in their transportation methods—as discussed throughout this reflection—the concept of driverless cars presents multiple disadvantages and concerns that must be thoroughly considered before widespread adoption becomes viable.

The necessity of equipping transmitters and receivers with multiple antennas in wireless communication systems has been acknowledged for over a century. The initial advantage observed was the adaptive directivity achieved by controlling the constructive and destructive superposition of electromagnetic (EM) signals using an antenna array. This technique, known as beamforming, allows a transmitter to focus a signal on a desired receiver while minimizing interference at specific locations. Similarly, a receiver can enhance signals from a particular direction while suppressing unwanted interference using multiple antennas.

Another benefit is the increased robustness against channel fading offered by multiple antennas. As the number of antennas and the array size increase, it becomes less likely for all transmit-receive antenna pairs to experience deep fades simultaneously. This is known as spatial diversity and channel hardening.

The most recent advancement in this field is multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) communications, which allows antenna arrays to spatially multiplex multiple data layers at the same time and frequency. This can be implemented in multi-user MIMO mode, where a multiple-antenna base station (BS) communicates with multiple user equipment (UE) simultaneously. This is facilitated by adaptive beamforming, which enables the BS to give each transmitted signal a different spatial directivity, amplify signals received from UEs in various directions, and filter out interference in both transmission directions. There is also single-user MIMO mode, where a multi-antenna BS and multi-antenna UE exchange multiple data layers simultaneously by beamforming through different propagation paths.

Initially introduced as a premium feature in cellular and WiFi networks, MIMO technology has become mainstream. The 5G technology is built around the Massive MIMO concept, which involves having more antennas at the BS than at the UE, making it feasible to protect data layers from mutual interference through spatial filtering, even with imperfect channel state information (CSI) and hardware impairments. As of 2023, a typical 5G BS has 64 antenna ports and supports up to 16 data layers, such as 8 UEs assigned with two layers each. The increasing demand for data traffic in cellular networks, currently growing at 40% annually, is driving the adoption of MIMO. The 5G MIMO technology, especially in the 3.5 GHz band, can significantly increase capacity compared to 4G, allowing higher speeds per device and accommodating more simultaneous connections. If data traffic continues to grow at the current rate over the next decade, 6G technology will need to deliver approximately 30 times the capacity of current networks. Emerging user devices, such as those for augmented reality, and services, like federated learning and hyper-reliable low-latency communication, may accelerate wireless traffic growth. Therefore, next-generation MIMO technology should aim to support at least 100 times the capacity of current networks.

The task of best arm identification (BAI) involves finding the optimal arm in a bandit environment, with significant applications in areas like online advertising, drug discovery, and hyperparameter tuning (Lattimore and Szepesvári, 2020). BAI is typically tackled through two primary paradigms: fixed-confidence and fixed-budget. In the fixed-confidence setting, the goal is to identify the optimal arm with a pre-specified confidence level (Even-Dar et al., 2006; Kaufmann et al., 2016). On the other hand, fixed-budget BAI involves determining the optimal arm within a set number of observations (Audibert et al., 2010; Karnin et al., 2013; Carpentier and Locatelli, 2016). Within this context, the probability of error (PoE) and simple regret are two main metrics used for evaluation. PoE refers to the likelihood of incorrectly identifying the optimal arm (Audibert et al., 2010; Karnin et al., 2013; Carpentier and Locatelli, 2016), while simple regret measures the expected performance difference between the chosen and the optimal arm (Bubeck et al., 2009; Russo, 2016; Komiyama et al., 2023). Our focus is on minimizing PoE in the fixed-budget BAI setting.

Existing algorithms for PoE minimization in fixed-budget BAI are predominantly frequentist and often utilize elimination strategies. Bayesian methods have primarily aimed at minimizing simple regret (Komiyama et al., 2023; Azizi et al., 2023) or have been examined from a frequentist viewpoint (Hoffman et al., 2014), which fails to exploit the advantages of knowing informative priors. Recently, Atsidakou et al. (2022) introduced a Bayesian version of the well-known Sequential Halving (SH) algorithm (Karnin et al., 2013), providing a prior-dependent bound on the probability of error in multi-armed bandits (MAB) under certain limiting assumptions on the prior. However, their proofs are heavily influenced by frequentist approaches and come with strong constraints.

Several recent studies have explored adaptive methods for frequentist fixed-budget BAI. Researchers like Qin (2022), Degenne (2023), and Wang et al. (2023) investigated whether adaptive algorithms can consistently outperform the best static algorithm for any bandit instance. Remarkably, Degenne (2023) found that no universally superior adaptive algorithms exist for several BAI problems, including Gaussian BAI. Wang et al. (2023) demonstrated that in Bernoulli BAI with two arms, uniform sampling is consistently effective. Inspired by these findings, we have developed a method based on fixed and non-adaptive allocations in a Bayesian setting, leveraging both prior information and the environment's structure. As shown in Section 5, our static but prior-informed algorithm can outperform adaptive baselines. Moreover, our proofs incorporate fully Bayesian techniques, offering a novel technical approach that results in a tighter upper bound and applies under milder assumptions.

A motivating example involves a scenario with three arms (K = 3), where prior information strongly suggests that either of the first two arms is more likely to be optimal than the third one. This raises a pivotal question: what strategic approach should be used to allocate resources to the seemingly suboptimal third arm? Moreover, if there's greater confidence in the first arm compared to the second, how should the budget be optimally distributed between them?

Driverless cars have both positive and negative aspects, but I personally do not think that we should have them on our streets. Multiple states have already outlawed the testing of driverless cars, and I am siding with those states. Driverless cars are dangerous, they will make people even lazier than they already are, and a lot of people probably would not be able to afford these cars.

One major concern is the safety risk. Driverless cars are dangerous because everything is controlled by a computer; the passenger is not in control at all times. Traffic laws state that the only safe car has a human driver in control at all times. If there is a passenger in a driverless car and it begins to malfunction resulting in injury or even death, whose fault will it be? The passenger or the manufacturer?

Additionally, driverless cars just make things so much more complicated. I think most people would rather drive their own cars anyway because they feel more secure being in control rather than having a computer manage everything for them.

Another issue with driverless technology is its potential to exacerbate societal laziness. People in this country already dislike doing things for themselves; having driverless cars will only worsen this tendency. If people do not have to drive, then they might neglect other responsibilities as well. Not having to drive just leads to more lazy actions down the road; driving should remain one of those essential tasks individuals must perform themselves.

Furthermore, there's an economic aspect to consider—manual vehicles are already expensive enough as it is; it's hard to imagine how costly driverless models might become if introduced on public roads today! Who would truly afford such innovation except perhaps affluent individuals? Hence investing heavily into developing these autonomous automobiles appears wasteful when considering limited accessibility across various income brackets nationwide!

The quest for improved understanding of vision-language (VL) in AI has been relentless, with extensive research focused on empowering models to perceive, comprehend, and rationalize in response to multimodal inputs. This is especially apparent in the realm of visual question answering (VQA), where models are trained to interpret and respond to visual content and queries (Li et al. 2020; Tan and Bansal 2019; Yu et al. 2019; Anderson et al. 2018). However, most VQA studies have concentrated on 2D visual inputs like images or videos, creating a gap in the comprehension of real-world 3D environments.

Acknowledging the aforementioned limitation in understanding 3D inputs, 3D visual question answering (3D-VQA) has emerged as a novel and crucial form of 3D scene understanding task. Recent initiatives such as ScanQA (Azuma et al. 2022) and SQA have garnered increasing attention in research, requiring VQA models to grasp the 3D scene rather than flat pixels. Many 3D-VQA methods employ a combination of a 3D object detector and a Transformer-based vision-language fusion backbone to predict answers.

Despite progress in integrating 3D aspects into VQA, the current performance of 3D-VQA tasks remains limited, particularly in generalizing to new 3D visual concepts. As shown in Figure 1 (a), a significant generalization gap exists between training and inference in current 3D-VQA methods (such as ScanQA by Azuma et al. 2022). Some visual concepts that never appeared in the training data make generalization challenging for 3D-VQA models. This challenge is mainly due to the lack of visual content in existing datasets. For example, in popular 3D-VQA datasets like ScanQA and SQA, only around 800 indoor scenes are used for question formulation. However, this challenge could potentially be mitigated by incorporating 2D vision-language models familiar with diverse visual concepts.

To leverage both 2D and 3D visual cues, some prior 3D-VQA works (Parelli et al. 2023; Delitzas et al. 2023) have utilized the CLIP model to enhance 3D scene representation through scene-level feature alignment loss using top-down 2D images. However, two issues arise in these approaches: 1) the complexity and incompleteness of top-down views hinder the understanding of 2D vision-language models, limiting the incorporation of 2D knowledge. As depicted in Figure 1 (b), top-down images may contain irrelevant visual context, while crucial information about the queried object might be missing. 2) By focusing on image/scene-level rather than region/object-level representations, this global-level modality alignment approach overlooks fine-grained 2D-3D correspondence. Moreover, by neglecting the detailed 2D VL relationship captured within the 2D vision-language model (VLM), these approaches inefficiently utilize the pre-trained 2D VLM.

澳洲一名年轻妈妈伍兹（Madeline Woods）在8月17日开心生下儿子后，却被医生通知她确诊新冠肺炎。过了几天后，出生仅9天的儿子也感染，成为澳洲年纪最小的确诊病例。这名妈妈自责地表示，她知道自己确诊后都不敢抱孩子、几乎24小时都戴口罩，但孩子还是被传染了，所幸孩子入院治疗后，目前恢复状况良好。

住在雪梨的年轻妈妈伍兹在生产前一天去的诊所得知自己确诊，于是她也去做了PCR检测，结果在19日确诊。伍兹表示，她尽了一切努力避免传染给孩子，「我一直很紧张，喂他喝奶时都戴着口罩，第一个星期时我完全不敢抱他。」没想到，儿子出生9天后身体突然出现状况，伍兹感到很担心，于是立即叫救护车将孩子送往医院。

孩子也接受了PCR检测，结果确认为阳性，他也是澳洲年纪最小的确诊病患。伍兹得知结果后感到崩溃，但医生和护理师告诉她，新生儿对病毒的抵抗力很好，一定能康复。雪梨儿童医院医师乔安娜指出，在新南威尔士州3000多名确诊儿童中，绝大多数症状很轻微，有的孩子甚至没有任何症状。

乔安娜表示，雪梨目前只有3名确诊孩童出现重症，正在加护病房治疗，但这些孩子都有先天疾病问题。由于全球12岁以下孩童无法接种疫苗，保护他们的最佳方式是提高整个社区的疫苗接种率。

Imagine a future where you don't have to worry about being too tired while driving, taking your kids everywhere, waking up early for a long commute, or your child's safety when they get their license. Driverless cars are on the horizon, and they are much safer than most people think.

Driverless cars can significantly improve everyone's daily life. Not only would they reduce the need to worry about the rising costs of gas, but they also have the potential to save countless lives by preventing the numerous accidents that occur annually worldwide. With driverless cars, the risk of people driving under the influence would diminish, and the safety of inexperienced, young drivers would no longer be a major concern. Additionally, the need to wake up early and drive while half-asleep, a common cause of accidents, would be eliminated. You would also likely avoid the hassle of traffic stops and the risk of speeding tickets, allowing the police to focus on more pressing matters.

Whether you like it or not, driverless cars are the future. They promise to save many lives, reduce the stress of driving, and decrease the incidents of drunk, distracted, and fatigued driving. They also offer the benefit of saving on gas, making the prospect of driverless cars even more appealing.

HÀ NỘI - Of the 14 teams in the V.League 1, Sông Lam Nghệ An (SLNA) are the only team never to have played below the top tier. However, that unblemished record is in danger as they sit at the bottom of the table with only 10 points from 12 matches. After their 1-0 loss to Thanh Hóa on Sunday, acting skipper Phan Văn Đức emotionally posted on his Facebook page, calling for unity and perseverance among his teammates. The loss has placed SLNA in a precarious position, facing the risk of relegation.

SLNA’s recent struggles have prompted significant changes within the club. The result led to the resignation of president Nguyễn Hồng Thanh and coach Ngô Quang Trường last week, marking a seismic shift for the team. Despite these challenges, SLNA has a storied history, having never played below the top tier and producing many of Việt Nam’s biggest football talents. They have won three V.League 1 titles, three National Cup trophies, and four National Super Cups, alongside success at lower age levels.

In the past, SLNA has overcome tough situations. Their previous nightmare was in 2018 when they languished in last place but managed to bounce back with eight consecutive wins, finishing fourth. The team’s worst-ever finish was last year when they placed 10th. However, the club has been struggling with financial issues, affecting their ability to retain key players and make strategic signings. Many homegrown talents like Quế Ngọc Hải, Nguyễn Trọng Hoàng, Ngô Hoàng Thịnh, and Phạm Khắc Ngọc have left the team in recent years due to financial constraints.

This year, SLNA's reliance on Vietnamese international Phan Văn Đức has been evident, as he has scored five goals this season, accounting for 71 percent of the team’s total goals. The team's three foreign players have contributed only two goals, leaving Đức to shoulder much of the offensive burden. Former coach Trường admitted that SLNA is overly dependent on the 25-year-old, and other teams have managed to neutralize their threat by focusing on him.

In addition to financial woes, SLNA is suffering from an injury crisis. Key players like midfielder Đặng Văn Lắm, captain Hoàng Văn Khánh, defender Nguyễn Sỹ Nam, and striker Hồ Phúc Tịnh have been sidelined for several weeks. Despite these challenges, the team remains hopeful for a great escape as they are only three points away from Sài Gòn FC in the relegation playoff spot. SLNA's first task will be to secure three points against Hà Nội FC on Friday at home.

Hà Nội FC, currently seventh with 17 points, is also facing challenges this season, struggling defensively with 14 goals conceded. In their 25 meetings, SLNA has secured only five wins against Hà Nội FC, alongside 10 draws and 10 defeats. Coach Nguyễn Huy Hoàng of SLNA expressed determination, stating, "We must accept challenges. We are working hard and united to get through difficulties.” Meanwhile, captain Khánh aimed to inspire his teammates on social media, asserting that "Sông Lam Nghệ An will never give up!” VNS

Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), including wheeled ground vehicles, quadrupeds, and humanoids, are invaluable tools across various sectors such as agriculture, manufacturing, disaster response, military, and extraterrestrial exploration [1], [2]. Once robust and reliable, these robots have the potential to transform economies and significantly enhance human capabilities. However, operation in new and dynamically changing environments without prior maps, which may be GPS-denied, such as caves and lava tubes on Mars, unknown buildings, contested military regions, and areas affected by natural disasters, remains an unsolved problem [3].

Traditionally, automating a mobile robot is modularized into perception, motion planning, and control [4], [5]. State-of-the-art methods utilize Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) [6] to estimate robot state using onboard sensors while constructing a model of the environment. This approach helps map unknown environments in real-time, followed by trajectory planning and control for navigation. However, SLAM's reliance on sequential motion estimation is prone to mapping and pose estimation errors. Additionally, these modular methods are computationally expensive due to their requirement for multiple Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) for each subtask, making them infeasible for real-time execution at high speeds or on resource-constrained AMRs like NASA's Multi-Modal Mobility Morphobot for Mars exploration [9].

In contrast, end-to-end approaches that directly map sensor inputs to control outputs are more computationally efficient, eliminating the need for explicit feature extraction and engineering [10] - [12]. Most end-to-end navigation and autonomous driving implementations utilize vision-based Deep Learning (DL) with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) [13]. DL requires vast amounts of curated training data, which is costly and labor-intensive to collect and label. Conversely, Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) does not require such data and can effectively use just two simple neural networks during training, executing complex behaviors with a single two-layer actor network during inference [14], [15]. DRL has also been instrumental in achieving superhuman performance in various domains [16], [17].

Despite its advantages, DRL has seen limited application in real-world end-to-end navigation due to sample inefficiency, requiring extensive collisions to reinforce positive behavior [19]. This can lead to physical damage and increased costs. While safety controllers [20], [21] can prevent collisions during training, they can also lead to suboptimal policies as they limit the agent's experimentation with a full range of actions and observations. Training AMR navigation using onboard sensors presents additional challenges, requiring untethered hardware for online training, which may slow down the process. Incorrectly defined rewards can lead to undesirable behaviors, making the design of effective reward functions non-trivial.

Training in simulation offers several benefits, such as cost-effective training, accelerated learning, and rapid hyperparameter tuning. However, bridging the simulation-to-reality gap is challenging due to differences in physics [23], [24], and progress has been hindered by a lack of high-fidelity simulation tools. Techniques like domain randomization [25] and modeling sensor and actuator noise aim to create more robust policies, but they often result in suboptimal performance when transferred to reality [26].

This paper introduces a novel method for training DRL in simulation for cognitive end-to-end navigation in unknown environments without GPS, using only onboard sensors, and transferring the learned policy to the real world without additional training. The contributions of this work include:

- Demonstrating emergent behavior in a DRL navigation agent that extends to applications outside the training distribution through rigorous training in constrained environments.
- A novel zero-shot simulation-to-real-world policy transfer technique using high-fidelity sensor and actuator models and a reward component to bridge the differences between simulator and real-world physics.
- Insights into observation space curation and nonlinear learning curves that enhance understanding of online on-policy DRL training in continuous observation and action spaces.

The developed method provides a robust foundation for AMR systems to navigate without prior maps, compatible with various AMR forms and embedded computer payloads. The tools developed are open-source, thoroughly tested in multiple real-world scenarios, including unstructured terrains and dynamic obstacle avoidance.

The rest of the paper is organized as follows: Section II summarizes related work. Section III describes the materials used. Section IV details the method. Section V presents and analyzes the results. Section VI discusses the findings and future directions, and Section VII concludes the paper.

足球明星辛普森结束假释，获得完全自由身。图片显示他在2017年出庭时的档案照片。（NBC／Gatty Images）

前美式足球巨星辛普森（O. J. Simpson）于12月1日重新获得自由身。在1995年被指控的谋杀案中，刑事部分被判无罪，但民事案件需赔偿3350万元。搬到内华达州拉斯维加斯后，他仍然麻烦不断。2008年因持枪抢劫罪被判33年监禁，且在9年内不得假释。据称，他在2017年获假释后表现良好，因此内华达州假释委员会同意，他从11月30日起免除罪责，重新获得自由身。

辛普森的原判刑期本应至2022年9月29日届满，但2020年夏季假释委员会同意提前至2022年2月9日。最近，因表现良好再减三个月刑期，于是在11月30日决定提前释放他。

辛普森的律师Malcolm LaVergne表示，辛普森不打算接受采访，也不愿透露是否会继续留在拉斯维加斯。然而，辛普森在2017年10月1日获假释时曾向法庭表示，他计划刑满后搬到佛罗里达州。

辛普森早年成长于旧金山，在1967年荣获海斯曼奖（Heisman Trophy），随后进入美国职业橄榄球联盟（NFL），在1973年因一季度达到2000码而入选名人堂。退休后，他从事橄榄球评论员等工作。

El gobierno promovió una serie de excepciones para la tramitación y autorización de obras particulares en el contexto de la pandemia por la covid-19, con el objetivo de impulsar y reactivar el sector. En Bariloche, la obra privada es el motor de la actividad, a diferencia de otras ciudades de la provincia que dependen en gran medida de la inversión pública.

Sin embargo, la construcción privada en Bariloche enfrenta problemas históricos, como los largos trámites en la municipalidad. Para solucionar este inconveniente, el gobierno local ha buscado implementar una plataforma digital que agilice los procesos internos y que ha sido respaldada por el colegio de Arquitectos de Río Negro y la empresa Kafe Sistemas SRL.

Aunque el convenio para el uso de esta plataforma fue impulsado antes del inicio de la cuarentena, recién la semana pasada el Concejo Deliberante lo autorizó de manera unánime, en la fase 2 en la que la obra privada está habilitada para ser retomada con hasta 5 obreros.

Este nuevo sistema permite acelerar el proceso de factibilidad, visado, inspección y aprobación de obras particulares, evitando demoras y viajes innecesarios. Además, se mantiene informados automáticamente a todos los involucrados sobre los cambios y avances de cada expediente, y se reduce el riesgo de pérdida de documentación.

En abril, el municipio implementó el Sistema de Gestión de Obras Privadas, un formato de expediente totalmente online, para que los responsables de obra puedan avanzar en los trámites y obtener la autorización cuando se retome la actividad. Sin embargo, aún se espera la fase 3 (estimada para fines de junio) para autorizar las obras privadas con más de 5 obreros, mediante la presentación de una declaración jurada en la municipalidad, según el plan "Reactivando Bariloche".
