لا داعي للمبالغة في القلق عندما يعاني الرضيع من الإمساك، فهي مشكلة شائعة في هذا العمر المبكر ويمكن علاجها بسهولة. المزعج في هذه الحالة هو الألم الذي يشعر به الطفل. هناك عدة أسباب قد تؤدي إلى الإمساك، منها: نوعية الحليب، تناول الأطعمة الصلبة، الإصابة بعدوى أو التهاب، الأدوية التي يتناولها الطفل، تناول أطعمة غنية بالدهون، وأيضاً قد يكون السبب عدم حصول الطفل على ما يكفي من الحليب أو الماء.

بدايةً، لا ينبغي علاج إمساك الرضيع باستخدام المسهلات، حيث إن الأعشاب والعلاجات الطبيعية قد تكفي. من أفضل العلاجات الطبيعية للإمساك عند الأطفال الذين تجاوزوا عمر 6 أشهر هو عصير الخوخ (البرقوق).

أما الطفل الذي بلغ عمره سنة أو أكثر، فيمكنه تناول الزبيب، وإذا كان الطفل أصغر من 12 شهراً، يمكن إضافة الزبيب إلى الماء وخلطه في الخلاط لتقديمه كعصير للرضيع.

ومن العلاجات الفعّالة للإمساك زيت جوز الهند، الذي يُعتبر بمثابة دواء مسهّل نباتي. ولا يحتاج الطفل إلى أكثر من 2 ملل من زيت جوز الهند.

路透台北10月5日电——台湾股市周四连续第五天上涨，达到两周以来的最高点。分析师指出，美国三大股指再次创下历史新高，加之新台币由贬值转为升值，带动台湾股市随亚洲股市一同上涨，最终指数站上10,479点的月线关键点。

台湾加权股价指数收盘上涨0.47%，达到10,518.27点。此前高点为9月21日的10,578点。今日初步成交额为1,050.63亿新台币，上个交易日经修正后为1,094.20亿。

国泰证券期货顾问处经理蔡明翰表示，今天台股上涨的过程中，新台币对美元也止跌回升。如果稍后公布的外资买卖超数据显示出明显的买超，预计将对台股的多头产生较大的激励作用。他说：“新台币止贬回升，此前由于外资资金流出，台股盘整已久，或许会出现转机。”

然而，蔡明翰认为，由于双十连续假期临近，今日大盘成交量未随指数上涨而扩大，预计明日将进一步缩减。

Paris termine l'année en beauté contre Strasbourg

L'année 2020 n'aura pas été la plus belle pour le Paris Saint-Germain en Ligue 1. Cependant, les Parisiens ont décidé de la clôturer en beauté, et c'est chose faite avec ce large succès face à Strasbourg au Parc des Princes (4-0).

PSG 4-0 Strasbourg

Conférence de presse après conférence de presse, Thomas Tuchel se plaint - à juste titre - du rythme imposé aux joueurs et des nombreux blessés au Paris Saint-Germain. Pourtant, les blessures ont parfois un côté positif : elles permettent à de jeunes joueurs formés au club de saisir leur chance. C'est le cas du défenseur Timothée Pembélé, qui profite des absences pour montrer qu'il est aussi à l'aise dans l'axe que dans un rôle de piston droit, et qu'il est même capable de marquer des buts. Son premier but en professionnel a permis à Paris de s'imposer face à Strasbourg (4-0) et de rester dans le groupe de tête. Timothée Pembélé prouve ainsi à son coach qu'il n'est pas nécessaire d'attendre que l'équipe compte 10 blessés pour l'aligner sur le terrain.

Seguro que los ves prácticamente a diario. Siempre están ahí para protegernos, estemos en la ciudad, en el mar o en la montaña. Hablamos de la Guardia Civil, un cuerpo que este año ha cumplido 175 años, nada más y nada menos. Pero, ¿qué sabemos de la Guardia Civil? ¿Cómo nació? ¿Por qué se llama así?

Los compañeros de 'La Mañana de Fin de Semana' hicieron un gran especial por su 175 aniversario, donde hablaron con el escritor Lorenzo Silva, todo un experto en el cuerpo. Silva comentó todo lo relativo a la historia de la Guardia Civil, información que hemos recuperado y que se puede escuchar en la sección de historia de 'La Mañana Fin de Semana'.

Desde sus inicios, la dedicación de la Guardia Civil a los demás fue absoluta, hasta el punto de proteger a la gente en cada rincón de España. Si algo popularizó su imagen fue su lucha contra los bandoleros. Las labores de la Guardia Civil fueron concebidas desde sus inicios para un grupo de servidores públicos de élite. Para entrar en el cuerpo, el listón que puso su creador, el Duque de Ahumada, estaba muy alto. No solo hablamos de altura física, ya que pedían 1 metro y 60 centímetros para entrar. Los candidatos debían tener entre 25 y 45 años, saber leer y escribir (algo que en un país con una gran mayoría de ciudadanos analfabetos limitaba mucho las opciones), y tener una hoja de servicio en el ejército inmaculada.

Sin duda, la Guardia Civil es sinónimo de seguridad, ayuda y entrega por un país y por sus ciudadanos. Sin dar nunca un paso atrás, ni siquiera en los peores momentos, han luchado incansablemente contra el terrorismo, los peores crímenes, las catástrofes naturales y un largo etcétera. Por eso, solo podemos agradecerles infinitamente su labor en estos 175 años de servicio a España y, por supuesto, desearles que sean muchos más.

The European Union's Emission Trading System (EU-ETS) is the world's first major carbon trading market aimed at combatting climate change and reducing Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions cost-effectively. It operates on a Cap-and-Trade (CAP) principle, allowing companies with point source emissions to receive or purchase emission allowances that can be traded as needed. This complex centralized trading system involves making centralized decisions on aggregate emission quantities, writing allowances accordingly, and distributing them among emission sources.

Since 2018, the EU-ETS has started penalizing vehicle manufacturers for surpassing fleet-wide emission targets for new vehicles sold annually. Manufacturers must pay an excess emissions premium for each gram per km above the set target. The focus is on implementing a new trusted and distributed system to audit emissions at the vehicle-level.

Distributed Ledger Technologies (DLTs) have introduced peer-to-peer applications that ensure trust among parties involved. Blockchain technology is a type of DLT where every node maintains a copy of the ledger, enabling secure and immutable transactions with consensus among network nodes. The primary goal of applying Blockchain to the transportation industry is to establish a fully distributed ETS system facilitating direct communication between producers and consumers while bypassing administrative issues and ensuring security.

In this study, a distributed emissions allowance trading system called B-ETS is proposed to address the challenges of the current EU-ETS system. This system utilizes Blockchain and Smart Contracts to allow emission exchanges among vehicles transparently and immutably. An economic incentive-based mechanism encourages drivers to reduce emissions by penalizing excessive emissions and rewarding good driving behavior.

The proposed V2V-based allowance trading system complements the existing EU-ETS by holding drivers accountable for meeting personal emissions targets. This personalized feedback and incentives motivate drivers to contribute to environmental sustainability by maintaining a positive Emission Allowance Balance (EAB) and avoiding penalties for excessive emissions.

The study's contributions include introducing B-ETS as a distributed Blockchain-based emission trading system compliant with EU-ETS regulations, implementing an economic incentive-based system to promote eco-friendly driving habits, and presenting a theoretical model to evaluate the communication efficiency of the proposed system. The paper is structured to delve into the system model and analysis, performance evaluation, and concluding remarks, highlighting future research directions.

**Belarus Faces New Sanctions Over Jetliner Incident and Journalist Arrest**

Western nations are preparing to impose new sanctions on Belarus and sever its aviation links after it dispatched a warplane to intercept a Ryanair aircraft, resulting in the arrest of a dissident journalist. This action has been condemned by officials as "state piracy." The arrested journalist, 26-year-old Roman Protasevich, appeared in an online video, claiming he was in good health while in pretrial detention in Minsk, and admitted to organizing mass disturbances in the capital last year. However, his allies, including his father, dismissed these statements as being made under duress.

Polish Deputy Foreign Minister Pawel Jablonski reported that Protasevich's mother had expressed concerns about his health, though details remain scant. Meanwhile, Belarus’ Interior Ministry stated that Protasevich was in jail without health complaints. U.S. President Joe Biden condemned Belarus's actions and requested options to hold those responsible accountable.

U.S. National Security Adviser Jake Sullivan, in a call with exiled Belarusian opposition leader Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya, reiterated the United States' support for democracy, human rights, and fundamental freedoms for the Belarusian people. The White House conveyed these sentiments.

European Union leaders, meeting in Brussels, called for a ban on Belarusian airlines from the 27-nation bloc's airspace and urged EU-based carriers to avoid Belarus airspace. They also agreed to expand the list of sanctioned Belarusian individuals and requested an urgent investigation by the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) into the Ryanair plane’s forced landing in Minsk during its Greece-Lithuania flight.

Belgian Prime Minister Alexander de Croo emphasized the need for a "swift and severe" reaction. Irish Foreign Minister Simon Coveney described the incident as "aviation piracy, state-sponsored." EU and other Western countries have also demanded Protasevich's release, whose social media platform, maintained in exile, remains one of the few independent news outlets about Belarus following last year’s crackdown on dissent. Accompanying Protasevich, 23-year-old student Sofia Sapega was also detained.

Some nations and airlines preemptively reacted to the Ryanair flight diversion. Britain instructed its airlines to avoid Belarus and suspended the air permit for Belarus's national carrier, Belavia, effective immediately. KLM, part of Air France KLM, temporarily halted flights over Belarus, as reported by Dutch news agency ANP.

Despite these actions, options for Western retaliation seem limited. The ICAO lacks regulatory power, and the EU cannot control flights over Belarus, except those departing from or arriving in Europe. Skipping Belarusian airspace would increase travel time and costs.

Previous rounds of U.S. and EU financial sanctions on Minsk have had little effect on President Alexander Lukashenko's behavior, who survived mass protests following a disputed election. Lukashenko has consistently denied election fraud. Since then, authorities have detained thousands of his opponents, with prominent figures either imprisoned or exiled.

Protasevich’s former employer, NEXTA, interviewed his mother, who suspected a bomb threat on the flight as a ruse to capture her son. "I just want to say that my son is simply a hero," she declared tearfully, urging international awareness. His father, Dzmitry Protasevich, described the situation as "total insanity."

Belarus claims it acted due to a false bomb threat attributed to Hamas, a claim the group denies. State media reported the intervention as a direct order from Lukashenko. Ryanair’s CEO Michael O’Leary described the event as a state-sponsored hijacking, suggesting security agents were on board. Lithuanian officials noted that five passengers, including Protasevich and Sapega, did not continue the flight, suggesting three others disembarked in Minsk.

Meanwhile, Russia, a supporter of Lukashenko, accused the West of hypocrisy.

I never knew the master's wife. Father always said she was kind and generous, often sneaking him scraps from the table when the master wasn't watching. Of course, the master did the same. That's just how humans were.

Father used to say that the master was like a god. He cared for us, protected us, taught us, and played with us. In return, we offered our loyalty, small as it may have seemed. How could we not be faithful to someone so good? Those days feel so long ago now. Father has since passed on, and I’ve had children of my own. The master's children look after them, visiting often in their grand chariots. Those visits were always joyful.

Now, I'm old. My time would be up soon, and I felt at peace with that. I’d fathered many children, gone on countless walks, and sniffed many butts. Rest was soon coming, which was a relief because I was tired. Sometimes, when I was with the master, I forgot how tired I was and played like I was a puppy again. Then, of course, I’d be even more exhausted.

I thought about my life as I lay comfortably on my back. I heard the door open, signaling the master’s familiar footsteps. I waited patiently. "Dag nabbit, Tex! I told you not to get on the couch!" he grumbled, tossing his hat onto the rack. "Well, if you’re not getting off, at least make some room."

Father always said humans lived for eons, claiming the master had been his master, and his father’s before him, and so on through countless generations. I was grateful because the master was a good and kind man. He sat beside me, and I rested my head on his lap, looking up at him. He scratched behind my ears, and I felt my eyes close. Surely the master was magical; nothing else felt like that. Ohhh...

"Come on, Tex. We've gotta go to the store. Wanna ride in the car?"

I leapt to my feet, barking excitedly. Yes! A ride in the chariot! What a treat. The master secured my leash to my collar, struggling with it a little, and we got into the chariot. It roared like a lion, and I barked back, ready to defend the master. Silly chariot.

As the master drove, he kept one hand on the back of my head. It felt nice, and I panted happily, watching the world pass by. Suddenly, he stopped scratching me. Confused, I looked up. The master clutched his chest with one hand while holding the chariot's reins with the other. Something was wrong, terribly wrong. I barked in alarm.

I searched for something, anything, to help, but the chariot was moving too fast. We were no longer on the road, heading toward a massive tree. I was terrified, barking incessantly.

Then it was over.

The article "Unmasking the Face on Mars" discusses the misconception of a face-like formation on the surface of Mars, which some believe to be evidence of alien activity. However, scientific evidence has disproved this theory, revealing that the "face" is simply a natural landform. In 2001, a more detailed photograph of the so-called face was taken, which clearly showed that it is a butte or mesa, similar to landforms found on Earth.

Hollywood has perpetuated the idea of the "Face on Mars" as a pop culture icon, appearing in films, books, magazines, and radio talk shows. This sensationalization of extraterrestrial life contributes to the public's belief in alien involvement, despite the lack of concrete evidence. While some speculate that the face could be a genuine artifact of a past alien civilization, the scientific community remains skeptical, attributing the formation to geological processes.

Although the possibility of the face being of alien origin cannot be completely ruled out, the prevailing scientific consensus is that the Mars face is a natural geological feature, not a remnant of a past alien civilization. The advancements in imaging technology, such as the 2001 photograph, have provided a clearer understanding of the formation, debunking the myth of the alien face on Mars. Thus, the fascination with the idea of alien life on the red planet is a product of the imagination, rather than a scientific reality.

En la reunión de este miércoles, Luis Antonio Torres Iribar, presidente del Consejo de Defensa Provincial en La Habana, afirmó que es necesario trabajar, tomar medidas extremas y hacer las cosas correctamente para superar la actual fase de la #COVID-19 en la que se encuentra la ciudad. Destacó que la actitud responsable y consciente de la población es fundamental en este proceso. Iribar expresó su confianza en los habitantes de La Habana para ganar esta batalla.

Explicó que la decisión de que una provincia avance de una fase a otra en la lucha contra la #Covid19 depende de la situación sanitaria. Detalló los indicadores que se tienen en cuenta, los cuales demuestran que la capital es el epicentro de la pandemia. Convocó a mantener una vigilancia total tanto en la comunidad como en los grandes centros laborales, sociales y de servicios, y a tomar medidas higiénico-sanitarias rigurosas.

El presidente del CDP resaltó la importancia de inspeccionar diariamente los lugares con alta concentración de personas durante esta etapa clave para elevar la exigencia, el control, la disciplina y el orden. Subrayó la necesidad de cortar la cadena de transmisión de la epidemia y llamó a mantener el distanciamiento social y físico durante la celebración del próximo Día de los Padres.

También hizo referencia a un plan para combatir la proliferación del mosquito Aedes Aegypti y convocó a completar las fuerzas destinadas a esa tarea. Iribar criticó duramente la sucursal de Caracol del municipio de La Habana del Este por varias violaciones de precios, ocultamiento de productos y otros problemas que afectan a la población. Se tomarán medidas contra aquellos que, con su comportamiento irresponsable, perjudican el trabajo y el prestigio del resto de los trabajadores de esa rama.

El Doctor Carlos Alberto Martínez, director provincial de Salud, informó que el martes se confirmaron siete casos positivos de COVID-19 después de procesar mil 600 pruebas PCR. Seis de los nuevos casos son asintomáticos. Cinco de ellos tienen una fuente de infección demostrada al ser contactos de pacientes confirmados anteriormente. Tres de estos casos corresponden al evento de la Unidad Constructora para el Turismo número cuatro, en el municipio de #LaLisa.

Representantes de la Unión de Ferrocarriles evaluaron estrategias para la recuperación y mantenimiento de líneas con situaciones complicadas. La reunión también contó con la presencia de Yanet Hernández Pérez, vicegobernadora de la ciudad.

Al inicio del encuentro, Torres Iribar instó a los presentes a asumir esta lucha contra la pandemia con la misma valentía y determinación con la que actuó siempre el Mayor General Máximo Gómez Báez, uno de los grandes líderes militares y estrategas de las guerras independentistas, quien falleció en La Habana el 17 de junio de 1905.

今日（7日），日本首相安倍晋三宣布东京、大阪及福冈等三大都会区进入紧急状态，以应对日益严重的COVID-19（新冠肺炎）疫情，特别是在首都东京。

过去两周，日本的疫情让人愈发担忧，尤其是东京有可能成为下一个纽约，而纽约市及纽约州已成为美国疫情的重灾区。为何会有这样的担忧？

原因在于东京的医疗体系面临重重压力。首先是病床数量不足，医疗装备欠缺，而医护人员感染案例频频出现。此外，东京人口密度很高，这些因素导致本土感染风险居高不下，使得当前的防疫战斗充满挑战。

正在纽约抗疫前线的哥伦比亚大学医学中心日本籍心血管科医师岛田悠一，上周末（4日）发文警告称，现在东京的状况就像三周前的纽约。东京的新冠肺炎单日确诊数在当天首次突破100人，次日（5日）更有143人确诊。这一趋势引发了广泛关注。

路透社报道称，截至6日，日本的累计确诊数几乎翻倍至超过3600人，其中东京是最大的疫情聚集地，有超过1000例确诊。东京都知事小池百合子对此非常担心，不断要求首相安倍宣布国家进入紧急状态。

当前东京的抗疫工作面临四大困难。首先，病床严重不足。东京都政府统计显示，截至5日，东京住院的新冠肺炎患者共有951人，而仅安排了约1000个病床供其使用。日本厚生劳动省的数据显示，全日本治疗传染病患的负压病房仅有1882张，其中东京仅145张。为缓解压力，东京都从今天起将轻症病患转移至酒店或其他设施。

其次，医护人员装备不足。在东京中型医院及诊所服务的护士们表示，由于防疫物资短缺，他们不得不重复使用口罩，也不确定是否有足够的N95口罩或防护衣。

第三，医护人员感染不断。以东京都台东区上野的永寿综合医院为例，过去两周已通报140例确诊，其中至少44例是院内医护人员。 

最后，东京作为一个拥有1400万人口的大城市，传染风险极高。日本影响力最大的医疗团体日本医学会以及东京都知事小池百合子都呼吁政府尽早宣布紧急状态，以便地方政府可以依法采取关闭公共设施和学校停课的措施，鼓励民众尽量待在家中，以切断病毒传播路径，减少每日新增确诊数。

« Tu vois, j'ai juste trouvé ce pantalon beau et je me suis dit qu'il irait bien avec moi », explique-t-il en interview. Sur son affiche, il arbore du rouge à lèvres ainsi qu'un teint blanc immaculé de geisha. « Mais dès que j'entre dans un bar, il y a toujours quelqu'un pour me demander pourquoi je porte des culottes de pyjama. Alors je me suis dit : "Vous voulez parler de ce pantalon ? Eh bien, parlons-en !" »

Provocation ? Plutôt une tentative, à l'instar d'un Hubert Lenoir, de ne pas tant revendiquer une identité sexuelle spécifique que de pousser son public à se demander comment il réagirait s'il était réellement gay ou trans.

« Le spectacle ne traite pas spécifiquement de l'homophobie, mais plutôt de notre habitude de ranger immédiatement dans une case toutes les personnes ayant une sexualité différente de l'hétérosexualité. C'est souvent la première question qu'on pose à quelqu'un de différent : "Es-tu gay ?" », déplore l'humoriste de 25 ans, qui, pour mieux appuyer son propos, préfère entretenir un certain flou quant à sa propre orientation. « Nous n'agissons pas nécessairement de façon haineuse, mais c'est plus fort que nous : nous avons toujours besoin de catégoriser les gens, ce qui finit par exclure certaines personnes, que ce soit l'intention ou non. »

L'amour plutôt que la haine

Féministe, gauchiste et anticapitaliste, Alexandre Forest n'est pas né pourtant dans un couloir de l'UQAM, mais sur une ferme à Sainte-Mélanie (dans Lanaudière) de parents « curieux et ouverts d'esprit », malgré un paysage moral encore largement influencé par le catholicisme. Des problèmes d'anxiété le tourmentent dès l'adolescence, jusqu'à ce qu'il décide de s'inscrire à l'École nationale de l'humour (et également de consulter).

« J'ai l'espoir que répondre à la haine par la haine engendre simplement plus de haine, alors que si nous sommes gentils et patients avec les gens, nous pouvons changer les choses. Et je crois que l'humour peut ouvrir ce dialogue. »

Une colère contre le système, catalysée par le Printemps érable, transparaît immédiatement dans son écriture. Aujourd'hui ancrée souvent dans une expérience personnelle, cette colère continue de se manifester dans les performances d'Alexandre Forest. Celles-ci touchent en plein cœur grâce à l'acuité du regard que l'humoriste pose sur l'hypocrisie d'une société se glorifiant de sa tolérance, mais brillent aussi, surtout, grâce à la tendresse dont fait preuve le grand sensible qui les porte. Lorsque Alexandre Forest explique à ses amis masculins avides pourquoi il ne risquerait jamais de coucher avec une amie proche, de peur de perdre une précieuse compagne de brunch, c'est la violence d'une époque où tout devient marchandise qui attriste notre adepte de longs bains chauds et de mimosas.

« Dans la vie et sur scène, je suis quelqu'un de très pacifiste qui ne veut pas brusquer les gens. Je veux simplement engager la discussion », confie-t-il. Il présente également, durant le Zoofest, une lecture de sa pièce Ici... ce n'est pas simplement une marque de liqueur, située dans un futur où François Legault, devenu premier ministre, aurait vendu le Québec à Pepsi. « J'ai la conviction que répondre à la haine par la haine ne fait que créer plus de haine, alors que si nous sommes gentils et patients avec les gens, nous pouvons changer les choses. Et je crois que l'humour peut ouvrir ce dialogue. »

Apprendre à danser

Sa récente participation au Festival d'humour de l'Abitibi-Témiscamingue, où il a remporté le Concours de la relève, a renforcé sa foi en l'humanité, tout en la mettant à l'épreuve. Comment ne pas se réjouir de la réaction enthousiaste de cette vaste foule estivale, habituellement plus encline à un humour d'observation basique, à ses blagues plutôt subversives ? Mais comment ne pas non plus se sentir déprimé en voyant certains collègues récolter des ovations en imitant « la voix de l'homme noir, du Chinois, du gay » ?

« Il y a encore une partie de mon répertoire que je ne peux pas interpréter lors d'une soirée d'humour classique à Montréal, car beaucoup de spectateurs viennent simplement se détendre et oublier leur journée », observe-t-il en évoquant l'une de ses diatribes assez musclées sur le néolibéralisme. « Mais il y a aussi de plus en plus d'amateurs d'humour, des personnes qui comprennent que les humoristes ne sont pas des animateurs de mariage et qui apprécient nos numéros pour ce qu'ils sont, voyant qu'il s'agit d'une forme artistique qui essaie de transmettre un message. »

Essayer de transmettre un message, oui, voire de propager un discours déjà présent chez les intellectuels. Si un ouvrage comme Je serai un territoire fier et tu déposeras tes meubles, de Steve Gagnon, a jeté les bases d'une réflexion sur la masculinité toxique au Québec, Alexandre Forest pourrait contribuer à la faire davantage circuler et à montrer à toute la province qu'un véritable homme est d'abord quelqu'un qui écoute la musique de son cœur.

« Je vois autour de moi tous ces hommes qui se demandent comment agir pour paraître virils, et qui semblent parfois penser qu'il faut absolument faire de la moto et coucher avec un maximum de femmes. Il est important de leur faire comprendre qu'il est tout à fait normal de regarder Friends en pleurant. Il est normal d'aimer Céline. Récemment, j'ai découvert que j'adorais danser ! J'avais toujours refoulé ce désir et pourtant, c'est tellement amusant ! »

With deep learning models and algorithms becoming integral to modern AI systems, it is crucial to thoroughly evaluate these algorithms and systems to minimize any adverse societal impacts. One primary issue highlighted in the literature is the incorporation of bias within algorithms [8], [22]. Research has demonstrated that the performance of deep learning algorithms can vary significantly among individuals with different attributes, such as gender and skin tone, in various settings [2], [17]. For example, it has been observed that Twitter's automatic face-cropping algorithm tends to favor young, lighter-skinned individuals over others [23]. With an increasing number of such issues, it is imperative to include fairness as a key metric in the evaluation of these algorithms.

The fairness of facial analysis algorithms has been a focus of research in the literature over the past few years [15], [20], [21], [22]. Most research efforts have concentrated on raising awareness of bias in face recognition systems, and several datasets have been proposed to address this [10], [24]. However, limited research has explored the impact of face detection, which is a crucial component of the recognition pipeline, and failures in this area can lead to incorrect decisions (Fig. 1). To the best of our knowledge, none of the existing studies on bias in face detection address the issue of bounding box localization. As the first contribution of this work, we analyze various facial detectors to determine if they exhibit any biased behavior. The presence of bias in deep models has been attributed to both non-demographic factors, such as variations in pose, illumination, and image quality, and more complex, demographic factors, such as race, gender, and skin tone [11].

To investigate biased behavior, datasets with extensive annotations of different attributes, which are lacking in existing databases, are necessary.

新加坡IG艺术家QimmyShimmy拥有二十万的高人气。让她脱颖而出的是那带有诡谲气息的创造力。作品包含内脏、大脑、婴儿五官等造型的食物，彻底颠覆大众对于艺术与食物之间连结的想像。个个既逼真又细致的作品让人看了头皮发麻，网友惊呼：“是什么让你的脑袋里浮现这些怪诞又邪恶的画面？”。对此QimmyShimmy一再声明：“永远不要羞于喜欢那些会带给你快乐的奇怪事物，这些只是我的作品。”更幽默的与粉丝互动：“欢迎跟我打招呼，我不会吃了你！”

#沁凉冰品：到底是眼睛吃冰淇淋还是吃「眼睛冰淇淋」？

人家说看到帅哥美女就等于是眼睛吃了冰淇淋，那你有吃过真的「眼睛冰淇淋」吗？如果有一天冰棒上铺满的不再是珍珠或红豆，而是内脏器官及眼球。或是冰淇淋不再是由层层的奶油堆叠，取而代之的竟然是缠绕在一起的婴儿脸庞与断臂，你还敢大口咬下吗？

女孩的第二个胃是拿来装甜点的，永远不嫌饱。但如果有一天你在蛋塔上看到自己的胃呢？小而巧的塔类甜点，如果换作手臂、内脏，甚至是大脑口味，要女生们怎么受得了。这个「内脏塔」彻底实践了「蛋塔虽小，五脏俱全」。再也不用担心吃太多甜点会蛀牙，因为牙齿都在甜点上了。

*The Year: 2116*

*The Place: Washington, D.C.*

*News Reporter:* This week marks the 100th anniversary of Congress's historic 2016 Prohibition Act criminalizing crack caffeine, often known to users as "coffee".

Crack caffeine was originally banned because of its contributing role in a variety of social ills, including but not limited to heart disease, type A personalities, overwork, and poor dental health. While crack caffeine is a stimulant, historians have cited its history as an opiate of the masses, making them believe that the oppression of the 9 to 5 workday and the 40-hour workweek was bearable.

In recent years, however, scientists have begun experimenting with the drug. While these experiments have mainly been limited to non-human subjects, a few prominent companies are poised to start trials administering small drips to humans. It is postulated that crack caffeine's effect on depressed subjects may give it some medicinal merit.

Oregon and Washington state, historic crack caffeine hubs, and Washington, D.C., a city where many prominent citizens, including Congresspeople, have been accused of being coffeeheads, are considering legislation to decriminalize crack caffeine, and have already instituted policies allowing for the medical use of condensed crack caffeine, known to users as "chocolate."

There is no word yet on whether the federal government will continue to enforce crack caffeine prohibitions in states in which it is decriminalized, as the federal government is waiting to see if this legislation becomes law.

The driverless car frontier is one that has many positive effects. The main attribute of driverless cars is that it eliminates the area for human error when on the road, making roads safer and decreasing fatalities from car accidents, which are the number one cause of death for teenagers. However, because driverless cars can also make errors, they still have a driver who maintains control and can navigate certain variables such as road construction or nearby accidents. Driverless cars not only present safer roads but also have the opportunity to be less harmful to the environment. Sergey Brin predicts that these cars will use half of today's taxi fuel consumption, reducing pollutants released into the air and creating a less toxic environment.

Driverless cars have always been envisioned in an idealistic world where humans wear futuristic attire and communicate in unconventional ways. However, recent advancements in this field suggest that our generation will likely see driverless cars transition from idealistic to realistic technology. While driverless cars represent a positive step forward for humanity with their numerous benefits, it is crucial to remain coherent about retaining driving skills and not becoming overly reliant on this technology.

The fact that technology for driverless cars exists is astounding and contributes to cultural growth by inspiring new discoveries and technologies that benefit society as a whole. This advanced technology offers inspiration for inventors aiming to create a better world through science innovations. Although driverless cars offer significant advantages such as reducing accident rates and environmental pollution, there remains a concern about potential drawbacks if people become complacent or lazy due to overreliance on this advanced technology.

When considering the availability of driverless cars, it is essential for individuals to maintain their driving skills despite technological advancements. While humans may be tempted by convenience offered by new technologies like autonomous vehicles, it remains important not to overlook basic driving skills necessary for handling unforeseen circumstances beyond what automated systems can predict accurately. To avoid losing essential knowledge about how things work without relying solely on automation or advanced technologies like self-driving vehicles.

In conclusion, while embracing the positive attributes presented by driverless car technology could inspire further innovation in engineering fields; caution must be exercised against complacency or dependence on these advancements at the cost of losing fundamental skills associated with manual driving tasks. Driverless vehicles represent progress toward safer transportation options but require individuals not to neglect critical driving abilities essential even when using autonomous features effectively.

Large language models (LLMs) have shown great efficacy in tackling complex reasoning tasks. One key technique contributing to their success is the chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting method (Wei et al., 2022b), which encourages LLMs to engage in multi-step reasoning rather than providing direct answers. This approach significantly enhances the model's capacity to handle challenging tasks such as arithmetic and symbolic questions.

The overall effectiveness of CoT largely hinges on the quality of the demonstrations provided. In instances where no examples are given except for the prompt "Let's think step by step," known as Zero-Shot-CoT (Kojima et al., 2022), LLMs struggle with reasoning and encounter issues related to hallucination. While manually designing demonstrations for each question can mitigate such problems (Wei et al., 2022b), it comes with a substantial labor cost. To tackle these challenges, Zhang et al. (2023) propose Auto-CoT, which can automatically generate demonstrations as prompts. This method initially groups questions from a dataset into clusters and then selects a representative question from each cluster. These chosen questions are answered using Zero-Shot-CoT to derive their rationales (the intermediate reasoning chain). The automated method's performance is comparable to that of Manual-CoT.

Despite the effectiveness of the automated method, the development of a robust and comprehensive set of demonstrations remains an area for further investigation. Several studies recommend incorporating external knowledge to ensure the accuracy of the intermediate reasoning chain (Zhao et al., 2023; Weng et al., 2023; Li et al., 2024). Others suggest generating multiple CoT paths and implementing a verification process to maintain coherence (Wang et al., 2023b; Yao et al., 2023; Liu et al., 2023).

However, existing research primarily focuses on the precision of demonstrations, with limited exploration of the distributional power inherent in these demonstrations. Building on the works of Min et al. (2022) and Madaan et al. (2023), LLMs engage in CoT through a counterfactual approach. This approach doesn't require precise example results but instead learns from the underlying patterns (e.g., equations, templates) demonstrated by the examples.

In this paper, we introduce a novel approach termed Pattern-Aware Chain-of-Thought (PA-CoT) and illustrate that LLMs can enhance reasoning performance by embracing the diversity inherent in demonstration patterns. Following the Auto-CoT framework, we automatically generate question clusters and select representative questions from each cluster. However, instead of relying solely on question embeddings for clustering, we explore multiple methods to enhance the diversity of rationale patterns.

Determining the network structure of decentralized networks like the Internet or sensor networks with minimal overhead is a challenging task. This problem has been extensively researched, as evidenced by previous studies (e.g., [BEE + 06, Dou05, MZ13, MZ23, RLYW21]). In these networks, the vertices represent distinct networks (autonomous systems), and the edges denote peering relations (voluntary interconnections). Tools such as traceroute (also known as tracert) are employed to track the route from one network to another through the internet.

In scenarios where full path information is restricted due to privacy and security considerations, only delay information may be accessible. One of the fundamental tools in peer-to-peer or internet networks is a ping-pong protocol. This protocol involves two nodes, where one node sends a dummy message to the other node, which then responds with a dummy message. By measuring the time between the departure of the first message and the arrival of the second one, the first node can estimate the distance between itself and the second node in the network. This paper aims to address the question of how quickly a hidden network can be reconstructed solely using a ping-pong protocol.

To model this ping-pong protocol, the distance query model was introduced [BEE + 06]. In this model, only the vertex set V of a hidden graph G = (V, E) is known, and the objective is to reconstruct the edge set E through distance queries to an oracle. By querying the oracle for the shortest path distance between pairs of vertices (u, v) ∈ V 2 in G, the algorithm can iteratively reconstruct the graph based on the responses obtained. If there exists a unique graph consistent with the query responses, the graph can be reconstructed.

For a graph class G comprising connected graphs, an algorithm is deemed successful at reconstructing the graphs in the class if the distance profile obtained from the queries uniquely identifies each graph within the class. The query complexity is defined as the maximum number of queries needed for the algorithm to reconstruct an input graph from G. For randomized algorithms, the query complexity is determined by the expected number of queries considering the randomness in the algorithm.

While querying the oracle for the distance between every pair (u, v) of vertices in G would enable complete reconstruction of the edge set (E = {{u, v} | d(u, v) = 1}), this approach has a trivial upper bound of O(|V|^2) on query complexity. This upper bound is generally tight, even for sparse graphs like trees. The challenge lies in high-degree vertices, leading to a focus on connected n-vertex graphs with a maximum degree ∆.

Kannan, Mathieu, and Zhou [KMZ15, MZ13] developed a randomized algorithm with a query complexity of Õ∆(n^3/2), where the subscript denotes that the constant may vary based on ∆, and Õ(f(n)) represents a shortcut for O(f(n) polylog(n)). This algorithm, along with subsequent work by Rong, Li, Yang, and Wang [RLYW21], significantly advanced the understanding of reconstruction algorithms for specific graph classes. Further research efforts have explored the reconstruction of phylogenetic trees, introducing new challenges and insights into distance-based models.

In this paper, we present precise bounds on the number of distance queries required to reconstruct various natural graph classes. Our contributions include new algorithms and techniques that enhance the efficiency of reconstruction for specific graph structures. By improving query complexity and extending the applicability of algorithms to diverse graph classes, we aim to advance the field of network reconstruction.

Se ha convertido en un momento muy esperado para estrechar los lazos de vecindad en estos días de confinamiento. Todos los jueves, entre las 20:00 y las 21:30, se celebra en el pequeño núcleo ribagorzano de Torres del Obispo un concurso gastronómico de tapas por vía telemática, al que concurre buena parte de las casas del pueblo (concursan las casas, las unidades familiares, no las personas individuales). Esta iniciativa, además de dejar un buen puñado de recetas que serán degustadas por el vecindario una vez levantado el confinamiento, está contribuyendo a mantener alta la moral vecinal.

Se trata del I Concurso de Tapas #yomequedoencasa, ideado y organizado por las jóvenes hermanas Gloria y Julia Trillo, quienes recuerdan e intentan emular las jornadas de tapas que se celebran los jueves en la hostelería de Graus y otras localidades ribagorzanas. Lanzaron su idea el pasado día 2 aprovechando el grupo de WhatsApp ‘Vives en Torres’, creado en el pueblo durante el estado de alarma, que se ha revelado como una excelente herramienta para mantener el contacto entre los vecinos.

La dinámica es muy sencilla; todos los jueves a las 20:00 comienzan a recibir las tapas presentadas ese día a concurso, cerrándose el plazo de admisión de recetas hora y media después. Se exponen todas en el grupo de WhatsApp, adjuntando si se desea una pequeña explicación de los ingredientes y del proceso de elaboración. Los participantes pueden otorgar tres, dos y un punto a tres de ellas, siendo la ganadora la que recibe más votos.

I believe driverless cars are dangerous. They are not yet on the road because there isn't enough information to determine their safety. While imagining driverless cars is fascinating, several considerations must be addressed before integrating them into society. BMW has announced the development of "Traffic Jam Assistant," a system that can manage driving functions at speeds up to 25 mph. This car is equipped with special touch sensors to ensure the driver maintains contact with the steering wheel. Although the driverless car that BMW is introducing sounds intriguing, it is not entirely safe. It is not fully autonomous, as someone must hold the steering wheel. What if the driver falls asleep while the car is operating, and the car tries to alert the driver due to an approaching work zone or accident, and the driver does not wake up?

美国股市周二上涨，标普500指数逼近纪录高位。道指升0.6%，标普500指数和Nasdaq指数升0.5%。这是由于美国政府提高了私人医保计划支付率，同时工厂订单数据也证实了经济的稳步改善。

虽然标普500指数再创收盘新高，但没有突破1,576.09点的纪录高位。道指也刷新了收盘高位。

美国政府决定不下调差额医保计划的保险商支付率，相反允许上调3.3%。这一消息提振了一些医保股，包括Humana，该公司约三分之二的营收来自差额医保计划。Humana的股价上涨5.5%位居标普500指数成份股中的涨幅领先者。UnitedHealth Group的股价大涨4.7%，Cigna的股价上涨2.9%。

上周四，标普500指数创下收盘新高，而道指在3月5日首次升穿2007年的纪录高位。然而，股市尾盘缩减涨幅，给了投资人又一个检验近期升势的理由。

美国经济数据的不断增强支持了股市的上升趋势。周二公布的2月工厂订单增加了3%，略高于预期。周一公布的美国制造业数据疲弱导致股市回落。自今年年初以来，标普500指数已经上涨了10.1%。

据预测，市场在周五美国公布非农就业报告前的走势将受到限制。3月就业报告可能为投资人提供美联储在降低失业率方面的成功线索。根据路透调查，市场预计上月非农就业岗位增加约20万，而2月增加了23.6万个岗位。为了降低失业率，美联储维持了宽松的货币政策，这也使股市受益。

相对整体市场而言，医保股仍然较便宜。Humana的预估市盈率为9.4倍，远低于标普500指数成份股企业均值约16.5。UnitedHealth的市盈率为10.6，Cigna为9.7。

أكملت الإدارة العامة للتعليم بمنطقة القصيم ترحيل 2,477,107 كتاب مدرسي إلى 1600 مدرسة، لجميع المراحل الدراسية، في جميع مكاتب التعليم، لقطاعي البنين والبنات، تحقيقًا لمتطلبات الانضباط المدرسي والبداية الجادة لعام دراسي جديد. 

عمدت الإدارة إلى استنفار قياداتها وطواقمها الإدارية والتنفيذية من خلال النزول المباشر والميداني على واقع المدارس والمقار التعليمية، وذلك لإتمام العمل والاستعداد للعام الدراسي الجديد. كما تابعت الإدارة عمليات ترحيل المقررات المدرسية إلى جميع مدارس البنين والبنات في كافة مراحل التعليم الثلاث، وقامت بزيارة المستودعات المركزية في مدينة بريدة.

Pour découvrir officiellement le nom du meilleur joueur de l'année, il faudra attendre ce vendredi en début d'après-midi, avec l'annonce de World Rugby. Officieusement, Antoine Dupont a déjà revêtu son plus beau costume, à l'instar de Lionel Messi lors de ses réceptions du Ballon d'Or. Et les déclarations d'Ugo Mola lors de la conférence de presse de mardi n'ont en rien dissipé la rumeur.

« Je l’ai vu faire plein de photos », a plaisanté le manager du demi de mêlée du Stade Toulousain. « Il y a des chances qu’il ait gagné. » Depuis la création de cette récompense il y a 20 ans, seuls Fabien Galthié (2002) et Thierry Dusautoir (2011) ont porté haut les couleurs françaises. Sans que cela ne change radicalement la vie des lauréats, notamment en dehors des terrains.

« Forcément, ta notoriété augmente, c’est une distinction mondiale qui te fait entrer dans un cercle prestigieux », explique le "Dark Destroyer", membre du jury cette année. « Mais en ce qui concerne les contrats, cela n’a pas vraiment changé grand-chose. »

Après le sacre de Dusautoir, une décennie s'est écoulée, marquée par une des pires périodes du rugby français. Mais depuis presque deux ans, une génération extrêmement talentueuse, comprenant également Ntamack, Marchand et Alldritt, a redonné de l'éclat aux passionnés de rugby. Promu capitaine des Bleus cet automne, le spectaculaire Antoine Dupont a mené son équipe vers une éclatante victoire sur les All Blacks à Saint-Denis (40-25), devant 80 000 spectateurs et jusqu’à 7,6 millions de téléspectateurs.

« La cerise sur un gâteau déjà copieux »

À tout juste 25 ans, ce titre de meilleur joueur de l'année représente « très certainement la cerise sur un gâteau déjà bien garni, qui accroîtrait son rayonnement à l'international ». Cette métaphore pâtissière est l'œuvre de Christophe Quinquandon, président-fondateur de Bros. Entre autres activités, cette société accompagne des entreprises dans leur marketing, ainsi qu'une vingtaine de sportifs, dont Dupont.

« En 2017, après la première année de l'agence, j'ai demandé à chaque associé de choisir un héritier, à la fois pour devenir partenaire de Bros. et un athlète que nous souhaiterions représenter. Blaise Matuidi a désigné Presnel Kimpembe et Vincent Clerc a choisi Antoine. » Adoubé par l'ex-ailier, aujourd'hui retraité mais toujours visible sur les affiches publicitaires de nos villes aux côtés de ses collègues des années 2000, Chabal et Michalak, l’ancien joueur d’Auch et Castres a depuis tracé sa route sans avoir besoin de chaperon.

Il coche toutes les cases

« En 2019, il y avait des prémices, se remémore Quinquandon. 2020 a été un peu chaotique [avec le Covid-19]. C'était compliqué pour les marques de se positionner, le Top 14 n'ayant pas pu se terminer. 2021 est vraiment l'année de l'explosion. Antoine a été décisif dans des grands matchs au sein d'une équipe championne d'Europe et championne de France pour la deuxième fois consécutive. C'est un joueur décisif, avec des statistiques individuelles impressionnantes. »

Mais dans une discipline où le sacro-saint collectif est autant une réalité sportive qu’un puissant argument marketing, la personnalité de Dupont s’aligne parfaitement avec les attentes des sponsors. « Il incarne les valeurs que les marques recherchent dans le rugby. C’est un coéquipier exemplaire, qui s’intègre dans l’esprit d’équipe. Il est à la fois atypique et très contemporain.

亚太自由妇女协会、台湾北社等本土社团于3月29日召开了一场记者会，主题为「正告中国：台湾不是中国的一部分！」。这次活动由台湾北社等多个本土社团和青年团体联合组织，旨在强烈抗议和严正驳斥中国关于台湾的谎言，重申「台湾不是中国的一部分，台湾是主权独立的民主国家！」。

杨黄美幸，亚太自由妇女协会理事长，与其他多位团体领导人共同主持此次记者会。她指出，中共通过不断重复谎言来利用人类心理上的弱点，在国际上宣传台湾属于中国，这是一个非常严重的问题。她强调，台湾人民应更正和清楚表达自己的看法，并从历史角度反驳中共的论点。即便台湾曾隶属清朝，但清朝也是中国被异族统治的时代，根据中共逻辑，甚至可能需要重新划分欧洲版图。

台湾北社社长李川信对中国在美中高层会谈中的言论进行了批评，指出杨洁篪等人的言论是不实的，「就是不是他才要一直讲」。他也提到中国对联合国2758号决议的引用是误导性的，并呼吁台湾社会各界支持台湾迈向正常化国家。

福和会理事长林逸民从历史角度阐述，中共从未占领过台湾，因此无法声称台湾是其一部分。他引用明清时期的历史例证，强调台湾历来不属于中国。

台湾教授协会会长许文堂补充说，中共所提的一中原则与美国的一中政策完全不同。「台湾是中国一部分」只是中共的片面主张，并未得到国际认可。他引用美国国务卿庞皮欧和美国国防部的观点，支持台湾从未是中国一部分的事实。

台大研究生协会会长吴依洁和台湾青年民主协会理事长张育萌也代表青年一代出席。张育萌指出，在习近平的扩张野心下，台湾人民对自身身份认同的比例达新高，中国在国际上的咄咄逼人只会进一步暴露其不可信任的形象。台湾年轻人坚定不移地捍卫国家主权和自由民主。

总体而言，这次记者会通过从历史、国际法和现实多角度，再次强调台湾作为独立民主国家的立场，以团结和坚定的声音反对中共的虚假宣传。

قررت نقابة التمريض إقامة دعوى قضائية ضد فيلم "الحرامي والعبيط"، وذلك بسبب تجسيد روبي لشخصية ناهد، الممرضة السيئة السمعة، التي تقوم بأعمال منافية للآداب وتبيع أعضاء المرضى. يشارك في بطولة الفيلم الخالدين صالح والصاوي. تطالب النقابة بوقف عرض الفيلم وسحب جميع نسخه من دور العرض، لما فيه من إساءة كبيرة للمهنة وإظهار الممرضة بصورة غير لائقة، مما قد يؤثر على نظرة الجمهور لها، خصوصاً أن الفن يُشكل مرآة للواقع.

الفيلم مقتبس عن قصة من تأليف أحمد عبد الله، وإخراج محمد مصطفى، ومن إنتاج أحمد السبكي.

Bruce Campbell, la star des trois premiers "Evil Dead", avait révélé au début du mois que le nouveau film de la saga s'intitulerait "Evil Dead Now". Cependant, l'acteur est revenu sur ses propos et a dévoilé le nouveau titre du film : "Evil Dead Rise!", dont la sortie est prévue pour 2021.

**Evil Dead : De quoi s'agit-il ?**

Le premier "Evil Dead", réalisé par Sam Raimi, est sorti en 1983. L'intrigue se déroule dans une forêt, où une cabane sert de refuge à cinq étudiants en vacances. En explorant la cave, les deux garçons du groupe découvrent un vieux magnétophone, qu'ils décident d'écouter. Cet appareil émet une incantation magique qui réveille des esprits maléfiques, déclenchant une horreur indescriptible. Les cinq étudiants au centre du film sont interprétés par Bruce Campbell, Ellen Sandweiss, Hal Delrich, Betsy Baker et Theresa Tilly. Le succès du premier "Evil Dead" a conduit à deux suites, sorties en 1987 et 1994, également réalisées par Sam Raimi. En 2013, Fede Alvarez a réalisé un remake du film culte, avec Raimi comme producteur aux côtés de Bruce Campbell. Enfin, "Ash vs Evil Dead", une série concluant l'arc narratif du personnage d'Ash, incarné par Campbell, a été diffusée de 2015 à 2018.

**Evil Dead Rise! Présentera une nouvelle histoire**

Outre le fait de révéler que le prochain film s'intitulera "Evil Dead Rise!", Bruce Campbell a partagé des informations sur l'intrigue. Nous savions déjà que Sam Raimi, qui officiera à nouveau en tant que producteur du nouvel opus aux côtés de l'acteur des trois premiers films, a personnellement choisi Lee Cronin pour réaliser le film.

Periodic behaviors frequently arise in the dynamical analysis of systems, especially in complex models that depict natural phenomena like epidemics or population dynamics. These models typically involve some intrinsic delay in their description, which is the focus of our current discussion.

While the study of periodic solutions in ordinary differential equations is well-established in terms of computation, continuation, and bifurcation (refer to the MatCont package [2] as an example of the latest advancements), the theory and computational tools for delay equations are still evolving. DDE-Biftool [1, 22] is a significant reference for delay differential equations, utilizing methodologies based on previous work [20] that extend traditional piecewise orthogonal collation methods used in ordinary differential equations (refer to [4, 5]). However, when tackling more intricate systems that involve renewal, Volterra integral, or integro-differential equations, there is a noticeable deficiency [12, 13].

The motivation behind this work stemmed from the necessity to address this gap by extending numerical collocation techniques [20] to Renewal Equations (REs). Beyond the practical aspects of implementation and computation, considerable effort was directed towards sourcing relevant literature for error analysis and convergence. Recognizing the scarcity of comprehensive references or general guidelines (as discussed in Section 1.2 below), we embarked on an extensive investigation starting with the fundamental case of Retarded Functional Differential Equations (RFDEs), largely influenced by recent papers [29, 30, 31] focusing on the numerical resolution of Boundary Value Problems (BVPs).

To the best of our knowledge, this work represents the first thorough and detailed examination of error and convergence in piecewise collocation methods for computing periodic solutions of general RFDEs. The proposed approach involves collocating the solution derivative following [31], with the intention of extending it to REs, as elaborated in Section 2.2.

In this introduction, we begin by establishing two equivalent BVP formulations for general RFDEs in Section 1.1 to facilitate the computation of periodic solutions. Section 1.2 provides an overview of the pertinent literature, while Section 1.3 summarizes the aims, contributions, and results of our proposed analysis. Additionally, Section 1.4 introduces and discusses relevant function spaces and notations.

The subsequent sections of the paper are divided into three main parts: Section 2 focuses on validating the necessary theoretical assumptions, Section 3 delves into the discretization process and validates the required numerical assumptions, and Section 4 pertains to the final convergence analysis. Concluding remarks are offered in Section 5, and Appendix A compiles the results used in the proofs outlined in the aforementioned main sections.

Let us consider the RFDE y′(t) = G(yt), where G: Y → Rd is a function defined on a state space Y ⊆ F([-τ, 0], Rd) for a given maximum delay τ > 0.

The text discusses the advancements and challenges in the field of deep neural network (DNN) compression, particularly in relation to the rate-distortion function, which is a fundamental measure of lossy compression efficiency. Here's a restructured version of the text to enhance its logical flow and coherence:

---

Driven by advances in deep neural network (DNN) compression schemes, rapid progress has been made in developing high-performing lossy compression schemes for large, high-dimensional datasets that remain practical [1]-[4]. These methods have empirically outperformed classical compression schemes for real-world data, such as images. However, it remains unknown how well they perform in comparison to the fundamental limit, which is the rate-distortion function. The rate-distortion function, a measure of the asymptotic limit on the minimum number of bits required to achieve a certain distortion, is defined as R(D) := inf EQUATION, where any rate-distortion pair (R, D) satisfying R > R(D) is achievable, and no code can achieve a rate-distortion less than R(D) [16]-[18].

One approach to investigate the performance of DNN compression schemes is to examine a stylized data source, like the sawbridge random process, with a known, analytically tractable probability distribution, as done in [5]. This allows for a closed-form solution of the rate-distortion function, enabling a comparison with the empirically achievable rate and distortion of DNN compressors trained on the data source's realizations. However, this approach, while insightful, does not evaluate DNN compressors on the true, complex, and high-dimensional sources of interest, such as real-world images, for which architectural choices, such as convolutional layers, have been specifically engineered [6].

过去一年，英国科技行业表现出色。根据最新数据，2019年英国科技行业的投资规模激增至132亿美元，较2018年增长41亿美元，达到英国历史最高水平。

根据英国数字经济委员会的Tech Nation和Dealroom.co提供的调研报告显示，英国公司获得的投资占欧洲地区总投资的三分之一，超过德国（70亿美元）和法国（52亿美元）的总和。报告还列举了2019年英国科技行业的亮点：
- 风投机构的投资规模同比增长44%，增幅超过美国、中国、德国和法国；
- 英国新增了8家独角兽企业，总数达到77家，数量是德国的两倍、法国的三倍；
- 早期投资事件增长了20%，51亿美元流向英国初创公司；
- 2019年54亿美元的投资中，有多轮投资单次超过1亿美元，事件数量是去年同期的两倍以上；
- 金融科技、人工智能、深科技和清洁能源是英国表现最出色的行业。

随着风险投资规模增长了44%，英国快速发展的科技公司数量开始激增。英国连续三年风险投资增幅超过40%。与此形成鲜明对比的是，法国的投资增速仅为2018年的三分之一，以色列更是只有五分之一。相反，美国和中国则分别出现了20%和65%的下降。

在全球范围内，英国2019年的风险投资总额仅次于美国和中国。从城市层面来看，伦敦已经成为世界上风险投资最多的地区之一，与旧金山湾区、北京和纽约并驾齐驱。2019年，总部位于伦敦的公司共获得97亿美元的融资。

2019年，近半数（60亿美元）对英国的投资来自美国和亚洲投资者，英国科技行业的人均海外投资超过了美国。与德国和法国相比，英国拥有最广泛的外国和本土投资者组合。

去年，随着8家估值超过10亿美元的独角兽公司在英国诞生，英国的独角兽公司总数达到了77家，早期初创公司的融资额也从2018年的累计40亿美元增至51亿美元。

2019年的早期投资表现强劲。早期阶段的投资事件增长了20%，54亿美元的投资中，单轮超过1亿美元的事件数量是去年同期的两倍。

شكراً لقراءة هذا الخبر عن ارتفاع حصيلة شهداء العدوان الإسرائيلي على قطاع غزة إلى 115 شهيدًا، والآن مع تفاصيل الخبر.

القاهرة - سامية سيد - أعلنت وزارة الصحة الفلسطينية، اليوم الجمعة، عن ارتفاع حصيلة الشهداء في قطاع غزة إلى 115 شهيدًا، بينهم 28 طفلاً و15 سيدة، بالإضافة إلى 621 إصابة بجروح مختلفة. وأدى العدوان إلى دمار كبير في المنشآت والبنى التحتية.

وفقاً لوكالة الأنباء الفلسطينية، تعرّضت المنطقة الشمالية من القطاع، خاصة بيت حانون وبيت لاهيا وشمال غرب مدينة غزة، فجر اليوم لقصف كثيف بعشرات الصواريخ من الطيران الحربي ومدفعية الاحتلال الإسرائيلي والزوارق الحربية. وأدى هذا إلى تشريد العشرات من الأسر، الذين اضطروا إلى البقاء في الشوارع والطرقات بسبب العدوان.

كما أطلقت مدفعية الاحتلال عشرات القذائف نحو الأحياء السكنية والأراضي الزراعية شمال القطاع وشرق خان يونس جنوب القطاع.

**Alerta Aeropuerto** es un programa que se transmite desde hace varios años a través de National Geographic. Su propósito es visibilizar las actividades delictivas que se enfrentan dentro de aeropuertos, específicamente en las ciudades de Lima, Bogotá, Sao Paulo y Madrid.

Entre las muchas tareas que asume la policía aeroportuaria se encuentra la de interceptar a los pasajeros que intentan transportar droga, de ahí la popular frase "es positivo a alcaloide de cocaína", la sustancia que más se trafica bajo esta modalidad. Además, se ocupan de casos de falsificación de documentos, fraude fiscal por dinero no declarado y trata de personas.

El reflejo de estas situaciones tan crudas como inesperadas ha generado una verdadera legión de seguidores del reality, auténticos fanáticos que inundan las redes sociales con sus comentarios y solicitudes. Este es su momento, ya que hoy se transmite una súper maratón.

**Alerta Aeropuerto** se emitirá el viernes 1 de mayo durante todo el día a través de National Geographic. Por otro lado, en las redes sociales no paran de pedir que se graben nuevas temporadas del popular programa.

¿Cuántas temporadas hay de **Alerta Aeropuerto**?

Después de cuatro temporadas, **Alerta Aeropuerto**, la serie éxito de National Geographic, aterriza en uno de los aeropuertos más importantes de Sudamérica: el Aeropuerto Internacional Guarulhos, en Sao Paulo, Brasil.

El gobierno de Aristóteles Sandoval ha mostrado una insistencia notable por proyectarse como fresco e innovador, no solo en sus mensajes oficiales, sino también en eventos como la Glosa Ciudadana del Quinto Informe de Gobierno. Este año, en lugar de utilizar el Palacio de Gobierno, se eligió como sede el edificio México Innovación y Diseño (MIND).

El evento, en el que participaron especialistas sobre diversos temas, se celebró en el quinto piso del edificio MIND. Aunque este espacio tiene una capacidad para 200 personas con 300 metros cuadrados de superficie, es menor al utilizado el año anterior en el patio principal del edificio gubernamental. Para acomodar a todos los invitados, se habilitó un espacio adicional donde se podía seguir la transmisión a través de una pantalla y bocinas.

En la Glosa, se dispuso una mesa redonda en la que se sentaron el gobernador Aristóteles Sandoval y tres especialistas invitados para cada uno de los cuatro bloques temáticos, al estilo de los programas televisivos que tratan temas de interés colectivo. A su alrededor se colocaron sillas y bases que formaron estrados donde se ubicaron funcionarios, expertos, representantes de medios de comunicación y el equipo de sonido. Los reporteros también se encontraban en los alrededores.

Durante el receso, los participantes tuvieron acceso a una terraza donde pudieron disfrutar de fruta, refrescos, agua, botanas y baguettes. Además, otro espacio se utilizó para realizar entrevistas y se habilitó un área para la transmisión del evento.

Este tipo de ejercicios fueron ampliamente reconocidos, ya que el gobierno de Jalisco es el único que los desarrolla. A lo largo de las intervenciones de los especialistas, se observaron pocas críticas hacia la administración de Aristóteles Sandoval.

Le Mensuel de Rennes et Le Télégramme révèlent les résultats de la concertation menée par la Ville sur les questions de sécurité. Comment les Rennais perçoivent-ils l’insécurité ? Quel est leur sentiment ? Leurs attentes ? Ces conclusions, synthétisées dans un document de huit pages baptisé "livre blanc", détermineront la stratégie de la capitale bretonne pour les cinq prochaines années.

Le premier chapitre du document est consacré au bilan de la période 2015-2020. Depuis 2015, la délinquance générale a augmenté de 13,7%. Cela confirme ce qui a déjà été écrit par Le Mensuel et Le Télégramme au cours des dernières années ou des derniers mois. Cette hausse est le résultat de différents facteurs, tels que plus de faits de délinquance, une activité plus forte des services de police et plus de dépôts de plainte pour des faits qui auparavant ne faisaient pas l'objet d'une plainte, etc.

Il faut cependant se méfier des statistiques. La délinquance est un phénomène complexe et les données publiées doivent être traitées avec précaution.

Au-delà des statistiques, le bilan du livre blanc met en évidence plusieurs phénomènes. Tout d'abord, il y a une "hausse de la visibilité du trafic de stupéfiants", marquée par une "appropriation des espaces publics et privés" par les dealers, ce qui crée des tensions entre les habitants et les trafiquants. L'attrait des réseaux pour les jeunes est également confirmé, avec des enfants de 10 à 12 ans impliqués.

Le livre blanc souligne également la banalisation des phénomènes de violence chez les jeunes, l'élargissement des troubles liés aux rassemblements festifs et à l'alcoolisation sur la voie publique à l'ensemble des quartiers, une forte augmentation des plaintes pour atteintes sexuelles et une dégradation "significative" des conditions de sécurité dans le centre-ville de Rennes, en grande partie attribuée aux jeunes étrangers en errance.

El ministro del Interior, Daniel Palacios, ha enviado una dura advertencia a todos los grupos criminales en Colombia. Tras la captura de alias 'Otoniel', líder del Clan del Golfo el pasado 23 de octubre, las autoridades continuarán con los operativos.

El jefe de la cartera ha afirmado que no bajarán la guardia frente a las organizaciones armadas ilegales en distintas regiones del país, exigiéndoles a los delincuentes que se entreguen o enfrenten las consecuencias.

"Quedarán criminales en diferentes partes del país y el mensaje para ellos es muy claro: someterse a la justicia o ser capturados y, en caso contrario, serán dados de baja en operaciones militares", declaró Palacios.

Además, el ministro del Interior añadió que la captura del líder del Clan del Golfo es un ejemplo de la capacidad del Gobierno para golpear las estructuras criminales. "Ninguno puede esconderse en ninguna parte del territorio nacional donde la justicia no pueda alcanzarlos (...). Otoniel, que creía estar seguro, fue capturado", dijo.

Palacios también se refirió al intendente Edwin Guillermo Blanco, el oficial que falleció durante la operación 'Osiris' del pasado fin de semana, destacando que su sacrificio fue un testimonio de su dedicación al país.

"Hablar de su profesionalismo, heroísmo, capacidad, entrenamiento y dedicación, así como de cómo avanzó y lideró a sus compañeros en los momentos en los que sacrificó su vida, muestra a una persona valiente que entendía la importancia de su labor y la contribución de los policías en Colombia", concluyó el ministro.

The cyber cell of Delhi Police has identified 10 members, including minors, of an Instagram group which was being used to share obscene messages and morphed pictures of underage girls on the social media site. Officials said a minor has also been apprehended and quizzed, and the devices used for the “offensive, vulgar communication” have been seized from the members of the group known as 'Bois Locker Room'.

Some of those involved in the group are from reputed schools in the national capital. Information about the group came to light after a girl shared screenshots of its activities, following which the group started being called out on social media. During social media monitoring, the police noticed that the group was being used by the participants to share obscene messages and morphed pictures, leading to the registration of a case under relevant sections of the IT Act and IPC on Monday.

The police have also asked Instagram to provide details of the accounts of the group. Delhi Women and Child Development Minister Rajendra Pal Gautam condemned the incident, stressing that it cannot be tolerated. The WCD department plans to work with the Directorate of Education to develop a strategy to prevent such incidents.

DCW chief Swati Maliwal emphasized that the guilty should not be spared and stated that around 10 members of the group have been identified. Major identified members are being examined, while the minor members are being dealt with as per the provisions of the Juvenile Justice Act, according to police officials. Further actions will be based on the material evidence gathered during the investigation.

In response to the incident, Instagram stated that it takes such behavior very seriously and does not tolerate it. The platform removed objectionable content featuring minor girls as soon as it was made aware of it. The Delhi Commission of Women had issued a notice to Instagram and Delhi Police after taking cognizance of the matter.

Social media users expressed outrage, discussing issues like gender bias, the objectification of women, and the need for monitoring online activities of children. Actress and activist Swara Bhaskar highlighted the toxic masculinity reflected in such incidents and called for addressing the mentality that creates rapists. Later, '#GirlsLockerRoom' started trending on Twitter, focusing on similar social media groups with vulgar comments by females.

Venus is similar to Earth, but with much harsher living conditions. It is the closest planet to Earth in terms of density and size. However, studying Venus presents significant challenges. It is difficult to gather samples directly from its surface, leading NASA to develop new technologies to facilitate our exploration of the planet.

Despite the obstacles, studying Venus is a worthy endeavor. By overcoming the obstacles posed by Venus, we can further human curiosity and drive scientific progress into other daunting realms.

The text mentions that Venus, much like Earth, may have once been covered by vast oceans and possibly supported life. This similarity to Earth underscores the importance of studying Venus. While Venus presents a challenging environment, it remains a compelling option for planetary exploration. NASA is working on innovative approaches to studying Venus, albeit with the limitations imposed by its hostile conditions.

NASA has encountered difficulties in studying Venus, with previous spacecrafts surviving on the planet's surface for only a few hours. However, the agency continues to strive to develop successful methods for studying Venus, despite the challenges it presents.

I believe that using technology to read students' expressions can be intrusive and inappropriate. Students may come to school seeking comfort and support from friends they trust, and having a machine in the classroom that can identify their emotions without their consent could disrupt that. Forcing students to reveal their true emotions when they may not want to can be counterproductive and even harmful. The example of using muscle clues to detect insincerity in politicians and celebrities does not translate well to students, as each individual expresses their emotions uniquely. Computers may not be able to accurately interpret human emotions, as emotions are complex and nuanced. Therefore, the technology may not be as effective as claimed, and resources could be better utilized elsewhere. Rather than investing in technology to analyze emotions, resources could be directed towards finding cures for illnesses and aiding those in need. It would be more beneficial to utilize knowledge and resources to make a tangible difference in people's lives, rather than attempting to decipher emotions through a computer.

Can you hide your emotions by having a smirk on your face? The answer is yes, but can other people use a computer to detect the emotions hidden underneath? This question leads us to explore the technology capable of performing this task.

The technology used for this type of research is called the Facial Action Coding System (FACS). FACS enables computers to identify human emotions by constructing a 3-D model of the face. For the system to work, all 44 major muscles in the model must mimic human muscle movements to recognize the emotions expressed. FACS primarily looks for six emotions: happiness, surprise, anger, disgust, fear, and sadness, to fully assess a human face.

This technology can be valuable in various settings. For example, in schools, FACS can be utilized to assess the emotions of students, potentially identifying those dealing with sadness, anger, and other emotions, based on a simple photograph. This could provide a new way to support students, offering insights into their emotional well-being. Moreover, FACS can be a fascinating tool for students, allowing them to explore the technology, understand the emotions, and, perhaps, the emotions they, themselves, express, by analyzing a single picture.

Dans cette édition, Inspire Middle East vous invite à explorer le marché du commerce électronique dans la région à l‘ère du post-Covid. Nous donnons aussi la parole à l’entrepreneuse Joy Ajlouny, une virtuose de la « disruption » spécialisée dans le lancement des startup et la levée de fonds. Une « serial entrepreneuse », fine conseillère pour les startup. Ne jamais prendre un non pour une réponse ferme, ne jamais cesser de promouvoir son entreprise et oublier sa vie personnelle… Ce sont quelques-uns des mantras de celle qui se présente sans complexe comme « un éléphant dans un magasin de porcelaine » et qui fonctionne au défi. 

Née en Californie de parents palestiniens, Joy Ajlouny est une entrepreneuse connue pour faire fructifier les jeunes pousses à travers le monde et a levé plus de 100 millions de dollars de financements. Elle est aussi la cofondatrice de Fetchr, la société qui a révolutionné le secteur de la livraison au Moyen-Orient en supprimant l’impératif d’une adresse. D’après Startup Genome, le numéro un du conseil aux jeunes entreprises innovantes, à l‘échelle planétaire, la « startup economy » pèse 3000 milliards de dollars et représente 7 des 10 sociétés qui comptent le plus dans la Tech. 

Le marché des startup au Moyen-Orient se développe rapidement, mais comme le reste du monde, il se relève difficilement de la crise du Covid-19. Selon le rapport de ce cabinet de conseil, plus de 70 % des startup à travers le monde ont vu leurs revenus chuter. Ceci dit, décrocher des financements reste possible. Pour preuve, la grande récession de 2008 : à l‘époque, des entreprises comme Facebook et LinkedIn avaient levé du capital risque. Les startup sont un levier de création de richesses et d’emplois et des villes du Moyen-Orient comme Abu Dhabi et Dubaï figurent au top 100 du classement mondial des écosystèmes émergents.

Euronews : « Joy, quand vous connaissez le paysage des startup et du commerce électronique aux Émirats arabes unis, quelle comparaison faites-vous avec la Silicon Valley par exemple, et que manque-t-il à l‘écosystème ici ? »

Sipping at my tea, I listened to the record playing in the background. It was one of my last boxes of genuine good quality Builder's Brew. I never cared much for refined tastes or the poncy ways of my fellow Brits. They were mostly just brown-haired Romans with hardly a trace of Celt in them, unless you ventured to the remote rural corners of Cornwall or Ireland where bloodlines intertwined like writhing snakes.

I have been around for a very long time, living a life filled with both good and bad moments. My first wife betrayed me with a friend, my lands were ravaged beyond recognition, and even my hammer was shattered into stone fragments. The enclosures marked a significant change in England, transforming the verdant fields into artificial squares like pieces on a chessboard.

I reminisced about the past, recalling the times when a Welsh land thief was hailed as a hero and the encroachment of a foreign God's influence eroded the old ways. Despite the exaggerated rumors about my abilities, I still had a connection with my people from my youthful days of fighting alongside them.

As I pondered on my mortality and the blight that afflicted me, I lamented the absence of good old-fashioned milk due to the epidemic that had devastated Coventry. In search of soya milk, I embarked on a journey to a semi-automated farm powered by electricity, seeking to cleanse myself of the blight that plagued me.

Reflecting on the past and the transformation of society, I longed for a return to simpler times when priests held a mystical power and men could be perceived as wizards. Despite the darkness of our past actions, there was a sense of yearning for the connection with humanity that once existed.

As the record came to an end, I contemplated the idea of visiting Japan and experiencing their advanced technology, including robots capable of holding conversations. Pondering on the differences between my kind and the more aggressive counterparts in Japan, I considered stopping in Germany for good beer before continuing my journey.

Realizing that I had spent the entire day indoors watching the zombie horde outside, I decided to venture south towards the Channel. With thoughts of encountering Japanese chatbots and wondering whether to bring flowers to a robot, I embarked on a new adventure as an ancient God-king, ready to explore a world transformed by time and technology.

Les dirigeants des pays membres de l'Otan se sont réunis lors d'un sommet de l'alliance à Bruxelles le 25 mai 2017. Le Monténégro est officiellement devenu lundi le 29e membre de l'Otan, marquant un moment où le président américain Donald Trump envoie des signaux ambigus à l'égard de l'Alliance atlantique.

Le ministre des Affaires étrangères, Srdjan Darmanovic, a remis l'instrument d'accession de son petit pays de 620.000 habitants à l'Alliance lors d'une cérémonie au département d'État américain, en présence du Premier ministre Dusko Markovic. "Nous célébrons aujourd'hui le fait que plus jamais quelqu'un décidera dans notre dos à notre place et à la place de notre État, comme cela a été le cas dans le passé", a déclaré M. Markovic pendant la cérémonie.

L'entrée dans l'Otan est un évènement historique pour le Monténégro, un pays qui a dû endurer d'énormes sacrifices au 19ème et au 20ème siècle pour être reconnu par le monde sous son propre nom et ses propres symboles, a-t-il indiqué. Cette intégration favorisera "la stabilité dans l'ouest des Balkans" et "la paix et la sécurité internationale", a souligné le secrétaire général de l'Otan, Jens Stoltenberg.

Cependant, l'intégration dans l'Otan de ce pays, qui faisait partie de l'ex-Yougoslavie communiste, est vue par Moscou comme une "provocation". Avec l'intégration du Monténégro, l'Otan contrôle désormais tout le littoral nord de la Méditerranée, depuis le détroit de Gibraltar jusqu'à la Syrie.

شركات التأمين تتخذ إجراءات جديدة بعد أزمة «قناة السويس»

في أعقاب أزمة السفينة العملاقة العالقة في مجرى قناة السويس شرقي مصر، توقعت مصادر في قطاع التأمين أن يتحمل مالك السفينة وشركات التأمين تعويضات بملايين الدولارات، حتى في حال إعادة تعويم السفينة بسرعة. 

وأوضحت هيئة قناة السويس في بيان أن السفينة «إيفر غيفن»، التي تعد واحدة من أكبر سفن الحاويات في العالم بطول 400 متر وحمولة 224 ألف طن، جنحت صباح الثلاثاء بسبب اختلال توجيهها وسط رياح عاتية وعاصفة ترابية، مما يهدد بتعطيل شحنات عالمية لأيام. 

وبحسب مصادر، فإن السلطات المصرية كانت تعمل على إعادة تعويم السفينة بعد ظهر الأربعاء، لكن المعلومات السابقة عن إعادة تعويم جزئية كانت غير دقيقة. وقال وكلاء تأمين وسماسرة إن مالك السفينة، شركة «شوي كيسان كيه كيه» اليابانية، وشركات التأمين، قد يواجهون مطالبات من هيئة قناة السويس عن فاقد الإيرادات، ومن السفن الأخرى التي تعطلت حركتها.

وقال دافيد سميث، مدير مكتب سمسرة التأمين البحري «مكجيل» وشركاه: «كل الطرق تؤدي إلى السفينة». ولم يتسن التواصل مع الشركة المالكة للحصول على تعليق. وتقول مصادر قطاع التأمين إن سفن الحاويات بهذا الحجم تكون عادة مؤمنا عليها ضد الأضرار التي قد تلحق بالهيكل والمعدات. وذكر مصدران أن السفينة مؤمن عليها في السوق اليابانية، وتتحمل الشركة المؤمنة على الهيكل والمعدات تكلفة عملية إنقاذ السفينة أيضًا.

وأشار مارتن شوتيفاير، المتحدث باسم شركة الخدمات البحرية الهولندية «بوسكاليس»، إلى أن الشركة كُلفت بالمشاركة في العملية، ويتجه فريق من نحو 10 أفراد إلى مصر.

Large language models (LLMs) are quickly gaining popularity across various domains due to their potential to automate and enhance a wide range of tasks (Bommasani et al., 2021; Bubeck et al., 2023). One significant application is in decision-making under uncertainty, which involves offering guidance on the best course of action amid various possibilities while considering user objectives and uncertainties about the world. The skill to make sound decisions under uncertainty is crucial in high-stakes fields like business, marketing, medicine, aeronautics, and logistics (Kochenderfer, 2015; Peterson, 2017). Its importance extends beyond organizational decisions to assisting individuals in making well-informed choices (Luce & Raiffa, 1989; Berger, 2013). Research consistently shows that human decision-making can be illogical, influenced by biases and incomplete information when lacking such frameworks (Bazerman & Moore, 2012). Similarly, achieving optimal decisions with LLMs poses challenges, such as fixating on specific explanations or information, neglecting to consider all evidence, and struggling to handle uncertainty, biases, or align with user goals and preferences (Ferrara, 2023; Benary et al., 2023). Our study showcases experiments that exemplify these challenges.

Moreover, beyond making optimal decisions, understanding why an LLM makes a specific decision is crucial. This comprehension builds trust in the decision, validates its optimality, and enables improvements to components that might lead to suboptimal results. The ability to explain decisions and ensure decision-making quality, a concept we term as human auditability, is vital for the practical application of LLMs in aiding decision-making in real-world scenarios (Thirunavukarasu et al., 2023).

In this paper, our objective is to develop a framework that empowers LLMs to make more optimal decisions under uncertainty. This framework aims not only to enhance decision accuracy but also to enable human users to grasp the reasoning behind each decision and assess its optimality. Drawing inspiration from previous work on multi-step scaffolding like Chain of Thought (CoT) (Wei et al., 2022) and Tree of Thoughts (ToT) (Yao et al., 2023), we offer a scaffold for LLMs that follows the classical decision theory framework, initially devised for optimal human decision-making under uncertainty. Our approach involves key steps: identifying and predicting relevant unknown variables based on contextual information, determining a utility function aligned with user goals, and using this utility function to pinpoint the decision maximizing expected utility. We term our proposed framework DeLLMa, short for Decision-making Large Language Model assistant.

After presenting our framework, we demonstrate results on benchmark decision-making environments using real datasets that simulate two practical scenarios: one in agriculture and the other in finance. We then conduct a comparative analysis of DeLLMa against various LLM decision-making strategies, including zero-shot (direct) prompting, self-consistency (Wang et al., 2022), and CoT approaches. Our findings reveal that DeLLMa significantly enhances decision accuracy, showing improvements of up to a 40% increase in prediction accuracy in both scenarios, especially evident with increased complexity and actions. Additionally, DeLLMa's structure enables us to comprehend the rationale behind each decision it makes. In summary, our contributions are:
• Introducing DeLLMa, a framework for optimal, human-auditable LLM-based decision-making under uncertainty, employing a multi-step scaffolding approach.
• Detailing and implementing a specific version of this framework tailored to address a subset of decision problems that is compatible with current LLMs.
