Oregon Food Bank CEO Susannah Morgan emphasizes the critical need for food as daily life faces disruptions due to the COVID-19 pandemic. With schools closed and many people facing job loss, the demand for food assistance is on the rise.

Despite the challenges, food remains available through various channels, including the Oregon Food Bank's warehouse in Northeast Portland, which currently holds 4 million pounds of food. The organization also works with over 1,400 partner pantries and food assistance sites across Oregon and southwest Washington.

The demand for food assistance has surged by 20 to 30 percent in recent weeks, a trend expected to continue as unemployment rates climb. In response, Morgan urges people to provide financial support instead of organizing food drives, as handling donated food poses logistical challenges during the pandemic.

Morgan, with her extensive experience in disaster relief efforts, acknowledges the unique nature of the current crisis, which impacts everyone on an ongoing basis. She emphasizes the importance of unity and generosity in the face of adversity, urging individuals to tap into their compassion and support one another.

As the situation evolves, the Oregon Food Bank remains committed to meeting the increasing need for food assistance and encourages the community to contribute to their efforts through financial donations.

My mother had always insisted that I never enter the drawing room, and my father’s stern glance over the top of his glasses spoke louder than any words. I had always followed their rules, as they’d given me no reason not to. My older brother, John, was a clear example of the consequences of defiance—he hadn’t been home in years.

That afternoon, however, was different. My parents were out, and the house was mine. It was a warm, lazy Sunday with a soft breeze flowing in through the open windows. The neighborhood was quiet; most of my friends were away at sailing or tennis camps. I had just finished a mystery novel about a young girl who discovers a secret cave and solves an accidental murder. Perhaps it stirred something in me—a longing for adventure, nostalgia for my brother's antics, or maybe I was simply bored. Whatever the reason, I found myself standing before the closed oak door to the forbidden room. I loved its look and how the heavy doorknob felt cold in my hand despite the warm day. I turned the knob, and the door opened softly.

The room was almost blinding in its brightness. A soft lace curtain fluttered in the breeze of the open bay window. An ornate wooden desk faced the outside, with a matching chair positioned neatly. Despite being filled with pens and stationery, the desk was organized, as if on display. A dress pattern hung on a sewing mannequin, quite lovely yet dated—unusual, as my mother didn’t sew. I giggled at the thought that it might belong to my father. Considering it was just the three of us living there, I couldn’t fathom who used the room or why. Framed calligraphy adorned the walls, so perfectly done that I assumed it was a print, though I would later learn it was my mother's handwriting, and each piece had taken her months to complete.

As I admired the plush white carpeting, so different from the rest of the house, my attention turned to the bureau. Despite having already broken so many rules, I hesitated to open it. But curiosity won, and I figured the punishment wouldn’t be much worse for doing so. I turned the delicate knob, and it clicked open. An unplaceable but loved scent filled the air. The bureau housed old coats and dresses, with hat boxes lined along the top shelf. Small drawers held jewelry and stiff white elbow-length gloves. The scent would come and go, revealing itself with each drawer I opened or coat I brushed against. I buried my face into the heaviest coat, trying to breathe more of it in. That’s how my mother found me—wrapped in a fur coat, eyes closed, wondering why such a perfect room had been kept from me.

“All of this belonged to your grandmother. We redid the house when she died, everything but this room. This is exactly how she left it,” my mother explained, sitting on the floor next to me. “You loved her so much as a baby. She’d babysit you while your father was overseas and I was at work. You’d cry every night I came to pick you up and run into her arms every morning I dropped you off. At the time, I felt jealous. When your father returned and I stopped working, I told her I wouldn’t need her help raising my children. I threw away her cards for you, wouldn’t let her visit you kids for months.” As she spoke, my mother’s eyes filled with tears of regret. I had always seen her as the epitome of grace and perfection, so I didn’t think it was as terrible as she made it out to be.

Over the past decade, images have been getting increasingly larger. Consumer cameras on smartphones now capture images at 4K resolution, which is roughly 8.3 million pixels, while professional DSLR cameras capture images at 8K resolution. In other fields, sensors on satellites and microscopes capture images with over a billion pixels. However, modern computer vision pipelines are limited by the memory in the systems they are trained upon, resulting in the development of models that only operate on small images.

Computer vision practitioners often limit the size of images using two less-than-ideal methods: down-sampling or cropping. While these simple operations produce powerful models when measured against typical computer vision benchmarks, they result in the loss of high-frequency information or global context, which is crucial for many real-world tasks. For instance, consider a video feed of a football game captured in 8K resolution. A model attempting to determine where a player on the left side of the screen will pass the ball to on the right side cannot analyze the entire image in one pass. The image, the downstream model, and all intermediate tensors cannot fit into the memory of modern, large VRAM GPUs. A common approach is to process the image by treating it as individual "windows," each fed through the model without sharing context, resulting in sub-optimal performance.

To address these challenges, we introduce xT, a framework that allows myopic vision backbones to effectively integrate local and global context over large images. Our approach tackles the issues of quadratically-increasing GPU memory utilization and the integration of context across very large images. We achieve this by enhancing the strengths of hierarchical vision backbones through nested tokenization of images and processing resulting features with long-sequence models from the field of natural language processing, such as Transformer-XL and Mamba.

The key to our method is the nested tokenization of large images at multiple levels: at the region level for the region encoders and then at the patch level inside the encoders to capture local details. The image regions then undergo independent, hierarchical encoding by passing through a vision backbone that serves as a region encoder. Hierarchical region encoders yield down-sampled features, which, when combined with context encoders, allow us to process more regions simultaneously than typically possible. One such context encoder, Transformer-XL, is illustrated in Stage 2. It processes previous sequence tokens recurrently using cross-attention, significantly extending its context range with depth. The resulting sequence, enriched with both local and global context, is finally fed to a task-specific decoder.

xT matches and surpasses the performance of competitive large image architectures on multiple downstream tasks that require large visual contexts, such as segmentation, detection, and classification.

Ce dimanche-là, par pur hasard, Anne Hidalgo et Marine Le Pen lancent leur campagne présidentielle simultanément. Bien que leurs univers et leurs électeurs potentiels soient très différents, cela ne semble pas les déranger. Cependant, pour ceux qui suivent les deux discours à la télévision l'un après l'autre, le contraste est frappant : l'une est très inspirée tandis que l'autre semble perdue. Pourtant, elles portent toutes les deux une veste bleu ciel.

Marine Le Pen semble encore en quête d'identité. Elle a cependant trouvé un mot qui lui permet de réaffirmer ses convictions fondamentales : celui de « libertés ». Elle aborde des sujets tels que la civilisation, l'immigration (Zemmour étant désormais dans le paysage) tout en attirant de nouveaux publics : les anti-pass, les "gilets jaunes", les petits entrepreneurs, les femmes et les jeunes. Au final, presque imperceptiblement, elle poursuit son travail de décentralisation du programme économique.

"I'm nervous," she confessed, anxiously pushing up the bridge of her glasses with quick, short jabs of her index finger. 

"Don't be. I think this stuff is full of nonsense anyway," I replied, shoving my hands deep into my pockets and sighing softly as we walked toward the center.

"So, you're not scared at all? What if it says tomorrow?" she pressed.

With a playful smirk, I shrugged. "Then you and I would grab a few rounds at McGinney's and toast to my life tonight." Her quiet laugh and a gentle elbow jab to my side revealed she wasn't quite herself. "Just relax, Emily," I reassured her.

We turned the corner and ascended the stone stairs. Large lampposts flanked either side, remnants of the city's past standing tall amidst its vast remodeling. Such hints of our history always comforted me—reminders that not everything had changed. However, one light wasn't working, and the other flickered and buzzed ominously as we passed beneath. Our eyes followed it briefly before we opened the door and stepped inside.

Emily entered first and joined the line. The center was lined with confessional-style booths along the walls. People entered, sometimes in pairs but never more than two at a time. Some emerged smiling, others expressionless, and a few appeared shaken, shocked, or even in full hysterics. As we stood there for what seemed like half an hour, taking only half-steps forward, I noticed there weren't any older people. The oldest person I saw leaving was in their mid-fifties. Perhaps they knew something we didn't, or maybe they simply didn't care. Maybe they had the right approach.

"C'mon..." Emily grabbed my hand, pulling me from my inner contemplation, and led us to the booth. We slipped behind the curtain together.

The process was simple. You placed your finger into a small contraption that inserted a tiny needle, drew a minute amount of blood, and displayed your results on a computer screen in under a minute. We glanced over the automated directions, and I was about to put my finger in when Emily stopped me. 

"No," she insisted, pulling my hand away. "I want to go first. I can't wait anymore." I nodded, and she obliged. The screen prompted, "You will feel a small pinch." Emily's slender figure gave a tiny jolt. For some reason, I expected some sort of computer sounds—beeping or booping, perhaps. Instead, there was silence. 

"Your results are ready. Please sign using the touch-pad to indicate you are ready to see your results. Thank you, and good luck." 

"Good luck?" I scoffed, shaking my head at the screen. "Ready?"

"No," she said flatly, quickly signing her initials across the smudged pad before she could rethink her decision.

Barranquilla (Colombia), 29 jul (EFE).- Con una marca de 66,30 metros, la mejor de su carrera, Mauricio Ortega le entregó hoy el oro a Colombia en la prueba de lanzamiento de disco de los Juegos Centroamericanos y del Caribe de Barranquilla.

En su primer intento, Ortega batió su mejor registro personal, que era de 65,84 metros, y derrotó al cubano Jorge Fernández, quien hizo un lanzamiento de 65,27 metros, su mejor de la temporada pero insuficiente para imponerse al colombiano.

En el tercer puesto terminó el jamaiquino Travis Smilke, que en su último lanzamiento realizó una marca de 64,68 metros, 3,89 metros más que el mexicano Mario Cota, quien ocupó el cuarto lugar.

Los otros tres competidores de la prueba fueron el jamaiquino Basil Bingham, el curazaleño Joshua Phelipa y el hondureño Winston Campbell.

The Union Minister of State for Education, Subhas Sarkar, informed the Rajya Sabha on November 22 that there are currently 3,900 vacant teaching posts and over 3,000 ad-hoc teachers working in colleges affiliated with the University of Delhi. The issue of ad-hoc teachers has been a prominent one in nearly every movement led by the DU Teachers' Association in recent years but has yet to be resolved.

In response to a question raised in the Lok Sabha in August, the government stated that there were only 58 ad-hoc teachers at DU. So, how did the number suddenly escalate to 3,000? Well, the data provided in August was specific to the university departments and did not include the affiliated colleges. However, Dr. Shabana Azmi, an ad-hoc teacher of Political Science at Zakir Husain College, contested this figure during the recent DUTA elections, claiming that, according to electoral rolls, there are more than 4,000 ad-hoc teachers. She emphasized the need to scrutinize how the government arrived at their count.

Ad-hoc teachers have long been advocating for absorption, with support from the left-led DUTA, though Dr. Azmi believes more action is required. She expressed dissatisfaction with the lack of significant support from teachers' groups and criticized the way the issue was sidelined during a recent Executive Council meeting. Dr. Azmi, a member of the Adhoc Teachers Front (ATF), highlighted the disparity in treatment compared to permanent faculty members who receive promotions while ad-hoc teachers face uncertainty.

Ad-hoc teachers now hesitate to participate in interviews due to reported instances of displacement for newer recruits. They also raised concerns about the requirement of a PhD for appointments, stressing that many ad-hoc teachers have been unable to complete their doctorate due to job commitments. Dr. Azmi questioned the sudden change in qualification criteria from a Master's degree to a PhD.

To address these grievances, ad-hoc teachers plan to engage with DUTA, relevant officials, and the Education Ministry before considering a full-fledged protest, similar to that of 2019. Dr. Azmi mentioned that newly elected DUTA President, Dr. AK Bhagi, promised to champion the cause of ad-hoc teachers. If dialogue fails to yield results, ad-hoc teachers are prepared to take to the streets, with the support of permanent faculty members.

DUTA witnessed a significant change with the election of Dr. AK Bhagi from the RSS-affiliated National Democratic Teachers Front as the DUTA President. Dr. Bhagi highlighted some progress in efforts to absorb ad-hoc teachers, citing small victories such as maternity leave entitlements for ad-hoc teachers. He identified this issue alongside the demand for salaries for teachers in 12 DU colleges under the Delhi government as critical agendas for DUTA.

ظهرت صورة للنجم محمد صلاح، لاعب منتخب مصر والمحترف في صفوف ليفربول الإنجليزي، في حديقة الأورمان بالجيزة من خلال رسم بالنجيل الطبيعي. 

بدأت فكرة الجرافيتي ورسم وجه صلاح بعد تألقه في الملاعب الأوروبية وتفوقه على نجوم العالم، ليصبح أيقونة للشباب. هذه المرة، قام الفنان هشام الجلاد، المتخصص في الرسم بالزهور، باستغلال أعياد شم النسيم واحتفالات الربيع ليقوم خلال معرض الزهور بحديقة الأورمان، برسم صورة لصلاح باستخدام النجيل الطبيعي، وهو عمل يتطلب خبرة واسعة في مجال الزراعة.

لاقى البورتريه الطبيعي إعجاب زوار المعرض، وتزايدت الطلبات لشرائه، إلا أن الجلاد رفض التنازل عنه، ولكنه سمح للزوار بتصويره. تتميز البورتريه بشكل خاص بلحية محمد صلاح المميزة، حيث حرص الجلاد على أن تكون مصنوعة بالكامل من النجيل الطبيعي القابل للنمو، حيث يرويها يوميًا باستخدام "رشاش" مياه خاص، ويقوم بتهذيبها بمقص صغير، وكأن اللاعب المصري تحت يده في صالون حلاقة. ويتخيل الجلاد هذا المشهد يوميًا وهو يقف أمام الصورة مستعدًا للقيام بالمهمة.

La foire d'art contemporain Art Up! investira les locaux du Grand Palais à Lille pour la 13e fois du jeudi 5 au dimanche 8 mars 2020. Cette édition mettra en avant le travail de 750 artistes exposés par une centaine de galeristes, venant de la région, de France et de l'étranger. Didier Vesse, à la direction de l'événement depuis plus de dix ans, a présenté cette édition axée sur le textile, une tendance observée depuis plusieurs années.

Le thème du textile, choisi pour cette édition, s'intègre parfaitement au Nord, région historiquement liée à l'industrie textile. Dès l'entrée de la foire, les visiteurs pourront identifier le thème à travers une coulée de stands jusqu'au bar, mettant en avant l'exposition des élèves d'écoles d'art de l'Euro-région et les galeristes qui s'y sont associés.

En 2019, la foire a accueilli plus de 40 000 visiteurs, une moyenne de 10 000 personnes par jour, et pour cette édition, l'objectif est d'attirer toujours plus de monde. Des galeristes locaux, de la région parisienne, de Belgique, des Pays-Bas, et d'autres régions de France et du monde participeront à l'événement, soulignant l'importance de la représentation locale et internationale.

Art Up! s'est imposé au fil des ans comme un rendez-vous incontournable des amateurs d'art à Lille, attirant une clientèle fidèle et diversifiée. En plus des œuvres exposées, la foire propose diverses animations telles que des conférences, une "Nuit de l'art" et des ateliers pour toute la famille. Le programme dense est le reflet de la motivation des galeristes et des artistes, offrant chaque année une expérience riche en découvertes artistiques.

En tant que directeur, Didier Vesse souligne l'importance de la présence des galeristes et artistes sur place pour interagir avec le public et enrichir l'expérience des visiteurs. Art Up! est non seulement un lieu de vente pour les professionnels, mais aussi un espace de découverte pour tous, visant à attirer de nouveaux publics curieux qui deviendront peut-être des passionnés et des collectionneurs au fil des éditions.

In "The Challenge of Exploring Venus," the author suggests that studying Venus is a worthy pursuit despite the dangers it presents.

Venus is often referred to as Earth's "twin" due to its similar density and size, and it is occasionally the closest planet to Earth in terms of distance. Many people acknowledge these similarities, although some remain skeptical, believing it to be a mere celestial body rather than a planet. This resemblance, along with its striking visibility in the sky, has earned it the nickname "the evening star."

Scientists have extensively studied Venus to determine if it could potentially support human life. Despite their efforts, they faced numerous challenges, such as understanding the planet's hostile conditions, and ultimately paused the mission to send humans to Venus. Although the results were initially disappointing, the study of Venus led to the development of new methodologies and the naming of celestial features to enhance public understanding, as the text notes, "Venus, sometimes called the 'evening star.'"

The article demonstrates the resilience and innovation of the scientific community, illustrating that the pursuit of knowledge, even in the face of failure, can lead to the creation of new understanding and the achievement of unexpected successes.

Jack shuffled through the aisles with an awkward box tucked beneath his coat, his gaze vacant. He contemplated his actions, wondering which of the Seven Deadly Sins they fell under—pride, envy, or perhaps sloth, which came third. He had been meaning to read more, perhaps a book or two, eventually, when he found the time. He shrugged, deciding it didn't matter. Either he would leave the store a conceited, vain, but dumb man, or he would end up in handcuffs. Jack's history as an accidental shoplifter was, after all, quite legendary.

The thought of his mother, running a comb through her golden, perhaps even blonde, hair, lingered in his mind, though he wasn't sure if, in reality, it was as long, or if nostalgia had embellished it, making it waist-length and curled.

Por indicación del titular del Ejecutivo, Miguel Barbosa Huerta, el Gobierno del Estado realizará el pago de los cursos presenciales de los meses de abril y mayo a los instructores del Instituto de Capacitación para el Trabajo del Estado de Puebla (ICATEP), anunció el secretario de Gobernación, David Méndez Márquez.

Se conformó una comisión de más de 20 instructores de cursos en línea y presenciales, encabezados por el director del ICATEP, Noé Torralba Flores. En coordinación con el secretario de Gobernación, Méndez Márquez, lograron llegar a este acuerdo.

Tras convenir el pago pendiente de dos meses, el ICATEP se comprometió a presentar un análisis pormenorizado de los cursos y la cantidad de horas, así como una propuesta de las posibles fechas para que los cursos sean impartidos formalmente.

Además, a solicitud de los instructores, se acordó iniciar un proceso de auditoría para detectar y sancionar las presuntas irregularidades en puestos directivos en algunas unidades, ya que estas acciones violentan la normatividad de este Organismo Público Descentralizado.

Explaining the behavior of machine learning algorithms, especially in the context of AI, is a significant challenge in the field of machine learning. The European Union's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) emphasizes the importance of explainable AI, prompting the machine learning community to recognize the need for a better understanding of black-box models. While there has been substantial research on explaining the behavior of supervised machine-learning models, the concept of explanation in Reinforcement Learning (RL) remains unclear. Current efforts in explainable RL often employ techniques similar to those used in explaining supervised classifiers, focusing on what drives an agent's actions in the current environment rather than the intended outcomes of those actions. However, understanding the chain of events an agent intends to unfold as a result of a specific action choice is crucial, as it reflects the agent's reasoning process and sheds light on the decision-making process.

Recent research has highlighted the importance of introspective abilities in RL, emphasizing the need for "Explainable Agency" to enhance the interpretability of an agent's behavior. To address this need, this paper introduces a novel approach to standard value-based RL frameworks that enables the projection of predicted future trajectories based on the current observation and proposed action. Unlike existing methods that rely on repeated forward simulations to predict an agent's future states, the proposed approach recovers the sum of past events weighted by the agent's learning of Q-values, ensuring consistency with the agent's behavioral policy. By mathematically guaranteeing this consistency, the method provides a local interpretation of the agent's intentions, offering valuable insights into the agent's expected behavior.

By presenting a simple addition to RL frameworks that enhances the interpretability of an agent's behavior, this work aims to assist RL practitioners in understanding and debugging model behavior for improved reliability and trustworthiness of RL systems.

SAN ANTONIO – Officials in Texas coastal areas are urging residents to take precautions and plan ahead as Tropical Storm Beta approaches the coastline. Due to possible flooding and damaging winds, several counties and cities have issued voluntary evacuations and disaster declarations. Governor Greg Abbott also issued a disaster declaration for 29 counties, including Bexar, on Monday, just hours before the system is expected to make landfall. It is anticipated to reach land sometime Monday afternoon or evening near Port Lavaca.

德国最大循环经济执行机构瑞曼迪斯台湾区总经理戴英杰指出，德国在2002年曾发生猪口蹄疫，为防止未来再度爆发猪瘟等疫情，德国政府宣布自2005年起禁止以厨余喂猪，从此以后，德国猪改吃饲料。德国政府以政策鼓励民间以厨余、动物粪尿等发展沼气发电，迄今德国有高达8600座沼气发电厂。

HOUSTON — A Houston attorney, Landon Keating, 30, is facing legal charges for allegedly recording a co-worker using the bathroom. Keating is charged with five counts of invasive visual recordings. The victim informed Precinct 4 deputies that she discovered a cell phone hidden in the bathroom of her office. Upon further inspection, she found several videos of herself on the phone, which was owned by Keating.

Precinct 4 investigators, led by Constable Mark Herman, found several hundred video and image files of the victim on the device. The case has been transferred to the High-tech Crimes Unit for further investigation. Keating was subsequently arrested and booked into the Harris County Jail. His bond was set at $25,000, with $5,000 assigned for each count.

Security forces in the Democratic Republic of Congo have been accused of illegally detaining and torturing pro-democracy advocates by Human Rights Watch (HRW) in a recent statement. The crackdown, which occurred just prior to the upcoming presidential election next year, resulted in the arrest of approximately 40 activists, musicians, and journalists during a news conference held in Kinshasa on March 15. The gathering was organized by Congolese and West African campaigners to encourage youth participation in politics.

The government alleges that the organizers were promoting armed insurrection, and a security source informed Reuters that an investigation is underway into the financing of the event. Despite Congolese law requiring that detainees be charged and granted access to legal representation, three activists are currently held by the National Intelligence Agency (ANR) without any formal charges.

In a worrying development, intelligence agents and police in the eastern city of Goma also detained members of the group Struggle for Change (Lucha) who were peacefully protesting against the detentions in Kinshasa. Four Lucha members, arrested on April 7, are now being held in Goma’s central prison on charges of inciting disobedience to public authority, as reported by HRW.

When questioned about the report, government spokesman Lambert Mende redirected inquiries to the prosecutor-general, who did not provide a response to requests for comment.

It just didn't make any sense. All I wanted was to provide a service that met a genuine need. There was so much opportunity in the current market, which is why I majored in business. I dreamed of creating the next hit product that the world would go wild for. Plus, there was the more obvious incentive: I would face virtually no competition. If I could just get something started, boom, I’d have an instant monopoly, and there was no way the government could stop me—after all, the politicians were all clowns.

But I couldn't identify a need. It seemed like all people cared about was being clowns. How could I sell them anything, even if they were willing to buy from me? Then it hit me: clown cars. Proteins are involved in almost all life activities of organisms, making the study of their sequences, structures, characteristics, and roles a major area of research in the life sciences in the postgenomic era. A protein sequence can be thought of as a string of amino acid letters. The residues, structural domains, and families of amino acids that make up a protein resemble words, phrases, and sentences in human language. Therefore, machine learning methods developed for natural language and other sequences are well suited to the task of predicting proteins.

Most sequence-based language models, such as BERT, XLNet, and ELECTRA, are designed to process natural language with a bias towards English. Given the notable parallels between protein sequences and the structure of natural language, employing natural language processing techniques to analyze protein sequences emerges as a logical approach.

ESM-2, developed by Facebook, is recognized as the most extensive protein sequence language model to date, featuring a sophisticated architecture with 48 layers and over 15 billion parameters. This groundbreaking model is trained on an expansive dataset comprising up to 250 million protein sequences sourced from Uniparc, which encompasses 86 billion amino acids. Leveraging this comprehensive base, ESM-Fold emerges as an innovative 3D protein structure prediction tool, offering swift and precise predictions from single inputs. However, challenges arise in the model's reliance on statistical analysis of amino acid compositions, affecting its ability to capture the full functional complexity of proteins.

The computational complexity of ESM-2 and ESM-Fold, coupled with their need for a large amount of computational resources, can pose obstacles for researchers without high-performance computing facilities. Additionally, while ESM-Fold shows promise in predicting protein structures from single sequences, it may struggle with proteins exhibiting complex folding patterns or requiring interactions with other molecules for accurate modeling.

In general, contributions to this research can be categorized into three main areas. One such contribution involves fusing graph pre-training with masked language modeling to refine the ESM2 model, achieving unparalleled performance in protein-centric tasks beyond what ESM2 offers.

Why The Facial Action Coding System Is Irrelevant

Human emotion can be displayed in many ways, such as body language and facial movements. However, it is up to individuals to decide if they want to show their emotions to others. The Facial Action Coding System (FACS) is not valuable because it is a personal choice to reveal emotions, emotions are not essential in a classroom setting, and there are limited benefits to knowing emotions in various careers.

People's emotions are their own, and while they can be influenced by external factors, they do not necessarily have to be shared with others. The article "Making Mona Lisa Smile" suggests that individuals can often infer how someone is feeling based on their facial expressions, rendering FACS redundant in such situations.

In a classroom, the focus is on academic subjects, not emotions. Introducing FACS to a classroom could be disruptive, as students and teachers should prioritize learning over monitoring emotions. Dr. Huang's idea that a classroom computer could detect student emotions and adjust lessons could lead to students manipulating the technology, hindering the learning process.

While understanding emotions can be beneficial in fields like psychology, in a classroom, it is unnecessary. FACS could potentially replace teachers, which would be detrimental to the educational system, as teachers play a crucial role in student development and learning.

The limited benefits, lack of relevance in educational settings, and the potential invasion of privacy, make the Facial Action Coding System a technology of questionable value.

Historical archives and libraries house a diverse array of document sources that capture the memory of the past. Recognizing scanned images of these documents enables the reconstruction of history. A significant subset of archival data comprises historical photographs, brimming with evidence that narrates a snapshot of a bygone era. By keenly observing subtle cues present in various objects within the scene—such as clothing, hairstyles, surroundings, tools, machinery, and natural landscapes—one can glean important insights to estimate the photograph's creation date. Furthermore, texture and color features can also aid in accurately determining the image's age, as photographic techniques have evolved over time, leaving distinct date imprints.

Estimating the creation date of cultural heritage photographic assets is a complex endeavor typically undertaken by experts, like archivists or genealogists, who leverage their specialized knowledge of these visual clues to provide precise date assessments for undated photographs. However, manual analysis is labor-intensive and costly, prompting a growing interest in automated image date estimation models to streamline large-scale archival processing with minimal human intervention.

Traditionally, date estimation methods for historical images revolve around direct computation through classification or regression. In this paper, we introduce an innovative approach for estimating the date of historical photographs within a retrieval framework. This method incorporates the date estimation of photographs into the ranked search results for a given query image, offering a contextualized prediction based on the other images in the collection. Even in cases where the exact date remains elusive, users can derive valuable insights from the relative ordering of photographs, aiding in annotating document sources within archives.

Our proposed model for historical photograph retrieval hinges on a novel ranking loss function, smooth-nDCG, grounded in the Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain ranking metric. This approach enables the training of our system based on known relevance feedback, such as the distance in years between images.

Central to our methodology is optimizing rankings to elevate images with dates closer to the query image, resulting in higher ranks. When presented with an unknown image as a query, the method calculates distances to a support dataset comprising images with known dates. By assuming that highly ranked images share the same date, the system estimates the date of the query image.

Unlike existing literature, our method not only predicts but also ranks images based on a query. By prioritizing images in chronological order relative to the query, our system can retrieve a list of images sorted by temporal proximity, which holds relevance for diverse applications and systems reliant on sifting through vast datasets.

Highly constrained problems are at the core of a wide variety of different applications (e.g. scheduling, hardware verification, or robotic manipulation planning). To robustly tackle such problems, they are represented as constrained optimization or satisfaction problems, and one aims to find a diverse set of feasible solutions.

Focusing on problems in continuous domains, there are two main approaches to generate solutions. The first is to use a nonlinear solver to generate a joint assignment for all variables simultaneously. However, joint optimization is sensitive to the initial guess and prone to converging to infeasible points or the same local optima, especially in highly nonlinear problems. The second approach involves decomposing the problem by sequentially assigning subsets of variables. Yet, this method is often impractical due to joint constraints on variables. Defining dedicated constraint manifold sampling operations and a sampling order requires a deep understanding of the problem domain. While defining good decompositions works for simple or structured settings, it is suboptimal for complex scenarios.

In this work, we present an algorithm that efficiently generates a diverse set of solutions for high-dimensional nonlinear programs with many infeasible local optima. Our method leverages the factored structure of the problem and the factored graph representation of the task. This allows us to reason online about the best sequence of constrained conditional sampling operations, thereby optimizing for success rate and computation time.

Our approach focuses on problems in robotic sequential manipulation, which involve finding feasible solutions satisfying kinematic and dynamic constraints imposed by the robot and the environment, potentially influenced by future actions and goals. These problems encode discrete structures due to mode-switches representing contact or kinematic changes. By generating a diverse set of feasible mode-switches and optimizing trajectories considering the entire set, we can address infeasibility and suboptimality issues encountered with a single mode-switching sequence.

For example, in a pick-and-place problem, with robot configurations, joint values, and relative transformations, different sampling sequences can be used to generate a full sample, such as jointly optimizing all variables, sampling the relative transformation first, and then computing robot configurations, or computing the pick configuration and relative transformation first, and then the place configuration.

Our main contributions include a new framework for modeling constrained conditional sampling in constraint graphs and computation operations as a stochastic decision process, pruning strategies that reduce the possible computations based on the factored constraint graph representation, and an algorithm using Monte-Carlo Tree Search to find sequences of computational operations that maximize generated solutions within a fixed computational time.

The speculation surrounding Mark Little's potential move to Peterborough has sparked discussions among fans. Recently, large language models (LLMs)—extensive deep learning models based on the transformer architecture—have been introduced [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]. Notably, researchers from OpenAI were the first to present a commercial LLM, namely GPT-3.5, a large generative model pre-trained on natural language and source code. Similarly, Rozière et al. [2] from Meta introduced Code LLaMA, an open-source LLM based on the LLaMA-2 model [3] further trained with source code.

Prior studies have experimented with various approaches to leverage LLMs, such as prompt engineering [6, 7, 8], few-shot learning [9, 10, 11], and model fine-tuning [12, 13, 14], for downstream tasks. For instance, Arora et al. [7] proposed a prompt design based on question-answering, which helps an open-source LLM outperform GPT-3, even when few-shot learning is employed. Another example, Brown et al. [9], conducted an empirical study on few-shot learning, applying it to LLMs for a variety of natural language processing (NLP) tasks. Additionally, Chen et al. [14] conducted an experimental study, fine-tuning an LLM, specifically, GPT-3, on source code.

Le Rwanda célèbre ce jeudi le 25e anniversaire du « Jour de la libération », qui marque la fin du génocide de 1994 perpétré contre les Tutsis et le début d’une nouvelle ère de réconciliation, d’union et de développement. Placée sous le thème « Ensemble nous prospérons », cette fête nationale, qui coïncide avec le 4 juillet, commémore le jour où les Rwandais se sont engagés dans un long cheminement pour transformer le pays après la défaite du régime génocidaire, chassé par le Front patriotique rwandais (FPR) sous la conduite de Paul Kagame.

Cette journée sera ponctuée par une série d’activités en liaison avec la mémoire du génocide et l’histoire de la libération du Rwanda, faite d’échanges et réflexions, de programmes de sensibilisation dans tout le pays, et d’une cérémonie officielle au stade Amahoro (paix). Comme à l’accoutumée, le président rwandais, accompagné de dignitaires invités, présidera jeudi la cérémonie officielle de commémoration de la journée de la libération au stade Amahoro de la capitale rwandaise. Plusieurs dirigeants et hauts responsables d’Afrique et d’ailleurs sont attendus à cette fête nationale qui célèbre également l’essor économique du Rwanda, dont Kigali est devenue la vitrine moderne.

L’anniversaire de la libération, qui sera fêté dans tout le pays et parmi la diaspora rwandaise dans le monde entier, marque également la fin d’un deuil national de 100 jours, le temps qu’a duré le génocide entre avril et juillet 1994, faisant près d’un million de morts. Fort des leçons du passé, le Rwanda se présente aujourd’hui, vingt-cinq ans après le génocide, comme une success story en termes de stabilité, de développement et de croissance, et un modèle africain en matière de bonne gouvernance, de politiques sociales et de protection de l’environnement.

« Kwibohora (jour de la libération) est l’occasion de s’arrêter sur les réalisations et les acquis du Rwanda pendant un quart de siècle et de jeter la lumière sur le travail qui doit être accompli par les Rwandais durant les années à venir », a souligné mercredi le président rwandais Paul Kagame dans un discours diffusé sur les antennes de la télévision nationale. S’adressant aux citoyens rwandais, le chef d’État a affirmé qu’il reste beaucoup à faire pour la transformation du pays en relevant « qu’il appartient à chaque citoyen de prendre la mesure de sa responsabilité personnelle en accomplissant son devoir ».

拜登政府为了加速处理边境紧急拘留中心中数千名无证儿童的问题，已要求联邦调查局（FBI）停止对工作人员及志愿者进行指纹背景审查。儿童福利专家对此感到震惊，并表示这将危害儿童的安全。

目前，边境巡逻紧急拘留中心已达人满之患，并被指不适合作为拘留设施。为加速让这些无证儿童离开，拜登政府团队采取了新措施，包括将由私人承包商运营的帐篷营地、会议中心以及其他大型设施纳入使用，这些做法过去多届政府均有采用。

仅在3月，拜登政府就宣布在南德州设立了八个新的紧急庇护所，新增1万5000张床位，是现有规模的两倍以上。这些紧急庇护所无需州政府许可，也无需提供与HHS永久设施相同的服务，但成本却远高，平均每个儿童每日要花费775元。

为了加速释放并安置这些儿童，拜登政府已豁免了要求工作人员和志愿者通过指纹背景审查程序的规定。这一程序的初衷是为了保护庇护中心的儿童。不过，HHS发表声明指出，有关工作人员和志愿者仍需通过公开的刑事纪录审查。

对于豁免有关人员指纹审查的做法，HHS督察长承认FBI的指纹审查提供了独特的保障。移民维权组织Every Last One的执行董事、儿童精神病专家艾咪·科恩（Amy Cohen）指出，如果不对前线人员进行指纹检查，最弱势的无证儿童将面临严重的身体和性虐待危险。

目前有5000多名无证儿童被拘留在边境，其中大部分被关押在南德州的帐篷设施中。维权组织声称，政府必须加快安置这些儿童，而不是开设更多无人照顾的紧急设施。到目前为止，所有设施内仍有1万8000名儿童和少年等待释放和安置，这一数字每天都在增加。

كشف التقرير أن مبيعات الهواتف الذكية تراجعت بنسبة 5.8 في المئة خلال الربع الرابع من عام 2017، وأن إجمالي المبيعات انخفض إلى 408 مليون وحدة خلال الفترة من أكتوبر حتى ديسمبر الماضي، مقارنة مع 432 مليون وحدة في نفس الفترة من 2016.

وأكدت "غارتنر" أن هذا التراجع هو الأول منذ عام 2004، مشيرة إلى أن الشركتين الصينيتين للهواتف الذكية "هواوي" و"شاومي" كانتا البائعتين الوحيدتين ضمن أكبر 5 شركات في السوق (سامسونغ وأبل وأوبو ...) التي شهدت نموا في المبيعات خلال الفترة المشار إليها.

وفيما يتعلق بأداء الشركات الكبرى، تراجعت مبيعات سامسونغ إلى 74 مليون وحدة مقابل 77 مليون وحدة، في حين هبطت مبيعات آبل إلى 73 مليون وحدة مقارنة مع 77 مليون وحدة في عام 2016.

Le collectif "Pou La Gwiyann dékolé" ("Pour que la Guyane décolle") a décidé de lever les barrages "jusqu'à nouvel ordre", après plus de trois semaines de conflit social en Guyane et un fossé croissant entre opposants et partisans des blocages. La Guyane était paralysée depuis plus de trois semaines par un mouvement social portant des revendications en matière de sécurité, d'économie et de justice sociale pour permettre à ce territoire d'outre-mer de rattraper son retard par rapport à la métropole.

Une nouvelle réunion du collectif est prévue lundi. Les barrages seront tous ouverts, à l'exception de quelques-uns jugés stratégiques, notamment celui du Centre spatial guyanais, vitrine économique du territoire mais symbole des inégalités persistantes pour les Guyanais. Ce mouvement social a empêché le lancement de la fusée Ariane depuis plus de trois semaines.

"Les barrages sont ouverts, mais pas levés."

Le collectif, par le biais de son porte-parole Mikael Mancée, leader charismatique du mouvement des 500 Frères contre la délinquance, dont la particularité est de se déplacer cagoulés, a immédiatement annoncé sur Guyane 1re : "Les barrages sont ouverts, mais pas levés", soulignant que la mobilisation se poursuivait. "La circulation est rétablie, en cette période culturelle forte pour la Guyane", a-t-il assuré. Le week-end de Pâques est un moment très suivi par la population guyanaise.

Le collectif, constitué de socio-professionnels, d'associations, de syndicats et d'élus, a également refusé qu'une délégation se rende à Paris pour rencontrer François Hollande. L'idée d'une telle délégation avait été évoquée dans l'après-midi, mais elle n'a finalement pas été retenue afin de marquer "la colère de la population envers un président qui n'a jamais prêté attention à eux depuis le début du mouvement", a déclaré un membre du collectif, Youri Antoinette.

Se structurer en "pôles"

Au cours de la journée, les socio-professionnels ont expressément demandé "la levée des barrages routiers qui les divisent" pour "perpétuer l'esprit du 28 mars [date d'une mobilisation historique en Guyane, NDLR] et sauver les emplois guyanais". "Nous sommes mobilisés, cela ne s'arrêtera plus, nous avons soulevé quelque chose qui ne sera pas oublié. Nous sommes engagés pour des mois", a averti Mikael Mancée. Le collectif a décidé de se structurer en différents "pôles" pour la suite du mouvement. "Nous élaborons des dossiers concernant l'ensemble du territoire, dans tous les domaines", a-t-il expliqué.

El Departamento de Hacienda ha comenzado a enviar correos electrónicos a los 502,203 contribuyentes para informarles que la mayoría de ellos son elegibles para recibir un pago de $1,200 como parte del plan para mitigar el impacto económico del COVID-19, según lo establece la ley conocida como Cares Act.

La comunicación establece que la agencia utilizará la información de la cuenta bancaria proporcionada en la planilla de contribución sobre ingresos del 2019 para realizar el depósito directo del dinero federal.

El correo electrónico que reciben los contribuyentes no indica la fecha en la que se reflejará el depósito del dinero. Sin embargo, Hacienda había informado que esperan comenzar a enviar los $1,200 a partir del próximo lunes, 27 de abril.

"Una vez que el Departamento del Tesoro Federal apruebe el Plan de Distribución presentado por el Departamento de Hacienda, como lo requiere la ley Cares Act, procederemos a realizar el pago a través de depósito directo", establece la agencia.

Además, la agencia gubernamental enfatiza en su mensaje que no es necesario realizar ningún trámite para recibir el Pago de Impacto Económico.

Se distribuirá en fases, comenzando por los contribuyentes que presentaron las planillas de 2019 y, posteriormente, los de 2018. Sin embargo, los contribuyentes del último año deberán esperar a que la agencia complete un proceso de sincronización de diferentes bases de datos para identificarlos.

قال مصطفى عبدالنبى، بقال تموينى فى محافظة أسيوط، إنه رغم سداد قيمة السلع التى تقدم بطلب الحصول عليها وهى السكر، والأرز، والزيت، والشاى ناعم، والمسلى، والتونة، والأجبان وزن ربع كيلو، لم يحصل عليها بالكامل، موضحاً أن المواطنين الذين يتعامل معهم لا يفضلون الشاى الخرز.

أكد ماجد نادى، المتحدث الرسمى باسم نقابة بقالى التموين، أن باقى السلع المدرجة على قائمة المقررات التموينية، التى من المفترض أن تطرح للمواطنين، حاملى البطاقات التموينية فى شهر فبراير لم يسلمها مسئولو مخازن شركتى الجملة للبقالين حتى الآن، رغم دفع قيمتها المالية.

يشار إلى أن وزارة التموين أصدرت توجيهًا وزاريًا فى أكتوبر الماضى، يلزم بقالو التموين بدفع قيمة السلع التى يحصلون عليها، فى الفترة من 21 إلى 25 من كل شهر، على أن يتسلموها يوم 27، تمهيدًا لبيعها لأصحاب البطاقات التموينية.

أكد عدد من بقالى التموين لـ«المال»، أن أزمة عدم توافر باقى السلع والمقررات التموينية الخاصة بشهر فبراير الجارى، لا تزال مستمرة حتى الآن، مطالبين بسرعة توفير باقى المقررات.

يشار إلى أن عدد البطاقات التموينية يصل إلى 20 مليون بطاقة ذكية، يستفيد منها ما يقرب من 70 مليون مواطن، ويحصل الفرد على 50 جنيهاً شهريًا، والتعامل من خلال 30 ألف بقال تموينى على مستوى الجمهورية، و3 آلاف فرع مجمع استهلاكى.

تحوى قائمة المقررات التموينية على ما يقرب من 60 سلعة غذائية وغير غذائية، متاحة شهريا أمام البقالين فى المخازن التابعة للتموين، منها الأرز، والسكر، والزيت، والألبان الجافة، والأجبان، والمكرونة، والعدس، ومنظفات بأوزان وأصناف مختلفة مثل الصابون، والكلور، ومساحيق الغسيل.

قال إن فروع المجمعات الاستهلاكية الثلاث، الأهرام، والنيل، والإسكندرية، تتوافر بها كل السلع التموينية، ومتاح لأصحاب البطاقات التموينية الحصول على السلع الخاصة بالبطاقة، من أى جهة سواء بقالة تموينية، أو مجمعًا استهلاكيا، أو فروع جمعيتى.

Live commenting is an emerging feature of online video platforms that enables real-time comments to fly across the screen or appear alongside the video, allowing viewers to engage with comments and video content simultaneously. Automatic live commenting seeks to enhance viewer interaction by providing additional opinions and responding to comments from other viewers, thus encouraging user engagement on online video sites. Moreover, it serves as an excellent testbed for models dealing with multi-modal information, requiring the integration of vision, text, and audio to produce video comments. As such, it is both an intriguing and vital task for human-AI interaction.

Despite significant advancements in multimodal learning, live commenting remains a challenging endeavor. Recent research on live commenting utilizes an encoder-decoder model to generate comments. However, these models often fail to explicitly capture the interaction between video content and comments, resulting in comments that are generic and irrelevant to the specific video. Figure 1, for instance, demonstrates that encoder-decoder models tend to produce popular, generic comments, such as "Oh, my God!", in contrast to the more informative and video-relevant reference comments, like, "The cat is afraid of spicy." This occurs because the encoder-decoder models prioritize the language model, neglecting the video-comment interaction, and, to minimize empirical risk, resort to generating frequent, safe, and, often, less meaningful comments.

أعلن المبعوث الأممي إلى اليمن، مارتن غريفيث، أنه عقد اجتماعا إيجابيا ومثمرا، أمس الاثنين، مع نائب وزير الدفاع السعودي، الأمير خالد بن سلمان. وأشار المبعوث الأممي، على حسابه على "تويتر"، اليوم الثلاثاء، إلى "جهود ظافرة تحت قيادة الأمير خالد بن سلمان لاستعادة النظام والاستقرار في جنوب اليمن". وقال إنه اتفق مع نائب وزير الدفاع السعودي على "ضرورة استمرار الحوار".

وأسفرت معارك نشبت خلال الشهر الحالي، بين قوات الحكومة اليمنية والمجلس الانتقالي في عدن، عن استيلاء عناصر الأخير على العديد من معسكرات الفريق الأول، فضلا عن قصر معاشيق الرئاسي ومؤسسات حكومية أخرى. ولم يتوقف القتال إلا بعد تهديد قوات التحالف باستخدام القوة ضد المخالفين للهدنة.

وطالبت قوات التحالف بقيادة السعودية، قوات المجلس الانتقالي بالانسحاب من المواقع التي استولت عليها من قوات الرئيس اليمني، عبد ربه منصور هادي. واشترط التحالف إتمام الانسحاب قبل بدء حوار دعت إليه الرياض بين الحكومة اليمنية وعناصر المجلس الانتقالي من أجل التوصل إلى تسوية.

ووصلت لجنة سعودية إماراتية، الخميس الماضي، إلى عدن للإشراف على انسحاب قوات المجلس الانتقالي من المؤسسات الحكومية والعسكرية في المدينة.

ويقدم المبعوث الأممي إلى اليمن، اليوم الثلاثاء، إحاطة إلى مجلس الأمن حول أحداث عدن. يمكنكم مشاهدة البث الحي لإحاطة المبعوث الأممي إلى اليمن مارتن غريفيث لمجلس الأمن اليوم في تمام الساعة 10 صباحاً نيويورك/5 مساءً اليمن، عبر موقع الأمم المتحدة.

Dany Delmas, qui a hissé Infaco au rang de leader mondial du sécateur sur batterie, vient de recevoir l’Ordre national du mérite, un honneur qui suscite une grande fierté pour ce chef d’entreprise de Cahuzac-sur-Vère.

Le mercredi 10 novembre, c’est la ministre déléguée chargée de l’industrie, Agnès Panier-Runacher, qui a remis en personne la médaille de chevalier et le ruban bleu à Dany Delmas, dans les locaux du ministère. Entouré de son épouse Michèle, de ses enfants et petits-enfants, ainsi que de Paul Salvador et Michel Bonnet, maire de Cahuzac-sur-Vère, Dany Delmas affichait un grand sourire. En signe de gratitude, il a apporté des bouteilles de Gaillac pour le personnel.

Il y a un an, la ministre avait demandé aux députés de proposer des candidats pour l’Ordre National du Mérite. Marie-Christine Verdier-Jouclas, députée, avait immédiatement pensé à Dany Delmas pour sa contribution remarquable avec Infaco. Davy Delmas, son fils, avait alors fourni les éléments nécessaires pour constituer un dossier qui suivit son cours.

Quelques jours avant la cérémonie, seul son fils Davy et la députée étaient dans la confidence, alors que Dany Delmas, loin de se douter de l’honneur qui l’attendait, était à la chasse en Espagne avec des amis.

Pour mémoire, Dany Delmas a créé Infaco et lancé le premier sécateur Electrocoup en 1984, depuis son garage. Aujourd’hui, l’entreprise a distribué près de 500 000 sécateurs, emploie 120 salariés et collabore avec 400 distributeurs dans 60 pays. Malgré cette croissance, Infaco est restée ancrée à Cahuzac-sur-Vère, le pays natal de Dany Delmas. À chaque extension, la construction devait se faire sur le site d’origine, sans négocier.

La recherche de la performance est une constante chez Infaco, tant dans l’atelier que dans la relation clients.

المناطق - تبوك - علي العميري:

اختتمت منطقة تبوك ومحافظاتها، أمس، فعاليات وأنشطة أسبوع البيئة لعام 1442 هـ، الذي نظمه فرع وزارة البيئة والمياه والزراعة بالمنطقة بمشاركة الجهات الحكومية والأهلية والروابط والمتطوعين، تحت شعار "البيئة لنا ولأجيالنا".

وتضمنت الفعاليات التي افتتحها وكيل إمارة منطقة تبوك، الأستاذ محمد بن عبدالله الحقباني، العديد من البرامج والأنشطة، كان من أبرزها زراعة وتوزيع أكثر من 27 ألف شتلة على الجهات الحكومية والجمعيات والمواطنين. كما شملت الفعاليات تنظيم 10 فعاليات متنوعة بين حملات تشجير وتنظيف الشواطئ في منطقة تبوك وكافة المحافظات التابعة لها. وتم أيضًا تقديم ثلاث محاضرات عبر الإنترنت، شارك فيها عدد من المختصين والمهتمين بالبيئة، حيث تناولت المحاضرات موضوعات مثل التلوث في المنزل وكيفية تجنبه، وحماية النظم الإيكولوجية ووقف فقدان التنوع البيولوجي، وحلول مبتكرة لمكافحة التصحر. وشارك في أسبوع البيئة أكثر من 400 متطوع ومتطوعة، وتم نشر 25 رسالة توعوية متنوعة عن البيئة.

وأوضح مدير عام فرع الوزارة بمنطقة تبوك، المهندس هزاع بن الأفنس الرويلي، أن هذه الفعاليات تأتي استنادًا إلى قرار مجلس الوزراء بتخصيص أسبوع خاص بالبيئة كل عام، حيث تتولى وزارة البيئة والمياه والزراعة تنظيمه بمشاركة الجهات الحكومية والقطاع الخاص والجمعيات البيئية في أول أسبوع من فصل الربيع من كل عام. وأكد حرص الوزارة على مشاركة الجميع في المحافظة على البيئة بجوانبها كافة، في البر والبحر والجو، والتوسع في زيادة الرقعة الخضراء تحقيقًا لرؤية المملكة 2030م. كما أكد على رفع مستوى الوعي بأهمية الحفاظ على البيئة، وتفعيل دور المؤسسات الحكومية والخاصة والجمعيات الخيرية في هذا الجانب، وزيادة مسؤولية الأفراد تجاه البيئة، والإسهام في الحد من التلوث البيئي.

Many people believe that the rock formation on Mars was created by aliens, but scientists disagree. Initially, scientists thought that the formation, located in Cydonia, was just another Martian mesa, common in that region, with unusual shadows that made it resemble an Egyptian pharaoh. The article explains that a few days later, they observed a massive rock formation that seemed to resemble a human head, but the effect was merely the result of shadows, which created the illusion of eyes, a nose, and a mouth. The rock was not a creation of aliens, but a natural formation, yet it has captured the imagination of many. Scientists are confident that the rock's appearance is the result of natural processes, and not the work of extraterrestrials, although some people have different beliefs about how the rock, somehow, looks like a face.

When the image first appeared on a JPL website, thousands of eager web surfers awaited, only to see a natural landform, not the alien monument they had hoped for.

TALLAHASSEE, Fla. -- While hawksbill turtles are not the only marine turtles endangered by the destabilizing effects of climate change, a recent study by researchers at Florida State University indicates that this critically endangered species is particularly vulnerable.

The study, published in the journal PLOS ONE, was conducted by FSU's Department of Earth, Ocean, and Atmospheric Science. It suggests that projected increases in air temperatures, rainfall, and intense solar radiation could significantly reduce hatching success for hawksbills at several major nesting beaches.

Historically, Earth has experienced numerous climate shifts. However, researchers point out that today's rapid climate changes, combined with unrestrained human development, pose unprecedented threats to hawksbills and other marine turtles.

"Marine turtles have existed for millions of years and have adapted to significant climatic changes during that time," said Mariana Fuentes, Assistant Professor of Oceanography and co-author of the study. "In the past, they adapted by shifting their nesting grounds and seasons to align with more favorable conditions. However, increasing threats to nesting habitats from coastal construction, storms, and rising sea levels are jeopardizing their ability to adapt."

To assess the impact of climate change on hawksbill hatching success, FSU researchers analyzed over 5,000 nests from five Brazilian beaches, where most regional hawksbill nesting occurs. The team focused on five climatic variables—air temperature, rainfall, humidity, solar radiation, and wind speed—to develop a comprehensive model of the subtle effects of a changing climate on the sensitive incubation process.

"There is a lack of research on how climate change might affect hawksbills, especially this population," said Natalie Montero, a former FSU graduate student who led the study. "We chose to investigate the impact on hatchling production because significant changes in the number of baby marine turtles born can dramatically affect population stability."

As reptiles, marine turtles rely on external heat sources for body temperature regulation, making hawksbills and their relatives particularly sensitive to air temperature. This sensitivity is most evident in marine turtle nests, where extreme temperature fluctuations can influence egg incubation, dictate sex ratios, and determine hatching success.

For some marine turtle species, rising temperatures might not necessarily result in less successful incubation. For instance, a study by Montero and Fuentes published earlier this year showed that for loggerhead turtles on the temperate nesting beaches of North Florida, changing conditions might lead to potential short-term increases in hatching success by 1 to 7.6 percent.

However, the outlook for hawksbills is less promising. Montero and Fuentes found that rising air temperatures, coupled with increased rainfall and solar radiation, are projected to reduce overall hatching success at Brazilian nesting sites by up to 11 percent by 2100. Elevated temperatures may warm nests beyond the threshold for healthy incubation, while increased rainfall could saturate the soil and suffocate the embryos.

Even if the turtles manage to incubate successfully and hatch, they face the challenge of heightened solar radiation, which could heat the sand to the point of causing the nests to collapse—a major hazard for hatchlings as they make their way to the sea.

Although the future might seem bleak for this already dwindling species, Montero believes there is still time for humans to mitigate the impact.

"Humans can support marine turtles in numerous ways," she said. "Reducing coastal construction and protecting more coastal habitat will help ensure that both current and future nesting sites are available. It's also crucial to minimize human impact on dune structures and beach vegetation. Additionally, reducing trash and microplastics on the beach can create a higher quality nesting and incubation environment."

Maria A.G. dei Marcovaldi, Milagros Lopez-Mendilaharsu, Alexsandro S. Santos, and Armando J. B. Santos from the Fundação Pró-Tamar in Brazil contributed to this research. The study was supported by grants from the Sea Turtle License Plate Grants Program.

Finite automata, or finite state machines, are the simplest class of computational devices possessing memory. Their memory is finite and stored exclusively as their state, but that alone is enough to make their analysis challenging. In contrast to simpler devices entirely characterisable by mappings of individual inputs to their corresponding outputs, finite automata may need the entire input history to determine their next state or output.

The learning of finite automata is a classical problem in computational learning theory, and can be phrased as follows: given a language L and a set of examples E, use E to find a finite acceptor automaton D that accepts words in L and rejects words not in L, or at least find a D that performs these duties with sufficient accuracy. For instance, L can be the language generated by the regular expression a * bb * . The set of examples E could consist of the entire L, with us placing an additional requirement of conciseness on the learning process to arrive at a single, practical solution (say an automaton with at most three states). Or, E could contain words such as aab and bbb marked as positive examples (the words D should accept), and aaa and aba marked as negative examples (words to be rejected by D).

Strictly algorithmic, formal, statistical, and genetic approaches have all been proposed, but this problem remains open mainly because the solutions lack an agreed single measure of merit. Some have argued for automata that concisely represent E, while others preferred automata that generalised well to L in scenarios where E contains only a few examples representative of the original language. Another degree of freedom arises in the constraints that are placed on E. One can insist that E consists of only positive examples (i.e. E ⊆ L), that E contains enough examples to sanction good generalisation to L (e.g. all repetitions of a pattern beyond a certain count signify that the pattern may be repeated indefinitely), or that E contains both positive and negative examples (i.e. E ∩ L = ∅ = E ∩ L c , where L c denotes words not in L). We give a detailed overview of related work in Sect. II.

This paper proposes a neural model that learns a finite acceptor automaton for target language L from a given E consisting of positive and negative examples. We insist that the logic of the resulting automaton is fully explainable by humans, that the resulting automata generalise well to L despite being based on only E, and that the representations are concise, or at least such that they do not contain too much redundancy of computational logic.

Internally, our model learns a regular grammar rather than a finite automaton.

Diffusion models [13, 36, 38] have seen a significant surge in both capabilities and applications [22, 25, 29]. Among these, Stable Diffusion (SD) [30] and SDXL [27], pre-trained on the large-scale LAION-5B dataset [33], have emerged as powerful generative models. The open-source community has also benefited from various personalized diffusion models available on CivitAI [4], trained using DreamBooth [32] or Low-rank Adaptation (LoRA) [15]. These models can generate creative, high-quality images at their training resolutions, such as 512×512 for SD-based models and 1024×1024 for SDXL-based models, based on provided prompts. However, they often encounter challenges when tasked with generating images at resolutions outside their trained domains. As illustrated in Figure 2, SD-based and personalized diffusion models produce low-resolution images (e.g., 256×256) with poor fidelity and high-resolution images (e.g., 1024×1024) with subpar framing and composition, a phenomenon we term resolution domain inconsistency.

To address these limitations, existing research is categorized into two main approaches. The first is post-processing [1, 9, 16], as seen in models like MultiDiffusion [1] and ElasticDiffusion [9], where images in their trained resolution domain are repeatedly processed and stitched to produce images with flexible resolutions through overlap. However, this method often results in longer inference times due to the complex post-processing operations. The second, more straightforward, approach involves fine-tuning models on a broader range of resolutions, enabling them to generate resolution-free images, as demonstrated by models using LoRA [15]. However, most models on CivitAI [4] lack detailed information about their training datasets, and fine-tuning on general datasets, such as LAION-5B [33], can alter their original style, as shown in Figure 2, a phenomenon we term style domain inconsistency.

Can we, then, develop a plug-and-play resolution adapter, capable of generating images with unrestricted resolutions and aspect ratios, for various diffusion models, without altering their original style domain?

El "Dream Team" fue el nombre que recibió la selección de baloncesto de EE.UU. integrada por las máximas estrellas de la NBA de los años 80 y 90, que compitió en los Juegos Olímpicos de Barcelona. Desde entonces, la expresión ha perdurado para definir a un elenco de notables deportistas. También es aplicable a la "selección" de empresarios y escritores (en algunos casos, ambas cosas a la vez) que aparece en el libro "Aprendiendo de los mejores: tu desarrollo personal es tu destino", del experto español en RR.HH. Francisco Alcaide Hernández.

Dale Carnegie, Napoleón Hill, Robert Kiyosaki, Richard Branson, John Maxwell, Steve Jobs, Jack Welch, Deepak Chopra, Brian Tracy, entre otras personalidades, reflexionan allí sobre el desarrollo personal, los negocios, las empresas, los equipos de trabajo y hasta la vida misma, resumió Federico Muttoni, director de la consultora Advice, al recomendarlo.

"Es muy entretenido, fácil de leer, tiene decenas de aportes y entrega lecciones que pueden ser puestas en práctica rápidamente", resaltó Muttoni.

"Hay que preguntarse qué estamos haciendo, aprendiendo, cambiando hoy que nos esté acercando al lugar en el que queremos estar mañana", afirmó Muttoni a raíz del libro.

"Aprendí muchas cosas de este libro, pero lo más importante está vinculado a lo que dice en su título", indicó. Para el consultor, el desarrollo se sustenta en el aprendizaje permanente y la "predisposición al cambio ágil", dos cualidades personales que resultan claves para la gestión empresarial. "No se pueden dirigir empresas del siglo XXI con estructuras y metodologías del siglo XIX. Lo que cada uno no haga por sí mismo, probablemente otros tampoco lo harán. Hay que preguntarse qué estamos haciendo, aprendiendo, cambiando hoy que nos esté acercando al lugar en el que queremos estar mañana", analizó Muttoni, quien aconsejó "desarrollar nuevas formas de pensar, para abrir nuevas posibilidades para nuestro destino". Y sentenció: "No hay nada peor que la 'esperanza pasiva'. Hay que empujar el desarrollo, aprender, hacer, actuar".

BUENOS AIRES (AP) — Conseguir el peluche de la mascota oficial de los Juegos Olímpicos de la Juventud 2018 se ha vuelto un desafío tan complicado como ganar una medalla.

"Pandi", un yaguareté o jaguar del norte de Argentina, está en el centro de un confuso episodio que involucra a la organización del evento deportivo en Buenos Aires, al fisco y a la empresa que importó los peluches de China.

A diferencia de lo que ocurre en los Juegos Olímpicos, la mascota no está disponible para la venta al público que asiste a las distintas sedes de las disciplinas.

Esto se debe a que la Agencia Federal de Ingresos Públicos (AFIP) retuvo en la aduana unos 5.000 muñecos de peluche porque la empresa importadora no cumplió con los requisitos al declarar la carga.

El gobierno de la ciudad de Buenos Aires licitó a mediados de este año los derechos para la venta de artículos de mercadotecnia de los juegos, entre ellos "Pandi". Hubo un único ofertante, una sociedad llamada "Quiero ver la guita".

Según el fisco, la importadora no declaró los peluches como juguetes, lo cual le habría permitido eludir el pago de un gravamen especial.

Los organizadores de los Juegos declinaron hacer comentarios sobre el caso, como había solicitado The Associated Press, aunque aclararon que se gestionó con el fisco liberar parte de la mercancía retenida en el puerto para la entrega exclusiva de "Pandi" a los atletas.

Los Juegos Olímpicos de la Juventud superaron las expectativas en cuanto a la concurrencia de público. En cada una de las sedes, es frecuente ver largas filas de espectadores desde horas antes del inicio de cada competencia.

Exploring other planets, especially when it's dangerous, raises questions about its worth. In "The Challenge of Exploring Venus," the author argues that studying Venus is indeed a worthy pursuit, despite the inherent risks. To back up this claim, the author presents several compelling reasons.

First, Venus is the planet most similar to Earth. Long ago, Venus likely had vast oceans and could have supported various forms of life, similar to Earth. Even today, Venus shares several features with our planet, including valleys, mountains, and craters, which is why it is often referred to as Earth's "twin."

Next, the challenge of exploring Venus holds significant value. The pursuit of Venus exploration pushes the boundaries of imagination and innovation, spurring technological advancements. Furthermore, the research conducted, such as that by NASA, can lead to new inventions, benefiting humanity. Additionally, exploring Venus can provide profound insights into the planet, enhancing our understanding of the solar system.

Finally, the author argues that the mission to Venus, while dangerous, could potentially be both safe and scientifically productive.

En Panamá, hasta el momento se han registrado alrededor de 1,010 especies de aves, de las cuales unas 12 son consideradas endémicas, lo que significa que solo existen en nuestro país.

Como parte de la fauna silvestre, estas aves están sujetas a las disposiciones contenidas en la Ley 24 de 7 de junio de 1995, "Por la cual se establece la legislación de la Vida Silvestre en la República de Panamá".

También es importante destacar que, según la Resolución No. DM-0657-2016, alrededor del 30% de las especies del país se consideran amenazadas y/o en peligro de extinción.

Aunque el Águila Harpía es el ave nacional, nuestro país alberga especies de gran interés debido a su belleza u otras características particulares, como el Pavón, el Quetzal, el Ave Sombrilla y la Guacamaya Bandera, entre otras.

Las aves desempeñan funciones importantes en los ecosistemas, como la regeneración y el mantenimiento del bosque mediante la dispersión de semillas y la polinización. También actúan como controladores biológicos de especies de insectos que generalmente se consideran plagas.

Desde el punto de vista económico, las aves representan un valioso recurso para nuestro país, ya que su diversidad atrae a aficionados a la observación de aves, una actividad que genera importantes beneficios para la economía local.

أنهى نادي ليفربول الإنجليزي الجدل حول التقارير التي تتحدث عن رغبة ريال مدريد وبرشلونة في ضم الدولي المصري محمد صلاح، مهاجم الفريق، خلال سوق الانتقالات الصيفية المقبلة. جاء ذلك وفقًا لما كشفته صحيفة «ميرور» البريطانية اليوم الأربعاء.

وأوضحت الصحيفة أن نادي ليفربول يرفض بشكل قاطع التفريط في النجم المصري محمد صلاح، مؤكدةً بقائه مع "الريدز" في الموسم المقبل، رغم الاستهداف المستمر له من قِبل ريال مدريد وبرشلونة. وأشارت إلى أن مجلس إدارة ليفربول يعتبر محمد صلاح عنصرًا مهمًا في تحقيق هدفهم في الموسم المقبل، وهو الفوز بلقب الدوري الإنجليزي الغائب عن خزائن النادي منذ موسم 1989-1990.

من جهة أخرى، نقلت صحيفة «إكسبرس» البريطانية عن مصادر إعلامية إسبانية أن صلاح البالغ من العمر 25 عامًا يفضل الانتقال إلى برشلونة في حال قرر الرحيل عن ليفربول والانضمام إلى الدوري الإسباني.

وقد حقق النجم المصري، الذي انضم إلى ليفربول في الصيف الماضي قادمًا من روما الإيطالي مقابل 42 مليون يورو وبعقد يمتد حتى صيف 2022، جائزة أفضل لاعب في ليفربول لشهر مارس. وهذه هي المرة السادسة التي يفوز فيها بالجائزة هذا الموسم، بعدما حافظ على مستواه المميز في جميع مباريات الفريق خلال تلك الفترة، حيث سجل ستة أهداف، منها أربعة أهداف ضد واتفورد في الدوري الإنجليزي.

تفقد عاطف سعد، نائب رئيس مركز ومدينة المنصورة، اليوم الأحد، الوحدة المحلية ببرق العز في تمام الساعة الثانية عشر ونصف، للاطمئنان على انتظام العمل والانضباط الوظيفي. تبين عدم وجود مسئول الشئون الإدارية واحتفاظه بسجلات الحضور والانصراف، الأمر الذي أعاق الاطلاع عليها، حيث لم يتواجد بالوحدة سوى 4 من العاملين فقط. بناءً على ذلك، قرر سعد رفع مذكرة بالواقعة للمحاسب هاني سليمان، رئيس مركز ومدينة المنصورة، وإحالتها للشئون القانونية لاتخاذ الإجراءات اللازمة حيال الواقعة.

كما تفقد سعد مركز شباب قرية برق العز، وتبين أنه مغلقًا. قدم نائب رئيس مركز ومدينة المنصورة مذكرة للمحاسب هاني سليمان، رئيس المركز، لمخاطبة مديرية الشباب والرياضة لاتخاذ الإجراءات القانونية اللازمة حيال التحقيق مع مسئولي مركز الشباب.

Reinforcement learning (RL) holds the promise of empowering autonomous systems, like robots, to autonomously acquire a diverse range of skills. Moreover, RL can facilitate the continuous improvement of these skills through experience. However, translating this potential into reality has been challenging. Even with RL methods capable of learning complex behaviors from high-dimensional observations, such as images, the problem settings of RL often do not align seamlessly with real-world constraints. As a result, successful robotic learning experiments have typically relied on environmental instrumentation for defining reward functions, resetting between trials, and obtaining ground truth state. To overcome these limitations and enable the practical and scalable deployment of autonomous learning systems that improve continuously through real-world operation, algorithms must be designed to learn within real-world environments.

The key to addressing these challenges in a scalable manner lies in developing robotic systems with three essential capabilities: the ability to learn from raw sensory inputs, assign rewards to trials without external instrumentation or hand-designed perception systems, and learn continuously in non-episodic settings without the need for manual intervention to reset the environment. Such a system can autonomously amass significant real-world data essential for effective generalization without extensive instrumentation in each training environment. Achieving this goal would remove a major hurdle hindering current RL algorithms from learning scalable, generalizable, and robust real-world behaviors, ultimately bringing us closer to realizing embodied learning-based systems that enhance continuously through their own real-world experiences.

In light of these prerequisites, we present a practical implementation of a learning system that meets these criteria. While previous studies have investigated these issues individually, amalgamating them into a cohesive real-world learning system presents several challenges, as discussed in Section 3. Through empirical analysis in simulation and on a real-world robotic system, we propose simple yet effective solutions that collectively culminate in a comprehensive robotic learning system. This system can autonomously learn from raw sensory inputs, derive reward functions from readily available supervision, and learn without the need for manually constructed reset mechanisms. We demonstrate the effectiveness of this system in learning dexterous robotic manipulation tasks in the real world, showcasing substantial improvements over ablations and prior research.

Casi una cuarta parte de la población de Venezuela necesita ayuda humanitaria urgente, según un informe interno de la ONU que muestra un aumento de la desnutrición y las enfermedades en consonancia con el deterioro de las condiciones de vida en el país. El informe, obtenido el jueves por la AFP, fue presentado esta semana a Nicolás Maduro, quien atribuye la crisis económica de Venezuela a las sanciones de Estados Unidos, y al jefe parlamentario Juan Guaidó, reconocido como presidente interino por más de medio centenar de países.

El reporte "Visión general de las necesidades humanitarias prioritarias" proporciona datos detallados sobre la magnitud de la crisis humanitaria en Venezuela, mientras la Organización de las Naciones Unidas busca obtener apoyo para acelerar su respuesta. Según el informe de 45 páginas, se estima que 7 millones de personas, aproximadamente el 24% de la población total del país, tienen necesidades prioritarias urgentes de asistencia y protección.

En 2018, más del 94% de la población venezolana vivía en la pobreza, incluido el 60% que se encontraba en situación de pobreza extrema, según una encuesta de tres universidades en Caracas citada en el informe. Uno de los mayores impactos de la crisis ha sido en la nutrición, con una disminución en el consumo de carne y verduras entre 2014 y 2017. En particular, el consumo de leche se redujo en un 77%.

Aproximadamente 3,7 millones de personas están desnutridas en el país, tres veces más que la tasa del período 2010-2012, según cálculos de la ONU. Al menos el 22% de los niños menores de cinco años sufren de desnutrición crónica. Enfermedades prevenibles como la tuberculosis, la difteria, el sarampión y la malaria han resurgido y aumentado, al igual que la hepatitis A, debido a la falta de acceso a agua potable segura.

El informe destaca los "desafíos sin precedentes" que enfrenta la población venezolana para acceder a servicios esenciales como protección, atención médica, medicamentos, vacunas, agua, electricidad, educación y alimentos, debido a una economía cada vez más contraída y al malestar político. Los salarios medios se han desplomado, y el flujo migratorio, que incluye a profesionales y técnicos de todos los sectores, ha exacerbado la debacle de las condiciones de vida.

Anthony Colette, un homme très occupé, est désormais acteur et chanteur. À l'âge de 26 ans, il n'oublie cependant pas l'importance de "Danse avec les Stars". Il a déjà confirmé sa participation à la prochaine saison du concours.

Révélé par l'émission de TF1 en 2017, Anthony Colette a déclaré à Voici qu'il reprendrait son rôle de chorégraphe dans la saison 11 de Danse avec les Stars, animée par Camille Combal et Karine Ferri. Connu pour son rôle d'Hadrien dans la série télévisée Demain nous appartient, le danseur a expliqué qu'il ne tournerait pas pendant cette période afin d'être entièrement disponible. "Tout ce qui m'arrive aujourd'hui, c'est grâce à cette émission. Je l'aime et lui suis reconnaissant. Donc oui, je serai toujours présent pour elle", a souligné Anthony Colette.

En parallèle de sa carrière de danseur, le jeune homme mène divers projets. Le 11 juin dernier, il a dévoilé à ses fans le clip de sa chanson de l'été, Bella Bella, sur son compte Instagram.

À rappeler que la saison 11 de Danse avec les Stars, reportée d'un an en raison de la crise sanitaire mondiale, devrait débuter sur TF1 à la rentrée. Selon Camille Combal, toute l'équipe de production est prête, avec plusieurs surprises en réserve pour les téléspectateurs. "Le casting est exceptionnel et quelques nouveautés sont prévues", a-t-il assuré à Télé Star.
