North Salt Lake Police Investigating Assault Involving Young Girl

NORTH SALT LAKE, Utah — The North Salt Lake Police Department is ramping up patrols in the city’s Foxboro community following a reported assault involving a young girl.

While authorities do not have any concrete leads on a potential suspect, a Facebook post from the City of North Salt Lake mentioned the possibility that the assailant could also be a minor. 

“In light of these very serious allegations and our commitment to ensuring the public stays informed to safeguard themselves and their loved ones, we urge parents to be mindful of their children’s whereabouts and the company they keep,” the post emphasized.

The police clarified that the incident appears to be an isolated case, and there is limited additional information that can be shared at this time.

Members of the police department’s command staff will be present at the Foxboro North clubhouse to address any inquiries from 5:30 to 8 p.m. on Friday.

Conventional planar (2-dimensional) video streaming is the most prevalent application on mobile devices. However, virtual reality (VR) video streaming is rapidly emerging as a key player in the entertainment market. Cisco predicts that video streaming will account for over 79% of mobile data traffic by 2022, and Goldman Sachs anticipates approximately 79 million users will engage with VR video streaming by 2025. To enhance the immersive experience, video formats and mobile display panels now support higher resolutions (e.g., 4K) and refresh rates (e.g., 120Hz). These advancements, however, lead to significantly increased energy consumption, which adversely affects mobile device battery life. Therefore, mobile systems need an efficient planar/VR video display architecture that provides high energy efficiency while supporting high video resolutions and refresh rates.

In conventional mobile systems, DRAM main memory and the display panel consume most of the energy for planar video streaming. Figure 1 illustrates the measured energy consumption breakdown of a real Intel Skylake mobile system streaming videos at 30 frames-per-second (FPS) in full-high-definition (FHD, 1920×1080), quad-high-definition (QHD, 2560×1440), and 4K (3840×2160) resolutions. The system's energy consumption is divided into three major components: DRAM (main memory), Display (all components in an LCD display panel), and Others, which includes the processor (including the video decoder and display controller), network (WiFi), and storage (eMMC). As the size of a single decoded frame in high-resolution video (e.g., 24MB for a 4K video) grows, DRAM alone accounts for more than 30% of the total system energy consumption. Although state-of-the-art VR streaming schemes significantly reduce the energy consumed by "Others" (especially the processor) compared to unoptimized VR video streaming, they do not impact DRAM and Display, showing similar energy consumption trends.

In this paper, we identify two inefficiencies in conventional video display schemes that underutilize advanced architectural features in modern mobile computing systems. First, the video decoder or GPU stores video frames in DRAM before the display controller transfers them to the display panel, resulting in substantial data movement and high DRAM bandwidth usage. Modern mobile systems commonly employ a remote frame buffer (RFB) inside the display panel to improve energy efficiency during static-image displays. However, current video streaming architectures do not leverage the RFB due to certain limitations.

حصلت نورة خليفة السويدي، الأمين العام للاتحاد النسائي العام، على جائزة المرأة العربية والمسؤولية المجتمعية، والتي تُعتبر الجائزة الأولى في مجال المسؤولية المجتمعية في الوطن العربي، وذلك تحت رعاية جامعة الدول العربية.

تمنت نورة السويدي أن يكون هذا الإنجاز فخرًا لقيادة دولة الإمارات الرشيدة، ولسمو الشيخة فاطمة بنت مبارك، التي تهتم بدعم وتمكين المرأة الإماراتية بكل جهد ووقت ومال.

خلال الحفل الافتراضي الذي نظمه المجلس العربي للمسؤولية المجتمعية، أعربت نورة عن اعتزازها بالجائزة التي حصلت عليها، مُشيرة إلى أهمية الجهود التي يبذلها المجلس في دعم وتمكين المرأة وتحقيق التنمية الاجتماعية والاقتصادية.

أثنت نورة السويدي على دور القيادة الرشيدة في الإمارات وسمو الشيخة فاطمة بنت مبارك في تعزيز التعاون مع الجهات العربية والعالمية من أجل تعزيز التنمية والنماء في مختلف المجالات، خاصة فيما يتعلق بتمكين المرأة وتعزيز القيم الإنسانية.

نوهت نورة السويدي بالجهود الفعّالة التي يبذلها المجلس العربي للمسؤولية المجتمعية في دعم المرأة وتقديم الخدمات الإنسانية، مُؤكدة على أهمية تعزيز قيم التسامح والتعاون بين شعوب العالم.

It's not the memory of her skin that saddens me, nor the scent of her hair brushing across my face. It’s not the loss itself that burdens my heart. The reason I'm writing this, my hands trembling ever so slightly, delves into something darker than the mere loss of love.

I first saw her in 1989 at Kent, while I was deeply entangled in the struggle of completing my graduate degree in biochemistry. Forgive me if I've shared this before; my thoughts often escape me, and I frequently lose my way. The stress was immense, and with what Janice referred to as my "condition," I was trying to be careful with my medication, striving to stay healthy. Unfortunately, I wasn't careful enough. I missed pills and fell out of routine. Yet, I’d insist I was holding on tightly—perhaps too tightly. Maybe that's why I find myself in this empty place now.

I’m not sure why I hadn't noticed her earlier. She just appeared one day, sitting in the lecture hall. That moment remains vividly etched in my memory. A mere glimpse, a reflection on the laminate table top—a fleeting glance for a few seconds before she vanished.

This continued for days, weeks. I would see her, never directly, just as reflections or glimpses—a puzzle pieced together bit by bit. She seemed to appear when I needed her most, right as the pressure mounted to unbearable levels. During times when I felt I was losing control, straining to earn a degree for which it was increasingly evident I barely possessed the talent. The thought of her provided comfort; knowing that she existed—a pure, beautiful presence in my world.

Gradually, I saw her more often. Then we spoke, our whispers audible only to us. Inevitably, as youth often does, we fell for each other. Love. Please understand me—I am not a fool. While my mind may betray me at times, I am no fool. Whatever you've heard, whatever you believe, know this: I was truly in love with her. It’s a sense of completeness you recognize only if you've ever had the privilege of experiencing it—a fullness beyond words.

After graduation, we drifted apart, separated by an unbridgeable distance. Yet, it never felt final. As movies often phrase it, “au revoir, not goodbye.” Inevitably, we reunited several times over the years. Miraculously, she appeared whenever I needed her most—when I neglected my health, when my marriage unraveled, when my dear sister Janice succumbed to cancer. She would come, reinvigorating me, and we'd fall in love anew. Again and again, over the years, we rediscovered our love.

But now she's gone for good. It has to be this way. I take my pills as prescribed, adhere to my routine, and maintain my health. No stress, no pressures. I don't need her anymore.

The lights flickered and the muttering of nations quelled under the glare of Atlantis' representative to the United Nations' General Assembly. The man wore a navy suit with a soft white tie, a small trident emblem pinned to his lapel. Within days of Atlantis' discovery, the Alanteans had struck hard and fast at their ancient Athenian rivals. The nuclear strikes had killed millions and had left the Balkan states devastated, and all the while the world stood and watched, unable to comprehend the unleashed military might of Atlantis.

The man spread forth his arms, "Beyond the Pillars of Hercules," his voice boomed, "a new nation has arisen! A nation that will not bow under the tyranny and threat of the old world." The man gave a mocking smile to the audience's stunned silence. They had all witnessed the horrors of what had happened years earlier. "But now," the man continued, "we have returned to reclaim the position that is rightfully ours. But we do not stand before you as conquerors, no. We stand as liberators from an ancient agitator. So please, allow me to introduce you to the God-King of the seven seas and lands East of the Mediterranean," he spread his arms wide and bellowed, "Poseidon!"

The doors to the assembly hall slammed open so hard that they cracked in half.

The Face on Mars has been a subject of debate regarding its origins. Many have speculated that it was created by aliens, but there are several reasons why this theory is not plausible.

Firstly, the Mars Orbiter Camera team captured a photo of the Face on Mars in 1998 that was ten times sharper than the original picture taken by the Viking in 1976. This high-resolution image allowed for a clearer view of the supposed face, revealing no signs of alien construction. The more detailed the images became, the more apparent it was that this formation was simply a natural landform.

In addition to this, further evidence against alien involvement came in 2001 when Malin's team took another high-resolution photo of the Face on Mars. Despite using advanced technology and maximizing resolution capabilities, no indications of alien craftsmanship could be discerned in these images.

Moreover, it is worth noting that logical reasoning also points to the improbability of aliens creating the Face on Mars. Multiple photographs taken over time have failed to reveal any traces of extraterrestrial influence or activity around this feature. It is illogical to persist in attributing something as intricate as facial features to beings from another world when all empirical evidence suggests otherwise.

In conclusion, based on photographic evidence and rational thinking, it is clear that aliens did not create the Face on Mars. The series of detailed images captured by various missions only serve to reinforce the notion that what some perceived as an artificial creation is indeed nothing more than a naturally occurring geological formation.

Video prediction in computer vision involves estimating future frames at the pixel level based on previous frames. This capability is crucial for intelligent decision-making systems, making video prediction an area of growing interest in both industry and research. Its potential applications are vast, including weather forecasting, traffic situation prediction, and autonomous driving. However, predicting video at the pixel level remains challenging due to the complexities of capturing high-dimensionality and long-term motion dynamics.

To tackle these challenges, several studies have proposed using deep neural networks (DNNs) to better capture the high-dimensionality and long-term dynamics inherent in video data. Some models simplify the problem by constraining motion and disentangling components, yet they often fail to consider long-term frame dynamics, resulting in blurry frames or incorrect motion trajectories. Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) have been developed to address these issues by focusing on long-term dependencies. RNNs utilize memory cell states to remember past inputs, adjusting according to the current input sequence. Despite this, RNNs struggle with sequences of limited dynamics, such as short-term motion, because their memory cells primarily focus on immediate input relations. For instance, predicting future leg movements in a short walking sequence can be challenging for RNNs, as the long-term motion context is not adequately captured.

Our work seeks to address these long-term motion context issues, which previous video prediction efforts have not fully resolved. To predict future frames accurately, it is essential to determine the long-term motion context that the input belongs to, such as distinguishing between walking and running. The challenges include (i) predicting long-term motion context in sequences with limited dynamics and (ii) handling the high-dimensionality of video data.

In this paper, we propose a novel motion context-aware video prediction approach to address these challenges. To tackle the first issue, we introduce long-term motion context memory (LMC-Memory) with memory alignment learning. Unlike RNNs' internal memory cells, LMC-Memory is external and consists of its own parameters, designed to preserve various long-term motion contexts from training data beyond the current input. Memory alignment learning involves two phases: storing long-term motion context from extensive sequences and matching short-term sequences with stored contexts. This allows for the recall of long-term motion dynamics from short-term sequences.

To address the second challenge, we propose decomposing a memory query used for storing and recalling motion contexts. Given the high-dimensionality of video sequences, capturing the exact motion context matching the input can be difficult. The proposed memory query decomposition allows for storing local contexts and recalling the suitable local context for each input part, enhancing the alignment between input and stored long-term motion context in LMC-Memory.

The major contributions of this paper are as follows:
- We introduce a novel motion context-aware video prediction method that addresses the limitations of RNN-based methods in capturing long-term motion contexts.

Burton Albion is looking to recharge ahead of Saturday's League One trip to Doncaster Rovers, hoping an extra day's rest will make a difference. Recently, they endured a grueling schedule, playing nine games in four weeks. Their latest match, a 3-2 loss to Gillingham, highlighted the toll this demanding period has taken on the team.

Consider the potential of computers that can understand your emotions and assist you in the classroom. Dr. Paul Eckman has developed computer software capable of doing just that. By analyzing facial muscle movements, this software can identify your emotions. I believe that this technology is valuable in the classroom because it can recognize when a student is confused and offer assistance like a real instructor. Additionally, if a student becomes bored, the computer can detect this and help keep them engaged. Furthermore, such technology can be especially beneficial when there is a shortage of teacher support in the classroom.

One significant advantage of this computer technology is its ability to detect when a student is bored and assist as if a real instructor were present. For instance, if a student is drifting off, the computer can recognize this and help the student stay focused. This feature can be incredibly beneficial to both students and teachers, highlighting the potential value of this technology in the educational environment.

Moreover, the ability of the computer to offer immediate help when a student is confused is a significant benefit. Imagine being in a math class and getting stuck on a problem. The computer can sense the confusion and provide assistance until the instructor is available. It can also offer quick tips or facts if a student is struggling to understand a new topic. This immediate support can be a valuable resource for both students and instructors.

Additionally, the presence of computers that can read expressions can be a tremendous help when there is a shortage of teacher assistance. For example, in a large classroom, a teacher might not be able to attend to every student. The computer can step in, recognizing a student’s confusion and providing the necessary support, allowing the teacher to focus on other students. This technology can be a significant asset in both large and small schools, especially those with a limited number of teachers.

"And what's in it for me?" she asked, her gaze fixed on me. Her hair was longer than mine had been since middle school, and her makeup was expertly done. Honestly, I looked stunning.

"I don't know... you'll be doing yourself a favor?" I replied, crossing my arms. She watched, probably assessing my muscles, wondering if they would fit her designer wardrobe. "Look, you don't want to be famous, that's cool. I'll just try the next reality."

"I didn't say I wouldn't do it. I'm just pretty sure there's a downside," she sighed. "No point in denying it. I know your tells."

"Well, there is this one guy. He's kind of stalking me."

"You're in the movies. That's going to happen."

"No, but he's been inside my house."

I raised an eyebrow. She—I—was really upset. I already knew I was going to agree to the switch. It was only a week, and I wouldn't mind a little pampering. 

"And you *haven't* called the cops?" I asked. 

"Of course I have!" she snapped, in that dignified way the upper class can somehow manage. 

"Alright, alright. Don't worry. I'll handle it," I sighed. 

In retrospect, I'm really glad my dad talked me out of joining the drama club.

Ce vendredi 24 août, Emmanuelle Béart et Daniel Auteuil se sont retrouvés dans le sud de la France pour célébrer le mariage de leur fille Nelly, âgée de 26 ans. Un moment empreint d'émotion pour l'actrice, qui a partagé une photo de la mariée sur son compte Instagram.

C'était indéniablement une journée parfaite pour échanger ses vœux. Tandis que l'on apprenait le mariage surprise de Vincent Cassel et de sa compagne Tina Kunakey, deux autres acteurs français se sont également retrouvés devant Monsieur le Maire ce même jour. Emmanuelle Béart et son ancien compagnon Daniel Auteuil étaient à la mairie de Saint-Rémy-de-Provence pour célébrer l'union de leur fille aînée, Nelly. Comme ses parents, la jeune femme de 26 ans a choisi de vivre son amour discrètement, en s'unissant dans la plus grande intimité avec son fiancé, Lucas Veil, petit-fils de Simone Veil et fils de l'actuelle ministre de la Santé, Agnès Buzyn.

Selon le quotidien La Provence, la mariée, vêtue d'une longue robe blanche fluide, est apparue en fin d'après-midi au bras de son père, Daniel Auteuil, lui aussi en blanc. Accueillie chaleureusement par les invités sur le parvis de l'hôtel de ville, Nelly s'est avancée vers sa mère, habillée d'une tenue fleurie, pour lui offrir un tendre câlin. Elle a ensuite rejoint son futur époux, qui l'attendait avec impatience à l'intérieur de la mairie de Saint-Rémy-de-Provence. Leurs destins scellés pour la vie par le maire Hervé Chérubini, les mariés ont été acclamés par leurs nombreux proches à leur sortie de la cérémonie. Des grains de riz et des bulles de savon ont volé sur leur passage.

Fière de sa fille, Emmanuelle Béart a partagé un souvenir de ce jour exceptionnel avec ses fans sur les réseaux sociaux. Sur une photo publiée le samedi 25 août, on aperçoit Nelly, de dos, dans sa robe de mariée. « Oh ma petite fille… Prends soin de toi… Lulu et Nana pour toujours », a-t-elle écrit en légende, dévoilant les délicates broderies de son voile en dentelle. Très émus, les admirateurs de la comédienne n'ont pas manqué de féliciter la mère et la fille. « Meilleurs vœux à Nelly », « Que du bonheur », « Tellement émouvant », « Un grand moment », « Si belle », ont-ils commenté.

Transformer architectures have become a cornerstone in natural language processing, particularly with the rise of self-supervised models like BERT, RoBERTa, XLNet, and BART. Although these pre-trained models excel in performance, they are often accompanied by significant memory and computation demands, which pose challenges in practical applications. To address these issues, model compression has gained significant interest from both academia and industry. Among the various compression techniques, quantization, which operates using low-precision arithmetic, is a crucial method for compressing large models to fit lightweight devices.

Recent research has increasingly focused on the quantization of Transformer-based models. Several studies have introduced innovative techniques: an 8-bit quantization scheme for BERT-like models, group-wise quantization with mixed-precision analysis, the combination of distillation with quantization, and integer-only quantization through nonlinear operation approximation. However, few investigations have delved into the inherent bottleneck of quantizing Transformer-based models.

Recent papers highlight a critical challenge with Transformer models: they often contain large outliers, which tend to cluster in specific embedding dimensions, especially around unique tokens. These outliers can severely impact quantization performance, with reports of up to a 12% performance drop even with 8-bit quantization. While some methods attempt to circumvent this issue by using finer quantization granularity, this approach increases computation costs and reduces acceleration benefits.

In our study, we aim to address these challenges by suppressing rather than bypassing outliers. We conduct a thorough analysis to understand the causes of outliers and the effects of clipping them. We find that the scaling parameter γ in the LayerNorm structure acts as an outlier amplifier. By isolating this parameter, we can enhance activation robustness for quantization. Our analysis also reveals varying impacts of clipping different outliers: while aggressive outliers can often be clipped without accuracy loss, clipping important outliers may lead to a sudden accuracy drop. Interestingly, less important outliers, which often form long tails, are linked to a limited number of tokens.

Building on these insights, we propose an outlier suppression framework to enhance low-bit Transformer models. This framework comprises two main components: Gamma Migration and Token-Wise Clipping. Gamma Migration mitigates outliers by migrating the outlier amplifier γ into subsequent modules, thus promoting quantization-friendly models without additional computation. Token-Wise Clipping efficiently determines a suitable clipping range, starting with a coarse-grained token-wise approach that quickly identifies less important outliers and followed by a fine-grained optimization stage. This framework is adaptable to various models and tasks and can complement existing methods. Moreover, our approach to outlier suppression offers a fresh perspective on NLP quantization.

In summary, our contributions are as follows:
1. We thoroughly examine the causes and effects of outliers in NLP models, uncovering two key findings that address transformer quantization bottlenecks.
2. We introduce an efficient and easy-to-implement outlier suppression framework, featuring Gamma Migration and Token-Wise Clipping.
3. Gamma Migration alleviates outliers by reassigning the outlier amplifier in LayerNorm to subsequent modules, reducing quantization errors without extra inference time.
4. Token-Wise Clipping efficiently establishes an optimal clipping range by focusing on the variability of token ranges and prioritizing significant areas.
5. Extensive experiments on various NLP models (BERT, RoBERTa, BART) and tasks (text classification, question answering, summarization) demonstrate that our framework sets a new benchmark in transformer quantization, achieving full-precision accuracy with 6-bit post-training quantization and 4-bit quantization-aware training for BERT.

I think driverless cars are a good idea. Technology is always changing, and I feel like this is a right step towards the future of car technology. Just like cassettes and eight tracks, maybe normal cars one day will be something of the past because of greater technology that has surpassed the normal driving cars that we are accustomed to today.

Why is this technology so great, you may ask? Well, first off, how convenient would it be to be looking at your emails while on the road, or perhaps taking a phone call without the worry of getting into a car wreck? Not only that, but if everyone had a car like this, then the number of fatal crashes that we have in a year would go down significantly.

This new technology would, of course, cost a lot of money, not only to manufacture but for purchase. The type of technology that you would be receiving would be the most bang for your buck. It would come equipped with sensors all around the car, ensuring not only your safety but also the safety of the passengers. Los comienzos de año son siempre momentos propicios para reflexionar, también para quienes forman parte del ecosistema emprendedor (startups, inversores, etc.). Tras un 2020 marcado por la pandemia y sus consecuencias, este 2021 se abre con esperanza ante el éxito de la vacuna, aunque también con un clima de incertidumbre económica.

El año 2020 dejó un ecosistema emprendedor con muchas pérdidas, pero también con numerosos éxitos para los 'startuperos' españoles. La peor parte, como era de esperarse, se la llevaron las startups del sector turístico, de viajes y eventos. Aun así, según cifras del Observatorio de la Fundación Innovación Bankinter y El Referente, en 2020 se alcanzó la segunda mejor cifra de la historia de España en términos de inversión, con 1.101,786 millones de euros, una cifra ligeramente inferior al acumulado de 2018, que cerró con 1.227,090 millones de euros.

Ante este panorama, el ecosistema emprendedor debe anticiparse y adaptarse a las necesidades del mercado más que nunca. Por esta razón, la plataforma South Summit ha analizado las principales tendencias a tener en cuenta en este 2021:

1. Digitalización: la pandemia ha consolidado las fórmulas de trabajo remoto, eventos virtuales, reuniones online y, en definitiva, ha puesto de manifiesto que vivimos en una era digital. Por tanto, aquellos actores que no se encuentren ya en esta era o que no hagan un esfuerzo importante por unirse a ella, difícilmente tendrán un futuro de éxito. El empleo de este año se basará también en la demanda de profesionales expertos en digitalización. Según datos del Mapa del Emprendimiento 2020, realizado por South Summit, un 66% de startups quieren contratar nuevos profesionales en sus equipos este año, debido en gran parte a las nuevas necesidades de empleo digital que demanda el mercado actual.

2. Innovación Abierta: esta estrategia de negocio basada en la colaboración entre corporates y startups permite un win-win para ambos actores. Es una forma de mantener viva la innovación en grandes empresas y dotarlas de la agilidad necesaria para adaptarse a los cambios fácil y rápidamente, lo cual seguirá siendo clave durante este año, ya que el futuro de la innovación pasa, más que nunca, por ser colaborativo.

3. Marco legal: los emprendedores señalan que todavía queda mucho por hacer en cuanto a regulación para facilitar la creación de nuevos proyectos y su continuidad. De hecho, según datos del Mapa del Emprendimiento 2020, entre sus mayores demandas se encuentran una mejor regulación fiscal para startups (67%) y acceso a financiación (74%).

4. Emprendimiento rural: el 30% del territorio español concentra al 90% de la población, según datos del Gobierno. Una cifra que demuestra que los pueblos están desapareciendo y, con ellos, las grandes oportunidades que ofrecen para emprender. Sin embargo, la modalidad de teletrabajo acogida el pasado año por muchas empresas ofrece un nuevo horizonte para la reactivación de la vida y economía en zonas rurales, lo que podría traducirse también en nuevas oportunidades de negocio. Esta situación empodera al emprendimiento rural, que se enfrenta igualmente al desafío de la visibilidad, al apoyo de todos los actores y a la eliminación de la brecha digital.

5. Salud, por encima de todos los demás sectores: según datos del Mapa del Emprendimiento 2020, uno de los sectores que más ha crecido este último año y en el que más se invierte es el de la Salud.

Search engines like Google, Baidu, and Bing are essential tools that help individuals find valuable information within vast online content. Typically, a modern search engine employs a multi-stage pipeline that progressively filters out irrelevant documents (i.e., web pages), with retrieval being the initial phase. This stage aims to identify a few hundred or thousand relevant candidates from the immense pool of web content, significantly influencing the search engine's overall performance.

However, the unprecedented size and diversity of web documents pose numerous challenges to the retrieval system. First and foremost, semantic matching is a critical issue, as traditional text-based methods like BM25 may struggle to capture relevant information presented in different phrasing. Additionally, the growing number of queries in natural language style further complicates semantic modeling. Secondly, both search queries and web content exhibit high heterogeneity, following long-tail distributions. For instance, a substantial portion of less common queries (i.e., tail queries) may be entirely new to the search engine, making it challenging to accurately infer the semantics of these queries and documents. Thirdly, to have a significant impact on real-world applications, practical solutions are needed to deploy the retrieval model effectively for large-scale data processing.

Both academia and industry have invested substantial effort in addressing these challenges. Various studies have explored bi-encoder models, such as Siamese networks or two-tower models, to facilitate semantic retrieval. These models utilize different representation learning techniques as semantic encoders, with recent advancements like BERT proving to be powerful tools in semantic understanding. The adoption of BERT-based bi-encoders has led to state-of-the-art performance in retrieval tasks, credited to their deep attention-based structures (such as Transformer) and pretraining and fine-tuning approaches. However, there remains a gap in understanding how to develop and implement such retrieval models within the online environment of a search engine.

This paper introduces a novel retrieval system implemented in Baidu Search, China's prominent search engine, utilizing the state-of-the-art Chinese pretrained language model ERNIE for effective semantic matching. The system's design addresses the aforementioned challenges by:

1. Leveraging an ERNIE-based bi-encoder for expressive semantic matching to tackle semantic matching issues, incorporating a poly-interaction scheme and data mining strategies to enhance model effectiveness.
2. Introducing a multistage training paradigm to optimize the retrieval model, allowing for rich knowledge absorption and boosting generalization ability, particularly beneficial for handling tail queries.
3. Developing a system architecture supporting large-scale web retrieval by integrating semantic and conventional text matching for generating relevant candidates, along with a post-retrieval filtering module for unified quality assessment.

This paper represents one of the most extensive applications of pre-trained language models for web-scale retrieval, offering practical experiences and insights on incorporating PLMs in web retrieval. Key contributions include the innovative retrieval model leveraging Transformers for semantic encoding, a multi-stage training paradigm for enhanced learning, and an efficient system design for seamless integration with existing workflows to boost overall performance.

Recommender Systems (RS) have recently become crucial tools to address information overload in various domains with abundant data, such as e-commerce, education, finance, and health (Zhu et al., 2021). Among the key technologies within RS, Collaborative Filtering (CF) has achieved significant success due to its domain-independent nature and simplicity in explanation. CF aims to extract user and item representations from their interactions to predict user preferences and recommend items (Chen et al., 2022). However, as the number of users and items grows exponentially, CF-based recommendation methods often face high time and space costs (Qi et al., 2021a).

Fortunately, hash-based CF (Hash-CF) approaches (Chen et al., 2018) have shown promise in compressing data and speeding up computations for recommendations involving billions of users and items (Shan et al., 2018). In large-scale recommendation scenarios, Hash-CF encodes high-dimensional real-valued vectors into compact one-hot codes (hash representations) to achieve significant storage compression and accelerate recommendations through bitwise operations like XOR. This enables a more efficient recommendation model even with massive datasets.

However, existing Hash-CF approaches encounter challenges related to the learned hash representations. Firstly, there is a challenge in optimizing discrete hash representations, as obtaining such representations typically involves the sign function, leading to a complex mixed-binary-integer optimization problem that is NP-hard (Wang et al., 2018). A potential solution involves replacing the sign function with a continuous relaxation, such as the tanh function, to learn deterministic hash representations in an end-to-end manner. However, this approach lacks robustness due to a lack of noise tolerance consideration. Variational Autoencoder (VAE) (Kingma and Welling, 2014) offers a probabilistic approach to model features as distributions, accommodating uncertainty in data for robust recommendation (Liang et al., 2018). 

Another challenge is how to preserve semantic information in discrete representations. Hash representations inherently lack the ability to convey semantic information as effectively as real-valued representations. Although existing Hash-CF approaches attempt to control quantization loss, they struggle to maintain semantic consistency between real-valued and hash representations, resulting in the loss of crucial semantic information necessary for accurate recommendations.

To address these challenges, we propose a novel Hash-CF recommendation approach, termed HCFRec, that generates compact yet informative hash representations for effective and efficient recommendations. Our proposal consists of two main components based on the VAE framework to ensure robust generalization capability. For the first challenge, the hash representation generation component models user and item features as real-valued representations following a simple normal distribution.

The "Face on Mars" may look like an alien has constructed it but the shadows of the bumps make it seem like it is an actual human face. If aliens had created this form, wouldn't there be more of these human-looking landforms? The answer to that question would be yes. The pictures from 2001 show that the artifact was really just a natural creation. Before scientists had found the Face on Mars, the question is... just how old is it?

In the beginning of the article, it states, "New high-resolution images and 3D altimetry from NASA's Mars Global Survey spacecraft reveal the Face on Mars for what it really is: A mesa" (UTFONM, 1). Thus meaning that the Face on Mars was not created by aliens. Before scientists had access to pictures in 1976 and '98 with awful quality, a clearer image in 2001 showed exactly what the Face on Mars truly represents. The article also stated that the Face on Mars "...huge rock formation... which resembles a human head... formed by shadows giving illusions of eyes, nose, and mouth" (UTFONM, 1). This is proof that it only exists as a natural landform.

If aliens were responsible for creating such structures on Mars, wouldn't there have been more similar formations? There's no evidence suggesting aliens were involved in crafting the Face on Mars within this article. If indeed alien beings were behind its creation, NASA would likely have explored and documented it extensively instead of concealing such a discovery for financial gain. According to information presented in this article; "Meanwhile defenders of NASA budget wish there was an ancient civilization on mars" (UTFONM), implying benefits arising from such extraterrestrial involvement.

It might be intriguing to consider whether beings capable of space travel could have constructed such structures; however,"There was no alien monument after all" according to this source (UTFONM).

El exdiputado nacional del Frente para la Victoria (FpV), José María Díaz Bancalari, falleció ayer en la ciudad de Buenos Aires. El dirigente, de 72 años, estaba internado en el Sanatorio Güemes desde hacía algunos días debido a una descompensación que agravó su estado tras haber quedado en coma como consecuencia de un accidente cerebrovascular.

Sus restos comenzaron a ser velados anoche en San Nicolás, ciudad natal del dirigente y de la que fue intendente. 

Nacido el 5 de septiembre de 1944, Díaz Bancalari tuvo una extensa militancia en el Partido Justicialista (PJ) que lo llevó a ocupar diversos cargos institucionales y partidarios en las últimas décadas. 

A los 28 años, fue designado prosecretario legislativo del Senado bonaerense, cargo que ocupó entre 1973 y el golpe de Estado de 1976. 

Con el retorno de la democracia, Díaz Bancalari fue elegido intendente de San Nicolás en 1983 y luego diputado nacional en 1987. No obstante, no completó su mandato ya que en 1990 fue convocado por el entonces gobernador Antonio Cafiero para ocupar el cargo de Ministro de Gobierno y Justicia.

Posteriormente, Díaz Bancalari fue elegido senador bonaerense para el período 1991-1995 durante la presidencia de Carlos Menem. Aunque fue reelecto, ocupó la banca hasta 1997, cuando el entonces gobernador Eduardo Duhalde lo convocó nuevamente para liderar el Ministerio de Gobierno y Justicia.

A partir de 2003, Díaz Bancalari se fue acercando al kirchnerismo y cumplió dos períodos como diputado nacional: entre 2007 y 2011, y desde 2011 hasta 2015, cuando se distanció de la política activa.

The natural products chemical space encompasses hundreds of thousands of molecules that are not only fascinating from a chemical perspective but also due to the diverse and impressive biological properties that many of them possess. The significance of this chemical space is further highlighted by the substantial number of these molecules currently used as medicines in human and veterinary practice.

From a phytochemical and pharmacognostic standpoint, natural molecules are categorized into different families based on their biosynthetic origins or shared chemical characteristics. Many of these natural molecule families play crucial roles in human health, not only in medicine but also in areas such as nutrition and cosmetics. Among these families, terpenes stand out as a diverse group of compounds that have found applications in various industries. Terpenes have been utilized not only in medicine (such as artemisinin and taxol) but also in food (carotenoids as colorants), flavors (menthol, limonene, pinene), and preservatives (eugenol).

With tens of thousands of known terpenes, they are often classified based on the number of carbons they contain, reflecting their biosynthetic pathways. Terpenes can be categorized as monoterpenes (C10), sesquiterpenes (C15), diterpenes (C20), triterpenes (C30), and so forth, depending on the number of C5 isoprene units. Some terpenes may also be lactones or contain sugars, leading to their classification as terpene lactones or terpene glycosides, respectively.

As with other classes of natural products, the rapid discovery of new molecules makes it increasingly challenging to manually curate and study each molecule's chemical descriptors individually. Data science-based approaches are essential in organizing, interpreting, and filtering vast amounts of data, sometimes unveiling relationships that might go unnoticed by human observation.

The quality of data in data science-driven analysis is crucial, and the digitalization of information has facilitated the use of data science frameworks to explore the natural products chemical space. In this study, we applied a data science and artificial intelligence approach to analyze the COCONUT database, the largest and most comprehensive natural product database available. According to the most recent source, over 55,000 terpenes were known, and we extracted 59,000 terpenes from this database to conduct our analysis.

Driverless cars have become a significant development in recent years, sparking controversy over their necessity and feasibility. Some argue that driverless cars are not truly autonomous yet as they still require a driver for certain functions. However, I firmly believe that driverless cars are a beneficial concept, and here is why.

One of the key advantages of driverless cars is their ability to significantly reduce fuel consumption by almost half, which has positive implications on multiple levels. Gas emissions contribute to pollution, particularly with the increasing number of motorists on the roads today. These emissions harm the ozone layer crucial for maintaining air quality. Therefore, any opportunity to decrease gas consumption through driverless technology is highly beneficial not only for environmental reasons but also for lowering fuel costs.

Moreover, as gas prices continue to rise over time, drivers experience financial strain due to this ongoing expense. By transitioning to driverless cars that require less fuel, individuals can save money that would otherwise be spent on gasoline.

In terms of functionality, driverless cars serve more as assistants rather than fully independent operators. This feature can relieve pressure on drivers—especially new ones—by taking over certain tasks such as steering and braking while alerting them when human intervention is necessary.

Safety remains a top priority for companies developing these vehicles, ensuring consumer satisfaction with advanced safety features designed to prevent accidents or collisions effectively.

Another aspect worth considering is entertainment within these vehicles. Despite concerns about potential boredom from not actively driving while inside a car, manufacturers have focused on incorporating various entertainment systems like heads-up displays to enhance passengers' experiences during travel.

In conclusion, I am convinced that embracing driverless car technology offers numerous benefits: reduced pollution levels; cost savings through lower gas consumption; alleviation of stress on new drivers; improved safety features; and enhanced in-car entertainment options. While there may be further enhancements needed before achieving complete autonomy in vehicles, embracing this innovative technology signals an essential step towards progress in transportation solutions.I sincerely believe that widespread adoption of drivereleess card will bring positive changes adn improvements nd encourage youo do research further into this impactful innovation.

Si hay algo que caracteriza a la generación Z, también llamados centennials, es que son verdaderos "nativos digitales". Nacieron a partir del año 1995 (con los inicios de Internet) y hasta el presente. Son "autodidactas" (aprenden por tutoriales, "creativos" (incorporan rápido nuevos conocimientos) y sobreinformados. Según otra terminología, también se los denomina "generación cristal", por la fragilidad que implica estar en la vanguardia de la tecnología pero no saber cómo procesar esas grandes cantidades de información, y por la cualidad efímera que tienen sus vínculos y sus emociones. A la vez, estos chicos necesitan desarrollar una inteligencia emocional que les permita conectar mejor con el mundo, para obedecer menos mandatos que las generaciones anteriores y desarrollar más confianza en sus propios juicios.

Vamos a hacer un recorrido -a grandes rasgos- de qué implica ser un centennial en cada etapa de su crecimiento.

Bebés
"Nosotros traemos a un bebé a un mundo donde todo está digitalizado. Y lo que empiezan a ver esos chicos desde que nacen es que mamá y papá siempre están conectados. A través de las redes, a través de los celulares", comenta el Licenciado Sergio Farinelli, especialista en infancia, promotor de vida activa y saludable, consultor e investigador en primera infancia.

I believe that driverless cars could be fun for some, especially those who are lazy and dislike the complications of driving on confusing and disorganized roads. Some people would appreciate having someone else take over the wheel for them. However, while it may seem like a convenient option, a driverless car can take away the joy of actually driving for future generations.

First, I am against the idea of driverless cars because I enjoy the hands-on experience of driving. The feeling of turning the wheel and controlling the brakes manually is part of what makes driving enjoyable for me. The prospect of using voice commands to operate a vehicle seems mundane and uninspiring compared to traditional driving experiences.

Secondly, my opposition to driverless cars extends to their potential impact on society. Will these vehicles reflect positively on humanity or showcase our selfishness by taking natural skills and turning them into automated conveniences? The rapid evolution from current vehicles to driverless ones raises questions about where this technological progression will end. What other advancements might come after driverless cars?

Lastly, my resistance towards embracing driverless cars is also influenced by cost considerations. With some models priced at over $500,000, they are financially out of reach for many individuals with lower incomes. Additionally, many Americans are still paying off debts from purchasing their current vehicles; introducing high-priced autonomous cars may further exacerbate financial burdens.

In conclusion, I have outlined three reasons why I oppose driverless cars: their impact on personal enjoyment, societal implications, and prohibitive costs associated with ownership. Each point underscores my belief that there are significant drawbacks to this emerging technology that warrant careful consideration before widespread adoption occurs.

Control of complex mechanical systems, such as robots, typically requires a solid understanding of system dynamics to achieve high control performance. In this context, learning-based approaches show promise as they can accurately model additional influences on top of the nominal dynamics, such as friction or external forces. One effective learning-based method for such scenarios is Gaussian process regression, which demonstrates excellent generalization capabilities even with limited training samples (Rasmussen and Williams, 2006). Moreover, this method provides uncertainty bounds for the learned dynamics, making it valuable for safety-critical control applications, as demonstrated, for instance, by Umlauft et al. (2017) and Capone and Hirche (2019).

While considerable attention has been given to the theoretical aspects of GP regression, the appropriate discretization of continuous-time mechanical systems, in conjunction with GPs for simulation and control, has received limited focus. Marsden and West (2001) proposed variational (symplectic) integrators as suitable discretization methods for mechanical systems, as they maintain key structural properties, such as energy or momentum conservation, and constraint satisfaction, leading to higher accuracy than generic integrators, such as explicit Runge-Kutta methods, and enabling larger prediction time steps, which is crucial, for instance, for online control. However, the advantageous properties of variational integrators, when combined with Gaussian process regression, have not been explored.

There are many people who enjoy driving for various reasons, such as fun, family bonding, or socializing with friends. However, some companies are considering the development of driverless cars to eliminate the need for manual driving. In this essay, I will argue against the production of driverless cars and explain why they should not be allowed on the roads.

The first reason against driverless cars is that obesity and laziness are already significant issues in America. With sedentary lifestyles contributing to health problems, having driverless cars could worsen this situation by reducing physical activity even further. Driving involves physical movements like walking to the car, steering, and getting in and out of the vehicle – all forms of exercise that would be eliminated with autonomous vehicles.

Another concern is the safety aspect of driverless cars. If a technical malfunction occurs while a self-driving car is on the road among human-operated vehicles, it could lead to severe accidents or injuries. The question of liability in such cases remains unanswered – whether fault lies with the manufacturer or user adds another layer of complexity to this issue.

Furthermore, existing laws prioritize safety by emphasizing alert and responsible driving practices. Introducing autonomous vehicles into this regulatory framework could pose challenges as they may not align with current legal standards aimed at protecting drivers, passengers, and pedestrians. Lawmakers must consider how allowing driverless cars might compromise public safety on our roads.

In conclusion, due to concerns regarding escalating obesity rates in America, safety implications associated with potential malfunctions in autonomous technology during road use, and conflicts with existing laws focused on alert driving practices for public safety; I firmly believe that driverless cars should not be manufactured or permitted on our streets at present.

Ultra-Wideband (UWB) is a general term for radio communication that utilizes a bandwidth close to or greater than 500 MHz. Recently, research in UWB has primarily focused on Impulse Radio UWB (IR-UWB), a technique that employs radio frequency pulses of very short time duration (nano- or picoseconds), resulting in a large bandwidth.

The IR-UWB technique offers three main benefits. First, UWB supports a high channel capacity due to its high bandwidth, which enables low transmission power, essential to avoid narrowband interference with other wireless technologies. Second, the short time-duration of the pulses reduces the impact of multipath, allowing pulses to be separated and filtered at the receiver, making UWB robust to multipath effects. This spatial diversity can even be exploited to improve localization accuracy in some instances. Third, the high temporal resolution allows for much more precise timing. The steep rising edge of the pulses enables the receiver to accurately determine the time of arrival of the signal, facilitating centimeter-level accurate ranging with techniques like Time-of-Flight (ToF), Time Difference of Arrival (TDoA), and Two-Way Ranging (TWR). When combined with error correction techniques, the ranging error can be as low as 58 mm.

However, UWB also has drawbacks. The low transmission power, necessary to prevent narrowband interference, limits UWB communication to relatively short distances. Additionally, the high bandwidth can cause UWB pulses to be severely distorted, potentially limiting the performance of UWB receivers.

UWB systems have gained significant media attention, as numerous companies, across various industries, have integrated the technology into their products. For example, the Samsung Galaxy Note 20 Ultra, which incorporates a UWB chip, can be used for the device-to-device service, "Nearby Share," and as a digital key to unlock a door. Similarly, Apple iPhones utilize UWB to enhance spatial awareness, enabling Apple devices to locate one another precisely.

In recent decades, the significant advancements in both computing device performance and portability have empowered developers to create software with increasingly sophisticated capabilities. As computing power and compactness improved, they became accessible to a wider non-specialized user base, leading to widespread adoption. However, the enhanced functionalities also resulted in software becoming more complex, presenting challenges for users. The transition from large desktop screens to small smartphone, tablet, and handheld device displays has notably contributed to the growing intricacy of software interfaces. User interface (UI) design and user experience (UX) design are pivotal in managing this complexity and ensuring users can interact with software easily and efficiently.

In the design and enhancement of user interfaces, valuable guidance can be gleaned from user interaction data records. Previously, interface improvements were primarily driven by user and designer feedback obtained through surveys and issue reporting. With the automation of digital systems, structured data collection has become more systematic. Many websites and apps now track user actions such as pageviews, clicks, and searches, commonly referred to as click data. Click data, a subset of user interaction data, records a user's actions in real-time when engaging with a system. Analyzing click data can reveal areas of the interface that need simplification through techniques like frequent itemset analysis, pattern mining, and sequence mining. However, while these methods offer insights into UI design, they often overlook the process perspective, which details the actions within a system that lead to achieving a specific goal, such as a user's objective in using an interface.

Process mining, a burgeoning field within data science, focuses on understanding process executions by analyzing historical event logs collected by information systems. This approach provides insights into process behavior, conformance, and performance over time. While process mining has traditionally been applied to business processes, its scope has expanded to diverse domains such as logistics, auditing, production engineering, and healthcare. Leveraging process mining techniques on user interaction data, especially with the rise of Robotic Process Automation, presents new opportunities and challenges in associating event data with process instances.

To tackle this challenge, a critical aspect is establishing a case notion that groups user interactions into cohesive process instances. This case attribution approach for click data, as proposed in this paper, segments user interactions based on normative behavior using a neural model trained on simulated process executions. By applying this method to a real-world scenario involving a mobility sharing app and conducting process mining analyses, our evaluation demonstrates the effectiveness and efficiency of our approach. The study reveals that our method provides a meaningful case notion from input interaction logs, offers scalability for large datasets, and delivers actionable insights when analyzed using process mining techniques.

The paper is structured as follows: Section 2 introduces fundamental concepts, Section 3 outlines the event-case correlation method, Section 4 presents the method's scalability, Section 5 illustrates the application in a real-life scenario with expert feedback, Section 6 reviews related literature, and Section 7 concludes the study.

Ultimately, despite ongoing debate over its origins and purpose, available evidence points towards The Face on Mars being a natural landform rather than an alien creation. Garvin emphasizes adhering to principles like scale comparisons and recognizing familiar geological features even in unfamiliar environments as essential factors contributing to understanding phenomena such as this Martian formation.

Instance segmentation is a widely recognized task in computer vision that involves predicting a mask and a class category for each target object in an image. Typically, high-performing models depend on large datasets of annotated data, which are costly to obtain. This paper builds on our previous study, introducing a semi-supervised scheme called BASIS (Budget Aware Semi-supervised Semantic and Instance Segmentation) [1]. With a limited annotation budget, BASIS surpasses previous efforts in weakly or semi-supervised semantic and instance segmentation.

Figure 1 demonstrates the BASIS semi-supervised pipeline. It begins by training an annotation network using only a few strongly-annotated samples. This network is then employed to pseudo-annotate unlabeled or weakly-labeled samples. A second segmentation network is trained with both the few strongly-annotated samples and the pseudo-annotations provided by the annotation network. In our earlier work, the samples selected for strong annotation were chosen randomly. In this study, we propose an alternative selection method, inspired by active learning techniques, which enhances performance.

Our proposed sample selection method involves initially training a model with a random subset of a very few strongly-annotated images. This model is then used to generate pseudo-annotations for a pool of unlabeled samples. Alongside the pseudo-annotations, the model predicts a confidence score that reflects the quality of the masks produced. This score indicates the ease or difficulty of segmenting different object instances with the current model. Based on this score, a subset of samples from the pool is selected for strong annotation by a human. Finally, as with BASIS, the annotation network is trained with the available strongly-annotated samples.

The primary contribution of our work is the introduction of a novel approach to estimate the mask confidence score. Specifically, our model is trained to predict an estimation of the Intersection Over Union (IoU) of the pseudo-annotations compared to the corresponding ground truth masks.

J'ai toujours pensé que mon voisin était chanceux ! Il possède un appartement, més o menys semblable au mien à une exception près : il a un accès au toit et s'en sert (amb tota la raó) de terrasse ! Je pourrais me dire que je n'ai pas eu de chance, que moi aussi j'aurais pu tomber sur un appartement comme le sien, mais je sais comment relativiser. El meu veí m'a confié qu'il aurait aimé que son appartement soit, comme le mien, exposé plein sud. Chacun a de quoi envier l'autre !

Comme on dit, « L'ase d'en Mora, de tot s'enamora ». Littéralement, ce proverbe peut se traduire par « l'âne de Mora tombe amoureux de tout ». C'est une phrase que l'on peut dire à quelqu'un qui pense que tout le monde est meilleur que lui ou qui ne cesse de répéter que les autres possèdent plus et de meilleure qualité. C'est un réflexe bien tenace qui, malauradament, peut provoquer des comportements peu conviviaux, no us faré un dibuix ! A nous de trouver des moyens de canaliser ces énergies négatives.

En français, nous avons le proverbe bien connu « l'herbe est toujours plus verte ailleurs » ou la variante « l'herbe est plus verte dans le pré du voisin ». Avec mon voisin, per exemple, nous avons opté pour la solution « apéritive » (quand nous ne sommes pas en confinement ben segur).

ROMA, Italia (EFE).- La cumbre mundial de Salud que se celebrará el próximo 21 de mayo en la capital italiana "representa una oportunidad para el G20 y todos los líderes" mundiales de "aprobar una declaración de 'Roma'", que pueda ser "un punto de referencia" para "prevenir futuras crisis sanitarias mundiales", aseguró hoy el Gobierno italiano.

La reunión, organizada por la presidencia italiana del G20 y la Unión Europea (UE), con la presencia de líderes internacionales y regionales y representantes de las organizaciones sanitarias internacionales, tiene "el objetivo principal" de "construir una respuesta común para garantizar a todos la seguridad sanitaria".

El Ejecutivo italiano indicó en su web que esta cumbre es "una oportunidad" para "compartir las experiencias" de la emergencia sanitaria por la COVID-19 que permitan elaborar y aprobar una "Declaración de Roma", cuyo contenido "puede servir de punto de referencia para reforzar la cooperación multilateral y las acciones conjuntas para prevenir futuras crisis sanitarias mundiales".

"La cumbre mundial de salud es un evento especial del G20 coorganizado con la Comisión Europea. Discutiremos cómo fortalecer nuestros sistemas de salud y su seguridad, cómo mejorar nuestra capacidad para enfrentar crisis futuras con espíritu solidario", escribió en Twitter el primer ministro italiano, Mario Draghi.

También la presidenta de la Comisión Europea, Úrsula von der Layen, se refirió a la cumbre de Roma en sus redes sociales. "Somos un planeta. Una salud. Y hoy en el Día Mundial de la Salud digámoslo de nuevo: las pandemias globales necesitan respuestas globales. El 21 de mayo convocaré la cumbre mundial de salud con el G20. Uniremos al mundo para prepararse mejor contra futuras crisis de salud", tuiteó.

La cumbre abordará la "Coronavirus Global Response", la maratón de donaciones que el año pasado recaudó casi 16,000 millones de euros de donantes de todo el mundo para el acceso universal a tratamientos, pruebas y vacunas contra la COVID, aseguró el Gobierno italiano.

También se tratará la labor de las instituciones y los marcos multilaterales, en particular la Organización Mundial de la Salud y el Reglamento Sanitario Internacional, así como otras iniciativas y procesos sanitarios, incluidos los del G20 y el G7.

Venus shares numerous similarities with Earth, making it a compelling subject for exploration. Not only does it resemble our planet, but it also presents intriguing dangers, making it a fascinating place to study.

Astronomers believe that Venus, much like Earth, was once covered in oceans and may have supported life. The planet's surface, characterized by rocky sediment, features valleys, mountains, craters, and more, drawing striking parallels to Earth. As stated, "Long ago, Venus was probably covered largely with oceans and could have supported various forms of life, just like Earth today... The planet has a surface of rocky sediment and includes familiar features such as valleys, mountains, and craters." This highlights the remarkable similarities between Earth and Venus.

Despite these similarities, Venus is far more perilous. Its temperature, significantly higher than Earth's, is a result of its proximity to the sun, and the atmospheric pressure is a staggering 90 times greater than what we experience.

La bonne nouvelle, c'est que vous n'êtes pas fou : 70 % des propriétaires d'animaux laissent la radio ou la télévision allumée lorsqu'ils s'absentent, afin que leurs animaux ne se sentent pas seuls. Désormais, ils n'écouteront plus rien d'autre que Spotify Pets, conçu pour vous et vos compagnons à quatre pattes. Renforcez votre lien grâce à des listes de lecture basées sur vos goûts musicaux. Vous pouvez ainsi partager votre musique préférée avec votre meilleur ami, qui vous accompagnera même quand vous êtes à la maison.

Selon le géant du streaming musical, les chiens, les chats, les oiseaux et même les iguanes apprécient les mélodies presque autant que les humains. Plusieurs études soutiennent cette théorie et montrent que la musique peut soulager le stress des animaux de compagnie. La meilleure partie est que vous n'aurez plus à passer des heures à réfléchir aux chansons que vos poissons, tortues ou animaux à fourrure pourraient apprécier pour créer la playlist parfaite.

Spotify Pets crée automatiquement une série de playlists spécialement dédiées aux animaux. Les chansons sont sélectionnées par un algorithme, basé non seulement sur vos playlists préférées, mais aussi sur la race, les caractéristiques et la personnalité de votre compagnon. Que vous ayez un hamster, un canari, une perruche, un cochon, un chien ou un chat, tout ce que vous avez à faire est d'entrer sur Spotify Pets. Choisissez l'animal que vous avez comme animal de compagnie, puis explorez une série de fonctionnalités pour sélectionner celles qui correspondent le plus aux caractéristiques et à la personnalité de votre animal : sa couleur, son apparence physique, et son tempérament (détendu, énergique, timide ou amical). Ajoutez ensuite le nom de votre animal et une photo pour compléter son profil, et voilà ! Mettez vos écouteurs et profitez-en ensemble ou seul. Meaw !

Ne pensez pas que la firme suédoise a négligé l'algorithme. Elle a mené une étude détaillée sur le comportement des animaux, ainsi que sur la relation entre les humains et leurs compagnons, y compris une enquête qui a révélé que 8 personnes sur 10 estiment que les animaux aiment la musique, notamment le rock classique et doux.

Mais ce n'est pas tout : l'étude Spotify Pets a montré qu'une personne sur cinq donne à son animal le nom de son chanteur préféré, une tendance particulièrement forte pour des noms tels que Bob Marley, Elvis, Freddie Mercury, Bowie et Ozzy. La grande majorité des propriétaires d'animaux pensent que la musique réduit le stress de leurs compagnons, augmente leur bonheur et leur procure un sentiment de compagnie. Construisez votre playlist et montrez-la au monde en partageant le profil de votre animal sur les réseaux sociaux avec le hashtag #SpotifyPets.

Annoncée il y a plusieurs mois déjà, la nouvelle série de Marc Cherry, le créateur de "Desperate Housewives", a déjà trouvé l'une de ses stars en la personne de Lucy Liu. "Why Women Kill" est attendue sur la plateforme de streaming CBS All Access courant 2019.

À peine l'arrêt de la série "Elementary", dans laquelle elle tenait l'un des rôles principaux, annoncé, Lucy Liu a déjà trouvé de quoi rebondir. L'ancienne "Charlie's Angels" vient d'intégrer le casting de la prochaine série du créateur de "Desperate Housewives", ont annoncé les médias américains.

La nouvelle pépite de CBS All Access s'intéressera à la vie de trois femmes vivant à trois époques différentes. Le téléspectateur suivra le quotidien d'une femme au foyer dans les années 1960, d'une mondaine dans les années 1980 et d'une avocate en 2018, qui doivent faire face, entre autres, à l'infidélité de leur mari.

Lucy Liu incarnera le rôle de Simone, une femme élégante, chic, débordante de vie, l'incarnation parfaite de la confiance en soi, évoluant comme si le monde tournait autour d'elle. Avec son air suffisant, Simone ne jure que par les apparences, remplissant sa vie de virées shopping et de soirées mondaines dont elle a le secret. Visiblement heureuse en mariage, son mari Karl la trouve merveilleuse, ce qui ne l'empêche pas de la tromper. Lorsque Simone découvre le pot aux roses, elle est dévastée et sa vie se retrouve chamboulée.

Pour le moment, Lucy Liu est la seule actrice à avoir été annoncée au casting de la prochaine série de CBS All Access, dont la date exacte de diffusion n'a pas encore été dévoilée.

L'actrice révélée dans la série "Ally McBeal" de 1998 à 2002 fait déjà partie de la grande famille de CBS, puisqu'elle joue le rôle du docteur Joan Watson dans la série policière "Elementary", inspirée des aventures de Sherlock Holmes d'Arthur Conan Doyle.

Canalizados a través de la Secretaría de Desarrollo Social de la Municipalidad, se atendieron diversos pedidos de mejoramiento de las familias que viven en el ex basural, ubicado en la zona suroeste de la ciudad.

Estos pedidos incluyeron la provisión de materiales para la construcción de pisos, agua, conexiones de electricidad domiciliaria, alumbrado público, mejoramientos habitacionales, entrega de alimentos y abrigo, arbolado y atención sanitaria. Además, se otorgó un subsidio a Cáritas María Auxiliadora, que brinda apoyo social a este sector.

El intendente José Lauritto, junto a funcionarios municipales, estuvo presente en el lugar durante la ejecución de algunos de estos trabajos.

Marianela Marclay, secretaria de Desarrollo Social, informó que, según los relevamientos realizados, diez familias se encuentran asentadas en esa zona "en condiciones de alta vulnerabilidad, con viviendas precarias construidas con madera, chapas y nylon, y pisos de tierra en algunos casos, lo que genera hacinamiento".

Con base en esta información, se tomaron medidas para integrar a estas familias a los servicios mínimos que permitan mejorar sus condiciones habitacionales, ya que no están en condiciones de asumir estas mejoras con recursos propios. Además de Marclay, en la relación con las familias y la mejora de sus condiciones, también intervino el concejal Sergio Vereda.

Sánchez insinuó que intensificará la represión de las protestas por el encarcelamiento de un rapero. El presidente del Gobierno español, Pedro Sánchez, prometió hoy hacer frente "a cualquier tipo de violencia", después de que manifestantes se enfrentaran anoche con la policía y cometieran desmanes en una tercera noche de protestas por el polémico encarcelamiento de un rapero.

"La violencia es un ataque a la democracia. En consecuencia, el Gobierno de España hará frente a cualquier tipo de violencia", afirmó el dirigente socialista en alusión a las protestas por el rapero Pablo Hasél, que han provocado tensiones con su socio de coalición, Unidas Podemos, algunos de cuyos dirigentes aplaudieron las marchas y criticaron su represión.

Los altercados estallaron el martes pasado por la noche en Cataluña, horas después del ingreso en prisión de Hasél, condenado a nueve meses por unos tuits en los que insultaba a la monarquía y a la policía, y ensalzaba a personas implicadas en delitos de extremismo. La movilización se ha extendido a otras ciudades del país como Granada o Madrid, donde se prepara una nueva manifestación para mañana.

Para hoy estaba convocada una huelga y una manifestación estudiantil en la región de Cataluña, lugar de origen del controvertido rapero y donde las protestas fueron de mayor intensidad. Anoche, la policía detuvo a 16 personas en Barcelona y Valencia durante los altercados estallados por tercer día consecutivo tras el encarcelamiento de Hasél, informaron autoridades locales.

En Barcelona, que acumula tres noches de protestas, la policía informó de ocho nuevas detenciones por "actos vandálicos y altercados", que se suman a las 51 personas arrestadas desde el martes en la región de Cataluña. Los manifestantes lanzaron objetos contundentes contra la policía, levantaron barricadas con contenedores y mobiliario urbano en llamas, y atacaron la redacción de un diario local. Según los servicios de emergencia regionales, seis personas fueron atendidas por lesiones, informó la agencia de noticias AFP.

En Valencia, en el este de España, la protesta para reclamar la libertad del rapero también derivó en choques entre manifestantes y policía, que cargó contra la multitud y disparó proyectiles de espuma. Según la Policía Nacional, se practicaron ocho arrestos y diez agentes resultaron lesionados. Los servicios de emergencias no informaron del número de manifestantes heridos.

El balance de detenidos desde el martes se acerca al centenar de personas. También se registraron numerosos heridos, entre ellos una joven que perdió la visión de un ojo en Barcelona, presuntamente por un proyectil de espuma disparado por la policía.

Networks are ubiquitous, ranging from protein-protein interaction networks in biology to social networks on social media platforms, enveloping us in different mediums and scales. Consequently, a substantial body of research delves into various facets of networks/graphs, their embeddings, and predictions. Our specific focus lies in predicting the structure of a dynamic, undirected, unweighted network/graph at a future time step, encompassing new nodes and edges.

Dynamic graphs, as encountered in social networks, evolve over time through the addition and deletion of nodes and edges. In contrast, the structure of static graphs remains constant. For instance, while traffic patterns fluctuate over time in road networks, the fundamental graph structure remains unchanged. Though static graphs have been scrutinized for a longer duration, dynamic graphs have garnered significant interest (Pareja et al., 2020; Trivedi et al., 2019; You et al., 2022; Barros et al., 2021; Sankar et al., 2020). The broad applicability of dynamic graphs across various scenarios such as recommender systems, autonomous vehicles, and social networks has propelled it into a burgeoning research domain.

Typically, dynamic graphs are represented in two distinct formats: discrete-time dynamic graphs (DTDG) and continuous-time dynamic graphs (CTDG) (Kazemi et al., 2020). Discrete-time dynamic graphs involve a series of graphs at regular time intervals, like daily activity graphs in social networks. On the other hand, continuous-time dynamic graphs are event-driven, with each event representing activities such as edge formation or node addition. In this work, we concentrate on discrete-time dynamic graphs (DTDG).

Node classification emerges as one of the prominent tasks in dynamic graphs. Examples include predicting paper subject categories or classifying protein roles in a protein-protein interaction network. Other tasks encompass graph classification, link prediction, edge classification, entity/relation prediction, time prediction, and network clustering. 多项因素推动汽车价格攀升至新高，并持续上涨（路透）。汽车经销商展厅内停放的车辆仅为以往的一小部分，无论是新车还是二手车，这导致价格达到历史最高水平。根据JD Power的数据，第一季度新车平均价格为3万7200元，较一年前上涨了8.4%。

根据JD Power的统计，约有一半的购车者支付的价格低于官方价的5%，甚至有些高于官方价。与两年前相比，今年大约有200万购车者最终支付的价格接近官方价。

此外，根据JD Power的其他数据显示，自今年年初以来，拍卖会上出售的大宗二手车价格上涨了26%，而同期零售价格仅上涨了7%。这种大幅增长表明大宗价格上涨的幅度预示着更大的涨势。

JD Power的巴里（David Paris）表示：“大宗二手车价格达到前所未有的最高水平，而二手零售价格也迅速上涨。”

相比一年前，汽车销售情况发生了180度的转变。那时，许多汽车经销商因新冠疫情关闭或提供有限服务和维修，导致大量工作流失和在家工作，汽车销量暴跌30%，是自经济大衰退以来的最大季度跌幅。

然而，现在销量正在蓬勃发展，3月经过季节性调整后，新车销量达到2017年10月以来的最高水平。

但是，由于电脑芯片短缺，全球汽车工厂被迫关闭或减产，导致需求更加旺盛。根据Cox Automotive的数据，今年前三个月北美地区新车产量减少约340万辆。二手车市场同样供不应求，一些供需指标显示出有史以来最严重的缺货情况。

强劲的销售和有限的供应这两个因素推动着汽车价格上涨。Edmonds.com资深洞察经理卓瑞（Ivan Drury）表示：“需求旺盛，但供应短缺。”

许多因素导致了供应短缺，其中包括就业市场改善、办公室重新开放以及在家工作的员工回到公司。此外，消费者手头现金充裕、市场利率极低，对更昂贵车型和选配件的兴趣增加，甚至汽车租赁也严重不足。专家预测，购车者面临的局势不会很快改善。

Cox Automotive资深经济学者切斯布鲁（Charlie Chesbrough）说：“这是一场完美风暴。如果不愿意支付接近官方价格，还有很多人愿意支付。这些问题至少会持续到今年年底。”

下面是导致汽车价格上涨的所有因素：

晶片短缺导致供应不足

电脑芯片短缺只是压缩可售车辆库存的一个因素。专家指出，其他汽车零件，如轮胎和塑料，也已经开始供不应求。

The utilization of large-scale pre-training for dialogue generation (Zhang et al., 2020; Freitas et al., 2020) has significantly propelled the development of interactive and humanlike dialogue systems. However, despite advancements, cutting-edge open-domain chatbots like BlenderBot (Roller et al., 2021), EVA (Zhou et al., 2021; Gu et al., 2022), and PLATO (Bao et al., 2021b) still struggle with consistency in their interactions, often producing self-contradictory or contextually inconsistent responses (Shuster et al., 2022; Gu et al., 2022; Xu et al., 2022a). These inconsistencies violate Grice's cooperative principle (Grice, 1975) and significantly undermine users' long-term trust (Huang et al., 2020; Lee et al., 2022).

Detecting dialogue contradictions has proven to be a valuable strategy for enhancing chatbot consistency (Welleck et al., 2019; Nie et al., 2021), but it remains a challenging task. The conversational context necessitates the consideration and modeling of contextual information. For example, in Figure 1's "Contradiction" scenario, while b2 does not explicitly contradict b1, given u1, the intended meaning of b1 should be "I like dogs, cats," making b1 and b2 contradictory. Conversely, in the "Non-contradiction" instance, although b1 and b2 may appear inconsistent ("love" vs. "dislike"), considering the dialogue context, b2 actually means "I dislike noodles," aligning with b1 and not creating a contradiction.

Despite this challenge, current datasets for contradiction detection (Dziri et al., 2019 et al., 2019) typically only focus on the textual entailment relationship between isolated sentences (Dagan et al., 2005), which inadequately addresses the complexity of dialogue contradiction detection due to the absence of contextual information. A recent study (Nie et al., 2021) introduced the DE-CODE dataset, where conversations contain contradictions between the final utterances and the dialogue histories. However, DECODE lacks broad coverage of typical contradiction categories, with most cases being human-written, creating a gap from real-world scenarios where users prompt chatbots to make contradictions.

In this study, we introduce CDCONV, a benchmark for Contradiction Detection in Chinese Conversations, comprising 12K multi-turn conversations annotated with contradiction labels (§3). Unlike previous work (e.g., Nie et al., 2021) that focused solely on History Contradiction, CDCONV encompasses two additional categories: Intra-sentence Contradiction and Role Confusion, denoting self-contradictory replies and speaker role confusion, respectively.

Due to the significant imbalance between non-contradiction and contradiction cases in natural human-bot conversations (§3, Nie et al., 2021), we combine automatic and manual methods to construct CDCONV conversations (§4.1). Initially, we employ automatic methods to simulate common user behaviors triggering chatbots to make contradictions (§4.2), followed by meticulous human screening and annotation to ensure data quality (§4.3). We validate the efficacy of these trigger methods and highlight how top Chinese open-domain chatbots (EVA and PLATO) can be easily led into making contradictions (§4.4).

Finally, we evaluate prominent Chinese pre-trained models on CDCONV (§5), emphasizing the critical role of contextual information modeling in dialogue contradiction detection. Nonetheless, there remains ample room for future research in dialogue modeling, integrating common sense and worldly knowledge, and reasoning.

In summary, our contributions include:
- Introducing CDCONV, a benchmark for detecting contradictions in Chinese conversations, featuring 12K annotated conversations covering three typical contradiction categories.

Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have shown remarkable progress in recent years, yet their vulnerability to small perturbations remains a critical challenge. Despite significant advancements in adversarial attacks [3, 6, 16, 41], the underlying reasons for CNN fragility to these perturbations are still not well understood [25, 33, 4, 44, 32]. State-of-the-art models often generate perturbations that resemble statistical noise, affecting both high and low image scales, akin to high and low frequencies. This inability to localize an attack is a key limitation of time-domain attacks, as they end up modifying unnecessary or unrelated information in the image [20, 2].

To address this, we propose a novel approach, shifting the focus from generating adversarial attacks in the time domain to exploiting vulnerabilities in deep learning models by creating fine, structural perturbations in the high scale Wavelet decomposition, specifically in meaningful image content. Studies have shown that the early convolution layers of CNNs capture low-level edge and edge orientation information, possibly resembling the receptive fields of human vision [19, 49].
