The concept of Remaining Useful Life (RUL) refers to the expected remaining lifespan of a component or equipment, and its prediction is crucial for informing maintenance decisions and reducing the risk of catastrophic failures during operation. Accurate RUL prediction is vital for Prognostic and Health Management (PHM) and maintenance planning, as preventive maintenance actions are scheduled based on RUL predictions and the equipment's health condition to prevent unexpected failures and minimize total maintenance costs.

This study introduces and validates a new computational architecture and prognostic model for highly accurate RUL prediction of rotating machinery, which plays a critical role in various industrial applications like power generation and transportation. Given the challenging working conditions under which rotating machinery operates, timely failure prediction and maintenance are essential for equipment reliability. Advancements in sensor technologies and data acquisition have led to the increasing popularity of data-driven methods for RUL prediction, with various machine learning models being proposed and applied to rotating machinery.

For instance, Zhang et al. developed a deep learning (DL) and health indicator-based RUL prediction method, while Wang et al. designed a hybrid prognostic model with Relevant Vector Machine (RVM) and health indicators for the RUL prediction of rolling element bearings, both reporting high prediction accuracy. The design and selection of a prognostic model should align with the input raw data to avoid overfitting and underfitting, emphasizing the importance of a balanced approach to this challenge.

Deep Learning (DL) stands out as a key technology for RUL prediction due to its ability to handle high-dimensional data effectively. Several studies have demonstrated the superior performance of DL models in predicting RUL for various systems, including ball bearing machines and complex systems like railways. Additionally, Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) has proven effective for modeling time streaming data with uncertainty quantification, offering improved accuracy compared to other models. While these approaches show promise, they still face challenges in achieving high accuracy in RUL prediction.

The main contribution of this study lies in developing and validating a novel computational architecture for highly accurate RUL prediction with uncertainty quantification, leveraging the strengths of DL neural networks and non-stationary GPR to address current challenges in predicting the RUL of rotating machinery. The performance of the proposed RUL prediction model is tested and benchmarked using real-world experimental data, demonstrating significantly higher accuracy compared to existing alternatives in recent literature.

The remainder of the article is structured as follows: Section 2 introduces our RUL prediction model and its technical details, Section 3 presents the datasets and computational experiments used for testing and benchmarking, Section 4 discusses the computational results, and Section 5 concludes the study.

City Manager Edward M. Augustus Jr. earlier this year tasked the Human Rights Commission and the Police Department to collaborate on engaging community conversations regarding a body camera program, as part of wider reforms aimed at dismantling structural racism in Worcester. The commission received briefings on police body cameras and is set to host community listening sessions on the topic through the summer and fall.

The idea of a permanent body camera program in Worcester, building upon a 2019 pilot program, has garnered support from both police and community advocates. However, the city is waiting for recommendations from a statewide task force before implementing a full program. Concerns were raised about privacy protections, consequences for non-compliance with camera policies, and potential delays in accessing public records related to body camera footage.

At-large City Councilor Khrystian King emphasized the need to move forward with implementing another pilot program without waiting for the task force's recommendations. He stressed the importance of transparency and accountability that body cameras could provide, supporting both officers and citizens.

Lt. Sean Murtha provided details on the previous body camera pilot program, highlighting its success and the positive feedback from participating officers. He outlined the policies and procedures governing camera usage, emphasizing the potential benefits in promoting accountability and resolving complaints efficiently.

The city, according to Isabel Gonzalez-Webster of Worcester Interfaith, must ensure solid policies are in place to make body cameras a tool of trust between the police and the community. She urged the city to go beyond the state task force recommendations and set a high standard for body camera usage, emphasizing the need to balance transparency with privacy considerations.

Daniel Nakamoto from the state Executive Office of Public Safety and Security discussed the state's efforts to assist local departments in developing body camera programs. He highlighted a grant program to support capital purchases for such programs and acknowledged the state's lag in adopting body cameras compared to the national average.

Rahsaan Hall of the ACLU stressed the importance of community engagement in shaping body camera policies, emphasizing transparency and privacy considerations. He recommended clear guidelines for camera usage, public availability of key footage, and consequences for policy violations, while also advocating for limits on surveillance technologies.

As the Human Rights Commission prepares for citywide listening sessions on body cameras, commissioners raised questions about privacy, storage, and oversight. They expressed a need for clarity on the feedback sought from the public, especially in light of pending state task force recommendations. Scheduled listening sessions in various districts will provide an opportunity for community input on the issue.

In conclusion, the discussions at the Human Rights Commission meeting highlighted the complexities and considerations surrounding the implementation of a body camera program in Worcester. While there is broad support for such a program, stakeholders are grappling with issues of privacy, transparency, and community engagement to ensure that body cameras serve as tools for accountability and trust-building between law enforcement and the public.

Have you ever had to drive a car but wished you could just relax while driving? Well, the folks at Google are working on that with their driverless car technology. This innovation offers both positive and negative aspects, and I will share my thoughts on the matter.

There are numerous benefits to the driverless car concept. You can sit back and unwind in the car until encountering a roadblock or potential crash. It alleviates the stress of being stuck in traffic, and Google's driverless car has successfully traveled half a million miles without incident, potentially reducing the number of accidents.

However, the driverless car also has its drawbacks that may make some people prefer to stick with traditional driving. It is not entirely autonomous and cannot handle tasks like pulling in and out of driveways. Since not everyone will have a driverless car, the risk of accidents may not decrease significantly. Additionally, you cannot simply doze off and let the car take you to your destination; you still need to remain alert and conscious.

Regarding my stance on the matter, it may differ from others, but that's perfectly fine.

Así lo anunció el presidente de Canarias, Ángel Víctor Torres, en una declaración a los medios de comunicación. El domingo pasado, después de enterarse de las declaraciones del párroco, el presidente se puso en contacto con el consejero de Justicia, Julio Pérez, para que iniciara los procedimientos necesarios y no permitir que estas declaraciones "queden impunes".

El presidente canario expresó su reconocimiento tanto al Cabildo de Gran Canaria como a la Fiscalía Provincial, destacando que es inaceptable ignorar declaraciones tan vergonzosas, inaceptables, lamentables y denunciables del padre Báez.

Ángel Víctor Torres dejó claro que la sociedad canaria se avergüenza de estas declaraciones, ya que no las representa ni se siente cerca de afirmaciones tan graves, lo cual deja a quien las pronunció en una posición de nulidad.

وصل الوفد، الذي يضم الرياضيين من كوريا الشمالية، اليوم الخميس، إلى الجارة الجنوبية للمشاركة في الأولمبياد الشتوي الذي سيُعقد في بيونغ تشانغ. تأتي هذه الخطوة كجزء من "أولمبياد السلام"، الذي تسعى إليه سيؤول بعد شهور من التوتر مع بيونغ يانغ. قبل ثمانية أيام من انطلاق الألعاب المقررة بين التاسع من فبراير و25 منه، وصل عشرة متزلجين من كوريا الشمالية إلى مطار قرب مدينة غانغ نونغ (شمال شرق)، وفقًا لإعلان وزارة التوحيد الكورية الجنوبية، بعد رحلة مباشرة نادرة بين الكوريتين. ولتحقيق هذه الغاية، كان يتعين على سيؤول الحصول على ترخيص خاص لإعفاء الطائرة من العقوبات الأميركية.

سيلتحق الرياضيون الكوريون الشماليون العشرة بمقر إقامتهم في غانغ غونغ، حيث ستُقام منافسات التزلج. خارج المطار، رفع المؤيدون لهذا التقارب بين الجارتين صورًا لعلم التوحيد، والذي يُظهر شبه الجزيرة على خلفية بيضاء مع عبارة "نحن واحد".

ساهمت الألعاب الأولمبية في التقارب بين الشمال والجنوب، وهو ما لم يكن متوقعًا قبل بضعة أشهر بسبب التوتر في شبه الجزيرة، خاصة بعد تكرار بيونغ يانغ إطلاق الصواريخ الباليستية عابرة للقارات. كما قامت كوريا الشمالية بأكثر من تجربة نووية، وسط تصريحات متوترة بين الزعيم الكوري الشمالي كيم جونغ أون والرئيس الأمريكي دونالد ترامب، أحد حلفاء الجنوب.

قاطعت بيونغ يانغ لعدة أشهر الدعوات المتكررة من سيؤول للمشاركة في الأولمبياد الشتوي الذي أُطلق عليه اسم "ألعاب السلام"، حتى تجاوزت المواعيد النهائية لتسجيل اللاعبين، قبل أن يتم التوصل إلى اتفاق لمشاركة 22 رياضيًا كوريًا شماليًا، بما فيهم 12 لاعبة ضمن فريق موحد للكوريتين في لعبة الهوكي على الجليد.

يشارك الرياضيون الكوريون الشماليون في التزلج الألبي، التزلج الشمالي، التزحلق الفني على الجليد، التزحلق السريع، والهوكي على الجليد للسيدات. تم رفع العلم الكوري الشمالي في كوريا الجنوبية، وفقًا للجهات المنظمة، بعد دخول قرار الإعفاء من الحظر حيز التنفيذ.

Neural networks have become an essential tool for machine learning practitioners due to their impressive performance, especially in vision and natural language processing (Goodfellow et al., 2016). In practice, neural networks are often utilized in the overparametrized regime and can even fit random labels (Zhang et al., 2021). Despite their tendency to overfit significantly, these overparametrized models perform well on real-world data, a phenomenon referred to as "the generalization puzzle" (Nagarajan & Kolter, 2019).

To address this puzzle, several research directions have emerged, offering potential explanations, such as implicit regularization (Chizat & Bach, 2020), interpolation (Chatterji & Long, 2021), and benign overfitting (Bartlett et al., 2020). VC theory, however, has not been able to provide an explanation, as the existing bounds on the VC dimensions of neural networks are typically on the order of the number of weights (Maass, 1994; Bartlett et al., 2019). The question of whether neural network architectures exist that can model a wide range of classifiers with low VC dimension remains unanswered.

This work focuses on a class of neural networks with threshold activation, termed hyperplane arrangement neural networks (HANNs). By leveraging the theory of sample compression schemes (Littlestone & Warmuth, 1986), we demonstrate that HANNs can have a VC dimension significantly smaller than the number of parameters, showcasing their high expressivity. We also establish, through analysis, that HANN classifiers achieve minimax optimality in an overparametrized setting, given data with Lipschitz posterior class probability.

We evaluate the empirical performance of HANNs on 121 UCI datasets, in line with recent neural network and neural tangent kernel studies (Klambauer et al., 2017; Wu et al., 2018; Arora et al., 2019; Shankar et al., 2020). Klambauer et al.

Computer fonts are widely used in our daily lives. The legibility and aesthetic of fonts adopted in books, posters, advertisements, etc., are critical for their producers during the designing procedures. Thereby, the demands for high-quality fonts in various styles have increased rapidly. However, font design is a creative and time-consuming task, especially for font libraries consisting of large amounts of characters (e.g., Chinese).

For example, the official character set GB18030-2000 consists of 27533 Chinese characters, most of which have complicated structures and contain dozens of strokes. Designing or writing out such large amounts of complex glyphs in a consistent style is time-consuming and costly. Thus, more and more researchers and companies are interested in developing systems that can automatically generate high-quality Chinese fonts from a few input samples.

With the help of various neural network architectures (e.g., CNNs and RNNs), researchers have proposed many DL-based methods for Chinese font synthesis. DL-based methods aim to model the relationship between input and output data (outlines, glyph images, or writing trajectories). Most of them are CNN-based models, such as zi2zi, EMD, and SCFont. Intuitively, we can represent a glyph as the combination of a writing trajectory and a stroke rendering style. Thus, there are some RNN-based methods (e.g., FontRNN) synthesizing the writing trajectory for each Chinese character.

Despite the great progress made in the last few years, most existing approaches still need large amounts of offline or online glyph images to train the font synthesis models. Moreover, the quality of vector outlines/glyph images synthesized by those methods is often unsatisfactory, especially when the desired font is in a cursive style or the number of input samples is too small.

The design of our FontTransformer is motivated by the observation that a Chinese character is typically rendered as a glyph image when it is composed of sequential strokes in essence.

The notion of using a computer as a musical instrument is not readily embraced by many computer music practitioners. In this report, we explore the challenges associated with perceiving the computer as a musical instrument and investigate potential solutions. At the outset, it is beneficial to consider the unique features that computer technology brings to musical instrumentation.

Traditional acoustic instruments, such as strings, woodwinds, brass, and percussion, involve direct physical interaction with the sound production mechanism. Strings are plucked or bowed, tubes are blown, and surfaces are struck, with the performer’s gesture directly exciting the acoustic mechanism. Instruments like the piano and organ mediate this connection through mechanical linkages or electrical connections, yet they still follow a "one gesture to one acoustic event" paradigm. 

In contrast, when sensors capture gestures and computing elements generate sound, a vast array of possibilities emerges. Unfortunately, the electronic music instrument industry often adheres to traditional paradigms, particularly with standard keyboard controllers. Musical instruments and their gestural interfaces become widely used for various reasons, many of which are social in nature, such as the development of a repertoire. However, such sociological aspects are beyond the scope of this paper. Our focus will be on factors like ease of use, skill development potential, reactive behavior, and the coherence of the cognitive model for control.

A conceptual framework for controller research and development is presented in the figure below. A human performer aims to produce a specific musical result, communicating intentions to the body's sensorimotor system (or "motor program"). Parameters are sensed at the gestural interface and passed to controller software, which conditions, tracks, and maps them to algorithms generating the musical material. Although schematic and incomplete, this framework offers insight into the roles of human motor learning, controller mapping, and generative software as a unified adaptive system.

Unlike the one gesture to one acoustic event paradigm, our framework allows generative algorithms to create complex musical structures comprising many events.

▲ 陈姓男子以低价购买信用卡资料，再申请电商账号进行盗刷购物，随后以低价出售商品获利。（图／记者邱中岳翻摄）

记者邱中岳／台北报导

台北市刑大接获线报，发现有不法集团在网络上购买信用卡资料，随后到电商平台进行盗刷。为了避免被发现，他们仅购买5,000元以下的商品，再以低价在另一个电商平台上架出售获利。在短短一个月内，获利高达60万元，连日常开销也用盗刷的方式支付，如叫外卖、购买加油券等，导致许多商家几乎拿不到钱。

警方调查发现，32岁的陈姓男子居住在台南，自2020年1月起，通过渠道以200至500元不等的价格，向盗刷集团购买信用卡资料，随后在露天拍卖等电商平台盗刷购物。但为了避免警方查缉，他们仅购买5,000元以下的产品。

▲ 陈姓男子不仅盗刷商品，还利用盗刷的信用卡资料支付日常餐饮和生活用品。（图／记者邱中岳翻摄）

陈姓嫌犯等人还将商品以低价转手在其他电商平台出售，初步估计从事该行为4个月来，不法获利已高达300万元。最后，警方在5月初逮捕了陈嫌及其5名犯罪同伙，讯后依照诈欺、伪造文书、《组织犯罪条例》等罪移送法办。

警方发现，许多持卡人发现信用卡被盗刷后，否认交易并拒绝付款，银行也拒绝吸收这些盗刷呆账，导致电商卖家损失惨重。有电商损失近百万元，愤而报警。

警方进一步调查发现，从2020年1月起，不法分子在网络电商平台申请账号，并输入购买的信用卡资料进行盗刷。仅1个月内，就有52组买家账号盗刷了台湾及外国人士的信用卡。

She basically jumped in front of my truck and then opened the door. It was pretty shifty – forced entry in an F-150. It isn't so much as I picked her up. I asked her her name and what she wanted and needed in this world. Her answers were monotone and strange to say the least. But when we hit the highway, her talking increased.

She told me what she really desired, more than diamonds or money or babies, was someone to love. I thought it cliche at first, but with someone so shady, it seemed to fit like a glove. Who could want a roving maniac with dirt-encrusted fingernails and jeans ripped beyond recognition? Who could need to be needed by an eccentric person more animal than woman? I could. I do. 

The more we drive, the more I realize she hasn't told me where to go. I look, and I can see in her eyes, she knows I'm hooked. We stop at a coffee shop, and she runs to the restroom. I wait and wait for her, until I'm sore. But just like a siren with its song, I was someone, I was hooked, but not the fish she was searching for.

Nawazuddin Siddiqui's much-anticipated film 'Ghoomketu' is set to finally premiere on the digital platform ZEE5 on May 22. Film critic and trade analyst Taran Adarsh announced the film's OTT release on Twitter, revealing that the story follows an inexperienced writer, played by Nawazuddin Siddiqui, who aspires to make a big name for himself in Mumbai's film industry.

In this comedy-drama, the narrative is from the perspective of Nawazuddin Siddiqui's character and features filmmaker Anurag Kashyap as a corrupt cop. Nawazuddin has described Ghoomketu as a quirky and unique character, expressing his joy in portraying this role. He also shared his happiness that a humorous film like this is being released on the OTT platform during the lockdown to lift everyone's spirits.

The official plot of the movie reads: "On his quest to come up with a great story, he is inspired by everyday mundane activities. Will his ambition and determination exceed his talents? Or will a corrupt cop (Kashyap), on a mission to find Ghoomketu, bring his 30-day escapade to a halt?"

Directed by Pushpendra Nath Mishra and produced by Phantom Films and Sony Pictures Networks (SPN), 'Ghoomketu' features Anurag Kashyap alongside actors Ila Arun, Raghubir Yadav, Swanand Kirkire, and Ragini Khanna in pivotal roles. Special appearances are made by Amitabh Bachchan, Ranveer Singh, Sonakshi Sinha, Chitrangada Singh, Lauren Gottlieb, and filmmaker Nikhil Advani.

The gleaming fist of metal smashed into Amrin's jaw, making him stumble onto the table behind him. Blood dripped from his mouth. He spat and saw a tooth. Turning back, he allowed himself to laugh. 

"For someone so holy and up god's arse, Olanus, you're bloody quick to employ violence," he remarked, wiping the blood from his mouth. 

His assailant stepped out from the shadow of the room and into the light. Clad head to toe in shining steel, the armor emphasized his already fearsome physique. The helm covered his face, but the holy symbols on his tabard and the familiarity of the punch told Amrin exactly who it was. The knight raised an armored fist and stabbed a finger at him. 

"Did you not think I would find you here, brother?" he spat. 

Amrin shrugged off his cloak and placed it on the chair next to him. He wanted Olanus to see that he was armed. Not that a dagger would do much against a couple of inches of heavy plate. 

"I was rather hoping you did," Amrin retorted, batting his hand away. "Hopefully, I can talk you out of this madness before you get more people killed." 

"Madness? You pervert life with your vile sorcery, while I wish to save innocent people, and I'm the one who is mad? You willingly perform magic that is destroying you."

Amrin lowered his hood and felt his swollen jaw. Olanus wasn't wrong. Sunken eyes, pallid skin, and atrophied muscles. When you deal in death, the effects take their toll. 

"Yes. I re-animate the dead. But that is only flesh and bone. The souls have passed. If they haven't, it's my job to help them on their way. The scientific advances we have made in medicine alone will help thousands. But we respect the natural order. Life can be prolonged. But outright preventing death is obscene!" 

Olanus, his fists clenched, took a step back.

The Government's decision not to reinstate the night bus, alongside all other routes, at a time when Gibraltar has fully opened retail, restaurants, bars, and is being promoted as the perfect holiday destination this summer, is criticized by the GSD for being inexplicable and inconsistent with the Government's policy on promoting less car use. The GSD states that the night service will operate in a reduced manner, despite the Government reviewing the extent of the service due to public pressure.

Shadow Minister for Transport and the Environment Elliott Phillips MP emphasizes the importance of a robust public transport service to provide viable alternatives to using cars and motorbikes. Phillips believes that the provision of a night bus is crucial for building confidence in the community about these alternatives. He stresses that investing in the night bus service is essential for the long-term benefits for children, health, the environment, and tourism.

Phillips criticizes the Government for its short-sightedness and lack of vision in transportation policy. He argues that the decision not to reinstate the night bus and considering reducing its operation is counterproductive and inconsistent with the Government's green/child-friendly city policy. Phillips suggests that instead of focusing solely on the net cost of £75,000, the Government should first assess how to reorganize the bus service to provide a fully functional night service for the community. He concludes that the Government's actions in transport policy are hindering progress rather than advancing it.

أكد وزير الدفاع القبرصي، سافاس إنجيليدس، أن بلاده تحاول باستمرار إبراز الدور الذي يمكن أن تلعبه في منطقة جنوب شرق البحر المتوسط، وذلك عقب المناورات العسكرية المشتركة التي أجرتها مع فرنسا، بالتعاون مع حاملة الطائرات الفرنسية شارل ديجول.

وأضاف إنجيليدس - في تصريحات له نقلتها وكالة الأنباء القبرصية (سي إن إيه) اليوم الثلاثاء - أن المزيد من التدريبات المشتركة بين قبرص وفرنسا ستُجرى في المستقبل، تشمل الدفاع الجوي والطيران والبحرية، بهدف رفع قدرات الحرس الوطني القبرصي. وأوضح أن المرحلة الأولى من التدريبات المشتركة مع فرنسا تضمنت محاكاة مهاجمة أهداف افتراضية من خلال تفعيل نظام الدفاع الجوي القبرصي، حيث تمت هذه المهاجمة عبر طائرات "رافال" من حاملة الطائرات الفرنسية شارل ديجول.

وأشار إنجيليدس إلى رضاه عن نتائج التدريبات حتى الآن، معتبرًا أن "تدريبات اليوم تُمثل مثالًا واضحًا على التعاون الوثيق بين قبرص وفرنسا على المستوى العسكري".

وردًا على سؤال حول مدى إمكانية مناقشة زيادة التعاون بين البلدين في مجال الأمن والدفاع مع وزيرة الدفاع الفرنسية فلورنس بارلى، أكد وزير الدفاع القبرصي أن "نحن نبادل وجهات النظر حول تقييم المخاطر في المنطقة واتخاذ مزيد من الإجراءات لتعزيز هذا التعاون".

Galicia inicia hoy la desescalada de las restricciones frente al coronavirus con la reapertura de la hostelería y la posibilidad de reuniones de personas no convivientes. También se permitirá la movilidad entre municipios.

A las 10:00 horas, la hostelería tendrá un mínimo de un control semanal y podrán ser precintados por incumplimientos. Galicia ha publicado este jueves en el Diario Oficial de Galicia (DOG) el plan para la reapertura de una hostelería segura en la comunidad, un documento en el que se recogen las nuevas exigencias de publicidad de aforos, seguimiento de usuarios y régimen de control para evitar brotes de covid-19. Este plan entra en vigor con el arranque de la desescalada, este viernes.

Entre otras cuestiones, el documento incluye un plan de inspección y control a nivel autonómico y municipal para comprobar el cumplimiento de las medidas, indicando que la Xunta "velará por la adecuada colaboración con las entidades locales", especialmente las de menor tamaño. De forma genérica, la Xunta recomienda que los ayuntamientos sin Policía Local o con menos de tres efectivos en activo promuevan una visita semanal por cada local de hostelería, con medios propios o ajenos; mientras que aquellos municipios con más de tres efectivos de Policía Local y de hasta 20.000 habitantes deberán realizar dos visitas semanales por local de hostelería. En colaboración con las fuerzas autonómicas y estatales, el plan establece unos "estándares mínimos" de control exigidos por las autoridades sanitarias, dependiendo del tamaño y recursos del municipio en cuestión.

A las 9:30 horas, la Xunta reabre en los municipios con mejores datos bingos y salones de juego, pero mantiene cerrados albergues.

When a company is launching a new product and wants to use social media for marketing, understanding who to hire for such campaigns becomes of most importance to maximize profit. With the explosion of social media in recent years, a common strategy has been to target certain influential individuals for advertising. These individuals, or "influencers," become the initial spreaders in different social settings, and through their connections and followers, companies reach greater awareness (and sales) in the entire society. However, social groups are constantly evolving and thus influencers in certain social setting may no longer be the optimal selection in the few months or years until the product is released, which can lower efficiency. It becomes clear, then, that being able to predict future influencers is extremely important.

Within a mathematical setting, one can consider social networks as graphs, where the nodes represent members of the network, and their connections are represented by edges. The study of how nodes can influence a network has been done for many decades, and the reader can refer to recent surveys such as Lü et al.'s [42] in 2016, Pei et al.'s [50] in 2019, and AbdulAmeer et al.'s [3] in 2022 to learn about the scope of such work.

In particular, Domingos and Richardson [16] studied influence through a viral marketing perspective. In 2003, Kempe et al. [30] formalized this as the influence maximization problem (IMP) of choosing k nodes of greatest influence, proving that a complete solution was NP-hard. However, it is interesting to note that to the best of our knowledge, no mathematical definition of a social influencer has been proposed in the literature, and thus we shall introduce here what we think can be a useful way of thinking of such important individuals within our society (see Definition 29).

In the present paper, we will focus on heuristic measures, revolving around local centralities due to lower time complexity: while global metrics take into consideration more complete information about the graph, they are often computationally expensive.

1111人力银行近日公布的「职场平权现况调查」显示，台湾职场的性骚扰问题确实严重。调查结果指出，超过半数的上班族（50.7%）曾遭遇职场性骚扰。其中，女性的遭遇比例更高，达到六成八，而男性约为两成。

性骚扰的形式主要包括有意的碰触（67.6%）和言语骚扰（61.5%），接下来是侮辱和歧视态度与行为（35.5%）、被盯著看（31.5%）以及搂肩抠手（25.6%）。性骚扰事件发生的主要地点是办公空间，占比60.6%，其次是公开场合（24.7%）和密闭式场所（16.0%）。从时间上看，上班时间（65.7%）是性骚扰发生最多的时段，其次是下班以后（12.4%）和外出洽公时（6.8%）。

在施加性骚扰的人群中，比例最高的是同事（33.0%），其次是老板（22.7%）和直属主管（14.5%）。具体分析显示，对女性进行性骚扰的主要是「同事」，而对男性来说，「直属主管」的比例最高。

值得注意的是，调查发现有高达46.2%的受害者选择隐忍不发。其中，男性选择隐忍的比例更高，达到58.3%，而女性为44.4%。这一数据显示，虽然性骚扰在职场中普遍存在，但许多人仍选择沉默应对。

Isn't it fascinating how far technology has advanced, enabling computers to accurately read a person's emotions down to the precise calculation? Indeed, there now exists computer software capable of discerning emotions to the exact percentage. This innovative software was developed by Professor Thomas Huang in collaboration with Professor Nicu Sebe. This cutting-edge technology deserves recognition by everyone, particularly school children.

This software is adept at identifying every muscle in the face and comprehends the anatomy of these muscles. Each movement of a muscle is termed an 'action unit'. Dr. Huang draws on the research of psychologists like Dr. Paul Eckman, the originator of FACS (Facial Action Coding System). Eckman has categorized six fundamental emotions – happiness, surprise, anger, disgust, fear, and sadness – and linked each of these with characteristic movements of the facial muscles. This process allows the software to decipher every facial muscle and correlate it with the associated emotion, including the recognition of mixed emotions by assessing different units, a skill that can be challenging for a human to master.

Interestingly, we, as humans, instinctively conduct a similar, albeit less precise, 'calculation' on a daily basis. Although we are adept at deciphering the nonverbal emotions of others, the exact interpretation of a facial expression, especially for someone lacking a background in anatomy, can be a daunting task.

Facial expression recognition (FER) is a critical task within the computer vision community, aimed at enabling computer programs to automatically identify facial expressions from input images. This task has garnered significant interest due to its wide-ranging applications in human-computer interactions, medical progress monitoring, and driver fatigue monitoring, among other fields. However, FER presents unique challenges, particularly when conducted "in the wild." The difficulty arises from the significant intraclass variances and inter-class similarities among expression categories, which make it distinct from general image classification tasks. For instance, the same individual in identical lighting and posture may display different expressions, while people of various identities, ages, genders, and poses may express the same emotion.

In recent years, the development of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) has led to numerous methods that significantly enhance FER performance. However, the Vision Transformer (ViT), introduced for image classification, has emerged as a promising alternative due to its non-local self-attention mechanism. Despite its potential, ViT's performance in FER remains inferior to state-of-the-art CNNs, with the exception of the TransFER model. The primary issue is that ViT requires extensive data for training, owing to its large number of parameters and lack of inductive bias. The existing FER datasets are much smaller compared to general image classification datasets like ImageNet, making it challenging for Transformer-based modules to converge well and often result in a focus on occlusion or background areas instead.

Various methods, such as regularization and attention techniques, have been proposed to tackle these issues. The TransFER model, for example, generates an attention map to reduce the impact of noisy features by multiplying them with the feature maps. However, even in this model, noisy features are still fed into downstream processes. This raises the question: Why compute noisy features if they are already identified as noise?

Benefiting from the flexible design of the Transformer model, which can adopt any number of tokens as input without altering model parameters, we propose the Attentive Patch Pooling (APP) module to directly discard noisy features. Unlike simply multiplying noisy features with a small value, the APP module pools them directly, as shown in Fig. 1. This approach takes advantage of the attention mechanism in Transformer blocks, making it more intuitive to perform attentive pooling.

Recent findings, such as those from CPVT, suggest that replacing the [class] token with global average pooling (GAP) can improve performance. DeepViT further investigated this, finding that attention maps become similar after certain layers and proposed a Re-attention method to increase layer diversity. In contrast, inspired by the Max Pooling technique in CNNs, which reduces feature map size and provides an abstract and robust representation, we directly drop less essential tokens, retaining only a small number to embed information. The Attentive Token Pooling (ATP) module utilizes the Transformer's attention mechanism to discard less important tokens in deep blocks. Fig. 2 illustrates the differences between these methods, showing how ATP gradually decreases the token number in deep blocks to interrupt noisy feature propagation more effectively than Max Pooling.

Our proposed APViT model, which combines APP and ATP, is illustrated in Fig. 2(d). This model offers several key contributions:

1. The APP module selects the most distinguishable local patches from CNN feature maps, preventing noisy patches from affecting recognition performance downstream.
2. The ATP module leverages the Transformer's attention mechanism to focus only on the top-k relevant tokens, reducing the influence of noise and occlusions and saving computation time.
3. Experimental results on several challenging in-the-wild datasets demonstrate the advantages of our APViT method over state-of-the-art approaches.

ذكرت وكالة أنباء إيرانية، اليوم الأربعاء، أن السلطات أغلقت الوصول إلى الإنترنت عبر الهاتف النقال في عدة محافظات، قبل يوم من الاحتجاجات الجديدة التي دعت إليها وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي، وفقا لما أوردته رويترز.

ونقلت وكالة الأنباء شبه الرسمية، عن مصدر مطلع في وزارة الاتصالات وتكنولوجيا المعلومات قوله إن الإغلاق تم بأمر من "السلطات الأمنية" وسيغطي مقاطعات البرز وكردستان وزنجان في وسط وغرب إيران وفارس في الجنوب.

برعاية مؤسسة العيسي للمبادرات الإنسانية، قامت مجموعة "طفرة عدنية" في مديريات محافظة عدن بفتح الشوارع المغلقة وإزالة الأتربة ومخلفات السيول الناتجة عن الأمطار الغزيرة التي شهدتها المحافظة بسبب المنخفض الجوي.

وستسهم مؤسسة العيسي للمبادرات الإنسانية بشكل كامل في رفع الأضرار والمخلفات وإصلاح بعض الطرق التي دمرتها السيول. كما سيتم توزيع سلة غذائية متكاملة مصحوبة بمبالغ مالية كمساعدات للأسر الأكثر تضرراً، بالإضافة إلى إجراء صيانة بسيطة لمنازلهم المتضررة، بهدف التخفيف عنهم وتعويضهم عن الأضرار.

وأكد الشيخ أحمد صالح العيسي، المعروف بأعماله الخيرية والإنسانية، دعمه اللامحدود لشباب "طفرة عدنية" في مواجهة الأضرار التي خلفتها السيول في مدينة عدن والتي أعاقت حركة السير.

Discourse structure plays an essential role in text generation across various domains, including news (Van Dijk, 2013) and peer-reviewed articles (Shen et al., 2022b). In the legal domain, it's equally important to draft summaries that follow a structured blueprint (Xu et al., 2021). For instance, as shown in Figure 1, a legal expert might summarize a long legal opinion by clearly delineating the issues addressed, the decision's conclusion, and the reasoning behind the decision. 

In the legal domain, besides directly adopting raw document-summary pairs for supervised training using abstractive summarization models such as BART (Lewis et al., 2020) and Longformer Encoder Decoder (LED) (Beltagy et al., 2020), Elaraby and Litman (2022) proposed highlighting salient argumentative sentences in the inputs to train a model that is argument-aware. However, we focus on improving adherence to argument structure by utilizing annotated discourse structures to create structure prompts, rather than manipulating the original articles.

Despite progress in controllable generation, limited research has focused on controlling discourse structure. Recently, Spangher et al. (2022) and Shen et al. (2022a) proposed methods to generate sentences with discourse structure labels. However, these efforts have not been applied to the legal domain, where argumentative structure is crucial. Prior work in the legal field highlighted the importance of argumentative structure from the input (Elaraby and Litman, 2022), yet utilizing argument structure to guide text generation remains unexplored.

Based on a corpus analysis showing that experts use common patterns to summarize legal opinions—with the most frequent pattern shown in Figure 1—we developed a novel structure-prompting approach called STRONG (Structure conTRollable legal OpiNion summary Generation).

行政院副院长陈其迈于12日上午与两位美国学者举行线上会议，分享台湾在「大数据防疫」上的成功经验。与会者包括疾管署副署长庄人祥、卫福部资讯处处长，以及行政院资安处处长。这次会议重点在于台湾如何利用大数据分析来链结入境资讯与健保资料库，并应用科技落实居家检疫，以降低社区感染风险。

陈其迈特别指出，两位与会的美国学者是来自史丹佛大学的王智弘教授和健康法律学者Michelle M. Mello教授。王教授曾分析台湾的三大关键防疫措施：「大数据分析、新科技、主动采检」。在会上，陈其迈详细说明了台湾在钻石公主号事件中，如何通过识别和掌握电子足迹，以大数据分析识别热点，并及时发布细胞简讯和健康追踪。

Mello教授对此表示好奇，并询问为何台湾在疫情防控中，能赢得民众的高度信任。陈其迈以三点进行了回应：1. 疫情指挥中心每日公开透明地召开记者会说明疫情进展；2. 行政院长苏贞昌于12月31日便要求政府超前部署，包括登机检疫等快速有效的行动；3. 自2003年SARS事件后，人民与政府已形成合作伙伴关系，了解如何在疫情期间与政府协作。

Is the Facial Action Coding System Useful in Classrooms?

Imagine a machine capable of not only recognizing but also understanding emotions through facial expressions. Such a machine exists: the Facial Action Coding System, or FACS. This technology could be incredibly beneficial in classrooms. It could identify students' emotions, help prevent or address issues before they arise, and provide teachers with valuable feedback that might not be communicated verbally.

FACS creates a 3D model of the face, analyzing all 44 major facial muscles to interpret a person’s emotions. For instance, raising the frontalis pars lateralis, the muscles above the eyes, indicates surprise. Implementing this technology in classrooms could help educators discern students' emotions and understand their feelings better.

Recognizing emotions in the classroom can be extremely beneficial. Students, on average, spend 6-8 hours a day in classrooms, and their emotions, still in development, are a crucial part of their maturation. Occasionally, students might experience breakdowns or outbursts for various reasons. A student, for example, could be stressed about their grades, which might lead to a decline in performance. With FACS, such behavior could be anticipated, allowing teachers to provide the necessary encouragement or academic assistance. Furthermore, the school environment, with its numerous variables, can also pose challenges.

Private optimization serves as the primary approach for private machine learning, aiming to train effective models without leaking sensitive attributes of the training data. Differential privacy (DP) is considered the gold standard for measuring this information leakage [DMNS06, DR14]. Among various private optimization techniques, noisy gradient descent and its variants are the predominant algorithms. A central question in this field is how to quantify the differential privacy of these algorithms. However, achieving tight characterizations remains a challenge, even in the seemingly simple setting of convex optimization.

In essence, DP measures how distinguishable the output of a (randomized) algorithm is when run on two adjacent datasets—datasets that differ in only one individual record. There are numerous ways to measure this distinguishability, leading to several relaxations of DP, such as those discussed in [BS16, Mir17, DRS22]. Different DP notions result in varying privacy analyses, and an extensive body of work has sought to establish sharp privacy bounds for noisy gradient descent and its variants [BST14, ACG + 16, FMTT18, CYS21, YS22, AT22, ABT24].

A common method employed in this analysis is the composition theorem, which incurs a privacy cost for each intermediate iterate along the optimization trajectory, potentially leading to suboptimal privacy bounds. Recent research has significantly improved the privacy analysis in cases of convex and strongly convex losses, demonstrating that the privacy leakage of noisy (stochastic) gradient descent does not increase indefinitely with the number of iterations, t [CYS21, YS22, AT22, ABT24]. This stands in stark contrast to the composition-based approach, which provides privacy bounds that scale with √t.

These "convergent" privacy bounds have been proven in the Rényi DP framework, which, although analytically convenient, is inherently lossy. To achieve the tightest possible privacy bounds, it is natural to employ the f-DP framework [DRS22] for analysis. The f-DP framework is preferable because it: (1) precisely characterizes all aspects of the hypothesis testing problem defining DP, allowing optimal f-DP bounds to be losslessly converted into bounds in other privacy frameworks like (ε, δ)-DP or Rényi DP; (2) remains lossless under the composition of multiple private mechanisms, a crucial operation in DP; and (3) is easily interpretable in terms of the original hypothesis testing definition of DP.

However, analyzing privacy leakage within the f-DP framework is challenging. Quantifying the complete tradeoff between Type I/II errors is considerably more complex than addressing less informative alternative notions of privacy. Consequently, the analysis tools for f-DP are currently limited. These limitations are particularly evident in the fundamental problem of assessing the privacy loss of noisy gradient descent and its variants. To illustrate this, existing privacy guarantees based on f-DP diverge as the number of iterations t increases, whereas recent work employing divergence-based DP definitions indicates that noisy gradient descent and its variants can maintain privacy, even with indefinite iterations, for strongly convex problems [CYS21, YS22, AT22, ABT24] or even just convex problems [AT22, ABT24]. Convergent privacy bounds complement renowned results for minimax-optimal privacy-utility tradeoffs [BST14, BFTGT19], enabling extended training periods beneficial to typical learning problems that are not worst-case and gain from prolonged training.

Can convergent privacy bounds be directly achieved within the tight framework of f-DP?

Paper writing is an essential skill that junior graduate students or researchers should master because of its importance in learning, understanding, applying, and synthesizing new knowledge. Basically, the structure of a typical research paper follows a pattern known as the "King Model," which delineates the thematic progression of an article through six sections: title, abstract, introduction, body, discussion, and references. Among the major components of academic papers, abstracts, which usually consist of separate paragraphs outlining the content of the paper, have become increasingly important. For example, with the boom in search engines and bibliographic databases, the title and abstract are often the only two parts of a research paper that a potential reader can freely view, while access to the full paper may be subject to charges to the copyright owner. In addition, when researchers conduct systematic investigations of related work, they have to spend time reading the full manuscripts if the corresponding abstracts are obscure, so they may abandon researching them. In addition, during the blind review process, editors use abstracts to invite appropriate reviewers with expertise in the relevant field to evaluate papers.

Concerns about the academic abstract writing skills of undergraduate and graduate students in higher education are well documented. From a faculty member's perspective, writing well is more than just following writing conventions. It also involves creative inspiration, problem-solving, reflection, and editing, culminating in a complete manuscript. From a student's perspective, writing an abstract can be a daunting task, both in terms of getting ideas on paper and mastering writing rules such as logic, summary, argument, and grammar.

Une exposition à Marseille rend hommage à Johnny Hallyday, rassemblant photos, affiches de films et partitions du chanteur aux mille vies, loin des affrontements familiaux autour de son héritage. Présentée au château de la Buzine, l'exposition « Johnny ! » a été montée en un temps record de trois mois. Elle évoque les différentes facettes de l'artiste, qui a connu une carrière de 57 ans, depuis la « bête de scène » jusqu'à la timide idole des jeunes photographiée en noir et blanc dans les rues de Nice, en train de s'acheter des mocassins.

Une centaine de clichés et d'objets, tels que des blousons en cuir qu'il portait lors de ses virées à moto ou sa guitare électrique dédicacée, ont été récoltés auprès de ses photographes officiels et de collectionneurs. Torse nu, une main dans un gant de boxe quand l'autre serre le micro, on aperçoit le chanteur combatif et animal. Sur une autre photo du célèbre photographe des années 60-70, Gilbert Moreau, on découvre un Johnny Hallyday envoûté, allongé sur la scène du Palais des sports.

La vie privée du chanteur est également évoquée à travers une trentaine de unes de Paris Match, dont il assurera les plus grosses ventes : s'y succèdent Sylvie Vartan, Nathalie Baye, Adeline Blondieau, puis Laeticia, dont le prénom est orthographié Laetitia lors de sa première couverture. Un sens du spectacle que l'on retrouve quand il chante « J'ai un problème » en 1973 face à Sylvie Vartan, sensuelle, les deux en jean rehaussé de strass, alors que leur relation vacille. On le revoit ému sur scène pour ses 60 ans quand son public lui souhaite un joyeux anniversaire ou embrassant sa fille Laura ou sa mère à la sortie de concerts.

Une deuxième partie, composée de photos en noir et blanc plus méconnues, revient sur les débuts de l'artiste, avant qu'il ne devienne une icône, et alors moins à l'aise devant les objectifs. Dans les coulisses, un Johnny aux airs de Gavroche glisse un œil à travers le rideau pour apercevoir le public du théâtre de Verdure de Nice. Une scène cocasse le montre en train de s'égosiller sur les planches tandis que son public se retourne vers Jacques Brel pris dans un mouvement de foule au premier rang.

« On me demande pourquoi une exposition si tôt, mais c'est même un peu tard quand on voit les vies de Johnny. On aurait pu faire ça il y a dix ans, mais on le croyait immortel », commente Bernard Pascuito, commissaire de l'exposition et auteur d'un livre sur Johnny. « C'est une belle manière de parler de Johnny et de son œuvre qui change de la façon dont on parle de lui en ce moment », soupire l'ancien journaliste.

Des partitions originales de « Que je t'aime » et « Requiem pour un fou » viennent clore l'exposition, dont les photos seront régulièrement renouvelées jusqu'à sa clôture le 17 septembre prochain.

美国海洋研究船莎莉莱德号完成新型气象雷达SEA-POL的安装，并补给水、油等资源后，于2日启航前往帛琉海域进行研究。任务完成后将返回基隆港，预计将于9月底再次停靠。

台湾大学海洋研究所副教授杨颖坚解释称，莎莉莱德号此次在基隆港停靠主要是为了补给资源和更换船上仪器，以准备进行下一次航行任务。下一步，莎莉莱德号将前往帛琉海域进行海上大气变化的研究。

这次在基隆港更换的仪器是2017年启用的海基型双偏振气象雷达SEA-POL，可用于测量半径100公里的海洋和大气变化，为研究提供数据。杨颖坚指出，虽然SEA-POL在台湾仅使用两年，但已经来台湾两次。

SEA-POL分装在3个货柜中，从美国运往台湾，然后在基隆港组装并与船体结合。参与研究任务的奥勒冈州立大学海洋物理学系教授詹姆斯·莫姆告诉中央社记者，海洋环境的变化与气候变化密切相关，他希望通过海洋学和大气学的结合，为未来的研究方向提供指导。

除了SEA-POL，莎莉莱德号还搭载了多种探测仪器，包括海流速度、水温、海水浓度，以及声纳和水下定位系统等。

一位船上的研究人员告诉中央社记者，台湾的地理位置对于在西太平洋、菲律宾海域甚至南海进行研究的船只来说非常重要，因为台湾是一个理想的停靠、补给和人员仪器更换地点。他指出，台湾具备观测台风和洋流的条件，并在相关大气和海洋科学研究领域取得许多显著成果。

尽管这是莎莉莱德号首次停靠台湾，但许多科研人员已经不止一次访问台湾，有些甚至熟悉台湾的美食和景点。一位穿着写有“台湾东北海域探测”字样衣服的科研人员告诉中央社记者，这是他之前来台时收到的衣服。他说，由于工作关系，他至少已经来过台湾十多次。

去年，杨颖坚曾带领台湾大学管理的海洋研究船“海研1号”与美国海研船共同执行任务，还派遣学生和技术人员到美国海研船上学习。杨颖坚表示，未来莎莉莱德号执行的研究计划将继续采用这种合作模式，加强台美科学合作。

The sixth generation (6G) of wireless mobile networks is anticipated to deliver key performance indicators including 1 Gbps data rates per user, ultra-low latency (1 ms or less), massive device connectivity, and ultra-high reliability (99.99999%). Additionally, 6G is set to enhance programmability and quality of service (QoS) by incorporating technologies such as software-defined networking (SDN), network function virtualization (NFV), multi-access edge computing (MEC), in-network computing, dynamic orchestration, and machine learning/artificial intelligence (ML/AI). These advanced features make 6G networks a complex infrastructure that presents numerous opportunities to integrate non-traditional resiliency capabilities for networked applications.

Various systems designed to safeguard human lives are increasingly reliant on communication networks. These systems include smart city infrastructures, smart agriculture solutions, power grids, autonomous vehicle traffic systems, tactical defense networks, and emergency response systems. Any disruption or delay in communication poses a significant threat to human lives. For instance, a delay in reporting a frequency drift in a smart grid network could lead to power generation inefficiencies and potentially trigger a catastrophic grid collapse.

While current network generations typically fulfill their objectives under normal conditions, we anticipate that 6G-enabled systems, with intelligently leveraged advanced features, will have the capacity to sustain mission objectives even during disruptions. Resiliency should be a foundational element in the design and architecture of 6G systems to address a wide array of adverse events and failure scenarios. In the context of 6G systems, resiliency is defined as the ability to endure, adapt gracefully to, and swiftly recover from malicious attacks, component failures, and natural or human-induced disruptions.

The conventional method for ensuring resiliency involves replicating components so that if one instance fails, the others can handle incoming requests. However, this approach is limited to homogeneous stack environments with similar hardware, operating systems, and libraries. This work proposes to restore critical functionality by adapting it onto available non-homogeneous resources within the device-to-edge-to-cloud continuum of 6G networks.

We envision an adaptive resiliency framework called La Résistance 6G (LR6G) network. To illustrate, consider a scenario where a critical service hosted on the C-RAN is disrupted by a security attack such as reflective DDoS. In this situation, leveraging small IoT devices may offer a resilient solution to combat the adversary within the Edge-to-Cloud network.

Unlike 5G networks, LR6G network is service-centric and system-oriented, expanding beyond network functions. LR6G possesses distinct characteristics:
1) It consolidates available resources, including network and storage equipment and IoT devices, into a unified resource pool without losing visibility into their individual capabilities.
2) It transforms diverse resources into a unified, programmable platform to achieve desired performance and security objectives.
3) It can segment functionality to fit individual resource constraints, while also proactively identifying potential vulnerabilities across the system.

The paper is structured as follows: Section II provides background on resiliency strategies for distributed functions, Section III introduces the proposed LR6G architecture, and Section IV presents the conclusions.

Intracranial hemorrhage (ICH) is a relatively common, life-threatening condition, affecting 25 out of every 100,000 people annually. It can develop following physical trauma or spontaneously, without any external cause. The seriousness of ICH is highlighted by a high 30-day mortality rate, reaching up to 52%, and a significant risk of lasting consequences for survivors. For these reasons, the swift detection of ICH is crucial, enabling the early initiation of treatment. Delays in diagnosis, even by a few minutes, can increase the risk of permanent brain dysfunction or even result in fatality. Modern computer systems that analyze brain CT scans can provide rapid, effective support for computer-aided diagnosis, proving invaluable for physicians, particularly in acute cases.

Currently, most advanced methods focus on deep learning, particularly using convolutional neural networks (CNN) and their various adaptations or combinations. Published detection algorithms, such as those in references [2] and [3], utilize 3D CNN-based classification at the patient level, offering a decision on the presence of ICH in patient scans. The authors of [4] designed a system that combines a 2D CNN with a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) algorithm for ICH detection in CT slices. Another approach, blending CNN and recurrent neural networks, was introduced in [5], which includes classification of ICH sub-types.

For 2D ICH segmentation, including type classification, the authors of [6] applied a cascade CNN model. Similarly, the authors of [7] proposed a hybrid 2D/3D approach, utilizing the Mask Regional-CNN algorithm, for the same task.

أكد رئيس جمعية صيادي مدينة كلباء، إبراهيم يوسف، أن 560 صيادًا في مدينة كلباء التابعة لإمارة الشارقة يعانون من شح الأسماك وتوقف شبه كلي في رحلات الصيد خلال الفترة الأخيرة، نتيجة لتقلبات الطقس التي شهدتها المنطقة خلال فصل الشتاء، مما أدى إلى ارتفاع أسعار الأسماك في الأسواق.

وأوضح يوسف لـ"الإمارات اليوم" أن سوء الأحوال الجوية والرياح الشديدة التي تهب على المنطقة وارتفاع أمواج البحر، خلال اليومين الأخيرين، أدت إلى توقف كلي لحركة الصيد نظرًا لالتزام الصيادين بتعليمات الجهات المعنية، تحسبًا لسلامة قواربهم والعمال المرافقين.

وأكد أن الصيادين يتجنبون الذهاب للبحر في الوقت الحالي تحسبًا لعودة الرياح مجددًا، مما يمكن أن يتسبب في أضرار لقواربهم وأدوات الصيد وفقدانهم للمال.

I believe it should be reserved for scientists to delve deeper into human emotions and understand how they impact us. Allowing anyone to interpret emotions just from a single picture could potentially be detrimental in certain situations.

For instance, consider a scenario where someone is initially feeling very happy, but then a sad thought crosses their mind, such as the passing of a pet, causing them to feel a bit down. If they then share a picture with a friend, the friend may misinterpret the situation, assuming something terrible has occurred, leading to unnecessary worry and conflict, potentially damaging their friendship.

I'm not suggesting that this technology wouldn't have its merits, but it could also have negative consequences. There are different perspectives on this matter, with some seeing the potential for assisting others, while others view it as a threat or an invasion of privacy.

In my opinion, this technology shouldn't be introduced just yet, as it could be harmful if misused or misinterpreted.

In recent years, the landscape of multimedia services over the Internet has seen remarkable transformations. Initially focused on traditional flat videos, the industry has advanced to panoramic (360-degree) videos and now to volumetric videos. Anticipated to reach a market value of $22.5 billion by 2024, volumetric videos have garnered significant attention from both researchers and industry stakeholders.

The concept of volumetric videos originates from the holograms and 3D virtual environments often depicted in popular science fiction, such as "Star Wars" and "Blade Runner." These imaginative stories have inspired efforts to replicate reality with extraordinary detail, surpassing the limitations of flat screens. Advances in computer graphics and information processing have been instrumental in the transition from two-dimensional to three-dimensional volumetric videos. Despite more than a decade of rapid development, volumetric video technology remains in its early stages, offering vast potential for growth and innovation. Unlike traditional videos, volumetric videos provide an unparalleled experience of spatial immersion and six degrees of freedom (DoF) interactivity, encompassing three dimensions of viewing position (X, Y, Z) and three dimensions of viewing orientation (yaw, pitch, and roll).

We offer an overview of volumetric video delivery systems, and Figure 1 illustrates the high-level architecture of such systems. Volumetric videos can be captured by cameras or stored as video files on cloud servers. These videos are then transmitted over the Internet using various access networks, including Ethernet, WiFi, and cellular networks. Once transmitted, the videos can be displayed on a variety of devices, including desktops, mobile devices, and Head-Mounted Displays (HMDs). HMDs, such as the Apple Vision Pro, HTC VIVE, and Sony PlayStation VR, provide a more immersive experience, allowing users to immerse themselves in a photorealistic virtual world, freely exploring the video content from any position and viewing angle.

Les jeunes veulent des aventures. Dieu les pardonne. Malheureusement, des marxistes cinquantenaires ayant passé l'âge des gamineries s'enfoncent dans un certain infantilisme : ils ne veulent pas vieillir (pour X raison). Cette juvénilisation doit s'incarner, prendre corps. Pour cela... Ahed Tamimi.

Ahed Tamimi est une jeune Palestinienne qu'on ne présente plus. Elle fut célébrisée bien malgré elle (?) le jour où (après qu'elle eut giflé un militaire) des policiers israéliens l'enfermèrent, ignorant qu'ils allaient opérer un effet Streisand et que tous les médias se concentreraient sur son activisme particulier.

Or, comme certains ont pu le remarquer, l'amour soudain des Occidentaux pour la jeune fille n'est pas un hasard. En vérité, il est même très clair : Ahed Tamimi est Katniss Everdeen. La raison de sa célébrité est due à la « katniss-everdeenation » des esprits.

Ceci consiste dans le simple fait qu'avec la juvénilisation des combats, à savoir l'association fabuleuse de la jeunesse à la rebellitude, on peut aisément faire le parallèle entre, d'une part, la jeune Palestinienne, et de l'autre, les Harry Potter, les Katniss Everdeen, et que sais-je encore (ou comme les personnages de Le Labyrinthe, de 2014, film immonde s'il en est).

Une fois encore, le processus s'avère courant. On a affaire, de fil en aiguille, à la mythisation de l'événement qui, à cause de sa structure intrinsèquement pauvre, doit, par l'imagination des foules, s'enjoliver en archétypant ses figures principales. Ainsi Ahed Tamimi devient-elle Katniss, c'est-à-dire la surchrétienne révoltée (car qui sont Katniss Everdeen et Ahed Tamimi, sinon des marxistes – donc des sur/subchrétiennes – qui s'ignorent ?).

En fait, cette mythisation d'une histoire banale ne relève pas du hasard. Plutôt, le mythe donne le nord et le sud. Ce faisant, ses partisans apprécient les gestes d'Ahed Tamimi dans la mesure où elle imite Katniss Everdeen (par conséquent dès lors qu'elle imite Jésus-Christ, puisque Katniss Everdeen – bien qu'elle ne soit pas noire et/ou handicapée – est une réactualisation christique en tant que libératrice du mal).

La seule chose – peut-être inquiétante – est non pas qu'il y a eu mythisation d'un personnage actuel ce qui, à vrai dire, est plutôt courant. En revanche, ce qui est inquiétant, c'est bien le fait qu'à tout prendre les politiques et les badauds optent davantage pour une historiette juvénile (The Hunger Games), cryptoreligieuse, en lieu et place d'une franche histoire religieuse, à savoir un mythe « en soi ». Et comme toujours, pencher pour un mythème (« Ahed Everdeen, ou Katniss Tamimi est la rebelle sacrée ») dégradé par rapport au mythème originel est un signe de dégradation générale de la conscience qu'on entretient par rapport à soi.

Si bien que, au niveau de l'intellectualité, les agents de communication propalestiniens devraient y réfléchir à deux fois : comment peut-on prendre au sérieux une jeune fille lors même qu'on juvénilise davantage (afin de faire correspondre au mode de pensée – arabe comme européenne – « capitaliste ») cette jeune fille dont on prétend qu'elle incarne un combat sérieux ?

Soit elle est importante, dans ce cas devant nécessairement suivre une modalité d'existence médiatique spéciale basée sur la condition usuelle de la sériosité (style académique, etc., serait-il singé), soit elle est au fond comme ceux qui l'utilisent à profit : des enfants ennuyés par l'absence générale de motivations existentielles. En somme, ceux derrière Ahed Tamimi, pourrait-on dire, sont désespérés de ne pas faire partie d'une histoire...

Par conséquent, ils s'inventent une vie par la voie de la facilité... Le capitalisme ! Ce qui est d'autant plus paradoxal que la critique originelle des propalestiniens touche au mode même du fonctionnement du capitalisme juvénile au moyen duquel, selon eux, la dualité Israël-États-Unis prospérerait.

Qu'on utilise les armes de l'ennemi, je comprends. Seulement savent-ils ce qu'il en coûte ?

I lacked practical skills to survive, for in this world, power did not come from knowing how to hunt or build a fire. Cunning, however, went a long way in a wasteland.

That’s how it all began. I was merely compensating for the skills I lacked, which seemed like the obvious path to take.

A king doesn’t need skills; a king needs subjects.

I started with the children, the few that remained. Small, scared, and cut off from everything they knew, it was easy to win their love. Offer them a warm place to sleep and a scrap of food, and suddenly, you become the father they thought they had lost forever.

In those first months, I was, indeed, a father. I was cold, to make them fight for my approval, and cruel, to teach them distrust. I molded them into what I needed them to be, so I could preserve my own life.

When my scavengers and thieves were discovered, I turned it to my advantage. A doe-eyed child can evoke a multitude of protective instincts. Before long, I was more than a Dickensian master of thieving children.

I had men and women, now, who sought my guidance, and it was just as well, for, despite their training, children, often, were of little use.

Yet, I remained, to them, a father, regardless of their age.

PHILADELPHIA (AP) — Saint Bonaventure secured a decisive victory over Saint Joseph's with a score of 74-56 on Tuesday night, marking their fifth consecutive win. Justin Winston led the Bonnies with a career-high 20 points, while Kyle Lofton also contributed 20 points. 

Osum Osunniyi was a key player for the Bonnies (17-8, 9-3 Atlantic 10 Conference), adding 12 points, grabbing nine rebounds, and blocking three shots. The Bonnies made an impressive 13 of 31 three-point attempts (42%), with Winston and Lofton each scoring four. Dominick Welch also played a pivotal role, scoring nine points and adding seven assists, seven rebounds, and three steals.

Saint Joseph's struggled in the second half, managing only 22 points, which was a season low for the team. Ryan Daly was the standout for the Hawks (4-20, 0-11), scoring 21 points and providing four assists. Myles Douglas added 10 points, while Toliver Freeman contributed seven rebounds.

Looking ahead, Saint Bonaventure is set to play Davidson at home on Friday. Meanwhile, Saint Joseph's will face Rhode Island on the road on Saturday.

Como en cada inicio de estación, el otoño nos trae una nueva edición del ciclo M.E.S.A., una iniciativa de A.C.E.L.G.A., que tiene como protagonistas a distintos productos de temporada para promover su consumo. En esta oportunidad, uno de los destacados es el membrillo y, para poner manos a la obra, compartimos esta receta de jalea de membrillo de Dolli Irigoyen, publicada en su libro "Frascos" de Editorial Planeta.

### Ingredientes:
- Membrillos: 6 (1,5 kg)
- Azúcar: 700 gr
- Agua: 700 cm³

### Procedimiento:
1. Lave bien y pele los membrillos. Córtelos por la mitad y retire las semillas. Reserve la pulpa.
2. En una cacerola, coloque el agua junto con el azúcar, las cáscaras y las semillas. Cocine a fuego lento hasta que el almíbar tome consistencia (aproximadamente una hora). Cuele y descarte las cáscaras y las semillas.
3. Agregue los membrillos al almíbar, vuelva a poner la cacerola en el fuego y siga cocinando a fuego mínimo hasta obtener la consistencia deseada.
4. Lo ideal es colocar una cucharadita de la jalea sobre un plato frío para observar la consistencia.
5. Retire del fuego y, con la preparación aún caliente, rellene frascos esterilizados (ver el paso a paso en la página 18 del libro "Frascos"). Coloque etiquetas con el nombre y la fecha de elaboración. Reserve en un lugar fresco y oscuro.
6. Una vez abierto, conserve en la heladera por hasta un mes.

### Tip:
Haga puré con la pulpa de membrillo para acompañar carnes o preparar cascos en almíbar. El membrillo es una de las frutas con mayor concentración de pectina en la cáscara y las semillas.

### Nota:
M.E.S.A. de otoño. Como en todas las ediciones, los chefs y restaurantes participantes ofrecen un menú o combo de tres (o más) pasos a base de aceite de oliva, palta y membrillo (se puede optar por los platos que integran el menú por separado, sin obligación de tomar todos los pasos). En esta edición, además, se suman restaurantes que no proponen un menú de pasos, sino que incorporan estos tres productos elegidos en distintos platos de su carta. Los restaurantes ofrecerán estos platos hasta el lunes 30 de abril de 2018 inclusive.

My family is poor, and as much as we want to talk, we can only speak a little. We have a limited amount of Tattoo Money, so we must choose our words carefully. My mom saves nearly $3,000 for each child, and we receive our Tattoos when we turn 18. My sisters both chose practical words, ones that would help them secure a job so they could acquire more words. Over time, they accumulated nearly the entire English language, every word they might need, inked on their skin in fine, gold-colored lettering. They could speak, but they couldn't lift us out of poverty.

I turned 18 yesterday and spent hours contemplating my tattoos. I knew Mom had worked tirelessly to earn enough money to give me a voice, to allow me to speak, and so I did the best thing I could think of. It wasn't the most elegant solution, but it would enable me to do something no one had been able to do since Free Talk became impossible, something that would give me a unique talent and lift us out of poverty, giving us more than just a handful of words, giving us everything we could ever need.

I, of course, got a few standard tattoos, words like, "thank," "love," "you," "mama," "sweetheart," "help," "baby," "sick,"—the words you need to express yourself. I also got a special tattoo of my own design, inspired by pictures I had seen in a school book, of a tool used by old occultists.

I remember the look on the artist's face when I handed him the tattoo list. He seemed confused, but determined, to see how it would turn out.

Destiny is a captivating series filled with vibrant characters, formidable villains, and perilous aliens bent on your demise. While the franchise's core essence revolves around completing missions and acquiring loot, developer Bungie has dedicated significant effort to expanding the game world. Traditionally, Destiny 2's lore has been conveyed within the game itself. However, Bungie has now ventured into new storytelling avenues with the introduction of Destiny 2's online comic book series, "Fall of Osiris."

Centered around the enigmatic figure of Osiris, readers will uncover the reasons behind his rift with the Vanguard and his subsequent branding as a traitor. We had the opportunity to discuss this new narrative with Destiny 2's narrative director, Margaret Stohl.

Heavy: Why did Bungie choose to present Osiris' backstory in a comic book format?
Stohl: One of the distinguishing features of Destiny is the vastness and intricacy of its universe, encompassing rich character backgrounds and detailed world-building. Having a background in comics - I also write monthly Captain Marvel stories for Marvel and novels - I see tremendous potential for future storytelling within Destiny. There are myriad ways to explore the narrative, both through traditional gaming channels and beyond. It's not merely about transferring Destiny stories into comics, but about exploring diverse storytelling avenues within the Destiny universe.

Heavy: Can we anticipate future comics delving into Guardians and enemies that haven't been fully explored in the games?
Stohl: Adhering to Marvel's discretion, I'm cautious about divulging too much. However, I can confirm that there are more comics in the works. This initial release is labeled as issue 001, typically signaling the beginning of a series, so readers can certainly anticipate further installments. Beyond that, specifics remain under wraps.

Heavy: How many issues can we expect in the "Fall of Osiris" series?
Stohl: While I'm unable to provide an exact number, I can share that we are collaborating with Ryan North, a highly regarded comics creator who recently earned two Eisner awards at San Diego Comic-Con. We have assembled a team of seasoned comics talent to complement our experienced game writers, fostering a dynamic and innovative partnership. It's fascinating to discover the shared passion for gaming among many comics writers and vice versa, facilitating a seamless collaboration.

Heavy: Will the comic book narrative align with that of Destiny 2, or are they designed to remain distinct?
Stohl: You can already observe how stories from the expansion world are being conveyed. I anticipate a growing convergence between the two mediums as we progress.

Heavy: Is there a particular character from Destiny's lore that you are eager to feature in a comic?

Siguen apareciendo irregularidades en algunas actuaciones personales del fiscal de Los Ángeles, tras confirmarse que empleados de la fiscalía se han ocupado de asuntos personales del fiscal Rocky Delgadillo.

En una declaración escrita, la oficina de la fiscalía confirmó ayer que en varias oportunidades empleados de la oficina realizaron diligencias personales para el fiscal e, incluso, cuidaron a sus niños. La pareja tiene dos niños de 6 y 3 años que, según informó un vocero de la fiscalía, en varias ocasiones han sido llevados a las oficinas, para ser dejados a cargo de alguno de los empleados de confianza del fiscal. Otras veces fueron atendidos en su propia casa. Otros empleados de la fiscalía también han llevado sus niños a la oficina, aclaró el portavoz.

Según explica el comunicado, en diferentes ocasiones funcionarios de la ciudad, algunos de los cuales son personas conocidas por el Fiscal durante muchos años, estuvieron a cargo de cuidar los niños de Delgadillo, “en su tiempo personal”. Los esposos Delgadillo pagaron por esos servicios, aunque algunas veces los empleados no quisieron recibir pago, manifiesta la comunicación.

Adicionalmente, en raras ocasiones, empleados de la ciudad realizaron diligencias personales para el fiscal en sus horas de almuerzo o en otro tiempo personal, informó la fiscalía.

Por otra parte, Michelle Delgadillo, esposa del fiscal, compareció ayer ante una corte de Santa Mónica y fue condenada a pagar una multa de 431 dólares y a un año bajo libertad condicional, por conducir sin licencia, no presentar prueba de seguro vehicular y manejar un coche sin registro. El Fiscal también pagó cinco multas que su esposa tenía pendientes por diferentes infracciones de tráfico, confirmó su oficina.

El Código Municipal de la ciudad, determina que “ningún empleado de la ciudad debe usar su posición… o el poder de su autoridad o de su oficina o cargo, de ninguna manera, para inducir o coaccionar a otra persona para proveer directa o indirectamente, nada de valor que pueda representar una ventaja personal, un beneficio o una ganancia económica”.

Dans le cadre de l'AS Saint-Étienne, du mercato et de la Ligue 1, Whabi Khazri, initialement annoncé proche du Stade Rennais, a finalement choisi de poursuivre sa carrière à l'ASSE. Selon les informations du journal Le Progrès, il est quasi certain que l'international tunisien rejoindra Saint-Étienne ce lundi. Sa visite médicale est prévue pour cet après-midi, suivie de la signature d'un contrat de quatre ans avec le club stéphanois.

Il est à noter que le milieu offensif de 27 ans avait suscité un intérêt prononcé de la part du Stade Rennais. Cependant, grâce à une offre attractive de 7 millions d'euros plus 3 millions d'euros de bonus, Saint-Étienne a remporté la mise et a convaincu le joueur, notamment grâce à l'argumentaire convaincant de Jean-Louis Gasset. Ainsi, Khazri devient la première recrue de luxe des Verts, qui pourraient bientôt officialiser l'arrivée d'un autre renfort offensif en la personne d'Adam Ounas, dont le prêt sans option d'achat en provenance de Naples est également sur le point d'être finalisé.
