Han sido meses de duro trabajo para la Junta directiva de la Protectora de Animales y Plantas de Ceuta. Durante este tiempo, se han realizado los preparativos y trámites necesarios para enviar a casi un centenar de animales a Francia en busca de un hogar. Esto incluye la búsqueda de casas de acogida, revisiones veterinarias, cuarentenas, vacunaciones y pruebas para descartar enfermedades.

El viernes pasado, 50 perros y 43 gatos partieron hacia varios refugios en Francia. El presidente de la Protectora de Animales, Javier Blanco, explica que están ansiosos por aliviar la saturación en las instalaciones y que los animales encuentren un hogar lo más rápido posible.

Los preparativos para el viaje comenzaron a las tres de la madrugada del viernes, cuando los miembros de la Junta Directiva y los voluntarios comenzaron a preparar a los animales y a embarcar en el ferry. Se administraron sedantes para hacer el viaje más cómodo y se aplicó una última dosis de antiparasitario antes de subir al camión. Este año, un nuevo refugio se ha unido a la lista de establecimientos que solicitan perros y gatos de la ciudad.

Los voluntarios tienen la esperanza de que en Francia los animales encuentren un hogar rápidamente, ya que las adopciones son más fluidas en ese país.

Durante toda la noche, hubo momentos de intensa emoción mientras se despedían de los perros y gatos. Aunque casi cien animales abandonaron la Protectora, todavía quedan muchos más esperando su oportunidad.

Después de más de 20 horas de viaje, el equipo llegó a Francia. Aunque es difícil dejar a los animales, saben que es lo mejor para ellos.

Las casas de acogida han desempeñado un papel fundamental en este viaje. Han brindado cuidado y atención a los animales durante meses, y ahora tienen la oportunidad de encontrar un hogar en Francia.

Luisma y Barajas son dos casos especialmente dramáticos. Fueron rescatados en Marruecos, donde Luisma fue quemado y a Barajas le arrancaron los dientes de un golpe. Aunque su recuperación ha sido lenta, esperan encontrar un hogar juntos en Francia.

Piñona fue rescatada del motor de un coche junto con su hermano. Aunque se escapó de su casa de acogida, finalmente la encontraron y espera encontrar adoptante en Francia.

Capi también fue víctima de maltrato animal. Sus propietarios lo mantenían encadenado y solo le daban agua estancada y pan mohoso. Después de ser rescatado, espera encontrar una familia en Francia.

NASA scientists believe that exploring Venus is worthwhile due to the unique features and materials present on the planet that cannot be found on Earth. Despite the extreme dangers posed by the intense heat and radiation emanating from Venus, robots could be used for exploration, eliminating the risks associated with sending humans to the planet.

Furthermore, Venus is not only worth exploring but also extremely dangerous. The planet's thick atmosphere, composed of nearly 97 percent carbon dioxide and sulfuric acid clouds, creates inhospitable conditions. With temperatures reaching a scorching 800 degrees Fahrenheit and atmospheric pressure 90 times greater than that of Earth, Venus presents significant challenges for exploration.

To address the risks involved, NASA aims to deploy a man-made vehicle that can hover above Venus, allowing for exploration without endangering human lives. One of the key challenges to overcome is the difficulty of approaching the planet's surface, obscured by the thick layers of clouds that shroud Venus.

Using facial recognition to examine students' emotions is completely immoral and a severe intrusion on privacy. Students should be able to express their emotions freely without the unsettling feeling of someone watching them through a screen. This kind of technology is akin to reading minds and is highly invasive.

Moreover, who's to say how accurate these assessments are? Many people display facial expressions that might not match their true emotions. For instance, when I'm focused on classwork, my face often appears blank, but that doesn't mean I'm not happy or engaged. 

This technology not only seems like a bad idea but should also be considered for legal restrictions. At the very least, there should be a feature to disable it, similar to a privacy mode. 

Leonardo da Vinci may have been trying to decode the Mona Lisa to understand her enigmatic expression, and that's acceptable for a piece of art.

The notion that constructively defined functions and computable functions can be equated is widespread in intuitionistic logic, especially in constructive type theory where computation is fundamental. This intuition is formalized in the axiom CT ("Church's thesis"), which asserts that every function is computable, meaning it can be defined within a computational model. CT has been extensively studied in Russian constructivism and in the realm of constructive reverse mathematics.

CT allows for proving results in recursion theory without relying heavily on specific computational models, as reasoning can be done directly with functions. While it is feasible to develop synthetic concepts in computability theory without axiomatic assumptions, adopting CT leads to stronger outcomes. Essentially, CT furnishes a universal machine for all functions within the logic, enabling the demonstration of the non-existence of certain decision-making functions whose existence is independent of any axioms.

It is evident that CT contradicts traditional classical mathematics, as the law of excluded middle (LEM) in conjunction with a variant of the axiom of countable choice (AC_N, N) permits the formulation of non-computable functions. This discrepancy can be further elucidated in various ways. For instance, to establish a non-computable function directly, the weak limited principle of omniscience (WLPO) and the axiom of countable unique choice (AUC_N, B) are sufficient. Alternatively, Kleene observed the existence of a decidable tree predicate with an infinite number of nodes but lacking a computable infinite path. When functions and computable functions are equated via CT, a Kleene tree contradicts weak Kőnig's lemma (WKL) and Brouwer's fan theorem.

Nevertheless, it is known that CT is consistent with Heyting arithmetic when coupled with Markov's principle (MP), which, under CT, asserts that computation termination remains stable under double negation.

El pasado domingo 11 de abril se llevaron a cabo las Elecciones 2021. Hasta el momento, Pedro Castillo de Perú Libre sería el virtual ganador. Sin embargo, aún está en disputa quién será el candidato que pase a la segunda vuelta. Los candidatos con mayores opciones son Hernando de Soto (Avanza País) y Keiko Fujimori (Fuerza Popular).

Con el 70,313% de las actas contabilizadas por la ONPE, Pedro Castillo (17,143%) se mantiene en el primer lugar de las preferencias electorales, seguido por Keiko Fujimori (13,093%), Hernando De Soto (12,929%) y Rafael López (12,566%).

Elecciones Generales 2021: Conteo rápido de Ipsos al 100%

El conteo rápido de Ipsos Perú a boca de urna da como ganador de las Elecciones Generales a Pedro Castillo de Perú Libre con un 18,1%. En segundo lugar se encuentra la candidata de Fuerza Popular, Keiko Fujimori, con un 14,5%, mientras que en tercer lugar está Rafael López de Renovación Popular con 12,2%.

Según Ipsos, Hernando de Soto se quedaría en la cuarta posición con 10,7%, seguido por Yonhy Lescano y Verónika Mendoza, con 9,8% y 7,9%, respectivamente.

Lea también: ONPE informa que el 73% de los electores acudieron a votar en las elecciones 2021.

حرم الإسلام عددًا من البيوع، خاصة تلك التي يتم فيها التحايل للحصول على منفعة بطرق غير صحيحة. ومن أبرز هذه البيوع "بيع العينة"، الذي يُعرَف أيضًا بـ"السلف". في هذا البيع، يبيع التاجر للمشتري شيئًا بثمن مؤجل، ثم يعود ويشتري هذه البضاعة نقدًا بسعر أقل.

ونظرًا لتشابه هذا النوع من البيع مع البيع بالتقسيط الذي أجازه الشرع، كان من الضروري توضيح الأحكام لمنع الوقوع في الحرام. الشيخ عبد الحميد الأطرش، الرئيس السابق للجنة الفتوى، يوضح أن بيع العينة يعد قرضًا بواجهة بيع لاستغلال الربا. فبيع السلعة بثمن مؤجل ثم شراؤها نقدًا بسعر أقل يُعرف باسم "الحرق". أشار الشيخ إلى أن الشافعية يرونه جائزًا لأنهم يراعون العقد وليس النية، بينما المالكية يحرّمونه ويعتبرونه سلفًا جر نفعًا، وهذا هو رأي جمهور العلماء.

وقد حذّر النبي ﷺ من بيع العينة بقوله: "إذا ضن الناس بالدينار والدرهم، وتبايعوا بالعينة، واتبعوا أذناب البقر، وتركوا الجهاد في سبيل الله، أنزل الله بهم بلاء لا يرفعه عنهم حتى يرجعوا إلى دينهم". وأوضح الأطرش أن البيع بالتقسيط مع زيادة في السعر ليس محرمًا، لأنه يوجد سلعة يمكنك قبولها أو رفضها.

أما إذا اشترى شخص سلعة وقام "بحرقها" عن طريق شرائها بثمن مؤجل ثم بيعها بثمن أقل، فإن البائع الأول لا يُعتبر آثمًا لعدم معرفته بأفعال المشتري. في هذه الحالة، يتحمل البائع الثاني الخسارة فقط.

غرد مدير مركز "الإرتكاز الإعلامي" سالم زهران عبر صفحته على تويتر قائلاً: "يوم الإثنين، سيدخل الرئيس المُكلف من الباب الرئيسي في بعبدا أمام عدسات الكاميرات، وذلك على عكس المرات السابقة. وإذا قام بتقديم مسودة تشكيلة حكومية تتألف من 18 وزيراً، فهو يعلم مسبقاً أنها لن ترى النور لأنها غير متفق عليها. فهل سيغادر بعد ذلك في عطلة الأعياد منتظراً العام 2021؟".

La actriz Lydia Bosch ha comunicado en el día de su 57 cumpleaños que padece cáncer de piel. "Hola querida familia, hoy es mi cumpleaños y quiero compartir con vosotros que hace dos semanas, a través de una biopsia en una lesión de la piel de mi barbilla que nunca terminaba de curar (llevaba más de un año sin darle importancia), me diagnosticaron un carcinoma basal o epitelioma basocelular de tipo expansivo. Es un tipo de cáncer de piel, pero aunque la palabra en un principio asuste mucho, no es un cáncer peligroso (no afecta a ningún órgano vital) como puede ser el melanoma", compartió Lydia Bosch con sus más de 246.000 seguidores en Instagram.

Lydia Bosch ha explicado que su cáncer de piel "se origina en las células basales más profundas de la epidermis, crecen muy lentamente, pero debe ser tratado para evitar que continúe creciendo", y destaca que "el principal factor de riesgo para desarrollar epiteliomas es la exposición al Sol".

La actriz ha querido ponerse como ejemplo para que otras personas tomen precauciones a la hora de tomar el sol y que sus excesos no acaben convirtiéndose en problemas de piel: "Yo desde mi adolescencia he comprado todas las papeletas para tenerlo. He hecho verdaderas burradas para broncearme. Y el efecto acumulativo del Sol en mi piel me ha provocado esto".

Lyda Bosch pide en su cuenta de Instagram que "tenemos que tomar conciencia y hacernos revisiones también de la piel anualmente para evitar males mayores, y coger el hábito de ponernos protección solar diariamente".

"Voy a empezar a cuidarme en serio y compartiré por aquí (su cuenta de Instagram) mis avances y descubrimientos. Ahora soplaré las velas, pediré mi deseo y empezaré a leer y a escuchar cada uno de vuestros mensajes. Gracias, gracias, gracias por vuestro incondicional cariño", agradeció Lyda Bosch a sus seguidores tras su anuncio.

Intervention inhabituelle mardi matin pour les pompiers de Haute-Savoie. Ils ont été appelés pour sauver un cheval tombé dans la piscine d'une propriété privée à Fillinges.

C'est une drôle de surprise qui attendait les habitants de Fillinges (Haute-Savoie) ce mardi matin. Les pompiers ont été sollicités pour venir en aide à un cheval en fâcheuse posture. S'étant échappé d'un enclos voisin, l'animal a fini sa course dans la piscine d'une propriété privée.

Une quinzaine de personnes ont dû intervenir, notamment des sauveteurs aquatiques, ainsi qu'un vétérinaire. Il a été nécessaire de vider la piscine, puis de sangler l'animal pour le hisser hors de l'eau.

2018年九合一选举刚刚结束，但在选举中表现出色或更加火红的政治人物中，国民党的美女立委许淑华给人们留下了深刻印象。她被赞誉为"神力女超人"，同时还担任台中市长候选人卢秀燕和高雄市长候选人韩国瑜的竞选发言人，这在六都选举史上相当罕见。许淑华以大胆的作风和不受拘束的行事方式深受许多人的喜爱。

回顾过去，许淑华在步入政坛之前参加了1996年的中华小姐选美，获得第四名。2002年1月，她代表亲民党参加南投县议员选举，并成功当选南投县议员。2005年12月，她以超过六成的得票率当选为南投市长。2009年12月，她以超过八成的得票率成功连任南投市长。

Motsi Mabuse appeared on Good Morning Britain to respond to presenters Ben Shephard and Kate Garraway's questions about the news of a professional dancer testing positive for coronavirus. The Strictly Come Dancing judge assured the hosts that everyone involved in the ballroom dancing program was "being tested and trying to isolate."

Earlier this week, it emerged that there was a positive coronavirus case in the professional line-up, but it had not affected the pre-recorded launch show scheduled for this weekend. The BBC confirmed that the celebrity partner of the professional dancer tested negative, although their identity and participation in the competition's kickoff on September 25 remain uncertain.

Speaking on the show, Motsi emphasized the ongoing challenges presented by the pandemic and the importance of staying vigilant. She expressed confidence that despite the circumstances, all involved would remain healthy and committed to the competition.

When asked if the positive test could lead to a last-minute pairing change before the live shows, Motsi reassured that everyone would be ready for the first live show as planned. However, there are concerns among producers about the potential disruptions caused by the situation.

BBC bosses are now on edge, awaiting any further developments that may impact the contestants and the competition. As the show moves forward, the team is working diligently to ensure the safety and success of the program amidst the uncertainty surrounding the ongoing pandemic challenges.

The ability of technology to read expressions could be incredibly valuable for various reasons. Many individuals struggle to guess or recognize others' feelings, which can lead to communication problems. While it may not solve every issue, it could certainly mitigate some of them.

With technology advanced enough to interpret people's emotions, it could prevent or defuse conflicts. For instance, if a computer detects that someone is feeling sad or depressed, it could alert a teacher to offer support to that student. By providing assistance, it could prevent the individual from making poor decisions, benefiting them in the long term. Additionally, it could help teachers tailor their teaching methods to be most effective for students. If the technology detects that a student is confused, it could notify the teacher, allowing them to address the issue. Often, students, or people in general, hesitate to ask for help, either due to embarrassment or a desire to be independent.

Este jueves, Julián Serrano participó en el programa Verdad/Consecuencia (TN), donde expresó su opinión sobre las campañas políticas de las PASO. Sin embargo, su intervención generó duras críticas en las redes sociales debido a que proporcionó cifras incorrectas sobre la pobreza y no pudo definir el concepto de comunismo. Después de convertirse en tendencia, publicó un contundente descargo en Twitter.

Durante su participación, Julián reclamó por una reducción de impuestos y expresó su pesar por el éxodo de varios de sus amigos del país. El influencer afirmó: "En Argentina, el libre mercado siempre ha sido una palabra maldita, y así nos va, con un 70% de pobreza".

La conductora Luciana Geuna le advirtió que la cifra oficial es del 42%, pero él no se retractó y afirmó que en la Provincia de Buenos Aires era así. Ella interrumpió nuevamente para aclararle que estaba equivocado, pero él insistió: "Bueno, pero dame cuatro meses".

Más tarde, protagonizó otra situación incómoda al afirmar que "si se combate el comunismo, se tiene que ir con todo". Maru Duffard le preguntó si consideraba al gobierno de Alberto Fernández como comunista, a lo que él respondió: "Sí, bueno, sí. El socialismo que luego se convierte en comunismo a lo largo del tiempo".

Sorprendida por estas declaraciones, Geuna le pidió que explicara su entendimiento del comunismo, a lo que él respondió que podría buscarlo en Wikipedia.

Estos sucesos se viralizaron en Twitter y Julián recibió numerosas críticas. Molesto con los usuarios que calificaron su participación en el programa como un "papelón", salió a aclarar la situación. Se justificó diciendo: "Nunca dije que no sabía qué era el comunismo, iba a leer en voz alta la definición para continuar explicando mi idea, pero me interrumpieron".

Respecto a la corrección sobre el índice de pobreza, expresó: "En Argentina, la cantidad de personas en situación de pobreza es mucho más alta que la 'cifra oficial', y el tiempo me dará la razón en este punto".

Continuando su descargo, Julián admitió su error al no haber dado la definición (que sabía, obviamente) en lugar de dar pie a que lo cortaran.

شكرًا لقراءتكم الخبر عن استقبال رئيس جامعة الأقصر لوفد مبادرة «المليون ريادي». الآن نبدأ بالتفاصيل:

أبوظبي - بواسطة نهى إسماعيل - اشترك لتصلك أهم الأخبار

استقبل الدكتور محمد محجوب عزوز، رئيس جامعة الأقصر، اليوم السبت، وفدًا من وزارة التخطيط ضمن مشروع "رواد 2030" ومبادرة "المليون ريادي"، وذلك لتوقيع بروتوكول تعاون مع جامعة الأقصر لإنشاء حاضنة لريادة الأعمال. يهدف البروتوكول إلى تخصيص عدد من المنح لطلاب جامعة الأقصر على منصة "المليون ريادي"، والتي تهدف إلى تأهيل الشباب والمساعدة في توفير البيئة اللازمة لنمو الأفكار والابتكارات وتحويلها إلى أعمال ناجحة.

وأوضحت الدكتورة غادة خليل، مديرة مشروع "رواد 2030"، أنه إيمانًا من وزارة التخطيط والتنمية الاقتصادية بأهمية تعزيز توجه الدولة لتحفيز ريادة الأعمال، تم إطلاق مشروع "رواد 2030" بتمويل من البنك الأهلي المصري وبنك مصر، وذلك لنشر ثقافة ريادة الأعمال من خلال بناء قدرات الشباب لتمكينهم من تحويل أفكارهم إلى مشاريع على أرض الواقع.

ومن جانبه، وجه رئيس الجامعة بتوفير كل الدعم والتسهيلات اللازمة لإنشاء حاضنة الأعمال داخل الجامعة، مشيدًا بفكرة المبادرة التي تعتبر نقلة نوعية وخدمة تقدمها جامعة الأقصر لطلابها بشكل خاص ولأبناء المحافظة بشكل عام.

The increasing utilization of machine learning (ML) across various sectors such as finance, autonomous driving, industrial automation, computer vision, speech recognition, and healthcare has given rise to concerns regarding data privacy and security. These concerns are particularly pertinent for cloud-based ML services, where sensitive data is processed on remote servers.

Homomorphic encryption (HE) is a type of encryption that enables computations on ciphertext without the need for decryption. This makes HE a valuable tool for safeguarding privacy in ML applications, ensuring the confidentiality of sensitive information even when handled by third parties. In the context of cloud-based ML services, where sensitive data is frequently transmitted to remote servers for processing, HE plays a crucial role in protecting data privacy. For example, a bank could utilize HE to develop an ML model for detecting fraudulent transactions without accessing customer data, while a healthcare provider could analyze patient medical records using HE without revealing the patient's identity. This potential has piqued the interest of cloud service providers such as Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Naver Cloud in integrating HE into ML-based cloud services like Data Box Frame.

While convolution operations are essential in convolutional neural networks (CNNs), they can be computationally intensive when executed on ciphertext within an HE framework. To mitigate this, most HE-based CNN implementations, such as TenSEAL, leverage the im2col function. This function transforms input data into a matrix without compromising the original information, enhancing computational efficiency. However, this approach limits the flexibility of CNN models to configurations accommodating only a single convolution layer, potentially hindering their application in more intricate structures.

In practical scenarios, encrypted user data could be shared across multiple ML models, enhancing versatility and utility. To address this, we introduce UniHENN, a privacy-preserving CNN model constructed using HE. UniHENN enables efficient CNN inference without relying on the im2col function, allowing encrypted input data to be utilized across different ML models. We present a novel computation method for convolution operations on flattened input within UniHENN, enabling flexible reuse across various ML models and supporting batch operations for efficient processing of multiple ciphertexts.

Our key contributions include:

- The introduction of UniHENN, an innovative CNN model inference mechanism based on HE that promotes input ciphertext reusability.
- Empirical evidence demonstrating UniHENN's efficiency, with experimental results showing superior performance compared to state-of-the-art HE-based 2D CNN inference architecture PyCr-CNN.
- A batch processing strategy for UniHENN designed to handle multiple data instances in a single operation, significantly reducing inference time for multiple images.

In conclusion, UniHENN offers a promising approach to privacy-preserving ML models, showcasing improved efficiency and flexibility in handling encrypted data across diverse ML applications. Source code for UniHENN is accessible at https://github.com/hm-choi/uni-henn.

Breast cancer is a significant cause of death for women globally. While digital mammography is effective in detecting breast cancer, it struggles with identifying dense lesions that resemble dense tissues. Additionally, it involves ionizing radiation. As a safer alternative, ultrasound (US) imaging plays a crucial role in screening and diagnosing breast cancer. However, US images often suffer from low resolution and poor contrast due to speckle noise, making segmentation challenging.

To address these issues, researchers have turned to cutting-edge deep learning techniques to improve manual segmentation. Despite the success of deep learning in computer vision, its effectiveness in medical US images is limited by the size of available data. The labor-intensive process of collecting and annotating US images underscores the need for a deep learning approach that can learn from a minimal amount of annotated data.

The U-Net architecture, a popular network for segmentation, is a fully convolutional network comprising convolutional, maxpooling, and up-sampling layers. To tackle the challenge of training U-Net with limited data, researchers have proposed strategies involving data augmentation and transfer learning. While data augmentation falls short in capturing real data characteristics, our proposed methodology, based on transfer learning, leverages US simulation data and natural images as auxiliary datasets. The aim is to improve segmentation outcomes, even with a limited image dataset.

أعلن مصدر أمني سعودي أن مجهولين قاموا بإضرام النيران في سيارة إحدى السعوديات في مكة المكرمة عمداً، وذلك بعد حوالي أسبوعين من سماح السلطات في المملكة لأول مرة بقيادة المرأة للسيارة. وبدأت النساء في المملكة العربية السعودية، في 24 من الشهر الماضي، بقيادة السيارات في الشوارع بعد رفع الحظر على ذلك.

وقال المتحدث الرسمي لشرطة منطقة مكة المكرمة، في بيان صحفي اليوم الثلاثاء، إن "الجهات الأمنية باشرت التعامل مع بلاغ عن تعرض سيارة بقرية الصمد في محافظة الجموم بمنطقة مكة المكرمة، لحريق متعمد". وأشار إلى أنه "تم إخماد الحريق، واتخاذ الإجراءات الاستدلالية والبحثية للواقعة التي لا تزال محل المتابعة الأمنية".

وأظهر مقطع فيديو للحادث النار تشتعل في سيارة متوقفة، بينما تعلق امرأة على الفيديو بالتعريف عن نفسها على أنها صاحبة السيارة، وتدعى سلمى الشريف. وتقول الشريف، في الفيديو الذي نشر على مواقع التواصل الاجتماعي، إن الحريق متعمد، وأن بعض شبان القرية المعارضين لقيادة النساء للسيارات هم من أضرموا النار في المركبة.

The examination is a crucial method for evaluating the academic performance of students, whether objectively or subjectively. Objective multiple-choice questions are evaluated using pre-defined correct answers, making the assessment straightforward. In contrast, subjective questions require students to provide descriptive responses, allowing the evaluator to determine the students' level of knowledge and assign grades based on their judgment. Subjective responses are generally lengthier and more substantive than objective answers, necessitating considerable effort and time for manual assessment. Additionally, the marks assigned to the same subjective questions can vary from evaluator to evaluator due to differences in their evaluation methods, moods during evaluation, and even their relationships with students (Bashir et al., 2021). Therefore, an automated evaluation process for subjective answers becomes necessary to ensure consistency. Such automation not only saves human effort, allowing educators to focus on more meaningful tasks but also ensures fair and plausible evaluation results for students.

The shift of examinations to an online mode during the recent Covid-19 pandemic has highlighted the need for a subjective answer evaluation model, aligning with current educational requirements and offering vast application value. Subjective answer evaluation falls under the sub-field of text classification, involving comparing student answers with model answers and classifying them into grade categories. Automatic evaluation of answers is challenging because of the domain-specific nature of questions and the scarcity of manually labeled data (Iwata and Kumagai, 2020). Most proposed evaluation methods (Patil et al., 2018; Sakhapara et al., 2019; Bhonsle et al., 2019; Johri et al., 2021; Girkar et al., 2021) rely on traditional statistical and NLP techniques. These methods involve four main steps: preprocessing (tokenization, stopwords removal, chunking, POS tagging, lemmatizing), vectorizing (BoW, TF-IDF, Word2Vec, LSA), computing similarity scores (cosine similarity), and classifying (KNN). However, these steps are time-consuming and cumbersome, especially for long, heterogeneous, and noisy texts.

Recent advancements in deep learning, particularly the invention of BERT (Devlin et al., 2018) and transfer learning in NLP (Howard and Ruder, 2018; Radford et al.), have led to robust models that outperform most approaches in NLP tasks with minimal feature engineering. Inspired by this, efforts to improve automatic evaluation methods using advanced deep learning techniques have been made (Krishnamurthy et al., 2019). A large pre-graded training dataset is required to compute scores instead of relying solely on model answers.

To address the problem of limited labeled data, we approach subjective answer evaluation as a meta-learning problem: the model is trained to classify students' answer scores from a series of small tasks called episodes.

For the first time in weeks, my roommate didn't go to bed at exactly nine in the evening. It seemed like a blessing; my naturally guilt-ridden self could stay up for a while longer with the light on, maybe do some writing, probably watch Game of Thrones. In my newly freed hour or so, while my roommate watched a movie, I slouched on my bed, opened my browser, and began to scroll.

But then I remembered. I had promised myself, upon the discovery of Reddit, that I would take advantage of the writing prompts thread as often as I could. The task, however, is easier said than done. I needed to find something easy, something simple, something short. I wanted to write something that I wouldn't feel compelled to actually keep and save in a Word document, yet I wanted something that I felt was worth being posted.

What was I to do? The first prompt I saw had the potential for pages upon pages of ideas, a year of stories, mishaps, and re-drafts. Good, but not for my purposes. The next prompt felt more like a fun idea than a story, kind of like a shower thought. Those prompts bothered me; there was no real suggestion for a plot, no real conflict, or other fiction-y mumbo jumbo, suggested.

أعلنت وزارة التنمية الاجتماعية في عمان اليوم الجمعة أن طفلاً تبرع بما جمعه في حصالته لصالح حساب الخير، الذي يستهدف عمال المياومة الذين يعتبرون الفئة الأكثر تأثراً بتوقف أعمالهم خلال أزمة كورونا.

وذكر المدير المالي في الوزارة، علي عبد الحافظ، أن الطفل الذي قدم التبرع قام بهذه الخطوة بدافع التكافل الاجتماعي وحبه للمساهمة في تحقيق الخير.

أكد عبد الحافظ أن تلقي الاتصال من الطفل واعلام الوزارة بالتبرع كانت لحظة جميلة وأسهمت في تعزيز الشعور بالوحدة الوطنية والتفاؤل خلال هذه الظروف الصعبة.

وفي حديثها خلال لقاء صحفي أمس، أوضحت وزيرة التنمية الاجتماعية، بسمة اسحاقات، أن مجموع التبرعات المُقدمة لحساب الخير بلغ مليون و400 ألف دينار، مشيرة إلى أن عمال المياومة يمكنهم التقدم بطلب الدعم عبر موقع الوزارة لمدة 10 أيام.

وأوضحت أن الدعم المقدم سيكون نقدياً وطارئاً ولفترة محددة، وسيتم صرفه خلال شهر نيسان الحالي، مع إمكانية صرف دفعة ثانية في حال استمرار تأثر القطاعات المتضررة بسبب الإجراءات الحكومية.

وأشار الناطق الإعلامي في الوزارة، أشرف خريس، إلى دعوة المواطنين والشركات والمؤسسات للمساهمة في دعم حساب الخير عبر الحساب البنكي المخصص لذلك.

وكانت الحكومة قد أعلنت سابقًا عن إطلاق "حساب الخير" لاستقبال التبرعات النقدية الموجهة لقطاع الحماية الاجتماعية، سواء من داخل المملكة أو خارجها، وذلك من خلال الحوالات البنكية أو القنوات الإلكترونية المتاحة.

Personally, I believe that "driverless" cars are extremely dangerous. They cannot react as quickly to sudden events as a human driver can. Moreover, they are not entirely "driverless" as there must be a person in the car at all times to take control in case of any emergencies. There is a risk of the technology that operates the car malfunctioning or crashing while passengers are onboard. Therefore, I do not support the idea of driverless cars as they create a hazardous environment, and passengers may become too engrossed in their phones or devices.

One of the primary reasons I do not endorse driverless cars is the safety concern they pose for passengers. If a company such as Google were to oversee the technology in a car, it may not be able to adapt to unforeseen circumstances, such as accidents or changing weather conditions, affecting its performance.

Furthermore, passengers may get distracted by their phones or devices, potentially leading to accidents.

تُطلق طيران ناس رحلاته إلى سالزبورغ ابتداءً من 23 يوليو المقبل بمعدل 3 رحلات أسبوعيًّا، وذلك تزامنًا مع إعادة فتح النمسا أبوابها للسياح. أعلن طيران ناس، الناقل الجوي السعودي، والطيران الاقتصادي الرائد في منطقة الشرق الأوسط، عن إطلاق رحلات مباشرة بين الرياض وسالزبورغ النمساوية، بمعدل 3 رحلات أسبوعيًّا ابتداءً من 23 يوليو القادم. تتزامن قرار طيران ناس باستئناف الرحلات إلى هذه الوجهة السياحية الأوروبية مع قرار السلطات النمساوية إعادة فتح أبوابها للسياح، مما يؤكد حرص طيران ناس على مواصلة إضافة خيارات جديدة للضيوف للاستمتاع بموسم الصيف الحالي. القرار يدعم النهج الاستراتيجي لطيران ناس في تعزيز شبكة وجهاته لتلبية متطلبات شرائح مختلفة من الضيوف، مع الاستمرار في تعزيز الخدمات وتحسين جودتها وتقديمها للمسافرين بأسعار تنافسية. منذ رفع تعليق السفر الدولي للمواطنين السعوديين، عمل طيران ناس على تلبية الطلب المتنامي على الرحلات الدولية، ووضع خطة طموحة تهدف إلى الوصول إلى الطاقة الاستيعابية القصوى في عام 2021، بهدف المساهمة في تحقيق أهداف المملكة في أن تصبح محطة عالمية للسفر. مع سالزبورغ، يبلغ عدد وجهات الصيف التي يقدمها طيران ناس للضيوف 11 وجهة، تضم: سالزبورغ - كييف - لفيف – طشقند - تيرانا - سراييفو - باكو - تبليسي - باتومي - الغردقة - شرم الشيخ.

With the fast development of manufacturing, a lot of heavy and tedious work can be done by machines automatically, significantly improving efficiency. Inspection, as the last and crucial step in making products, especially for 3C products (Computer, Communication, Consumer Electronic products), still involves a significant amount of labor. However, with the trend of device miniaturization, more and more inspection work cannot be completed by simple labor without specialized and complicated tools. For example, the size of mobile phones decreases each year, imposing more stringent requirements for inspection tools. Foxconn Electronics, a renowned contract manufacturer, is exploring the use of structured light-based inspection machines for fault detection, a critical noncontact optical 3D measurement method widely used in various applications, including industrial inspection, virtual reality, and animation.

Newell watched with interest as the rat before him began to cringe. It was the fourth one he'd poisoned this month alone, and it seemed that this one would meet its end as well. He felt a hint of sympathy for the poor thing as it lay there, twitching; it could have been him taking those shuddering last breaths. With a heavy sigh, he draped a cloth over the rat's cage. His morbid curiosity had left him suddenly, and in its place he felt a faint sort of nausea.

Aaron Powlett, he knew, would not stop the attempts on his life unless things changed. And while Newell had a fine nose, he considered an eventual failure on his part inevitable; detecting poison in tea by its scent alone was no accurate science, and he was loathe to test each sip and bite on one of his laboratory rats. If he had any interest in regaining his living standards, he had no choice but to talk to Powlett. The conversation would definitely be a disastrous mess of unease and lacking direction, but with luck, Powlett would agree to stop. He shrugged on his coat with determination.

On the way out, he found a bouquet of flowers in the hall, bearing a blank card. Newell did not even consider that they might be non-poisonous, and jotted down a quick warning on the card—he didn't fancy his maid being killed by them. With a promise to himself to burn the bouquet at his return, he made his way towards the Powlett residence. It was not a long walk, not long enough to develop regrets anyway. After a knock and a short wait, he was admitted by the valet who looked at him with wide eyes. As they waited in the lounge for the man of the house, the valet gave a quiet cough.

"I was not expecting to see you again, Mr. Roan," he said.

Newell didn't mind the breach of etiquette and responded in a tone belying his nervousness: "I had not planned on it either, but circumstances—" He stopped speaking the moment ‘circumstances’ entered the room. Aaron Powlett, dressed in a smart suit, had halted in his way just shortly after stepping through the door frame. He was obviously investing a lot of care into a neutral expression, but the strained muscles of his jaw as well as his rigid posture made his fear quite clear, at least to those who knew him as well as Newell.

“Leave us,” he told the valet, for all the world looking like he wanted to accompany him. The servant hurried off and a heavy silence settled. Aaron opened his mouth as if to speak, but ended up biting his lower lip instead. His gaze kept flickering towards the door. This was not the behavior Newell had hoped for, but it was the one he'd expected. He saw himself forced to be the first to talk.

“You've been trying to murder me,” he said, attempting a casual tone.

Silence.

“Let me be frank. I'm tired of fearing for my life. I came here with the intent to resolve the situation, once and for all.”

Silence.

“Aaron.”

At that, the man looked up, for the first time meeting Newell's eyes. He had begun to tremble. “Newell,” he whispered, taking a clumsy step forward. “I didn't mean to hurt you, I just—”

“Tried to avoid me by having me killed,” Newell interrupted. “I know. Now.... I was… am not averse to your affections. I ask you to accept them as well, as is only fair. Your denial has hurt me physically, and in other ways. I do not deserve to be punished for your emotions.”

For a moment, Aaron looked like he would understand. His brow was wrinkled in confusion, and he was muttering to himself quietly as if deeply in thought. Then Newell took a step towards him, and all turned around.

“You,” Aaron suddenly snarled, crowding against him, pushing him back, back against the wall. “You only have yourself to blame. Had you not bewitched me, I'd never have seen fit to send for your death. But you, you have ruined me!”

They were breathing hard, and only inches apart. Newell closed his eyes in anticipation of a blow. What followed instead was the gentle weight of Aaron crumbling against him. Newell felt arms encircle his neck instead of the choking hands he had expected and the wetness of tears met his cheek. It was utterly surreal, and Newell did not respond, simply let Aaron sob against him in the most undignified way.

The man was muttering something. It was muffled by fabric and tears, but it sounded important; Aaron appeared to be repeating it over and over again. After some time, Newell carefully pried his former friend's hands off of him. He didn't let them go when pushing Aaron away, and Aaron made no move to resist his grasp. Instead, he finally stopped muttering and looked at Newell with a gaze of some clarity, if bright with tears.

“I knew I had lost to your curse,” he said softly. “I knew there was no going back, so I attempted to avenge myself. But the devil was always going to win, and you did. Your curse has wrecked me.

The demand for large deep learning (DL) models has surged in recent years, thanks to their dominating accuracy across a range of tasks in natural language processing (NLP) [3, 5, 10, 12] and computer vision [13, 33, 65]. These models are typically developed in user-friendly DL frameworks like PyTorch [41], which feature dynamic model graphs. However, these frameworks lack sufficient optimization for high-performance execution, a critical issue as models grow exponentially in size and training time increases accordingly.

To address the growing model training time, developers have proposed various optimizations. Manual optimization is one approach, implemented at different layers of model training. This includes inserting high-performance kernels [11, 28, 40, 54] for computationally intensive operators on specific devices (e.g., NVIDIA GPUs), employing data, tensor, and pipeline parallelism [37, 49, 54], and using activation checkpointing [8, 21, 25] to efficiently distribute training across multiple devices. However, manual optimization introduces challenges. Challenge 1: Generality - Incorporating these optimizations requires intrusive changes to the model implementation, which restricts generalization to other models. Even minor model changes may necessitate new optimizations. Moreover, optimized models become platform-specific, obliging developers to maintain multiple implementations for different platforms and devices. Challenge 2: Ease of Tuning - Optimization schemes have numerous configurations to tune (e.g., pipeline stages, number of activation checkpoints) to achieve optimal performance. This tuning process is tedious and error-prone, especially when tied closely to optimizations.

Another set of optimization approaches involves converting DL models into static graphs and using DL compilers for automatic optimizations. For example, JAX [4] uses the XLA compiler [18] to trace the entire model into a static graph, enabling aggressive optimizations such as operator fusion, expression simplification, and 3D parallelism [70]. Similarly, PyTorch 2.0 [42] introduces a compiler interface to trace dynamic graph executions and construct static graphs in torch.fx [51]. While automatic optimization requires minimal engineering effort and addresses challenges in manual optimization, it introduces new challenges. Challenge 3: Programmability - Static model graphs require that everything be statically analyzable and deterministic, which may impose constraints on users. For instance, JAX requires pure Python functions without in-place updates [4]. PyTorch 2.0 cannot trace through essential collective operators like all_reduce for distributed training [42]. Developers may find it difficult to control optimizations in fine granularity, such as disabling certain rules or excluding operators from a compiler pass. Challenge 4: Debuggability - Developers typically use layer modules as building blocks to maintain model understanding, but DL compilers flatten these into single-level dataflow graphs, obscuring the original model and complicating troubleshooting.

To address these challenges, we propose Slapo, a Schedule LAnguage for Progressive Optimization, designed for DL frameworks with dynamic model graphs. Slapo features several major innovations:

1. **Decoupling Model Execution from Definition**: Slapo separates model execution ("schedule") from definition, allowing developers to maintain the same model implementation while enabling performance engineers to optimize model- or platform-specific schedules independently. This concept draws inspiration from domain-specific compilers like Halide [48] and Apache TVM [7], which decouple tensor operator scheduling from arithmetic definition.

2. **Auto-tuning**: Slapo provides a programming interface for specifying tuneable knobs, creating a tuning space that Slapo's auto-tuner can explore for optimal configuration, addressing Challenge 2. This enables auto-scheduling as seen in Ansor [69], a feature planned for future work.

3. **Progressive Optimization**: Slapo employs a "trace by need" approach, tracing desired modules into static graphs for compiler-based optimizations. This allows developers to control the tracing process through scheduling primitives, addressing Challenge 3.

Sound source localization (SSL) aims at estimating the pose or location of sound sources, and it is a crucial research topic. Various signal processing methods have been proposed for SSL, which work well under certain assumptions such as high signal-to-noise ratio, known number of sources, and low reverberation. However, these ideal conditions rarely exist in real-world applications, necessitating special treatments. 

With the increasing popularity of smart speakers in home environments, SSL can enable a variety of applications such as monitoring human activities, speech enhancement, and human-robot interaction. Recently, data-driven approaches, particularly deep learning, have outperformed classical signal processing methods for various audio tasks, including SSL. Multiple network architectures have been developed to localize sound sources, adapting to challenging acoustic conditions and microphone configurations, and even performing simultaneous localization and classification of sounds.

However, a significant downside of these data-driven methods is their need for extensive training data, which is expensive to gather and label. Acoustic simulators offer an appealing solution as they can generate high-quality labeled datasets abundantly. Yet, models trained on synthetic data often suffer a critical drop in performance when exposed to real-world data due to domain shift, where acoustic conditions are outside the distribution of the synthetic training dataset.

To address these challenges, several works have recently explored domain adaptation for SSL. Unsupervised methods using entropy minimization of localization output have been proposed, but they are not suitable for problems requiring multiple outputs. An alternative includes two adaptation methods for multiple SSL: (1) a weakly supervised method that provides the number of sources for real-world data, and (2) an unsupervised method based on Domain Adversarial Neural Networks (DANN) which aligns latent feature distributions for synthetic and real-world domains. Although the weakly supervised method improved localization performance, the adversarial approach did not yield significant benefits. Nonetheless, adversarial methods remain popular for tasks outside SSL, such as semantic segmentation in computer vision and other audio tasks like Acoustic Scene Classification and Sound Event Detection.

In this paper, we address the lack-of-data problem for 2D multiple SSL by leveraging simulation to generate a large amount of labeled data inexpensively. We then tackle the domain shift issue by training the localization model to ensure transferable knowledge to the real-world. The main contributions of this work include: (a) exploring two domain adaptation methods based on adversarial learning—gradient reversal and label flipping—to demonstrate their effectiveness for multiple SSL, (b) proposing a novel ensemble discrimination method for domain adaptation in SSL, which involves placing a discriminator at different levels of the localization model, and (c) extensively evaluating our proposed method on data captured from real environments. We ensure result consistency by conducting experiments with different random seeds and reporting their mean and variance.

Through our experiments, we show that our ensemble discrimination method outperforms standard adversarial learning approaches and performs similarly to localization models trained in a supervised fashion on labeled real-world data. To our knowledge, this is the first successful attempt at tackling domain adaptation for multiple SSL without requiring any labels from real-world data.

Local differential privacy (LDP), a variant of differential privacy, is an emerging paradigm that allows an untrusted server to collect aggregated statistics from distributed users while providing strong privacy protection. In the LDP framework, users locally perturb their data before reporting it to the untrusted server. The server then aggregates the statistics of interest from these perturbed data. Due to its robust privacy guarantees, LDP has seen widespread practical deployment. For instance, Google has integrated LDP into Chrome to collect data on default homepages and search engines, while Apple uses LDP in iOS to gather information on popular emojis and words.

Despite its benefits, LDP is susceptible to poisoning attacks, where an attacker can compromise the integrity of the collected data. Qingqing Ye and Tianyu Wo are the corresponding authors.

Students attend school every day, and throughout their day, their moods and emotions can fluctuate. Ever wondered what their emotions are? There's no need to worry anymore because a new technology has just emerged: the Facial Action Coding System (FACS), which allows computers to identify human emotions. However, this tool is not suitable for classroom use.

The FACS, or Facial Action Coding System, in my opinion, should not be utilized in classrooms for several reasons. One primary reason is that students experience various emotions throughout the day. They might feel happy one moment and upset the next. Using this system would require teachers to pause class activities frequently to analyze students' facial expressions with a computer program. This practice would waste valuable learning time—not only for the student being scanned but also for others who have to wait during this process.

Moreover, as described in a referenced statement: "The process begins when the computer constructs a 3-D model of the face; all 44 major muscles in this model must move like human muscles." This indicates that before analyzing emotions, creating a facial model adds even more time to an already lengthy process.

Furthermore, using FACS won't change how students feel; it merely identifies their current emotional state without offering any solutions or improvements. Whether a student is mad or sad doesn't alter how they are feeling after being scanned.

In conclusion, FACS should not be integrated into classrooms as it detracts from valuable instructional time without benefiting students' emotional well-being or enhancing classroom dynamics. The Facial Action Coding System remains an impractical tool in educational settings since it does not contribute positively toward improving anyone's experience or outcomes within schools.

Many car companies are working on driverless cars, a highly debatable topic with numerous pros and cons. Some believe that these cars have the potential to change the world. While driverless cars might make life easier by allowing people to relax and not pay attention to the road, there are significant drawbacks to consider. 

For instance, when a teenager first gets their license, navigating their surroundings in a regular car helps them become familiar with their environment. If they relied solely on a driverless car, they might not pay attention to where they are going, and a malfunction could leave them disoriented. Moreover, in the event of an accident, determining fault could become complex and contentious.

Despite the enticing idea of driverless cars, I believe the concept is unnecessary, and the resources dedicated to their development could be put to better use.

Zoom在远距需求提升之际频频爆出资安疑虑。为此，该公司宣布将暂停所有新功能开发，并专注于其推出的「90天资安计划」。Zoom已宣布将推出Zoom 5.0，带来全面的安全升级。Zoom 5.0是该公司90天资安计划中的重要里程碑，旨在主动识别、解决和增强平台的安全性和隐私功能。

Zoom执行长袁征表示，对于该公司能在90天计划中迈出这一步感到很自豪，但这仅是开始。袁征表示，Zoom将坚定不移地致力于提供最安全的平台，从而赢得客户的信任。

Zoom产品长Oded Gal也表示，他们从整体角度考虑了用户的隐私及平台的安全性。在系统后端，AES 256位元GCM加密标准将提高保护用户资料传输的安全标准。在前端，Zoom将于会议控制栏中添增「安全图示」功能，对数百万的新用户来说，将确保他们可在会议中即时调整所有安全相关设定。

Zoom 5.0的主要更新部分包括网路和用户体验及控制选项。在网路方面，Zoom将升级至AES 256位元GCM加密标准，提高会议资料的传输安全。用户体验方面，Zoom将增强主持人的控制权限，增加了安全性图示来方便用户找到所有安全性功能。此外，还有其他的改进，如预设启用等候室功能、会议密码的复杂度与预设启用、云端录影密码等。

Zoom 5.0还提供了新的资料结构，让大型机构可以跨多个帐号连接联络人，使其能更轻松、安全地搜寻会议、对话及电话联络人。管理员也可以在他们的Zoom选单中查看会议如何连接至Zoom的资料中心。

最后，用户现在可以选择关闭Zoom Chat通知的预览功能，新的非PMI会议将使用长ID增加复杂性，并对会议ID和邀请选项进行了调整，避免用户误触分享会议ID。

通过这些安全升级和改进，Zoom致力于提供最安全的远距视讯会议平台，并赢得用户的信任。

小党挑战，蔡英文捡枪，绿营立委四处寻找子弹

2019年9月23日 联合报 记者：陈洛薇

蔡英文总统表示，在面对中国的打压时，要明确代表台湾人民表达立场，并坚决不接受“一国两制”。（摄影记者：胡瑞玲） 分享至脸书

2020年的大选回归蓝绿对决，但第三势力仍然对民进党的选情构成牵制。前副总统吕秀莲与喜乐岛联盟合作报名参与总统大选，时代力量也扬言征召立委黄国昌参选总统。再加上台北市长柯文哲领军的台湾民众党声势浩大，蔡英文总统明年想要实现完全执政，难度可谓相当高。

蔡政府执政三年多以来，两岸外交难有进展，观光业者面临寒冬，国家陷入断交危机，蔡总统当初向国人承诺的“维持现状”早已失效。在内政方面，蔡总统屡屡失分，推动的年金改革和转型正义导致社会严重对立，总统府特勤私烟案重创蔡政府形象，公惩会前委员长石木钦案更让蔡英文的司法改革蒙羞。

民进党在国会完全执政，掌握了过半席次，立法院俨然成了蔡政府的立法机关。然而，当初承诺给民间团体的实价登录2.0（揭露门牌资讯、预售屋实价登录）和矿业法修法一再跳票，关乎千万劳工退休保障的劳保年改仍被执政党搁置。完全执政缺乏制衡力量，绿色小党纷纷挑战，使得民进党这次的立委选举倍感危机。

在2016年的立委选举中，民进党在国会大获全胜，赢得了68个席位。但自去年九合一选举大败后，党内对于明年国会席次持悲观态度。2020年的立委选举中，国民党、台湾民众党进军国会，加上时代力量和其他泛绿小党争夺政党票，民进党面临腹背受敌的局面。

本报的民调也显示，约四成选民在立委选举中考虑投给蓝绿以外的其他政党，未来国会第三势力可能隐然成形，对民进党立委选情的冲击远高于国民党。

蔡英文积极拉拢选民，通过操作“恐中牌”来挽回支持度，但民进党的政党支持度仍然低迷不振，这显示选民可能会分裂投票。

It was another miserable day filled with dark skies and endless rain. But it wasn't the weather that bothered me, it was the fact that I was forced into a marriage with a man I didn't love. I can't take this anymore, I thought to myself. At first, I actually did feel like the luckiest girl in the world. Whatever I wanted, he made it happen. Even when I didn't know what I wanted, he knew. He always remembered the tiniest of details, which was kind of adoring. But that was the problem… He always knew. He never physically hurt me, he would never do that.

When people learn that I am dating the world's greatest superpower, they tell me how lucky I am. I hear the jealousy in their tone. If only they knew what I know now. What I needed most now was a little bit of alone time, you know? Just some time to collect my thoughts and reflect. As long as I was with this man, I would never get that. That's why I've decided that today I will finally put an end to this sorry excuse of a relationship. I know giving all of this up must sound crazy, but if I don't do this now, I don't think I will ever be able to escape. And escape his reach I must.

I've already packed my bags and booked the flight. I'll be staying at my sister's cabin that just happens to be off the grid. It's exactly what I need in this moment. I left him a note explaining something that I knew he would never understand. The sound of tires rolling to a stop on the wet pavement alerted me to the arrival of my cab. It was time. I finished my note, grabbed my bags, and made my way out in the rain to the warmth of the waiting taxi. As I got in, I directed the driver to bring me to the airport.

1986年，汤姆·克鲁斯在《捍卫战士》中展现了英俊的风采（取材自IMDb）。

时隔半个世纪，汤姆·克鲁斯主演的1986年电影《捍卫战士》（Top Gun）续集《捍卫战士：独行侠》（Top Gun: Maverick）即将于2021年7月2日在美国上映。关于这部被誉为电影史上最经典的军事电影之一的续集，《捍卫战士》中有五个鲜为人知的秘辛。除了欣赏汤姆·克鲁斯的英姿之外，观众是否曾留意过与电影相关的人物及背景细节呢？

在《捍卫战士》中，汤姆·克鲁斯饰演美国海军飞行员"独行侠"米契尔上尉（LT Pete "Maverick" Mitchell）。这位年轻又自信的F-14战机飞行员因其出色的飞行技术而被选入顶尖训练团队，即美国海军战斗武器学校（US Navy Fighter Weapons School），在那里接受训练，并展开与飞行学校中由凯莉·麦吉利斯饰演的"恰莉教官"夏洛特·布莱克伍德（Charlotte Blackwood）之间的爱情故事。

2016年，电影公司为了庆祝《捍卫战士》上映30周年，推出了蓝光特别版本。扮演中队长"毒蛇"麦卡菲上校的汤姆·斯科里特（Tom Skerritt）曾表示：“无论是世世代代的观众，还是新一代观众，他们都热爱这部电影并怀着和过去一样的热情欣赏它。”他接着说：“全球没有一名飞行员会只看一遍《捍卫战士》。”但是，即使有些观众观看了20次，也许仍然不了解电影中的这五个秘密。

1. "毒蛇"本尊担任技术顾问
美国海军退役少将派特里克·佩蒂格鲁（Rear Adm. Pete "Viper" Pettigrew）曾担任飞行员和美国海军战斗武器学校的飞行教官。他的部分人生故事后来成为《捍卫战士》的叙事情节。派特里克·佩蒂格鲁本人在电影拍摄期间担任技术顾问，片中的无线电呼叫代号"毒蛇"也源自他的故事。在2017年，派特里克·佩蒂格鲁表示：“我以我的外貌、性格和专业技能而闻名，‘毒蛇’并非虚构，许多年前它真实存在，并曾是我的无线电呼叫代号。”他透露，编剧曾向他征求意见，想知道是否可以在《捍卫战士》中用他的无线电呼叫代号来指称麦卡菲。派特里克·佩蒂格鲁谦虚地表示，他并未担任过指挥官，但编剧告诉他“没关系”，于是《捍卫战士》中便用“毒蛇”这个代号呼叫麦卡菲。此外，派特里克·佩蒂格鲁还曾在电影中客串出演，与"恰莉教官"一同登场。

2. "恰莉教官"真有其人
"人物"杂志在1985年的一篇文章中提到，原本"独行侠"想要追求的对象并不是"恰莉教官"，而是一名体操运动员。然而，电影导演在与当时年仅30岁的克里斯汀·福克斯（Christine Fox）在圣地亚哥米拉玛海军航空站见面后，作为当时在海军分析中心任职的福克斯，坚信《捍卫战士》中必须有"恰莉"这个角色的存在。福克斯曾告诉军事网站，"恰莉"这个角色仅是略微基于她的真实情况而创作；福克斯表示，她应电影组的要求与麦吉利斯共处一天，分享许多关于海军生活的细节，以使麦吉利斯能更好地演绎"恰莉"这一角色。福克斯在她的军事生涯中先后担任国防部计划暨预算评估署署长、前总统奥巴马时期的国防部代理副部长等重要职位，成为美国史上位级最高的女性国防部官员之一，也是五角大楼最资深的文职官员之一。

3. 经典台词的无心插柳

The breadth and depth of academic research conducted in the United States today are heavily reliant on federal funding. According to the National Science Foundation's annual Higher Education Research and Development Survey, total higher education R&D expenditures reached $86.4 billion for the 2020 fiscal year, with over $46 billion originating from the federal government [1]. Specifically, in the field of academic biomedical research, the National Institutes of Health (NIH) awarded research grants exceeding $29 billion during the same fiscal year [2]. Notably, a pivotal study highlighting racial disparities in research funding, conducted in 2011, focused on the NIH [3]. Subsequent studies have further contributed to the national dialogue using NIH proposal data [4] [5] [6] [7] [8].

The NIH stands as the primary and most influential funder of academic biomedical research in the United States. Research awards from the NIH, particularly through mechanisms like R01 grants, significantly impact promotion decisions and the sustainability of research programs. The substantial size and duration of these awards allow researchers to dedicate more time to research and less to grant-writing. Academic institutions highly value NIH funding due to its higher indirect cost rates compared to non-federal funding, and its role in assessing Medical School research programs in external rankings. For example, in the evaluation of Medical Schools for the "Best Medical Schools for Research" rankings by US News & World Report, a weight of 0.4 out of 1.0 is assigned to "Research Activity", a metric primarily based on federal funding [9], primarily NIH grants. While US News & World Report introduced a campus ethnic diversity index in 2020 [10], it does not influence the "Best Medical Schools for Research" rankings. As Ginther's research [3, 4] and recent acknowledgments and expansions by NIH researchers suggest [5, 6], a significant disparity persists in NIH funding rates between white principal investigators (PIs) and Black/African American (B/AA) PIs. This disparity underscores the inherent conflict between medical school rankings and faculty diversity.

The critical need for enhanced diversity in academic medicine and the biomedical workforce has been well-documented. While many academic institutions advocate for greater equity among faculty demographics, there is a lack of quantitative data to support specific interventions. Understandably, academic administrators and faculty leaders are cautious about implementing reforms that could inadvertently exacerbate existing inequities or create new systemic issues. Given the stakes involved, this policy paralysis can result in a cycle of calls for action followed by educational initiatives, which while crucial, are insufficient on their own to drive policy changes.

An actionable step forward is for academic administrators to leverage existing proposal databases at their institutions to assess diversity in academic research. Given the significance of extramural grant funding in academic research and its impact on promotion, tenure reviews, and departmental evaluations, it is logical to start any study on potential research inequities with an analysis of research grant proposals and awards. This approach not only enhances understanding of the complexities of the research funding system but also serves as a foundation for revising faculty development, research support procedures, performance metrics, and promotion and tenure review processes.

Dr. James Hildreth highlighted that at historically black colleges, there is a perceived "intimidation factor" in submitting proposals to the NIH and a belief that proposals may not be evaluated fairly [11]. This observation, combined with reported racial/ethnic discrepancies in award rates by the NIH, prompted an investigation into the relationship between race/ethnicity and submission behaviors for principal investigators at the University of Michigan Medical School (UMMS).

The face on Mars is fake because on the day the face was first seen, outside was very foggy. This means that the cameras would have to see through haze. However, some still thought that the face was made by aliens, even though it was winter and in bad weather.

Then later we took a picture of the face on a clear day and didn't see a face. This makes me think that there has never been a face on Mars.

Another reason that I think the face on Mars is fake is because the statue was supposed to be approximately two miles long and maybe even longer. This makes it seem unreasonably tall. If the face were two miles tall, then many of the other rocks would be smaller, but they are not; actually, the surrounding rocks are much bigger.

My last reason for doubting if there ever existed a Face on Mars is because our pictures aren't of high quality. The original camera took 43 meters per pixel, while in 2001 each pixel represented 1.56 meters - leading to no evidence of any actual structure resembling a human-like figure or statue.

In conclusion, everyone now needs to know that the "face" found on Mars mountain is an optical illusion due to poor weather conditions during photo capture and low-resolution imagery from outdated cameras employed by NASA at different times.

MARTINEAU, Claude
Au CHU - Hôpital de l'Enfant-Jésus, le 27 septembre 2018, à l'âge de 80 ans, est décédé Monsieur Claude Martineau, époux de Madame Jeannette Tremblay, fils de feu Madame Maria Cloutier et de feu Monsieur Lucien Martineau. Il résidait à Charlesbourg, Québec.
Claude Martineau a mené une carrière admirable au sein du corps de police de la Ville de Québec. Ayant occupé plusieurs postes, il a terminé sa carrière en tant que directeur du corps de police de Québec/Beauport. Il a été très impliqué dans la communauté. Il laisse dans le deuil son épouse et amour de sa vie, Madame Jeannette Tremblay; ses enfants : François (Julie Pichette) et Patrick (Johanne Raté); ses petits-enfants adorés : Mathieu et Maude; ses frères et sœurs : Gaston (Claudette), Claudette (Sylvain), Doris, Suzanne (George Pettigrew), son beau-frère Maurice Delisle ainsi que plusieurs neveux, nièces, cousins, cousines et ami(e)s. Il rejoint ses proches décédés : son frère Gilles, sa sœur Charlotte, son beau-frère Michel Bégin ainsi que sa belle-sœur Rita Tremblay. La famille recevra les condoléances, en présence des cendres, de 12h à 14h au Mausolée Catherine-de-St-Augustin (nouveau). La mise en niche des cendres suivra.

Day one was filled with tears and words of wisdom, but God takes back what he wants after all. The doctor mentioned, "We went by the books." However, it all had to come to an end after three months of war within my soul and vessel. Now, I wait, listening to the constant beeping and the hissing of air being pushed slowly against my will into my lungs.

Its close now, I can feel it. The nurse entered to comfort me for a final moment. Her face spoke of frustration, all her emotions already overstimulated to feel sorrow for a man lingering on a sharp knife, slowly being cut like warm butter and forgotten forever. She handed me a blue file and asked me to read it "very carefully."

While autonomous driving technologies have made significant progress, autonomous vehicles (AVs) still encounter considerable challenges. Achieving robust perception, prediction, and interaction in real traffic scenarios, particularly with human-driven vehicles, remains difficult. An AV's behavior may vary—being overly cautious, aggressive, or, at worst, unsafe—depending on its assessment of others' actions.

This issue is particularly pronounced in compact and unstructured environments like parking lots, where numerous interactions with humans occur in close proximity. Such conditions can lead to congestion if suboptimal strategies are employed. However, the potential to implement sensing and communication infrastructures in these environments offers opportunities for developing algorithmic solutions for connected AVs.

Extensive research has been conducted to address vehicle motion prediction, with algorithms developed based on varying levels of accessible information. Physics-based methods utilize pose history to provide intuitive short-term predictions, employing Kalman Filters to project vehicle dynamics over time and forecast a trajectory or reachable area. Conversely, data-driven methods, such as Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), specifically Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, can learn motion models without explicit knowledge of vehicle parameters or input profiles. The LSTM's encoder processes pose history and summarizes the sequence, which is then used by a decoder for prediction.

Since vehicle motion is directly influenced by intent—such as turning, lane keeping, and lane changing—integrating intent information with motion data can enhance prediction accuracy. The LSTM encoder learns to represent motion data, predict intent, and generate interpretable multi-modal predictions. For highway or urban driving, intent is generally classified based on lane graphs.

Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), which do not require explicit trajectory or environment structure processing, have been used with LSTMs to combine information and make predictions from image sequences. Recent advances have applied these architectures to bird's-eye view (BEV) semantic images, incorporating vehicle geometry, dynamics, and collision avoidance constraints for multi-modal motion prediction.

Most existing research has concentrated on structured environments with well-defined road networks comprising intersections, lanes, and traffic lights. However, in environments like parking lots, several challenges arise: limited public datasets of human-driven vehicles in such settings, the complexity of parking maneuvers compared to highway driving, and the increased collision and congestion risks due to compact spaces and the proximity of surrounding objects.

This work focuses on predicting a human driver's intended parking spot and future trajectory, given a set of features and model abstraction levels. The paper offers the following contributions:

1. Development of a parking lot simulation environment using the CARLA simulator and a racing wheel interface.
2. Collection of an annotated dataset of human parking behaviors, including both forward and reverse parking maneuvers and various parking spot selections.
3. Proposal of a hierarchical LSTM model structure to provide both intent and multi-modal trajectory predictions.
4. Introduction of a nested CNN-LSTM model structure with a visual encoder applied to semantic BEV images capturing parking lot geometry.
5. Comparison of a physics-based Kalman Filter baseline with the more complex LSTM and CNN-LSTM models to investigate the impact of model complexity, feature complexity, and the amount of accessible information on prediction performance.

El desbordamiento de casos de paludismo en Bolívar y las muertes causadas por esta enfermedad son ahora una realidad que el Gobierno no puede ocultar. El Ministerio de Salud activó este viernes un plan de contingencia de 72 horas para combatir la afección, que en la semana epidemiológica 43 registra 12,000 casos y 32 decesos en la entidad. Para ello, se distribuyeron 200,000 tratamientos para las especies *vivax* y *falciparum* en ocho localidades y sectores de la región, según publica Correo del Caroní.

A las afueras del módulo de salud en el sector Manoa de San Félix, nada ha cambiado. Cientos de personas acuden diariamente en busca del tratamiento contra el paludismo, con la esperanza de recibir la medicación completa. Algunos no soportan la espera y terminan desmayados. El colapso es tan evidente que esta vez las autoridades admiten la crisis, manejando cifras oficiales que discrepan con las contabilizadas por diferentes organizaciones dedicadas a registrar el aumento de la malaria en Venezuela, como la red Defendamos la Epidemiología.

Este viernes, el gobierno activó un plan de contingencia de 72 horas para combatir el paludismo en el estado Bolívar. La viceministra de Salud, Moira Tovar, informó que estarán desplegados en ocho localidades y sectores de la entidad para atender a las comunidades con mayores incidencias.

En Caroní, el plan se activó en los ambulatorios Manoa, Vista al Sol, Pozo Verde y Gran Sabana; en Heres, en el ambulatorio de La Sabanita; y en los hospitales de Piar, Sifontes y El Callao.

La principal queja de los pacientes y familiares es la entrega incompleta del tratamiento. En el módulo del sector Manoa en San Félix, mientras esperaban por los medicamentos, denunciaban que apenas les entregaban tres pastillas, cuando deberían tratar la enfermedad durante 14 días y recibir dos fármacos: cloroquina y primaquina.

根据微软官方资料指出，预计于 5 月 11 日终止支援的作业系统版本包括：Windows 10 1909：家庭版、专业版、教育版专业版、工作站专业版、Windows Server 所有版本，Windows 10 1809：除了 LTSC 外的所有版本，Windows 10 1803 与 Windows Server 1803：所有版本。依照 AdDuplex 在 3 月底公布的 Windows 10 各版本市占率统计图显示，这次将停止支援的 1909 版本市占率高达 18.4%、1809 版本市占率 1.2%、1803 版本市占率则是 1.4%，三个版本的市占率约两成左右。另外，前几个月已经终止支援的 Windows 10 1903 版本也还有 4.6% 的市占率。

现在已经有不少电脑搭载 Windows 10 作业系统了，但是你有注意到自己的作业系统是哪个版本吗？Microsoft 微软官方公告，如果作业系统是 Windows 10 1909、1809 和 1803 版本，将在 5 月 11 日到期，未来将不提供更新服务，建议使用者为了自身电脑安全起见，赶紧升级作业系统。

对于多数使用者而言，不更新作业系统除了怕系统有一堆大小错误、不稳当机之外，也有少部分人不知道要需要更新作业系统，加上即使是作业系统的技术支援到期后，电脑仍然可以继续使用，所以也没那么迫切升级的需求。但是微软提醒，由于技术支援到期后，再也无法收到安全与品质更新，将提高安全风险及病毒的风险。为了个人资安、减少风险，建议使用者们赶紧检查 Windows 10 作业系统版本，并尽速升级到最新版本。

至于如何确认自己电脑上安装的 Windows 10 版本呢？：第一步：选取 「开始」 按钮，然后选取 「设定」。第二步：在 「设定」 中，选取 「系统」进入「关于」就能查到。如果想要更新 Windows 10 作业系统时，则是在开启「设定」后，进入「更新与安全性」设定，就会自动检查与安装升级新版本啰。图片及资料来源：Microsoft、AdDuplex

Les pertes causées par les catastrophes naturelles ont explosé de 151 pour cent au cours des 20 dernières années, a révélé jeudi une agence onusienne. La Stratégie internationale pour la prévention des catastrophes de l'ONU a indiqué que les États-Unis arrivent en première place, avec 944 milliards $ US, soit deux fois plus que la Chine. Le Japon, l'Inde et Porto Rico complètent les cinq premières places.

La facture engendrée par les tremblements de terre, les éruptions volcaniques, les inondations, les ouragans et les autres catastrophes climatiques a atteint 2900 milliards $ US au cours des 20 dernières années. Un responsable de l'agence a évoqué une « hausse importante » du nombre de catastrophes climatiques, qui sont responsables de 77 pour cent des pertes économiques directes attribuables aux désastres. Ces catastrophes climatiques auraient causé 2250 milliards $ US des pertes totales, comparativement à seulement 895 milliards $ US entre 1978 et 1997. Le reste est attribué à des « catastrophes géophysiques » comme les tsunamis et les séismes.

L'agence a précisé mercredi que les données pour 1998-2017 découlent des chiffres officiels, ce qui signifie que les pays les plus puissants économiquement sont souvent surreprésentés. Cela signifie aussi que la facture de 2900 milliards $ US n'est qu'une fraction des pertes réelles, car l'assurance est moins courante dans les pays en voie de développement.

Une vidéo devenue virale montre un groupe d'hommes armés, probablement des policiers en civil, en train de frapper un Gilet jaune avec des matraques. Cette vidéo a suscité une vive polémique sur Internet, non seulement en ce qui concerne l'authenticité des images, mais aussi sur la légitimité des actions policières lors des manifestations.

Cette vidéo, diffusée sur les réseaux sociaux, a rapidement circulé, provoquant l'indignation des internautes et soulevant de nombreuses questions. Selon un utilisateur qui a partagé la vidéo sur Twitter, la scène se déroule pendant l’Acte 6 des Gilets jaunes à Toulouse.

Choqués par cette scène de violence, de nombreuses personnes qualifient l'usage de la force de disproportionné, critiquent la police et demandent l’ouverture d’une enquête.

> "Oui, mais un #giletsjaunes contre tous ces agresseurs, ça me paraît disproportionné, et on entend 'Il est avec nous, laissez-le'. Une enquête serait souhaitable, non???" — kalidor any (@4296f5e40d5c496), 23 décembre 2018.

> "Ce comportement de la part des policiers n’est pas acceptable! Quelle dérive!" — Yves Pozzo di Borgo (@YvesPDB), 23 décembre 2018.

Certains estiment que les policiers devraient plutôt soutenir les protestataires.

> "C'est la énième vidéo honteuse des forces de l'ordre que je vois par rapport à ce qui se passe avec les Gilets jaunes. C'est vraiment du grand n'importe quoi! D'autres internautes se rappellent de l'affaire Alexandre Benalla, conseiller à la sécurité de la présidence, filmé en train de frapper des manifestants et qui fut ensuite mis en examen.

> "On dirait des #Benalla, pas vraiment des policiers… On te prête casque et arme, cache-toi le visage et tabasse?! #Castaner #GiletsJaunes." — Cleorinne J 🦅🐓 (@CleoJackson777), 23 décembre 2018.

L’idée d’une « milice privée à l’Élysée » avait été évoquée lorsque le scandale Benalla a éclaté en juillet. François-Xavier Lauch, chef du cabinet d’Emmanuel Macron, avait alors nié ces allégations. Cette idée refait désormais surface sur Internet.

> "Comportement honteux, indigne d'une démocratie… Début des milices privées macroniennes?" — philou (@motardpourtjrs), 24 décembre 2018.

De nombreux internautes estiment qu'une réaction officielle des autorités, notamment de Benjamin Griveaux, secrétaire d'État, et de Christophe Castaner, ministre de l’Intérieur, est attendue.

Venus, the second planet from our sun, is often referred to as Earth's twin due to its similar size and density. However, the similarities largely end there. Venus has a harsh atmosphere composed of 97% carbon dioxide, clouds of sulfuric acid, and the hottest surface temperature of any planet orbiting the sun. Despite these challenges, scientists have endeavored to send unmanned spacecraft to Venus, intrigued by the possibility that it may once have been the most Earth-like planet, featuring valleys, mountains, and evidence of ancient oceans.

The author supports the idea that studying Venus is a worthy pursuit, despite the dangers, by highlighting the planet's similarities to Earth and its proximity to our planet. The text mentions, "...Venus was probably covered largely with oceans and could have supported various forms of life, just like Earth." This suggests the potential that Venus, at some point, may have harbored conditions suitable for life, making the exploration of Venus a valuable endeavor. Additionally, the author notes, "...recall that Venus can sometimes be our nearest option for a planetary visit, a crucial consideration given the long time frames of space travel."

Joey was a little scared as the shadowy figure beckoned him closer. "Yes, that's it, come closer," it whispered. Joey cautiously shuffled over to the closet, intrigued. The creature slithered farther back into the closet as Joey approached, whispering promises of wonders and friendship.

As Joey crossed the doorway to the closet, the door slammed shut. The figure revealed its true intentions, mocking Joey for his naivety. Joey, unfazed, responded with unexpected nonchalance. He pointed out his disappointment in the creature, comparing it to the cooler monsters others had received.

Confused by Joey's reaction, the creature grew frustrated and threatened him. Joey, unimpressed, tried to offer constructive criticism to help the monster meet expectations for future victims. The two ended up spending the night redesigning the creature, turning it into a more formidable and impressive being.

By morning, the creature, now named Void, thanked Joey for his help and even offered him a last meal before their final showdown. However, Joey was called downstairs for breakfast by his mom. Void, showing a newfound sense of honor, granted Joey more time to enjoy his meal before their inevitable confrontation.

After breakfast, Joey returned to the closet to find Void waiting with a checkers board, offering a game before their final encounter. The once scary creature had transformed into a companion, thanks to Joey's unexpected empathy and creativity.

Recent studies have highlighted the significant role that recommendation and personalization continue to play in the realm of deep learning. In large enterprises like Facebook, Google, and Alibaba, deep learning-based recommendation systems dominate the AI-inference cycle within their production cloud. However, concerns have been raised regarding the validity of certain recent recommendation results, particularly those based on deep learning techniques. These studies have pointed out flaws in evaluation protocols, including the use of selective baselines and metrics that may lead to misleading signals of improvement.

One of the key controversies in evaluating recommendation models revolves around the use of sampling. While ranking all available items for each user is a common academic and industrial practice, sampling a smaller set of items and comparing relevant items against the sampled ones is also prevalent. However, researchers have argued that commonly used evaluation metrics like Recall, Precision, Average Precision, and NDCG may not align consistently with global metrics, raising doubts about the effectiveness of sampled metrics for recommendation evaluation.

Recent research has delved into aligning sampling-based top-k Hit-Ratios with global top-K Hit-Ratios through a mapping function to bridge the gap between the two metrics. While these efforts have shown promise in approximating the relationship between sampling and global metrics, they are limited to simpler metrics like Recall/Hit-Ratio and cannot be extended to more complex metrics such as AP and NDCG. Despite these advancements, the debate around the effectiveness of sampling for recommendation evaluation persists, with proposed approaches either lacking informativeness or being restricted to basic metrics.

The question of how sampling can be effectively utilized for recommendation evaluation remains unresolved, with ongoing debates and limitations in existing methodologies. While statistical techniques like MLE and Bayesian approaches are commonly used for sampling-based inference in statistics, their applicability to developing sampling-based estimators for recommendation evaluation metrics remains a subject of inquiry. Further research is needed to explore how sampled recommendation ranking results can be accurately translated to their global counterparts and to develop comprehensive methodologies for evaluating recommendation systems.

Congress: Act Now To Repeal SALT Deduction Cap
As part of their 2017 overhaul of the tax code, the previous administration set a $10,000 cap on federal deductions for state and local taxes. Whether it was truly a petty act of revenge aimed at political adversaries matters little at this point; the result was a backdoor tax hike for Nassau residents that was folded into a so-called “Tax Cuts and Jobs Act.” U.S. Rep. Thomas Suozzi and Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer of New York recently revealed that they filed legislation to repeal the federal State and Local Tax (SALT) deduction cap. This proposal deserves swift consideration and approval by the House of Representatives and U.S. Senate.
Then, it was painful. Now, amidst the sharp economic downturn caused by the COVID-19 pandemic, it is simply devastating. Thankfully, President Biden has indicated his support for eliminating the cap and the concept enjoys bipartisan support amongst Long Island’s Congressional delegation. Momentum is building—and not a moment too soon. As a result of the most severe economic downturn since the Great Depression, Nassau County and the region are still reeling from an alarming spike in unemployment and food insecurity. Repealing the SALT deduction cap would provide an essential boost to our long-term recovery and deliver meaningful relief to many Nassau families.
Drucker, of Plainview, is Nassau County Legislator for the 16th Legislative District.
The Truth About The SALT Deduction
This is a response to the letter to the editor by Legislator Arnold Drucker on eliminating the limit on state and local taxes. The SALT cap of $10,000 was initially described as a disastrously provision for New York citizens. It did not turn out that way. For very many middle income families it actually resulted in a tax saving. While our SALT is over $15,000 the greatly increased standard deduction more than covered that and resulted in lower taxes. Studies indicate that many more lower and middle income families are using the standard deduction now (and saving money). One report stated that these families’ deductions grew from $900 million to $2.3 billion from the higher standard deduction. The SALT cap mainly affects high earners. So what do they do to compensate for it? They purchase tax-free government bonds and that helps New York State by lowering the borrowing interest—a significant saving to the state.

Measurement systems are characterized by their wide bandwidth and calibration capability. Phase shift measurements are widely used to evaluate or characterize circuits where phase shifting is a crucial aspect of their behavior, such as phase shifters, beamforming circuits, modulators, demodulators, and amplifiers. Analog phase detectors, when combined with 90º phase shifters, can cover a phase detection range of 360º, albeit with limitations on operating bandwidth that require careful adjustment of internal voltages. Detecting phase shifts of 360º or more becomes challenging at higher operating frequencies, limiting options to multiplier circuits with a detection range of ±90º. This necessitates the grouping of detectors when monitorizing multiple outputs, as discussed in [1, 2].

To address the frequency limitations of 90º phase shifters, a new design is proposed, centered on double multiplication of in-phase and phase-shifted signals, to enhance phase range detection using analog phase detectors. This design, once calibrated, mitigates problems arising from impedance mismatching and phase shift deviation, and can be managed with a tailored control software, which, in turn, also ensures applicability to higher frequency bands, given the commonality of multipliers and switches.
