Transformer-based pre-trained neural networks such as BERT and RoBERTa have significantly advanced various Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks. These models leverage the self-attention mechanism, which establishes relationships among symbols within a sequence to produce a relational representation. Due to their remarkable performance, there is a growing demand for the efficient deployment of these pre-trained Transformer models. However, the computational nature of Transformers poses challenges to straightforward implementation. The most prominent issue is the enormous size of these models. For instance, GPT-3 contains 175 billion parameters and 2048 tokens, leading to substantial memory and computational overhead. Key research efforts have sought to alleviate this issue. Some studies have used quantized bit-precision to reduce the memory footprint and speed up BERT inference, while others have proposed dynamic pruning and quantization to minimize computational complexity. Despite the potential of these methods, their focus has mainly been on matrix multiplication. 

Another crucial, yet less explored, characteristic of pre-trained Transformers is the mix of non-linear computations required to realize the self-attention mechanism. Typical Transformer computations involve several non-linear operations, such as the GELU activation function, Softmax, and Layer normalization. These are usually executed using high-precision, and thus expensive, 32-bit floating-point arithmetic, which significantly slows down the overall computation, as noted in previous studies. 

Several prior works have aimed to mitigate the computational bottleneck posed by non-linear operations. One study proposed approximation techniques to compute GELU, Softmax, and LayerNorm using 32-bit integer arithmetic, while another suggested hardware-friendly, reduced-precision computation techniques, and a custom accelerator for Softmax.

June 28, 2016, was the day I got out of the pin. It was also the day I told my last story to Jake.

That morning, I met Jake in the visiting cell to go through our weekly routine. He would give me lessons on reading and writing, and in return, I would share my stories—my crimes—with him. Jake was taking my stories and selling them as a ghostwriter to the highest bidder among all the illiterate inmates. They'd be back, though, not like me. Those idiots still wouldn't know how to write once they got out.

We always started with the lesson first, then moved on to the story. We went through prepositional phrases and direct objects. I was ready, and I knew it. I could read, write, arrange words in the right order on the page, and understand which pronoun referred to whom or whatever—I didn’t care. I had a big smile on my face, feeling so happy that I would be getting out soon.

Jake, on the other hand, was an asshole. He couldn't wait to get through the lessons and got frustrated when I couldn't understand. I really hated that guy a lot. I hated his privileged life and his big words. I hated how he was making money off us. But he had struck a deal with me, and he was my way out. I would save myself one last story to write once I knew how. 

After the lesson, he immediately jumped to the story. I was so excited, though, that I didn’t care. Everything had fallen into place, and it was perfect. I couldn’t show it, though—I couldn’t let him know today was the last day.

He took out his big special pen and pad, looked at me, and said, "So what's the story toda—ehhhh! ehhhhh! couggggghhh! cooughhhh!" 

And then I took his big shiny pen out of his throat, wrote down today’s story, and walked right out.

Le débat ardent à Nanterre portait sur la résidence habituelle de Johnny Hallyday, en France ou aux États-Unis. Cette question déterminera si le tribunal français est compétent pour trancher le litige entourant son héritage, le 28 mai prochain. Les avocats de Laeticia, la veuve, et de ses enfants aînés, David Hallyday et Laura Smet, ont présenté des arguments radicalement opposés à la barre pour démontrer les liens du chanteur avec l'une ou l'autre des deux nations.

D'un côté, un Johnny « tour Eiffel », en référence à son concert historique au Champ de Mars, de l'autre, un Hallyday imprégné de culture américaine. L'avocat de Laeticia souligne que Johnny a passé plus de temps aux États-Unis qu'en France, mais celui de David et Laura insiste sur le fait que la famille, les amis, les souvenirs, l'activité professionnelle et les projets du chanteur se trouvent en France.

En jeu se trouve un patrimoine de plusieurs dizaines de millions d'euros, incluant des propriétés, des voitures de luxe, des droits sur 1 160 chansons et des royalties d'albums tels que "Mon pays, c'est l'amour", écoulé à plus de 1,4 million d'exemplaires. Le testament de Johnny prévoyait le transfert de tous ses actifs vers un trust américain dont sa veuve est la seule bénéficiaire.

Les aînés ont réussi à obtenir le gel d'une partie des biens et des droits d'auteur en France en 2018. Si le tribunal français se déclare incompétent, une procédure devra être initiée aux États-Unis. En revanche, s'il se saisit du dossier, cela déterminera la législation applicable à l'héritage, mettant en lumière l'importance de la résidence dans cette affaire.

On Thursday, Fidelity Bank Plc in Lagos presented Mr. Lawal Abimbola Bakare, Alex Shaibu, and Ekene Nzurumike with their cash prizes of N5 million, N3 million, and N1 million, respectively, to wrap up its Get Alert in Millions Promo.

During the event, Mr. Nnamdi Okonkwo, the Managing Director of the bank, represented by Mrs. Chijioke Ugochukwu, the Executive Director in charge of Products and Shared Services, expressed that the promo had brought joy to the customers who won various prizes. He also assured that the bank would soon introduce another promo to delight its customers.

In his address, Mr. Okonkwo stated, “We have witnessed one of the most successful promos in the banking industry recently. It was a unique promo designed to enhance the standard of living for our customers. The promo winners came from various backgrounds, including hairdressers, students, and a young lady working in an NGO who aspired to establish a fish farm. With her N2 million win, she could now pursue her dream of fish farming. We also had a case of a father struggling to pay his children's school fees, who also won a cash prize, making the burden of school fees much lighter. These are just a few of the lives we have impacted so far.

Recently, we held a draw that resulted in 13 cash winners and 12 consolation prizes of generating sets and refrigerators, totaling 25 winners nationwide. For the Lagos Draw presentation, we awarded cash prizes of N5 million, N3 million, and N1 million. The remaining N20 million cash prizes are being distributed to 171 winners across the country simultaneously.

Although the Get Alert in Millions Promo is coming to a close, there will be more promos in the upcoming weeks.”

For customers who did not win in the promo, Mr. Obaro Odeghe, the Chairman of the Promo Committee, reiterated the assurance of more exciting opportunities in the near future that they can participate in.

“We are officially concluding the Get Alert in Millions Promo today with the prize presentation to the winners. The journey, which began in September 2016, has been nine months of uplifting stories for Fidelity Bank customers. Those who won today never expected such a windfall in their lives. There are future opportunities for customers yet to win, offering a chance to benefit from Fidelity Bank’s generosity.”

Reading someone's facial expression may sometimes be effective, but it doesn't necessarily reflect their true emotions. For example, a person might appear angry or confused but could actually be feeling extremely happy. In an article, the author mentioned that Dr. Huang used a picture of the Mona Lisa to test new emotion-recognition software. However, the effectiveness of the software is questionable, as it was tested on a painted image rather than a real, living person. Additionally, da Vinci may have exaggerated the Mona Lisa's facial expression for artistic purposes, making it an unreliable test subject.

Using this software in a classroom setting may not be effective. If a student makes a certain face, it doesn't necessarily mean they are bored or confused; it could just be their natural expression. The software could misinterpret their facial cues, or it might even glitch. Moreover, using the software would require a camera, which raises safety concerns. Hackers could potentially access the computer, stealing personal information or, worse, the student's identity.

In conclusion, this software is not valuable for classroom use, as students have other, more pressing needs than a facial coding system. The presence of a camera, if known, could be a distraction, making the software unnecessary.

57岁的何先生最近感到喉咙不适，并伴有口腔异味。在医院检查时，医生发现他的喉咙中有一颗直径约2公分的异物，起初以为是肿瘤。没想到在检查过程中，这颗异物竟掉进了气管，引发了呼吸困难。所幸，医生迅速采取哈姆立克急救法将异物排出，才发现这是一颗罕见的「陨石级」扁桃腺结石。医生提醒大众，要做好口腔清洁，并多喝水，以避免扁桃腺结石的形成。

「哈姆立克」急救化险为夷  
亚洲大学医院耳鼻喉科医师邱建仁表示，这位患者到院时，常感到喉咙有异物。通过内视镜检查，发现扁桃腺有一颗球状物，因其体积较大，起初误认为是肿瘤。不料，在进一步确认时，这颗球状物掉入了气管，引发呼吸阻塞。幸好及时通过催吐解除了危险，最终确诊为一颗2公分大的「陨石级」扁桃腺结石。

邱建仁解释说，扁桃腺位于喉咙后方的两侧，其表面凹凸不平，类似月球。当退化或坏死的组织、细菌、霉菌等分泌物堆积在扁桃腺的凹槽处，就容易钙化形成「结石」。患者可能会咳出带有异味的白色或微黄色小颗粒，并出现异物感、口臭、吞咽困难等症状。

一般而言，扁桃腺结石的大小约如米粒，但这颗结石约有2公分大，临床上十分罕见。为避免类似情况再次发生，医生建议患者要加强口腔清洁。

The field of particle physics (HEP) has produced numerous articles over the last seven decades, covering progress in theory, experiment, and phenomenology. These articles have been published in various journals. With the advent of digital content about 30 years ago, this wealth of information became accessible online. By finding the preprint version of a journal article on the arXiv, it is possible to classify, for instance, a PLB article as NP or HEP and further divide it into experiment, phenomenology, or theory.

To achieve this classification, scripts were written to download and analyze the monthly arXiv submission web pages for several repositories, including Astrophysics (astro-ph), High Energy Physics Experiment (hep-ex), High Energy Physics Lattice (hep-lat), High Energy Physics Phenomenology (hep-ph), High Energy Physics Theory (hep-th), Nuclear Experiment (nucl-ex), and Nuclear Theory (nucl-th), from the inception of arXiv until the end of 2019. This analysis was conducted in January 2020.

To prevent duplicate entries, only arXiv publications were retained where the first subject area of the article matched the repository name. Although articles on the arXiv can appear in multiple repositories, the subject areas (equal to the arXiv repository) are consistently ordered in all repositories, ensuring a single entry per article in our analysis.

The following steps were performed to inventory all arXiv articles: 

1. **Step 1**: Download all monthly webpage summaries for each arXiv repository. Create small summary files with a line for each article, using these files for further steps. This ensures the original arXiv webpage is accessed only once.

2. **Step 2**: Select articles where the first subject area matches the repository name.

3. **Step 3**: Select articles with a link to a published journal article, excluding those with "Submitted to xyz." Specifically, look for the "Journal-ref" associated with the article. At this point, the arXiv articles are divided into a set with journal references (referred to as arXiv-with-journal) and a set without journal references (referred to as arXiv-without-journal).

Table 1 contains the number of articles selected in the above steps for each of the arXiv repositories. Table 2 illustrates what is on the arXiv and what inputs are used for subsequent steps. The next step is to take the ArXiv-with-journal set for each repository and interpret the information stored in the journal reference. This reference indicates the journal where the arXiv manuscript is published. Interpreting this information is challenging due to varying referencing methods and conventions, as well as occasional spelling mistakes that disrupt algorithms. An algorithm was developed to identify most referenced publishers, including PLB, and break down journal information into journal name, volume, page or article ID, and year. This allows for counting the number of articles on the arXiv published in a given year and in certain journals.

An example is shown in Table 2, depicting this information for the hep-ex repository across all available years. This table is a simple illustration of the existing data for all repositories. Other repositories publish in more or different journals. The journals are the standard ones listed in Appendix A, with any journal not listed contained in the "Other" column. The year "9999" accounts for articles where the year was not found or encoded. Similar tables exist for each analyzed arXiv repository, as shown in Appendix B for the nucl-th repository.

These tables convey how many arXiv articles have been published in a journal. Despite identifying many journals, the focus remains on columns containing PRL and PLB. If all articles published in PLB are referenced on the arXiv, the PLB column should match the number of PLB articles published that year.

We proceed by comparing the arXiv to PLB. Ideally, all articles published in PLB after ~1992 should also appear on the arXiv if authors follow the process: submit to arXiv and journal for refereeing, then update arXiv with the journal reference post-publication. Counting PLB articles was previously detailed in a publication [4], listing PLB publications since 1967. For this report, only years with potential arXiv data are used.

All considered arXiv repositories can contribute articles to PLB. To compare the datasets, ArXiv-with-journal is split into two sets: ArXiv-with-PLB-only and arXiv-with-non-PLB, containing non-PLB journal references. Counting articles per year in arXiv-with-non-PLB yields the number of ArXiv articles with PLB references, where the year is "year published in PLB." Table 3 shows these results.

The expectation was that most PLB articles would have an arXiv reference. However, this is not the case for many years. Figure 1 graphically displays the fraction of PLB articles with an arXiv reference each year, representing the ratio: Total arXiv/Total PLB. Ideally, all PLB publications should correspond to an arXiv article with the PLB reference.

Humanity, an unremarkable species by galactic standards, lacked physical prowess, possessed average intelligence, and offered no unique talents or traits of value to others. Initially, when the Hoto made first contact with humans, doubts arose about the worth of establishing formal relations. Consequently, only the Hoto engaged with humans regularly, feeling a sense of responsibility as the ones who revealed humanity's place in the galaxy.

Unexpectedly, this seemingly benign alliance between the Hoto and humans would have a profound impact on the galaxy. Conflict arose when a rare tililium deposit was discovered on a Hoto colony near the Xig alliance, leading to a fierce battle for control. Despite the Hotos seeking aid from the Allied Planets, the loss of a single colony was deemed preferable to war. Only humanity responded to the call for help, demonstrating loyalty to their friends despite their limited military strength.

The subsequent war with the Xigs proved devastating, with the Xigs overpowering the Hotos and eventually targeting Earth. Although initially overlooked, Earth emerged as the last bastion of resistance, accepting Hotian refugees and fortifying its defenses. Humanity's tenacity and rapid acquisition of knowledge surprised all, enabling them to develop advanced technologies and field a formidable armada against the Xig invaders.

The defeat of the Xig fleet at Earth marked the turning point, leading to the liberation of Hoton and the restoration of lost territories. Human determination and unyielding pursuit of victory extended beyond the war's end, as they continued to advance and dismantle the Xig alliance. The unconditional surrender of the Xigs and dissolution of their military highlighted humanity's resolve and capability.

Post-conflict, concerns arose among the Allied Planets about humanity's newfound power and potential aggression. However, humanity's return to Earth without incident and their acceptance of a place on the governing council demonstrated their desire for peace and collaboration. Despite their fearsome reputation in battle, humans proved to be a fundamentally peaceful race, advocating for unity and mercy in the aftermath of victory.

Ultimately, the galactic community recognized humanity's capacity for both conflict and compassion, embracing them as a strong ally while cautioning against provoking their formidable resolve. The phrase "Never push the pink-skins to the thin ice," originating from the Hotos, became a universal lesson in respecting humanity's strength and resilience.

Suiza - La UEFA confirmó que los sorteos de Cuartos de Final, Semifinales y la Final de la Champions League 2019-2020 se llevarán a cabo el viernes 10 de julio en su sede en Nyon, Suiza, a las 05:00 horas (hora de México). Una hora más tarde, se realizarán los sorteos de las últimas eliminatorias de la Europa League. La UEFA también recordó que no habrá cabezas de serie ni restricciones para enfrentamientos entre equipos del mismo país, y cualquier limitación será anunciada antes de la celebración del sorteo. El sorteo para la final determinará al equipo local por razones administrativas.

El Comité Ejecutivo de la UEFA anunció el 17 de junio que la Champions League 2019-2020 concluirá con una fase final entre ocho equipos en Lisboa, del 12 al 23 de agosto. Esta fase se jugará a partido único, con los cuatro equipos que ya estaban clasificados para los cuartos de final antes del parón por la pandemia del coronavirus, y los cuatro equipos que saldrán de las eliminatorias aún por decidir. Los partidos se llevarán a cabo en el estadio La Luz del Benfica y en el José Alvalade del Sporting de Portugal.

Antes de la interrupción por la pandemia del coronavirus en marzo, el Atalanta eliminó al Valencia, el Leipzig al Tottenham, el Atlético de Madrid al Liverpool (defensor del título) y el París Saint-Germain al Borussia Dortmund. Quedan por definir las eliminatorias entre el Manchester City y el Real Madrid, con ventaja para el equipo inglés; entre la Juventus y el Lyon, con ventaja para el equipo francés; entre el Bayern de Múnich y el Chelsea, con clara ventaja para los bávaros; y entre el Barcelona y el Nápoles, tras el empate a uno en San Paolo.

La decisión sobre dónde se disputarán estos enfrentamientos se ha pospuesto y se determinará según la evolución de la pandemia. Se ha sugerido que, de ser necesario, las sedes podrían ser Guimaraes (estadio Afonso Henriques) y Porto (Dragao).

The data collection process for a given phenomenon can be influenced by various sources of variability, creating distinct domains. For instance, natural images with differing illumination, contrast, or noise may impact the classification performance of a machine learning model previously trained in another domain. Similarly, in biology, the study of single-cell dynamics is conducted using diverse instruments, conditions, and modalities, presenting unique challenges and opportunities. In many cases, the relationships between different domains are unknown. Thus, the fusion and integration of multi-domain data have been extensively studied in the data science community for supervised learning, data mining, and exploratory data analysis. One of the earliest methods for achieving this is Canonical Correlation Analysis (CCA), which identifies a linear projection to maximize the correlation between two domains. Over the years, CCA has been extended to different formulations such as sparse CCA and Kernel CCA.

In many applications, a reasonable assumption is that two different datasets, measured from the same underlying phenomenon, are captured under various conditions, instruments, and experimental designs. Manifold alignment assumes a shared latent space from which observations are mapped by functions f and g to different ambient spaces. We aim to uncover the underlying relationship between observations residing in different spaces, X and Y, without assuming any known pairings. Instead, we assume there are labeled observations for different classes. The assumption is that data collected in different domains are governed by a set of shared underlying modes of variation or latent variables. The manifold assumption often applies, suggesting that data in different domains lie on a low-dimensional manifold embedded in high-dimensional ambient spaces, resulting from smooth mappings of latent variables. With this in mind, manifold alignment (MA) has become a common technique for data integration. Applications of MA include handling different face poses, protein structure alignment, medical images for Alzheimer's disease classification, multimodal sensing images, graph-matching, and integrating single-cell multi-omics data.

Various MA methods have been proposed based on different prior knowledge assumptions that relate the two domains. Methods such as CCA or multi-view diffusion maps can be categorized as supervised MA, as they assume paired data. More challenging scenarios arise when little or no a priori pairing knowledge is available. Purely unsupervised algorithms are designed for scenarios where there are no pairings or other side information. These algorithms rely solely on the topology of each domain to infer inter-domain similarities.

Methods that utilize additional information are often categorized as semi-supervised MA. Some methods consider partial correspondence information, where a few one-to-one matching samples act as anchor points for aligning the rest of the data. Some approaches leverage the graph structure of the data, closely related to Laplacian eigenmaps, while others use neural networks, such as the GAN-based MAGAN or autoencoders.

However, acquiring even partial correspondences can be costly or impossible, as in biological applications where the measurement process destroys cells, making it impossible to measure other modalities of the same cells. Even without known correspondences between domains, unsupervised MA is not the only option. If we have access to side information like discrete class labels, we can use this extra knowledge for manifold alignment. Motivated by this, we propose a new semi-supervised MA algorithm called MALI (Manifold Alignment with Label Information). MALI leverages the manifold structure of data in both domains, combined with discrete label information, and does not require known corresponding points between domains. Built on the manifold learning method Diffusion Maps and optimal transport, MALI outperforms current state-of-the-art MA algorithms in this setting across multiple datasets by several metrics.

The setting described above is similar to the domain adaptation (DA) problem. In traditional machine learning, the training set and test set are assumed to be sampled from the same distribution and share the same features. However, these assumptions often do not hold, due to various collection circumstances. When data is expensive or time-consuming to label, it may be desirable to train a model on existing related datasets and adapt it to a new task. The goal is to leverage the knowledge acquired from training on one dataset to enhance performance on the same task with a different dataset, or potentially even a different task. One approach to tackle DA is to use MA, as knowledge can be transferred through MA via the learned inter-domain correspondences or by training on a shared latent representation of both domains.

واجهت شارمين بروكس، سيدة أمريكية تبلغ من العمر 38 عامًا، صعوبات كثيرة لتحقيق حلمها، حيث نجحت مؤخرًا في الوصول إلى هدفها بعد 18 عامًا من التحديات.

تروي بروكس تجربتها قائلة: "عندما كان عمري 17 عامًا، كان جسمي مثاليًا حينما التقينا أول مرة". ومع ذلك، بعد إنجاب طفلها الأول، ازداد وزنها بشكل مضطرد، مما حرمها من ارتداء بدلة الزفاف، وأدى إلى تأجيل زواجها لمدة 18 عامًا.

أشارت بروكس إلى شعورها بالضيق والسلبية تجاه أطفالها قائلة: "لم أتمكن من التعامل مع الأطفال أو المنزل. كنت أنام طوال الوقت تقريبًا". وأوضحت أنها كانت تتناول كميات كبيرة من الطعام، حيث كانت تأكل ما يصل إلى 20 قطعة من الشوكولاتة يوميًا وتتناول وجبات ضخمة، وكانت متعتها تناول الزبادي بالفواكه بعد وجبة العشاء كل ليلة.

Police Briefs: Incidents Reported in Northville

**Mail Theft**

A new T-shirt with a Hawaiian-style pattern was reported stolen from a mailbox in the area of Six Mile and Beck. The complainant informed the police that she had received an Amazon email notification on October 25 confirming delivery, but the T-shirt was missing from the mailbox both that day and the following day. Additionally, the woman had recently been a victim of identity theft, with someone opening a credit card account in her name and attempting to open several other accounts. She speculated that someone might have sifted through her mail, possibly searching for newly-delivered credit cards.

**Unemployment Fraud**

Three residents of Northville Township reported to the police that their identities were used in fraudulent applications for Michigan unemployment benefits. The individuals, two men aged 47 and 60, and a woman aged 48, each filed separate police reports. Their respective employers informed them of the fraudulent applications, and these incidents were either reported or were to be reported to state authorities.

**Vandalism**

In another incident, a house on Hilltop Drive, near Seven Mile and Beck, was egged in the early hours of October 29. According to a police report, eggs were thrown at a window above the front door, with the shells ending up on the porch.

根据警方的每日罪案报告，案发时现场曾发生口角，疑犯被指为一名21岁非洲裔男子，而受害人则为一名亚裔男子。一些社交媒体用户声称，这起案件可能是一宗企图抢劫案，亚裔受害人在自卫过程中开了枪。

对于这些社交媒体上的说法，旧金山警方拒绝评论其真实性，并拒绝确认案件是否与抢劫有关。目前，尚无任何人被捕，案件已交由凶杀案调查组继续处理。

The theatrical release plan for *Black Widow* has been anything but straightforward. As one of the first major blockbusters impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic, the film was delayed multiple times by Marvel Studios throughout 2020. Now, however, it appears that the movie has finally secured a definitive summer release date, prompting Marvel to roll out new promotional material. Earlier today, Marvel unveiled six character posters, offering fans an up-close look at the film's main characters.

The posters feature Scarlett Johansson as Black Widow, also known as Natasha Romanoff, Florence Pugh as Yelena Belova, Rachel Weisz as Melina Vostokoff, David Harbour as Red Guardian, O-T Fagbenle as Mason, and the main villain, Taskmaster. Notably, while each poster includes the actor's name, Taskmaster's remains a mystery, fueling fan speculation about the character's identity. Theories about who might be behind the Taskmaster mask range from Clint Barton to a Natasha clone. In the comics, Taskmaster's alter ego is Tony Masters, but Marvel Studios has not linked him to the film. The absence of an actor's name could be a significant clue.

*Black Widow* is set after the events of *Captain America: Civil War* and before *Avengers: Infinity War*. The film follows Natasha as she returns to her "family" and confronts Taskmaster and other threats to humanity. This movie promises to delve into Natasha's past, which has largely been overlooked in previous MCU films.

Given that *Black Widow* is technically a prequel, there are rumors of cameos by other MCU actors. Robert Downey Jr.'s Tony Stark is frequently mentioned in these rumors, which makes sense since it is implied that Natasha went into hiding after breaching the Sokovia Accords post-*Civil War*. A brief appearance by Stark at the beginning of the film could help casual viewers understand the timeline. Other rumored cameos include Chris Evans as Steve Rogers, Anthony Mackie as Sam Wilson, and Elizabeth Olsen as Wanda Maximoff, as they eventually join Natasha as vigilantes. However, the most likely cameo might be Jeremy Renner's Clint Barton, given his long-standing connection with Natasha in both the comics and films.

In January, Marvel Studios released the official synopsis for *Black Widow*, describing it as an "action-packed spy thriller." The synopsis reveals that Natasha Romanoff confronts "the darker parts of her ledger" when a dangerous conspiracy tied to her past emerges. Pursued by a relentless force, Natasha must reconcile her history as a spy and the fractured relationships she left behind before becoming an Avenger.

I believe the development of self-driving cars will enhance our future. The introduction of these vehicles offers significant benefits: they allow drivers to engage in other productive activities, maintain some level of control in adverse conditions, and employ various sensors to ensure passenger safety.

Self-driving cars enable people to use their travel time more efficiently. This advantage is particularly valuable for those who spend hours commuting, as it allows them to accomplish work during the journey. One concern could be that drivers might become distracted and less alert if they need to intervene. However, as noted in an article, "Some manufacturers hope to address this by incorporating in-car entertainment and information systems that use heads-up displays. Such displays can be turned off instantly when the driver needs to take over." This means that drivers can utilize these regulated systems without compromising safety; if an emergency arises, the car can deactivate these devices.

These vehicles are intelligent enough to recognize when it's necessary for passengers to assume control. This capability is crucial because it demonstrates that while cars handle routine driving conditions independently, they still afford human intervention when needed. According to another article: "In 2013, BMW announced the development of 'Traffic Jam Assistant.' The car can manage driving functions at speeds up to 25 mph; special touch sensors ensure the driver maintains contact with the wheel. Indeed, none of the cars developed so far are entirely driverless." This indicates that should a vehicle encounter challenging conditions or begin losing control, passengers have the ability—and responsibility—to take over.

Modified self-driving cars are equipped with advanced technology designed for optimal performance and safety. For instance: "Google's modified Toyota Prius uses position-estimating sensors on its left rear wheel; a rotating sensor on its roof; a video camera mounted near its rearview mirror; four automotive radar sensors; a GPS receiver; and an inertial motion sensor...

由于Omicron变种病毒在全美迅速传播，纽约市新冠病例数字不断增加，纽约大学于15日宣布了一系列防疫措施。首先，该校决定即日起取消所有非必要聚集活动，并将期末考试改为线上进行。此外，纽约大学要求全体师生和员工在1月18日前完成补强针接种。除了纽约大学，复敦大学、雪城大学、和普林斯顿大学等高校也颁布了类似的要求，以严防病毒传播。

具体来说，纽约大学的新冠病毒检测数据显示，校园内确诊率有所增加。尽管这一数字尚未引发恐慌，但校方仍强调需要提高警惕，严格执行防疫措施。学校鼓励各学院将期末考试和其他相关测试改为线上进行，教师需在15日下午5时前通知学生关于期末考试形式的改变。同时，校方要求从即日起取消所有校内非必要、非学术性聚集活动。

在疫苗接种方面，纽约大学要求所有符合条件者在1月18日前完成补强针接种。根据校方数据，校园内有80%的学生和教职员工符合接种条件，截至14日，已有3000人提交了接种证明。除此之外，位于纽约上州的雪城大学和复敦大学也要求全体师生在新学期开始前接种补强针。而康州的文理学院维思大学同样要求全体师生在1月14日前完成接种。

其他高校也在采取相应措施。普林斯顿大学于15日宣布将期末考试改为线上，同时取消所有无法戴口罩进行的室内活动，并可能将这些活动延期至1月7日后。该校教师员工接种率达到96%，本科生和研究生的接种率则分别为99%和98%。

**En el festival de cine proyectarán películas de la región, Pituka Ortega**

**Lunes 8 de abril de 2019 - 12:13 a.m.**

**El cine en Panamá está floreciendo**
Ya contamos con varios productores que se han hecho un lugar en la industria y han logrado grandes éxitos taquilleros. Actualmente se celebra el octavo Festival de Cine, y Pituka Ortega, una de las pioneras en la materia, tiene todos los detalles para que usted pueda disfrutarlo y conozca más sobre la vida de los cineastas.

**Películas de la región**
Habrá cine de Panamá, Costa Rica, República Dominicana, Cuba y de otros países. El mejor cine del mundo estará presente. Los asistentes verán el cine de su región, de su país, un cine que está generando mucha atención desde hace 10 años.

**Expectativas del Festival**
Este año es especial porque vienen invitados muy importantes. Para los panameños, saber que tienen una actividad cultural que también habla de su propia identidad y lo que son capaces de generar, está creando un sentido de orgullo. Aunque no todos asistan, saben que el festival existe y que está generando mucha atención internacional. Esto genera orgullo porque, cuando los panameños hacen las cosas bien, se sienten orgullosos.

**Premios y candidatos**
La Federación Internacional de Prensa y Críticos, un cuerpo de periodistas del mundo entero del más alto nivel, ha seleccionado a Panamá para otorgar el premio a la mejor película de la sección para América Central y el Caribe. Los realizadores de esta sección sentirán un gran orgullo de tener a la Federación en Panamá. Tenemos tres películas panameñas en esta sección: una ficción de José Ángel Canto titulada ‘Estación seca’, una premier mundial de Edgar Soberón Torchía llamada ‘Radio’ y un documental muy interesante titulado ‘Tierra adentro’ de Mauro Colombo producido por Abner Benaím. Además, hay películas de Costa Rica, Guatemala, Cuba, República Dominicana, todas de la región.

**La industria del cine en Panamá**
- **Directores emergentes**: Pituka menciona a varios directores destacados como Abner Benaím, Ricardo Aguilar, Ana Endara, Anie Canavallo y Arian Benedetti.
- **Ganancias como director de cine**: Aunque la vida de Hollywood no es alcanzable, es posible vivir profesionalmente del cine en Panamá. La experiencia en el cine o la televisión también abre puertas para otros tipos de proyectos, generando una industria más fuerte a nivel nacional e internacional.
- **Productores y promotores**: Depende del tipo de distribución. Hay mercado tanto para películas ligeras como experimentales. Es importante ser persistente y tener suerte, talento y hacer las cosas en el momento adecuado.

**Producción de cine en la región**
- **Documentales vs. Ficción**: Hacer un documental puede ser menos costoso y más flexible, pero no es fácil y tiene muchos retos. Abner Benaím comenzó con una ficción llamada ‘Chance’ que tuvo éxito local.
- **Costo de producción**: En Centroamérica y el Caribe, una película rara vez supera los 3 millones de dólares. Las películas pueden costar desde medio millón hasta 3 millones de dólares, dependiendo de lo recursivo que sea el equipo.
- **Financiamiento**: El fondo cine de Panamá es notable a nivel internacional, con 2.2 millones de dólares destinados al fondo de estímulo de la industria. La Dirección Nacional de Cine utiliza lo que queda para talleres y para llevar a cineastas nacionales a festivales de cine.

**Enfoque de Pituka Ortega**
Pituka actualmente no está trabajando en ninguna producción y se dedica completamente al festival. Ha realizado historias del Canal y ‘La Ruta’, pero estos proyectos le causaron mucho estrés. Está feliz dedicándose al Festival de Cine.

**Impacto del Festival**
El festival es una actividad cultural excelente para el turismo nacional e internacional. Genera mucho ruido positivo y atención. Se lleva a cabo gracias al apoyo del Estado, la empresa privada y la población, a través de una asociación sin fines de lucro que reinvierte los ingresos en el festival y en la industria nacional.

**Conclusión**
El festival de cine en Panamá está creciendo y generando mucho interés y orgullo tanto a nivel nacional como internacional. Con el apoyo adecuado y el talento local, la industria del cine en Panamá seguirá floreciendo y alcanzando nuevos logros.

I am in favor of advancing towards driverless cars for several reasons. Once the technology is perfected, roads will become safer, transportation costs will decrease, and travel on roads could become faster.

The concept of driverless cars is remarkable, and when perfected, it will create new opportunities for road transportation. These cars will have the ability to detect vehicles that a human driver might miss, reducing the number of accidents significantly.

Some states have already permitted computer-driven cars on the road, indicating the increasing safety of driverless vehicles. Manufacturers anticipate that more states will authorize the use of driverless cars as they continue to enhance safety and affordability.

Another benefit of driverless cars is the potential for more economical transportation. For instance, Sergey Brin, the co-founder of Google, predicts that the fuel consumption of these cars will be half of the current rate, reducing environmental impact. Brin also suggests that driverless taxis will offer greater safety and flexibility, minimizing the risk of hazardous driver behavior.

Moreover, driverless cars could facilitate quicker travel between destinations. These autonomous vehicles have the capability to travel at speeds higher than the current highway limits, while maintaining safety through advanced sensors, making the roads safer.

In conclusion, the development of driverless cars is an ongoing process, and further research is needed to perfect the technology for road use. However, the evolution of driverless cars will transform the future of transportation, offering a safer, faster, and more cost-effective means of travel.

D'accord, le titre est abrupt, mais il est venu à moi lorsque je lisais la page d'accueil d'un journal local avec des titres très significatifs : "Un homme de 50 ans se noie dans la Limmat", "Deux adolescents retrouvés sans vie dans un logement", "Un cycliste de 61 ans décède après une chute", "Accident de canyoning : le disparu toujours pas retrouvé", puis plus loin : "Trois corps déjà retrouvés" et encore : "L'alpiniste, décédé au Festijoch, est identifié".

Et sur un autre site que je consulte pour accéder à ma boîte e-mail, je lis en première position : "La pandémie a fait 50 000 morts en Inde". Alors voilà, comme il n'y a plus de quoi apeurer la population par un nombre impressionnant chez nous, on brandit celui de l'autre bout du monde. Dans le même article, on rajoute celui d'un autre continent : "Les États-Unis les plus touchés avec plus de 170 000 morts".

Ce qui est frappant, c'est l'utilisation du nombre de cadavres pour nous effrayer, plutôt que de nous inciter à prendre conscience du vécu des habitants de ces régions, bien au-delà du Covid, et des souffrances qu'ils endurent avant de mourir. "D'autant que l'Inde entre dans la période des moussons, propice au développement de maladies. Plus d'un demi-million de personnes sont contaminées chaque année en Inde par des maladies favorisées par les pluies, comme la dengue et le paludisme, lors de la grande mousson qui s'abat sur le pays d'Asie du Sud de juin à septembre. Des infections qui présentent des symptômes presque identiques à ceux du Covid-19 : fièvre, difficultés à respirer, perte d'appétit".

Aux États-Unis, nous prenons connaissance de causes d'un autre ordre, mais tout aussi dramatiques, qui aboutissent à une situation tragique attribuée au coronavirus afin de ne pas considérer la responsabilité d'autres origines, face auxquelles la population est tout aussi démunie que face à une mousson, voire plus encore ! On pouvait déjà lire le 5 mai : "Après la crise du virus, le monde fait face à une plus grande dépression que les années 1930, avec des centaines de millions de personnes au chômage aux États-Unis, en Occident et dans le monde entier", qui doivent vivre avant de faire face à la mort "la pauvreté, l'insécurité alimentaire et la misère humaine". Non, ce n'est pas le Covid qui a d'abord affaibli la population, mais plusieurs causes politiques, dont une en particulier : "Il faut se poser des questions alors que le militarisme occidental inacceptable, dirigé par les États-Unis, et l'insensibilité néolibérale semblent n'être qu'une légère politique irritante par rapport à ce qui s'annonce".

En Europe, nous ne pouvons plus brandir l'étendard de la mortalité, alors nous brandissons celui du rebond. Les chiffres sont toujours utilisés, même s'ils ne concernent plus les morts mais les tests positifs, dont certains sont faux et d'autres ne révèlent en aucun cas une maladie avérée.

To mark the 45th anniversary of McDonald’s in the UK, an independent report conducted by Development Economics examines the chain’s impact on UK cities, including Aberdeen, through job creation and economic contributions from its supply chain. According to the report, McDonald’s contributes £149 million to Scotland, supporting 9,616 jobs. The total contribution, including suppliers and induced gross value added, amounts to £233 million.

Overall, the report reveals that McDonald’s and its supply chain contribute an estimated £3.36 billion annually to the UK economy, with a total economic impact of around £54.4 billion. This includes spending £35.6 billion with UK businesses and creating 2.1 million jobs. In Aberdeen specifically, McDonald’s contributes £9.02 million, ranking 6th in Scotland, with Glasgow leading the list followed by East Renfrewshire and Falkirk.

Local franchisee Craig Duncan, who operates multiple McDonald’s restaurants in Aberdeen and the north-east, employs over 280 people in the city. The transition to digital information within industry and society has led to an increasingly abundant amount of accessible data. This vast quantity of data presents challenges to data mining and machine learning techniques, as scalability becomes a major concern, as highlighted by Fan and Bifet [2013]. To address the complexities posed by large datasets, strategies for data reduction have been developed.

One data reduction technique used in machine learning tasks is prototype selection. The primary objective of prototype selection methods is to create a concise set of representative data points from the entire dataset. It is important to note that, as these methods eliminate a portion of the data samples, they inevitably face a trade-off between reducing the dataset size (thereby decreasing computational resource demands) and maintaining the quality of classification results, as outlined by Chou et al. [2006] and Carbonera and Abel [2018a].

Numerous studies have shown that prototype selection not only generates more manageable datasets, reducing the computational resources needed for machine learning tasks, but it can also enhance the accuracy of the resulting models. This improvement occurs through the removal of redundant or erroneous instances from the training set, as emphasized by de Haro-García et al. [2019]. Additionally, recent studies by Alswaitti et al. [2024] underscore prototype selection algorithms as key enablers of sustainable AI practices for developing green AI models.

Some studies, such as those by Arnaiz-González et al. [2016], distinguish between prototype selection and instance selection. In this view, instance selection involves choosing a subset of the original dataset instances, whereas prototype selection can replace original instances with synthetic ones. In this work, we use the term prototype selection to encompass both approaches.

Most prototype selection methods proposed in the literature, such as those by Wilson [1972], Wilson and Martinez [2000], Brighton and Mellish [2002], Nikolaidis et al. [2011], Lin et al. [2015], and Leyva et al. [2015], suffer from high execution times, which pose challenges when dealing with large datasets. In this paper, we propose a simple approach called PSASA (Prototype Selection Accelerator based on Spatial Abstraction), designed to speed up conventional prototype selection algorithms. Our method serves as a preliminary step that efficiently produces an initial set of candidate prototypes smaller than the original set. The algorithm has two main steps: (I) it uses the notion of spatial partitioning to identify sets of similar instances in the original dataset, and (II) for each spatial partition, it creates a prototype from the set of instances of each class within that partition. The prototypes generated can then be used as input for conventional prototype selection algorithms in a subsequent step. Thus, our approach performs a rapid initial prototype selection that can be refined by another conventional, typically slower, algorithm. Moreover, since the second algorithm's input (some conventional instance selection algorithm) is reduced, its running time is proportionally decreased. To our knowledge, this is the first proposal for a pre-step to accelerate conventional prototype selection approaches.

Our approach focuses on accelerating the processing time of conventional prototype selection algorithms, striving to maintain the original performance in terms of classification quality achieved by a classifier trained with the resulting reduced dataset. Therefore, our goal is not to enhance the classification quality of traditional algorithms.

The approach presented in this paper builds on concepts proposed by Carbonera and Abel [2018a, b, c]. However, it is crucial to note that these previous works introduced novel prototype selection methods, whereas our paper presents a novel algorithm aimed at accelerating conventional prototype selection methods.

We integrated our approach with five conventional prototype selection algorithms from existing literature.

Venus is often referred to as the "Evening Star," shining brightly in the night sky. It is the planet closest to Earth. Despite the challenges, exploring Venus is worthwhile as it is our planetary neighbor and Earth's twin.

Humanity has launched numerous spacecraft to Venus, but most missions have lasted only a few hours. This precaution is wise as no spacecraft has returned to Venus in over three decades. Venus's atmosphere is nearly 97% carbon dioxide, and its surface temperature is a scorching 800 degrees Fahrenheit, far surpassing any conditions encountered on Earth.

The idea of Venus once being covered in oceans and hospitable to humans is intriguing. However, the pressure and extreme conditions on Venus pose significant challenges. NASA is developing innovative approaches to explore Venus, such as using simplified electronics made of silicon carbide, tested in a simulated Venusian environment. While modern computers are powerful, they are also delicate in harsh conditions.

Journeying to Venus and beyond should not be hindered by danger and uncertainty. Instead, exploration should push the boundaries of imagination and innovation, to unlock the mysteries of the universe.

Un hombre acusado de una agresión sexual ha sido absuelto. La sentencia de la sección sexta de la Audiencia de Santa Cruz de Tenerife sostiene que la mujer mantuvo relaciones sexuales con el acusado en un aseo de un establecimiento de ocio en Playa de Las Américas. Sin embargo, no considera probado que esa relación no fuera consentida.

La denunciante relató ante la Policía y en la vista oral que, cuando iba a salir del baño, el procesado la empujó hacia dentro, le tapó la boca para que no gritara, le subió el vestido, bajó su ropa interior y la penetró vaginalmente. Pero la sala destaca que el examen forense no revela ninguna lesión que debería haberse producido a causa de la violencia descrita por la mujer. Además, señala que los hechos ocurrieron en un baño concurrido y nadie entró durante los cinco a diez minutos que duraron.

Según la testigo, los hechos ocurrieron alrededor de las 3.30 horas y ella regresó al hotel entre las 6 y 7 de la mañana después de pasar por otros locales de ocio. Sin embargo, su amiga testificó que no iban de fiesta, sino que intentaban tranquilizarla. Los hechos fueron denunciados a las 22.30 horas del mismo día, algo que el tribunal considera incongruente con la gravedad de los hechos.

La Audiencia también destaca que las declaraciones de la mujer reflejan una frialdad y falta de emociones en el relato de los hechos que no concuerdan con lo narrado. Esto coincide con el informe forense, que señala que en general no se muestra muy afectada y solo lloró un poco durante la exploración ginecológica. Estas circunstancias debilitan la credibilidad de la testigo.

En cuanto al acusado, en un primer momento negó cualquier relación con los hechos, pero luego los reconoció, alegando que había sido sexo consentido. Explicó que negó haber tenido un encuentro sexual porque era casado y trabajaba en el local donde ocurrieron los hechos.

La Fiscalía había calificado los hechos como agresión sexual y solicitaba una pena de ocho años de prisión para el acusado, así como seis años de libertad vigilada. El hombre estuvo en prisión preventiva desde el 9 de noviembre de 2018 hasta el 8 de octubre de 2019.

**New Threats and Increased Competition Drive Innovation in the Global Web Application Firewall Market**

LONDON, Nov. 6, 2017 /PRNewswire/ -- Web applications are essential technologies that every online company relies on to engage with employees, partners, customers, and potential clients. However, the exposed nature of these applications presents hackers with numerous opportunities to test defenses. Additionally, the ever-evolving technologies create new chances for hackers to discover and exploit vulnerabilities. Organizations of all sizes need comprehensive web application firewall (WAF) solutions to safeguard exposed threat vectors. According to Frost & Sullivan's research, titled "Global Web Application Firewall (WAF) Market Analysis, Forecast to 2021," the WAF market is projected to grow at a compound annual growth rate of 13.7% from 2016 to 2021, reaching over $1.1 billion by 2021. The research offers a market overview of current challenges, drivers, restraints, forecasts, and trends, with discussions on WAF product and cloud service segments. It also provides a market share and competitive analysis of top players such as Akamai, Citrix, Cloudflare, F5 Networks, Fortinet, Imperva, Penta Security, Qualys, Radware, Sophos, and Wallarm. For more information on this analysis, please click here.

"Web technologies are rapidly evolving to support the global digital transformation trend, including the proliferation of mobile devices, the Internet of Things, and cloud computing. This swift pace of change can pose challenges for traditional WAF solutions," stated Chris Rodriguez, Senior Industry Analyst for Network Security at Frost & Sullivan. "WAF vendors must continuously innovate to tackle these new threats and enhance customer value by advancing their product offerings with innovative features such as API security, bot detection, and controlled technology."

To thrive in a fast-paced environment, WAF vendors should:

1. Support the application development lifecycle through deep integration with DAST/SAST tools.
2. Enable APT and threat hunting by incorporating complementary technologies such as SIEMs to identify significant security events.
3. Protect applications with consistent policies, regardless of their deployment location, including public and private cloud environments.
4. Address emerging trends such as IoT risk.
5. Deliver solutions for emerging verticals such as manufacturing.

"Demand for web security will increase, but WAF will not be viewed as a cure-all," noted Rodriguez. "WAF will be one of many web security technologies competing for security budget allocations in the coming years."

The "Global Web Application Firewall (WAF) Market Analysis, Forecast to 2021" is part of Frost & Sullivan's Network Security Growth Partnership Service program.

The working alliance between the therapist and the patient is an important measure of the clinical outcome and a qualitative predictor of therapeutic effectiveness in psychotherapy. The alliance entails a number of cognitive and emotional aspects of the interaction between these two agents, such as their shared understanding of the objectives to be attained and the tasks to be completed, as well as the bond, trust, and respect that will develop during the course of the therapy.

While traditional methods to quantify the alliance depend on self-evaluative reports with point-scales valuation by patients and therapists about whole sessions, the digital era of mental health can enable new research fronts utilizing real-time transcripts of the dialogues between the patients and therapists. By analyzing the psychotherapy dialogues, we are interested in studying the usage of natural language processing technique to extract out turn-level features of the working alliance and see if it can help better inform us of the clinical condition of the patient.

Here we present the Working Alliance Transformer (WAT), a transformer-based classification model to classify the psychotherapy sessions into different psychiatric conditions. Our methods consist of a psychological state encoder that quantifies the degree of patient-therapist alliance by projecting each turn in a therapeutic session onto the representation of clinically established working alliance inventories, using language modeling to encode both turns and inventories, which was originally proposed in [4] as an analytical tool.

We collated and preprocessed the Counseling and Psychotherapy Transcripts from Alex Street, the publisher company, which consists of transcribed recordings of over 950 therapy sessions between multiple anonymized therapists and patients that belong to four types of psychiatric conditions: anxiety, depression, schizophrenia, and suicidal. This multi-part collection includes speech-translated transcripts of the recordings from real therapy sessions, 40,000 pages of client narratives, and 25,000 pages of reference works.

On this dataset, we evaluate quantitatively the effectiveness of this inference method in improving the classification or diagnosis capability of deep learning models to predict psychiatric conditions from therapy transcripts.

Au Palais des enfants de Bucarest, le personnel sanitaire vaccine à tour de bras depuis le mois de mars 2021. Dans l’espoir d’inciter de façon ludique la population roumaine à se faire vacciner, le personnel de ce centre de vaccination situé au cœur de la capitale a érigé un sapin inédit. Composé de 19 000 doses de vaccin Pfizer, Moderna et Johnson déjà utilisées, ce geste symbolique vise à encourager la vaccination dans un pays où la campagne n’avance pas comme prévu. Les autorités sont désemparées face à une population réticente à se faire vacciner contre le Covid.

Ce projet original a été salué comme un geste “pour la vie, pour la santé, qui a nécessité plusieurs centaines d’heures de travail”, comme on peut le lire sur la page Facebook de Ro Vaccinare, le site officiel de la campagne de vaccination. Les artistes en herbe ont même souligné que c’était une manière différente de célébrer l’esprit de Noël.

Cependant, après l’enthousiasme initial autour de ce premier sapin anti-Covid, une douche froide s'est abattue sur le centre. Selon le webzine Hotnews, des “plaintes anonymes, adressées à la Garde nationale de l’environnement”, ont mené les commissaires de cet organisme de contrôle à infliger une amende de 90 000 lei [18 000 euros] au responsable du centre. Ils ont ordonné la destruction du sapin et même la possible fermeture du centre, sous prétexte qu’il n’aurait pas respecté les conditions de stockage des déchets médicaux.

Cette amende a suscité une vive indignation en Roumanie. Raed Arafat, le chef du département des Situations d’urgence, a également critiqué la mesure, la qualifiant de “néfaste et exagérée”, ajoutant que le scandale a été attisé par les partisans de la campagne antivaccination.

Machine learning is experiencing a renaissance powered by transformers. Over the past five years, neural architectures for natural language processing, vision, and several other domains have largely been overtaken by transformers. However, many classes of image-level generative models have resisted this trend. While transformers are widely used in autoregressive models, they have seen less adoption in other generative modeling frameworks. For instance, diffusion models, which have been at the forefront of recent advances in image-level generative models, predominantly use a convolutional U-Net architecture as the de facto backbone. The groundbreaking work by Ho et al. first introduced the U-Net backbone for diffusion models. Initially, U-Net, having achieved success in pixel-level autoregressive models and conditional GANs, was adapted from Pixel-CNN++ with a few modifications. The model is convolutional, primarily consisting of ResNet blocks. Unlike the standard U-Net, the architecture incorporates additional spatial self-attention blocks, essential components in transformers, at lower resolutions. Dhariwal and Nichol explored various architectural choices for the U-Net, such as the use of adaptive normalization layers to inject conditional information, and the number of channels in convolutional layers. Nonetheless, the U-Net's high-level design, as proposed by Ho et al, has largely remained the same. 

In this work, we aim to demystify the significance of architectural choices in diffusion models and provide empirical baselines for future generative modeling research. We demonstrate that the U-Net's inductive bias is not crucial to the performance of diffusion models, and it can be readily replaced with standard designs, such as transformers.

Angelique, a young girl with mahogany hair and tan skin, was anxiously counting down the seconds as she awaited the moment that would determine the course of the rest of her life. She was the youngest in her class and possibly in her grade, with everyone else having already received their powers. Some had minor abilities while others had powers that required monitoring by a psychiatrist or even recruitment by the National Heroes Association, a supernatural police force.

As she sat at a party with her friend Sam, who tried to distract her from her nerves, Angelique found herself fixated on the clock ticking away the minutes until her fate would be revealed. Sam's attempts to lighten the mood with random chatter were appreciated, but Angelique couldn't shake off her anxiety, stealing glances at the clock to track the dwindling time.

With each passing minute, Angelique felt the tension rise within her until the moment arrived and the room seemed to fade away. Suddenly, she found herself in a barren, scorching wasteland, struggling to survive under a merciless sun. The experience was overwhelming, and as her body succumbed to the extreme conditions, she let out a final scream before losing consciousness.

The aftermath of Angelique's ordeal was shrouded in uncertainty, as she slipped into a coma and her parents faced the heartbreaking decision to end her life support. Her body wracked with uncontrollable spasms, she never emerged from her unconscious state, leaving behind a mystery of what power she may have gained and the tragic consequences of its manifestation.

In the end, Angelique's story serves as a cautionary tale of the potential dangers that come with unlocking extraordinary abilities, highlighting the delicate balance between power and the fragility of human existence.

Amanda Samuels emerged from The Pit, surprised to find someone waiting for her. The passage of time inside The Pit was difficult to gauge, but she was aware that a significant duration had elapsed since she and the others had entered. As she stepped out, a man exclaimed, "Oh my god! Amanda Samuels!" and quickly reached for a camera to snap a photo before extending his hand to her.

"Mike Jackson," the man introduced himself. "It's an honor to meet you. I've been coming out here for the past ten months on assignment with the Daily News."

"Amanda," she replied, shaking his hand. "How long have we been gone?"

"Not as long as you might think," Mike replied swiftly. "One year, eight months, and six days."

"You haven't got it down to the hour?" Amanda smirked, and Mike chuckled, a bit embarrassed. Amanda laughed with him, her attention drawn to his camera. "Do you want to say anything about what happened down there?" Mike asked. "This thing has live stream capability—I bet everyone would love to hear from you. Of course, I understand if you don't want to..."

Amanda shook her head, determination in her eyes. "It's important that I get my story out there," she told him. "I'm ready to go when you are."

After a quick, excited call to his manager, Mike set up the camera on a tripod. "Let's roll," he announced. "This is Mike Jackson, on scene with Amanda Samuels, who has just emerged from The Pit, seemingly unscathed. Welcome back to civilization, Amanda. How did you do it?"

"Thank you, Mike," Amanda said, her voice gracious. "It certainly wasn't easy, I can tell you that. The darkness, the nightmarish creatures, the constant fear—it all starts to get to you, at first."

She paused, and Mike, with a supportive smile, encouraged her to continue. "We tried to focus on the mission we were given. We soon realized that fighting our way out wasn't an option. After we lost Dex, we didn't know how to go on."

Scaling the cyber hunt problem poses several key technical challenges. Detecting and characterizing cyber threats at scale in large enterprise networks is hard because of the vast quantity and complexity of the data that must be analyzed as adversaries deploy varied and evolving tactics to accomplish their goals. There is a great need to automate all aspects, and, indeed, the workflow of cyber hunting. AI offers many ways to support this. We have developed the WILEE system that automates cyber threat hunting by translating high-level threat descriptions into many possible concrete implementations. Both the (high-level) abstract and (low-level) concrete implementations are represented using a custom domain-specific language (DSL). WILEE uses the implementations along with other logic, also written in the DSL, to automatically generate queries to confirm (or refute) any hypotheses tied to the potential adversarial workflows represented at various layers of abstraction. We summarize WILEE in Section 2.

In this contribution, we focus on presenting two AI components of WILEE that coordinate to support its automated query generation for hunting, see Figure 1. First, in Section 3, we introduce a hunt component, named Malmo, that uses Natural Language Processing (NLP) to automate extraction and translation of known threat descriptions. Known threats can be identified with pattern recognition and signature-based methods. Their descriptions are embedded within human-readable, semi-structured documents. Malmo extracts and translates, to a machine-digestible format, key fields of the documents, including indicators of compromise, to make them operational for the hunt. Known threats evolve into unknown threats.

A family C of subsets of a finite set X is a convexity on X if ∅, X ∈ C and C is closed under intersection (van de Vel (1993) ). Indeed, the most studied graph convexities are defined in this way, with the P-convex sets forming a convexity on V (G). Given a graph G and a family P of paths of G, the P-interval of a set S ⊆ V (G) is formed by S and all vertices of every path of P between vertices of S. The set S is P-convex if S is equal to its P-interval. The P-convex hull of S is the minimum P-convex set containing S. For instance, the well-known geodetic convexity has P as the family of shortest paths (Pelayo (2013); Dourado et al. (2016) ), the P 3 convexity has P as the family of paths of order 3 (Campos et al. (2015) ; Centeno et al. (2011)) , and in the monophonic convexity, P is the family of all induced paths (Dourado et al. (2010) ; Duchet (1988) ).

The set S is said to be P-convexly independent if for every u ∈ S, it holds that u does not belong to the P-convex hull of S -{u}.

La justicia militar tiene abierta la investigación de dos presuntos casos de acoso sexual en el seno de las Fuerzas Armadas sufridos por dos mujeres soldado en cuarteles de Gerona y Palma de Mallorca, según han confirmado a Europa Press fuentes del Ministerio de Defensa.

El primero de los casos tuvo lugar en el Regimiento Arapiles 62 de Gerona. La denuncia parte de una soldado contra un cabo y otro compañero soldado por acoso profesional y sexual. El caso trascendió en octubre del pasado año cuando la soldado decidió no solicitar la renovación profesional en las Fuerzas Armadas. Entonces, su capitán preguntó los motivos que le llevaban a esa decisión y la soldado le relató el presunto caso. Ante esta denuncia, el capitán informó al Jefe de Estado Mayor del Ejército de Tierra (JEME), general Francisco Javier Varela, para la apertura de un expediente disciplinario a ambos militares. Fue informada entonces la fiscalía y el titular del Juzgado Togado Militar Territorial nº 31 de Cataluña ha acordado la incoación de diligencias previas para esclarecer los hechos. En concreto, el juez militar estudia si los hechos pudieran ser constitutivos de delitos de abuso de autoridad o relativos al ejercicio de los derechos fundamentales y de las libertades públicas, previstos y castigados en los artículos 47, 48, 49 y 50 del Código Penal Militar.

El segundo de los casos tuvo lugar en el Regimiento 47 de Infantería de Palma de Mallorca el pasado mes de noviembre cuando una soldado pidió la baja médica debido al presunto acoso sufrido por parte de un teniente. En este caso, el capitán es quien se dirige directamente a la justicia para denunciar los hechos, que están en manos del Juzgado Togado Militar Territorial nº33 de Palma de Mallorca, que ha abierto diligencias previas. Por su parte, el teniente ha sido destinado a otro acuartelamiento en comisión de servicio.

The "Evening Star," another name for Venus, is known for its inhospitable conditions to humans. Despite the dangers and obstacles, there is ongoing debate about sending more explorations to the planet, a viewpoint supported by the author of "The Challenges of Exploring Venus." The author argues that exploring Venus holds value and should be pursued.

One key point made by the author is that Earth shares similarities with Venus, making further studies on the planet essential. The author frequently emphasizes this connection by highlighting features that both planets possess. For instance, Venus still exhibits characteristics akin to Earth such as rocky terrain with valleys, mountains, and craters (Exploring Venus). This evidence underscores the author's belief in exploring Venus due to its resemblance to our own planet.

Moreover, NASA should consider a manned mission to Venus as it presents a unique opportunity for planetary exploration. Given its proximity and occasional closeness to Earth compared to other planets like Mars or beyond, traveling to Venus could be more feasible in terms of time and cost (Exploring Venus). By emphasizing this point, the author underscores the practicality of exploring a neighboring planet like Venus over more distant options.

Addressing how we can navigate the challenges of exploring Venus is crucial according to the author. One proposed solution involves utilizing robust yet dated technology that can withstand extreme conditions better than modern counterparts (Exploring Venus). Additionally, deploying a blimp-like vehicle in the upper atmosphere of Venus could offer a safe vantage point for exploration despite limitations on direct sampling (Exploring Venues).

In conclusion, while acknowledging that exploring chaotic and scorching hot environments like those found on Venus may seem daunting or impractical at first glance due their inability support life; however they also hold significant scientific value worth pursuing. The insights shared in "The Challenges of Exploring venus" underscore why venturing towards venus over other planets makes sense based off factors such as similarities with earth prompt arrival times potential technological solutions overcoming hurdles along journey providing worthiness visiting venus despite facing numerous challenges along way ensuring valuable outcomes derived from ultimately embarking upon missions there.

"You will pass down this story to your children, and they will pass it on to their children," the old man said confidently as he led his apprentice to the Wall of Stories. Despite his scrawny frame wrapped in bear furs and his toothless smile amidst a tangle of gray hair, the man exuded a certain gravity, aided by his piercing black eyes that seemed to peer into souls. He guided the young girl deep into the cave, his left hand gliding along the wall as if tracing his way in the dim light.

Finally, they arrived at The Wall of Stories, the grandest chamber of the cave. The vast space opened up before them, mostly shrouded in darkness even with the illumination of the old man's torch. The flickering orange light revealed a multitude of painted figures – animals, people, handprints, glyphs, and depictions of hunting, nature, and life. The People of the Red Cliff had been preserving their stories on this wall for generations, even before the cataclysmic event that fractured the sky. Standing before the ancient artwork, the old man turned to his young apprentice. "Tell me the tale."

The girl, a budding shaman of barely ten winters, had gazed upon the Wall many times before. Small for her age with icy eyes and mud-colored hair, she possessed a keen memory that made the stories as familiar to her as the calls of animals were to the hunters. She hovered her hand over the painted scenes, cautious not to disturb the tribe's history with her touch.

"The People of the Red Cliff have inhabited these lands for as long as memory serves," she began, gesturing over a scene depicting men and women. "We have shared this land with the bear, hunted the deer, and honored our departed by returning them to the earth. Our ancestors linger here, just as we shall forever." 

Listening skeptically, the old man was surprised by her flawless recounting. She narrated the tales of the tribe's families, conflicts with neighboring clans, plagues, births, deaths, and rituals, matching each with its corresponding painting. She was proving to be an ideal storyteller.

"Generations ago, the sky shattered when our elders were but children," she continued, pointing to a section where everyday life was obscured by ash, almost obliterating the scenes beneath. "The sky spirit abandoned us, leaving only dreary clouds. The once-blue sky has vanished, and the sun's brilliance has dimmed." 

She went on to describe the struggles of rival tribes, the decline of wildlife, the scarcity of food plants, the harsh winters, and the spread of diseases. The old man observed her hand move over depictions of battles, sickness, and even cannibalism, realizing the weight of her responsibility to preserve these stories as the colors threatened to fade.

"Few children born among us survive to adulthood. A decade has passed since a child endured a winter, though many have been born. Restlessness grips the tribe, driving some to seek new lands," she stated, her hand indicating an expansive blank wall covered in soot from long-extinguished fires. "But in every direction, they find only ash. This land is ours, the domain of the People of the Red Cliff, where we persist."

Nodding in a rare display of approval, the old man placed a reassuring hand on the girl's shoulder and offered her a bowl of paint. Taking a handful of yellow paste, she smeared it beneath the handprints of countless shamans before her.

"You will pass on this story to your descendants," the old man declared with a mix of confidence and unease, sensing that she might be the last of her line. "And they will share it with their children," she concluded solemnly, completing the ritual. Perhaps she, too, harbored the same fears as the old man.

"Come," the old man broke the silence, "you must learn to create the paints." Together, they carried the light back towards the cave's entrance, slowly succumbing to the engulfing darkness, the legacy of humanity fading into obscurity.

The use of this technology in educational settings could greatly benefit students. For instance, it can detect when a student is confused, allowing them to receive additional help. If a student appears bored, the lesson plan can be adjusted to better engage them. Additionally, the technology can identify when a student is interested, confirming that the teaching approach is effective. Implementing this technology in schools would be highly advantageous.

Another valuable application in schools is identifying when a student becomes frustrated in class. This can alert teachers, enabling them to address the source of frustration or remove it. If a teacher is experiencing anger, the system could recommend a brief break to help them regain composure.

Managing frustration is crucial, as unchecked anger can lead to negative outcomes. This technology can be used to identify triggers and provide support to individuals to help them cope.

Furthermore, the technology can assist students aspiring to become therapists in learning to recognize subtle facial cues to understand emotions. Utilizing the Facial Action Coding System (FACS) to teach this skill is an ideal application. In a school scenario, the technology might detect bullying, indicated by a student's expression of fear around certain individuals. 据CNBC援引消息人士报道，SpaceX在新一轮融资中获得了8.5亿美元。融资后，该公司的估值将飙升至约740亿美元。

按照大多数标准，这是一轮大规模的融资，但对于SpaceX而言却并非如此。加上这笔最新注资，SpaceX自2002年成立以来已累计筹集超过60亿美元的资金，其中包括去年8月筹集的20亿美元风险投资（当时的投资估值为460亿美元）。两次融资的估值差异表明，至少在投资者看来，SpaceX的预期价值在半年内显著提升。

目前，SpaceX已取得多项瞩目成就，例如为Starlink项目发射了1000多颗卫星，通过龙飞船将NASA宇航员送往国际空间站，两次成功完成Starship飞船的高空飞行测试，以及单箭143星的超级“太空拼车”发射任务。这些成就吸引了大量潜在客户。

SpaceX最近的成功无疑为其拓展市场和获得更多投资奠定了良好基础。然而，对SpaceX来说，未来的使命依然艰巨，包括继续研发Starship以证明其在太空的价值，以及将Starlink建设为覆盖全球的网络提供商等等，这些目标依然任重而道远。

"Charlotte, have you seen the cat?" I called out as I walked down the hallway. We had adopted the cat from a shelter last week, and she was still quite shy.

"No, did you leave the backdoor open for the dogs?"

Oh no, I had forgotten. I groaned.

I hurried out to the back, calling for Astro, opened the gate to the alley, and walked across the wooded lot to the neighbors' house. We had been living here for almost two years and were on friendly terms with most neighbors. However, this particular house, a smallish gray Victorian with a wrap-around porch, always seemed quiet. Though lights were occasionally on at night, I had never seen any sign of activity. Situated as the last house before the lake, it was surrounded by more trees than the others. If I ever had a thought about it, I speculated it was inhabited by an elderly person who rarely left while I was at work.

I ventured through the little woods, calling out and making futile clicking sounds in hopes of attracting the cat’s attention. A meow echoed from the back, prompting me to press on. Despite feeling slightly uneasy about entering my neighbor's yard without permission, I couldn't risk losing the cat, or Charlotte would be furious.

I found the cat on the porch, but to my surprise, a woman was sitting there. She had black hair, blue eyes, and a distinctive chin. Dressed in a white top, linen shawl, and dark pants, she gazed at me inquisitively as I approached. Her expression seemed to convey a mix of assessment and amusement.

"Hi! I'm Peter from next door. Have you seen a cat around here? I apologize for intruding, but she's new to the neighborhood and I'm afraid she might get lost."

The woman continued to smile silently before pointing behind me. Turning around, I spotted Astro, transfixed by the woman. As I retrieved the cat, I turned back to thank her, only to find she had disappeared inside.

"Okay, nice to meet you," I muttered, realizing I had just encountered the mysterious neighbors.

Back in my house with Astro, I informed Charlotte of the incident. 

"I found the cat at the neighbor's house. There's a strange woman living there," I explained.

"Which neighbor?" Charlotte inquired.

"The one by the lake. We haven't met her before. She had black hair," I replied.

Charlotte seemed puzzled. "What are you talking about?
