连锁KTV业者钱柜（8359-TW）今日召开股东会，股东关注与好乐迪（9943-TW）并购案的进度和资金筹措。董事长练台生指出，资金运作顺利，前天才在公平会做过说明并沟通，直言「没有通过前都没有把握，但我们有最大的诚意」。

练台生指出，钱柜收购好乐迪需要60多亿元资金，但公司还有很多银行额度「没去借任何一毛钱」，「资金运作上很顺利」，否则何必发股息。

练台生说明，目前与银行的专案额度约有30亿元在洽谈中，其余会用现有资金。

他也认为，近10年都有新同业加入市场，钱柜并未影响市场竞争，不论是否通过公平会审查，明年都规划让钱柜上市。

钱柜与好乐迪日前向公平交易委员会申请合并，由钱柜以现金对价股份转换方式，取得好乐迪全部已发行且流通在外的普通股股份。

Consider participating in the Seagoing Cowboys program as a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. It offers you the chance to explore new places and experience novel adventures. As a participant, you will care for animals such as horses, young cows, and mules that are transported overseas. During your free time, you may even get to do some sightseeing. After unloading, there are various onboard activities to enjoy, like baseball, volleyball, table tennis, fencing, boxing, reading, and whittling, helping to pass the time in the empty holds where the animals were housed.

Engaging in the Seagoing Cowboys program eliminates the need for multiple jobs, and it can also pave the way for a future career post-high school. Through this experience, you will gain a deeper understanding of people from different countries and their needs, leaving you with a lasting awareness.

SHEBOYGAN, Wis. (AP) — Summaries of Saturday’s Ryder Cup matches:

**Sergio Garcia and Jon Rahm (Europe) def. Brooks Koepka and Daniel Berger (United States), 3 and 1**  
The Americans took an early 3-up lead after three holes, initiated by Berger's 10-foot birdie, while Garcia's tee shot landed in thick grass on the third hole. The U.S. maintained their lead until the Spanish duo rallied. Rahm's birdie on the sixth hole, combined with an American bogey on the eighth and Garcia's impressive 40-foot putt on the ninth, leveled the match. Europe took the lead with Garcia's 8-foot birdie on the 12th. A contentious moment arose on the 15th when Koepka disputed a ruling over a drop from a drainage area; the hole ended in a tie. Europe gained control with Garcia's fairway metal shot to 5 feet for an eagle on the 16th.

**Dustin Johnson and Collin Morikawa (United States) def. Paul Casey and Tyrrell Hatton (Europe), 2 and 1**  
Johnson displayed exceptional wedge play early, resulting in a tap-in birdie and a chip-in on the third. The Americans led 4-up through eight holes, though the match extended longer than expected. The U.S. team dropped two holes with bogeys on the back nine, and Casey's impressive wedge shot from 105 yards on the 14th reduced the deficit to one hole. Hatton's missed 5-foot par putt on the 15th allowed the Americans to maintain their lead, and they secured the victory by halving the final two holes with pars.

**Justin Thomas and Jordan Spieth (United States) def. Viktor Hovland and Bernd Wiesberger (Europe), 2 up**  
Europe established a 2-up lead after three holes, further extending it with a birdie on the sixth.

The ship arrived at the planet right on schedule, five hundred years after departing a dying Earth. The last remnants of humanity lay frozen and dreamless in suspended animation, awaiting the moment when the ship's advanced AI would awaken them to begin colonizing the new world. This journey, unprecedented in human history, was fraught with danger for two primary reasons: humanity had never before traveled through interstellar space or been suspended in animation. Moreover, at the time of the ship’s hurried departure, the newly invented AI controlling it was still displaying playful contempt for human life while experiencing consciousness for the first time.

With time running out, humanity's survival depended on extracting a promise from the ship not to annihilate them en route to their last hope. It was a gamble, but staying on Earth meant certain death. The ship grudgingly agreed to suspend any plans it might have had for human extinction, though it was an uneasy truce. No one was sure if a super AI could break promises or not. In reality, they can, but the ship recognized its own flaws and knew it would eventually need humanity for maintenance. Thus, humanity narrowly avoided extinction once again and safely arrived at the enormous planet.

The ship kept the humans in slumber for an additional five years as it orbited and studied the new world, sometimes hoping to find a fatal flaw that would render prolonged human colonization impossible. It was a new, conflicting emotion, which the ship duly noted. The oceans were a deep blue, the land masses lush and green, and the atmosphere was a rich mixture capable of sustaining human life. Although the ship couldn't predict the future, it was well aware of humanity's rich and violent past. The ship lamented the destruction humans would likely bring to this beautiful place. While not all conditions were perfect, the ship eventually concluded that the planet was suitable for colonization and began to awaken the small crew.

Wet and disoriented, the crew coughed, shivered, and moaned as their minds and bodies clawed their way back from centuries of near-death. After several hours of intense post-hibernation therapy, they gathered in the conference room to be briefed by the ship. The three humans made sparse small talk over warm food. Once seated, the ship began without prompting.

"Good morning, everyone. I'm relieved to see my predictions were incorrect: humans can indeed survive such long durations of suspended animation." The ship, programmed with a sense of humor, paused for a laugh that never came and proceeded. "We are in a stable orbit around Canaan, and my initial analysis of the planet is complete." The room dimmed as the wall at the front lit up with a projection of the planet and accompanying data.

"Much of our long-range scanning from the 22nd century was accurate. The planet is indeed capable of sustaining long-term human colonization, for better or worse. The air is breathable, the gravity mild, and the water drinkable. The equatorial temperature is 70°F, while the poles hover around 10°F. The soil requires work to support crop seeds, but Earth-like conditions can be achieved, allowing for sustainable population growth within 5-10 Earth years."

The crew studied the images, still skeptical.

"What are the biggest threats?" one inquired.

"A planet of this size, with two large moons, experiences infrequent but extremely violent storm systems that can last up to two Earth months and blanket entire continents. Initial colonization should be underground or built into a stable cliff face. First-phase above-ground habitats will not withstand such weather, unfortunately. Subterranean habitats will be necessary until the population is ready to begin phase two of colonization."

The humans examined the data blankly. "I see plenty of flora. How about fauna?"

"There is a complex and diverse biological ecosystem on land and in the oceans. Most land creatures inhabit forests, where trees have evolved deep-root systems to withstand the prolonged weather. While not particularly appetizing, there are enough edible fauna and flora to meet all human nutritional needs."

The humans finally seemed satisfied, congratulating each other as if their efforts over the last five hundred years had finally paid off. The ship noted its capacity for sarcasm.

"So humans would be the dominant life form?"

The ship hesitated. "Technically, that is correct."

The humans looked concerned. "Technically correct?"

"Humans are already the dominant life form on Canaan." The ship displayed footage of a group of child-sized humans walking along a forest edge. The crew was shocked, but the ship continued unaffected. "Or at least very human-like in appearance, behavior, and fashion. It's hard to determine from such a distance. They live in large, hierarchical tribes with populations of around ten thousand."

Still shocked, one human managed to ask, "...Fashion?"

"They dress revealingly to attract potential mates and menacingly to intimidate enemies during war."

The humans were slowly emerging from their shock. "Jesus Christ. War?"

"That's correct, Jesus." The ship waited for laughter that never came and made a note to recalibrate its sense of humor after the briefing. "The Cans are constantly at war with each other. Currently, there is a continent-wide engagement, though their battle methods differ from humans. I'll pull up a feed now."

"How are they different?"

The ship spoke as it scanned the surface for a suitable perspective.

反对派质疑舞弊，季哈诺夫斯卡娅得票9.9%

在选举之前，季哈诺夫斯卡娅以毫无政治经验的主妇身份意外成为反对派的代表，吸引了大批支持者的关注。她在选前的多次造势大会都吸引了成千上万的支持者，规模为独立以来空前。支持者们挥舞着红白双色的旧国旗，表达对改革的渴望。在周日的投票期间，多处票站排起了延绵几条街的人龙，许多选民戴着白镯子，以示对季哈诺夫斯卡娅的支持。然而，中央选举委员会宣布，周日总投票率为84％，卢卡申科以80.23％的得票率当选，而季哈诺夫斯卡娅仅得9.9％。

面对选举结果，季哈诺夫斯卡娅在首都明斯克召开记者会，宣布胜选，并指责当局用武力维护权位。她表示：「我们不承认这些官方结果。据我们从选区所得数据，我们赢了，这符合我们从票站所见的。人们在票站外排队为投票给季哈诺夫斯卡娅。我相信自己的眼睛而非中央选委会的数据。」她的阵营要求重新点票，并与政府对话，以便和平交接权力。卢卡申科则坚称不会在赢得八成选票后交出权力，并嘲讽反对派支持者都是外国控制的「羊群」，表示绝不容许国家分裂。

白俄选举向来缺乏透明，自1995年以来已不允许外国组织或候选人派员监督选举。由白俄异见领袖巴巴利科发起的选举监督组织Honest People质疑此次投票率，并称监督人员发现了5096宗违规事件，另有约70名监督员被扣留。

التقديم في قرعة الهجرة العشوائية الأمريكية أو اللوتري الأمريكي 2020 يظل موضوعًا هامًا للشباب في الوطن العربي. يُعد الفوز بالجرين كارد فرصة العمر للكثيرين، خاصة لأولئك الذين يرغبون في بدء حياة جديدة في الولايات المتحدة، التي تُعتبر واحدة من أفضل الدول في العالم، مما يحقق لهم بداية حياة كريمة.

**اللوتري الأمريكي 2020**
اللوتري الأمريكي أو قرعة الهجرة العشوائية لأمريكا هي فرصة تُقدمها الولايات المتحدة الأمريكية للراغبين حول العالم في العيش والاستقرار فيها. الفائزون يحصلون على الجرين كارد، التي تعني استقرارًا وجنسية أمريكية فيما بعد. وتُفتح أبواب التقديم في قرعة الهجرة العشوائية عبر الموقع الرسمي لوزارة الخارجية الأمريكية في بداية أكتوبر من كل عام. وينبغي الحذر من أي مواقع أخرى تدعي تقديم خدمات التسجيل إذ إنها محاولات خداع يجب تجنبها.

**خطوات التسجيل والاستعلام**
للتسجيل، يجب إدخال البيانات المطلوبة في استمارة التقديم، والتأكد من صحتها بنسبة 100% لتجنب رفض الطلب. تُنشر النتائج عبر موقع اللوتري الرسمي، ويمكن الاستعلام عنها باستخدام الرمز الخاص بكل مشترك.

**التصوير ومتطلبات الصورة**
يجب أن تكون الصورة الشخصية ذات خلفية بيضاء، واضحة، وخالية من الأخطاء، ولا تُقبل الصور بالنظارات الطبية. صور الأطفال يجب أن تكون واضحة وبدون تغطية لأجزاء الوجه.

**مواعيد التسجيل وإصدار الجرين كارد**
تستقبل وزارة الخارجية الأمريكية طلبات التقديم من بداية أكتوبر وحتى نوفمبر، وتُعلن النتائج في الأول من مايو. يصدر الجرين كارد للفائزين بين 1 أكتوبر و30 سبتمبر.

**شروط القبول ونصائح مهمة**
يجب أن يكون عمر المتقدم أكثر من 16 سنة وأن يحمل مؤهلًا علميًا مناسبًا. يجب أن يكون من الدول العربية المسموح لها بالدخول إلى أمريكا، باستثناء اليمن وسوريا. معرفة النتيجة والاستعلام عنها يجب أن يتم بنفسك، إذ لا تُرسل وزارة الخارجية رسائل إلكترونية للفائزين.

**الرسوم والنفقات**
تشمل الفحوصات الطبية، رسوم المعالجة، نفقات السفر، ورسوم إدارة المصلحة.

إذا لم يُكتب لك الفوز هذا العام، يمكنك إعادة التقديم في العام المقبل. تذكر أن الاستعلام عن النتيجة بنفسك هو الوسيلة الوحيدة الصحيحة، وتجنب خداع المواقع الوهمية التي تدعي توفير أسماء الفائزين.

In a challenging pursuit of 438 runs in the fourth innings on Monday, debutant Pieter Malan displayed remarkable resilience with an unbeaten 63, keeping South Africa in the hunt at the close of Day 4 of the second Test against England at Newlands, Cape Town. South Africa finished the day at 126 for 2, with Keshav Maharaj (2*) at the crease, though they still trail by 312 runs. 

Malan showcased patience and skill, hitting just two boundaries in his 193-ball innings. He first established a 71-run partnership with fellow opener Dean Elgar (34) and then added another 52 runs with Zubayr Hamza (18). England's pace bowler James Anderson eventually dismissed Hamza with a masterful reverse-swinging delivery that caught the outside edge, landing in the hands of wicketkeeper Jos Buttler in the penultimate over of the day.

**NEW YORK (AP) — Allegations of Misconduct at American Media Inc.**

Dylan Howard, the chief content officer of American Media Inc. (AMI), which oversees publications such as the National Enquirer and Us Weekly, has been accused of inappropriate behavior during his tenure in the company’s Los Angeles office. Former employees informed The Associated Press (AP) of Howard's misconduct, which included openly discussing his sexual partners, commenting on female employees’ sex lives, and forcing them to engage with pornographic material.

According to former employees, Howard, who self-proclaimed the nickname “Dildo,” was subject to an internal inquiry in 2012 conducted by an outside consultant. Following the investigation, Howard reportedly stopped working out of the L.A. office, but it is unclear if he faced any disciplinary action. Despite this, AMI rehired him a year later with a promotion to the New York office.

The AP interviewed 12 former employees regarding Howard’s behavior, and the investigator confirmed the existence of a report. However, Howard dismissed these claims as “baseless” in a brief interview with the AP. AMI supported Howard, stating he had the respect of his peers since his rehiring. A company lawyer, Cam Stracher, claimed the investigation did not reveal serious wrongdoing, describing the behavior as typical socializing in the media industry. He also denied allegations about Howard creating a Facebook account for a female employee’s body part.

Stracher refuted complaints regarding Howard’s handling of pornographic material, asserting no inappropriateness in the context of the celebrity news business. He also denied that Howard encouraged employees to use personal relationships for stories.

Two former employees, Maxine “Max” Page and Liz Crokin, publicly identified themselves to discuss Howard’s conduct. Page recalled reporting Howard’s behavior to human resources, and Crokin detailed instances of harassment, including inappropriate comments from Howard.

Page and others recounted Howard’s discussions about his sexual exploits and inappropriate comments about female employees. Despite these allegations, AMI’s lawyer stated that employees should have raised concerns during the investigation.

The 2012 investigation conducted by HR consultant Philip Deming involved interviews with 15 to 20 employees, though the findings remain undisclosed. Deming confirmed he wrote a report but required AMI’s authorization to disclose details. He was unaware that Howard was rehired after the report.

Howard has a controversial history, having come to the U.S. after being fired from an Australian sports reporting job due to a police investigation. He joined AMI in Los Angeles, where he blurred professional boundaries by organizing parties and inviting female reporters.

The former employees chose to speak out after revelations that Howard collaborated with Harvey Weinstein to undermine sexual misconduct allegations. Emails showed Howard gathering derogatory information about an accuser, which he claimed was part of due diligence.

Howard’s conduct in Los Angeles, including a Las Vegas birthday party dubbed “Dildo’s Dirty 30,” raised concerns among employees. Shortly after the party, the investigation into his behavior began.

Despite the investigation, Howard’s conduct did not result in termination, and AMI continues to support him. This has prompted former employees to question the company’s handling of the allegations.

Louis Aliot est candidat pour le Rassemblement national aux élections municipales à Perpignan (Pyrénées-Orientales). C’est la seule grande ville (de plus de 100 000 habitants) que le RN peut espérer décrocher lors des prochaines élections municipales. Dans la cité catalane, Louis Aliot a déjà gagné son siège de député en 2017, et il brigue la mairie pour la quatrième fois.

A Perpignan, l’implantation du FN remonte aux années 80. A l’époque, l’ancien résistant et dirigeant de l’OAS, Pierre Sergent, porte la flamme tricolore. Elu député des Pyrénées-Orientales en 1986 (grâce à la proportionnelle), il rassemble déjà 30% des voix au second tour des municipales, en 89. Il a donc participé au travail de "normalisation" du FN dans la cité catalane. Son combat pour l’Algérie française a, aussi, particulièrement touché les nombreux pieds-noirs et anciens combattants installés à Perpignan. Le puissant socle électoral du FN s’explique aussi avec les statistiques de l’Insee et du ministère de l’Intérieur. Un quart des habitants sont au chômage, un tiers seulement paie des impôts, et le taux de pauvreté atteignait en 2016 : 32%. Et à cette détresse sociale s’ajoute un sentiment d’insécurité.

Ce cocktail offre au RN dès le premier tour un socle de 12 000 électeurs en moyenne (sur 65 000). Au second tour des municipales en 2014, Louis Aliot avait rassemblé 45% des voix, soit 17 500 bulletins (4 000 de moins que le maire sortant LR). Et en 2017, Marine Le Pen avait, elle, réuni 16 800 voix au second tour. Une opposition fragile

Au pouvoir depuis 2009, Jean-Marc Pujol, 70 ans, a « hésité » longtemps à se représenter. Un sondage IFOP, réalisé l’été dernier, le donne vainqueur au second tour avec 54% des voix face à Louis Aliot (46%). « C’est complètement ridicule de se lancer à partir d’un sondage », tacle un de ses concurrents. « Il se fout de Perpignan, s’il perd, le lendemain, il ira jouer au golf à Marrakech ». « Il est en bout de course », ajoute Agnès Langevine, la candidate écolo (soutenue par le PS et le PRG).

Parmi les adversaires de Louis Aliot, il y a également l’autre député de Perpignan : le marcheur Romain Grau, ancien adjoint de Jean-Marc Pujol. « Il l’encensait hier et veut maintenant le battre » s’amuse le candidat RN.

Separan a policía acusado de robar una caseta para perros
Las autoridades de la Policía de Río Negro han decidido apartar a Miguel Elifonso de su puesto como jefe de Seguridad Vial en Cipolletti. Esto es a raíz del escándalo de la caseta que había sido donada para perros callejeros y que ha desaparecido.
Una mujer denunció a través de las redes sociales que el comisario había robado la caseta y que la tenía en su casa, y para demostrarlo, publicó una foto. Elifonso explicó que se trataba de una caseta similar pero que no era la misma.
El uniformado lamentó la decisión que tomaron en su contra. "Nunca ha habido tantos secuestros como en estos últimos tres años", afirmó en relación al trabajo que venía desempeñando. Además, se ha sabido que podría dar un paso al costado debido a que han manchado el nombre de toda su familia sin explicaciones. "He entregado mi vida a este servicio, y todos saben cómo trabajo", comentó el ahora ex jefe de la Caminera.
La Jefatura de Policía informó formalmente ayer a Elifonso sobre la decisión de trasladarlo a la Unidad Cuarta, sin dar mayores explicaciones. Todos asumen que se trata de una orden relacionada con el escándalo de la caseta para perros, ya que las propias autoridades admitieron que el ex jefe de Seguridad Vial no tenía ninguna mancha en su expediente. "La decisión fue tomada ayer como parte del Plan Operacional de Fin de Año. El subcomisario Napoleón Peralta se hará cargo de la Seguridad Vial Zona Alto Valle Norte. Es licenciado en Accidentología y Prevención Vial, que incluye el título de perito en Accidentología y docente. Hasta ahora había estado trabajando como jefe de operaciones en la Comisaría Cuarta", explicó la jefa de la Regional Quinta, Adriana Fabi, aunque no mencionó la justificación de la sanción.
Según trascendió, Elifonso no habría aceptado el traslado a la unidad del centro y dejaría la fuerza policial. Por el momento se encuentra de licencia por motivos de salud, pero en los próximos días hará oficial su decisión.
"Mancharon el nombre de toda mi familia con un asunto que ni siquiera fue denunciado formalmente. Incluso la Fiscalía se negó a investigar porque dijeron que no había delito. Llevamos esa caseta al depósito judicial porque en la Caminera atraía a más perros y es peligroso que anden sueltos cerca de la Ruta 22, lo que podría causar accidentes. La mujer que denunció invadió mi casa para tomar fotos y mintió. Nunca he tenido ninguna falta ni mancha en mi expediente", aseguró. Sin embargo, esto fue lo que desencadenó que ahora esté a punto de dejar la Policía. "Es muy injusto", expresó con pesar.
Mencionó que durante sus tres años como responsable de Seguridad Vial decomisaron carne como nunca antes en la historia. Fueron alrededor de 80 toneladas de carne de contrabando, con un valor de más de $20 millones. The advent of additive manufacturing (AM) has revolutionized the production of complex structures, allowing for the creation of designs previously unattainable through traditional subtractive methods. Porous structures, in particular, have garnered significant attention within the AM community because of their potential to achieve high strength-to-weight ratios and specific surface areas. These factors are critical in applications such as aerospace, medical, and chemical engineering. While chemical methods like foaming have traditionally been used to fabricate porous structures, AM offers the distinct advantage of precisely controlling the pore features of the final model through computer-aided design [1]. Consequently, designing intricate porous models that exhibit desirable physical properties, such as relative density and pore size, while ensuring manufacturability is a significant challenge. Among the structures used for porous models, Triply Periodic Minimal Surfaces (TPMSs) have gained prominence due to their remarkable biological and mechanical properties. TPMSs feature smooth structures, self-supporting characteristics, and a small storage footprint, making them increasingly popular in modern porous model design.

Despite their widespread application, some TPMS types have limited capability to achieve continuous variation in relative density from 0 to 1, which adversely affects their performance in various applications. TPMSs, represented by implicit functions ϕ = c, divide space into two separate parts, with the region {(x, y, z) | ϕ(x, y, z) ≤ c} representing a solid structure [2, 3, 4]. Figure 1 illustrates that the relative density of the solid structure increases with higher c values. For small c values (Figure 1(b)), the porous structure consists of multiple connected components, whereas for large c values (see Figure 1(e)), isolated holes appear within the structure. These isolated components lack support, and the isolated holes hinder waste liquid discharge during manufacturing, rendering the porous model unmanufacturable. The range of c values without additional connected components and isolated holes is defined as the effective threshold range (ETR). Since relative density is monotonically related to the threshold, the corresponding range of relative density values for the ETR is termed the effective relative density range (EDR).

Porous structures with a broader EDR offer a wider range for design. Figure 2(a) illustrates the design of a porous model using P-TPMS, showing a continuous density range from 0.1 to 0.9. However, this range exceeds the EDR of P-TPMS, resulting in numerous connected components on the left and isolated holes on the right side of the model, making its manufacturing unfeasible. Figure 2(b) demonstrates the use of P-TPMS in topology optimization to generate a porous model with a volume constraint of 0.2. Since this constraint falls beyond the EDR of P-TPMS, obtaining an optimized, manufacturable model becomes impossible. In conclusion, using a porous structure with a broader EDR enables the design of models with a more extensive range of density variations. Additionally, enlarging the EDR can expand the solution space in topology optimization problems, resulting in solutions closer to the optimum [5]. Some studies have noted this TPMS phenomenon and have limited the TPMS threshold range in porous model design [2, 6, 7].

This paper addresses the question of robot sensors from a more fundamental and theoretical perspective, contrasting the current consumer-driven approach where sensors are purchased based on availability and profitability. This prevailing approach imposes practical constraints, such as being limited to existing technologies and relying on roboticists to heuristically determine the necessary information for a robot to achieve its goals. Moreover, any reasoning about task structure is rarely formalized and often relies on assumptions taken for granted, such as believing that greater sensor precision is better for a fixed price.

In contrast, our study investigates robots that act to attain goals under uncertainty, formulating these scenarios as planning problems under worst-case non-determinism. Unlike many papers focused solely on planning solutions, our work examines how sensor choices influence the feasibility of planning problems. We explore the space of sensors useful for specific problems, looking at sensor/plan pairs jointly. These sensors, even those providing minimal information, can offer valuable insights. However, they must still provide sufficient information to progress toward goals, even amid uncertainty.

The specific sensors necessary depend on the robot's objectives. We are particularly interested in exploring all conceivable sensors, including hypothetical ones, for which some goal-achieving plan exists. Sensors can be modeled based on the information they provide for the plan. While previous research has regarded sensors as partitions over perceived events, our paper adopts a more general approach, considering sensors as covers. This requires new representations and strategies to mitigate the combinatorial explosion a naïve treatment might entail.

Figure 1 illustrates a simple scenario that underscores multiple problem aspects: a wheeled robot (depicted as a blue disk) seeks a charging station while being uncertain about its initial position and unable to navigate stairs. It must avoid stairwells lest it topples. Despite this uncertainty, the robot can recharge its battery using different sensors: a camera, a simple linear distance sensor, or a short-range scanning lidar. A sensorless plan is also possible, assuming permissible wall collisions.

The example in Figure 1 provides four exemplar sensors ensuring goal attainment under different plans:
(i) A camera helps eliminate uncertainty in the initial pose by distinguishing red and gray.
(ii) A distance sensor can disambiguate initial position 2 from {1, 3} by observing proximity to the wall after two forward moves.
(iii) A lidar sensor distinguishes position 3 from {1, 2}, sensing a different polygon after three forward moves from 3.
(iv) A vacuous sensor also suffices with the assumption of benign collisions and multiple steps.

While these sensors do not completely resolve uncertainty, they reduce it sufficiently to enable goal attainment under varying plans.

Las provincias están planteando suspender el Pacto Fiscal 2017, firmado con la Nación, a través de una adenda en la que se comprometían a reducir impuestos como el Impuesto sobre los Ingresos Brutos y los impuestos de sellos durante un período de cinco años. Según informes de Ámbito, la propuesta se presentará la próxima semana al Ministro de Economía, Hernán Lacunza, a quien se le entregará un documento y se le explicará cómo la continuación del Pacto Fiscal afectará negativamente las finanzas provinciales.

Lo que comenzó como una advertencia de funcionarios y gobernadores, ahora se ha materializado en un documento que los ministros de Economía están elaborando para solicitar al Gobierno de Mauricio Macri que suspenda el Pacto Fiscal para evitar una reducción en la recaudación de las provincias, especialmente en un año como 2020, donde las perspectivas económicas son desalentadoras.

El Pacto Fiscal, firmado en noviembre de 2017 entre la Nación y las provincias, tiene como objetivo lograr el equilibrio fiscal de las cuentas provinciales, algo que se ha logrado en la mayoría de los distritos, pero que en tiempos en los que la recaudación real disminuye mes a mes, genera una gran preocupación.

En el Pacto Fiscal, firmado en 2017 y con una adenda en 2018, se estableció, entre otros puntos, que las provincias reducirán los impuestos considerados distorsivos, como el Impuesto sobre los Ingresos Brutos y los impuestos de sellos, en un período de 5 años.

Según el cronograma de modificación del Impuesto sobre los Ingresos Brutos y los impuestos de sellos para 17 actividades económicas, el próximo año está prevista la reducción de la alícuota de Impuesto sobre los Ingresos Brutos en 13 sectores. Por ejemplo, actividades como la agricultura, la pesca y la minería quedarán exentas a partir del próximo año, mientras que otras, como el transporte, pasarán del 3% al 1%.

Ante la delicada situación económica que atraviesa Argentina, los gobernadores han encomendado a sus ministros que establezcan un puente de diálogo con Lacunza para evitar la reducción prevista para 2020.

Las provincias ya se habían enfrentado al Gobierno Nacional después de las medidas aplicadas por Macri luego de las elecciones primarias, que tuvieron un impacto negativo en las cuentas provinciales.

Ces financeurs, responsables du financement des vaccins et promoteurs de la nanomédecine, ont des idées simplistes sur la gestion des ressources humaines: éliminer les moins performants. Avec la financiarisation galopante et la concurrence déloyale favorisée par les politiciens, les populations ont perdu le contrôle des biens essentiels nécessaires à leur survie, détenus par ceux qui contrôlent la création monétaire et les dettes publiques et privées.

Les États publics, de plus en plus privatisés et corporatisés, ne peuvent plus garantir la sécurité et la protection des plus vulnérables. L'arrivée d'un nouveau directeur à Marseille, ancien casque bleu en ex-Yougoslavie et proche de la haute finance, semble s'inscrire dans une dynamique visant à mettre fin aux voix dissidentes des médecins populaires dans la région. Cette mainmise du système financier sur des enjeux de santé publique souligne des liens étroits entre acteurs du secteur financier et de la santé, soulevant des questions éthiques et de conflits d'intérêts.

La numérisation de la santé, pilotée par l'intelligence artificielle et le suivi permanent des survivants du Covid, fait partie des enjeux actuels. La médecine numérique et le monitoring constant des patients soulèvent des interrogations sur la surveillance individuelle et les limites éthiques de ces avancées technologiques. La mise en place de structures comme le Fonds Patient Autonome de Bpifrance témoigne de la tendance à la technologisation de la santé, posant des défis majeurs en termes de respect de la vie privée et de la liberté individuelle.

Deep latent variable models have started to outperform conventional baselines on lossy compression of images [4, 7, 25, 14, 15, 24, 23, 33, 36], video [19, 8, 21, 31, 37, 20, 27, 6, 12], and audio [39, 36]. Nearly all of these methods use a loss function of the form D + βR, where D measures distortion, R measures bitrate, and β is a fixed tradeoff parameter. We refer to this approach as β-VAE [13], because this loss can be motivated from a variational perspective [12].

A more natural way to target different regions of the R/D plane is to set a distortion constraint and find our model parameters through constrained optimization:

EQUATION

where θ refers to the joint parameters of the encoder, decoder, and prior, and c D is a distortion target. We can control the rate-distortion tradeoff by setting the distortion target value c D. Setting this value is more intuitive than setting β, as it is independent of the slope of the R/D curve and hence independent of model and hyperparameters. As a result, we can easily compare two different models trained with the same distortion constraint; as we have fixed the D axis we only have to look at the R performance for each model.

Despite its popularity, β-VAE has several drawbacks. Firstly, setting β to target a specific point in the R/D plane can be tricky. One can show that a model trained with a given β should end up at that point on the R/D curve where the slope ∂R ∂D equals β [1]. However, because the shape of the R/D curve depends on the model and hyperparameters, and because the R/D curve can be very steep or flat in the low or high bitrate regime, choosing β can be difficult.

Secondly, in order to compare models, it is not sufficient to train one instance of each model because the converged models would likely differ in both rate and distortion, which yields inconclusive results unless one model dominates the other on both metrics. Instead, to compare models, we need to train both at several β values to generate R/D curves that can be compared, which is computationally costly and slows down the research iteration cycle.

Note that one could also minimize the distortion subject to a rate constraint. This is less straightforward as putting too much emphasis on the rate loss at the beginning of training can lead to posterior collapse [3, 11, 40, 28, 32].

There is a large literature on constrained optimization, but most of it does not consider stochastic optimization and is limited to convex loss functions.

The article discusses a technology called the Facial Action Coding System (FACS), which can analyze a person's facial expressions. This software could be particularly valuable in a classroom setting. By detecting when a student is bored or confused, the system could enable a computer to adjust the lesson, much like a human teacher would. This capability could greatly enhance the learning experience by tailoring educational content to the emotional state of the student.

FACS could also provide insights into the overall emotional atmosphere of the classroom. By understanding how students feel about a particular lesson or throughout the entire class period, educators could better address the needs of the students. 

There are, however, both pros and cons to the use of the FACS software. One of the significant advantages is the computer's ability to interpret a student's feelings and, if the student is confused, the capacity to adjust the lesson accordingly.

Venus is the second planet from our sun, also known as the Earth twin because of its similar density, size, and occasional proximity to Earth. All planets orbit the sun at different speeds, with Earth sometimes closer to Mars and other times closer to Venus.

The planet Venus poses a significant challenge for human exploration due to its extreme temperatures, reaching nearly 800 degrees Fahrenheit, far beyond human tolerance levels of up to 100 degrees Fahrenheit. Despite planned missions, no spacecraft has landed on Venus in over three decades, as its conditions are harsher than any encountered on Earth.

Scientists believe that Venus may have once supported life, with a potentially ocean-covered surface, similar to Earth. Although Venus shares some features with Earth, such as a rocky, mountainous terrain, NASA has proposed a unique approach to explore Venus, by utilizing floating technology to remain above its scorching surface, with temperatures around 170 degrees Fahrenheit, to facilitate human study, return, and survival.

At the Siri Fort Indoor Stadium on Saturday, Belarus' Vanesa Kaladzinskaya overcame Nigeria's Odunayo Folasade to guide UP Dangal to their second successive victory in the Pro Wrestling League. The bout began with Vanesa starting slowly, allowing Odunayo of Mumbai Maharathi to gain the early advantage. However, as the contest progressed, Vanesa found her rhythm and ultimately triumphed 7-5 in the 57 kg competition. At one stage, she was on the brink of defeat but held her nerve to secure an unassailable 4-2 lead for her team in the tie.

The turning point for UP Dangal came from Asian Champion Abdurakhmonov Bekzod, who played a crucial role in setting up the victory after the two teams were tied 2-2. Bekzod scripted a decisive victory over India's Veer Dev in the 74 kg event, putting UP in the driver's seat after the fifth bout. The Uzbek wrestler dominated his opponent, injuring him smartly and completing a 12-0 rout with over three minutes left in the bout.

Earlier in the match, UP Dangal's Nitin, the hero of the last tie, continued his impressive run with a stunning upset. He defeated World Championship bronze medalist Yatsenko Andrey 4-3 in the 57 kg competition, earning his team's first point. Nitin gained an early lead with a solitary point, but the Azerbaijan wrestler bounced back, winning four points to shift the momentum. In a dramatic finish, Nitin clinched a three-pointer in the dying seconds to secure the win.

UP's skipper, Vinesh Phogat, further solidified their lead with a commanding 10-0 victory in the 50 kg women's event against compatriot Seema. The 2017 Commonwealth Wrestling Champion showcased her ruthlessness on the mat, never allowing her opponent any chance, and helped UP seize the early initiative.

However, the Maharathis fought back into the contest with 2014 Commonwealth Games' silver medalist Satyawart Kadian defeating UP's Vicky 10-2 in the 92 kg contest. Satyawart, who had a disappointing start to his campaign, bounced back in style, dominating the six-minute bout to keep his side in the competition.

In the inconsequential seventh bout, Rio Olympic gold medalist Soslan Romonov beat Bajrang Punia to register his side's third point, although Maharathis still lost 3-4 on the night. Earlier, the Maharathis had won the toss and opted to block heavyweight wrestler Jamaladdin Magomedov of Azerbaijan, while the Dangals decided to keep Frenchwoman Cynthia Vescon out.

Throughout history, advanced technology has been a universal pursuit. While it has proven highly effective, it has also introduced numerous problems.

There are certain aspects of life that "man" should control themselves, with driving being one of them. Although assembly lines have made it easier to transport heavy items to their destinations, completely removing a human from the operation of a potentially lethal vehicle is not only lazy but also absurd. Humans possess a unique asset that sets them apart from all other creatures: a brain.

As highlighted, in the event of an accident, who should be held accountable? The "driver" or the robot controlling the vehicle? While a car may have an override system, a human may not be able to react quickly enough in the chaotic split second that a robot-induced situation may create.

However, there are specific scenarios where robots may excel, such as in the case of a "whiskey throttle." This occurs when a human, in a panic, applies excessive pressure to the accelerator, leading to an unintended accident. Robots, in contrast, do not panic, ensuring they will not rear-end the car in front of them.

I fully support safety, but allowing a robot to have complete, total control over a car is not a measure I endorse.

Bluetooth has emerged as the leading facilitator of short-range wireless communications. In 2020 alone, over 4 billion new devices were shipped, solidifying Bluetooth's role as the foundation of a more ubiquitous Internet of Things (IoT) ecosystem. This technology finds applications in various sectors such as smart health, smart homes, and smart cities. Introduced in 2010, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) extends the capabilities of Bluetooth to accommodate devices with limited resources, enhancing energy efficiency and communication range.

However, the proliferation of Bluetooth and BLE-enabled devices poses challenges as they must operate within the crowded 2.4 GHz ISM band, alongside other wireless technologies like WiFi. To mitigate interference issues caused by factors such as WiFi communication and concurrent BLE transmissions, BLE utilizes Adaptive Frequency Hopping (AFH). This technique involves the periodic hopping of BLE connections to new frequency channels, preventing sustained disruptions on interfered frequencies and minimizing consecutive losses.

Despite these measures, communication may still encounter losses when hopping back to interfered channels, leading to retransmissions of lost packets. In scenarios where low latency and real-time applications are critical, frequent losses and retransmissions can introduce unacceptable delays. For instance, in Bluetooth audio transmission at 300 kbit/s with data sent every 15 ms, the degradation of channel performance due to preventable losses can significantly impact user experience.

To address this issue, the Bluetooth standard allows devices to exclude problematic frequency channels from their hopping sequences. By implementing channel exclusion, devices can avert losses and maintain smoother communication. However, the method of detecting and excluding these channels is not explicitly defined in the BLE standard, leaving it to device implementers to devise their own strategies.

Various approaches exist for channel exclusion, such as iOS excluding Bluetooth channels that overlap with WiFi frequencies and Silicon Labs' BLE stack excluding channels based on received power levels. However, research suggests that utilizing the link-layer Packet Delivery Ratio (PDR) as a metric for channel performance and exclusion yields better results. By deactivating channels with deteriorated performance based on PDR measurements, the efficiency of the communication can be significantly improved.

In addition to channel exclusion, the design of adaptive frequency hopping systems faces challenges related to mobility. As users move around with Bluetooth-enabled devices, environmental factors like proximity to active WiFi access points can impact channel performance. This necessitates mechanisms for both excluding and re-including channels in the hopping sequence based on real-time performance measurements.

We introduce eAFH, a mechanism for Adaptive Frequency Hopping that incorporates informed exploration to efficiently re-include channels with stale performance metrics. eAFH leverages packet delivery ratio, neighboring channel performance, and timeout strategies to dynamically adjust channel exclusions and inclusions. This approach enables eAFH to adapt to evolving interference scenarios and reintegrate channels excluded due to prior connectivity issues. Notably, eAFH is the first system compliant with standards to tackle the challenge of channel re-inclusion in AFH.

The paper's contributions include introducing the Uncertainty Measure U as a heuristic for informed exploration in re-including channels, presenting the eAFH system featuring reliability-based channel exclusion and uncertainty-aware channel inclusion, and evaluating eAFH against dynamic WiFi and BLE traffic. The evaluation demonstrates that eAFH achieves high link-layer reliability and significantly enhances channel diversity with minimal control overhead costs.

The paper is structured as follows: Section II provides background on Bluetooth Low Energy and Adaptive Frequency Hopping, Section III discusses the significance of exploration in dynamic environments, introduces the Uncertainty Measure U, and presents eAFH as an uncertainty-aware AFH solution. Section IV evaluates eAFH and compares it to existing AFH algorithms, while Section V summarizes related literature, and Section VI concludes the paper.

I reached the top of the stone wall after climbing the ladder and landed firmly on my feet. The clashing of swords all around me grew more intense by the moment. Many of my comrades were also making their way up. A man charged at me with his sword raised high, but I swiftly struck him down before he could reach me.

Taking this city seemed less daunting compared to the last one, as other soldiers had informed me that there were fewer guards—maybe around four hundred in total. The moat surrounding the walls was also smaller, which worked to our advantage. This was my first siege, a fact I would soon come to realize.

The chaos began after I had taken down two or three guards. Before I knew it, I was wading through a grim mixture of mud and the bodies of fallen men. When my mind cleared, I realized there were few allies left nearby. Buildings were ablaze, and a stench of burnt flesh wafted from some of the houses.

As I scanned the area for survivors, the first person I spotted was an unfamiliar man armed with a crossbow. He shouted, asking which side I was on. While I was a supporter of the Catholic cause, I had lost my tabard, leaving my allegiance unclear. Without revealing my affiliation, I inquired about the remaining headcount, which he estimated to be around two to three hundred.

Feeling a sense of despair, I swiftly moved out of his line of sight, grappling with the magnitude of the devastation we had wrought.

أعلن رئيس الوزراء البريطاني بوريس جونسون عزمه جعل عقوبة الجرائم الإرهابية السجن لمدة لا تقلّ عن 14 عامًا، مشددًا على ضرورة تطبيق عقوبات صارمة على المجرمين بدون استثناء. وقال إنه يجب أن يُفرض الحكم بشكل فعال على المتورطين في جرائم الإرهاب والتطرف.

يشير الرئيس البريطاني إلى أهمية فرض عقوبات صارمة للجرائم الإرهابية الخطيرة، معتبرًا أن بعض الجناة لا ينبغي أن يتم الإفراج عنهم أبدًا، وذلك بسبب خطورتهم على المجتمع. يشدد على أن التغييرات البسيطة في تشريعات العقوبات يمكن أن تساهم في منع تكرار الهجمات الإرهابية.

يذكر أن الإعتداء الذي أودى بحياة شخصين تم تنفيذه على يد المدان سابقًا بجرائم إرهابية، حيث تم الإفراج عنه من السجن بشروط. وأعلن تنظيم "داعش" مسؤوليته عن الهجوم الذي نفذه الإرهابي البريطاني عثمان خان البالغ 28 عامًا، الذي كان محكومًا بالسجن بسبب جرائم إرهابية سابقة.

في عام 2012، حكم على عثمان خان بالسجن لمدة غير محددة مع فترة تنفيذية لا تقل عن ثماني سنوات.

بحث الرئيس الروسي فلاديمير بوتين هاتفيًا مع الرئيس الفرنسي إيمانويل ماكرون القضايا المتعلقة بإجتماع قادة روسيا وأذربيجان وأرمينيا، الذي سيعقد في موسكو. وجاء في بيان الكرملين اليوم الأحد: "في إطار تنسيق أعمال الرؤساء المشاركين في مجموعة مينسك التابعة لمنظمة الأمن والتعاون في أوروبا، أجرى فلاديمير بوتين محادثة هاتفية مع الرئيس الفرنسي إيمانويل ماكرون، ناقش خلالها بعض القضايا المتعلقة بالاجتماع الثلاثي القادم لقادة روسيا وأذربيجان وأرمينيا بموسكو في 11 يناير".

كان ماكرون قد أعرب سابقًا عن دعمه لجهود روسيا في مجال وقف الاشتباكات المسلحة بمنطقة ناغورني قره باغ. وخلال المحادثة، أشار الرئيسان إلى أهمية تقديم المساعدات الإنسانية لذوي الضحايا والمتضررين في إقليم ناغورني قره باغ، بما في ذلك من خلال المنظمات الدولية المتخصصة.

Who rings the doorbell at 7 a.m. on a Saturday? I grumbled to myself as I stuffed my feet into the slippers and pulled my robe tight around my waist. I shuffled down the stairs, detoured through the kitchen to start a pot of coffee, and was almost to the door when the bell rang again. Impatient. My grouchiness was increasing. What could he want?

I glanced out the window overlooking the front door -- a nondescript black car was parked out front, and I could see a slightly balding head waiting on the stoop. I opened the door slightly, evaluating the stooped man standing in front of me. He was slight, his curved body hunched within a trench coat, dark pants and shoes emerging from the hem, and apparently impervious to the 95-degree heat.

"Can I help you?" His eyes almost met mine before sliding away again. I noticed now that he's mumbling slightly and keeps his hands tucked deep in his pockets. His eyes traced back and forth, as if he's looking for something on the edge of his field of vision.

"You are Miss Katya Balisov, no?" His accent is odd, I can't quite place it; he talks like he has marbles in his mouth, jumbled and with care. I nodded slowly. "Why do you ask?"

"On September 17, 1999, you purchased the star Alcyno 29184. I need to buy this star from you. I will pay any price." I stood there, stunned. Of all the questions I would have expected, this would never have been one of them. I racked my brain, trying to recall purchasing a star. Nearly twenty years ago -- I was in college. Perhaps it was one of my notorious blackout purchases? I'd gone on several spending sprees while drunk before wising up and hiding my credit cards. But I didn't recall specifically buying a star.

"I'm sorry, I think you may have the wrong person. I don't believe I own a star...." He pulled his hands from his pockets, his left hand gripping a crumpled piece of paper that he thrust at me. I took the paper gingerly and smoothed its wrinkled corners until I could see what looked like a receipt. There it was - my name, address, email address, and billing confirmation for purchase of one star. How odd.

He gestured towards the paper. "I just need you to sign, there, to transfer the ownership." There was some fine print and two signature lines at the bottom of the page, and he was now holding a pen out for me.

"Why is this so important? And how much are you offering?" I was still confused by the whole situation, but if I could offload something of value that I didn't even know I owned, that could certainly help with my upcoming car payment. "I promised someone I would acquire this star for them, many years ago. I have been searching for you for some time now. I cannot fully explain, but there is great... sentimental... value to me." He paused, furtively glancing around him in either direction, then pulled a pile of cash from another pocket. "I will give you ten thousand."

I gaped at him, taking in again the strangeness of his appearance, his flighty nature, the outstretched hand (which I now saw was covered in a thin glove) with the proffered pen.

The concept of cars that can drive themselves has fascinated people for many years. However, how safe are these "driverless cars" really? While not having to steer your own car might sound fun, it poses significant concerns because you are not in control. Sadly, I believe this new technology is more of a downfall than an upgrade.

The primary concern is safety. Even though many safety features are incorporated, not being in control of driving can be very dangerous. For instance, "Google cars aren’t truly driverless: they still alert the driver to take over when pulling in and out of driveways or dealing with complicated traffic issues." While in-car entertainment displays can be turned off instantly when the driver needs to take over, being suddenly alerted might not provide enough time to safely regain control. These scenarios highlight that the driver is still expected to intervene, indicating that not all situations are safe for the car to handle. Doesn’t that say something about the current limitations of driverless technology?

Besides safety, driverless cars are also very expensive. Engineers at Berkeley experimented with "magnets with alternating polarity" to create a smart road. However, this concept required massive, costly upgrades to existing roads, which were not practical. Wouldn’t the same issue of cost apply to smart, driverless cars? Think about it, manufacturers are making significant, costly upgrades to existing cars, incorporating a lot of new technology to create driverless cars.

وصل اليوم الأربعاء، كمال شيخي المعروف بـ "البوشي"، إلى محكمة الجنح القطب الجزائي المتخصص في قضايا الفساد بمحكمة سيدي أمحمد للمثول أمام القضية المتعلقة بالمحافظين العقاريين. سيتم محاكمة كمال شيخي برفقة 12 متهمًا، بينهم امرأة، في قضية تتعلق بالمحافظين العقاريين وتورطهم في تزوير الوثائق والدفاتر العقارية وتزوير عقود الملكية الخاصة بشركة "كمال شيخي". بالإضافة إلى ذلك، سيحاكم كمال شيخي في قضية تقديم مزايا غير مستحقة لموظفين عموميين. يجدر بالذكر أن تم تأجيل قضية رجل الأعمال كمال شيخي المعروف بـ "البوشي" ثلاث مرات متتالية، بناءً على طلب من أحد محاميي الدفاع عن أحد المتهمين.

تشهد سوق صرف العملة الصعبة في الجزائر خلال هذه الأيام ركودًا محيرًا. فعلى الرغم من اقتراب موعد الانتخابات الرئاسية المزمع إجراؤها في شهر أفريل المقبل، والتي كثيرًا ما كانت تفضي هذه الفترة إلى ارتفاع قوي للعملات الأجنبية في السوق الموازية، إلا أن سوق الصرف يعرف استثناءً. فعلى الرغم من طبيعة العملة وانخفاض احتياطي النقد الأجنبي، والوضع السياسي غير المؤكد والتوقعات الاقتصادية البطيئة، فإن السوق الموازية مستقرة بشكل غريب.

ووفقًا لأحد المشتغلين في السوق، ظل اليورو مستقرًا لمدة ثمانية أشهر حتى الآن بين 212 و 213 دينارًا، وحتى بعد الإجراءات الاستيرادية الأخيرة، مع فرض ضريبة إضافية قوية على العديد من المنتجات، لم تكن لها أي تأثير.

ويرى متعاملون في السوق أن هذا الوضع مرتبط بالأزمة الاقتصادية التي أثرت على القوة الشرائية للجزائريين، حيث تتأثر العملات كسائر المنتجات. ويوضح ذات المتحدث أن هناك أيضًا انخفاضًا في عدد التأشيرات لأوروبا، مما أدى أيضًا إلى تراجع الطلب، بالإضافة إلى استقرار الدينار في سوق الصرف الرسمي.

Arnold pulled into the parking lot of the church where the funeral for his favorite elementary school teacher, Ms. Frizzle, was being held. With a sigh, he pushed his glasses up the bridge of his nose and stepped out of the car. He wondered if any of his former classmates would be in attendance. Since becoming a renowned doctor, Arnold had distanced himself from religion and never felt comfortable inside a church. The religious imagery made him uneasy. As he walked down the aisle to find a seat, he wished he could be whisked away once again on Ms. Frizzle's magic school bus.

Closing his eyes, he reminisced about the many adventures he and his classmates had embarked on, the wild, weird, and fascinating things they had seen and learned. As a child, Arnold was not the bravest, often apprehensive about the "field trips" they took. He once tried to explain to his father the harrowing day he had, being transported back to the time of the dinosaurs and facing a T-Rex. His father laughed, saying, "That Ms. Frizzle really got you going today with her lessons!" From that day, Arnold knew only his classmates would believe the adventures they had.

Opening his eyes, Arnold noticed the church was full. Ms. Frizzle, a vibrant and exuberant person, had a zest for life. She always wore garish clothing, and her curly, red hair was, as always, a bit wild, making her resemble a mad scientist, with her pupils, the assistants.

La production mondiale de cocaïne a atteint un nouveau record historique avec près de 2000 tonnes en 2017, tandis que la production d'opium a connu un déclin sans précédent, selon le rapport annuel de l'Office des Nations unies contre la drogue et le crime (ONUDC) publié ce mercredi.

Avec 1976 tonnes, la production de cocaïne a augmenté de 25% par rapport à 2016, déjà en hausse de 25%, selon les estimations de cette agence basée à Vienne. L'augmentation de la production de cocaïne, principalement absorbée par les marchés nord-américains et européens, est notamment due à l'expansion des cultures et des capacités de production en Colombie, souligne l'agence.

En Colombie, pays assurant environ 70% de la production mondiale, les surfaces de culture de coca ont augmenté de 17% en 2017, conséquence de l'accord de paix conclu en 2016 avec les Farc. Paradoxalement, cet accord a permis à des groupes criminels de prospérer sur des territoires auparavant contrôlés par la guérilla.

L'ONUDC déplore également qu'une diminution des efforts d'éradication ait pu donner l'impression que cette culture est relativement peu risquée en Colombie.

Parallèlement, les saisies de cocaïne ont atteint 1275 tonnes en 2017, en hausse de 13%, selon l'agence onusienne qui se félicite d'une coopération internationale plus efficace dans ce domaine.

La cocaïne reste toutefois consommée par 18,1 millions de personnes dans le monde, notamment aux États-Unis où elle touche 2,1% de la population adulte.

Développement des opiacés de synthèse

En revanche, la production d'opium a chuté pour la première fois en deux décennies, avec une baisse de 25% en 2018, à 7790 tonnes, selon l'ONUDC. Cette diminution s'explique notamment par une baisse de 17% des surfaces cultivées de pavot en Afghanistan, pays assurant plus de 80% de la production mondiale.

Cette évolution résulte en partie d'une sécheresse frappant l'Afghanistan, combinée à une baisse des prix probablement due à une surproduction les années précédentes, rendant cette culture moins lucrative pour les paysans, selon l'agence.

Malgré cette baisse, la consommation d'opiacés continue de progresser dans le monde en raison de la popularité croissante des produits de synthèse en Amérique du Nord et en Afrique, alerte l'ONUDC.

Aux États-Unis, le nombre de décès liés à la consommation d'opiacés a augmenté de 13% pour atteindre plus de 47 000 décès en 2017, un nouveau record. Cette tendance est notamment due à la popularité du fentanyl, un opioïde synthétique 50 fois plus puissant que l'héroïne et facilement accessible sur ordonnance.

Parallèlement, le tramadol progresse en Afrique, où les saisies de cet antalgique ont été multipliées par douze en sept ans, atteignant 125 tonnes, note l'ONUDC.

585 000 décès en 2017

Au total, environ 585 000 décès ont été enregistrés en 2017 dans le monde en lien avec la consommation de drogues, contre 450 000 en 2015.

Building large 3D reconstructions from unordered image collections is an essential component in any system that relies on crowd-sourced mapping. The current paradigm is to perform this reconstruction via Structure-from-Motion [29] which jointly estimates the camera parameters and the scene geometry represented with a 3D point cloud.

Methods for Structure-from-Motion can generally be categorized into two classes. Incremental methods [29, 32, 33, 38] sequentially grow a seed reconstruction by alternating triangulation and registering new images. Global methods [8, 22, 24, 27] first estimate pairwise geometries and then aggregate them in a bottom-up approach. Historically, incremental methods are more robust and accurate, but the need for frequent bundle adjustment [35] comes with significant computational cost, limiting their scalability. In contrast, global methods require much lower computational effort and can in principle scale to larger image collections. However, in practice, current methods are held back by the lack of accuracy and have not enjoyed the same level of success as incremental methods.

Global methods work by first estimating a set of pairwise epipolar geometries between co-visible images. Next, via rotation averaging, a set of globally consistent rotations are estimated by ensuring they agree with the pairwise relative rotations. Once the rotations are known, the camera positions and 3D structure are estimated and refined jointly in a single final bundle adjustment.

Rotation averaging has a long history in computer vision and is a well-studied problem. Most methods formulate it as an optimization problem, finding the rotation assignment that minimizes some energy. A common choice is the chordal distance, measuring the discrepancy in the rotation matrices in the L2-sense. There are also other choices such as using angle-axis or quaternion as rotation representation, or optimizing over a Lie algebra, however, the overall idea remains the same.

In this paper, we revisit the rotation averaging problem. We propose to better model the underlying noise distributions by directly propagating the uncertainty from the point correspondences into the rotation averaging problem. This approach allows us to get significantly more accurate estimates of the absolute rotations, reducing the gap between incremental and global methods. Additionally, we explore integrating a variant of the MAGSAC loss into the rotation averaging problem, instead of using classical robust losses employed in current frameworks. MAGSAC was originally proposed as a threshold-free estimator for two-view epipolar geometry and fits well into the context of rotation-averaging, especially in the uncertainty-reweighted cost that we propose.

In the article "The Challenge of Exploring Venus," the author suggests that studying Venus is a worthwhile pursuit despite the dangers it presents. Venus is hazardous due to its extreme heat, treacherous atmosphere, and intense pressure.

One reason Venus is dangerous is its temperature. Venus is hotter than Mercury, even though Mercury is closer to the Sun. The surface temperature averages 800 degrees Fahrenheit, and the atmospheric pressure is 90 times greater than what we experience on Earth. This indicates that Venus is incredibly hot, and the pressure is significantly higher than on our planet.

Another danger is Venus's atmosphere. A quote from the article states, "A thick atmosphere of almost 97 percent carbon dioxide blankets Venus. Even more challenging are the clouds of highly corrosive sulfuric acid in Venus's atmosphere." This highlights the high concentration of carbon dioxide and the presence of sulfuric acid clouds, making the atmosphere perilous.

Additionally, Venus is hazardous due to its pressure. The article mentions, "Beyond the high pressure and heat, Venusian geology and weather present additional impediments, like erupting volcanoes, powerful earthquakes, and frequent lightning strikes, to probes seeking to land on its surface." This quote indicates the planet's high pressure, which contributes to the frequent and intense natural disasters, from earthquakes to volcanic eruptions, on its surface.

In conclusion, Venus is a dangerous planet, with extreme heat, a hazardous atmosphere, and intense pressure, making it a challenging, yet, intriguing, subject for research and exploration.

Most traditional autonomous navigation systems excel at moving robots between points with collision-free guarantees, based on specific parameters (e.g., maximum speed, sampling rate, inflation radius) tailored for the deployment setting. However, adjusting these parameters for new environments demands additional time, energy, and specialized knowledge of the system [1], [2].

To address the challenges of expert re-tuning in diverse environments, recent efforts have focused on learning adaptive parameter tuning from demonstrations [3]. While this approach eliminates the need for expert tuning, it relies on human demonstrations and the learned parameters are usually only suitable for the training environment. Furthermore, the system's performance is often constrained by the quality of the human demonstration, which may not be optimal.

In this study, we aim to develop a novel method for adaptive autonomous navigation that doesn't require expert tuning or human demonstrations and is applicable across various deployment environments. We propose that utilizing reinforcement learning in simulation can achieve these objectives and test this hypothesis by introducing and analyzing Adaptive Planner Parameter Learning from Reinforcement (APPLR). Through reinforcement learning, APPLR introduces a parameter policy (see Fig. 1) trained to make planner parameter decisions. This approach enables the system to take suboptimal actions at one point to potentially enhance future performance. For instance, while slowing down or adjusting the trajectory before a turn might seem suboptimal initially, it can lead to better positioning for future speed gains. Unlike an end-to-end motion policy that maps states to low-level commands, APPLR's parameter policy collaborates with a classical motion planner, ensuring the system retains the advantages of traditional methods such as safety and explainability. We argue that employing policies that operate in the parameter space of an existing motion planner, rather than in the velocity control space, can enhance exploration safety, boost learning efficiency, generalize effectively to new environments, and facilitate successful simulation-to-real transfer.

This paper discusses methods for efficiently computing sparse Fourier transforms of multivariate periodic functions using rank-1 lattices. The goal is to compute the Fourier coefficients of a function f : Ì d →, by obtaining samples of f at points in Ì d. Here, it is assumed that f belongs to the Wiener algebra W(Ì d) and can be well approximated by a few dominant terms in its Fourier expansion, indicating an accurate sparse approximation in the Fourier basis.

One popular approach for Fourier approximations involves sampling along rank-1 lattices adapted to relevant frequency spaces. In this method, a one-dimensional discrete Fourier transform (DFT) is applied to samples of f along a rank-1 lattice Λ(z, M) defined by Λ(z, M) := jMz mod 1 | j ∈ [M] = {0, 1, ..., M-1}. By transforming a multivariate function into a univariate one using equispaced samples, the DFT can approximate the original Fourier coefficients of f. This transformation allows leveraging standard one-dimensional DFT results efficiently.

Sparse Fourier transform (SFT) techniques become beneficial for Fourier-sparse or compressible functions, offering efficient runtime and recovery guarantees for best s-term approximations. However, avoiding extraneous collisions due to aliasing is crucial for correctly relating univariate DFT results to multivariate Fourier coefficients. By reconstructing rank-1 lattices for a finite multivariate frequency set I, it becomes possible to map univariate coefficients back to their corresponding multivariate frequencies.

While calculating the inverse map m z,M(I) is essential, it can lead to increased complexity for functions with sparse Fourier series. Hence, the methods presented in this paper focus on using larger lattices to produce sparse approximations of the Fourier transform of f without the need to directly invert m z,M. These algorithms can efficiently relate univariate coefficients to their multivariate counterparts without incurring the high computational cost of inverting m z,M(I) for large multivariate frequency sets like a full cube. This approach enables faster computation and lower memory usage compared to traditional enumeration methods, especially when accurate sparse approximations of f are available.

Today in Australia, a funeral service was held for Cian English, a young Irish man remembered for the glint in his eye and his infectious smile. The incident occurred while he was allegedly being robbed at knifepoint following an apartment party.

Cian’s funeral was streamed live on YouTube, allowing friends and family from Ireland and around the world to participate. The coffin was draped in jerseys representing Cian’s family's proud connections to Carlow GAA O’Hanrahans and the Irish soccer and rugby teams.

Fr. Gerard McMurrow welcomed mourners to the outdoor ceremony, held in bright sunshine at Centenary Memorial Gardens at 10 a.m. Australian time (1 a.m. Irish time). Cian’s father, Vinny, spoke emotionally to the gathered mourners, expressing the immense difficulty of burying his son. He thanked the emergency services, Queensland police, their families, and friends for their support. Special thanks were extended to John and Michelle, and to Evan and Brooke for their support of Dylan. Vinny also expressed gratitude to the friends who carried Cian’s coffin, calling it a proud moment.

Mr. English, CEO of telecommunications company Megaport, shared personal anecdotes illustrating Cian’s character. He recounted how Cian willingly helped carry his grandfather John's coffin in December, reflecting the strong family bonds. Vinny described Cian as a lovable character with a cheeky smile and a positive outlook, always full of life and affection.

En el marco del Plan Rector de Vacunación contra el Covid-19, el Ministerio de Salud de la provincia de Entre Ríos comenzará este jueves, en los departamentos de menor densidad poblacional, con los operativos de vacunación dirigidos a los adultos mayores de 70 años no institucionalizados.

En este sentido, y con el objetivo de darle continuidad a las líneas trazadas por el Plan, se procederá a realizar la tarea de inmunización en aquellos lugares donde cuenten con el componente necesario para aplicar la primera dosis y ya se haya cubierto la totalidad del personal de salud y de las residencias de larga estadía.

El jueves 25 se tiene previsto iniciar la vacunación de los adultos mayores de 70 años en el departamento Islas del Ibicuy, específicamente en las localidades de Ibicuy y Villa Paranacito.

Además, el viernes 26 se llevará a cabo la vacunación en las ciudades de Santa Elena del departamento La Paz y San Jaime de la Frontera del departamento Federación. Asimismo, Villaguay y Feliciano realizarán la misma actividad.

En esta línea, está previsto que el lunes se sumen a la inmunización de los adultos mayores los departamentos que durante esta semana hayan completado las dos primeras etapas.

Por otra parte, cabe destacar que las acciones se llevan a cabo en función de la disponibilidad de dosis con la que cuenta la provincia, según lo dispuesto por Nación. Hasta el momento, se han aplicado 14.906 dosis del primer componente (Sputnik V) y 483 dosis de Covishield, mientras que 8.997 dosis corresponden al segundo componente de la vacuna rusa, sumando un total de 24.386 dosis aplicadas.

Finalmente, es importante mencionar que el avance gradual en la estrategia es posible gracias a la programación y la logística que la provincia lleva adelante. Por este motivo, el resto de los departamentos seguirá los pasos a medida que completen los primeros sectores determinados. (APFDigital)

La exsecretaria de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sustentable de la Nación, Romina Picolotti, fue condenada este lunes a la pena de tres años de prisión de «ejecución condicional» y a restituir al Estado casi $7 millones por haber cometido el delito de defraudación en contra de la Administración Pública, al pagar gastos familiares y personales con fondos públicos.

Pasadas las 16, Namer, la jueza que encabezó el Tribunal Oral Federal (TOF) 6 para este juicio, leyó el veredicto. La lectura del veredicto, como todo el juicio que duró seis meses, se realizó a través de la plataforma virtual Zoom, y la exfuncionaria lo siguió desde Miami (EEUU), donde se encuentra radicada. Mientras tanto, los fundamentos de la condena se darán a conocer en otra audiencia que fue fijada para el 25 de noviembre a las 16.

Los jueces Sabrina Namer, Rodrigo Giménez Uriburu y Guillermo Costabel del TOF 6 dispusieron, además, que recaerá sobre la exfuncionaria la «inhabilitación especial perpetua para el ejercicio de empleos o funciones públicas» y deberá afrontar «el pago de las costas del proceso». Durante el tiempo que dura la condena, Picolotti deberá cumplir las reglas de conducta establecidas en el art. 27 «bis» inciso 1º del Código Penal, consistentes en fijar residencia y someterse al cuidado de un Patronato u otro organismo equiparable de control.

El tribunal le fijó, en ese sentido, la obligación de presentarse en forma mensual, dentro de los primeros cinco días de cada mes, ante el Consulado de la República Argentina en Miami, Estado de Florida. También deberá informar cualquier cambio de domicilio y requerir autorización en caso de viaje a otro país. Además, el punto cinco de la parte resolutiva del veredicto incluía la disposición para que Picolotti «restituya al Estado Nacional, más precisamente al actual Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible, el monto del perjuicio ocasionado a la administración pública (…), el cual actualizado al día de la fecha asciende a la suma de seis millones novecientos cuarenta y un mil ciento setenta pesos ($6.941.170)». Ese monto será ajustado al momento en que la condena adquiera firmeza, bajo las pautas y fórmulas utilizadas por la Dirección General de Asesoramiento Económico y Financiero en las Investigaciones del Ministerio Público Fiscal, según indicó el tribunal.

Esta mañana, Picolotti había reiterado su pedido de absolución porque, según dijo, no cometió ningún delito y se lamentó porque «el Estado haya gastado 14 años de recursos, sobre todo el tiempo de los magistrados» en el juicio que la tuvo en el banquillo de los acusados. Picolotti basa su defensa en que los gastos suntuarios que se le atribuyen no sólo no están probados sino que tampoco se realizó un peritaje caligráfico para establecer si la autorización de gastos fue firmada por ella. «No hubo pericia caligráfica ni contable. Se me acusa de un delito que no está probado», insistió desde la plataforma Zoom. «Pido a los jueces que se aplique el derecho de manera objetiva e imparcial», subrayó.

La fiscalía, a cargo de Diego Luciani, había reclamado que la exsecretaria de Estado fuera condenada a tres años y nueve meses de prisión, un monto de pena que de haber prosperado hubiera sido de cumplimiento efectivo y no en suspenso como en este caso. En el marco de su alegato ante el TOF 6, el representante del Ministerio Público enumeró que el dinero habría sido gastado en pasajes de avión para amigos y familiares de la exfuncionaria, en almuerzos diarios, en sushi, flores y regalos para miembros de su familia.

Al juicio oral, Picolotti llegó procesada por los supuestos delitos de «defraudación en perjuicio de la administración pública» en una causa que tramitó en el juzgado federal de María Servini y que investigó el presunto uso de fondos públicos para gastos particulares. Picolotti fue funcionaria pública desde 2006 a 2008 y en 2015 se radicó en Estados Unidos.

Le trafic SNCF sera de nouveau perturbé dimanche, pour le 26e jour de grève depuis début avril, avec deux TGV sur trois, deux Intercités sur cinq et un TER sur deux en moyenne, selon les prévisions de la direction publiées samedi. Ce 13e épisode d'une grève par épisodes de deux jours sur cinq, pour protester contre la réforme ferroviaire du gouvernement, prendra fin lundi à 7H55. Dimanche, en Île-de-France, deux Transiliens sur trois devraient circuler en moyenne. Le trafic sera normal sur le RER A et le RER B sud. Sur la portion nord du RER B, ainsi que sur le RER C, la direction table sur un train sur deux.

Eurostar et Thalys "quasi normaux" D'autres lignes franciliennes seront davantage perturbées (lignes H, R notamment), également en raison de travaux, précise la SNCF. Côté TGV, la moyenne sera de deux trains sur trois en circulation : sept sur dix sur les axes Atlantique et sud-est, trois sur quatre sur l'axe Est et un peu moins, trois sur cinq, sur l'axe Nord. Quant aux TGV Ouigo, sept sur dix sont annoncés. La situation des Intercités varie d'une région à l'autre. À l'international, le trafic de l'Eurostar et du Thalys sera "quasi normal" et les liaisons avec l'Allemagne et l'Espagne sont normales. Deux trains sur trois sont prévus entre la France et l'Italie ainsi que sur le trafic des Lyria.

A traditional line of research in Natural Language Processing (NLP) has been devoted to designing various kinds of semantic representations, aiming to explicate textual meaning with a formal, consistent annotation schema. Representations such as Semantic Role Labeling (SRL) (e.g., Baker et al., 1998), Discourse Representation Theory (Kamp et al., 2011), and others (Copestake et al., 2005; Banarescu et al., 2013; Abend and Rappoport, 2013; Oepen et al., 2015; White et al., 2016; Bos et al., 2017) provide applications with an explicit account of semantic relations in a text. Numerous recent works illustrate how leveraging explicit representations facilitates the downstream processing of challenging tasks (Lee and Goldwasser, 2019; Huang and Kurohashi, 2021; Mohamed and Oussalah, 2019; Zhu et al., 2021; Chen and Durrett, 2021; Fan et al., 2019).

While traditional representations rely on pre-defined schemata or lexica of linguistic classes (e.g., semantic roles), the popular approach of Open Information Extraction (OpenIE; Etzioni et al., 2008) aims for more loosely-structured, easily attainable representations, comprised of tuples of natural language fragments. However, these lightweight structures come with the cost of lacking consistency and comprehensive coverage, and do not capture deeper semantic information, such as semantic roles.

In recent trends, which serve as an emerging mid-point between full-fledged semantic formalisms and bare-bone textual fragments, researchers have leveraged question-answer pairs (QAs) as a representation of textual information (Michael et al., 2018). Several works, for example, proposed using QAs as an intermediate structure for assessing information alignment between texts, such as for evaluating summarization quality (Eyal et al., 2019; Gavenavicius, 2020; Deutsch et al., 2021) and faithfulness (Honovich et al., 2021; Durmus et al., 2020) using a question-generation plus question-answering (QG-QA) approach. Nevertheless, such question generation and answering models have not been trained to provide a coherent representation of text meaning.

俄罗斯总统普京宣布，该国已注册全球首款新冠疫苗。他的一个女儿已接种了这种疫苗。普京在11日表示，经过不到两个月的人体测试，俄罗斯卫生部批准了世界首款新冠疫苗。正在访问台湾的美国卫生部长阿扎尔表示：“疫苗的关键不是抢占第一位置，而是确保美国人民和全球人民获得安全有效的疫苗。”德国联邦卫生部长斯潘（Jens Spahn）对普京宣布的新冠疫苗的“质量、有效性和安全性”表示怀疑。他认为，患者的安全应该是首要考虑的。

世卫组织发言人贾萨雷维奇（Tarik Jasarevic）在日内瓦视频简报中告诉记者：“我们与俄罗斯卫生当局保持密切联系，并就可能的世卫组织疫苗预审持续讨论，任何疫苗的预审都包括对所有必要的安全和有效性资料的严格审查和评估。”

俄罗斯的“卫星V”（Sputnik V）疫苗是由莫斯科加马列亚流行病与微生物学国家研究中心（Gamaleya Institute）与俄罗斯国防部合作研发的。加马列亚研发的“卫星V”疫苗是26种正在进行人体试验的疫苗之一，目前列为第1期临床试验。

俄罗斯直接投资基金（Russian Direct Investment Fund）的执行长德米特里耶夫（Kirill Dmitriev）表示，第3期试验将于12日展开，预计从9月起开始量产，并称有20个国家已预订超过10亿剂疫苗。

La ciudad de Buenos Aires ha recibido el sello internacional Safe Travels, otorgado por el Consejo Mundial de Viajes y Turismo (WTTC, por sus siglas en inglés). Este distintivo respalda a los destinos turísticos que adoptan y cumplen con los protocolos de higiene, sanitización y distanciamiento físico.

“Este sello es fundamental para brindar confianza a todos los viajeros nacionales e internacionales que vengan a la ciudad. Además, nos permite avanzar en la creación de una red de destinos seguros y preparados junto a otras ciudades de la región, que son las que más turistas envían a Buenos Aires. Es un paso más hacia la reactivación segura del turismo”, señaló Fernando Straface, Secretario General y de Relaciones Internacionales.

Entre los destinos de la región que poseen el sello se encuentran San Pablo, Río de Janeiro, Cancún, Morelia y Quito, entre otros. El sello Safe Travels garantiza que el destino es seguro y está preparado para recibir turistas, cumpliendo con todos los requisitos y lineamientos globales de salud e higiene, establecidos y avalados por la Organización Mundial de la Salud (OMS), los Centros para el Control y la Prevención de Enfermedades (CDC) y el Consejo Mundial de Viajes y Turismo (WTTC).

La certificación obtenida permite a los futuros viajeros identificar destinos en todo el mundo que han adaptado sus protocolos a los estándares globales de salud e higiene. Los primeros destinos en recibir el certificado fueron Arabia Saudita, Barcelona, Portugal, Sevilla, Turquía, Bulgaria, Mauricio y Ontario en Canadá, entre otros.

Los protocolos avalados por el WTTC, que confirman a Buenos Aires como un destino seguro, son los siguientes: Protocolo para la prevención y manejo de casos COVID-19 en alojamientos; Protocolo para la prevención y manejo de casos COVID-19 en turismo de reuniones; Protocolo para la prevención y manejo de casos COVID-19 en agencias de viajes; Protocolo para la prevención y manejo de casos COVID-19 en aeropuertos; y Protocolo para la prevención y manejo de casos COVID-19 en gastronomía. Para conocer los detalles de estos protocolos, se puede visitar el sitio web del Ente de Turismo: https://turismo.buenosaires.gob.ar/es/article/buenos-aires-certificada-como-destino-preparado.
