He woke exhausted, as he had done every day this week. In a daze, he showered, dressed, and ate before picking up his keys to leave his home and head out to his car. It was a green car, with faded paint that had once caught the light in a way that almost seemed to glitter. Now it simply held together, with spots of brown rust etched into its sides.

How many times had he done this? He often wondered this to himself, sometimes aloud, often shouting, as if he were trying to break some terrible hush that held over a crowd; but it was only ever him, and him alone. Today he didn't ask, shout, or even think the question as he closed the car door and took slow breaths of the chilled air. There was no resistance left in him; this was his fate. He simply sat in his car, with his left hand on the wheel and his right hand on the key, which was placed in the ignition, unable to move. Was this what his life was now? Nothing more?

Instead of turning the key, he felt compelled to simply sit and stare at the trees that littered his backyard. So he did. He sat for an entire hour, until the dim sunlight grew bright and cars on the previously empty road behind him roared past. Here he was, just like the day before, only aware. Not in the way one would feel superior to their previous self, the being who possessed their skin and bones the cycle before—the countless others who seemed to simply exist while they toiled to put their work and time into assets to bring this mind into existence. No, the man, as he was, found himself to be the same as he had been the day before.

Only this morning, when compared to the others, for some reason, he had noticed the details. The pine needles on the branches of the great evergreens behind his home seemed to swirl in millions of tiny patterns that transfixed him. Somewhere in the back of his mind, he knew he was late for something, but as he got out of his car and walked into his backyard, he realized it didn't matter—not right now. This was a moment to seize, to hold onto, to learn from; this was not a time to let go.

As he walked through the cool grass, he felt his shoes, polished black to fit into his office attire, grow cold and damp from the morning dew.

In this paper, we introduce the ζ-calculus, a non-linear typed system with support for higher-order functions where duplicated variables are interpreted as sharing. The language provides syntax, typing rules, operational semantics mapping terms in ζ to diagrams of the ZX-calculus, and an equational theory that is sound with respect to the rules of ZX. We demonstrate how the linear λ-calculus can be embedded in the ζ-calculus and present examples showcasing the language's capabilities, including the use of higher-order functions.

Sharing of data can be interpreted in various ways beyond cloning. One interpretation is sharing a qubit, where a duplicated variable indicates sharing of a qubit's state. For instance, if variable x refers to a qubit in state α |0 + β |1, using x twice implies creating an entangled pair of qubits in state α |00 + β |11. QML uses this interpretation of duplicated variables but lacks support for higher-order functions.

To share a qubit, a basis must be chosen. The ζ-calculus introduces binding abstractions for different bases, using two binders, ζ and ξ, corresponding to the Z- and X-bases. Sharing across the Z-basis is denoted by ζxM, while sharing across the X-basis is denoted by ξxM. These operations map qubit states across the respective bases.

The ζ-calculus emphasizes sharing and higher-order functions in its semantics. Sharing in the Z-basis is exemplified by ζx x, x, which duplicates a variable introduced in Z. This term can be likened to λx.(x, x) in the λ-calculus. Furthermore, the language supports higher-order functions, where one function accepts another function as input. An example of this is applying the function ξf f, f to the sharing function ζx x, x, illustrating sharing of the sharing function.

Nanopore sequencing has emerged as a promising technology for the sequencing of DNA, but it is limited by distortions imposed by the physics of the sequencer. A complete model of the nanopore sequencer has not yet been established in the research community. Therefore, the purpose of this paper is to introduce a model suitable for developing codes that enable reliable data storage in synthetic DNA when using nanopore sequencing for the reading operation.

The nucleotides adenine (A), cytosine (C), guanine (G), and thymine (T) connected to a sugar-phosphate backbone molecule form the bases, the primary elements of single-stranded DNA (ssDNA). These bases create arbitrary length sequences that can be seen as an alphabet {A, T, C, G}.

The nanopore is a microscopic pore that accommodates τ nucleotides for a random duration determined by a motor protein that shifts nucleotides one by one through the nanopore. Simultaneously, an ionic electrical current flowing through the nanopore is uniquely disturbed by the nucleotides inside it at any given time and is sampled by the sequencer at a frequency fs. By measuring the current level through an output function f, the nanopore sequencer estimates the state of the system defined by the bases in the nanopore. However, several distortions reduce the reliability of detection:
- Random dwell times (sample duplications): Fluctuations in the motor protein operation result in a random number of samples per nucleotide.
- Fading: Minor variability in the physical dimensions of the nanopores slightly changes the current level for each nucleotide.
- Inter-symbol interference (ISI): The detection of a single base is distorted by interference from neighboring bases in the electrical current.
- Noisy measurements: Each sample is distorted by measurement noise, with occasional backsteps (tandem duplications) and deletions observed in experimental data.

A tractable channel model must be selected before applying information-theoretic methods to the nanopore sequencer. Our channel model incorporates inter-symbol interference, noisy measurements, and duplications, based on a finite-state Markov channel (FSMC) extended to include duplications. Fading is not included, as its effect can be accounted for as additional measurement noise, and deletions can be eliminated by adjusting the sampling rate relative to the motor protein's speed.

The primary contribution of this work is establishing a tractable channel that models the dominant distortions in nanopore sequencing. Secondary contributions include generalizing MAP detection algorithms and estimating achievable rates using methods analogous to existing literature. The paper is organized as follows: preliminaries on (hidden) Markov and semi-Markov chains are presented in Section II, the noisy nanopore channel is introduced in Section III, detection algorithms are derived in Section IV, achievable information rates are computed in Section V, and numerical results are presented in Section VI.

Consider a robot tasked with a coverage task on a building floor, such as performing a safety inspection or collecting data. The increasing availability and use of high-resolution sensors like cameras and LiDAR necessitate the robot's ability to process high-dimensional observations for real-time decisions. Traditionally, navigation approaches rely on constructing and utilizing a high-fidelity map of the robot's environment. However, this raises several questions: Is a map truly necessary for the task? Does a map-based representation satisfy the robot's onboard memory constraints? Are there more memory-efficient representations? These questions highlight the need for principled methods to find memory representations that are not only sufficient for the task but also reduce the robot's memory requirements.

To illustrate the potential benefits of memory-efficient policies, consider a robot tasked with covering an n × n maze, a simplified version of the building floor coverage task. Blum and Kozen demonstrate a control policy, a clever, handcrafted, wall-following, and zigzagging routine, that only utilizes O(log n) bits of memory, significantly less than a map-building strategy, which requires at least O(n²) memory. Beyond memory efficiency, this policy offers additional advantages, including computational efficiency and improved generalization and robustness.

The Facial Action Coding System is a new technology that utilizes a 3-D computer model of the face to analyze facial expressions. While it may not be able to discern internal emotions, it can identify external expressions such as annoyance, sadness, or anger. It can be useful for understanding non-verbal cues, especially in educational settings.

If this technology were advanced enough to accurately interpret students' emotions, it could greatly benefit teachers in understanding their students' behavior in the classroom. By comparing facial expressions to a neutral face, the system can even detect mixed emotions. While those close to someone may already be able to read their emotions, this technology could provide additional insights, especially in cases where students may be struggling silently.

The accuracy of the Facial Action Coding System is crucial for it to be trusted and utilized effectively. For example, a genuine smile can be distinguished from a fake smile, which is important in understanding someone's true emotions. By being able to detect boredom or confusion, this system could be a valuable tool in educational settings to identify students who may be struggling or disengaged, ultimately improving the learning environment for everyone.

解构新自由主义全球化下的「第五大族群——新住民」论述

「第五大族群」论述的出现，一方面延续了「四大族群」对抗中国民族主义的台湾民族主义论述，强调台湾是一个多元族群的国家，与以汉族为中心的中国不同。另一方面，在日益激烈的新自由主义全球化背景下，随着中国经济实力增强，台湾企图通过南向政策对抗中国，进而形成了以东南亚新住民为主要形象的「第五大族群」。最初被视为「社会问题」的「第五大族群——新住民」，被认为降低了台湾的全球竞争力。然而，随着新自由主义全球化下中国和东盟国家在全球体系中地位的提升，「第五大族群」的分类意义逐渐转变为「社会资产」。来自东南亚的人不再被默认视为「低劣他者」，有可能阻碍我们对抗中国，而是被视为「南向先锋」，可协助我们抗衡「邪恶他者」——中国。

社会经济的变迁也带来了人们的观念的变化。随着全球竞争的加剧，特别是面临中国市场的挑战，国家一方面迫切需要「高质量的人才」以增强全球竞争力，另一方面，在新自由主义意识形态下，不断推动教育私有化、市场化以减少政府支出，使得所谓的「优质」成为人们必须自己培养的素质，而非国家的责任提供普遍的教育。国家变得像一家「公司」，将「竞争」视为终极目标，而不是缩小贫富差距以确保平等与正义。公民则变成了「消费者」，只要求国家（公司）确保他们购买的「产品」的「品质」，而不是行使公民权利要求国家履行确保平等、正义的责任。执政者成为国家这个「公司」的管理者，为了让公司在全球市场中获得一席之地，需要随时调动当下所需的人才，并修订法律以便在全球范围内竞争各类专业人才，使得高阶专业人士不仅具有资本，而且具备高尚品格，从而成为我国公民。

一、新住民成为台湾第五大族群？

1993年，民进党籍立法委员林浊水及叶菊兰首次提出了「四大族群」的概念。经过多年，「四大族群」的划分已成为台湾族群构想的普遍主张。21世纪初，台湾开始出现「五大族群」的说法，将「新住民」列为闽南、客家、外省、原住民等「四大族群」之外的「第五大族群」。这种五大族群的说法不仅在大众媒体中出现，也出现在官方文件中。根据行政院官网的国情简介，对台湾人民的族群构成描述为：「台湾居民以汉族为最大族群，约占总人口的97%，其他2%为16个台湾原住民族，另外1%包括来自中国大陆的少数民族、大陆港澳配偶及外籍配偶。」在此描述中，进一步将族群分为汉族（河洛族群、客家族群）、台湾原住民族、战后移民（即民间通称的「外省人」）、大陆港澳及外籍配偶（被称为「新住民」）。

Smashing my kitten-like house companion had always been a fantasy I was all too willing to entertain. The little nuisance had it coming.

Minutes later, I was scrubbing blood off the wall and ceiling fan. It was time to go out and buy a new pet.

Au moment où je rédige cette critique sur le plus récent et le plus grand MacBook Air, il est évident que le saut de génération promis par Apple avec ses puces Apple Silicon a été accompli. En sortant il y a de nombreuses années de l'enveloppe mince qui définissait les ordinateurs portables ultra fins, cela a changé la définition et la direction même de la conception des appareils informatiques. Aujourd'hui, le MacBook Air fait un grand bond en avant en termes de performances brutes, défiant l'idée générale selon laquelle les ordinateurs portables ultra fins doivent sacrifier des performances pour la portabilité extrême de l'écran. En réalité, ce MacBook Air se rapproche tellement du MacBook Pro en termes de puissance de traitement et de capacité à la maintenir, tout en conservant un design sans ventilateur. En effet, il s'agit du même processeur Apple M1 qui équipe à la fois le MacBook Air et le MacBook Pro, sans compromis sur les performances.

L'Apple MacBook Air avec M1 est disponible en deux options sur la boutique en ligne Apple India et chez les détaillants. Les prix du nouveau MacBook Air avec M1 restent les mêmes que ceux des versions précédentes alimentées par des processeurs Intel. Cela signifie que la configuration de base du MacBook Air avec M1, équipé d'un processeur 8 cœurs et d'un GPU 7 cœurs, est proposée à 92 900 Rs, tandis que la version avec un processeur 8 cœurs et un GPU 8 cœurs est vendue à 1,17,900 Rs.

La transition majeure d'Intel vers la plate-forme Arm pour la puce M1 aurait pu être complexe, mais Apple a anticipé les problèmes potentiels en optimisant macOS Big Sur pour le nouveau silicium et en développant le logiciel Rosetta 2 pour garantir la compatibilité des applications conçues pour les puces Intel. Les performances du système et le comportement des applications ont été améliorés, évitant ainsi les lenteurs rencontrées sur d'autres appareils basés sur Arm. Le MacBook Air avec M1 fonctionne désormais de manière similaire au MacBook Pro, offrant des performances exceptionnelles pour des tâches exigeantes telles que l'édition vidéo et la navigation web intensive.

En plus de ses performances, l'Apple M1 offre une autonomie de batterie encore plus longue, dépassant les 12 heures déjà impressionnantes du MacBook Air précédent. Le design du MacBook Air avec M1 reste inchangé, avec des options de couleur classiques et un poids de 1,29 kg.

He'd been practicing lucid dreaming. This idea of being able to control his dreams fascinated him, and he would often wander around the world, flying to places he had never been. In fact, this question had pestered him all of his life: "How can I see things and places I'd never been to?" 

Tonight was no different. He'd brushed his teeth, gargled a strong mint-flavored mouthwash, and jumped straight into bed. As usual, he had set his alarm to 3 am, just enough time to fall into REM sleep and be awakened so he could bring his brain back down to the near meditative state of lucid dreaming. Just before letting his brain go, he repeated to himself in his mind: "Tonight, I'm gonna figure out the meaning of life. I'm gonna see the source of us all and find out why we are here." He was incredibly smart but not especially attractive and by any definition, an underachiever. This would let his brain free to fantasize about being the one who would one day be the most influential person in history. "I mean, I have the brains, I'm a genius.... it's just that no one realizes it," he'd often think to himself.

*BEEP BEEP BEEP BEEP BEEP*

No matter for how long he'd been doing this, he'd get the heavy head feeling every time the alarm went off. But he always instinctively knew what he had to do. He flipped his pillow to the cool side, and once more, he was focusing on the meaning of life. Soon after, he was in a void. He had woken up not floating above his body, but in a darkness so blinding that he could not see his own hands in front of his face. In fact, he had already started to check all his dream indicators, and they had all failed the test. The watch on his wrist was ticking, he could not breathe if he held his nose, and his index finger did not go through his palm as it usually would.

"What the heck?!" he said out loud, reaching to his bedside lamp switch as he assumed he had simply woken up. There was nothing, he was in complete void. Nothing was within reach. In fact, he had just now realized he was floating. There was no floor, no bed, just him.

Suddenly everything around him was bright as day. Blindingly white everywhere. A white so bright he instinctively covered his eyes to soften the pain but it was of no use. His arm could not block the light. Then a figure emerged from the brightness, a human by any definition. He asked the figure: "Where am I? What is all of this?"

"You don't remember?" the figure said, the features of whom could still not be discerned due to the light shining from behind it.

Fidèles à leur réputation de cinéphiles, les Toulousains adorent aller au cinéma. En 2016, une étude du CNC révèle que la fréquentation des salles a augmenté de 4%.

Le Centre national du cinéma et de l'image animée (CNC) vient de publier la Géographie du cinéma 2016, qui présente une cartographie complète du secteur. On y apprend que les salles de la Haute-Garonne ont dépassé les 5,6 millions d'entrées, soit une progression de plus de 4 %. C'est la plus forte fréquentation de la région Occitanie.

Notre département compte 38 cinémas, dont 27 classés Art et Essai. Ce sont principalement ces petites et moyennes salles qui ont connu une hausse de leur fréquentation. Ainsi, l'ABC à Toulouse a enregistré une augmentation de 12 % de ses entrées, atteignant 180 000 pour l'année 2016. « Cette belle dynamique s'explique par les 50 ans de notre cinéma et la sortie de quelques bons films, dont Moi, Daniel Blake de Ken Loach, Palme d'Or à Cannes, Juste la fin du monde de Xavier Dolan, que nous avons accueilli, et enfin Ma vie de courgette, qui fut une belle surprise », annonce Marc Van Maele, le directeur de l'ABC. Et d'ajouter : « En plus, le cinéma a un côté addictif : plus on voit de bons films, plus on a envie d'en voir. »

Même constat à l'American Cosmograph : « Après une année 2015 difficile, 2016 a été une bonne année avec 237 031 spectateurs enregistrés. Notre fréquentation a augmenté de 6,3 % », précise Annie Mahot, l'une des gérantes. « Demain, Merci patron, Paterson de Jarmusch et Manchester by the Sea ont bien marché chez nous », ajoute-t-elle.

2016 fut également un très beau succès pour le Véo de Muret, qui annonce une hausse de 12 % de ses entrées, atteignant 513 000. « Ici, nous accueillons avant tout un public familial qui apprécie les dessins animés et les comédies », explique son directeur, Léonard Labouz. « Zootopie, Vaiana, Les Tuche et Les Animaux fantastiques ont dopé nos entrées. »

Même son de cloche au Central de Colomiers, qui a vu sa fréquentation s'accroître de 5,3 %. « Nous disposons de deux salles de projection et misons sur une programmation à la fois généraliste et d'Art et Essai pour satisfaire le public le plus large », annonce Marie Vassort. Dans son top 2016, le Central cite Star Wars avec Rogue One, 007 Spectre, Moi, Daniel Blake, Vaiana et Miss Peregrine de Tim Burton. « Je constate que les gens recherchent de plus en plus des cinémas à taille humaine et de proximité », reprend la gérante. Le Central prévoit de construire trois salles de plus « dans le but de garder les films plus longtemps à l'affiche, permettant ainsi au bouche-à-oreille d'opérer », conclut Marie Vassort.

Avec sa seule salle de projection, Le Méliès à Castelmaurou a lui aussi bénéficié d'un record de fréquentation en 2016 « avec une hausse à deux chiffres », précise son directeur, Patrick Jannite. « Aujourd'hui, le passage au numérique nous permet de proposer la même qualité de projection que les grandes salles, ce qui nous a permis de capter une autre clientèle. »

En revanche, cette hausse de la fréquentation profite moins aux grandes salles. Pour le Mega CGR de Blagnac, l'année 2016 s'est achevée sur une légère hausse de 0,40 %.

مسؤولو النادي الأهلي يقتربون من حسم صفقة ضم ثنائي منتخب مصر، علي غزال وعمرو طارق، لتعزيز خط دفاع الفريق خلال فترة الانتقالات الشتوية في يناير المقبل. ينتظر لجنة التعاقدات بالأهلي قرار مجلس الإدارة بشأن ضم الثنائي بعد تأكيد موافقتهم على الانضمام للفريق. ويسعى مجلس النادي بقوة لجلب عدد من الصفقات المميزة من أجل استعادة البطولات بعد خروجه من البطولة العربية.

شكرًا لقراءتكم خبر "الأهلي يقترب من ثنائي الفراعنة" على موقع خليج 365. نذكركم أن المقال تم كتابته بواسطة الفجر وقد يكون قد تم نقله كليًا أو جزئيًا. يمكنكم متابعة المستجدات من مصدره الأصلي عبر الرابط المرفق. نحن غير مسؤولين عن محتوى الخبر ونتمنى لكم يومًا سعيدًا.

Jujuy al día® – El Director Provincial de Emergencias, Guillermo Siri, calificó como muy exitoso el operativo desarrollado en la primera jornada de pago en bancos de nuestra ciudad, tanto por parte del personal desplegado para tal finalidad, como de los jubilados y pensionados que colaboraron y se prestaron de manera muy respetuosa a la tarea implementada.

En ese sentido, puntualizó que en la primera jornada del operativo se consiguió concluir con el pago aproximadamente a las 11 horas sin mayores inconvenientes.

Para la jornada del viernes 26, aclaró que se procederá al pago a jubilados y pensionados, nacionales y provinciales, cuya finalización del DNI sea 1 y que cobren por ventanillas. Asimismo, como una medida de seguridad para las personas mayores, solo se habilitarán las colas a partir de las 8 horas, cuando se abran las puertas de los bancos, teniendo en cuenta que para los próximos días se prevé un marcado descenso de temperatura. 

Se estima que el operativo del viernes concluya a las 12 horas, concluyó Siri.

The development of new technology, such as the Facial Action Coding System, which can identify human emotions, has sparked a debate regarding the invasion of privacy it may entail. Creating a system that can detect people's emotions and actions raises concerns about privacy infringement. People may feel their privacy is being violated, and the constant monitoring of their emotions and actions can lead to a sense of surveillance. This could result in a loss of freedom and a breach of trust in relationships, as everyone has personal and private aspects of their lives.

In the modern era of advancing technology, the use of such systems can be beneficial, but it also raises significant privacy and relationship concerns. The ability of technology to track facial movements, even in real or digitally altered faces, and to analyze physical characteristics, can lead to a sense of intrusion and a lack of safety. While the Facial Action Coding System may have its advantages, the potential negative impact on privacy and personal freedom cannot be overlooked.

While the Facial Action Coding System may offer some benefits, the potential drawbacks, such as the infringement of privacy and the potential erosion of personal freedom, must be taken into account. The system's ability to decipher facial expressions and emotions may be seen as a breach of privacy, causing discomfort and a lack of security. This can, in turn, disrupt relationships, as the sense of privacy and autonomy is compromised, and the feeling of being constantly monitored can lead to a sense of unease and a lack of trust.

La situation avec Covid-19 s’aggrave plus rapidement que ne le prévoyaient les responsables de la santé publique, a averti vendredi le médecin en chef, le Dr Tony Holohan, alors que 582 nouveaux cas de virus avaient été signalés. Six autres décès de patients atteints de Covid-19 ont été rapportés par l’équipe nationale d’urgence de santé publique (Nphet), portant à 2 149 le nombre total de décès dans la pandémie. Le Nphet a également signalé 582 cas confirmés supplémentaires, portant à 78 254 le nombre total de cas dans la République. Il s’agit du total quotidien le plus élevé depuis le 5 novembre.

Parmi les nouveaux cas, 193 sont à Dublin, 59 à Wexford, 47 à Louth, 42 à Meath et 34 à Cork, les 207 cas restants étant répartis dans tous les autres comtés. Vendredi après-midi, 198 patients de Covid-19 étaient hospitalisés, dont 34 en soins intensifs. Il y a eu 13 hospitalisations supplémentaires au cours des dernières 24 heures. La flambée des cas a poussé l’incidence de la maladie sur 14 jours à nouveau au-dessus de 100, à 100,8 cas pour 100 000 personnes. Donegal, Louth et Kilkenny ont les chiffres de comté les plus élevés, tandis que Leitrim et Clare ont les plus bas.

Pendant ce temps, il y a eu une augmentation significative du nombre d’épidémies de Covid-19 dans les ménages privés. De nouvelles données du Centre de surveillance de la protection de la santé (HPSC) montrent que 328 éclosions supplémentaires – définies comme deux cas ou plus – se sont produites dans des maisons familiales la semaine dernière, une augmentation de 18% par rapport aux 279 signalées la semaine précédente. Les maisons privées restent le lieu d’épidémie le plus fréquemment signalé. Il y a également eu 13 éclosions supplémentaires parmi les membres de la famille élargie.

En ce qui concerne le secteur de l’hôtellerie, une épidémie a été enregistrée dans un hôtel, mais aucune dans les restaurants ou cafés. Si le gouvernement tient compte des nouveaux conseils de Nphet, les restaurants et les cafés fermeraient le 28 décembre, sauf pour les plats à emporter. Pendant ce temps, 19 autres flambées ont été signalées dans les écoles dans la semaine précédant le samedi 12 décembre, portant à 103 le nombre d’épidémies ouvertes associées aux contextes. Il y a également eu neuf nouvelles éclosions aiguës dans les hôpitaux et quatre autres dans des maisons de soins infirmiers. Neuf nouvelles éclosions sur le lieu de travail ont également été enregistrées, dont une dans une entreprise de production d’aliments ou de boissons, une dans l’industrie de la construction, trois dans la fabrication et une dans un bureau.

Jeudi, le médecin-chef, le Dr Tony Holohan, a averti que le virus se propage dans les milieux sociaux, y compris les fêtes de Noël, les lieux de travail et les funérailles. «Je ne saurais trop insister sur l’importance de limiter vos interactions maintenant. Les conséquences de ne pas le faire seront une croissance exponentielle en janvier, une augmentation substantielle des hospitalisations et des risques pour la vie », a-t-il déclaré. «Chacun de nous doit faire tout son possible pour protéger la santé publique – coupez vos contacts, ne voyez que ceux que vous avez besoin de voir. Choisissez de socialiser en toute sécurité, à l’extérieur si possible. Si vous voyez une foule, évitez-la. En choisissant d’agir en toute sécurité dès maintenant, nous pouvons ensemble limiter l’impact que cette maladie aura dans les semaines et les mois à venir – et ce faisant, nous pouvons protéger les personnes vulnérables et éviter des décès inutiles», a-t-il ajouté.

Le département de la santé du Nord, dans ses chiffres publiés vendredi après-midi, a signalé 12 décès supplémentaires dus au virus, portant son total à 1 166. 510 nouveaux cas supplémentaires de virus ont également été signalés, portant le total à 60 797. Il y a 445 patients recevant un traitement Covid dans les hôpitaux d’Irlande du Nord, 31 en soins intensifs et 26 sous ventilateurs.

路透社5月6日电——企业软件制造商BMC Software Inc（BMC.O）宣布，由贝恩资本和Golden Gate Capital牵头的财团将以约69亿美元将其私有化。BMC Software增长乏力一直是其最大股东的困扰。

BMC的大股东Elliott Management认为，BMC管理层忽视了进入快速增长的云计算市场的重要机会。Elliott Management持有BMC 9.6%的股份，并持续一年多推动BMC的出售。

“私有化对他们有利，因为这使他们能够进行必要的变革，而作为上市公司，做出这样的改变并不容易。”Lazard Capital Markets分析师Joel Fishbein表示。

该交易是今年迄今为止最大的一笔“纯粹的”杠杆收购交易。

财团提出的收购报价为每股46.25美元，比BMC上周五收盘价45.42美元高出不到2%。

周一，BMC在纳斯达克市场的股价收于45.42美元，与前日持平，盘中最高上涨0.29美元，至45.71美元。

该私募股权投资财团还包括新加坡主权财富基金旗下的GIC Special Investments Pte Ltd，以及专注于软件和网络业务的纽约投资公司Insight Venture Partners。

根据销售协议，BMC可以在30天内寻求其他收购提议，但分析师称，公司不太可能获得更高的报价。

BMC表示，该交易预计将在今年稍后完成。

في واحدة من أغرب القضايا التي شهدها القضاء السعودي، اتهم رجل أعمال سعودي والدته رسميًا بتمويل الإرهاب بعد نزاع مالي بينهما حول مبلغ 22 مليون ريال (ما يعادل حوالي 5.8 مليون دولار). 

وذكرت صحيفة "عكاظ" المحلية، اليوم الأربعاء، أن القضية مطروحة أمام القضاء بعد أن انتهت النيابة العامة من تحقيقاتها، ووجهت الاتهامات لرجل الأعمال وشخص آخر كان يعمل سابقًا كمسؤول في هيئة الأمر بالمعروف والنهي عن المنكر، بتقديم بلاغ كاذب ضد والدة رجل الأعمال، مدعين أنها تمول أنشطة إرهابية وتتعاون مع حزب إرهابي خارج المملكة.

وتشير تحقيقات القضية إلى أن رجل الأعمال دفع رشوة بقيمة أربعة ملايين ريال لمسؤول بارز بهدف إدراج والدته في قائمة الترقب والقبض بعد خلاف مالي بينهما، إذ كانت تطالبه بسداد شيك بقيمة 22 مليون ريال لأعمال تجارية ضمن شركة عائلية.

وأفادت الصحيفة أن رجل الأعمال أقدم على تقديم بلاغ كاذب ضد والدته إلى الجهات المختصة، مستعينًا بمسؤول الهيئة السابق كوسيط لنقل الاتهامات التي تضمنت أن والدته تدعم حزبًا إرهابيًا ماليًا وتزور مواقع تابعة له خارج البلاد، وتملك شبكة لتوزيع أموال لدعم أنشطته.

ونقلت الصحيفة عن مصادر غير معلنة أن رجل الأعمال اعترف بتقديم البلاغ ضد والدته لكنه نفى دفع أي رشوة للقبض عليها، بينما أشار المسؤول السابق إلى أن البلاغ كان بناءً على المعلومات التي قدمها له رجل الأعمال وكان من منطلق واجبه الوطني والشرعي، وأنه نقل البلاغ دون التآمر لإضرار والدة رجل الأعمال.

وبعد تحقيقات دقيقة، تبين عدم صحة الاتهامات الموجهة للسيدة السعودية، وبدلاً من ذلك تم توجيه الاتهامات لابنها ومسؤول الهيئة السابق.

ويواجه رجل الأعمال تهمًا بتقديم رشوة لموظف عام لإدراج والدته ضمن قائمة الترقب والقدوم، وتسجيل قضية تمويل إرهاب ضدها، إضافة إلى التآمر مع موظف عام لإساءة استعمال السلطة الإدارية، وتقديم بلاغ كيدي ضد والدته، فضلاً عن تهمة عقوق الوالدين ومحاولة الإضرار بوالدته وتشويه سمعتها لتحقيق مصالحه الشخصية والمالية.

In an inspirational story, Ruby Beauty, once a victim of body shaming, is now winning medals for her country. Ruby, a mother of a six-year-old, was abandoned by her husband due to her physical appearance and faced criticism for being overweight. Despite these challenges, Ruby refused to be demoralized and turned to fitness to transform her life.

Ruby shared, "My husband's rejection based on my weight was a wake-up call for me to prioritize my health. I started walking and shed a significant amount of weight. The journey became even tougher after having my son, but I remained focused on my goal." She emphasized the financial strain of using expensive supplements but managed through teaching Zumba classes. Ruby has achieved national recognition in bodybuilding in Assam and also clinched the title of Ms. Chennai, expressing her desire for support from the state government to further her growth in the field.

Her coach, Kartik, praised Ruby's determination and predicted her success in winning the Ms. India title. He highlighted her exceptional willpower and rapid progress, contrasting her commitment to the short-lived motivation of many others he has trained. Kartik confidently stated, "She will easily secure the title of Ms. India in fitness."

In the current era, body shaming is prevalent on various platforms, causing detrimental effects on individuals, especially young women and men. Ruby's journey serves as a beacon of hope, demonstrating that resilience and dedication can lead to transformative achievements. Her story shines as a reminder that amidst challenges, there is always a silver lining, inspiring others to overcome adversity and pursue their dreams.

When you join the Seagoing Cowboys, you join a year of adventure. Not only do you get to take care of animals like horses, cattle, and more, but you also get to sightsee as well. "It's an unbelievable opportunity for a small-town boy," says a cowboy named Luke. "Besides helping people, I had the side benefit of seeing Europe and China. But seeing the Acropolis in Greece was special," he says. So was taking a gondola ride in Venice, Italy, a city with streets of water. Imagine seeing beautiful cities that you always wanted to see, right in front of your eyes.

Soon enough, you'll know everything there is to know about taking care of the animals, like feeding, washing, grooming, and even playing with them. "It's an opportunity of a lifetime." Additionally, you get to have fun. He reached back to feel it again. It was still there. He tied his shoes and adjusted his tie in the mirror, then touched it once more. The small round knob, barely the size of a thimble, protruded from his neck just above his snow-white collar. His inner monologue raced with questions. "How long has it been there? Should I see a doctor? Does everyone have one? Impossible, I would have noticed. But I just noticed mine. Can everyone see it?" He touched it again, still there.

Barry Roper, an average height, slender, quiet, shy, clumsy, and notably unlucky man, was taking his chance today. He loathed his days emptying the trash cans along the residential neighborhoods and was unsatisfied with his constant financial desperation. Renting a small studio apartment, he was perpetually drowning in stress and anxiety, fearing his car wouldn't start. Barry finally dug up the courage to do something about it.

Barry's true passion was cards. He never missed a televised high stakes game of Texas Holdem and Pot Limit Omaha. He dreamt of building a bankroll and taking it to Vegas, where his name would be mentioned among the greatest players. Barry had been practicing dealing cards alone in front of his television, watching old tapes of poker world championships, and he knew he was a good dealer.

Then, that morning, the dial appeared. Barry twisted his back and leaned into the mirror to get a better look. White lines, raised like scars, wreathed the brassy knob. Alternating lines were marked with digits increasing in value going clockwise around the peculiar blemish, starting with 0 near the eight o'clock position and ending at 16 on the other side. Just above the knob sat a triangle pointing at the number seven. Barry gingerly caressed the newly discovered anatomy, feeling the cold, hard shell. He tugged it gently, knowing it wouldn't be painless to remove.

Thoughts raced in Barry's mind. "What are the numbers? What will happen if I turn it? Will it even turn? Maybe it's just an odd mole, and I'm imagining things. Stress and nerves. That's what it is." He couldn't resist. Grasping the knob between his fingers, he carefully slid his thumb towards his palm. With a barely audible 'click,' the arrow now pointed at the number eight.

Although there were no immediate effects, Barry had the distinct impression that he shouldn't do that again. It felt wrong, unnatural. Yet, at the same time, his anxiety dissipated into a level-headed calm. "It's been there for a long time; I just never noticed. It seems like no one else does either.

MONTRÉAL, le 28 juillet 2020 /CNW Telbec/ - Le Syndicat des débardeurs du port de Montréal (SCFP 375) a entamé hier matin une grève générale de 96 heures afin d'exercer une pression sur l'Association des employeurs maritimes (AEM).

Dans l'avis de grève envoyé le 24 juillet dernier à l'employeur, le syndicat précise que « les débardeurs seront en grève sur le territoire du port de Montréal, y compris le terminal de Contrecœur, pour une durée de quatre jours, soit du lundi 27 juillet 2020, à 7 h, jusqu'au vendredi 31 juillet 2020, à 6 h 59 ».

Cette grève est la deuxième en moins d'un mois au port de Montréal. L'un des principaux enjeux de cette négociation concerne les horaires de travail.

Hier, la tension est montée d'un cran lorsque les syndiqués ont découvert la présence de briseurs de grève. Ces derniers sont des gestionnaires de la compagnie Termont Montréal inc., l'un des plus grands exploitants du port de Montréal.

« C'est pour nous un affront majeur. C'est la première fois en quarante ans que je suis témoin d'un tel manque de respect envers les débardeurs. Nous allons trouver une réponse à la hauteur de cette provocation », a averti Michel Murray, conseiller du SCFP et ancien débardeur lui-même.

Le SCFP 375, représentant 1125 débardeurs, s'efforce de renégocier un contrat de travail depuis que la convention collective est arrivée à échéance le 31 décembre 2018.

Les négociations avaient pourtant repris récemment suite à un jugement important du Conseil canadien des relations industrielles (CCRI) concernant les services essentiels à maintenir en cas de grève. L'AEM avait échoué dans sa tentative de faire déclarer la totalité des activités de débardage comme services essentiels.

Comptant près de 122 000 membres au Québec, le SCFP représente non seulement le Syndicat des débardeurs du port de Montréal, mais aussi les débardeurs des ports de Québec, Trois-Rivières, Sorel, Matane, ainsi que ceux d'Arrimage du Saint-Laurent (Baie-Comeau), pour un total d'environ 1450 membres. Le SCFP est également présent dans les secteurs suivants : affaires sociales, communications, éducation, universités, énergie, municipalités, sociétés d'État et organismes publics, transports aérien et terrestre ainsi que le secteur mixte.

Tennis : Alizé Cornet saura bientôt si elle sera sanctionnée pour ses absences aux contrôles antidopage

Alizé Cornet devra attendre quatorze jours avant de connaître son sort, suite à son audience mardi à Londres devant le tribunal indépendant de la Fédération internationale de tennis (ITF). Elle est accusée d'avoir manqué trois contrôles antidopage entre novembre 2016 et octobre 2017.

Âgée de 28 ans, la joueuse niçoise risque une lourde sanction si elle est reconnue coupable. En effet, le règlement de l'ITF, conformément au Code mondial antidopage, prévoit une suspension de deux ans, voire d'un an selon les circonstances, pour une telle infraction.

L'ITF devrait rendre sa décision dans les 14 jours suivant l'audience, soit avant le début de Roland-Garros le 27 mai. Selon le verdict, la joueuse ou l'Agence mondiale antidopage (AMA) auront la possibilité de faire appel devant le Tribunal arbitral du sport (TAS), sans garantie que la sanction soit suspendue.

**台东医疗新篇章：5G远距看诊与医疗资源的进步**

从绿岛到台东的直线距离为52公里，在本岛的任何一处开车只需不到一个小时。然而，对于早期的绿岛民众来说，等船、搭船、加上转车，至少需要两个半小时才能到达医疗设施。随着当地政府引进各类医疗资源，尤其是今年五月绿岛开通5G远距看诊服务后，这种情况已有大幅改善。

**医疗救治中的距离挑战**

对于医护人员来说，抢救人命是一场与时间的赛跑，而距离往往是时间的最大阻碍。绿岛的一位民众分享了一个悲剧故事：「我同学的阿姨得了盲肠炎，家人紧急开渔船送往台东救治，但病患却不幸在船上病故，只得折返。」他表示，早期绿岛只有一位医师，且没有空中转运，导致许多民众无法及时就医。

**绿岛与大武的医疗提升**

如今，绿岛卫生所已经能够处理急诊业务，急症病患经过医师评估后，可以通过直升机转送到台东；若天气不佳，则由保七走水路接送。虽然距离仍远，但已大大改善。大武卫生所主任卢克凡医师强调，许多病患其实都可以救得回来，关键在于缩短民众和医院之间的路程。住在大武乡的张信昌先生因血尿到卫生所就诊，所幸在大武卫生所开办专科业务后，他的癌症很快被发现并得到妥善治疗，现在他只需定期追踪。

**大武卫生所的新举措**

根据台东县政府2018年的主要癌症死因统计报告，大肠癌占第五位。为减轻民众舟车劳顿之苦，并提高就医意愿，大武卫生所在今年九月起开办大肠镜、胃镜检查门诊，每月一次，由高医医师驻诊。

C’est un long bâtiment enduit de rose pâle, évoquant un faux air de palazzo italien, qui borde l’avenue de Tourmany, à Mougins, dans les Alpes-Maritimes. Les cyprès de la rue, les cactus en pot devant l’entrée, et le nom de l’établissement, « La Riviera », rappellent que nous sommes sur la Côte d’Azur. Depuis fin mars, cet établissement d’hébergement pour personnes âgées dépendantes (Ehpad) a enregistré 31 décès parmi environ 110 résidents, tous victimes directes ou indirectes du Covid-19, selon l’Agence régionale de santé.

La tragédie laisse les familles dans un état de sidération. Elles accusent la direction de l’établissement d’avoir dissimulé la progression de la maladie. Plusieurs ont déposé une plainte contre X pour « mise en danger de la vie d’autrui », et le parquet de Grasse a ouvert une enquête. « Nous étions préparés. Nous avons pris toutes les mesures barrières nécessaires », assure le porte-parole du groupe Korian, propriétaire de l’Ehpad.

Alors qu’au moins 2 417 personnes vivant en Ehpad sont décédées depuis le début de l’épidémie, « La Croix » a choisi de donner un nom et un visage à ces victimes, en retraçant le parcours et la fin de vie de quatre résidents de « La Riviera ».

**Odette**

Si Arnaud accepte de parler, c’est, confie-t-il, « pour Odette, pas pour moi ». Comme toutes les autres familles des victimes de l’Ehpad de Mougins, ce quadragénaire souhaite rendre hommage à sa grand-mère. « Parce qu’elle le méritait, d’abord ; mais aussi parce que les conditions de son décès me rendent malade. »

Odette est née le 24 mars 1926, à Saint-Lattier, dans l’Isère. Elle est une jeune fille de la campagne, grandissant dans la ferme familiale où habite encore sa sœur. À 20 ans, peu après la guerre, elle épouse Jean Noyer, ancien résistant dans le Vercors devenu représentant de commerce.

Odette et Jean s’installent à Romans-sur-Isère (Drôme) et ont deux enfants. Mais Odette perd son mari alors qu’elle n’a que 60 ans, puis une sclérose en plaques emporte sa première fille. « Cela aurait pu faire d’elle quelqu’un d’aigri. Mais non, c’était une femme forte, positive, sociable », ajoute Arnaud.

À Romans, Odette habitait juste en face de l’église qu’elle fréquentait assidûment, jusqu’à ce que la perte d’autonomie l’oblige à se rapprocher de sa fille, à Mougins. En juillet 2018, la nonagénaire rejoint « La Riviera ». « Elle avait encore toute sa tête, assure Arnaud. Le 24 mars, pour ses 94 ans, nous avons insisté toute la journée pour l’avoir au téléphone en passant par le standard.

Will this technology be valuable in the classroom? While it seems impressive, the question remains: will it truly be beneficial? If the technology can read facial expressions, it could potentially be useful, but here’s why it might not be.

Have you ever felt bored in school? We all do at times; it’s a natural part of the experience. Now, imagine if our computers could detect our boredom—would that automatically make lessons more engaging? Lessons are often pre-designed or created by teachers. If our computers detect boredom, the expectation might be to modify the lesson. But how would that work? Teachers would need to prepare multiple versions of a lesson to accommodate different responses. Additionally, some school topics are inherently dull, and it might be challenging to make them more engaging.

There are, however, a few potential benefits, such as the technology's ability to detect if someone is feeling down. It could be a helpful tool for students who might need support but are reluctant to ask. Yet, if implemented, the technology might merely highlight the numerous stressed faces of students overwhelmed by homework, while trying to balance their personal lives. This, however, raises the question: does it infringe on personal space? Many people prefer to keep their emotions private, and the use of such technology in schools could compromise the privacy we value.

While the technology might be a step forward, is it the right fit for the school environment?

شكرًا لكم على قراءة خبر عن تعيين 25 امرأة في منصب العميدة والوكيلة بكليات جامعة الأزهر. دعونا نلقي نظرة أكثر تفصيلًا على الأمر الآن:

قال الدكتور محمد المحرصاوي، رئيس جامعة الأزهر، ونائب رئيس مجلس إدارة المنظمة العالمية لخريجي الأزهر، إن للأزهر الشريف دورًا كبيرًا في دعم حقوق المرأة. فقد أولى المرأة اهتمامًا كبيرًا، ممثلاً في اعتماد حقوقها وتأكيد دورها الهام في تقدم مجتمعها. هذا الاهتمام تم تتويجه بإصدار وثيقة الأزهر عام 2013.

وجاءت هذه التصريحات خلال فعاليات اللقاء الشهري لبرنامج "سفراء الأزهر أون لاين"، تحت عنوان "المرأة المصرية ودورها في السلم والأمن"، والذي أُقيم في مقر المنظمة العالمية لخريجي الأزهر، بحضور قادة جامعة الأزهر ونواب مجلس الشيوخ. تم بث اللقاء عبر صفحتي المنظمة و"سفراء الأزهر" على فيسبوك.

أشار المحرصاوي إلى الدور البارز الذي تلعبه المرأة في الأزهر الشريف، حيث تشغل عدة مناصب رائدة في الجامعة والكليات المختلفة. فهناك كليات كاملة مخصصة للإناث في جامعة الأزهر، وهناك 12 عميدة للكليات المختلفة، بالإضافة إلى 13 وكيلة بالإضافة إلى رؤساء الأقسام وغيرهن في المناصب القيادية.

من جانبه، أكد أسامة ياسين، نائب رئيس مجلس إدارة المنظمة، أنه يجب على المرأة المصرية أن تكون شريكة فعالة ومكافئة للرجل في المساهمة في تحقيق السلام، خاصةً في ظل الظروف الصعبة التي نمر بها. كما أكد أن دور المرأة في تربية النشء يعتبر الأهم، حيث تشكل التربية الاجتماعية للشخص مفتاح فهمه وسلوكه.

أكد الدكتور نظير عياد، الأمين العام لمجمع البحوث الإسلامية، على أن الإسلام أكرم المرأة وأعطاها مكانة اجتماعية خاصة في جميع المجالات. وأشار إلى أن الشريعة الإسلامية أقرت مبدأ المساواة بين الرجل والمرأة، وجعلتهما متساويين في التكليف. وأشار إلى أن دور المرأة المصرية عبر التاريخ كان ملحوظًا في مختلف المجالات العملية والعلمية والثقافية والاجتماعية والاقتصادية والإبداعية وغيرها.

وفيما يتعلق بالأمن والسلام، أكد الدكتور يوسف عامر، رئيس لجنة الشؤون الدينية والأوقاف بمجلس الشيوخ، أن دور المرأة المصرية في ذلك كبير وملحوظ ومنطقي.

Libby gazed up at me with her mismatched eyes, her head cocked to one side as it always had. Initially, it seemed like a silly quirk when she was just a pup with oversized paws and a stubby tail. It was as if she couldn't comprehend a world confined by a flat horizon. Over time, I came to see it as charming, the way she would strike a pose with one ear perked up and the other tucked back—a playful greeting to all and none. But now, the gesture seemed laden with weariness, a poignant display of sadness and acceptance of the harshness of a indifferent fate.

But, of course, those were my feelings, not hers.

Although she couldn't jump into the car as easily, her tail still wagged as I lifted her into the passenger seat. Sitting a bit taller, she made a concerted effort to prop herself up by the window, so she could observe the passing sidewalks and parks she was leaving behind. As we reached our final destination, she extended her neck to lick my hand.

Knowledge distillation (KD) [Buciluǎ et al., 2006; Hinton et al., 2015] is a popular method for compressing a large "teacher" model into a more compact "student" model. In its most basic form, this involves training the student to fit the teacher's predicted label distribution or soft labels for each sample. There is strong empirical evidence that distilled students usually perform better than students trained on raw dataset labels [Hinton et al., 2015; Furlanello et al., 2018; Stanton et al., 2021; Gou et al., 2021]. Multiple works have devised novel KD procedures that further improve student model performance (see Gou et al. [2021] and references therein).

Several works have aimed to rigorously formalize why KD can improve the student model performance. Some prominent observations from this line of work are that (self-)distillation induces favorable optimization biases in the training objective [Phuong and Lampert, 2019; Ji and Zhu, 2020], lowers the variance of the objective [Menon et al., 2021; Dao et al., 2021; Ren et al., 2022], increases regularization towards learning "simpler" functions [Mobahi et al., 2020], transfers information from different data views [Allen-Zhu and Li, 2020], and scales per-example gradients based on the teacher's confidence [Furlanello et al., 2018; Tang et al., 2020].

Despite this remarkable progress, there are still many open problems and unexplained phenomena around knowledge distillation. For instance, why do soft labels sometimes help? It is agreed that a teacher's soft predictions carry information about class similarities [Hinton et al., 2015; Furlanello et al., 2018], and that this softness of predictions has a regularization effect similar to label smoothing [Yuan et al., 2020]. Nevertheless, KD also works in binary classification settings with limited class similarity information [Müller et al., 2020]. How exactly the softness of teacher predictions (controlled by a temperature parameter) affects student learning remains far from well understood.

Another open problem is the role of the capacity gap. There is evidence that when there is a significant capacity gap between the teacher and the student, the distilled model usually falls behind its teacher [Mirzadeh et al., 2020; Cho and Hariharan, 2019; Stanton et al., 2021]. It is unclear whether this is due to difficulties in optimization or due to insufficient student capacity.

Moreover, what makes a good teacher? Sometimes less accurate models are better teachers [Cho and Hariharan, 2019; Mirzadeh et al., 2020]. Furthermore, early-stopped or exponentially averaged models are often better teachers [Ren et al., 2022]. A comprehensive explanation of this remains elusive.

This paper provides a new theoretically grounded perspective on KD through the lens of supervision complexity. This concept quantifies why certain targets (e.g., temperature-scaled teacher probabilities) may be "easier" for a student model to learn compared to others (e.g., raw one-hot labels), owing to better alignment with the student's neural tangent kernel (NTK) [Jacot et al., 2018; Lee et al., 2019]. Specifically, we provide a novel theoretical analysis (§2, Thm. 3 and 4) of the role of supervision complexity on kernel classifier generalization and use this to derive a new generalization bound for distillation (Prop. 5). This highlights how student generalization is controlled by a balance of the teacher generalization, the student's margin with respect to the teacher predictions, and the complexity of the teacher's predictions.

Based on this analysis, we establish the conceptual and practical efficacy of a simple online distillation approach (§4), wherein the student is fit to progressively more complex targets, in the form of teacher predictions at various checkpoints during its training. This method guides the student in the function space (see Fig. 1) and leads to better generalization compared to offline distillation. We provide empirical results on a range of image classification benchmarks confirming the value of online distillation, particularly for students with weak inductive biases.

Beyond practical benefits, the supervision complexity view yields new insights into distillation. For instance, temperature scaling and early-stopping of the teacher have proven effective for KD. We show that both techniques reduce supervision complexity, at the expense of also lowering the classification margin. Online distillation manages to smoothly increase teacher complexity without degrading the margin.

Furthermore, for students with weak inductive biases and/or with much less capacity than the teacher, the final teacher predictions are often as complex as dataset labels, particularly during the early stages of training. In contrast, online distillation allows the supervision complexity to progressively increase, thus allowing even a weak student to learn.

Lastly, online distillation is highly effective at matching the teacher and student NTK matrices. This transfers relational knowledge in the form of example-pair similarity, as opposed to standard distillation, which only transfers per-example knowledge.

Talisman Menswear's answering machine message captures the current situation perfectly. "Please don't leave a message regarding the face masks — unfortunately, I'm receiving hundreds of calls and can't keep up," says owner Paul Jerome.

Since the Victorian Government announced that mask-wearing would be mandatory for regional Victorians starting Monday, the demand has only intensified. On Thursday and Friday alone, Mr. Jerome received hundreds of orders. In addition to being overwhelmed by calls, he is also struggling to source enough elastic to fulfill all the requests. After local suppliers ran out of stock, Mr. Jerome began importing rolls of elastic from the United States, but they have been taking nearly two weeks to arrive. "Elastic is the new toilet paper," he remarked.

Each triple-layered mask takes Mr. Jerome about 30 minutes to make, and he has been working 14- to 15-hour days to meet the demand. "Just a fortnight ago on Sunday, I worked 21 hours and made 53 masks," he shared.

As a result, masks are strictly made to order, with a limit of four masks per order. Inquiries can only be made via the Talisman Menswear Facebook page, not by phone or text.

To make matters worse, Mr. Jerome has been dealing with customers frustrated by the 10-day turnaround and the $20 price per mask. He urges the community to be patient and understanding, reminding them that any face covering is better than none. "Everybody is doing the best they possibly can," he said. "Don't be greedy — there are plenty of other people out there making masks. Order what you need to get by, because this is something we'll have to deal with for a while."

El Juzgado de Primera Instancia e Instrucción 1 de Santa Coloma de Farners (Gerona) ha acordado tomar declaración a N.S.L., esposa del presunto autor del doble crimen del pantano de Susqueda, en presencia del fiscal, los abogados de la acusación particular, la defensa y el propio investigado, tras acordar la continuación del procedimiento por dos delitos de asesinato (u homicidio) y un delito de tenencia ilícita de armas. En un auto al que ha tenido acceso Europa Press, el juez concede a la defensa un plazo de diez días para que señale cuándo la mujer va a estar en España --se fue a vivir a Colombia de forma definitiva poco después del crimen-- para tomarle declaración, y avisa de que si en dos meses no ha podido ser interrogada, cursará una comisión rogatoria.

El juez considera que existen indicios "más que suficientes" de que J.M.G., el 24 de agosto de 2017 entre las 11.20 y las 11.26 horas, presuntamente mató a los jóvenes M.H.L. y P.M.P. en la zona de la Rierica del pantano de Susqueda disparándoles con un arma, y que posteriormente se deshizo de los cuerpos atándolos a mochilas lastradas con piedras. Detalla todos los indicios recabados hasta el momento contra él, que le sitúan como única persona presente, a la hora en que supuestamente se produjo el crimen, en la zona de la Rierica donde ocurrió --él mismo se sitúa en este punto al testificar ante el juez--.

También cita la "revelación" de un compañero de celda a quien J.M.G. le confesó que fue su hijo quien cometió el crimen y que él solo le ayudó a deshacerse de los cadáveres porque se lo debía al haber matado a su madre: un testigo a quien se le da credibilidad, si bien se descarta que el hijo participara en el doble crimen porque en ese momento estaba en otro municipio. Asimismo, considera que el autor de los hechos conocía a la perfección el pantano y tuvo como motivación "una discusión provocada por un encuentro casual", requisitos que reúne J.M.G. ya que era conocedor de la zona y además sufría una patología que afecta a su ira y control de impulsos.

El juzgado ha acordado realizar más de un centenar de pruebas; entre ellas, citar a 46 testigos, incluidos los padres de los fallecidos, el hijo del investigado J.M.G., y los vecinos y excursionistas que estaban en el pantano el 24 de agosto, cuando ocurrió el doble asesinato, entre otros. Además, ha pedido numerosas diligencias periciales a los investigadores de los Mossos d'Esquadra como varios croquis sobre el recorrido del Opel Zafira con el que las víctimas llegaron al pantano ese 24 de agosto --captados por última vez por una cámara de la presa del pantano a las 10.18 horas--, sobre las posibles rutas en kayak de los jóvenes y del Land Rover Defender del investigado.

El titular del juzgado solicita a los Mossos informe sobre las comunicaciones de las personas bajo la zona de cobertura del pantano, un informe fotográfico del lugar de los hechos, y que junto al Instituto de Ciencias de la Tierra Jaume Almera se analice la piedra hallada en la mochila del joven asesinado M.H.L. y la piedra que estaba dentro de su coche para ver si coinciden con las de la zona de la Rierica, donde supuestamente murieron. Pide a la Unidad central de balística de los Mossos que haga un informe para determinar el calibre y el tipo de arma y la distancia del disparo de cada fallecido, en base al diámetro de los orificios de entrada y salida de los cadáveres, y que se vuelvan a realizar inmersiones en el pantano para encontrar dicha arma y otras pertenencias.

También ordena a la Unidad de medios aéreos de los Mossos para que hagan un informe fotográfico del estado de la plantación de marihuana localizada en los días de la búsqueda de los cadáveres. Asimismo, quiere analizar los terminales informáticos y los dispositivos electrónicos del investigado y su hijo para localizar pistas sobre la munición y el arma empleada en los homicidios, así como nombrar a dos médicos forenses para que elaboren informes sobre las patologías mentales de J.M.G.

عشاق الهواتف الذكية عادة ما ينتظرون مؤتمر شركة أبل للتعرف على منتجاتها الجديدة. تسعى الشركة لجذب المستهلكين من خلال تحسينات في الكاميرا والمعالج بدلاً من تغييرات جذرية في التصميم. حقق آيفون، المنتج الرئيسي للشركة، إيرادات ضخمة بلغت حوالي 137.8 مليار دولار العام الماضي، وهو ما يمثل قرابة نصف عائدات أبل.

يساهم آيفون أيضاً في زيادة مبيعات ملحقات ومنتجات أخرى تقدمها الشركة، مثل Apple Watch. يُعقد المؤتمر عادة في الربع الأخير من كل عام، وتبهرنا الشركة في كل مرة بأجهزتها الجديدة. أعلنت عن نسخة الـ Pro من هاتفها المميز، ويبلغ سعر آيفون 13 برو في السعودية 3750 ريال. من المؤكد أنه سيكون متوفراً في مكتبة جرير. جاء الهاتف بعدة نسخ: 13 ميني، 13 العادي، 13 برو ماكس، واليوم سنتحدث عن نسخة الـ Pro.

آيفون 13 برو يتميز بطول 146.7 مم، وعرض 71.5 مم، وسمك 7.7 مم، ووزن 204 غرامات. أعلنت أبل عن سلسلة هواتفها الجديدة آيفون 13، التي شهدت تحسينات في جودة الكاميرات وسطوع الشاشة بدقة أفضل مع شاشة أوليد الرائعة، وذلك لكل من الإصدارين آيفون 13 mini وآيفون 13.

路透克利夫兰/圣安东尼奥1月8日（记者 Kim Palmer/Jim Forsyth） - 去年12月14日，康涅狄格州桑迪胡克小学发生的校园枪击惨案在全美引发了关于教师是否应该持枪的热烈辩论。随后，多个州推出了针对教师的枪支使用培训课程，其中德克萨斯州和俄亥俄州的参与热度尤为显著。

在德克萨斯州，一位教练透露，原本收费85美元的一个枪支使用培训课程对教师免费开放，结果一推出便吸引了400人报名，令校方不得不增设一个新班。截至目前，已有约460名学员顺利从这两个班次毕业。

与此同时，俄亥俄州的七叶树枪支协会（Buckeye Firearms Association）表示，该协会最新推出的为期三天的枪支使用培训课程已有超过900人报名。这些学员包括教师、行政人员和学校雇员，显示出教育领域对持枪保护校园的关注度不断上升。一些教师甚至表示，即便冒着失业的风险，也决心通过持枪保护学生的安全。

不仅是德克萨斯州和俄亥俄州，犹他州也早在桑迪胡克校园枪击案发生后数日，便有约200名教师参加了由枪支支持者组织的免费培训课程。然而，这些行动引发了广泛争议和反思。

批评人士认为，让教师持枪是一种由疯狂枪迷推动的荒谬理念，只会增加校园的危险性，并让教师偏离教书育人的核心职责。部分教育工作者也明确表示反对此类活动，认为他们的本职工作是教书而非扮演警察的角色。

Tamarcus Robinson, 39, and Caress Stokes-Robinson, 34, from Pensacola, were arrested on Wednesday afternoon following an incident involving a child at a local elementary school. Robinson was charged with cruelty toward a child and was booked into the Escambia County Jail with a bond set at $6,000. Stokes-Robinson faced charges of child neglect and was also booked into the county jail with a bond of $5,000.

The arrest stemmed from a report received by the Florida Department of Children and Families after a school staff member noted a bruised face on a boy who attended the school. The concerned staff member reported the incident, prompting an investigation.

Subsequent investigation revealed that the child had been struck in the face multiple times with a belt by Robinson. Authorities observed bruising on the child's face, noting a red mark on the left side that appeared to resemble a belt buckle. The boy was taken to the Gulf Coast Kid's House for further examination and questioning by investigators.

Stokes-Robinson was questioned over the phone and claimed that the boy's injuries occurred from a fall, but the investigators found the explanation dubious. Both Robinson and Stokes-Robinson were subsequently arrested on the same day as the incident and were in custody by Thursday afternoon. County records showed that they remained detained at that time.

The identities of Robinson, Stokes-Robinson, and their relationship to the child were not disclosed in the redacted arrest report, leaving room for speculation on the dynamics at play in this disturbing incident.

I served as a Seagoing Cowboy, caring for horses being transported to Europe. I recall a time when I attempted to persuade others to join the program, but it was unsuccessful.

Excuses such as "I don't like the sea air," "I hate the ocean," "I can't swim," "What if we get torpedoed? I can't swim," and "I have allergies to horses" were common responses I received when trying to recruit others. While I managed to convince a few, most viewed me negatively, attempting to distance themselves. I always felt a tinge of sadness as I watched them walk away, but I took solace in knowing I had made the effort. Eventually, I stopped trying to persuade them.

Now, as I find myself at sea, I reflect on those I had reached out to. I wonder about their current activities and whereabouts. Upon my return, I sought out each person I had approached, eager to share my experiences. I found that many regretted not joining the program.

英国，3月29日，本该是“脱欧独立日”的这一天，数千民众聚集在伦敦国会外，挥舞国旗，抗议英国脱离欧盟（EU）的进程被推迟。他们高呼公投结果遭到背叛，并对政治瘫痪导致的延迟表达不满。

接近三年前，脱欧公投以52%的支持率通过，这一决定引发了广泛的社会分裂。3月29日本应是英国正式退出欧盟的最后期限。然而，英国国会议员第三次投票否决了首相特蕾莎·梅（Theresa May）与布鲁塞尔达成的脱欧协议，使得议员们对如何妥当进行脱欧，甚至是否能妥善脱欧感到困惑不已。

在阳光下的国会广场（Parliament Square），聚集的群众要求议员尊重多数民意，现场气氛融合了派对与抗议的元素。国会的投票结果让倾向于无协议脱欧的支持者失望，他们高呼：“强硬脱欧，现在就要，梅伊是背信忘义的母牛。”

这些支持脱欧的选民在国会周围游走，举着写有“对政客的信任已死”和“无法自治，自由算什么？”的标语，有些人挥舞着代表英国、英格兰、威尔斯和康瓦尔的旗帜。前欧洲议会议员、疑欧派代表苏珊·伊凡斯（Suzanne Evans）表示，未能在格林威治时间23时准时脱欧的后果将是严重的。她说：“这本应是我们独立日的庆祝活动，但我们现在无法信任议员们的承诺，这真是可耻。”

她进一步指出：“这已超出脱欧本身，是国会与人民的对抗，关系到民主和我们的选票是否有意义。从目前的情况来看，答案是否定的。我们的国家陷入了困境。”

与此同时，狂热的脱欧支持者希望英国立即在没有任何分手协议的情况下退出欧盟，遵循世界贸易组织（WTO）的贸易规则。而在政治光谱的另一端，亲欧派的伦敦市长沙迪克·汗（Sadiq Khan）推出了一项公车宣传活动，车身上写着“我们都是伦敦人”。

À Baudinard-sur-Verdon, ce samedi 16 mai, le temps sera très nuageux au réveil, avec une température moyenne de 14°C en début de journée. Le vent soufflera à environ 5 km/h, avec une direction changeante. La température débutera à 11°C à l'aube pour atteindre progressivement 18°C vers la fin de la matinée. Une légère éclaircie est prévue vers 9h.

Pendant la deuxième partie de la journée, la force du vent fluctuera entre 5 et 10 km/h, tandis que la température diminuera graduellement de midi à 18h pour atteindre 13°C. La direction du vent restera variable. Le ciel restera couvert avec des averses en fin d'après-midi et des pluies entre 17h et 18h.

En soirée, la température restera stable à 13°C. Le vent soufflera toujours à environ 5 km/h avec une orientation instable. Les nuages persistants apporteront des pluies, de la bruine et des averses.

Pendant la nuit, le thermomètre restera constant à 12°C. Les nuages persisteront, avec des averses prévues entre minuit et 6h. Le vent continuera à varier autour de 5 km/h avec une direction fluctuante.

Pour la journée suivante, la température de l'air restera dans la moyenne pour un mois de mai, atteignant en moyenne 16°C, avec un maximum de 19°C vers midi. Le temps sera principalement couvert, avec des averses du matin au soir et des orages en soirée.
