不少司机都认为泊车是个噩梦，尤其是驾驶技术不佳时，容易发生意外。近日，一段惊险的影片在网络上疯传，内容显示一辆黑色私家车在驶出停车位时，不慎撞到旁边的车子，随后发生了险象环生的场面。

据悉，事件发生在圆方的停车场内。一辆黑色保时捷SUV在驶出车位时过早扭转方向盘，不小心碰到了左边的车辆。女司机在情急之下，尝试倒车回到车位，但在没有拉手刹的情况下开门下车查看，导致车子溜后，她被夹在邻柱和车子之间。直到车门碰到柱子，车辆才停下来，场面相当惊险。

不少网民在观看影片后纷纷表示惊讶，有人直呼「差啲畀自己架车夹死」，也有人指出「好多人一撞车就心乱」。有人则指出，车门的开启救了她，如果车门没有被柱子挡住关闭，后果可能更加严重。更有网民专业点评司机的失误，指出她在转弯出车时的角度已经太小，即使是双线转弯也可能会撞到旁边的车。此外，还有人奉劝：「累人累物，不如出街坐的士仲好啦，唔好害人！」

泊车对一些司机来说确实是个难题，尤其是在需要尾入车头向外泊L位时，更容易因「顾得左唔顾得右」而撞到旁边的车辆，结果赔了夫人又折兵。对此，有网民分析了「尾入泊车」的五大好处，帮助司机更安全地停车。

My entire family, quite literally, attended the Academy. It's amusing, really. After you've been around long enough, you start hearing stories that mirror your own.

I remember torturing this poor soul for money when I was just a few hundred years old. During our downtime, he shared his life story with me. Hell is a business like any other, with plenty of tasks that need doing. Young demons like myself either take up federal roles, like torture or security, or they head to the Academy. It really depends on what you want to do, you know?

Anyway, this guy, John, had a life eerily similar to mine. His entire family attended the human equivalent of the Academy—college. He was the only one who didn't fancy the idea of more schooling, thinking it was a racket.

He told me he chose a trade, just like I did. He became a plumber, while I became a torturer. We both dealt with a lot of serious stuff, you know?

John had a rough time; his wife left him, his dog died, and some inexperienced upstart was promoted over him with half the qualifications but double the pay. I might have felt sorry for him if I didn't know why he was down here with us demons.

Child molesters. I mean, really. I get that some desires are uncontrollable, but acting on them is inexcusable.

John mentioned he had considered pursuing a more serious education instead of the two-year program he completed. He said he would have gone for it if not for the ridiculous school loans. He believed a better education could have meant more money, a contented wife, a saved dog, and a promotion. But he just couldn't handle the loans.

I thought long and hard about it. John was so similar to me, and even though he despised schooling, he wished he could have gone.

Whatever. This guy inspired me to get my act together and attend the Academy. His life was a mess simply because he didn't pursue education due to financial concerns?

Sizz'ag'aar could feel his swim bladder pulsing with agitation at the oppressively warming, blindingly bright emissions of the lights in front of him. It was never a pleasant sensation, but he had become used to it with the passage of time and, he supposed, been conditioned to "perform" for the humans when they presented him with the lights. He was still puzzled by the lights. For the last several orbits of this world around its host star, the humans had insisted on shining them upon him, practically every time he went anywhere and attempted to replicate their speech sounds.

Back on the homeworld, bright light was an indicator of a deadly solar eruption, a distressingly common occurrence on Klethoom. Here, though, there was no such negative connotation to the lights. The very first time he had thought it was a hostile gesture, that he had been discovered and that they were going to incinerate him. But it had not been long before he realized that this was just another barbaric practice the humans inflicted upon one another. Certainly not all of the humans merited having the lights shined down on them, but many humans, especially those deemed important, seemed to have to endure it. He took it as an indicator of his skill as an impostor that he seemed to have worked his way into a position where the humans saw him as light-worthy, though he was rather unhappy with the frequency with which they insisted he be illuminated.

It had been many, many orbits before he had cracked the code of the human glyphs. They weren't intuitive, conveying only primitive phonetic information rather than abstract concepts, but at least he could finally recite the matching sounds for each combination of signs. It was an invaluable skill to have acquired, as now the humans would present him with sounds he needed to recite, even if he didn't understand the meaning of any of it.

The human standing under the text-screen, next to the large black lens-box, gestured at him in sequence with his human digits—first all five of the ugly, unwebbed fingers, then four, then three, until there were no fingers left. This was one of many unspoken indicators he had picked up during his many orbits living amongst this world's natives, and he knew it was time for him to begin imitating the humans' speech sounds.

A damning Corruption and Crime Commission report, which was tabled in WA Parliament on Tuesday, found smuggling drugs into jail was as easy as stuffing them down the front of a prison officer's pants. The report found corrupt officers swapped "large amounts" of cash for anabolic steroids, methylamphetamine, and synthetic cannabis. It alleged two former prison officers at the center of the investigation "possessed and supplied steroids and methylamphetamine to prisoners." 

A covert investigation into the security of the state's corrections system has unveiled a "disturbing network" of corrupt prison guards, prisoners, and "organized crime syndicates" smuggling drugs into WA prisons. Lax security in WA's prison system has been the subject of an ongoing Corruption and Crime Commission investigation. There were "multiple instances" of custodial officers associating with criminals and members of crime gangs, using prohibited drugs, smuggling prohibited drugs into prison, and taking bribes in the form of cash and drugs, according to investigators.

The report labeled the state's prison system a "corruption risk hot-spot."

كتب هاني نصر العربي في السبت 15 أغسطس 2020، الساعة 01:14 مساءً - أنت الآن تقرأ خبرًا يفيد بأن الإدارية العليا توجب إعادة محاكمة 4 أساتذة قذفوا رئيس أكاديمية الفنون بالطماطم. تفضل بمزيد من التفاصيل على موقع "الخليج 365".

قضت المحكمة الإدارية العليا، برئاسة المستشار عادل بريك، نائب رئيس مجلس الدولة، وبحضور المستشارين سيد سلطان والدكتور محمد عبد الوهاب خفاجي ونبيل عطالله وأسامة حسنين نواب رئيس مجلس الدولة، بإلغاء قرار مجلس تأديب أعضاء هيئة التدريس في أكاديمية الفنون، وذلك بسبب مخالفته للقوانين المعمول بها. كان القرار السابق يتضمن مجازاة الأساتذة الذين قاموا بالاعتداء على رئيس الأكاديمية وتحريض الطلاب ضده، وهذا القرار جاء بناءً على إحالة رئيس الأكاديمية لهم بسبب سلوكياتهم المسيئة.

وأمرت المحكمة الجهات المعنية في الأكاديمية بتصحيح إجراءات إحالة الأساتذة للمحاكمة التأديبية، لمراجعة التهم الموجهة ضدهم وفقًا للقانون.

وأكدت المحكمة أن من حق رئيس الأكاديمية ممارسة سلطته في إحالة أعضاء هيئة التدريس للمحاكمة التأديبية، ولكن يجب أن تكون الإجراءات محايدة وعادلة. إذا كان هناك تحيز في الإجراءات، ينبغي تطبيق القوانين المنصوص عليها، وفي حال عدم قدرة رئيس الأكاديمية على توفير الحيادية، يجب عليه التنازل عن صلاحياته لآخر. القانون ينص على ذلك وفي حالة عدم تحديد المانع، يلتزم القاضي الإداري بتقديم التوجيهات اللازمة.

على الرغم من عدم وجود تصريح محدد بخصوص هذا الموضوع، إلا أن لزاميات سلوك مؤسسة الأكاديمية تفرض التنازل مباشرة من قبل السلطة الثانوية التي تشغلها نائب رئيس الأكاديمية بدلاً من رئيسها. ولا يجوز لرئيس الأكاديمية ممارسة سلطاته مالم يتوفر الحياد في موقفه.

وأشارت المحكمة إلى أهمية احترام ضوابط المحاكمة التأديبية وضرورة تأكيد مبدأ العدالة فيها. وأكدت على عدم جواز إحالة أعضاء هيئة التدريس للمحاكمة التأديبية في حال وجود خصومية جدية بينهم وبين رئيس الأكاديمية. كما أن مسألة تحديد جدية الخصومية ودرجتها تقع تحت تقدير المحكمة بناء على معطيات القضية.

【明报专讯】在我上个月发表的文章〈哲学角度：从警察国家谈到试当真——以洪席耶理论看「香港电影已死」〉中，引发了不少回应、质问和批判。这是一种可喜的现象，因为只有通过开放的论辩与交流，公共领域才能得以丰富和多样化，这也是民主精神的核心所在。在回应这些问题之前，我认为有必要进一步讨论洪席耶的「感性分配」（Le partage du sensible）概念。

再论洪席耶的感性分配
洪席耶认为，反对派也可以是police的一部分，而未必是真正意义上的「政治」（politique）。在社会规范下，任何角色都有其「位份」（part）。执政者有其显赫的「位份」，但反对派因承载着大众的期许和价值观，也有其「位份」。有「位份」的人即使没有分配资源的权力，他们在社会中还是「被看见」，能够与当权者抗衡、谈判。在社会认可的「分配观」下进行权力或资源的再分配。而「逆民」则没有「位份」，他们往往不被社会「看见」，更遑论被主流或建制的「分配观」认可。他们的呐喊和反抗就是要打破既有的「分配观」，这正是洪席耶所言的真「政治」！

洪氏的政治观与美学观一脉相承。在建制或主流社会下，「感性分配」为社会中的人、物、形式进行分配与定位，以打造「和谐完美」的共同体面貌。「非和谐」或「多余」的东西往往被唾弃，成为一种噪音。因此，我们在「感性」上的认知——美丑、喜恶、好坏等看法，受着既有「位份」的架构及其「分配观」影响。

以影视作品为例，传统美学观在角色设定、故事叙述与情节铺排上，主张系统性、完整性的排序方法和逻辑。传统叙事离不开「起承转合」的方程式；对角色的诠释有着与社会主流价值既定的准则和表现手法；甚至比喻上的处理，其符号系统必然有迹可循。演员的选角符合社会既有的「位份」（如英雄要威风凛凛，女主角要是美人）；人物设定难以离开社会一般的定型与偏好，如对不同阶层或性格的印象易导向传统想像，甚至掉进二元对立。

观众易代入角色，看得入戏，因角色描写往往对应社会中有「位份」的人物。相对于传统的「感性分配」，「艺术逆民」因其对「美」与叙事的逻辑不同，往往被贬抑，不被重视，甚至不被看见。

当毛记电视遇上CapTV
2015年毛记开台时以二次创作和政治戏谑为主打，恶搞TVB、亚视和政府记招等，讽刺社会百态。毛记虽然挑战权威政府与主流电视台，获得网民盛赞其团队大胆创新，但这并不等于是「艺术逆民」。毛记节目在特效、铺排、表演方式等上高度仿效「大台」节目。

Un equipo de investigadoras del Instituto de Física de la UNLP y el Instituto de Química y Fisicoquímica Biológicas de la UBA desarrollaron una innovadora estrategia terapéutica que arrojó excelentes resultados en la recuperación funcional del nervio ciático en un modelo animal. Tras minuciosos estudios de laboratorio, propusieron y demostraron la eficacia de un procedimiento que consiste en amplificar la terapia celular con direccionamiento magnético. Concretamente, las científicas demostraron que la terapia con células madre multipotentes adultas aisladas de tejido adiposo, cargadas con nanopartículas magnéticas de óxidos de hierro y direccionadas con fuerzas magnéticas, permite alcanzar una marcada mejora en la recuperación nerviosa, observándose el restablecimiento de la mielina y la recuperación funcional del nervio ciático.

“Los enfoques farmacológicos y quirúrgicos actuales solo son parcialmente eficaces. Frente a ello, las terapias con células madre adultas han mostrado algunos resultados alentadores y se han identificado como candidatas prometedoras para el tratamiento de la regeneración nerviosa”, explicaron las responsables del proyecto. Se trata de un proyecto interdisciplinario liderado por los grupos de las doctoras Marcela Fernández van Raap de la UNLP y Patricia Setton-Avruj de la UBA, quienes dirigieron la tesis doctoral de la doctora Paula Soto en esta temática.

El mayor obstáculo del proyecto es conseguir un número suficiente de células en el lugar lesionado para producir efectos terapéuticos significativos. "Para superar esa dificultad, nuestra propuesta combina estrategias biológicas con células madre mesenquimales derivadas del tejido adiposo y nanotecnológicas de orientación magnética. Es un procedimiento de gran relevancia, ya que presenta los primeros experimentos in vivo de orientación de ‘células madre magnéticas’ para la regeneración de nervios periféricos. Utilizando un método no invasivo y no traumático, mejoramos el reclutamiento de células en el nervio lesionado, fomentando la remielinización del nervio y su recuperación funcional”, explicaron.

أعلنت وزارة التربية والتعليم، الخميس، توزيع عدد من الكتب المدرسية المتوفرة في المخازن الرئيسية والفرعية من رصيد كتب العام الماضي وذلك في مناطق درنة. وقالت الوزارة، في منشور عبر صفحتها على فيسبوك، إن مكتب شؤون المخازن القبة يشرع في توزيع ما يتوفر من الكتاب المدرسي في المخازن الرئيسية، والفرعية على المؤسسات التعليمية، من واقع المتوفر من رصيد كتب العام الماضي.

أعلن مراقب التربية والتعليم درنة عبدالحميد حماد الطيب، عن الانتهاء من توزيع المقررات الدراسية على طلبة الشهادتين الإعدادية، والثانوية بشقيها الأدبي والعلمي من فائض مكتب المخازن التعليمية درنة. وأوضح في كتاب وجهه لمدير مكتب شؤون المراقبات بالوزارة أنهم خاطبوا المؤسسات التعليمية بعدم إلزام الطلبة بشراء المقررات لمناهج سنوات النقل، لعدم توفرها في مخازن الوزارة الفرعية بدرنة، مؤكداً مخاطبتهم الجهات الرقابية بطلب منع المقررات الدراسية في المحلات التجارية.

في وقت سابق الخميس، حددت اللجنة الوزارية المشكلة لحل أزمة الكتاب المدرسي مدة زمنية قدرها شهرًا من تسليم النسخة الإلكترونية للكتاب المدرسي، وتعهدت بسداد المبلغ المالي بعد تسليم الكمية كاملة لمركز المناهج التعليمية والبحوث التربوية. وقالت اللجنة إن الشركات المحلية والدولية التي سيجري تكليفها تعهدت بتوريد الكتاب على دفعات، وأن أولى الدفعات سوف تُسلم بعد ثلاثة أسابيع من بدء العمل.

يأتي ذلك في أعقاب تكليف القيب برئاسة اللجنة الوزارية المشكلة من قبل حكومة الوحدة الوطنية لإيجاد آلية مثلى لتوفير الكتاب المدرسي بشكل عاجل وتوزيعه على المدارس كافة خلال المدة القريبة المقبلة.

وأعلن مكتب النائب العام، الصديق الصور، الإثنين الماضي، حبس وزير التربية والتعليم بحكومة الوحدة الوطنية، موسى المقريف، على خلفية أزمة عدم طباعة الكتاب المدرسي، بعدما تبين للنيابة العامة من خلال التحقيقات إهمال وتقصير الوزير.

AI-native RAN is a prominent concept driving the evolution of wireless mobile networks by integrating AI throughout the entire RAN architecture. AI has shown significant success in various aspects of RAN design and optimization. These AI-driven RAN workloads can be deployed at the network edge, such as in centralized units (CU) or distributed units (DU). Edge-deployed machine learning (ML) workloads, unlike traditional cloud-centric architectures, are attractive for meeting the latency, scalability, reliability, and privacy requirements of beyond-5G applications. They also offer a compelling solution for privacy-focused multi-vendor deployment scenarios and compliance with data regulations.

However, a common limitation in many AI-driven RAN studies is the tendency to focus on specific RAN problems, features, or use cases in isolation. This often leads to the customization of AI for particular use cases, resulting in specialized AI models. Implementing solutions with specialized AI models in operational RANs can lead to the proliferation of multiple specialized ML models for each downstream task (radio feature), increasing both RAN complexity and operational costs. Managing the independent life cycles of these edge-distributed workloads sharing limited compute resources (such as base stations, CU/DU) poses challenges in terms of availability of labeled data and compute-memory resources that need to scale with denser deployments.

In contrast, a more desirable approach is the vision of a general-purpose AI-native RAN, where a single AI algorithm can handle a wide range of networking operations across the entire protocol stack. Achieving this requires designing an AI algorithm capable of simultaneously managing multiple RAN tasks. Multi-task learning (MTL) is a paradigm that can train a machine learning model to perform multiple RAN-related tasks jointly, drawing inspiration from how humans leverage prior knowledge to learn new tasks efficiently.

Our study aims to address three key research questions: (i) How does the design space of state-of-the-art MTL approaches impact the overall performance of RAN-related tasks in terms of model architecture and weighting strategies?

新冠肺炎疫情持续肆虐全球，不过台湾的防疫工作备受国际肯定，但六都市长在防疫的表现上，近期也开始被关注。根据「QuickseeK」的网路舆情调查显示，好感度方面，台南市夺冠，其次为新北市，垫底的则是高雄市。TPOC台湾议题研究中心透过QuickseeK快析舆情资料库分析，统计自今年1月1日以来，六都市政府在防疫期间的声量，台中市政府、高雄市政府的网路声量，远远超过其他四都。

根据QuickseeK快析舆情资料库的调查，网路也呈现类似的趋势，台南市的网路好感度以0.8夺冠，新北市居次，至于三至六名，依序为台中市、桃园市、台北市及高雄市。根据QuickseeK结果的分析，高雄市政府声量波动很大，但许多是负面声量造成的，喊出封城被网友嘲讽是「封城秀急」，还有抛出高雄市医护人员全面普筛，以及要求敦睦舰队官兵疫调等议题。

但是在满意度方面，则是另外一回事。根据远见调查研究中心资料显示，三月份「六都防疫满意度」调查结果，满意度最高为新北市长侯友宜，其次是台南市长黄伟哲，接续分别为桃园市长郑文灿、台中市长卢秀燕、台北市长柯文哲与高雄市长韩国瑜。

Long ago and even today, an old man wanders in the outlands. He is cursed, and we hope he stays there.

Once, this old man was just an older man, a man of family, name, and a life he could not part from. When his time came, he wished to gamble for another day. Death brought him to the Brothers to strike a bet, for Death is but one face of many.

The Three Brothers decide which tales must end so that others may begin. The youngest prefers the name Misfortune. They say the First Brother arrogantly tried to court Lady Luck, who needed no suitors and punished him with her misdeeds. The middle brother goes by Folly or Plague, depending on his mood. When life first sprang forth from the land, the Second Brother pushed it back down. The Third, the eldest, remains nameless. He is the strongest, with no comparison. We are just beginning to find words to capture part of his title. Perhaps it was he who separated the skies from the world, brought order out of primeval chaos, and now threatens to reclaim it.

A game of cards determined the man's fate. He easily won against the Brothers, who let him go as per their agreement. Death is fair to all, after all. But humanity is never satisfied with what it has.

Thrice, the man stole glory from their hands, taunting them to their faces and igniting their eyes. A small glass filled with water, the elixir of immortality to keep the reaper at bay for as long as desired. A deck of cards to challenge Fate and alter the Brothers' course. A sack to contain the world's evils.

The man aged and squandered his ill-gotten spoils.

He threw the water in the First Brother's face after taking a sip, leaving none in the glass to protect his family.

He played Fate's hand too many times, resulting in bloodshed near his home.

يشمل قياس إنتاجية الأطباء والاستشاريين وحساب التكاليف في المستشفيات
دشّن مدير الشؤون الصحية بجدة الدكتور مشعل السيالي الإصدار الجديد من برنامج تخطيط الموارد البشرية، بحضور مديري الإدارات والمساعدين بصحة جدة.
يشتمل الإصدار الجديد من البرنامج على قياس إنتاجية الأطباء والاستشاريين وحساب تكاليف الموارد البشرية في المستشفيات وفقًا لسعة الأسرة السريرية لكل مستشفى. يُعتبر البرنامج الآلي فعّالًا جدًا في قياس المؤشرات المطلوبة، والمساهمة مباشرة في تحقيق الأهداف المرجوة، بالإضافة إلى زيادة معدلات الإنتاجية.
أكد "السيالي" خلال حفل التدشين على أهمية استفادة الجميع من البرنامج خلال الفترة القادمة، مما سينعكس على سرعة اتخاذ القرارات ومعالجة أي مشكلات تتعلق بالعمالة، وفهم مؤشرات الأداء. كما أثنى على التحسينات في الإصدار الجديد وأشاد بأهمية دعم إنشاء بيئة تساعد الموارد البشرية في تحقيق أهدافها في تحقيق مستويات إنتاجية معيارية.

Brain tumors are a growth of abnormal cells in the brain. Cancerous primary tumors are the most likely to cause severe symptoms, as they spread and cause damage to the surrounding normal brain tissue, raising intracranial pressure. Symptoms range from headaches and nausea to seizures, paralysis, and loss of vision and speech. Additionally, these tumors may cause a hemorrhagic stroke and can result in death within two days. Hence, early discovery is critical to prevent severe degeneration and allows for more treatment options, increasing the chance of recovery.

Segmentation is an important prerequisite to surgery. Manual segmentation requires radiologists to first determine the region of interest (ROI), then manually draw the boundaries surrounding the ROI. Although this is possible in 3D, it is usually done in a slice-by-slice manner by encircling the ROI or annotating voxels of interest. Not only is this time-consuming, but it is also prone to subjectivity, and results are subject to large intra- and inter-expert variability, leading to considerable differences in extracted radiomic values. There is a need for automatic methods to reduce cost, time, and bias.

To address the challenges in segmentation, this paper proposes a region-based anomaly detection method using image inpainting to generate a coarse heatmap, followed by a refinement postprocessing stage. Specifically, we adversarially train a deep convolutional neural network (DCNN) architecture to locate and inpaint missing healthy brain regions. The intuition is that the network will fail to reconstruct unhealthy data that it has not observed in training.

GOLF（Gap of Learning & Field）联盟是国内首个由企业自发成立的学用接轨联盟，致力于推动跨领域知识共享学习平台，帮助大学生提前了解产业动态和学习资源，顺利接轨职场所需技能。联盟成立三年多来，已成功媒合超过千名实习生。为提供更完善的教育学习服务，GOLF联盟官方网站进行全面改版，建立学习数据资料库，记录学员的学习历程，并促进校企之间的合作。

GOLF联盟的创始始于2017年底，由友达光电、仁宝电脑、纬创资通等企业领军，齐聚国内多家企业打造跨产业、跨系所、跨领域知识共享平台。联盟提倡「产学接轨、学用合一」的理念，通过纬创集团的纬育统筹教育学习服务运营，力成科技的教育发展事务推广等举措，为大学生提供丰富学习资源，加深教育资源服务，共同培育未来人才。

GOLF联盟主张提升大学生的职场软实力、跨域学习力和产业专业力。学生可以通过线上学习和线下实作课程，建立完整的职涯学习履历。该联盟通过数据资料库导入官网，学生可以免费观看线上学习资源，报名线下研习实作课程，并申请企业实习职缺，促进学生与校企之间的双向价值链。

GOLF联盟的目标是持续提供大学生丰富的学习资源，深化教育资源服务更多校企，构建优质的产学双向链结平台。通过学习地图，联盟引导学生提升软实力、跨域学习能力和产业专业力，为他们提供实习培训蓝图和产业实习机会。这些举措旨在帮助学生顺利接轨职场，提前熟悉产业动态，为未来的就业做好准备。

I believe that driverless cars could pose significant dangers and potentially cause harm to people on the road. I am concerned that individuals may become overly reliant on these vehicles, leading to a lack of attention to other traffic, pedestrians, and obstacles. Additionally, there are various other factors to consider, including potential consequences, legal implications, and safety laws for those involved in any accidents.

While car manufacturers are striving to ensure that individuals keep their hands on the wheel, there is a risk that people may misuse this newfound freedom, resulting in disastrous outcomes. Although driverless cars are capable of driving, they may struggle to navigate complex situations. While these vehicles are designed to feature heads-up displays, I believe that this could potentially lead to negligence, such as drivers falling asleep, not paying attention, or making poor decisions.

For these reasons, I am hesitant to embrace the idea of driverless cars, as I doubt that everyone would utilize them as safely as intended by the manufacturers. Furthermore, the interaction between driverless cars and vehicles operated by human drivers raises concerns, as the former may not react quickly enough to erratic driving, potentially leading to legal complications for both companies and individuals.

A través de la dinámica de preguntas y respuestas en Instagram, un seguidor, de los casi cuatro millones que tiene, le preguntó a Yina Calderón sobre su odio a ‘Epa Colombia’, debido a los distintos conflictos que ambas han evidenciado en redes sociales. 

Yina Calderón manifestó que quiere reconciliarse con Epa Colombia y lo hizo saber a sus seguidores a través de redes sociales, cuando le preguntaron sobre su relación con la empresaria de keratinas. 

Pero, para sorpresa de muchas personas, la Dj aseguró que no existe ningún odio y, por el contrario, se quiere reconciliar con ella. “Yo no la odio para nada; sí hemos tenido discusiones, pero yo tengo todo el interés de limar asperezas con ella. Es más, la quiero invitar a almorzar, Daneidy ‘te quiero invitar a almorzar’. Almorcemos, hablemos y ya dejar tanta bobada que estamos es pa’ crecer todas”, respondió Calderón.

Además de la invitación a almorzar, Calderón reconoció que Epa algunas veces tenía razón, pero que por cuenta del alcohol no se había dado cuenta. “Ahora que le he bajado al alcohol entiendo que Daneidy, a veces tenía razón en algunas cosas, solo que de pronto no me daba cuenta. Por eso les digo que me gustaría almorzar con ella, hablar y ya, dejar tanta lidia”, añadió.

LUBBOCK, Texas — The Texas Department of Transportation’s (TxDOT) $34.4 million project is underway for completion in spring of 2021. This initiative is part of a statewide effort to enhance safety and involves adding more than 27 miles of cable median barriers to the I-27 corridor in Lubbock and Hale County.

Diana Ascencio from TxDOT explained the significance of the project, which began in January 2021. "The reason that this project is so important is that both the concrete barrier and the cable median barrier are designed to keep drivers from traveling across the median onto oncoming traffic," said Ascencio.

Michael Oliver, senior project manager for West Texas at Webber, noted that the project is ahead of schedule. He urged patience from the public, acknowledging the inconveniences caused by construction. “I would just ask people to be cautious,” said Oliver. “I know it’s disruptive, but there’s no way we can build this project without being some kind of nuisance, but we’re working very hard. We have a lot of talented individuals that are building a quality project.”

In addition to the I-27 corridor project, Ascencio mentioned that TxDOT has other projects underway. These include installing median barriers on US 84 and US 6282.

She is driving home from an amazing date, reflecting on the evening. She thinks about what a gentleman he was, how he opened all the doors for her, how he gently put his hand on her lower back as he escorted her out of the restaurant, and how he looked into her eyes with such tenderness, allowing her to talk all night. Her euphoria is interrupted by some bright lights down the road. As she slows down, she realizes something isn't normal. Terror starts to creep in as her heart beats faster and faster. Suddenly, she slams on her brakes upon seeing a creature she has never encountered before.

Ring! Ring! Ring!

She wakes up, realizing it was just a dream—a dream she has had every night since they took her. She has finally returned home to Earth. In disbelief, she finds a stranger and asks to use their cell phone. Despite the years that have passed, she can't believe she still remembers his phone number. Initially confused and unsure of who it was, he soon realizes and immediately gets dressed to come to her.

"Where have you been all these years?" he asks, filled with concern.

"You won't believe me," she replies, a hint of mystery in her voice.

He studies her and notices she has changed. She is in shape but skinnier, her hair is short and messy, her fingernails look unattended, and her clothes are unlike any style he has ever seen. There are a few scars on her, and her nose is crooked.

"I'll listen to anything you have to say," he assures her, his voice full of sincerity.

"I'm really tired," she confesses. "I just spent days flying at light speed—I mean, traveling. I just want to sleep for a couple of days."

Microservices have brought a significant transformation in the software industry, ushering in a new paradigm for structuring the software development process. This innovative approach involves multiple independent teams managing the entire lifecycle, from development to deployment, of loosely coupled, independently deployable services. Due to their modular nature, microservices are particularly well-suited to the modern software industry, where the ability to release software updates and enhancements rapidly is a crucial competitive advantage.

While microservices offer numerous benefits, they also introduce new challenges, particularly in maintaining consistent software performance. This complexity stems from several factors. First, the inherent complexity of these systems often obstructs the implementation of proactive measures for performance assurance, such as pre-production performance testing. Second, these proactive measures are frequently constrained by time and resources, given the substantial pressure to deliver quickly to the market. Third, microservices systems usually exhibit emergent performance behaviors in the field, which are difficult to predict in advance. Finally, these systems undergo continuous software changes, with multiple releases occurring daily, and handle highly variable workloads, making them more susceptible to unforeseen performance regressions.

These challenges have spurred increased interest in the concept of observability, which is the ability to gain a comprehensive understanding of a system's performance by analyzing its logs, traces, and metrics. Today, distributed tracing tools are widely used in practice to enhance the observability of microservices systems. These tools track the flow of requests, recording the propagation as they traverse different RPCs and services, and provide visual aids, such as swimlane visualizations, to support the performance analysis of end-to-end requests.

Bruxelles propose un budget européen légèrement en hausse, mais avec des coupes dans des secteurs emblématiques tels que l'agriculture et la politique de cohésion. La Commission européenne a plaidé hier en faveur d'un budget post-Brexit de l'UE en augmentation, mais avec des réductions dans des secteurs clés comme l'agriculture. Les subventions directes aux agriculteurs, dont la France est le principal bénéficiaire, seraient moins importantes et orientées vers les petites exploitations. Les "réductions modérées" proposées s'élèvent à 5 % pour la Politique agricole commune (PAC) et à 7 % pour la politique de cohésion, qui sont les deux principales lignes budgétaires de l'UE. Ces annonces ont suscité la colère de plusieurs pays, dont la France. Le ministère de l'Agriculture a réagi rapidement en déclarant qu'elle "ne pourrait accepter aucune baisse de revenu direct pour les agriculteurs", dénonçant une "baisse drastique, massive et aveugle" ainsi que des mesures "inacceptables".

Le mécontentement est également partagé du côté de la Fédération nationale des syndicats d'exploitants agricoles. Christiane Lambert, sa présidente, a exprimé une "grande déception" : "On parle de -5 % mais c'est en réalité -10 % avec l'inflation. Face aux nouvelles priorités, c'est la politique agricole qui en pâtit alors qu'on lui demande toujours plus : être plus respectueuse de l'environnement, monter en gamme et lutter contre le changement climatique, c'est incompréhensible !" La Coordination rurale a également soutenu la position du ministère de l'Agriculture, qualifiant de "inacceptables" les propositions de la Commission.

Pourtant, Jean-Claude Junker a défendu un budget "ambitieux, équilibré et juste pour tous". Le président de la Commission européenne estime également que les coupes proposées ne constituent pas un "massacre", soulignant la nécessité d'augmenter les financements dans d'autres domaines tels que la défense, la recherche ou la protection des frontières extérieures. Malgré la perte de la contribution britannique, le budget proposé par l'exécutif européen est en augmentation, passant à 1 279 milliards d'euros pour la période 2021-2027, contre 1 087 milliards pour les années 2014-2020. Les propositions de la Commission européenne, notamment les coupes dans la politique de cohésion, ont suscité la colère de nombreux autres pays. Certains, comme la Pologne, se sentent également visés par le gel des aides aux pays en violation de l'État de droit, une mesure proposée pour la première fois par Bruxelles.

Las condiciones climáticas intensifican la voracidad de las llamas contra las que luchan varias dotaciones de bomberos que, en conjunto con Defensa Civil de la provincia, buscan extinguir el fuego desatado en la zona de las altas cumbres de difícil acceso en el límite de Tucumán y Catamarca. En el lugar están trabajando tres aviones hidrantes, dos privados que se unieron al del Plan Nacional de Manejo del Fuego, que hacen base operativa en un aeródromo privado de La Cocha, mientras que por tierra al combate lo llevan a cabo 40 brigadistas de dotaciones de la división Bomberos de la Policía, bomberos voluntarios de Alberdi, Tafí del Valle, Concepción, Aguilares, Bella Vista, Alderetes y guardaparques de Los Alisos.

Marcelo Oyola, miembro de Bomberos Voluntarios de Alberdi, habló este mediodía en radio LV 12, y estimó que hasta el momento serían entre 40 y 50 hectáreas las que se ven afectadas en la zona de Yánima, donde llevan a cabo el trabajo al pie de la montaña debido a la imposibilidad de poder avanzar por estas horas. Los incendios en Yánima habrían tenido su inicio entre el “miércoles o jueves de la semana pasada, pero el cuerpo de bomberos de Alberdi hizo contacto visual con los primeros focos, lo que es la cumbre del cerro, el día viernes a las 20.30”, explica el brigadista.

“Hasta el momento no es favorable el panorama para el cuerpo de bomberos que está trabajando en la zona ya que no hay pronóstico de lluvia, hay mucho sol y se activan mucho más rápido. Por ahora está controlado porque no hay mucho viento, pero el calor hace que todo lo combustible arda mucho más rápido“, alertó Oyola.

Corporations today collect their customers' private information to train Machine Learning models that power a variety of services like recommendations, searches, targeted ads, etc. To prevent any unintended use of personal data, privacy policies, such as the General Data Protection Regulation [14] (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act [6] (CCPA), require that these corporations provide the "Right to be Forgotten" (RTBF) to their usersif a user wishes to revoke access to their data, an organization must comply by erasing all information about her without undue delay (typically a month). Critically, models trained in standard ways are susceptible to model inversion [13] and membership inference attacks [31], demonstrating that training data can be exfiltrated from these models.

Periodic retraining of models after excluding deleted users can be computationally expensive. Consequently, there is a growing interest in designing computationally cheap Machine Unlearning algorithms as an alternative to retraining for erasing the influence of deleted data from trained models. Since it is generally difficult to tell how a specific data point affects a model, Ginart et al. [15] propose quantifying the worst-case information leakage from an unlearned model through an unlearning guarantee on the mechanism, defined as a differential privacy (DP) like (ε, δ)-indistinguishability between its output and that of retraining on the updated database. With some minor variations in this definition, several mechanisms have been proposed and certified as unlearning algorithms in literature [15, 20, 30, 24, 17, 32].

This paper proposes a sound definition of data-deletion that does not suffer from the aforementioned shortcomings. Under our paradigm, a data-deletion mechanism is reliable if A) it is stateless, i.e., does not rely on any secret states that may be influenced by previously deleted records; and B) it generates models that are indistinguishable from some deleted record independent random variable. Statelessness thwarts the danger of sustained information leakage through internal data structures after deletion. Moreover, by measuring its deletion privacy via indistinguishability with any deleted-record independent random variable, as opposed to the output of retraining, we ensure reliability in the presence of adaptive requests that can create dependence between current and deleted records in the database.

In general, we show that under adaptive requests, any data-deletion mechanism must be privacy-preserving with respect to existing records to ensure the privacy of deleted records. Privacy with respect to existing records is necessary to prevent adaptive requests from creating any unwanted correlations among present and absent database entries that prevent deletion of records in an information theoretic sense. We also prove that if a mechanism is differentially private with respect to the existing records and satisfies our data-deletion guarantee under non-adaptive edit requests, then it also satisfies a data-deletion guarantee under adaptive requests. That is, we prove a general reduction for our sound data-deletion guarantee under non-adaptive requests to adaptive requests when the unlearning mechanism is differentially private with respect to records not being deleted. We emphasize that we are not advocating for doing data deletion through differentially-private mechanisms simply because it caps the information content of all records equally, deleted or otherwise. Instead, a data-deletion mechanism should provide two differing information reattainment bounds; one for records currently in the database in the form of a differential privacy guarantee, and the other for records previously deleted in the form of a non-adaptive data-deletion guarantee, as these two information bounds together ensure deletion privacy under adaptive requests as well.

However, is indistinguishability to retraining a sufficient guarantee of deletion privacy? We argue that it is not. In the real world, a user's decision to remove his information is often affected by what a deployed model reveals about him. Unfortunately, the same revealed information may also affect other users' decisions. Such adaptive requests make the records in a database interdependent. For instance, if an individual is identified to be part of the training set, many members of his group may request deletion. Therefore, the representation of different groups in the unlearned model can reveal the individual's affiliation, even when he is no longer part of the dataset. We demonstrate on mechanism certified under existing unlearning guarantees, including Gupta et al. [18]'s adaptive unlearning, that the identity of the target record can be inferred from the unlearned model when requests are adaptive. Since it is possible that adaptive deletion requests can encode patterns specific to a target record in the curator's database, we argue that any deletion privacy certification via indistinguishability to retraining, as done in all prior unlearning definitions, is fundamentally flawed.

Is an unlearning guarantee a sound and complete measure of deletion privacy when requests are non-adaptive? Again, we argue that it is neither. A sound deletion privacy guarantee must ensure the non-recovery of deleted records from an infinite number of model releases after deletion. However, approximate indistinguishability to retraining implies an inability to accurately recover deleted data from a singular unlearned model only, which we argue is not sufficient. We show that certain algorithms can satisfy an unlearning guarantee yet blatantly reveal the deleted data eventually over multiple releases. The vulnerability arises in algorithms that maintain partial computations in internal data-dependent states for speeding up subsequent deletions. These internal states can retain information even after record deletion and influence multiple future releases, making the myopic unlearning guarantee unreliable in sequential deletion settings. Several proposed unlearning algorithms in literature [24, 18] are stateful (rely on internal states) and, therefore, cannot be trusted. Secondly, existing unlearning definitions are incomplete notions of deletion privacy they exclude valid deletion mechanisms that do not imitate retraining. For instance, a (useless) mechanism that outputs a fixed untrained model on any request is a valid deletion algorithm. However, since its output is easily distinguishable from retraining, it fails to satisfy these unlearning guarantees.

Based on our findings, we redefine the problem of data-deletion as designing a mechanism that (1.) satisfies a data-deletion guarantee against non-adaptive deletion requests, (2.) is differentially private for remaining records, and (3.) has the same utility guarantee as retraining under identical differential privacy constraints. On top of these objectives, a data-deletion mechanism must also be computationally cheaper than retraining for being useful. We propose a data-deletion solution based on Noisy Gradient Descent (Noisy-GD), a popular differentially private learning algorithm [3, 1], and show that our solution satisfies all the three objectives while providing substantial computational savings for both convex and non-convex losses. Our solution demonstrates a powerful synergy between data deletion and differential privacy as the same noise needed for the privacy of records present in the database also rapidly erases information regarding records deleted from the database. For convex and smooth losses, we certify that under a (q, ε dd)-Rényi data-deletion and (q, ε dp)-Rényi DP constraint, our Noisy-GD based deletion mechanism for d-dimensional models over n-sized databases with requests that modify no more than r records can maintain a tight optimal excess empirical risk of the order O qd ε dp n 2 while being Ω(n log(min{ n r, n ε dd qd}) cheaper than retraining in gradient complexity.

الوكيل الإخباري - كشفت دراسة حديثة عن فوائد مذهلة لتناول الفلفل الحار، مؤكدة أنه يساهم في حل العديد من المشاكل الصحية.

وأوضحت الدراسة أن الفلفل الحار يساعد في زيادة طول العمر، وإنقاص الوزن، بالإضافة إلى الحماية من النوبات القلبية وأنواع معينة من السرطان، وفقًا لما نشرته صحيفة "إكسبريس" البريطانية.

ربط البحث الجديد بين تناول الفلفل الحار وانخفاض خطر الوفاة، وهو ما أكدته دراسات سابقة. حيث قام الباحثون بمقارنة خطر الموت بين 23 ألف شخص، وقسموهم إلى مجموعتين: الذين تناولوا الفلفل الحار والذين لم يتناولوه. وتبين أن خطر الوفاة بسبب النوبة القلبية كان أقل بنسبة 40% بين من يتناولون الفلفل الحار أربع مرات على الأقل في الأسبوع.

وتوصل العلماء، بعد متابعة الحالة الصحية للمشاركين في الدراسة وعاداتهم الغذائية على مدى ثماني سنوات، إلى الفوائد الصحية لاستهلاك هذا النوع من التوابل. يشمل ذلك قدرته على زيادة تكسير الدهون في أنسجة معينة، وكذلك تثبيط آثار بعض البكتيريا والفطريات.

RWMC Chief Inspects City's Cleanliness

Rawalpindi: Following the directives of the Secretary of Local Government Punjab, the Rawalpindi Waste Management Company (RWMC) has launched a Cleanliness Awareness Drive in the city.

As part of this initiative, the CEO of RWMC, Flight Lt. (r.) Asim Ayyub, conducted inspections of various areas in the city to assess the cleanliness situation, according to a press release. He visited Raja Bazaar, Fawara Chowk, Liaquat Road, and Iqbal Road to oversee the sanitation procedures on Wednesday.

During his visit, CEO Asim Ayyub engaged with the public, including local residents, traders, and individuals from various professions, to gather suggestions for enhancing the company's operations. Accompanying him was Senior Manager of Operations, Dr. Hamid Iqbal.

The CEO held meetings with traders and merchants to discuss the cleanliness status of the markets and sought their feedback. He emphasized the importance of proper waste disposal, encouraging traders to utilize the company's waste containers or hand over waste to sanitary workers rather than littering openly. He assured prompt action in case of any reported cleanliness issues.

Acknowledging the value of public feedback, CEO Asim Ayyub assured swift resolution of complaints and invited individuals with inquiries about Solid Waste Management to approach him directly, emphasizing his accessibility to address their concerns.

In a proactive move, the CEO resolved the registration issues of Mini Dumpers in workshops and directed their deployment in various Tehsils of Rawalpindi, including Gujjar Khan and Taxila.

L'ouverture de la procréation médicalement assistée (PMA) à toutes les femmes sera proposée par le gouvernement dans le cadre de la révision de la loi de bioéthique en 2018, a annoncé la secrétaire d’Etat à l’égalité entre les femmes et les hommes, Marlène Schiappa, le 12 septembre.

Dans une déclaration sur RMC-BFM-TV, la secrétaire d’Etat a souligné que cet engagement de campagne du président Emmanuel Macron serait respecté, précisant que cette évolution serait probablement intégrée dans les révisions de la loi bioéthique de l'année suivante, comme l'avait déjà annoncé la ministre de la santé Agnès Buzyn en juillet.

Mme Schiappa a argué que rien ne s'oppose à rendre la PMA accessible légalement à toutes les femmes, se basant sur l'avis favorable émis par le Comité consultatif national d’éthique (CCNE) en juin en faveur de cette ouverture aux couples de femmes et aux femmes célibataires, mettant ainsi fin à une discrimination envers les femmes lesbiennes et célibataires.

Cette mesure est considérée comme une avancée en termes de justice sociale, selon Mme Schiappa, qui a souligné l'importance de mettre fin à l'inégalité entre les femmes capables financièrement de recourir à des PMA à l'étranger et celles qui ne le peuvent pas. Actuellement, la PMA est réservée au traitement de l'infertilité chez les couples hétérosexuels.

En avril, Emmanuel Macron avait exprimé son soutien à une loi élargissant l'accès à la PMA aux couples de lesbiennes et aux femmes célibataires, tout en attendant l'avis du CCNE pour établir un consensus élargi.

Lucas Ocampos anticipó que estaba listo para dar pelea en el campeonato, a pesar de que quedaban tres partidos por jugar. Mostrando confianza, se preparó como un soldado para enfrentar al Wolverhampton. Y cuando el partido se complicaba, conectó de cabeza un centro de Banega y metió al Sevilla en las semifinales de la Europa League.

En la instancia anterior, Ocampos fue clave en la victoria 2-0 sobre la Roma. En el primer gol, arrastró la marca y dejó libre el terreno para Reguilón. Luego, asistió a En-Nesyri para sellar el triunfo. Con su gol ante los ingleses, Ocampos aumentó sus impresionantes números en la temporada: 17 goles y cinco asistencias en 41 partidos.

No hay que olvidar las grandes actuaciones de Ocampos en la Liga de España. A pesar de haber estado tres meses sin actividad, anotó 11 goles en 25 juegos. Fue el goleador del Sevilla en La Liga con 14 tantos y hasta se lució como arquero improvisado en un partido ante el Eibar.

La próxima "guerra" para Ocampos será mucho más complicada. El domingo jugará las semifinales contra el Manchester United. Aunque los Diablos Rojos tienen experiencia europea, el Sevilla ha levantado la Europa League en cinco ocasiones. Ocampos expresó su ambición por ser campeón, pero sabe que enfrentarán equipos fuertes.

Los de Solskjaer saben que tendrán que dar batalla para derribar al soldado Lucas.

The ominous parchment felt almost surreal in Aikarus's hands. Standing near the entrance where he had discovered the peculiar package, he read while scratching his hair with dirty, unkempt fingernails.

> *HOW TO KEEP THE HOMUNCULI AWAY FROM THE BREATH OF LIFE AND MOTION*

> * Place the homunculi inside a circle of salt, near a source of light such as the Sun or the Moon.
> * Using the owner's blood as ink, write the names of the Heralds of Heaven all around the circle.
> * With a silver pin blessed by a true believer, pierce the chest of the homunculi.
> * Spend the entire night praying over the circle, without faltering.
> * Resist the temptations of the dark Wraiths that will come to bargain with you at midnight.
> * When the Sun rises anew, burn the homunculi on a sanctified altar. Do not breathe the smoke that will arise, for it belongs to the Lord.
> This is a Test of Character, with your soul on the line.

Aikarus set the parchment aside and sighed, his fingernails now scratching so hard that they drew a bit of blood from his scalp. Normally, he would have dismissed the package as a silly prank by his friends, but something about it convinced him that it was absolutely real. The parchment was not written by human hands.

"Well, I guess I'll be damned or something," he muttered, tossing the entire package, parchment included, into the trash. "This time you were really, extra naughty, you know." 

Near his feet, his fluffy Pomeranian puppy had the sense to feign guilt, with breadcrumbs still scattered around its snout. It wagged its tail a bit and tried to look cute.

美国公债市场周四出现上涨，主要受到多个因素的影响。投资者对美国总统特朗普的税改计划持怀疑态度，加之朝鲜和叙利亚的地缘政治紧张局势持续，这些都刺激了避险需求。

周四，美国标售的七年期公债获得了强劲的需求，尤其是来自海外央行的间接投标得标率达到了历来的最高水平，达到81.7%，远高于3月的71.1%和65.4%的均值。标售得标利率远低于标售前的二级市场水准，投标倍数达到2.73，高于上月的2.56和均值2.53。这也对美债形成了支撑。

此外，月底买盘也助推了公债的价格，因为机构投资者为了体现投资组合指标预期的改变而进行的买入行为。BMO Capital Markets利率策略师Aaron Kohli指出，美国政府即将停摆的威胁促使投资人不惜代价抢购七年期公债，为中期债券带来了强劲的动能。

在特朗普周三公布仅一页纸的大幅度减税计划后，市场担心这可能会令美国联邦财政赤字猛增。特朗普的减税计划主要针对企业，与国会两党多年来指望的全面税改计划相比显得单薄。BNY Mellon高级固定收益策略师Marvin Loh表示，特朗普提议大规模减税，却没有暗示如何增加收入。

纽约尾盘，指标10年期公债价格上涨，收益率从周三的2.311%降至2.294%。30年期长债也表现类似，收益率从2.97%降至2.962%。短债方面，两年期公债收益率从周三尾盘的1.278%降至1.257%。

周五，投资者将关注美国国内生产总值（GDP）第一季度初值，路透访查的分析师预计为增长1.2%。

En muchos casos, los destinos elegidos para el próximo verano son lugares más cercanos para las personas que planean viajar a principios de 2021. En esta época, la tendencia es realizar trayectos que no estén a largas distancias.

En la ciudad de Buenos Aires, se observa un creciente interés para el próximo verano en destinos cercanos, como el Delta de Tigre, a unos 30 kilómetros del centro porteño. El gerente general de Airbnb para Brasil y Sudamérica, Leandro TristÒo, mencionó que las consultas sobre esta zona han aumentado en un 90%.

TristÒo señaló que las búsquedas de lugares a menos de 80 kilómetros de Buenos Aires se han duplicado en comparación con el año anterior, lo que refleja un cambio en la elección de destinos de los argentinos a raíz de la pandemia por el coronavirus. Este cambio también ha modificado la forma en que viajamos.

En cuanto a los destinos de la costa atlántica, una agencia de viajes en Banfield informó a "Crónica" que Mar del Plata y Pinamar son los destinos más solicitados. En general, la gente consulta más por cabañas que por hoteles al viajar al interior del país, debido al miedo a contagiarse durante el viaje.

AVs rely on sensors and aftermarket devices to collect information from the surrounding environment, enabling them to make informed decisions. Designers face the challenge of balancing accuracy, field of view, system complexity, and cost when selecting and positioning sensors. AV accidents often occur at night or in adverse weather conditions, highlighting the need for improved performance in challenging scenarios.

Innovative techniques, such as integrating image processing and deep learning, aim to enhance the performance of AVs and human-driven vehicles in low light or adverse weather conditions. By predicting the behavior of front drivers based on taillight signals and leveraging wireless communication, this approach can improve safety and communication among vehicles. The study focuses on collecting and labeling datasets, examining AV research, and introducing the proposed approach, with outcomes and future directions discussed in subsequent sections.

In the dark, the visibility of drivers significantly decreases, posing challenges for AVs and human drivers. AVs, with their ability to analyze the environment, react quickly, and make optimal decisions, outperform humans in critical situations, highlighting the role of machine learning in achieving autonomy in vehicles and improving safety and traffic management.

Despite the advancements in AV technology, challenges, such as the impact of adverse weather, the limitations of sensors, and the need for computational efficiency, continue to be areas of focus for researchers and designers. Recommender Systems (RSs) are typically created by analyzing user data, such as user ratings on items. Existing regulations, like the General Data Protection Regulation [EU, 2014], mandate the ability to erase personal data concerning individuals, raising concerns about privacy in RSs. Machine learning models extensively used in RSs have the potential to remember training data [Bourtoule et al., 2021]. Besides deleting the target data, data erasure is also necessary to unlearn the data lineage in RS models. It is advantageous for both users and recommendation platforms to develop an erasable RS that supports unlearning alongside learning. An erasable RS can protect user privacy and enhance recommendation performance through active unlearning, as RS performance is sensitive to training data that may be corrupted by errors or deliberate attacks [Schafer et al., 2007].

Figure 1 depicts the process of learning and unlearning in recommendations. In the learning phase (black arrows), the platform trains recommendation models using user data. During the unlearning phase (blue arrows), the platform erases the target data lineage based on unlearning requests from users. Unlearning requests typically fall into two categories: (i) user-wise erasure (E1) which erases all data from specific user(s), and (ii) data-wise erasure (E2) which erases a portion of user data. To assess unlearning methods, we outline three objectives: G1: Unlearn Completeness, G2: Computational Efficiency, and G3: Model Utility.

Recent research has addressed the challenge of Machine Unlearning (MU) to erase the target data lineage in machine learning models. A common MU approach involves retraining the model from scratch on a new dataset after deleting the target data, achieving G1 and G3 but not G2. Given the substantial computational load of recommendation models, efficiency is a crucial concern for unlearning. To address inefficiency, two types of MU methods have been introduced: retrain unlearning and reverse unlearning [Bourtoule et al., 2021; Schelter et al., 2021; Sekhari et al., 2021]. Retrain unlearning divides the original dataset into subsets and retrains the model on specific subset(s) to reduce computational burden, while reverse unlearning focuses solely on the target data and performs reverse operations.

Unfortunately, these MU methods cannot be directly applied to recommendations due to the prevalent use of Collaborative Filtering (CF) in RSs [Shi et al., 2014], which overlooks collaborative information across users and items. Retrain unlearning restricts each model to utilizing collaborative information within its subset, diminishing total model utility (G3). Conversely, reverse unlearning overlooks collaborative effects with associated data, failing to achieve completeness in unlearning (G1).

In this paper, we address the user-wise erasure issue and introduce LASER as a solution. Following the retrain unlearning concept, LASER naturally fulfills G1 by consisting of two modules: the Group module and Sequential Train (SeqTrain) module. These modules aim to achieve efficient unlearning (G2) while enhancing model utility (G3) by preserving collaborative information. The Group module divides the data into balanced groups for retraining, based on user similarity measured by the distance of collaborative embedding learned through hypergraph.

Norka. Brisas del Mar, La Havane, 1960. ALBERTO KORDA

Le photographe cubain Alberto Korda représente un cas unique. Dans une première vie, au milieu des années 1950, il se distingue dans l'univers de la mode à La Havane. Avec la révolution de 1959, il devient, pendant dix ans, le chroniqueur du castrisme, réalisant le célèbre portrait de Che Guevara que tant de jeunes ont accroché dans leur chambre. En 1968, son studio est brutalement fermé par le régime. Cependant, il ne renie pas la révolution et se tourne vers la photographie sous-marine. Lorsqu'il meurt à Paris en 2001, à l’âge de 72 ans, Fidel Castro, qui assistera à ses funérailles à La Havane, s'interroge : « Comment est-il mort vraiment ? » D’une crise cardiaque, pendant la sieste, dans une chambre d’hôtel. Le dictateur réagit : « Ça, c’est du Korda. »

Ce photographe, qui passe avec une désarmante fluidité de la mode à la révolution, du capitalisme luxueux au communisme en treillis, fait l'objet d'une exposition dans le cadre du 7e festival Kyotographie à Kyoto (quinze expositions, un "off", divers événements). Bien qu'elle ait été présentée dans de nombreux pays, elle ne l'a pas encore été en France. Ce que l’on découvre au Japon n’est pas l’intégralité de l’œuvre de Korda, loin de là, mais un thème qui relie ses deux vies : les femmes et leur beauté. D’un côté, les mannequins qui défilent dans son studio, de l’autre, de jeunes miliciennes qui défilent dans la rue en uniforme et fusil. Tout semble les opposer et pourtant tout les rapproche.

En 1954, La Havane est une capitale moderne. Les boutiques de mode sont nombreuses, les créateurs talentueux. Korda ouvre cette année-là un studio photographique, d’abord dans le centre historique, puis dans le quartier moderne du Vedado, avec ses grandes avenues, hôtels, boutiques de luxe, tours, casinos et studios de télévision. Cet univers consumériste résonne avec le sien. Ses clients incluent diverses marques qui publient ses images sous forme de publicité dans la presse, ainsi que des mannequins ou actrices en devenir cherchant à se faire un nom.

Un regard inédit sur la femme

Le succès de Korda réside dans le regard inédit qu’il porte sur la femme. Alors que la femme était souvent représentée comme brune ou métissée, sensuelle et sexuée, avec des formes généreuses, sous son objectif, elle devient blonde, indépendante, spirituelle, existant par elle-même.

من قبّعات ومفروشات وأجهزة مذياع، يعطي مصمّمون فرنسيون حياة جديدة لبعض المنتجات من خلال "الارتقاء في إعادة تدويرها" كي يصبح "المنبوذ مرغوبا"، مستقطبين اهتمام ماركات كبيرة.

في أوديارب، في إقليم الباسك الفرنسي، يعيش ديدو وجوانا إيتشبيري، وهما شقيقان خرّيجا الفنون الجميلة. جوانا درست لفترة في الغرفة النقابية للتصميم في باريس، بينما تابع ديدو دروساً في مدرسة سان-لوك العليا للفنون في بلجيكا. فازا بجائزة لجنة التحكيم الكبرى لأكسسوارات الموضة المرفقة بمشروع تعاون مع "شانيل" بفضل قبّعات مصنوعة من مواد معاد تدويرها، مثل أصائص زهور وأوعية بلاستيكية وأحذية من المطاط وغرفة هوائية. كما حصلا أيضاً على جائزة "إيرميس" عن سوار من ابتكارهما.

وقد أسّسا الشقيقان ماركتهما "أوانتشوزي" في متجر جدّتهما القديم، حيث يعيشان وسط بيئة طبيعية غنية بالموارد المعاد تدويرها. يقول ديدو: "نجعل المنبوذ مرغوبًا"، ويضيف: "هذا المشروع لا يمكن تنفيذه سوى هنا. ولو كنّا على الساحل، لكنّا ابتكرنا قبّعات من نوع آخر". وتوضح جوانا: "عهدنا الترميم منذ الصغر، فقد كبرنا على مبدأ تحوير استخدام أي قطعة لإعادة استخدامها في مكان آخر".

على بعد 300 كيلومتر في سان-ميدار-آن-جال بالقرب من بوردو، يقوم توما بيتو، الذي كان سابقاً يمارس التزلّج على اللوح، بصنع المفروشات من مواد أعيد تدويرها.

For example, it takes about a month to reach China and two weeks to cross the Atlantic Ocean.

Participating in this program means taking on responsibilities as well. As part of your adventure, you'll help care for animals like horses, young cows, and mules. Following World War II's end, there's a need to support countries affected by the war. You'll be contributing to efforts led by UNRRA (the United Nations Relief and Rehabilitation Administration), which was formed by 44 nations working together.

By joining the Seagoing Cowboys, you're not just seeing new places; you're also helping people in need while having fun doing so. One of your destinations could be Greece or even embarking on a cattle-boat trip—an exciting experience in itself! So if you're considering being part of an unforgettable expedition with purpose and enjoyment intertwined—think about joining us!

Emmanuel Macron veut éviter de froisser les populations et le paysage en ce qui concerne les projets éoliens et solaires. Il affirme qu'il faut savoir adapter ou renoncer aux projets d'éoliennes "au cas par cas" qui, selon lui, peuvent créer trop de tension et dénaturer le paysage. Dans un entretien à franceinfo, il souligne la nécessité de concilier pragmatisme et ambition climatique tout en étant en déplacement en Polynésie française.

Il salue les endroits où les projets en solaire et en éolien sont bien conçus, intégrés harmonieusement dans le paysage et acceptés par la population, générant également des retombées économiques. Il encourage à aller dans cette direction, mettant en avant la stratégie de développement massif des énergies renouvelables dans les territoires ultramarins, tels que la Polynésie, en tant que stratégie de souveraineté.

Emmanuel Macron insiste sur la préservation des paysages français, affirmant que cela fait partie de notre patrimoine, de notre richesse profonde et de notre identité. Il met en avant le solaire par rapport à l'éolien et souligne l'importance d'améliorer la concertation locale pour les projets éoliens, particulièrement lorsque la population locale exprime des réserves.

Le président évoque également le développement du solaire sur les friches militaires, tout en rappelant que le nucléaire est une chance pour la France en termes d'émissions de CO2 par habitant. Il invite à ne pas tomber dans des débats trop généraux sur le nucléaire.

Emmanuel Macron souligne l'importance de la résilience face aux dérèglements climatiques, mettant en avant l'adaptation des infrastructures telles que les hôpitaux, les écoles et les maisons de retraite aux changements climatiques à venir. Il insiste sur l'impératif d'équiper le pays pour faire face aux épisodes de fortes chaleurs de plus en plus fréquents.

Le président aborde également l'adoption par le Parlement du projet de loi climat la semaine précédente, présenté comme un tournant écologique par le gouvernement mais critiqué pour son manque d'ambition par les ONG et la gauche.

When developing visualizations and visualization systems, it is common to enhance charts and graphs with visual elements to convey more detailed and nuanced information about data relationships. These visual enhancements can include textual and graphical annotations, embellishments, and free-form drawings. They serve various purposes, such as communicating insights, supporting collaboration, guiding readers through narrative stories, tracking analytic provenance, and visualizing implicit errors. Research has shown that these augmentations can improve comprehension and retention of visualizations, and free-form drawings can also add playful commentary, user hunches, and ambiguity.

The effectiveness and broad usefulness of visual augmentations have led to the development of design frameworks to help determine how to incorporate augmentations into visualization systems and tools, and to assist designers in creating data visualizations. However, many of these frameworks have been established in a top-down manner, based on expert insights, or through surveys of existing visualizations. What remains less explored are the types of augmentations used when individuals have the freedom to sketch and express various data relationships. Building a design framework from the ground up can help identify common types of augmentations that are more intuitive and understandable to visualization audiences. It can also highlight examples of augmentation designs that are not currently well-supported by visualization tools, and offer guidance on how to improve these tools to better align with user expectations and mental models.

To bridge this gap, we conducted a design elicitation study to define a user-informed visualization augmentation design space. Augmentations have been referred to in various ways, such as embellishments, chart-junk, annotations, and free-form drawings, and, in this paper, we collectively refer to them as augmentations. Drawing on previous research, we define visualization augmentations as visual modifications to a chart or graph, aimed at conveying information about data relationships that are not explicitly captured in the data visualizations.

In our study, participants were presented with 10 prompts, each describing a different data relationship, and were asked to visually represent the meaning of each prompt on a set of printed bar, point, and line charts.

In recent years, short-form videos documenting people's daily lives have become widely popular on social media. This trend has led to a surge in activity videos and significantly facilitated research on video understanding [6, 14, 32, 56, 70, 86]. These videos reveal that most daily activities consist of a series of sequential steps rather than a single action. These steps form a procedure characterized by key steps following a consistent pattern, while different individuals may perform the same activity using varying procedures with step-level differences, as depicted in Figure 1(c).

This paper introduces a novel concept called action task sequence verification, which aims to determine if the procedures depicted in two videos are consistent at the step level. This verification method has broad applications, including instructional training and performance assessment. To clarify this concept, we provide specific definitions for related terms.

- Step: An atomic unit of human action or interaction with an object, typically labeled by a verb, a noun, and sometimes prepositions (e.g., 'remove the old wrapper').
- Procedure: A sequence of steps performed in chronological order to achieve a specific goal (e.g., 'remove the old wrapper - wrap with the new wrapper').
- Task: An activity that must be completed within a defined timeframe or deadline (e.g., 'Rewrap battery' and 'Change the car tire' in COIN).

Tasks can be completed using various procedures, with each video showcasing one procedure for a specific task. Positive pairs (P/N pairs) consist of two videos performing the same procedure, while negative pairs involve videos showing different procedures for the same task.

The need for sequence verification arises from limitations in traditional action tasks such as action recognition, localization, and segmentation. These tasks are often confined to predefined categories and require labor-intensive annotations of steps. Our proposed sequence verification task overcomes these limitations by verifying video pairs based on their embedding space distance, eliminating the need for predefined labels and detailed step annotations, thus enabling handling of open-set settings.

Our sequence verification method focuses on verifying procedures with semantically similar steps rather than those associated with unrelated tasks, emphasizing action step association over background distinctions. The selection of an appropriate dataset is crucial for successful task performance.

أعلن الجيش الإسرائيلي سقوط قذيفة صاروخية أطلقت من قطاع غزة باتجاه منطقة مفتوحة في الأراضي الإسرائيلية.

وقال الناطق باسم الجيش، أفيخاي أدرعي، في بيان صادر اليوم الأربعاء: "تم رصد إطلاق قذيفة صاروخية من قطاع غزة باتجاه الأراضي الإسرائيلية قبل قليل. تم تفعيل الإنذار في منطقة مفتوحة فقط".

وأفادت هيئة البث الإسرائيلية أن "دوي انفجارين على الأقل سُمعا في منطقة مفتوحة بالقرب من مستوطنة شعار هنيغف المحاذية لقطاع غزة".

وفي وقت سابق، كشف وزير التعاون الإقليمي الإسرائيلي، عضو المجلس الوزاري الإسرائيلي المصغر للشؤون الأمنية والسياسية (الكابينيت)، تساحي هنغابي، عن خطط إسرائيلية لشن هجوم على حماس في قطاع غزة.

وأوضح هنغابي للإذاعة الإسرائيلية أن "الجيش جاهز ومستعد للقيام بعملية عسكرية إذا لزم الأمر"، مؤكدًا أن "الكابينيت وافق على خطط لمهاجمة حماس".

ونقل الإعلامي الإسرائيلي من قناة "20" العبرية، أمير أفيغاي، مساء أمس الثلاثاء، تغريدة للوزير هنغابي تفيد بأن "الجيش الإسرائيلي مستعد ومجهز، وأن الكابينيت وافق على خطط لشن هجوم على حماس".

تأتي تصريحات الوزير الإسرائيلي هذه في أعقاب تهديدات مماثلة من المسؤولين الإسرائيليين بشن عملية عسكرية واسعة ضد قطاع غزة إذا استمر التوتر في القطاع. وهدد رئيس الوزراء الإسرائيلي، من أوكرانيا، بإمكانية شن عملية عسكرية قاتلة ضد قطاع غزة إذا لزم الأمر.

One way to cope with the NP-hardness of a problem is through the theory of parameterized complexity, where structured instances are solved faster than worst-case instances by quantifying structure using an additional parameter. Ideally, fixed-parameter tractable algorithms are achieved with running time \(O^*(f(k))\), where \(k\) is the parameter and \(f\) is some computable function. Once such an algorithm is established, the next natural step is to take a fine-grained perspective to determine the smallest possible function \(f\) for this problem-parameter combination. This approach helps in quantifying the precise impact of the considered structure on problem complexity.

We study connectivity problems from this fine-grained parameterized perspective, building upon the breakthrough result of Cygan et al. [19], which introduced algorithms with running time \(O^*(\alpha^{tw})\) for connectivity problems parameterized by treewidth (\(tw\)). The cut-and-count technique played a key role here, reducing connectivity problems to locally checkable counting problems. The obtained bases \(\alpha\) were proven to be optimal, assuming the Strong Exponential-Time Hypothesis (SETH) [17].

However, small treewidth is only possible for sparse graphs, leaving a knowledge gap regarding the precise complexity of connectivity problems in dense structures. In dense graphs, clique-width is a popular parameter. Bergougnoux [2] applied cut-and-count to several width-parameters, including clique-width. Further, Bergougnoux and Kanté [4] leveraged the rank-based approach of Bodlaender et al. [9] to achieve single-exponential running times \(O^*(\alpha^{cw})\) for a large class of connectivity problems parameterized by clique-width. Despite these advances, the bases obtained for specific problems were far from optimal.

For instance, the former article implies an \(O^*(128^{cw})\)-time algorithm for the Connected Dominating Set, while the latter offers an \(O^*((27 \cdot 2^{\omega+1})^{cw})\)-time algorithm for the Connected Vertex Cover and an \(O^*((8 \cdot 2^{\omega+1})^{cw})\)-time algorithm for the Connected Dominating Set, where \(\omega\) is the matrix multiplication exponent (see Alman and Vassilevska W. [1]). These results, with bases as large as 216 and 64 respectively for \(\omega = 2\), indicate potential room for improvement.

We show that the running times for Connected Vertex Cover and Connected Dominating Set parameterized by clique-width can be significantly optimized through novel algorithms. These enhanced algorithms still utilize the cut-and-count technique, fine-tuned by analyzing necessary cut-and-count states, and incorporate techniques such as fast subset convolution, inclusion-exclusion states, and label distinction. We further prove the optimality of these algorithms under SETH by constructing lower bounds through Lokshtanov et al.'s [37] principles. Specifically, we achieve these tight lower bounds: Theorem 1.2 states that assuming SETH, the following hold for all \(\epsilon > 0\): Connected Vertex Cover cannot be solved in time \(O^*((6-\epsilon)^{cw})\), and Connected Dominating Set cannot be solved in time \(O^*((5-\epsilon)^{cw})\).

This work is part of a broader research initiative to determine the optimal running times for various connectivity problems relative to a range of width-parameters, providing a nuanced understanding of the trade-off between generality and complexity. The known results are summarized in Table 1. Cygan et al.'s cut-and-count technique [18, 19], along with their lower bounds, have clarified the complexity relative to treewidth (and pathwidth) for many connectivity problems. Bojikian et al. [10] explore the more restrictive cutwidth, combining cut-and-count with the rank-based approach to enhance treewidth-algorithms or construct more economical lower bounds.

A companion paper [28] provides the first fine-grained parameterized results for connectivity problems parameterized by a dense width-parameter. It introduces modular-treewidth, an extension of treewidth into the dense graph regime via modular decompositions. Modular-treewidth either reduces directly to the treewidth-case or applies the cut-and-count technique to handle complex problems, adhering to different design constraints.

شكراً لقرائتكم **"من هو الطفل منفذ تفجير الشيخ زويد.. ولماذا هاجم السوق؟"**. نؤكد لكم أننا نسعى دائماً لإرضائكم، والآن مع التفاصيل:

---

**التفجير ونتائج التحقيقات الأولية**

بعد ساعات قليلة من وقوع حادث التفجير الانتحاري في سوق الثلاثاء بمدينة الشيخ زويد بمحافظة شمال سيناء، توصلت أجهزة الأمن المصرية إلى معلومات كاملة حول الطفل منفذ التفجير. وأكدت مصادر قبلية لـ"العربية.نت" أن التحريات، التحقيقات، وشهادات شهود العيان كشفت أن الطفل ينتمي لعائلة تقيم بمنطقة "قبر عمير" جنوب المدينة. كما يتم حالياً تحليل الحامض النووي (DNA) للكشف عن هويته. ومن المنتظر أن تعلن الأجهزة الأمنية عن التفاصيل الكاملة بعد انتهاء الفحوصات وتطابق عينات الحامض النووي لأقاربه مع الأشلاء التي تم العثور عليها في موقع الحادث.

---

**اختيار السوق الشعبي كمسرح للتفجير**

وفي سياق متصل، كشف إبراهيم شعير، عضو مجلس النواب المصري عن مدينة الشيخ زويد، أن اختيار السوق الشعبي، الذي يُقام كل ثلاثاء، لتنفيذ العملية يعود إلى سببين رئيسيين:

1. **استهداف الرائد ماجد صبري**، رئيس مباحث قسم شرطة المدينة، الذي نجح منذ توليه منصبه في تقويض الإمدادات والمؤن التي تصل إلى العناصر الإرهابية في المنطقة.
2. **إيقاع أكبر عدد ممكن من الضحايا المدنيين** في السوق، الذي يشهد ازدحاماً كبيراً في هذا اليوم من كل أسبوع.
