قال السيد القصير، وزير الزراعة، إن لدينا 9 مزارع في دول أفريقيا، منها زانزيبار وإريتريا، حيث نستخدمها كمراكز بحثية ومزارع لإنتاج التقاوي. ونتجه نحو فتح مزارع جديدة في دول أفريقيا الأخرى مثل الجزائر وجنوب السودان. وفيما يتعلق بالجلسة الحوارية التي عقدها المجلس الأعلى للإعلام، أضاف السيد القصير: "لدينا أكثر من 20 منطقة معتمدة للاستثمار في قطاع الدواجن على مستوى الجمهورية، ويُعتبر قطاع الزراعة جزءًا من مبادرة حياة كريمة".

وواصل السيد القصير، مشيرًا إلى أنهم كانوا يرويون بالغمر، ولكنهم بدأوا الزراعة على مصاطب لتقليل استهلاك المياه وزيادة الإنتاجية وتقليل استخدام الأسمدة. وذكر أيضًا أن مشروع تبطين الترع يستهلك من ميزانية الدولة ملايين الجنيهات بهدف حماية الترع واستخدامها للري لتعزيز موارد الزراعة. وأشار إلى أنهم الآن يملكون تقديرًا دقيقًا لرؤوس الماشية وجودتها وتوزيعها في المحافظات لتحديد احتياجاتها من الأعلاف والخدمات البيطرية والرعاية، وذلك لوضع سياسة الاستيراد. ولفت إلى أن كل هذه الخطوات لم تكن موجودة من قبل.

وفي سياق آخر، أعلن وزير الزراعة أنه تم البدء في تنفيذ الزراعة التعاقدية وإنشاء مراكز لجمع الألبان لضمان سلامة المواطنين. كما تم تطوير هذه المبادرات وتوقيع اتفاقيات مع وزارة الإنتاج الحربي لتطوير المشروع. وأكد أن هذا العمل سيشهد تقدما كبيرًا خلال المرحلة الحالية.

وأشار وزير الزراعة إلى أن المشروع القومي للبتلو موجه لصغار المربين ويسهم في تحسين معيشتهم، مشيرًا إلى أن عدد المستفيدين من المشروع بلغ 28 ألفًا، وإجمالي عدد الرؤوس تجاوز 300 ألف رأس.

In the book "Automated Reasoning: 33 Basic Research Problems," Larry Wos discusses the challenges faced by computer programs that reason. One of these problems, Problem 31, remains unresolved and is currently the subject of active research. Wos' Problem 31 delves into the properties that an automated reasoning program should possess in order to discover new and interesting theorems, as opposed to merely proving conjectured theorems. The automatic discovery of new theorems is a significant goal in itself and has been explored using various methods within specific areas. However, distinguishing between uninteresting, trivial facts and new, interesting facts is a more challenging task that researchers are tackling using different approaches.

Wos also poses the question of how a reasoning program can effectively select interesting results from a potentially large set of conclusions it can draw. Different fields have encountered questions related to the discovery of new and interesting theorems, with varying approaches to achieving this goal. Some researchers focus on systematically exploring broad mathematical knowledge areas to generate new theorems, while others pursue mathematical discovery within specific domains. These approaches do not aim to solve the problem of automated theorem finding in general but rather to discover new theorems in targeted areas.

While there is existing literature on automated theorem proving and the concept of proving in various disciplines, Wos' problem concerning the discovery of interesting theorems remains unresolved. The challenge of determining whether a theorem prover can produce interesting theorems is further complicated by the undecidability of the problem. This means that there is no algorithmic procedure that can definitively determine if a Turing Machine capable of producing theorems can also generate interesting ones. As a result, evaluating whether a theorem prover can produce interesting theorems requires heuristic criteria and expert input. To address this, expert surveys can shed light on the characteristics of a theorem prover or finder of interesting geometric theorems, and additional surveys can clarify metrics and approaches related to the interestingness of geometric theorems.

The landform on Mars that resembles a face is not a result of alien activity, but rather a natural occurrence. This particular landform stands out among the others on the planet due to its unique shape. While some may speculate about extraterrestrial involvement, it is more plausible that geological processes shaped this formation. If there were indeed aliens on Mars, it is unlikely that they would create just one face-shaped landform and leave it at that. It is more reasonable to assume that this is a product of the planet's natural evolution.

The unusual appearance of the face-shaped landform is likely due to the way it has grown over time. It is not the only landform on Mars, but it is distinctive in its resemblance to a face. If other landforms were to form in a similar manner, they would likely exhibit the same characteristics.

افتتح اليوم الجمعة الشيخ ماجد راضي، وكيل وزارة الأوقاف بالسويس، مسجد عمر بن عبدالعزيز بحي السويس، بعد صيانته وإعادة تأهيله، بناءً على توجيهات وتعليمات الدكتور محمد مختار جمعة، وزير الأوقاف، وإشراف المحافظ عبدالمجيد صقر.

أدي الشيخ أحمد محمد الشحات، مدير إدارة أوقاف السويس، خطبة الجمعة بعنوان «الحج في زمن الأوبئة» في مسجد عمر بن عبدالعزيز.

أكد "راضي" أن جميع الخطباء في المساجد التزموا بموضوع الخطبة الموحدة تحت عنوان "الحج في زمن الأوبئة"، وأنهم لم يرصدوا أي مخالفات بصلاة الجمعة اليوم.

نفى اللاعب الدولي الأرجنتيني سيرجيو أغويرو، نجم نادي مانشستر سيتي الإنجليزي، ما تردد عن رؤية مواطنه ليونيل ميسي، مهاجم فريق برشلونة الإسباني، يتشاجر مع أحد لاعبي "السيتيزنز" عقب المباراة التي جمعت الفريقين مساء الثلاثاء على ملعب "الاتحاد"، ضمن الجولة الرابعة من دور المجموعات لدوري أبطال أوروبا لكرة القدم.

وقال أغويرو في تصريحات نقلها موقع "فور فور تو" البريطاني: "لم أتحدث مع ميسي بعد الخسارة، فعندما تخسر يكون مزاجك سيئاً. لقد رأيته بعد اللقاء، وكان يبدو في حالة سيئة. من خلال معرفتي به، أستطيع أن أفهم متى يكون جيداً ومتى يكون منزعجاً. بشكل عام، لا يوجد أحد سعيد عند الخسارة".

وأضاف قائلاً: "شجار ميسي؟ لم أرَ شيئاً. اعتقدت أن ميسي يتحدث إليّ، لكنه لم يفعل، ثم تحدث لاعبون آخرون مع الموظفين. لم يكن هناك ما يستدعي القلق".

وبحسب صحيفة "إيلاف"، تابع مهاجم مانشستر سيتي بقوله: "سمعت شيئاً ما ولكني لم أفهم ما حدث. عندما يخسر شخص ما، يجب أن تحترمه. ميسي لم يكن في مزاج جيد لأتحدث معه، وأنا احترمت ذلك".

The availability of high-quality and diverse 3D assets is critical in many domains, including robotics, gaming, and architecture. Creating these assets has traditionally been a manual and laborious process, demanding expertise in challenging computer graphics tools.

Recent advancements in 3D generative models have revolutionized the creation of 3D assets, allowing for easy generation from simple text prompts or single images. While optimization-based methods can produce high-quality assets, they often require a significant amount of time, sometimes hours, to generate a single 3D asset. In contrast, emerging feed-forward 3D generative methods have shown exceptional quality and diversity while offering substantial speed improvements over optimization-based approaches.

Introducing the Gaussian Reconstruction Model (GRM) as a new feed-forward 3D generative model has been a significant development in the field. GRM utilizes a sparse-view reconstructor that takes four different views of a 3D object as input and produces the corresponding 3D scene. By replacing the triplane scene representation with 3D Gaussians and employing a transformer architecture, GRM achieves efficient and high-fidelity reconstructions, particularly in capturing fine-grained details.

The GRM model, with its innovative design and utilization of 3D Gaussian splatting, has demonstrated state-of-the-art quality and speed in sparse-view 3D reconstructions. By combining GRM with multi-view diffusion models, it excels in text-to-3D and single image-to-3D object generation, showcasing its versatility and effectiveness in various applications.

In conclusion, GRM represents a breakthrough in feed-forward 3D generative modeling, offering efficient reconstruction capabilities through the use of 3D Gaussians and a transformer architecture. Its success in achieving high-fidelity reconstructions and superior speed makes it a valuable asset in the realm of 3D asset creation for diverse industries.

Deep learning models, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs), have demonstrated human-level performance in various applications, such as healthcare, surveillance, and machine translation. However, in the healthcare sector, most intelligent diagnostic systems are limited to diagnosing only one or a few diseases. Once deployed, these systems cannot be easily extended to diagnose all diseases affecting a particular tissue or organ, such as the skin or lungs, as medical specialists can. The challenge in collecting comprehensive data for all such diseases, due to reasons like privacy concerns and limited data sharing, makes it impractical to train a system capable of diagnosing all diseases simultaneously. A potential solution is to enable these systems with a continual or lifelong learning ability, allowing them to learn to diagnose more diseases over time, without relying heavily, or at all, on the original data of diseases they have previously learned.

Such continual learning, particularly in new classes, could also be beneficial in other applications, such as automated retail stores. However, current intelligent models suffer from a phenomenon known as catastrophic forgetting, where new learning leads to the loss of previously acquired knowledge.

La exembajadora de Colombia en Francia, Viviane Morales, ha denunciado que ella y sus dos hijos fueron víctimas de un asalto en su residencia ubicada en el norte de Bogotá el pasado viernes 9 de julio.

Según informó, el atraco fue perpetrado por varios hombres alrededor de las 7:50 p.m., en medio del partido entre Colombia y Perú. Los asaltantes los amordazaron con corbatas que encontraron en el lugar.

La exfuncionaria informó que los ladrones estuvieron en su casa durante aproximadamente una hora y media y se llevaron joyas, entre otros objetos. Curiosamente, antes de marcharse, los delincuentes devolvieron los computadores y los celulares.

Morales ha confirmado que presentó la respectiva denuncia, y la Policía Metropolitana de Bogotá ha informado que, una vez ocurridos los hechos, recogió los testimonios y los videos de las cámaras de seguridad para llevar a cabo la investigación y dar con los responsables.

"Y en un 11 de noviembre, fue la heroica Cartagena" canta el himno de la ciudad donde inició y finalizó el proceso de independencia de la naciente República de Colombia. El 11 de noviembre de 1811 se expide la primera declaración de independencia del territorio neogranadino, y tiene lugar en la ciudad amurallada bajo el grito “¡Que viva la libertad. Que muera la tiranía!” En ella jugaron un papel importantísimo las élites locales, quienes lideraron el proceso ideológico y democrático para la respectiva declaratoria; sin embargo, en este proceso independentista, también jugaron un papel importante los sectores populares de la época, liderados por Pedro Romero en la movilización de los Lanceros de Getsemaní. En esta ciudad se encontraron indígenas, mulatos, y negros libres que levantaron su voz contra la Corona Española. Desde ese momento, se inició una tradición que congregaría a todo el pueblo cartagenero en torno al folclor, la libertad, la alegría, la religiosidad, la creatividad y las prácticas militares comunes de cada momento histórico. Por tal motivo, la celebración de la independencia de La Heroica se extiende a toda Colombia permitiendo una conmemoración nacional con epicentro en Cartagena.

El 11 de noviembre de 1812, un año después de la declaración de independencia, se convocó en Cartagena una marcha en honor a los valientes héroes que entregaron la libertad. En medio de marchas militares y discursos patrióticos, se conmemoró este importante acontecimiento en el territorio cartagenero. De la misma forma, el tradicional canto Te Deum se abría paso entre las élites desde una narrativa que exalta al Dios poderoso, alaba al Dios de los ejércitos; de este modo, la Iglesia Católica continuó haciendo presencia en las esferas públicas, con la intención de restringir las celebraciones de la gente, y conservar la estructura ceremonial-religioso-político de la fecha. Sin embargo, la diversidad étnica y las tradiciones folclóricas surgieron entre la multitud una vez finalizada la celebración estructural; con máscaras y música viva se produjo el regocijo propio de la libertad, como una nueva manifestación de emancipación de las nuevas élites que se empezaron a formar. De esta manera iniciaron las fiestas de independencia, las fiestas del 11 de noviembre: un primer momento religioso, militar y sobrio, seguido por la alegría del pueblo en los bailes, disfraces y jolgorio. Con el pasar de los años, la idea misma de independencia fue moviendo los ideales de apropiación de la fiesta, de modo que el regocijo terminó por desplazar completamente la postura rígida política y religiosa de la conmemoración de la independencia. Las Fiestas de la Independencia son de la gente.

La independencia de Cartagena fue un proceso en el que todos los sectores de la ciudad participaron desde las diferentes vivencias e ideologías. En este camino, se destacan personajes claves como Pedro Romero, el almirante José Prudencio Padilla y los hermanos Gutiérrez de Piñeres, quienes, desde las esferas superiores de la ciudad, aportaron los ideales políticos, militares y sociales para la construcción de una sociedad libre. También surgieron, desde los sectores más populares, movimientos que representaban los intereses más básicos de la gente, pero no por eso, menos importantes. Los Lanceros de Getsemaní fueron un grupo determinante para derrocar la opresión española, pues manifestaron su inconformidad, dieron sentido a las ideas revolucionarias y asumieron su postura emancipadora. Por su parte, los negros cimarrones fueron una fuerza presente en todo el proceso libertario que, desde antes de la declaratoria de independencia, se aventuraron a lugares desconocidos en huida del poder de los blancos, formando palenques, de los cuales aún siguen algunos vigentes y son patrimonio de nuestra cultura. Desde aquel 11 de noviembre de 1812 y solo con escasas excepciones como en la retoma y el sitio de Murillo, Cartagena no ha dejado de celebrar y conmemorar su hazaña independentista.

Willie Murphy, an 82-year-old bodybuilder, was preparing for bed at her home in Rochester, New York when a man pounded on her door, claiming he needed an ambulance. Despite calling the police, Murphy refused to open the door. However, the man broke in and began skulking through her dark house.

Murphy took matters into her own hands and defended herself fiercely. She clobbered the intruder with a table, poured shampoo in his face, and beat him with a broom until the police arrived at the scene. Murphy recounted the incident, saying, "He was outside saying, 'please call an ambulance because I’m sick. I’m sick.' I’m alone and I’m old but guess how solid I am." She displayed her strength by describing how she attempted to jump on a table but it broke due to her forceful action.

The intruder was subdued by Murphy's resilient defense and was subsequently taken to a hospital for treatment.

Have you ever imagined being in a car with no driver? That scenario may become a reality very soon. I believe that the concept of self-driving cars can introduce several challenges, ranging from determining liability in case of an accident to ensuring the highest possible safety standards. There are three key points to consider that may make you think twice the next time you get behind the wheel: the need for someone inside while driving, the possibility that this necessity may change in the future, and how these cars can alert a passenger if something goes wrong.

Currently, self-driving cars likely require a driver because of potential obstacles such as roadblocks, construction, or other hazards that might lead to a crash or require evasive maneuvers. Additionally, without a human driver present, issues could arise—for example, if another vehicle were to collide with an empty self-driving car. The opposing driver might unfairly blame the autonomous vehicle simply to claim compensation from its manufacturer.

There might be ways to alert standby drivers when their assistance is needed. For instance, if equipped with a screen like those used for DVDs or television shows and an impending accident is detected, the vehicle could either disable entertainment devices or flash warnings on-screen about imminent danger so that drivers can intervene effectively. Alternatively, for those using cell phones for entertainment purposes without such screens available nearby them inside their vehicles themselves , sensors could activate lights beneath rearview mirrors indicating detected risks ahead requiring attention immediately!

Now imagine it's been one-two decades since autonomous automobiles first launched successfully into commercial markets worldwide; perhaps by then there won't even necessarily exist reasons anymore demanding human presence during operation times whatsoever!

**Polonia: Manifestaciones para pedir el veto a la ley que limita los medios**

**Polonia.- Miles de polacos se manifiestan por la libertad de prensa.**

En concentraciones realizadas en más de cien ciudades del país, este domingo los ciudadanos pidieron al presidente Andrzej Duda que vete una ley sobre medios aprobada por el Parlamento el pasado viernes. Esta legislación prohíbe a empresas fuera del espacio económico europeo tener una participación mayoritaria en medios polacos. De aprobarse, obligaría al grupo estadounidense Discovery a vender su participación en la red de televisión privada TVN, conocida por su canal de información crítico con el Gobierno.

Donald Tusk, líder de la oposición y expresidente del Consejo Europeo, ha hecho un llamado a la unidad para conseguir la anulación de la ley. 

«Cuando estemos juntos, cuando seamos solidarios, ganaremos y barreremos a este mal Gobierno. No quedará ni rastro de él», declaró Tusk.

**«Silenciar a los medios que vigilan nuestras espaldas»**

La oposición acusa al ejecutivo populista conservador de Mateusz Morawiecki de querer controlar la justicia y los medios de comunicación. 

«Creo que el intento de amordazar a TVN, porque se trata principalmente de esto, es el nuevo paso para construir un estado autoritario», asegura un manifestante. «Están haciendo esto para facilitar su victoria electoral, silenciando los canales de televisión que vigilan nuestras espaldas».

El partido gobernante Ley y Justicia argumenta que la legislación es importante para la seguridad nacional y evitar que compañías no europeas influyan en la opinión pública.

The 40-acre Turkey Track 7 fire in southern Douglas County, which was started by a human on Tuesday, has been contained by firefighters to 90 percent as of Friday. The fire, located roughly nine miles north of Woodland Park on the edge of the 2002 Hayman Fire area, is primarily fueled by grass and dead trees, according to the U.S. Forest Service.

Despite the containment progress, the area where the fire occurred will remain closed over the weekend.

This article discusses the potential benefits and features of Google's driverless cars, which have been designed to enhance safety and convenience worldwide. Since 2009, Google's driverless cars have demonstrated remarkable safety records, having been driven for more than half a million miles without a crash. Although not fully autonomous, these cars offer various advanced features to assist and alert drivers, ensuring a safer driving experience.

One of the key features of Google's driverless cars is their ability to handle driving at speeds of up to 25 miles per hour. Despite this capability, the cars require drivers to remain attentive, as they are not yet equipped to handle all driving scenarios. When the driver needs to take over, the car notifies them through various means, such as vibrating the driver’s seat, flashing lights, and making announcements, ensuring the driver is prepared to manage the vehicle, especially in the event of unexpected traffic situations, roadwork, or accidents.

The driverless cars are equipped with a special touch sensor, a technology that dates back to the 1980s, when automakers, including BMW, developed speed sensors to create antilock brakes, which later evolved to respond to road dangers.

为了加速学校重开，加州州长纽森提出66亿元经费，帮助学校能够在3月底安全恢复亲身受课。虽然很多学区的工会还是持保留态度，但纽森希望学区至少试一试。

州长纽森周二参观了Palo Alto联合学区的Barron Park小学。该学区的小学在去年秋天就恢复了亲身授课，采用亲身授课和远程教学轮流的混合教学模式。学校校园人数有限，教室内座位重新安排，保持社交距离。体育课每小组仅限3名学生，目的是确保师生安全。

纽森表示：“这证明我们可以在州的其他地方做到这一点，州内并非每个地方都拥有相同的资源，我们不是不知道。”州政府拨出20亿美元奖励在3月内重开的学区，提供资金帮助购买个人防护设备、通风升级和新冠病毒测试等费用。

Palo Alto联合学区小学去年10月已恢复亲身授课，下星期K到12年级学生都可回校上课。学区总监Don Austin表示：“我们是模范。去年10月以来，已有超过2,500名学生返校上课，零传染，有少量病例但未在学区内传播，我们按设计安排小组，我认为我们是榜样。”

尽管有成功经验和州府刺激经费，但仍有很多学区不会立即跟进。Santa Clara县最大的学区，3万名学生的圣荷西联合学区，将原定于4月21日返校，前提是所有教师接种疫苗。纽森表示不会强制学校重开，将继续与学区工会合作。

加州目前确诊率不到3%，单日新增确诊人数由上个月的一万多人下降到两千多人。

在12月21日，高雄举办了「反韩」和「挺韩」的大游行。国民党总统候选人韩国瑜提到：「历任来高雄做市长的人，时间一到说拍拍屁股就走人。」对此，曾任高雄市长的谢长廷在22日通过脸书发表感言，并表示下个月将回台投票。

谢长廷表示：「人隔数千里，魂梦却常相依，老市长想念高雄。」他指出，自己担任高雄市长六年，任期最后两年去了行政院担任院长。他愿意接受批评，但由韩国瑜来谴责市长落跑，是否恰当，社会自有公评。

谢长廷回忆道，1998年他以些微之差当选高雄市长，遵循母亲的教诲「吃人一口还人一斗」，因为高雄人给了这个机会，「我心怀感恩，不敢懈怠」。他全力落实选前承诺的「海洋首都」政见，例如兴建捷运、整治爱河和前镇河、改善自来水品质、活化驳二等旧码头仓库、以及兴建蓄洪池以解决本和里地区的淹水问题。这些在第一任期大致完成，剩下的如红毛港迁村、铁路地下化和世运主场馆等项目，都需要中央的庞大预算支持，因此在第七年他去了中央，担任行政院长期间批准了这些陈年旧案。然而，他在高雄并没有做满任期，被批评为落跑市长。

为了完成高雄捷运，谢长廷指出自己曾被国民党立委邱毅抹黑成高捷弊案15件的贪污恶人，兴建巨蛋也被检举图利，最后却没有一件起诉。他表示，如果当时不做，原设计的数据会变动，物价高涨，高雄可能和台北以外的县市一样，不再有兴建地下捷运的机会。因此，他无惧干扰和压力，坚持加速兴建，虽然经历多年讼累，但迄今无怨无悔。

Pour éviter la propagation du coronavirus, faut-il proscrire les paiements en espèces ? La question, bien que surprenante, est d'une importance réelle. Contrairement à de nombreux autres pays, en France, le cash reste le moyen de paiement principal, représentant à lui seul 68 % des transactions effectuées en magasin. Voici quelques éléments de réponse.

**Les espèces peuvent-elles transmettre le coronavirus ?**

Le ministère de la Santé, reprenant les termes de l'Organisation mondiale de la santé (OMS), assure que « le risque d'être infecté par le Covid-19 en touchant des pièces de monnaie, billets de banque ou cartes de crédit, est très faible ». La Banque de France et la banque centrale européenne (BCE) précisent également qu'« il n'existe aucune preuve que des virus tels que le coronavirus aient été propagés par les billets ».

Selon la Banque de France, « comme pour la grippe saisonnière et comme sur toute autre surface, les gouttelettes respiratoires d'une personne infectée déposées sur un billet de banque pourraient survivre pendant une période limitée, mais pas significative pour être un vecteur majeur de transmission ». Comparé à d'autres surfaces comme des poignées de porte ou des paniers à provisions, la probabilité de contagion par un billet est moindre.

Alexandre Bleibtreu, médecin-infectiologue à l'hôpital de la Pitié-Salpêtrière à Paris, se veut rassurant : « Le risque est infime. Il peut se transmettre si l'on ne respecte pas les mesures d'hygiène de base, mais a priori, il n'y a pas plus de risque qu'avec une carte bancaire ou un téléphone mobile ».

**Comment s'en prémunir ?**

Il est crucial de respecter les gestes barrières, en particulier le lavage fréquent des mains, pour éviter tout risque de propagation. Alexandre Bleibtreu précise que « le virus résiste entre 4 et 10 minutes sur une surface inerte ». Pour contaminer quelqu'un, il faudrait cracher sur un billet ou le lécher. Cependant, avec une hygiène adéquate, le risque de transmission via les billets est négligeable.

**Le virus sonne-t-il le glas des espèces ?**

Selon Frédéric Micheau, directeur d'études chez OpinionWay, « ce virus accélère le déclin du paiement en espèces enclenché ces dernières années ». Il voit « dans la crise actuelle l'amorce d'un nouveau mouvement de fond », favorisant le paiement sans contact, en plein essor.

**Assiste-t-on à des changements de comportements ?**

La Banque de France ne note, à ce jour, aucun impact sur la demande de billets ni aucun mouvement significatif en matière de retraits aux distributeurs automatiques. Elle n'anticipe pas non plus un ralentissement de sa production dans les jours à venir.

**Comment réagissent les autres pays ?**

Certains pays touchés par l'épidémie ont pris des mesures drastiques. La Chine, par exemple, a détruit de nombreux billets provenant des zones contaminées et imprimé en urgence de nouveaux billets. Le pays nettoie le reste de sa monnaie avec des ultraviolets ou à haute température avant de les isoler entre sept et quatorze jours. Aux États-Unis, toute monnaie provenant d'Asie est mise en quarantaine avant circulation. En Corée du Sud, la circulation des billets a même été suspendue.

**Quelles mesures de précaution en France ?**

En France, hormis l'appel au respect des gestes barrières, aucune mesure spécifique comme la décontamination des billets n'est prévue. La Banque de France indique qu'aucun billet en euros n'a été retourné d'Asie et que les autres billets, provenant de zones non à risque, sont traités sur plusieurs jours, éliminant tout risque sérieux de contagion.

As most languages exhibit clear gender bias, contributing directly to the perpetuation and reinforcement of sexist ideologies (Harris et al., 2017), it is crucial to identify and highlight these biases in the expanding realm of textual content, including online and printed materials such as educational textbooks.

Historically, efforts to detect gender bias in text focused on the frequency of gendered terms, whereas a feature-based approach concentrates on capturing contextual and semantic cues in the classification process. Word Embedding (WE) and Contextual Word Embedding (CWE) models, currently the predominant textual representation, are susceptible to perpetuating biases ingrained in the training data. Despite attempts to debias these models, research has shown that these methods tend to mask, rather than eradicate, systematic gender biases in word embeddings (Blodgett et al., 2020; Gonen and Goldberg, 2019).

Having a driverless car would be fascinating. These vehicles are designed to operate autonomously, yet it is essential for the driver to retain the ability to take control when necessary. This feature is particularly important in situations like road construction, where human judgment might be more reliable. Therefore, a driverless car that allows manual control in specific situations would be ideal.

Driverless cars, such as those developed by Google, have been tested under specific conditions since 2009. These cars have driven over half a million miles without a crash, which suggests a high level of safety. However, it is important to note that Google’s cars are not entirely driverless, as they rely on alerts to signal the driver to intervene, such as when navigating complex traffic, pulling in and out of driveways, or dealing with roadwork.

One of the appealing aspects of driverless cars is the ability to handle tasks like answering emergency calls, as the driver can be alerted to take control if necessary, ensuring a safe response to the situation. If, however, a driverless car were to cause an accident, the responsibility would, in my opinion, fall to the manufacturer, as they are the ones in control of the car’s design, production, and, to a large extent, its operation.

(Noticias Ya) - Una madre del condado de Highlands permitió que una serpiente mordiera a su hija de un año con el fin de darle una lección. A pesar de las críticas, ella defiende su decisión.

La mujer publicó un video en Facebook en el que se muestra cómo una serpiente llamada "red rat snake" mordió a su bebé, riéndose después de que éste comenzara a llorar, según informó el portal de noticias ABC Action News.

Aunque el video ya ha sido retirado de la red social, la madre aseguró en una entrevista con ABC que no se arrepentía de haber puesto a su bebé en contacto con la serpiente.

La madre relató que encontró a la serpiente en la entrada de la propiedad familiar, ubicada en las afueras de Sebring:

"La serpiente me había mordido a mí y a mi hijo varias veces sin causar ninguna herida", dijo. "Por eso pensé que era una buena oportunidad para presentarla sin que realmente le hiciera daño".

Por su parte, la Oficina del Alguacil del Condado de Highlands está investigando lo sucedido.

"La gente es demasiado sensible", dijo. "Solo piensan que herí intencionalmente a mi bebé, pero las personas que me conocen saben que nunca haría daño a mis hijos".

Aseguró que el niño no resultó herido, simplemente tuvo miedo debido al rápido movimiento de la serpiente.

"Sus dientes son demasiado pequeños para realmente penetrar la piel", explicó al reportero Ryan Smith. "Así que no es peligroso", reiteró.

La madre defiende su decisión y argumenta que es importante que sus hijos aprendan a manejar todo tipo de vida silvestre y sepan de qué deben mantenerse alejados, ya que viven en una propiedad rural de 9 acres en el condado de Highlands.

En la entrevista, mencionó que creció aprendiendo a manejar reptiles ayudando a su padre, y sigue creyendo que sus métodos están enseñando a sus hijos una valiosa lección.

I am against the development of driverless cars. Automotive companies have created impressive products and worked diligently, but I feel this endeavor is ultimately pointless. While driverless cars might offer a few benefits, as mentioned in the passage, no car is entirely autonomous. If the tasks required in a driverless car are the same as those in a regular vehicle, the purpose becomes questionable. I believe driverless cars are unnecessary, likely to be expensive, and encourage laziness.

According to the passage, even in a driverless car, you still need to pay full attention and be ready to take the wheel at any moment. This is the same requirement as in a regular vehicle, where you must be fully attentive and maintain control. The only advantage might be a brief break from steering, but that hardly justifies the technology. People have driven cars for years, and vehicle safety and efficiency have continuously improved, so why do we need technology to take over a task we've managed successfully?

Not only do I find the idea of driverless cars ridiculous, but I also believe they would be very expensive. The passage opens with, "Can you imagine a time in the future when no one buys cars because no one needs them anymore?" If cars aren't being purchased, how will vehicle companies sustain their revenue? Their income would quickly decline, if not disappear entirely. I imagine the cost of driverless cars would be exorbitant, as the advanced technology required would be far more expensive than a standard car.

How hard is it, really, to sit in a car and steer the wheel? Teenagers start driving at the age of 15 or 16, and if driving were overly difficult, I doubt they would start so young.

"Doctor, is there a meeting on the third floor?"

I stepped into Dr. Goodswin's office, but he was nowhere in sight. His chair sat empty, suggesting he had simply stepped out—perhaps to the bathroom or to visit patients. Sighing, I glanced at my energy organizer. I'd been meticulously budgeting my daily energy to avoid depleting it all in my reckless young adult years. I knew I didn't have the energy to search for the missing doctor, so I decided to leave him a memo. Borrowing some paper from his desk, I wrote, "Meeting: 3rd floor, 13:00."

Suddenly, my pen pierced through the paper, revealing a hidden button in Dr. Goodswin's desk. A door swung open behind the filing cabinet, unveiling a new hallway that stretched into the unknown. It resembled the hospital corridors, except for the scuff marks on the floor and the damp air emanating from it. Curiosity tugged at me. Should I venture in? What secret was the doctor concealing?

The hallway was narrow but not confining. I was taken aback by its steep descent. Sticking close to the wall, I pressed onward.

Just as claustrophobia began to set in, the hallway expanded into a series of wider corridors lined with solid steel doors. Someone had gone to great lengths to maintain its cleanliness—it was even more sterile than the hospital itself. But why? What lay here that demanded such stringent sanitation? There was only one way to find out. I quietly pushed open the first door on my left and stepped inside.

It was like something out of a science fiction horror story.

Row upon row of tubes filled with fluid contained babies of various shapes and sizes. As I ventured deeper into the room, I saw the fluid was slowly decaying the bodies. Skin was missing, revealing burst blood vessels and muscles. The white of bone peeked through.

I couldn't bear to stay any longer, but curiosity rooted me in place. Stifling my nausea, I shielded my eyes from the skeletons and pressed on to the room's end.

At the end stood a massive machine resembling a boiler. In front of it was a beaker of glowing liquid, radiating warmth and energy. The heat touched my skin like a cozy radiator.

"... solved one of the greatest problems..."

Voices! They echoed from somewhere behind the machine. I had to hide! In a panic, I crouched beneath one of the pipes and watched as Dr. Goodswin and another scientist approached the beaker. The doctor appeared frazzled, as if he hadn't slept in days, yet he maintained a calm demeanor. His scientist companion chattered excitedly.

"Dr. Goodswin, if what you’re saying is true, you could be hailed as one of the greatest scientists of all time. But..."

Dr. Goodswin interrupted. "You want to see if it truly works, yes?"

He produced a syringe from his pocket, drawing the tiniest amount of the glowing liquid into it and holding it up for the scientist to see. The scientist was practically trembling with excitement. Dr. Goodswin then carefully injected himself with the liquid. The transformation was immediate. His receding hairline thickened into a full head of black hair.

In 1976, an object resembling a human face was discovered on the planet Mars by NASA's Viking 1 spacecraft as it orbited around Mars, capturing images for potential landing sites for Viking 2. This 'human head,' spanning two miles, captured attention as it appeared to gaze back at the cameras from a region on Mars known as Cydonia. The appearance of this 'Face' likely sparked surprise among mission controllers at NASA's Jet Propulsion Lab.

Soon after the unveiling of what appeared to be a 'human face,' the decision was made to reveal it to the public in order to generate interest in Mars. This move succeeded in drawing widespread attention, leading NASA to dub it "Face on Mars," turning it into a global icon that featured in various media for over two decades.

The speculation surrounding this object on Mars reignited discussions about the possibility of life existing on the planet. Even after 18 years following the conclusion of the Viking missions when NASA's MGS arrived at Mars in September 1997, Cydonia remained a focal point for exploration efforts. Chief scientist Jim Garvin emphasized its importance and ensured that capturing images of the Face was prioritized during their mission.

In April 1998, MGS flew over Cydonia and produced an image ten times clearer than those taken by Viking, generating much anticipation among eager spectators awaiting its release. However, due to wispy clouds obstructing visibility, some were left wanting more clarity from this second look at the Face.

Subsequent attempts were made by MGS to capture clearer images of the Face with improved resolution capabilities. In April 2001, a significant breakthrough occurred with an exceptional photo taken by Malin's team showing details comparable in size with landforms found in regions like America’s Western states.

Despite speculations about alien origins or structures linked to intelligent life forms on Mars associated with this enigmatic formation resembling a human head – further detailed examination revealed that shadows creating an illusionary resemblance played trickery upon observers’ eyesight suggesting otherwise - hinting towards other natural geological explanations rather than extraterrestrial involvement.

The many-decades effort to understand, and then replicate, the brain's computational paradigm(s) is far from complete. Although neuroscientific experiment and theory have revealed much about the elements of neural computation, refining and combining them into a cohesive, widely accepted paradigm remains the subject of intensive ongoing research. One line of research targets deep, hierarchical spiking neural networks (SNNs), similar in structure to convolutional neural network (CNN) classifiers. Much of the SNN research targets improved energy efficiency when implementing supervised classification. 

In contrast, the research reported here does not address problems for which state-of-the-art machine learning already excels. Rather, the goal is to tackle a problem for which conventional machine learning methods are less adept, but for which neuromorphic methods appear to be well-suited: online unsupervised clustering. Clustering partitions a set of input patterns into groups where the members of a cluster are more similar to each other than to members of other clusters. An online implementation consumes and processes inputs item-by-item, supporting real-time processing of streaming inputs. Because clustering is achieved online without metadata, the clustering function adapts dynamically to changes in the input data patterns. 

This paper demonstrates that online unsupervised clustering is achievable via a simple, neuromorphic paradigm that can be described as a centroid-based clustering method. Spike Timing Dependent Plasticity (STDP) is at the core of the online clustering mechanism. STDP operates independently at each synapse, using only locally available information, making the learning highly parallel, fast, efficient, and displaying the emergent behavior of a brain-like learning mechanism.

The application of pseudo time-series (PTS) data, characterized by sequential patterns similar to traditional time-series data but lacking a conventional temporal dimension, has attracted significant interest across various fields, including remote sensing, bioinformatics, and medicine. For instance, in hyperspectral imaging, the sequence of bands within each pixel forms a pseudo time-series, capturing variations in spectral signatures. Analyzing these variations is crucial for estimating various physical and chemical properties from the data. In scientific research, obtaining a low-dimensional representation of high-dimensional hyperspectral data is important for enhancing computational efficiency and identifying the most relevant features for specific tasks. This dimensionality reduction is primarily achieved through two methods: Feature Extraction (FE) and Feature Selection (FS).

FE algorithms transform the original data into a reduced-dimensional representation that captures the most relevant information. Examples of such algorithms include Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Locally Linear Embedding (LLE), and Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA). With the advent of deep learning (DL), numerous DL-based methodologies have been proposed for feature extraction in recent years. However, using FE algorithms for dimensionality reduction often compromises interpretability, resulting in the loss of a direct understanding of individual features. Consequently, when interpretability is a priority, FE algorithms may not be the best choice.

To maintain interpretability while reducing data dimensionality, FS algorithms are typically employed. These algorithms involve selecting a subset of relevant features based on defined criteria. Selecting the optimal features from the original set for a particular machine learning task can be formulated as a combinatorial optimization problem, which is often NP-hard. Therefore, traditional FS algorithms, which rely on heuristic searching, cannot guarantee optimality. Each algorithm has its advantages and disadvantages depending on the heuristics used.

Common FS algorithms can be classified into three categories: (a) Filter, (b) Wrapper, and (c) Embedded methods. Filter methods, such as Variance Threshold (VT) and Mutual Information (MI), select features based on statistical measures. Although computationally efficient and algorithm-independent, they fail to capture feature interactions or dependencies, as they assess features independently. Wrapper methods, like Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) and Sequential Forward Selection (SFS), address this limitation by evaluating the performance of different feature combinations, albeit with higher computational costs. This issue can be mitigated with Embedded methods, such as Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (LASSO) and Ridge regression, where feature selection is integrated into the model training process for the specific task. In recent years, several DL-based FS algorithms have been proposed. However, none of the existing FS algorithms are tailored for PTS data, and they do not reduce time complexity by exploring the feature dimension with gradient-based search.

A major challenge in finding an optimal subset of features through gradient-based search is that such searches are designed for continuous optimization, whereas feature indices, representing feature positions in the dimension, are discrete integers. A common solution is discrete relaxation, which involves transforming a discrete problem into a continuous one by allowing variables to take on fractional values. By applying discrete relaxation to PTS data, we can transform the problem into one of continuous optimization using gradient-based search. Ultimately, the target set can be derived by rounding each target index to the nearest integer.

Sheth et al. demonstrated an effective way of utilizing discrete relaxation in feature selection. Their proposed method aims to achieve a set s ∈ {0, 1}^D through gradient-based search, where s_i = 1 indicates the presence of the i-th feature, and s_i = 0 indicates its absence. They obtain such a set by optimizing a cost function inspired by a proposal by Kong et al., representing the residual variance estimate for a subset of features. To perform gradient-based search between discrete integers 0 and 1, they relaxed the discrete search domain to a continuous one using a sigmoid transformation. However, in the context of PTS data, their method shares the same limitation as other DL-based FS algorithms: it does not leverage the sequential pattern in the data. Additionally, they conduct gradient-based search over a relaxed continuous domain (ranging from 0 to 1) for all original features, resulting in a time complexity dependent on the original feature dimensionality. We seek a solution where time complexity depends on the number of targeted selected features but remains robust against the high dimensionality of the original features.

To dissociate time complexity from the original feature dimension, we frame the scenario of feature selection as a supervised machine learning problem to be addressed with a DL-based model that takes high-dimensional PTS data as input and outputs the corresponding response variable. During the training process, only a subset of the original feature indices, matching the specified target size, is used. This ensures that computational complexity depends on the target size, not the original feature size. It also indicates that the number of training samples required does not depend on the original feature size, as model parameters are influenced by target size alone. This is significant since DL-based models typically require more training samples compared to other algorithms. Through training, the subset is updated to represent the set of important features for the supervised machine learning task.

In this research, we propose a DL-based FS algorithm named Feature Selection through Discrete Relaxation (FSDR). FSDR effectively and efficiently selects important features in PTS data, addressing the limitations of traditional algorithms.

En 2015, l'Organisation du commerce islamique estimait le marché mondial du halal à 2.300 milliards de dirhams. Au Maroc, ce segment peine à décoller, la faute à un amalgame entre les aspects business et religieux du secteur. Une niche à exploiter pour les exportateurs est introduite en 2012 par l'Institut marocain de normalisation (Imanor), la certification halal permet d'attester la conformité d'une entreprise ou d'un produit aux normes définies par la religion islamique. 

Le Maroc enregistre depuis 2004 une croissance de 12% dans le secteur du halal, selon l'ex-ministre chargé du Commerce extérieur, Mohamed Abbou. Ce dernier intervenait lors du Forum africain sur le business halal qui se tenait à Dakar en mars 2016. Malgré cette croissance à deux chiffres, la certification halal ne représente visiblement pas une nécessité pour les producteurs, encore moins pour les consommateurs. Christophe Grieshaber, président directeur général d'Evora Maroc, filiale locale de la marque de cosmétiques allemande Evora, affirme que le label peine à devenir un argument de vente majeur au Maroc. "Lorsque nous avons obtenu la certification, nous pensions répondre à un besoin des consommateurs. Mais nous nous sommes rapidement rendu compte qu'elle n'intéressait que peu de clients, notamment les femmes de plus de 50 ans. Les plus jeunes, elles, ne semblaient pas y accorder trop d'importance au moment de l'achat", raconte-t-il.

À ce jour, "environ 100 entreprises ont vu leurs produits recevoir ce label, 90% d'entre elles exerçant dans le secteur de l'agroalimentaire. Le reste exerce dans le cosmétique", précise le directeur de l'Imanor, Abderrahim Taïbi. "Accéder aux marchés étrangers qui exigent une certification halal. La quasi-totalité des produits labellisés est destinée à l'export", poursuit-il. En 2015, le label a été reconnu par l'autorité malaisienne chargée des affaires islamiques (Jakim), ce qui a permis aux produits marocains "de faire leur entrée dans le marché malaisien et de pouvoir être concurrentiels". Par extension, "le label est désormais reconnu dans le groupement économique Asean regroupant dix pays de l'Asie du Sud-est, dont le marché ne compte pas moins de 600 millions de consommateurs", poursuit Abderrahim Taïbi.

Une aubaine pour les exportateurs marocains? "Oui, s'ils arrivent à dissocier le halal religieux du halal business. Il y a aujourd'hui chez les opérateurs marocains un amalgame entre les deux qui freine l'essor des produits voués à l'exportation", répond Hassan Sentissi, président de l'Association marocaine des exportateurs (Asmex). "La majorité d'entre eux estime que les produits sont automatiquement reconnus comme halal, car ils sont produits au Maroc par une main d'œuvre marocaine, donc musulmane. Or, pour les marchés étrangers, ces arguments ne font pas le poids devant un label en bonne et due forme", explique-t-il.

Un manque à gagner pour les PME, Abderrahim Taïbi regrette le "désintérêt" des entreprises marocaines pour le label, qu'il voit comme "un tremplin vers des marchés porteurs", notamment ceux de l'Asie du Moyen-Orient et de l'Asie du Sud-est.

Guirec Arhant, le maire, et Cécile Boeté, la responsable culturelle, ont présenté "Le Petit Guide", qui réunit pour la première fois toute la programmation culturelle et festive de la saison.

La société Coqueliko, basée à Perros-Guirec, a relevé le défi de réaliser un petit guide culturel avec une mise en page rafraîchissante, pour le compte de la Ville. "Cet exemplaire est un premier essai," prévient le maire. "Il est perfectible. Il va au-delà du guide saisonnier habituel des événements municipaux. Il intègre la programmation de tous ceux qui contribuent à l'animation culturelle et festive de la commune : galeristes, librairies, cafés-concerts..."

L'objectif final est d'avoir un guide avec une programmation d'avril à décembre. Pour l'instant, le guide couvre déjà jusqu'à septembre/octobre. Selon Cécile Boeté, responsable culturelle, "toutes les animations sont répertoriées dans un même document et cela change tout."

"L'objectif est d'en faire le petit agenda que l'on garde toujours à portée de main," ajoute Guirec Arhant. Tiré à 20 000 exemplaires, il sera distribué à tous les habitants de Tréguier. Disponible dans les offices de tourisme, chez les professionnels du tourisme et dans les commerces, il est également consultable et téléchargeable sur le site de la Ville. De plus, ce guide offre un avantage supplémentaire ! En effet, en téléchargeant gratuitement l'application Arzone, il sera possible de scanner une page du guide pour accéder à des "contenus virtuellement enrichis" (liens vidéo, audio, images), comprenant des informations pratiques mises à jour.

In "The Flavor Matrix," author James Briscione encourages cooks to explore beyond traditional food and wine pairings by focusing on the fundamental aromatic compounds that often link ingredients in unexpected ways. For instance, in this stir-fry, he pairs the floral, grassy flavors with a New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc, which is also renowned for its "greenness." La Policía Local de Zaragoza ha detenido a un varón de 19 años de edad, de iniciales A. N. P., por un presunto delito de seguridad vial. Al parecer, el joven fue detenido mientras conducía un ciclomotor por el paseo de Cuéllar a las 21:10. Los agentes solicitaron su documentación y permiso de conducir, descubriendo así que nunca había obtenido el carnet.

También se han registrado detenciones por robos. O.K., de 21 años, y A.M.G.A., de 50 años, fueron sorprendidos sustrayendo objetos de un vehículo en la calle Pedro Saputo alrededor de las 2:30 de la madrugada de este jueves. Ambos fueron detenidos por un presunto delito de robo con fuerza. Y.L., de 27 años, también fue detenido por intentar robar dinero a un ciudadano mediante amenazas en la calle Conde de Aranda a las 0:40 de la noche de este jueves.

La Policía Nacional informó de una noche “muy tranquila”. Se reportaron varios hurtos en locales de ocio en la zona de Cesáreo Alierta y Camino de las Torres, sin embargo, no se realizaron detenciones. Estos robos suelen ocurrir en el interior de los bares de las discotecas, implicando la sustracción de teléfonos móviles, abrigos, entre otros objetos. Además, se recibieron llamadas sobre peleas en la misma zona de Cesáreo Alierta, pero al llegar los agentes ya no encontraron a nadie en el lugar.

Durante la noche, a las 2:00, la Policía Nacional detuvo a un hombre que agredió a otro con un taco de madera en un bar ubicado en la calle Burgos. Afortunadamente, se trata de una agresión leve que no requirió atención médica. El hombre fue puesto en libertad tras ser citado para un juicio rápido y su vehículo fue inmovilizado y puesto a disposición judicial.

Do you think the Facial Action Coding System (FACS) is entirely accurate and valuable? In my opinion, it is not. I have three reasons to explain why this technology is not always reliable. For instance, I could be frowning yet feeling happy, showing signs of joy. It is important not to place blind trust in technology, as it can sometimes lead us astray. I find it surprising that people rely on technology to guide them, even when it might lead to the wrong conclusions.

The article states, "For instance, you can probably tell how a friend is feeling simply by the look on her face." I disagree. Often, I ask my friend how she is feeling when she appears grumpy, only to find out she is actually in a good mood. Her facial expression can be misleading. Similarly, people often ask me, "What's wrong?" when, in reality, I am just relaxed. Some people naturally have a serious expression, a fact I have learned the hard way, and it is indeed true.

Relying on technology can sometimes provide incorrect information. I remember when I sprained my foot. I went to the doctor, and the X-ray initially showed nothing wrong. I am, however, grateful the doctor, who, after a thorough examination, discovered that the inner part of my foot was, in fact, sprained, with a slightly bent bone, requiring time to heal.

Claudio Ranieri has strongly criticized Aboubakar Kamara for displaying disrespect towards his Fulham teammates, supporters, and the club by disregarding instructions and taking a crucial penalty, which he missed, potentially jeopardizing their victory against Huddersfield.

Fulham ultimately secured three vital points with a 1-0 win, thanks to Aleksandar Mitrovic’s stoppage-time goal. Earlier in the match, Kamara ignored Mitrovic, the club’s designated penalty taker, opting to take the penalty himself, which was subsequently saved by Huddersfield's Jonas Lossl at 0-0.

Kamara had previously scored from the penalty spot in a 4-1 defeat against Manchester United earlier this month. However, the normally composed 67-year-old Ranieri was visibly upset that Kamara “thought only of himself” and suggested he might consider dropping him from the team for his actions, which Ranieri claimed he had never encountered before.

Ranieri expressed his frustration, stating, “It is not possible to explain what happened after we got the penalty, or maybe I should say it is easy when a man thinks only of himself. It is not right. He didn’t respect me, the club, his teammates, the crowd. He took the ball and just said, ‘I want to shoot.’ He didn’t listen to reason.”

Ranieri continued, “I have spoken a little to him. I think he didn’t understand what I said. Mitrovic was the designated taker, but Kamara scored our last penalty and took it on himself, ‘I am the man.’ He did not apologize, he just told me ‘I wanted to shoot.’ I said to him, ‘If the whole team just said I want to shoot, what would happen?’ It is impossible to speak to this man.”

Ranieri further lamented, “He did not understand the reason; for him, everything is fine, we won the match. It is unbelievable; the first time in my life I have seen that. I understand why the fans might boo him, but of course, it is better if the fans and us are altogether. You must respect the nominated taker.”

Considering Kamara’s future in the team, Ranieri said, “I hope he can understand; it is clearly difficult. I don’t know if that is it, if it is finished or if it will continue. Maybe I will take him away from the squad. But I will do what is best for the squad. If it is good for them, he plays. If I think it isn’t, he comes out. We’ll play the Arsenal match on Tuesday, then I decide. The other players are calm because we won – but not me. It is not important whether we won or lost, it is important what you did and why.”

Mitrovic’s last-minute goal left Huddersfield at the bottom of the Premier League, having lost all seven of their league fixtures this month. Their manager, David Wagner, reflected on their current situation, saying, “Obviously it’s a low point. Not only because we’ve lost seven in a row but how we lost it. It’s a heavy loss we’ve conceded at Fulham. We will need for sure a little bit longer than only 30 minutes afterwards to deal with it. December wasn’t our month, obviously. But for me, it’s not possible to think so quickly after the game about the transfer window or the next game. I have to reflect. It’s very difficult.”

TASAKI最近在巴黎高级订制服装周期间发布了一系列名为「魔法花园」（Jardin Enchante）的珠宝作品，这些作品包括创意总监Prabal Gurung首度为品牌打造的TASAKI Atelier珠宝。此次发布会选择在巴黎丽池酒店举行，TASAKI的珠宝作品与国际珠宝旗舰店并列在芳登广场上，标志着该品牌正式晋升为顶级珠宝行列。以珍珠起家的TASAKI近年来积极转型，不仅大量采用彩宝和钻石，还与国际知名设计师合作推出联名作品，并于去年重金礼聘Prabal Gurung担任设计总监。

跳脱传统珠宝风格，TASAKI特别注重精致细腻的镶工和唯美的设计风格，使其在众多珠宝品牌中独树一帜。例如，一条名为「玫瑰花园」（Jardin de rose）的项链，颈链以祖母绿、紫翡勾勒缠绕弯蜒的枝叶，烘托艳红蛋白石主石的玫瑰花，美得令人屏息。此外，「玫瑰花园」（Jardin de rose）耳环的设计也极具唯美浪漫，玫瑰花鲜艳欲滴。

大自然是造物主的奇迹，想要通过珠宝重现自然之美，是镶嵌工艺的一大考验。Prabal Gurung为TASAKI操刀的首季作品TASAKI Atelier，以山泉、海湾、瀑布、冰河穴四大主题诠释珠宝的超现实之美。珍珠被幻化为飞瀑流泄的水滴，流泄在女人的粉颈上，十分唯美。螺旋耳环坠子上的闪耀钻石则像是伴随涌泉不断往上冒的微气泡，仿佛将山水美景瞬间定格，化为优雅永恒的珠宝作品。

Prabal Gurung首度为TASAKI打造的珠宝作品，以钻石和珍珠呈现「海湾」的意象，而TASAKI设计总监Prabal Gurung也特别诠释了珠宝「绕指柔」的一面。以贵金属和宝石构成的珠宝，通常予人冰冷坚硬的感觉，但TASAKI的作品则如行云流水般弯蜒曲折，展现其柔美的一面。

Reos del penal número 5 en San Cristóbal de Las Casas, Chis., pertenecientes a la organización Solidarios de la voz de El Amate, han informado que varios de ellos presentan síntomas como dolores de cabeza, fiebre, tos y gripe desde el viernes. Ante esto, han solicitado a las autoridades del reclusorio que refuercen las medidas de prevención del Covid-19.

En una llamada telefónica desde la cárcel, también han pedido atención médica y medicamentos, ya que hasta el domingo solo les han dado pastillas para el dolor. Además, han solicitado que se les realicen las pruebas de coronavirus.

Detallan que el viernes 15 de mayo, Mariano Gómez López (53 años), Felipe Díaz Rodríguez (50 años) y Mario Gómez López (39 años) presentaron síntomas compatibles con Covid-19, como dolor de cabeza, escalofríos y flujo nasal. Felipe también sufre de diarrea.

El sábado 16 por la mañana, Mariano Pérez Velasco (40 años), Marcos Gómez López (37 años) y Martín Gómez López (31 años) experimentaron los mismos síntomas. Ese mismo día acudieron a la enfermería del penal, donde el enfermero les proporcionó pastillas de eritromicina y les informó que era el único medicamento disponible.

Más tarde, el sábado por la tarde, Roberto Martínez Pérez (34 años) y Mario Díaz Rodríguez (30 años) también presentaron los mismos síntomas, al igual que los otros seis compañeros.

Los reos temen contagiarse de Covid-19 debido a que el personal entra y sale del penal, y en los últimos días han ingresado algunos reos cuyas condiciones de salud se desconocen.

Además, mencionan que el domingo otros reos, que no pertenecen a Solidarios de la voz de El Amate, también presentaron dolores de cabeza y solicitaron medicamentos, pero no a todos se les proporcionaron.

Venus and Earth share certain similarities but are also distinct in their own ways. While both planets are unique, Venus remains a true mystery. With temperatures reaching about 800 degrees Fahrenheit and a closer proximity to the Sun compared to Earth, Venus intrigues scientists, who speculate that it might be capable of sustaining life. In this discussion, we will explore the characteristics of Venus, how it compares to Earth, and the efforts being made to study and explore it.

Earth and Venus are often referred to as the "twin planets," but significant differences exist between them, notably that Earth can sustain life, while Venus currently cannot. Venus orbits the Sun much faster than Earth, resulting in a shorter year. Although numerous spacecraft have successfully reached Venus, it has been more than 30 years since the last mission. This hiatus is largely due to Venus's atmosphere, which is 97% carbon dioxide, creating a thick, heat-trapping "blanket" that renders the planet extremely hot and inhospitable to humans. The harsh conditions, compounded by natural phenomena such as volcanoes, powerful earthquakes, and frequent, surface-reaching lightning, make Venus a challenging target for exploration.

لم تلبِّ المساعدات الإنسانية التي وُزعت في مدينة الموصل العراقية خلال عيد الأضحى احتياجات السكان الذين يعيشون وسط الأنقاض في البلدة القديمة، بعد مرور أكثر من عام على تحرير المدينة من مسلحي تنظيم داعش في معركة أخيرة أسفرت عن تشريد العديد من السكان وجعلهم متسولين.

ذكرت وكالة "رويترز" أن سكان البلدة الغاضبين التفوا حول شاحنة صغيرة محملة بلحوم بقرتين مذبوحتين، حيث تسارعوا وسط الزحام ومشاعر اليأس للحصول على قطع اللحم من الرجل الذي كان يقف في صندوق الشاحنة، ثم انتظر البعض وصول شاحنة أخرى للحصول على نصيبهم من اللحوم.

قال علي شريف، البالغ من العمر 24 عامًا، للوكالة يوم الخميس الماضي، بعد أن حصل على بعض اللحم من إحدى السيارات: "هناك الكثير من السكان الذين يحتاجون إلى المساعدة في الحصول على الطعام وإعادة بناء منازلهم.. الجميع هنا تضرروا من الحرب".

لم يطرأ تحسن يذكر على حياة المسلمين السُّنة في البلدة القديمة غرب الموصل، منذ أن أعلنت القوات العراقية النصر على داعش. وكان بعضهم قد رحب بوصول المتشددين في 2014، ما أدى إلى ضغوط إضافية عليهم من الحكومة التي يقودها الشيعة في بغداد، والتي يتهمونها بمعاملتهم كمواطنين من الدرجة الثانية.

قال المسؤول المحلي، علي أغا، وهو يتجول في الأزقة الضيقة المتشعبة للبلدة القديمة في الموصل ويقرع الأبواب لتوزيع اللحم: "سنوزع هذا على الفقراء هنا لمساعدتهم، ونسأل الله أن يبارك لنا. حكومتنا لا تفعل أي شيء لمساعدتهم".

لا تزال الكثير من الشوارع الضيقة في البلدة القديمة مليئة بالركام الذي خلفته الضربات الجوية التي نفذتها قوات التحالف بقيادة الولايات المتحدة دعمًا لقوات الحكومة العراقية في حملتها للقضاء على تنظيم داعش، والتي استغرقت تسعة أشهر من المعارك العنيفة.

تظهر بعض المباني المتبقية وكأنها على وشك الانهيار، كما يمكن رؤية أشلاء الجثث وسط الأنقاض، وتفوح رائحتها في المناطق التي شهدت أشرس المعارك غرب نهر دجلة الذي يقسم الموصل، ثاني أكبر مدن العراق.

أسست بغداد "صندوق إعادة إعمار المناطق المتضررة من العمليات الإرهابية" لمساعدة المدن والبلدات التي دمرت خلال معارك تحريرها من المتشددين الذين سيطروا على ثلث مساحة العراق لفترة.

تفيد بيانات الصندوق المنشورة يوم الإثنين، 20 أغسطس/آب، بأن خطة إعادة إعمار الموصل والمناطق المحيطة بها في محافظة نينوى تستهدف إقامة 78 مشروعًا في الفترة 2017-2018 بقيمة 75.5 مليار دينار عراقي (63.69 مليون دولار)، وأضيف إليها مبلغ 135 مليون يورو (154.4 مليون دولار) كقرض من ألمانيا.

لكن الخبراء يتوقعون أن تكلف إعادة إعمار الموصل وحدها، التي كان يسكنها مليونا نسمة قبل الحرب والآن بها 646 ألف مشرد، مليارات الدولارات. وأضاف الصندوق في بيان هذا الشهر أن "قلة المخصصات قياسًا بحجم الدمار" تشكل تحديًا كبيرًا أمامه.

في أوائل أغسطس/آب، عاد حازم محمد، البالغ من العمر 52 عامًا، وأسرته إلى كومة من الأنقاض كانت يومًا ما منزلهم، بالقرب من ملعب كرة قدم سابق تعرض لأضرار جسيمة، وعلى بعد دقائق سيرًا على الأقدام من أطلال مهجورة لا تزال تفوح منها رائحة رفات لم تُستخرج بعد.

نصب محمد خيمة على أطلال منزله القديم لتوفر بعض الظل لأسرته في جو صيفي حار تتجاوز فيه درجات الحرارة 43 درجة مئوية، بينما كانت زوجته تغلي الماء على نار بالقرب من الخيمة، وكان الأطفال يلعبون داخلها.

قال محمد: "قررت أن أقيم مع أسرتي في هذه الخيمة لتشجيع الحكومة العراقية والمنظمات الإنسانية على إعادة بناء منزلي والمنازل الأخرى المدمرة في البلدة القديمة".

Are you looking for a job that goes overseas? Then I have the job for you! You should come join me in the Seagoing Cowboys program. We go overseas to all kinds of countries. Here is some information you might need before you decide to join.

SANTIAGO.- El Tercer Tribunal Colegiado condenó a 30 años de reclusión a un hombre acusado de amarrar y golpear a tres ciudadanos chinos mientras intentaba robar a mano armada en una tienda propiedad de las víctimas.

Los jueces José Rafael De Asís, Alicia Guzmán y Deyanira Méndez declararon culpable a Jesús Rafael Batista por los delitos de robo con violencia, nocturnidad en casa habitada, uso de armas, asociación de malhechores e incendio.

Tras la presentación de la fiscal litigante Isabel Santos, quien demostró la responsabilidad penal del acusado, los jueces ordenaron que Batista pague una indemnización de cinco millones de pesos, además de las costas civiles, junto con la pena de prisión, la cual deberá cumplir en la Cárcel Departamental de San Francisco de Macorís.

El expediente señala que el 21 de febrero de 2018, aproximadamente a las 07:10 de la noche, las víctimas Yun Lu, Zhongkai Lin y Yun He se encontraban trabajando en la tienda Plaza Verano, ubicada en la calle Del Sol, en el centro de la ciudad, junto al acusado Jesús Rafael Batista, quien era su empleado.

El documento agrega que cuando se disponían a cerrar, todos los empleados se retiraron, pero una de las víctimas escuchó un ruido en el segundo nivel del edificio, momento en el que Batista los sorprendió con un arma de fuego, los ató de pies y manos, los golpeó varias veces en la cabeza, mientras los amenazaba con matarlos si no le entregaban la llave de la caja registradora.

De acuerdo con el relato de los hechos, el imputado, quien actuó en compañía de un adolescente, robó un millón de pesos, 30 mil dólares y otras monedas extranjeras, una computadora portátil y tres teléfonos celulares. Además, tomó dos galones de un líquido presumiblemente acetona e incendió el segundo nivel donde se encontraban las cámaras de seguridad y el servidor del sistema de la tienda.

Finalmente, cuchillo en mano, Batista amenazó a las víctimas diciéndoles que si llamaban a la Policía, regresaría al día siguiente y los mataría.

À onze matchs de la fin de la saison, trois clubs costarmoricains et une écurie bretillienne se disputent l’accession en National 3. Une lutte acharnée s’annonce jusqu’au terme du championnat.

**Régional 1**

Les candidats à l’accession sont encore nombreux. Au fil des semaines, les contours de la course vers le National 3 se dessinent peu à peu. Parmi les clubs costarmoricains à l’affût figurent Quessoy, Lamballe et la réserve du Stade Briochin, une équipe dont la montée dépend de la performance de son équipe première en National, pour décrocher le précieux sésame. Les Vitréens, quant à eux, sont déjà hors-jeu pour la même raison. Ainsi, seul Guipry-Messac accompagne les trois clubs des Côtes-d’Armor dans cette lutte acharnée. Cependant, depuis quelques semaines, les Griffons, bien que toujours en tête, perdent du terrain. « Il y a une petite baisse de performance de certains cadres. Nous avons perdu notre capitaine sur blessure en octobre. Nous avons un effectif moins fourni et presque plus aucun joueur du groupe de National 2 ne redescend avec nous. Mais c’est la vie d’un club », reconnaît Jérôme David. Malgré tout, pas question de quitter le fauteuil de leader pour l’entraîneur des Griffons : « On va faire le maximum pour être champions, comme l’année dernière ».

**Lamballe revient fort, Quessoy s’accroche**

Derrière eux, avec une dynamique inverse, se trouvent Julien Bouesnard et les Lamballais. Après un début de saison poussif, ils enchaînent sept victoires consécutives. « La montée ? Oui, c’est l’objectif, on ne va pas se mentir. On préfère ne pas en parler parce que ça porte malheur, mais on l’a quand même dans un coin de la tête », confie l’un des fers de lance de l’attaque la plus prolifique du groupe. « Il faut rester soudés comme on l’est actuellement pour aller au bout ».

Cet état d’esprit est partagé par Quessoy.

Jean-Pierre Pernaut, le légendaire présentateur du journal de 13h sur TF1, le 12 février 2015 dans un studio à Boulogne-Billancourt.

Séquence émotion attendue vendredi sur TF1 : après 33 ans à la tête du journal, Jean-Pierre Pernaut présentera son dernier 13h pour se consacrer, non pas à la retraite, mais à de nouveaux projets, dont une émission hebdomadaire.

Mi-septembre, le journaliste, âgé de 70 ans, avait annoncé sa décision d'arrêter ce journal qu'il anime depuis 1988. « Je n’ai pas de regrets, ça a été une aventure extraordinaire, et je laisse le 13h dans un état formidable », a-t-il assuré lors d'un entretien avec l'AFP.

Après avoir présenté, selon ses propres calculs, environ 7 000 journaux télévisés, Jean-Pierre Pernaut préfère se retirer du journal de la mi-journée alors qu'il est au sommet des audiences et de sa popularité.

Car le succès du « taulier », comme le surnomment ses collègues de TF1, ne faiblit pas : il a encore battu son record d’audience depuis avril 2018, en attirant 5,9 millions de téléspectateurs, soit une part d’audience de 45,8 %.

- Pas de retraite pour « JPP » -

Ainsi, même si « JPP » quitte le 13h, il n'est pas question pour lui de s'arrêter complètement. Bien au contraire, il regorge de projets au sein du groupe TF1, chaîne qu'il a rejointe dès sa création début janvier 1975.

Au programme du « boss » - son autre surnom - le développement de « JPP TV », une plateforme en ligne lancée jeudi pour proposer des sujets régionaux créés par TF1, et le lancement le 9 janvier sur LCI, la chaîne d’info du groupe, d’une émission hebdomadaire intitulée « Jean-Pierre et vous ».

« Ce sera une émission sur l’actualité vue par les Français, qui interviendront en direct avec nous depuis plusieurs régions, pour commenter et réagir », avec des journalistes de LCI qui répondront en plateau à leurs questions.

Sans oublier la réalisation de trois ou quatre longs reportages par an, consacrés aux terroirs, pour le magazine de TF1 « Grands reportages », la préparation d’un livre dont la sortie est prévue pour février, et un projet d'écriture de pièce de théâtre avec sa femme Nathalie Marquay.

Toutes ces activités auront pour fil rouge la proximité avec les régions et leurs habitants, qu'il n'a eu de cesse de promouvoir dans son JT quotidien.

Le ministre britannique des Affaires étrangères, Boris Johnson, a suscité des critiques mardi après avoir suggéré que la Libye pourrait attirer des touristes et des investisseurs une fois débarrassée de ses problèmes. Lors de son récent voyage en Libye, pays en proie au chaos depuis la chute de Mouammar Kadhafi en 2011, Johnson a mentionné l'intérêt des entreprises britanniques pour investir à Syrte. Il a même évoqué la possibilité de transformer Syrte en une sorte de Dubaï en mettant en avant ses atouts naturels et sa population jeune et dynamique, mais a ajouté de façon controversée que le seul obstacle à cette transformation était de "se débarrasser des cadavres".

La carrière politique de Boris Johnson est connue pour ses déclarations polémiques et sa personnalité controversée, qui divise autant ses partisans que ses détracteurs. Emily Thornberry, chargée des Affaires étrangères dans l'opposition, a vivement critiqué ses propos sur Syrte, qualifiant son attitude de cruelle et grossière envers les victimes des conflits passés.

Face à cette polémique, Johnson a riposté sur Twitter en accusant ses détracteurs de manipuler la réalité de Syrte sans connaissance du contexte complexe de la situation. Il a souligné le rôle essentiel de la Grande-Bretagne dans la reconstruction de la Libye, où il s'est rendu à plusieurs reprises cette année.

Cette controverse n'est pas la première pour Johnson, qui avait déjà commis une bourde en qualifiant le continent africain de "pays" lors d'un discours en 2016. Ces dérapages ont suscité des appels à son limogeage, notamment de la députée Jo Swinson du parti Libéral-Démocrate, qui estime qu'il n'est pas apte à occuper ses fonctions actuelles.

【旅奇传媒/记者-王政】在西拉雅国家风景区内，「西拉雅文化」最具代表性。随着90年代平埔正名运动的兴起，西拉雅族人开始了一场「找回自己是谁」的行动，唤醒了原住民对文化和族群的认同。基于对原住民文化的尊重与保护，政府正式将其命名为「西拉雅国家风景区」，使该地区融合了日治、台湾农村和原民文化的多元特色。

为了让更多人了解这个地区，交通部从去年开始积极推动观光圈政策。在政府的大力支持下，大西拉雅观光圈正式形成，以关子岭地区为中心，向外延伸至白河、南寮、东山、后壁、官田、六甲、左镇、盐水等区域，并北扩至嘉义中埔和大埔地区。该观光圈通过体验观光、深度旅游和资源互补的区域整合理念，结合旅游和商品通路，协助补强区域资源不足之处，整合食宿、游购、行等优质资源，形成区域产业联盟，延长观光旅游停留时间，提高品质，建立产销通路，创造游客、业者与政府的三赢局面。

尽管疫情一度使国民旅游市场按下暂停键，但随着台湾疫情趋于平稳，根据中央流行疫情指挥中心的公告，警戒等级降至第二级，市场复苏在即。为此，交通部观光局西拉雅国家风景区管理处宣布「台湾好行─关子岭线」将于今年7月31日起正式复驶，让民众尽情探索西拉雅的优美风光。

「台湾好行－关子岭线」不仅连接了交通节点——高铁嘉义站、南靖火车站、后壁火车站，还串联起享有盛名的台湾四大温泉之一关子岭温泉。其中，南靖火车站是日治时期为应对糖业兴盛而建的车站，也是嘉义县唯一保存原貌的木造车站。附近乡村依然保留着早期眷村的风貌。在火车站对面的南靖糖厂休闲园区，可以品尝招牌的红豆牛奶冰，户外广场还保留着当时的小火车头，见证了糖业时代的繁华与兴衰。

The concept of driverless cars presents both advantages and disadvantages. One positive aspect is that these vehicles can be used until they crash or the owner decides not to use them anymore. Additionally, the implementation of advanced systems such as GPS receivers is beneficial, as it can assist drivers in navigating unfamiliar areas and help prevent accidents by allowing for quick assistance if needed.

A significant advantage of driverless cars is their ability to individually control wheels and reduce power from the engine, which enables far better response and control than a human driver could manage alone. Continuous advancements in computer software are making it possible for these cars to handle more driving tasks independently, potentially enhancing overall road safety.

However, there are notable drawbacks to consider. The possibility of accidents or breakdowns occurring in the middle of the road remains a concern. While technology aims to detect and respond effectively to dangers such as out-of-control skids or rollovers, some people may not recognize imminent threats until they experience them firsthand.

I disagree with certain aspects surrounding driverless vehicles. For example, allowing people to drive while distracted by activities like texting could lead to significant accidents due to their inability to control the vehicle adequately. Additionally, there is ongoing debate about liability in case of an accident involving a driverless car; whether it is the fault of automakers or owners remains contentious.

In 1979, A. Shamir presented the following threshold problem introduced by C. L. Liu regarding eleven scientists working on a secret project in his paper on secret sharing [30]. As a warm-up, we relax Liu and Shamir's assumption and design a physical k-out-of-n threshold padlock system. Our system only requires one padlock and one key per participant, which is practical compared to the previous exponential solution.

Establishing lower bounds on the number of padlocks necessary for any abstract threshold system, we show that for a 2-out-of-n configuration, less than 2 log2(n) padlocks are sufficient if keys can be duplicated. There is an optimal solution for this configuration, requiring O(log(n)) padlocks, which can be realized using our physical system as a building block. However, for k-out-of-n configurations with k ≥ 3, solving the problem with fewer than n padlocks is more complex. We prove that it is impossible for k ≥ √2n, making our physical device optimal in such cases.

Additionally, we are able to provide algorithms building systems for k = 3 with only about 2.5√n padlocks, where each participant owns 3 keys. Discussing more complex access structures, we develop a tentative padlock algebra for logic gates and provide associated algorithms, combining threshold cryptography and secret sharing with the theory of block designs, packings, and Sperner families.

Finally, we propose a recursive algorithm to build larger systems that require only a logarithmic number of padlocks. Our algorithm requires O(log(n)k-1) padlocks asymptotically to realize a k-out-of-n threshold padlock system. Our physical results apply to the numerical world by linking the number of padlocks to the size of the finite field used for secret sharing.

The paper's outline covers various sections addressing different aspects of the proposed threshold padlock system. Section 2 reviews existing threshold mechanisms, Section 3 describes our novel physical k-out-of-n threshold padlock system device, and Section 4 derives generic bounds on the number of padlocks required. Section 5 delves into more complex access structures, providing solutions on logic formulae and introducing the use of a sealed wire. Further details on lower bounds, optimality of the solution for large k, smaller realizations with fewer than n padlocks, and the recursive construction are outlined in subsequent sections.

TORONTO (AP) — The latest on Canada's parliamentary elections (all times local):

9 a.m.
Canadians are electing a new Parliament on Monday following a tight election campaign that has raised the threat of Prime Minister Justin Trudeau being knocked from power after one term. The 47-year-old Trudeau channeled the star power of his father, the liberal icon and late Prime Minister Pierre Trudeau, when he won in 2015. However, a combination of scandal and high expectations have damaged his prospects. Polls indicate Trudeau's Liberal Party could lose to the rival Conservatives, or perhaps win but still fail to secure a majority of seats in Parliament, forcing them to rely on an opposition party to remain in power. It has been 84 years since a first-term Canadian prime minister with a parliamentary majority lost a bid for re-election.

7:05 p.m.
Polls have closed in Canada's Atlantic Coast province of Newfoundland and Labrador, and the results of Canada's federal election will now start to trickle in. 7:40 p.m.
Polls in Atlantic Canada are closing in a federal election that could potentially unseat Justin Trudeau and his Liberal party from power. Trudeau had previously won every seat in Atlantic Canada in 2015, marking the beginning of a wave that helped him secure a majority of seats in Parliament. Two fundamental challenges exist with remote sensor data integration. First, existing optical sensors operate on various spatial, spectral, or temporal resolutions, producing heterogeneous data representations like hyperspectral imagery or LiDAR point clouds with geometric measurements. Converting all data to the same resolution or mapping to the same grid for fusion may lead to misalignment errors or loss of accuracy. Second, standard supervised learning methods typically require precise labels for each data point, which can be challenging to obtain, especially in high volume. Raw sensor data often contains missing and imprecise measurements due to occlusion, environmental factors, and sensor noise, resulting in uncertainties when fusing real-world remote sensing data.

To address these challenges, a Multiple Instance Multi-Resolution Fusion (MIMRF) method was previously proposed for integrating multi-modal and imprecisely labeled remote sensing data. This method utilized Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) to handle the label uncertainty issue and the Choquet integral for multi-resolution fusion. However, the computational complexity of the original MIMRF algorithm increases exponentially with the number of sensor sources, limiting its efficiency. This work introduces an efficient alternative to the original MIMRF algorithm by incorporating binary fuzzy measures (BFMs) with the MIL framework, aiming to enhance efficiency while preserving the effectiveness of multi-resolution fusion. Experimental results on real-world remote sensing data are presented to demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of the proposed fusion algorithm.

The paper is organized as follows: Section 2 describes the MIMRF framework, detailing the challenges of remote sensor data integration. Section 3 introduces the proposed efficient MIMRF with binary fuzzy measures, outlining the improvements made to the original algorithm.
