A long time ago, I heard a story about the origin of Obi Wan. A few Star Wars fans had noticed a similarity between the sound of his name and that of some of the other characters. A couple of examples are C3PO and R2D2. They're also call Artoo and Threepio for short. Now take Obi Wan's name and run this idea in the other direction - Obi Wan could also be OB1. It was theorized that this might indicate some kind of as-yet-unrevealed backstory that Obi Wan was a clone of some sort.

So I ran with the idea. And it started to make its own kind of sense the more I thought about it. It goes something like this.

Once upon a time, a small group of Jedi got an idea. Let's take advantage of this new cloning technology and try and clone ourselves. Just as was done later with Jango Fett, the clones were to be based on a superior example. The Jedi selected a young Jedi Master named *Ben* Kenobi. The location for the cloning facility was an obscure planet just south of the Rishi Maze named Kamino. There, the Jedi requested the clones to be produced in batches of 100 clones each. Each clone would have its own unique alphanumeric designation according to its unit number within each batch. The very first clone to be produced in this fashion would therefore be known as Original Batch, number one. Or OB1, for short.

Ben Kenobi gave his DNA sample to the Kaminoans, and the process got underway. Unfortunately for the Jedi, there was a problem. It was the midichlorians. In a totally unforeseen turn of events, the midichlorians did not replicate along with the rest of the body's cell during the cloning process. There was only one single multiplication instead of the hundred that was expected. What's more, only one of the clones received these midichlorians. The first clone, OB1. The rest of the clones came out of the process physically complete and perfect in every way except the one that mattered most. They had not one single midichlorian amongst the lot. Ninety-nine clones of Ben Kenobi, completely lacking in any Jedi powers whatsoever. It was a disaster, and the whole project was immediately canceled, never to be mentioned again. Even the location of Kamino itself was deleted from the Jedi library. The 99 powerless clones were quietly relocated, each one to a separate planet, scattered across the far reaches of the Republic.

There was one small success, though - OB1. Based on an already powerful Jedi but with twice the level of midichlorians. The young OB1 was renamed Obi Wan and entered into Jedi training at the earliest possible age. As young Obi Wan progressed through his training, the Jedi council came to realize that he would soon be a very powerful Jedi.

When OB1 became the Padawan of Qui-Gon Jinn, Ben Kenobi retired to a far-off world called Tatooine. This was done to avoid the rest of the Jedi from noticing that he had been cloned. Eventually OB1, now known as Obi Wan, came to fulfill his potential. He was, in fact, a type of super Jedi. A few years passed, and the time came when the Sith chose to reveal themselves.

Dear diary,

We were on the first train to Germany. The countryside is so beautiful here. I remember our first day in Munchen, my mother leading me by the hand as we moved with the crowd. I was awestruck by the towering monuments, the churches, the gardens. Everyone was so nice - they gave us food, water, even toys!

But... the trains won't stop coming. People won't stop coming. What was once a gorgeous beer garden is now a shelter for the homeless. People are fighting in the streets, and two months ago, they imposed a curfew. My father hired a university student to give me private lessons instead of going to school because he wants to know I'm "safe." Are we really safe? Are we going to go somewhere else, and will that place end up like this too? I miss my friends. I miss the old bakery on the corner. 

Don't tell my father, but sometimes I wish the trains had never come at all.

Le président de la Confédération, Ueli Maurer, a exprimé son souhait de renégocier l'accord-cadre avec l'Union européenne lors d'une rencontre électorale de l'UDC à Oberglatt (ZH). Lors d'une interview avec TeleZüri, il a souligné que, selon lui, l'accord-cadre actuel ne serait pas accepté au niveau national, et qu'il était nécessaire de revoir certains points importants. Il a affirmé que ces déclarations devaient être perçues comme un message à l'UE, et a mentionné que des consultations étaient en cours pour identifier les divergences, en vue d'une éventuelle renégociation.

Toutefois, en décembre, le commissaire européen Johannes Hahn a rejeté toute possibilité de nouvelles négociations de l'accord-cadre avec la Suisse. Le Conseil fédéral a également indiqué qu'en cas d'échec de l'accord-cadre dans sa forme actuelle, l'UE ne serait pas en mesure de lancer de nouvelles discussions avant la mi-2020. Cette situation met en évidence les défis auxquels la Suisse est confrontée dans ses relations avec l'UE, notamment en ce qui concerne la renégociation de l'accord-cadre.

The article "Unmasking the Face on Mars" explores various theories about the mysterious formation on the Martian surface. The most logical explanation is that the "face" is merely a natural landform. The article highlights how the more sensational, conspiracy-driven theories are not supported by NASA, which has conducted extensive research on the subject.

The article includes photographs from the years 1976, 1998, and 2001, showing the formation's gradual appearance over time. These images, along with substantial research, confirm the structure is, indeed, just a mesa. Multiple studies and evidence support this conclusion, reinforcing the idea that the "face" is a natural landform.

Twenty-five years ago, the Viking 1 spacecraft captured the likeness of a human face, a massive feature spanning nearly two miles. It was revealed to be a large rock formation, bearing a resemblance to a human head. Despite the evidence, some people doubted the explanation, suspecting a NASA cover-up, even though the agency provided ample research to the contrary.

The "Face on Mars" has inspired films, books, magazines, and radio discussions, with some individuals preferring the idea of a hidden, more sensational, truth, despite the overwhelming evidence.

The only light in the room emanated from a single bulb hanging from the ceiling. My handcuffs were chained to the table, my ankles shackled to the chair, leaving me with nothing to do but wait for my mysterious visitor. The guards had refused to divulge any details about the meeting, except that it was indeed happening. I hadn't been given much choice about that—or about anything else lately. I almost looked forward to my last meal, at least then my preferences might be considered.

Finally, the door opened. In the dim light, I couldn't discern more than the shadowy outlines of the people entering the room, but I recognized two of them: Donovan and McNall, two of the prison's toughest, meanest guards. They positioned themselves on either side of the door while the third shadow, a stranger, stepped into the light. He was a man I had never seen before—tall and lean, with close-cropped brown hair streaked with gray at the temples. He wore a dark, well-tailored suit.

"Diana McFarlane," he greeted me as he sat across from me. "Convicted of numerous murders and sentenced to death." He leaned across the table toward me. "How would you like to live instead?"

I raised an eyebrow. "I thought that offer was off the table."

"I have a special deal for you," the man said. "Humanity has been given a rare opportunity by a certain benefactor—a chance to let everyone live free from pain or sadness, except one. That one person will become immortal but live in misery, ensuring the happiness of the rest of humanity."

I leaned back as far as my bound hands allowed. "How is this possible?"

"I'm afraid I can't explain the 'how.' I'm here as a representative of all humankind, to offer you the chance at eternal life."

"And eternal misery," I noted.

"And eternal misery," he confirmed.

I tilted my head slightly. "Why me?"

"Because the world was given a choice, and they decided that if anyone was to make this sacrifice, it should be someone who already has nothing to lose, someone deserving of punishment. Those sentenced to death seemed the best candidates. I've approached several such individuals globally, and if any had accepted, we wouldn't be having this conversation. If you decline, I'll move on to the next name on my list."

"How long do I have to decide?"

"I'm afraid I need an immediate answer. If you choose to accept the death penalty you've been condemned to, I'll need to leave right away. Many are eager to find someone willing to make this sacrifice."

"Eternal misery doesn't sound appealing," I mused.

"And death does?"

"That depends on what comes after death. If there's nothing, I have nothing to look forward to. But if there's life after death, I'd likely head straight for Hell and eternal misery anyway, so what's the difference?"

The man folded his hands. "There may be no difference for you, but it means a world of difference to the families and friends of your victims. They would no longer have to mourn the losses of their loved ones—loved ones you took away. You could ease their pain."

I looked down at my hands on the table. "If I cared about that, do you think I would have killed all those people in the first place?"

"I believe that if I keep asking, I'll eventually find someone ready to atone."

I fell silent, considering his words. On one hand, I couldn't envision a world where no one grieved for lost loved ones. Sadness, in my experience, made happiness more precious. If you only knew happiness, would you truly appreciate it?

On the other hand, I could relieve the pain I had caused so many survivors. Wouldn't that be a greater justice than simply having my life taken? If I stayed and was executed, my victims' families might feel avenged, but they would be happier if I took this deal. I couldn't deny my guilt. Perhaps I could make amends for some of my crimes.

I raised my eyes without lifting my head. "I'm your girl."

A small smile creased the corner of the man's mouth. "You understand you will not be released from prison? You will spend your eternal life here. You are still a convict, and honestly, no one outside these walls wants their happiness tainted by witnessing your misery."

That stung a little, but I shrugged. "Hey, you never said anything about setting me free. Just about letting me live. I mean, people could thank me for bearing all their pain and sadness by at least letting me go home, but if I'm going to be miserable anyway, I guess it doesn't matter where I am."

"And you're sure about this?"

"I can't say I'm sure about anything. But I agree to this."

The voting for the presidential election concluded at the state secretariat here today with 180 out of total 182 members of the Gujarat Assembly having exercised their franchise. In the 182-member Gujarat Assembly, the ruling BJP has 122 MLAs, while the Congress has 57, the NCP has two, and the JD(U) one. In the Lok Sabha, all 26 MPs from the state belong to the BJP. Out of the total 11 Rajya Sabha members from Gujarat, two belong to the Congress while nine are from the BJP. As the Assembly complex is undergoing renovation, the voting was conducted at the adjoining Swarnim Sankul-2 complex inside the secretariat here. Only MLAs cast their votes here, while all the MPs exercised their franchise in Delhi, Gujarat BJP's chief whip Pankaj Desai said.

Gujarat Chief Minister Vijay Rupani, former CM Anandiben Patel, Deputy Chief Minister Nitin Patel, and Leader of the Opposition in the state Assembly Shankersinh Vaghela were among those who cast their votes here. State Congress in-charge Ashok Gehlot, who is the sitting MLA from Rajasthan and currently on a visit to Gujarat, cast his vote here. BJP president Amit Shah, who represents Naranpura seat of Ahmedabad, cast his vote in Delhi, while the lone JD(U) MLA, Chhotu Vasava, refrained from voting as a mark of protest. Rebel BJP MLA Nalin Kotadia, who was expelled from the party recently, announced that he has not voted for Kovind to register his protest against the "atrocities" committed on the Patel community during the 2015 quota agitation.

"The Congress fielded Kumar, a Dalit, only after we announced Kovindji's name. Why the Congress did not think of her when they made Pratibha Patil or Pranab Mukherjee the president?" he asked. The NDA's candidate, Ram Nath Kovind, was here on Saturday to seek the support of the BJP MLAs and MPs, while the UPA's nominee, Meira Kumar, visited the state last month to launch her campaign from the iconic Sabarmati Ashram.

Consider the challenge of assigning a label to an object. In scenarios where label noise is minimal, predicting a single label is effective. However, in many applications, some data items may be ambiguous due to noise or occlusion. In such instances, even expert human annotators might disagree on the true label, opting instead to provide a list of possible answers while excluding classes that are evidently incorrect.

Research indicates that even on straightforward tasks, such as CIFAR-10, human annotators sometimes disagree (Peterson et al., 2019). Figure 1 illustrates this, showing images with varying levels of disagreement among annotators. The first row displays unambiguous images, while the second and third rows include images with, respectively, two and three possible classes. In all images, a single object is present, but, for some, the low image resolution prevents precise identification, leading to, for example, ambiguity among three classes. Nonetheless, filtering, or ruling out, some classes, remains beneficial in the presence of ambiguity.

In this paper, we explore an adaptive classification approach, allowing computational classifiers to, much like human experts, respond with a list of candidate labels.

The author makes a compelling argument for studying Venus. Despite the challenges involved, studying Venus could be worthwhile, as it may serve as a second Earth. The surface of Venus is incredibly hot, with average temperatures exceeding 800 degrees Fahrenheit, which makes exploration difficult.

NASA, however, has an intriguing proposal for sending humans to study Venus. The idea involves hovering or floating about 30 miles above the planet's surface, where air pressure is similar to Earth's sea level, creating conditions, although challenging, that are survivable for humans. Nonetheless, to obtain rock samples, it would be necessary to get closer to Venus’s surface, necessitating the development of a machine capable of enduring Venus’s harsh conditions for a meaningful duration, as the author suggests. Sebastian Vettel has led calls for an investigation into the apparent tyre failures suffered by Lance Stroll and Max Verstappen during the Formula 1 Azerbaijan Grand Prix. Both drivers suffered heavy high-speed crashes after their left-rear tyres seemed to give way, prompting concern for driver safety on the track.

On Lap 30, Stroll was pitched into the wall on the drivers’ left as he rounded Turn 19—a kink in the long front straight. The Canadian was still running the hard compound Pirelli tyres on which he’d started the race at the time of the incident. Later, Verstappen crashed out only metres up the road with a seemingly identical problem, having pitted on Lap 12 to swap his soft tyres for a set of the hard compound rubber and crashing out 32 laps later.

Indeed, it prompted Red Bull’s sporting director Jonathan Wheatley to radio FIA race director Michael Masi, advising that there was no warning prior to Verstappen’s failure. He effectively recommended the race be red-flagged on safety grounds. Speeds down the more than two-kilometre front straight in Baku easily exceed 300kmh, making it one of the fastest sections of track all season. As a street circuit, it is hemmed in by walls, offering little opportunity for the driver to react and save the car before careering into a concrete barrier.

“I saw that he lost the car very late in the straight,” Vettel said of his Aston Martin team-mate Stroll’s crash. “I thought maybe first he clipped the wall outside of 19. But then I looked the next lap, and there was not a scratch. That would have been very unusual, but I couldn’t explain why he would crash so late in the straight.

Present work. Firstly, we review the mini-batch training process and the existing effective tricks of GCNs, which can often make training faster and better for node classification tasks. Based on this, we propose two novel tricks for node classification tasks: GCN res Framework and Embedding Usage. By applying adaptive and initial residual connections, as well as softmax layer-aggregation, the GCN res Framework can help alleviate the over-smoothing problem. For instance, on ogbn-arxiv, our model demonstrated a 1.39% improvement in test accuracy compared to GCN. We also benchmarked our model against other baselines like DeeperGCN and GCNII to showcase significant gains. Moreover, the effectiveness of Embedding Usage was validated through experiments on ogbn-mag, ogbn-products, and ogbn-proteins, resulting in a notable 2.15% test accuracy boost on ogbn-mag. Lastly, we discovered that combining different strategies can often enhance various GCNs, such as elevating GraphSAGE's test accuracy from 78.70% to 81.54% on ogbn-products, achieving top performance among models based on SAGEConv and its variants.

More recently, Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) and their variants have successfully extended convolution and pooling operations to graphs, delivering strong performance across diverse domains like computer vision, recommendation systems, and natural language processing. Spatial-based GCNs like GCN, GraphSAGE, and GraphSAINT have started to supplant spectral-based GCNs due to their enhanced efficiency and flexibility. To tackle the scalability challenge of GCNs, researchers have proposed two minibatch training algorithms: sampling-based and clustering-based, to scale GCNs to large graphs. Tasks in graph representation learning can be segmented into node classification, link prediction, and graph classification, with node classification emerging as a popular benchmark for evaluating GCNs due to its clarity and simplicity.

Much effort has been directed towards refining the implementation of GCNs, exemplified by initiatives like the Open Graph Benchmark (OGB), which has significantly advanced GCN research. Prior to the introduction of OGB datasets and its leaderboard, GCN studies lacked a standardized experimental protocol, leading to discrepancies in dataset splitting and evaluation methods that impeded fair comparison across different experiments. Additionally, using small graph datasets such as Cora, Citeseer, and Pubmed in earlier studies posed challenges in transferring techniques to larger real-world graphs. Consequently, tricks that could enhance GCN performance were either inadequately emphasized in literature or embedded solely in source code. The advent of OGB datasets and leaderboard has underscored the importance of these tricks under more equitable evaluation standards and real-world graph scenarios, where the gains from employing such tricks sometimes surpass those achieved through model architecture improvements.

While humans can also interpret emotions, the technology provides a more precise analysis, especially in the classroom setting, where a computer can quickly identify a bored or confused student, adjusting the lesson accordingly, mimicking the role of a human instructor.

The implementation of such technology in the classroom can make the learning experience more engaging and effective, particularly for students who struggle to grasp certain subjects the first time around. Some students require additional guidance, and the technology can offer the necessary support, ensuring the material is better understood. Thus, the integration of technology like this can greatly benefit the classroom, enhancing the educational experience for the students.

**Les élections régionales**  
Le scrutin se déroulera les dimanches 20 juin (premier tour) et 27 juin (second tour). Il s'agit d'élire les 102 élus qui siégeront pendant six ans au Conseil régional de Normandie. Parmi les compétences de cette collectivité : la gestion des lycées, la formation professionnelle, les transports, le développement économique, l'aménagement du territoire, l'agriculture, la gestion des fonds européens, le sport et la culture.

**Les élections départementales**  
Autrefois appelées cantonales, elles se tiendront également les dimanches 20 et 27 juin ! Dans chacun des cinq départements normands, les habitants devront élire leurs conseillers départementaux (appelés "conseillers généraux" jusqu'en 2015). Dans chaque canton, un binôme mixte sera élu.

When I was fourteen, I truly opened my eyes and realized her beauty for the first time. Her flowing locks glimmered in the sunlight, and her eyes held a conservative beauty that captivated me. I wanted nothing more than to stare into her gaze for endless hours, mesmerized by her presence. Her skin appeared heartwarming and comforting, as though an embrace from her could solve all the world's problems with a simple sign of affection. 

I longed to grace her delicate face and touch her hand with mine. I wanted to hold her forever. For she was Love. She was Desire. She was Temptation. She was Distraction. She was Destruction. She was a candlelight that never left my thoughts. She was always there, but never here. 

For she was Love. That and nothing more.

As soon as the first rays of sun forced their way through my window, I threw the covers off. I had been up for over an hour, but I knew my mom wouldn't like me up so early, and I didn't want to risk getting in trouble on my birthday. I had already dressed the night before so I could make it over to Professor Oak's laboratory as soon as possible. I didn't want to be like someone I once heard about, who showed up late and almost didn't get a Pokémon at all. That wouldn't be me.

By the time I walked out of my room, my face already hurt from smiling. "Happy Birthday!" my mom exclaimed. My favorite food was already on the table, though I was unsure how much I would actually be able to eat. My stomach felt like I had eaten nothing but candy for the last few hours, and it continued to turn as my heart pounded. I sat and began to eat, fiddling with my silverware and napkin. My hand brushed against the glass, almost toppling it over, but I caught it just in time. My eyes kept being drawn out the window, searching for anyone else that might be passing by.

"Oh, go ahead," my mom said, smiling and nodding toward the door. "You want to make sure you get the best Pokémon you can, right?" Before she had finished speaking, I had already leaped out of my chair. I quickly hugged her before grabbing the door and flinging it open, letting the fresh air rush into the room as I ran. I realized my shoes were untied a bit too late as I fell hard to the ground. It normally hurt, but not this time. I knew I couldn't afford to trip again, so I hurried and began to tie my shoes.

As I started to stand, I heard the sounds of wings overhead. *I wonder what Pokémon it is,* I thought to myself. *Soon, I'll be able to catch—* I stopped short as I realized it wasn't a Pokémon at all, but an owl. A letter fluttered to the ground as it flew away, and I tasted my breakfast in my mouth for a brief second. I broke the seal on the letter and began to read, my thoughts no longer on what Pokémon I would choose, but on which house I would be placed in.

"Dean!" my friend yelled as he ran up to me. "Oh, you got one too! Are you excited?" "Of course I am," I said quickly. "Well, I'm not sure." My eyes moved over the words of the letter but did not read them. "I was just on my way to Professor Oak's lab." "Oh," my friend said. His smile waned, but only slightly. His excitement matched what mine had been only moments earlier. My knees began to ache from the fall moments earlier.

"Well, I better get going," my friend said as he walked away. "There's a lot of things on the list!"

美国总统当选人川普的交接团队今天继续在民主党的伤口洒盐，指责民主党放任自身电邮帐号被骇，以驳斥情报机构指控俄罗斯干预美国总统大选的一份报告。

尽管川普接受了莫斯科参与网攻包括民主党全国委员会（DNC）在内的美国目标的可能性，他还是很快就反驳情报圈指责俄国介入大选的推断，并称相关指控是为对抗他的「政治猎巫」（政治迫害）的一部分。

法新社报导，川普团队发表评论的两天前，川普才与美国各情报单位首长见面。情报首长们告诉川普，是俄国总统蒲亭（Vladimir Putin）直接下令大规模网攻并将骇得的资料公布，用意是帮助川普赢得白宫宝座。

川普的女高级助理康威（Kellyanne Conway）今天重申了他们的立场，告诉美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）：「任何有意影响我们选举的企图，均告失败；这些全都没成功，这是非常重要的一点。」她在谈及俄国时，将问题归咎于民主党任自身帐号被骇。

康威说：「我们会谈到这个，是我们也因DNC电邮遭骇外泄的资料所困窘；那份报告的内容并无火花，因为DNC根本没建防火墙。」

康威进一步表示，川普的民主党对手希拉蕊．柯林顿（Hillary Clinton）会输掉大选，问题全在她自己身上。康威说：「美国民众不喜欢、不信任她，或不相信她诚实，这些都不需维基解密来说服美国人。」

On Monday, Manly will learn how long they'll have to manage without Tom Trbojevic, as statistics underscore his status as the most influential attacking player in the NRL. The star fullback was rushed for scans on his left hamstring Sunday night, following the Sea Eagles' gritty 14-6 victory over Canberra. 

Dylan Walker, the team's five-eighth, also underwent examination alongside Trbojevic, with Manly worried about potential ligament damage in his foot after initial concerns about his ankle. 

Fortunately, the initial assessment from Manly's coaching staff suggests that Trbojevic's injury is not as severe as the one that sidelined the 23-year-old for eight weeks last year. However, any absence of Dally M leaderboard front-runner Trbojevic will certainly cause anxiety among Manly fans. 

Trbojevic has either scored or assisted in 11 of Manly's 14 tries this year, indicating that only three were achieved without his involvement. His 78.6 percent influence in Manly’s tries is unrivaled by any other player in the league. Shaun Johnson follows with 53.3 percent at Cronulla, making him and Trbojevic the only two players to have directly contributed to more than half of their teams' tries this season.

Despite this setback, Manly can expect Trbojevic's return well before the run-up to the finals. "I'm not too concerned," said coach Des Hasler. "Later in the season, it might have been more dramatic, but there is still time. He's just disappointed because he loves playing footy, and that will be the hardest part."

Manly is set to receive some reinforcements next week against Cronulla. Hasler is optimistic that winger Jorge Taufua will return from a quad injury, while prop Martin Taupau is expected back from a dislocated thumb. Brad Parker is also anticipated to recover from a concussion within the seven-day turnaround, allowing him to return to the centers.

Brendan Elliot will likely step in as fullback, as he did at the end of last season to cover for Trbojevic.

In this article, the example they use to show how it could be efficient in schools is '"a classroom computer could recognize when a student is becoming confused or bored." and then goes on to say how the software could change the lesson for them, or give some help. What would an average student (saying this software isnt yet in classrooms) do in the same situation? Raise their hand, ask for help from a teacher, and get personal help just the same way the technology would solve the problem. To be fair though, not all students have an available teacher, or some work at home; what could those students do? Contact someone else (like a teacher for example in online school), figure it out, and eventually understand the problem all the same. With this technology of course, the idea is that the student doesn't have to put in any effort of asking for help and could identify the eventual solution by just showing emotion. Worded differently, this entire example of how classroom computers are beneficial could become a statement of flaws in this idea.

Firstly, the software could most likely be easily tricked. For evidence of students easily being able to get help & manipulate lessons by emotions; students could also manipulate lessons purposefully using software features to easily get ahead in problems or simply not put much effort into understanding them. The point about ease because of software with confused students is valid but what about lessons that communicating teaches them? The future aspects of life aren't going to be solely technology-based; so what happens when people rely too much on getting their emotions read easily and start communicating less with actual people? Not everyone can interpret others' troubles just by appearance alone. What would someone think when they are trying to convey a certain feeling and no one notices (because it's definitely not easy for normal people)? That's where being around others and asking for help/communicating feelings prepares individuals—it teaches them problem-solving skills not only socially but also academically.

The way that its written shows many possibilities for this technology; however when considering replacing communication even if just within schools - it isn't necessarily beneficial. Students may overly rely on technology as seen from my perspective as a student despite its initial seeming helpfulness - such reliance may modify fundamental values like sharing feelings, communication methods might change significantly within future generations due partly due to over-reliance on such technologies which can reverse human interaction efficiency.

El portavoz socialista de Economía, Pedro Saura, asegura que, con la reforma del Gobierno del sistema de pensiones, las pensiones públicas serán "de miseria" en 2050, ya que el gasto público en esta materia será "el mismo que el de hoy" pero con "seis o siete millones más de pensionistas", por lo que cada uno de ellos "toca a menos". 

Así lo ha asegurado en una entrevista en los Desayunos de TVE recogida por Europa Press. Saura considera que el Gobierno "está invitando a que el que pueda se haga una inversión privada", por lo que ve necesario que se plantee un cambio que pase por el empleo de calidad y por ingresar más dinero en los presupuestos hacia las pensiones, con "una reforma fiscal en profundidad que haga los impuestos más progresivos". 

En este contexto, ha reiterado la intención de su partido de hacer una enmienda a la totalidad de los Presupuestos. "No estamos de acuerdo con el techo de gasto ni con una revalorización del sistema de pensiones donde los pensionistas pierden poder adquisitivo, y el Gobierno dice que no quiere plantear una reforma fiscal en profundidad", ha argumentado.

Por otra parte, Saura ha recordado que la renta mínima de inserción que piden los sindicatos "es una medida y una iniciativa histórica del PSOE y de la socialdemocracia". Con esto, llevarán esta iniciativa de entre 6.000 y 7.000 millones de euros al primer Pleno del Congreso del año, con la esperanza de obtener el respaldo mayoritario de la Cámara.

El portavoz socialista también ha hecho referencia durante su entrevista a la subida de la luz. Apeló a "un gobierno y ministros que hagan menos de comentaristas sobre tiempo y meteorología" y "aborden en profundidad una reforma que pasa inicialmente por evaluar los costes del sistema energético, los peajes". En este sentido, ha defendido que la forma de calcular esos peajes debería pasar a la Comisión Nacional de los Mercados y la Competencia (CNMC) y que el bono social debería dotarse de mayor volumen de recursos económicos.

Le dernier week-end, douze athlètes minimes du club vannetais ont fait le déplacement à Saint-Brieuc pour le championnat de Bretagne. Malgré des conditions climatiques difficiles, sous la pluie, les Vannetais ont accompli l'exploit de décrocher huit médailles, dont sept titres et une troisième place. 

Leila Danet a réalisé un triplé en or dans les épreuves de poids, javelot et hauteur. Pierre Mahé a également obtenu un triplé en or au disque, au marteau et au poids (photo). Théodore Liot a remporté le 2 000 mètres, tandis que Nils Poullaouec a décroché le bronze à la hauteur.

Mel B a retrouvé son ex-nounou au tribunal de Los Angeles, dans le cadre de la procédure de divorce avec Stephen Belafonte. La chanteuse accuse la jeune femme de 25 ans de violence conjugale.

La guerre entre Mel B et son mari Stephen Belafonte se poursuit. Le vendredi 8 septembre, l'ex-chanteuse des Spice Girls a fait face à son ancienne nounou, Lorraine Gilles, au tribunal de Los Angeles. Lorraine Gilles, 25 ans, est arrivée au bras de son époux. Mel B accuse l'Allemande de l'avoir menacée de dévoiler une vidéo explosive et humiliante d'elle en plein acte sexuel. L'avocat de Mel B, Larry Bakman, a demandé au juge de requalifier la poursuite pour harcèlement en poursuite pour violences conjugales - ce qui est plus simple à prouver que l'harcèlement, rapporte le Daily Mail.

L'avocat a déclaré que Mel B acceptait de retirer la plainte si Lorraine Gilles retirait à son tour sa demande de remboursement des frais d'avocat. "Elle a le droit de demander le remboursement de ses frais," a plaidé son avocat Todd Eagan. "Mme. Gilles a accumulé de nombreux frais et elle n'est pas multimillionaire."

Il y a quelques jours, Lorraine Gilles, ancienne nounou du couple, révélait avoir eu une liaison forcée avec Stephen Belafonte. Selon elle, Mel B était à l'origine de leurs ébats.

The author suggests that studying Venus is a worthy pursuit despite the dangers it presents. He notes that Venus is one of the brightest points of light in the sky and is one of the planets in our solar system with the highest surface temperatures, reaching 800 degrees Fahrenheit. This is remarkably high, even though Mercury is closer to the sun but does not reach Venus's temperatures.

The atmospheric pressure on Venus is 90 times greater than what we experience on Earth. These conditions are far more extreme than anything humans encounter on our planet. Such an environment would crush even a submarine designed to dive to the deepest parts of our oceans and would liquefy many metals.

Studying Venus is challenging due to numerous obstacles. Venusian geology and weather present additional challenges, such as erupting volcanoes, powerful earthquakes, and frequent lightning strikes, which complicate the efforts of probes trying to land on its surface. These factors, including the extreme conditions, weather, temperatures, and pressure, make the study of Venus's surface difficult.

Moreover, the dense atmosphere prevents light from penetrating, and, most importantly, researchers cannot collect samples of rock, gas, or anything else, from a distance. However, NASA is exploring alternative approaches to studying Venus, including a project that is revisiting the concept of mechanical computers, a technology first envisioned in the 1800s, which played a crucial role during the 1940s, in World War II.

Laurie Jean Nelson, born on January 16, 1953, in North Carolina, passed away on February 13, 2019. She spent her early years in Santa Barbara, where she graduated from high school in 1971. Laurie married Phil Nelson in 1980, and they enjoyed their time together in Santa Barbara before eventually settling in Lake Tahoe. Laurie had a vibrant personality, an engaging smile, and a love for laughter. She found fulfillment working in hospitality at Caesars in Lake Tahoe, cherishing the encounters with celebrities like Red Skeleton.

After retiring from the Forest Service, Phil and Laurie relocated to Boise, Idaho, seeking a milder climate and a change of scenery. In Boise, they immersed themselves in the community, with Laurie starting her own business creating glass yard art with the help of her sister-in-law. She took immense pride in this new venture. The couple enjoyed the Boise nightlife, biking along the green belt, and spending time with their pugs, particularly her beloved Cricket. Their annual trips to Hawaii for the Pro Bowl became a cherished tradition, providing them with respite and enjoyment each year.

Laurie faced a significant health scare when she suffered a massive heart attack six years ago. Despite the ordeal, she believed she survived to support Phil during his own illness in 2018, staying by his side until his passing later that year. Laurie faced her own medical challenges with determination, as she believed it was what Phil would have wanted. Now reunited with her beloved husband, Laurie leaves behind a legacy of strength and resilience. She is survived by her stepson, Shawn Nelson, his family, her sister Dundie, and her extended family.

Laurie's zest for life, her unwavering support for her loved ones, and her entrepreneurial spirit will be deeply missed by all who knew her.

It was a typical reunion, to say the least—tense, angry, and with probably a bit too much alcohol being passed around. The family had always been somewhat dysfunctional. Ever since that big fiasco back in the 1860s, things had never quite returned to normal. Still, all things considered, nothing went *that* bad.

First, Texas had one too many Budweisers and began ranting about how half of his family "didn't know the meaning of a hard day's work" and how "they think we're idiots. Well, if they ever came down to our level, they'd understand we have smarts where it matters!" Oklahoma smiled, nodded, and agreed with everything his big brother said.

Louisiana, the Carolina twins, Tennessee (the musician of the family), Alabama, Georgia, Arkansas, and Mississippi, the "special" one, took over a corner of the room. They commiserated over how they were the laughingstock of the family, just because they ended up on the wrong side of that big family fight. They felt just as important to this family as anyone else. Why were they always the joke?

Florida tried to join the pity party but was shut out. Even though he had a lot in common with them—poor hygiene, low IQ, and slight racist leanings—he had gotten rich thanks to a deal with a theme park. Now, he was "too uppity" for his poorer brothers.

Florida wasn't welcome on the other side of the room, either. The richer, more business-minded family members didn't want to associate with their brother who grew up in the southern part of town. They lived in the Northeast! They had money and reputations to uphold.

New York led this faction of the family. He was the richest... and the most pretentious. Pennsylvania, Vermont, New Hampshire, "Don't call me tiny" Rhode Island, "Did you call Rhode Island tiny?!" New Jersey, and Massachusetts all relied on him. They would deny it, of course, but they wouldn't say 'no' when money happened to flow their way.

In the middle of the room stood the homeschooled members of the family, the Midwest. Honestly, there wasn't much difference between them all. Even their parents had trouble telling them apart, especially the Dakota girls—really pale, not much in terms of features, and not much money either. They had all embraced the farming and factory life. They were the blue-collar members of the family. But nobody really appreciated the fact that they would probably starve without them, so nobody bothered to say 'hi.'

Twenty-five years ago, something intriguing happened on Mars. NASA's Viking spacecraft #1 was orbiting the planet, capturing images of potential landing sites for the upcoming NASA spacecraft #2. During this mission, it identified a striking resemblance of a human face in the terrain.

A few days later, NASA unveiled this image to the public, describing it as a "huge rock formation...which resembles a human face." This discovery sparked a wave of speculation and curiosity about the possibility of extraterrestrial involvement.

Many questioned the origin of the face on Mars, wondering why any potential aliens would choose to create a human-like structure on a distant planet. Skeptics dismissed the idea of alien intervention, suggesting alternative explanations for the peculiar formation.

While a few scientists entertained the notion of the face being an alien artifact, the majority of the scientific community focused on the task of photographing the Cydonia region on the Martian surface. This area became a priority for NASA, leading to the Mars Global Surveyor mission in 1997, almost two decades after the Viking mission.

Years later, the Mars Global Surveyor provided a closer look at the mysterious face on the planet.

In the Central Highlands, six new cases of diphtheria have been confirmed, bringing the total number of cases in the region to 84 over the past month, with three fatalities reported across the four provinces of Dak Nong, Kon Tum, Gia Lai, and Daklak.

In Daklak Province, a new case involves a 19-year-old H’Mong resident of Krong Bong District’s Cu Pui Commune, who is currently 38 weeks pregnant. She exhibited symptoms such as fever, headache, sore throat, and fatigue, prompting her visit to M’Drak District’s Medical Center on July 14. Her samples, collected by the Central Highlands Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology, tested positive for diphtheria, as confirmed by a representative from the Daklak Center for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC).

In Gia Lai Province, three new diphtheria cases were detected in Dak Doa District. Notably, these cases displayed no symptoms, according to Ho Ngoc Gia, the director of CDC Gia Lai. In response, local health authorities have implemented comprehensive measures, including setting up quarantine checkpoints, sterilizing affected areas, and screening over 5,200 individuals. Additionally, more than 51,000 doses of preventive medicine have been distributed, and approximately 1,400 residents of Bong Hiot Hamlet have been vaccinated, bringing the total infected cases in Gia Lai to 21.

Dak Nong Province reported two additional cases, increasing its total to 30, with two fatalities. According to Eban Thanh Son, deputy director of CDC Dak Nong, the province plans to administer 82,000 doses of diphtheria vaccine, monitor over 1,100 individuals, and collect 1,071 samples for testing in the affected localities.

Overall, the efforts across these provinces underscore the region's commitment to controlling and preventing the spread of diphtheria.

El vicepresidente de la Junta de Andalucía, Juan Marín, clausuró hoy en Córdoba un encuentro de profesionales turísticos en el que se presentaron las líneas clave del Marco Estratégico de Turismo de Andalucía 2021-27. El consejero señaló que este documento será el principal instrumento planificador y marcará el futuro estratégico de esta industria durante los próximos seis años. Además, destacó que el Plan META ayudará a la reactivación del sector tras la crisis sanitaria. De esta manera, se han consensuado siete elementos clave que estructurarán el Plan META, los cuales se enmarcan principalmente en el impulso de un nuevo modelo de gestión; la sostenibilidad, la innovación y la tecnología como motores de evolución.

Are driverless cars good or bad? Google may say that they are good, but others argue that they could pose dangers to civilians and other road users. This article raises concerns about the potential risks associated with self-driving cars and questions why individuals are not driving themselves if they still have full control over the vehicle.

In a world filled with distractions such as cellphones, the ease of being distracted is a valid concern. The prospect of self-driving cars leading to an increase in accidents and deaths due to human error is a troubling possibility. While the article also mentions the excitement of driving in a technologically advanced world, the potential for serious accidents and fatalities cannot be ignored.

The advancement of technology has made life more convenient, with alternatives like "hoverboards" and ride-sharing services like Uber reducing the need for personal transportation. The sense of autonomy and purpose associated with driving could be lost with the introduction of self-driving cars. The convenience of self-driving cars may contribute to a sense of laziness and a lack of personal responsibility, further impacting society.

The introduction of self-driving cars could lead to a decline in physical activity and a further reliance on technology to perform basic tasks. The potential for increased distractions and a false sense of security could result in a rise in reckless behavior, such as texting and driving, and a disregard for the safety of others. The impact of self-driving cars on the economy and the well-being of individuals and the community is a cause for concern and should be carefully considered before their widespread adoption.

In conclusion, the introduction of self-driving cars could have detrimental effects on the economy and the safety of individuals and the community.

Découvrez les nouvelles sur la série The Witcher saison 2. Malheureusement, la crise sanitaire est venue pointer le bout de son nez et a repoussé le début du tournage au grand dam des fans. Véritable succès lors de sa sortie sur Netflix il y a plus d’un an, la série The Witcher fut évidemment renouvelée pour une deuxième saison. Bien heureusement, la plate-forme de streaming a confirmé via son Twitter la sortie à venir de la saison 2.

Que sait-on pour l’instant sur la saison 2 de The Witcher ? La fin de la première saison s’est conclue sur la réunion de Geralt et Ciri après tant d’épisodes à se chercher. Point fort de l’intrigue également, la prise de Citra et l’invasion par Nilfgaard. Netflix avait alléché les fans en partageant sur Twitter une page inédite du script de la saison 2 où l’on pouvait y voir une balade de Jaskier, notre poète préféré.

L’intrigue de cette nouvelle saison de The Witcher mettra en avant la relation entre Geralt et Ciri, avec également des développements concernant l'avenir de Yennefer et l'arrivée d'un nouveau sorceleur. La productrice du show, Lauren Hissrich, a confié que la relation entre Geralt et Ciri serait un moment fort de cette saison, avec un approfondissement de leur lien paternel.

Profitant du tweed, la plate-forme a annoncé la reprise du tournage le 17 août 2020, après son interruption en mars lorsque l’acteur norvégien Kristofer Hivju avait contracté le Covid-19. Malgré la reprise du tournage, il est encore trop tôt pour une annonce officielle de la date de sortie de la saison 2 de The Witcher. Le plus probable serait de tabler sur la fin d’année 2021 ou début 2022.

El fotógrafo José Núñez Ponce expone durante todo el mes de mayo una colección de imágenes de Ibiza titulada ‘Pityusen’ en Aubergine by Atzaró, ubicado en la carretera de Santa Gertrudis a Sant Miquel. «La temática es Ibiza, sus paisajes, flores, naturaleza y cultura, muy acorde con el lugar en el que se exponen», comenta el autor. La exposición se inauguró el pasado 30 de abril, coincidiendo con la reapertura de Aubergine tras un año de cierre debido a la pandemia, y se podrá disfrutar hasta el próximo 30 de mayo en dicho espacio.

¿Vale la pena organizar un Mundial? ¿Se recuperan los gastos generados? ¿Qué se hace luego con los estadios? ¿Qué beneficios deja una Copa del Mundo al país? Estas son las preguntas que muchos uruguayos se hacen desde que, hace ya unos cuantos años, el primer gobierno de Tabaré Vázquez impulsó la coorganización del Mundial 2030 con Argentina.

Las inversiones necesarias para albergar un Mundial son muy grandes y, desde el principio, se tuvo conciencia de que Uruguay no podría organizarlo solo. Por ello, se recurrió a Argentina como socio estratégico y, años más tarde (2017), se unió Paraguay.

Al país que organiza un Mundial generalmente le quedan infraestructuras, tanto buenas como malas. Por ejemplo, los estadios en Sudáfrica y algunos en Brasil se han convertido en edificios sin uso, que costaron mucho dinero. Eso no fue una inversión, sino un gasto. Sin embargo, las ciudades sedes obtienen muchos beneficios económicos en el momento (la llegada masiva de turistas genera divisas frescas) y también en infraestructura, ya que se mejoran los servicios de transporte, se reparan las calles e incluso se construyen nuevas y modernas carreteras.

Por todas estas razones, en general, los gastos se recuperan e incluso generan beneficios. En el caso de Uruguay, se dejaría el Estadio Centenario renovado, un nuevo estadio en el interior y obras de infraestructura social, como una red ferroviaria entre Montevideo y la otra sede.

Además, al haber solo dos estadios, no caerían en desuso, a pesar de que el Centenario últimamente no sea tan utilizado para el fútbol local, pero sí para la Selección y otros eventos. Sí existe cierto riesgo para el eventual nuevo estadio, aunque si se construye en Maldonado, al menos ese departamento cuenta con dos equipos profesionales que podrían utilizarlo.

Pero lo más importante de todo es que la inversión podría recuperarse rápidamente debido a la cantidad de partidos que Uruguay está previsto albergar. Eduardo Abulafia, coordinador del comité organizador uruguayo, declaró en el programa "100% Deporte" (Sport 890) que se jugarán un mínimo de 18 partidos en la fase de grupos, más posiblemente octavos de final, cuartos, semifinales y tal vez la final.

Envuelta en oscuridad e inquietud, al igual que su protagonista, Nightcrawler (2014) no es una película de terror, pero logra infundir miedo. Genera tanto temor como los ojos grandes que Jake Gyllenhaal despliega en la pantalla. Tanto miedo como el de las almas perdidas en la eterna noche en la que sobreviven aquellos que no encuentran significado en la vida. Tanto miedo como si, por ejemplo, un sociópata pensara hallar su lugar en el mundo trabajando como reportero de sucesos nocturno para la televisión. Sí, ese tipo de miedo... Un miedo ficticio que se nutre de la más pura realidad.

Detrás de la trama que presenta esta película, penúltima del ciclo Visiones del Oficio organizado por el Diario de Cádiz en celebración de su 150 aniversario, se despliega una crítica contundente al sensacionalismo y al todo vale, a lo cual el director Dan Gilroy supo dar forma magistral en su debut cinematográfico. Un lanzamiento destacado gracias a su habilidad propia y, por supuesto, a la actuación escalofriante de Gyllenhaal que cautiva al espectador desde la primera escena.

La cinta refleja la misma oscuridad e inquietud que la brillante interpretación de Jake Gyllenhaal en Nightcrawler. En esta película, el actor que se hizo conocido con "Cielo de octubre" y que ha labrado su propio camino en la historia del cine más allá de su apellido cinematográfico de renombre, encarna a Lou Bloom, un joven apasionado y extraño que lucha por hallar empleo y propósito en la vida. Su revelación surge al convertirse en testigo de un accidente y descubrir el mundo televisivo del periodismo de sucesos nocturnos. Así, Bloom se esforzará por obtener beneficios al llegar primero a escenas de crímenes o accidentes para fotografiar los hechos y vender las imágenes al mejor postor.

Rene Russo y Riz Ahmed (otro actor de ojos grandes que oscilan entre la ternura y la letalidad) acompañan de manera excepcional a Gyllenhaal en una película que sumerge al espectador en un viaje lleno de miserias y perversiones amplificadas, sí, por los medios de comunicación, pero no inexistentes más allá de las cámaras.

Cada martes, hasta el 28 de noviembre, los interesados pueden asistir a estas proyecciones, que se realizan a las ocho de la tarde en Multicines El Centro, de forma gratuita con una invitación que se puede obtener en la sede del Diario de Cádiz (edificio Fénix, avenida del Puerto, 2) al presentar el anuncio del ciclo que podrán encontrar en el periódico de ayer y hoy.

هاجمت "غرفة عمليات سرت الجفرة" التابعة لحكومة الوفاق السابقة، اللجنة العسكرية المشتركة "5+5" بعد مطالبتها بتجميد جميع الاتفاقيات العسكرية. رفضت "غرفة عمليات سرت الجفرة" هذه المطالبة ودعت لجنة "5+5" والمجلس الرئاسي وحكومة الوحدة الوطنية إلى عدم تجميد الاتفاقيات العسكرية الأجنبية، خاصة تلك مع تركيا وروسيا.

في بيان لها، أكدت الغرفة أن اللجنة العسكرية لم تلتزم بمهامها المكلفة من المجلس الرئاسي وأنها لم تظهر بدون تحيز تجاه أي جانب. وأشارت إلى أن تأخر لجنة 75 في أداء مهامها يظهر نية الطرف الآخر في عرقلة عمل اللجنة وممارسة الضغط عليها.

وأكدت "غرفة عمليات سرت الجفرة" أنهم لم يكونوا مناصرين للحرب، لكنهم سيدافعون عن أنفسهم إذا تعرضوا للهجوم، وذلك حسب تعبيرهم. من جانبها، طالبت اللجنة العسكرية المشتركة بتجميد جميع الاتفاقيات والمذكرات العسكرية مع دول أجنبية، وأعلنت ذلك رسميا حتى يتم انتخاب رئيس من قبل الشعب.

وفي خطاب موجه إلى المجلس الرئاسي والحكومة، أشارت اللجنة المشتركة إلى أهمية تنفيذ قرار مجلس الأمن الدولي رقم 2510 لسنة 2020، والذي يشدد على وقف إطلاق النار في ليبيا وخروج جميع المرتزقة والمقاتلين الأجانب من الأراضي الليبية.

社区内连续爆发变种病毒传播，导致多幢大厦需要全体居民接受21天隔离检疫。特首林郑月娥昨日透露，针对已完成双剂疫苗接种并且接种后已过14天的人士，考虑调整其隔离检疫安排。呼吸系统专科医生梁子超在今早的电台节目中批评政府缩短已接种疫苗人士隔离期的决定缺乏科学依据，担心这将增加病例走入社区的机会，导致问题进一步扩大。

梁子超指出，隔离21天依然存在病例走漏的可能性。他批评政府在尚未解决全部问题的情况下，缩短密切接触者或涉及变种病毒个案人士的隔离期是毫无科学根据的决定。梁强调，疫苗不会影响病毒潜伏期，打与不打疫苗并不会改变病毒的潜伏期，也没有一种疫苗能完全阻止病毒传播，尤其对于变种病毒的了解更是有限。

梁重申，即便减少部分人的隔离期，最终可能导致上千人需要接受21天隔离检疫。他警告政府随意缩短密切接触者或变种病毒相关人士的隔离期是非常危险的决定。港大感染及传染病中心总监何栢良则表示，缩短已接种疫苗人士的隔离期在一定程度上是有科学依据的，并援引英国卫生局的报告来支持这一观点。

针对最近的变种病毒个案，梁子超指出，一些患者已具备抗体，在体内携带病毒超过一周。

Dicen que el teatro es un espejo de la sociedad y que muchas veces nos reflejamos en cada uno de los personajes que nos presentan a través de las diferentes historias que vemos en el escenario. Si la puesta en escena logra hacer clic con nosotros, ya sea por la historia o porque nos identificamos con alguno de los personajes, es porque tal vez estamos viviendo alguna situación parecida y el teatro nos lleva a reflexionar al respecto. Sin embargo, es una de las artes más bellas, porque es en vivo y nunca una función será igual a la de ayer o la de mañana.

Les cuento todo esto porque fui a ver el sábado la “Orestíada” en el teatro el Galeón. Es una obra de Esquilo, adaptada por Robert Icke y traducida por Pilar Ixquic Mata. Son 180 minutos de intensidad con dos intermedios para poder ir digiriéndola poco a poco, porque como buena tragedia griega no es fácil, pero el trabajo de Lorena Maza es maravilloso, hizo un gran trabajo al no hacerla tediosa, sino fluida y con unos trazos que hasta el mejor director del mundo envidiaría. El reparto es de diez, ya que tenía que encontrar a estos actores que le imprimieran el corazón en cada diálogo emitido por el personaje. Yo me quedé con la boca abierta con Laura Almela y su Virginia Woolf, pero aquí no bajó su calidad histriónica. También está acompañada de Mauricio Davison, José Carlos Rodríguez, Emma Dib, Cristian Magaloni, Inés de Tavira, Abril Pinedo, Luis Miguel Lombana, Evangelina Martínez y Renata Ramos. ¿Ahora ya entienden por qué les dije de diez? Esta se presenta de jueves a domingo a las 18:00 hrs. La entrada general es de 150 pesos. Vayan, se las recomiendo.

Otra que vi en el Centro Cultural Universitario en el teatro Juan Ruiz de Alarcón fue la de “Por un pañuelo la maté”. Fue escrita por Andrea Salmerón y Alfonso Cárcamo, y dirigida por la misma Andrea, basada en “Otelo” de William Shakespeare, esa gran obra basada en los celos. ¿Quién no ha tenido celos? Pues yo sí los tuve ese día y enojo. La dramaturga sitúa en tiempo actual la historia, en las altas cúpulas de la política mexicana, pero utilizando los diálogos de la época con que los escribió Shakespeare. Aparte la ubicaron en un contexto de feminicidio, tema con el que estoy de acuerdo en manifestarse en contra y es necesario alzar la voz. Pero siento que no encaja del todo. Creo que pudo pulir el lenguaje, si ya la está llevando a la época actual, con adjetivos de nuestra época, el uso de las drogas y hablando de corrupción y cómo se prostituyen las mujeres que entran de edecanes al servicio de la Cámara de Diputados. Por Dios, sean así de coherentes. Me pareció muy larga. Pero a lo mejor estoy muy amargado, aun así, insisto, creo que le pudieron sacar más provecho. El elenco está conformado por Leonardo Zamudio, Antonio Vega, Sofía Sylwin, Nicolás de Llaca, Juan Cabello, María Sandoval, Daniela Arroio, Alfonso Cárcamo, Erwin Veytia, José María Negri, Carlos Álvarez, Emma Sofía Peraza.

En la ciudad se llevó a cabo una reunión de seguridad entre el ministro de la defensa, Luis Carlos Villegas, y la gobernadora del Valle, Dilian Francisca Toro. Sin embargo, antes de que esta reunión se cumpliera, un hombre le quitó la vida a un reconocido mecánico y comerciante de la Villa de Céspedes.

La acción sicarial tuvo lugar el viernes pasado en el barrio Nuevo Príncipe, específicamente en la calle 44A con carrera 23. La víctima, identificada como Jamith Antonio Peña García, llegaba en una motocicleta de alto cilindraje a una vivienda del sector.

El agresor, tras esperar a que Peña García descendiera de la motocicleta, se acercó sin mediar palabra y le disparó en múltiples ocasiones. La víctima, de 40 años, falleció en el lugar de los hechos. Era un reconocido mecánico y propietario de un taller en la carrera 30.

Los allegados de Peña García no logran entender qué pudo haber llevado a que acabaran con su vida de esta manera. Lo recuerdan como un hombre trabajador, honesto y dedicado a su familia. Además, destacan su liderazgo social y religioso, ya que fue pastor en una iglesia cristiana no católica de la ciudad.

Las autoridades actuaron rápidamente y, gracias a la información proporcionada por la ciudadanía, lograron capturar a un joven que coincide con las características del homicida. Además, se le encontró en posesión de un arma de fuego, por lo que fue puesto a disposición de las autoridades competentes.

Jamith Antonio Peña García deja a una niña huérfana y residía en el corregimiento de Aguaclara.

The potential of technology to read the emotional expressions of students is immense. This ability could significantly impact how and what students learn. For example, if a student is struggling with a problem, the computer could detect this and adjust the difficulty level. While technology may not benefit all students equally, some students may excel in hands-on learning, visual aids, or auditory instructions, all of which a teacher can provide. However, meeting the individual needs of multiple students without consuming excessive time is a challenge. This new technology, on the other hand, could swiftly identify a student's frustration or difficulty, even when the student remains silent, thus eliminating the ability to conceal emotions through facial recognition.

Beyond enhancing the learning process, the Facial Action Coding System could prove beneficial in addressing mental health issues. For instance, if a student displays a high degree of sadness or anger, educators could promptly identify the underlying concerns, allowing for the provision of appropriate support.

Facial recognition technology has the potential to address a myriad of issues, far beyond what one could initially imagine.

Amy Sedaris Embraces Bossy Role in New Movie, Dishes on Siblings, Bunnies, and Babies

Amy Sedaris discusses her latest role as the new addition in "The Boss Baby: The Family Business," the sequel to the popular 2017 animated film, describing it as the perfect fit for her.

"A bossy baby is not your typical baby. If it were a regular baby, it might have been like, 'I don't want to do this. It won't be fun.' But a bossy baby, sporting a three-piece suit and clip-on tie, is exactly the kind of character I enjoy playing. I have a soft spot for playing bossy individuals," she shares with PEOPLE in this week's feature.

The plot of the sequel centers on the Templeton brothers— Tim (James Marsden) and his Boss Baby brother, Ted (Alec Baldwin)— who have grown up and drifted apart.

Sedaris, 60, who grew up with three sisters and two brothers, including the renowned author David Sedaris, expresses her fondness for her large family and their enduring closeness.

"I find the most joy in the company of my family," says Sedaris. "We were like the Munster family. The kids in our neighborhood clamored to play at our house, but we were selective. We share a similar sense of humor, and we continue to uphold our tight-knit family bond."

Sedaris, known for her roles in "The Mandalorian" and "At Home with Amy Sedaris" (her comedy series on truTV), shares that her passion for acting has been a lifelong pursuit.

"Even as children, my brother David and I had an imaginary cooking show and a makeshift 'Price Is Right' game we played together," she reminisces.

Venus is a worthy subject of study because it is the closest planet to Earth in terms of density and size. It is sometimes even closer to Earth than any other planet in the Solar System. Venus could have had similar features to Earth. Scientists are working to find ways to study the features of Venus's surface.

In the past, Venus likely had vast oceans and could have supported various forms of life, similar to Earth. This similarity to Earth is why scientists are keen to study Venus. The planet's surface is rocky, with familiar features such as valleys, mountains, and craters, akin to those on Earth. However, studying Venus is hazardous due to its atmosphere. NASA is exploring alternative methods to study Venus, including using simplified electronics made of silicon carbide, which have endured Venus-like conditions in tests lasting three weeks. Additionally, NASA is revisiting old technology, such as mechanical computers used in World War II, to study Venus's surface.

Venus has a thick atmosphere, consisting of nearly 97 percent carbon dioxide, and extreme temperatures, with surface temperatures averaging over 800 degrees Fahrenheit, and pressure 90 times greater than Earth's. Venus's hostile environment, with erupting volcanoes, powerful earthquakes, and frequent lightning, poses challenges to landing probes, as no spacecraft has survived Venus's surface for more than a few hours, making Venus a perilous study subject.

Les aliments et les boissons descendent de la bouche vers l'estomac par l'intermédiaire d'un tube musculaire appelé "œsophage". La muqueuse de l'œsophage est faite de cellules fines et plates appelées cellules squameuses, mais elle contient également des cellules glandulaires. Les cellules glandulaires fabriquent et sécrètent du mucus et d'autres liquides qui contribuent à la digestion.

Il arrive parfois que les cellules de l'œsophage deviennent cancéreuses, ce qui conduit à la formation d'un cancer de l'œsophage. Lorsque les cellules de l'œsophage se mettent à se diviser de manière anarchique, on parle de cancer de l'œsophage. Il existe deux types de cancer œsophagien: le cancer à cellules squameuses et l'adénocarcinome.

Le cancer à cellules squameuses se développe dans la partie supérieure et médiane de l'œsophage. Si les sucs gastriques remontent le long de la partie inférieure de l'œsophage, ils peuvent irriter les cellules glandulaires et modifier alors leur apparence. Ces modifications peuvent entraîner la formation d'un cancer des cellules glandulaires appelé adénocarcinome.

Les symptômes du cancer œsophagien incluent: une difficulté à déglutir, une perte de poids considérable, des douleurs dans la gorge, le dos et derrière le sternum, des vomissements et une raucité de la voix. Le cancer œsophagien peut ensuite se propager (métastaser) vers d'autres organes du corps.

La chirurgie constitue le traitement le plus fréquent de ces types de cancer.

The electronic structure problem is one of the most important many-body problems in modern computational physics and chemistry. From understanding the emergent superconducting properties of twisted bilayer graphene at certain magic angles to explaining the complex mechanisms underlying light-harvesting molecules, an incredible range of scientific phenomena are governed by many-body electronic interactions. It is therefore hardly surprising that electronic structure calculations have a wide domain of applications—from drug discovery and the creation of new compounds for sustainable energy and green catalysis, to the design of quantum materials with exotic magnetic, ferroelectric, or superconducting properties.

At the heart of molecular electronic structure is the challenge of numerically computing the ground state eigenvalue of the electronic Hamiltonian—an unbounded, self-adjoint operator acting on a Hilbert space of antisymmetric functions. Given that the spatial dimension of the Hilbert space increases linearly with the number of electrons \(N\), the computational cost of a standard Galerkin discretisation of the electronic Hamiltonian typically scales exponentially with the degrees of freedom. Consequently, state-of-the-art numerical methods in molecular electronic structure theory rely on a low-rank, non-linear parametrisation of the sought-after eigenfunction.

One prominent class of algorithms is the coupled cluster (CC) methods, which use an exponential ansatz for the targeted ground state of the electronic Hamiltonian. Specifically, in the single reference CC method, the ground state is represented as the action of an exponential cluster operator—defined as the operator exponential of a linear combination of bounded maps (excitation operators)—on a carefully selected reference function. This approach transforms the eigenvalue problem into a highly non-linear system of equations for the unknown coefficients in the linear combination of excitation operators. Approximations to the ground state energy are achieved by limiting the class of excitation operators, leading to a hierarchy of more manageable non-linear, root-finding problems. Truncations based on excitation orders give rise to different methods like CCSD (single and double excitations) and CCSDT (single, double, and triple excitations). The CCSD(T) variant is particularly esteemed as the 'gold standard' of quantum chemistry, especially for small and medium-sized molecules.

Although the CC method is the preferred approach for computing ground states of dynamically correlated molecules in quantum chemistry, its mathematical analysis is relatively recent. The groundwork was laid less than 15 years ago by Schneider and Rohwedder, who provided the correct functional analytic setting for formulating and analyzing the coupled cluster equations.

Comparative analysis of scalar fields is a fundamental topic in scientific visualization. In recent years, topological abstractions have gained increasing interest for comparisons, offering two significant advantages over direct scalar field comparisons. Firstly, abstract comparisons focus on topological similarities, minimizing the impact of geometric symmetries. Secondly, these abstractions are usually orders of magnitude smaller than the actual domain, which is particularly important as the complexity of ensemble datasets continues to grow. One of the most studied abstractions is the merge tree, which represents the nesting of super- or sublevel sets in a rooted tree structure.

A common method of analysis is the application of tree edit distances to merge trees. Tree edit distances are a well-established framework for measuring the similarity of rooted trees, offering the benefits of being intuitive, efficiently computable, and providing mappings between substructures. Additionally, the metric properties of these edit distances, along with the edit mappings, make them suitable for tasks beyond simple distance computations, such as feature tracking, interpolation, and clustering.

There has been rapid development of specialized tree edit distances, particularly for merge trees, as well as their applications in various scalar field analysis tasks. A significant challenge, however, is the presence of vertical and horizontal instabilities, as described, for example, by Saikia et al.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) faces significant challenges, one of which is the automatic processing of large volumes of unstructured textual data. A crucial subfield addressing this issue is Natural Language Processing (NLP), which involves developing algorithms to process, analyze, and understand extensive text or speech data in human language. Within the biomedical domain, the application of these methods is referred to as Clinical NLP (cNLP). This subfield focuses on analyzing, manipulating, and interrogating clinical narratives. 

In radiology, a substantial amount of textual data is generated daily, primarily in the form of free-text reports, such as transcriptions. Recognizing the need for the adoption of structured reporting (SR) in clinical practice, many medical societies, including the European Society of Radiology and the Radiological Society of North America, advocate the creation of reference registries. Responding to these needs, the Italian Society of Medical and Interventional Radiology (SIRM) has designed structured reports for CT scans of patients with oncological conditions, such as breast, lung, colon, rectum, lymphoma, pancreas, and stomach cancers, as well as COVID-19. Despite these efforts, the rapid creation of unstructured clinical information necessitates the development of NLP solutions to transform existing reports into structured, manageable, and interpretable formats.

Data visualization has been broadly applied to communicate data and information in an effective and expressive manner. Recently, an emerging trend has been to combine narrative and storytelling with visualization. The norms of communicative and exploratory information visualization are used in narrative visualizations to tell the desired story. However, creating visualizations with narrative information is a challenging and time-consuming task. Such a creation usually requires data analytic skills and visualization design expertise. Even experts need to spend much time and effort creating an ideal visualization for a specific design scenario. Therefore, by summarizing the experience in practice, researchers specify various design spaces and visualization scenarios for distinct narrative genres, which guide users to create narrative visualizations.

With the emergence of new user requirements and the advancement of automation technology, an increasing number of intelligent tools have been created to assist the visual creative process. Authoring tools offer rich interactions that allow users to control the creation process. However, such tools still require users to decide on each visualization element manually. To further weaken the barriers and reduce the burdens of creation, researchers have developed ML/AI-supported tools and ML/AI generator tools to support a more automatic process. ML/AI-supported tools usually provide recommendations as part of the narrative visualization creation process, requiring users to make their design choices. However, ML/AI-generator tools do not need user expertise in visualization and can generate a complete set of visualization designs without user intervention.

Over the past few years, related surveys of automated techniques have focused on the automation of traditional statistical charts. Automatic tools that support various genres of narrative visualizations have not been sufficiently investigated. Systematic reviews on how automation shapes visual design and visual narrative processes are generally lacking. The narrative process describes the primary responsibilities and actions of data visualization storytellers and the types of artifacts that result from these activities. Most previous studies aim at the creation process from the visual design level. Advances in artificial intelligence and human-computer interaction have brought more opportunities and challenges to this field. Therefore, a state-of-the-art survey is required to provide a better understanding of automation involvement in narrative visualization creation tools.

To address this gap, we collected 91 design spaces and tools covering the six genres of narrative visualization and classified them into four automation levels. This allowed us to describe how automatic techniques could be progressively used in visualization design and visual narrative, enabling users to create data visualizations. By analyzing the tools of each narrative visualization genre, we compared the focus of the four levels of tools in each narrative genre to help users select the appropriate tool for different scenarios.

At this juncture, we are confronted with a vast intelligence of completely unknown origin. This intelligence has existed on the planet far longer than humankind, and its influence is so deeply ingrained that it cannot be eradicated. It cannot be comprehended in a way that allows us to reason with it. These beings arrived as naked spores many millennia ago, embedding themselves deep within the soil and forming extensive, intricate networks of mycelium. Whether these spores were intentionally planted is impossible to determine.

When the apes first encountered the fungal flesh in the ground, it seemed suitable for consumption. They examined the mushrooms closely and, after a moment's thought, began to eat. The alien settled in the brain, contributing to the increase in brain size evident in the fossil record. As it took hold, this duality manifested within the population. Those who understand that language is the key to meaning hold a powerful tool in their hands, granting them access to the wellspring of all knowledge and direct contact with the cosmic truth.

Our ancestors reach out to us through time, revealing our true nature and our destiny as children of the world.

马里兰州的许多郡市呈现族裔多元化，但近几年仇恨犯罪有所增加。（记者张筠 / 摄影）

联邦调查局（FBI）近日发布的一份报告显示，2020年马里兰州的仇恨犯罪数量较2019年增加了超过一倍。然而，马州政府对此表示，向联邦汇报仇恨犯罪的地方执法机构数量非常有限。虽然2020年仇恨犯罪确有整体增长，但联邦政府掌握的信息过于片面，该州仇恨犯罪的实际增幅并没有FBI报告中所述的那么严重。

根据联邦调查局的数据，2020年以前，马里兰州的仇恨犯罪数量一直在下降。但从2019年到2020年，这一数字从19起增至40起，增幅约为110%。这些案件多与族裔有关，包括针对非裔、亚裔等少数族裔的攻击案件。全国范围内，2020年的仇恨犯罪数量达到了十年内的峰值，共有7759起，此外还有大量案件未被记录。

尽管联邦数据显示马州的仇恨犯罪大幅增加，但州政府的记录却与联邦数据存在差异，主要原因在于并非所有地方执法机构每年都向联邦汇报仇恨案件。马里兰州法律规定，全州153个警察机构和消防部门必须向州警汇报仇恨犯罪数据，但联邦政府并无此要求，因此其掌握的数据缺乏连贯性且较为片面。

例如，联邦数据显示2019年马里兰州共有19起仇恨犯罪，2020年增至40起，但实际上2019年和2020年分别只有10个和14个地方执法机构向联邦政府汇报仇恨犯罪，而大量案件未被记录或证实。根据马里兰州警的「2019仇恨偏见报告」（2019 Hate Bias Report），2019年该州记录了385起仇恨犯罪，其中哈维郡（Howard County）就有49起仇恨犯罪。

Desde 2009 hasta 2019, Huawei ha invertido más de 4 mil millones de dólares en 5G, una cifra superior a la inversión total en 5G de todos los principales proveedores de equipos en Estados Unidos y Europa. Esta fuerte inversión en I+D impulsa la innovación y el desarrollo de Huawei, siendo un factor clave en nuestro éxito.

La relación de Huawei con el gobierno chino no difiere de la que cualquier otra empresa privada tiene con operaciones en China. Al igual que otras compañías tecnológicas en China, tanto nacionales como extranjeras, Huawei recibe cierto apoyo del gobierno en términos de políticas. Sin embargo, nunca hemos recibido un trato adicional o especial. Nuestro capital de trabajo proviene principalmente de nuestras propias operaciones comerciales y financiamiento externo, y no de subsidios gubernamentales. Durante los últimos 10 años, el 90% de nuestro capital de trabajo ha provenido de nuestras operaciones comerciales. El financiamiento externo de Huawei se rige por las reglas del mercado, y el costo de nuestra deuda se ajusta a los estándares del mercado.

La realidad es que todas las compañías tecnológicas que operan en China tienen derecho a ciertos subsidios del gobierno, siempre y cuando cumplan con determinadas condiciones. Esto también incluye a las compañías tecnológicas extranjeras. Los subsidios otorgados a estas empresas se destinan principalmente a programas de investigación. Huawei solicita estos subsidios gubernamentales al igual que cualquier otra empresa. Como menciona el propio artículo, también es común que los gobiernos occidentales ofrezcan subsidios para apoyar programas de investigación tecnológica. En la última década, el total de subsidios que Huawei ha recibido de gobiernos tanto dentro como fuera de China representa menos del 0.3% de nuestros ingresos totales. En 2018, solo recibimos una cantidad equivalente al 0.2% de nuestros ingresos anuales.

Recientemente, el Wall Street Journal ha estado publicando una serie de artículos falsos e irresponsables sobre Huawei, los cuales han dañado seriamente nuestra reputación. Huawei se reserva el derecho de emprender acciones legales para proteger nuestra reputación.

Deep Neural Networks (NNs), particularly deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), have gained significant attention over the past decade and have excelled in various machine learning tasks such as speech recognition, image classification, and video games. Popular CNN models like AlexNet, VGGNet, GoogleNet, and ResNet have demonstrated that deeper networks can notably enhance performance across different architectures.

One key challenge in deep learning is understanding why neural networks, especially very deep ones, perform effectively in practice. The expressivity of NNs is one reason for their superior performance, as they can represent a wide range of functions encountered in real-world applications. While single-layer NNs can approximate continuous functions with a sufficiently large width, multiple layers can achieve this with a more manageable width, leading to improved representation capabilities.

The expressivity of NNs can be measured by the maximal number of distinct linear regions they can compute in their function domain, particularly when using Rectified Linear Units (ReLUs) as activation functions. ReLU networks divide the input space into linear regions, with studies showing that deep fully-connected ReLU NNs exhibit exponentially more linear regions than shallow networks with the same parameters.

Research has focused on quantifying the number of linear regions in fully-connected ReLU NNs, with bounds established for their expressivity. While most studies have concentrated on fully-connected networks, the challenge lies in extending these findings to ReLU CNNs due to the complexity of hyperplane arrangements. This paper introduces novel mathematical tools to address this issue and presents results on the number of linear regions for ReLU CNNs, demonstrating their increased expressivity compared to fully-connected NNs.

The contributions of this work include developing methods to study the expressivity of ReLU CNNs, deriving formulas for the number of linear regions, and establishing bounds for multi-layer networks. By showcasing the enhanced expressivity of deep ReLU CNNs over shallow counterparts, this research sheds light on why deeper networks typically outperform shallower ones and provides insights into their architecture efficiency.

The paper is structured into sections discussing CNN architectures, activation patterns, linear regions, and results on both one-layer and multi-layer ReLU CNNs. Experimental settings for validating the findings are briefly explained, leading to conclusions and suggestions for future research. Additional details on hyperplane arrangements and theorem proofs can be found in the Supplementary Material.
