It’s only October, but we can already declare it: Popeyes is having the best year among fast-food chains. While others have been busy trying to keep up with the trend of meatless burgers and drive-thru innovations, Popeyes has succeeded by focusing on the fundamentals—serving exceptionally delicious chicken that customers crave. The demand for their chicken is so high that a newly opened Popeyes in Arden, North Carolina, is causing traffic disturbances for the small neighboring community just outside of Asheville.

Local news station WLOS has captured the scene, showing cars lined up along Airport Road and parked in the lots of nearby businesses when the Popeyes parking area is full. WLOS reports that approximately 30 cars are backed up onto the highway during peak lunch and dinner hours. While some residents are clearly thrilled about the addition of the new chicken joint that debuted over the weekend, others are complaining that the traffic caused by Popeyes is an inconvenience.

This serves as a warning to other communities anticipating the arrival of a new Popeyes: Ensure that your department of transportation is involved from the outset.

路透香港2月26日 - 太平洋恩利周二宣布，其附属公司中渔集团计划全面收购在挪威及秘鲁上市的Copeinca ASA。交易预计最高代价约为34.02亿挪威克朗（约46.8亿港元）。同时，中渔集团计划以每股0.34坡元（约2.13港元）的价格发行最多10.5亿股供股股份，筹集约22.4亿港元。

公司的声明指出，中渔集团向Copeinca提出的股份现金要约价格为每股53.85挪威克朗（约74.31港元），要约将在欧洲中部时间3月14日至4月12日下午11:59进行。若收购方获得至少50.01%的已发行股本的接受，收购方将至少支付15.754亿挪威克朗。预计收购方将需支付最高代价约34.02亿挪威克朗，以充分落实自愿现金收购要约。该收购价格较Copeinca周一收盘价44.3挪威克朗溢价21.7%。

声明进一步表示，收购Copeinca将使中渔集团在秘鲁北部及中部地区额外获得10.70%的秘鲁凤尾鱼捕捞配额，并在南部地区获得3%的捕捞配额。若收购成功完成，中渔集团将在秘鲁北部及中部地区共拥有16.9%的秘鲁凤尾鱼捕捞配额，而在南部地区的捕捞配额为14.72%。这将使中渔集团成为秘鲁最大的鱼粉公司。

目前，太平洋恩利间接持有中渔集团约46.9%的股权。在中渔完成供股后，太平洋恩利的持股量将升至约50.7%。太平洋恩利股份周二上午暂停交易，下午复牌后股价没有变化，报0.43港元。

L'attaquant de Manchester United, Edinson Cavani, envisage de quitter l'Angleterre pour retourner en Amérique du Sud cet été, avec une préférence pour Boca Juniors, a déclaré son père mardi à la télévision argentine. Cela intervient avant que l'international uruguayen n'exprime son attachement aux Red Devils sur Instagram. "Edinson ne se sent pas à l'aise là où il est aujourd'hui", a expliqué Luis Cavani à la chaîne TyC Sports. "Il réfléchit depuis plus de deux ans à l'idée de se rapprocher de sa famille."

Le père de l'ancien buteur du Paris SG et de Naples a précisé que son fils souhaiterait jouer pour le club argentin de Boca Juniors. "Il échange beaucoup avec l'entraîneur Juan Roman Riquelme, et cela lui plairait de jouer à Boca. Cette idée lui a toujours plu (...) Imaginez-le célébrant un but avec leurs supporters. Nous savons ce que représente Boca et le football argentin. Il y a 60 % de chances qu'Edinson retourne en Amérique du Sud", a-t-il ajouté.

Cependant, quelques heures plus tard, son fils, âgé de 34 ans, a tenu à calmer les rumeurs en publiant sur son compte Instagram une photo de lui portant le maillot rouge de Manchester United, accompagnée des mots : "fier de porter ce maillot". En début d'année, son entraîneur Ole Gunnar Solskjaer a exprimé son souhait de convaincre l'attaquant, auteur de six buts en 18 matchs de Premier League et actuellement diminué par une blessure musculaire, de prolonger son contrat qui se termine à la fin de la saison.

Luis Cavani est également revenu sur la suspension de trois matchs infligée à son fils par la fédération anglaise (FA) en fin d'année dernière, en raison d'un message jugé raciste sur Instagram. En réponse à un message de félicitations d'un ami après son doublé décisif lors de la victoire de Manchester United à Southampton (3-2) le 29 novembre, Edinson Cavani avait écrit "Gracias negrito" ("merci petit Noir"). Après avoir effacé le message, l'ex-buteur du PSG avait présenté ses excuses, et les Red Devils l'avaient défendu en expliquant que le terme avait été utilisé avec une intention amicale et qu'il avait une connotation différente en Amérique du Sud. "Le fait qu'il ait été suspendu est une absurdité. Ici, nous utilisons toujours ce mot. Nous ne sommes pas racistes", a plaidé Luis Cavani.

《十月初五的月光》第五集剧情呈现了许多错综复杂的情感纠葛。在剧情中，莎娇感动于文初和君好为她建立粉丝群组并安排网上直播的举动。另一方面，莎华在外出谈公事时与展辉重逢，却得知展辉已结婚，让她感到失落。二人之间的对话揭示了彼此的遗憾和失落。此外，君好误解了文初和礼信之间的亲密关系，导致了一系列误会的发生。莎娇的多年知己全海景也面临家庭问题，让人感叹人生的曲折和无奈。

在最新一集中，礼信提出改建秘密基地的方案遭到莎华的拒绝，引发了新的纷争。莎华对世光的绯闻感到厌烦，并警告他要自重。莎华借酒浇愁，与展辉之间的尴尬气氛也被展现出来。同时，江依文被掳走，引出了金胜的报复行动，让整个剧情更加扑朔迷离。金胜的背景故事也逐渐浮出水面，揭示了他母亲的悲惨遭遇。君好逐渐改变对礼信的看法，而展辉与看似莎莎的君好之间的联系也引起了观众的好奇。

整个剧情展现了人物之间错综复杂的情感纠葛，将观众带入了一个扣人心弦的故事世界。每一位角色都有着自己的内心秘密和挣扎，让人无法预料下一步的发展。这种剧情设置和角色之间的交织关系，为观众呈现了一幅多维度、多层次的人物画卷，让人期待着下一集的精彩发展。

Today marks the launch of Britain's first classical music radio station specifically designed for children. This new station offers a diverse playlist that includes everything from "Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star" to the works of Tchaikovsky. Fun Kids Classical is targeted at children aged 6 to 12 and their parents, providing a "calming and contemplative" alternative to pop music stations.

The digital station has been developed in collaboration with Lang Lang, the renowned Chinese pianist who performed at the Queen’s Diamond Jubilee in 2012. It is being introduced by the Fun Kids radio network, which began broadcasting nationally in 2016 and now reaches 300,000 children each month.

Matt Deegan, the station manager, expressed his concern about the limited radio choices available for children, noting that while adults have access to over 200 radio stations in the UK, children are often restricted to only one or two options.

لم يكن السوري مضر الشيخ أحمد يعلم عندما وصل قبل عامين إلى ألمانيا، أن مشروعاً جامعياً عن الطبخ يجمع اللاجئين والمواطنين شارك فيه، سيتطور ليصبح جمعية مسجّلة، يدعمها الرئيس الألماني بنفسه، ويصل صدى نشاطاتها إلى مختلف المدن الألمانية ثم إلى عدة دول أوروبية مجاورة. وقال مضر لـ"هافينغتون بوست عربي" إن المشروع لقي دعماً من الدولة لأنه أثبت فعاليته في عملية دمج اللاجئين في المجتمع الألماني.

تسعى جمعية اوبر دين تيلراند كوخن، التي شارك فيها مضر، إلى تحقيق عملية اندماج طويلة الأمد عبر بناء مجتمع متعدد الثقافات من خلال مشاريع متعددة بينها الطبخ، يشارك فيها كل فئات المجتمع، بحسب موقعها الرسمي. كما تشمل مشاريع الجمعية أيضاً تشكيل فرق رياضية وأخرى للرقص والغناء، وأنشطة متنوعة، منها ما هو مخصص للفتيان، إلى جانب يوم خاص بالنساء، يجتمع فيه سيدات لاجئات مع سيدات ألمانيات. لم يتوقف القائمون على الجمعية عند نشر جلسات الطبخ المشتركة في مدن ألمانية أخرى فقط، حيث إنهم طبقوها في عدة مدن أوروبية، عبر مطبخ "جوّال". ونجحوا في جمع عدد كبير من أبناء ٥ بلدان أوروبية، هي: فرنسا وهولندا وإيطاليا وبلجيكا والسويد، مع اللاجئين المقيمين فيها، للطبخ معاً لمدة شهر.

جلسة طبخ مع الرئيس: نجاح المشروع لفت أنظار السياسيين الألمان، حتى أن الرئيس الألماني يواخيم غاوك، تواصل مع القائمين عليه منذ بداية العمل فدعمهم وساعد على توسعة المشروع إلى مدن ألمانية أخرى، وصلت إلى ٢٣ مدينة. وقال مضر: "دعانا غاوك في سبتمبر/أيلول الماضي إلى احتفال المواطن، الذي ينظمه الرئيس سنوياً في حديقة قصره بيلفو، فأخذنا معنا مطبخنا المتحرك. وعبر غاوك عن رغبته حينها بحضور درس طبخ مع زوجته، فاقترحت عليه تعليمهما طريقة إعداد التبولة السورية". ولم تخلُ جلسة تعليم غاوك من طرائف، كما يحكي مضر: "عندما سألني الرئيس لماذا أستعمل الملعقة في عصر الليمون، رددت مازحاً بأننا في سوريا لا نملك عصارات ليمون.. وعندما انتهينا وتناولنا التبولة واستعد الجميع لالتقاط الصورة الجماعية أمام كاميرات القنوات التلفزيونية، قلت للرئيس الألماني إننا لا نستطيع الابتسام بعد أكل التبولة؛ لأن البقدونس يبقى عالقاً على الأسنان، فضحك غاوك كثيراً كما يبدو ذلك واضحاً في الصور الملتقطة له حينها، ووضع يده على فمه، ثم أخبرني أنه أحضر معه فرشاة أسنان".

غالبية الطبخات التي يحضّرونها سوياً، كما يحكي مضر، كانت أكلات شرقية، إلى جانب بعض الأكلات الأفغانية والإفريقية والآسيوية وفقاً للمشاركين فيها.

كُتب ودروس في الطبخ من أجل الدعم: ولأن المشروع ليس تجارياً – بحسب مضر – فإنهم عملوا على توفير دعم مالي يضمن استمراره، فأصدروا ٣ كتب وطرحوها للبيع. أوضح مضر أن الكتاب الأول كان من القطع الصغير، وعندما أرادوا نشر كتاب آخر، زاروا عدة مخيمات للاجئين وطلبوا منهم كتابة وصفة طبخة يعدونها في منزلهم، إلى جانب سرد قصصهم، والمشاكل التي صادفتهم، وكيف جاءوا إلى ألمانيا، فتضمن الكتاب في النهاية ٣٦ وصفة. ولفت الشاب السوري إلى أن الكتاب الثالث جمع وصفات أعدها لاجئون ذوو خبرة في الطبخ برفقة طباخين مشاهير من دول كألمانيا وفرنسا وأميركا والبرازيل، أجروا تعديلات عليها قبل أن يقدموها.

What didn’t happen, you say? Well, I’ll tell you.

From the beginning, everything seemed to happen as one might expect. The world was warm and bright, occasionally tinged with a little cold. It was rich, a dirt pile with enough soil for the worms to eat, enough worms for the birds to eat, enough birds for the cats to eat, enough cats for the wolves to eat, and then enough bears for man, the greatest of the worms, to eat.

But then, nothing happened. It didn’t stop, nor did it slow down. It simply didn’t happen. There was nothing—no lights, no sounds, not even the person you are sitting next to. There wasn’t even an empty void, for how can you have a void of nothing, when nothing happened?

Time never happened. The universe never happened. You never happened. All, thanks to a vengeful god, the last of his species, who survived the battle of the heavens, the greatest of the killers.

Captain Obvious glanced at his watch with practiced ease. "The Commander is fifty-five minutes late," he noted. 

Sergeant Sarcasm crossed her arms and leaned back in her seat. "Don't sweat it," she said. "He wouldn't let us down, would he? His loyalty is the stuff of legend!" 

Meanwhile, the Admiral was losing her patience. "I don't care if he's throwing orphans out of a burning building," she shouted as she stormed out of the private room. "I'm not paying his share! Doesn't he know how expensive this fucking place is?!" Her outburst drew the attention of patrons in the main room of the restaurant. Meeting their wide-eyed stares, she raised her voice even higher. "Go back to your overpriced mush, you cowards!" With that, she slammed the door and returned to the room. 

Once the Admiral had taken her seat, there was a knock. "WHAT?!" she bellowed. 

A timid waiter opened the door. "I'm terribly sorry, sir, ma'am," he said, his voice trembling. "The Commander just called to let you know that he'll soon be on his way." Without waiting for a reply, he closed the door and scurried back to the kitchen. 

The Sergeant smirked.

Un nouveau rapport surprenant de l’un des principaux médias de football espagnols, AS, affirme que Manchester United est en train de conclure un accord pour signer Saúl Ñíguez de l’Atlético Madrid. L’Espagnol a été lié à United lors de plusieurs fenêtres de transfert, mais après une première vague d'intérêt cette fois-ci, la piste semblait s'être refroidie à seulement une semaine de la date limite. Cependant, la mauvaise performance de United au milieu de terrain contre Southampton ce week-end a mis en évidence la nécessité d’un milieu de terrain capable de faire le lien entre la défense et l’attaque.

Cela pourrait avoir remis l'intérêt pour Saúl Ñíguez à l'ordre du jour. L’Atlético, quant à lui, promet d'avoir une dernière semaine de marché très chargée et pourrait voir un départ de dernière minute. Comme l’a appris AS, deux clubs de Premier League se sont intéressés aux services de Saúl, et son départ pourrait être imminent.

Manchester United et Chelsea apprécient le joueur, mais United a pris les devants dans les négociations, car ils recherchent un milieu de terrain possédant la portée que Saúl a tant exploitée ces dernières saisons. Dans une tournure qui ravivera l'enthousiasme des fans des Red Devils, l’accord devrait prendre la forme d’un prêt. La formule proposée pour reprendre ses services est similaire à celle qui a envoyé Morata à la Juventus : un contrat de prêt en échange d’une somme financière conséquente et du paiement d'une bonne partie de son salaire.

Il est surprenant d’entendre que l’Atlético serait prêt à accepter un tel accord, surtout que l'absence du joueur de 26 ans les laisserait à court de solutions au milieu de terrain. Cependant, le joueur est connu pour être malheureux, et Diego Simeone pourrait penser que réduire la masse salariale et donner au joueur la chance de retrouver la forme qui l’a abandonné une grande partie de la saison dernière pourrait être un pari qui vaut la peine d’être pris.

Quoi qu’il en soit, si cela est vrai, les nouvelles en provenance d’Espagne sont très excitantes pour Manchester United alors que la fenêtre de transfert touche à sa fin.

Con gran expectativa, entraron en funcionamiento las nuevas plantas modulares de tratamiento de agua potable instaladas en la planta El Milagro en Cajamarca. Esta moderna infraestructura, que se pone al servicio de la población, forma parte del paquete de once proyectos del Programa Agua para Cajamarca, en el marco del convenio suscrito entre la Municipalidad Provincial, Sedacaj y Yanacocha. El objetivo es mejorar el abastecimiento de agua en esta ciudad.

Se trata de las primeras plantas en el país instaladas para uso de servicio público, demostrando alta eficiencia y producción, además de ahorro de tiempo y espacio en su operación. Consta de dos módulos con una capacidad de tratamiento de 60 litros por segundo (lps) cada uno, y cuentan con un tratamiento denominado “flotación por aire disuelto”. Además, serán controladas de manera automática e inteligente por el sistema SCADA, reconocido a nivel internacional. Así lo mencionó el alcalde cajamarquino Andrés Villar Narro, quien inauguró la puesta en funcionamiento de las plantas.

Por su parte, la vicegobernadora de Cajamarca, Angélica Bazán, destacó el aporte de Yanacocha para mejorar el abastecimiento de agua, esencial para el desarrollo de las distintas actividades humanas, especialmente la salud.

Durante los meses de abril a junio, se iniciará el mejoramiento de uno de los módulos de la planta antigua, lo que permitirá aumentar su capacidad en 40 lps. Sumado a los 120 lps de las nuevas plantas modulares, se logrará un incremento total en la producción de agua potable de 160 lps, lo que significará más horas de agua y un mejor servicio al usuario. La inversión en esta obra asciende a S/11,546,356.53.

Experiencia

La ejecución de los trabajos estuvo a cargo del Consorcio Company Estructuras EIRL, una empresa cajamarquina asociada con Spena/Westech, especialistas en la instalación de plantas Trident HS System de fabricación americana. Durante 2019, se realizará el proceso de capacitación y acompañamiento al personal de Sedacaj para la operación y mantenimiento de las plantas, garantizando su efectividad y sostenibilidad. El objetivo final es aumentar el suministro de agua potable a los hogares.

قالت الممثلة البرازيلية ديبورا سيكو إنها كانت تعاشر زوجها، هوجو مورا، 10 مرات في اليوم، بهدف الحمل والإنجاب. وأضافت أنها كانت تقضي معظم وقتها في هذه العلاقة لتحقيق حلم الإنجاب والأمومة. 

في حديثها إلى مقدمة البرامج التلفزيونية سابرينا ساتو عبر موقع "يوتيوب"، أوضحت ديبورا: "أصبحت حاملاً بعد شهرين من الحب، حيث كنا نمارس العلاقة الزوجية 10 مرات في اليوم في المتوسط". ووصفت تلك الفترة بقولها: "كنا في وقت كنا نمارس فيه الجنس فقط. بعد ذلك، بدأنا نتحدث ونمارس الجنس ونطبخ ونمارس الجنس ونشاهد فيلمًا، ولكن قبل ذلك كان مجرد ممارسة الجنس".

لحسن الحظ، أثمرت هذه العلاقة عن حمل وأنجبت ابنتهما ماريا فلور، التي أصبحت الآن في الرابعة من عمرها، ما أدى إلى تغيير حياتها بشكل كبير. وعلى الرغم من اعترافها بأن لديها فرصة أقل للراحة في الوقت الحاضر، لكنها لا تزال تشعر بشهوة كبيرة نحو زوجها. 

أضافت قائلة: "في بعض الأحيان في المصعد عندما نغادر إلى العمل، أفكر: 'الجحيم الدموي، أنت وسيم للغاية، وأود أن ... '". وصدمت صراحة ديبورا العديد من متابعيها بسبب جرأتها المتزايدة في الحديث عن علاقتها الزوجية. ومع ذلك، هناك من دافع عنها، مشيرين إلى أنها تألقت في عشرات المسلسلات والأفلام، بما في ذلك فيلم "اعترافات فتاة برازيلية" في عام 2011.

Venus, despite its harsh conditions, holds valuable information that can only be uncovered through exploration. This is the central claim of "The Challenge of Exploring Venus." Throughout the article, the author emphasizes the numerous challenges associated with exploring Venus but offers limited explanation of its benefits and why such exploration is worthwhile despite the risks.

The author begins by presenting several facts about Venus to instill doubt in the reader. This approach transitions into the main idea by posing a provocative question: "If your sister planet is so inhospitable, why are scientists even discussing further visits to its surface?" After this skeptical introduction, he briefly outlines some benefits of returning to this hot, dense world. This addition demonstrates consideration for uninformed readers by first explaining why Venus is difficult to explore before delving into arguments supporting its exploration.

He then addresses this question by providing historical insights about Venus. The initial fact—"Astronomers are fascinated by Venus because it may well have been the most Earth-like planet in our solar system"—piques curiosity and leads into further discussion. This paragraph effectively hooks readers with surprising facts that highlight scientists' interest in studying such a planet.

After capturing reader interest, one would expect an in-depth discussion on how Venus' similarities with Earth make it a valuable research target. Instead, he abruptly shifts focus to another argument about exploration challenges. Although highlighting these difficulties aligns with the article's main theme, he only touches upon exploring's value in paragraphs four and eight. The remaining sections suggest solutions for overcoming exploratory hurdles but fail to elaborate on paragraph four's assertion regarding potential benefits.

At best, his argument suggests that past Earth-like conditions make Venus ripe for study without explaining why this matters. Furthermore, he introduces another point in paragraph five with an assertive claim: "the value of returning to Venus seems indisputable," stated prematurely in paragraph four.

The idea of automated control has been a topic of discussion in various contexts, from border control turrets to androids, and has also been a popular theme in science fiction films like The Matrix and iRobot, where artificial intelligence (A.I.) takes control over humanity. However, potential issues arise with the implementation of automated cars, raising questions about whether A.I. should drive or humans, ultimately boiling down to a comparison of human error versus the limited thought capacity of a computer.

On one hand, automated cars have the potential to save lives, as a significant number of yearly car crash fatalities are caused by drunk or distracted drivers. With automated cars, human impairment, such as being drunk, would not affect the car's performance, potentially reducing car-related deaths, as speeding and car chases would be eliminated. This presents a strong argument in favor of automated cars, as they could significantly enhance road safety.

Nevertheless, the uncertainties surrounding automated cars, particularly in emergency situations, where the A.I. may not know how to react, raise concerns, as human intervention and decision-making capabilities could be crucial.

صرح كستوتيس يانكاؤسكاس أن أذربيجان تملك الكثير لتقدمه لأوروبا في مجال السياحة. وأشار إلى أن العديد من السياح الأوروبيين الذين يزورون أذربيجان يعودون بشعور من الرضا، معترفين بأنهم اكتسبوا معلومات قيمة عن البلاد. وأكد على أهمية زيادة توعية السياح الأوروبيين بمناطق أذربيجان.

وتحدث يانكاؤسكاس عن المشاريع التي نفذها الاتحاد الأوروبي في مناطق شاماخي وإسماعيلي وغابالا، مؤكداً على استمرار تنفيذ مثل هذه المشاريع مستقبلاً. وقال: "لقد شهدنا أن الدعم المالي البسيط من الاتحاد الأوروبي أدى إلى تغييرات إيجابية كبيرة في حياة المستفيدين منها. لأذربيجان تقاليد غنية وموارد وفيرة، وأثمن هذه الموارد هو شعبها. نسعى جاهدين لتحسين ظروف الحياة في الأقاليم وتعزيز النشاط الاقتصادي والاجتماعي فيها.

The Seagoing Cowboys are a group of individuals who provided crucial assistance after World War II. They delivered horses, small cows, and food to towns left in ruins, helping countries in desperate need. They traveled across the Pacific and Atlantic Oceans to provide food to the homeless.

People should consider joining this program because it offers vital assistance to towns in need. Without such support, these communities could face severe hardships, including starvation. Joining the program is not only beneficial to those in need but also provides an opportunity for personal growth, allowing participants to discover the good within themselves.

Take Luke, for example, a seagoing cowboy who made nine trips, the most anyone in the program has ever completed.

Cars were initially created to transport humans to their desired destinations, and they were meant to be driven by people. The introduction of driverless cars raises several concerns, primarily because we don't know how reliable the technology is. Additionally, even with autonomous vehicles, the driver must remain alert, and it remains unclear who would be held accountable if an accident occurs.

Technology can fail; computers crash every day, elevators break down, and escalators stop working. If these common failures can happen daily in other technologies, who's to say something similar won't happen with driverless cars? There’s a possibility that brakes could fail in the middle of a busy intersection or that a warning from a car might come too late before you run into an obstacle. These vehicles only "mimic" human driving skills but may not replicate them reliably.

Moreover, what is the point of having a driverless car if the human occupant must stay awake? The only conceivable advantage would be for passengers who wish to sleep during travel. However, if these cars aren't sophisticated enough to handle complex situations autonomously and require human intervention at critical moments—such as when "the Google car simply announces when the driver should be prepared to take over"—they shouldn't be allowed on streets. If someone doesn't hear this warning because they're asleep or otherwise distracted, it could result in catastrophic consequences.

Legal accountability also becomes murky with autonomous vehicles: "If the technology fails and someone is injured, who is at fault—the driver or the manufacturer?"

In 1976, NASA captured a picture of Mars using the Viking 1 spacecraft. This photo depicted a Martian mesa that bore a striking resemblance to a human face. Upon its unveiling to the public, widespread excitement ensued. Speculations arose, with some attributing the formation to extraterrestrial origins, while others posited that it was simply a natural landform on Mars.

To substantiate my claim that this photo showcases a typical geological feature on Mars, let's examine the timeline of when these images were captured. When Viking 1 initially photographed the "Face," limitations in photography technology hindered our ability to discern intricate details. By contrast, technological advancements by 2001 allowed for clearer imagery when the Mars Global Surveyor (MGS) revisited and photographed the "Face." Despite improved clarity in the MGS image, obscured by clouds at the time, removing which might have confirmed its status as a landform earlier.

During this period, conspiracy theorists suggested that NASA concealed evidence of life on Mars from public knowledge out of reluctance or secrecy. However intriguing such discoveries would be scientifically significant; it seems implausible for such groundbreaking revelations to be withheld from humanity under any circumstances without sufficient substantiation.

This aligns with my initial assertion regarding technological progression over time—comparing photos from 1976 and 2001 highlights notable disparities in image quality due to advancements in technology. For instance, discrepancies in shading between Voyager 1's photo and MGS's depiction contribute significantly to differing perceptions of features present on Mars.

Despite our collective fascination with discovering life beyond Earth and hopes ignited by anomalies like the Face on Mars—scientific consensus indicates unfavorable conditions for sustaining life on Mars currently—facing reality is sometimes essential amid seemingly fantastical possibilities within our vast universe; acknowledging we may indeed be alone encourages seeking factual answers rather than clinging solely onto romanticized notions of extraterrestrial existence as portrayed by visions like The Face on Mars.

Sylvester Junior Kines, 48, of North Oak Street, Mount Carmel, was charged with two felony counts of aggravated assault, one misdemeanor count of possessing instruments of crime, one misdemeanor count of simple assault, and one misdemeanor count of disorderly conduct. The charges were filed by Mount Carmel Borough Police Lt. David Donkochik in the Mount Carmel Office of District Judge William Cole.

Donkochik reported that he responded to the area of Fifth and Oak streets at 11:06 a.m. Tuesday for a report of one man armed with a box cutter fighting another man. When he arrived, Donkochik ordered both men to the ground at gunpoint, saying he didn't know which of the men had the weapon.

Kines was found with a gray and yellow Dewalt utility knife. The alleged victim Dewayne Wilson had slash marks on his sweatshirt and jeans, as well as four bleeding wounds, including one laceration over 12 inches in length and a severe laceration on his upper left bicep about eight inches in length, police said.

Witnesses told police that Kines attacked Wilson. At one point, witnesses said Wilson had his hands up and did not appear to want any trouble, police said. Witnesses said it was clear that Kines was the aggressor, according to police.

Another witness provided a video from his cellphone showing Kines going after the victim and swinging the item in his hand as if he was attempting to slash Wilson, police said.

Nov. 18—MOUNT CARMEL — A Mount Carmel man accused of stabbing another man with a box cutter was taken into custody at gunpoint on Tuesday, according to Mount Carmel Borough Police.

Wilson was transported via ambulance to Geisinger-Shamokin Area Community Hospital in Coal Township for treatment of his injuries. Kines was committed to Northumberland County Jail in Coal Township in lieu of $100,000 cash bail following an arraignment on Tuesday. A preliminary hearing is scheduled for 9:30 a.m. Wednesday in front of Cole.

Elsa sat on her bed, staring at the ceiling when there was a tug at her bed cover. She held back the sigh, as she couldn't really be annoyed at her sister when she was already awake. “Elsa?” The whispered inquiry came. Elsa looked down to see small ginger pigtails bouncing up and down as Anna tried to jump onto the bed in her pajamas.

Elsa rolled her eyes and sat up, offering a hand to her sister and pulling her up onto the bed. She sat there, staring with wide eyes at Elsa expectantly. “What, Anna?” Elsa asked, fiddling with her fingers on the bed sheet. She already knew what Anna wanted, though. “The magic, Elsa, do the magic!” She demanded, her voice leaving her hushed whisper and coming out louder than the five-year-old probably intended.

“It's night time, we need to sleep,” Elsa said, shaking her head, but feeling her resolve crumble to her sister's begging eyes. Elsa groaned and put a hand up to silence Anna before she said anything else. “Only if we do it quietly, so we don't wake anybody up.”

“We'll do it quietly, come *on*,” Anna grabbed at Elsa's hand and tried to pull her out of the bed. Elsa caved into her sister's begging and allowed herself to be pulled along. They giggled as they ran through the corridors, whispering nothings, small jokes. The castle was large, and when they made it to the grand hall, Elsa was just as excited as Anna was.

She held her hands up, concentrating on the area in front of her. Biting her lip, she passed a wink to her sister as her hands began to glow a light purple. The space in front of her seemed to fill, a void opening in the hall, a rift being torn. Anna watched in awe as her sister made the rift grow larger and larger. The stars seemed within reach, and she swirled her hands, following her sister's motions.

“It's so pretty,” she muttered. Elsa smiled, turning to open a new rift, leaving the first for her sister to play with. She concentrated, the purple glow engulfing her entire body. Once it was large enough for a person to fit though, she jumped. Anna laughed as Elsa landed on top of her, having scared her with the initial jump. “I wan'a go,” Anna insisted, jumping up and down. Elsa closed one of the two, and allowed Anna to make a preparatory jump. She stood in front of one open portal, and jumped through, just as Elsa made a new one so that Anna would land in her arms.

“Again, again,” Anna exclaimed, delighted. The game continued, with Anna jumping back and forth through the portals until suddenly, she didn't come through one of them. “Anna?” Elsa called into the void. “Anna, where are you?”

She saw the pigtails floating, Anna's hands trying to grab at anything. Something was pulling her deeper. It had one eye and many tentacles. Elsa couldn't even see the whole thing, but her heart was filled with dread. She grabbed one of Anna's hands and pulled as hard as she could. The monster pulled back, but Elsa was filled with determination. “Kick it, Anna,” she shouted.

Anna's legs kicked as hard as they could until she was able to yank her sister straight through the portal. They all disappeared as exhaustion took over the children, and Elsa's magic drained away. Anna flew across the room, with nothing to hold her back. A loud crack resonated throughout the hall as what was presumably Anna's head collided with the floor. Elsa scrambled across the floor to her sister. “Anna, Anna,” she shook her sister's body, tears filling her eyes and panic setting in. “Mama, papa,” she screamed, hoping that someone would come.

The doors slammed open, and their parents rushed in. Their father gasped, “Elsa, what have you done? This is getting out of hand.” Anna's leg was pulsating with purple goo, and Elsa was clutching at her, whispering reassurances.

2019年7月6日，联合报记者王长鼎即时报导——一起因5千元债务引发的持刀伤人案件，近日在新北地方法院宣判。刘姓男子因不满林姓男子拖欠债务且有钱玩线上游戏，召集友人持刀上门讨债，并导致林男重伤险些丧命。法院依杀人未遂、恐吓及侵占等罪，判处刘男8年徒刑，吴男则因杀人未遂被判5年6个月，另部分判决可上诉。

Semantic segmentation seeks to segment all objects in an image, encompassing both 'things' and 'stuff,' while determining their categories. This task is a challenging aspect of computer vision and serves as the foundation for many higher-level functions, such as scene understanding [12, 27], object tracking [19], and vision-language applications [2, 24]. In recent years, Vision Transformers based on encoder-decoder architectures have emerged as a new paradigm for semantic segmentation. The encoder comprises a series of multi-head self-attention modules that capture features of image patches, while the decoder includes both self- and cross-attention modules to generate segmentation masks. Early works [35, 22, 28] typically employed Vision Transformers designed for image classification to address the semantic segmentation challenge, which only encode single-scale features. Unlike image classification, which recognizes one object in an image, semantic segmentation aims to extract numerous objects of various sizes. This makes it difficult to segment and recognize different objects using only single-scale features.

Recent approaches [15, 29, 30, 10, 3] attempt to leverage multi-scale features to tackle this issue. These methods first utilize hierarchical transformers such as the Swin Transformer [15] and PVT [29] to extract multi-scale image features, which are then combined using techniques like the pyramid pooling module (PPM) [34] or the feature pyramid network (FPN) [14] borrowed from CNNs. We argue that such combinations are ineffective at selecting an appropriate scale for each image patch. Features at sub-optimal scales may reduce segmentation accuracy, as demonstrated in CNN-based works [4, 26]. To address this, CNN-based methods [4, 26] design learnable models to select optimal scales. However, these models are complex, often using multiple networks [4] or requiring scale labels [26], which reduce network efficiency and may lead to overfitting.

In this paper, we leverage inherent characteristics of Vision Transformers to guide the feature selection process. Specifically, our design is inspired by the following observations: (1) As shown in Fig. 1(a), the self-attention module in the transformer encoder learns the correlations among image patches. If an image patch is correlated with many patches, small-scale (low-resolution) features should be preferred for segmenting this patch because they have large effective receptive fields [32], and vice versa. (2) In the transformer decoder, the cross-attention module models correlations between patch-query pairs, as illustrated in Fig. 1(b), where the queries represent object categories. If an image patch is correlated with multiple queries, it indicates the presence of multiple objects, necessitating large-scale (high-resolution) features for fine-grained segmentation. Conversely, an image patch correlated with only a few queries requires small-scale (low-resolution) features to prevent over-segmentation.

(3) These observations can inform design choices for both category-query-based decoders and object-query-based decoders. In object-query-based decoders, each query token corresponds to an object instance, with the cross-attention module extracting relationships between patch-object pairs. High cross-attention values suggest that the image patch contains multiple objects and requires high-resolution features.

A three-day festival showcasing artists, music, and food will take place at Aquatic Center Park ♦
Prepare to enjoy hand-crafted art, crafts, and entertainment as the Tooele Arts Festival makes its return to Aquatic Center Park this weekend. A Tooele County tradition since 1985, the festival will run from Friday to Sunday. Co-director Kaye Beeny shared that the free event will kick off at 10 a.m. each day and will host over 60 visual artists.

A variety of art forms will be on display and available for purchase, ranging from paintings, ceramics, and iron works to sketches and quilting, Beeny noted. While many artists hail from Tooele County, there will also be participants from Idaho, Arizona, Nevada, Montana, California, and Colorado. Beeny highlighted that festival-goers enjoy connecting with the county's talented local artists, emphasizing the community's support for them.

Throughout the day, attendees can relish in entertainment at the park while browsing the artists' creations. The program includes performances by various local groups such as dance and gymnastics ensembles, as well as the Tooele Summer Orchestra. Additionally, musical acts from Tooele County and beyond will take the stage around 4 p.m. on Friday and Saturday, with headline performances by the country-rock band The Krew and pop artist Dallas Wayde scheduled for 8:30 p.m. on those nights.

Beeny assured that all performers are family-friendly, catering to younger visitors as well. To engage the younger audience, there will be a rotating craft station where they can participate hands-on and create spin art on vinyl records. Saturday will also feature watermelon contests for kids of all ages, with age-group competitions starting at 3:45 p.m. for the youngest participants.

For those craving something beyond watermelon, the festival will offer a diverse selection of food options from about 20 vendors, serving up various culinary delights. Before the festival commences, the Tooele City Arts Council is hosting a plein air art contest, with the winning pieces to be exhibited at the Tooele Arts Festival. The contest invites drawings, paintings, or photographs created in Tooele County in the open air, inspired by the French term "en plein air."

Beeny encouraged local artists to partake in the contest as an opportunity to showcase their work at the festival without needing a booth reservation. The contest categories include age groups 12 and under, amateur, and experienced artists. While the festival welcomes all visitors, Beeny clarified that only registered service animals are allowed on the premises.

Sparse optimization involves optimizing a function \( f \) over \( s \)-sparse vectors, meaning vectors with at most \( s \) non-zero entries. This type of optimization is prevalent in fields such as machine learning, where the objective is to create smaller models for reasons of efficiency, generalization, or interpretability. Another application is in compressed sensing, which aims to recover an \( s \)-sparse signal from a limited number of measurements. A related challenge is low-rank optimization, where the sparsity constraint is applied to the spectrum of a solution, typically a matrix. This is crucial in tasks such as matrix factorization, recommender systems, and robust principal components analysis, among others. More broadly, structured sparsity constraints are designed to capture the unique structure of a specific task, limiting the solutions to those considered "simple" in a relevant context, such as group, tree, and graph-structured sparsity. For a more in-depth exploration of generalized sparsity measures, see, for example, [Sch18].

Among the numerous algorithms developed for sparse optimization, three are particularly noteworthy:

1. The LASSO [Tib96], which relaxes the \( \ell_0 \) (sparsity) constraint to an \( \ell_1 \) constraint, thereby convexifying the problem.
2. Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (OMP) [PRK93], which incrementally builds the solution in a greedy manner.
3. Iterative Hard Thresholding (IHT) [BD09], which employs projected gradient descent on the set of sparse solutions.

Of these, IHT is generally the most efficient, as it introduces minimal overhead compared to standard gradient descent, making it the preferred tool for large-scale applications.

In recent years, prompt-based or in-context learning has proven effective in achieving high performance on numerous natural language generation (NLG) tasks [1, 18, 22]. This study delves into the effectiveness of prompt-based learning in managing both personality and semantic accuracy in natural language generation for dialogues. The experimentation focuses on the PERSONAGE corpus, a benchmark dataset for stylistically-controlled NLG in the restaurant domain. This corpus contains reference utterances that stylistically vary based on the linguistic profiles of five different Big-5 personality types: agreeable, disagreeable, conscientious, unconscientious, and extravert [34, 4, 26, 5, 29, 30].

Two distinct types of discrete prompts are compared: (1) Data-to-text (D2T) prompts, which directly illustrate generation from a meaning representation incorporating personality specifications, and (2) prompts based on textual style transfer (TST) instructions [40], which require the conversion of the meaning representation to a textual pseudo-reference. The comparison between these two prompt types is exemplified in Table 1 for the agreeable Big-5 personality style. The study also examines the impact of providing varying numbers of demonstrations and whether the examples showcase one personality or multiple personalities systematically. Results demonstrate significant performance improvements by generating multiple outputs for each setting [16] and ranking them based on a blend of personality accuracy, semantic accuracy, and fluency.

For assessing semantic accuracy, a comparison is made between off-the-shelf semantic faithfulness metrics such as BEYOND-BLEU and BLEURT and PERSONAGE-specific scripts for calculating slot error rate [49, 41, 36]. To measure personality accuracy, a personality classifier is trained.

Building on the findings from PERSONAGE, the best-performing experimental setting is applied to an out-of-domain dataset for Data-to-Text NLG for Video Games, ViGGO. This test aims to determine whether personality examples from the restaurant domain can be utilized on meaning representations for the video game domain to generate personality-stylized utterances about video games. The ViGGO corpus provides a domain-specific script for calculating semantic accuracy [12], allowing for the application of the same ranking functions used for PERSONAGE.

The results reveal that prompting with a single personality yields better performance in achieving the target style and accurately rendering the meaning. The top-performing setting achieves personality accuracies of 100% and a best slot error rate of 22%. It is worth noting that there is no prior research investigating the efficacy of prompt-based learning in simultaneously controlling style and semantic accuracy in NLG.

El nuevo truco de Instagram para evitar el uso por menores de 13 años

La plataforma comenzará a solicitar la fecha de nacimiento a todos aquellos que intenten abrir una cuenta.

EP Madrid Actualizado: 05/12/2019 01:39h

Noticias relacionadas:
- Cómo evitar que sepan si has visto una «storie»

Instagram busca prevenir el uso de su plataforma por parte de jóvenes menores de 13 años, la edad mínima requerida según sus condiciones de uso. Para ello, ha comenzado a solicitar a los usuarios que crean una nueva cuenta que proporcionen su fecha de nacimiento para verificar su edad.

La red social ha anunciado este miércoles en un comunicado una serie de actualizaciones destinadas a ofrecer una aplicación más segura para los usuarios jóvenes. Estas nuevas funciones también limitarán quiénes pueden enviarles mensajes directos.

A partir de este miércoles, la compañía solicitará la fecha de nacimiento a cualquier usuario que intente crear una cuenta. En los términos de uso de la aplicación se especifica que los usuarios deben tener al menos 13 años para poder registrarse en Instagram.

La compañía, que cree que esta medida ayudará a mantener a los jóvenes más seguros, ha explicado que la fecha de nacimiento no será visible para los demás usuarios. Para aquellos que ya tienen una cuenta, no será necesario agregar esta información. Si la cuenta de Facebook está vinculada con la de Instagram, se agregará automáticamente la fecha de nacimiento que aparece en el perfil de la primera aplicación a la cuenta de Instagram.

Con esta actualización, la compañía examinará las edades de sus nuevos usuarios y les proporcionará información sobre los controles de cuenta y configuraciones de privacidad recomendadas para jóvenes. Además, Instagram está trabajando para que los usuarios solo reciban mensajes directos de las personas que siguen. Quienes habiliten esta función podrán decidir quién les envía mensajes y quién los añade a hilos grupales.

He felt his heart skip a beat. Panic buzzed around his head like a swarm of flies as his eyes darted frantically around the room, searching in vain for something between reason and emergency.

He couldn't breathe.

The gripping cold in his chest slowly gave way to a sickly warm tingling, spreading down his arms and legs until it felt as though he might vibrate apart.

As he began to remember, the feeling subsided, fading until he was able to move again. He was like a marooned sailor with a distant memory of once having sea legs. Stumbling, he slouched toward the sofa and was relieved to feel the stiff cushions beneath him, ending his fall.

Wiping the sweat from his forehead with the back of an equally damp hand, he began to laugh.

He stayed like that for a while: head cradled in two trembling hands, elbows resting on quivering knees, laughing. His laughter did not grow in intensity; there was no building crescendo. It ended as quietly and calmly as it had begun.

Finally lifting his gaze from the bloodstained floorboards, he took a moment to study her face. It looked different, detached from her head, as if it somehow lacked context. Her arms, now at opposite sides of the room, did not strike him in any particular way. The head was still in the sink, out of his line of sight, though he imagined it looked as it always had: perfect.

随着时间逼近，台湾能否重返世界卫生大会（WHA）令人期待却渺茫。尽管在最近的七大工业国组织（G7）外长会议上提出了力挺台湾加入世界卫生组织（WHO）和WHA的联合公报，并且法国参议院高票通过了有关台湾加入国际组织的决议文，国际社会纷纷挺台，但WHO却至今未做出正面回应。

尤其是，WHA的网上报名系统已截止，台湾仍未收到邀请函。外界对台湾今年重返WHA的评估认为存在困难。不过，今年的WHA将线上举行，仍有一线希望。能否在最后一刻突破中国的阻挠，以观察员身份重返WHA？各界仍怀有期待。

中国全面控制WHO，封杀台湾参与WHA已有多年。自2017年起，台湾连续四年未能参与WHA，中国以“一中原则”和“经中央政府同意”为由阻挠台湾。尽管国际社会有不少声音支持台湾重返，但在中国政治打压下，台湾最终未能如愿。

随着COVID-19疫情在全球蔓延，越来越多国家呼吁不应排除台湾在全球卫生体系之外。国际社会对台湾的支持前所未有强烈。即使台湾可能仍无法参与今年的WHA，全球已认识到台湾的重要性。随着全球公共卫生意识提高，西方国家将更关注WHO改革，台湾重返WHA并非绝对无望。

面对国际社会的支持，中国不可能示弱，仍将继续阻挠台湾。中国一直将台湾问题政治化。中国若接受国际社会的提议让台湾重返WHA，将意味着自己的错误行径，也会助长台湾民进党政府。然而，台湾问题已超出中国单方面控制。随着台海稳定成为全球关注焦点，美国声援台湾，国际社会认同台湾问题国际化，这是中共所不愿见到的结果。

这两年对习近平而言至关重要，将全力阻挠台湾的国际空间，否则将损害中共政权稳定。中国越打压台湾，越加深了以美国为首的民主阵线对中国的疑虑，台湾也必将走向更亲美的道路，两岸关系更难以修复。

台湾能否重返WHA也反映了美中之间的竞争。既然美国全力支持，但若最终叩关失败，不仅让台湾失望，更将让美国在全球多边机制中颜面尽失。对拜登来说，这将是首次美中对决中的首败，美国必将寻求恢复尊严，对WHO进行改革势在必行。

Il est tout à fait naturel de concevoir des jouets technologiquement plus avancés, voire plus intelligents que ceux de la concurrence. Cependant, il est essentiel de les protéger contre les intrusions, comme tout autre produit informatique connecté.

Équipés de microphones et parfois de caméras, ces jouets connectés offrent un niveau élevé d'interaction, contrairement aux anciens modèles qui ne proposaient que des réponses préétablies. Grâce à Internet, un réseau Wi-Fi à domicile ou une connexion Bluetooth, les jouets et jeux peuvent être associés à un ordinateur ou à un téléphone intelligent.

Si le géant Hasbro affirme être conforme à la loi américaine sur la confidentialité en ligne des enfants, son jouet connecté Furby Connect permettrait, selon le groupe allemand Stiftung Warentest, à un pirate situé dans un rayon de 30 mètres de prendre le contrôle de la connexion sans fil afin d'activer le microphone et de parler à l'enfant.

Un autre exemple concerne la poupée My Friend Cayla, qui utilise un logiciel de reconnaissance vocale couplé à un traducteur en ligne de Google. Son microphone enregistre les conversations pour les transmettre aux serveurs via Internet - une fonctionnalité qui ouvre la porte aux pirates, selon les chercheurs en cybersécurité contactés par le NYTimes.

Si la poupée Cayla n'est pas associée à un téléphone intelligent ou à une tablette par son propriétaire, n'importe qui se trouvant dans un rayon de 15 mètres du jouet peut prendre le contrôle de la connexion Bluetooth pour activer le jouet.

To sustain his own existence, he must draw life force from young girls. These girls are enchanted by him, only later realizing they do not fulfill their full potential in life.

哈登在布鲁克林的初次亮相备受关注。在赛前练习中，他穿着篮网队的练习衣投篮，被摄影机捕捉到了他回归全盛时期的精壮身材。这与他之前在火箭队时期被称为“路人肥大叔”的体态有显著不同，原本的大腹便便完全消失。

此前，哈登在休赛季回归时的爆肥照片在网上疯传，丰腴的体态让球评们直摇头。然而，从今天赛前练习的照片来看，哈登的大肥肚彻底消失，显得身材相当精实。对此，美国媒体《Legion Hoops》在推特上评论道：“哈登欺骗了所有人！”而《NBA Central》则补充道：“哈登又瘦了。”

在今日篮网对战魔术的比赛中，哈登表现出色，仿佛没有适应问题，立即融入比赛。他贡献了32分、14次助攻和12个篮板的大三元成绩，不仅助攻数创下了篮网队史的新纪录，还成为史上首位在转队后初登场即拿下30分大三元的球员。这一扫了他在火箭最后几场比赛中的低迷状态。同时，杜兰特也表现出色，猛攻42分，证明了哈登的加入并不影响他的发挥。

【MIRROR / 音乐会 / Music On The Road / Carousell / Anson Lo / Edan / Ian陈卓贤 / Anson Kong / 姜涛 / Jer柳应廷】

人气男团MIRROR的六位成员将于12月7日在湾仔会展举办音乐会。近日，音乐会门票在网上拍卖平台上掀起炒卖潮，甚至有人以23,000元开价出售两张门票。主办单位已经分阶段公布了参与音乐会的六位成员名单，并确认姜涛和柳应廷（Jer）将加入演出。

演出成员名单包括卢瀚霆（Anson Lo）、吕爵安（Edan）、陈卓贤（Ian）、江𤒹生（Anson Kong）、姜涛以及柳应廷（Jer）。此次音乐会的门票并未公开发售，而是通过申请指定网上行光纤入屋宽频及额外服务的客户以换领方式派发。成功申请的新客户或现有客户将获得两张门票及限量海报。

网上拍卖平台Carousell最近出现了大量征求或出售音乐会门票的帖子，价格从6000元至13,500元不等，有些甚至以23,000元出售两张门票。不少帖子强调会展座位有限，仅有8000个，而且只开一场演出，出价低于4000元可能是骗局，因为申请宽频合约有一定成本。

不少MIRROR的粉丝看到炒卖帖子后感到失望，抱怨“点抢呀啲飞”，并表示申请宽频服务可能更“化算”，但担心迟申请会错过好位置或被安排到最后排。此外，有粉丝向主办单位建议推出网上售票。

同场加映：MIRROR麦当劳“篮神卡”掀起炒卖潮，姜涛、Anson Lo及Edan的签名卡被炒至千元一张。麦当劳此前邀请姜涛、Anson Lo及Edan担任代言人，并推出以篮球为主题的限量“篮神卡”。这些卡以随机形式派发，自兑换期开始，就吸引了大量粉丝在社交平台上发文交流或转售，其中姜涛、Anson Lo和Edan的个人造型签名卡价格最高，每张一度炒至1100元，不过这些帖子很快被删除，曾被质疑为恶作剧。

早前，MIRROR首次举办演唱会就引发全城关注，即便追加场次，门票依然一票难求，被炒至天价，个别炒家甚至开价逾10万元。《香港01》记者在二手拍卖网上搜寻演唱会门票的帖子时，发现罕见地出现“求飞多过放飞”的情况。

All students and staff at Ara Institute of Canterbury must be fully vaccinated before teaching commences next year. People will need to have their first jab by January 24 and be fully vaccinated by February 14, 2022. Unvaccinated individuals without a Ministry of Health approved exemption will not be allowed entry to Ara campuses or facilities from that date. It has not been determined what the consequences will be for unvaccinated students and staff, but Darren Mitchell, Ara’s acting chief executive, clarified that it was not a strict "no jab, no job, no study policy."

The decision to mandate vaccinations followed consultation, with the majority of submissions supporting the policy. Ara is the most recent tertiary provider to implement a vaccine mandate, joining Te Pūkenga, the Crown entity overseeing the country's polytechnics, which requires full vaccination for anyone visiting its sites, except when a local risk assessment permits otherwise. Ara, with around 16,000 students across campuses in Christchurch, Timaru, Ashburton, and Oamaru, found it challenging to make the decision.

Mitchell emphasized their intent to collaborate with affected individuals to explore possible options for them to continue their engagement with employment or study. The policy aims to minimize risks if the region faces fluctuating alert level restrictions, as vaccination is crucial for preventing such scenarios. Several New Zealand institutes of technology and polytechnics, including Wintec, Nelson Marlborough Institute of Technology, Toi Ohomai, and Otago Polytechnic, have also introduced vaccine mandates.

It is essential to note that anyone can report a reaction to the Covid-19 vaccine, so caution is advised when interpreting online information. The announcement was made this week to offer students and staff ample time to become fully vaccinated and evaluate their choices over the holiday period. Ara recognizes that vaccination is a personal decision but stresses the obligation to provide a safe environment for all on its campuses.

Con el celular en mano y desde la primera fila de la platea, Antonia registró el espectáculo del cantante y compositor colombiano, cantando todas sus canciones. El detalle: la pequeña asistió al concierto luciendo una camiseta blanca con una dulce dedicatoria escrita por la novia de Yatra, Tini Stoessel: "Feliz cumpleaños, Anto. Te amo, Tini".

Esta no fue la primera vez que la familia presidencial se encontró con el artista colombiano y su novia. En junio pasado, Tini y Yatra visitaron la Quinta de Olivos y hasta entonaron algunas canciones junto a Mauricio, Juliana y Antonia. "¡Qué tarde tan hermosa compartimos hoy! Sebastián Yatra supo que Anto era fanática y se puso en contacto para visitarnos con Tini. ¡Muchas gracias por venir y por tanta buena energía!", expresó Awada en su cuenta de Instagram.

Minutos antes de que comenzara el espectáculo de su ídolo máximo, Antonia estaba sentada. Sin embargo, decidió levantarse de su butaca para disfrutar de una mejor vista del escenario. ¿Fueron solas? No. Aunque no se las ve en las imágenes, Juliana y Antonia asistieron al concierto con algunas amigas de la pequeña y su hermana mayor, Valentina, fruto de la relación anterior de Awada con su expareja, Bruno Barbier.

Value stocks are generating plenty of attention this year, and many market observers believe that this trend should extend to mid- and small-cap fare. This environment could be a promising sign for the Invesco S&P MidCap 400 Pure Value ETF (RFV), allowing it to build on its 2021 momentum. The RFV follows the S&P MidCap 400® Pure Value Index, and several factors suggest that its bullish trajectory may continue.

"The outperformance in mega-cap tech stocks has likely nearly run its course as valuations in these stocks have moved up considerably in recent weeks, thanks to better-than-expected earnings and a retreat in bond yields," said Andrea Bevis, senior vice president at UBS Private Wealth Management in Boston. "We believe the next leg of the equity rally will be driven by value stocks, and small and mid-cap segments of the market."

Notably, mid caps are leading large- and small-caps this year, and RFV boasts the right sector mix to capitalize on the current market environment. Approximately two-thirds of its sector weight is allocated to cyclically designated groups, a significant trait when cyclicals are leading, growth is faltering, and defensives are lagging.

As of May 10, RFV allocates about 43% of its holdings to financial services, materials, and energy stocks, thus leveraging the fund to both rising Treasury yields (bank stocks) and soaring commodity prices (energy and materials). This allocation cements RFV's status as a beneficiary of the reflation trade. "Despite recent tech strength, investors should diversify beyond mega-cap tech companies and rotate into cyclical and value-oriented areas of the market that should continue to benefit from higher yields and a broadening economic recovery," adds Bevis.

Bevis also emphasizes that investors should use periods of market volatility to add exposure to cyclical sectors, which are key beneficiaries of the economic recovery. "Sectors with a high quality cyclical bias, such as consumer discretionary, energy, and financials, are our most preferred sectors of the market," she continues. While there are current concerns about inflation, Bevis expects any near-term spikes to be temporary. Strong corporate earnings are expected to outweigh concerns about supply chain constraints and rising commodity and transportation costs.

Conditional expressions are crucial for representing the knowledge and reasoning capabilities of intelligent agents. They play a significant role in various fields, including nonmonotonic reasoning, causal inference, learning, and more generally, reasoning under uncertainty. This paper introduces an algebraic structure for conditional events, providing a logical foundation for analyzing the concept of conditional probability—a fundamental tool in Artificial Intelligence.

Since the groundbreaking work of Gaifman [22], building on the initial ideas of his supervisor Alfred Tarski [31], it has been considered natural to explore the conditions under which Boolean algebras, i.e., classical logic, serve as the logic of events in probability theory. As clearly stated in [23], events, described in some language, can be equated with the sentences that describe them, and the probability function can be seen as an assignment of values to these sentences. The wealth of knowledge accumulated in formal languages makes such a project feasible.

Our focus is on developing this idea further, considering conditional probability as a primitive notion and deriving unconditional probability as a specialization. Taking conditional probability as a fundamental concept is an approach with a long tradition, dating back to at least [12] and including [32, 44, 45, 51]. The primary rationale for this perspective is the methodological view that probability assessments are never made in isolation. Instead, each probabilistic evaluation is conducted in light of available evidence, making every assessment inherently conditional.

To achieve our goal, the first step is to clarify how conditional knowledge and information should be represented. We propose a structure for representing conditional events as the primitive objects of uncertainty quantification. In other words, we aim to capture the logic or algebra that replaces classical logic when focusing on conditional probability. In our preliminary investigations [20, 21], we suggested a methodological approach involving the following questions:

1. Which properties of conditional probabilities depend on the measure's characteristics and are independent of the logical properties of conditional events?
2. Which properties depend on the logic—whatever it may be—of conditional events?

Bruno de Finetti was the first to challenge the assumption that conditional events could be described by truth-functional classical logic. He referred to these as trievents [12, 14], motivated by the notion that conditional events like "a given b" express hypothetical assertions—the assertion of the consequent a based on the supposition that the antecedent b is satisfied. Thus, evaluating a conditional involves a two-step process: first checking the antecedent, and if not satisfied, the conditional loses meaning. Otherwise, the evaluation proceeds to the consequent, and the conditional event takes on its value.

This interpretation enabled de Finetti to use the classical notion of uncertainty resolution for conditional events, as assumed by Hausdorff and Kolmogorov, except that de Finetti allowed the evaluation to be a partial function. This is clearly illustrated through the betting interpretation of subjective probability, which extends to various coherence-based measures of uncertainty [18, 19]. For example, in the context of a two-valued classical logic valuation v, de Finetti interprets conditional events "θ given φ" as follows:

- Won if v(φ) = v(θ) = 1
- Lost if v(φ) = 1 and v(θ) = 0
- Called-off if v(φ) = 0

This concept has been further developed in uncertain reasoning, with links to non-monotonic reasoning [17, 36, 35, 34]. In probability logic, this approach has been pursued in [9], where, despite being measure-theoretically oriented, the semantics of conditional events is three-valued. However, the algebra of conditional events developed in this paper will form a Boolean algebra. As we will demonstrate, the three-valued semantics of conditional events is compatible with the requirement that they form a Boolean algebra. This compatibility arises because uncertainty-resolving valuations no longer correspond to classical logic valuations, as in de Finetti's work.

El delegado del Gobierno en Cataluña, Enric Millo, ha afirmado este viernes que el presidente de la Generalitat, Carles Puigdemont, "podría plantear en una reunión con el presidente Rajoy que lo que desea es modificar la Constitución. A partir de ahí, se debería articular una propuesta, llevarla al Congreso, debatirla y votarla".

En una entrevista en Catalunya Ràdio recogida por Europa Press, ha negado que el Ejecutivo central pueda considerar una modificación de la legalidad vigente para permitir un referéndum: "Esto tendría que acordarlo el Congreso de los Diputados".

No obstante, ha lamentado que esta no sea la postura de la Generalitat: "Lo que hacen es decir: 'usted déjeme hacer un referéndum aunque no esté contemplado ni en la Constitución ni en el Estatut, y si no me deja hacerlo, lo haré igualmente'. Esto no deja margen para negociar nada".

Millo ha destacado que el compromiso del Gobierno con el diálogo con el Govern "sigue tan vivo como el primer día" y que prueba de ello son los actos de varios ministros en Cataluña, como el que realizará la próxima semana la vicepresidenta Soraya Sáenz de Santamaría.

"No hay ninguna otra manera de resolver los problemas entre políticos y administraciones", ha aseverado, aunque ve difícil que Puigdemont y Mariano Rajoy se puedan encontrar en los próximos meses.

قدّم النائب محمد فؤاد، عضو مجلس النواب، طلب إحاطة لرئيس مجلس الوزراء ووزير السياحة والآثار بشأن ضرورة تطوير أنماط الفنادق في مصر. وأشار "فؤاد" إلى أن الفنادق في مصر تعاني من نقص في أنماطها، التي تعتبر أساسية لتنشيط السياحة، على الرغم من جهود الحكومة في تعزيز القطاع السياحي وتطوير أنشطته في البلاد.

وأوضح النائب أن فنادق "الموتيلات الصغيرة، الكامب، الطبيعية، والعلاجية" يعاني من تنوع أنماطها وجودة الخدمات المقدمة. فهذه الأنماط المتنوعة تلعب دورًا حيويًا في تحفيز وتنشيط حركة السياحة، وبالتالي، يعتبر التركيز على الفنادق التقليدية وفئاتها غير كافٍ لاستهداف واستقطاب فئات أوسع من السياح.

هذا الطلب يأتي في إطار الجهود المستمرة لتعزيز القطاع السياحي في مصر وتطويره بشكل شامل، ويظهر أهمية تحسين أنماط الفنادق كوسيلة لتعزيز الجاذبية السياحية للبلاد.

La poesía le salvó de una depresión infantil a los ocho años al morir su padre. Ya adulta, la poeta, actriz y actual diputada socialista en la Asamblea Regional, Magdalena Sánchez Blesa (Puerto Lumbreras, 1970), tuvo una cafetería literaria llamada 'El café de la feria' en su pueblo Alhama de Murcia. En su primer libro, un cuadernillo con grapas titulado 'Cosas de niña', se encontraba el poema que le dio a conocer, 'La madre', que refleja la enorme tarea que tienen las madres y las exigencias infinitas de los hijos. “Escribía sobre gente con muchas fatigas, muchas penas; como lo estaba sufriendo en mis propias carnes sabía que quería consolar a los que estaban más tristes”, dice.

Sus vídeo-poemas han atravesado el Atlántico y se han viralizado en los países de habla hispana, sobre todo, a raíz de su cuarto poemario 'Instrucciones a mis hijos'. La diputada pasó hace tres años un cáncer de mama. Mientras recitaba en el Auditorio Víctor Villegas a mujeres que lo habían padecido, ella ya sufría sin saberlo esa enfermedad. A los dos meses se la diagnosticaron y su exmarido la casó "con mi pañuelico en la cabeza" como juez de paz con su actual pareja, David Perea, responsable de la maquetación de su último libro 'Te necesitas'. “Tengo dos hijos preciosos con mi ex y otro con mi actual marido. Mi ex entra en mi casa y se sienta con nosotros. Digamos que hemos añadido amor a la familia en una convivencia hermosa”, apunta Magdalena mientras desayuna un café con leche y una tostada con tomate.

La figura de su madre es fundamental para su obra. “Mi madre era como la tortuga Morla de ‘La historia interminable’: viuda a los 40 años con seis hijos, uno de ellos en su vientre y siempre decía ‘No pasa nada’”. Cuando perdí a mi madre fue uno de los momentos más duros de mi vida porque era mi musa, mi inspiración. Murió hace tres años de un tumor cerebral que se la llevó en tres meses. En el epitafio de su lápida pone ‘Presiento que a partir de hoy todo va a ir bien’ y fue lo que dijo tres días antes de morirse. Sabía que se moría, pero fue positiva hasta el final de sus días.

A veces es difícil distinguir a la poeta de una gurú espiritual, aunque no se considera creyente, sino “practicante”. Sánchez Blesa pone su número de teléfono en sus libros y la gente la llama. “Me quiero suicidar”; “Mi hijo con 24 años ha empezado a pegarme”; “Mi madre me metió a la prostitución”; “Mi hijo es un drogadicto y se muere”, le dicen. “Me han contado lo más grande que te puedas imaginar”, señala Sánchez Blesa, “yo les doy mis palabras y les recomiendo entrar en acción”.

Te defines como poeta de aceras y patios.
Así es. ‘La madre’ lo escribí con 20 años. Pensé cómo puedo hacer entender a la gente que cuando lleguen a casa no pueden poner a su madre de esclava. No era de una calidad literaria de la que me sienta satisfecha, pero fue el poema que me dio a conocer porque lo que quería era usar palabras con las que la gente se sintiera identificada. Quizás mi literatura es muchísimo más sencilla y tenga menos calidad literaria que otra, pero por lo que sea llega a un ama de casa y ese ama de casa se sienta y llora.

Pones tu número de teléfono en el libro ‘Te necesitas’. ¿Te llaman?
Hay gente que me dice que se quiere suicidar. Les propongo hablar de la vida: ve a una residencia de ancianos y dales consuelo; no te vayas de la vida sin leerte ‘El Quijote’, no te mires solo a tu ombligo y luego vete a un psiquiatra que te ponga un tratamiento porque a veces se requiere de una química o de un psicólogo que encamine a una persona con dificultades. Pero puedo hablar un rato un contigo y decirte que también he pasado muchas fatigas y que todo lo he convertido en una enseñanza para mí y para quien venga detrás.

He tenido un cáncer, que no ha sido lo peor que me he pasado en la vida, pero que cuando me miraba en un espejo no me conocía.

Car-buying consumers are at great risk after weather events like Hurricane Harvey and the threat posed by Hurricane Irma. They're at risk that flooded vehicles will eventually flood the market. The late Tom Zimmer, a former National Insurance Crime Bureau investigator and long-time source of mine, demonstrated for me three years ago how states will print salvage titles in the insurance companies' names -- and in a different color. "A regular Tennessee title is going to be green," he demonstrated. "Notice how the (Tennessee salvage title) is blue."

By law, when a flood drowns cars on a retail or auction lot, the lot must total out those vehicles in coordination with its insurance company and brand those cars' titles as salvage titles in the name of the insurance company. It also takes days, even weeks to secure a salvage title on a flooded vehicle. There's the flood itself, then the waiting to get a claims adjuster out to conduct an inspection, then the determination of loss and liability, then the generation of the title. "There's a gap of time between the actual incident and the branding of the title, so basically, you are unprotected at that point until those titles are branded," said Stan Norton, managing partner of City Auto and dealer member of the Tennessee Motor Vehicle Commission.

Bottom line, you should never buy a car without proof of a clean title. Period. If you insist on taking the risk of considering a car that has either a salvage title or no title at all, Zimmer said use your eyes -- and your nose -- to determine if it may be a flooded vehicle. "Are there artificial air fresheners in there that are probably covering up the odor of mold?" he said. He also said look for sand, dirt or silt traces in the upholstery, on the floorboard and around the interior. Chris Basso, public relations director for Carfax vehicle history reports, recommended before purchasing the car, have a reliable mechanic inspect the trunk, engine, and spare tire well for water or debris. Look for condensation in the dashboard, headlights, and taillights -- and look for excess rust on interior metal parts.

Andy Wise walks you through the steps of filing a flooded vehicle claim, as long as you have comprehensive coverage. "You should rely on vehicle history reports, and you should absolutely get those," Norton said.

In today's server architecture, compute nodes and memory are tightly coupled, with memory technology being entirely dictated by CPUs. This tight coupling between the CPU and memory subsystems restricts flexible server system design with different memory hierarchies, leading to stranded compute, network, and/or memory resources. Consequently, this increases a datacenter's Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).

With the increasing push towards decoupling CPU and memory resources, a paradigm shift is taking place in next-generation server architectures for memory access and data movement. CXL (Compute Express Link) is an open, industry-supported interconnect based on the PCI Express (PCIe) interface that enables high-speed, low-latency communication between the host processor and end devices (e.g., accelerators, memory expanders, smart I/O devices). CXL allows cache-line granular access to connected devices with byte-addressable memory in the same physical address space. From an OS perspective, CXL-Memory appears as a separate NUMA node, with memory access latency slightly higher (50-100 ns) than remote NUMA access latency. This NUMA-like behavior with main memory-like access semantics makes CXL-Memory an excellent candidate for the slow-tier in datacenter memory hierarchies.

CXL 1.0/1.1 enables a point-to-point link between the CPU and end devices. CXL 2.0 introduces one-hop switching that enables multiple end-devices to connect to a single host, supporting memory pooling. CXL 3.0 further advances this with multi-hop hierarchical switching, allowing complex network topologies through cascading and fan-out, including non-tree topologies like Spine/Leaf, mesh, and ring-based architectures. CXL 3.0 supports PCIe 6.0 (64 GT/s, up to 256 GB/s of throughput for a x16 duplex link) and expands the potential for very complex and composable rack-scale server designs with varied memory technologies.

In addition to memory pooling, CXL 3.0 enables memory sharing across multiple hosts on multiple end-devices, where hardware can manage coherency of the shared memory regions through Back Invalidation (BI). Connected devices, such as accelerators, memory expanders, and NICs, can perform peer-to-peer communication, bypassing the host CPUs. From CXL 2.0 onward, devices can be hot-plugged or removed. Device-attached memory is mapped to the system's coherent address space and accessible to the host using standard writeback semantics. Memory located on a CXL device can be mapped as either Host-managed Device Memory (HDM) or Private Device Memory (PDM).

To update the memory address space for connected devices to different host devices, a system reset is needed; traffic towards the device must stop to alter device address mapping during this reset period.

The field of imaging sciences often deals with inverse problems, where the objective is to estimate an unknown image \( x \in \mathbb{R}^d \) from an observation \( y \). This observation is related to \( x \) through a forward model, which can be expressed as:

\[ y = A(x) + n \]

where \( A \) is the observation operator and \( n \) represents additive noise. The challenge of recovering \( x \) from \( y \) by inverting this model is typically an ill-posed or ill-conditioned problem, meaning the solution may not be unique or stable with respect to perturbations in \( y \). To address this, additional information about the unknown image \( x \) is required to make the problem well-posed.

The Bayesian statistical framework offers a robust approach to formulating well-posed solutions for such inverse problems. Within this framework, the likelihood of observing \( y \) given \( x \) is modeled by a probability density function \( p(y|x) \), while prior assumptions about \( x \) are expressed through a prior density \( p(x) \). These densities are typically specified directly or through their potentials, \( U(x) = -\log p(x) \) and \( F(x, y) = -\log p(y|x) \). Bayes' theorem is then employed to derive the posterior distribution of \( x \) given \( y \), with the posterior density function expressed as:

\[ p(x|y) = \frac{p(y|x)p(x)}{\int p(y|x)p(x) \, dx} \]

This model forms the foundation for making inferences about \( x|y \) and deriving Bayesian estimates. Among various Bayesian estimators, the imaging field predominantly utilizes the maximum-a-posteriori (MAP) estimator due to its computational efficiency compared to estimators that require expectation calculations, such as the Minimum Mean Square Error estimator (MMSE).

Traditionally, Bayesian imaging has relied on explicit priors, including Markov random fields, priors expressing sparsity in transformed domains, or learning-based priors like patch-based Gaussian mixture models. Log-concave models are especially favored for computational and analytical reasons. They facilitate MAP estimation and uncertainty quantification using convex optimization techniques, which scale efficiently to high dimensions and offer strong convergence guarantees. Log-concavity also supports advanced Monte Carlo sampling algorithms and ensures the well-posedness of \( p(x|y) \), confirming \( x_{\text{MAP}} \) as a formal Bayesian estimator.

In scenarios where the posterior density \( p(.|y) \) is proper and differentiable, with a Lipschitz continuous gradient, first-order optimization methods can be used to compute MAP estimators. The gradient descent algorithm, initiated from \( X_0 \in \mathbb{R}^d \), follows this recursion for \( k \in \mathbb{N} \):

\[ X_{k+1} = X_k - \delta_k \nabla \log p(X_k|y) \]

The sequence \( \{X_k\}_{k \in \mathbb{N}} \) converges to critical points of \( p(.|y) \) under mild conditions on \( \{\delta_k\}_{k \in \mathbb{N}} \) and \( p(.|y) \). Alternatively, stochastic gradient descent (SGD) offers robustness against local minima and saddle points, which is beneficial when \( x \rightarrow p(x|y) \) is not log-concave:

\[ X_{k+1} = X_k - \delta_k (\nabla \log p(X_k|y) + Z_k) \]

Here, \( \{Z_k\}_{k \in \mathbb{N}} \) are i.i.d. Gaussian random variables with zero mean and identity covariance. Although various optimization schemes surpass SGD in convergence properties, SGD remains straightforward, robust, and well-supported by convergence theory, making it a valuable tool in imaging science.

In recent years, deep learning has become prevalent in solving imaging inverse problems, achieving exceptional performance in tasks like image denoising. Deep networks can function without explicit knowledge of the forward model or incorporate this model via unrolled optimization techniques. However, these networks often require retraining for different problem configurations and struggle with advanced inferences like decision-theoretic procedures.

Plug & Play (PnP) approaches offer a hybrid solution, combining explicit model components with data-driven techniques. These methods integrate an explicit likelihood density with a prior or regularization term defined by an image denoising algorithm, \( D_\epsilon \). The denoiser substitutes the gradient or proximal operator in iterative optimization schemes to compute \( x_{\text{MAP}} \). This allows separating the data observation model from regularization, often represented by a neural network denoiser trained on data.

【明报专讯】位于港岛南区的黄竹坑，对不少人来说都颇为陌生。原因是这里没有大型商厦和购物中心，即使几年前港铁通车，这个社区也未有变得热闹起来。然而，近年相继有不少酒店进驻，尤其是以工业风加艺术型格作主打的酒店，为区内增添了不少活力。下次staycation，不妨考虑黄竹坑区。

工业风×艺术酒店 处处打卡位
港岛南区近年来增添了不少新酒店，除了以家庭客路为主的大型主题乐园式酒店，亦有文青风新酒店进驻。上月，一家充满艺术风的精品酒店The Arca登陆黄竹坑，令这个小社区变得潮起来。The Arca位于香叶道，以炭灰色砖墙打造型格外貌，室内设计由本地设计品牌DEFT操刀，配上绿墙、金属色系，通过不同的质感对比及艺术品，营造一股时尚且带有工业风的格调。

温馨客房 饱览山海靓景
酒店共提供7个房型、187间客房，大部分为基本双人客房，包括拥有海景的sea signature与城市景的city signature。来到港岛南，选择向海的房间是不错的选择。黄竹坑的海景有着独特的美丽，游艇、渔船整齐停泊在避风塘，远处还有玉桂山和鸭脷洲，蓝天白云海岸远山，让人有种在南法马赛度假的感觉。这与维港海景是不一样的体验，唯一瑕疵是部分客房被新建成的豪宅阻挡了少许海景。大部分房间窗台均备有软垫，可以舒服地倚在窗边欣赏景色。

房间设计采用大地色系，营造出很homey的感觉。一般双人客房面积约为330平方呎，使用无主灯、浅色系配搭，加上特大玻璃窗，令空间更显宽敞。想与家人共度时光，可以选择面积达780平方呎的sea suite套房，最多可供3人入住，内有精致吧台、用餐区、梳化电视区及主人房。套房兼备圆形浴缸与淋浴间，提供了泡澡的愉悦体验。

池畔晒太阳 捕捉水面与海连成一线
酒店的另一大特色是位于顶楼的无边际海景泳池Arca Sky。电梯门一开，往左一瞥就能看见泳池。特定角度下，可以拍摄到泳池水面与海连成一线的画面，非常适合打卡。

سؤال واحد يشغل بال عشاق كرة القدم في هذا الوقت من كل عام، من هو اللاعب الأحق بالحصول على الكرة الذهبية. من يحصد الكرة الذهبية لهذا العام بعد كل ما حدث من ظروف ومستجدات على ساحة كرة القدم؟!

العام يمر وينتهي الموسم الكروي ويفوز هذا بدوري الأبطال وذاك بالبطولات القارية ويبقى السؤال الأكثر تداولًا، من أحق بتلك الجائزة الأهم بين كل الجوائز الفردية. جائزة هذا العام تحمل أهمية خاصة للغاية في ظل وجود عوامل أكثر تحسم الحاصل عليها، حيث تلعب بطولة كأس الأمم الأوروبية وكوبا أمريكا.

بالإضافة لذلك فهناك حالة من التوازن بين بطولات الأندية، فلا يوجد فريق واحد اكتسح كل الألقاب كما كان الوضع قبل عام مع بايرن ميونخ مثلًا. فبطل الدوري الإسباني غير بطل الكأس غير بطل دوري أبطال أوروبا غير بطل الدوري الإنجليزي وهناك في إيطاليا عاد إنتر ليزاحم يوفنتوس في الدوري وبفرنسا فشل باريس سان جيرمان.

لو نظرنا للموسم الخاص بالأندية سنجد أن أمل الكبار ميسي ورونالدو ونيمار ومبابي قد انتهى بحلول شهر مايو وخسارتهم للدوريات المحلية الخاصة بهم. أضف لهم نجوم ريال مدريد الذين لم يحققوا أي شيء طوال الموسم سواء فرديًا أو جماعيًا، ومعهم بايرن ميونخ بعد خيبة الأمل الأوروبية.

بين أزمة الرواتب وتجديد عقد ميسي.. لابورتا في مأزق. وبعد انطلاق بطولة كأس الأمم الأوروبية بدأ الأمل يتسرب لبعض هؤلاء النجوم وعلى رأسهم كريستيانو رونالدو بعد بدايته القوية في البطولة. لكن بمغادرته لها من دور الـ 16 انتهى أمله تمامًا، وتبعه كيفين دي بروينه وروميلو لوكاكو ونجولو كانتي وكيليان مبابي بخروج منتخبات بلادهم عن البطولة بالإضافة لنجوم ألمانيا.

في الوقت الحالي يعد ليونيل ميسي هو الوحيد المتبقي من ضمن الكبار الذي يستطيع التنافس على الكرة الذهبية بوصول منتخب بلاده لنصف نهائي كوبا أمريكا. وهناك أيضًا نيمار لكن بدرجة أقل، في ظل غيابه لقرابة ثلاثة أشهر خلال الموسم لإصابات متنوعة جعلته يتغيب عن 20 مباراة لباريس سان جيرمان.

A Suffolk council has continued to invest taxpayer cash in property elsewhere in the country by snapping up a trade park 120 miles away in Coventry. The Pilot Trade Centre in Coventry is the 19th property added to the portfolio of CIFCO Capital Ltd, the councils' property investment company. Despite criticism from opponents who say "people will resent their money being sent to Coventry,” Mid Suffolk and Babergh district councils argue that the move will bring in £300,000 a year in rent, which can be reinvested into public services at home.

In January, the councils spent £5.7m on the Basingstoke Business Centre, which is 140 miles away. The portfolio also includes properties such as a building housing a hair salon and GP surgery in Nottingham city centre and West Park House in Southampton, let to a law firm, as well as sites housing an M&S and a Wagamama restaurant. The purchase has been made using £100m of taxpayer cash, with £15m more of commercial investments due to be agreed before March 31.

The model of borrowing public money and investing it in commercial property, as done by CIFCO, is not unique to Suffolk but is controversial. John Matthissen, the Green and Liberal Democrat shadow portfolio holder for investments at Mid Suffolk council, expressed opposition to the move, citing concerns from constituents about their money being sent to Coventry. In contrast, Babergh District Council leader John Ward emphasized the importance of CIFCO's income stream in helping the councils weather the global crisis and continue providing essential services.

CIFCO's 2019/20 accounts showed “significant” losses, with losses of £3.5m in the financial year. The impact of Covid-19 on the value of investments has contributed to these losses. Even before that, CIFCO had been experiencing financial challenges, with aggregate losses in net income totaling £8m since its launch in 2017. The costs of buying properties, including stamp duty and fees, have been a factor in these financial difficulties.

Despite the financial challenges, the councils highlight that CIFCO has brought in £4.5m of net income to both authorities.

She also served as a Union Representative for the International Ladies' Garment Workers' Union.

Throughout the years, Helen was an active member of the Altar Society of Our Lady of Mt. Carmel Church, the Mt. Carmel Seniors, the Richard A. Rutkowski Association, and the Queen Wanda Society.
