Makowski, son-in-law Edward Szaro, and grandson John Myhre.

Quantum machine learning seeks to leverage quantum computers to enhance the capabilities of machine learning. One potential avenue for achieving quantum advantage in this field is through the use of quantum embedding kernels. These kernels allow quantum computers to encode data in ways that are challenging for classical machine learning methods to replicate. Noisy intermediate-scale quantum computers have shown potential in tackling tasks that are difficult for classical computers and have been promising in running proof-of-concept quantum machine learning applications. However, current quantum computers operate at a speed that is at least six orders of magnitude slower than classical computers. Moreover, the operational cost of quantum computers is high, necessitating the development of resource-efficient methods. Therefore, there is a critical need to improve how we run and benchmark these noisy quantum systems.

Several practical bottlenecks constrain the use of quantum hardware for machine learning. First, the conventional methods for measuring quantum kernels require quantum resources that scale quadratically with the size of the training dataset, which is restrictive since machine learning typically involves large datasets. Second, data must be efficiently encoded into the quantum computer to generate a useful quantum kernel. While various encoding methods have been proposed, they often face limitations due to the number of qubits or are characterized in a heuristic manner. Lastly, the inherent noise in quantum computers compromises the quality of experimental results. Error mitigation strategies have been suggested, but these generally demand a substantial amount of additional quantum computing resources.

In this work, we use randomized measurements to calculate quantum kernels.

El "yo no lo voté" se multiplicaba a fines de los 90. La década llegaba a su fin y los 10 años y cinco meses de presidencia de Carlos Menem dejaban un país complejo, tanto social como económicamente. Sin embargo, no solo "alguien" efectivamente lo había votado, sino que muchos lo habían hecho. No una, sino dos veces, ya que sus habilidades políticas, entre otras situaciones, le permitieron mover las piezas de tal manera que en 1994 motorizó la reforma de la Constitución, acortando los períodos presidenciales a cuatro años y permitiéndole la reelección, la cual tuvo lugar en 1995. De este modo, fue presidente desde el 9 de julio de 1989, cuando recibió el mandato de Raúl Alfonsín, con quien precisamente pactó la reforma de 1994, hasta el 10 de diciembre de 1999, fecha en la que entregó el poder a Fernando de la Rúa.
Durante su gobierno, que en realidad fue 100% "menemista", Menem, quien inicialmente ascendió al poder defendiendo las tradiciones del General y del viejo justicialismo, fue el primero en proclamar la necesidad de modernizarse y no estancarse en la era del '45, año en que Perón se convirtió en líder de masas. Sin embargo, nunca dejó de hacer referencia al fundador del PJ. El menemismo, en esencia, representó un equilibrio entre el discurso popular y la acción liberal; entre promover la justicia social sin contar con un Estado benefactor e intervencionista; entre entonar cánticos de "combatir al capital" con los dedos en V y liberar el mercado para que se autorregule.
El gobierno de Menem emergió de las ruinas de una Argentina casi en bancarrota, brilló en un período en el que parecía que todo marchaba sobre rieles y el país, de verdad, estaba avanzando hacia el primer mundo, tal como lo afirmaba el propio Menem, para luego desplomarse en los últimos años de su mandato.
La doble presidencia de Menem abarca muchas facetas, pero posiblemente, la Ley de Convertibilidad y el denominado 1 a 1, que equiparó el peso argentino con el dólar estadounidense, son los puntos más destacados.

Hoy, se llevará a cabo una reunión virtual del Consejo Consultivo Social Local el 6 de abril de 2020. Desde las 12, se informará sobre la situación sanitaria ante la pandemia del COVID-19, las acciones preventivas que se están ejecutando y las acciones que serán necesarias a futuro para contener la economía global y local que se ven afectadas. Estos temas serán los ejes principales de este encuentro.

En la foto de archivo, aparece Amalia Galanti, secretaria de gobierno y participación ciudadana.

Este lunes, a partir de las 12, se realizará una nueva reunión del Consejo Consultivo Social. Este espacio está integrado por representantes del Estado local, organismos de otros niveles del Estado e instituciones intermedias, y se llevará a cabo de manera virtual para cumplir con el distanciamiento social.

"Convocamos a esta reunión virtual del Consejo Consultivo Social porque estamos atravesando momentos difíciles, de gran incertidumbre, donde se pone en juego la salud de todos y donde también se ve afectada la economía, a nivel global y local", señaló Amalia Galanti, secretaria de gobierno y participación ciudadana.

شدد القيادي في "تيار المردة"، النائب السابق كريم الراسي، على أن "لا أحد قدم تسهيلات أكثر من النائب السابق سليمان فرنجية، ولا أحد قدم طروحات إيجابية أكثر مما قدمه فرنجية. اليوم، هو يدق جرس الخطر، وهو الوحيد الذي يُسمَع رأيه من الجانبين ومحترم من قبلهما". وتمنى لو أن "رئيس حكومة تصريف الأعمال، سعد الحريري، قبل بتشكيل الحكومة، لأنه لو فعل ذلك لكانت الحكومة قد حصلت على الميثاقية".

ولفت الراسي في حديث تلفزيوني إلى أن "رئيس الحكومة المكلف، حسان دياب، ليس طرفًا في الصراع السياسي، لكنه يواجه مشكلة في التمثيل المسيحي. حتى الآن، لم يستشر أي فريق سوى فريق بعبدا، لذلك عليه إما أن يكون بعيدًا عن الجميع أو قريبًا من الجميع". وأكد أن "الاستشارات يجب أن تأخذ وقتها، وعليه أن يشكل لائحة بأسماء مقبولة تكون بعيدة عن الإعلام، وأن يحصل على موافقة الأكثرية لتكون التشكيلة مُرتاحة عند إرسالها إلى مجلس النواب.

شدد محمد يوسف المدرب العام لفريق الأهلي على صعوبة مواجهة الإسماعيلي المقررة الأربعاء المقبل في ملعب برج العرب. وقال يوسف في تصريحات للموقع الرسمي للنادي الأهلي إن مواجهة الإسماعيلي تعتبر خطوة مهمة في رحلة الدفاع عن اللقب، خاصةً أنها أمام منافس كبير. وأضاف يوسف أن المباراة بين الأهلي والإسماعيلي تقام في المباراة المؤجلة بينهما من الجولة 18 بمسابقة الدوري.
وأكد يوسف أن مباريات الأهلي مع الإسماعيلي دائماً تكون مليئة بالقوة والإثارة والندية. وأعرب عن ثقته في قدرات اللاعبين الذين يدركون جيداً أهمية كل نقطة متبقية في مشوار البطولة. كما أشار يوسف إلى وجود حالة من الإصرار والعزيمة لدى الجميع للحفاظ على اللقب.
وأضاف يوسف أن الفريق يلعب دائماً من أجل الفوز وأن هذه المرحلة تحتاج إلى استغلال أفضل للفرص المتاحة. وشدد على ضرورة أن يتحلى اللاعبون بشخصية الأهلي وأن يلعبوا ويقاتلوا حتى الثواني الأخيرة من أجل حسم نقاط المباراة الثلاثة وتحقيق أهداف الفريق.
في السياق ذاته، قال مصدر في الزمالك لموقع "في الجول" إن المدرب كريستيان جروس لديه اتجاه لعدم المجازفة باللاعب محمود عبد الرازق "شيكابالا" في نهائي الكونفدرالية. وأضاف المصدر أن الفريق يعول على الكونفدرالية كسلاح لفك شراكته مع فريق مازيمبي.

This paper explores the application of the finite element method (FEM) to a semilinear parabolic equation featuring a singular convection term expressed as:
\[ u_t = u_{xx} + N^{-1}x u_x + f(u), \quad x \in I = (0, 1), \, t > 0 \]
where \( u = u(x, t) \), with \( x \in I = [0, 1] \) and \( t \geq 0 \), represents the function of interest. Here, \( f \) is a given locally Lipschitz continuous function and \( u_0 \) is a continuous function specified in the initial condition. In this study, we consider \( N \) as an integer greater than or equal to 2.

To investigate the blow-up solution of the given equation, we employ Nakagawa's time-increment control strategy, a method known for its effectiveness in approximating blow-up times. In contrast to the standard finite element approximation, which proves inadequate for this purpose, we introduce a novel mass-lumping finite element approximation. We establish its convergence, apply it to a blow-up analysis, and outline the rationale behind this study.

In many engineering scenarios, mathematical models involve at most three spatial dimensions. While solving partial differential equations (PDEs) in higher dimensions typically serves mathematical curiosity, it often unveils profound aspects of PDEs. One notable outcome of such investigations is Fujita's identification of the blow-up exponent in the semilinear heat equation given by \( U = U(x, t) \), where the parameters \( N \) and \( f(U) \) are defined accordingly. Fujita demonstrated that a positive solution experiences finite-time blow-up if \( 1 + \alpha < 1 + 2/N \). On the other hand, a solution maintains smoothness over time if the initial value is sufficiently small and \( 1 + \alpha > 1 + 2/N \). The critical exponent, \( p_c = 1 + 2/N \), introduced by Fujita in Eq. (3), delineates this behavior. Subsequent to Fujita's seminal work, extensive research has delved into critical phenomena in various nonlinear PDEs, leading to valuable insights applicable to problems with three or fewer spatial dimensions.

However, challenges arise when tackling non-stationary problems in four-dimensional space using numerical methods, even with modern computing resources. As a result, numerical investigations into blow-up solutions of nonlinear PDEs have predominantly been confined to two-dimensional space. Noteworthy exceptions include studies applying Nakagawa's time-increment control strategy to various nonlinear PDEs but limited to one spatial dimension. For instance, pioneering works addressed the finite element method for a semilinear heat equation in a two-dimensional polygonal domain and the finite difference method for the radially symmetric solution of the semilinear heat equation in an \( N \)-dimensional ball.

Building upon prior research, this paper delves into radially symmetric solutions to Eq. (3). By assuming radial symmetry and simplifying the N-dimensional equation to a one-dimensional form, we focus on a specific problem configuration. Notably, the investigation involves studying the problem in an N-dimensional unit ball with a homogeneous Dirichlet boundary condition and expressing \( U \) as \( u(x) = U(x) \) for \( x \) within the ball. By adopting this approach, we analyze problem (1).

Following an extension of previous work by Cho and Okamoto, who refined existing schemes and achieved optimal-order convergence using Nakagawa's strategy, we confront the challenge of adapting finite element schemes to the semilinear equation. While the convergence properties of schemes differ based on the Lipschitz continuity of \( f \) and the spatial dimension, our study navigates these intricacies to devise a robust finite element approximation. Through our novel mass-lumping approximation, we establish the discrete maximum principle, verify convergence properties, and execute blow-up analyses for systems with varying spatial dimensions.

The outcomes of our study are encapsulated as follows, denoted as (ML-1) and (ML-2):
- The solution of (ML-1) remains non-negative under certain conditions on \( f \) and \( u_0 \), with similar results observed for (ML-2) subject to specific time increment constraints.
- (ML-1) converges optimally to the solution of (1) in the weighted \( L^2 \) norm in space and the \( L^\infty \) norm in time, with further convergence analysis provided.

Backdoors are essentially deliberate prediction shortcuts, designed to establish a link between trigger features and target labels in models, allowing for high-confidence predictions when triggers are present. To combat this threat, defense strategies need to focus on removing these backdoor triggers either during training or testing phases. Training-time defense involves discarding trigger-affected samples to break the correlation between triggers and target labels. Test-time defenses detect and remove trigger tokens from textual input to prevent backdoor activation. However, the challenge arises when backdoor triggers are invisible or implicit, making them difficult to detect and filter out. New types of attacks, like stylistic attacks based on textual style transfer, further complicate defense strategies by using stealthy and complex triggers. In the era of large language models, the risk of malicious data pollution hidden in training data poses an unprecedented threat, necessitating effective end-to-end defenses against various backdoor attacks.

Recent studies have shown that backdoor attacks on language models, such as data poisoning attacks, pose significant threats by exploiting vulnerabilities through trigger insertion in training data. These attacks can lead to critical document oversight in systems, potentially causing information leakage. Moreover, attackers can extract sensitive personal information from language models, highlighting the need for robust defense strategies in real-world scenarios. The development of efficient defense mechanisms is crucial to address the safety issues posed by backdoor attacks in diverse applications.

In response to the challenges posed by backdoor attacks, a new framework called Nested Product of Experts (NPoE) is proposed as an end-to-end defense technique against multiple backdoor triggers. NPoE builds on the PoE framework by employing an ensemble of shallow models to capture distinct backdoor triggers. This ensemble is then used to train a main model that is shielded from backdoors present in poisoned training data.

Fenton Restaurant Week is heating up and impressing even the pickiest eaters. Over a dozen restaurants are participating in the third annual event, which runs from January 21 to January 27. One of the highlights of the week is the special menu items offered at a discounted price at The Corner Bar and Grill in Fenton.

"The food is amazing!" exclaimed Sara Tabaka, who visited The Corner Bar and Grill for some brunch and brews. She appreciates how restaurant week shines a light on her hometown, noting that she plans to visit other participating venues like The Laundry and The Fenton Fire Hall. "We will keep coming back for more! It's really good!" she added.

Justin Trombley, the Executive Chef at The Corner Bar, is enthusiastic about the event, saying, "It's really cool! It gives us an opportunity to do something outside of the box." This sentiment is echoed by many local chefs who see the week as a chance to experiment and showcase their creativity.

Another local favorite, The Fenton House, has been serving the community for decades. This week, they are offering a 15 percent discount on the entire bill. Melanie Varner, the assistant manager, reassures customers that despite updates to the restaurant, they continue to serve all the beloved classic dishes. "The restaurant has changed but it is still the same delicious menu," said Varner.

Docentes de la Facultad de Arquitectura, profesores y alumnos de la Escuela de Educación Técnica N°4 “Alfonsina Storni” y directivos de Edea presentaron este lunes un nuevo avance del proyecto “Electricidad Segura” en el marco del Programa "Hábitat y Ciudadanía" que llevan adelante en el barrio Nuevo Golf. En esta ocasión se dotó de instalaciones eléctricas seguras, no sólo a viviendas del barrio, sino también al centro comunitario construido recientemente en Calle 81, entre Cerrito y Gianelli.

El arquitecto Fernando Cacopardo, impulsor del programa, explicó que “en este proceso de trabajo iniciado hace 12 años, hemos ido construyendo una red de socios, una red de cooperaciones, entre los que se encuentra Edea y la escuela Técnica Alfonsina Storni N°4. Esta es una de las alianzas solidarias más interesantes que hemos desarrollado en estos años de acciones en equipo". Cacopardo sostuvo que “desde el programa Hábitat y Ciudadanía queremos generar conciencia sobre la importancia del trabajo en conjunto que, como en este caso, contribuye a mejorar la calidad de vida de la gente".

Por su parte, el gerente general de la distribuidora eléctrica, Esteban Pérez Elustondo, destacó que “el proyecto se ha consolidado más allá de las personas que participan y lo impulsan. A lo largo de estos años, las instituciones que toman parte del mismo han cambiado sus directivos sin que se haya modificado el compromiso y la vocación de servicio que conlleva esta iniciativa”. Pérez Elustondo puso de relieve la labor del arquitecto Cacopardo y su equipo, y el de los alumnos de la Escuela Técnica "Alfonsina Storni", así como también de los profesores que acompañan a los chicos. "Este proyecto -dijo- ofrece la posibilidad de desarrollar en la práctica los conocimientos que los alumnos adquieren en la escuela todos los días, al tiempo que les permite compartir una experiencia social en un ámbito para algunos desconocido.”

La empresa eléctrica y la Escuela Técnica "Alfonsina Storni" firmaron en julio del año 2005 un convenio a través del cual Edea coopera técnicamente con dicha escuela. Esto posibilitó que los alumnos, bajo supervisión de personal docente, pudieran poner en práctica sus conocimientos realizando las instalaciones eléctricas en las viviendas construidas a partir del programa Hábitat y Ciudadanía, dotándolas con los elementos de seguridad y protección correspondientes, entre ellos un disyuntor diferencial.

Para cumplir con estas tareas, en el inicio de la experiencia, la distribuidora eléctrica donó un set completo de herramientas, aparatos electrónicos de medición y elementos de seguridad para todo el equipo de trabajo. Estos pasaron a formar parte del patrimonio de la escuela, y también proveen todos los materiales eléctricos que las obras demandan.

Los resultados de los últimos estudios científicos realizados con esta sustancia confirman que el sueño de duplicar la esperanza de vida podría hacerse realidad muy pronto...

• El término "fullerenos" se refiere a moléculas compuestas exclusivamente por carbono, como el grafito o el diamante, que pueden adoptar diversas formas geométricas. El fullereno C60, una esfera de tamaño inferior a un nanómetro, se asemeja a una cúpula geodésica, de ahí su denominación "buckminsterfullereno" en honor al arquitecto Buckminster Fuller, quien lo popularizó. El fullereno C60 es una molécula pura compuesta por sesenta átomos de carbono.

• Los fullerenos se encuentran en la naturaleza, así como en el espacio, y fueron descubiertos en 1985 por tres investigadores (Harold Kroto, Robert Curl, Richard Smalley), quienes recibieron el Premio Nobel de Química en 1996. Pueden generarse de forma natural en pequeñas cantidades durante combustiones, en relámpagos a través de la atmósfera, o artificialmente, como durante la vaporización del grafito bajo una atmósfera de gas inerte.

• Hasta la fecha, se han publicado más de 1300 estudios sobre los fullerenos, incluido un importante estudio realizado en ratas que ha despertado grandes expectativas y del que aún se sigue hablando...

El fullereno C60 aumenta en un 90% la longevidad de ratas de mediana edad

• En comparación con la restricción calórica o el tratamiento con rapamicina, que aumentan la esperanza de vida entre un 15 y un 20% (lo cual es significativo), el aporte adicional de fullereno C60 incrementa la esperanza de vida de los roedores en un 90%. Este resultado destacado es el resultado de una investigación publicada en abril de 2012 por el profesor Fathi Moussa (profesor de química analítica en la Universidad de Orsay Paris-Sud) y Tarek Baati (Facultad de Farmacia CNRS Châtenay-Malabry), quienes utilizaron suspensiones a largo plazo de fullereno C60 en aceite de oliva. Comprobaron que, además de una total ausencia de toxicidad, la administración de este compuesto permitía casi duplicar la esperanza de vida de las ratas, sin que ninguna desarrollara cáncer en comparación con el grupo de control.

• La toxicidad del C60 se evaluó al disolverse en aceite de oliva (0,8 mg por ml), demostrando ser su mejor vehículo de transporte y, sobre todo, una solución perfecta, ya que el fullereno C60, lipófilo, se disuelve muy poco en agua. Los investigadores comprobaron una total ausencia de toxicidad, incluso con dosis de hasta 1,7 mg/kg de peso corporal.

Una notable capacidad para combatir el estrés oxidativo

• Estos efectos impresionantes se han observado no solo por la reducción del estrés oxidativo, sino también por su completa y notable absorción en el tracto gastrointestinal, así como su total eliminación en las 10 horas posteriores a su absorción. El fullereno C60 se elimina principalmente a través de las vías biliares y no a través de la orina.

• Una investigación previa, publicada en 2008, ya demostró que su administración en ratones no solo aumentaba su longevidad, sino que también mejoraba la deficiencia cognitiva relacionada con la edad.

• Otro estudio realizado en 2011 también demostró sus efectos beneficiosos en el crecimiento y la longevidad de organismos primitivos, como algas verdes y diversas variedades de hongos Aspergillus.

Un potente poder de penetración celular

• Gracias a su elevado número de enlaces dobles, el fullereno C60 actúa como un poderoso antioxidante. Sin embargo, su capacidad para penetrar fácilmente en el interior de las células, en su núcleo y sus mitocondrias, lo convierte en el cazador intracelular de radicales libres más eficaz del mundo.

Prometedor contra enfermedades neurodegenerativas

• Debido a su pequeño tamaño, el fullereno C60 atraviesa fácilmente la barrera hematoencefálica, lo que abre numerosas aplicaciones médicas, especialmente en el campo de la nanomedicina, mediante el desarrollo de nuevos compuestos activos que podrían ser utilizados en el cerebro. Se revela como una sustancia muy prometedora en el tratamiento de diversos trastornos neuronales.

• Estudios en curso también muestran que retrasa los síntomas de la esclerosis lateral amiotrófica (ELA) y sus propiedades antioxidantes sugieren que tiene efectos neuroprotectores contra enfermedades degenerativas como el Parkinson. De hecho, el fullereno C60 es capaz de neutralizar el anión superóxido y el peróxido (H2O2) e inhibir eficazmente la peroxidación de los lípidos.

• Incluso se considera que el fullereno C60 podría ser un agente activo en el tratamiento de la enfermedad de Alzheimer, ya que los investigadores han demostrado que combate la agregación de proteínas beta amiloides y la degeneración de las neuronas piramidales del hipocampo. Esto podría llevar al desarrollo de nuevos medicamentos para el cerebro, aprovechando sus propiedades antioxidantes y antiagregantes.

Un valioso aliado en oncología

• Los fullerenos también se revelan como potentes transportadores de fármacos convencionales utilizados, por ejemplo, en oncología, permitiendo alcanzar con mayor precisión el objetivo tumoral gracias a sus propiedades autofágicas frente a las células cancerosas.

• Según un estudio realizado en 2011, el fullereno C60 en solución, en una dosis de 5 mg/kg, no solo inhibe en más del 76% el crecimiento de un tumor trasplantado (carcinoma de pulmón), sino que también tiene un efecto antimetastásico de casi el 48%.

• Una publicación de 2009 destacó su capacidad para estimular el crecimiento del cabello, dato especialmente interesante para contrarrestar los efectos de la quimioterapia, por ejemplo.

CONAKRY, Guinea (AP) — Guinea's opposition parties announced on Wednesday that they will not participate in the legislative elections scheduled for February. They intend to push for a delay unless the president withdraws his bid to seek another term. 

The opposition's statement follows last year's massive demonstrations where tens of thousands urged President Alpha Condé not to amend the constitution to allow him a third term. At least nine people were killed during one of the protests in October. 

At least five parties have declared their intent not to take part in the February 16 vote. They have also called for new demonstrations on January 13 to protest both the legislative elections and Condé's proposed constitutional changes. 

"Not only will we not participate in this election, but we will also oppose its occurrence by all legal means, as it is merely a charade," stated Ousmane Gaoual Diallo, spokesperson for the Union of Democratic Forces of Guinea, one of the leading opposition parties. 

"We cannot engage in an election that is rigged, with an electoral commission president whose actions are dictated by President Alpha Condé," added Sidya Touré of the Union of Republican Forces, another opposition leader. 

Despite the opposition's declarations, Presidential adviser Souleymane Keita asserted that the vote will proceed. 

"If the opposition chooses not to participate, they will face the consequences," he said. "We will move forward with the elections on February 16, with or without the opposition." 

Condé's mandate concludes in December 2020, yet he seeks a referendum to enable a third term in the West African nation, which has a population of approximately 12 million. The 81-year-old Condé was first elected to a five-year term in 2010, marking Guinea's initial democratic transition of power since gaining independence from France in 1958. He was re-elected in 2015.

A recent study suggests that red wine, particularly a plant compound called resveratrol found in it, may have beneficial effects on depression and anxiety for those who enjoy a glass in the evening. Resveratrol is known for its potential heart health benefits, and the study published in Neuropharmacology now indicates that it could also aid in alleviating depression and anxiety symptoms.

The study, which focused on the impact of resveratrol in mice and built upon previous in vitro research, concluded that resveratrol may help protect against corticosterone, a stress hormone associated with depression and anxiety. While resveratrol is just one of the compounds in red wine, it is important to note that alcohol, as a whole, acts as a depressant on the body’s central nervous system (CNS). Although CNS depressants may not induce immediate feelings of sadness, prolonged use can lead to lethargy, muscle weakness, agitation, and impaired judgment.

Moreover, alcohol consumption can disrupt the sleep-wake cycle and cause attention deficits, potentially leading to issues such as blackouts. While temporary feelings of euphoria and altered judgment may accompany alcohol consumption, sustained and heavy use can have lasting effects on memory and immune functions. These effects are commonly associated with depression, such as disrupted sleep, altered judgment, lethargy, agitation, and muscle weakness.

The relationship between red wine, depression, and anxiety is multifaceted. While resveratrol has shown promise in lowering stress hormone levels linked to these conditions, it is essential to consider the broader impact of alcohol consumption. Scientific knowledge has long suggested that red wine can benefit heart health due to its polyphenol antioxidants, including resveratrol. However, recent research indicates that individuals with diets naturally high in resveratrol do not necessarily have reduced risks of heart disease or cancer.

Dr. Kenneth Mukamal from Harvard Health advises putting claims of resveratrol's heart health benefits into context alongside other lifestyle factors and alcohol consumption. Understanding the effects of different drinking patterns and types of alcoholic beverages is crucial. While acknowledging the potential anti-depression and anti-anxiety effects of resveratrol in red wine, it is essential to consider the broader impact of alcohol on the CNS.

**The Face**

In 1976, NASA's Viking 1 spacecraft captured a photograph of a formation on Mars' surface, believed by some to resemble a "face." Over the years, debates have ensued about whether "the face" was created by aliens or is merely a natural landform. Here's why I believe it is a natural landform.

In the article "Unmasking the Face on Mars," paragraph 12 explains that the image actually shows a formation on Mars comparable to a butte or mesa, landforms common in the American West. Some argue that a picture alone is insufficient to accurately determine the nature of a formation, as it represents only a portion of the scene. However, in paragraph 11, Garvin states, "As a rule of thumb, you can discern things in a digital image that are three times larger than the pixel size." Thus, if the image contained objects like airplanes, Egyptian-style pyramids, or even small shacks, they would be identifiable.

Some might claim the image taken by the Viking 1 spacecraft, given the 20th-century technology, is unreliable. However, paragraph 10 describes how the spacecraft was rolled 25 degrees to center the "face" in the field of view, allowing the team, led by Malin, to capture a remarkable photo using the camera's absolute maximum resolution. In the 2001 image, each pixel spans 1.56 meters, a significant improvement from the 43 meters in the 1976 Viking photo, demonstrating the decision was based, not on 20th-century technology, but on the advancements of the 21st century.

La fermeture inacceptable du forage de Thione (Par Jean Ndiaye)

La fermeture controversée du forage de Thione, situé dans le département de Kaffrine, a suscité un vif émoi en raison de son caractère sans précédent, ubuesque, scandaleux, anachronique et véritablement kafkaïen. Cette décision fait écho aux heures les plus sombres du stalinisme et nous ramène à l'ère révoltante du colonialisme. En effet, pour contraindre les habitants, qui osent s'opposer à ce qu'ils considèrent comme une atteinte à leur autonomie maintes fois exprimée, les autorités ont choisi de fermer le forage desservant de nombreux villages, dont Dioumada et Thione.

Derrière cette mesure arbitraire se cache l'intention de confier la gestion du forage à l'OFOR, alors que le comité local élu par les habitants a remporté l'adhésion générale en raison de ses performances remarquables. En effet, grâce à l'engagement des membres du comité et aux directives claires des autorités religieuses locales exhortant les habitants à régler leurs factures, le fonctionnement du forage a été exemplaire.

Les habitants ont donc été perplexes face à la décision des autorités de fermer brutalement le forage, les plongeant dans une situation difficile en ces périodes de canicule, de travaux agricoles et surtout de pandémie de COVID-19. Il est impératif que les autorités comprennent qu'il est impossible d'administrer une population sans tenir compte de ses préoccupations, principe fondamental de la démocratie participative.

Pourquoi confier la gestion des forages à des entités qui ont déjà prouvé leur incapacité à assurer un approvisionnement adéquat en eau pour les habitants ? Comment peut-on justifier moralement le fait de priver des milliers de Sénégalais d'accès à l'eau simplement parce qu'ils ne partagent pas l'opinion des dirigeants locaux qui, déconnectés de la réalité, se considèrent investis d'une mission salvatrice envers les habitants ruraux ?

Ces "chefs de province" portent un coup sévère à la volonté maintes fois exprimée par les autorités centrales d'impliquer les populations dans la résolution de leurs problèmes. Il est grand temps que nos gouvernants apprennent à prendre en considération nos suggestions et notre approche des situations. Un peu plus d'humilité de leur part ne serait vraiment pas de trop !

Ainsi, le précieux liquide ne coule plus à Thione et dans les environs, car quelques individus cachés dans l'ombre cherchent à s'approprier la gestion du lucratif forage qui, rappelons-le, dessert de nombreux villages.

Le plan du premier ministre britannique pour adopter l’accord conclu avec l’UE a été contrarié par les députés. Réunis samedi 19 octobre, les députés de la Chambre des communes ont infligé un nouveau revers à Boris Johnson. Le vote tant attendu à propos de l’accord trouvé mercredi par Boris Johnson et l’Union européenne (UE) n’a finalement pas eu lieu. Les députés ont adopté un amendement qui complique singulièrement les plans de Boris Johnson, le contraignant à demander un report du Brexit le temps que toute la législation nécessaire à la mise en œuvre de l'accord soit adoptée.

Après l’annonce du vote, Boris Johnson a réagi en réaffirmant sa détermination à sortir son pays de l’UE le 31 octobre coûte que coûte, refusant de négocier un report avec les 27. La Commission européenne a pris acte du vote des députés britanniques et attend la marche à suivre du gouvernement britannique. L’Elysée a souligné que l’accord a été négocié et qu'il revient au Parlement britannique de l'approuver ou de le rejeter.

Le premier ministre britannique doit maintenant se conformer au « Benn Act » et demander une extension de l’article 50. S’il ne le fait pas, il violerait la loi britannique. Le camp du « Remain » voit l’amendement Letwin comme un gain de temps pour espérer un nouveau référendum. Pendant ce temps, des manifestations se déroulaient dans les rues de Londres, exprimant le dernier espoir d'organiser un deuxième référendum.

Maintenant, la question est de savoir si Boris Johnson enverra la lettre demandant un report du Brexit au 31 janvier 2020. Bien que cela semble peu probable, il risque de violer la loi s'il ne le fait pas. John Bercow pourrait être amené à rédiger la lettre sur ordre d'un juge ou des députés. Le flou entourant la situation rend incertaine la direction que prendra le Brexit dans les jours à venir.

What an exciting era we live in, with a plethora of new inventions that have greatly improved and added enjoyment to our lives. Among these innovations, one technological advancement stands out as potentially transformative: the self-driving car. This revolutionary vehicle is designed to operate autonomously, driving itself without human intervention. While there are many advantages to this cutting-edge technology, I am here today to shed light on some of its drawbacks.

One major drawback is the expectation for drivers to remain alert even while using a self-driving car. It seems counterintuitive that you would need to be constantly vigilant behind the wheel of a vehicle that is meant to drive itself. If you are already present and attentive at the steering wheel, why not just drive manually? Additionally, self-driving cars currently have speed limitations set at 25 mph—considerably slower than typical driving speeds. Given our tendency to travel faster than this limit, it may be more efficient for individuals to take control and drive themselves.

Moreover, relying solely on a self-driving car could lead to mundane and passive experiences as you wait your turn for control in risky or challenging situations. Furthermore, in the event of an accident caused by system failure or human error while operating a self-driving car, assigning blame becomes complex and uncertain—an issue that would necessitate new legal frameworks.

The cost implications of adopting this technology are also significant. Many individuals may find themselves unable to afford a self-driving car due to its high price point—potentially double or significantly increasing current vehicle costs due to advanced technologies integrated into these vehicles. The expenses involved in deploying satellites into space for mapping purposes further add substantial financial burden on consumers.

FARGO, N.D. (Valley News Live) - The holiday season is a prime time for scammers to target online shoppers. This year, with web traffic at an all-time high, scammers are particularly active. The Federal Bureau of Investigation reports an increase in these types of schemes and rip-offs.

"The fraudsters know we're using the internet a lot more," said Kevin Smith of the FBI’s Minneapolis Division. "Many people are rushed or distracted, especially in 2020, and scammers will exploit that."

The Moorhead Police have issued a warning to be cautious while shopping online. Captain Deric Swenson noted that while these scams affect local residents, the perpetrators are often located far away. "Many of these scams originate online and overseas, making it extremely difficult to identify, prosecute, and recover losses from the suspects," Swenson explained.

These scams frequently focus on popular holiday gifts, such as the new Xbox or PlayStation consoles. A common piece of advice is that if an offer seems too good to be true, it probably is. "Sometimes you'll see a company claiming they can sell you that Xbox or other in-demand items," Swenson added. "If the deal looks too good to be true, take the time to investigate."

To avoid falling victim to these scams, consider the following tips: use only reputable websites, regularly check receipts and bank statements, and use a credit card instead of a debit card, as credit cards offer more protection. If you do inadvertently give your information to scammers, act quickly by contacting your bank and the authorities.

Smith advised contacting the FBI if you've been scammed while shopping online, stating, "Any information you provide could be a crucial piece that helps us in an investigation or uncovers a fraudster. We need every little detail to connect the dots and address these issues."

Scams can be reported to the Internet Crime Complaint Center at IC3.gov.

La communauté aborigène a appelé à une «remise à plat» de l'exploitation minière en Australie à la suite des conclusions d'une enquête parlementaire qui a cloué au pilori le géant minier Rio Tinto, responsable de la destruction d'un site historique. En mai, le dynamitage de la grotte de Juukan Gorge dans l'État d'Australie Occidentale, un site vieux de 46 000 ans considéré comme sacré par les peuples Puutu Kunti Kurrama et Pinikura (PKKP), avait suscité l'émoi dans le pays.

Un rapport préliminaire avait conseillé à toutes les compagnies minières en Australie Occidentale de revoir les accords passés avec les propriétaires terriens autochtones et de suspendre toute destruction planifiée des sites patrimoniaux jusqu'à la mise en place de protections juridiques renforcées. 

L'enquête parlementaire a recommandé que le groupe anglo-australien Rio Tinto dédommage les PKKP, reconstruise le site détruit et s'engage à respecter un moratoire permanent sur l'exploitation minière dans la région. Le porte-parole de la société aborigène des PKKP, Burchell Hayes, s'est félicité des conclusions de l'enquête. Il a déclaré : « La destruction de Juukan Gorge a été une catastrophe planétaire qui a touché le cœur des PKKP et de la communauté au sens large. Nous espérons que les conclusions préliminaires de l'enquête entraîneront une remise à plat fondamentale du secteur, notamment en ce qui concerne les relations entre les propriétaires autochtones et les sociétés minières ».

Burchell Hayes espère que ces recommandations « ouvriront la voie à des partenariats plus équitables grâce à un plus grand respect et à un bénéfice mutuel ».

Understanding the impressive performance of deep neural networks (DNNs) has been a focal point of extensive research, exploring their architectures and the universal approximation property (UAP). The UAP of two-layer neural networks on compact sets was first established by Cybenko in 1989, sparking widespread investigation into the UAP across various contexts for DNNs. Studies have concentrated on determining the minimal depths and widths of deep ReLU networks needed to achieve UAP (Hornik, 1991; Park et al., 2020). These fundamental findings aid in uncovering the intricate connection between approximation capabilities and neural network structures.

Nevertheless, there has been relatively less emphasis on a related issue: understanding the impact of training dataset characteristics required to attain the UAP in neural networks.

For instance, when examining the swiss roll dataset depicted in Figure 1 (a), a critical practical question arises: What are the optimal depth and width needed to fully classify this dataset? Despite the practical significance of this query in the realm of training neural networks, existing theoretical results only offer basic lower bounds (minimum depth of 2 (Hornik, 1991) and a width of max{d x + 1, d y } (Park et al., 2020)), which are often impractical in real-world applications. While empirical evidence suggests that increasing the depth or width of networks could lead to successful outcomes, there remains a lack of theoretical guarantees to predict these results.

In this paper, we address the challenge of identifying the optimal neural network architecture for classifying a given dataset. This endeavor is approached through the perspective of the polytope structure of deep ReLU networks, a topic that has garnered significant attention in recent studies (Black et al., 2022; Grigsby & Lindsey, 2022; Berzins, 2023; Huchette et al., 2023). Our primary theoretical objective is to tackle the "multiple manifold problem," introduced by Buchanan et al. (2020): Given two disjoint topological spaces X + and X -, what is the optimal architecture for the neural network N such that N (x) > 0 for all x ∈ X + and N (x) < 0 otherwise? By leveraging the geometric properties of DNNs, we offer a comprehensive solution to this question. Our approach entails establishing both upper and lower bounds for the depth and widths of networks required for dataset classification, based on the polytope covering of the datasets. Notably, we construct a neural network with practical applicability. For instance, our findings in Theorem 3.4 indicate that the swiss roll dataset in Figure 1 (a) can be effectively classified using a three-layer ReLU network with 24 neurons, as illustrated in Figure 1(c).

Another significant contribution of this paper is the exploration of the converse situation, demonstrating that trained neural networks inherently capture the geometric properties of the dataset and facilitate the extraction of the dataset's polytope structure. To showcase practical utility, we identify and discuss simple geometric characteristics of real-world datasets such as MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR10, achieved through neural network training. Our contributions can be summarized as follows:

• Explicit construction of networks: We introduce the novel concept of a polytope-basis cover (Definition 3.2), which details the geometric structure of the dataset. Building on this, we propose the design of a three-layer ReLU network tailored to efficiently classify the dataset, using its polytope-basis cover as a guiding framework (Theorem 3.4).

苏富比宣布，明年1月的纽约苏富比西洋古典艺术周将拍卖文艺复兴大师波提且利（SANDRO BOTTICELLI）的作品「忧患之子(The Man of Sorrows)」，估价逾4000万美元（约新台币11亿元）。

苏富比表示，波提且利为这幅画作注入了非凡的心理深度，阐述了基督的人性与神性这两种特质。画中展现了基督上半身的三处伤口，包括双手被钉在十字架上的伤痕，以及在身体右侧被士兵刺破的伤口。绕着基督头顶的小天使手持着象征基督受难与死亡的「基督的武器」（Arma Christi）——左边有代表举起和放下十字架的木梯、羞辱基督的耻辱柱，以及刺穿基督肋旁的长矛；右边则有基督被鞭打时抱住的鞭柱、拆开十字架上的钉子的拨钉钳，以及在基督临终前让他缓解口渴的醋胆。波提且利用自然的色彩描绘了这些元素，并精细地刻画了每一个细节。

苏富比表示，「忧患之子」创作于15世纪末至16世纪初，是波提且利的晚年作品。当时，他受到狂热的道明会修士吉罗拉莫·萨佛纳罗拉（Girolamo Savonarola）的影响。尽管作品以基督教象征为主题，却融入了许多宗教异象的元素。

Disney World ahora requerirá que tanto sus empleados sindicalizados como los trabajadores asalariados y no sindicalizados estén completamente vacunados contra el COVID-19 para mantener sus puestos en el parque temático en Florida. Disney anunció el mes pasado que todos los empleados asalariados y por horas no sindicalizados deberían recibir la vacuna en un plazo de 60 días. La compañía también pidió a todos los empleados que trabajaban desde casa que mostraran un comprobante de vacunación antes de regresar al trabajo.

El acuerdo se alcanzó el lunes con una coalición sindical poco después de que la vacuna Pfizer obtuviera la aprobación total de la Administración de Alimentos y Medicamentos (FDA, por sus siglas en inglés). Requiere que los trabajadores muestren prueba de vacunación antes del 22 de octubre para seguir empleados, aunque pueden solicitar exenciones por razones médicas o religiosas, según un comunicado del gremio. La compañía realizará eventos de vacunación en el lugar de trabajo para sus empleados durante las próximas semanas, según el comunicado del sindicato.

Cualquier empleado que no cumpla y no solicite una exención, será “separado de la empresa con un estado de recontratación ‘sí’”, según el Service Trades Council Union. Antes de los despidos y licencias debido a la pandemia, la coalición sindical cubría a unos 43.000 de los 77.000 trabajadores de Disney World.

Steganography is a technique designed to conceal the existence of communication between two parties, in contrast to cryptography which focuses on hiding the content of the exchanged information. It is considered a failure if an adversary even suspects the presence of hidden communication without being able to prove it. Steganalysis, on the other hand, is utilized to uncover such covert communication. Various forms of media can be used for steganography, with those possessing a high degree of redundancy being more favorable, such as photos, audio, and videos.

Blockchain, initially introduced as a peer-to-peer network for digital currency like Bitcoin, has gained traction in diverse research fields due to its unique characteristics. In the context of Bitcoin, distributed consensus among miners ensures the integrity and permanence of information stored on the blockchain. Different payment models within Bitcoin, such as pay to public key (p2pk), pay to public key hash (p2pkh), and pay to script hash (p2sh), facilitate secure transactions by depositing funds into designated addresses. Each Bitcoin transaction involves input and output addresses, allowing the transfer of funds from one or more sources to one or more destinations.

The paper explores the potential of blockchain in facilitating hidden data embedding (steganography) and presents two algorithms tailored for this purpose – a high-capacity algorithm and a medium-capacity algorithm. These algorithms have a unique characteristic of embedding data without altering the original content, making steganalysis challenging. By assessing existing steganography schemes in blockchain, the paper highlights the absence of practical solutions for this application.

The paper is structured as follows: Section 2 outlines the advantages of utilizing blockchain for steganography. Section 3 evaluates previous steganography schemes in blockchain. Section 4 provides an overview of the HDW algorithm, a foundational component for the proposed algorithms. Sections 5 and 6 introduce and assess the two algorithms for steganography in blockchain, respectively. Section 7 discusses the unresolved challenges in steganography within blockchain, and Section 8 concludes the paper.

In the dynamic realm of cloud operations, incident management poses a significant challenge for enterprise-level cloud service providers like Microsoft, Google, and Amazon. Notable events such as the Amazon outage [O'Donovan, 2023] highlight the critical need for a robust incident management system. Incidents can vary from minor operational disruptions to severe system failures, leading to financial losses, operational disruptions, damage to reputation, and legal issues. Swiftly identifying, troubleshooting, and resolving system incidents is crucial for ensuring service reliability and operational continuity. While automated systems can handle low-severity incidents, high-severity ones require immediate, hands-on intervention from On-Call Engineers (OCEs) due to their complexity. To address this, service teams document common troubleshooting steps in Troubleshooting Guides (TSGs), enabling OCEs to effectively tackle incidents.

To explore the impact of TSGs on incident mitigation, we analyzed approximately 1000 high-severity incidents in the past twelve months, necessitating immediate OCE intervention. Our analysis, in line with previous research [Jiang et al., 2020; Shetty et al., 2022; Jiang et al., 2023], supports the effectiveness of TSGs in incident mitigation. Incidents accompanied by TSGs saw a 60% reduction in the average time-to-mitigate (TTM) compared to those without, underscoring the crucial role of TSGs. This positive trend, as supported by research [Lotufo et al., 2015; Li et al., 2018], persists across different companies, even with varying TSG formats. Despite their usefulness, the unstructured nature, varying quality, and internal focus of TSGs, as emphasized by [Shetty et al., 2022; Chen et al., 2023], hinder their optimal utilization, especially for new hires, and add complexity, especially in multi-team coordination scenarios, to the incident mitigation process.

قال خالد عكاشة، عضو المجلس القومي لحقوق الإنسان، إن هناك مخططًا كان يستهدف تحويل ليبيا إلى بؤرة تهديد لشمال إفريقيا بأكمله عقب انسحاب حلف الناتو، مشيرًا إلى أن مصر تمكنت من إدراك هذا المخطط في وقت مبكر.

وأضاف عكاشة، في تصريح إعلامي، أن المرحلة الأولى من تنفيذ هذا المخطط تمثلت في تحويل ليبيا إلى معسكرات تدريب تستقطب وتؤهل عناصر من مختلف الدول العربية والإفريقية وحتى من خارج المنطقة. وقد استغل المخططون حالة الفراغ الأمني والسيولة السياسية في ليبيا لنقل هذه العناصر عبر القوارب إلى سوريا والعراق، بهدف نشر الفوضى هناك.

وأشار إلى أن فترة حكم جماعة الإخوان في مصر شهدت نشاطات مكثفة لاستقطاب الشباب المصري وإلحاقهم بمعسكرات التدريب في ليبيا، تمهيدًا لإرسالهم للانضمام إلى تنظيمات مثل داعش والقاعدة.

وتابع عكاشة حديثه موضحًا أن ذروة هذا المشهد تمثلت في ما وصفه بـ"اللحظة الفاصلة"، عندما أعلن محمد مرسي، خلال فترة توليه رئاسة مصر، قائلاً: "لبيك يا سوريا".

أعرب عضو لجنة الحوار بمجلس النواب، حماد العبيدي، عن تفاؤله بنتائج اجتماع طنجة، مشيرًا إلى أن الاجتماع يأتي بعد جلسات حوار سابقة في تونس اتسمت بشيء من التعقيد. وأضاف العبيدي أن وجهات النظر تكاد تكون متقاربة جدًا لتذويب الجليد، متوقعًا الوصول إلى نتيجة جيدة تختصر المسافات في الحوار المقبل.

بدأت أمس في مدينة طنجة المغربية جولة جديدة من الحوار الليبي – الليبي للجنة 13+13. وتتناول هذه الجلسات التشاور حول الحوار الجاري في تونس وتوحيد الرؤى حول المسارين السياسي والدستوري في ليبيا.

تأتي هذه الجولة الجديدة من الحوار بعد جولتين سابقتين في مدينة بوزنيقة خلال شهري سبتمبر وأكتوبر الماضيين، واللتين تُوجتا بالتوصل إلى تفاهمات شاملة حول ضوابط وآليات ومعايير اختيار شاغلي المناصب القيادية للمؤسسات السيادية، كما نصت عليها المادة 15 من الاتفاق السياسي الليبي الموقع في ديسمبر 2015 بمدينة الصخيرات المغربية.

كما تأتي هذه الجولة بعد يومين فقط من انتهاء لقاء طنجة التشاوري بين أعضاء مجلس النواب، حيث توصل الأعضاء إلى تفاهم حول عقد اجتماع في مدينة غدامس، وذلك بعد سنوات من الانقسامات. حقق المجتمعون نتائج ملموسة، أبرزها إنهاء المرحلة الانتقالية بإجراء انتخابات رئاسية وبرلمانية خلال عام.

وتتصدر المناصب السيادية محاور النقاش في طنجة بهدف الوصول إلى حل متوافق عليه لعرضه لاحقًا على مجلس النواب للتصويت عليه.

In "The Challenge of Exploring Venus," the author discusses not only the risks and dangers of attempting to study Venus up close but also the potential benefits and knowledge we could gain if successful. With dangers such as eight-hundred-degree weather, atmospheric pressure ninety times greater than Earth's, sulfuric acid in the atmosphere, etc., the mission may seem nearly impossible. However, while the author presents the cons of this mission, they also highlight its pros.

The author supports their ideas by explaining why scientists are so intrigued by Venus. Despite its dangers, scientists and astronomers are eager to study Venus because it is often referred to as Earth's "twin" and believed to have once been the most Earth-like planet in our solar system. They speculate that Venus may have once been covered in oceans based on similarities between its features and those found on Earth—such as rocky sediment on its surface, valleys, mountains, and craters.

Furthermore, visiting Venus could have a significant impact on society and history if achieved without facing catastrophic consequences. The author suggests that there might be a way to study Venus using existing technology that has been in use for decades.

One innovative idea proposed by NASA is deploying a blimp-like vehicle above the planet's surface for scientific observation. By hovering about 30 miles above Venus' landscape, this vehicle would provide researchers with valuable data without risking destruction from harsh conditions below. Drawing a parallel with how jet airplanes navigate storms by flying above them safely makes this concept more relatable.

By successfully sending such a vehicle above Venus' surface, temperatures could drop significantly from eight hundred degrees to one hundred seventy degrees Fahrenheit while air pressure becomes tolerable for humans—similar to that at sea level on Earth. Though challenging at first glance, achieving this goal is possible through perseverance over time.

NASA is also exploring alternative approaches using older technology designed for durability rather than speed or flexibility seen in modern equipment. By considering machinery from World War II era like mechanical computers powered solely by gears and levers which can withstand extreme pressures and temperatures present on Venus.

It's not just that excessive stress can reduce study and work efficiency, but that stress has a strong link to psychological illnesses. Previous research has found a significant association between stress and depression [32]. Long-term exposure to high stress levels can negatively impact our well-being [15, 66, 80], leading to various physical diseases such as hypertension [72], cardiovascular disease [72], infectious illnesses [85], and even cancer [21]. Therefore, raising awareness and effectively managing stress are crucial for maintaining good health.

Recently, stress-tracking technologies that automatically detect and collect stress data throughout the day have become commercially available. Wearable products, such as smart bracelets and watches made by Huawei [39], Garmin [37], and Samsung [40], now come equipped with automatic stress tracking features. Additionally, there are dedicated stress-tracking products like Healbe Gobe2 [38], Wellbe [42], Bellabeat Leaf Urban [36], and Spire Stone [41]. Venus is a worthy pursuit despite the dangers it presents. As the closest planet to Earth and one of the brightest points of light in the night sky, Venus has long captured the interest of scientists and astronomers. Its similarities to Earth, along with the unique challenges it poses, make it a fascinating subject of study.

Exploring Venus, however, is not without its challenges. The planet's geology and critical living conditions make it a difficult place to examine. Venus's surface temperatures average over 800 degrees Fahrenheit, and the atmospheric pressure is 90 times greater than what we experience on Earth. This extreme environment, combined with its proximity to the sun, makes it a risky place for human survival. The article "The Challenge of Exploring Venus" highlights these dangers, noting, "Venus has the hottest temperature of any planet in our solar system, even though Mercury is closer to the sun." The planet is also prone to erupting volcanoes and powerful earthquakes, further complicating the exploration efforts.

Despite the dangers, the study of Venus is a worthwhile endeavor. Venus, once, may have been the planet most similar to Earth, and it is the planet's rocky, Earth-like surface, with features such as valleys, mountains, and craters, that makes the exploration of Venus a compelling pursuit.

Durante el día de mañana, se prevén chubascos y tormentas eléctricas en las regiones occidental y central, con posibilidad de que sean fuertes e intensas en algunas áreas del sur de estas regiones, en zonas montañosas de la región central y en el municipio especial Isla de la Juventud.

Aviso Especial No.2
La Habana, Cuba: Durante el día de mañana, se prevén chubascos y tormentas eléctricas en las regiones occidental y central, con posibilidad de que sean fuertes e intensas en algunas áreas del sur de estas regiones, en zonas montañosas de la región central y en el municipio especial Isla de la Juventud.

Esta situación meteorológica está asociada con una amplia zona de bajas presiones, cuyo centro se encuentra al oeste de las Islas Caimán, en el noroeste del mar Caribe.

Este sistema tiene una alta probabilidad de convertirse en una depresión tropical en las próximas horas. Su movimiento será lento y hacia el noroeste, permaneciendo en el extremo noroccidental del mar Caribe durante las próximas 24 a 48 horas.

Independientemente de su desarrollo, se espera que continúe generando áreas de lluvias en las regiones occidental y central durante este periodo. Estas lluvias pueden ser fuertes y persistirán durante el resto del fin de semana y el lunes.

Tensions in the Middle East have prompted several countries to reassess the safety and security of their nationals in the region. South Korea’s Foreign Ministry announced last week that it would work to enhance the security measures for approximately 1,600 South Korean nationals working primarily on construction sites in Iraq. Meanwhile, India’s foreign ministry spokesman, Raveesh Kumar, stated that India is not planning to evacuate any citizens from the volatile region "yet."

In the Philippines, President Duterte convened an emergency meeting with his defense secretary and top military and police officials on Sunday to discuss evacuation plans. “President Duterte ordered the Armed Forces of the Philippines to be prepared to deploy military assets to repatriate overseas Filipinos in the Middle East, particularly from Iran and Iraq, at any moment’s notice,” said Sen. Christopher Lawrence Go, a close ally of Duterte who attended the meeting.

Amidst this backdrop, Iran has vowed retaliation, while President Donald Trump has warned that American forces would target 52 Iranian locations if Americans are attacked. Additionally, Iraq’s Parliament has called for the expulsion of all American troops from Iraqi soil, a move that could potentially lead to a revival of the Islamic State group in Iraq, further destabilizing the Middle East.

Military chief of staff Lt. Gen. Felimon Santos Jr. stated that Philippine forces have identified possible evacuation routes not only in Iraq and Iran but also in other potential hotspots, such as Israel. “There are probabilities like that and we are improving our plans just to cover everything just in case something happens,” Santos informed reporters in Manila. The Department of National Defense noted that there are more than 7,000 Filipino workers and their dependents in Iraq and Iran, many of whom are employed in U.S. and other foreign facilities and commercial establishments in Baghdad. These workers are a small portion of the hundreds of thousands of Filipinos working in countries around the Persian Gulf.

The Philippines is a major contributor to the global workforce, with about a tenth of its population of over 100 million working abroad, primarily as household help, construction workers, seamen, and professionals. Other countries are facing similar challenges. Asians represent 40 percent of the world’s migrant population, and the Middle East is a common destination for employment. The Gulf Arab states are home to more than 7 million Indian expatriates, who play a crucial role in driving the region’s economy and populate cities as doctors, engineers, teachers, drivers, construction workers, and other laborers. Au Mexique, les membres du cabinet présidentiel rencontrent quotidiennement le président Andrés Manuel López Obrador. Toutefois, 10 mois après le début de la pandémie, Jorge Alcocer Varela, secrétaire à la Santé, a présenté un protocole sanitaire visant à prévenir la contagion du Covid-19 lors des réunions et dans l'environnement du directeur général. Il semble ironique qu'Alcocer Varela ait déclaré qu'il n'y avait pas eu de grande alarme, malgré plusieurs cas d'infection signalés parmi les responsables, tels que le gouverneur d'Hidalgo, Omar Fayad, testé positif après une réunion du cabinet en mars dernier, parmi d'autres fonctionnaires.

Cependant, le responsable de la santé a affirmé que très peu de cas de la maladie ont été signalés et que le suivi a permis de rompre la chaîne de contagion. Il a souligné que la température est vérifiée pour chaque participant et que du gel hydroalcoolique est disponible à l'intérieur du Palais National. Lors d'une conférence de presse matinale, Alcocer Varela a été interrogé sur les procédures à suivre après que le président a été en contact avec le porte-parole présidentiel, Jesús Ramírez Cuevas, testé positif pour le Covid-19 le week-end précédent.

Alcocer Varela a expliqué qu'il était essentiel de contacter immédiatement les personnes en contact avec des cas confirmés pour mener des investigations, que ce soit au travail, en famille ou lors d'autres réunions. Concernant les réunions, le secrétaire à la Santé a précisé que des mesures strictes étaient mises en place pour assurer la sécurité de tous les participants, comme le respect des règles de distanciation sociale, le port du masque et la désinfection régulière.

Il a également mentionné que certains fonctionnaires choisissent de se soumettre à des tests rapides avant les réunions, tandis que ceux en contact fréquent avec le président passent un test PCR toutes les deux semaines. Enfin, Alcocer Varela a souligné que les participants aux réunions ont la possibilité de réaliser des tests PCR chaque début de semaine à l'Institut de diagnostic et de référence épidémiologique (INDRE) ou de se faire prélever des échantillons auprès des proches du président. Ces mesures sont partagées sur la page officielle d'informations sur le coronavirus.

The Alliance for a Healthier Generation (Healthier Generation), one of the nation’s preeminent children’s health organizations, recently announced that it had named 355 schools from 23 states as “America’s Healthiest Schools,” including Whitley County’s Pleasant View Elementary School, which received a bronze level award.

America’s Healthiest Schools – 77 percent of which serve high-need student populations – received the Healthier Generation’s National Healthy Schools Award at the bronze, silver or gold level, based on the number of best-practices they have implemented relating to children’s health.

Healthier Generation’s team of school health experts evaluate schools based on their ability to serve healthier meals and snacks, get students moving more, offer high-quality health and physical education, and support staff wellness.

All of America’s Healthiest Schools meet or exceed federal nutrition standards for school meals and snacks, offer breakfast daily, incorporate physical activity before, during or after the school day, implement district wellness policies and update progress annually, and involve parents and community members in decision-making.

In neutral atom quantum computers, extracting information from the system typically involves fluorescence imaging [1]. An electron-multiplying charge-coupled device (EMCCD) or complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) camera captures an image of the array of atoms. A reconstruction algorithm then analyzes this image to detect the occupancy of each potential atom site. An example of such an image can be seen in Fig. 1a. However, since no ground truth exists for images taken on real systems, the state of the system can only be inferred by trusting the reconstruction algorithm.

When imaging the experiment, Poissonian-distributed photoelectrons from atomic fluorescence compete with stochastically distributed electrons from various origins of camera noise. In a performance-tuned quantum computer, the qubit readout time is minimized, allowing only a few fluorescence photons per atom to be collected. This competition between photoelectrons and noise electrons diminishes confidence in determining whether a site contains an atom, thus affecting the final image analysis.

This problem is exacerbated by potential atom loss during the imaging process if not perfectly tuned. Sites of lost atoms resemble normal occupied sites but have varying effective exposure times, leading to a continuous transition between the brightness of unoccupied and occupied sites. Ultimately, the key metric is whether a site is occupied after imaging, a binary decision. While this can be improved by taking consecutive images, they still lack certainty. Sites that are inherently dimmer or appear dimmer by chance might be excluded from testing on real data despite being significant, as assumptions about their occupancy are probabilistic.

Optimized detection algorithms are necessary to enhance detection fidelity under these challenging conditions. However, designing and training these algorithms require labeled data with absolute knowledge of atomic presence or absence, which is unattainable from real-world experiments. To address this, we propose generating artificial images with realistic properties directly from the corresponding ground truth. Starting from a given array of atom locations and states, our approach constructs a picture simulating the imaging process. Since image formation, considering influences from both photoelectrons and noise electrons, is well understood, we can produce atomic fluorescence pictures nearly indistinguishable from real ones. Additionally, the simulated pictures can be generated faster than real ones, facilitating rapid development and training. Fig. 1b shows such a simulated image.

Since the simulation output is based on the absolute truth of occupancy, it can be used to benchmark detection algorithms accurately by comparing the reconstructed state to the original one. However, it is crucial to trust the simulator's capability to produce accurate images. All noise sources and probability distributions must be modeled and sampled accurately to evaluate an algorithm's performance using the generator's data.

After implementing the simulation, we demonstrate the differences and similarities between its output and actual images. Accurate modeling processes include:
1) The probability distribution of filling the array with atoms and the likelihood and timing of atom loss during imaging.
2) The properties of the optical system, including any imperfections or aberrations a physical camera may encounter.
3) The internal workings of different cameras, from the physical pixel to the digital output.

The real data informing our approach and evaluations originate from experiments at the Strontium Rydberg Lab at the Max Planck Institute for Quantum Optics (MPQ). Section II provides a brief explanation of a nearly equivalent setup. It is important to note that some data comes from the early stages of the overarching project or was acquired through intentional parameter choices, which may cause images to appear subpar compared to state-of-the-art techniques.

In the real world, manipulators must adapt to the dynamic environment they operate in. This requires the ability to navigate obstacles and respond to changes effectively. Dynamic obstacle avoidance is crucial for manipulators to function robustly, especially in cluttered and dynamic environments. The primary challenge lies in getting a manipulator's end-effector from one point to another.

Current obstacle avoidance methods have focused on open-loop motion planning, which involves computing a sequence of joint coordinates that are then converted to joint velocities during runtime. However, a more reactive approach directly works with joint velocities to avoid non-stationary obstacles. This approach, known as resolved-rate motion control (RRMC), is cost-effective, easily computable, and highly reactive.

Differential kinematics play a key role in developing reactive controllers for obstacle avoidance. By considering the rate of change of distance between the robot and obstacles, controllers can steer the manipulator away from collisions. To address over-constrained scenarios, strategies such as utilizing kinematically redundant manipulators or introducing intentional errors in the path trajectory can be employed.

Maximizing manipulability, which measures a robot's ability to achieve arbitrary velocities, is crucial for enhancing robot performance and obstacle avoidance while reducing the risk of singularity issues. By incorporating manipulability optimization into reactive motion control, manipulators can adapt to volatile environments more effectively.

Reactive motion control offers a real-time solution for navigating obstacles, avoiding joint limits, and maximizing manipulability without the need for extensive preplanning. The proposed controller in this paper aims to achieve these goals for both stationary and moving obstacles, making it suitable for a wide range of robotic applications.

Incorporating the principles of differential kinematics, manipulability maximization, and obstacle avoidance into a quadratic programming (QP) framework, the NEO controller presented in this paper offers a comprehensive solution for real-time robot motion control. The paper also includes experimental validation in simulation and on a physical robot, along with an open-source Python library for implementing the controller on various manipulators. The subsequent sections detail the methodology, development, and experimental results of the NEO controller, showcasing its effectiveness in challenging and dynamic environments.
