The tour itinerary recommendation is a popular and challenging problem with significant implications for tourism and related fields such as transportation and logistics [1]. This issue has attracted substantial interest from both academia and industry. It combines elements of recommendation and planning problems. From a recommendation perspective, it involves aspects of top-K item recommendation and learning to rank, as we aim to suggest a subset of the most relevant points of interest (POIs) to a user in the form of an itinerary. From an operations research perspective, it resembles a constrained optimization problem, where the goal is to maximize the utility a user derives from the planned itinerary while ensuring it meets specific time and location constraints.

In this paper, we explore the tour itinerary recommendation problem from both recommendation and operations research perspectives, focusing on how recent advances in natural language processing have propelled research in this area. Specifically, we examine the adaptation of language models for the task of tour itinerary recommendation, such as the use of word embedding techniques like Word2Vec and GloVe for POI representation learning, and the application of transformer-based models like BERT for next POI and itinerary recommendation. Figure 1 provides an overview of the potential applications of such a framework.

À nouveau accessible depuis le déconfinement, la cathédrale d'Amiens renoue enfin cet été avec les visites guidées et le spectacle son et lumière Chroma. La fréquentation est satisfaisante, mais selon les commerçants du secteur, rien de comparable aux années précédentes. Pour l'instant, du moins.

La relance économique : la cathédrale d'Amiens et ses environs reprennent doucement vie après le confinement. Privée de ses fidèles et de son public pendant tout le confinement, la cathédrale Notre-Dame d'Amiens reprend doucement mais sûrement vie ces dernières semaines. Les visiteurs sont de nouveau accueillis depuis le 11 mai, mais en ce début de vacances scolaires - en semaine, et sous une météo capricieuse - il est indéniable qu'il n'y a pas énormément de monde. "C'est superbe, mais je trouve que l'on n'est pas très nombreux", assure Christophe, venu du Jura. "C'est un site connu, donc les gens vont revenir assez rapidement je pense, il faut laisser du temps au temps."

Certains vacanciers, comme Christine et sa petite-fille, sont très heureux de se retrouver un peu seuls pour visiter. Malgré tout, certains y trouvent leur compte : plus de sécurité, plus de calme et une opportunité pour profiter du site et de ses œuvres.

D'autres optent pour les visites guidées de l'édifice qui ont repris début juillet, notamment via l'office de tourisme. Selon la directrice de l'organisme, la fréquentation est comparable aux années passées, avec des groupes oscillant entre 15 et 30 personnes en fonction des jours. "Ce qui reste en marge, c'est la clientèle étrangère", précise Cordula Riedle. "Elle est là, mais moins que d'habitude."

Profiter de Chroma : certains touristes restent jusqu'au soir pour assister à Chroma, le spectacle son et lumière projeté sur la façade de la cathédrale, depuis le 11 juillet et jusqu'au 30 septembre. Jusqu'à présent, selon Amiens Métropole, il y a eu 3 000 spectateurs chaque soir, un chiffre similaire aux éditions précédentes.

Mais pour Isabelle Jacob, propriétaire d'un restaurant voisin, le constat est plus mitigé. "C'est en dents de scie. On a vu une vraie affluence le premier weekend, mais en semaine, il y a beaucoup moins de monde."

Du côté des restaurateurs des environs, comme Isabelle Jacob, le bilan est plus contrasté. Alors qu'en temps normal, dans sa pizzeria, Loïc Fournet observe un véritable "effet Chroma". "On voit la cathédrale depuis notre terrasse, alors dès que la nuit tombe, les gens reprennent un verre et restent pour voir le spectacle. C'est rigolo, ça anime un peu le quartier. Alors on attend que ça, que ça revienne à la normale..."

First and foremost, we cannot claim that an alien created these human-like faces. Currently, there is no evidence to support the existence of aliens, much less their involvement in this phenomenon. It is most likely a natural landform, as rock formations over time could have merged to create this face-like figure on Mars.

Furthermore, this is clearly a natural formation, not the work of aliens, as there were no alien monuments found in similar instances. On April 5, 1998, thousands of web users eagerly awaited the release of the first image on a JPL website, which appeared to confirm that the formation was, in fact, a natural landform.

Not everyone, however, was satisfied with the conclusion that it was a natural formation, not the work of aliens. The "face on Mars" stirred a great deal of interest, appearing in films, magazines, books, radio shows, and, quite possibly, in the checkout line of your local grocery store.

Ion transport plays a crucial role in a wide array of biophysical processes and technological applications, including transmembrane ion channels, electrochemical energy devices, and electrokinetics in microfluidics [1, 3, 49]. The classical Poisson-Nernst-Planck (PNP) theory, based on a mean-field approximation, is often used to describe ion dynamics in various scenarios. The Nernst-Planck equations model the diffusion and convection of ions under electrostatic potential gradients, while the Poisson equation governs the electrostatic potential, factoring in charge density from mobile ions. Despite its success, PNP theory is only applicable to dilute solutions due to the assumptions inherent in mean-field approximations [1, 36]. For example, it overlooks ionic steric effects that are significant in concentrated electrolytes found in confined environments, such as high ionic concentrations in ion channels.

To address these limitations, several modified PNP theories incorporating steric effects have been developed over the past few decades. One approach accounts for steric effects by adding the entropy of solvent molecules to the electrostatic free energy [5, 26, 29-31, 38, 44, 47, 52]. A notable feature of these models is the prediction of a saturation concentration for compactly packed counterions near charged surfaces. Another method involves adding an excess chemical potential, informed by density functional theory [27, 39] or the Lennard-Jones potential for hard-sphere repulsions [15, 25, 32]. These models often result in integro-differential equations that are computationally challenging. To circumvent nonlocal integral terms, approximations up to leading-order terms are proposed, yielding local models [23, 25, 32]. However, these models can be ill-posed for concentrated electrolytes under certain parameters [19, 32]. To mitigate this, concentration gradient energies, which are higher-order terms, can be added to stabilize the solution [19, 20, 21, 22]. These gradient energy terms are widely applied in the Ginzburg-Landau theory for phase separation in mixtures, leading to the Cahn-Hilliard (CH) equations through a conserved H^-1 gradient flow of the Ginzburg-Landau functional [6].

The introduction of H^-1 gradient flow to the electrostatic free energy, combined with concentration gradient energies, results in the Poisson-Nernst-Planck-Cahn-Hilliard (PNPCH) equations incorporating steric interactions:

\[
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial c_m}{\partial t} &= \nabla \cdot \left( m \, c_m \nabla \left( z_m \psi + \log c_m + \sum_{n=1}^{N} g_{mn} c_n \right) - \sigma_m \nabla c_m \right), \\
-\nabla \cdot (\kappa \nabla \psi) &= \sum_{m=1}^{M} z_m c_m + \rho_f,
\end{aligned}
\]

where ψ is the electrostatic potential, \( c_m \) represents ion concentration for the mth species, \( z_m \) is the valence, \( \rho_f \) is the fixed charge density, and \( \kappa \) and \( m \) arise from nondimensionalization. \( G = (g_{mn}) \) is the coefficient matrix for steric interactions, and \( \sigma_m \) is a gradient energy coefficient (see Section 2). These equations have been effectively applied to study ion permeation and selectivity in ion channels [21], as well as charge dynamics in room temperature ionic liquids and highly concentrated electrolytes [20, 22].

The past year had been the most challenging of her life. Only one person had managed to earn her trust, and he had spent the better part of those months betraying it. He always regarded her with disdain, yet by now she felt even that was more kindness than she deserved.

At least he noticed her. No one else did.

She now sat beside him on a balcony, her frosty breath mingling with the cold night air. Her focus, as usual, was on maintaining an outward appearance of being okay, while internally, she was at her breaking point, barely holding on.

After a prolonged silence, she turned to him and, with a serious, yet subdued, tone, asked, "Do you think there's anything in me worth trying to save?"

He looked at her, a mix of confusion and annoyance in his eyes, as if her emotional needs, her pain, were an inconvenience.

After a brief, almost dismissive, pause, he replied, "Meh, if I can't say anything nice, I shouldn't say anything at all."

When I downloaded the new iOS update, it added a "recommended words" feature on my iPhone, displaying a grey box with three suggested words. When I updated my phone, it asked if I wanted to turn on "Conversation Recommendations from Roberto." I thought, why not? I figured it was either a joke or a genuine feature, so I enabled it. Initially, it seemed to have no effect. Then, I received a message from my best friend, who was distraught after a breakup. In the "recommended words" box, I saw three options: "Hostile," "Compassionate," and "Sarcastic." I chose "Compassionate," and, guided entirely by the "recommended words," I managed to lift his spirits, and we agreed to go out for a beer.

Afterwards, I found myself on complete auto-pilot, with every conversation offering three new options. I was helping friends, getting myself into various situations, and, overall, I seemed to become quite popular, both with people I met and with those I texted. 

One day, I met a beautiful girl at a party, and we exchanged numbers. I can’t even describe her, she was that stunning. I decided to text her, but, to my surprise, I didn't see the usual three conversation options, only rude, accusatory ones, like, "Why'd you break my heart?"

Las Bellas pronto estarán de vuelta y Universal no ha querido esperar más para darnos un primer vistazo a la película. En el vídeo no falta nadie, desde la directora Trish Sie, que sustituye tras las cámaras a Elizabeth Banks, hasta Rebel Wilson o Anna Kendrick. Esta última lleva años explotando un tipo de imagen en multitud de películas durante los últimos años y en ningún caso le ha funcionado tan bien como con su personaje Beca. Eso sí, en 'Dando la nota - aún más alto' ('Pitch Perfect 2') básicamente pasaba el testigo al personaje interpretado por Hailee Steinfeld, por lo que habrá que ver qué es exactamente lo que nos venden aquí.

Lo cierto es que Universal también andaba ya con ciertas prisas para iniciar la campaña promocional, ya que el estreno de 'Dando la nota 3' está fijado para el 22 de diciembre y la película va a necesitar toda la ayuda posible para no ser aniquilada por 'Star Wars: Los últimos Jedi' ('Star Wars: The Last Jedi'), que llega a los cines apenas una semana antes. Sin grandes fichajes - las mayores novedades del reparto son Ruby Rose y John Lithgow-, habrá que ver si no habría sido mejor elegir otra fecha.

Cuesta creer que una película como 'Dando la nota' ('Pitch Perfect') haya acabado convirtiéndose en el inicio de una lucrativa franquicia. La cuestión es que la primera entrega costó 17 millones de dólares y recaudó casi 120, mientras que el costo de la segunda llegó hasta los 29 millones, pero es que luego acabó ingresando más de 287. Era demasiado tentador hacer otra más y ahora lo único que falta es que esté a la altura de sus predecesoras.

شكرا لقرائتكم خبر تعرف على الحكم الشرعي في اغتصاب قط في الأردن. الآن سنتطرق إلى تفاصيل الخبر.

أثارت حادثة اغتصاب قط في المملكة الأردنية الهاشمية جدلاً واسعاً على منصات التواصل الاجتماعي، وأدى ذلك إلى طرح تساؤلات حول الحكم الشرعي في هذا الفعل. فقد أشار البعض إلى أن إتيان البهائم يعتبر من المحرمات والقبائح التي تنفر منها الطبيعة السليمة، وأنه لا يميل إلى هذا النوع من الأعمال إلا الأشخاص الفاسدين الذين تلوثت فطرتهم.

وقد اتفق العلماء على تحريم إتيان البهائم، استناداً إلى قول الله تعالى في القرآن الكريم "وَلا تَقْرَبُوا الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ" (الأنعام: 151). ويروي الترمذي وابن ماجه وأحمد عن ابن عباس أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "من وقع على بهيمة فاقتلوه واقتلوا البهيمة".

ويعتقد جمهور الفقهاء أنه لا يُحد على الشخص الذي يُغتصب بهيمة، ولكن يعتبر مذنباً، ويستدلون بقول ابن عباس رضي الله تعالى عنهما حيث قال: "من أتى بهيمة فلا حد عليه". إلا أن هذا القول يعتبر استثناءً فقط في حالات معينة، ولذلك لا يتم تطبيق حد الجلد على هؤلاء الأشخاص.

Un gendarme de la brigade motorisée de Melle (Deux-Sèvres) est décédé samedi matin "en service" après avoir heurté accidentellement un poids lourd. Il avait 47 ans. Selon les premiers éléments de l'enquête de la gendarmerie, le motard circulait avec l'un de ses collègues sur la D948 entre Melle et Niort lorsqu'il a dévié inexplicablement de sa trajectoire, au niveau de la commune de Mougon, pour finir par entrer en collision avec un poids lourd venant en sens inverse. Le motocycliste, adjudant-chef de son état, a perdu la vie sur le coup. L'enquête est désormais entre les mains de la brigade de recherches de Niort.

Une enfant de 11 ans est morte ce lundi matin 13 janvier dans le XVIe arrondissement de Paris après avoir été renversée par un poids lourd sur le chemin de l'école. Le drame s'est déroulé peu après 8h, au croisement de la rue Jean de La Fontaine et de la rue George Sand. La fillette traversait le passage piéton au feu vert, accompagnée de sa mère, lorsqu'elle a été renversée. Un massage cardiaque de 40 minutes a été réalisé par les pompiers, en vain. Les pompiers ne sont pas parvenus à ranimer l'enfant, malgré un massage cardiaque de 40 minutes. Une autopsie devrait être réalisée à l'institut médico-légal.

La fillette traversait au feu vert lorsqu'elle a été renversée par le poids lourd. Le chauffeur du camion était en train de tourner lorsqu'il a renversé la fillette et ne l'aurait pas vue. Il a été interpellé et placé en garde à vue. Inconnu des services de police, l'alcootest n'a révélé aucune trace d'alcool dans le sang. L'enquête a été confiée au Service de traitement judiciaire des accidents (STJA).

La maire du XVIe arrondissement, Danièle Giazzi, s'est dite en colère, signalant la dangerosité des passages protégés.

When given the opportunity to change how you look for the rest of eternity, everyone must have the same first reaction: the possibilities are endless. You could pull from your wildest fantasies to become what you had always wanted to be. I thought of all the people I had been jealous of back on Earth: the kids who never had acne in high school, the guy down the hall in my dorm freshman year who girls were magnetically attracted to, the rich consultants and lawyers who went to Yale Law and looked the part, the Dos Equis-lookalike retirees who seemingly stayed in shape without even trying.

I started with my hair. No more receding hairline. That awkward cowlick on the back of my head? Gone. My hair became blonder, longer, shinier, and less frizzy, exactly how I had always wanted it to be. Next, I tackled my nose, making it shorter and flatter, the way I had always wanted, since I thought my nose was too big, and I hated how it looked from the side. I changed everything. I made my ears smaller, my cheekbones higher, my teeth whiter, my shoulders broader, my chest more toned, my muscles more defined, my feet less fat.

Aunque vivimos en la era digital, todavía hay partes del mundo que siguen reglas analógicas.

Baselworld, la feria de relojes y joyas más grande del planeta, acaba de comenzar en la ciudad suiza de Basilea con una exhibición de lujosos productos que incluyen Rolex de última generación, relojes híbridos futuristas y joyas centenarias.

Es un mundo donde cualquier producto puede valer miles de dólares... incluso cientos de miles.

Se trata de relojes hechos con la máxima precisión, generalmente en ediciones limitadas y que, en algunos casos, han tomado años de desarrollo por parte de ingenieros especializados.

Por ejemplo, un reloj de pulsera puede tener alrededor de 100 piezas, pero el reloj de bolsillo Calibre 89 de Patek Philippe tiene 1.728.

Muchos de los relojes de lujo son ediciones limitadas. / Getty Images

Y para poder competir, las grandes marcas apoyan sus campañas de marketing con celebridades de renombre, actores o deportistas. Está previsto que este año asistan personajes como Maradona, Usain Bolt y José Mourinho.

Pero, ¿realmente vale la pena?

"Baselworld sigue siendo el encuentro más importante de la industria relojera", dice Ricardo Guadalupe, director ejecutivo de Hublot.

Uno de los productos que la empresa lanzará en la feria es el primer reloj del mundo elaborado con cerámica de un intenso color, una innovación cuyo desarrollo les tomó cuatro años, cuenta Guadalupe.

La empresa Hublot pasó cuatro años desarrollando el "Red Magic watch". (Foto cortesía Hublot) / BBC

Los nuevos productos generalmente se mantienen en secreto hasta el día del lanzamiento. Entre ellos se encuentran las nuevas versiones de Rolex, que exhibió sus productos por primera vez en Baselworld en 1939 y siguen siendo las más esperadas por empresas, coleccionistas y aficionados.

Nuevos relojes inteligentes híbridos

En el evento se presentarán nuevos relojes inteligentes híbridos, que tienen un aspecto tradicional pero al mismo tiempo se conectan utilizando las últimas tecnologías disponibles en el mercado.

Esta ha sido una estrategia desarrollada por algunos fabricantes de piezas de lujo que quieren competir con los teléfonos inteligentes de Apple, aprovechando la exclusividad de sus marcas.

La mayor demanda de relojes de lujo proviene de China y Hong Kong. / Getty Images

Sin embargo, para aquellos que son puristas de la tradición suiza, está la compañía Patek Philippe.

Pero, ¿quiénes han comprado estos relojes?

La reina Victoria y el príncipe Alberto, por ejemplo, los adquirieron en 1851 en la Gran Exhibición de Londres.

Los fabricantes de relojes de lujo son muchas veces considerados como productores de máquinas de alta tecnología en miniatura.

La empresa MB&F, con sede en Ginebra, tiene una historia que se caracteriza por revelar productos inusuales y vanguardistas.

"No hay un argumento racional para fabricarlos, excepto que son maravillosas piezas de arte", dice Charris Yadigaroglou.

"La razón es la belleza y su mecánica".

Tiempos difíciles

Sin embargo, el glamour de esta lujosa feria no puede ocultar las dificultades económicas que ha enfrentado la industria de fabricantes de relojes.

Esta edición de Baselworld se redujo de ocho a seis días y el número de expositores disminuyó en casi 400.

The liquor vends in the district have been closed since the curfew was imposed on March 23. With the Punjab government ordering the opening of liquor vends in the state from Thursday, Ludhiana liquor vend owners have marked circles outside their shops to maintain social distancing. According to the state government's orders, only five customers will be allowed outside the shops at a time. There is also a provision to deliver liquor to the doorsteps of residents, with a maximum of two litres of liquor per customer. A curfew pass has been made mandatory for the staff of vends delivering alcohol to doorsteps, while delivery of liquor has been prohibited in containment zones.

Learning from other states, the district police have geared up to handle any potential chaotic situation outside liquor vends. Commissioner of Police Rakesh Agrawal stated that the police were prepared to tackle any such situation and were committed to executing the government's orders.

Meanwhile, the move has received a mixed response from the public. Kulwant Singh of Sarabha Nagar mentioned that due to the substantial monetary losses the government had suffered during the lockdown, it was compelled to open liquor vends to generate revenue. He suggested that while relaxation should be provided, the government should exercise maximum caution.

Celebrated Nigerian designer, Maki Oh, launches an exclusive 8-piece menswear collection of stylish silk shirts celebrating Lagos in twilight. The shirts feature her signature indigo dye Adire prints that have become synonymous with the brand. One shirt, in particular, is printed with the word Oh, standing out as a key piece in the collection.

Speaking to Vogue, Amaka Osakwe, creative director of Maki Oh, shared her inspiration behind the collection. She expressed a desire to see more men in silk, envisioning a happier world where everyone wears silk and embraces each other longer. Osakwe reflected on the use of the logo on the shirts, finding fascination in logomania and its impact on fashion trends.

To complement the launch of the menswear collection, Maki Oh created a short film set in Lagos after dark. Director Arie Esiri captured the urban landscape in a dystopian light, featuring handsome men donned in Maki Oh prints roaming the typically bustling streets of Lagos. The film was shot in the early hours of the morning to evoke a haunting, end-of-days atmosphere.

The city's architectural marvels, such as the National Theatre and Tafawa Balewa Square, serve as the backdrop for Osakwe's sensual new designs. The film, produced by A Whitespace Creative Agency and Kimiera Production, showcases the essence of the Maki Oh man against the vibrant tapestry of Lagos. Set to the music of 'Boj' the Microphone, the film offers a stunning portrayal of the brand's aesthetic and the allure of the city.

In her interview with Vogue, Maki Oh emphasized the cultural significance of wearing fabrics printed with names or faces in Nigerian society. The collection pays homage to this tradition while infusing modern design elements, creating a fusion of heritage and contemporary style. The exclusive menswear range is a testament to Maki Oh's artistry and her unique interpretation of Lagosian culture.

织出不一样的女力

屏东排湾族的武玉玲和花莲太鲁阁族的林介文，两位擅长纤维艺术的女性艺术家，正在屏东美术馆举办「织．女」联展。她们以编织创作诠释部落的美学与哲思，展现不一样的女力。从毛线中，她们编织出一棵树、一亩田，甚至是一双腿，以女性的生命观点出发，展现其无限的想像力。

武玉玲来自屏东县三地门乡大社村，早期专注于创作传统排湾族饰品。莫拉克台风后，虽然部落迁村，但她看到了部落展现的生命力，尤其是妇女共耕的情境让她难以忘怀。因此，她转向大型创作，结合部落妇女的力量，诉说女性生命的经历。在这次展览中，她通过毛线、回收布料和金属的缠绕，创作出「一棵树、一亩田」，展现女性的坚韧毅力。

另一位来自花莲的艺术家林介文，曾在台湾各地及新克里多尼亚、中国大陆、港澳、西班牙等地驻村创作。外界形容她在现代与古老的灵魂间穿梭，她同样通过编织展现女性的力量。

本次联展以「种子」为核心概念，呈现芽与土地、子宫与身体、部落与女性的链结力量。通过她们的作品，观众可以感受到不同族群以织、缠、勾、绕的生命故事。

Mientras Morelia y Toluca abrían fuego en el Clausura 2019, el monarca América prefirió el apapacho de su pueblo, y por partida triple. En la noche en que arrancó la Liga y, por ende, la defensa de su título, el rey desfiló por la alfombra roja.

A las 19:00 horas, el águila Celeste sobrevoló el Estadio Azteca. Luego, el apagón total permitió que los aficionados iluminaran el escenario con la luz de sus celulares. Alrededor de 27 mil fans acudieron a la fiesta azulcrema para celebrar los títulos del primer equipo, de la femenil y de la Sub 17.

Los monarcas entraron a la cancha recorriendo un sendero formado por 10 antorchas. Luego, chocaron las manos de varios niños que formaron un pasillo mientras ondeaban pañuelos cremas.

La afición se rindió ante el profesionalismo de su capitán Oribe Peralta, quien ayer levantó el trofeo por todo lo alto junto a los capitanes de la Sub 17, Santiago Naveda, y de la femenil, Cecilia Santiago. La vuelta olímpica, bajo los acordes de Queen y su "We are the Champions", marcó la despedida.

Mientras los demás equipos ya se matan en la cancha, el rey está de manteles largos.

En el último año de la legislatura vasca, la coalición Elkarrekin Podemos estrenará una previsión en su reglamento interno: cada uno de los tres socios -Podemos, IU y Equo- podrá mantener una posición política diferenciada, e incluso contradictoria, en un asunto crucial, la negociación de los presupuestos autonómicos. Este lunes, IU-Ezker Anitza, en Vitoria, confirmó que sus dos parlamentarios no apoyarán en ningún caso unos presupuestos que consideran continuistas con los que Elkarrekin Podemos rechazó en los tres años anteriores. Podemos, en Bilbao, ha defendido explorar las negociaciones sin prejuzgar si será posible llegar a un acuerdo con el Gobierno. Equo, en un comunicado, también se ha mostrado "favorable" al acuerdo.

Una comisión de tres personas de la coalición -dos de Podemos y una de Equo- se reunió el pasado jueves en Lakua con el consejero de Hacienda, Pedro Azpiazu, en un primer encuentro para hablar sobre los presupuestos de 2020. Después de fracasar la vía del PP y la de EH Bildu, Elkarrekin Podemos es la única salida viable para que el Gobierno, en minoría, pueda cerrar la legislatura sin problemas. El líder de Podemos y portavoz de la confluencia, Lander Martínez, agradeció que el Gobierno incluyera como prioridades la lucha contra la emergencia climática y la igualdad. La delegación presentó una plataforma valorada en 350 millones con medidas en esas dos áreas, pero también para aumentar un 8% la Renta de Garantía de Ingresos (RGI), revertir algunas políticas fiscales e implementar un plan de empleo. Azpiazu ya rechazó varios de esos puntos y Podemos declaró públicamente que ninguna de sus condiciones eran "líneas rojas" y están dispuestos a seguir negociando.

Sin embargo, el diagnóstico de IU es diferente. Su parlamentario Jon Hernández, presente en la reunión, aseguró que para su partido sí hay líneas rojas. En una rueda de prensa en solitario en el Parlamento junto al otro electo de IU, Íñigo Martínez, y la coordinadora en Euskadi, Isabel Salud, indicó que "respeta" la idea de Podemos de seguir negociando pero desde la constatación de que "no hay margen" para respaldar a PNV y PSE-EE. Y quisieron dejar claro que no ha sido IU quien ha cambiado su posición porque "desde el inicio de la legislatura" ha sido "crítica con las políticas del Gobierno".

Turnberry | Donald Trump termine son séjour au Royaume-Uni en beauté avec une visite privée dans son luxueux complexe hôtelier de Turnberry en Écosse ce samedi et dimanche, après avoir créé l'émoi en critiquant la stratégie de la Première ministre Theresa May sur le Brexit. "Je serai au Trump Turnberry (le nom de l'établissement sportif et hôtelier, ndlr) pour deux jours de réunions, d'appels et, je l'espère, de golf - ma principale forme d'exercice!", a tweeté le président américain samedi matin, arrivé vendredi soir en Écosse. "Le temps est magnifique, et cet endroit est incroyable!", a ajouté le dirigeant, qui se rendra ensuite à Helsinki en Finlande où il rencontrera son homologue russe Vladimir Poutine. Sa visite en Écosse devrait, en principe, être moins mouvementée que ses deux premiers jours au Royaume-Uni. Arrivé à Londres jeudi, le président américain a créé la polémique en exprimant, dans une interview au tabloïd The Sun, que le choix de Londres de favoriser une relation étroite avec l'UE après le Brexit tuerait "probablement" la possibilité de conclure un accord de libre-échange avec les États-Unis. Cette déclaration a été d'autant plus cinglante pour Mme May que la Première ministre britannique lui avait réservé un accueil chaleureux jeudi soir et vanté la force du lien transatlantique. Donald Trump s'est montré plus conciliant vendredi lors d'une conférence de presse conjointe des deux dirigeants à Chequers, la résidence de campagne des Premiers ministres britanniques. Affichant sa volonté de parvenir à un "formidable" accord d'échange bilatéral avec Londres, M. Trump s'est voulu optimiste: "nous voulons faire des échanges avec le Royaume-Uni, ils veulent en faire avec nous". En écho, Theresa May a évoqué sa volonté d'aboutir à un accord "ambitieux" avec Washington une fois le Royaume-Uni sorti de l'UE. Le président américain a également regretté la manière dont le tabloïd avait interprété ses propos, avant de faire l'éloge de Mme May, fragilisée au sein de son parti conservateur après des démissions récentes, dont celle du ministre des Affaires étrangères Boris Johnson. "C'est une très bonne négociatrice, très ferme, elle est très intelligente", a souligné le magnat de l'immobilier, qui a pris le thé vendredi après-midi au château de Windsor avec la reine Elizabeth II. Pendant ce temps à Londres, des manifestations contre la venue de M. Trump ont rassemblé plusieurs dizaines de milliers de personnes dénonçant sa politique migratoire, son "sexisme" ou son "déni" du changement climatique. D'autres manifestations l'attendent en Écosse, où il compte également de nombreux détracteurs. Vendredi soir, environ 2 000 personnes se sont rassemblées à Glasgow, à environ une heure de route de Turnberry (côte ouest) et de ses trois terrains de golf, tandis qu'une manifestation est prévue samedi à Édimbourg.

The author supports the idea of exploring Venus despite its extreme conditions. The article discusses the challenges of surviving on Venus, such as temperature differences and radiation levels, but emphasizes that it is doable. While there will be many problems to overcome, it is noted that it can be safe with proper preparation. Venus is highlighted as the brightest planet in the sky and one with similarities to Earth.

Even though the oceans on Venus may liquefy certain metals, advancements in technology can lead to new types of metal that can withstand such conditions. Vehicles like jets can navigate above storms and rugged terrain, making exploration feasible. Solar power is abundant on Venus due to its brightness, enabling sufficient energy for various purposes.

Despite Venus's average temperature of 800 degrees Fahrenheit and atmospheric pressure 90 times greater than Earth's, survival is possible with appropriate measures. The author encourages taking risks and pushing boundaries through innovation and imagination. Efforts are underway to enhance the durability of electronic devices like cellphones and tablets for use in extreme environments like Venus.

While acknowledging the significant differences between Earth and Venus in terms of temperature, weather patterns, terrains, and overall harshness on Venus compared to our home planet, the author believes that solutions exist for these challenges. Strategies such as using aircraft to bypass storms or developing stronger materials for underwater exploration demonstrate potential ways to address obstacles on this alien planet.

تواصل المغردون تفاعلهم لليوم الثاني على التوالي مع الرسالة التي وجهها صاحب السمو الشيخ محمد بن راشد آل مكتوم، نائب رئيس الدولة ورئيس مجلس الوزراء حاكم دبي - رعاه الله - مع بداية الموسم الجديد للعمل والإنجاز في دولة الإمارات. أكدوا أن أفعال سموه تسبق أقواله، وأبدوا ثقتهم العالية بحكومة دولة الإمارات وقيادتها الرشيدة.

قالت نَجْلاء الميل: "لقطة مميزة تثلج الصدر، باعثة ومحفزة لنا جميعًا أن ننهض ونباشر وظائفنا ومهمتنا أينما كنّا. موفق سيدي، بداية خير وبركة بإذن الله".

من جانبه، عبّر محمد بن خالد الجسمي قائلاً: "الله يكثر من أمثالك يا سندنا وفخرنا، بك نعتز. يا مدرسة الحياة والفكر المدبر، يا رمز النجاح في الحياة. الله يحفظك ويحفظ عيالك".

وغرد محمد: "كلنا ثقة بحكومتنا الرشيدة بقيادتك سيدي. الله يوفقكم".

وقال سيف المحيربي: "صاحب السمو الشيخ محمد بن راشد، أنتم أهل لذلك. نسأل الله لكم التوفيق دائمًا وأبدًا".

أما أم محمد: "الله يوفقكم طويلا في العمر ويعطيكم الصحة والعافية لما فيه صالح الوطن والمواطن".

وقال خالد النعيمي: "صاحب السمو الشيخ محمد بن راشد آل مكتوم قدوة للأجيال في خدمة الوطن ومرجع لكل إنسان في العمل والإدارة. هو المعلم الأول وقائد السعادة".

وأضاف المغرد محمد صالح الجنيبي: "الحمد لله على نعمة الإمارات، الله يبارك في الجهود ويوفقكم ويعينكم. وسيدي سمو الشيخ منصور بن زايد آل نهيان، نعم الرجل الذي يحقق تطلعاتنا وطموحاتنا".

وصرحت عائشة سيف الخاجة: "كل التوفيق والنجاح لأصحاب المعالي الوزراء والقادة والمسؤولين في ترجمة توجيهات صاحب السمو الشيخ محمد بن راشد آل مكتوم على أرض الواقع بأكمله لتستمر دولتنا الحبيبة في تحقيق النجاحات والإنجازات غير المسبوقة في مختلف المجالات، لنكون أفضل الأفضل في عام سعيد مليء بالتفاؤل والإيجابية".

وعلّقت المغردة لطيفة: "أفعالك تسبق أقوالك شيخنا، الله يحفظك، قائد وقدوة، قيمة وقامة نتعلم منها، ستظل كلماتك عبيرًا نتنفس منه معنى النجاح والامتياز. الله يحفظك، معك دائمًا حتى النهاية".

وصرّحت المغردة أم محمد: "الله يحفظك ويطيل في عمرك شيخنا بوراشد ويعطيك الصحة والعافية. قادتنا القدوة في كل عمل تقومون به. فعلاً وصلت رسالتك، ورأينا التفاعل الجميل من خلال جميع وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي. حمست الجميع للنشاط والإيجابية واتخاذ القرارات. لنتعلم منكم (أصحاب القرارات) وننفذ المطلوب".

وأشاد المغرد سيف المحيربي: "هكذا تبنى الوطن، وفقكم الله".

وأبدى المغرد عبدالله الكعبي: "أفعالك تسبق أقوالك سيدي، الله يحفظك". وغرّد عبدالله الدرمكي: "بوركت جهودكم طويلا في العمر".

وأخيرًا، عبّر المغرد جمال الدوبحي قائلًا: "الحكمة والتعقّل والاتزان، حفظ الله سموكم". وعلّق سالم بن طوق: "خطوة مهمة جدًا سيدي في هذا الوقت. الاهتمام الأول لديكم هو تنوير وشفافية المعلومات لدى العالم. لهذا يجب رصد المعلومات وضبط الأخبار التي تسيء للوطن. وعلينا أيضًا نشر الأخبار الإيجابية للعالم أجمع.

The term "Software Engineering" was coined in 1968 at a conference aimed at discussing the need for the software development discipline to be more strongly based on theoretical and engineering principles (Naur and Randell, 1969). The Waterfall model, a then-popular model used in manufacturing, was initially adopted as the standard approach for developing computer software. However, over time, it became evident that a strict implementation of this model was not suitable for software development. Various modifications, such as the Spiral model (Boehm, 1988), and alternative models like XP (Beck, 2000), emerged. The authors of these models hold different perspectives on software development. Earlier models treat software development as an engineering activity and emphasize control, while more recent models focus on effective communication and view software as a service.

Despite the significant variation in approach, until recently, it was widely believed among methodology architects that strict adherence to their approach, without additions or omissions, was essential for effectiveness (Cusumano et al., 2003). However, industry experiences have shown that this belief does not align with real-world practices. There has been advocacy for a deeper understanding of the software development process to support industry in flexibly selecting practices based on objectives and context (Bajec et al., 2007; Fitzgerald, 1997; Hansson et al., 2009; Kirk and Tempero, 2004; Kirk and Tempero, 2005; Kirk, 2007).

This viewpoint has now become widely accepted (Avison and Pries-Heje, 2008; MacCormack et al., 2012; Petersen and Wohlin, 2009; de Azevedo Santos et al., 2011; Turner et al., 2010). The notion that methodologies and practices must be strictly followed has been replaced by the understanding that customization is essential. To achieve effective tailoring, a thorough comprehension of the relationships between objectives, process, and context is crucial.

The role of theory in software engineering (SE) has been explored from various angles. It has been noted that there is limited emphasis on theories in software engineering (Sjøberg et al., 2008). The need for theory-building to accumulate knowledge applicable in diverse settings has been emphasized. While there is consensus on the benefits of focusing on theory building, uncertainties remain on how to proceed.

Our research aims to apply an ontological approach to develop a conceptual model describing software initiatives, referring to the software-related processes implemented to achieve specific outcomes. Establishing such a model would aid the software industry in selecting suitable practices aligned with organizational objectives and contexts. Before formalizing a software initiative conceptually, a deeper understanding of the foundational constructs is necessary. This paper outlines our progress in this pursuit. Section 2 provides an overview of our progress to date, section 3 discusses efforts in establishing a theoretical foundation for software development, and section 4 summarizes the paper, discussing limitations and outlining future work.

The Seagoing Cowboys offer an opportunity to aid war-torn countries in Europe. These volunteers assist individuals facing hardship and provide much-needed support.

Joining the Seagoing Cowboys is a rewarding and enriching experience. The act of helping those in need evokes a unique sense of fulfillment. Moreover, embarking on this journey grants the chance to explore new and unfamiliar territories. Participants have the privilege of visiting Europe and China, witnessing iconic landmarks such as the Acropolis in Greece, experiencing a gondola ride in Venice, Italy, exploring a castle in Crete, and observing the Panama Canal on the way to China.

Once the Seagoing Cowboys have completed their humanitarian duties, they engage in recreational activities. Returning trips involve unloading the animals, which clears the way for the volunteers to use the holds for games like baseball, volleyball, table tennis, fencing, and boxing. Additionally, the group partakes in reading, whittling, and various other games, fostering camaraderie and relaxation.

In essence, the Seagoing Cowboys offer a multifaceted opportunity. Participants not only provide aid to the needy, but also have the chance to explore new, exciting destinations, and enjoy recreational activities with their peers.

Former Indiana running back Stevie Scott, a Syracuse, N.Y., native and three-year starter from 2018 to 2020, quickly found a new home in the NFL with the Denver Broncos after being cut by the New Orleans Saints last week. Despite going undrafted in the 2021 NFL Draft, Scott was signed by the Saints as an undrafted free agent. However, he did not make it through the final cuts and was released by the team last week after not playing in their first preseason game.

Denver signed Scott following an injury to running back Adrian Killins in their second preseason game against the Seattle Seahawks, adding more depth to the position group. Scott, known for his prowess in pass protection and knack for scoring touchdowns, may find a place in the league despite not possessing elite speed. His signing with the Broncos offers him a new opportunity to showcase his skills and contribute to the team.

At Indiana, Scott was a standout player, becoming one of just three Hoosiers to score at least 10 rushing touchdowns in three consecutive seasons. He ranks fourth all-time in touchdowns and ninth in rushing yards in the school's history. A two-time second-team all-Big Ten selection and one-time honorable mention, Scott brings a solid pedigree to the Broncos' running back corps.

Joining the likes of Melvin Gordon III, Javonte Williams, Mike Boone, Royce Freeman, and Damarea Crockett, Scott will wear No. 32 for Denver. As the Broncos work towards finalizing their roster cuts and preparing for the regular season opener on September 12 against the New York Giants, Scott aims to make his mark in his new football home. He will have a familiar face in former Indiana safety Jamar Johnson, a fifth-round draft pick of the Broncos in April, as he navigates his journey in Denver.

Rents in London have decreased during the Coronavirus pandemic, according to property portal Zoopla. However, London remains an exception, as rents have risen in a vibrant rental market across the UK as a whole.

"Average rents in London have fallen by 5.2 percent over the last 12 months, reaching levels last seen in 2014," Zoopla reported. This decline is attributed to "new working patterns and the lack of tourism during the pandemic."

In contrast, rents outside of London increased by 1.7 percent, and rental demand has surged by a fifth over the past year. This strong demand is driven by a squeeze on lending to potential first-time buyers, Zoopla explained. 

"At the same time, supply remains constrained, with investment in buy-to-let properties still reduced following changes to Stamp Duty (the additional 3 percent surcharge on second properties) and the broader tax regime introduced from 2016 onwards."

Renters are increasingly interested in larger properties, particularly those with access to outdoor spaces. 

"The search for space, first observed in the sales market, is now being strongly replicated by renters. Zoopla's top searches for rental properties include terms like gardens, parking, garages, balconies, and pets, reflecting a need for outdoor space and freedom necessary to cope with lockdown. There is also evidence that while the market as a whole is moving more quickly, the market for rented houses is moving more rapidly than that for rented flats, highlighting this desire for more space among renters."

"For most of the UK, the demand-supply gap is supporting moderate levels of rental growth," said Zoopla's head of research, Gráinne Gilmore.

"The split in the rental market caused by COVID-19 has now become pronounced, and we are witnessing a firmly entrenched two-speed market. 

"We haven't seen an exodus of students from cities, and as more people remain in the rental market due to the squeeze on mortgage lending, higher levels of demand will continue to support rents. However, muted earnings growth will begin to limit the potential for rental growth in some markets. 

"The search for additional space, both indoor and outdoor, within the rental sector is set to continue as the country experiences further lockdown periods."

Residents of Freedom Park in Nomzamo Strand, Cape Town, are reaching out to the government for assistance in rebuilding their lives after a devastating fire left half of the community destitute. The blaze ripped through the area, destroying homes and disrupting the lives of many.

As the nation observed Freedom Day, the inhabitants of the informal settlement were still grappling with the loss of their homes, furniture, and personal belongings. The fire ravaged 90 structures, affecting over 300 people last Monday.

Community counselor Sitembile Mfecane highlighted the ongoing struggles faced by the fire victims in reconstructing their lives. Despite assessments by the Department of Disaster Relief and Sassa, no tangible assistance has been provided yet. While some donations from empathetic residents have been received, the affected families require more support.

Mfecane stressed the urgent need for necessities such as food, clothing, and materials to rebuild homes, especially with winter approaching. With a high rate of unemployment in the community, the financial burden is significant. Without substantial resources, aid, and donations, the residents may find it challenging to overcome this trying period.

An appeal has been made for individuals and organizations to step in and help the community recover from this tragic event. Community leaders are urging the public to lend support to the affected families.

For those willing to assist, please contact Sitembile Mfecane at 073 248 0407.

(Source: Cape Argus)

The Tesla Model Y offers versatility in various aspects. With its crossover style providing spaciousness and comfort, combined with the street-blazing performance of the all-electric powerhouse, it stands out as one of Tesla's finest vehicles. Yet, the Model Y offers more than just a comfortable ride to the store or a quick spin on the drag strip. It could very well be Tesla's premier camping vehicle, thanks to its myriad available options suitable for individuals or families.

The Kilowatts YouTube channel showcased a range of options for creating a comfortable and spacious sleeping setup for those venturing into the wilderness with their Model Y for a night of camping. Two options catered to in-cabin sleeping comfort, while a unique experience awaited those who opted to camp on top of the vehicle using the Tesla roof rack, available for purchase on the company's website.

The two interior options feature simple mattresses that guarantee a cozy overnight stay within the all-electric crossover. While previous demonstrations focused on showcasing the vehicle's spaciousness compared to the Model 3, the two options highlighted by Kilowatts host Ryan differentiate between available mattress choices from Dreamcase and Exped.

Both mattress options offer a comfortable resting place for owners, with the final decision boiling down to personal preference and budget. Pairing either cabin mattress with the Model Y's "Camp Mode," which optimizes airflow and air conditioning usage to extend the vehicle's range, promises an overnight experience that rivals a hotel room.

Alternatively, a more intriguing option invites campers to sleep atop the Model Y using a tent from Yakima, though other choices exist. These top-loading tents offer several benefits, including a unique experience allowing up to two people to camp atop the crossover.

Sleeping on the Model Y's roof presents advantages, potentially offering a memorable camping experience that competes with wilderness camping. Notably, the rooftop tent spares owners from sleeping on the ground and could deliver a more authentic camping adventure than the in-cabin mattresses.

With its generous space and expansive glass roof providing panoramic views of the sky, the Model Y emerges as a top contender for Tesla's ultimate camping vehicle. The array of camping options available for the Model Y caters to various preferences, ensuring the perfect accommodations for any owner seeking their ideal camping experience.

The rapid advancement of blockchain technology and communication methods has sparked significant interest in the Metaverse, hailed as the next-generation Internet paradigm [1] - [3]. Governments and companies worldwide are gearing up for the impending Metaverse era, with initiatives such as South Korea integrating Metaverse-based lessons, Facebook's transformation into a Metaverse-focused entity, now known as Meta, and Tencent's investment in the AR platform "Avakin Life" [4] - [6].

A pressing challenge in the Metaverse is bridging the gap between the virtual realm and reality through extended reality (XR), encompassing virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR) [7] - [10]. Current research primarily targets enhancing communication and computation for VR to deliver users an immersive experience [11], [12]. However, mobile VR services demand exceptionally high data rates, posing challenges even in the 5G landscape. Moreover, users grapple with the weighty nature of existing VR devices, necessitating a solution.

Mobile augmented reality (MAR) emerges as a viable alternative to VR and a crucial component of the Metaverse [13] - [16]. Unlike VR, MAR blends reality with the virtual world, curtailing communication and computational expenses [17] - [19]. AR devices also excel in weight compared to VR gadgets, offering enhanced comfort and safety as wearable technology. AR boasts unique benefits in various sectors like navigation, healthcare, tourism, shopping, and education, requiring interaction with the physical world [20] - [22].

While AR necessitates lower data rates than VR, efficient communication resource allocation remains crucial due to the vast number of users and devices linked to the Metaverse server. To enhance communication resource efficiency and quality of service (QoS), Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) and reinforcement learning (RL) for VR/AR services have garnered significant attention [23] - [29]. Various studies have proposed innovative approaches, such as an RL-based energy-efficient MEC framework for AR services and utilizing deep RL for MAR services over 6G networks.

This paper introduces an AR-based Metaverse model featuring resolution control and a resource allocation algorithm. The proposed algorithm, addressing the mixed-integer nonlinear programming (MINLP) optimization problem, leverages an outer approximation (OA) algorithm to achieve the global optimum. Simulation results demonstrate the algorithm's ability to maximize utility within communication resource constraints, outperforming conventional greedy algorithms.

Key contributions of this study include:
- Proposal of an MAR-based Metaverse model for reality-centric applications.
- Introduction of a resolution control and resource allocation optimization problem for Metaverse MAR services, solved using an OA algorithm.
- Implementation of simulation to compare the proposed algorithm against a benchmark greedy algorithm under diverse parameter settings, highlighting the efficacy of the proposed Metaverse MAR service model.

The subsequent sections of this paper are structured as follows: Section II outlines the proposed system model, Section III defines the problem and Section IV presents the solution approach. Section V showcases simulation results and Section VI concludes the paper.

Denver (CNN) — Colorado authorities have issued a warrant for homicide following the discovery of human remains in rural southern Colorado, police reported on Wednesday. Local and state officials announced that they uncovered the remains of three individuals on two properties in Lasauses, Colorado, while executing a search warrant.

Authorities are now seeking Adre Jordan Baroz, 26, in connection with these remains. "Our primary objective is to remove him from the streets," stated Alamosa Police Chief Ken Anderson, who announced the warrant. "He currently poses a danger to the public."

Chief Anderson also noted that Baroz is considered armed and dangerous. Lasauses is a small town situated along the Rio Grande in southern Colorado, nestled between Alamosa to the north and the New Mexico border to the south.

The investigators mentioned that the remains have yet to be identified. It may take weeks or even months to determine the gender, age, and identity of the deceased. However, Monte Vista Police Chief George Dingfelder confirmed that forensic anthropologists have established the remains belong to three individuals.

On November 10, the Conejos County Sheriff’s Office, which has jurisdiction in Lasauses, requested assistance from the Colorado Bureau of Investigation in executing the search warrant, according to Sheriff Garth Crowther. Upon discovering remains at the initial property, evidence prompted the authorities to search a nearby location, where they found additional remains.

Due to the ongoing investigation, law enforcement has not disclosed details regarding why Baroz has been identified as a suspect, how long the remains were on the properties, or whether they are connected to any recent missing persons cases. Investigators continue to search the properties for more remains and evidence.

CNN’s Eliott C. McLaughlin contributed to this report.

Rohit Prasad was born into the Kshatriya, one of India's upper castes, and would have ruled over a province or city in ancient times. But he was born in 2209, and instead of pursuing political ambitions at home, he went to American schools to chase his boyhood dream of building the robots he saw in comic books. While in school, Rohit fell in love with Alison, a pretty French Biology student. A few years after graduation, they got married and (after Rohit's parents recovered from the shock of their youngest son marrying an American) ended up in California working for Acceltromix, an ambitious nano-tech/biotech startup company that became wildly successful after inventing a series of plants and machines that could effectively turn seeds, sunlight, and water into fuel for faster-than-light engines.

Like all successful Silicon Valley startups, Acceltromix owed most of its success to some innovation and a great amount of luck. The company managed to file their patents without attracting much attention outside the small world of space tourism, which was enough to pay the bills and a small dividend to investors. But it was the announcement of the Exodus project that catapulted Rohit, Alison, and everyone else who held shares of Acceltromix into the ever-growing club of young Californian billionaires. Exodus would pack Earth's major cities into space colonies and send them to the far reaches of the galaxy in search of more hospitable environments for humanity's ceaseless growth. The colonies of Palo Alto and San Francisco would all make planet-fall in the southern hemisphere of Tau Ceti e, the closest habitable planet, with the idea that they could support the other colonies with any inventions and innovations necessary to complete their longer journeys.

Acceltromix was very interested in keeping their headline-winning team of roboticists and botanists intact. For that reason, Alison, Rohit, and their colleagues were given some time off to engage in several rounds of familial negotiations. The couple was currently sitting in their massive one-thousand square foot apartment in Palo Alto, wearing virtual reality headsets for a Skype VR session with Alison's parents.

“Hi, Mom!” began Alison.

“Hello, Alison,” responded Mrs. Fournier, Alison's mother. “The lilacs are lovely this time of year. Do you think you'll have time to visit before you leave?” Mrs. Fournier asked, as if Alison was about to leave home again for another degree. Mrs. Fournier remained heroically in denial that her daughter would soon live on another planet, never to see her again.

“That's why we called, Mom. We wanted to talk to you again about the trip…about Exodus. We've given it a lot of thought and we wanted to know if you would come live with us,” said Alison.

“And come with you to Tau City?” said Mrs. Fournier.

“It's Tau Ceti e, Mom,” Alison corrected.

Mrs. Fournier sighed before continuing, “I don't know, dear. We have the bakery, and Paris is such a beautiful city. We like it here. I can't imagine leaving.”

“Yeah, it's nice,” chimed in Mr. Fournier, never one to miss a chance to complain, “But the bakery is getting tiresome. I've baked baguettes every day for a long time. I could do with a change of pace.”

“Oh, Cecil, you always say that, but you'll be back in front of the ovens tomorrow morning whistling to yourself before you know it,” chided Mrs. Fournier to her husband before continuing, “Look, honey, we're happy here now, we'll be happy when the ships take off and we finally have Earth to ourselves, don't worry about us. You just go on and have a great time inventing new flowers and robots on your new planet.”

Between the catacombs under the city and the venerated stone architecture above, Paris was poorly adapted for conversion into a space colony. As such, it was one of the few cities that had elected to stay behind. The French who wanted to leave were welcome to join other cities in the European Union or other cities in which they had family, of course, but a surprisingly large majority of Parisians didn't want to leave Earth or their beloved city.

“Alison is pregnant,” said Rohit in a familiar monotone voice.

Brigitte Bardot s'est rendue ce dimanche à Fréjus pour « soutenir » les Gilets jaunes, affirmant que « beaucoup de Français les admirent » et réitérant son soutien « à fond ».

La star du cinéma français a fait une visite surprise à un groupe de Gilets jaunes dans le Var, près de sa propriété La Madrague. Elle est arrivée dans l'après-midi dans une salle d'hôtel où les manifestants s'étaient réunis pour discuter du grand débat national, provoquant la surprise générale.

« Ne lâchez rien », a-t-elle lancé. « Ne lâchez rien. Je vous soutiens, à fond, à fond. »

Vêtue d'un gilet fluorescent signé par des membres des Gilets jaunes, BB a expliqué sa présence sur place : « Les soutenir. Ils ont besoin qu'on les soutienne. Ils ont besoin de savoir que beaucoup de Français les admirent. »

À une journaliste qui lui demandait s'il était important pour elle d'être là, Brigitte Bardot a répondu qu'elle était venue pour « faire plaisir » aux Gilets jaunes, soulignant leur « grand courage ».

Après être restée à peine quelques minutes, elle est repartie, déclarant aux journalistes qu'il fallait « tout changer en France », selon le Nouvel Observateur.

Cela fait aujourd'hui exactement trois mois que les Gilets jaunes se rassemblent tous les samedis, initialement pour protester contre la hausse des prix du carburant. Le 16 février, ils se sont mobilisés pour leur acte 14 dans de nombreuses villes françaises. Les estimations de leur nombre varient de 41 500 selon le ministère de l'Intérieur à 230 000 selon le syndicat France Police-Policiers en colère.

Un informe realizado por el Instituto de Investigación Criminal y Ciencias Forenses de la Procuración bonaerense determinó que la ropa que Santiago "Chano" Charpentier llevaba la noche en que fue baleado por un oficial de policía en un episodio confuso presentaba residuos de pólvora. Esto significa que el disparo se realizó a corta distancia. La defensa del oficial utilizará este informe para solicitar el sobreseimiento del acusado, argumentando que actuó en legítima defensa frente a un inminente ataque del músico.

El informe, de 11 páginas y al que tuvo acceso la agencia Télam, reveló que en la chaqueta de la marca Topman que usaba "Chano" había presencia de residuos de disparo debido a la existencia de partículas características de GRS, es decir, rastros de plomo, antimonio y bario, tres elementos que se liberan al efectuar un disparo.

Entre las conclusiones de los peritos del Instituto de Investigación Criminal y Ciencias Forenses de la Procuración bonaerense se destaca que a medida que la distancia entre la persona muestreada y el punto de detonación es menor, la concentración de partículas características (plomo, antimonio y bario) en comparación con las partículas ambientales es mayor.

"Esto significa que la cantidad relativa de partículas características de residuos GSR disminuye a medida que aumenta la distancia al punto de detonación del arma de fuego que origina dichos residuos", afirmaron.

Esta conclusión fue considerada por el abogado Fernando Soto, defensor del oficial de policía Facundo Amendolara (27), como evidencia de que en el momento en que realizó el disparo, el oficial tenía al músico cerca y actuó en legítima defensa.

El abogado señaló que de la pericia se desprende que el disparo se efectuó desde una distancia de "entre 50 y 70 centímetros", lo que interpreta como una señal de que el policía se defendió cuando iba a ser atacado por el músico. Por lo tanto, adelantó que solicitará el sobreseimiento de Amendolara.

"Esto demuestra lo que hemos dicho sobre la distancia (desde donde se disparó) y el peligro del cual Amendolara tuvo que defenderse", agregó el defensor.

Además, destacó que el resultado de la pericia coincide con la distancia mencionada por los testigos, que sitúan al músico y al policía a una distancia de entre 1.50 y 2 metros entre ellos.

"Esa distancia, restando el brazo y el cuerpo estirado del policía con el arma en la mano, deja un espacio total de entre 50 y 70 centímetros entre el cuerpo y la boca del cañón, que es desde donde sale el disparo", explicó.

Sin embargo, fuentes judiciales consultadas por Télam señalaron que si bien la pericia arrojó un resultado favorable al acusado, el fiscal Martín Zocca, de la Unidad Funcional de Instrucción (UFI) 1 de Zárate-Campana, aún debe analizarla en detalle.

Además, confirmaron que también se informó de un resultado negativo en las muestras de sangre del oficial de policía en relación con el consumo de sustancias en el momento del hecho.

También se extrajeron las imágenes del DVR correspondientes a las cámaras de seguridad de la casa de "Chano", ubicada en el barrio privado Parque La Verdad de Exaltación de la Cruz, aunque se determinó que "no correspondían al día del hecho" ocurrido el pasado 25 de julio.

Según fuentes con acceso al caso, el próximo miércoles se realizará una evaluación psiquiátrica sobre el estado del exlíder de Tan Biónica basada en los antecedentes clínicos, los informes del Sanatorio Otamendi donde estuvo internado después del disparo y de la clínica psiquiátrica a la que fue trasladado para tratar sus adicciones.

Una vez que termine de analizar todas las pruebas, el fiscal Zocca estará en condiciones de tomar una decisión sobre la situación procesal del oficial de policía, quien actualmente está acusado de "lesiones gravísimas agravadas por el uso de arma de fuego y por haber sido cometidas por un funcionario policial", delito que conlleva una pena de hasta 15 años de prisión.

美国宾夕法尼亚州48岁女子克莉辛达·布莱特（Krisinda Bright）日前残忍地射杀了她的两个子女，分别是16岁的儿子杰弗瑞（Jeffrey Bright）和22岁的女儿洁思敏（Jasmine Cannady）。警方在调查过程中发现，两名死者的头部均有枪伤。令人震惊的是，布莱特被捕时竟然坦承，儿子在死前曾拼命哀求她不要开枪，而她仍然开了两枪。

警方于22日接到布莱特的报案。当他们赶到现场时，发现她浑身是血地站在门廊上。当警员询问她是否受伤时，她冷淡地回答说，血来自她的两个孩子。警察进入屋内，目睹了可怕的景象：16岁的杰弗瑞和姐姐洁思敏陈尸家中，脸部和头部均有枪伤。

布莱特承认，她是在女儿躺在楼上房间时将其射杀，随后又来到楼下，准备对准儿子开枪。儿子拼命哀求道：“拜托不要开枪，我要报警了。”然而，她却无情地扣动扳机，一枪未能致命，便再开一枪，理由是她“不想让孩子受苦”。

事件传出后，令许多邻居感到非常震惊，因为布莱特平时看起来是一位好母亲，孩子们也总是显得很快乐。

The article discusses the making of the Mona Lisa's face and introduces the Facial Action Coding System (FACS), a program that can identify emotions such as sadness, anger, and happiness. Professors Thomas Huang and Nicu Sebe are currently involved in the development of FACS, which was created by Dr. Paul Ekman.

FACS is capable of recognizing when someone is sad, which is quite impressive in terms of technological advancement. Dr. Ekman has categorized six basic emotions: happiness, surprise, anger, disgust, fear, and sadness, based on the movements of facial muscles.

In conclusion, while it may not be a crucial aspect of the world, the ability to discern emotions, like determining whether a person in a picture is happy or sad, is a fascinating concept. Dr. Ekman, along with Professors Thomas and Nicu, are brilliant individuals.

There are many excellent and well-reasoned examples of why this technology is valuable.

If others know what that individual is feeling, they might be able to help. For instance, the passage states, "a classroom computer could recognize when a student is becoming confused and bored." Dr. Huang says, "then it could modify the lesson, like an effective human instructor." This technology could be useful in many different situations, making it a valuable tool.

Another important application is in the realm of crime, where reading emotions is crucial.

Virgil van Dijk a vivement réagi face aux critiques après les trois dernières défaites de Liverpool. Le défenseur central ne comprend pas les critiques soudaines, alors que les Reds ont réalisé une grande partie impressionnante de la saison.

Les joueurs de Liverpool ont perdu en Ligue des Champions contre l'Atlético Madrid, puis contre Watford en Premier League, avant d'être éliminés en FA Cup par les Blues de Chelsea.

[Port-au-Prince] – A healthy and productive life starts with good nutrition. Pregnant and breastfeeding women are at higher risk, and children require a balanced diet rich in vitamins for a long and healthy life.

Since 2017, the United States Agency for International Development (USAID) has been collaborating with the Ministry of Public Health and Population, the private sector, and other partners on the Ranfòse Abitid Nitrisyon pou Fè Ogmante Sante (RANFOSE) project. Their goal is to ensure that fortified food products are readily available nationwide to enhance the health of Haitian families.

U.S. Ambassador to Haiti Michele Sison emphasized, "The U.S. government's joint efforts with our Haitian counterparts are leading to improved nutrition, health, and food security for Haitian communities."

"When young Haitians can reach their full physical and intellectual potential, they are better equipped to contribute to Haiti's future economic prosperity."

The RANFOSE project has made sure that the Haitian population now has access to foods enriched with essential vitamins and minerals. Currently, 76% of the flour and 65% of the oil sold in Haiti are fortified with vitamins.

Food fortification is a straightforward, cost-effective method that enhances the nutritional value of commonly consumed foods. The project primarily focuses on enriching wheat flour with iron and folic acid, vegetable oils with vitamin A, and salt with iodine.

The quality control manager at Carribex S.A., a local food company collaborating with RANFOSE, Carl-Henri, stated, "Since the introduction of this program, our company has proactively sought information and committed to offering products that adhere to food fortification regulations. Investing in micronutrients is investing in the country's future."

This company has chosen to fortify the butter, margarine, and shortening it produces, earning them the prestigious Serge Toureau prize established by the Ministry of Health to commend efforts combating vitamin A deficiency in Haiti.

EL NUEVO DIARIO, FREETOWN.- Al menos 98 personas fallecieron y más de 100 resultaron heridas en Freetown, la capital de Sierra Leona, después de explotar anoche un camión cisterna que transportaba combustible al colisionar con otro camión, confirmaron hoy a Efe los servicios de socorro.

Bah indicó que las personas heridas fueron evacuadas a varios hospitales de la capital y que hay trabajadores sociales y expertos ayudando a los damnificados.

“Es un incidente desgarrador para un país en el que todavía están frescos los recuerdos de los trágicos corrimientos de tierra de 2017 y del brote de ébola de 2014-2016. Más de 100 pacientes están siendo atendidos ahora en diferentes hospitales de Freetown”, declaró en un comunicado Mohammed Mukhier, director en África de la Federación de la Cruz Roja y la Media Luna.

“El hospital principal está desbordado y las familias tienen dificultades para identificar a sus seres queridos quemados o muertos, ya que los cuerpos están muy carbonizados”, declaró Kpawuru E. T. Sandy, secretario general de la Cruz Roja en Sierra Leona.

Según recogió el medio local The Sierra Leona Telegraph, algunos residentes cercanos al lugar donde se produjo la explosión -que destruyó casas y otros vehículos- salieron de sus casas tras la colisión de los vehículos con cubos y bidones para recoger el combustible derramado. Se trata de una práctica habitual en algunos países africanos que produce un aumento del número de víctimas si el camión termina explotando y que ocasionó el pasado mes de julio en Kenia la muerte de trece personas que se acercaron a un camión cisterna accidentado para extraer el combustible del vehículo y que explotó después.

Mohamed Kamara, un testigo del accidente, explicó a Efe que éste se produjo en torno a las 20.00 horas (misma hora GMT) cuando el camión cisterna quería abastecer de combustible a una estación de servicio. “De repente un remolque golpeó el camión cisterna y éste estalló”, explicó Kamara al señalar que fue entonces cuando la gente comenzó a llegar para obtener el combustible. “Como querían conseguir el combustible, el conductor del camión cisterna les dijo que se alejaran. El conductor corrió para salvar su vida; todos los motociclistas que se encontraban cerca del lugar murieron”, agregó.

La alcaldesa de Freetown, Yvonne Aki-Sawyerr, declaró esta madrugada en su cuenta de Facebook que estaba “profundamente” entristecida tras conocer la noticia y envío sus condolencias a las familias y seres queridos de las víctimas. “Los vídeos y fotos que circulan por las redes sociales son estremecedores”, dijo al indicar que ella no podía estar allí en persona, pero que la Policía y el teniente del alcalde se encontraban en el lugar de los hechos apoyando a la Agencia Nacional de Gestión de Desastres.

“Como institución responsable de las catástrofes, actualmente estamos en el terreno, hemos creado un centro de mando de incidentes para ayudar a coordinar la gestión del incidente”, declaró Mohamed Lamrane Bah, director de comunicaciones de la Agencia de Gestión de Desastres de Sierra Leona, al señalar que la cifra de fallecidos podría aumentar por la situación crítica de algunos heridos.

Por su parte, el presidente de Sierra Leona, Julius Maada Bio, declaró hoy estar “profundamente consternado” y envió sus condolencias a quienes han perdido a sus seres queridos, asegurando que su Gobierno “hará todo lo posible para apoyar a las familias afectadas”.

**Introduction to Knowledge Graphs and Entity Alignment**

Knowledge Graphs (KGs) have emerged as a prominent method for storing knowledge by representing entities and their interconnections. As KGs and their applications, such as Question Answering and Information Retrieval, have evolved, the importance of aligning KGs from different sources has grown significantly. Entity Alignment (EA) in KGs, which aims to integrate KGs based on practical requirements, is fundamental in the field of data integration.

**Challenges in Entity Alignment**

The heterogeneity of KGs, derived from various sources, presents significant challenges in aligning entities. EA research primarily focuses on identifying and exploiting correlations between heterogeneous KGs through deep learning techniques, such as Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). Since 2019, over 70% of EA studies have incorporated GNNs, capitalizing on their ability to capture KGs' structural correlations, achieving remarkable performance on benchmark EA datasets.

**Addressing Heterogeneity in Knowledge Graphs**

Overcoming heterogeneity and mining correlations between KGs are the main concerns of EA. Existing methods often evaluate performance on widely-used KG datasets, particularly cross-lingual KGs. However, heterogeneity is not limited to linguistic differences; it includes varying data sources, scales, structures, and temporal information. Highly heterogeneous KGs (HHKGs), where source and target KGs differ significantly, pose additional challenges. Figure 1 illustrates a toy example of HHKGs, highlighting differences in scale, structure, and density, with minimal overlap.

**Practical Applications and Limitations of Current EA Methods**

Practical applications demonstrate the necessity of studying HHKG alignment. For instance, personal KGs aim to integrate domain knowledge with general KGs for personalized recommendations, and geospatial databases require aligning entities from multiple knowledge providers. Despite the urgency, most EA methods are evaluated on limited benchmarks, lacking datasets for HHKG research, which hinders understanding of EA methods, especially GNN-based ones, and limits their practical application.

**Research Questions and Dataset Analysis**

This work addresses two essential research questions:
- RQ1: What are the limitations of existing EA datasets, and what gaps exist between them and practical scenarios?
- RQ2: What EA methods are needed in practical applications?

To answer RQ1, we analyze existing EA datasets and discuss their limitations through statistical analysis. We identify unreasonable assumptions and oversimplified settings and propose two new datasets, ICEWS-WIKI and ICEWS-YAGO, to better reflect practical scenarios.

**Methodological Evaluation and Proposed Solutions**

For RQ2, we conduct empirical evaluations of representative EA methods on HHKG datasets. We find that GNN-based methods, which perform well on traditional EA datasets, struggle under HHKG conditions. GNNs' reliance on implicit structural patterns fails when HHKGs' structure information is challenging to utilize. This leads us to reconsider the progress of GNN-based EA methods.

**Insights and Proposed Method: Simple-HHEA**

We further investigate GNN components causing performance degradation on HHKGs. Our analysis reveals:
1. The complexity of HHKG structure information challenges message passing and aggregation, leading to poor GNN performance.
2. The necessity of leveraging structural information, especially when other data quality cannot be guaranteed, calls for EA models that can adaptively exploit diverse information types.

In response, we propose a simple yet effective method, Simple-HHEA, which jointly leverages entity names, structure, and temporal information. Extensive experiments on proposed and benchmark datasets underscore three keys for EA models: adaptability to diverse information quality, capability to extract clues from heterogeneous data, and efficiency.

**Contributions**

1. We identify the limitations of previous EA datasets and propose a practical task, EA on HHKGs, supported by two new datasets.
2. We critically evaluate existing GNN-based EA methods, highlighting potential issues from oversimplified dataset settings.
3. We provide a direction for future EA improvements through the implementation of Simple-HHEA, a straightforward yet effective approach.

I walked through the long hallway, my polished shoes sinking into the plush carpet. I sighed and slumped my shoulders, trying to push aside the thoughts racing through my mind. Raising my head, I could see the door that would determine my fate drawing near, although the hallway seemed to stretch endlessly before me.

Glancing to the side, I studied the portraits of those who had walked this same path before me, pondering whether any had felt as hesitant as I did. Apparently, I had slowed down, as one of my ever-present guards urged me forward.

As we approached the large white door, I began fidgeting with my collar, resisting the urge to run my hand through my hair and disrupt the perfectly placed granite block atop my head.

Upon reaching the door, I paused and whispered a quick prayer to anyone who might be listening. Summoning all my strength and mustering false courage, I pushed open the door and stepped through.

Before I had even fully crossed the threshold, the noise of a large crowd reached my ears, and the brisk February air stole my breath. The sight of thousands of people below, cheering, would have taken my breath away regardless. I felt an urge to flee, to hide. I believed I was not the right person for this role, that I did not deserve it.

Nevertheless, I pressed forward, ascending to the podium, knowing that even if I did not desire this, even if I did not feel worthy, it was my duty. A booming voice jolted me out of my internal turmoil as I heard the announcement:

Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) radar has garnered significant attention over the past decade, with a focus on its advantages in detecting multiple targets, estimating parameters, and various other applications. MIMO radar operates by emitting multiple orthogonal waveforms simultaneously using colocated or widely separated antennas to achieve waveform and spatial diversity. Colocated MIMO radar, which can also achieve waveform diversity in the Doppler domain, is known as slow-time MIMO radar, with its waveform design approach termed Doppler Division Multiple Access (DDMA).

In bistatic colocated MIMO radar, various algorithms have been developed for joint direction-of-departure (DOD) and direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation. These algorithms include Multiple Signal Classification (MUSIC), the Estimation of Signal Parameters via Rotational Invariance Technique (ESPRIT), and the Unitary-ESPRIT (U-ESPRIT) algorithm, among others. While these signal subspace-based methods have limitations, such as poor performance at low signal-to-noise ratios, the Parallel Factor (PARAFAC) analysis has been proposed to address these challenges, particularly in the context of slow-time MIMO radar, where the conventional tensor model may not be suitable due to the reduced number of samples in the Doppler domain.

This letter presents a novel tensor model for bistatic slow-time MIMO radar, focusing on joint DOD and DOA estimation. The model organizes the received signals in a 3rd order tensor, and the modified Alternating Least Squares (ALS) algorithm, along with additional constant terms, is utilized to estimate the factor matrices. By fully leveraging the Vandermonde structure of the transmit and receive steering matrices, the angle information is extracted, leading to the enhancement of the angle estimation performance in the slow-time MIMO radar.

Visual place recognition is a critical component in the robotics industry, extensively used in SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) systems for loop closure detection [1], [2]. These systems rely on image retrieval to create large-scale 3D maps, particularly in multiagent SLAM scenarios [3]-[5]. Convolutional neural network (CNN)-based approaches such as NetVLAD [6] and DGC-Net [7] have shown promising results in this area.

Several common solutions exist to enhance localization performance further, each involving retraining the whole network with additional data. A prevalent approach focuses on attention-seeking regions in images, involving the distribution of landmarks and the partitioning of pictures based on these regions [8]-[11]. For example, [12] incorporated NetVLAD to construct a feature pyramid of top landmarks, improving accuracy. Moreover, [13] introduced a multi-layered region-based method extending DGC-Net and integrating NetVLAD. Despite the better real-time performance of DGC-Net [7], challenges persist due to objects changing over time in images.

Another widely used strategy is to increase the depth of the neural network by adding additional layers to the default network. For instance, [14] introduced a multi-layered region-based framework using NetVLAD and performing dense pixel matching to enhance place recognition. To address large-scale image correspondence matching, researchers have proposed network upgrades, such as HD-CNN [15], a hierarchical deep CNN scheme, and other methods partitioning spatial information in higher layers [16], [17]. However, these methods pose challenges for real-time SLAM systems due to their computation time and large feature dimension size.

The third popular method in the robotics industry involves integrating 3D-depth information. Utilizing corresponding 2-D images with 3D maps enhances system performance in loop closure detection [18]-[21]. Additional techniques, including GPS information [22], semantics graph matching [19], and attention-seeking approaches [9], [13], [23], have also yielded positive results for image retrieval tasks. In robotics, it is crucial that the place recognition module remains decoupled from GPS or 3D data to ensure multiagent SLAM systems can function without overwhelming their servers. However, these approaches require retraining complex networks to improve accuracy.

Our proposed study introduces the Multiple AcQuisitions of perceptiBle regiOns for priOr Learning (MAQBOOL) approach, which significantly enhances image retrieval performance based on a pre-trained model.

In order to study the drift, we need to assume a reference pitch, and then measure the deviation from that reference pitch in the course of a segment or performance. Intonation drift happens both in choirs and solo singing, and it usually occurs in the downward direction. Harmonic progression has been mentioned as one of the causes of drift in choir. In this paper, we consider drift in solo singing. Our main goal is to computationally measure the drift in the course of a performance.
