头份市立纳骨堂经过8年建设，耗资2亿余元，于10月17日正式启用。新设施的启用为市民带来便利，不必再长途跋涉将亲人骨灰送至其他乡镇的纳骨塔供奉。然而，有市民反映，公立纳骨塔的费用高于邻近乡镇，并质疑1万5000元的管理费是否合理。

市公所对此表示，头份市立纳骨堂的建筑工法和建材因年代不同而有所调价，价格可以接受公众评议。殡葬管理所长戴志村进一步解释，纳骨堂使用了SMC塑钢材和铝合金材质，这些都是高价用材。此外，由于纳骨堂位于山坡地，还需考虑水土保持费用，并以30年为估算年限基准来制定合理收费标准。

在县议会的总质询中，议员邱秋琴提到市民的反映：纳骨塔给设籍市民最低费用为每个塔位3万2000元，其中包含1万5000元的管理费。这一总价比竹南普觉堂的每位2万5000元高出7000元，市民认为管理费过高不合理。

对此，民政处长彭基山指出，市立纳骨堂的费用由市公所管辖，市代表会审议通过，基于尊重乡镇自治原则，县府无法干涉，但会要求市公所在讨论研议中考虑市民意见。

For the past week, I've been staring at my phone and wishing it would make some kind of noise. A text, phone call, I'd even take one of those damn annoying Amber Alert messages. I can't stand the silence, I can't stand being in the dark. Your pictures still haunt me on Facebook. Your smile, the little dimple on your left cheek that only showed up when you were truly happy. I lived for that dimple. It's strange, we complain about people putting too many photos online, but that changes when the person is gone. Now, I am asking myself why we didn't take more pictures together, why we didn't ever follow through on our plans. We were all talk. 

And now your parents made me come to this stupid party. "It'll make you feel better!" they told me. What they really meant was, "It'll make *us* feel better." And that's fine. They've been great this past week, and I don't mind being the strong one on the outside. I don't mind being the one who acts like there is nothing wrong. 

But on the inside, I am dying. The pain just gets worse the closer it gets to midnight. I don't want to scream, "HAPPY NEW YEAR!" and then turn around to kiss someone who is not there. I don't want to go home to an empty house. 

"Thirty seconds left! Here we go!" I hear someone yell from the back of the room.

أشكركم على قراءة مقالنا حول تحذير أسامة نبيه للمنتخب المصري من خصم محتمل في كأس الأمم الإفريقية. نسعى دائماً لتقديم محتوى يرضيكم، وفيما يلي نوضح التفاصيل.

أفاد أسامة نبيه، المدرب السابق لمنتخب مصر، أن مجموعة مصر في كأس الأمم الإفريقية 2019 تتطلب تركيزًا كبيرًا من اللاعبين والجهاز الفني، حيث لا يوجد فريق قوي وآخر ضعيف. وأكد نبيه خلال حفل قرعة كأس الأمم الإفريقية: "منتخب الكونغو فريق لا يُستهان به، ويجب على اللاعبين توخي الحذر والتركيز لتفادي المفاجآت الإفريقية في الأدوار الأولى".

وقد وضعت القرعة منتخب مصر في المجموعة الأولى إلى جانب زيمبابوي وأوغندا والكونغو الديمقراطية.

Le Fonds Monétaire International (FMI) a récemment publié un rapport indiquant que le déficit budgétaire en Tunisie va créer un besoin de financement encore plus important au niveau de la balance des paiements, atteignant 1,7 milliard de dollars US (environ 4,9 milliards de dinars), ce qui représente 4,7 % du PIB. Le FMI a également souligné que l'épidémie de Covid-19 va aggraver les déséquilibres macroéconomiques déjà élevés du pays, ramenant la croissance à un niveau jamais vu auparavant, à -4,3 %.

En outre, le FMI a estimé que le déficit budgétaire pour 2020 devrait augmenter à 4,3 % du PIB, au lieu de diminuer à 2,8 % du PIB comme initialement prévu dans le budget. Les recettes fiscales devraient être inférieures de 5,2 milliards de dinars par rapport à l'objectif budgétaire, en raison des mesures d'urgence, de la baisse de la croissance et des dividendes des entreprises du secteur pétrolier, ainsi que de l'augmentation de la valeur des importations. Ainsi, le FMI a indiqué que la Tunisie devra faire face à un besoin de financement externe supplémentaire de 950 millions de dollars US, soit l'équivalent de 2,7 milliards de dinars (2,6 % du PIB).

Par conséquent, le FMI a conclu un nouvel accord de financement avec la Tunisie, qui devrait débuter vers la mi-2020. Le gouvernement tunisien s'est engagé à relever deux défis structurels importants une fois la crise actuelle apaisée : réduire durablement les subventions pour l'électricité et le gaz naturel tout en préservant les tarifs sociaux, et réaliser des économies supplémentaires sur la masse salariale de la fonction publique. Il a également annoncé des négociations avec le syndicat UGTT à cet effet, notamment sur les politiques salariales pour 2021 et à moyen terme, ainsi qu'un audit de la fonction publique pour détecter et réduire l'absentéisme et les travailleurs fantômes.

Dans le même temps, la Banque Centrale de Tunisie (BCT) s'est engagée à resserrer sa politique monétaire en cas d'accumulation d'anticipations de dépréciation ou d'aggravation des pressions inflationnistes, et à limiter les interventions sur le marché des changes aux seules nécessaires. Elle a également promis de maintenir un dialogue politique régulier avec la mission du FMI.

The Transformer model (Vaswani et al. 2017) has set a new standard in several neural language generation (NLG) tasks, such as machine translation (Deng et al. 2018) and text summarization (Chang, Huang, and Hsu 2018). Built upon the encoder-decoder framework, it consists of an encoder network that transforms the input sentence into a sequence of hidden states, each corresponding to a specific word, and a decoder network that generates the output sentence word by word. During each decoding step, the decoder utilizes an attentive reading mechanism (Luong, Pham, and Manning 2015; Vaswani et al. 2017) to select the appropriate input hidden states and determine which word to generate next.

Despite its success, the decoding process in the Transformer model relies heavily on local representations encoded in the hidden states, which primarily focus on word-level information. Studies (Vaswani et al. 2017; Devlin et al. 2018; Song et al. 2020) reveal that these hidden states emphasize word-to-word mapping, akin to word alignment, which guides the attention mechanism in generating target words. This approach, however, lacks explicit incorporation of global sentence-level information.

Global information, as Frazier (1987) pointed out, encompasses the overall context of a sentence, which is crucial in neural text generation tasks. In recurrent neural network (RNN) based models (Bahdanau, Cho, and Bengio 2014), introducing global information has been shown to improve output quality and reduce redundancy, as demonstrated by Chen (2018) in text summarization. Similarly, Lin et al. (2018b) indicated that integrating global information in machine translation yields structurally more accurate sentences. Although self-attention mechanisms in the Transformer can handle long-distance dependencies, they lack a specific mechanism for modeling global sentence-level representations.

This paper addresses this challenge by proposing a novel Global Representation Enhanced Transformer (GRET). We divide the challenge into two core issues: (1) how to model global contextual information, and (2) how to integrate this global information into the generation process. For the first issue, we propose two complementary methods during the encoding stage to generate global representations from local word-level representations. Firstly, a modified capsule network (Sabour, Frosst, and Hinton 2017) is employed to extract global features from local states, overcoming the redundancy and noise inherent in direct word-to-word mappings. Capsule networks, known for their strong feature extraction capabilities (Zhao et al. 2018), are effective in synthesizing comprehensive feature vectors.

Secondly, we introduce a layer-wise recurrent structure to enhance global representations by aggregating information across different layers. Previous research (Peters et al. 2018; Dou et al. 2018) suggests that different layers capture varied linguistic aspects—lower layers are more syntactic, while higher layers are more semantic. By combining inter-layer information, our method constructs a holistic global context, complementing the intra-layer information extracted by the capsule network.

For the second issue, we propose a context gating mechanism to dynamically control the integration of global representation into the decoder at each step.

El padre de Alejandro, Don Vicente Fernández, se encuentra convaleciente después de haber sido sometido a una operación de emergencia en Guadalajara.

Alejandro Fernández regresó rápidamente a México cuando se enteró de que su padre, Vicente Fernández, había sufrido un accidente en casa y se encontraba en estado delicado de salud.

Esta mañana, el cantante fue captado a su llegada al Aeropuerto de la Ciudad de México por diferentes medios locales, quienes le preguntaron sobre la salud de su padre, ya que se encuentra ingresado en Guadalajara. Sin embargo, él declaró desconocer los detalles.

"No sé, no tengo idea. Obviamente estamos en contacto con la familia, pero no tengo ninguna información. No sé si está hospitalizado, realmente no sé", respondió.

Con una fotografía de ambos juntos en las redes sociales, "El Potrillo" demostró su apoyo incondicional a su padre.

"Te amo, pa", fue lo que escribió el cantante junto a la publicación.

Se sabe que Vicente Fernández ingresó al hospital durante el fin de semana para ser operado de emergencia de las cervicales, tras sufrir una caída en su rancho, Los Tres Potrillos.

"Ha sido una gran victoria para el Sevilla. Estamos muy contentos. Hoy jugábamos en casa y teníamos que ganar", dijo Arana.

El rival tenía clara su estrategia. "Mantuvimos la concentración durante todo el partido. Estábamos en casa y teníamos que ganar. El Huesca jugaba a la contra y debíamos estar concentrados. Logramos la victoria, que es lo más importante", añadió.

Sobre el estado de forma del equipo, Arana comentó: "Es muy importante. Estamos en un buen momento y siempre digo que debemos trabajar duro y centrarnos en cada partido. Estamos siguiendo esa premisa y nos va muy bien".

Thinking about personal finances can feel like a heavy burden. Some people effortlessly keep theirs in order, while others struggle. Learning how to manage finances effectively can greatly ease this burden. Discover new approaches to managing your money in this article.

You can save money by adjusting your air travel schedule on a small scale, such as shifting trips to different days or seasons. Flights in the early morning or late at night are often much cheaper than midday trips. By organizing your other travel needs around off-peak flying times, you can save a significant amount of money.

Create a separate bank account for emergency funds and refrain from using it for daily expenses. An emergency fund should only be used for unexpected expenses that are out of the ordinary. Keeping this fund separate from your regular account will provide peace of mind, knowing you have funds available when needed most.

Teach your young child about finances by giving them an allowance to use for toys. This will help them understand that spending money on one toy means having less money for another. It instills the value of being selective about purchases.

It's never too late to start saving for your future. Instead of spending everything you earn, or even more, get serious and start planning for tomorrow. Begin saving, investing, and preparing today for the future you desire.

Consider switching to a credit union if your bank charges high monthly fees for a checking account. Credit unions often offer better deals since they are member-owned and not profit-driven like traditional banks. Eligibility for credit union membership is usually based on residence, employment, or organizational affiliation.

Avoid credit repair offers received via email, as they could be potential fronts for identity theft. Only work with credit repair agencies in person to ensure security.

To prevent bills from being overlooked and going unpaid, set up a filing system to keep track of due dates. If you pay bills online, use a service that sends reminders as due dates approach.

When it comes to personal finance, consider buying a used car instead of new. New cars depreciate rapidly, whereas used cars can be found in good condition with low mileage, having already absorbed the initial depreciation cost.

Opt for buying breakfast cereal in large plastic bags rather than boxed versions for cost savings. Compare unit prices to see the difference in cost, as bagged cereal is typically more affordable with similar ingredients.

Regularly review and rebalance your investments to ensure you are maximizing returns.

漫威最新英雄电影《尚气与十环传奇》正在全球热映中，这部影片的主角尚气是继《黑豹》之后另一部由少数族裔领衔主演的漫威英雄电影。影片中的重要卡司也都是亚裔演员，剧情风趣幽默，突破了好莱坞对华人的刻板印象，因此大受好评。它不仅成为5月疫情爆发后全台第二部票房破亿的电影，还创下了美国劳工节假期的最高票房纪录，为因疫情而低迷的电影院带来了复苏的契机。

《尚气与十环传奇》在票房上超越了《黑寡妇》，成为2021年至今最成功的电影。两部漫威电影在多次推迟后于今年首映，但情况截然不同。《尚气》在劳工节周末于传统电影院的大银幕上独家上映。（screenrant.com, 9/24/2021）

《尚气》在美国的影院放映已经进入尾声，接下来它将对上即将在10月上映的另一部漫威电影《猛毒2:血蜘蛛》。让我们拭目以待，看看《尚气》能否保持今年的票房纪录。

[广告]请继续往下阅读...

现在，让我们从相关新闻中学习一些重要的英文单词吧！在电影界，“票房”的英文是box office。我们经常用票房来形容一部电影的卖座情况，这在英文中可以通过box office + 名词的组合来表达。如果电影非常卖座，可以说是box-office success或box-office hit，hit在这里作为名词使用，表示成功的意思。在娱乐新闻中，hit也经常出现，例如hit song（热门歌曲）等。

相反地，如果电影票房不佳，可以用box-office bomb来形容，许多演员都害怕被贴上box-office poison（票房毒药）的标签。

以下是一些例句：
The science-fiction movie was a box-office hit, grossing $50 million worldwide.
（这本科幻电影非常卖座，全球票房总收入有5千万美元。）

卖座电影的英文怎么说呢？blockbuster这个词可以指因内容精彩而非常成功、卖座的电影或书籍。
例如：
After its release last week, the blockbuster film has banked $600,000 for the company.
（在上周上映后，这部畅销电影已经为公司赚进60万美金。）

premiere是“首映”的意思，可以用作动词或名词，常见于多益测验中。
例如：

أثارت سيطرة ميليشيات الحوثيين على مدينة الحزم، عاصمة محافظة الجوف اليمنية، اليوم الأحد، ردود أفعال غاضبة بعد أيام من سقوط مديرية الغيل، خاصة بعد تداول أنباء عن سقوطها دون مقاومة. وكانت الصدمة كبيرة لدى اليمنيين نتيجة لهذا الانقلاب الذي شهدته محافظة الجوف، والتي تُعتبر الثالثة من حيث القرب من المملكة العربية السعودية بعد صعدة وحجة التي سقطت في يد الحوثيين سابقاً. كما أشار العديد من الناشطين والكتاب والمحللين السياسيين إلى وجود "خيانة" في صفوف الشرعية اليمنية وجيشها الوطني، مما أدى إلى هذا التدهور السريع والمفاجئ للمحافظات التي كانت تحت سيطرتها منذ نحو ٤ سنوات. وقد أُثيرت شكوك حول وجود خلافات داخلية وتباينات في صفوف الشرعية التي يديرها حزب الإصلاح الإخواني.

أشار الكاتب والمحلل السياسي اليمني محمد جميع في تغريدة على تويتر إلى أن سقوط الجوف يعكس وجود قيادات الدولة خارج اليمن وتورطها في معارك فرعية ومكايد، ووجود آلاف الأسماء الوهمية داخل صفوف الجيش الوطني الذي خذل الجوف وقبائلها. وأضاف بأن سقوط الحزم عاصمة محافظة الجوف في أيدي الحوثيين يعكس نفس الواقع ويعكس الصراعات الجانبية والمكايد بعيداً عن معركة القضاء على الانقلاب.

من ناحية أخرى، قال الصحفي والكاتب اليمني صالح البيضاني في سلسلة تغريدات على تويتر: "ينبغي أن لا يمر سقوط الجوف دون عواقب، وينبغي محاسبة المسؤولين عن خذلان الجوف بشدة. إذ كانت الجوف تقاتل بمفردها بينما كانوا مشغولين بتمويل الحملات الإعلامية ضد التحالف العربي. فمن خسر الجوف ليس أميناً على عدن". وتحدث البيضاني عن تجميع الشرعية لقواتها في شبوة وتخوم عدن ضمن حربها ضد الجنوب، مع تداعيات سقوط محافظات الشمال بيد ميليشيات الحوثيين.

بالنسبة إلى العقيد مراد طريق، خبير عسكري في رئاسة الأركان العامة، يروي أن حزب الإصلاح يقف وراء سلسلة الهزائم التي تعانيها القوات الوطنية، حيث أكد أن الشرعية لم تأخذ المعركة بجدية. وفي نفس السياق، أوضح العميد ركن طيار حسين العمري أن إبعاد الكفاءات الوطنية من القوات المسلحة اليمنية يعد سببا رئيسيا لهذه الخسائر المتتالية.

في الوقت نفسه، تداول نشطاء يمنيون وثيقة على وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي، تُزعم أنها صادرة عن المنطقة العسكرية السادسة ومحافظ الجوف، تطالب بتبديل بعض القوات نتيجة رفضها تنفيذ الأوامر وفشل تنفيذ الخطط المعدة. ولم تصدر حكومة الشرعية بيانا رسميا بخصوص هذه الأحداث في الجوف والوثيقة المتداولة، ولم يتم التحقق من صحتها من قبل إرم نيوز.

6月11日，知乎App 6.0正式上线。新版本同时在iOS和Android端推出，主要变化体现在两个方面。首先是在外观界面上，对信息架构进行了调整和优化，旨在更清晰地整合功能和场景，进一步提升用户体验。在内容生态方面，推出了新产品「众裁」，邀请用户共同参与社区争议的解决，推动社区规范的演进，同时在社区规模不断扩大的情况下，强化社区共识。

旧版本的知乎App底部导航栏依次为「首页」「想法」「会员」「消息」「我的」五个入口。而在新版中，界面调整为「首页」「会员」「+」「消息」「我的」，并进行了信息的重新配置。

此外，新版本在内容生态建设上增加了新的产品和功能——「众裁」。「众裁」即众人裁判，旨在深化用户参与社区管理的理念，维护良好的社区氛围。未来，一些具有争议性的问题将由多位众裁官共同决定是否违规，被判违规的内容将根据规范自动处理。知乎团队还将依据参与和投票情况，促进社区规范的发展。

La consejera de Economía, Conocimiento y Empleo del Gobierno de Canarias, Elena Máñez, señaló ayer durante su visita a Lanzarote el compromiso inversor de su departamento con los territorios no capitalinos más afectados por la crisis a causa de la covid-19, apuntando que en Lanzarote y La Graciosa se han destinado 6,5 millones de euros en políticas activas en el mercado laboral. Esto, añadió, ha permitido contratar 538 personas sin ocupación este año.

Máñez explicó que en el marco de los proyectos estratégicos de la Agencia Canaria de Investigación, Innovación y Sociedad de la Información se va a «ampliar esa banda ancha a La Graciosa porque si se habla de generar economía y diversificar actividad tiene que disponer de las infraestructuras necesarias para una conexión real en todos los puntos del territorio». La consejera anunció que su departamento ha concedido 1,2 millones de euros para la extensión de la banda ancha ultrarrápida en La Graciosa para que disponga de mejor conexión. Así, agregó que se trabaja por el desarrollo de tecnología e innovación con el Cabildo y con el tejido empresarial «de una isla con valor tanto turístico como medioambiental, de sostenibilidad».

Máñez mantuvo un encuentro con la presidenta del Cabildo de Lanzarote, María Dolores Corujo, y parte de su equipo de gobierno junto al viceconsejero de Economía e Internacionalización, Blas Acosta; la directora del Servicio Canario de Empleo (SCE), Dunnia Rodríguez; y el director de la Aciisi, Carlos Navarro. Corujo resaltó el «firme compromiso» del Gobierno con las pequeñas y medianas empresas, las familias y los territorios alejados como La Graciosa «para tratar de paliar la crisis económica y social desatada por la pandemia».

Máñez visitó San Bartolomé junto a su alcalde, Alexis Tejera, para conocer los dos proyectos de formación en alternancia con el empleo (PFAE) que se ejecutan por 622.653,70 euros para contratar e impartir los certificados de profesionalidad en atención sociosanitaria a domicilio y en dinamización de actividades infantil y juvenil a 30 personas paradas. Asimismo, estuvo junto al alcalde de Tías, José Juan Cruz, donde se desarrollan cinco cursos con una financiación de 1.484.085,19 euros para la contratación y formación en jardinería, albañilería, limpieza, socorrismo en playa y diseños web de 75 desempleados.

Finalmente, se reunió con el presidente de la Cámara de Comercio de Lanzarote y La Graciosa, José Torres, y el comité ejecutivo de la corporación privada de derecho público como entidad colaboradora en la tramitación de las ayudas autonómicas a pymes y personas autónomas afectadas por la covid-19, que ya resolvió 208 subvenciones directas. Máñez también se refirió a la concesión de 1,4 millones de euros en ayudas tanto a pequeñas y medianas empresas como a autónomos de las 2.342 solicitudes recibidas.

Attribute-based CTG (Zhang et al., 2022) focuses on generating sentences satisfying pre-specified attributes such as topic and sentiment, which remains extremely challenging in recent progress (Dathathri et al., 2020). Especially multi-attribute CTG, it is typically unsupervised since no example of a sentence with specified attributes could be obtained during training (Lample et al., 2019).

2. Existing efforts for attribute-based CTG can be roughly divided into two types: fine-tuning and utilizing extra attribute classifiers. The first type usually finetunes a pre-trained language model (PLM) on the attribute-specific data (Ziegler et al., 2019), yet stores a full copy of the PLM for each desirable attribute. To partly address this issue, control codes are introduced to generate various styles of sentences with one PLM, such as keywords (Keskar et al., 2019) and numerical sequence (Lyu et al., 2021). However, re-training whole PLMs could be expensive (Yang and Klein, 2021) and they rarely attend to multi-attribute CTG. The second type introduces extra attribute classifiers to guide a PLM, such as back-propagating gradients of classifiers (Dathathri et al., 2020) or weighting output logits (Krause et al., 2021; Yang and Klein, 2021). Such a paradigm shows encouraging improvement, while the text fluency tends to decrease and inference time increase (Qian et al., 2022).

3. To overcome the aforementioned limitations, we propose a Text-attribute controller (Tailor) - a prompt-based approach to attribute-based CTG. The key idea is to represent each attribute as a pretrained continuous vector (hereinafter known as the single-attribute prompt) to control a fixed GPT-2 for single-attribute CTG, and effectively concatenate such single-attribute prompts as a whole for multi-attribute CTG. This allows Tailor to be easily expanded by training the corresponding attribute prompt if a new attribute emerges, while avoiding re-training the whole PLM.

4. The single-attribute prompt is concatenated with the input prefix and then guides the generation of a fixed GPT-2 switch to a pre-specified attribute. More importantly, we experimentally find that such single-attribute prompts could be simply concatenated to generate sentences with multi attributes. However, this manner always suffers from fluency decrease and position sensitivity. To address these issues, the key lies in bridging the gap between the training and the testing stage.

5. In detail, the single-attribute prompt only attends to itself in the attention matrix while training, since it is individually trained by the attribute-specific data. However, when it comes to the testing stage, the second prompt also attends to the first one in the concatenation, with the simultaneous change of the position-ids sequence. To fill this gap, Tailor introduces a Multi-Attribute Prompt mask (MAP mask) and a Reindexing Position-ids sequence (RP sequence) for the fixed GPT-2.

6. MAP mask prevents distinct single-attribute prompts from cross-attention, and RP sequence ensures stable position-ids information for the PLM after swapping, by individually numbering each prompt. Inspired by the role of 'and' in connecting parallel phrases for natural sentences, Tailor further provides a training method that contains a continuous connector to connect two single-attribute prompts as a whole to multi-attribute CTG. As shown in Figure 1, the proposed Multi-Attribute Prompt connector (MAP connector) can be concatenated with any two single-attribute prompts and hint a GPT-2 to multi-attribute CTG.

7. We experimentally reveal the combining ability of continuous prompts. Prompt Learning is a new paradigm in NLP summarized as "Pre-train, Prompt and Predict". In short, it can guide a single PLM to solve various downstream tasks by reformulating these tasks into a text-to-text manner. Recently, continuous prompts have attracted attention, which usually forms as a set of continuous task-specific vectors to the input.

8. In this paper, we experimentally reveal the potential of combining continuous prompts to accomplish multi-attribute CTG.

The author of the article "Making Mona Lisa Smile" describes a new technology called the Facial Action Coding System, which enables computers to identify six human emotions. This technology should be utilized to read the emotional expressions of students in a classroom, as it holds significant value.

Dr. Eckman has classified six basic emotions - happiness, surprise, anger, disgust, fear, and sadness, which are programmed into the system, allowing for a deeper understanding of how individuals feel without the need to inquire. Each emotion triggers a distinct facial muscle movement, which is then recognized and categorized.

Implementing this technology in the educational setting could enhance the learning process for students, especially those who may struggle with attention or comprehension. A classroom computer, equipped with the Facial Action Coding System, could identify when a student is confused, bored, or distracted, and adjust the lesson to cater to the student, similar to the adaptation of a skilled human instructor, thus fostering improved engagement and understanding.

Furthermore, the technology can also benefit teachers and staff, as it can help identify students who may not outwardly express their emotions. 美食大陆业务回暖，美国市场扩展，今年营运前景看好

2019年7月2日 经济日报 记者 黄文奇 即时报导

美食-KY（2723）今日（2日）举行了父亲节档期蛋糕销售说明会。公司表示，随着节庆旺季的到来，将推出“平价蛋糕”，目标销售量达到5万颗。在中国市场回暖及美国市场扩张的助力下，法人预计美食今年的每股税后纯益（EPS）有望超过去年，达到9至10元。

美食旗下的咖啡连锁品牌85度C，目前在中国大陆的销售持续回升，毛利率和营业利润率已连续三个季度上升。法人表示，第二季度为营业淡季，加之美国新中央厨房开始计入折旧，尽管如此，营运利润仍保持稳定。本季度受旺季推动，营运动能将有所提升。

今日，美食进行除息操作，每股发放5元现金股利，除息参考价为171元，股利发放日期为16日。开盘时股价即展现填息的势头，在开盘16分钟内顺利完成填息，最终以173元收盘，上涨2元。

在展店计划方面，中国大陆市场计划新增15家门店，以提高美食平台的曝光度，改善大陆市场运营。法人预计，今年85度C在大陆的运营将逐渐改善，优于去年表现。

在美国市场，美食目前在美国西岸拥有55家直营门市，预期今年将再增加15家门店，中长期目标则为100家。由于美国市场业绩不断增长，中央厨房在今年3月已完成去瓶颈工程，能够支持现有店面数量，第二座中央厨房也在第二季度投入运营。预计在门店扩展的推动下，今年美国市场的营收将实现两位数增长。

近期，美食旗下的85度C于7月4日至8月5日期间推出话题产品“粉红色巧克力”蛋糕，该公司研发的“红宝石巧克力蛋糕”新品成为首批使用的连锁咖啡品牌。美食指出，粉红色巧克力是继黑巧克力、白巧克力和牛奶巧克力之后，时隔80年诞生的全球第四种巧克力，将于18日上市，每家门市限量10颗，预计将引发抢购热潮。

美食强调，此次使用的粉红巧克力，被誉为“红宝石巧克力”，是巧克力界的“最新物种”，因此也被称为“世界第四种巧克力”。

La sostenida disminución de contagios de coronavirus ha llevado a un cambio en la utilización de las Unidades de Terapia Intensiva (UTI). Durante el punto más crítico de la segunda ola, se cancelaron cirugías y se pospusieron tratamientos para priorizar a los pacientes críticos con COVID-19, pero diez semanas después, ocupan menos de un tercio de las camas, mientras que los internados por otras patologías se han duplicado.

Según el informe del Ministerio de Salud, actualmente hay 3,173 personas internadas en estado crítico por coronavirus en todo el país, la cifra más baja desde el 17 de septiembre de 2020, cuando eran 3,108.

Después de haber alcanzado un pico de 7,969 casos el 14 de junio, apenas 15 días después del récord de contagios en un solo día desde el inicio de la pandemia, la situación de las UTI logró aliviarse. En aquel momento crítico, las autoridades sanitarias de la mayoría de los distritos habían ordenado la cancelación de cirugías no urgentes y la postergación de atenciones para priorizar los casos de COVID-19.

Desde entonces, han transcurrido diez semanas en las que tanto los contagios como la ocupación de camas en las unidades de terapia intensiva han mostrado un descenso. En el Gobierno atribuyen este descenso en parte al progreso de la campaña de vacunación, así como al control de la segunda ola a través de un nuevo período de aislamiento social.

Según los datos de la Sociedad Argentina de Terapia Intensiva (SATI), cuando la ocupación de camas por pacientes con coronavirus subió del 58% al 73% a finales de mayo, la atención a otras patologías se redujo del 32% al 18%. En ese momento, solo quedaba el 9% de camas libres y el personal estaba extremadamente saturado.

No obstante, la situación empezó a cambiar desde entonces. El 30 de julio fue la primera vez que se informó de una mayor ocupación de camas por pacientes con otras patologías que por aquellos con COVID-19, según el informe de la SATI.

Major financial exchanges such as NASDAQ, Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME), and London Stock Exchange (LSE) have recently expressed interest in migrating their workloads to the cloud. This move aims to significantly reduce their capital expenditure, improve scalability, and reduce operational burdens. For cloud providers such as Amazon, Google, and Microsoft, this migration represents a substantial business opportunity, as it is a mutually beneficial undertaking for all parties involved. Major market participants of these exchanges would also benefit from this migration since they currently maintain expensive on-premise infrastructure for data analysis and regression modeling to formulate their trading strategies.

To facilitate this shift, cloud providers and financial exchanges have announced long-term partnerships. Both parties recognize the challenges of migrating varied workloads currently managed on the exchanges' on-premise infrastructure. In this context, our focus in this paper is on "speed race" trading, a crucial and highly profitable aspect of electronic trading for both financial exchanges and market traders.

'Speed race' trading is a form of systematic electronic trading where market participants (MPs) use high-performance computers to quickly react to and exploit new market opportunities, such as volatility or price discrepancies. High-Frequency Traders, as they are known, invest heavily in hardware, systems, and algorithmic development to achieve impressively low reaction times, often on the microsecond or nanosecond scale. This business model is viable only if all MPs can compete fairly, as guaranteed by the Central Exchange Server (CES) operators. Fairness means that all participants receive simultaneous access to market data, and trades are executed in the exact order they were generated.

With on-premise deployments, financial exchanges ensure fairness in speed race trading by guaranteeing equal bi-directional latency to the relevant market participants. Exchanges go to great lengths to maintain this fairness, using technologies like layer-1 fan-out switches and equal-length cables to all co-located MPs. However, public cloud datacenter networks were not originally designed for such fairness guarantees. They cater to a heterogeneous, multi-tenant environment with diverse workloads, making it difficult to ensure equal latency between the CES and various MPs, even within the same cloud region.

This challenge has recently drawn attention from the academic community. Proposed solutions aim to achieve fairness by providing equal, albeit inflated, bi-directional latencies in the cloud, relying on tight clock synchronization and buffering for market data delivery. However, these approaches are fragile because datacenter network latencies are variable and unbounded. Other proposals necessitate intrusive modifications to existing CES implementations.

In this paper, we propose a novel approach to address fairness in cloud environments for speed race trading. Our key insight is that equal bi-directional latencies are not essential to achieve fairness. Instead of preemptively equalizing latency, we can post facto correct latency differences by ordering trades differently. We introduce logical delivery clocks that track time relative to when market data were received, allowing us to present Delivery Based Ordering (DBO). This system orders trades to guarantee fairness even in network topologies with non-deterministic and unbounded latency.

We have implemented a real DBO system, evaluated on a bare-metal server testbed utilizing programmable NICs, and further assessed it in a public cloud deployment using standard VMs. Our system achieves guaranteed fairness and sub-100 microsecond 99.9th percentile latency while servicing 125,000 trades per second.

Transformer-based architectures, such as BERT, have recently led to breakthroughs in various language-related tasks, including document classification, sentiment analysis, question answering, and various forms of text mining (Vaswani et al., 2017; Devlin et al., 2019; Adhikari et al., 2019; Sun et al., 2019a; Yang et al., 2019; Lee et al., 2020). These models create semantic representations of text, which can be subsequently used in many downstream tasks (Devlin et al., 2019). The training process for Transformers typically includes two phases: pre-training, where the model learns to extract semantic representations from large, task-independent corpora, followed by task-specific fine-tuning on a separate dataset to further optimize model performance.

In this paper, we study the effects of fine-tuning Transformer-based architectures in a federated learning (FL) setting, where models are trained in a decentralized fashion on a number of local compute instances, called clients, and intermittently aggregated and synchronized via a central server. Federated learning is a solution for distributed computing and data, providing a level of privacy regarding the sharing of personal or sensitive data. Model aggregation is commonly performed via the averaging of the weights of the individual client models, known as Federated Averaging (FEDAVG) (McMahan et al., 2017a).

The number of clients in a federated learning setting can vary, depending on the application. For example, in scenarios where smartphones are used as clients, the number can reach into the millions (Hard et al., 2018).

面对新型冠状病毒疾病（COVID-19）疫情持续延烧，大家对于是否可以到医院进行产检充满疑虑。恩主公医院妇产科主任王铎声医师表示，在这一波疫情流行的期间，孕妇更需要如期进行检查。孕妇是容易感染新型冠状病毒的族群，因此应进行定期产前检查，并密切注意胎动变化。有妊娠期合并症或并发症者要适当增加产检次数。同时，医院皆有完善的防疫措施，提醒大家进出医院时配戴外科口罩、勤洗手、回家后立即更换衣物并冲澡，做好个人卫生保护自己。

关于新型冠状病毒是否会通过胎盘、母子垂直感染的问题，根据《The Lancet》医学期刊的报告，研究团队在分娩时抽取了羊水、脐带血、新生儿口咽表皮细胞以及母乳，都没有发现新型冠状病毒的存在。然而，在武汉儿童医院确诊的两例新生儿新型冠状病毒感染病例中，母亲为新型冠状病毒确诊患者，因此专家推测可能存在母婴垂直感染传播途径。

至于疑似及未痊愈的新型冠状病毒确诊病例是否可以喂母乳，目前尚未发现新生儿哺乳感染病例。但关于新型冠状病毒是否通过胎盘垂直传播，或出生后通过母乳传播的问题仍不清楚。因此，对于确诊新型冠状病毒的妈妈，新生儿应立即按病毒感染留成隔离观察2周，不要进行哺乳。

对于符合以下任一条件的新生儿，需要进行新型冠状病毒感染检查：1.孕产妇确诊或高度疑似感染者；2.孕产妇密切接触家人确诊或高度疑似感染者；3.新生儿出生后家庭照护人员有确诊和高度疑似感染者。台湾目前虽未出现孕妇确诊案例，但仍需要做好防疫工作。

王铎声医师指出，在照顾新生儿方面，应尽量减少照护人员的数量，定时开窗通风，勤洗手，对新生儿的用物进行消毒（高温或75%酒精）。同时，应密切观察新生儿的体温、吃奶、呼吸、黄疸等变化，若有不适应及时就医。对于确诊或疑似感染的妈妈，建议将新生儿隔离14天。如果新生儿出现发烧、咳嗽、呼吸困难、精神反应差、吃奶差、反复呕吐等症状，应及时就诊。

Conceptual Graphs (CG) are a graph-based knowledge representation family of formalisms with a clear distinction between ontological knowledge and factual knowledge, as well as reasoning mechanisms based on graph operations and foundations in first-order logic. The expressiveness of CG has been extended through the addition or relaxation of constraints, such as inference rules and constraints, resulting in different formalisms. Datatypes have also been proposed to represent non-symbolic values.

This paper focuses on propositions that enable the representation and manipulation of imprecise knowledge, particularly within the framework of fuzzy set theory. These propositions enhance the knowledge representation capacity of CG by defining weights or embedding fuzzy sets to quantify imprecision, occurring in either the ontological or factual part. These extensions have been applied in various domains, including image matching, database querying, and ontology mapping.

The goal of this paper is to review the state of the art of methods used to represent imprecise information in CG to enhance its knowledge representation capacity. The paper primarily examines constraints on the CG formalism, detailing which constraint is relaxed, how it is relaxed, and the implications for knowledge representation. The focus is on knowledge representation, rather than reasoning mechanisms, as understanding the formalisms is crucial before considering associated reasoning elements.

The paper is structured as follows: Section II provides a review of the CG formalism based on Chein & Mugnier specification, with a focus on elements used in most fuzzy extensions. Section III presents the different axes of discussion for studying fuzzy formalisms. Subsequent sections delve into the inclusion of imprecise knowledge in CG: Section IV details propositions enriching concept nodes with weighting coefficients, Section V discusses the use of fuzzy values within concept nodes, Section VI explores nodes containing multiple concepts, and Section VII addresses simpler fuzzy extensions or adaptations of previous cases.

A former police detective is behind bars after stealing thousands of pounds in cash seized from passengers at Heathrow Airport. Michael Harrington, 46, from Staines, worked at the airport as a Detective Sergeant with the Metropolitan Police, tasked with carrying out financial investigations and seizing unauthorised cash from those travelling in and out of the country. During his five years in the role, between July 2009 and July 2015, it is estimated that he stole between £75,000 and £83,000 from 16 victims, according to the Crown Prosecution Service (CPS).

In some instances, Harrington seized cash from victims and then falsely recorded that it had been given back after it was found to be lawful money. In others, he recorded the amounts seized to be less than they actually were, pocketing whole sums in the process. The disgraced former financial investigator was jailed for four-and-a-half years for 16 counts of theft at Southwark Crown Court on Wednesday (February 28).

Riaz Jakhura, from the CPS London’s Complex Casework unit, said: "Harrington took advantage of a number of passengers, including foreign nationals making their way through Heathrow Airport. He abused his position as a financial investigator for the police, contributing to significant stress and financial hardship for some of his victims. The overwhelming evidence against Harrington meant that he had no choice but to admit his crimes."

Two victims suffered financial loss when attending weddings abroad without the legitimate money they had planned to take with them. On one occasion, Harrington denied a victim the opportunity to have an interpreter present when confiscating legitimate money. He was caught when victims started to contact police about getting back the money seized, leading the police to Harrington. Harrington, who had been suspended from the Met Police pending the completion of the court case, admitted the thefts in October last year.

He had previously failed to turn up to an earlier sentence hearing, prompting a warrant for his arrest.

一名怀孕31周的孕妇连续发烧，导致早产一名男婴。宝宝出生后因发烧、呼吸困难和精神活动不佳而住院，被确诊患有败血症和脑膜炎，原因是感染李斯特菌。经抗生素治疗后，宝宝幸运地未留下后遗症，母亲回忆怀孕期间食用生菜沙拉，可能是感染原因之一。

内湖国泰诊所小儿科主治医师陈秋吟指出，李斯特菌是少数在4度低温条件下仍能生长繁殖的细菌，对干燥、高温、酸性环境、盐和酒精具有耐受性，需要达到72度以上才能被杀灭。

陈医师解释，李斯特菌主要通过食物传播，例如生菜沙拉、生鱼片和生乳酪等生食常见而容易引发感染。卫生福利部疾病管制署曾在山猪皮、卤牛筋等即食肉制品中检出李斯特菌。此外，孕妇感染可能会通过胎盘传染给胎儿，少数情况可能因直接接触而感染。

孕妇感染李斯特菌可能出现发烧、腹泻、恶心、呕吐等肠胃炎症状，严重者有可能出现败血症、中枢神经系统感染风险，尤其是脑膜炎最为常见，主要发生在孕妇、胎儿、新生儿和免疫力低下的长者以及罹患爱滋病、糖尿病、癌症、肾脏疾病等病患。

陈医师补充说，即使孕妇症状可能较轻微，如发烧、疲倦或肌肉酸痛，李斯特菌仍可能通过胎盘传染给胎儿，进而引发流产、死胎、早产期败血症和初生婴儿脑膜炎。

陈医师强调，根据世界卫生组织的研究报告，李斯特菌感染全球平均每10万人中有0.34例，但致死率可高达25.9%。

陈医师提醒，预防李斯特菌感染，要记住处理食物前要洗手，确保食材清洁，食物新鲜，煮熟，生熟分开，注意食物温度，并避免食用未经消毒的生乳及其制品，不让高风险人群食用低温保存的生菜沙拉等食品，降低感染风险。

With the increasing prevalence of machine learning models capable of generating text that resembles human writing, concerns about potential misuse are on the rise. As the detection of text generated by Large Language Models (LLMs) becomes more challenging, the most practical approach to distinguish between LLM-generated and human-generated text is to intentionally embed a watermark in the LLM-generated text.

A series of studies have demonstrated that it is possible to embed a watermark in LLMs by modifying the output texts. Recently, Christ, Gunn, and Zamir presented a method to embed a watermark in LLM outputs without altering the distribution of responses. They showed that with a secret key, the modified LLM outputs can be detected as watermarked, while it remains computationally infeasible to differentiate between the original and modified LLMs without the key, even with multiple queries.

In this context, we aim to extend the watermarking technique proposed by Christ, Gunn, and Zamir to embed any hidden payload into LLM responses while maintaining undetectability. This means that LLMs can encode additional information, such as user metadata or session details, in their responses without changing the quality of the text. By employing a dynamic variant of Error Correcting Codes with feedback, we are able to transform the watermarking scheme into a message embedding technique.

Our approach, unlike other methods that alter the distribution of responses, allows for the recovery of hidden messages from LLM responses without knowledge of the prompt used. Our scheme can encode a linear amount of hidden bits in LLM outputs, which is shown to be asymptotically optimal under realistic assumptions. Importantly, our scheme minimally impacts the complexity of the text generation process, making it straightforward and efficient to implement.

While we provide theoretical proofs and empirical examples to support the effectiveness of our scheme, we acknowledge that it may not be robust to edits of the generated text, which remains an open problem for future exploration.

La Unión de Educadores de la Provincia de Córdoba aprobó el viernes pasado la propuesta salarial del gobierno provincial, después de un comienzo de clases con huelgas debido a la controversia.
Según los portavoces del sindicato docente, 22 de los 24 departamentos cuyos representantes participaron en la asamblea del viernes respaldaron la oferta del gobierno.
Según explicó Juan Monserrat, presidente de la UEPC, el acuerdo incluye una cláusula gatillo y también se ajusta a las fluctuaciones de la recaudación y la inflación.
"Tiene una cláusula gatillo con un retroactivo del 5%, se aplica la cláusula gatillo completa hasta agosto y luego se evalúa cómo va la recaudación y la inflación", dijo a Cadena 3.
Además, señaló: "El gobierno ha propuesto y se ha aprobado mil pesos por agente por cargo en febrero, para el mes de marzo 1.300 pesos, y en abril 1.500 pesos por cargo".
Detalles:
Cláusula gatillo: se aplicará automáticamente entre febrero y agosto, inclusive.
Cálculo: entre febrero y agosto, el aumento será equivalente al porcentaje publicado por el IPC de Córdoba (Índice de Precios de la Provincia de Córdoba) y se pagará al mes siguiente.
Retroactivo: además, se pagará un retroactivo a febrero, un adelanto del 5% de aumento salarial.
Cuándo se suma la recaudación: a partir de septiembre, se continuará con la cláusula gatillo, pero se analizará la evolución de la recaudación.

Despite residing on this planet for over four hundred years, our progress was not unfolding as expected.

We continued to dwell in the Ark, adhering to our deep space protocols which limited our population growth. As pioneers, we led a spartan existence.

In ancient times, as we escaped the dying Earth’s gravitational pull, the Ark was populated by the finest minds of humanity. They initiated the Ark's journey, set everything to auto-pilot, and then patiently waited.

Subsequently, their offspring waited.

And their descendants waited.

Now, the knowledge passed down from our predecessors has gradually faded, obscured through the centuries, akin to a prolonged game of Chinese whispers.

What's intriguing is that, somehow, I retain all that knowledge, almost as if it's ingrained in me. I cannot recall a time when I did not possess it.

Think about a time when you felt extremely tired, barely able to keep your eyes open, and everything you heard seemed like a blur because you were simply zoned out. I believe that using technology to read emotional expressions in students could bring valuable insights to classrooms.

Sometimes, these emotions make it challenging for students to concentrate during class, especially when teachers introduce new lessons. Implementing this software in schools could be advantageous, shaping a better educational environment. The software can help teachers understand the emotions students are experiencing during a lecture. D'Alto quotes Dr. Huang, of the Beckham Institute for Advanced Science at the University of Illinois, who predicts, "A classroom computer could recognize when a student is becoming confused or bored."

La NASA ha recibido el primer mensaje enviado por la sonda 'Voyager 2' desde el exterior del Sistema Solar, convirtiéndose en el segundo aparato humano en lograrlo desde el espacio interestelar. La señal tardó más de 16 horas en llegar a la Tierra. "¡Dos señales del espacio interestelar! Un nuevo estudio revela lo que los instrumentos de la nave han encontrado después de cruzar la frontera cósmica donde termina el entorno creado por nuestro Sol y comienza el vasto océano del espacio", explicó la NASA a través de su cuenta en Twitter.

La 'Voyager 2' alcanzó la frontera de la heliosfera, que se encuentra a unos 20.000 millones de kilómetros de la Tierra, más de 40 años después de su lanzamiento. A diferencia de su nave gemela, la 'Voyager 1', la 'Voyager 2' ha proporcionado datos mucho más detallados. Sin embargo, salió de la "burbuja solar" seis años después debido a sus paradas en Urano y Neptuno.

"No sabíamos qué tan grande era la burbuja y, obviamente, no sabíamos si la nave podría sobrevivir el tiempo suficiente para alcanzar la frontera de la burbuja y adentrarse en el espacio interestelar", explicó el profesor Ed Stone, del Instituto de Tecnología de California (CalTech), quien ha estado trabajando en la misión desde su lanzamiento en 1977.

Al abandonar la heliosfera, la nave dejó atrás las partículas cargadas del Sol y entró en un vacío donde solo se percibe el frío viento interestelar proveniente de una supernova que explotó hace millones de años. Anteriormente se creía que este viento solar se disiparía gradualmente con la distancia, pero la 'Voyager 1' confirmó que existía una frontera definida por una repentina disminución de la temperatura y un aumento en la densidad de las partículas cargadas, es decir, el plasma.

La 'Voyager 2' proporcionará mucha más información que su nave gemela debido a que un instrumento clave diseñado para investigar las propiedades del plasma se averió en 1980 en la sonda pionera. Los resultados se publicaron en cinco artículos diferentes en la revista 'Nature Astronomy' y revelan una frontera de la heliosfera mucho más definida de lo que se pensaba.

Además, los resultados sugieren que "la heliosfera es simétrica, al menos en los dos puntos de cruce de las sondas", según Bill Kurth, coautor de uno de los cinco artículos, lo que respalda la hipótesis de que tiene una forma esférica en lugar de parecerse a la estela de un cometa. "Es como observar a un elefante con un microscopio", advirtió Kurth.

A year and a half was how long Kenny Moore expected to serve in Maine State Prison when he was found guilty of aggravated assault, burglary, and theft as a teenager. He spent the next two decades in and out of prison on compounding charges, five of those years in solitary confinement. Sitting on a hard, narrow bed between dirty cinderblock walls, Moore recalls the mental decline he suffered during that desperate half-decade in the VR documentary After Solitary, a nine-minute short produced in partnership with PBS’s Frontline that was featured at last week’s AFI Film Festival.

Once, over three days, Moore pulled out all the hair on his body. He cut his wrists repeatedly and wrote on the wall with his blood. He attacked the guards. That led to a longer stint in solitary. He also learned how to cope by sending secret messages to other inmates. It’s hard to imagine what that experience must’ve been like, but After Solitary tries to help us see it. Sometimes, Moore vanishes and the viewer is left alone in his former cell, a modern-day dungeon that’s meant as a punishment within a punishment. Inside the immersion of an Oculus Rift, I felt many of the emotions Moore might have felt during his first few minutes of solitary: fear, disgust, anger, and claustrophobia. Feeling trapped in the cell and, admittedly, woozy after a day of VR, I ripped the headset off my face—and was relieved I could do so.

Urgent and upsetting, After Solitary exemplifies the once-glittering, now-fading hope that VR’s hypemen (and women) extol about the technology. In a 2015 TED talk, Chris Milk, founder and CEO of the VR company Within, called virtual reality the “ultimate empathy machine.” (Milk likely borrowed the phrase “empathy machine” from the late Roger Ebert, who had called cinema “the most powerful empathy machine in all the arts.” Television and the novel arguably have greater claims on that title, but that’s a debate for another time.) VR is a medium with tremendous artistic potential, but many of the titles that have grabbed the most attention so far are journalistic projects that take viewers into humanitarian crises, like Project Syria and Clouds Over Sidra, both of which focus on the plight of Syrian child refugees. They want to make us feel—really feel—for their subjects.

It’s certainly heartwarming that so many VR creators are interested in creating empathy for people and communities in need. But the idea that spending 10 or 15 minutes in virtual reality can dramatically realign a viewer’s sympathies is a delusion. And worse yet, relatively unchallenged self-promotion from an industry that wants to sell the public on its innovations’ potential good and distract from their current and inevitable abuses.

No matter how advanced virtual reality gets, it can’t make anyone care against their will. The summary that Frontline’s official YouTube account provides for After Solitary is “What's it really like to be locked up in solitary confinement?” But it would be an insult to inmates in solitary for me to say that, after watching a VR film one-third the length of the average sitcom, I have any idea what it’s like to be alone and confined for days or months or years on end.

The backlash against the “VR as the ultimate empathy machine” idea appears to be in full swing. Most recently, Mark Zuckerberg’s virtual visit to hurricane-ravaged Puerto Rico was instantly met with accusations of tone-deafness. Without the background to contextualize what viewers are seeing, immersive projects focusing on calamities risk becoming disaster porn—a charge already launched at Zuckerberg’s VR tour and Clouds Over Sidra, a collaboration between Within and the United Nations that was criticized, in part, for depoliticizing the refugee crisis. Other types of well-meaning empathy-creation projects have come under fire as well. Some disability simulations, like those replicating blindness, have been indicted for specious or patronizing depictions of life with an impairment.

Then there’s the unfortunate reality that the creators who are getting into VR during its current infancy are the ones who can afford to do so with little promise of financial reward. At Engadget’s Alternate Realities conference last week, Ruthie Doyle, the program manager of the Sundance Institute’s VR lab, bemoaned that the hardships of artistic sustainability have already created a diversity problem among the ranks of virtual-reality creators. Sure, any hobbyist can download the free version of Unity, the game designer engine, and a cheap 360-degree camera can be had on Amazon for less than $100. But time, labor, and technological know-how remain significant hurdles for would-be creators.

Filmmaker Rosie Haber (full disclosure: a friend) compared where VR is now to the early years of cinema, when many films were “anthropological exercises.” However well-intentioned, the current crop of journalistic immersion might be the latest incarnation of Nanook of the North, Robert J. Flaherty’s 1922 documentary about the life of an Inuit man in the Canadian Arctic. The very concept of empathy creation through VR is an Othering process: So-and-so’s experiences are so vastly different from yours, it’s presumed, that you can only understand their situation if you step into their shoes.

More companies are embracing Information Technology (IT) in their operations. To standardize IT-related activities, the British government developed the IT Infrastructural Library (ITIL), which defines the standards and best practices across the entire IT service life cycle, including strategy, design, transition, operation, and continuous service improvement. According to ITIL, "operation" refers to processes crucial to the day-to-day running of companies, encompassing the direct delivery of goods and services from service providers to end users.

An incident is an event that prevents a user from performing their task, which could be due to a system fault, an access request, or a lack of user knowledge. An incident ticket is a document containing user-generated text and system information. The ticket routing problem in incident management and service operation is the focus of our study.

In the incident management workflow recommended by ITIL, a user creates an incident ticket, which is then matched with an expert group responsible for processing it. If the initial group cannot resolve the issue, the ticket is transferred to another group until it is resolved. The ticket routing problem involves assigning the ticket to an initial expert group for processing and transferring it to another group if necessary.

Previous works have addressed the ticket routing problem using classification models trained on textual content and transfer histories of tickets. In our study, we propose a joint framework that considers features from both expert assignment and ticket transfer in an end-to-end model, aiming to improve incident resolution efficiency.

Through large-scale analysis on archived tickets, we discovered that tickets with shorter routing sequences tend to have higher content clarity. We also found that the probability of specific roles in ticket routing differs across expert groups, and we extracted network features to model expert groups using structure information.

Our proposed Unified Framework for IT Ticket Routing (UFTR) computes a matching score for each ticket-group pair by incorporating features from ticket and group interactions. UFTR outperforms baseline models on real ticket data processing, with the listwise ranking model showing marginally better results. The Ticket-Group features were found to be the most important in our ranking model, contrary to previous findings.

In conclusion, our study contributes a comprehensive framework for IT ticket routing that enhances incident resolution efficiency and improves routing evaluation metrics.

Text embeddings are an important tool for a variety of NLP tasks. They provide a general and compute-efficient solution to problems like topic classification, document clustering, text mining, and information retrieval, among others. Most modern techniques for learning text embeddings rely on minimizing a contrastive loss. This involves identifying, for each example x in the training set, a positive example x+ and a set of negative examples x-i associated with x. The choice of x+ and x-i is a key factor that distinguishes these techniques.

Unsupervised methods rely on in-batch negatives for x-i and data augmentation for x+. Supervised or weakly supervised methods, on the other hand, rely on mining heuristics or annotated datasets to build the positive and negative pairs. For example, a common choice is to use entailment and contradiction pairs, respectively, as in datasets like SNLI and MNLI.

In this work, the problem of learning text embeddings is approached from the perspective of the objective function used. Two self-supervised representation learning algorithms, Barlow Twins (BT) and VI-CReg, are considered, which are introduced in the computer vision literature. These methods are classified as dimension contrastive, which, unlike the sample contrastive, de-correlate the embeddings across their dimensions, regulating the objective function. Both sample and dimension contrastive methods rely on data augmentation, which is more straightforward for image data, while being considered trickier for textual data.

The main goal of this paper is to compare the embeddings learned through sample-contrastive and dimension-contrastive techniques, and explore different augmentation strategies, using Sim-CSE, Barlow Twins, and VICReg, for the comparison.

There was a long silence, broken only by a slow exhale and three life-changing words: "Okay. I'm ready."

General Pratt nodded firmly, ceremoniously pushing open the double doors and leading the president inside. The tense hum of voices died down almost immediately as faces turned somber at her presence. After another long pause, she spoke. "Well? Give me the skinny, people. What do I need to know?"

General Pratt turned to face her when no one responded. "Madam President, what you're about to hear tonight is top secret—classified data beyond all other classified data. If any of this were to get out..." He shuffled his feet and glanced at his colleagues. "Well, suffice it to say that it can't get out." He turned away, nodding to a younger man sitting at the table. "Jenkins, let's start with you."

"W-well, uh, first, I suppose we should talk about... about Area 51, ma'am. You see, it's—uh, there are aliens there—" A murmur ran through the room, and more than one member muttered disappointment with Jenkins' lackluster presentation. Like a comedian losing a crowd, he sputtered on without much enthusiasm until Pratt finally cut him off. "Yes, yes—thank you, Jenkins, that was... informative. The bottom line is, yes, we've been conducting experiments on aliens at Area 51, but that's only the tip of the iceberg here, ma'am." In a lower voice, he confided, "You'll have to forgive the poor boy; it's his first time doing this, and he obviously isn't comfortable with the material." The president nodded, her expression surprisingly forgiving and understanding, perhaps due to the revelation of what Jenkins said rather than how he said it.

A woman barely older than Jenkins stood next. Her uniform bore the surname 'Latrell.' "I think we can all agree that aliens obviously exist. No real surprise there. But you may not have guessed that aliens aren't the only non-human intelligent life forms we're aware of, Madam." A few furtive looks flew between the others at the table. "I'm talking about smaller creatures. You may know them better as pixies." The president's eyebrows rose in a mix of surprise and skepticism. "They're not like they are in fairy tales, madam. From our research, they appear to be some kind of offshoot of insects that somehow developed... well, near-human levels of intelligence. They're fast, they're tiny, and they prefer to stay unseen, but those we've captured have refused to give us any information about their goals or roles in the ecosystem." Latrell sat quietly, confident in her report. The president leaned back, clearly taken aback by this second piece of information. More hushed murmurs rolled back and forth across the room.

"Let's see, who wants to go next? Ah, Muller, how about you?" An older but well-groomed man stood, not in a uniform this time but in a neat gray suit. "Yes, well, I don't know what will shock you after the 'pixie' briefing, but there are certainly other important things you should know. My area of focus over the last thirty years has been Russia." The newly appointed president, still grappling with Latrell's report, leaned forward eagerly. "You've been told that some of Soviet Russia's greatest leaders were dead and buried, but the truth is much more sinister. For one, Joseph Stalin is alive and well. That is, as well as one can be with a mechanical lower body. He didn't die of a stroke. He was assassinated. Or rather, someone tried to assassinate him. The tissue damage was so severe that they had to cut him in half and attach his torso to a sort of mechanical undercarriage. If you've seen The Clone Wars, it's kind of like that."

A brief look of confusion crossed her face. "The Clone... What?"

Muller continued without pause. "That's not the worst of it. When Cyborg Stalin was only a boy, he had Karl Marx cryogenically frozen. After the assassination attempt, he thawed him out and went on to build a Soviet counterpoint to the idyllic 1950s America. An underground communist society, spearheaded as a collaboration between the two men—though he's more machine now than man. This secret communist sovereign nation still exists today, and we believe it is still being led by its original founders, who appear to have developed some kind of anti-aging technology with the help of scientists who joined their secret nation."

The president pushed her chair back and stood, shock and fear etched across her face. "I—I need some air, this is all too much.

Le 6 octobre, dans une interview accordée au Journal du Dimanche (JDD), le Premier ministre Edouard Philippe s'est exprimé sur les revalorisations des salaires des personnels hospitaliers, en amont d'une grande manifestation prévue le 14 novembre pour dénoncer les conditions de travail dans les hôpitaux. Il a souligné ses efforts pour améliorer la rémunération des infirmiers débutants, annonçant une revalorisation de 200 euros par mois depuis le début du quinquennat. Cependant, cette affirmation a été rapidement remise en question par le Syndicat National des Professionnels Infirmiers (SNPI), qualifiant ces chiffres de "fake news".

Le salaire des infirmiers est régi par le protocole Parcours professionnels, carrières et rémunérations (PPCR), applicable à l'ensemble des fonctionnaires. L'évolution des rémunérations est calculée en fonction de l'indice majoré et du point d'indice, qui n'a pas augmenté depuis février 2017. En 2019, l'indice majoré est passé à 388, ce qui correspond à un salaire mensuel brut de 1 818,16 euros, et devrait augmenter à 390 en 2020, atteignant ainsi 1 827,54 euros. Cette augmentation de 15 points n'équivaut cependant pas aux 200 euros annoncés par le Premier ministre, étant donné que cela représente une hausse d'un peu plus de 70 euros bruts.

Le cabinet du Premier ministre défend la position d'Edouard Philippe en détaillant le calcul des salaires des infirmiers débutants, incluant les primes perçues. En ajoutant ces primes, le salaire de base d'une infirmière passerait de 2 016 euros en 2017 à 2 199 euros en 2019, soit une augmentation totale de 183 euros bruts par mois. De plus, les heures supplémentaires et les gains liés à leur défiscalisation-désocialisation, mis en place par le gouvernement en 2019, viennent s'ajouter à cette augmentation.

Cependant, le calcul effectué par Matignon est critiqué car il prend en compte des données antérieures à l'élection d'Emmanuel Macron, ne reflétant pas une revalorisation entièrement effective depuis le début du quinquennat. De plus, la prise en compte des heures supplémentaires dans l'évolution salariale est contestée par certains acteurs du secteur, soulignant que ces éléments ne devraient pas être inclus dans la revalorisation des salaires. En résumé, la revalorisation des salaires des infirmiers débutants n'a pas été de 200 euros par mois depuis le début du quinquennat, comme affirmé par le Premier ministre, mais plutôt autour de 100 euros, une différence significative à prendre en considération.

"Is everyone good? Sound off," Paladin Daemus's voice echoed through the dusty corridor.

"Liam here," Liam, the Heavy gunner and ammunition mule, responded.

"Joyce here," Joyce, the last-minute replacement initiate in the task force, chimed in due to another member's injury.

"Halter here," Halter, the team's key technician, confirmed his presence.

A brief silence followed Halter's response.

"Clark, are you there?" Daemus inquired, but received no answer.

Halter uncovered Clark's lifeless body, revealing severe damage to his armor and ribcage. "Clark is gone," he reported.

"Damn. Retrieve his holotags, and let's continue," Daemus commanded.

"Sir Daemus," Initiate Joyce interjected, her voice ringing with uncertainty, "Is this gold worth the risk?"

"This isn't about treasure, Joyce. We're here for the Brotherhood's greater good. The digital copy of the national archives holds invaluable wealth beyond material gains," Daemus explained.

"But, sir," Joyce countered, "We've lost five men already, and we're uncertain—"

"We press on. That's an order," Daemus declared as the ceiling crumbled, casting a dim light on the group.

After stripping Clark's body of supplies, Halter tossed a flare down the hall, signaling their onward movement.

As the flare illuminated an intersection, gunfire erupted, briefly lighting up the corridor before fading into darkness.

"Another turret!" Liam exclaimed, as the team cautiously approached the suspected location.

Following a brief explosion and moment of tension, Liam confirmed, "It's down."

Navigating through a maze of corridors and encountering turret resistance, they finally reached the grand entrance.

"We should be close, sir. The vault lies ahead," Halter reported, relieved. "The turrets here seem inactive, possibly controlled by a separate mainframe."

"Proceed slowly and watch for traps," Daemus advised, wary of potential dangers from the past.

Upon reaching the other side without incident, the team breathed a collective sigh of relief, knowing their mission was nearing its end. Before them stood the imposing door of the vault, containing the nation's former gold reserves and invaluable knowledge.

"Halter, access the terminals. If necessary, we may need to breach a wall," Daemus instructed.

With tense keystrokes and heavy silence, Halter worked to unlock the vault, surrounded by the flickering emergency lights and the glow of the terminal.

After a nerve-wracking wait, Halter's triumphant cry marked the opening of the vault, revealing the long-dormant treasures within.

However, their victory was short-lived as a missile detonated, triggering automated defenses within the room, unleashing a barrage of gunfire from sentry bots.

"Get inside the vault!" Daemus commanded amidst chaos, realizing they were under attack.

In the ensuing firefight, the team sought refuge behind the door, realizing Halter had fallen, his sacrifice echoing the impending danger.

"Can we seal the door?" Joyce cried out, her desperation palpable.

Liam, with limited options, prepared his remaining grenades, as Daemus made a risky decision.

Ignoring protests, Daemus planned a daring move to access the servers amidst the chaos. With a moment of unity, they executed a diversion to allow Daemus a chance to reach the servers.

As Daemus fought through the perilous path, he felt the impact of gunfire but pressed on, driven by duty. Despite the odds, he managed to reach the server room, sealing himself in to complete the vital transmission.

With the transfer underway, Daemus left a poignant message of valor and sacrifice before succumbing to his injuries, his final act ensuring the legacy of the fallen team.

In the quiet aftermath, as Daemus closed his eyes and drifted into eternity, his spirit rested knowing he had fulfilled his duty with honor.

Grandfather was the only one in the family without powers, and he was among the few who had lived in the time Before and survived. This was before genes started mutating, before people acquired powers, and before the world as he knew it ended. Today, things are different. We learned all about it during history lessons at school. Mr. T. transported us back to the Before, where we witnessed the wars, starvation, shootings, and massacres. Every child today knows the story, because, as a wise man from the Before once said, those who cannot learn from history are doomed to repeat it. And we certainly don’t want that. 

We are fortunate that the wars ended as swiftly as they began. The Normals, like my grandfather, who tried to eliminate those with powers, were quickly subdued by us. When my second cousin Sophia discovered her ability to bend the wills of others, Grandfather was deeply displeased. After all, it was one of the powers most feared back in the Before. Those with this ability were the ones who dominated, leading to wars. Countries fought for supremacy, millionaires woke up to find they had signed away their fortunes, and people everywhere found themselves doing things they never would have otherwise. That was when the true Wars began. 

Things are better today, though. People like Sophia are kept safe. I haven't seen her since she registered her powers two hours after turning sixteen. Joshua, my older brother, has the ability to transform into a guinea pig, much to Grandfather’s amusement. It seems, however, that abilities are not hereditary. Father is a genius with technology, while Mother can heal with just a touch. I turn sixteen in a little less than two hours, and I can't wait to discover what my power will be. 

It is the Law to register your abilities no more than two hours after you receive them. If you don't, well, you might cease to exist. That’s what we have been taught since our carefree days in preschool. They will hunt you down no matter how you try to hide. Uncle Kevin tried to hide Cousin Kingsley when they realized he could make people disappear. In the end, they made Cousin Kingsley disappear. 

I have just come into my powers.

Many people believe that the "face" on Mars is an actual face or that it was created by aliens. However, it has been convincingly proven that it is not an actual face. First, it is a rock. Second, the angle of the camera captured the shadow in such a way that it seemed like a face. Third, the idea that it was a face was perpetuated for marketing purposes.

My first reason is that it is simply a rock on Mars. As stated in paragraph three, it is a large rock formation that resembles a human head. This is a clear indication that it is just a rock. Over the years, the rock has weathered, developing more crevices, and is losing the semblance of a face. If a real face were buried there, it would not lose its form so easily.

My second reason is the angle at which the camera captured the rock. The shadow it cast created the illusion of a face. A better angle would have shown that there was nothing significant. Additionally, examining the surrounding area, you would find many similar rock formations on Mars. It is also suggested that the resolution of the camera may have contributed. If the technology we have today had been available when the rock was first discovered, the image would have been clearer, revealing the rock's true appearance.

My final reason is the marketing aspect. The face theory was perpetuated because it generated interest and publicity. It was a strategic move, as the theory was featured in Hollywood, books, magazines, and even radio, thereby promoting NASA.

I believe that having cars that can drive themselves is a very bad idea. There are many roadblocks we have to break through before we even start to test these in real-life situations. People may not be as alert as they are today if cars do all the work for them until the human has to take over. What happens if the self-driving car breaks down and people do not know how to fix it because they believe it will not break? Furthermore, if a driverless vehicle gets into a wreck, who is responsible? If the human is not driving, how can they determine fault?

I personally do not think that battery-powered cars are a good idea. While driverless cars are claimed to be more fuel-efficient, if everyone drove a diesel car or truck, it would be just as efficient because diesel burns hotter, resulting in the burning off of more harmful chemicals and the creation of more power. Although I do not own a diesel vehicle and have an old truck that is not fuel-efficient, I prefer diesel. However, I do acknowledge that eventually, we may have to transition to electric cars, but I do not see the need for driverless cars. We have managed well without them, so why switch to them now?

Instead of investing in these futuristic dreams, it would be more beneficial to allocate that money to more pressing matters.

日本新日皇德仁于2019年即位，接受象征皇权的剑及玺，展现了对教育和家庭的高度重视。德仁幼名浩宫，其名字由祖父昭和日皇命名，灵感来源于《中庸》中的“浩浩其天”，希望他心胸开阔、聪明智慧。

作为明仁的长子，德仁在家庭中受到不同于传统的教育。其母亲美智子皇后打破皇室几百年来的乳母制，亲自哺乳、养育子女，这可能是德仁重视家庭的原因之一。美智子皇后的教育理念强调决策的执行力，这也影响了德仁的生活和工作方式。他与雅子的婚姻经历就是一个例证：追求近七年后才得以与雅子结婚，并承诺一生全力守护她。即便雅子因为适应皇室生活而长期疗养，德仁仍承担起所有公务，并积极参与女儿爱子的学校活动，尽管部分舆论批评他过于关注私人生活。

德仁与上一代不同，他出生于战后，因此没有像父亲明仁那样对战争有直接的感悟。他更关注现代社会的问题，包括水资源、教育和少子化、高龄化问题。尽管日本皇室成员大多为生物学家，德仁专攻历史学，特别是交通史。他的大学毕业论文探讨了中世濑户内海的交通，而在英国留学期间，他进一步研究泰晤士河的交通史，之后扩展到饮用水和水患等水资源问题，并担任联合国“水与卫生顾问委员会”的名誉主席。

公众普遍认为德仁温厚达礼，而几个小故事也展现了他幽默的一面。例如，他会在演讲中穿插生活趣事，让严肃的场合增添轻松氛围。有一次，他因女儿刷牙时水龙头一直开着而认真警告她，这种小故事往往令人莞尔。此外，他在与朋友通话时，因对方的小孩吵闹，他竟然在电话中扮成超人力霸王哄孩子开心。

The "Face on Mars" is just a landform. Like many other NASA scientists, I do not believe that it was made by ancient civilizations or aliens. The pictures taken from Mars initially suggested a face-like structure, but with newer technology, we now see that it is simply a mesa or butte. Despite NASA providing real photos of the area on Mars, there are still disagreements about its true nature.

In 1976, NASA sent out the Viking 1 mission which captured an image that sparked public interest in what became known as "the Face on Mars." While many scientists were skeptical about it being an actual face, this image became a cultural icon featured in various media for years. However, doubts persisted among NASA scientists regarding its true identity.

In 1998, to address public curiosity and skepticism about the "Face on Mars," NASA conducted another imaging mission using the Mars Global Surveyor (MGS). The resulting high-resolution images confirmed that the structure was indeed a natural landform rather than a face. Despite this conclusive evidence presented to the public online in 1998 and later in 2001 under clearer conditions, some continued to question NASA's findings.

Critics accused NASA of withholding information or hiding potential evidence of extraterrestrial life by claiming the landform was not artificial. However, such accusations overlook the fact that any discovery supporting alien existence would greatly benefit and elevate NASA's reputation globally. Additionally, advanced imaging technologies used by MGS provided much clearer pictures compared to earlier missions like Viking.

Ultimately, despite personal beliefs or suspicions regarding the nature of "the Face on Mars," factual evidence and detailed photographs suggest otherwise – it is indeed a natural landform rather than an artificially created face. Through multiple missions aimed at capturing detailed images for public scrutiny and understanding of Cydonia's features like this one alleged face formation; these efforts reflect NASA's commitment to transparency and scientific inquiry above all else.

Would we blame the car for any wrongdoing, or should individuals bear the responsibility? Moreover, in a world with malicious individuals, the potential for misuse of such technology is a concern. On January 6, 1992, the California Assembly elected E. Dotson Wilson as its Chief Clerk and Parliamentarian. The Berkeley native made history that day, becoming the first African American to be voted into that all-important, non-partisan role at any legislative body in the United States. Since then, he has been re-elected to that office every two years by all 80 members of the state Assembly for 26 consecutive terms.

“It has been an honor working for the Assembly,” said Dotson, who is retiring this month. “I am humbled to have had a front-row seat as policy is being made in the world’s fifth-largest economy. California has always been at the forefront of policy change in the United States.”

When the state Assembly held a special tribute on the chamber floor on August 29 to thank him for 27 years of service as Chief Clerk, Wilson had gained another history-making notch on his belt. The 64-year-old, who now resides in the Sacramento area, is currently the longest-serving Chief Clerk in the history of the state of California.

“He has given us the gift of his wisdom, expertise, acumen, temperament, and deep commitment to fairness over the decades,” said Assembly Speaker Pro-Tem Kevin Mullin (D-San Mateo). “Institution above party. Service above self.”

Later that evening, the California Legislative Black Caucus hosted a reception at the Grand Sheraton in Sacramento to acknowledge Wilson’s service to the Assembly and the inspiration he has provided to countless African American elected officials and staff members. Almost everyone CBM interviewed for this article mentioned the example of professionalism Wilson set for colleagues at the Capitol.

“Your name will take you places because of your integrity,” said Assembly Shirley Weber (D-San Diego), chair of the Legislative Black Caucus. “You can’t buy it, you can’t market it, it’s who you are. And, your name speaks volumes in this house and across the nation.”

Wilson first joined the California Assembly as a fellow in 1979. He worked his way up to deputy chief of staff for former Assembly Speaker Willie Brown, Jr., who served in the lower house’s top leadership role for 15 years and later became the first African American mayor of San Francisco in 1996. Brown nominated Wilson for Chief Clerk.

“He was one of the greatest politicians in the history of the state,” said Wilson, reflecting on his experience working for Brown. “You’re only as strong as the people whose shoulders you stand on, and Willie Brown is one of those people for me. At the time, California was going through a lot of social and political changes, and Brown showed extraordinary leadership.”

Wilson says Brown is one of those Californians who does not get enough credit – “not only for his broad knowledge of the law but also his razor-sharp understanding of policy.”

Wilson, who grew up in Albany near Berkeley, says that from childhood, he has always been fascinated with history, law, the legislative process, and how they impact ordinary people.

“I was not old enough to be part of the civil rights movement,” says Wilson. “But growing up in the Berkeley area, I got to see a lot of that activism and the change that followed up close.”

Wilson recounts a story his parents told him about not being able to buy a house in the 1950s because there were laws in California that allowed sellers to discriminate against people based on race and religion. Then the legislature passed the California Fair Housing Act (AB 1240), also known as the Rumford Act, that outlawed that practice.

“That, to me, as a young person, was a turning point,” says Wilson. “That’s when it was clear to me that politics and the fight for civil rights and equality were all intertwined.”

During his 27 years as Chief Clerk, Wilson worked with about 500 Democrat and Republican elected lawmakers, overseeing a staff of 30. He ensured members followed parliamentary procedure and that the legislative process ran smoothly, efficiently, and fairly.
