Traffic congestion is an increasing burden on the economy due to accelerating urbanization. For instance, the cost of traffic congestion in the United States reached $124 billion in 2014 and is projected to rise to $186 billion by 2030, according to a Forbes report. One promising solution to alleviate urban traffic congestion is the implementation of Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS). A crucial component of ITS is traffic prediction, which aims to forecast future traffic conditions in road networks based on historical data. Accurate traffic prediction is essential for effective traffic scheduling and management.

Traffic forecasting is challenging due to the complex temporal dependencies (i.e., the traffic condition at a particular road is related to its historical data) and spatial dependencies (i.e., traffic conditions of adjacent roads influence each other). Traditional methods rely on linear time series models for traffic forecasting, but these methods fail to capture nonlinear temporal correlations and often overlook spatial dependencies. Recently, a range of learning-based traffic predictors has emerged. These models typically use recurrent neural networks (RNNs) or temporal convolution modules to capture temporal dependencies. For spatial dependencies, they often employ Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) because of the graph-structured nature of road networks. Despite achieving impressive results, these graph-based methods are limited in their accuracy. This limitation primarily arises because the graph structure used in GCNs is heuristically defined, potentially missing crucial spatial correlations needed for accurate traffic prediction.

Recently, researchers have focused on adaptive graph-based methods, designing various attention mechanisms to learn latent graph structures. However, existing adaptive graph-based methods face three significant limitations. First, they construct the latent graph structure from scratch, disregarding the observed topology of the road network. Second, attention-based graph learning methods often suppress negative spatial relationships due to the SoftMax operation, even though these relationships might be useful for traffic prediction. Third, while introducing uncertainty into the graph structure (e.g., using DropEdge) has proven effective for improving the generalization ability of GCNs, GCN-based traffic predictors typically treat the graph structure as a deterministic variable and do not explore its uncertainty.

These challenges have led us to propose a Bayesian Graph Convolutional Network (BGCN). BGCN treats the graph structure as a random sample drawn from a parametric generative model and infers its posterior based on the observed topology of the road network and traffic data. Specifically, BGCN decomposes the graph structure into two components: (1) a precomputed constant adjacency matrix that infers potential spatial relationships based on physical road connections using a Bayesian approach; and (2) a learnable adjacency matrix that captures a spatial pattern shared across all time steps from traffic data in an end-to-end manner, allowing for the representation of negative spatial correlations. BGCN then approximates the posterior of the graph structure by performing Monte Carlo dropout on the parametric graph structure.

The primary contributions of our work are as follows:
1. This is the first attempt to apply Bayesian graph convolutional networks to traffic prediction.

Une majorité de Parisiens (58%) se déclarent mécontents de la maire PS de la capitale, Anne Hidalgo. Si le premier tour des élections municipales avait lieu cette semaine, il s'annoncerait très serré, quelles que soient les hypothèses, selon un sondage Ifop pour le Journal du Dimanche (JDD). Parmi les sondés, 26% sont "plutôt mécontents" et 32% "très mécontents" de Mme Hidalgo, soit une augmentation de dix points par rapport à un sondage réalisé les 31 mars et 1er avril 2016.

Les résultats varient considérablement en fonction des sympathies politiques. Ainsi, 70% des sympathisants de gauche se disent très ou plutôt satisfaits, contre 40% pour les sympathisants de La République en Marche et seulement 11% pour ceux de droite. Concernant la piétonnisation des berges de Seine rive droite, une mesure emblématique de la maire dans sa lutte contre la pollution, 54% des personnes interrogées s'y déclarent "favorables", ce qui représente une baisse de six points, tandis que 46% y sont défavorables (+6%).

Les opinions divergent également sur les transports. Interrogés sur des aspects précis du bilan de la municipalité, les sondés jugent positivement la vie culturelle (76%), l'animation de la ville (64%), et le rayonnement de Paris à l'étranger (61%). En revanche, ils ont une opinion plutôt négative concernant les transports en commun (48%), la lutte contre la pollution (43%) et la sécurité (38%), et très négative concernant la propreté (27%) et la circulation (24%). Malgré ces critiques, 88% des personnes interrogées se déclarent satisfaites de vivre à Paris.

Plusieurs hypothèses sont envisagées pour un premier tour des élections municipales si elles se tenaient "dimanche prochain". Dans l'hypothèse d'une candidature de La République en Marche (LREM) avec le porte-parole du gouvernement Benjamin Griveaux, qui envisage une candidature municipale, il prendrait une légère avance avec 32% contre 29% pour Anne Hidalgo et 21% pour Florence Berthout (LR), présidente du groupe Les Républicains et Indépendants du Conseil de Paris. Une liste de La France Insoumise (LFI) conduite par Danielle Simonnet obtiendrait 11%. Si LREM soutenait Mme Hidalgo, la maire socialiste obtiendrait 41% contre 38% pour LR et 12% pour LFI. Dans l'hypothèse d'un soutien de LREM aux Républicains, LR obtiendrait 40%, Mme Hidalgo 39% et LFI 12%.

Le Syndicat des entraîneurs du football du Sénégal (SEFS) a révélé que seuls cinq clubs sur les 28 évoluant dans les deux Ligues de football professionnel au Sénégal ont continué à payer des salaires à leurs joueurs malgré l'arrêt des compétitions lié au Covid-19. Dans un communiqué, le syndicat a souligné que parmi les 28 clubs de la Ligue professionnelle, seuls cinq respectent encore leurs engagements contractuels envers les joueurs et les entraîneurs. Il exprime des inquiétudes quant à la persistance de cette situation jusqu'au 2 janvier prochain.

Depuis l'interruption des compétitions due à la pandémie de Covid-19, la majorité des entraîneurs de toutes divisions se retrouvent sans salaire, a informé le syndicat regroupant les entraîneurs. Ce constat a été fait lors de la réunion élargie de son bureau le 30 août dernier.

The Federal Reserve on Saturday announced that it was reviewing the procedures for the annual stress tests that banks must undergo to demonstrate their resilience, following a correction in the test results. The U.S. central bank considers these stress tests crucial for safeguarding the financial industry's health post-crisis and is exploring potential adjustments to the procedures in response to the incident, according to a spokesperson.

A spokeswoman stated, "We are examining the cause of the error and taking steps to prevent such occurrences in the future." On March 21, the Fed revised the results for several of the 30 banks that participated in the stress tests, a day after the initial results were released. This adjustment did not impact which banks passed the examination, as most saw minimal changes in their capital ratios under stress.

In a significant development, the Fed rejected Citigroup's plans for increased shareholder payouts due to the test results, marking the second time in three years that the bank failed to obtain approval from the Fed for its capital distribution plans. This outcome had a negative impact on the bank's stock, causing a decline of more than 5%.

CEO Michael Corbat, who has been focused on repairing Citi's relationship with regulators since assuming office in late 2012, faced a setback with this news. The Fed mentioned that discrepancies in handling capital actions and assumptions related to compensation contributed to the adjustments in the capital ratios of the banks.

The Fed reiterated that an annual review of the stress test process was standard practice and emphasized the importance of identifying and rectifying any errors to maintain the integrity of the examination. This information was initially reported by The Wall Street Journal.

My bunk mate once told me, "It ain't too different from the guys who were sent to Australia." He asked if I had ever seen pictures of Australia—big, giant, red desert covered in dust that gets into your clothes, boots, eyes, and hair. It even gets into your mouth, between your teeth, and in your lungs. The smell of it stains the inside of your nostrils, and every meal I have is tinged with the taste and smell of it. We're all here, working to make that go away.

The prisoners work long hours to keep the terraforming station operational. The scientists made it fairly easy for us. We fill capsules with various liquids and fuels, sweep and clean the mechanical parts, and take samples in vials, of dirt, and of air. We put them in boxes and ship them off to people who can figure out what these things have to say. If we do not do these things, the terraforming station will fail. If that happens, we've got no air, and that'll kill us long before we run out of water or food. For the most part, we work in the bubble, where we don't need to wear our survival suits.

The ground was dry, and the hot westerlies blew the dust in little eddied currents as Jack, thirteen years old, gazed up at the searing blue sky. It wasn't even the heat of the day, yet the air leeched liquid life out of the cracked dirt, wringing out the earth and Jack's soul like a sponge. He longed for even a single cloud or any indication that moisture existed, hoping for a respite from the unrelenting dryness. But the air breathed drier and drier, and chapped lips licked by dry tongues beseeched a deaf Mother Nature. There would be no relief in sight.

Jack falls asleep, and in his dreams, a marvelous waterfall cascades down a verdant green slope, breaking on his back. The roar of the waterfall competes with his shouts of exultation as a warm spring rain mists down from the heavens, nourishing his parched being. Floating on his back, he takes deep breaths and long drinks, savoring the replenishment that seems so far away in his waking life.

If Adam Liaw were in charge of marketing vegetables in Australia, his tagline would be simple: Vegetables are delicious. The former Masterchef winner, television presenter, columnist, and prolific recipe writer was candid and direct about food trends during his address at Hort Connections 2019 in Melbourne, the largest gathering of the horticulture supply chain in Australia.

Instead of a standard slide show presentation and polished video, Mr. Liaw opted to engage with the audience by having an informal chat about food. This allowed him to share his insights on Australian dietary trends, food choices, and industry promotion in a more conversational manner.

Right from the beginning of his presentation, Mr. Liaw emphasized that the food movement in Australia was leaning towards increased vegetable consumption. Supported by data, he pointed out that Australians were cooking more vegetable-based meals, a shift he observed through social media trends and research outlets.

Delving into the analysis of recipe searches, Mr. Liaw noted a growing interest in exploring new vegetables and innovative ways to prepare traditional ones. He highlighted the importance of social media in gauging consumer preferences, particularly the rising popularity of inventive vegetable dishes.

Mr. Liaw, known for creating around 700 recipes annually, credited early seasons of Masterchef for changing how Australians viewed food. He emphasized the need to write recipes that resonate with a wide audience, whether by evoking exotic locales or offering practical solutions for home cooks across the country.

3D Visual Grounding (3DVG) is a critical component in various applications like autonomous robotics, virtual reality, and the metaverse. This technique localizes specific objects within 3D scenes based on textual descriptions. While this task may seem simple for humans, it poses a significant challenge for machines due to their limited perceptual capabilities. The goal of 3DVG is to accurately pinpoint objects while eliminating distractions.

Traditional supervised 3DVG approaches achieve localization by matching objects generated by 3D detectors with textual descriptions. These approaches are precise but require extensive annotations and are limited by pre-defined vocabularies. To address these issues, a novel visual programming approach integrating zero-shot learning and large language models (LLMs) is proposed.

Zero-shot learning can generalize across new categories using pre-trained capabilities like CLIP, while LLMs provide planning and reasoning capabilities essential for 3DVG. A visual programming approach is developed, involving generating a 3D visual program with LLMs, converting it into Python code, and identifying the target object's location through code execution. A language-object correlation module enhances accuracy by merging geometric and appearance information.

The contributions of the proposed approach include eliminating the need for extensive annotations, transforming visual programs into Python code, and introducing relation and LOC modules for spatial reasoning and open-vocabulary localization. Extensive experiments on popular datasets show superior performance, comparable to existing supervised approaches.

In summary, the study presents an innovative 3D visual programming approach for 3DVG, showcasing improved localization accuracy without the need for extensive annotations. By leveraging zero-shot learning and LLMs, the proposed method demonstrates strong performance on standard datasets, offering a promising direction for future advancements in 3D scene understanding.

Privacy is a fundamental desire for everyone. Sometimes, it is beneficial to leave someone alone, whether they are feeling sad, happy, or angry. Using the Facial Action Coding System to interpret students' emotional expressions is not advantageous.

Consider a situation where someone is grieving the loss of a loved one. That individual likely prefers to keep their emotions private. If a computer is employed to assess their feelings, it could exacerbate their distress. While a computer can recognize emotional expressions, it is not yet capable of responding to situations where the individual may need support. As mentioned in paragraph six, a computer can discern whether a person is happy, sad, confused, or bored. In a school setting, a student can simply raise their hand to seek assistance from a teacher. Conversely, a computer is likely to use complex language to adjust a lesson, which may not be helpful.

The issue is that, although new technology can read emotions, it cannot understand a person as a human can. In many paragraphs, such as paragraph eight, the author discusses how a computer analyzes facial expressions to interpret emotions. In a school, some shy students, who might be hesitant to ask for help, are often academically capable, achieving good grades. While it's not a certainty, a shy student is more likely to seek assistance from a teacher, a human, who can better understand, rather than a computer, which only reads facial expressions.

Moreover, this technology could, unintentionally, jeopardize friendships or relationships.

The Wolf with the Scars

It was a very cold night in Alaska when a lone wolf with scars upon its face roamed the land. A big storm, a blizzard, swept through Alaska, and the howls of many packs of wolves could be heard. The Dringo Pack, a pack of 10 wolves, inhabited a small territory from Howling Hills to Dead's Pit, known for its scarcity of prey. The Raptor Pack, with up to 15 wolves and led by an Alpha Male and Alpha Female, was the second biggest and fastest pack in all Alaska, ranging from Deep Pit to mountain Thrasher. The largest pack, Dranko, with up to 25 wolves, was the strongest, with the white Beta Male Wolf being the last remaining of the past Alpha Male of the pack.

The Pack Dranko began invading Raptor Pack territory, leading to a confrontation between the white Beta Male Wolf and the Alpha Male of Dranko. The Alpha Male attacked the white wolf, branding him with three scars of banishment. Fleeing from the pack, the white wolf found himself in the territory of the Dringo Pack, where he encountered a young White and Grey Wolf pup. The young wolf warned him of the Blazing Fire Pack, a dangerous group heading towards Raptor and Dranko, aiming to claim all of Alaska. They decided to warn the other packs and set off together, racing against time to reach safety.

They reached the Raptor territory and then the Dranko Pack, just in time to witness a fierce battle unfolding between Dranko and the Blazing Fire Pack. The white wolf, realizing the imminent danger, challenged the Alpha Male of Dranko for leadership. After a brutal battle, the white wolf emerged victorious, becoming the new Alpha of Dranko. The two packs united to face the Blazing Fire Pack, resulting in a decisive victory for Dranko.

With the white wolf as their new leader, the Dranko Pack emerged as the largest and most powerful pack in Alaska. The white wolf, now nineteen years old, and the young female wolf, ten years old, became the Alphas, leading the pack to prosperity. Their legend grew as they expanded their pack to almost forty-five members, the largest pack ever in Alaska. The white wolf reflected on his journey, remarking, “They threw me to the Wolves but I returned leading the Pack. This is my Legend. May the next generation follow in my footsteps as the next great Alpha.”

أظهرت دراسة حديثة أن الأمهات الحوامل يمكنهن تقليل مخاطر الولادة المبكرة بالخروج في الشمس أثناء شهور الحمل الأولى. ووجد باحثون من جامعة إدنبرة الأسكتلندية أن النساء اللواتي يحصلن على مزيد من ضوء الشمس في الأشهر الـ3 الأولى من الحمل يقللن من فرص الإصابة بمشاكل في المشيمة التي قد تؤدي إلى الولادة المبكرة ومن ثم فقدان الجنين.

وتزيد احتمالية الولادة المبكرة لمن يحصلن على أقل قدر من ضوء الشمس بنسبة 10% عن النساء اللاتي يحصلن على أعلى المستويات، وفقاً لموقع "studyfinds" الأمريكي. وتعد المضاعفات التي تسببها الولادة المبكرة (التي تُعرَّف على أنها أطفال يولدون أحياء قبل 37 أسبوعاً من الحمل) هي السبب الرئيسي لوفاة الأطفال دون سن الـ5.

ويعاني الناجون من الولادة المبكرة من معدلات إعاقة أعلى، بما في ذلك صعوبات في التعلم ومشاكل بصرية وسمعية، مقارنة بالأطفال الذين اكتملت فترة حملهم. وحلل الفريق الأسكتلندي في البحث الذي نشر في مجلة Frontiers in Reproduction Health العلمية، بيانات رعاية الأمومة لما يقرب من 400 ألف أم وأكثر من 500 ألف طفل ولدوا بعد 24 أسبوعاً من الحمل، وقاموا بفحص سجلات الأمومة لجميع المواليد الأحياء في أسكتلندا بين عامي 2000 و2010.

ومع ذلك، قال أعضاء الفريق البحثي إنهم سيحتاجون إلى إجراء المزيد من الدراسات لفهم الرابط بين أشعة الشمس والولادة المبكرة بشكل أفضل. ويبحث الخبراء بالفعل فيما إذا كان الضوء الاصطناعي يمكن أن يعزز صحة الحمل، لإفادة الوالدين في الأماكن ذات أشعة الشمس المحدودة.

واكتشف بحث سابق أنه عندما تصل أشعة الشمس لجلد الإنسان، تفرز الأوعية الدموية مركباً يسمى أكسيد النيتريك يساعد على خفض ضغط الدم. ويشير ذلك إلى أن التعرض لأشعة الشمس يحسن الصحة بشكل عام لأن فوائد خفض ضغط الدم تفوق بكثير مخاطر الإصابة بسرطان الجلد.

كما يساهم ضوء الشمس أيضاً بشكل مباشر في إنتاج فيتامين (د)، مما يساعد على نمو عظام الطفل الذي لم يولد بعد والأسنان والكلى والقلب والجهاز العصبي.

Disney's "Shang-Chi and The Legend of the Ten Rings" has become a box office sensation, grossing $71.4 million in ticket sales over the Labor Day weekend. This marks a significant achievement as the movie was the first Marvel film to be exclusively released in theaters since the onset of the pandemic. It is set to remain in theaters for 45 days before becoming available on streaming services.

Starring an Asian superhero in the lead role, "Shang-Chi" has received critical acclaim and has secured the second-highest box office earnings during the pandemic, trailing only behind "Black Widow." The latter, released in July simultaneously in theaters and on Disney+, led to a legal dispute when Scarlett Johansson sued Disney for breaching her contract, alleging that the online release affected her compensation tied to ticket sales.

The success of "Shang-Chi" has revitalized confidence in the theatrical movie industry, surpassing initial projections and demonstrating the effectiveness of a theatrical-first strategy in attracting audiences to cinemas. Amid delays in major movie releases due to the Delta variant surge, the movie industry has found hope in the performance of "Shang-Chi."

Despite its triumph at the domestic box office, "Shang-Chi" faces another hurdle as it has yet to receive approval for screening in China. This setback has not dampened the movie's success, which is seen as a pivotal moment for representation and inclusivity in the superhero genre.

The National Association of Theatre Owners has pointed to the exceptional performance of "Shang-Chi" as evidence that an exclusive theatrical release can yield greater profitability, contrasting with the hybrid release model tested by "Black Widow." The response from moviegoers to "Shang-Chi" has been overwhelmingly positive, signaling a promising resurgence for the theatrical movie experience.

In particular, to expect an FPT algorithm that improves by a factor of (1 - 1/e), we need to assume additional structure within the input families. 2021 a été une année très particulière en ce qui concerne le marché des crypto-monnaies, et l’un des principaux protagonistes a été Shiba Inu et Dogecoin. Ces pièces, sorties de nulle part essentiellement sous la forme de mèmes, sont devenues si populaires qu’elles ont rendu leurs premiers acheteurs riches. Le prix du Shiba Inu a augmenté de plus de 50 000 000 %, tandis que le prix du Dogecoin a augmenté de plus de 3 300 %. Cependant, avec un marché étonnamment en baisse à la fin de l’année, vous avez sûrement des doutes sur l’investissement dans l’un ou l’autre, et nous vous aiderons dans la décision.

Il existe un certain nombre d’avantages et d’inconvénients lorsqu’il s’agit d’investir dans l’une ou l’autre de ces deux crypto-monnaies, et nous les partagerons avec vous. Tout le monde parle de crypto-monnaies mais… apportent-elles vraiment quelque chose, au-delà de leur statut de marchandise à spéculer ? Voyons à quoi elles servent.

Pourquoi investir dans le Shiba Inu ? D’une part, Shiba Inu est un jeton ERC-20 construit sur la blockchain Ethereum, avec la possibilité que cette devise puisse avoir la fonctionnalité de contrat intelligent implémentée à l’avenir, augmentant ainsi sa valeur. Vous devez savoir que Shiba Inu est activement déflationniste et que les jetons sont régulièrement brûlés et retirés de la circulation. Shiba Inu a une capitalisation boursière d’environ 18,3 milliards de dollars, par rapport à la capitalisation boursière de Dogecoin de 23,3 milliards de dollars. Bien que Shiba Inu soit un peu en dessous, selon Google Trends, il suscite plus d’intérêt que Dogecoin. Shiba Inu devrait également être ajouté à la plate-forme Robinhood Markets dans les mois à venir, ce qui pourrait créer un catalyseur de prix positif pour le jeton.

Pourquoi investir dans Dogecoin ? En ce qui concerne Dogecoin, on estime actuellement que plus de 65 % des jetons se trouvent dans environ 98 portefeuilles numériques. Bien que cela puisse favoriser la volatilité, c’est mieux que Shiba Inu où plus de 53 % des jetons en circulation sont détenus dans seulement quatre portefeuilles cryptographiques. Mais l’atout le plus important de Dogecoin est peut-être le soutien du fondateur de Tesla et de SpaceX, Elon Musk. Tesla commence déjà à accepter certains paiements en Dogecoin, et à tout moment, un simple tweet d’Elon Musk peut catapulter la valeur de cette devise.

Chaque jour, des crypto-monnaies arrivent sur le marché avec de grandes ambitions, mais ces 5 en particulier ont un avenir vraiment prometteur.

The Tulsa Race Massacre Commission recessed Saturday without making a decision regarding the status of U.S. Sen. James Lankford. Co-chairman Kevin Matthews stated that the group would reconvene Monday morning to continue discussions.

Lankford, who is also a commission co-chairman, angered some members by joining a Senate protest of some states' electoral votes. Although he ultimately dropped his protest, he continued to express reservations about the election process in states that were carried by Democrat Joe Biden. A few days later, Lankford apologized, explaining that he did not realize the protest would be perceived as an attempt to invalidate the ballots of Black voters in cities such as Detroit, Atlanta, and Philadelphia.

In response to these actions, several Black Tulsans called for Lankford to resign or be removed from the commission, which is coordinating activities for the May 31-June 1 centennial of the Tulsa Race Massacre.

金管会近日宣布将放宽房贷及个人贷款风险权数的规定，引起市场关注。摩根大通对此发布评论，指出政策提前松绑将有利于提升台湾银行的普通股权益第一类资本（CET 1）、第一类资本（tier 1）以及资本适足率（CAR）。在最佳情况下，预计整体银行CET 1将提升48-147个基点，其中富邦金（2881）、中信金和新光金受惠最大。

金管会的最新政策包括将房贷风险权数依贷款成数（LTV）计算，以及将个人贷款适用较低风险权数的门槛放宽到2,000万元以下。这两项措施可能于明年下半年和1月实施，市场普遍认为这将有助于提高银行资本适足率。

Change detection is a fundamental application of remote sensing, aimed at assigning binary labels ("change" or "no change") to every pixel in a study area using at least two co-registered images captured at different times. The definition of "change" can vary depending on the application, encompassing scenarios such as urban expansion (Chen and Shi, 2020), flood mapping (Giustarini et al., 2012), deforestation (Morton et al., 2005), and cropland abandonment (Löw et al., 2018). Changes across multiple land-cover classes, known as semantic change detection, can also be simultaneously addressed (Daudt et al., 2019). This remains a challenging task due to the various forms of change attributed to varying environmental conditions that may not constitute a change for the objects of interest (Varghese et al., 2018).

Numerous change-detection algorithms have been developed and summarized in several reviews (Lu et al., 2004; Coppin et al., 2004; Hussain et al., 2013a; Tewkesbury et al., 2015).

In recent years, advancements in computer vision, particularly deep learning, have significantly advanced the field, especially in applications where spatial context is crucial. This progress is driven by the democratization of powerful computing systems, the growing availability of data, and innovative methods to exploit this data (Daudt et al., 2019).

Our hypothesis is that human intelligence identifies differences in images by detecting changes in objects of interest at a higher cognitive level (Varghese et al., 2018). We understand this because the time required to identify changed objects between two images increases with the number of objects changed (Treisman and Gelade, 1980). There is a strong correlation between processing time and the number of individual objects that changed; more complex changes require more time to process. Therefore, simply subtracting extracted features from images, a constant-time operation, cannot account for the complexities of human perception. Consequently, the deep convolutional neural networks proposed in this study address change detection without relying on bespoke feature subtraction (Chen and Shi, 2020).

In this work, we developed neural networks using attention mechanisms to emphasize areas of interest in two bi-temporal coregistered aerial images. The network learns what to emphasize and how to extract features that describe change at a higher level. To achieve this, we propose a dual encoder-single decoder scheme that fuses information from corresponding layers with relative attention, ultimately extracting a segmentation mask as the final layer. This mask designates change for classes of interest and can also be used for the dual problem of class attribution of change. As in previous work, we employ conditioned multi-tasking (Diakogiannis et al., 2020), which is crucial for stabilizing the training process and improving performance.

In summary, the main contributions of this work are as follows:

1. We introduce a new set similarity metric, a variant of the Dice coefficient called the Fractal Tanimoto similarity measure (section 3). This measure offers a finer-grained similarity metric between layers by adjusting the steepness toward optimality using a depth recursion hyper-parameter. It can be employed as a "sharp" loss function for model fine-tuning in the latest training stages and as a set similarity metric between feature layers in the attention mechanism.

2. Using the aforementioned set similarity as a loss function, we propose an evolving loss strategy for fine-tuning neural network training (section 4), which helps prevent overfitting and enhances performance.

3. We introduce the Fractal Tanimoto Attention Layer (FracTAL), specifically designed for vision tasks (section 5). This layer utilizes fractal Tanimoto similarity to compare queries with keys within the Attention module, combining spatial and channel attention.

4. We present a feature extraction building block based on the Residual neural network and Fractal Tanimoto Attention (section 5.2.1). The new FracTAL ResNet converges faster to optimality than standard residual networks, enhancing performance.

5. We introduce two variants of a new feature extraction building block, the Compress-Expand / Expand-Compress unit (CEECNet unit, section 6.1), which shows improved performance compared to standard residual units and the FracTAL ResNet unit.

6. Building on these findings, we introduce a new backbone encoder/decoder scheme, a macro-topology called "mantis," tailored for change detection tasks (section 6.2). The encoder is a Siamese dual encoder where features extracted at each depth are fused using FracTAL relative attention, eliminating the need for manual feature subtraction.

Forecasting the future is crucial in financial risk management and analytics. It plays a significant role in various decision-making processes, such as predicting stock market moves for investment decisions, correlating returns for asset allocation choices, and estimating portfolio P&L distribution for risk management and regulatory purposes using VaR and Expected Shortfall measures. VaR represents a quantile of the portfolio P&L distribution in a future period, calculated from the risk factor distribution based on valuation models. The accuracy of VaR models hinges on forecasting the risk factor distribution conditioned on historical data and prevailing market conditions. Although historical simulation (HS) is a widely used VaR model in commercial banks, it may not capture the tails of distributions accurately due to its reliance on limited historical scenarios.

Generative Artificial Intelligence (Generative AI) encompasses deep-learning models capable of producing high-quality content like text and images based on their training data. This technology has the potential to revolutionize various industries, as seen with innovations like the AI chatbot ChatGPT and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) in image processing and financial time series generation. Institutions like Fujitsu and UBS have leveraged GAN technology for applications ranging from generating loan denial explanations to creating synthetic data for protection and enhancing real data. Despite its potential, the use of synthetic data in financial modeling requires careful consideration to ensure it aligns with real data without being overly correlated.

Financial time series generation aims to create synthetic data that closely resemble real data with variability, striking a balance between realism and utility for model training and testing. In the context of VaR and market risk modeling, the focus is on predicting the conditional distribution of P&L for a specific future horizon based on historical and market data. This paper explores deep learning methods for conditional multi-step time series generation, including Encoder-Decoder CGAN and Conditional TimeVAE, tested on simulated and real USD yield curves. A framework for evaluating the quality of generated time series is introduced, emphasizing the importance of conditional forecasting and key performance indicators such as distribution distance, autocorrelation, and backtesting.

Quadrotors, one of the most popular unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) nowadays, have been widely applied in various scenarios due to their compact size and flexibility, making them suitable for use in confined indoor spaces where safety is a concern. In these settings, safe trajectories are crucial to avoid obstacles and ensure safety. However, determining the control error bound during flight is challenging as it depends on external disturbances. Estimating disturbances accurately is essential to provide better control error bounds and facilitate trajectory planning.

The most critical disturbance source in indoor environments is the airflow generated by the quadrotor itself, which varies during flight and interacts with obstacles. Ego airflow disturbances can lead to safety issues, especially in confined spaces, as observed in hover experiments with quadrotors near obstacles. The variance of acceleration is used as a measure of disturbance, with variances near obstacles significantly higher than those further away. Constant error bounds assumed in previous planning and control methods struggle to adapt to such disturbance variations, potentially leading to unsafe or overly conservative motion planning.

To address these challenges, this paper focuses on estimating and adapting indoor ego airflow disturbances caused by rotor flow interacting with obstacles. A disturbance field is constructed based on map information and a proposed model. A motion planning framework for quadrotors is then developed, incorporating kinodynamic path search, B-spline trajectory optimization, and Hamilton-Jacobi forward reachable sets (FRSs) computed from estimated disturbances to ensure safety and robustness. This approach allows quadrotors to automatically adapt to ego airflow disturbances for safe navigation in complex indoor environments.

The contributions of this work include the formulation and validation of an ego airflow disturbance model for quadrotors in various environments, a robust motion planning framework considering control error bounds and FRSs computed from estimated disturbances, and the integration of this method with state estimation, mapping, and control modules for safe quadrotor flights. By addressing the challenges posed by ego airflow disturbances in confined spaces, the proposed framework enhances safety and efficiency in indoor quadrotor operations.

El Ministerio de Comercio chino informó que China y Estados Unidos han acordado cancelar los aranceles impuestos durante su guerra comercial en diferentes fases en las últimas dos semanas. Según el comunicado, ambas partes deben cancelar simultáneamente algunos de los aranceles existentes para alcanzar la "primera fase" del acuerdo comercial. La proporción de aranceles cancelados debe ser la misma, aunque la cantidad de aranceles cancelados puede ser objeto de negociación.

Gao Feng, portavoz del Ministerio de Comercio chino, explicó que en las últimas dos semanas, los principales negociadores de ambos países han mantenido conversaciones serias y constructivas para resolver diversas cuestiones fundamentales. Ambas partes han acordado cancelar aranceles adicionales en diferentes fases a medida que avancen en sus negociaciones, aunque no se ha proporcionado un calendario específico para la cancelación.

Según una fuente cercana a las negociaciones, China ha solicitado que Estados Unidos elimine los aranceles del 15% impuestos a los productos chinos valorados en aproximadamente $125,000 millones, que entraron en vigor el 1 de septiembre. Además, han pedido que se modifiquen los aranceles del 25% impuestos a las importaciones de productos por valor de $250,000 millones, que incluyen maquinaria, semiconductores y muebles.

China está presionando a Washington para que elimine todos los aranceles lo antes posible, argumentando que la guerra comercial debe terminar con la cancelación de los aranceles, según Gao. Se espera que los presidentes Xi Jinping y Donald Trump firmen un acuerdo preliminar que abra paso a negociaciones comerciales más amplias.

La firma del acuerdo entre ambos líderes podría tener lugar este mes en un lugar aún por determinar. Aunque inicialmente estaba programada para mediados de noviembre en Chile, durante una cumbre de líderes de Asia y el Pacífico que fue cancelada, se han sugerido varios lugares para esta reunión. Según un alto cargo de la administración Trump, un posible escenario es Londres, donde los dos líderes podrían reunirse después de la cumbre de la OTAN que Trump asistirá el 3 y 4 de diciembre. Sin embargo, Gao se negó a confirmar la fecha y el lugar de la reunión.

In the year 2364, individuals are born with chips implanted in their brains to eliminate the need for sleep. These mandatory chips are part of SCION, the megacorporation controlling the Towers. One such tower, constructed on the remains of Tokyo, is producing what the media has dubbed Dreamchips. These chips, when slotted into any neural link device (such as a datajack or a neural relay helmet), induce a dreamlike trance, allowing individuals to perform their duties while being mentally elsewhere.

I am Yoko, and I recently acquired a datajack. I had been contemplating purchasing a dreamchip for some time, but hesitated due to concerns about its impact. Most of my colleagues are now regularly entranced, appearing as mere shadows of their former selves. Rumors suggest a resistance group opposes the global distribution of dreamchips.

I delay my purchase for months, realizing that apart from a few SCION executives, I might be the only non-addicted employee. Despite our plea for worldwide adoption, us workers on the factory floor are largely ignored, presumed to be under the dreamchip's spell. To blend in, I install a dummy chip in my datajack, feigning disconnection from my surroundings. This pretense pays off unexpectedly when the CEO inspects the chips we assemble, expressing frustration over a group known as AVA challenging SCION's authority.

During his heated phone conversation, the CEO reveals unsettling information about the dreamchips' connection to unexplained deaths, which AVA has exposed. Feeling a surge of discomfort, I overhear him commenting callously on the workforce's compliance and personal hygiene, highlighting the pervasive control the dreamchips exert. The CEO's revealing words leave me stunned, yet he remains oblivious to my presence.

Later, a mysterious note appears in my pocket as I finish my shift: "Visit the Nightmare Club in the old Shibuya slums -AVA."

China’s banking regulator has approved the establishment of three new banks funded entirely by private firms, marking a significant development in a sector traditionally dominated by state giants. This move is part of Beijing’s efforts to open up state-controlled industries to private companies in order to stimulate various sectors, such as railways, airports, sea ports, oil and gas exploration, telecommunications, and banking.

According to the China Banking Regulatory Commission (CBRC), one of the new banks will be based in the Qianhai economic zone in Guangdong province, with funding coming from Internet company Tencent (0700.HK) and two local firms, Shenzhen Liye Group and Baiyeyuan Investment Company. The other two banks will be established in Wenzhou, Zhejiang province, and Tianjin, with backing from local private enterprises, including listed companies Zhejiang Chint Electrics (601877.SS) and Zhejiang Huafon Spandex (002064.SZ).

CBRC Chairman Shang Fulin emphasized that the three banks would specialize in different market segments and adopt unique development strategies while sharing a common goal of supporting the real economy and offering efficient financial services. The regulator also stated that it would continue to provide guidance to eligible companies interested in establishing private banks and expand the pilot program to other regions in due course.

Despite the slow progress in opening up state-controlled industries to private firms, the recent approval of these private banks signals a positive step towards increasing competition and diversity in China’s banking sector.

Studying Venus is a worthy pursuit because it is one of the brightest points of light in the sky, making it an intriguing starting point for astronomical investigation. Venus is often referred to as "The Earth Twin" due to its similarities in density, size, and proximity to our planet. This resemblance has led to a keen interest in understanding the planet, despite the challenges it presents.

One of the main reasons Venus is difficult to study is its thick atmosphere, which is composed of dense layers, often described as "blankets," beneath which are clouds of sulfuric acid. This hostile environment, characterized by extreme temperatures, makes Venus the hottest planet in our solar system, with surface temperatures reaching up to 800 degrees Fahrenheit, a condition unknown to humans. The atmospheric pressure is another daunting challenge, as it is more than 90 times greater than that of Earth. Moreover, Venus is geologically active, with erupting volcanoes, earthquakes, and, at times, lightning, adding to the complexity of studying the planet.

Des lettres des douze enfants bloqués depuis 14 jours dans une grotte inondée en Thaïlande ont été transmises samedi par les plongeurs, tandis que les secouristes évoquaient une fenêtre de trois à quatre jours pour les évacuer avant l'arrivée de nouvelles pluies.

"Ne vous inquiétez pas, Papa et Maman. Cela fait deux semaines que je suis parti, mais je vais revenir vous aider à la boutique", écrit Ekkarat, signant de son surnom, Bew. Ses parents tiennent une petite épicerie. "Je vais bien, mais il fait un peu froid ici. Ne vous inquiétez pas pour moi. N'oubliez pas de me préparer une fête d'anniversaire", ajoute un autre enfant, Duangphet, signant de son surnom, Dom. "Si je sors, s'il vous plaît, emmenez-moi manger du moo krata", un plat thaïlandais à base de porc grillé et de légumes, dit un troisième, Piphat, signant de son surnom, Nick.

Les lettres écrites par les enfants à leurs familles, qui attendent avec angoisse à la sortie de la grotte, sont les premières preuves de vie publiques transmises depuis mardi. Le jeune entraîneur de football qui a emmené le groupe d'enfants dans cette expédition qui a mal tourné a écrit une lettre d'excuses aux parents : "Merci pour tout le soutien moral. Je demande pardon à tous les parents", déclare Ekkapol Chantawong, 25 ans.

Les opinions en Thaïlande sont partagées entre ceux qui lui reprochent d'avoir emmené les enfants sous sa responsabilité dans une grotte connue pour être inondable à la mousson, et ceux qui lui sont reconnaissants d'avoir donné aux enfants sa ration de nourriture avant qu'ils ne soient localisés.

Après la publication de deux vidéos, la première filmée lors de la découverte du groupe par des plongeurs britanniques lundi soir, la deuxième mardi, aucune vidéo n'a été publiée depuis montrant le groupe perché sur un rebord à plusieurs kilomètres dans les profondeurs de la grotte.

Ils ont été piégés le 23 juin par la montée des eaux dans cette grotte au nord de la Thaïlande, à la frontière avec la Birmanie et le Laos. Les secours s’interrogeaient samedi sur l'opportunité de déclencher une évacuation périlleuse, les pluies de mousson attendues risquant de ruiner les efforts continus depuis plusieurs jours pour drainer l'eau de la grotte.

Curiosity is intrinsic to human nature, driving us to explore and discover new frontiers. History offers countless examples of how curiosity has shaped our world. If Christopher Columbus hadn’t set out to find a route to India, the British may never have discovered North America. Similarly, our curiosity fuels our ambitions in space exploration, and one of the most intriguing celestial bodies to study is Venus. Venus, in many ways, is strikingly similar to Earth, and investigating its mysteries may provide valuable insights, not only about our planet but also about the broader universe. As the article, *The Challenge of Exploring Venus*, explains, despite the planet’s extreme and hostile conditions, the potential doors Venus could open make the exploration effort worthwhile. Venus, the author argues, is a stepping stone, a planet worthy of our attention, due to its close relationship to Earth and the pathways it may reveal to further advancements in space exploration.  

To explore the future, the author emphasizes, we must begin the journey, and the first steps in space exploration should focus on the planets closest to us.

Dans le grand vestibule de la Sorbonne, des plaques de marbre honorent en lettres d’or les généreux donateurs. Le dernier nom à y figurer est celui de Jean Bélias, « bibliophile émérite », décédé en décembre 2010. On en sait peu sur ce monsieur, qui semblait privilégier la discrétion. Un amateur réservé, distingué et d’une rare érudition poétique, il était un homme secret, aux lectures raffinées, un esthète vivant seul, apparemment sans enfant. Courtier de profession, il avait accumulé dans son appartement de la rue des Vinaigriers à Paris plus d'éditions originales qu’il n'en pouvait contenir. Dans le petit milieu parisien des lettres, peu de personnes le connaissaient. Jean Bélias demeurait ainsi un illustre inconnu.

À sa mort en 2010, la bibliothèque Jacques-Doucet, régie par la Chancellerie des universités de Paris, a hérité de l'important legs du collectionneur Jean Bélias.

Cette semaine, nous nous penchons sur le nouveau cycle des Mondes d'Aldébaran, une saga de science-fiction commencée en 1994. L'auteur brésilien Luis Eduardo de Oliveira, alias Leo, a consacré près de 25 ans à raconter les péripéties des colons spatiaux face à des planètes hostiles. Pour ce dessinateur et scénariste francophone, ces aventures divertissantes sont aussi un moyen de mettre en scène les dérives de sociétés livrées à elles-mêmes, telles que la dictature militaire ou le fanatisme religieux. Dans ce contexte, les personnages, souvent féminins, se confrontent ou s'entraident, dotés de caractères bien trempés.

Les cycles précédents, Aldébaran (1994-1998), Bételgeuse (2000-2005), Antarès (2007-2015), et Survivants (2011-2017), sont composés de cinq ou six tomes chacun. Retour sur Aldébaran réunit Kim, l'héroïne phare des trois premiers cycles, et Manon, une protagoniste de Survivants. La série introduit une petite nouveauté graphique avec la coloriste Florence Spitéri, dont le travail apporte d'agréables nuances aux décors. Toutefois, les visages dessinés par Leo restent expressifs mais souvent trop similaires.

Le premier volume de Retour sur Aldébaran, étendu sur 64 planches au lieu des 46 habituelles, prend son temps, multiplie les dialogues et enchaîne présentations et retrouvailles. Ce choix permet au lecteur de se replonger en douceur dans l'univers de la saga. Cependant, ceux espérant découvrir une nouvelle planète à la faune et la flore exotiques, un des charmes récurrents de la saga, devront patienter puisque la fameuse «porte quantique» du Cube (cf. Antarès) n'est franchie qu'à dix pages de la fin.

Le scénario prend un tour intéressant en évoquant la défiance de l'opinion publique vis-à-vis des Tsaltérians, une espèce extraterrestre humanoïde à la technologie avancée (cf. Bételgeuse). Ces derniers ont choisi de contacter la planète Aldébaran-4 plutôt que la Terre, et refusent de dialoguer avec les autorités, préférant s'adresser à Kim, mère d'une enfant hybride. Cet embryon d'intrigue géopolitique conduit à l'une des rares scènes d'action du tome, mettant en lumière la représentation des personnages féminins dans la saga.

De retour sur Aldébaran-4, Kim Keller cherche à apaiser les tensions concernant sa fille Lynn, mi-humaine mi-extraterrestre, et désamorcer la méfiance envers les Tsaltérians. Elle décide de s'adresser à la population d'Anatolie, la capitale. Durant le discours, Manon, debout parmi les spectateurs, remarque un homme armé et parvient à le désarmer à mains nues. Un second agresseur blesse Amos, qui en protégeant Kim, assomme par inadvertance Lynn. Leo, plus à l'aise dans la représentation des paysages que des mouvements, utilise le champ-contre-champ pour alterner les vues de la foule et de la tribune, avec différentes valeurs de plan, rythmées par des répliques et des onomatopées.

Cette séquence illustre le courage et les compétences physiques de Manon, capable de neutraliser deux hommes armés en un clin d'œil, affirmant qu'une femme peut bien assurer le rôle d'agent de sécurité. Dans une interview, Leo avait reconnu son «côté féministe», justifiant qu'il avait fait de Kim une «femme forte et déterminée», tout comme Manon. Plus tôt dans Retour sur Aldébaran, Manon raconte à Alex comment elle a réagi face à son patron qui l'avait harcelée, en référence au mouvement #MeToo.

Pourtant, malgré ces intentions, Leo tend à présenter ses héroïnes comme des objets de désir pour les hommes, illustré par un triangle amoureux dans Survivants.

Un soldat de l'Armée nationale afghane fouille les passagers d'un autocar à un poste de contrôle établi dimanche sur la route dans le district de Khogyani, dans la province de Nangarhar.

(Kaboul) La trêve partielle d'une semaine entre les talibans, les États-Unis et les forces afghanes, entamée samedi, se maintenait encore mardi, pour son quatrième jour, avec une nette diminution des attaques des insurgés, ont indiqué des sources sécuritaires.

Agence France-Presse

« Le nombre d'attaques ennemies a baissé par rapport à avant » la réduction des combats, a déclaré à l'AFP Nasrat Rahimi, porte-parole du ministère de l'Intérieur.

Selon une source sécuritaire interrogée par l'AFP sous couvert d'anonymat, les attaques talibanes ont chuté de 75 à 15 par jour en moyenne depuis le début de la trêve partielle.

PHOTO MOHAMMAD ISMAIL, REUTERS Un garçon joue au ballon près de l'épave d'un véhicule blindé BTR-60 de fabrication russe, à Kaboul, lundi.

Cinq membres des forces de sécurité afghanes ont cependant été tués mardi dans des attaques talibanes, dont une embuscade dans la province de Ghazni (Est) et deux explosions d'engins dans les provinces de Farah (Ouest) et Zaboul (Sud), a rapporté M. Rahimi.

Les talibans ont revendiqué deux de ces trois attaques par l'intermédiaire de leur porte-parole Zabihullah Mujahid sur Twitter.

Ces attaques n'ont toutefois pas réussi à mettre fin à la « réduction des violences » en vigueur depuis samedi, une condition imposée par les États-Unis pour accepter de signer un accord avec les talibans en vue du retrait de leurs troupes d'Afghanistan en échange de garanties sécuritaires.

Dans un premier temps, les troupes américaines passeraient de 12 000-13 000 à 8 600 soldats en Afghanistan, selon Washington.

Le reste du contingent quitterait ensuite le pays progressivement si les talibans respectent leurs autres engagements, notamment celui d'empêcher que l'Afghanistan devienne un refuge pour les djihadistes cherchant à frapper à l'extérieur de ses frontières.

Par ailleurs, les forces américaines ont annoncé mardi la mort de quatre membres du groupe État islamique lors de deux frappes aériennes dans la province de Kunar (est).

Présent en Afghanistan depuis 2015, l'EI est un ennemi commun des États-Unis, des forces progouvernementales et des talibans.

« Nous continuons à éliminer les terroristes de l'EI où qu'ils se cachent pour protéger l'Afghanistan tout en respectant l'accord États-Unis-Afghans-talibans visant à réduire la violence », a tweeté Sonny Leggett, porte-parole des forces américaines.

Le gouvernement afghan avait annoncé en novembre la défaite de l'EI dans le pays, après que le groupe eut été chassé de la province du Nangarhar (Est), son bastion historique. Une partie de ses membres se sont depuis réfugiés dans la province voisine de Kunar, tandis que d'autres se sont rendus au gouvernement.

À l'approche des élections présidentielle et législatives tunisiennes de 2019, la nouvelle pièce intitulée "Hafedh 3annidham" écrite par Habib Bel Hedi et mise en scène par Rabeb Srairi offre une critique satirique des techniques de communication politique à travers un regard ironique sur la scène politique tunisienne actuelle, où les intérêts des hommes politiques priment sur ceux des citoyens.

Présentée en avant-première vendredi soir au Théâtre "Le Rio", "Hafedh 3annidham" raconte l'histoire d'un homme politique nommé "Hafedh" poussé par sa mère "Lella" à se présenter aux élections afin de conserver le pouvoir au sein de la famille. Entouré de ses deux gardes du corps (Oussama Kochkar et Wajdi Borji) et sous la direction de sa mère, "Hafedh" (interprété par Jamel Madani) fait appel à une conseillère en communication, "Lahlouba" (jouée par Rabeb Srairi), pour préparer sa campagne électorale.

Bien que la première impression de la pièce semble indiquer qu'il s'agit d'une comédie critiquant directement le parti au pouvoir et son chef, le texte de Habib Bel Hedi incite à une lecture plus profonde révélant la mise à nu des techniques de communication politique.

À travers une approche didactique et une dramaturgie audacieuse, les leçons de communication politique structurent le déroulement de l'histoire. Tout au long de la pièce, le public découvre le monde artificiel de la politique moderne. La gestuelle, l'héritage culturel, la rhétorique, l'improvisation lors d'un discours public, et le style vestimentaire des hommes politiques sont mis en lumière pour illustrer la quête du pouvoir.

"Hafedh 3annidham" se présente comme une critique acerbe de l'action politique contemporaine qui semble davantage servir les intérêts des dirigeants. Des jeux de mots et des métaphores évoquant les véritables problèmes du peuple sont interprétés avec fraîcheur et justesse par les acteurs.

The global energy system currently contributes to approximately 75% of greenhouse gas emissions, highlighting its crucial role in addressing the urgent need to combat climate change. Achieving Net Zero Emissions (NZE) by 2050 is essential to limiting the long-term increase in average global temperatures to 1.5°C. This ambitious goal requires a comprehensive transformation in how energy is produced, transported, and consumed in the United States, including the state of Florida. This transformation demands a focused effort to advance clean energy technologies leading up to 2030. Despite the growth in renewable energy, significant challenges remain in integrating these technologies into the grid-based energy market. Despite improvements in Florida's building energy efficiency, the building sector remains a major source of greenhouse gas emissions.

In 2020, Florida's net end-use energy consumption totaled 809 TWh across various sectors, with electricity retail sales accounting for 242 TWh. Overall energy losses within these sectors amounted to 373 TWh, resulting in a combined end-use energy consumption of 1,182 TWh. Notably, the efficiency of electric utility delivery to these sectors was only 40%. The transportation sector saw high fossil fuel consumption, with minimal electric consumption. Addressing these challenges requires innovative solutions to increase energy efficiency, reduce losses, and transition to renewable energy sources.

There have been global studies outlining pathways to achieve net-zero carbon dioxide emissions or 100% renewable energy by 2050, with specific insights into Florida's energy landscape. Transitioning to 100% renewable electricity in Florida has shown promising results, including grid stability, job creation, health benefits, and significant reductions in carbon emissions and energy costs. The focus is on increasing renewable energy sources, particularly solar and wind, while also exploring the role of hydrogen generation from electricity.

Efforts to reduce residential energy demand include energy-efficient architectural designs, high-performance appliances, optimized HVAC systems, and intelligent control mechanisms. Studies on Net Zero Energy Buildings (NZEBs) with PV and battery systems highlight the economic feasibility and environmental benefits of transitioning to sustainable energy solutions. By embracing renewable energy and enhancing energy efficiency, residential buildings can significantly reduce their carbon footprint while ensuring energy security and cost savings.

Future research should delve into the economic and technical advantages of NZEBs, exploring aspects such as monthly savings, grid independence, and peer-to-peer energy exchanges.

Tensions mounted on Good Morning Britain on Friday as Piers Morgan snapped at producers. This week, for the first time in a long while, the outspoken host has been consistently present on the ITV daytime show without taking a day off.

After returning from his two-week break, Piers has been co-hosting GMB with Susanna Reid from Monday through Friday, discussing topics ranging from England's second lockdown of the year to the US Election debacle and Donald Trump's explosive claims.

The lack of time off this week may have contributed to his irritation on Friday morning, as he complained about receiving instructions from the show's producers.

As the cameras resumed after an ad break, a surprised Susanna exclaimed, "What did you just say, Piers Morgan?"

Piers ranted, "There are people in my ear saying 'here's what you do.' It's almost like presenting by numbers. 'If you could do this, do this.' No! I've been here for nearly five years."

Susanna interjected, "You've not been here on a Friday, though."

"No, I haven't," Piers admitted, before adding, "And tension is mounting this week!"

Exhaustion. Complete and utter exhaustion. No one ever speaks about how overwhelming it can be. The stench of death and decay surrounds a person, a gruesome reminder of a horrific battle. It's a psychological torment that ravages a man's mind.

All he wanted was to sleep. To collapse, to fall, and to join the bodies scattered around him. Friend or foe, it no longer mattered, for in death, all men are equal. The bitter, gray dawn marked the end of a seemingly endless night. Even if the sky held colors, he doubted he could perceive them.

He reached out, grasping for anything to support him, before sinking to his knees. The soft, squelching earth greeted his ears, a muddy tapestry of countless, chaotic imprints. Bodies surrounded him. Death surrounded him. The impending darkness of finality, which he had long evaded, was finally closing in, its icy grip unrelenting. 

He had wanted to fight, for his friends, his family, his country. But that was a lifetime ago. He glanced skyward, one final time, a muddied hill forming at the edge of his vision. Rising from the ashes of the forsaken battlefield, the flag of the victor, the flag of his country, stood.

Introduction:

Hardware performance counters (HPCs) are widely used in profiling applications to characterize and find bottlenecks in application performance. Even though HPCs can count hundreds of different types of architectural and microarchitectural events, they are limited because those events are collected (i.e., multiplexed) on a fixed number of hardware registers (usually 4-10 per core). As a result, they are error-prone because of application, sampling, and asynchronous collection behaviors borne out of multiplexing. Such behavior in HPC measurements is not a new problem and has been known for the better part of a decade.

Problem Statement:

Traditional approaches of tackling HPC errors have relied on collecting measurements across several application runs, and then performing offline computations to (i) impute missing or errored measurements with new values or (ii) dropping outlier values to reduce overall error. These techniques are suitable for offline analysis but are untenable in emergent applications that use HPCs as inputs to complete a feedback loop and make dynamic real-time decisions that affect system resources using a variety of machine learning (ML) methods.

Proposed Solution:

This paper presents BayesPerf, a system for quantifying uncertainty and correcting errors in HPC measurements using a domain-driven Bayesian model that captures micro-architectural relationships between HPCs. BayesPerf corrects HPC measurement errors at the system level, thereby allowing downstream control and decision models to be simpler, faster, and use less training data when used in conjunction with ML.

Approach & Contributions:

The key contributions of BayesPerf include the BayesPerf ML Model, which incorporates microarchitectural relationships to combine measurements from several noisy HPCs to infer their true values and quantify the uncertainty in the inferred value due to noise. This allows for improved decision-making with explicit quantification of HPC measurement uncertainty and reduced need for aggressive HPC sampling.

Additionally, the BayesPerf Accelerator facilitates the use of the BayesPerf ML model in latency-critical, real-time decision-making tasks by presenting the design and implementation of an accelerator for Monte Carlo-based training and inference of the BayesPerf model. The accelerator provides significant reductions in power consumption and read latency overhead while maintaining high throughput and parallelism.

Prototype Implementation & Evaluation:

The paper describes an FPGA-based prototype implementation of the BayesPerf system for Linux running on Intel x86_64 (Sky Lake) and IBM ppc64 (Power9) processors. Experimental results demonstrate that BayesPerf significantly reduces HPC measurement errors and power consumption while maintaining low latency overhead. The system is further demonstrated in a high-level ML-based IO scheduler, showcasing reduced training time and improved workload makespan.

Conclusion:

The paper is organized into sections discussing the sources of HPC measurement errors, the design of the BayesPerf system, the formulation, training, and inference of the ML model, the accelerator for real-time inference, a prototype implementation, and evaluation results. By integrating BayesPerf with traditional methods, the paper highlights its potential and future challenges in improving HPC measurement accuracy and efficiency in decision-making tasks.

يمكن أن يكون من السهل كسر كلمة المرور الأكثر تميزاً إذا تم استخدام أحد برامج الكمبيوتر المتخصصة في اختراق كلمات المرور. ولذلك، يجب معرفة كيفية بناء كلمات مرور آمنة لحساباتك، والتي قد يستحيل اختراقها من أعقد أجهزة الكمبيوتر، وقد يحتاج الأمر إلى قرون طويلة.

أشار موقع Security.org، المتخصص في إعدادات الأمان، إلى أن إضافة حرف واحد كبير إلى كلمة المرور يمكن أن يغير فعاليتها بشكل كبير. أوضح الموقع أنه في حالة إضافة حرف كبير إلى كلمة المرور المكونة من ثمانية أحرف، فإنه يمكن كسرها في 22 دقيقة بدلاً من كسرها بشكل فوري في ثانية واحدة - بزيادة 1000%، وفقاً لما اطلعت عليه "العربية.نت". 

ولجعل كلمة المرور آمنة حقاً، يمكن إضافة المزيد من الأحرف أو أكثر من حرف كبير أو رقم أو رمز. ينصح الموقع باستخدام حرف واحد كبير على الأقل ورقم واحد، والذي يرفع أمان كلمة المرور المكونة من ثمانية أحرف إلى أن تستغرق ساعة واحدة للكسر. وفي حال إضافة رمز آخر فسيستغرق الأمر ثماني ساعات.

ولإنشاء كلمة المرور غير قابلة للاختراق والكسر، يجب ألا تقل عن 12 حرفاً، وتتضمن حرفاً كبيراً واحداً ورقماً واحداً ورمزاً واحداً على الأقل. حيث قدّر الموقع أن تستغرق 34000 سنة لكسرها من قبل برامج الكمبيوتر الضارة.

فسرت شركة البيانات الألمانية "Statista" السبب إلى أنه عندما نستخدم أنواعاً أكثر من الأحرف، فإن المجموعات المحتملة التي تتكون منها كلمة المرور تزداد أضعافاً مضاعفة. أوضح الموقع أن برامج التجسس والاختراق تقوم بعمل معادلات وفقاً لما يعرف بنظام التباديل والتوافيق.

L’épidémie de coronavirus a bouleversé toutes les relations humaines et interactions sociales, à l'exception de celles au sein de la famille. Selon une enquête menée par l'Institut national des statistiques (Kostat) et publiée aujourd'hui, 12,9 % des participants ont indiqué que leurs liens familiaux s'étaient resserrés, un pourcentage supérieur à ceux signalant des impacts négatifs.

En revanche, plus de 35 % des sondés ont déclaré que la pandémie de COVID-19 les avait éloignés de leurs voisins et amis proches. De même, ceux qui ont fait part de répercussions négatives sur leurs relations avec les membres de leurs clubs ou groupes de loisirs, ainsi qu'avec les fidèles de leur religion, sont plus nombreux que ceux signalant aucun changement significatif.

Ces changements dans les relations sociales ont également eu des répercussions sur les habitudes de consommation des Sud-Coréens. La livraison à domicile de repas arrive en tête avec près de 60 % des préférences, suivie des achats de masques, de gel hydroalcoolique et des activités de loisirs à domicile.

Le télétravail et l'enseignement en ligne ont été les principaux facteurs de ces changements. Depuis le début de l'épidémie en Corée du Sud en janvier 2020, 16,6 % des travailleurs ont travaillé à distance et plus de 90 % des élèves ont suivi des cours en ligne.

Les rassemblements publics et privés ont également diminué, tout comme les déplacements nationaux et internationaux. La participation à des événements culturels, artistiques et sportifs a chuté de deux tiers, ce qui a dégradé les conditions de vie pour 25 % des personnes interrogées, soit trois fois plus qu'auparavant.

En ce qui concerne les revenus et la dette, un nombre croissant de personnes déplorent une baisse de leurs revenus et une augmentation de leur dette. Enfin, sept Sud-Coréens sur dix préparent leur retraite, principalement par le biais de cotisations à un régime de retraite géré par l'État.

The goal of 3D human performance capture is the space-time coherent tracking of the entire human surface from different sensor types; this is a long-standing and challenging computer vision problem. Such densely tracked characters can be used in film, game, and mixed reality applications to create immersive and photo-real virtual doubles of real humans.

Previous multi-view-based approaches [11, 12, 13, 14, 19, 22, 49, 55, 59, 60, 80, 85] can capture high-quality surface details. However, they rely on impractical and expensive multicamera capture setups. To commoditize performance capture, ideally, just a single RGB camera should be necessary while still allowing users to track both the body pose and non-rigid deformations of skin and clothing. Prior monocular approaches were able to recover the pose and shape of a naked human body model [38, 39, 57], hands [10, 17, 23, 53, 82, 93, 94, 97], facial expression [41, 72, 73, 74, 77], or all of them [36, 58, 87, 98]; recovering cloth deformations remains out of their reach. Some previous work on monocular 3D human and clothes reconstruction uses volumetric [21, 95] or continuous implicit representations [65]. However, these approaches do not track space-time coherent surfaces and lack surface correspondences over time. On the other hand, template-based monocular methods [24, 25, 47, 90] can track low-frequency surface details coherently over time but cannot capture facial expressions and hand gestures. Joint capture of all aspects remains poorly studied.

To address these limitations, we present HiFECap, a novel monocular learning-based 3D human performance capture approach that jointly captures the skeletal pose, dense surface deformations, hand gestures, and facial identity and expressions. First, convolutional neural networks predict the skeletal pose and the coarse surface deformations from the segmented monocular image of the actor. High-frequency surface details are recovered by a deformation network as dense vertex displacements. These intermediate outputs are then combined in a differentiable character representation, which can be supervised with multi-view images and 3D point clouds during training. We further replace the hand and face regions of the original template with parametric hand and face models using our proposed registration strategy and drive them by predicting the parameters from images.

Have you seen the "Face on Mars"? If so, do you believe it is a natural formation or evidence of alien activity? While many people think the face is proof of extraterrestrial life, this is likely not the case. The Mars Global Surveyor, a mapping spacecraft, has passed over the area several times. However, these passes have revealed no evidence of alien civilization. This leads us to believe it is merely a natural landform.

The story began when NASA's Viking 1 spacecraft was orbiting Mars. Viking 1 was taking photos of potential landing sites for its sibling craft, Viking 2. During this mission, Viking 1 captured an image resembling a human face—an extraordinary find on planet Mars! When these images were released to the public, many believed they were evidence of life beyond Earth.

However, this might not be true. NASA suggests that the face is just a natural formation similar to buttes or mesas found on Earth. Despite considerable evidence supporting NASA's conclusion, public enthusiasm about extraterrestrial life remained high for some.

The initial pictures of the "Face on Mars" from NASA were quite unclear due to being taken through clouds by the Mars Global Surveyor. This led some people to suspect that NASA was hiding something in the fog—possibly evidence of alien life—though NASA aimed to dispel such theories.

A few years later, during a cloudless summer day in Cydonia region where this feature lies​ ,​NASA passed over and adjusted their spacecraft's position by 25 degrees to perfectly center its viewfinder​​​. They then captured an exceptional photo with maximum resolution available—a photo which clarified much confusion surrounding earlier fuzzy images

Upon analyzing these clearer photographs they realized beyond reasonable doubt: The ‘face’ had been formed naturally rather than artificially produced perhaps as speculated priorly . They subsequently released them publicly clarifying doubts among skeptics yet there remains persistent faction hoping steadfastly believing otherwise till date .

On Friday, the Chilean peso experienced gains following the approval by senators of a referendum to change the country's constitution, which dates back to the dictatorship era, set for next year. Meanwhile, other Latin American currencies remained largely stable as traders prepared for the holiday season.

The peso rose by up to 1% after Congress approved the plan to let voters decide if a new constitution is necessary—a central demand of the protests that have brought the country to a standstill since October, significantly impacting the currency.

The gains on Friday added to an improving global outlook this week, positioning the peso for its largest-ever monthly increase. A basket of Latin American currencies also seemed poised to end the year on a strong note, buoyed by the United States securing back-to-back trade deals with key partners China, Mexico, and Canada.

However, analysts noted there was little motivation for assets in the developing world to maintain their recent momentum, given the lack of a formally signed U.S.-China trade deal and British Prime Minister Boris Johnson's firm stance on Brexit negotiations. "The emerging market rally is losing some momentum," said Win Thin, head of emerging market currency strategy at Brown Brothers Harriman. "It's very quiet at our trading desk, especially with the year-end and some uncertainty ahead."

The Brazilian real remained nearly flat, despite a better-than-expected rise in the IPCA-15 consumer price index, which is seen as the official inflation forecast for Latin America’s largest economy. Mexico’s peso saw a slight increase for the second consecutive day. On Thursday, the central bank lowered its benchmark interest rate for the fourth straight time, as anticipated.

In equities trading, Brazilian shares dipped from record highs, with the largest domestic airline, Gol Linhas Aereas Inteligentes SA, declining about 1.2%.

Pérez se reunió ayer con el rector de la Universidad de Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, Rafael Robaina, para concretar varias acciones que formarán parte de un plan denominado ULPGC Campus Cero Emisiones. Este plan incluye la mejora de los enlaces por carretera, la creación de una parada de autobús preferencial y la peatonalización de una parte del Campus para el uso de patinetes y bicicletas eléctricas.

El vicepresidente del Cabildo también explicó que el plan acordado con el rector contempla tres tipos de intervenciones, algunas de las cuales ya están incluidas en los presupuestos de la corporación insular para el año 2021. Esto incluye una partida de 350.000 euros para la adquisición inicial de estos vehículos eléctricos, bicicletas y patinetes, así como para llevar a cabo el estudio de peatonalización de la parte del Campus que la Universidad considere adecuada.

El enlace de la Circunvalación con la Universidad podrá ser licitado el próximo año. Desde el área de Obras Públicas del Cabildo, se llevarán a cabo inversiones para la reordenación de la GC-3 en el acceso a la Universidad y el acondicionamiento de la carretera GC-110, dos proyectos que se encuentran actualmente en proceso de redacción, según declaró Pérez.

Estas medidas buscan solucionar los atascos que ocurren en horas punta en la rotonda que distribuye el tráfico hacia los barrios de Lomo Blanco y El Zurbarán. Sin embargo, aún no se ha definido el trazado ni la duración de los trabajos. Pérez señaló que al encargar el proyecto, se está avanzando hacia la solución, pero serán los ingenieros y técnicos del Cabildo quienes decidan la forma más conveniente de resolver este problema. Aunque no se ha establecido una fecha concreta, Pérez estimó que la obra podrá licitarse durante el año 2021.

Los problemas de tráfico en el acceso al Campus de Tafira se han producido desde la apertura de la Circunvalación, con retenciones de varios kilómetros, especialmente en las primeras horas de la mañana. Se prevé que estos problemas se intensifiquen con el funcionamiento de la última fase de la Circunvalación, que conectará Arucas con la costa de Bañaderos y aumentará el tráfico entre el norte y el sur de la isla.

Las restricciones impuestas por el coronavirus, que han reducido drásticamente la movilidad en la Circunvalación y en la propia Universidad, han aliviado los atascos desde marzo pasado, al finalizar e iniciar el curso, pero se espera que las colas regresen cuando todo vuelva a la normalidad.

La segunda acción del plan ULPGC Campus Cero Emisiones se llevará a cabo a través de la Autoridad Única del Transporte (AUT) de Gran Canaria, la empresa pública del Cabildo. Para ello, el Rectorado cederá unos terrenos frente a la biblioteca universitaria, en el centro del Campus de Tafira, para crear una parada preferente a la que llegarán todas las líneas de autobuses que circulen por la zona. Esta terminal de transporte público contará con soporte para patinetes y bicicletas eléctricas.

Se ha optado por estos vehículos en lugar de bicicletas convencionales debido a los desniveles y las complicadas pendientes entre esta parada de autobús y las diferentes facultades. Según el consejero de Obras Públicas, fue el rector Rafael Robaina quien planteó en la reunión de ayer la peatonalización de una parte de las carreteras del Campus.

**Inflation, reflation ou stagflation ?**

La crise Covid a créé les fondements d'un « grand reset » de l'inflation. La surcréation monétaire accumulée durant les confinements a permis d'éviter une grande dépression et pose les bases d'une sortie de dix ans de sous-croissance économique de la zone euro.

Pour beaucoup d'analystes moins catastrophistes, la crise Covid offre une opportunité unique pour la réémergence des pays occidentaux après 20 ans d'accaparement de la croissance mondiale par la Chine. La montée actuelle des prix est perçue comme un réajustement vers leurs niveaux d'équilibre long terme. La remise en marche des circuits de production, la relocalisation des usines vers les pays occidentaux et le réinvestissement dans les infrastructures pourront stimuler un cycle de croissance vertueux.

En revanche, certains analystes redoutent un effondrement du pouvoir d'achat dû à un retour d'une forte inflation, estimant que nous sommes au bord d'une crise systémique majeure qui remettrait en question les monnaies fiduciaires. D'autres, plus radicaux, voient le « grand reset » comme une auto-régulation inéluctable de l'espèce humaine face aux capacités limitées de notre planète.

---

**Que disent les marchés face à ces différents scénarios ?**

Les marchés financiers apportent des réponses via la valorisation des actifs, en particulier les obligations indexées sur l'inflation, l'or, le Bitcoin et les actions. 

Actuellement, on observe une stagnation relative du prix de l'or et une hausse continue des actions, ce qui pourrait être interprété comme une réponse négative des marchés aux théories de l'effondrement. Par ailleurs, l'évolution des taux réels, en particulier long terme, est un autre indicateur fondamental. Depuis 10 ans, les taux réels sont historiquement bas, ce qui pourrait valider les hypothèses de décroissance à long terme.

---

**Comment se protéger de l'inflation ?**

Les obligations indexées sur l'inflation semblent offrir une protection contre l'inflation, car leur remboursement est indexé sur l'indice des prix à la consommation. Cependant, elles présentent des taux réels négatifs, reflétant les taux réels négatifs de la BCE. Ces taux réels sont surprenants historiquement, surtout à long terme, et semblent indiquer une anticipation d'une inflation maîtrisée à moyen terme.
