Medical image segmentation (MIS) aims to pixel-wise delineate the targets of interest in medical images, serving as the foundational step in numerous medical image analysis pipelines. Automatic MIS has received significant attention, with deep learning (DL) showcasing remarkable success across a wide range of tasks. The success of DL often hinges on the availability of abundant annotated data. However, in the medical domain, high annotation costs lead to data scarcity, posing a significant challenge that hampers model performance. An MIS dataset typically contains only a limited number of data samples, ranging from tens to hundreds. When trained on such a small dataset, the model is at risk of learning limited knowledge and overfitting the training data, resulting in poor generalization performance when applied to real-world applications.

Self-supervised learning (SSL) offers a promising solution to address data scarcity by introducing auxiliary tasks to facilitate the segmentation task. By tackling auxiliary tasks, the model gains additional knowledge that can be transferred to enhance its understanding and improve generalization performance. These auxiliary tasks can be created based on the segmentation dataset in various ways. They can rely solely on the images by utilizing unsupervised tasks like auto-encoding and contrastive learning. Alternatively, auxiliary tasks can be based on the segmentation annotations, leading to tasks such as surface distance map prediction and contour prediction, which can be seen as alternative approaches to the segmentation task. Utilizing multiple auxiliary tasks with different mechanisms allows for the transfer of diverse knowledge, enhancing performance from various perspectives.

Existing methods commonly employ a multi-task learning framework and joint training paradigm to leverage multiple auxiliary tasks simultaneously. However, this approach may face challenges when dealing with heterogeneous auxiliary tasks with distinct formulations and learning objectives. In such cases, knowledge acquired from different auxiliary tasks may interfere with each other, impacting the performance of the target task. To address this issue, a more effective strategy involves pre-training the model on auxiliary tasks and fine-tuning it on the segmentation task, enabling better knowledge transfer and overall performance improvement.

To address these challenges, we propose a two-stage training method to harness multiple auxiliary tasks effectively. In the first stage, the target segmentation task is co-solved independently with each auxiliary task in both joint training and pre-training modes. The best model is then selected based on validation performance, resulting in elite segmentation models with unique knowledge from each auxiliary task. In the second stage, we employ an ensemble knowledge distillation method to combine the knowledge obtained from the models into a single, more powerful model for inference. Our method integrates five representative auxiliary tasks, including three unsupervised tasks (Rubik's Cube, MoCo-v3, and VICReg) and two surface distance prediction tasks created from segmentation annotations. These tasks are used to train U-Net models on an X-ray pneumothorax segmentation dataset (SIIM-ACR Pneumothorax Segmentation Challenge). Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in leveraging multiple auxiliary tasks to enhance segmentation performance.

A new software has been developed that enhances the accuracy of perceiving the emotions of others. This innovative technology holds promising applications across various industries. Its use in reading the emotional expressions of students in a classroom is particularly valuable, as it can make learning more engaging, improve accuracy, and facilitate better communication between humans and computers.

Incorporating the Facial Action Coding System (FACS) in a learning environment could significantly enhance the educational experience. By recognizing when a student is confused or bored, classroom computers can make learning more engaging. This same technology can also make computer-animated faces more expressive, benefiting applications in video games or virtual surgeries. Dr. Huang states, "Most human communication is nonverbal, including emotional communication, so computers need to understand that, too."

This implies that computers must be adept at interpreting nonverbal communication.

In addition to making learning more engaging, the Facial Action Coding System is highly accurate. The process begins with the computer constructing a 3D model of the face, where all 44 major muscles must mimic the movements of human muscles. Dr. Paul Ekman classified six basic emotions, associating each with characteristic facial muscle movements. Dr. Huang notes that even artists, such as Leonardo da Vinci, studied human anatomy to paint facial muscles precisely, conveying specific emotions.

Beyond its accuracy, the FACS fosters new ways for humans and computers to communicate. It tracks facial movements by analyzing the different units, allowing the software to identify mixed emotions.

Miles de parisinos y turistas se reunieron esta noche en los alrededores de Notre Dame, en París, para realizar otra vigilia tras el incendio que devastó la emblemática torre y gran parte del techo de la catedral.

Los lugareños se congregaron en la iglesia de Saint-Sulpice, desde donde caminaron hacia la icónica catedral, entonando himnos religiosos a lo largo del trayecto. La iglesia de Saint-Sulpice, construida en el siglo XVII y de gran importancia para el catolicismo francés, también sufrió un incendio el mes pasado, aunque no resultó tan dañada como Notre Dame.

"Ayer pensamos que toda la catedral se derrumbaría. Sin embargo, esta mañana todavía está de pie, valiente, a pesar de todo", comentó Marie Aimée, una de las religiosas presentes en la vigilia. Frente al monumento devastado por las llamas, algunos se arrodillaron y unieron sus manos en súplicas silenciosas. Otros cantaron con la mirada fija en un cielo anaranjado, cubierto por un denso humo.

Decenas de personas, que se convocaron espontáneamente, cantaron himnos a capela y, por momentos, fueron acompañados por dos violines. La catedral de Notre Dame también atrajo a Quentin Salardaine, un médico de París de 25 años, mientras las llamas iluminaban la noche.

"Creo que este edificio es un símbolo de París, sin importar si eres católico o no. Yo no lo soy", dijo. "Estoy aquí porque no podía quedarme en casa sabiendo lo que estaba sucediendo y que hay gente reunida entonando himnos religiosos".

El lunes por la noche, cientos e incluso miles de personas se alinearon a lo largo del río Sena, alrededor de la pequeña Isla de la Cité, que alberga a la catedral de Notre Dame, observando incrédulos y horrorizados cómo las llamas se propagaban por el techo y la parte posterior de la estructura. La aguja ardió y se desplomó.

El jefe de bomberos de París informó que las brigadas tuvieron dificultades para contener el incendio, que se extendió al exterior de madera de la iglesia y a una de sus distintivas torres. Los chorros de agua de las mangueras azotaron la fachada de Notre Dame. Incluso después de que los bomberos comenzaron a controlar el incendio, aún se podían ver algunas llamas asomándose por la cuenca sur, donde solía estar el techo.

Las luces que pasaban frente a las ventanas delanteras parecían ser de los investigadores. Afuera de Saint-Julien-le-Pauvre, más personas seguían uniéndose al coro improvisado. Blandine Bouret, de 68 años, dijo que conocía bien el vecindario. Su abuelo tenía una tienda a una calle de la catedral y su padre tenía un negocio cerca de allí. "Es terrible, es catastrófico.

**Introduction to Differential Privacy and Its Challenges**

Privacy in the digital economy is critical, particularly for end-users who share their personal data [1]. Differential privacy (DP) is the de-facto standard for privacy protection; however, it often results in diminished data utility. This trade-off between privacy and utility is a long-standing issue in differential privacy.

**Shuffle Model: Bridging Privacy and Utility**

An intermediate paradigm between the central and local models of DP, known as the shuffle model [2], has recently gained popularity. Initially, the shuffle model uses a local mechanism to perturb data individually, similar to the local model of DP. After this local sanitization, a shuffler uniformly permutes the noisy data to unlink them from the corresponding data providers. This approach allows the shuffle model to achieve a DP guarantee using less noise than the local model, thus providing better utility while retaining privacy. Consequently, the shuffle model offers an advantage in managing the trade-off between privacy and utility within the digital economy.

**Analytical Exploration of the Shuffle Model**

The privacy guarantees provided by the shuffle model have been rigorously studied, with various analytical and numerical results emerging. Analytical bounds offer a concrete basis for reasoning and mathematical analysis of properties like the privacy-utility trade-off. However, most analytical bounds for the shuffle model found in the literature are not tight. In this paper, we bridge this gap by deriving tight necessary and sufficient conditions for the tightest (ǫ, δ)-bounds of the DP guarantee provided by the shuffle model with the k-randomized response (k-RR) local mechanism.

**Framework for Tight Privacy Guarantees**

We incorporate the concept of privacy blankets introduced by Balle et al. in [3] and the idea of (ǫ, δ)-adaptive differential privacy (ADP) proposed by Sommer et al. in [4]. Definition 1.1 outlines differential privacy [5, 6], while Definition 1.2 details adaptive differential privacy (ADP). These definitions provide the foundation for our theoretical analysis.

**Analysis of Privacy Blanket Tightness**

Balle et al. in [3] introduced privacy blankets for shuffle models, deriving privacy estimates in terms of (ǫ, δ)-DP. However, they did not establish a theoretical condition for ensuring the tightness of these privacy blankets. In contrast, Sommer et al. [4] provided an explicit condition for a tight (ǫ, δ)-ADP, crucial for comparing utilities between shuffle models and other privacy mechanisms. We derive necessary and sufficient conditions to ensure a tight privacy blanket for the shuffle model with the k-RR mechanism as the local randomizer. By aligning these conditions with Lemma 5 of [4], we ensure a tight (ǫ, δ)-DP guarantee for the shuffle model.

**Mathematical Conditions and Critical Polynomial Analysis**

For effective privacy-utility analysis, we identify conditions under which the result of Balle et al. [3] ensures a tight differential privacy guarantee. We explore two cases from Lemma 5 [4] for different privacy parameters and derive critical polynomials to aid in this analysis. Definitions 2.1 and 2.2 introduce the critical polynomial and critical equation, providing the mathematical groundwork for Theorems 2.1 and 2.2, which confirm asymptotic tightness.

**Discussion and Future Work**

This work offers analytical insights into the conditions for obtaining optimal privacy guarantees for shuffle models using k-RR local randomizers. Exploring the space of tight DP guarantees for shuffle models could lead to significant advancements in privacy-preserving data analysis by optimizing the utility for given privacy levels. Future research will explore generalized shuffle models with various local randomizers and their application in digital markets, potentially influencing data pricing mechanisms based on privacy amplification by shuffling [9, 10].

Una vendedora ambulante de la tercera edad trabaja este miércoles con tapabocas en la Calle Peatonal de Tegucigalpa, Honduras. 

Tegucigalpa, 3 de junio (EFE). Las muertes violentas han disminuido un 22 % en Honduras, sin embargo, las denuncias por violencia machista han aumentado un 4,1 % en medio de la emergencia por la pandemia de COVID-19, según alertó este miércoles el Observatorio de la Violencia de la Universidad Nacional Autónoma del país centroamericano. 

Honduras ha sido considerado uno de los países más violentos del mundo debido a las altas tasas de muertes violentas, a pesar de no estar en guerra. En los últimos años, ha logrado reducir la tasa de homicidios de 85,5 por cada 100.000 habitantes en 2012 a 44,2 en 2019. 

Entre enero y mayo de este año se registraron 1.182 asesinatos en Honduras, 334 menos (22 %) en comparación con los 1.516 reportados en el mismo periodo de 2019, en parte, debido a la crisis provocada por el coronavirus, según indicó en entrevista con Efe la directora del Observatorio de la Violencia, Migdonia Ayestas. 

"Hay un promedio de 7 homicidios diarios, la mayoría derivados de ajustes de cuentas", subrayó Ayestas, quien mencionó que la mayoría de las muertes violentas ocurren con armas de fuego y armas blancas. 

El descenso no ha sido tan evidente a partir de la segunda quincena de marzo, a pesar de que el presidente de Honduras, Juan Orlando Hernández, decretó un toque de queda que se ha extendido hasta el próximo domingo, y ordenó el cierre de fronteras, la suspensión del transporte público y de centros educativos. Estas medidas se establecieron con el objetivo de contener la expansión del coronavirus después de que se detectaran los primeros tres casos de la enfermedad en Honduras el 11 de marzo. 

Durante el periodo entre el 15 de marzo y mayo, se reportaron 443 homicidios en el país, lo que representa un 41,2 % menos en comparación con las 755 muertes violentas del mismo periodo de 2019, según cifras del Observatorio de la Violencia.

Venus, which may have once harbored oceans and the potential for life, presents a compelling case for further exploration, even as the planet's volatile geology and weather pose significant challenges for spacecraft and probes.

In the author's assessment, Venus, with its similarities and striking differences compared to Earth, offers a unique opportunity for scientific inquiry and the possibility of future planetary missions. As the author eloquently argues, the study and exploration of Venus, the Earth's twin, hold the key to unlocking the mysteries of our neighboring planet, and the potential for groundbreaking discoveries that could reshape our understanding of the solar system.

Juan Carlos de la Cruz, secretario general de CCOO en el Metro de Madrid, lamenta profundamente la pérdida de Santos González, miembro afiliado a este sindicato, quien ha dedicado más de 43 años de su vida laboral a la empresa.

"En este día nos despedimos de otro gran compañero cuyos pulmones se vieron gravemente afectados por el amianto y el cáncer que desarrolló, por lo que ya se encontraba en tratamiento", expresó el representante de CCOO. Santos González fue el primer trabajador del Metro al que se le diagnosticó la enfermedad profesional el 27 de abril de 2018 y testificó ante la comisión de investigación sobre el amianto de la Asamblea de Madrid, detallando cómo había manipulado y estado expuesto al amianto durante sus labores en el Metro de Madrid.

Data science is still a nascent and emerging discipline, which makes it challenging for analysts to learn and keep up with new tools and techniques. There is already a dizzying array of libraries, such as Scikit-Learn, Pandas, and TensorFlow, and best practices and workflows change often. Furthermore, few standardized methods exist for data analysis: many times, the exact data transformations, computations, and analyses needed depend on the data, task, and user. This means that cookbook methods or simple workflow templates are insufficient to teach fledgling analysts how to tackle realistic and ever-changing data science problems.

In response, we present LODESTAR, an interactive and visual sandbox environment for independent learning of new data analysis methods and best practices in data science. Our aim in developing Lodestar is to simplify the process of finding and experimenting with new analysis methods by providing automated, data-driven recommendations. We want Lodestar to be a self-contained environment for rapid learning and iteration, where everything the user needs to infer the function and purpose of an analysis step is available in one place.

The Lodestar system uses a computational notebook interface (similar to a Jupyter notebook) showing a sequence of analysis steps in the form of Python code cells, but enables the user to initially select from and interact with self-contained code cells without having to write any code. The user merely selects which data frame to analyze, and the system displays a ranked list of recommendations of analysis steps to be executed on that data. Each analysis step is represented by an interactive visualization in the notebook interface, giving the user insights into its output and behavior. Furthermore, users can view the corresponding code for any analysis step, and even export the resulting notebook from Lodestar, providing flexibility in how users learn from and interact with Lodestar's analysis recommendations.

Lodestar provides recommendations for the user's next analysis step based on the current state of the analysis and the dataset being analyzed. Recommended analysis steps and workflows are derived from two sources representing current best practices in data science: existing data science tutorials from online academies and training materials (i.e., an expert recommendation), and common analysis patterns mined from a large corpus of publicly available Jupyter notebooks (i.e., a crowd recommendation). The code cells extracted from each source are manually curated, then programmatically clustered into synonymous analysis steps, and inserted into a large directed graph of connected cells representing common analysis workflows. The Lodestar recommendation engine can then identify and rank the most relevant analysis steps given a specific position in the graph.

We developed Lodestar using an iterative design process. We used early feedback from six participants to improve the interface design. Our findings show that key Lodestar interactive features, such as automated recommendations, a visualization of the full analysis workflow, a code review pane for suggested analysis steps, and export support for Jupyter Notebooks, provide significant value to those who are learning data science.

In this work, we make the following contributions: a holistic recommendation process involving two sources of data analysis practice: crowd-based and expert-based; a sandbox interface design integrating visualizations, interactions, and code to facilitate learning about new data analysis techniques; results from a formative study evaluating the Lodestar design; and a unique data analysis architecture that integrates a recommender system with a computational notebook interface. All our materials, including source code, documentation, and study results, have been made available on the following OSF page: https://osf.io/pztva/

El secretario general de las Naciones Unidas, Antonio Gutérres, pidió hoy a todas las partes del conflicto en Siria "que respeten la ley internacional y protejan a los civiles", y cumplan los acuerdos de alto el fuego en las zonas controladas por la oposición en Idlib, Alepo y Hama.

La ONU indicó que al menos 27 civiles, incluidas muchas mujeres y niños, perdieron la vida en los últimos nueve días por el conflicto armado en Siria, donde el gobierno y sus aliados intentan recuperar los últimos bastiones bajo control de la oposición y grupos yihadistas en Hama e Idlib.

Según la Oficina de Derechos Humanos de la ONU, las fuerzas del gobierno sirio han intensificado los ataques en la zona desmilitarizada y se prevé una contraofensiva de los grupos rebeldes, con riesgo de que resurja el conflicto. "Esta campaña militar puede llevar a una respuesta de otros grupos armados, incluido Hayat Tahrir al Sham, un grupo afiliado a Al Qaeda, creando una situación inestable que podría provocar más violencia y desplazamientos", declaró a la prensa la portavoz, Ravina Shamdasani, en Ginebra.

La escalada en los ataques del gobierno y sus fuerzas aliadas en Hama e Idlib, en el noroeste de Siria, está poniendo en grave peligro a miles de civiles, y ha dejado cientos de víctimas y más de 150 mil desplazados, precisó el organismo.

美银美林(BAC.N)的一项调查显示，亚太区企业CFO（首席财务官）对今年的商业景气持乐观态度，他们的主要担忧集中在中国经济增速的放缓，而非美国退出量化宽松政策。美银美林委托经济学人信息社（EIU）在今年1月对亚太区639名CFO进行了调查，其中76%的受访者预计2014年的收入将会增加，高于去年的72%。然而，只有60%预期盈利会上升，低于去年的65%。

美银美林亚太区企业银行主管冼伟诚在记者会上表示，尽管CFO对今年的商业环境普遍持乐观看法，但他们也担心劳动、原材料和信贷等成本的上升可能会对边际利润带来压力。企业已通过对日圆和美元的敞口进行充分对冲来管理风险。

调查结果显示，企业有信心通过开发新市场和客户获取增长，而不是依赖并购。这一策略的重点已从以往倚重中国相关并购转向东南亚市场，包括越南、缅甸、老挝、柬埔寨等新兴市场以及印度。冼伟诚指出：“企业在东南亚市场建立据地的风险较少，而在中国则需面对银行体系等金融风险。”调查中，62%的受访者今年没有计划参与并购。

该项调查覆盖了亚太区12个经济体，包括澳洲、中国、香港、印度、印尼、日本、马来西亚等。受访企业中一半为跨国企业，另一半为本地企业，行业涵盖银行、电讯、地产、医疗、金属矿业、能源及制造业。接近六成的受访者所在企业的年度收入达到10亿美元或以上。

今年主要的金融市场风险被认为是货币汇率波动（35%）、流动性（30%）和利率变化（20%），最后是交易对手风险（15%）。尽管利润存在不确定性，银行贷款仍是企业融资的首选，57%的CFO预期会利用银行贷款支持经营，这一比例高于去年调查时的25%。在各行业中，以制造业对银行贷款的需求最大，其次是医药和金属与矿业。

The average time to identify and contain a security breach is alarmingly long at 323 days, with an average cost of $4.35 million, as reported in IBM's Cost of a Data Breach Report 2022 [48]. Despite significant investments in intrusion detection systems over the past decade, this issue underscores the urgent need for more effective intrusion detection techniques capable of identifying unauthorized interactions within compromised systems.

One promising solution to this challenge is the use of honeypots, which are powerful cybersecurity tools designed to mimic real devices or resources. Honeypots are of no legitimate use to authorized users, making them more attractive to intruders who are probing a system. They can be closely monitored for access or other forms of interaction, providing reliable indicators of a breach. More advanced honeypots allow for deeper engagement, potentially revealing valuable intelligence regarding an intruder's intent, tools, or malicious payloads [22]. Organizations such as Attivo, Countercraft, Thinkst, and Penten are actively researching and commercializing honeypots and related cyber deception technologies.

A particularly effective type of honeypot is the honeyfile, which consists of fake documents designed to attract unauthorized users. Given that documents are ubiquitous and often contain sensitive information such as intellectual property and financial data, honeyfiles can be easily deployed and crafted to reflect topics relevant to suspected threats [47, 57]. By placing honeyfiles in document repositories or file systems, organizations can monitor them for access or exfiltration, serving as a breach detection mechanism. Additionally, the choice of topics or search terms used by adversaries can provide insights into their intent and interests [53]. The key to successful honeyfile implementation lies in the realism of both the appearance and content of the documents.

**Ananda Developments PLC Shareholder Update (11 November 2021)**

**Introduction**
Ananda Developments PLC ("Ananda" or the "Company") is a UK-listed medical cannabis company with the ambition to grow and provide carbon-neutral, consistent, high-quality medical cannabis for both the UK and international markets. The UK medical cannabis market is predicted to be worth £450m by 2025, and the European market is expected to reach USD 4.2bn by 2027.

**UK Medical Cannabis Market**
The UK has approximately 9,500 medical cannabis patients, with predictions from Maple Tree Consultants suggesting that this number will rise to about 25,000 by the end of 2022. The Directors of Ananda are optimistic about the industry's potential and are encouraged by the growing acceptance and understanding of medical cannabis as an effective treatment for various health conditions.

**Ananda's Plan**
Ananda plans to conduct a medical cannabis breeding and stabilisation programme aimed at creating a library of proprietary strains. These strains will be developed to thrive in local growing conditions and to be effective in treating conditions such as epilepsy, neuropathic pain, scleroderma, and Parkinson’s disease. Subject to further licensing from the Home Office, these strains will eventually be used for commercial production. The Directors believe that growing in natural conditions without artificial light or heat, based on their partner JEPCO's experience, will result in superior medical cannabis flowers and lower capital and operational expenditures.

**CEO's Perspective**
Melissa Sturgess, Ananda's CEO, commented on the company's strategy compared to North American models. She noted the financial pressures associated with high capital and operating costs in large facilities and highlighted Ananda's focus on a low-capital, low-operating cost model. This approach focuses on patient demand and aims to deliver superior medicines with strong margins.

**Research Facility Construction**
Since the update on 6 October 2021, the construction of the medical cannabis research growing facility in the UK by Ananda's 50%-owned subsidiary, DJT Plants Limited, has been progressing on schedule. The construction of the research facility is nearly complete, with security fencing, a completed reservoir, and finished growing rooms. Dr. Hadar Less, the project's lead geneticist, recently finalized lab requirements and plant nursery details on-site.

**Sale of Shareholding in Liberty Herbal Technologies Limited**
Ananda has sold its holding of 1,642,857 ordinary shares in Liberty Herbal Technologies Limited (LHT) for £100,000 in cash. The proceeds from this sale will support the ongoing construction, staffing, and operations at the medical cannabis research facility. As announced on 8 June 2021, Ananda is in the process of acquiring the remaining 50% of DJT Plants that it does not already own.

El gobierno provincial pretende avanzar con la derogación o suspensión por un año de la Ley de Enganche. En una entrevista, Alberto Fernández mencionó que gobernadores le habían planteado dificultades para afrontar incrementos salariales para judiciales fijados por la Corte Suprema de Justicia. La ley en cuestión es una especie de paritaria para el Poder Judicial, estableciendo asignaciones remunerativas y bonificaciones por antigüedad. La suspensión de la ley plantea interrogantes sobre cómo proceder si la Corte otorga un incremento durante ese periodo.

La Ley de Enganche antes de la 10.068 permitía a los vocales negociar incrementos salariales con el Poder Ejecutivo, similar a otros sectores estatales. La normativa actual también afecta asignaciones de representación y gobierno, así como bonificaciones por antigüedad. La iniciativa del Poder Ejecutivo busca un reacomodamiento de política salarial con foco en la equidad, mientras que desde el Poder Judicial se plantea la cuestión de los salarios en entes públicos y empresas estatales descentralizadas.

En el contexto de estas discusiones, surge la incertidumbre sobre el impacto de suspender la Ley de Enganche y cómo se aplicarían los incrementos salariales en caso de levantar la suspensión. Los actores involucrados acordaron sentarse a dialogar y buscar soluciones en medio de un escenario complejo en el que la equidad salarial y la sostenibilidad económica son temas de preocupación para todas las partes interesadas.

El número de nacimientos en España mantiene una tendencia a la baja desde hace varios años. Sin embargo, el descenso se ha acentuado nueve meses después del confinamiento durante el primer estado de alarma por el COVID-19, que comenzó el 15 de marzo de 2020. En noviembre de 2020, la tasa interanual de nacimientos en España se redujo más de un 10%, alcanzando descensos superiores al 20% en diciembre de 2020 y en enero de 2021, según las estimaciones del INE.

En concreto, en el mes de diciembre de 2020 nacieron 23.226 niños, lo que supuso un 20,4% menos que en el mismo mes de 2019 y el valor mínimo en un mes desde que comenzó la serie estadística del INE en 1941. En enero de 2021, el número de nacimientos repuntó ligeramente hasta los 24.061, aunque esta cifra fue un 20% inferior a la del mismo mes del año anterior.

En Salamanca, enero de 2021 registró la cifra más baja de nacimientos de los últimos años, con solo 103 bebés, 52 menos que en enero de 2020, cuando nacieron 155 niños. Este descenso se produjo de manera generalizada entre enero y abril de 2021, con 509 bebés nacidos, frente a los 589 que nacieron en la provincia de Salamanca en el mismo periodo de 2020. 

Al contundente descenso de enero se sumaron febrero, con 115 nacimientos (138 en el mismo mes del año anterior); marzo, con 126 nacimientos frente a 154; y abril, con 165 nacimientos comparados con los 142 de 2020.

La significativa caída de nacimientos en enero en Salamanca fue general en todas las comunidades autónomas respecto al mismo mes del año pasado. Mientras que la media nacional refleja una caída del 20%, las mayores disminuciones se dieron en Cantabria (–27,9%), el Principado de Asturias (–24,7%) y la Comunidad Valenciana (–24,5%), además de en las ciudades autónomas de Ceuta y Melilla. También en Castilla y León los nacimientos bajaron por encima de la media nacional, con un 22% menos. Por el contrario, los descensos menos acusados se registraron en La Rioja (–2,6%), Aragón (–10,7%) y la Comunidad Foral de Navarra (–12,9%).

MANSFIELD - The city has to spend more than a half-million dollars in federal funds by May 2, or risk losing them. That's according to Tracy Bond, community development director, who informed Mansfield City Council's finance committee of the news Tuesday. The money comes from two programs — Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) and HOME Investment Partnerships — run by the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD). They provide funding to improve or demolish houses and to support community programs. The large pot of unspent money is left over from previous HUD grant cycles, according to Bond.

Councilmen Cliff Mears, Jon Van Harlingen, and Walden "Butch" Jefferson held a finance committee meeting Tuesday to discuss how to spend federal funds. City Engineer Bob Bianchi briefed committee members on upcoming projects in his department. Legislation to approve $1.3 million for the final design of the North Lake Park dry dam, also called the Touby Run Flood Hazard Mitigation Project, may come before council next year. The city decided to pump the brakes on the dry dam's design in April partly to see if revenue from the water meter replacement project could help pay for the project. Other future projects include security upgrades to the city's wastewater treatment plant, work to prevent seepage at the Clear Fork Reservoir, and the replacement bridge at North Lake Park.

Bond said a draft of a "substantial amendment" to the city's consolidated plan for spending federal dollars will be submitted to council for approval and then sent to HUD. Bond, who became director in September 2018, said anywhere from $200,000 to $300,000 has been committed but not yet spent on emergency home repairs. Repair to sidewalks and equipment upgrades in the parks and recreation department are on her radar, and Bond said she is reaching out to other departments to see how the money could be spread out. Finance Director Linn Steward cautioned that the city's general fund would have to pay the difference if projects funded by the HUD dollars aren't complete by May 2. Van Harlingen echoed Steward's comments. "We're down to the wire here," he said.

"If we get a project on the table, a contract going, and HUD jerks the funds, that is a very serious concern of mine." The community development director also informed members of council's finance committee — Van Harlingen, 4th Ward Councilman Walden "Butch" Jefferson, and At-Large Councilman Cliff Mears — that leftover money must be spent before any "new" federal money can be spent on what the city has coined the St. Pete's/OhioHealth Mansfield Hospital district. 路透东京9月6日 - 下周，日本经济复苏的强劲证据预计将继续显现，尤其是第二季国内生产总值(GDP)的上修。这些数据支持了日本首相安倍晋三着手明年消费税调高计划的可能性。

路透调查显示，日本4-6月GDP环比年率修正后预计为增长3.7%，远高于初值的增长2.6%，这主要是因为资本支出增幅超乎原先预期。周日2350GMT时，GDP修正值将公布，周一的数据将进一步支持安倍通货再膨胀政策的效应正在扩大。企业对业务前景更有信心，开始在薪资和设备方面增加支出。

政府已将第二季GDP修正值，列为决定是否按计划调高消费税的关键因素。当前计划是到明年4月将消费税率从5%提高到8%，并在2015年10月进一步提高到10%。这也让政府有更多的筹码反击外界对加税的抨击声浪，抨击者呼吁延后加税或缩减幅度，因担心会使经济偏离复苏轨道。

“资本支出的回升将使得(加税)计划的调整更说不过去，”法国巴黎银行东京首席经济分析师河野龙太郎表示。他补充道，“除非从现在到做出决定的这段期间有什么意外发生，消费税将如期调升，预计会在9月底至10月初做出决定。”

Ralph Haupter es un todoterreno de la tecnología y un trotamundos de los negocios. Este alemán, formado en Stuttgart, trabajó un par de años en IBM a principios de los 2000, pero no tardó mucho en unirse a las filas de un coloso llamado Microsoft. Sus primeros cargos de responsabilidad en la casa norteamericana estuvieron ligados al canal de distribución en el país germano. Luego llegó el liderazgo operativo de la casa en Alemania y, después, el de consejero delegado de Microsoft en el país.

Ahí es cuando llega su instinto de trotamundos: durante siete años cambió de continente para coordinar los negocios de la empresa en China y, posteriormente, en toda Asia. Aunque el sabor a hogar tira mucho y, en abril de 2020, Haupter volvió a hacer las maletas para instalarse otra vez en el Viejo Continente. Esta vez, eso sí, como máximo responsable de Microsoft en toda Europa, Oriente Medio y África.

En un momento clave para el proceso de transformación digital europeo y con la oportunidad del siglo a la vuelta de la esquina, en D+I hablamos con Ralph Haupter. Estas son sus palabras:

**Vuelta a Europa y diferencias con Asia**

Has vuelto a Europa después de haber liderado la estrategia de Microsoft en Asia los últimos años. En abril de 2020 asumiste tu actual cargo, justo al principio de la pandemia. ¿Cómo ha sido esta vuelta a casa? ¿Cómo ves de diferente la región tras tu periplo asiático?

Literalmente, he estado los últimos 20 años viajando por todo el mundo, primero diez años en Asia, cinco de los cuáles en la Gran China, y luego otros cinco estableciendo nuestras operaciones en la región. Es emocionante volver a casa, reaprendiendo y mirando la economía. La tendencia de la digitalización es masiva y tenemos la perspectiva de que la mayor parte de nuestro PIB tendrá una huella digital en una forma u otra. Tenemos una gran oportunidad para seguir creciendo.

Veo grandes diferencias entre Europa y el mercado asiático. La innovación aquí es muy intencional, basada en la construcción de ecosistemas y aspectos como la sostenibilidad. En muchos países asiáticos, especialmente del sudeste de la región o China, se basan en la disrupción y la innovación. Aquí, en cambio, la transformación digital va de cambiar los métodos y procesos de las empresas gracias a la digitalización y al empoderamiento de los trabajadores.

The sitting room was extravagantly adorned with what appeared to be leather seats, possibly imported. Frank couldn't help but think the entire room was likely imported, possibly modeled after a European castle. Though not a man of means, Frank wore the best suit he could afford. An older gentleman, exuding an air of long-suffering patience and clad in a much pricier suit, opened a pair of double doors, appraised Frank, and then stood aside as the elegant Ms. Felix entered. She didn't just walk in; she sauntered in, accentuating what little she was wearing.

Seated across from Frank, she crossed her legs and smiled. "You, um..."

The older man interjected in a cultured voice, "Mr. Frank Greene."

"Right, Frank. So, Frank, your task here is to make me a 'better person'." She gestured with air quotes around 'better person'.

"Um, Ms. Felix, I haven't accepted the position yet. What do you mean by 'better person'?" 

Rolling her eyes and slouching in the chair, she continued, "Well, dear old granddad thinks I'm a disgrace. He believes I need to improve myself if I want to inherit anything. I have no idea what that entails, so I'm hiring someone to do it for me."

The Felix family had been in and out of the news for decades, mainly for their remarkable financial success across various business ventures. However, recently, the limelight had shifted to the exploits of the woman sitting in front of Frank, who seemed determined to explore every possible human excess.

"So, how am I supposed to achieve that?" Frank inquired.

After a brief silence, she replied, "Look, Frank, I need to shape up to get my inheritance, and your job is to make it happen. If I knew how to do that, I wouldn't need someone like you, would I?"

Frank pondered her words until she interrupted, "Well, Frank, you get it, right? I have a party to attend." With that, she began to rise.

Rising before her, Frank stated, "I'll do it, but I have a few conditions."

Relaxing back with an amused look, she responded, "Oh really? You can't sleep with me. Discuss payment with him," she motioned towards the well-dressed man, "and what else?"

Frank clarified, "That's not what I meant. Apart from salary negotiations, if I'm going to help you become a better person, you must heed my advice."

Dismissively, she waved her hand and retorted as she stood, "Yeah, yeah, talk all night, undivided attention. Gotta run."

"That's not what I mean either. If you want my help, you must truly listen."

"Boring! I'm not intoxicated enough for this. Get to the point," she interrupted.

"You need to listen and take action.

شركة الحديد والصلب: الخردة ثروة قومية وقرار تصديرها كارثي

أفادت الشركة الليبية للحديد والصلب بأن قرار وزير الاقتصاد والتجارة في حكومة الوحدة الوطنية رقم 90 لسنة 2021، الذي يسمح باستمرار تصدير الخردة، يؤدي إلى أضرار وانعكاسات سلبية. وأشارت الشركة في بيان قرأته "الساعة 24" إلى أن موضوع تصدير الخردة الحديدية يُعتبر من القضايا الساخنة التي تُتداول في أروقة وزارة الاقتصاد والتجارة الليبية منذ عقود، ويطمح إليه العديد من الشخصيات المتنفذة. كانت هناك محاولات وضغوطات عديدة على الوزارات المتعاقبة خلال العشرين سنة الماضية.

وأوضح بيان الشركة، الرائدة في صناعة الحديد والصلب في ليبيا، أن دراسات الجدوى الاقتصادية لهذه الصناعة في السبعينيات أكدت أهمية استخدام نسبة تتراوح بين 20-25% من المواد الخام من الخردة المحلية بأسعار منخفضة مقارنة بخامات الحديد المستوردة، مما يسهم في تخفيض كلفة الإنتاج. وحذر البيان من أن عدم استخدام هذه النسبة أو ارتفاع أسعار الخردة سيؤدي إلى تأثيرات سلبية على تكاليف الإنتاج وبالتالي على أسعار منتجات الصلب في السوق المحلية.

وأضاف البيان أن فتح باب التصدير يؤدي إلى ارتفاع أسعار الخردة الحديدية، وسيؤدي كذلك إلى تصدير الخردة عالية الجودة وحرمان المصانع المحلية منها، كما حدث سابقًا عندما كان باب التصدير مفتوحًا، مما أبقى في السوق الليبية خردة خفيفة وسيئة يصعب على التجار تصديرها.

وأشار البيان إلى أن خطة الإنتاج لعام 2021 أخذت في الاعتبار ارتفاع الأسعار العالمية لخامات الحديد، مما دفع الشركة إلى استخدام نسب عالية من الخردة وصلت إلى 40٪ لتقليل كلفة الإنتاج والاعتماد على الخامات المحلية.

川普在白宫记者会上表示，不想与北京谈论华为，称中国正经历50多年以来最糟糕的时期，「已经失去控制」，一定想要达成协议，「如果他们不想要，那也没关系。」他在推特上发文提到，不愿让国内经济体系继续帮助其他国家获利，「美国已经被关税恐怖主义（Tariff Terrorism）迫害50年。」

川普说，如果什么事都不做，美股可能会比现在还要高上1万点，但是「对我而言，这比经济更重要，我们必须和中国谈谈。」他认为，中国已经失去300万工作机会，产业供应链也承受绝对巨大的破坏，当局「失去控制」，「我们来看看将会发生什么事情，如果他们想要达成协议，那就会达成协议。如果不想要，那也没关系。」

川普3日在贴文中写道，「我们不能让经营整体经济的系统为其他国家获利，况且对方还向我们长期征收高额关税。不要逃避现实了。美国已经被关税恐怖主义迫害50年。但是，真正的协议还是可以达成。」

川普在记者会上表示，华为是军方和情报单位的一大忧虑，基于国家安全考量，不会和对方做生意，「华为现在已经不是我们想要讨论，或现在想要谈论的角色。」他也提到，共和党籍议员戴恩斯（Steve Daines）和珀杜（David Perdue）近日与中国国务院副总理刘鹤会面，传递「强烈的讯息」，「我们非常认真地给予支持，不是在玩游戏。」

根据了解，美国5月基于国安考量，将华为列入商务部「实体清单」（Entity List），企业如果没有获得特别的证照许可，不得将所生产的零件卖给「黑名单」上的公司。华盛顿与北京后来达成协议，美国愿意松绑对于华为的限制与禁令，但是中国必须购买美国农产品。

I believe that facial recognition technology is acceptable in some contexts. One reason I'm not entirely opposed to it is that it could assist individuals pursuing careers where understanding body language is crucial. However, my reservations stem from the fact that I find it unsettling. I don't think a computer should be able to interpret a person's emotions or feelings, as I believe there is no real necessity for it.

Why should a computer be required to interpret emotions for us? If a therapist relies on a computer to understand what's wrong with a patient, it only serves to further distance us in a world that is already disconnected.

Non-consensual deepfake pornography can be considered a form of image-based sexual abuse because intimate images are created and/or shared without the consent of the person or persons depicted in the images. The harms of image-based sexual abuse have been well-documented, including negative impacts on victim-survivors' mental health, career prospects, and willingness to engage with others both online and offline. The proliferation of NSII technologies means that anyone can now become a victim of image-based sexual abuse, and research suggests that women continue to bear the brunt of this online abuse.

The consumer creation of deepfakes, a portmanteau of "deep learning" and "fake," started in late 2017 on Reddit when a user named "deepfakes" posted NSII depicting the faces of female celebrities "stitched" onto pornographic videos. Continued consumer interest in deepfakes is reflected in the proliferation of dedicated deepfake sites and forums, often depicting celebrity targets. While deepfakes can be used in beneficial ways for accessibility and creativity, abuse potential has increased in recent years as the technology has advanced in sophistication and availability. Deepfakes can be weaponized and used for malicious purposes, including financial fraud, disinformation dissemination, cyberbullying, and sexual extortion ("sextortion").

Non-consensual synthetic intimate imagery (NSII) refers to digitally altered content that is fake but depicts the faces, bodies, and/or voices of real people. NSII can be created through more traditional means using photo-editing software to stitch together segments, add filters, or change the speed of videos, often referred to as "shallowfakes" or "cheapfakes." Increasingly, however, NSII is being created through the use of artificial intelligence (AI), involving methods such as speech-to-speech voice conversion, lipsyncing, puppet-master, face synthesis, attribute manipulation, and face-swapping. AI-generated NSII is more colloquially known as "deepfake pornography."

In the first phase of elections in West Bengal, 30 out of 294 constituencies are going to the polls. This includes all constituencies in Purulia and Jhargram, as well as some from Bankura, Purba Medinipur, and Paschim Medinipur. A significant portion of the electorate in these regions consists of Scheduled Tribes (STs) and other non-Bengali non-ST groups. There are 191 candidates contesting, including 21 women.

In the Salboni district, Sushanta Ghosh, the candidate of the Communist Party of India (Marxist), is involved in a triangular contest for power against Trinamool Congress' Srikanto Mahato and Bharatiya Janata Party's (BJP) Rajib Kundu. During the first leg of the assembly elections, Ghosh was attacked by unknown miscreants. She was subsequently escorted away by security, and an investigation into the attack is underway, which should provide more clarity on the incident.

A few hours before the polls began, the Purba Medinipur district experienced violence, with bombing and firing reported in the Satsatmasl village at the Argoal gram panchayat in the Bhagabanpur Assembly constituency. Two security personnel—Patashpour Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Depak Kumar Chakraborty and a Central Force soldier—were seriously injured in the incident. Taking cognizance of the situation, the BJP president of Purba Medinipur district claimed that a "terror factory" exists at the polling booth in Argoal, under the Bhagabanpur assembly, where the Trinamool Congress (TMC) is allegedly spreading terror to damage nearby booths.

Meanwhile, BJP candidate Samit Das from Paschim Medinipur accused the TMC of creating disturbances in the rural areas of the district. "Voting in Medinipur is going on smoothly. But, at some places in rural areas, TMC workers are trying to create a disturbance," he stated.

Según los últimos datos de la Consejería de Sanidad, correspondientes al martes 6 de julio, el 50,3% de la población de Cantabria mayor de 16 años está inmunizada contra el coronavirus. Esto se traduce en que un total de 252.218 personas han completado la pauta de vacunación, lo que representa el 40,8% de la población total de la comunidad autónoma.

En Cantabria, hasta la fecha actual, se ha vacunado a 340.236 personas, lo que equivale al 58,4% de la población total. Este porcentaje asciende al 67,9% si nos enfocamos únicamente en la población mayor de 16 años. Se destaca que el 83,6% de las personas de entre 50 y 59 años han recibido la vacuna, de las cuales el 80,2% han alcanzado la inmunidad. En el grupo de 60 a 69 años, el 92,8% ha sido vacunado, de ellos el 48% ha completado la pauta y el 44,8% ha recibido al menos una dosis. También ha aumentado al 33,2% el porcentaje de inmunizados entre 40 y 49 años, con un 67,9% de población vacunada, de los cuales el 34,8% ha recibido una dosis.

Esta semana ha comenzado la vacunación del grupo de edad de 30 a 39 años (grupo 11) en algunas Zonas Básicas de Salud (ZBS) en Cantabria. Hasta ahora, el 15,3% de este grupo ha sido vacunado, de los cuales el 12,4% han completado la pauta de vacunación. En el rango de 20 a 29 años, el porcentaje de vacunación alcanza el 10,9%, con un 9,7% de la población inmunizada. En cuanto a la población de 10 a 19 años, solo el 0,4% ha sido vacunado.

Detectives have been granted additional time to question a 20-year-old man arrested on Monday in Worthing on suspicion of terrorism offences. The arrest occurred around 5 am following a pre-planned operation at a residential address in Worthing, as confirmed by a police spokesman. Detectives from the Counter Terrorism Policing South East (CTPSE) apprehended the man under suspicion of the commission, preparation, or instigation of acts of terrorism under section 41 of the Terrorism Act (2000).

A warrant for further detention has been granted, allowing investigators to question the suspect until Monday (March 2), according to police. The arrest was intelligence-led and linked to Islamist-related terrorism, police confirmed. The search of the residential address in Worthing has now concluded.

Sussex Police urge anyone who notices any suspicious activity in their area to report it to Action Counters Terrorism at gov.uk/ACT.
